_note: 原版整批文案，按 DB key 索引。icon 是相对本目录的路径；character_skills.effects 每条是 [level, effect, scope, value]，文本拿 effects.<effect>.template 代入 %+n / %n 再拼 effect_scopes.<scope>。inline_icons 是文案里 [[img:]] token -> 文件。

desc.zh: 苟斯特在破落的国度中阔步前行，就如同他在苦心孤诣地修习亡灵术前，身为一位马倌而在帝国大道上四处奔走一样
desc.en: Ghorst traverses the forsaken realm as he did the roads of the Empire, as a groom, before the study of necromancy consumed his every waking moment.

desc.zh: 对于黑魔法的掌控令苟斯特获得了异常强大的力量，这可以让他在战斗中很容易地护卫自身
desc.en: Mastery of the dark arts has imbued Ghorst with preternatural strength, enabling him to easily hold his own in combat.

desc.zh: 随着时间的流逝，苟斯特的皮肤开始变得如同死尸一般粗糙，这令那些可以轻松杀死一个人的剑击与箭矢对他来说都不过成为了挠痒一般的侵袭
desc.en: Over time, Ghorst's skin has toughened like that of a corpse, causing arrows and sword-blows that would normally kill a man to merely glance off.

desc.zh: 在撑过了蓝玫瑰瘟疫，甚至是故意去感染这些瘟疫之后，苟斯特可以轻松地从一般性的伤害与疾病中恢复过来
desc.en: Having survived the deadly Plague of Blue Roses, even after deliberately infecting himself, Ghorst can easily recover from lesser wounds and sicknesses.

desc.zh: 那些被苟斯特的死亡之舞所影响的战士将即刻投身战场，并且在法术持续时变得更为致命
desc.en: By which those caught in Ghorst's Danse Macabre are hurled forward into the fray, becoming far more lethal whilst the spell lasts.

desc.zh: 艾博里克最喜欢在战斗最激烈时冲入战场，激励麾下军队奋勇作战
desc.en: Alberic is courageous and loves to be in the thick of battle, inspiring the rest of the army to valorous deeds.

desc.zh: 艾博里克的海军可以促进造船业的发展，并令沿海城镇变得繁荣昌盛起来
desc.en: Alberic's navy helps shipbuilding materials and provisions get to coastal settlements, allowing them to prosper.

desc.zh: 波尔德罗的海运航线曾为精灵殖民者们所利用，现在它们却在造福艾博里克的子民
desc.en: Bordeleaux's sea routes were once used by the Elven colonists; now they serve Alberic's people.

desc.zh: 公爵会在麾下的定居点中安排管理者，这些人非常熟悉本地的风土人情
desc.en: The duke appoints administrators amongst the smallfolk, who are familiar with local issues.

desc.zh: 湖神仙女是女神的精神具现化，她对神龛的庇佑能令此地更为接近女神
desc.en: The Fay is the spiritual representation of the Lady, her blessing upon a shrine can bring the goddess close.

desc.zh: 那些接触过圣杯的骑士会献出自己的全部身心，并终身追随湖神仙女的意志
desc.en: Those touched by the Grail are utterly devoted and would lay down their life for the Fay Enchantress.

desc.zh: 湖神仙女的魔法与巴托尼亚的土地牢固地结合在一起
desc.en: The magic of the Fay Enchantress is fundamentally tied to the lands of the Bretonni.

desc.zh: 湖神仙女收集着年轻人并将其送往彼世，其中一些人便会得到祝福，并以圣女的形式回归
desc.en: The Enchantress gathers the young and brings them to the otherworld, where some are blessed to return as damsels.

desc.zh: 国王拥有着将头衔赐予做出荣耀事业的臣子的权力
desc.en: The king has the power to bestow titles on those with honour.

desc.zh: 自从『统一者』吉勒斯以来，巴托尼亚的荣光还未曾如今天般受人尊敬过
desc.en: Not since Gilles the Uniter has the Royarch of Bretonnia been so respected.

desc.zh: 兵营中满怀着对国王召唤下次侠义战争的期望
desc.en: The barracks are full in anticipation of the king calling the next Errantry War.

desc.zh: 作为骑士道的典范，国王的举止影响着女神的所有子民
desc.en: As the paragon of chivalry, the king's behaviour reflects on all touched by the Lady.

desc.zh: 悍然对前任主公发动的一场袭击，却让崔特思获得了全新的头衔，以及遂行其意志的一支军队
desc.en: An audacious surprise attack on his predecessor has led to a new title for Tretch and an army to do his bidding.

desc.zh: 不死者的君主，已亡者的主公
desc.en: The monarch of the Undead, the liege of the Unliving.

desc.zh: 骑手与坐骑的羁绊，可不是只靠死亡便可割裂的
desc.en: The ties that hold man and beast together cannot be broken by death alone.

desc.zh: 这名巫妖祭司是如此的强大，以至于他可以直接从灵魂国度引导能量，并随心所欲地释放出来
desc.en: This Liche Priest is so powerful he can tap energy directly from the Realm of Souls and direct it at will.

desc.zh: 若要有效地发挥出战车的威力，那就需要精准的驾车技巧——如果亡灵将军们希望获胜，那么这股技巧就应该是几乎能达到舞蹈级别的才行
desc.en: Effective chariot warfare requires precise control - choreography, almost, if you will - if the victories sought by Unliving generals are to be achieved.

name.zh: 第六王朝的阿克哈扎二世
name.en: Alkhazzar II of the Sixth Dynasty

desc.zh: 战士国王的战车战术无与伦比。只有最优秀的车组才能为他效劳…当然，它们也会『再次』为他效劳
desc.en: This warrior-king was unmatched in chariot tactics. Only the finest crews served under him - and will again, of course…

desc.zh: 莱弥扎齐继续着与纳迦什的战斗，并在强大的乌沙比特的支援下夺回了神圣的喀穆里城
desc.en: Lahmizzash continued the fight against Nagash, retaking sacred Khemri with the aid of his potent Ushabti.

desc.zh: 拉喀什征服了尼赫喀拉东部群山之外的土地，他为王国带来了巨大的荣光
desc.en: Conquering lands beyond the mountains east of Nehekhara, Rakhash was a bringer of great prosperity.

desc.zh: 纳迦什战争结束后，瑟提普国王开始了自己的统治，他令祭司阶层与大墓地恢复了往日的荣光
desc.en: Ruling in the wake of the war with Nagash, Setep restored the Necropolis and the Priesthood to their former glory.

desc.zh: 柯特普的儿子，虽然仅维持了短暂的统治便不幸驾崩，但他对工程学与市政发展的贡献却足以彪炳史册
desc.en: The son of Khetep ruled only briefly before his death, but his grasp of engineering and urban development were legendary.

desc.zh: 瓦哈夫击退了游牧群的侵犯并捍卫了疆界，他是一位鲜有匹敌的沙漠悍将
desc.en: Wakhaf repelled the nomads and secured the borders. He is a peerless master of desert warfare.

desc.zh: 对于已经拒绝了死亡的人来说，单凭时间是无法伤害到他们的
desc.en: Time itself cannot harm those who have defied death.

desc.zh: 这名古墓技师对所有能够强化雕塑建筑的象形文字碑文了如指掌
desc.en: This Necrotect knows all the secret hieroglyphic inscriptions required to strengthen his statuary constructs.

desc.zh: 无数的亡灵军团都在不折不扣地执行着自己主人的命令
desc.en: The myriad Undead legions respond to their master's will without question.

desc.zh: 当阿萨芙女神的化身狂怒不已时，纯粹的恐惧能量波会无情地席卷胆敢仰视她的人
desc.en: As the embodiment of the Asp Goddess in full fury, a wave of pure terror rolls over those who look upon her.

desc.zh: 最为年长也是最为睿智的巫妖祭司，自然是葬仪祭团阶级议会的领袖
desc.en: The oldest and wisest of the Liche Priests is the head of the Mortuary Cult's hieratic council.

desc.zh: 『备受崇敬者、备受尊重者、诸秘领主、年岁神庙高阶祭司…』
desc.en: "Revered One, Venerable One, Lord of Secrets, High Priest of the Temple of Years…"

desc.zh: 亡灵便是永恒，因此理应随心所欲、考虑周全
desc.en: Unlife is forever; it is therefore prudent to go willingly and prepared.

desc.zh: 若要将灵魂从灵魂国度中召回，便需要很多准确诵读的咒语与符咒，而此人非常精于此道
desc.en: There are many perfectly-uttered litanies and precise incantations required to draw forth spirits from the Realm of Souls. This one knows them all.

desc.zh: 秃鹰之神帮助着沙漠游魂们，免得让他们迷失在沙漠烈阳之下
desc.en: The Vulture-God assists the desert poozler, lest they lose their way 'neath the scorching desert sun.

desc.zh: 索科奇的仆从们心中灌输了远古巫妖祭司的灵魂，所以他们以金属与岩石构成的躯体会行动自如，不受任何妨碍
desc.en: Imbued with the souls of ancient Liche Priests, Sokth's servants are unhindered by their mechanical bodies of metal and stone.

desc.zh: 雕刻成昆·阿法的尊贵模样的雕像，也定然能以蛇神的力量奋勇作战
desc.en: That which is sculpted in Qu'aph's noble image strikes with the strength of the Serpent-God.

desc.zh: 塞特拉不仅是个残忍的军阀，还是一位强大的巫师，更受到了死亡之术的加成：他不会衰老，不会死亡，恶毒残暴，几乎绝然无人能够匹敌！
desc.en: Settra is a brutal warlord and powerful sorcerer combined to deadly effect; ageless, deathless, venomous, and almost entirely without peer.

desc.zh: 神话与噩梦的材料，将岩石变成了更为可怕，更为凶残的现实
desc.en: The stuff of myth and nightmares made stone, and later terrifying, savage reality.

desc.zh: 巨蝎之神护卫着腐朽者、不诚者以及丧心病狂的谋杀者
desc.en: The God of the Scorpions protects the venal, the perfidious, and the downright murderous.

desc.zh: 沙漠之民的一生之中，皆是奉了巴斯看顾的誓言行事
desc.en: The people of the desert live and die by their oaths in Basth's graceful sight.

desc.zh: 狄迦夫会将残忍的豺头死神送至他不幸的敌人身旁
desc.en: Djaf's servants bring brutal, jackal-headed death to his unfortunate foes.

desc.zh: 慈悲的塔赫奇会将神圣的知识与无尽的智慧传承给他的民众
desc.en: Benevolent Tahoth imparts sacred knowledge and timeless wisdom to his people.

desc.zh: 古墓王及其侍从无不感到哈萨的愤怒正在他们的亡灵血管中奔腾
desc.en: The Tomb Kings and their servants feel Khsar's wrath coursing through their Unliving veins.

desc.zh: 『我们马上回来！我们马上就回这儿！』
desc.en: "We'll be back. We're coming back in here."

desc.zh: 即便是以卑鄙无耻的鼠人看来，崔特思这手玩得也挺阴的！
desc.en: Tretch's sneaky, ultra-duplicitous tactics are dirty, even by Skaven low standards!

desc.zh: 这并不是逃跑，而是知晓何时何地才能将优势最大化的策略
desc.en: It's not running away. It's knowing when and where to be to secure the best advantage.

desc.zh: 崔特思是个利用他人弱点的天才，他的军队绝不会出现在你希望他们出现的地方，而是不出则已，一出就毁天灭地
desc.en: A master of exploiting others' weaknesses, Tretch and his band are never where you expect them and always where they can do most damage.

desc.zh: 『我转过身去，然后他们就逃了、逃了！一瞬间就跑出那么远去？这不科学，是的、是的！』
desc.en: "I turned around and they'd run-scurried off! Covering that distance in no time at all? It can't be natural, yes-yes!"

desc.zh: 不难想象，一个没有荣誉与理解的种族根本不会在乎其他人的性命
desc.en: It should be no surprise that a race without a shred of honour or decency between them have even less regard for each other's lives.

desc.zh: 巫妖王终于复生，他将让尼赫喀拉的所有生灵品尝复仇的滋味！
desc.en: Reborn at last, the Liche King has returned to take revenge on all Nehekhara.

desc.zh: 黑暗魔法的能量可以用来施放亡灵法术，这种有害的能量能让亡灵更为活跃
desc.en: As the powers of Dark Magic are wielded for the purpose of Necromancy, its unwholesome energies invigorate the Undead.

desc.zh: 死亡对阿克汉来说已经不是障碍，因此他的战斗技巧也变得非常地娴熟
desc.en: Dying has not proved a hindrance to Arkhan, so strong are his skills on the field of battle.

desc.zh: 尽管阿克汉的亡灵军团不如塞特拉大帝的大军那般庞大，但巫妖王那无与伦比的魔力却给他们带来了很多的加持
desc.en: Although not as numerous as Settra's grand army, Arkhan's Undead legions are bolstered by the Liche King's unparalleled Necromantic dexterity.

desc.zh: 不死者的君主，已亡者的主公
desc.en: The monarch of the Undead, the liege of the Unliving.

desc.zh: 亡灵大法师的首席忠仆将再次站在他的身旁，至少预言中是这么记载的…
desc.en: The first and most loyal of the Great Necromancer's followers will stand at his side once again. So it is written…

desc.zh: 在女神阿萨芙的祝福下，这些箭矢会准确无误地射向当面之敌
desc.en: Carrying the blessing of the goddess Asaph, these arrows seek out the foe with unerring accuracy.

desc.zh: 死亡并不意味着终结，那些曾立下忠诚誓言的，终有一天会再次为之奋战
desc.en: Death isn't necessarily the end; those who have pledged service must rise to fight again another day.

desc.zh: 沙海深处的常年征战与血腥厮杀让坐骑与骑手结成了牢固的羁绊，纵使是死亡也无法令他们分离
desc.en: Formed by long campaigns and bloody slaughter in the stifling desert heat, the bond between steed and rider cannot be broken, even when death tries to intervene.

desc.zh: 『国王陛下迅捷的战车驭手！当国王苏醒之时，他们将继续追随国王的大军！』
desc.en: "The swift charioteers of the king. They who pursue the sovereign's foes on the day of his awakening."

desc.zh: 就连石头也变得不只是石头了！神秘的死亡法术会将扭曲而暴躁的精力注入石像，让他们活跃起来！
desc.en: Not even stone is set in stone it seems – arcane death magic is used to bring tortured, savage vigour to once-dormant stone sentinels.

desc.zh: 相比其他金属来说，平凡的石材却是更加受人尊敬，因为巨大的守卫正是由它们雕刻而来，并由巫妖祭司们注入了生命
desc.en: Simple stone is afforded more respect than other materials, for from its grain giant guardians are hewn, brought to shuddering life by the Liche Priests' sorcery.

desc.zh: 在蛇神之眼的永恒凝视之下，射出的箭矢会以难以置信的精准度直刺目标
desc.en: Arrows loosed under the ever-watchful eye of the Serpent Goddess find their marks with divine precision.

desc.zh: 沙漠本身便是他的坐骑
desc.en: The desert itself is his steed.

desc.zh: 尽管光芒逐渐消逝，但荣耀之梦仍需以无数的征战铸就而成
desc.en: A dream of glory attained through conquest great rages still, despite the dying of the light.

desc.zh: 这是沙漠的伟力，古墓王国度的不朽纪念碑，也会将敌人碾为尘埃
desc.en: The very strength of the desert, to stand sentinel over the Tomb Kings' domain and crush their enemies to dust.

desc.zh: 有些战利品很难为人所见，却比黄金与宝石珍贵得多
desc.en: Some of war's spoils are more difficult to see but are just as valuable as gold or jewels.

desc.zh: 为了征服死亡，此人踏遍了战场、平原与沙丘，因此他的军队可以再次精神饱满地向前进发了
desc.en: This one scours the battlefields, plains and dunes for the vanquished dead, so that his armies may march at full strength once more.

desc.zh: 这些罐子里装着许多巫妖祭司的遗骸，倒是驱役与约束新军的上好法器
desc.en: These jars contain the remains of many Liche Priests, which are useful for raising and binding a new force.

desc.zh: 尼赫喀拉的木乃伊统治者们醒来了，他们眼中燃着尸火，他们对权力、征服与报复睚眦之怨的渴望如同他们在世时一样强烈
desc.en: Nehekhara's mummified rulers are awake, their eyes burning with balefire, their thirst for power, conquest and vengeance every bit as strong as they were in life.

desc.zh: 正因如此，尼赫喀拉的亡灵军队才能保持不死不朽，并永远渴望屠戮
desc.en: By which the Undead armies of Nehekhara may remain deathless, undying and forever hungry for slaughter.

desc.zh: 战利品属于胜者，胜者通吃，这是自然之理
desc.en: To the victor, the spoils. All of them. Always.

desc.zh: 它矗立着监视大地，提防着敌人的潜伏与间谍们投机取巧的突袭
desc.en: It stands watch over the land, lest the foe's insidious, opportunistic agents dare to strike.

desc.zh: 这些已死多时的战马，如今再度得到了唤醒并为亡灵主人继续效忠
desc.en: Long-dead destriers, awakened to serve their Unliving masters far beyond death.

desc.zh: 这是尼赫喀拉军队的骄傲，它们能够以断骨碎髓的气势冲入敌阵，并用厚重的车轮将敌人碾为肉泥
desc.en: The pride of Nehekharan armies, impacting enemy lines with bone-shattering force and grinding the corpses beneath their heavy wheels.

desc.zh: 这是尼赫喀拉军队的骄傲，它们能够以断骨碎髓的气势冲入敌阵，并用厚重的车轮将敌人碾为肉泥
desc.en: The pride of Nehekharan armies, impacting enemy lines with bone-shattering force and grinding the corpses beneath their heavy wheels.

desc.zh: 作为不朽与永恒的象征，尼赫喀拉众神殿的统治者永远都在为子民们的福祉尽心尽力
desc.en: Symbolising immortality and eternity, the ruler of the Nehekharan Pantheon has always had a care for the wellbeing of his children.

desc.zh: 『他们站在那里，永远都在凝视着太阳——那可是永恒诸神的象征。看着他们的神圣形体，这可是多么可怕的事！』
desc.en: "They stand staring into the sun for eternity, the physical embodiment of the everlasting gods. Terrible ye who looked into their divine forms!"

name.en: Usirian the God of the Underworld

desc.zh: 忤逆地府的无面神的家伙会遭到严惩，并被永远打入地府中的最底层
desc.en: Those who oppose the faceless God of the Underworld shall suffer terribly, condemned to its lowest levels for eternity.

name.zh: 魔法与复仇女神阿萨芙
name.en: Asaph the Goddess of Magic & Vengeance

desc.zh: 服侍毒蛇女神的人会得到祝福，他们的箭矢将以精确的准度直刺目标
desc.en: They who serve the Asp Goddess are blessed with a precise aim with which to reach their objectives.

desc.zh: 无论卡莉达于何时苏醒，阿萨芙女神的力量都会流遍她的躯体，将生命与力量注入她的木乃伊遗骸，令她可以击败自己的敌人
desc.en: Whenever Khalida awakens, the power of the Asp Goddess floods her body, infusing life and power into her mummified remains so that she may defeat her enemies.

desc.zh: 当卡莉达从表姐涅芙瑞塔的鲜血之吻下获救后，美貌与复仇女神亲自为她净化了身上的邪恶
desc.en: Saved from the Blood Kiss at the hands of her cousin Neferata, Khalida was cleansed of evil by the Goddess of Beauty and Vengeance.

desc.zh: 亡灵弓箭手令古墓巨城蓬荜生辉，他们誓死效忠于至高女王
desc.en: The magnificent tomb city is renowned for its Undead archers, pledged to serve the High Queen for eternity.

desc.zh: 发誓为阿萨芙而战的人们自然也会崇拜卡莉达，因为她正是女神的化身，也是个充满怒气的亡灵
desc.en: Those pledged to fight for Asaph also worship Khalida, her physical embodiment in full, furious Unlife.

desc.zh: 卡莉达血管中奔腾的毒液赐予了她如同毒蛇出击一般的神速
desc.en: The venom running through Khalida's veins enables her to move with the speed of a striking asp.

desc.zh: 传奇般的智慧、气质与个人勇武令卡莉达卓尔不群，即使在不朽的古墓王中，她也是个出类拔萃的人物
desc.en: Her legendary intelligence, temperament and personal bravery make Khalida stand out, even from the extraordinary ranks of the immortal Tomb Kings.

desc.zh: 有些知识实在太过危险，因此只能传承给那些值得信赖的人
desc.en: Some knowledge is so dangerous that it is revealed only to those deemed worthy of the responsibility.

desc.zh: 只有那些天资聪颖、尊崇知识的人，才能修习亡灵术的奥秘
desc.en: Only those who display the correct degree of diligence and reverence may learn the secrets of Unlife.

desc.zh: 当灵魂被释放而出后，若是没能抓来新的灵魂代其承受永恒的折磨，他们便无法返回魂棺
desc.en: When the souls are released they endeavour not to return without new victims to torment for eternity.

desc.zh: 此法可以收割亡灵的灵魂，从而控制它们的躯体
desc.en: By which the very souls of the Undead can be harnessed, so their physical forms can be controlled.

desc.zh: 『杀掉他？不，我可不会——我会赐予他生命！』
desc.en: "Killed him? No, I did not - I gave him life!"

desc.zh: 此法可令飞扬的沙尘化为厚实的乌云，令敌人的军队与施法者难辨方向
desc.en: By which a whirling cloud of sand and dust is conjured to confound the foe's armies and magic-users.

desc.zh: 与他们的骑手一样，死去的坐骑仍然可被驱役还魂，成为打着响鼻，嘶鸣不已的亡灵奴仆
desc.en: Like their riders, fallen mounts can be brought back to spitting, snorting Unlife, and bound in servitude.

desc.zh: 如果要重现塞特拉的黄金时代，那么尼赫喀拉的卷轴与遗物就必须得到保全
desc.en: Nehekhara's scrolls and relics must be guarded if Settra's Golden Age is to be restored.

desc.zh: 无人记得卡特普的春秋，因为他已拒绝死神冰冷的拥抱长达数个世纪，并且还会继续这样做下去
desc.en: Ancient beyond memory, Khatep has denied death's cold embrace for centuries, and will continue to do so.

desc.zh: 最为年长也是最为睿智的巫妖祭司，自然是葬仪祭团阶级议会的领袖
desc.en: The oldest and wisest of the Liche Priests is the head of the Mortuary Cult's hieratic council.

desc.zh: 在塞特拉的铁腕统治之下，惨遭战火蹂躏的诸城以及敬奉尼赫喀拉诸神的纪念碑都得到了复原：世上曾经有过的富足与繁盛，终将再度上演
desc.en: Under Settra's iron-fisted rule, war-ravaged cities and monuments to the Nehekharan gods were restored; there was plenty and prosperity for all, and there will be again.

desc.zh: 对于虔诚的巫妖祭司来说，知晓自己在灵魂国度的行事准则与必备的祭礼咒语知识，这些都是基本性的技能
desc.en: Knowing your way around the Realm of Souls, along with knowledge of the required ritual incantations, are essential skills for the dedicated Liche Priest.

desc.zh: 吟唱之后，这段祷文可以遏制腐败，从而令古墓王的灵魂得以永存不朽
desc.en: When intoned, this ritual text holds back decay so the Tomb Kings' souls can be bound to their mortal remains once more.

desc.zh: 驱役亡灵并把它们绑定在肉身上，这需要非常专业的祭礼、颂辞与咒语，而此人完全通晓这些技术
desc.en: There are specialised rituals, chants and incantations for drawing forth dead spirits and binding them back into their corporeal forms; this one knows them all.

desc.zh: 勇敢的战士足以享受辉煌的来生——这一允诺足以令严整的军队直面艰辛的挑战
desc.en: The promise of a glorious afterlife worthy of a courageous warrior keeps embattled troops focused on the grim task at hand.

desc.zh: 聚集由魔法捏合而成的军队，这需要钢铁般的意志与超自然的力量
desc.en: It takes an iron will and unnatural - supernatural - strength to rally bound troops routed by magical means.

desc.zh: 黑暗的祷文可以用于复苏古墓王战死的士兵，将它们化为扭曲发颤的提线木偶
desc.en: Dark litanies are uttered to restore the Tomb Kings' slain soldiers to a twisted, chattering imitation of life.

desc.zh: 这些已死多时的战马，如今再度得到了唤醒并为亡灵主人继续效忠
desc.en: Long-dead destriers, awakened to serve their Unliving masters far beyond death.

desc.zh: 这是尼赫喀拉军队的骄傲，它们能够以断骨碎髓的气势冲入敌阵，并用厚重的车轮将敌人碾为肉泥
desc.en: The pride of Nehekharan armies, impacting enemy lines with bone-shattering force and grinding the corpses beneath their heavy wheels.

desc.zh: 这是因虔诚信奉战士女王而得到的褒赏，它的砂岩尾巴每挥动一下，都会让凡人皮开肉绽
desc.en: A reward for utter dedication to the Warrior-Queen, every swipe of its sandstone tail can carve through mortal flesh.

desc.zh: 这是尼赫喀拉军队的骄傲，它们能够以断骨碎髓的气势冲入敌阵，并用厚重的车轮将敌人碾为肉泥
desc.en: The pride of Nehekharan armies, impacting enemy lines with bone-shattering force and grinding the corpses beneath their heavy wheels.

desc.zh: 这些已死多时的战马，如今再度得到了唤醒并为亡灵主人继续效忠
desc.en: Long-dead destriers, awakened to serve their Unliving masters far beyond death.

desc.zh: 这是尼赫喀拉军队的骄傲，它们能够以断骨碎髓的气势冲入敌阵，并用厚重的车轮将敌人碾为肉泥
desc.en: The pride of Nehekharan armies, impacting enemy lines with bone-shattering force and grinding the corpses beneath their heavy wheels.

desc.zh: 车轮闪耀着魔法的火焰，强大的战车承载着诸神的祝福
desc.en: Its wheels ablaze with a mystical flame, the blessings of the gods are carried by this mighty chariot.

desc.zh: 这些巨大的狮子雕像几乎刀枪不入，它们会在敌阵中肆意漫步，并将敌人如同可悲的蝼蚁一般踩成肉酱
desc.en: Giant leonine statues, almost impervious to harm; they wade through foes, crushing them like bothersome insects.

desc.zh: 这些已死多时的战马，如今再度得到了唤醒并为亡灵主人继续效忠
desc.en: Long-dead destriers, awakened to serve their Unliving masters far beyond death.

desc.zh: 这些巨大的狮子雕像几乎刀枪不入，它们会在敌阵中肆意漫步，并将敌人如同可悲的蝼蚁一般踩成肉酱
desc.en: Giant leonine statues, almost impervious to harm; they wade through foes, crushing them like bothersome insects.

desc.zh: 这些已死多时的战马，如今再度得到了唤醒并为亡灵主人继续效忠
desc.en: Long-dead destriers, awakened to serve their Unliving masters far beyond death.

desc.zh: 这是尼赫喀拉军队的骄傲，它们能够以断骨碎髓的气势冲入敌阵，并用厚重的车轮将敌人碾为肉泥
desc.en: The pride of Nehekharan armies, impacting enemy lines with bone-shattering force and grinding the corpses beneath their heavy wheels.

desc.zh: 跨越死亡之墙，带回灵魂并绑定他们，这需要不小的技巧；但正如万事万物一样，所谓熟能生巧嘛！
desc.en: Reaching behind the wall of death to bring back the soul and bind it to you takes skill, but like anything, practice makes perfect!

desc.zh: 石柱基座上的力量，眼镜蛇与蝰蛇的猛毒
desc.en: The strength at the base of the pillar; the venom of the cobra and the asp.

desc.zh: 这种强烈的憎恨会传染四方，也会无可逃避
desc.en: Hatred this strong is infectious, contagious, and inescapable.

desc.zh: 古墓技师们强化了邪恶咒语的吟唱，加倍努力地保存并完成他们的修复工作
desc.en: Intensifying the chanting of sinister mantras, the Necrotects redouble their efforts to preserve and finish their restorative works.

desc.zh: 这部错综复杂的象形文字版画确是不无裨益，它会帮助古墓技师修复古墓王的纪念碑，让它们恢复昔日的荣光
desc.en: This intricate hieroglyphic engraving aids the Necrotect's drive to restore his Tomb King's monuments to their former glory.

desc.zh: 诸神的面孔自台座与壮观的雕像上俯视世间，缅怀着尼赫喀拉的昔日荣光
desc.en: The faces of the gods gaze down from their daises, imposing monuments to Nehekhara's former prestige.

desc.zh: 古墓技师技巧的大师通晓建筑工艺的所有方面：灵感、劳力、时间与成本，这些全都在它的亡灵掌控之中
desc.en: The master of the necrotectural art understands all aspects of the construction process; inspiration, labour, time and cost are all within his Undead grasp.

desc.zh: 雕刻神圣泰坦无需花费任何成本，因为最伟大、最有才华的古墓技师们自然会耗尽心血来完成这些巨大的石像
desc.en: No expense was spared in sculpting a Hierotitan - the greatest and most talented of Necrotects were contracted to work on the blessed stone that would form these gigantic statues.

name.zh: 死灵斯芬克斯雕刻宗师

desc.zh: 雕刻死灵斯芬克斯，便是在创造冥界中最伟大也最具破坏性的生物。并非所有的古墓技师都可以让这种造物化为亡灵，只有其中最具天赋者才具备这样的胆略
desc.en: To carve a Necrosphinx is to manifest the greatest and most destructive creature of the underworld. Not all Necrotects were adept at bringing such constructions to Unlife - only the most gifted of their trade even dare.

name.zh: 征战斯芬克斯雕刻宗师

desc.zh: 人称征战斯芬克斯的狮子雕像起初被建筑在喀穆里，而雕刻这些壮绝而致命的石头野兽的，便是来自第一城市的最伟大的古墓技师
desc.en: The leonine statues, known as Warsphinxes, were first constructed in Khemri; and so it is Necrotects who hail from the first city are the greatest carvers of these magnificent and deadly stone beasts.

desc.zh: 通过苏醒仪式而复生之后，古墓巨蝎的甲壳中灌满了来自腐尸的残余力量，它们随时可以倾巢而出，击杀与主人为敌的家伙
desc.en: Animated by a ceremony of awakening, the Tomb Scorpion's carapace is infused with residual power from the corpse within to swarm and kill the enemies of its master.

desc.zh: 沙海的秘密会在粗心旅人的面前一览无余
desc.en: The secrets of the desert reveal themselves to the unwary trespasser.

desc.zh: 尼赫喀拉之剑附注着死神的精华，它会以超自然的神力为狄迦夫收割灵魂
desc.en: Imbued with the essence of the God of Death, the Nehekharans' blades strike with supernatural force to harvest souls for Djaf.

desc.zh: 尼赫喀拉之剑附注着死神的精华，它会以超自然的神力为狄迦夫收割灵魂
desc.en: Imbued with the essence of the God of Death, the Nehekharans' blades strike with supernatural force to harvest souls for Djaf.

desc.zh: 此法可令死者不再继续安息，而是会挺尸而起成为抽搐不止、浑身作响的亡灵
desc.en: By which the dead don't stay that way for long, springing back into jerking, clanking Unlife.

desc.zh: 随着佩特拉的妻子挺身而出，捍卫尼赫喀拉的战士们远离邪恶的侵袭，挥舞的利剑会被神秘地折返方向
desc.en: Sword-blows are mysteriously turned away as Ptra's wife reaches out to shield Nehekhara's warriors from evil.

desc.zh: 随着佩特拉的妻子挺身而出，捍卫尼赫喀拉的战士们远离邪恶的侵袭，挥舞的利剑会被神秘地折返方向
desc.en: Sword-blows are mysteriously turned away as Ptra's wife reaches out to shield Nehekhara's warriors from evil.

desc.zh: 当此段咒文得以吟诵时，亡灵的空眼洞内会射出剧烈的激光，从而令其能够以超自然的速度与怒气进行战斗
desc.en: When the verses are spoken, a fierce light emanates from the Undead's empty eye-sockets, enabling them to strike with supernatural speed and fury.

desc.zh: 当此段咒文得以吟诵时，亡灵的空眼洞内会射出剧烈的激光，从而令其能够以超自然的速度与怒气进行战斗
desc.en: When the verses are spoken, a fierce light emanates from the Undead's empty eye-sockets, enabling them to strike with supernatural speed and fury.

desc.zh: 祈唤乌西里安之名时，骷髅之手会从沙海之下伸出，将敌人拖进他们的坟墓
desc.en: As the names of Usirian are invoked, skeletal hands burst forth from beneath the sand to drag the foe to their graves.

desc.zh: 祈唤乌西里安之名时，骷髅之手会从沙海之下伸出，将敌人拖进他们的坟墓
desc.en: As the names of Usirian are invoked, skeletal hands burst forth from beneath the sand to drag the foe to their graves.

desc.zh: 对于乌瑟霍普的不幸受害者，它的每个音节都会脱干此人身体的水分，抽净此人躯干的精力
desc.en: Every syllable strips moisture and saps vitality from the bodies of Usekhp's unfortunate victims.

desc.zh: 对于乌瑟霍普的不幸受害者，它的每个音节都会脱干此人身体的水分，抽净此人躯干的精力
desc.en: Every syllable strips moisture and saps vitality from the bodies of Usekhp's unfortunate victims.

name.zh: 塞霍姆特的骸骨风暴咒

desc.zh: 颅骨的旋风匆匆划过战场，以绿月女神愤懑而怀恨的名义扫灭一切当面之敌
desc.en: A whirlwind of skulls tears across the battlefield, devouring all in its path in the Goddess of the Green Moon's bitter, vindictive name.

name.zh: 塞霍姆特的骸骨风暴咒

desc.zh: 颅骨的旋风匆匆划过战场，以绿月女神愤懑而怀恨的名义扫灭一切当面之敌
desc.en: A whirlwind of skulls tears across the battlefield, devouring all in its path in the Goddess of the Green Moon's bitter, vindictive name.

desc.zh: 当心蝎子的蛰刺！它藏在黄沙之下，却是随时准备着突然一击
desc.en: Beware the scorpion's sting, hidden 'neath the desert sands yet always poised to strike.

desc.zh: 『这只是个开始！当亡灵大法师回归时，这里的一切都将粉身碎骨！』
desc.en: "This is just the beginning. When the Great Necromancer returns, all around will be laid waste!"

desc.zh: 意志超脱死亡的人，可以让自己的攻击远达坟墓之外，并造成毁灭性的破坏
desc.en: He whose will transcends death can strike out from beyond the grave, to devastating effect.

desc.zh: 对于最强的意志而言，死亡并不是什么阻碍
desc.en: Death is not an impedance to the strongest of wills.

desc.zh: 意志坚定的灵魂，又有谁能够打败呢？
desc.en: It is not possible to defeat such unshakeable spirit once its owner's mind is made up.

desc.zh: 杀死大量的人，你就是征服者；升神虽然也会近在眼前，但无尽的杀戮却会如影随形…
desc.en: Kill many and you *are* a conqueror; godhood is then but a protracted slaughter away...

desc.zh: 每一个步伐都是设计完美的舞步，就像是舞蹈一样…是的，死亡的舞蹈
desc.en: Every move is perfectly choreographed, as if it were a dance… a dance of death.

desc.zh: 这位领主深得友军爱戴，也深受敌人的恐惧——无论对象是凡人还是什么。此人的每一次举动，都会让自己已经堪称传奇的威名继续增添一份殊荣
desc.en: Renowned among their allies and feared by enemies both mortal and otherwise, this Lord's every deed adds to their already legendary reputation.

desc.zh: 全方位的无可战胜与无可匹敌，这便是塞特拉的力量！他永远不会回到自己的石棺之中！
desc.en: Inalienable and unassailable in all things, Settra's strength is such that he never needs to return to his sarcophagus.

desc.zh: 塞特拉的征服雄心永无止境，就连时间本身也逃不出他的野心
desc.en: Settra's thirst for conquest knows no bounds; time itself is not safe from his ambition.

desc.zh: 尼赫喀拉王冠上的宝石正是由塞特拉创建的——这是古墓王中至高无上的霸主麾下最为壮丽的城市
desc.en: The jewel in Nehekhara's crown was founded by Settra; the mightiest city of the Tomb Kings' absolute sovereign ruler.

desc.zh: 在尼赫喀拉，宣誓效忠统治者的人将在长时间内无法得到『适当』的安息
desc.en: In Nehekhara, those sworn to serve its rulers do not stay 'properly' dead for long.

desc.zh: 就连时间也逃不脱塞特拉的无尽怒火，他的战车之轮会碾碎一切事物！
desc.en: Time itself is not safe from Settra's unquenchable wrath; all will be crushed beneath the wheels of his chariots.

desc.zh: 塞特拉不仅是个残忍的军阀，还是一位强大的巫师，更受到了死亡之术的加成：他不会衰老，不会死亡，恶毒残暴，几乎绝然无人能够匹敌！
desc.en: Settra is brutal warlord and powerful sorcerer combined to deadly effect; ageless, deathless, venomous, and almost entirely without peer.

desc.zh: 不牺牲众多的子民，又何以建设强悍的帝国？
desc.en: You cannot build an empire without sacrificing a few sons…

desc.zh: 这件裹尸布曾在防腐液中反复浸泡，越变越强，这会帮助他们抵御除了致命的物理伤害以外的所有其它种类的伤害
desc.en: Soaked in and toughened by embalming fluid, the cloth bindings used to mummify afford the wearer additional protection from all but a direct hit from mortal projectiles.

desc.zh: 这些复杂的蒸馏物不仅能够令饮者在光荣的往生中免于腐烂，还会增加他们对于物理伤害的抵抗能力
desc.en: This complex distillation not only preserves the drinker in glorious Unlife, it also increases their physical resistance to attack.

desc.zh: 维持古墓王躯体不腐的液体同时也强化了他的裹尸布，令其能够抵御常人难以承受的伤害
desc.en: The fluid used to embalm the Tomb King toughens his bindings, enabling him to withstand a greater degree of damage than would otherwise be possible.

desc.zh: 永恒苦难所带来的痛苦，加之以疯狂的暴戾，这就是诸多古墓王复生后的人格状态。因此，他们会相较以前更为长久、更为努力、更为奋勇地进行战斗
desc.en: The pain of immortal misery, coupled with insane violence, characterises the return to Unlife for many of the Tomb Kings, who fight longer, harder and better than they ever could before.

desc.zh: 从阴间回转的灵魂会被束缚在容器中，从而提供一定程度的魔法抗性
desc.en: Souls retrieved from the Netherwold and bound to their controller provide a degree of magical resistance.

desc.zh: 古墓王的长子将奉献给诸神，他将在葬仪祭团中效力终生
desc.en: The firstborn son of a Tomb King is given to the gods, where he may serve the future itself as part of the Mortuary Cult.

desc.zh: 当时机到来之时，次子的次子便会继承父亲的位置，这是一种传统
desc.en: The second son of a second son shall succeed his father when the time comes. It is the custom.

desc.zh: 古墓王的次子们会负责统帅一部分军队，严格地执行他们父王钢铁般的意志
desc.en: The younger sons of a Tomb King command detachments within his armies, ensuring their father's unshakeable, iron will is enacted to the letter.

desc.zh: 未被派去服侍葬仪祭团的儿子们将会前往君主的永恒战争议会效力
desc.en: Those sons not given to serve the Mortuary Cult shall instead serve in their sovereign’s eternal council of war.

desc.zh: 挑战历史悠久的尼赫喀拉王朝的威势，就是冒着激怒这片沙漠中最负盛名之子的风险
desc.en: To challenge the might of long-established Nehekharan dynasties is to risk the wrath of the desert’s most reputable sons.

desc.zh: 『早在你的祖先知道怎么说话之前，我的名字就已经刻在黄金上了！』
desc.en: "My name was etched in gold long before your ancestors even knew how to speak."

desc.zh: 这些已死多时的战马，如今再度得到了唤醒并为亡灵主人继续效忠
desc.en: Long-dead destriers, awakened to serve their Unliving masters far beyond death.

desc.zh: 这些已死多时的战马，如今再度得到了唤醒并为亡灵主人继续效忠
desc.en: Long-dead destriers, awakened to serve their Unliving masters far beyond death.

desc.zh: 这些已死多时的战马，如今再度得到了唤醒并为亡灵主人继续效忠
desc.en: Long-dead destriers, awakened to serve their Unliving masters far beyond death.

desc.zh: 这些已死多时的战马，如今再度得到了唤醒并为亡灵主人继续效忠
desc.en: Long-dead destriers, awakened to serve their Unliving masters far beyond death.

desc.zh: 这是凯恩的礼物，其中便是永恒年轻与美貌的秘密。他的新娘会在里面洗澡，以便恢复青春
desc.en: A gift from Khaine, containing the secret of eternal youth and beauty. His brides may bathe in it to renew their vitality.

desc.zh: 它们已不再是真正的马匹，因为黑魔法已腐蚀了这些最优秀的精灵战马，并将其转化成了体侧黝黑的杀手
desc.en: True horses no longer, Dark Magic corrupts the finest Elven steeds and turns them into black-flanked killers.

desc.zh: 蝎尾狮的咆哮绝对能让凡间之物闻之而遁，因为他们知道，一只可怕的生物出现了
desc.en: The roar of a Manticore is guaranteed to send mortals fleeing, for they know a creature of terror is abroad.

desc.zh: 血腥女王所至之处，杀戮便会随之而来
desc.en: Where the Blood Queen treads, murder follows in her wake.

desc.zh: 对鲜血的需求，以及沐浴在粘稠的血液中的快感，永远驱使着哈尔·冈西的妖婆大开杀戒
desc.en: The need for blood - to bathe in its viscous goodness - will always drive the Crone of Har Ganeth onward.

desc.zh: 巫灵们非常尊奉他们的女王，因为再也没有其他人能像她一样驾驭凯恩的旨意了
desc.en: Witch Elves are drawn to their monarch, for no other commands Khaine's word like she.

desc.zh: 凯恩的恩宠会被赋予以屠杀染红世界之人
desc.en: Khaine's favour is bestowed on those that seek to bring murder into the world.

desc.zh: 作为凯恩选择的新娘，她便是凯恩的冠军与神使，因此无人能够伤害到她
desc.en: As Khaine's chosen bride, she is his champion and envoy, and no harm will come to her.

desc.zh: 血手之神眷顾着他的信徒
desc.en: The Bloody-handed God watches over his disciples.

desc.zh: 无论是精灵、矮人还是人类，他们的灵魂现在都在为血腥女王而服务
desc.en: Whether Elf, Dwarf, or man, their souls now serve the pleasure of the Blood Queen.

desc.zh: 屈服于血腥女王的感情吧！她的爱意是如此的激烈，几乎与杀戮没什么区别
desc.en: Give in to the Blood Queen's affection - her love is so intense as to kill.

desc.zh: 『如果我能拥有两个，那我为什么要满足于只有一个呢？』
desc.en: "Why stop at one, when you can have two?"

desc.zh: 只要献祭足够的祭品，那么血池最深的秘密便将属于你
desc.en: With enough sacrifices, the deepest secrets of the Cauldron of Blood will be yours.

desc.zh: 纳迦罗斯土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着杜鲁齐们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Naggaroth, tempted from their damp, warm caves to bear the Druchii to battle.

desc.zh: 被腐蚀的飞马从混沌荒原向南飞到了纳迦罗斯的钢铁山脉，并在那里筑起了巢
desc.en: The corrupted Dark Pegasi fly south from the Chaos Wastes to Naggaroth's Iron Mountains to make their nests.

desc.zh: 它们已不再是真正的马匹，因为黑魔法已腐蚀了这些最优秀的精灵战马，并将其转化成了体侧黝黑的杀手
desc.en: True horses no longer, Dark Magic corrupts the finest Elven steeds and turns them into black-flanked killers.

desc.zh: 纳迦罗斯土生土长的死神，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着杜鲁齐们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral death indigenous to Naggaroth, tempted from their damp, warm caves to bear the Druchii to battle.

desc.zh: 被腐蚀的飞马从混沌荒原向南飞到了纳迦罗斯的钢铁山脉，并在那里筑起了巢
desc.en: The corrupted Dark Pegasi fly south from the Chaos Wastes to Naggaroth's Iron Mountains to make their nests.

desc.zh: 它们已不再是真正的马匹，因为黑魔法已腐蚀了这些最优秀的精灵战马，并将其转化成了体侧黝黑的杀手
desc.en: True horses no longer, Dark Magic corrupts the finest Elven steeds and turns them into black-flanked killers.

desc.zh: 黑龙是马雷基斯秘密培养的产物，关于腐化与强化的黑魔法已经浸染了这条龙的身躯
desc.en: Secretly nurtured by Malekith, Black Dragons are enchanted with Dark Magic that corrupts and enhances.

desc.zh: 纳迦罗斯土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着杜鲁齐们奔向战场

desc.en: The corrupted Dark Pegasi fly south from the Chaos Wastes to Naggaroth's Iron Mountains to make their nests.

desc.zh: 它们已不再是真正的马匹，因为黑魔法已腐蚀了这些最优秀的精灵战马，并将其转化成了体侧黝黑的杀手
desc.en: True horses no longer, Dark Magic corrupts the finest Elven steeds and turns them into black-flanked killers.

desc.zh: 蝎尾狮的咆哮绝对能让凡间之物闻之而遁，因为他们知道，一只可怕的生物出现了
desc.en: The roar of a Manticore is guaranteed to send mortals fleeing, for they know a creature of terror is abroad.

desc.zh: 黑龙是马雷基斯秘密培养的产物，关于腐化与强化的黑魔法已经浸染了这条龙的身躯

desc.en: The roar of a Manticore is guaranteed to send mortals fleeing, for they know a creature of terror is abroad.

desc.zh: 点燃煅炉，将真正的工艺品与圣物带回世界上！
desc.en: To fire the forges and bring true craft and artifice back into the world.

desc.zh: 符文大师通晓自己技艺中的所有秘密
desc.en: There are none more adept at metal-shaping than those who command the runes.

desc.zh: 阿瓦隆姐妹是永恒女王选定的护卫，他们渴望在思想、身体和意志方面都臻于完美
desc.en: The Sisters of Avelorn are the Everqueen's chosen guardians and they aspire to perfection in mind, body and spirit.

desc.zh: 她便是璀璨之光，爱莎的神选！她的光辉并不只是从外部发散，而是从内部也散发了出来
desc.en: She is the Radiant – Isha's chosen – her beauty radiating not merely from without but from within.

desc.zh: 所有的阿苏尔族人都很敬爱永恒女王，但艾拉瑞丽在其中特别受到偏爱，因为她很喜欢与战士们共赴战场
desc.en: All Asur adore the Everqueen, but Alarielle is especially beloved for her willingness to join warriors in battle.

desc.zh: 传统上说，永恒女王并不会踏上战场，但艾拉瑞丽是个例外：她并不介意亲自惩罚踏入阿瓦隆的入侵者！
desc.en: The Everqueen does not traditionally go to war, but Alarielle is different - she will punish the invaders of Avelorn!

desc.zh: 在这个动荡的时代里，永恒女王便是爱莎与卡达伊神系诸神的代表，也是希望的灯塔
desc.en: Representing the Isha and all the Gods of the Cadai, the Everqueen is a beacon of hope in these turbulent times.

desc.zh: 这是来自爱莎的礼物：没有任何创伤是艾拉瑞丽挡不住的，她的庇护能力无人能比
desc.en: A gift from Isha; no wounds are beyond Alarielle's skills and her wards of protection know no equal.

desc.zh: 作为这片土地的卫士，永恒女王可以用超凡的技术操纵生命系与光明系的法术
desc.en: As guardian of the lands, the Everqueen can manipulate the Lores of Life and Light with unrivalled skill.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 它们是世上诸多战马中的最优秀者。尊贵、智慧、优雅与迅捷便是精灵骏马的特征
desc.en: The best of all horse breeds found anywhere in the world, Elven steeds are noble, intelligent, graceful, and swift.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的巨鹰是精灵们的坚定盟友，自从混沌入侵起便与他们并肩而战
desc.en: Ulthuan's Great Eagles are the firm allies of the Elves, fighting their causes since the coming of Chaos.

desc.zh: 虽然人们认为艾拉瑞丽本人很是激进，但她必须履行某些仪式义务，这也让许多阿苏尔族人感到了安心
desc.en: While Alarielle herself is seen as a radical force, she is bound to certain ceremonial duties, which is reassuring for many Asur.

desc.zh: 精灵都是些政治动物，但永恒女王拥有着至高无上的权威，因此众生皆会聆听她的话语，并将琐碎的事务放在一旁
desc.en: Elves are political creatures, but the Everqueen exists above such debased notions; when she speaks all listen and put aside petty machinations.

desc.zh: 作为大地之母的典范，阿瓦隆的女王，艾拉瑞丽保证了大地的繁荣与昌盛
desc.en: As a paragon of the Earth Mother and queen of Avelorn, growth and fortitude for the land itself is promoted.

desc.zh: 在精神上保护精灵，维护他们的福祉，这是永恒女王义不容辞的责任
desc.en: The spiritual defence and well-being of the Elves is the traditional duty of the Everqueen.

desc.zh: 仅需轻轻地一触，永恒女王便能消除混沌带来的污垢
desc.en: The Everqueen can banish the taint of Chaos with a single touch.

desc.zh: 爱莎的庇佑只会授予值得拥有它的人：那些试图保护生命而不是夺走它的人
desc.en: Isha's blessing is only granted to the worthy - those who seek to protect life rather than take it.

desc.zh: 在永恒女王的触碰之下，堕落的黑心会迅速土崩瓦解
desc.en: Those of a fell heart will be destroyed if they receive the Everqueen's touch.

desc.zh: 爱莎的庇护可以在最黑暗的日子里保护忠实的阿苏尔一族
desc.en: Isha's protection can protect the faithful Asur through the darkest of days.

desc.zh: 影王非常擅长洛依克的技巧，他可以长时间地隐藏身姿，这让他几乎能够潜入任何地方
desc.en: Using the tricks of Loec, the Shadow King excels at remaining unseen, allowing him to go almost anywhere.

desc.zh: 只要仍有叛徒与马雷基斯的奴才逍遥法外，影王就绝不能高枕无忧
desc.en: While there are traitors and minions of Malekith abroad, the Shadow King cannot – must not – rest.

desc.zh: 阿里斯·安纳尔愿意用任何手段摧毁他的敌人，他的复仇永无止境
desc.en: Alith Anar is willing to use any means to destroy his enemies; his vengeance has no limits.

desc.zh: 隐形的力量回归世间，向那些冤枉了纳迦瑞斯忠臣们的家伙复仇
desc.en: An unseen force, returned to take vengeance on those who have wronged the loyal folk of Nagarythe.

desc.zh: 致命的影子战士由国王所率领，他们是奥苏安所有嗜好战争的孩童中最为残忍的存在
desc.en: Led by their king, the deadly Shadow Warriors are the most ruthless of all Ulthuan's warlike children.

desc.zh: 作为逃过了不少死亡威胁的伏击大师，阿里斯·安纳尔永远都会将可怕的死亡送给当面的敌人
desc.en: As he is a master of ambushes and surviving certain death, the prospect of facing Alith Anar is always a deadly one.

desc.zh: 他会寻找你，他会找到你，他会杀了你
desc.en: He will look for you, he will find you, and he will kill you.

desc.zh: 虽然总会潜伏在阴影之中，但阿里斯·安纳尔的忠诚绝不输给任何奥苏安的王子
desc.en: He may lurk in the Shadows, but Alith Anar is as much royalty as any of Ulthuan's princes.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 作为艾拉瑞丽的使者，侍女们会将永恒女王的权威传达给四面八方
desc.en: As an envoy of Alarielle, the Handmaiden speaks with the authority of the Everqueen.

desc.zh: 在一个刀笔吏横行的文明中，巧妙的演讲甚至可以阻止冲突，拦截战争
desc.en: In a culture where words can cut as deeply as blades, a tactful speech can stop conflicts and waylay wars.

desc.zh: 并非所有的意图都需要隐藏在言语和诗歌背后。有时候，单刀直入才是更好的外交手段
desc.en: Not all intentions need be hidden behind words and poetry; sometimes, good diplomacy is direct diplomacy.

desc.zh: 懂得何时应当保守秘密，这会在未来带来可观的收益
desc.en: A secret kept is a favour to be returned at a later time.

desc.zh: 它们是世上诸多战马中的最优秀者。尊贵、智慧、优雅与迅捷便是精灵骏马的特征
desc.en: The best of all horse breeds found anywhere in the world, Elven steeds are noble, intelligent, graceful, and swift.

desc.zh: 侍女的行动得到了大地女神的青睐
desc.en: The Handmaiden's actions have gleaned the favour of the Earth Goddess.

desc.zh: 作为永恒女王的亲卫之一，此人受到了高度的信任；如果形势需要，此人将很乐意为永恒女王献上生命
desc.en: One of the Everqueen's inner circle; highly trusted, they will gladly die for the Everqueen if called upon to do so.

desc.zh: 与许多精灵一样，侍女们很擅长投射武器，但这个人的眼光特别的敏锐
desc.en: Handmaidens, like many Elves, excel at missile weapons, but this one's eye is especially keen.

desc.zh: 弓术的女杰，能在眨眼之间便射出一支箭
desc.en: A mistress of the bow, able to loose an arrow before a man can complete a blink.

desc.zh: 这是真正的鹰隼之眼，此人甚至可以一箭射落一根掉落的头发丝
desc.en: The eyes of the hawk, able to pluck a falling hair with a deft arrow sent from her bow.

desc.zh: 守护永恒女王乃是永恒的荣誉，任何侍女都不会拒绝这一荣光
desc.en: To protect and guard the Everqueen is an eternal honour and one that no Handmaiden has ever refused.

desc.zh: 不要把『侍女』这个头衔误认为是奴婢，因为她们都是战士，而且是强到难以置信的战士
desc.en: Do not mistake the title of Handmaiden as a serf, for they are warriors all, and incredibly powerful ones at that.

desc.zh: 作为一名卫士，这些勇敢的女战士发誓要保护阿苏尔所珍视的一切
desc.en: As a guardian, the Warrioress is sworn to protect everything that Asur hold dear.

desc.zh: 阿瓦隆的盾牌可以保护森林和女王，并且具有超自然的优雅
desc.en: Avelorn's shield protects its forests and queen, and is blessed with preternatural grace.

desc.zh: 这名战士倚矛而生，利矛便是其手臂的延伸，这使得其成为了战场上的一支不容忽视的力量。
desc.en: This warrior is one with their spear; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 没有人比妖婆赫莉本更热衷于谋杀，她也是最伟大的一位凯恩新娘
desc.en: There is no-one more devoted to murder than Crone Hellebron, greatest of all Khaine’s brides.

desc.zh: 作为阿苏尔全族的永恒女王，艾拉瑞丽不仅是阿瓦隆的领袖，也是整个奥苏安的精神导师
desc.en: As Everqueen of all Asur, Alarielle is leader of Avelorn and Ulthuan’s spiritual head.

desc.zh: 无论阿里斯·安纳尔走到哪里，都会有遮天蔽日的乌鸦前来享用影王留下的累累尸体
desc.en: Where Alith Anar stalks, so come the ravens to feast on the carrion in the Shadow King’s wake.

desc.zh: 就算有正道，此人也没什么必要知道
desc.en: If there's a right way to do something, this one doesn't have the wherewithal to know what it is.

desc.zh: 此人行事反常，其古怪行为令大人物们颇有微词：惹毛他们可没有好果子吃
desc.en: This one is something of an eccentric; their erratic behaviour has upset powerful people, which is seldom a good idea.

desc.zh: 如果你需要快些逃走，记得不要带上这家伙…
desc.en: Don't take this one along if you need to get away quickly… or maybe you should…

desc.zh: 此人即便在独处时也会心怀不安，他的本性就是如此的内敛
desc.en: This one doesn't even relax in their own company, so reserved is their nature.

desc.zh: 忍无可忍，无需再忍
desc.en: Some things should not have to be endured.

desc.zh: 作为，不作为，搞出变动，诸如此类，此人铁了心要跟主流对着干
desc.en: Action, inaction, change - you name it, this one will work against the prevailing wind.

desc.zh: 一旦形势所需，那么便理应向敌人投掷出全部的怒火
desc.en: On occasion, throwing the whole nine leagues at the enemy is just the ticket.

desc.zh: 历经磨练的技巧对敌人来说就好比打磨锋利的利刃
desc.en: Skills refined and improved upon over time can only increase one's edge over the foe.

desc.zh: 这么说吧，此人就是个炸药桶，你一定不会想尝尝他的怒火吧！
desc.en: You don't want to be on the wrong side of this one's ire - it's explosive to say the least!

desc.zh: 这就是健康强壮的典范，很显然此人早已经过多年的锻炼
desc.en: The very picture of good health. Clearly, there's many years still ahead of them.

desc.zh: 此人活动好每一根筋骨，随时随地准备出动
desc.en: Every fibre of their being is charged and ready for action - wherever, whenever.

desc.zh: 即使在高等精灵自己看来，千余岁还能如此精神焕发也是很不可思议的
desc.en: Impressively energetic for a thousand years old - even by their own reckoning.

desc.zh: 如果自身足够强硬，那么盔甲就只是摆设
desc.en: Armour is just a formality when you're as hard as nails and as tough as old boots.

desc.zh: 很多人都试过了，想杀这人没那么容易，相信我
desc.en: This one is not at all easy to kill, and many have tried, believe me.

desc.zh: 嗯，有趣。不过，我想知道是否有第三种方法…
desc.en: Hmmm interesting. I do wonder if there's a third way, however…

desc.zh: 坚强，硬挺，正经，不屈
desc.en: Stiff, starched, formal. Inflexible.

desc.zh: 做任何事都有正确和错误两条路，此人一般都爱走错的路
desc.en: There's usually a right way and a wrong way to do anything. This one generally gets it wrong.

desc.zh: 此人事事不落，整天干涉别人的事
desc.en: This one can never leave something alone. They always have to meddle.

desc.zh: 好的理念还需有公众支持才能付诸实施
desc.en: Good ideas oft-times need vocal, public support to turn them into reality.

desc.zh: 恶魔对细节了如指掌…
desc.en: The Daemon is very definitely in the detail…

desc.zh: 某种程度上来讲，人们可以补救军队的损耗
desc.en: Armies can be mended as surely as people can, up to a point of course.

desc.zh: 此人着眼长久，行事一心只为公义，不留私心
desc.en: This one acts not for themselves but the for the greater good, in defence of the future.

desc.zh: 好在世上总有人爱操心天下大事，要不然我们可就…哦等等…
desc.en: Fortunately, there are some who really apply themselves to the problems of the world. Just as well, otherwise we'd be… Oh wait...

desc.zh: 『事情总会有出路，总会有转机，你得去探索』
desc.en: There's always a way - always an angle. You just have to find it.

desc.zh: 此人看待老问题时总不乏新思路和新点子
desc.en: Never short of new ideas, or new ways of looking at old problems.

desc.zh: 此人技艺超群，堪称国之大器，简直就是智慧的化身
desc.en: An individual of exceptional skill and worth; the very embodiment of sagacity.

desc.zh: 我发现了出问题的地方，然后亲手修复了它
desc.en: I see something wrong and I fix it with my hands.

desc.zh: 走私、敲诈、勒索——这些都是野心勃勃的海盗们一天的工作！
desc.en: Smuggling, racketeering, bootlegging – all in a day’s work for the enterprising pirate!

desc.zh: 这名战士倚剑而生，利剑便是其手臂的延伸，这使其成为了战场上一股不容忽视的力量
desc.en: This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.

desc.zh: 在防御战中，一把灵活运转的利剑绝不会让自己的主人被轻易刺穿
desc.en: A blade that sings in defence will not let its wielder be penetrated.

desc.zh: 他人除了信奉之外别无选择，这便是此人心中之念
desc.en: Such is this one's conviction that others have no choice but to believe.

desc.zh: 虽然精确射击可以后天习得，但此人天生就精准善射
desc.en: Although precision in missile combat is something that can be learned, this one was born with a high degree of natural talent.

desc.zh: 当使用者是一名真正的杀手与屠夫时，人斩之剑将成为真正致命的神兵！
desc.en: A deadly blade is especially lethal when in the hands of this master death-maker, killer and slaughterer!

desc.zh: 有些生物非常擅长将满腔的怒火灌注到冲锋中去，就连周遭的大地都会在其足下颤动不已！
desc.en: Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.

desc.zh: 此人满怀战斗热情：似可赞颂？似可鄙夷？
desc.en: This one fights with a fervour to be both admired and despised.

desc.zh: 那些跑得特别快的家伙会更快地到达敌军那里
desc.en: Those who are fleet of foot can reach the enemy faster.

desc.zh: 全身板甲可将穿戴者从头到尾包裹得严严实实，有许多板甲都曾受过祝福或是拥有奥术之力
desc.en: Full-Plate armour protects the wearer from head-to-foot. Many such suits are blessed or imbued with arcane abilities.

desc.zh: 一对一的肉搏战自是一场劈砍与挑刺技术的生死对决。然而，诸如格挡回避等防御性动作也会为你赢得生存的机会
desc.en: Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.

desc.zh: 除了狂热的信仰之外别无他物，这绝非理性可以解释
desc.en: There is nothing but utter belief. There is no reasoning with this one.

desc.zh: 总是在战场上寻找豁口与优势，一定有什么地方能把刀子给捅进去
desc.en: Always on the lookout for an opening or advantage in battle - somewhere to put the knife in…

desc.zh: 这名历战老兵身上的累累伤痕是多场战斗遗留下的记忆，逃脱死神魔爪是此人的家常便饭，因此他值得众人的尊重与畏惧
desc.en: The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.

desc.zh: 身为领主，要有钢铁般的意志与绝不服输的气势，这样在面临险境时，麾下众将的立场才会坚定，并追随其至天涯海角
desc.en: The iron will and indomitable presence of this leader ensures their followers remain steadfast when facing peril.

desc.zh: 吟诵力量或信仰之语，便可改变自己在战场上的洞察力
desc.en: Speaking words of power or faith can alter perceptions on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 『敌人的恐惧和他们在污泥中流淌的血，就是支撑我活下去的动力』
desc.en: "The enemy's fear; their blood spilt in the mud – these are the things that sustain me."

desc.zh: 如果有架要打，那么此人就会在最激烈的战斗中冲在前面
desc.en: If there's swash to be buckled, this one will be right at the front, in the thick of the fray.

desc.zh: 此人绝不会轻易屈膝，除非他的意志与躯体全部被彻底地毁灭
desc.en: This one will not go down easily - it will be necessary to break both the will and the body first.

desc.zh: 那些天生便带着坚硬外壳的生物可不是那么容易杀死的，就算是强力的攻击，也不见得能刺穿他们的硬皮
desc.en: Creatures with tough hides or some kind of natural armour are tough nuts to crack - even a powerful attack may fall foul of their thick-skin.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼的力量和敏捷来自于更遥远的地方——非生物的超自然领域
desc.en: The strength and agility of the Vampire comes from a place beyond: the supernatural realm of the Unliving.

desc.zh: 『别看他们的眼睛，他们的眼里只有死亡！』
desc.en: "Don't look into their eyes, there is only death there!"

desc.zh: 杀伤猛士力大无穷、凶狠残暴，会将一切敌人彻底地撕碎、蹂躏、践踏，直至战场上只剩下他自己为止！
desc.en: Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.

desc.zh: 纯粹的、未经稀释的怨恨会让死者的眼神更为犀利
desc.en: Sheer, undiluted spite sharpens the dead eye further.

desc.zh: 潮水会减慢敌人的前进速度
desc.en: The tidal currents shall slow the foe's advance.

desc.zh: 潮水会减慢敌人的前进速度
desc.en: The tidal currents shall slow the foe's advance.

desc.zh: 无论身处何方，无人可逃脱深渊之吻——当肺叶里灌满海水时，连呼吸也会变得不再可能
desc.en: No matter how far away, none can escape the Kiss of the Deep, nor breathe again with lungs full of seawater.

desc.zh: 深海里到处都是各种各样的生物，其中许多从未，也不应该浮上海面
desc.en: All manner of creatures infest the deep, many who have never - and should never - be seen above the waves.

desc.zh: 深海里到处都是各种各样的生物，其中许多从未，也不应该浮上海面
desc.en: All manner of creatures infest the deep, many who have never - and should never - be seen above the waves.

desc.zh: 正如黑夜紧跟着白昼一样，当薄雾降临时，死亡也就变得并不遥远了
desc.en: As surely as night follows day, when the mist descends, death isn't far behind.

desc.zh: 正如黑夜紧跟着白昼一样，当薄雾降临时，死亡也就变得并不遥远了
desc.en: As surely as night follows day, when the mist descends, death isn't far behind.

desc.zh: 一旦被强大海怪的触手抓住，只有最强悍的人才能挣脱
desc.en: Once the mighty Kraken's tentacles take hold, only the toughest can fight their way free.

desc.zh: 一旦被强大海怪的触手抓住，只有最强悍的人才能挣脱
desc.en: Once the mighty Kraken's tentacles take hold, only the toughest can fight their way free.

desc.zh: 这艘鬼气森森的船上，竟是空无一人
desc.en: No one sails this ship of fools.

desc.zh: 这艘鬼气森森的船上，竟是空无一人
desc.en: No one sails this ship of fools.

desc.zh: 纯粹的、未经稀释的怨恨会让死者的眼神更为犀利
desc.en: Sheer, undiluted spite sharpens the dead eye further.

desc.zh: 『尔等应无所不至，永远捍卫良善与正义，反对不义与邪恶』
desc.en: Thou shalt be everywhere and always the champion of the Right and the Good against Injustice and Evil.

desc.zh: 虽然任何事物都难以取代冲锋的震撼与钢铁的冲击，但是重型炮兵的支援也是很有帮助的
desc.en: Although nothing can replace the thrill of the charge and the righteous clash of steel, seriously heavy artillery generally helps.

desc.zh: 最为优秀的良驹，其血脉已代代相传，并世辈为我们服务下去
desc.en: The bloodline of the noblest of all steeds has been preserved; it serves us still.

desc.zh: 当战斗开始时，诚心侍奉女神的信徒会得到女神的部分力量作为奖赏
desc.en: Those who serve the Lady purely are rewarded with a portion of her strength when battle is joined.

desc.zh: 许多巴托尼亚老兵声称，在战斗激烈时他们有时会感到一种莫名的安慰，帮助他们找寻目标，保持冷静
desc.en: Many Bretonnian veterans speak of a soothing presence felt on occasion in the heat of battle, helping them to find their mark and keep their cool.

desc.zh: 就算是愚蠢的农夫，也能学会坚守阵地，硬抗冲锋
desc.en: Even stupid peasants can learn to stand fast and brace against the charge.

desc.zh: 即使是蠢笨的农民也能弯弓，但只要稍加训练，他们就能学会射出稍微有那么点准头的箭
desc.en: Even dull and stupid peasants can aim a bow, but with a little training they can learn to shoot with some success.

desc.zh: 世上就没有任何对手是他无法应付的，没有
desc.en: There are literally no opponents too great for them to face down. None.

desc.zh: 当面临着被自方屠杀的可能性时，军阵中的小人物也会奋起反击…
desc.en: When the alternative probably involves being killed by their own side, the smallfolk tend to rise to the occasion...

desc.zh: 喝下圣杯中的饮料吧，你会得到重生的
desc.en: Drink from the chalice. You will be reborn.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 任何野兽都不可能完全听从指令，但这一鞭子至少能够带来最低限度的…顺从
desc.en: No beast can truly be controlled, but these desperate contrivances bring the smallest semblance of order.

desc.zh: 兽王毫无怜悯之心——那些逃跑的人很快就会发现，所有的道路都终将无情地通向箭或斧引领的死亡
desc.en: The Beastlord truly has no mercy – those who flee will soon find all paths lead to a brutal end by arrow or axe.

desc.zh: 只有从兽群中挑选出来的少数人会得到兽王的承认——这是他们在战斗中屠杀敌人和散播混乱所获得的奖励
desc.en: Only a select few from a herd gain their Beastlord's acknowledgement – a prize earned through the carnage and chaos they spread in battle.

desc.zh: 嘶叫兽群乃是野兽人的精锐，他们会屠杀所有那些被他们的野蛮而兽性的目光盯上的目标
desc.en: The Beastmen’s elite menagerie – the brayherds – slaughter all those caught in their savage, animalistic sights.

desc.zh: 混沌诸神向其追随者施以变异，虽然在南方佬看来很可怕，但这种礼物却是异常珍贵
desc.en: Mutations awarded by the Chaos Gods to their followers may look horrific to southerners, but such gifts are prized.

desc.zh: 战争的呼唤足以驱使兽群发动暴烈的冲锋，追逐荣耀或是血腥的死亡
desc.en: A summons to war in which all are drawn into the cacophonous charge; glory or sanguine death is the prize.

desc.zh: 这些巨大野蛮的战士是任何真正的兽群的核心
desc.en: These colossal, brutish warriors are the core of any true brayherd.

desc.zh: 此人立于战兽群前方，以长鞭撩起部下的狂暴本性，然后将其驱向敌军
desc.en: At the head of the warherd, he whips his followers into a frothing furore, then unleashes them upon the enemy.

desc.zh: 魔法的恶臭非常刺鼻，所以没有任何法师可以在遭遇战兽群时全身而退
desc.en: The stench of magic is palpable. No mage can stand in the midst of battle against the baying warherds.

desc.zh: 无尽的战斗与惨烈的暴行，这些便是野兽人的生存意义
desc.en: The Beastman delights in constant fighting; in vicious, ceaseless brutality. It gives him purpose.

desc.zh: 这股肆虐的狂暴可谓与生俱来：这不是自然选择的结果，而是深入骨髓的纯粹野性
desc.en: The desire to wreak havoc is innate, brought about not by choice but by sheer force of being.

desc.zh: 食物、饮水与杀戮，有多少都不够！不够！
desc.en: It is never enough. The food, the drink, the slaughter. It is never, ever enough.

desc.zh: 不自然的力量，黑暗威胁的光环，对混沌诸神坚定不移的忠诚——有些战士无疑已经受到了毁灭之力的触摸
desc.en: Unnatural strength, an aura of dark menace, an unwavering devotion to the Chaos Gods – some warriors have undoubtedly been touched by the Ruinous Ones.

desc.zh: 对北方人来说，没有什么比奋战至死，然后在诸神的凝视中倒下更为荣耀
desc.en: To the Northmen, there is no greater honour than to fight and perish under the gaze of the Gods.

desc.zh: 燃烧的弹丸划过天空，以凶猛的火焰征服敌人
desc.en: Subdue the enemy with savage fire, as flaming projectiles burn a trail across the sky.

desc.zh: 混沌诸神向其追随者施以变异，虽然在南方佬看来很可怕，但这种礼物却是异常珍贵
desc.en: Mutations awarded by the Chaos Gods to their followers may look horrific to southerners, but such gifts are prized.

desc.zh: 从远处摧毁敌人，乃是掌控战场的关键
desc.en: To devastate one's enemies from afar is the key to controlling the battlefield.

desc.zh: 破碎的骨头和垂垂将死的生命，混沌大军像一柄邪恶的战锤，狠狠击穿敌人的行伍
desc.en: Breaking bones and ending lives, the armies of Chaos strike like an unholy hammer crashing through their enemies' ranks.

desc.zh: 在领主神秘莫测的视线下，混沌军团不断前进，出于对他愤怒的恐惧，他们渴望杀戮敌人
desc.en: The legions march forth under the Lord's inscrutable gaze, eager to kill for fear of his wrath.

desc.zh: 纯粹的肌肉，被纯粹的仇恨支撑着，可以用可怕的力量直接打碎一个人类
desc.en: Hulks of pure muscle, held upright by unsullied hatred, can crush a man with a frightening lack of effort.

desc.zh: 痛苦的尖叫会极大地刺激混沌恶魔的嗜血欲
desc.en: The Daemons of Chaos bay for blood, spurred on by a chorus of agonised screams.

desc.zh: 混沌最具价值的先锋拥有最复杂的变异，这也使它们能够跑得更快更久
desc.en: The worthiest of Chaos' vanguard are blessed with the most elaborate mutations, which also enable them to move faster for longer.

desc.zh: 为什么一个人要伪装一个不属于自己的身份？原因有很多，但不会有一条是无辜的
desc.en: Why would one pretend to be what he is not? There are many reasons, none of them innocent.

desc.zh: 为什么一个人要伪装一个不属于自己的身份？原因有很多，但不会有一条是无辜的
desc.en: Why would one pretend to be what he is not? There are many reasons, none of them innocent.

desc.zh: 这种方法虽然有些生硬粗暴，但仍然非常、非常地有效
desc.en: Such methods are blunt and crude in the extreme, but still very, very effective.

desc.zh: 如果你提供的足够多，那么大多数人最终会开始以你的方式看待问题
desc.en: If you're offering enough, most people eventually start to see things your way.

desc.zh: 一些人认为她是个令人厌恶的怪物，但曼纳恩唯一的女儿却不这么认为
desc.en: Some think her a freak abomination, but Manann's true and only daughter knows different.

desc.zh: 当死掉之后，艾蕊娜萨英勇的对手便会成为她的义肢
desc.en: In death, her brave former-adversary has proved a useful replacement for Aranessa's blasted limb.

desc.zh: 『海中的野兽们啊，我命令你们效忠于我…』
desc.en: "Beasts of the sea, I command your allegiance…"

desc.zh: 艾蕊娜萨很小的时候就出海了，所以她在航海上的天赋经历了许多年的磨砺
desc.en: Aranessa has been at sea since a very young age, so her talent for seafaring has had many years to flourish and grow.

desc.zh: 她在海上度过了相当长的时间，其中大部分都是靠自己的智慧度过的，这也赋予了艾蕊娜萨极强的驾驭大炮的能力
desc.en: Her very long tenure at sea, much of it spent relying on nothing but her own wits, means Aranessa has become quite skilled with a cannon.

desc.zh: 说真的，无论在什么情况下，你都不会希望遇到这种情况…
desc.en: You really don't want to run into this one, ever, under any circumstances... Yes, really.

desc.zh: 若是没有框架，那么骨头、肌肉和肌腱又该如何连接在一起？
desc.en: Bone, muscle and sinew cannot always be relied upon to hold together unassisted.

desc.zh: 考虑到所有的船员都已经死了多久，他们的结绳技术真的相当出色
desc.en: Their rope skills are really rather excellent, considering how long the entire crew have been dead.

desc.zh: 死后得活，这往往会让人变得更加顽强
desc.en: Surviving death tends to instil a certain toughness in one.

desc.zh: 『现在听着，给我好好听着…计划是这样的…』
desc.en: "Now listen up an' listen good… here be the plan…"

desc.zh: 死亡并没有妨碍这个人精湛的瞄准技术。事实上，如果说有什么不同的话，那就是他的射术反而变得更好了
desc.en: Death hasn't got in the way of this one's sure-shotted aim; in fact, if anything, he's got better.

desc.zh: 所谓过犹不及，只有一点的话，不会有什么坏处
desc.en: You can't have too much of a good thing and a bit of what you fancy does no harm.

desc.zh: 永远不会有什么好结果
desc.en: It never ends well.

desc.zh: 只要是看过的东西，就绝不会消失不见
desc.en: What has been seen cannot be unseen.

desc.zh: 就像没有生命的飞蛾不可避免地被一束耀眼的火焰所吸引一样，溺亡者总会跌跌撞撞地向着曾经约束着他们的人靠近
desc.en: Like Unliving moths drawn inexorably towards a dazzling flame, the risen drowned strive - and stumble - to always be close to the one who has bound them.

desc.zh: 『给我听好了，亲爱的们，我只说一次…安静！你们这群该死的！』
desc.en: "Listen very carefully, me hearties, I shall say this only once… Quiet! Stromfels' stinkin' breath!"

desc.zh: 这些亡灵军团曾是人类，他们将永远遵照驭主的意志向前进发
desc.en: The once-men of the Undead legions march ever onwards, according to the will of their binder.

desc.zh: 这是一个肮脏的活计，既然如此，那为什么不使用一点额外的帮助来给自己建立些优势呢？
desc.en: This is a dirty business, that much is certain, so why not get a little extra help to give yourself an edge?

desc.zh: 『烧，烧尽你所行的一切！烧，烧尽你将成的一切！』
desc.en: "Fire, to destroy all that you have done; fire, to end all you've become."

desc.zh: 即使他们想挣脱，也无法获得自由
desc.en: They could not break free, even if they wanted to.

desc.zh: 小心那些在黑旗下航行的人——他们从不饶人一命，也从不放弃追逐！
desc.en: Beware those who sail under the black flag - they give no quarter and never, ever give up the chase.

desc.zh: 被诅咒永远呆在波涛里，永远得不到休息或安慰
desc.en: Cursed to haunt the waves forever, never finding rest or solace.

desc.zh: 只要不是被钉死的东西，这个家伙就会把它抢到手，而且，会把挡着他的路的人们全都干掉
desc.en: If it's not tacked down, this one'll 'ave it and kill anyone who gets in their way.

desc.zh: 『你永远也找不到这样的船员——他们中的大多数都是些恶毒的渣滓。我当然不愿意在最激烈的战斗中面对他们！』
desc.en: "You'll never find such a crew - villainous scum, the lot of 'em. I certainly wouldn't want to be facing 'em in the thick of battle!"

desc.zh: 在每个水手的…生命中都会有这样的时刻，就算还有其他出路，当海盗似乎仍然是最好的选择
desc.en: There's a time in every sailor's, er, life when the black flag seems like the best, if not the only option.

desc.zh: 在木板和隔板的深处，一种智慧在搅动着…
desc.en: Deep within the boards and bulkheads, an intelligence stirs…

desc.zh: 这种东西维系着这世上永恒的赌徒的存在
desc.en: Such things keep the eternal players' of this world alive.

desc.zh: 照顾好你的船，她也会反过来关心你的海上安全
desc.en: Take care of your ship and she will have a care for your wellbeing in return.

desc.zh: 死者很少在这些地方呆着…就像是让活着的人时刻注意他们的罪恶一样
desc.en: The dead rarely stay that way around these parts... and like to remind the living of their sins.

desc.zh: 『…到最后，海洋整个变成了深红色，就像一大桶酒』
desc.en: "…and by the end the ocean itself was a deep red, like a vast vat of wine."

desc.zh: 事实上，世界上的海洋是它最大的墓地
desc.en: In truth, the oceans of this world are its largest cemetaries.

desc.zh: 有些东西不应该被带到尘世中去，永远都不应该
desc.en: Some things should just never be brought over into the mortal world. Not ever.

desc.zh: 如这般驱役陨落的冠军勇士，驱使他们背叛女神而服务于新的主人，这分明就是亵渎！
desc.en: To raise fallen champions such as these, in betrayal of The Lady to serve new masters, is profanation indeed!

desc.zh: 也许塞洛斯塔那悦耳的音调听起来像海底的鲸鱼，在召唤深海的怪物为她服务？
desc.en: Maybe Cylostra's dulcet tones sound like whalesong beneath the waves, calling the monsters of the deep to her service?

desc.zh: 如此强烈的情感，足以唤起你能想象到的最黑暗的力量
desc.en: Such a strong emotion can summon the darkest forces imaginable to your side.

desc.zh: 你一定不希望见到她坏的一面…或者干脆任何一面，想想吧！
desc.en: You don't want to get on her bad side… or any side, come to think of it!

desc.zh: 平静的水面掩盖了下面潜藏的恐怖
desc.en: Calm waters belie the lurching terror beneath.

desc.zh: 这是世界上最美妙的声音，当然！
desc.en: The most fabulous voice in the world, ever. Obviously!

desc.zh: 死者的刀刃深深地、真实地切割着，以无穷无尽的超自然力量刺穿它的敌人
desc.en: The blades of the dead cut deep and true, thrusted with endless supernatural strength.

desc.zh: 他为曾经失去的生命而战，残酷地反抗光明的死亡
desc.en: He fights for a life once led now lost, brutally raging against the dying of the light.

desc.zh: 『今天是个去死的好日子；毕竟，谁还想长生不老呢？』
desc.en: "Today is a good day to die; after all, who wants to live forever anyway?"

desc.zh: 『…就这样，它消失了，连着整座村子以及其中的居民一起消失不见了…此后他们完全失去了踪影』
desc.en: "…and like that it was gone. Along with the village and its inhabitants… Ne'er to be seen - or heard of - again."

desc.zh: 有些人只是想看到世界熊熊燃烧
desc.en: Some beings just want to see the world burn.

desc.zh: 在肮脏、黏糊糊的环境中射击可不是一件轻松的事情
desc.en: Being shot at whilst covered in a foul, sticky mess is no picnic.

desc.zh: 假设你确实打中了目标，并且你的射击并没有在击中它时化为火花，那么这点小优势一定会带来不错的收益
desc.en: Assuming you get it right and your shot doesn't turn to flowers on impact, these little extras tend to bring advantage.

desc.zh: 『如果其他方法都失败了，那就一枪打过去然后喝个痛快！』
desc.en: "If all else fails, shoot it squarely and dive into the drink!"

desc.zh: …就是字面上的意思，他们从未失手过
desc.en: …literally, though they never miss.

desc.zh: …因为一旦它们进入水中，你就会希望你的目标永远呆在那里
desc.en: …because once they're in the water, you want your targets to stay there… forever.

desc.zh: 时刻随身带着家伙——你永远不知道什么时候需要它们
desc.en: Keep your tools on you at all times - you never know when you'll need them.

desc.zh: 这名英雄技艺超群，熟知各种常见错误，并知道如何才能避免犯错
desc.en: An expert in their craft, this Hero knows all the mistakes that can be made and how to best avoid making them.

desc.zh: 这绝对是一个值得关注的家伙，或许你该选择与他合作？
desc.en: Definitely one to watch and perhaps align yourself with.

desc.zh: 这个人对生活有一定的…活力和热情，而这项才华可以轻松感染周围的人
desc.en: This one has a certain… energy and enthusiasm for the life, which is proving to be infectious.

desc.zh: 在海上的岁月显然得到了回报——此人显然可以『走完全程』，这一点得到了船员们的青睐
desc.en: Years at sea have clearly paid off - this one can clearly 'walk the walk', which has found favour with their crew.

desc.zh: 人们甚至不会用平静的语调提起他，这就是此人的名声
desc.en: People don't even speak in hushed tones anymore, such is this one's renown.

desc.zh: 这条可怕的黑龙是堕落之心最喜欢的坐骑，它承载着克拉肯领主飞上战场，口中喷吐的不是火焰，而是毒雾
desc.en: This terrifying Black Dragon, Fellheart's favourite mount, belches noxious fumes in place of fire as it carries the Krakenlord to battle.

desc.zh: 『拼杀在前线，脑袋撞甲板；刀剑似铁寒，徒然又命断…』
desc.en: "Murder in the frontline, bang your head against the deck. The metal takes its price…"

desc.zh: 克拉肯领主来自一个掠袭者、提督和制图员辈出的古老家族；你可能会不禁惊呼，这和历代祖先是同一个模子刻出来的！
desc.en: The Krakenlord comes from a very long line of raiders, admirals and map-makers; a chip off the old block, you might say!

desc.zh: 最优秀的水手能把航海图倒背如流，他们总是会引领潮流
desc.en: The best sailors know their charts back to front and are always leagues ahead of the tide.

desc.zh: 为了不让他的船员们感到困惑，堕落之心把他父亲的军官们献给了玛瑟兰
desc.en: Showing his hand from the off, that there might be no confusion amongst his crews, Fellheart had his father's officers sacrificed to Mathlann.

desc.zh: 那些在废船战斗中被俘的不幸者将以各种方式为恐惧舰队服务
desc.en: Those unfortunates captured during a scrap will serve the Dreadfleet one way or another.

desc.zh: 从来没有什么人的名字能够如此完美，而此人就是他们的领袖！
desc.en: Never was a name so perfectly descriptive, and this one is their leader!

desc.zh: 『即使凑近了看，他们也永远不会知道其中的区别』
desc.en: "They'll never know the difference, even up close."

desc.zh: 如果有义务要付款，请放心，这个人会找到解决办法的
desc.en: If there's duty to be paid, rest assured that this one will find a way around it.

desc.zh: 世界上的野兽属于每个人，而不是单单一个人
desc.en: The beasts of the world belong to everyone, never a single individual.

desc.zh: 世界上的野兽属于每个人，而不是单单一个人
desc.en: The beasts of the world belong to everyone, never a single individual.

desc.zh: 火，要灭尽你的一切。火，要终结你的一切
desc.en: Fire, to destroy all that you have done; fire, to end all you've become.

desc.zh: 『黑魔法可能很有效，但没有什么能代替你手中的利剑』
desc.en: "Dark Magic might be effective, but there's no substitute for a good blade in your hands."

desc.zh: 这是一个漫长而艰难的旅程，但现在，虽然海盗中很难产生信任与忠诚，但它确实在领主和提督之间牢固地建立了起来
desc.en: It's been a long, hard voyage to get to this point, but now trust and loyalty - so difficult to engender among freebooters - is firmly established between Lord and admiral.

desc.zh: 哈肯的人格被分解成了许多部分，这是他贪得无厌的天性的恶果
desc.en: Harkon's personality has been broken into many parts, the end result of his insatiable lust for power.

desc.zh: 有些海员似乎天生就是演这个的
desc.en: Some seafarers appear to have been born for the role.

desc.zh: 当哈肯试图强化他的力量时，魔法的反弹反而使他永远与魔法之风失去了联系
desc.en: The magical backlash Harkon suffered whilst trying to increase his power left him cut off from the Winds of Magic forever.

desc.zh: 它会干净利落地输出死亡，但前提是你的手没被炸膛给炸掉！
desc.en: By which death is expertly dealt, assuming it doesn't blow your hand off in the process!

desc.zh: 有时候似乎是出于偶然，不同的人格碎片会给拉到一起。这就是来自诸神的恩惠
desc.en: Sometimes, by chance it seems, the disparate threads are drawn together. Gods help you when they are.

desc.zh: 他的罪行不计其数，他的罪恶无穷无尽…这就是海盗之王！
desc.en: His crimes are without number and his villainy without end… behold the Pirate King!

desc.zh: 『是条兔子腿。兔子。不，没关系，它会给我带来好运。是的！相信我！』
desc.en: "It's a rabbit's foot. A rabbit. No… Oh never mind - it brings me luck. It does! Trust me!"

desc.zh: 你最好杀了这家伙，否则他们会一直回来，直到你们中的一个死了。即使那样，也不能保证他会死心！
desc.en: You'd better kill this one or they'll keep coming back until one of you is dead. Even then, there's no guarantee it'll be over!

desc.zh: 这是最难以命中的移动目标：丧妖既不是鬼魂也不是亡魂，他们利用自己的灵体状态来更好地抵御远程火力的攻击
desc.en: The ultimate in moving targets; being neither ghost nor revenant, Mournguls use their not-quite-real state to better resist missile fire.

desc.zh: 复活后的腐尸巨蟹速度超凡且凶狠异常，任何喜好战争的亡灵海盗都会希望拥有这样一头坐骑！
desc.en: The unnatural speed and brutality of a reanimated Promethean makes it the ideal mount for any Undead, battle-mongering pirate.

desc.zh: 复活后的腐尸巨蟹速度超凡且凶狠异常，任何喜好战争的亡灵海盗都会希望拥有这样一头坐骑！

desc.en: The unnatural speed and brutality of a reanimated Promethean makes it the ideal mount for any Undead, battle-mongering pirate.

desc.zh: 巨大的亡灵螃蟹，它的钳子足以撕碎舰船，非常适合成为曼纳恩陆行后代的坐骑
desc.en: A giant Undead crab, whose pincers can tear ships apart, makes an impressive and fitting mount for the earthly offspring of Manann himself.

desc.zh: 身形巨硕，即使已经身死，却仍然非常危险：骑在这种食肉甲壳类动物身上的人，一定对自己的力量有着*无比*的自信
desc.en: Very large and dead, yet still exceedingly dangerous; whoever sits astride this carnivorous crustacean must be *extremely* confident of their power.

desc.zh: 复活后的腐尸巨蟹速度超凡且凶狠异常，任何喜好战争的亡灵海盗都会希望拥有这样一头坐骑！
desc.en: The unnatural speed and brutality of a reanimated Promethean makes it the ideal mount for any Undead, battle-mongering pirate.
