desc.en: The unnatural speed and brutality of a reanimated Promethean makes it the ideal mount for any Undead, battle-mongering pirate.

desc.zh: 哈肯的坐骑确实是骇人的怪兽——发出尖锐的、女妖般尖叫的惊惧兽，它能让任何听到它的人肝胆俱裂
desc.en: Harkon's personal mount is a dreadful thing indeed - a Terrorgheist with a piercing, banshee-like shriek that has the power to stun any who hear it.

desc.zh: 这个由肉、木头和石头组成的巨大而可以动弹的庞然大物是战场上跌跌撞撞的最可怕怪物之一
desc.en: This gigantic, reanimated hulk of flesh, timber and stone is one of the most fearsome things ever to lurch onto a battlefield.

desc.zh: 寒冷的恐惧即将来临：丧妖散发出致命的寒气，减慢了敌人的速度，逐渐彻骨，直至杀死对方
desc.en: Run true, for the frozen terror cometh; the Mourngul radiates a deathly chill that slows enemies, allowing it to go in for the kill.

desc.zh: 无尽的令人发狂的饥饿使他们无法解脱。然而，这并不能阻止丧妖的杀戮
desc.en: An eternity of maddening hunger, from which there can be no release. It doesn't stop the Mourngul from trying, however.

desc.zh: 丧妖在旋转的薄雾中逐渐浮现，带来了可怕的死亡
desc.en: From 'neath the swirling mist the Mourngul rises, bringing a terrible icy death in its dreadful wake.

desc.zh: 『…就这样，它消失了，连着整座村子以及其中的居民一起消失不见了…此后他们完全失去了踪影』
desc.en: "…and like that it was gone. Along with the village and its inhabitants… Ne'er to be seen - or heard of - again."

desc.zh: 诺克特拉斯是恐惧舰队无可争议的领袖。他当然遇到过其他的竞争者，但在打输挑战的同时，他们的生命也被剥夺了
desc.en: Noctilus is the Dreadfleet's undisputed master. There may well have been other contenders, but in losing their challenge their lives were also forfeit.

desc.zh: 诺克特拉斯利用波涛漩涡的黑魔法唤醒了破碎的战船残骸，从而可以在血腥掠夺者号受伤时进行即时修复
desc.en: Noctilus uses the Maelstrom's Dark Magic to raise up the shattered remains of dead warships to repair the Bloody Reaver when she is damaged.

desc.zh: 『叫吧，直到咽气为止！我要把它碾碎，让它尸骨无存！』
desc.en: "Scream and shout 'til my dying breath, I'm gonna smash it up 'til there's nothing left!"

desc.zh: 他们低声咕哝着，因为大声说出来会招致毁灭；他们说，伯爵以前是希尔瓦尼亚的午夜显贵…
desc.en: They mutter in hushed tones - for to speak of it aloud would invite destruction - that the Count was formerly a member of Sylvania's Midnight Aristocracy…

desc.zh: 『一枪下去就是一具无生命的尸体，他们一个个地倒了下去』
desc.en: "With heavy thump, a lifeless lump, they dropped down one by one."

desc.zh: 将他的船员和最黑暗的魔法绑定在一起，此举确保了没有任何武力可以打败诺克特拉斯的舰队
desc.en: Binding his crews together with the darkest of magics ensures that Noctilus' fleet cannot be beaten by force of arms alone.

desc.zh: 『是的，它们是从东方来的。不讨喜，但实用！特别是它们的毛皮…』
desc.en: "Yes, they’re from the east. Annoying, yet useful - their hides, particularly…"

desc.zh: 你必须留心这个家伙——当你和他握手时，记得过后数一下你的手指数！
desc.en: You have to watch this one - when you shake their hand, count your fingers afterwards.

desc.zh: 这是几乎无法阻止的恐惧，当丧妖降临人世时，他们会撕碎并吞噬受害者，却永远不知道满足
desc.en: An all-but-unstoppable terror, when the Mournguls descend they rend and devour yet never know satisfaction.

desc.zh: 如果有架要打，那么此人就会在最激烈的战斗中冲在前面
desc.en: If there's swash to be buckled, this one will be right at the front, in the thick of the fray.

desc.zh: 在战斗开始之前就把敌人撩得发狂，这是很有效的战术
desc.en: There is something to be said for whipping the foe into a frenzy before the fight is joined.

desc.zh: 『黑魔法可能很有效，但没有什么能代替你手中的利剑』
desc.en: "Dark Magic might be effective, but there's no substitute for a good blade in your hands."

desc.zh: 『黑魔法可能很有效，但没有什么能代替你手中的利剑』
desc.en: "Dark Magic might be effective, but there's no substitute for a good blade in your hand."

desc.zh: 丧妖永不满足的胃口进一步促进了他们的屠杀欲望
desc.en: The Mourngul's insatiable appetite gives a further boost to its ravening slaughter.

desc.zh: 丧妖在战斗中所造成的每一处创伤，都能使自己的伤口再生
desc.en: For every wound the Mourngul inflicts in combat, it can regenerate its own injuries.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼的力量和敏捷来自于更遥远的地方——非生物的超自然领域
desc.en: The strength and agility of the Vampire comes from a place beyond: the supernatural realm of the Unliving.

desc.zh: 世界上的野兽属于每个人，而不是单单一个人
desc.en: The beasts of the world belong to everyone, never a single individual.

desc.zh: 死亡总是近在咫尺
desc.en: Death is always just a shot away.

desc.zh: 『它有一些秘密成分。不，我不会告诉你它们是什么，但结果会说明一切』
desc.en: "It's got a few secret ingredients. No, I won't tell you what they are, but the results will speak for themselves."

desc.zh: 『它有一些秘密成分。不，我不会告诉你它们是什么，但结果会说明一切』
desc.en: "It's got a few secret ingredients. No, I won't tell you what they are, but the results will speak for themselves."

desc.zh: 『多拿点弹药过来，快点！！』
desc.en: "Get more ammo up here, NOW!!!!!!!!"

desc.zh: 『多拿点弹药过来，快点！！』
desc.en: "Get more ammo up here, NOW!!!!!!!!"

desc.zh: 『这东西反冲力让人头疼，但射击效果包你满意！』
desc.en: "The recoil's a nightmare, but you can't deny the end result!"

desc.zh: 『这东西反冲力让人头疼，但射击效果包你满意！』
desc.en: "The recoil's a nightmare, but you can't deny the end result!"

desc.zh: 巧妙的镜头组合让目标看起来更近了一点
desc.en: A clever arrangement of lenses makes the target seem just that bit closer.

desc.zh: 巧妙的镜头组合让目标看起来更近了一点
desc.en: A clever arrangement of lenses makes the target seem just that bit closer.

desc.zh: 有些人只是想看到世界熊熊燃烧
desc.en: Some beings just want to see the world burn.

desc.zh: 如果有义务要付款，请放心，这个人会找到解决办法的
desc.en: If there's duty to be paid, rest assured that this one will find a way around it.

desc.zh: 领主从来都是斧不离手，因为对他而言斧子就像胡子一样，是身体的一部分
desc.en: A Lord and his az are never separated, for it is as much part of him as his beard.

desc.zh: 那些经过先祖之神考验的人，将毫无疑问地证明他们的荣耀
desc.en: Those who pass the trials of the Ancestor God have proven their honour without question.

desc.zh: 没有人比那些直接遭受火力打击的人更了解矮人的力量
desc.en: None know the strength of the Dawi better than those who've suffered their firepower firsthand.

desc.zh: 能比那些不幸陷入矮人烈焰中的人的温度更为炽热的，怕是只有矮人锻炉中的熊熊烈焰吧！
desc.en: Only Dwarfen forges burn hotter than those unfortunates caught in the blaze of Dawi ingenuity.

desc.zh: 矮人的决心冷酷而坚定。矮人们在战斗中决不撤退，要么胜利，要么死亡
desc.en: Full of grim determination, when Dwarfs join battle there is no retreat, only victory or death.

desc.zh: 所有的矮人都崇拜葛林姆尼尔，但只有少数经过挑选的战士得到了他的认可
desc.en: All Dwarfs worship Grimnir, but only a select few warriors receive his personal recognition.

desc.zh: 摩尔金的恩惠不是一时兴起就能得到的：这位神只会赐福给矮人工程师中最真诚的门徒
desc.en: Morgrim's favour is not handed out on a whim; this god blesses only the truest disciples of Dawi engineering.

desc.zh: 该领主知道他的族人擅于射击，并希望其族人能在这条道路上更进一步
desc.en: This Lord knows his throng thrives in ranged combat and expects his Clansdwarfs to excel in that discipline.

desc.zh: 矮人们绵长的寿命令其积累了大量的战场经验，这让他们成为了卓越的战术家
desc.en: Dwarfs are long-lived with many years of battlefield experience, making them excellent tacticians.

desc.zh: 矮人们不断地推进着工程技术的进展，让他们的飞行装置飞得更高，发射的炮弹比以前更远
desc.en: The Dawi continually push the boundaries of engineering, be it by soaring ever higher in their flying contraptions or firing projectiles farther than ever before.

desc.zh: 那些指挥武器的人甚至可以在混战开始之前就决定一场战斗的胜负
desc.en: Those in command of ordnance can potentially decide a battle before the melee has even begun.

desc.zh: 『我们为了皇帝上阵杀敌，更是为了伟大的西格玛，我们的救星，我们的主！』
desc.en: “We march to war for our Emperor, and Sigmar, our saviour and lord.”

desc.zh: 当在战场上遭遇无数敌军时，行省军能依靠的就只有帝国锻造的坚定之钢
desc.en: Honest Empire-forged steel is all a state trooper could ask when confronting the myriad foes in battle.

desc.zh: 矮人姑且不论，但肯定没有哪个其它种族能承受这些大炮毁灭性的齐射
desc.en: Despite what the Dwarfs think, no other race can bring to bear such devastating artillery volleys.

desc.zh: 为大型熔炉和铁匠铺提供赞助，就能换回更为坚固，更为耐久的战争机器
desc.en: Patrons of great forges and smiths expect, and are rewarded with, tougher and more enduring war machines.

desc.zh: 该领主令其部下进行手枪能手的训练，从而将他们锻炼成了真正的神射手
desc.en: This Lord expects his men to practice the disciplines of the Pistolkorps, and all be expert marksmen.

desc.zh: 这位经验丰富的神枪手知道打出致命一枪所需要的精确射程
desc.en: The veteran marksman knows the precise range required to land the killing shot.

desc.zh: 这些战马为驰骋与战斗而生，但论起它们的立身之本，还得是风驰电掣的速度
desc.en: These steeds are bred for speed and war, but foremost it is their gallop which marks them out.

desc.zh: 站在前线要么会成就你，要么会毁灭你。而那些幸存下来的人将成为任何一支军队的中坚力量
desc.en: The frontline will either make or break you. Those who survive become the backbone of any army.

desc.zh: 有些人开始喜欢上了战争，对战争的痛苦麻木不仁，只为了杀戮的快感而活着
desc.en: Some men grow to relish war, dulled to the pain and living solely for the thrill of the kill.

desc.zh: 经过训练后，帝国狮鹫可以载人冲上战场。此时它们不仅是冷静的杀手，也对它的骑手极为忠诚
desc.en: Once trained to carry a man in battle, Imperial griffons are poised killers and incredibly dedicated to their riders.

desc.zh: 帝国飞马是高贵的带翼马，既聪明又忠诚
desc.en: An Imperial pegasus is a noble, winged steed, intelligent and loyal.

desc.zh: 乘坐战车意味着你可以更有战斗力，更有杀伤力！
desc.en: Ridin’ on chariots means ya can be even more fighty, an' even more killy!

desc.zh: 硬茬中的硬硬茬，给我整明白点，懂？
desc.en: ‘Ardest of da ‘Ard. Don’t mess, gottit?

desc.zh: 想要变大是一件容易的事，但想要变强是相当困难的！
desc.en: It’s one fing to be big, but quite anuva to be strong as well!

desc.zh: 比黑兽人还大，杀起人来也不差！
desc.en: Even bigga than a Black Orc, an' not bad at killin’ too!

desc.zh: 这个老大是个带着『小子们』的好手，他会不断激励手下的小子们获取更大的胜利，并一刀砍下最值钱的头颅
desc.en: This Boss is one with "da boyz", egging the lads on to greater feats and to hit bigga stuff with their choppas.

desc.zh: 兽人或许更强壮些，但是地精却会更聪明，更卑劣，更…更好！
desc.en: Orcs may be stronger, but Goblins are smarter, nastier, and better-er.

desc.zh: 这个老大掌握了『飞行的秘密』，因此砸了一大笔钱去维护他的战争机器，以便让这家伙飞得更高更远！
desc.en: This Boss realises the power of "flyin’ fings” and so invests a few teef in making sure his war machines can fling fings really far and really high!

desc.zh: 如果他们的坐骑能好好听话，那么绿皮骑兵将是一支非常恐怖的力量。至于如何驾驭它们，恐怕照着后屁股踢一脚，或者在坐骑前方绑个涂成胡萝卜状的地精，这就是诀窍了
desc.en: Greenskin cavalry can be devastating if the myriad mounts can behave. Getting a big stick and maybe a "carrot" in the form of an orange-painted gobbo is the answer!

desc.zh: 这家伙的撞击比任何从天而降的石头都狠，当然，比邪月亲自砸下来差点…不过那家伙真能砸下来么？
desc.en: Nuffin' smashes harder than a rock fallin' from da sky, except mebbe da Bad Moon, if it were to fall.

desc.zh: 最狡猾、最致命的地精和最大、最凶猛的兽人一样危险
desc.en: The sneakiest and stabbiest gobbos are just as dangerous as the largest, fiercest Orcs.

desc.zh: 艾蕊娜萨·盐怨是萨图沙岛上最可怕的海盗，但是最害怕她的人，还要数那些被她猎杀的诺斯卡海盗
desc.en: Aranessa Saltspite is the most feared pirate in all of Sartosa, but none fear her more than the Norscan curs she hunts.

desc.zh: 它也许是美丽而无辜的，但最终会被烈火吞噬。这是命中注定的结局
desc.en: Beautiful and innocent it may be, but all will be consumed by fire in the end. It is written.

desc.zh: 塞洛斯塔是个复仇的灵魂，一心要为凤凰王表演，为了实现她不朽的目标，她不惜倾其所有
desc.en: Cylostra is a vengeful spirit intent on performing for the Phoenix King, willing to sink all of Ulthuan to achieve her undying goal.

desc.zh: 你可能认为下落的距离不会太长，但你错了…距离彻底落入斯特姆菲尔的胸膛，真的需要相当长的时间…
desc.en: You'd think there wasn't much further to fall, but you'd be wrong - it's a long, long way down to Stromfels' Chest, after all…

desc.zh: 卢瑟·哈肯在他在世时结下了许多伟大的冷血死敌，但是他的亡灵军队却无所畏惧，甚至毫无感觉
desc.en: Luthor Harkon has made many great cold-blooded enemies in his time, but his Undead army fear - and feel - nothing.

desc.zh: 在这个艰难而黑暗的时代里，普通、正派的海盗怎么能过上诚实的生活呢？
desc.en: How else is an ordinary, decent pirate to make an honest living in these hard, dark times?

desc.zh: 杀戮是这个人思想的核心，希望他们也知道该如何驾驭一艘船…
desc.en: Killing is at the forefront of this one's mind. Hopefully, they also know how to run a ship.

desc.zh: 诺克特拉斯伯爵抛弃了希尔瓦尼亚，成为了恐惧舰队的舰长和葬船坟场的主人；他也是最早在公海上播撒死亡的人
desc.en: Count Noctilus abandoned Sylvania to become the captain of the Dreadfleet and master of the Galleon's Graveyard; he is the foremost bringer of death upon the high seas.

desc.zh: 成为领导者不仅仅需要肌肉，还必须知道如何赚钱以及如何制造痛苦——大量的痛苦
desc.en: It takes more than mere muscle to be leader, you must also know how to make money and how to inflict pain - a lot of pain.

desc.zh: 没有什么比一个直截了当的计划更能说明问题了——是的，一个计划就好！纵观所有的状况，直截了当经常会胜过叠床架屋
desc.en: There's nothing quite like a good, straightforward plan - and this is nothing like one! Complexity rarely trumps simplicity, in all matters.

desc.zh: 不管货物是火药、钢铁、黄金还是肉食，归根结底都无关紧要
desc.en: Be the cargo powder, steel, gold or flesh, in the final analysis it matters not.

desc.zh: 作为自从他杰出的祖父时代以来最伟大的海盗船长，洛克西亚正以『堕落之心』的名义行事
desc.en: The greatest Corsair since the time of his illustrious grandfather, Lokhir is doing the name of Fellheart proud in every sense.

desc.zh: 死亡与挣扎足以令这些残忍的战士们兴高采烈，他们会追随自己卑劣的主人直到天涯海角
desc.en: Delighting in death and suffering, these savage warriors follow their ignoble Lord wherever he goes.

desc.zh: 虽然生性野蛮，但他们也会拥有野蛮的行为准则，并会与那些看得上的人结成松散的同盟关系
desc.en: In spite of their savage nature, they are possessed of a savage code of conduct and form a loose brotherhood of those considered worthy.

desc.zh: 那些不愿对北方诸神屈膝的人，很快会发现他所珍爱的一切都会从他的眼前消失
desc.en: Those who do not bend the knee to the Gods of the North soon find all they hold dear obliterated before them.

desc.zh: 彻骨的寒冷会直刺敌方的皮肉，灼烧敌人的手足，直至其仆倒在地！
desc.en: The intense cold cuts into the flesh, burning the foe's extremities until they drop off altogether!

desc.zh: 在北方，利刃般的冰雹并不是天空中唯一的危险——空中的野兽也同样致命，而且难以预测
desc.en: The razor-sharp hail of the north is not the only danger in the Norscan sky – its airborne beasts are just as deadly and far less predictable.

desc.zh: 狩猎，无论大小；迎敌，无论强弱。至于猎物？无论是人与否，皆杀！
desc.en: No beast too large, no adversary too great; no quarry - mortal or otherwise - can evade them.

desc.zh: 冰寒的黑暗，震耳的暴行，这些来自遥远北方的事物绝不会为那些已然失去一切，并渴望遗忘的人们带来任何的慰藉
desc.en: The freezing darkness and stunning violence of the far north bring no small solace to those who have lost everything and wish to forget.

desc.zh: 彻骨的寒冷，近乎无尽的黑暗，这些极北之地的苦寒造就了真正的杀手之王
desc.en: The intense cold and near-constant darkness of the far north make for a certain kind of killer.

desc.zh: 巨大、致命、唯命是从，这位领主的怪兽部队特别地可怕与致命
desc.en: Giant, deadly, and able to take orders, this Lord’s monstrosities are especially terrifying and lethal.

desc.zh: 只有最凶猛的生物才能在寒冷的北方生存。最强壮的家伙们会被圈养起来准备打仗，并故意用饥饿让它们变得凶恶，准备迎接下一场战斗
desc.en: Only the fiercest creatures can survive the frozen north; the strongest are rounded up for war and starved into viciousness, ready for the next battle.

desc.zh: 眨眼之间，生死已定
desc.en: Blink and you die.

desc.zh: 『你能听见…黑夜的召唤吗？是时候让孩子们起床，集结队伍了！』
desc.en: "Can you hear it… the call of the night? Time for its children to arise and swarm."

desc.zh: 由于吸血鬼的本性，他们会尽量避免不适，并崇尚时尚的旅行
desc.en: By their very nature, most Vampires try to avoid discomfort and travel in style.

desc.zh: 领主向夜空发出吼叫，并听到了各种黑暗生物回应的嚎叫声
desc.en: The Lord howls out into the night, and is answered by the baying of dark creatures.

desc.zh: 死亡的力量是不可否认的
desc.en: The power of death cannot be denied.

desc.zh: 黑暗本身就是对所谓骑士誓言的嘲讽，而亡灵领主会追随战士的脚步前往最终时刻
desc.en: The Undead Lord has followed the warrior's path to its ultimate conclusion, in a dark mockery of a Knight's vow.

desc.zh: 这些邪恶灵魂渴望让凡间生物血肉横飞，它们会一直加速前进，直到发现新鲜的猎物为止
desc.en: Such evil spirits are desperate to spill mortal blood, and will speed along until they find some flesh to carve.

desc.zh: 黑魔法施术者可以变成蝙蝠，克服重力的限制飞向空中
desc.en: The Dark Magic-user can take to the skies, defying gravity by metamorphosing into a bat.

desc.zh: 『…而死者的军团在世界上投下了地狱』
desc.en: "…and the legions of the dead envoked all hell upon the world."

desc.zh: 『来吧，吾之大军，吾之亡灵奴仆，为吾带来胜利吧！』
desc.en: "Arise my host, my Unliving minions - bring me victory!"

desc.zh: 吸血鬼唤醒了古代死者的可怕遗骸，以此补足麾下低等领民的不足之处
desc.en: Vampires summon forth the gruesome remains of the ancient dead to bolster the masses of lesser minions under their control.

desc.zh: 最让人印象深刻的梦魇兽是用鲜血作为饲料的。这种高贵的巨兽是理想的坐骑
desc.en: The most impressive Nightmares are those reared on fresh blood. Such noble monstrosities are worthy mounts.

desc.zh: 血龙家族的首任当主仍然走在他们的队伍中，注视着以他的名义所做的一切
desc.en: The first master of the Blood Dragons still walks among their ranks, and sees all that is done in his name.

desc.zh: 骑士与其战马的羁绊极其牢固，有时甚至是字面意义的『至死不渝』
desc.en: A knight and his horse share a very strong bond – so strong that sometimes it can continue even after death.

desc.zh: 从死后的世界复活，来保卫他们的亡灵主人
desc.en: Brought back from death to guard their Unliving masters.

desc.zh: 兼具强大的力量与惊人的速度，吸血鬼很容易在对手的防线上打开缺口
desc.en: Using a combination of their great strength and amazing speed, it’s easy for a Vampire to create a gap in their opponent’s guard.

desc.zh: 地狱战马十分凶猛。涉猎束缚野兽知识的吸血鬼很高兴能让这些野兽服从他们的意志
desc.en: Hellsteeds are vicious. Vampires that dabble in the binding of beasts delight in breaking these wild creatures to their will.

desc.zh: 当黑暗生物接受了他们骄傲的挑战，而这个黑暗生物的眼睛就是死亡之眼时，许多人类冠军勇士就会改变他们的态度…
desc.en: Many mortal champions change their attitude when their proud challenge is accepted by a dark creature whose very eyes are the eyes of death…

desc.zh: 血龙骑士团正如其名，堪称任何敌人的克星
desc.en: Just like their monstrous namesake, the Order of the Dragon are formidable adversaries for any foe.

desc.zh: 真正的骑士永远不会放弃他的盔甲；有时这身铁甲似乎便是他身体的一部分
desc.en: A true knight will never abandon his armour; sometimes the steel skin appears to be part of his body.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼领主前往骸骨平原，并让一头僵尸龙成为了坐骑
desc.en: It is to the Plain of Bones that a Vampire Lord travels to claim a Zombie Dragon as their mount.

desc.zh: 黑暗魔法的能量可以用来施放亡灵法术，这种有害的能量能让亡灵更为活跃
desc.en: As the powers of Dark Magic are wielded for the purpose of Necromancy, its unwholesome energies invigorate the Undead.

desc.zh: 超自然的神力总是最好的选择：武器在施法者的盟友面前凭空出现，使他们能够剁碎肉体，劈斩灵魂，甚至剥夺意识
desc.en: The supernatural solution is often the best; weapons materialise before the caster's allies, allowing them to slice through flesh, soul, and consciousness.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽灵般的钟摆。随着一声令下，它将急速摇摆起来并穿越敌方阵势，锋利的刀刃足以切肉断骨
desc.en: A spectral pendulum is summoned by the Wizard. On command, it swings, razor sharp and with lethal speed, through the foe.

desc.zh: 当施放时，这股魔法可以重创敌人的思维，让他们痛彻心扉地感受到生命不能承受之重
desc.en: When cast this spell enfeebles enemy minds; they feel the crushing weight of reality bearing down upon them.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼的身体看起来像人类，但他们的反应是如此之快，即使是最快的剑客相比也显得笨拙
desc.en: The body of a Vampire looks human, but is capable of reactions so fast that even the quickest swordsman would look clumsy in comparison.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼的眼睛就像深坑一样，人类在里面找到了他们的末日；那些不幸的受害者只能愣愣地盯着，然后被这些磨刀霍霍的致命猎手勾魂夺魄
desc.en: A Vampire's eyes are like deep pits within which mortals find their doom; the unfortunate victims can do nothing but stare, entranced by the deadly hunter preparing to strike.

desc.zh: 最让人印象深刻的梦魇兽是用鲜血作为饲料的。这种高贵的巨兽是理想的坐骑
desc.en: The most impressive Nightmares are those reared on fresh blood. Such noble monstrosities are worthy mounts.

desc.zh: 如果说有什么不同的话，那就是这个人对生命的渴望比他们死前更强烈
desc.en: If anything, this one has an even greater lust for life than they did before their death.

desc.zh: 地狱战马十分凶猛。涉猎束缚野兽知识的吸血鬼很高兴能让这些野兽服从他们的意志
desc.en: Hellsteeds are vicious. Vampires that dabble in the binding of beasts delight in breaking these wild creatures to their will.

desc.zh: 意识的结合，其总和远远大于其各部分的简单叠加
desc.en: A coalesence of consciousness, the sum of which is much greater than its parts.

desc.zh: 这些虚伪的生物看起来是如此的无害和脆弱，以至于敌人放松了自己的防御——此刻，它们会猝然发动攻击…
desc.en: These deceptive creatures look so inoffensive and vulnerable that the enemy lowers his own defence, which is when they strike…

desc.zh: 『谁是女王？这就对了…现在，跪拜在我面前吧，害虫！』
desc.en: "Who's queen? That's right… Now, prostrate yourself before me, worm!"

desc.zh: 从远古时代开始，此人就开始捕食温血的雄性动物。那么，又有谁能拒绝做她的奴隶呢？
desc.en: How could a mortal resist the lure of a creature that has preyed on warm-blooded males since the dawn of time? Who could refuse to become her willing slave?

desc.zh: 吸血鬼领主前往骸骨平原，并让一头僵尸龙成为了坐骑
desc.en: It is to the Plain of Bones that a Vampire Lord travels to claim a Zombie Dragon as their mount.

desc.zh: 充满灵体的云雾将覆盖敌军，无形的利爪狠狠掐住敌人的咽喉
desc.en: Nebulous nature spirits assail the foe, clawing at them with hands not nearly as insubstantial as they appear.

desc.zh: 黑暗魔法的能量可以用来施放亡灵法术，这种有害的能量能让亡灵更为活跃
desc.en: As the powers of Dark Magic are wielded for the purpose of Necromancy, its unwholesome energies invigorate the Undead.

desc.zh: 『死灵术的力量啊，请听你最勤奋的学徒的请求：按照我的意志，流过我的身体！』
desc.en: "Forces of Necromancy, hear the request of your most-studious adept: flow through me according to my will!"

desc.zh: 施法者召唤野性的精灵，为友军的脆弱外表披上一层坚硬的皮肤
desc.en: Calling upon the beast spirits of the wild, the caster sheathes vulnerable flesh in unyielding fur and hide.

desc.zh: 那些在死亡面纱后面观看的人，在信徒们有所需要的时候，可以随时挺身相助
desc.en: Those who watch proceedings from behind the veil of death may reach through to aid their disciples, when required to intervene.

desc.zh: 最让人印象深刻的梦魇兽是用鲜血作为饲料的。这种高贵的巨兽是理想的坐骑
desc.en: The most impressive Nightmares are those reared on fresh blood. Such noble monstrosities are worthy mounts.

desc.zh: 远望未来，改变现在
desc.en: See the future, change the present.

desc.zh: 地狱战马十分凶猛。涉猎束缚野兽知识的吸血鬼很高兴能让这些野兽服从他们的意志
desc.en: Hellsteeds are vicious. Vampires that dabble in the binding of beasts delight in breaking these wild creatures to their will.

desc.zh: 在尼古拉契家族中，最古老的吸血鬼领主的巢穴里隐藏着诅咒的卷轴，其中可以找到关于死亡传说的黑暗秘密
desc.en: The dark secrets of Necromantic lore can be found in the cursed scrolls hidden within the lairs of the oldest Vampire Lords of the Necrarch family.

desc.zh: 施法者鼓动狂野的魔力，从而引导它那远古而蛮荒的力量
desc.en: The spellcaster attunes the magic of the wild, channelling its ancient and arcane power.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼领主前往骸骨平原，并让一头僵尸龙成为了坐骑
desc.en: It is to the Plain of Bones that a Vampire Lord travels to claim a Zombie Dragon as their mount.

desc.zh: 释放住在内心中的贪婪、原始的力量
desc.en: Unleash the ravenous, primal force that dwells within.

desc.zh: 野兽只知道狂怒和盛怒
desc.en: The savage beast knows only rage and fury.

desc.zh: 有些种族不会轻易忘却灭族之恨，而且可能需要几个世纪才能为它复仇
desc.en: Some races don't take annihilation lying down, and may take centuries to avenge the slight.

desc.zh: 沃拉格·血齿发誓要重建史崔格家族，并对毁灭了它的仇家报仇
desc.en: Vorag Bloodytooth swore to rebuild Strigos and avenge himself on its destroyers.

desc.zh: 乌索然的遗产，如今正掌控在值得信赖的人手中
desc.en: Ushoran's legacy is in safe hands.

desc.zh: 吃下死者的腐败烂肉，从而愈发强壮吧！
desc.en: Feed on the rotting flesh of the buried dead and grow strong.

desc.zh: 它永远不会结束
desc.en: It never ends.

desc.zh: 莫尔控制着虚幻的东西，梦想的东西，让他们与所有邪恶形态的亡灵相对抗
desc.en: Morr holds sway over the unreal, the stuff of dreams, ranging them against the Undead in all their nefarious forms.

desc.zh: 这头蝙蝠是如此的巨大，简直堪比一头龙！它可以轻松地将人抓离地面，或是一击便将战马打晕！
desc.en: Deadly giant bats the size of dragons, capable of plucking men from the field and stunning warhorses into paralysis.

desc.zh: 亡灵会不可避免地变更王道：尸妖和其它堕落的灵魂会强制为统治着凶残食尸鬼的暴君服务
desc.en: Unlife inevitably changes kingly ways; Wights and other fell spirits serve the monarch, who rules over a populace of bestial Ghouls.

desc.zh: 黑暗魔法的能量可以用来施放亡灵法术，这种有害的能量能让亡灵更为活跃
desc.en: As the powers of Dark Magic are wielded for the purpose of Necromancy, its unwholesome energies invigorate the Undead.

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the caster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 卡堂是一位变形术大师，他能把自己的形体变成任何他想要的形状。这次，他的魔法被用来召唤一头嗜血蝠狼，仿佛卡堂亲自在为你战斗
desc.en: Kadon, a master of forms, was able to shift his shape into anything he chose. Here, his magic is used to summon a Varghulf, as if Kadon himself fights for you.

desc.zh: 最让人印象深刻的梦魇兽是用鲜血作为饲料的。这种高贵的巨兽是理想的坐骑
desc.en: The most impressive Nightmares are those reared on fresh blood. Such noble monstrosities are worthy mounts.

desc.zh: 『随着时间的推移，他们会发现恐惧是一种巨大的动力，并为这一礼物向我们致谢』
desc.en: "In time they will come to see that fear is a great motivator, and thank us for that gift."

desc.zh: 某些生物永远不应离开它们出没和爬行的地窖，也永远不应被普通人看到
desc.en: Certain creatures should never leave the crypts in which they haunt and creep, and never be seen by ordinary mortals.

desc.zh: 『无论是牛还是人，等到生命结束时，也没什么区别』
desc.en: "Cows… people… they're all basically the same at the end of the day."

desc.zh: 『召唤我的蝙蝠仆从，我需要它们的才能』
desc.en: "Summon my servants, the bats. I have need of their talents."

desc.zh: 地狱战马十分凶猛。涉猎束缚野兽知识的吸血鬼很高兴能让这些野兽服从他们的意志
desc.en: Hellsteeds are vicious. Vampires that dabble in the binding of beasts delight in breaking these wild creatures to their will.

desc.zh: 有些吸血鬼会变成狼、蝙蝠或一阵烟雾。通过这样，他们会获得新形体带来的所有优势
desc.en: Some Vampires can change into a wolf, a great bat or a whirl of mist. In doing so, they gain all of the advantages of their new form.

desc.zh: 『来吧，我的暗夜仆从们，我们有一项伟大的工作要做』
desc.en: "Come, my night-shape servants, we have a great work ahead of us."

desc.zh: 经过训练，他们可以在最严酷的环境下生存，但他们仍然只是傀儡，不知不觉地为主人服务
desc.en: Trained to survive against the harshest of elements, yet still but mere puppets to the masters they unwittingly serve.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼领主前往骸骨平原，并让一头僵尸龙成为了坐骑
desc.en: It is to the Plain of Bones that a Vampire Lord travels to claim a Zombie Dragon as their mount.

desc.zh: 夜行鬼怪躲避阳光，嗜血如命
desc.en: Nocturnal spectres hiding from the light, addicted to your blood.

desc.zh: 任何野兽都不可能完全听从指令，但这一鞭子至少能够带来最低限度的…顺从
desc.en: No beast can truly be controlled, but these desperate contrivances bring the smallest semblance of order.

desc.zh: 黑暗潜藏在我们每个人的体内，释放着我们的欲望与贪婪
desc.en: The darkness within us all, given free rein to lust and gorge eternally.

desc.zh: 『复苏吧，我的朋友们，复苏吧！血肉虽然可贵，但灵魂的价值却远超万物！』
desc.en: “Rise, my friends, rise. Flesh and blood has its place, but spirit is the prize valued above all other.”

desc.zh: 邪魔振翅飞翔，黑暗的翅膀遮住了月亮，呼唤我们随之共舞…
desc.en: Evil takes flight; blotting out the moon on blackened wings, calling us to the dance…

desc.zh: 重重地出击，精准地出击
desc.en: Strike hard, strike true.

desc.zh: 最让人印象深刻的梦魇兽是用鲜血作为饲料的。这种高贵的巨兽是理想的坐骑
desc.en: The most impressive Nightmares are those reared on fresh blood. Such noble monstrosities are worthy mounts.

desc.zh: 数世纪的光阴让这些古老的森林精魂拥有了天然的盔甲，可以削弱对它们袭来的任何物理攻击
desc.en: Centuries upon centuries of existence have given these ancient Tree Spirits a natural armour, mitigating any physical blows dealt against them.

desc.zh: 就让库诺斯的力量汇聚到每道闪电之上，为他的敌人带去死亡吧！
desc.en: Let each bolt be imbued with the strength of Kurnous, and bring death to all his enemies.

desc.zh: 无箭之人，怎可称为游侠？箭矢不足者，又怎可称为神射手？
desc.en: What is a ranger without an arrow? Who can be the best without dozens?

desc.zh: 每一把利刃与每一支倒刺长矛都会最终找到它的归宿——当它们找到的时候，敌人才会切身感受到森林无限的愤怒
desc.en: Every blade and barbed branch will eventually find its mark – when they do, the forest’s infinite anger is truly felt.

desc.zh: 这一护甲如同森林的远古硬皮般坚韧。那些能够轻易撕碎他人的攻击，却可以被它轻松挡开
desc.en: Armour as hard as the ancient bark of the forest, it repels blows that would rend others asunder.

desc.zh: 让敌人感受自然的愤怒吧！当这些战士冲垮敌人的阵线时，他们便是自然之怒的化身！
desc.en: Let the enemy feel the fury of nature, embodied in these warriors as they crash through their lines.

desc.zh: 森林里的骑士像风一样，呼啸着从树枝旁经过，他们追逐着任何想要伤害他们称之为家的地方的人
desc.en: Moving like the wind, whistling past tree branches, the riders of the forest hunt any who would do harm to the place they call home.

desc.zh: 勇士们奋斗不息，如摆动的树枝般强力，极少有人能够抵御如此强悍的攻击
desc.en: The warrior strikes with the strength of a swinging tree limb; few can stand against such strength.

desc.zh: 整个艾索洛伦都在咆哮着绵长久远的愤怒，敌人无不知晓它的力量
desc.en: All of Athel Loren shouts with a fury as old as the ages, and the enemy knows its power.

desc.zh: 并不是所有的森林守护者都是屹立在地面上的——即使敌人位于空中，也难逃那些森林空中卫士的追猎
desc.en: Not all of the forest's guardians are rooted to the ground – flying enemies will always be in danger from the woodland's airborne protectors.

desc.zh: 无止的战意催生了加宽处理的箭壶，它能让射手射出几乎无穷无尽的漫天箭雨
desc.en: Always willing to fight on, a widened quiver allows arrows to rain, almost without end.

desc.zh: 领主自森林中感悟着缕缕心绪，因此获得了战无不胜的伟力
desc.en: Taking their cue from the forest itself, the Lord endures and overcomes all.

desc.zh: 敌所未见，则必不可中；敌所未见，则必不得生
desc.en: What the enemy cannot see, it cannot hit. What the enemy cannot see, it cannot survive.

desc.zh: 射击，隐蔽；射击，再隐蔽；再射击，再隐蔽。这便是射手的心得
desc.en: Nook and fire. Nook again, and fire. Nook a third time, and fire. All in a heartbeat.

desc.zh: 这位领主得到了艾索洛伦的庇护，整座深林便是他的盾牌
desc.en: Using the forest itself as a shield, this Lord is protected by their devotion to Athel Loren.

desc.zh: 森林教会了战士们对射击时机与射击部位的掌握，这令他们变得卓尔不群
desc.en: The forest teaches a warrior not only when to fire but where, which makes a bigger difference.

desc.zh: 攻击、格挡、闪避之法，即是艾索洛伦子民们必须领悟的奥义
desc.en: When to strike, when to block, when to dodge. These are all skills the warriors of Athel Loren must perfect.

desc.zh: 立于战场之上，奉森林之名厮杀，实为至高之震撼
desc.en: There is no greater thrill than to be in the midst of battle, slaughtering in the forest's name.

desc.zh: 在天命之时，一只红冠灵蜥崛起于从丛林深处，并自称是索提戈此刻，也是同永远的神选
desc.en: At times of great import, a single Red Crested Skink emerges from the deep jungle, claiming the title of the once and future Prophet of Sotek.

desc.zh: 提克塔托是有史以来为蜥蜴人服务的最伟大的翼龙骑手，他大胆的特技为他赢得了『诸天之王』的称号
desc.en: The greatest Terradon rider to ever serve the Lizardmen, Tiktaq’to’s daring stunts earned him the title 'Master of Skies'.

name.zh: 莫斯基塔领主的『右獠牙』

desc.zh: 能够升至如此高位并不令人奇怪，因为很少会有其他的工程术士会像伊克特·利爪这样臭名昭著
desc.en: Rising to this position was inevitable, for no other Warlock Engineer is as influential as the infamous, devastating Ikit Claw.

name.en: The Spirit of the Venerable Lord Kroak

desc.zh: 克罗卡领主的力量便是第一世代史兰的力量，他与古圣的联系远远超过那些尚存的同族
desc.en: Lord Kroak's power is that of a First Generation Slann, his connection with the Old Ones far greater than any of his living kin.

desc.zh: 鼓舞人心，英勇无畏，此人是同族中真正的领袖
desc.en: Inspiring and ferocious, this one is a true leader of his kin.

desc.zh: 最伟大的战士莫不投奔这位领袖麾下，并甘心供其驱策
desc.en: The greatest warriors flock to this leader, desperate to serve at his side.

desc.zh: 无与伦比的战士，全身心致力于古圣们的伟业
desc.en: A peerless warrior, dedicated to the Old Ones' work.

desc.zh: 已死掉的东西，怎能被再次杀死呢？
desc.en: You cannot kill what's already dead.

name.en: Supreme Shield of the Old Ones

desc.zh: 这并不是一面普通的盾牌，其中流动着古圣体内的力量，能够让使用者抵御魔法攻击
desc.en: More than just a shield, this one channels the visceral power of the Old Ones to protect its bearer from magical attack.

desc.zh: 区区城墙而已，怎能挡住克罗卡抵达目标的步伐？
desc.en: Mere walls cannot prevent Kroak from reaching his target.

desc.zh: 在经历了激烈的体力与精力的消耗之后，能令自己迅速恢复状态的能力确实会相当重要
desc.en: After a great act of power and violence, the ability to quickly return to a state of grace is valuable indeed.

desc.zh: 克罗卡的古老血统让他得以建立一个强大的心灵感应链接，通过这个链接，命令得以传达，古圣的意志得以强化
desc.en: Kroak's ancient lineage provide a powerful telepathic link by which orders are conveyed and the Old Ones' will is reinforced.

desc.zh: 作为第一世代的史兰魔祭司，克罗卡懂得很多关于早已失传的魔法以及足以赢得战争的技术手段
desc.en: As one of the First Generation of Slann, Kroak knows much about long-forgotten magics and ingenious, war-winning technology thought obsolete.

name.en: Greater Ward of the Old Ones

desc.zh: 服务于大计划者，将获得古圣们通过各种术式赐予的保护
desc.en: Those who serve the Great Plan are afforded the Old Ones' protection via ancient incantations and bygone utterances.

desc.zh: 任何事物都不可阻拦克罗卡的征途，任何！
desc.en: Nothing shall - or could - stand in Kroak's way. Nothing.

desc.zh: 伟大的克罗卡领主召唤出了一个小小的太阳。有趣的是，它一旦爆炸，这里就会化为一片断壁残垣…
desc.en: Mighty Lord Kroak spawns a small sun that, when it explodes, causes abject devastation… funnily enough.

desc.zh: 伟大的克罗卡领主召唤出了一个小小的太阳。有趣的是，它一旦爆炸，这里就会化为一片断壁残垣…
desc.en: Mighty Lord Kroak spawns a small sun that, when it explodes, causes abject devastation… funnily enough.

desc.zh: 伟大的克罗卡领主召唤出了一个小小的太阳。有趣的是，它一旦爆炸，这里就会化为一片断壁残垣…
desc.en: Mighty Lord Kroak spawns a small sun that, when it explodes, causes abject devastation… funnily enough.

desc.zh: 它们是同类当中最为大型，最为残暴的个体。相比同类而言，最古老的三角龙拥有更厚的皮肤，更大的犄角
desc.en: Amongst the largest and most ferocious of their race, the eldest Stegadons have thicker hide and larger horns than others of their kind.

desc.zh: 即使是在露丝契亚，巨角冷蜥也是极端罕见、濒临灭绝的物种。它拥有超乎寻常的迅捷，远远超出了其它的冷蜥同类
desc.en: Very rare and virtually extinct, even in Lustria, the Horned One's preternatural swiftness puts it way ahead of other Cold Ones.

desc.zh: 独特而可怕的飞行爬行动物，无论是对骑乘者还是敌人都一样的危险！
desc.en: Unique and terrifying flying reptiles that are just as much a danger to their riders as the enemy!

desc.zh: 这可不只是个装饰品，你知道的！
desc.en: It's not just for decoration, you know!

desc.zh: 它们是同类当中最为大型，最为残暴的个体。相比同类而言，最古老的三角龙拥有更厚的皮肤，更大的犄角
desc.en: Amongst the largest and most ferocious of their race, the eldest Stegadons have thicker hide and larger horns than others of their kind.

desc.zh: 蜥蜴人的栖息地和生态系统应该得到妥善保护，抵挡来自外界与地下的攻击！
desc.en: The Lizardmen’s habitat and eco-system shall be guarded against attack from without… and below!

desc.zh: 此人极其敏捷，几乎达到了蜥人的水平
desc.en: So deft and agile is this one, they’ve almost reached Saurus levels of battle prowess.

desc.zh: 露丝契亚的神殿城市中矗立着很多伟大的建筑，它们均服务于古圣们的『大计划』的实现
desc.en: Lustria’s temple-cities contain many fine structures dedicated to the Old Ones that stand in service of the Great Plan.

desc.zh: 如果你掌握诀窍，那么大多数野兽都可被你驯服，并遵从于你的意志
desc.en: If you know the way, almost any beast can be tamed and set to one’s will.

desc.zh: 在正确的领导下，传统的蜥蜴人工人与技工可以被训练成高效的战士
desc.en: With the correct leadership, the Lizardmen’s traditional workers and artisans can be trained to fight effectively.

desc.zh: 同一孵化池所孵化的灵蜥会彼此契合，从而在战斗中有效地支援彼此
desc.en: Skinks spawned from the same pool are connected, strengthening and supporting each other in battle by their presence.

desc.zh: 它们是同类当中最为大型，最为残暴的个体。相比同类而言，最古老的三角龙拥有更厚的皮肤，更大的犄角
desc.en: Amongst the largest and most ferocious of their race, the eldest Stegadons have thicker hide and larger horns than others of their kind.

desc.zh: 只有最古老、最庞大、最凶猛的族类才能开动诸神引擎！
desc.en: Only the eldest, largest and most ferocious of their kind can move the Engines of the Gods!

desc.zh: 它们是同类当中最为大型，最为残暴的个体。相比同类而言，最古老的三角龙拥有更厚的皮肤，更大的犄角
desc.en: Amongst the largest and most ferocious of their race, the eldest Stegadons have thicker hide and larger horns than others of their kind.

desc.zh: 只有最古老、最庞大、最凶猛的族类才能开动诸神引擎！
desc.en: Only the eldest, largest and most ferocious of their kind can move the Engines of the Gods!

desc.zh: 特亨霍因不仅是一位出色的演说家，他还亲自率领军队穿越了露丝契亚，对鼠辈们发动了一场圣战
desc.en: More than just a fantastic orator, Tehenhauin leads his armies personally across Lustria in a crusade against the vermin parasites.

desc.zh: 起先是鼠辈，随后是瘟疫，但这一切都会随着斯卡文鼠人的灭绝而结束——他们并不在古圣的计划之中！
desc.en: First comes the vermin, then comes the plagues, but it will end with the eradication of the Skaven - for they play no part in the Old Ones' plans.

desc.zh: 特亨霍因的追随者们很清楚，如果他们意志动摇，那么露丝契亚将遭到怎样的厄运。他们必须将预言坚持到底
desc.en: Those who followed Tehenhauin knew the what would befall Lustria if they faltered. The prophecy must be seen through to the bitter end.

desc.zh: 索提戈的子嗣们蜂拥而至，响应着特亨霍因的召唤，这些邪恶的蛇形生物把战斗的潮流转向了对先知有利的方向
desc.en: Sotek's children swarm to Tehenhauin's call, vicious serpents that turn the tide of battle in the Prophet's favour.

desc.zh: 索提戈的预言谈到了毁灭，但也谈到了希望。随着鼠辈的威胁被根除，蜥蜴人将重建家园
desc.en: Sotek's prophecy spoke of ruin and destruction but also of hope; with the vermin menace eradicated, the Lizardmen would rebuild anew.

desc.zh: 为了实现预言并战胜对露丝契亚的偷袭，索提戈赋予了他的追随者巨大的力量
desc.en: To fulfil the prophecy and overcome the Skaven assault on Lustria, Sotek gifted great power to his followers.

desc.zh: 特亨霍因被他的追随者奉为偶像，他获得了整个露丝契亚最优秀的灵蜥战群的忠诚
desc.en: Idolised by his followers, Tehenhauin attracts the loyalty of some of the finest Skink spawnings in all of Lustria.

desc.zh: 蛇神的言语让许多灵蜥洞悉了特亨霍因的神圣事业
desc.en: Word of the Serpent-God has opened many Skinks’ eyes to Tehenhauin’s holy cause.

desc.zh: 只有最古老、最庞大、最凶猛的族类才能开动诸神引擎！
desc.en: Only the eldest, largest and most ferocious of their kind can move the Engines of the Gods!

desc.zh: 即使是在露丝契亚，巨角冷蜥也是极端罕见、濒临灭绝的物种。它拥有超乎寻常的迅捷，远远超出了其它的冷蜥同类
desc.en: Very rare and virtually extinct, even in Lustria, the Horned One's preternatural swiftness puts it way ahead of other Cold Ones.

desc.zh: 独特而可怕的飞行爬行动物，无论是对骑乘者还是敌人都一样的危险！
desc.en: Unique and terrifying flying reptiles that are just as much a danger to their riders as the enemy!

desc.zh: 作为诸天之主，提克塔托只会率领速度最快、适应性最强的飞行动物
desc.en: As Master of Skies, Tiktaq’to leads only the fastest and most resilient flying beasts.

desc.zh: 只有提克塔托亲手挑选的精兵，才能与他和兹瓦普并肩作战
desc.en: Only those Tiktaq’to picks by hand may fight alongside him and Zwup up in the skies above the battlefield.

desc.zh: 这颗附有魔法的圆球能够引发一场巨大的爆炸，从而眩晕敌人，减缓其速度，方便你料理
desc.en: This magical rock causes a rather large explosion that stuns enemies, slowing them down for the kill.

name.zh: 高级泰波克的坠落铁球

desc.zh: 这颗附有魔法的圆球能够引发一场巨大的爆炸，从而眩晕敌人，减缓其速度，方便你料理
desc.en: This magical rock causes a rather large explosion that stuns enemies, slowing them down for the kill.

desc.zh: 他对自己的能力充满信心，这使得提克塔托总是带头冲锋，常常一击即中
desc.en: His sheer confidence in his own abilities causes Tiktaq’to always to lead the charge, often claiming his prize with the first strike.

desc.zh: 提克塔托的速度与敏捷无人能比，他端坐在自己最为珍视的坐骑兹瓦普之上，率领着一支连死神也不放在眼里的翼龙中队
desc.en: With the utmost speed and agility, Tiktaq'to leads his death-defying Terradon squadron from atop his prized-specimen mount, Zwup.

desc.zh: 在无数的战斗中磨练了自己的感官之后，诸天之主会在最合适的时候发动进攻，他在突破敌人的防御的同时也会鼓舞自己的部队
desc.en: Having honed his senses through myriad battles, the Master of Skies strikes at the most opportune time, emboldening his forces whilst breaking the foe's guard.

desc.zh: 作为最伟大的灵蜥酋长之一，提克塔托以训练下一代灵蜥领袖为荣
desc.en: As one of the greatest Skink Chiefs to fight in service of the Old Ones, Tiktaq’to takes pride in training the next generation of Skink leaders.

desc.zh: 带有锋利爪子与尖锐喙嘴的危险掠食者，这些飞行爬虫非常敏捷，在很远的距离上便可锁定自己的猎物
desc.en: Dangerous predators with sharp talons and pointed beaks, these giant flying reptiles are surprisingly agile and can spot their prey at great distances.

desc.zh: 带有锋利爪子与尖锐喙嘴的危险掠食者，这些飞行爬虫非常敏捷，在很远的距离上便可锁定自己的猎物
desc.en: Dangerous predators with sharp talons and pointed beaks, these giant flying reptiles are surprisingly agile and can spot their prey at great distances.

desc.zh: 带有锋利爪子与尖锐喙嘴的危险掠食者，这些飞行爬虫非常敏捷，在很远的距离上便可锁定自己的猎物
desc.en: Dangerous predators with sharp talons and pointed beaks, these giant flying reptiles are surprisingly agile and can spot their prey at great distances.

desc.zh: 只有最古老、最庞大、最凶猛的族类才能开动诸神引擎！
desc.en: Only the eldest, largest and most ferocious of their kind can move the Engines of the Gods!

desc.zh: 只有最古老、最庞大、最凶猛的族类才能开动诸神引擎！
desc.en: Only the eldest, largest and most ferocious of their kind can move the Engines of the Gods!

desc.zh: 没有什么东西是不可战胜的，就连超凡的恐惧也是如此
desc.en: There's nothing that cannot be conquered, even perfidious, duplicitous, treacherous fear.

desc.zh: 次元能量在跳动，他的血管里充满了能量。如果能量的刻度是从1到10，那么此人的工作刻度怕是11！
desc.en: Warp-energy is pulsing - through his veins a charge is racing. On a scale of one to ten, this one's operating on eleven!

desc.zh: 此人会永远搜寻自己所需之物，永远寻找自己的研究所需的资源
desc.en: This one harvests what he needs, forever on a quest to acquire the 'resources' made necessary by his research.

desc.zh: 尽管他的行事方式有些疯狂，但他仍然会一边探索一边修正，以便令整个行进过程尽可能地避免问题的出现
desc.en: Although in a somewhat ad-hoc fashion, he nevertheless fixes things as he goes, managing to avoid more than a a few scrapes in the process already.

desc.zh: 拿来杀人的话，这玩意能让你多快好省
desc.en: If you could once kill with it, this one can make it kill again, more and better.

desc.zh: 此人的天赋使他们能够胜任建筑技术工作，确保重要的建筑在需要时基本保持直立
desc.en: This one's natural talents lend themselves to the technical side of construction, ensuring vital buildings stay mostly upright when they are required to do so.

desc.zh: 锋利的、能把人掏空的旋转死亡之球，它被设计成能以地狱般的力量冲破敌人的防线
desc.en: A motorised ball of whirling, razor-sharp, eviscerating death, designed to plough through enemy lines with hellish vigour.

desc.zh: 那些第一眼看到这台强大的战争机器却露出微笑的对手，显然不知道接下来会有什么砸到他们头上！
desc.en: Those opponents who smile at first sight of this powerful war machine clearly have no idea what's about to hit them!

desc.zh: 这种高级盔甲注入了最纯粹的次元能量，使它比斯卡文鼠人使用的其他防护装备更加强大
desc.en: This advanced armour is infused with purest Warp-energy, making it more powerful than other protective measures employed by the Skaven.

desc.zh: 与他握手？嫌手多吗，朋友！
desc.en: Shake his hand? You'd better count your limbs, my friend!

desc.zh: 伊克特以其将魔法与机械技术相结合的能力而闻名。因此，这种多层缠绕装甲提供的保护远不止是额外的衬垫那么简单
desc.en: Ikit is famed for his ability to mix magic with mechanical technology; this multi-layered Warp-infused armour affords far more protection than merely extra padding, therefore.

desc.zh: 极其有趣，绝对会让敌人大吃一惊，但如果这玩意在空中忽然熄火，那就成了真正的噩梦！
desc.en: Enormous fun, and guaranteed to surprise the foe, but a proper nightmare when it cuts out mid-air!

desc.zh: 伊克特会通过各种各样的发明来提防自己潜在的健康问题，这些发明可以很容易地治愈疾病，确保他总是处于最佳状态
desc.en: Ikit is alerted to potential health issues by his multifarious inventions, by which ailments can easily be cured, ensuring he is always in peak condition.

desc.zh: 『现在我浑身充满力量，整只鼠要上天啦！是的、是的、是的、是的！！！』
desc.en: "Power surge now, exploding through, yes-yes-yes-YES!!!!!!"

desc.zh: 当心那些在战斗中重新振作起来的人，以免形势逆转！
desc.en: Be wary of one who can renergise himself in the middle of the battle, lest the tide be turned!

desc.zh: 次元能量在跳动，他的血管里充满了能量。如果能量的刻度是从1到10，那么此人的工作刻度怕是11！
desc.en: Warp-energy is pulsing - through his veins a charge is racing. On a scale of one to ten, this one's operating on eleven!

desc.zh: 授业总是会伴随风险，推进别人的事业很快会为自己掘下坟墓。然而，若是能将有成就的学生拉进你的团队，就能有效避免这种风险
desc.en: Treachery is always a risk; advancing others' careers can quickly become a fatal mistake. However, having accomplished students in your team can outweigh the dangers.

desc.zh: 这项新改良的设备可以升级伊克特的早先发明，从而大大增强它的工作效率
desc.en: This new and improved device upgrades Ikit's earlier invention for maximum efficiency.

desc.zh: 你可以用最优质的武器来让你感到欣慰，但只有经过与同样致命的敌人面对面的实弹检验的武器，才是最好的武器！
desc.en: You can tweak and prime weapons to your heart's content, but there remains no substitute for a live ammunition test against an equally-murderous foe!

desc.zh: 生产线的低效引发了伊克特的不满，因此他改良了自己的斯卡文工坊来更快、更好地量产自己的发明
desc.en: Finding assembly lines inefficient and therefore unsatisfactory, Ikit organises his Skaven workforce to manufacture his designs faster and better than the competition.

desc.zh: 当末日最终到来的时候，这个人就会出现在那里，像个疯狂至极的科学家一样咯咯地笑
desc.en: When the end finally comes, this one will be there, cackling like the supremely mad scientist he is.

desc.zh: 无尽力量可将已经完全破坏的事物破坏得更为彻底
desc.en: Unlimited power corrupts the already-totally-corrupted utterly.

desc.zh: 锋利的、能把人掏空的旋转死亡之球，它被设计成能以地狱般的力量冲破敌人的防线
desc.en: A motorised ball of whirling, razor-sharp, eviscerating death, designed to plough through enemy lines with hellish vigour.

desc.zh: 那些第一眼看到这台强大的战争机器却露出微笑的对手，显然不知道接下来会有什么砸到他们头上！
desc.en: Those opponents who smile at first sight of this powerful war machine clearly have no idea what's about to hit them!

desc.zh: 沾满剧毒的铜球，其毒性足以将敌人无情卷入痛苦与死亡的湍流漩涡之中
desc.en: Possession of this orb enables the user to inexorably drag the foe into a turbulent vortex of pain and death.

desc.zh: 马库斯·沃法特高超的追踪和杀戮技巧为他赢得了声誉，也赢得了卡尔·弗兰兹本人的认可
desc.en: Markus Wulfhart's advanced tracking and slaying skills have earned him both a reputation and the recognition of Karl Franz himself.

desc.zh: 哥罗克发誓要保护他的孵化之地，蜥蜴人神圣的首座城市伊塔扎不受任何来客的侵扰
desc.en: Gor-Rok has sworn to protect his spawning-home, the Lizardmen's sacred First City of Itza, from any and all comers.

desc.zh: 纳卡伊被尊为丛林的活化身，他是一只远古巨蜥，无论何时何地受到威胁，他都必须保卫露丝契亚
desc.en: Revered as the living embodiment of the jungle, Nakai is an ancient Kroxigor compelled to defend Lustria wherever and whenever it is threatened.

desc.zh: 为了保卫未来，赫特维希决心净化这个世界的无数杂质
desc.en: In defence of the future, Hertwig is resolved to cleanse the world of its myriad impurities.

desc.zh: 此人可以跟踪最细微的迹象，最微小的标记，无论敌人如何隐藏它们
desc.en: This one can follow the smallest of signs, the slightest of marks, no matter how well hidden the trail.

desc.zh: 当他们东倒西歪、面目全非的时候，也许敌人会为他们向帝国开战而后悔？
desc.en: As they careen and stagger about, their flesh irreparably charred beyond recognition, perhaps the foe will rue the day they made war on the Empire?

desc.zh: 『当心，你们这些肮脏堕落的野兽，你们的末日就要到了！』
desc.en: "Beware, ye foul, fell beasties, for your very doom approacheth!"

desc.zh: 可能这很残酷，但是当你想要确保获胜时，将敌人烧成灰烬的能力是非常有用的
desc.en: It may be cruel, but the power to burn the foe to ash is extremely useful when you want to be sure of winning.

desc.zh: 这些箭当然可以猎杀敌人，但主要用来造成混乱，引发炸群，使敌人精神崩溃
desc.en: These arrows will kill of course, but are mainly used to cause a disorientating, explosive spectacle to unnerve the enemy.

desc.zh: 沉默、敏捷，非常、非常地致命。这个人可以毫不费力地在射程内猎杀敌人，并且不暴露他的位置
desc.en: Silent, swift and very, very deadly, this one can take down the foe from range without breaking a sweat or revealing his position.

desc.zh: 刺穿皮肤，击杀灵魂
desc.en: Through the skin to kill the soul.

desc.zh: 只有蠢货，才会在没有补给和板上钉钉的计划时继续狩猎
desc.en: Only the foolish go on the hunt without supplies and a cast-iron plan.

desc.zh: 这种高超的射击技巧往往会令下属们士气大振
desc.en: Such advanced ballistic skills tend to rub off on one's subordinates.

desc.zh: 越多，越致命，越令人开心
desc.en: The more, the deadlier, the merrier.

desc.zh: 那些猎人将军附近的将士，会因他的防守能力与压力下的冷静态度而备受鼓舞
desc.en: Those close to a Huntsman General benefit from his defensive capabilities and cool demeanour under pressure.

desc.zh: 在帝国森林中狩猎了整整一生，这使得此人可以在战场上直面多种不同的猎物
desc.en: A lifetime spent hunting in the Imperial forests primes one to face a different kind of prey across the battlefield.

desc.zh: 知道哪些树叶、树根、浆果和蘑菇可以安全食用，哪些会让你死得不干不净，这是战役中的一个明显优势
desc.en: Knowing which leaves, roots, berries and mushrooms can be safely eaten, and which will kill you stone dead, is a distinct advantage on campaign.

desc.zh: 杰瑞克是个技艺高超的工程师，他能够很容易地发现并最大程度地利用自己可用的资源
desc.en: Jorek is a highly-skilled Engineer, capable of seeking out and making the best use of the resources available to him.

desc.zh: 说到生存的艺术，怕是无人能比得上卡劳娜久经磨炼的能力
desc.en: When it comes to the art of survival, there's no one who can match Kalara's finely-honed abilities.

desc.zh: 罗德里克花了很多时间在古墓和破庙中挖掘，对贵重物品有着敏锐的鉴赏力
desc.en: Having spent much of his time delving through archaic crypts and ruined temples, Rodrik has a keen eye for valuables.

desc.zh: 熊、兽人、巨蜥，猎物的大小并不是猎人大师的障碍
desc.en: Bears, Orcs, Kroxigor - prey-size is not a hindrance to the master hunter.

desc.zh: 这种传统捕兽器工具是用金属丝做成的套索；如果猎物挣扎，它就会越缩越紧，直至刺进肉中
desc.en: This traditional trapper's tool is a noose made from wire; if the foe struggles, it simply tightens, cutting into the flesh.

desc.zh: 当你的目标几乎没有逃跑的希望时，你就没有必要匆匆忙忙的了
desc.en: There’s no need to rush when your target has little prospect of escape.

desc.zh: 沃法特认为，毫不犹豫地消灭皇帝的敌人，这正是他宣誓履行的职责
desc.en: Wulfhart considers it his sworn duty to dispatch the Emperor's enemies without the slightest hesitation.

desc.zh: 卡尔·弗兰兹的侦察兵队长是同僚当中最优秀的存在：一位真正举世无双的猎人
desc.en: Karl Franz's Captain of Scouts is the very best in his field; a hunter truly without peer.

desc.zh: 马库斯·沃法特似乎要把他周围的空气都压弯了：箭矢与刀剑相交的那一刻，似乎也只是须臾之间
desc.en: Markus Wulfhart seems to almost bend the air around him – arrows and blades just seem to glance off, if they even connect.

desc.zh: 米登领浓密黑暗的森林是最无情、最不适宜居住的训练场，也是沃法特完善生存技能的地方
desc.en: The dense, dark forest of Middenland is the most unforgiving, inhospitable of training grounds, and the place where Wulfhart perfected his survival skills.

desc.zh: 理所当然，最好的猎人就是精英伏击者和散兵战士
desc.en: As you might expect, the very best hunters make for elite ambushers and skirmishers.

desc.zh: 眨眼，你就会死
desc.en: Blink and you'll probably be dead.

desc.zh: 夺去他们的眼睛，他们就不能射击了
desc.en: Deprive them of their eyes and they cannot shoot back.

desc.zh: 沃法特是迄今旧世界中最成功的怪物猎人和杀手
desc.en: Wulfhart is by far the most successful monster hunter and slayer anywhere in the Old World.

desc.zh: 往事不肯停留在原地，反而像一根刺扎在他的肋旁，使他心烦意乱
desc.en: The past refuses to stay in its place, and bothers Hertwig like a thorn buried in his side.

desc.zh: 杰瑞克天生聪颖，这让他总能先人一步
desc.en: Jorek's innate intellect means that, generally speaking, he is generally ahead of the curve.

desc.zh: 卡劳娜行动迅捷，几乎难以目击，目的明确，动作敏捷
desc.en: Kalara moves swiftly, almost unseen, with a sleekness of purpose as well as motion.

desc.zh: 他的大部分时间都住在丛林里，这里就像他的家一样
desc.en: Having spent most of his time living in the jungle, this feels like home.

desc.zh: 较低的体温，意味着蜥蜴人可以在相对较小的物种无法生存的环境中正常活动
desc.en: A low body temperature means the Lizardmen can operate normally in environments which would overwhelm lesser races.

desc.zh: 敌人哪儿也去不快——事实上，他们哪儿也去不了！
desc.en: The enemy aren't going anywhere fast – in fact, they're not going anywhere at all!

desc.zh: 能够让敌人慢下来，消耗他们的体力和战斗意志，这是一种强大的力量
desc.en: Being able to slow the foe, drain it of energy and the will to fight on, is a mighty power to wield.

desc.zh: 只有顽强的决心才能使一个人活上几个世纪之久
desc.en: Dogged determination alone can keep one alive for centuries.

desc.zh: 冷静地考虑目标，因为它会在短短一秒内以速度和侵略性发动攻击，这就是爬行动物的标志
desc.en: Cold consideration of the target, for just a second before it attacks with speed and aggression, are the mark of the reptile.

desc.zh: 在巨蜥面前，那些较小、较弱的种族非常容易受到惊吓
desc.en: Smaller, weaker races frighten easily afore the size and aggression of the Kroxigor.

desc.zh: 岩石般坚硬的肌肉和锋利的牙齿，再加上坚韧的肉质护甲，这使得巨蜥在战斗中几乎坚不可摧
desc.en: Rock-hard muscles and razor-sharp teeth bolstered by a tough, fleshy screen make the Kroxigor almost indestructible in battle.

desc.zh: 死神肯定会用锋利的尖牙等着你！
desc.en: Death surely awaits you with sharp and pointy teeth!

desc.zh: 必须要有人来保证新兵的数量和质量
desc.en: Someone has to ensure the numbers and quality of recruits remain high.

desc.zh: 必须要有人来保证新兵的数量和质量
desc.en: Someone has to ensure the numbers and quality of recruits remain high.

desc.zh: 蜥蜴人神圣的首座城市的领主可以召唤他的后代来为露丝契亚战斗
desc.en: A Lord from the Lizardmen's hallowed First City can summon his spawn-kin to battle in Lustria's defence.

desc.zh: 与那些可怜的对手不同，大白蜥的耐力几乎是无穷无尽的
desc.en: The stamina of the Great White Lizard is almost inexhaustible, unlike that of his pitiful opponents.

desc.zh: 这是蜥人战线向前推进的坚实中心，也是碾碎伊塔扎敌人的岩石
desc.en: The solid centre around which the Saurus battle lines advance, and the rock on which Itza's enemies are broken.

desc.zh: 『尊敬的古圣们，指引我的利爪，复苏我的亲族吧！』
desc.en: "Venerable Old Ones, guide my claw and restore my kin!"

desc.zh: 绝不后退，绝不投降。凝视深渊
desc.en: Never retreat, never surrender. Stare hard into the abyss.

desc.zh: 作为完全为战争和屠杀敌人而设计的战斗机器，哥罗克总是在战斗最激烈的地方出现
desc.en: A fighting machine, wholly purposed for war and the slaughtering of enemies, Gor-Rok can always be found where the fighting is thickest.

desc.zh: 他是同类中最伟大、最著名的战士，独自诞生的哥罗克满身独特的色彩马上预示着他就是未来的冠军勇士
desc.en: The greatest and most renowned of his kind, Gor-Rok's lone spawning and distinctive colouring immediately marked him as a future champion.

desc.zh: 年轻的史兰参涉凡世事务的决心尚未被岁月消磨。当混沌威胁迫近时，他们总能更快苏醒并投身战争
desc.en: Younger Slann’s determination to involve themselves in worldly affairs has not yet been dampened by age. They are faster to rouse themselves to war when Chaos looms.

desc.zh: 这一世代的史兰是强大的魔法使用者，他们可以随心所欲地驾驭魔法之风
desc.en: Slann of this spawning generation are powerful magic-users able to command the Winds of Magic to their will.

desc.zh: 第三代史兰虽不愿在传道时起身，却仍未丧失向眷族传授浩瀚智慧的兴致
desc.en: Slann of the Third Generation have not yet lost their interest in imparting their vast wisdom to their cohorts, though they would rather not stand up while doing so.

desc.zh: 在丛林中生活就意味着会懂得何种植物可以疗伤，何种植物吃下后会中毒身亡
desc.en: Life in the jungle means knowing the difference between which flora can heal and what, if ingested, will kill you.

desc.zh: 纳卡伊的出现表明一场非常重要的战斗即将发生
desc.en: Nakai's very presence indicates that a battle of great importance will soon occur.

desc.zh: 如此多的混沌恶魔被纳卡伊所杀，以至于这些家伙都不敢与他走在同一条路上
desc.en: So many Daemons of Chaos have been slain by Nakai that such entities fear to tread the same ground as him.

desc.zh: 慢慢地，小心地，这条蛇展开了身体，然后突然如闪电般发动了袭击，它的尖牙尽可能地咬住了它的猎物
desc.en: Slowly, carefully, the serpent uncoils, before striking suddenly – like lightning – and sinking its fangs as far as they will go.

desc.zh: 古老的纳卡伊被尊为丛林精魂的化身，它是首批诞生者中的最后一位，心怀古圣长久的愤怒而战
desc.en: Revered as a jungle-spirit made manifest, ancient Nakai is the last of the First Spawning, and fights with the Old Ones' long-dormant fury.

desc.zh: 纳卡伊受到了灵蜥祭司们的尊重，当他从战斗中归来时，他们会用仪式上的纪念品来装饰他那巨大的、伤痕累累的身体
desc.en: Nakai is treated with deference by the Skink Priests, who adorn his massive, battle-scarred body with ceremonial tokens when he returns from the fray.

desc.zh: 这个蜥蜴人种族的强大保护者发誓要前往任何大计划需要他的地方
desc.en: This mighty protector of the Lizardmen race is pledged to go wherever the Great Plan deems it necessary for him to be.

desc.zh: 岩石般坚硬的肌肉和锋利的牙齿，再加上坚韧的肉质护甲，这使得巨蜥在战斗中几乎坚不可摧
desc.en: Rock-hard muscles and razor-sharp teeth bolstered by a tough, fleshy screen make the Kroxigor almost indestructible in battle.

desc.zh: 死神肯定会用锋利的尖牙等着你！
desc.en: Death surely awaits you with sharp and pointy teeth!

desc.zh: 常理来说，巨大如小岛般的身躯很不利于隐蔽，但法师们精心设置的误导咒术却使之变成了可能
desc.en: One would imagine being the size of a small island would hinder stealth. The sorcerers weaving spells of misdirection in the hold would beg to differ.

desc.zh: 身材魁梧的人更容易鼓舞别人，只要看到他们就会让同袍们勇气倍增
desc.en: Men of great size and stature have an easier time inspiring others, the mere sight of them instilling courage in their brethren.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 亨利特制的锁子甲的铁片密度高得令人难以置信，这无疑会让比他更轻，更小的人们感到无从下手
desc.en: The impossibly dense iron of Henri’s custom-built chainmail would undoubtedly weigh down lesser – and smaller – men than he.

desc.zh: 凶残的野兽，无论面对人类还是龙族，都将为捍卫领地而不惜战至最后一息！
desc.en: Fierce beasts that will fight to the death any who enter their territory – be they man or Dragon!

desc.zh: 『伟岸者』亨利独特的美德使他可以不屈不挠地面对最为庞大、最为可怕的敌人
desc.en: Henri le Massif’s unique virtues make him almost indomitable in the face of the largest and most fearsome abominations.

desc.zh: 『亡灵天灾必须毁灭，这是女神的旨意！』
desc.en: “The Undead scourge must be destroyed. The Lady hath spoken.”

desc.zh: 苏勒曼曾是匹无主战马，它的前任主人是位阵亡的骑士，如今它却载着赫潘丝登上战场，勇敢地冲在了楔形阵的最尖端
desc.en: Commandeered as a rider-less warhorse of a slain Knight, Suleman boldly charges Repanse into battle at the apex of her feared lance formation.

desc.zh: 在勇敢的人眼里，危险像阳光一样闪烁
desc.en: In the eyes of the brave, danger gleams like sunshine.

desc.zh: 如果你想找到敌人，你只需要扔一块石头
desc.en: If you wish to find an enemy, you need merely throw a stone.

desc.zh: 荣誉和纯洁是义士的翅膀，使他们飞得比别人更高
desc.en: Honour and purity are the wings with which the righteous soar above their peers.

desc.zh: 『扔掉剑，拿起犁，这些土地现在是我们的了！』
desc.en: "Toss down your blade and pick up the plough, these lands are ours now!"

desc.zh: 骑士、农民、以及每一个居于他们之中的阶级，皆以为自己有义务追随赫潘丝走向死亡或荣耀
desc.en: Knights, peasants, and everyone in between feel honour-bound to follow Repanse to death or glory.

desc.zh: 驯兽师们亦有其下仆的嗜战天性，他们会用鞭子、长矛和鱼叉剁翻敌人，然后把敌人抽搐的尸体当做饲料
desc.en: Beastmasters share their minions’ belligerence, cutting down foemen with lash, spear, and harpoon before claiming their twitching bodies as fodder.

desc.zh: 苏勒赫死后，她的子嗣们继续以为死去祖先复仇的名义奋战在驯兽师的行伍里
desc.en: Since Sulekh’s death, her children continue to fight in the Beastmasters’ ranks in the name of vengeance for their fallen ancestor.

desc.zh: 大部分高阶驯兽师都拥有与生俱来的强悍力量与意志，足以胜任将最顽劣的冷蜥驯化为战争坐骑的任务
desc.en: The strength and willpower required to break in the extremely stubborn Cold One reptiles as war steeds is innately abundant in most High Beastmasters.

desc.zh: 把愤怒的血骸美杜莎从肮脏的地下巢穴中径直酣斗出来，这可不是胆小鬼能干的活！
desc.en: The wrangling of the wrathful Bloodwrack Medusae directly from their squalid subterranean lairs is not a job for the faint-hearted.

desc.zh: 这与野兽的本性无关：所有生物都最终要么屈服于驯兽师的意志，要么被他鞭笞至死
desc.en: It matters not the nature of the beast; eventually, all submit to the Beastmaster’s will or perish under his lash.

desc.zh: 对于驯兽师来说，陆地和海洋中最庞大的怪物乃是无价之宝，需要庞大的同理心方可驯化
desc.en: The most colossal monsters of land and sea are prizes beyond treasures to the Beastmaster, requiring colossal empathy to control.

desc.zh: 驯兽师的龙筋鞭粗壮多齿，骇人地噼啪作响，轻易地令野兽们怒气冲冲，跃跃欲战
desc.en: The startling crack of the Beastmaster’s hefty and ever-so-slightly serrated whip of Dragon-sinew suitably infuriates the beasts for battle.

desc.zh: 蝎尾狮的咆哮绝对能让凡间之物闻之而遁，因为他们知道，一只可怕的生物出现了
desc.en: The roar of a Manticore is guaranteed to send mortals fleeing, for they know a creature of terror is abroad.

desc.zh: 黑暗精灵的驯兽师乘着可怕的战车在荒野中游荡，他们使用装有倒钩的网和标枪来杀死敌人并诱捕猎物
desc.en: Dark Elf Beastmasters roam the wilds atop their dreaded chariots, armed with barbed nets and harpoons to slay the foe and ensnare their prey.

desc.zh: 杜鲁齐与动物的亲密关系保证了野兽大军莫不听命于他们的号令
desc.en: The honing of a Druchii's affinity with animals assures that the bestial ranks heed his imperious command with obedience.

desc.zh: 这头叫做『怨毒』的冷蜥比自己绝大多数的同族都大，它与马鲁斯·黑刃这样铁石心肠的屠杀者相得益彰
desc.en: Larger than most others of its kind, the ferocious Cold One named 'Spite' is truly a creature fit for a heartless murderer like Malus Darkblade.

desc.zh: 他是超自然的生物，最为黑暗的种族中的最异类者。若是在战斗中目睹此辈，便会在人类与精灵的心中激起一种原始的恐惧
desc.en: He is unnatural; an aberrant of the darkest kind. To lay eyes upon him in battle stirs a primal fear in the hearts of men and Elves alike.

desc.zh: 『毁灭之王来找你了！前进吧，地下的野兽！』
desc.en: "The Lord of Ruin is coming for you. Onwards, beast of the deep earth!"

desc.zh: 『憎恨之下，万物皆允』
desc.en: "With hate, all things are possible."

desc.zh: 不眠之夜令海格·葛雷夫领主有时间邪恶而有效地处理繁琐事务。比如说税收，是的，税收…
desc.en: Sleepless nights afford the Lord of Hag Graef time to viciously and efficiently tackle tedious matters. Like taxes, always taxes...

desc.zh: 每一刻的沉默都只是一场屠杀的开始
desc.en: Every moment of silence is but a slaughter yet begun.

desc.zh: 每抿上一口炼金药，都会残酷地提醒他自己已经变成了什么样子
desc.en: Each sip of the elixir is a harsh reminder of what he has become.

desc.zh: 马鲁斯不会流血，也不会感到疼痛。这种肉体的上的感触早已消失殆尽了
desc.en: Malus does not bleed, nor feel pain. Such expressions of the flesh have long since fallen away.

desc.zh: 身体上的创伤是可以忽视的，因为它们是非物质也无关紧要的
desc.en: Wounds of the body can be unmade, for they are immaterial and insignificant.

desc.zh: 『如果没有其他的，黑刃，你可以使用尽可能多的暴力来应对逆境』
desc.en: “If nothing else, Malus Darkblade, you can be counted on to react to adversity with as much violence as is physically possible."

desc.zh: 纳迦罗斯土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着杜鲁齐们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Naggaroth, tempted from their damp, warm caves to bear the Druchii to battle.

desc.zh: 绚丽的战车，它们是献给那些在战场上表现出献身精神、勇敢品质与高超武艺的勇士的礼物
desc.en: Magnificent chariots, gifted to those who have impressed with their devotion, bravery and prowess in battle.

desc.zh: 被腐蚀的飞马从混沌荒原向南飞到了纳迦罗斯的钢铁山脉，并在那里筑起了巢
desc.en: The corrupted Dark Pegasi fly south from the Chaos Wastes to Naggaroth's Iron Mountains to make their nests.

desc.zh: 它们已不再是真正的马匹，因为黑魔法已腐蚀了这些最优秀的精灵战马，并将其转化成了体侧黝黑的杀手
desc.en: True horses no longer, Dark Magic corrupts the finest Elven steeds and turns them into black-flanked killers.

desc.zh: 将高贵者与卑微者区分开来的，往往是对自己独特的热情和抱负的傲慢追求
desc.en: It is often the arrogant pursuit of their own unique enthusiasms and ambitions that distinguishes the noble-born from the low-born.

desc.zh: 那些有着最黑暗、最自私的野心的人总能找到一种方式将其实现
desc.en: Those with darkest, most self-serving ambitions will always find a way to see them through to fruition.

desc.zh: 在杜鲁齐社会中，获取任何位置都是强大力量的体现，因为这个种族不能容忍也不会冒险让弱者存在下去
desc.en: Reaching any position of power is an indication of great strength in Druchii society, for they do not tolerate nor risk a weakling’s presence.

desc.zh: 『人类王国绝不能陷落，我们的命运与之交织，如果他们陷落，我们也将步其后尘。因为这个原因，我教出了他们的第一批魔法大师；也是因为这个原因，虽然他们很野蛮，但我们绝不能抛弃人类』
desc.en: "The Realms of Man must not fall. Our fate is intertwined with theirs, and if they fall, so too do we. For this reason, I taught their first masters of magic, and for this reason, we must not abandon Men, despite their barbarous ways."

desc.zh: 黑色方舟由杜鲁齐掌舵，像他们的铁城墙一样坚不可摧
desc.en: Black Arks are helmed by Druchii as indomitable and unbreakable as their iron ramparts.

desc.zh: 亨利来自北巴托尼亚，他是个如同山峦一般高大的人类，特别擅长对抗大型对手，尤其是那些所能想见的最危险、最恐怖的野兽！
desc.en: Hailing from northern Bretonnia, Henri is as much mountain as man, and an expert when fighting large opponents, especially the most dangerous, horrifying beasts imaginable!

desc.zh: 对于巴托尼亚的小民来说，赫潘丝是他们的捍卫者，是希望的灯塔，否则他们的生活将成为无望的、受压迫的苦役
desc.en: To the smallfolk of Bretonnia, Repanse is their champion – a beacon of hope in what would otherwise be lives of hopeless, downtrodden drudgery.

desc.zh: 海格·葛雷夫最伟大的暴君是纳迦罗斯的传奇人物，杰出的战士和令人畏惧的领袖，他的仇恨可以驱使他战胜任何对手
desc.en: Hag Graef’s greatest tyrant is legendary in Naggaroth; an exceptional warrior and feared leader whose hatred can drive him to overcome any opposition.

desc.zh: 不管目标是什么，斯尼奇总能找到接近目标的方法。不管夜之领主的动机如何，死亡大师总是能实现他的主人的意志
desc.en: Regardless of the mark, Snikch always finds a way to get close. Regardless of the Nightlord’s motives, the Deathmaster always sees his master's will done.

desc.zh: 有些人学到了从阴影中绽放死亡艺术的能力。要小心这些家伙的武器…
desc.en: Beware the concealed weaponry of those trained in the art of delivering death from the shadows…

desc.zh: 那些通晓震旦兵法的艾辛氏族成员寥寥无几，他们利用自己学到的秘密深化了这个种族的恶意
desc.en: Those of Eshin knowledgeable in the Cathayan art of war are few and far between, using their learned secrets to advance their brood’s malevolence.

desc.zh: 创新的东方盔甲装配技术使得术士们在敌人的攻击范围内获得了些微的抵抗能力
desc.en: Innovative eastern techniques of armour assembly make it slightly less dangerous for the Sorcerer to be in range of their enemies’ attacks.

desc.zh: 当这枚炸弹爆炸时会喷出黑色的烟幕，遮住希望隐藏自己的军队并让其他人难以呼吸
desc.en: When a bomb is smashed, a dark smoke curls out, concealing those who wish to hide and choking everyone else.

desc.zh: 这是远东地区的发明与史库里氏族独创性的奇妙结合，这种爆裂炸弹将惊人的爆炸力容纳在了一个小小的包裹里
desc.en: A curious combination of far east invention and Skryre ingenuity, the Cracklebomb contains staggering explosive power in a small package.

desc.zh: 『惊不惊喜？意不意外？杀！』
desc.en: "Kill-Surprise!"

desc.zh: 『你小命已经没了！人类玩意！』
desc.en: "You are already kill-dead, man-thing!"

desc.zh: 其他大多数氏族都在努力寻找耐心来处理『文书工作』——这是艾辛氏族无情利用的另一个弱点！
desc.en: Most of the other clans struggle to find the patience to deal with such things as 'paperwork' – another weakness that Clan Eshin ruthlessly exploits!

desc.zh: 斯尼奇在他的受害者旁边留下了他独特的鲜血标记，这样其他人就会知道死亡大师来了，并就此生活在致命的恐惧中
desc.en: Snikch leaves his distinctive symbol traced in blood beside his victims, so others will know the Deathmaster is abroad, and live in mortal dread.

desc.zh: 事实证明，谋杀对象越重要，他们就越有可能携带一些值得『盗用』的东西
desc.en: As it turns out, the more important the murder, the more likely they are to be carrying something worth 'appropriating'.

desc.zh: 斯尼奇以与身为斯卡文鼠人毫不相称的专注潜行于战场之中，直到它露出自己的杀戮本质
desc.en: With almost un-Skaven-like focus, Snikch moves unseen through the battlefield until the moment of murderous truth.

desc.zh: 就其本质而言，擅长杀戮需要你同样擅长于不要死掉
desc.en: By its very nature, being good at killing requires that you are equally adept at not dying.

desc.zh: 所有的种族都有软弱的时候——当他们转过身去，而他们的朋友正看向错误方向的时候
desc.en: All races have moments of weakness – times when their back is turned and their friends are looking the wrong way.

desc.zh: 谁都不能击中不在那里的东西
desc.en: They cannot hit what isn't there.

desc.zh: 斯尼奇已经反复证明，任何围墙、任何城堡、任何隐藏起来的洞穴都无法把你从他的泣泪剑中拯救出来
desc.en: Time and time again, Snikch has proven that no wall, no castle and no hidden hole will save you from his Weeping Blades.

desc.zh: 艾辛刺客是利用稍纵即逝的弱点的专家。从黑暗中奋身而来，用神秘的技巧了断生命
desc.en: Eshin Assassins are experts are exploiting the briefest vulnerabilities. Bursting out of the darkness to end lives with uncanny skill.

desc.zh: 斯卡文鼠人枪法随缘，拳法无力，但艾辛刺客却能掌握这两种技艺！
desc.en: The Skaven are renowned for their cheap shots and sucker punches, but the Assassins of Eshin are masters of both!

desc.zh: 在大多数情况下都毫无偏差，刺客大师的训练就是一场火的洗礼
desc.en: Make no mistake – in most cases, a Master Assassin’s training is quite literally a baptism of fire.

desc.zh: 『剁了他们，混蛋！』
desc.en: "Chop 'em up, you gitz!"

desc.zh: 『这是俺的大砍砍！大砍砍哪儿都有，但俺这把最中！』
desc.en: "Dis ere's my choppa. Dere's many like it, but dis one is mine!"

desc.zh: 『除非俺让你去死了，你他妈才能去死！』
desc.en: "YOU'ZE NOT DEAD 'TIL I SAYS YOU ARE!!!"

desc.zh: 『你怕那些毛崽子？俺得让你瞅瞅，啥玩意才算可怕！』
desc.en: "You scared of dem gits? I’ll give ya somefink ta be scared of!"

desc.zh: 『你觉着靠点尖棍子就能挡住俺？扯你的搞毛蛋！』
desc.en: "If you fink some pointy spearz iz gonna stop me, den you'ze dead wrong."

desc.zh: 『长官！有一只绿皮踹营来了！』\n\n『就…就一只？』
desc.en: "Sir, there's a Greenskin approaching the camp!"\n\n"Just one?"

desc.zh: 咕噜的胃口可不仅局限于烹饪领域…
desc.en: Grom's appetite cannot be contained merely to the culinary realm…

desc.zh: 『给俺抹红！多敲点钉子！把轮儿搞得大大的！后面，黏上几个大炸炸！』
desc.en: "Paint it red! More spikes! Bigga wheelz! STIKK SOME BOMBZ ON THE BACK!"

desc.zh: 咕噜非常明白每次被打趴下之后该怎么振作起来，这事儿都整不明白还怎么当战将
desc.en: Like any good Warboss, Grom understands well the art of getting back up after every setback.

desc.zh: 每个城镇都会让火时刻烧得旺旺的，让肉烤得香香的，免得咕噜一时兴起决定来点小吃
desc.en: Every settlement keeps the fires stoked and the meat burning in case Grom decides to show up for an impromptu snack.

desc.zh: 身材高大的家伙经常轻视卑微的地精。然而，地精几乎会超乎本能地意识到，照着附近的小腿刺上一刀会多好玩儿！
desc.en: Those of great stature often overlook the humble Goblin. Goblins, however, are almost preternaturally aware of nearby shins in need of a good stabbin'!

desc.zh: 咕噜虽然腰围肥大，但弱小的敌人也因此奈何不了他
desc.en: Grom's ridiculous girth provides some measure of protection against the weapons of his puny foes.

desc.zh: 咕噜是个庞然大物，一个巨大无比的膨胀地精，以至于无论是事实还是字面上，其他地精都得仰望他！
desc.en: Grom is titanic – a bloated Goblin of such great immensity that every other gobbo looks up to him, both figuratively and literally!

desc.zh: 咕噜的『尖耳朵削片斧』像屠夫的砍刀一样，他挥着这把传奇武器从敌人身上切下美味的肉片！
desc.en: Like a butcher’s cleaver, Grom uses the fabled ‘Elf-Biter’ to make tasty cuts of meat out of his rivals!

desc.zh: 地精国王的战旗会带来莫名其妙的好运，还有他那狗屎运的旗手尼布莱特——此人曾被地精国王一屁股坐在身上，却不知怎么着活了过来
desc.en: Along with his serendipitous standard-bearer, Niblet, who once somehow survived being sat on by him, the Goblin King’s banner brings inexplicable luck.

desc.zh: 『俺们要狠狠砸蒙他们！』\n『不废话，就是干呗？』\n『整！』
desc.en: "We're gonna dis-kum-bob-url-rate em good!"\n"Izzat even a word?"\n"Dunno."

desc.zh: 『比硬还硬！硬得要死！』
desc.en: "'Arder than 'ard! Dead 'ard!"

desc.zh: 十个地精？拉倒吧。\n百个地精？好可怕…\n千个地精？俺滴妈！
desc.en:
Ten Goblins? Inconvenient.
A hundred? Alarming.
A thousand? 
Uh oh!

desc.zh: 装满了死去玩意的网里可以找到各种各样的东西。从可怕的腐烂食物到还活着的敌方士兵，存起来方便吃
desc.en: All manner of things may be found inside a net of Dead-things. From horrid rotten morsels to still live enemy combatants, stored for easy snacking.

desc.zh: 河巨魔巫婆身上总是带着她标志性的厚重沼泽黏液，它能以骇人的波动把刀剑与斧头偏转开去
desc.en: The River Troll Hag is never without her signature coating of thick swamp slime, which can turn sword and axe away with disturbing undulations.

desc.zh: 哪个绿皮都不会蠢到在河巨魔巫婆眼前晃悠，免得让她觉得自个有必要关注一下这家伙（经常会要命）
desc.en: No Greenskin would be so foolish as to act out of turn around a River Troll Hag, lest she decide they require her (often fatal) attentions.

desc.zh: 这位老大特别鬼祟，他可以在战斗开始前率军深入敌方小鬼的领地内
desc.en: This Boss is especially sneaky, able to deploy deep in enemy gits' terrain before battle.

desc.zh: 每把斧头都有世代使用的伤痕；每一次砍击都会带有先前所有砍过的人的力量
desc.en: Each axe bears the scars of generations of use; each strike fells with the strength of all those who struck before.

desc.zh: 在这些林地百战老兵眼中，任何丘陵、树林与谷地都不会构成任何障碍
desc.en: No hill, tree or valley is an impediment to these seasoned veterans of the forest.

desc.zh: 长期服役的战狮与它们的主人建立了真正的羁绊
desc.en: War lions which have remained in service for long enough develop a true bond with their handlers.

desc.zh: 这些巨大而咆哮的猫科动物凶猛异常，令战狮战车驭者们受益匪浅，这也令敌人难以逃开他们劈下的武器
desc.en: Those who employ War Lion Chariots benefit considerably from the ferocity of the huge, snarling cats, keeping foes exposed to their cleaving weaponry.

desc.zh: 光有才干是不够的，只有真正具备天赋的人，才能被选中到荷斯高塔中学习
desc.en: Mere talent alone is not enough, one must be truly gifted to be chosen to study at the Tower of Hoeth.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的巨鹰是精灵们的坚定盟友，自从混沌入侵起便与他们并肩而战
desc.en: Ulthuan's Great Eagles are the firm allies of the Elves, fighting their causes since the coming of Chaos.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 强大的银月龙会用自己的知识强化它们的骑手，其启迪的力量足以挫败恶魔
desc.en: Those atop the mighty Moon Drakes are steeled in the knowledge of their mount’s enlightened strength that has seen them face down Daemons.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度

desc.en: With precise applications of unmaking, any threat may be rendered null and void in turn.

desc.zh: 大法师所操控与运转的，乃是任何凡人修行者所望尘莫及的能量
desc.en: The Archmage crackles and flows with energies that would unmake any mortal practitioner.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
