desc.en: Those atop the mighty Moon Drakes are steeled in the knowledge of their mount’s enlightened strength that has seen them face down Daemons.

desc.zh: 众人皆可置疑；心机皆无所隐；无战则无和平
desc.en: No being is above suspicion, no motive shall remain hidden. No peace without war.

desc.zh: 若是无路可走，那便开辟出一条来！
desc.en: When no fixture presents itself, one must simply make their own.

desc.zh: 迷雾女神是隐藏者和迷失者的守护神。在伊瑞斯的迷雾中，人们最能感受到她的存在，据说她会在迷雾中指引着流浪者走向安全的地方
desc.en: The Lady of Mists is a patron of the hidden and the lost. Her presence is felt most strongly within the mists of Yvresse, where she is said to guide wanderers to safety.

desc.zh: 塔尔·伊瑞斯的精灵们满怀深仇大恨，战争让他们心受重创，也磨砺了他们的灵魂。塔尔·伊瑞斯绝不会再次陷落
desc.en: The Elves of Tor Yvresse contain a deep hatred, war has scarred their hearts and steeled their souls. Tor Yvresse will not fall again.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 艾萨里昂骑乘着风暴之翼，如剑刃之风般刺穿奥苏安的敌人，同时这只强大的狮鹫也会用喙与爪子狂暴地撕开敌人
desc.en: Together with Stormwing, Eltharion cuts through Ulthuan’s foes like a wind of blades as the mighty Griffon rakes and claws with savagery.

desc.zh: 这把符文镶边的长剑乃是艾萨里昂家族的传家之宝，为他赐予了其祖先的狂热精神
desc.en: This rune-encrusted longsword has been passed down through Eltharion’s family for generations, bestowing unto him the zeal of his forefathers.

desc.zh: 伊瑞斯古城捍卫者的冠冕，乃是坚定决心的象征，足以鼓舞人心
desc.en: The ceremonial crown of he who protects Yvresse’s ancient metropolis is an inspirational symbol of dogged determination.

desc.zh: 拆了他们的，来保护我们的
desc.en: Unmake what is theirs to safeguard what is ours.

desc.zh: 砍得比肉体更深的钢铁
desc.en: Steel that bites deeper than the flesh.

desc.zh: 在迷雾行者面前，世上绝无任何阴暗角落可供你隐藏
desc.en: No dark corner of the world will serve to hide you from the Mistwalkers.

desc.zh: 这些城墙自很久前就已矗立，直到这个世界化为乌有，它们才会倒塌！
desc.en: These walls have stood since ages past, and they will not fall until this world crumbles into nothing!

desc.zh: 龙王子是唯一永远不会为凤凰王垂下旗帜的精灵，这是据说由卡勒多亲自赐予的荣耀！
desc.en: Dragon Princes are the only Elves who would never dip their banners for the Phoenix King, holding to an honour said to have been granted by Caledor himself!

desc.zh: 当完成时，触目所及之处所余唯有白地
desc.en: When it is done there shall remain but mounds of ash as far as the eye can see.

desc.zh: 卡勒多人以傲慢著称。然而，他们作为精锐骑兵的声望却是难以置疑
desc.en: Caledorians are renowned for their arrogance. It is however hard to argue their proficiency as elite cavalry.

desc.zh: 这不是你应该害怕的龙…
desc.en: It is not the Dragon you should fear…

desc.zh: 伊姆瑞克是沉默王国卡勒多的王子。尽管龙已经衰落，但伊姆瑞克的职责并没有动摇
desc.en: Imrik is prince of the silent realm of Caledor. Despite the decline of the Dragons, Imrik does not waver in his duty.

desc.zh: 龙的时代早已过去，但卡勒多人的骄傲永不减弱。曾经在诸峰上肆虐的火焰，现在正在每个卡勒多精灵身上肆虐
desc.en: The age of Dragons is long past, but the pride of Caledorians doth never wane. The fires that once raged upon the peaks now rages within every Caledorian Elf.

desc.zh: 龙王子的坚定坐骑身披以『天银』制成的板甲与鳞甲，它模仿成了一条强大巨龙的外貌
desc.en: The Dragon Prince’s unwavering steed is bedecked in plates and scales of ‘sky-silver’ that mimic the appearance of a mighty Drake.

desc.zh: 这条对伊姆瑞克狂热效忠的龙，正是这位最后的正统龙王子无可争议的显赫地位的象征
desc.en: Imrik’s fanatically loyal Drake is a symbol of the Elf Lord’s irrefutable eminence as the last true Dragon Prince.

desc.zh: 这件附魔护甲由卡勒多家族诸位家主所穿戴，经历了足足四千年的战斗
desc.en: Donned by the masters of the House of Caledor, this ensorcelled armour has endured over four thousand years of battles.

desc.zh: 卡勒多是瓦尔铁砧的所在地，那里有一座供奉着铁匠之神的大型神殿。瓦尔祭司们将魔法之风绑定在钢铁上，锻造出无与伦比的魔法武器和盔甲
desc.en: Caledor is home to Vaul's Anvil, the site of a great temple to the God of Smiths. The work of the priests of Vaul binds the Winds into steel, and forges peerless magical arms and armour.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 最年轻的巨龙，长着暖色调的鳞片，拥有足以匹敌其火爆脾气的炽热吐息
desc.en: The youngest Dragons have a warm hue to their scales and a fiery temper, with scorching breath to match.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的野生狮鹫有着高贵的举止和敏锐的智慧，精灵与它们建立起了只有死亡才能打破的羁绊
desc.en: The wild Griffons of Ulthuan are creatures of noble bearing and keen intelligence, with whom Elves form bonds that only death can shatter.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的野生狮鹫有着高贵的举止和敏锐的智慧，精灵与它们建立起了只有死亡才能打破的羁绊
desc.en: The wild Griffons of Ulthuan are creatures of noble bearing and keen intelligence, with whom Elves form bonds that only death can shatter.

desc.zh: 泰格里斯骑着奥术凤凰奋勇作战，他驾驭着魔法风暴，利用狂号的魔法之风的力量横扫了整个凡间世界
desc.en: Fighting upon an Arcane Phoenix, Teclis rides the magical tempests, harnessing the power of the howling Winds sweeping through the world of mortals.

desc.zh: 维护保养一辆可以支持咕噜庞大重量的战车，这可将地精的工程技能推到了极限
desc.en: Maintaining a chariot that can support Grom's immense weight pushes Goblin engineering skills to their limits.

desc.zh: 冷静，沉着，镇定。没错就是这样！
desc.en: Cool, calm, and collected. Yeah, right!

desc.zh: 此人即便在独处时也会心怀不安，他的本性就是如此的内敛
desc.en: This one doesn't even relax in their own company, so reserved is their nature.

desc.zh: 勇气？坚强？别逗了好吗，这个怂货一点边都不沾
desc.en: Fortitude? Strength of character? Do me a favour – this yellow-bellied poltroon has none.

desc.zh: 此人从头到尾毫不合群，全身散发着忧郁哀伤的气息
desc.en: Definitely not the life and soul of the party; they exude melancholy and depression.

desc.zh: 此人脾气有如导火索，一点就着，见识一下燃烧的怒火吧
desc.en: Tempers, like wicks, can be ignited. Watch the anger burn.

desc.zh: 作为，不作为，搞出变动，诸如此类，此人铁了心要跟主流对着干
desc.en: Action, inaction, change – you name it, this one will work against the prevailing wind.

desc.zh: 这么说吧，此人就是个炸药桶，你一定不会想尝尝他的怒火吧！
desc.en: You don't want to be on the wrong side of this one's ire – it's explosive to say the least!

desc.zh: 黑暗之中未必总有光明
desc.en: Not every cloud has a silver lining.

desc.zh: 能守护阿苏尔生存之道的品质，此人无不具备
desc.en: Whatever quality is needed to stand guard over the Asur way of life, this one has it in abundance.

desc.zh: 大家泡澡的时候要想拿人寻开心，那非此人莫属
desc.en: If ever there was a candidate for a relaxing break at an all-inclusive spa, it was this one.

desc.zh: 此人身体看上去『不是很好』已成常态，很明显是药不太够了
desc.en: Looking "not too well" has become a permanent condition. Clearly, they're lacking essential herbs.

desc.zh: 都说两个总比一个强，这绝对是大错特错
desc.en: They say two are better than one. They are, of course, totally wrong in every respect.

desc.zh: 机会就像魔法，可以被个人意志所驾驭
desc.en: Chance is like magic – it can be harnessed to the individual's will.

desc.zh: 此人活动好每一根筋骨，随时随地准备出动
desc.en: Every fibre of their being is charged and ready for action – wherever, whenever.

desc.zh: 即使在高等精灵自己看来，千余岁还能如此精神焕发也是很不可思议的
desc.en: Impressively energetic for a thousand years old – even by their own reckoning.

desc.zh: 能量在他们的血管中流淌，填补着噩兆的虚空
desc.en: Through their veins a charge is racing. Energy, filling the ominous void within.

desc.zh: 『想要保持轻柔就必须多下功夫，你们天天坐着胡吃海喝跟你们说了也是白说』
desc.en: "Staying this supple takes effort. You don’t get definition like that by sitting about and drinking."

desc.zh: 『你想要什么跟外面的守卫说就好了，外面可有不少守卫』
desc.en: "If you need anything, there are guards outside the doors. Many guards."

desc.zh: 做任何事都有正确和错误两条路，此人一般都爱走错的路
desc.en: There's usually a right way and a wrong way to do anything. This one generally gets it wrong.

desc.zh: 机器以及任何科技进步都令此人厌恶至极，因为没有什么能代替得了辛勤劳作
desc.en: Machinery – and indeed progress of any kind – is anathema to this one, because there's no substitute for good, honest toil.

desc.zh: 此人事事不落，整天干涉别人的事
desc.en: This one can never leave something alone. They always have to meddle.

desc.zh: 近千年来，奥苏安许多高耸天际的建筑都出自此人的艰辛劳作
desc.en: Much of the Ulthuan skyline built over the last thousand years is down to this one’s sterling endeavours.

desc.zh: 『太迟了，太迟了』，等我一走后悔就来不及了
desc.en: "Too late, too late!" will be the cry, when the one with the bargains passes you by.

desc.zh: 好在世上总有人爱操心天下大事，要不然我们可就…哦等等…
desc.en: Fortunately, there are some who really apply themselves to the problems of the world. Just as well, otherwise we'd be… Oh wait...

desc.zh: 如果需要精确与组织，那么此人无疑是最佳人选。但是在聚会上，他就很无趣了
desc.en: If it requires accuracy and organisation, this one is your Elf. Not so much fun at parties, however.

desc.zh: 『事情总会有出路，总会有个角度的，你只需找到它即可』
desc.en: "There's always a way – always an angle. You just have to find it."

desc.zh: 此人技艺超群，堪称国之大器，简直就是智慧的化身
desc.en: An individual of exceptional skill and worth; the very embodiment of sagacity.

desc.zh: 『尖脑壳』是绿皮口中的传奇，他们既害怕又尊敬他的武功
desc.en: "Pointy-'ead" is legendary among the Greenskins, who both fear and respect his martial prowess.

desc.zh: 伊姆瑞克是『驯龙者』卡勒多的最后血脉，他继承了卡勒多的武功和对龙族的喜爱
desc.en: Imrik is the last of the line of Caledor the Dragontamer, and shares his lineage's martial excellence and affinity for Dragonkind.

desc.zh: 卡堂是一位变形术大师，他能把自己的形体变成任何他想要的形状。这次，他的魔法被用来召唤一头巨鹰，仿佛卡堂亲自在为你战斗
desc.en: Kadon, a master of forms, was able to shift his shape into anything he chose. This mastery is used to summon a Great Eagle, as if Kadon himself fights for you.

desc.zh: 卡堂是一位变形术大师，他能把自己的形体变成任何他想要的形状。这次，他的魔法被用来召唤一头巨鹰，仿佛卡堂亲自在为你战斗
desc.en: Kadon, a master of forms, was able to shift his shape into anything he chose. This mastery is used to summon a Great Eagle, as if Kadon himself fights for you.

desc.zh: 史卡斯尼克拥有一段独特的暗中工作历史，他在伏击与背叛方面拥有传奇般的天才！
desc.en: Skarsnik has a unique history with working in the dark, and his expertise in the matters of ambush and betrayal are legendary!

desc.zh: 『都可以拿，随便拿，都拿！』
desc.en: "Take it, take it all! Every las' bit of it!"

desc.zh: 『这怎么能叫藏着？问就是战略转移！』
desc.en: "It ain't really hidin, jus tac-tik-kel moving is all!"

desc.zh: 当迫不得已时，要确保你不是那个被『迫不得已』的家伙！
desc.en: When push comes to shove, make sure you aren't the one being pushed!

desc.zh: 虽然找到足够的油漆来做这项工作并不容易，但没人能否认它的成果！
desc.en: While locating enough paint for the job ain't easy, no one can deny the results!

desc.zh: 乌尔扎戈的脚随着一种只有他能听到的节奏移动，但他非常乐意分享它！
desc.en: Wurrzag's feet move to a rhythm only he can hear, but he's more than happy to share!

desc.zh: 与乌尔扎戈的战斗相对来说有些令人不安。当他在战斗中跳来跳去时，他的脚会踩出蛮荒兽人狂野的节奏
desc.en: Fighting Wurrzag is relatively disconcerting. His feet stamp out the wild of rhythm of the Savage Orcs as he jigs in and out of the fight.

desc.zh: 这个条目用于在戴查的神器任务战斗中组合技能
desc.en: This entry is used to group together skills for Drycha's Quest Battle

desc.zh: 作为腐坏氏族中最扭曲、最具创新意识的突变大师，斯洛特凭借自身的成功跻身于臭名昭著的地狱深坑九领主之位
desc.en: Throt’s successes as the most twisted and ingenious Master Mutator of Clan Moulder means he is now one of the infamous nine Lords of Hell Pit.

desc.zh: 很久之前，这里曾是戴查的领地，但如今曾经繁盛的灾厄之树的树根已经洒满了魔古尔的鲜血
desc.en: Long ago, Drycha held court on the tainted ground where Morghur’s blood was spilt amongst the roots of the once-glorious Tree of Woe.

desc.zh: 据说，奈丝特拉与阿洛翰乃是艾瑞尔灵魂中最为光辉与最为黑暗部分的具现化，是从女神灵魂中分离而出的悲悯与激情
desc.en: Some say Naestra and Arahan are the lightest and darkest aspects of Ariel’s spirit made manifest, her mercy and passion split from her soul.

desc.zh: 他们会急促地越过他们的主人，使用魔法丝线织成的大网拦住敌人打来的武器
desc.en: Scurrying over their host with feverish abandon, Netlings snag the weapons of enemies that come too close with webs of magical filaments.

desc.zh: 他们会急促地越过他们的主人，使用魔法丝线织成的大网拦住敌人打来的武器
desc.en: Scurrying over their host with feverish abandon, Netlings snag the weapons of enemies that come too close with webs of magical filaments.

desc.zh: 闪耀的小精灵们用忽闪的眼睛和扑棱的翅膀迷惑敌人的思维，使他们进入如醉如痴的恍惚之中
desc.en: The staring eyes and tattered wings of tiny, glowing Elves befuddle enemy minds, sending them into a sleep-like trance.

desc.zh: 恐怖从它们的主人那儿阴郁地现身，展现出最为可怕的一面来摧垮那些魂不附体的猎物的精神
desc.en: Mirthfully looming out from their host, Terrors take on their most fearsome aspect to dampen the spirits of their horrified prey.

desc.zh: 恐怖从它们的主人那儿阴郁地现身，展现出最为可怕的一面来摧垮那些魂不附体的猎物的精神
desc.en: Mirthfully looming out from their host, Terrors take on their most fearsome aspect to dampen the spirits of their horrified prey.

desc.zh: 星团乃是充满魔力的海绵体，外表体现为模糊而纯净的光团，将魔法之风呼唤到主人那儿
desc.en: Radiants are sponges for magical energy, manifesting as little more than blurred shapes of pure light that beckon the Winds to their host.

desc.zh: 绝望乃是艾索洛伦诸多恶意中最为可怕的一种，它的到来通常预示着即刻降临的死亡
desc.en: The Despairs are among the most feared Spites within Athel Loren, their arrival always foretelling imminent death.

desc.zh: 这些残忍的化身藏在宿主的凹陷中，随时准备砍了胆敢接近的家伙
desc.en: Hiding in their hosts' hollows are fiendish forms, ready to strike out at any who draw near.

desc.zh: 当射向敌人时，这些凶狠的森林化身会化为针形的箭矢，从远处打出痛苦的伤口
desc.en: Unleashed upon a foe, these aggressive manifestations of the forest are utilised for their needle-like arrows that inflict painful wounds from afar.

desc.zh: 当射向敌人时，这些凶狠的森林化身会化为针形的箭矢，从远处打出痛苦的伤口
desc.en: Unleashed upon a foe, these aggressive manifestations of the forest are utilised for their needle-like arrows that inflict painful wounds from afar.

desc.zh: 伯劳会展现出各种可怕的形态，如水银泻地般直冲敌人的眼睛，甚至冲进敌人的身体，直接打击他们的思维
desc.en: Shrikes take on various frightening forms, moving like quicksilver to target the eyes, and even enter foes’ bodies to attack their very minds.

desc.zh: 从肢体到弓箭，冷光的魔法孢子附着在友军的武器上，为其赋予了轻微但致命的附魔效果
desc.en: Bounding from branch to bow, the Luminescents’ magical spoors alight upon allies’ weapons to bestow a minor but lethal enchantment.

desc.zh: 腐坏氏族会为尊贵的军阀提供体格最大的痘疹巨鼠作为坐骑，从而击垮、碾碎并杀穿敌人的行伍
desc.en: For the gaudier Warlord, Clan Moulder offers their most bloated Pox Rats as mounts to flail, crush, and savage a way through the enemy’s ranks.

desc.zh: 森林龙并不享有鲁莽之名，但富有冒险精神的塞辛-哈尔却真实反映着暮光姐妹的好斗天性
desc.en: Forest Dragons are not known for their recklessness, but the venturesome Ceithin-Har is a true reflection of the Sisters’ combative aspect.

desc.zh: 作为食人魔与老鼠特别交配后的产物，碎骨者身后或绑或捆着一个牢固的平台，从而将斯卡文军阀背上战场
desc.en: A specially-engineered breed of Rat Ogre, the Bonebreaker has a braced platform strapped or bolted to its back for carrying a Skaven Warlord to battle.

desc.zh: 斯卡文军事体系的上升程序，便是从这些家伙开始的
desc.en: The ascension up the greasy pole of the Skaven military hierarchy starts in the brood.

desc.zh: 他的一生都在见证着他人因未能达成军阀的期望所承受的后果，这让他对失败的恐惧完全消失殆尽
desc.en: A lifetime spent witnessing the ramifications of others falling short of a Warlord’s expectations makes the fear of failure all-consuming.

desc.zh: 『是的、是的！对强大军阀动手等于找死！大角鼠在青睐着他、他！』
desc.en: "Yes-yes, it is deadly to attack mighty Warlord! Great Horned One watches over him-him!"

desc.zh: 腐坏氏族会为尊贵的军阀提供体格最大的痘疹巨鼠作为坐骑，从而击垮、碾碎并杀穿敌人的行伍
desc.en: For the gaudier Warlord, Clan Moulder offers their most bloated Pox Rats as mounts to flail, crush, and savage a way through the enemy’s ranks.

desc.zh: 即使是最为邪恶，最为冲动的怪兽，也会在次元石电棍的迅猛『鼓励』下遵循他人的意志
desc.en: Even the most vicious and impetuous monstrosities can be 'encouraged' to do one’s bidding with a quick jolt of Warpstone-generated electricity.

desc.zh: 一旦捕兽师将他可爱的『宠物们』释放到战场上，它们的嗜血狩猎就开始了！
desc.en: As soon as the Packmaster unleashes his beloved 'pets' upon the battlefield, their bloodthirsty hunt begins!

desc.zh: 携带瘟疫的老鼠与狼从阴沟中蜂拥而出，于敌军阵内散播致命的混乱
desc.en: Summoned forth from filth-ridden sewers, disease-carrying amalgamations of rat and wolf cause pestilent havoc in the enemy’s ranks.

desc.zh: 单有捕兽器与鞭子可不足以让人成为捕兽师，因为只有最优秀的人才能激励出怪兽潜能的极致
desc.en: A things-catcher and whip are not all that makes a Packmaster, for only the best have monster-goading down to a fine art.

desc.zh: 腐坏之主乃是腐坏氏族最精英的捕兽师，他们是无畏的牧者，擅长向他们的兽群灌输更加严苛的管控与纪律
desc.en: Moulder’s most elite Packmasters are known as Master Moulders, fearless wranglers who excel at instilling greater control and discipline into their packs.

desc.zh: 对捕兽师逞英雄？那你肯定会悲剧的
desc.en: Show a Packmaster a hero and he will show you a tragedy.

desc.zh: 捕捉弱小的敌人并非什么挑战，但话说回来，这样可以为兽群提供额外的口粮
desc.en: Catching lesser foes is hardly a challenge, but is undeniably useful to provide extra rations for the pack.

desc.zh: 擅长控制各种讨厌的生物
desc.en: Good at keeping all sorts of nasty creatures in check.

desc.zh: 斯洛特的尖刺皮鞭噼啪作响，将身形佝偻的地狱深坑突变体抽得火冒三丈，令它们狂怒地直扑上前
desc.en: Even the hunchbacked and mutated things of Hell Pit’s warrens can be frenzied forward by the stinging pain of Throt’s scathing minotaur-hide whip.

desc.zh: 腐坏氏族会为尊贵的军阀提供体格最大的痘疹巨鼠作为坐骑，从而击垮、碾碎并杀穿敌人的行伍
desc.en: For the gaudier Warlord, Clan Moulder offers their most bloated Pox Rats as mounts to flail, crush, and savage a way through the enemy’s ranks.

desc.zh: 桦树油可以软化木材，也可以在风干后硬化树枝，把它变成致命的战棍
desc.en: A birch’s oils can soften its wood, but once dry can harden branches into lethal clubs of war.

desc.zh: 即使是最恶劣的气象也无法摧毁坚韧而长寿的橡树，因为它早已饱经各种季节的考验
desc.en: Not even the fiercest weather conditions can strike down a hardy and long-lived oak, for it endures all seasons.

desc.zh: 柳树是报春使者，生命之源，可以支撑树木抵御最可怕的环境
desc.en: The willow is a harbinger of spring, and a conduit of lifeforces that can bolster a tree to withstand the direst of circumstances.

desc.zh: 无论冬季何时消退，桦树都是最早回青的树木之一，因为它最强的力量便是生命力
desc.en: Wherever winter retreats, the birch is amongst the first to sprout forth, for its vibrance is its greatest strength.

desc.zh: 接纳了橡树好战面庞的人们通常会站在战线的最前方，这是它专属的纯粹结构性力量
desc.en: Those who adopt the oak’s warlike aspect typically stand on the front line, such is the sheer structural strength of its genus.

desc.zh: 当柳树的好战面庞得到采纳时，它的枝叶便会垂下重叠，将一切可以造成伤害的袭来之物拒之于外
desc.en: Once the willow’s warlike aspect is adopted, branches and leaves droop and overlap, absorbing anything that may cause harm.

desc.zh: 随意挥洒鲜血的承诺唤醒了巢穴中的林地掠食者，他们垂涎三尺，期望着疯狂的杀戮
desc.en: The promise of spilt blood rouses the forest’s predators from their lairs, salivating in anticipation of the slaughter.

desc.zh: 林中的野兽总能感受树人的情感，并对他们经年累月丧失同族的悲痛感同身受
desc.en: The wild beasts of the forest always sense the emotions of the Treemen, empathising with their pain over eons of loss.

desc.zh: 无论是因战事而被唤醒，还是重新在梦境中沉眠，树人与生俱来的魔力都会滋养着森林与其中的小型精魂
desc.en: Whether roused for war or retreated into the dreaming lands of sleep, the Treemen’s innate magic nurtures the forest and its lesser spirits.

desc.zh: 虽然战林的精灵们仍然受到自己正为女王而战的魅惑，但这个法术的副作用已受到了压制
desc.en: Though the wargrove’s Elves remain under the enchanted delusion that they fight for their queen, the spell’s debilitations have been overcome.

desc.zh: 杜尔苏古老心灵中纵使曾残留一丝怜悯，也早已被侵蚀殆尽，并让他变得与毁灭者别无二致
desc.en: Any compassion remaining in Durthu’s ancient mind has eroded, making him little more than a destroyer.

desc.zh: 自然世界的区区火焰，岂能点燃艾索洛伦的生灵
desc.en: No mere fire of the natural world can burn that which is born of Athel Loren.

desc.zh: 杜尔苏心中仇恨的重量，足以渗入他所踏足的任何土地
desc.en: The sheer weight of Durthu's hatred is great enough to seep into the very land upon which he treads.

desc.zh: 杜尔苏与森林结下了绝对的羁绊，只需他略一露面，便足以驾驭其他长期沉睡的长老的力量
desc.en: Durthu's connection with the forest is absolute, his mere presence enough to harness the power of the other, long-slumbering Ancients.

desc.zh: 杜尔苏高耸的身躯正如大地本身一样，坚忍不屈
desc.en: Durthu's towering form is as unyielding and implacable as the earth itself.

desc.zh: 当奥莱恩将手伸向箭筒时，他从不会空手而归
desc.en: Orion is never left wanting when he reaches for his quiver.

desc.zh: 阿斯莱全员聆听着奥莱恩的号角：纵使它尚未被吹响，也会作为狂猎的开幕讯号而存在
desc.en: All Asrai heed Orion’s horn – even before it is sounded, it exists as a portent that the Wild Hunt is imminent.

desc.zh: 若是有人不幸落入猎人的视野，那么他就绝无逃脱的可能，因为此刻已经太迟了
desc.en: Those unfortunate enough to find themselves in the hunter’s sights will not escape their attentions, for it is already too late.

desc.zh: 『夏之仪式给了你人生的目标，吾等歌声为你灌注了库诺斯的血液。他以你之身而活着，也以你之身而狩猎…』
desc.en: "The rites of the summer gave you your purpose. Our songs filled you with the blood of Kurnous. He lives, through you. He hunts, through you... "

desc.zh: 林地和灌木丛足以让你躲避尘世，但森林之王却绝不可如此
desc.en: Foliage and shrubbery oft suffice to hide from the mundane, but the King in the Woods is anything but.

desc.zh: 这种仪式战舞不需要节奏或步调，却可以避开敌人笨拙的攻击，并发起致命的反击
desc.en: This ritualistic war dance requires neither rhythm nor order, enabling evasion of the enemy’s clumsy attacks, and lethal counterattacks.

desc.zh: 这名领主的军队会为艾索洛伦奋战不息，因为他们的灵魂已与森林的命运紧密相连
desc.en: The Lord charges their troops to fight for Athel Loren, for their very souls are tethered to its fate.

desc.zh: 使用洛依克亲自赐福的咒文之歌，便可避开色孽的凝视，令人变得难以察觉，难以捕捉
desc.en: Using rhythmic incantations endowed and employed by Loec himself to avoid Slaanesh’s gaze, one can stay unseen and uncaught.

desc.zh: 若是获得洛依克的庇护，便可模仿黑暗诸神的欺骗，如本能般通过把戏来逃避攻击
desc.en: Once consumed by Loec’s aspect, one can instinctively evade attack through trickery, mimicking his deception of the Dark Gods.

desc.zh: 若是获得洛依克的庇护，便可模仿黑暗诸神的欺骗，如本能般通过把戏来逃避攻击
desc.en: Once consumed by Loec’s aspect, one can instinctively evade attack through trickery, mimicking his deception of the Dark Gods.

desc.zh: 迷踪客能够在超乎常理的遥远距离发现敌人，他们的军队也会纷纷效仿这一能力
desc.en: Waystalkers’ keen eyes can spot an enemy at a distance that defies belief, and so they demand the same of their troops.

desc.zh: 科迪尔的冷酷之心会吸引最恶毒、最可怕的精魂
desc.en: Coeddil's curdled heart attracts the most malignant and terrifying spirits.

desc.zh: 在先祖的永恒意志之下，森林坚强地自力更生着
desc.en: By the eternal will of the Ancients, the forest looks after its own.

desc.zh: 从世界诞生之初，科迪尔就在编织着魔法之风
desc.en: Coeddil has weaved the Winds of Magic since the world was in its infancy.

desc.zh: 即使花上千年之久，对森林犯下的每项罪行都要受到清算！
desc.en: Even if it takes millennia, every crime committed against the forest shall be accounted for!

desc.zh: 科迪尔身上的枝杈与树洞中潜藏着一群叽叽喳喳的恶灵，他们全是被这位先祖的恶怨吸引而来
desc.en: Lurking amongst Coeddil’s branches and hollows are swarms of chittering Spites, all drawn to his pungent malice.

desc.zh: 在最黑暗的森林深处，科迪尔的信徒们等待着他的归来，而他们的愤怒也是年甚一年
desc.en: Deep within the blackest forests, Coeddil's followers have awaited his return, their seething rage intensified by every passing year.

desc.zh: 仇恨可以驱使一个人去缔结…不寻常的联盟
desc.en: Hate can drive one to make... unusual alliances.

desc.zh: 科迪尔曾会为所至之处带来生命，但现在它所激发的只是酸蚀与腐朽
desc.en: Once, Coeddil brought life wherever he walked. Now what growth he inspires is sour and rotten.

desc.zh: 顶生巨角，鼾若雷鸣，巨牡鹿无疑会令它的骑手勇气倍增
desc.en: With its magnificent frame and the great plumes of steam of its snorting breath, the Great Stag instils unflinching valour into those who ride it.

desc.zh: 顶生巨角，鼾若雷鸣，巨牡鹿无疑会令它的骑手勇气倍增
desc.en: With its magnificent frame and the great plumes of steam of its snorting breath, the Great Stag instils unflinching valour into those who ride it.

desc.zh: 若是知晓瘫痪敌手的战法，那么万物皆可成为猎物，即使对手极难被杀也不例外
desc.en: When one knows ways to inflict incapacitating injury, even upon that which is hard to kill, everything is prey.

desc.zh: 在魔法的加持之下，自然法则为战林赋予了仅凭光芒能量便可治愈军中战士的能力
desc.en: Enhanced by magic, the laws of nature grant the wargrove a heightened ability to heal its ranks from light energy alone.

desc.zh: 森林精魂最伟大的伪装，莫过于化为一片毫无知觉的普通森林
desc.en: Tree Spirits have no greater camouflage than to become as still as an insentient forest.

desc.zh: 对于那些鲁莽到无端打搅林地居民的人来说，森林有无数种方法可以引发不适、痛苦与死亡
desc.en: The forest has myriad ways to cause discomfort, pain and death to those foolhardy enough to make unwanted contact with its denizens.

desc.zh: 骑手与坐骑的羁绊远远超出了友谊或家人的范畴：他们早已合而为一
desc.en: The bond between rider and steed goes beyond friendship or family; they act as one.

desc.zh: 这只高贵驮兽的前额上带有一支螺旋犄角，它能迅捷地将施法者带至最需要他施展法力的地方
desc.en: Its forehead adorned with a spiral horn, this noble mount carries the Spellsinger where their magical gifts are needed most.

desc.zh: 振翅鹰翔，拥抱旭日；追逐敌手，一击毙命
desc.en: Fly on your wings, like an eagle. Touch the sun. Track the foe, ambush, and defeat.

desc.zh: 骑手与坐骑的羁绊远远超出了友谊或家人的范畴：他们早已合而为一
desc.en: The bond between rider and steed goes beyond friendship or family; they act as one.

desc.en: Fly on your wings, like an eagle. Touch the sun. Track the foe, ambush, and defeat.

desc.zh: 爱莎的庇护可以在最为黑暗的岁月中保佑虔诚的阿斯莱
desc.en: Isha's protection can protect the faithful Asrai through the darkest of days.

desc.zh: 所有的精灵本质上都是魔法生物，但相较奥苏安的顽固道德与纳迦罗斯的肆意施虐，阿斯莱织法者们的魔法技能却是无拘无束的
desc.en: All Elves are intrinsically magical beings, but Asrai Spellweavers practice spellcraft free of Ulthuan’s stiff-necked morality and Naggaroth’s heedless sadism.

desc.zh: 熟练的织法者可以轻松地利用森林来攻击敌人，他们会操纵根茎与枝叶来捕捉、扭曲他们的敌人
desc.en: Skilled spellweavers can turn the forest upon their enemies with frightening ease, summoning grasping, twisted roots and branches to smother their foes.

desc.zh: 从荒野中归来后，有些人会沉默不语，沉思默想，而另一些人则会讲述激励人心，发人师法的惊险故事
desc.en: Some return from the wilds silent and brooding, others with thrilling tales that inspire and teach.

desc.zh: 这位冷酷的守望者流连荒野，回避了其他阿斯莱同伴，独自磨砺着自己的技能
desc.en: A grim wanderer, touched by the wild, this character eschews the company of other Asrai to hone their skills.

desc.zh: 将诺斯卡愚民驱离混沌，并非难事；令混沌远离诺斯卡之身，难如登天
desc.en: You can take the Northman out of Chaos, but you can’t take Chaos out of the Northman.

desc.zh: 狂战士的认知能力毕竟强于鼠巨魔，因此，这点心智至少能让他成为稍微称职的军需官吧
desc.en: A Berserker has a tad more cognitive ability than a Rat Ogre – the mind of the former at least allows one to be a semi-competent quartermaster!

desc.zh: 事实证明，领导诺斯卡氏族与指挥一堆怪物没啥区别
desc.en: As it turns out, leading a Norscan clan and commanding a pack of monsters are not that different from one another.

desc.zh: 不洁者或许对自己杰作的飞黄腾达很不爽，但他们两个仍然维系着脆弱的联盟关系
desc.en: The Unclean one may be less than pleased about his masterwork’s meteoric rise, but the two share a flimsy alliance nonetheless.

desc.zh: 精明的军事才干，再拼合上原始的蛮力本能，令古尔奇足以获得登临腐坏氏族最高军事阶层的能力
desc.en: A unique combination of shrewd military intellect and raw brute strength has ascended Ghoritch to Clan Moulder’s most exalted military rank.

desc.zh: 古尔奇一直统治着地狱深坑的血腥竞技场，现在他监督着自己的继任者，好让其他的怪物保持斗志
desc.en: Ghoritch has always dominated Hell Pit’s blood-soaked arenas and now oversees his successors, keeping the other monsters fresh for war.

desc.zh: 古尔奇的身躯经过了重重改造，而这次次元石驱动的巨大剪刀取代了它的鼠巨魔利爪
desc.en: Giant snipping blades driven by Warpstone-driven pistons replace the Rat Ogre claws of Ghoritch’s heavily modified host body.

desc.zh: 熟练的外科手术技巧与仓促的类固醇注射让受伤的怪物了活了下来，并从此变得嗜杀如命
desc.en: Masterful field surgery techniques and hastily administered steroid shots keep wounded monsters alive and keen to maximise the slaughtering.

desc.zh: 作为腐坏氏族最强悍的战斗力，斯洛特会亲身施展手段撂倒最可怕的战争怪物
desc.en: As Moulder’s most frightening battlefield presence, Throt primes his combat capabilities to bring down the toughest monsters of war himself.

desc.zh: 『把所有的尸体部件、部件全拿走、拿走，是的、是的！一个器官都别落下！』
desc.en: “Take-hoard ALL body part-bits, yes-yes! No organ goes to waste!”

desc.zh: 几场自我发展的实验严重加快了斯洛特的新陈代谢速度，这虽然会令他不再疲劳，但也让他会在饥饿的驱使下变得毫无节制地危险
desc.en: Several self-developmental experiments have radically sped up Throt’s metabolism, preventing fatigue but making him mindlessly ferocious when hungry.

desc.zh: 腐坏氏族坐拥所有斯卡文氏族中最强壮的怪物，但对暴力窒息的恐惧让斯洛特的怪物简直更上一层楼！
desc.en: Clan Moulder command the hardiest monsters in all Skavendom, but the fear of a violent throttling makes Throt’s critters that little bit tougher!

desc.zh: 嵌在斯洛特左眼窝里的次元石碎片会向他的大脑直接注入邪恶魔力，从而增强了他的力量
desc.en: The Warpstone shard embedded in Throt’s left eye socket feeds its baleful influence directly into his brain, giving him added strength.

desc.zh: 艾索洛伦的每根枝条，每座树干，都以最原始的形式注入了大自然令人敬畏的力量
desc.en: Every twig, stick, branch and trunk of Athel Loren is infused with the awesome power of nature in its rawest form.

desc.zh: 『真是强劲超凡的果实，回味无穷啊』
desc.en: "A robust and otherworldly vintage, with a distinctly spellbinding aftertaste."

desc.zh: 『皆应爱我，而后绝望』
desc.en: "All shall love me, and despair."

desc.zh: 艾瑞尔的侍女们都充满了无穷的春天能量
desc.en: Ariel's handmaidens are imbued with the boundless energy of spring.

desc.zh: 阿斯莱的女王很少指挥军队，但她授权统率深林军队的将领们都具备着显赫的权威
desc.en: The Queen of the Asrai rarely commands armies, but those she empowers to lead the Deepwood Host do so with illustrious authority.

desc.zh: 艾瑞尔的魔力与她的魔法助手相得益彰，为空中注入了和谐的力量
desc.en: Ariel's magics interweave with those of her sorcerous acolytes, infusing the air with a harmony of power.

desc.zh: 在爱莎超凡的影响之下，魔法之风会间或地吹拂过她的子嗣们最为需要它的场所
desc.en: By Isha’s otherworldly influence, the Winds blow fortuitously across lands where her children need it the most.

desc.zh: 艾瑞尔是神力的触媒，她有能力如同自然女神本人一样使用法术
desc.en: Ariel is a conduit of deific power, capable of wielding spellcraft as if she herself were the Goddess of Nature.

desc.zh: 母神的举止就像一位优雅的精灵少女一样，既美丽又充满生机
desc.en: The Mother’s demeanour is one of a wholesome Elven maiden, both of great beauty and bounteous lifeforce.

desc.zh: 随着自然世界的持续衰落，艾瑞尔变得愈发好战，从而令她那危险的飞蛾形态得以延续
desc.en: Ariel becomes ever more warlike as the decline of the natural world continues, thus perpetuating her dangerous, mothlike form.

desc.zh: 森林女王影响着她王国的每一寸土地，她的生命力甚至与森林本身交织在一起
desc.en: The Queen in the Woods influences every acre of her realm, her lifeforce ever intertwined with the forest itself.

desc.zh: 艾瑞尔所到之处，树木与植被无不生机勃勃，为她的亲族提供食物与庇护场所
desc.en: Wherever Ariel treads, trees and vegetation are compelled to spring forth to provide sustenance and haven for her kin.

desc.zh: 如果林地要在这黑暗的时代存续下来，那么女王就需要一批既有意愿，又有能力用剑来征服其他土地的勇士
desc.en: If the glades are to survive these dark times, the Queen needs champions willing and able to put other lands to the sword.

desc.zh: 他曾是最早定居艾索洛伦林地的精灵法师中最重要的一位，现在是一位拥有深刻先知智慧的全能法师女王
desc.en: Once the foremost of the Elven magi who first settled Athel Loren’s glades, now an all-powerful Mage Queen of deep prophetic wisdom.

desc.zh: 许多人认为，当魔古尔的鲜血洒在曾经辉煌的灾厄之树的根部时，戴查就已失去了理智
desc.en: Many believe Drycha lost her mind when Morghur’s blood was spilt amongst the roots of the once-glorious creature known as the Tree of Woe.

desc.zh: 森林边缘的家伙们，除了朽木之外几乎无所不取，这是何等的作死行为！
desc.en: Those at forest fringes where the Wargrove is known to dwell gather anything but deadwood at their peril!

desc.zh: 长年以来对精灵行动无所不至的观察，令灾厄荆棘对它们的弱点了如指掌
desc.en: After years examining the Elves’ every action, the Briarmaven knows how to exploit their strengths as well as their weaknesses.

desc.zh: 即使是最勇敢的灵魂，也会被葱茏的森林迷宫所困扰
desc.en: The verdant labyrinth of the forest unsettles even the most courageous soul.

desc.zh: 长老的先任侍女曾是森林的监督者，通过驯服魔法之风来为大小枝干们带来养分：那个时代终将再次到来
desc.en: The Ancients’ former handmaidens were once the forest’s overseers, taming the Winds to bring sustenance to bough and branch – that time will come again.

desc.zh: 在戴查的心中，许多人都惨死在了阿斯莱一族手里，因此他们的名字会被她无尽的咒语所铭记
desc.en: Many are the spirits Drycha believes have been failed by the Asrai, their names remembered by the enchantments of her unending mantra.

desc.zh: 奈丝特拉的箭术堪称百步穿杨，而阿洛翰的剑法则灿若梨花，两姐妹都以森林的名义不懈奋战
desc.en: Naestra possesses lethality in her precision, and Arahan exuberance in her bladework, both fighting zealously in the forest’s name.

desc.zh: 如果自身足够强硬，那么盔甲就只是摆设
desc.en: Armour is just a formality when you're as hard as nails and as tough as old boots.

desc.zh: 死亡总是近在咫尺
desc.en: Death is always just a shot away.

desc.zh: 奈丝特拉与阿洛翰从不会逃避激烈的肉搏战，如果形势需要，他们会迅速进入战斗
desc.en: Naestra and Arahan do not shirk the bitter press of melee, moving swiftly to the fray should the situation require it.

desc.zh: 所谓双子的羁绊，便是只要双子其一还在呼吸，另一人所受到的一切伤害都将微不足道
desc.en: Such is the twins’ bond that the harms inflicted on one are inconsequential so long as the other yet draws breath.

desc.zh: 虽然她们出身神秘，但所有的精灵都知道奈丝特拉与阿洛翰是在为他们敬爱的法师女王代言
desc.en: Regardless of their mysterious origins, all Elves know Naestra and Arahan speak with the authority of their beloved Mage Queen.

desc.zh: 奈丝特拉忠实守护着阿斯莱一族所珍视的一切，她战斗的理由只是为了避免更大的伤害
desc.en: A dedicated sentinel of all that the Asrai hold dear, Naestra seeks battle only in pursuit of preventing greater harms.

desc.zh: 阿洛翰像一团不受控制的火焰，她为毁灭而生，狂热地爱好着战斗
desc.en: Like an unbridled flame, Arahan lives for destruction, welcoming battle with wanton joy.

desc.zh: 天空中的动物们崇拜着奈丝特拉，并出于敬爱而任其驱策；同时敬畏着阿洛翰，并出于尊重而任其驾驭
desc.en: The sky’s fauna adore Naestra, doing as she wills out of love, while fearing Arahan and doing as she wills out of respect.

desc.zh: 姐妹们行走在连巡林客都畏惧的道路上，她们踩踏着迷梦丛林，如同那里是永恒日光照耀下的阿兰洛克一样
desc.en: The sisters walk paths that even Waywatchers dread, treading the Dreaming Wood as if it were the eternally sunlit groves of Arranoc.

desc.zh: 每当双胞胎向戴斯领主提出新的挑战时，他就会微微一笑，然后回到熔炉的炉火旁
desc.en: Whenever the twins present Lord Daith with a new challenge, he simply gives a small smile and returns to the fires of the forge.

desc.zh: 从来没有一位野兽人领袖会如此难寻踪迹，以至无法受惩
desc.en: Never before has a Beastmen leader proved so elusive to retribution.

desc.zh: 在黑暗的邓肯瓦尔德森林深处，卡扎克挑选着原始的战士，补充他庞大的战兽群
desc.en: In the gloomy depths of the Drakwald Forest, Khazrak has his pick of primal warriors to add to his multiplying warherd.

desc.zh: 卡扎克兽群中的低等野兽们受到驱策，满嘴流涎，狂怒不已，它们会迅速撕咬被害者，使之骨肉分离
desc.en: The lesser beasts of Khazrak’s hordes are driven into such a slavering frenzy that all flesh and bone are quickly stripped from their victims.

desc.zh: 最受青睐的战利品，来自最受青睐的敌人
desc.en: From his most favoured enemies come the most favoured of trophies.

desc.zh: 卡扎克是头不同寻常的野兽：他异常狡猾，且具有精心设伏的习性，乃属一个狡诈恶敌
desc.en: Khazrak is an unusual beast; his deep cunning and propensity for carefully planned ambushes makes him a wily foe.

desc.zh: 黑暗征兆扭曲着魔法之风，残害他的敌人并强化他的兽群
desc.en: The Dark Omen twists the Winds to both savage his enemies and empower his hordes.

desc.zh: 马拉戈的亵渎如此炽烈，此乃任何其他嘶叫萨满皆不敢为。不过，总有狂愚之辈胆敢尝试分毫
desc.en: Malagor's profanities are so great that no other Bray-Shaman would dare enact them. Despite this, the foolish and insane attempt a fraction of his works.

desc.zh: 『他是刻在木画上的恶魔，记载他的古籍被封锁起来束之高阁，以免其中的邪恶秘密荼毒人们的心灵』
desc.en: "He is the devil rendered in woodcut in ancient tomes kept under lock and key, lest the terrible secrets within blast the sanity of any who read them."

desc.zh: 魔古尔所至，天穹昏暗，四境腐坏，其触及之生灵无不扭曲变异
desc.en: Morghur's approach darkens the sky, rots the land, and twists all life that it touches.

desc.zh: 亵渎接踵而至，魔古尔为他的兽群赠予了诅咒与祝福。生者长出了全新的异肢，获得了受诅的力量
desc.en: Profanity after profanity, Morghur bestows curses and blessings unto his horde. Those who live bring new mishappen limbs and damned powers to bear.

desc.zh: 魔古尔的现身便会掀起不安。除此之外，它的腐蚀触碰也会异化人类，令其变异退化，直至彻底沉沦
desc.en: Beyond the malaise of his presence, Morghur's corrupting touch can unmake a man, leaving him less than he was. Less than nothing.

desc.zh: 『我来到这儿，希望夺回一切。我来到这儿，希望看到遥远的深渊，看到铁梦之渊的祖先雕像…』
desc.en: "I came here hoping to take it all back. I came hoping to look upon the far deeps, on the ancestor statues of the Abyss of Iron’s Dream..."

desc.zh: 复仇心切的祖先们为贝勒加的军队添加了远古愤怒的余烬，令他们展现坚定不移的气魄
desc.en: Belegar's vengeful Ancestors impart an ember of their ancient rage within his forces, driving them to feats of incredible stalwartness.

desc.zh: 贝勒加的军队拥有极为丰富的地下战斗经验，他们短小精悍，轻装上阵，或者仅会带着适合任务的武器上阵
desc.en: Lightweight, compact or simply equipped with the right tools for the job, Belegar's forces are particularly experienced in underground warfare.

desc.zh: 整个宗族都为这长须勇者所倾倒，其狂热程度，前所未见！
desc.en: The throng is overtaken with gnollengrom with a fervour not seen since ages past!

desc.zh: 格瑞姆布林戴尔只需现身，就足以激励矮人们做出连最牢骚满腹的长须战士也会称赞的壮举！
desc.en: Grombrindal’s mere presence drives the Dawi to feats that even the grumbliest Longbeard would laud!

desc.zh: 格瑞姆布林戴尔从不迟到，也不会早来——他只会出现在至关紧要的时候
desc.en: Grombrindal is never late, nor ever early – he arrives precisely when needed the most.

desc.zh: 无人知晓格瑞姆布林戴尔是如何练就的，但他长存于世的历史足以表明此人已跨越了凡人的境界
desc.en: It is unclear how Grombrindal came to be, but his long history of appearances suggest he has crossed the bounds of mortality.

desc.zh: 世道江河日下，我们必须遏制工程师行会向来的谨慎态度！即使是他们，也不会公然否决白矮人！
desc.en: The world changes for the worse; the usual prudence of the Engineers Guild must be tempered! Even they would not deny the White Dwarf!

desc.zh: 血兽带着雄壮的牛头怪们迈向战场，大地在他狂奔的部众脚下伤痕累累、血流成河
desc.en: The Bloodbeast marches to war with his towering Minotaurs in tow, the land left scarred and bleeding in his stampeding wake.

desc.zh: 早在混沌降临此世之前，欧西约坦就已经是一个老练的猎手了。面对汹涌而来的游牧群，他带着同胞们发动了无数次大胆的伏击
desc.en: Already an accomplished hunter when Chaos came to the world, Oxyotl mounted countless bold ambushes with his spawn-kin against the oncoming hordes.

desc.zh: 这些好斗又顽固的巨兽拉着摇摇欲散的战车，它们的模样就像是巨大的野猪与强横的公羊的杂交产物
desc.en: Pugnacious and stubborn, the war beasts that pull these ramshackle chariots are grotesque combinations of great boar and mighty ram.

desc.zh: 这些好斗又顽固的巨兽拉着摇摇欲散的战车，它们的模样就像是巨大的野猪与强横的公羊的杂交产物
desc.en: Pugnacious and stubborn, the war beasts that pull these ramshackle chariots are grotesque combinations of great boar and mighty ram.

desc.zh: 这些好斗又顽固的巨兽拉着摇摇欲散的战车，它们的模样就像是巨大的野猪与强横的公羊的杂交产物
desc.en: Pugnacious and stubborn, the war beasts that pull these ramshackle chariots are grotesque combinations of great boar and mighty ram.

desc.zh: 这些好斗又顽固的巨兽拉着摇摇欲散的战车，它们的模样就像是巨大的野猪与强横的公羊的杂交产物
desc.en: Pugnacious and stubborn, the war beasts that pull these ramshackle chariots are grotesque combinations of great boar and mighty ram.

desc.zh: 这些好斗又顽固的巨兽拉着摇摇欲散的战车，它们的模样就像是巨大的野猪与强横的公羊的杂交产物
desc.en: Pugnacious and stubborn, the war beasts that pull these ramshackle chariots are grotesque combinations of great boar and mighty ram.

desc.zh: 一件极其简单的粗糙武器加上末日蛮牛超凡的冲击力，便足以破开盔甲，造成致命的杀伤
desc.en: A brutally simple weapon makes the Doombull’s incredible punching power more than enough to puncture armour and cause dreadful injury.

desc.zh: 所有有角的愤怒之父都是黑暗之主的意志化身，他们强大而又坚定，想要杀死他们简直是天方夜谭
desc.en: All horned Fathers of Rage encapsulate the raw will of the Dark Masters – they are strong, determined, and incredibly hard to kill.

desc.zh: 虽然末日蛮牛不是什么战术理论大师，他仍有着不俗的领导力，特别是在自己的亲族之中
desc.en: Though no master of strategy or battle doctrine, a Doombull is still capable of leadership, particularly over their own kin.

desc.zh: 想要带领一支长着犄角的军队冲锋陷阵，就得先砍烂第一个敌人，随后将斧刃范围内的其他敌人再统统砍翻
desc.en: To lead a horned army’s charge is to gore the first foe, then immediately seek to maim all others with an axe’s reach.

desc.zh: 末日蛮牛的咆哮在方圆数里内回荡不息，唤起寄宿于所有族群心中的强烈杀欲
desc.en: The bellowing call of the Doombull resounds for miles around, invoking the intense bloodlust that runs through all their kind.

desc.zh: 若是有人身强体壮，足以驯服残暴的剃刀兽，便可将其套上战车，奔赴战场
desc.en: Those strong enough to tame the powerful, unruly Razorgors can harness them for chariots.

desc.zh: 这些好斗又顽固的巨兽拉着摇摇欲散的战车，它们的模样就像是巨大的野猪与强横的公羊的杂交产物
desc.en: Pugnacious and stubborn, the war beasts that pull these ramshackle chariots are grotesque combinations of great boar and mighty ram.

desc.en: Pugnacious and stubborn, the war beasts that pull these ramshackle chariots are grotesque combinations of great boar and mighty ram.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满的周身环绕着堕落法术的气息，足以将现世扭曲并加以毒害
desc.en: A palpable miasma of fell sorcery surrounds the Bray-Shaman, distorting and maiming reality.

desc.zh: 萨满们通常不会亲自参战，而是用他们的灵魂去占据一具合适的怪物肉身
desc.en: Shamans do not generally engage in physical combat themselves, instead sending out their spirit to possess a suitably monstrous surrogate.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满转述着黑暗诸神的意志，那些忤逆他们的人将付出最为高昂的代价
desc.en: Bray-Shamans speak the will of the Dark Gods, and those that defy them pay the highest price of all.

desc.zh: 厚重且蓬乱缠结的皮毛与可怕的饰物不仅使得嘶叫萨满看上去邪恶无比，更能很好地抵御伤害
desc.en: Impenetrably matted fur and grim trinkets make the Bray-Shamans more than just vile to behold, but incredibly hard to injure.

desc.zh: 在嘶叫萨满的咒语声中，那些身体或意志较弱的人就会将他们的头发与皮毛织成密不透风的皮革
desc.en: By the Bray-Shaman’s incantations, those lesser in body or mind have their hair and fur clogged into impervious hides.

desc.zh: 在合适的人手中，嘶叫法杖不仅是地位象征或是施法媒介，更是一件残忍的武器
desc.en: In the right hands the braystaff is not just a symbol of position or conduit of magic, but also a brutal weapon.

desc.zh: 在癫狂的仪式庆典中，嘶叫萨满祈唤黑暗诸神的权能，将野兽之力注入到兽群之中
desc.en: In frenzied ritual celebration the Bray-Shaman invokes the Dark Gods’ power to infuse the herds with bestial strength.

desc.zh: 若是有人身强体壮，足以驯服残暴的剃刀兽，便可将其套上战车，奔赴战场
desc.en: Those strong enough to tame the powerful, unruly Razorgors can harness them for chariots.

desc.zh: 这些好斗又顽固的巨兽拉着摇摇欲散的战车，它们的模样就像是巨大的野猪与强横的公羊的杂交产物
desc.en: Pugnacious and stubborn, the war beasts that pull these ramshackle chariots are grotesque combinations of great boar and mighty ram.

desc.zh: 这些好斗又顽固的巨兽拉着摇摇欲散的战车，它们的模样就像是巨大的野猪与强横的公羊的杂交产物
desc.en: Pugnacious and stubborn, the war beasts that pull these ramshackle chariots are grotesque combinations of great boar and mighty ram.

desc.zh: 领主的声音中蕴含着不断增强的恐惧力量，这种来自黑暗之主的馈赠能保证其部下的顺从
desc.en: This Lord speaks with a dread booming voice – a gift from his Dark Masters to ensure obedience.

desc.zh: 对许多人而言，恶名昭彰的鸦父便是报丧使者，他的出现意味着自己所珍视的一切都将灰飞烟灭
desc.en: To many, the vilified Crowfather is a harbinger of the downfall of all they hold dear.

desc.zh: 陶诺斯在猩红的月光下痛饮于血河，从自己的这份杰作中吸收最为邪恶的活力
desc.en: Under a scarlet moon, Taurox drank deep from the bloody river of his own creation to gain a most unholy vitality.

desc.zh: 血兽的蹄下流淌着绯色的溪流，揭示着他深不可测的杀戮欲，令他不断浸没在新泼洒的鲜血之中
desc.en: The crimson stream flowing at the Bloodbeast’s hooves betokens his unfathomable thirst for slaughter, ever drenching him in freshly spilled blood.

desc.zh: 恐虐为战争提供了大量的恩赐，但对陶诺斯的馈赠恐怕是所有野兽人中最上等的赐福
desc.en: Khorne grants multitudinous gifts for the purposes of war, but Taurox’s gift is perhaps the greatest of any one Beastman.

desc.zh: 对新鲜红肉的渴望并非来自于食欲，而是来自吞食敌人血肉的那份邪恶快意
desc.en: The need for fresh red meat is not driven by hunger for sustenance, but the unholy exhilaration of consuming an enemy’s flesh.

desc.zh: 该问的不是『谁会坐视他摧毁整个世界』，而是『到底谁能阻止他啊』
desc.en: The question is not "Who would let him destroy the world?", it’s "Who can even stop him?"

desc.zh: 古老苍莽的森林里掩藏着最大的恐怖，他们潜伏于暗影之中，直到张开血盆大口
desc.en: The impenetrable masses of ancient, gnarled forests harbour even the most gargantuan horrors, lurking undetected until emerging to fill their maws.

desc.zh: 这位冠军勇士为一种奇异的末日愿景与彻底的仇恨所控制，将黑暗诸神的意志传递开去
desc.en: Possessed by a singular, apocalyptic vision and utter hatred, this champion proliferates the Dark Gods' will.

desc.zh: 骁勇善战的战角兽们通常有着自己的战场策略，带着大角兽随从们冲锋在战兽群的前方
desc.en: Often operating their own battlefield manoeuvres, the unyielding Wargors maraud ahead of the warherd with their Bestigor retinues.

desc.zh: 只要能朝着正确的方向冲锋、释放自己的野性，即便稍显弱小的野兽也能在兽群领袖的带领下茁壮成长
desc.en: Certain lesser beasts thrive under a pack leader, if only just to charge them in the right direction to unleash their savagery.

desc.zh: 在咆哮的战角兽的鞭笞下，野兽人的战车用铁蹄、犄角和利刃将一切拦路者悉数扫荡殆尽
desc.en: Spurred forth by the bellowing Wargors, Beastmen chariots scatter all before them with hooves, horns and blades.

desc.zh: 战角兽们夜以继日地盘算着各式各样的诡计，好让自己在对手面前取得优势
desc.en: Day and night the Wargors brood and plot the myriad ways they can gain the upper hand over their victims.

desc.zh: 若是有人身强体壮，足以驯服残暴的剃刀兽，便可将其套上战车，奔赴战场
desc.en: Those strong enough to tame the powerful, unruly Razorgors can harness them for chariots.

desc.zh: 这些好斗又顽固的巨兽拉着摇摇欲散的战车，它们的模样就像是巨大的野猪与强横的公羊的杂交产物
desc.en: Pugnacious and stubborn, the war beasts that pull these ramshackle chariots are grotesque combinations of great boar and mighty ram.

desc.zh: 就用这个来跟兽人和地精打招呼
desc.en: By which one greets grobi and urk alike.

desc.zh: 虽然很多工程师都会随身携带着无数的工具，但也有些人主张只带五个不同的量角器，并把它奉为信条
desc.en: While many engineers carry innumerable tools on their person, some espouse the art of carrying only five different protractors.

desc.zh: 仇恨双管铳的凶猛扫射，能令最为愚蠢的生物也心生恐惧
desc.en: The deadly blast of the Grudge-raker inspires fear in even the most dimwitted creature.

desc.zh: 『退后！这些玩意像矮人一样靠谱没错，但只试验过一千次而已！』
desc.en: "Stand Back! These are Dawr, but this is only the milluzth attempt!"

desc.zh: 有了这种双管弹丸喷射装置，就可以轻松解决落单的敌人，或是向面前的部队倾泻弹雨
desc.en: With this double-barreled, pellet-spewing device, one can riddle a single target or blast a swathe into oncoming troops.

desc.zh: 每一发子弹都精雕细琢，轻轻一触便能带来死亡
desc.en: Each round delicately crafted to deliver death with a personal touch.

desc.zh: 工程大师们手握无数独特的工具与设备，不打上一架可不会轻言放弃
desc.en: In possession of countless irreplaceable tools and devices, no Master Engineer goes down without a fight!

desc.zh: 对于矮人工艺所制造的武器来说，与其担心它们会不会在战斗中报废，还是先担心弹药够不够用吧！
desc.en: Dwarfen craftsmanship ensures any weapon is infinitely more likely to run out of ammunition before succumbing to the stress of battle!

desc.zh: 『把战争机器带上来！把望远镜给我！』
desc.en: "Bring the Barag forwards! Hand me that spyglass!"

desc.zh: 矮人符文魔法极为强大，而且难以防御！
desc.en: Dawi Rune Magic is potent, and damned hard to defend against!

desc.zh: 末日铁砧所至之处，铁砧卫士必随之而至：永远忠诚，永远警惕
desc.en: Where the Anvil of Doom goes, so too does the Anvilguard, ever loyal and vigilant.

desc.zh: 『必须精确契合！细节决定成败啊！』
desc.en: "It must be perfect! Anything less is as good as useless!"

desc.zh: 当面对如此的狂怒时，最安全的办法就是赶紧转头逃跑，越快越好！
desc.en: When facing a rage like this it's usually safest to run in the opposite direction. And quickly.

desc.zh: 铁砧散发着浓烈的神力，强烈地影响着敌方法师的思绪
desc.en: The dense power exuded from the Anvil weighs heavily upon the minds of enemy Wizards.

desc.zh: 这幅铁砧上附满了符文领主先辈们的工作记录，它所锻造出的可是史上最强悍的符文武器！
desc.en: Covered in the Runelord’s ancient script, the anvil has given form to the most powerful runic weapons ever forged.

desc.zh: 『不是这么整的，你个傻逼！』
desc.en: "Not like that, you wazzock!"

desc.zh: 『如果我们光荣的祖先用得称手，那我们也肯定能用得称手！』
desc.en: "If they were good enough for our glorious Ancestors, they're good enough for us!"

desc.zh: 传说中的符文武器，正是从末日铁砧上锻造而出
desc.en: Upon the Anvil of Doom the rune weapons of legend are forged.

desc.zh: 『每嵌上一个新符文都是对我们敌人的重击！』
desc.en: "Every new rune struck is a blow to our enemies!"

desc.zh: 『这些符文蕴含着强大的魔力，由一位真正的大师锻造在一起』
desc.en: The magic is strong in these runes, bound together by a true master.

desc.zh: 『以加祖尔之愿，这些掠夺死者的邪恶之徒将领受正义的制裁！』
desc.en: "By Gazul's will, the foul despoilers of the dead shall meet their justice!"

desc.zh: 『我在加祖尔的庇佑下杀出地底，只为先祖们的魂魄能得以安息』
desc.en: "From the Underearth I venture with Gazul's blessing, so that the spirits of the ancestors may rest in peace."

desc.zh: 『然而满世妖孽就能杀得了这些凡人吗？』
desc.en: "But can all the horrors of the world kill these mere mortals?"

desc.zh: 以信念之火驱散黑暗
desc.en: Burn away the darkness in the flames of conviction.

desc.zh: 托雷克拒绝新的技术，只使用古老的技艺为古矮人帝国的事业提供顾问和强力的武装
desc.en: Thorek does not abide new technology, using ancient techniques to lend his council and strong arm to the cause of the old Dwarf Empire.

desc.zh: 奸奇魔域中滋生的水晶可为飞镖附魔，令其获得刺穿任何护甲的能力。即使面对最强的敌人，也能直击其致命弱点
desc.en: The ground crystals of Tzeentch's realm can imbue darts with the power to pierce any ward and find the weakest points on the most formidable foes.

desc.zh: 这种毒药自罕见的花朵中萃取，而这花朵只生长在纳垢花园中毒性最强的角落。它会在漫长的痛苦中将人慢慢折磨致死
desc.en: Harvested from a rare flower found only in the most toxic corners of Nurgle's gardens, this poison ensures a long and painful death.

desc.zh: 替换为技能描述
desc.en: Replaced by ability description

desc.zh: 欧西约坦的时代更接近于一个技术奇迹的时代，那时蜥蜴人还使用着以古圣神力驱动的神秘装置
desc.en: Oxyotl’s time was closer to an age of technological wonders, when the Lizardmen wielded the Old Ones’ untold devices of mysterious power.

desc.zh: 灭绝是为天理，幸存则是意外
desc.en: Extinction is the rule. Survival is the exception.

desc.zh: 哪怕只是对这个世界在败给混沌后的命运略窥一二，就足以明白，与他们的战斗绝无退路
desc.en: A first-hand glimpse of the world’s fate – should Chaos succeed – is enough to know the fight against them must never falter.

desc.zh: 从混沌魔域的归途需要经过难以记述的堕落之地，还有栖息着众多奇幻生物的遗忘之地
desc.en: The path back from the Chaos Realm passes through fell places that cannot be recounted, but also forgotten lands of wondrous creatures.

desc.zh: 凭着直觉与机敏，欧西约坦在魔物环伺的混沌魔域中得以幸存。而在这里，他可不会给这些家伙幸存的机会了
desc.en: With nothing but instincts and cunning, Oxyotl survived the creatures of the Chaos Realm. In this realm, they will not survive him.

desc.zh: 欧西约坦的敌人们一次又一次发觉他就在附近，最后却都在一阵标雨中惨死
desc.en: Time after time, Oxyotl’s enemies arrive to find him ensconced nearby, soon meeting their deaths in a hail of barbed darts.

desc.zh: 先知的预知能力能够使得他周围的勇士们在最激烈的战况中保持镇静
desc.en: The Oracle’s divining presence can anchor the impassiveness of the braves around him in the most heated of battles.

desc.zh: 穴居龙会朝对手吐出剧毒的汁液，并利用灼烧肉体的嘶嘶作响找到他们的位置
desc.en: Spitting toxic bile, the Troglodon triangulates its victim’s location as the fluid sizzles upon searing flesh.

desc.zh: 筑巢于朽烂灌木丛中的爬行玩意们会彻底淹没敌人：这是一片真正的虫潮
desc.en: A vile wave indeed, the creeping things that nest in the decaying undergrowth swarm all over the foe.

desc.zh: 索隆格坐在他的石质王座上，率领着巨魔国度的所有怪兽，时刻准备着消灭一切敢于找上门的敌人
desc.en: Brooding upon his rocky throne, Throgg has pledged to fight all comers, with all the monsters of Troll Country at his side.

desc.zh: 『神能赐予我的，也能赐予他人。我不愿混杂在愚昧的动物中，不愿与它们为伍』
desc.en: "What the Gods gifted to me can be gifted to another. I will not be the one mind in a race of blunt, witless animals."

desc.zh: 索隆格有着成为统治者的勃勃野心，但并不代表他是个只会躲在幕后使唤军团的暴君
desc.en: Despite his aspirations as a ruler, Throgg is no tin tyrant hiding behind foolish legions.

desc.zh: 乌弗瑞克曾追随过伟大的战士之王，亦曾诅咒过拒绝他的诸神
desc.en: Wulfrik once pursued the path of a great warrior king, and for a time cursed the gods for denying him.

desc.zh: 乌弗瑞克的舌中大礼意味着没人能拒绝他的决斗，但他仍喜欢用粗鲁的谩骂来摧毁敌人的心智
desc.en: Wulfrik’s Gift of Tongues means no-one can deny him a duel, but he still delights in crude invectives to break his enemies’ spirits.

desc.zh: 如同野兽般强大的人类也要倒在他们脚下
desc.en: Men as great as the beasts they bring down.

desc.zh: 符文铁匠打磨的护甲糅合了魔法与金属工艺，比其他任何凡世种族所打造的装备都更坚固
desc.en: Blending magic and metalwork, the Runesmith hones armour with greater solidity than items wrought by any other mortal race in the world.

desc.zh: 当符文铁匠感受到战火的肆虐时，他的群落所持的武器就会像在高温的炉膛里那样散发微光——这或许是来自葛朗尼的馈赠吧
desc.en: Perhaps by some gift of Grungni, when a Runesmith feels the rage of battle his throng’s weapons glow with the heat of the forgefires.

desc.zh: 若是立誓有所捍卫之人，战斗起来必定更加英勇，宁可欣然赴死也不愿蒙受失败之辱
desc.en: One bound by an oath to defend fights all the harder, gladly giving his life rather than face the dishonour of failure.

desc.zh: 说来或许匪夷所思，但在地下深坑的战斗中，人们必须与爆炸物近在咫尺也能泰然处之
desc.en: Deep-tunnel warfare requires one to become comfortable standing closer to explosions than is perhaps sensible.

desc.zh: 这些人长期远离安全的城塞、外出追踪敌人，因而成为了能够出其不意接近敌人的专家
desc.en: Long periods spent tracking foes far from the safety of the Holds makes experts at approaching enemies from unexpected angles.

desc.zh: 世间无匹的亡灵术能令国王都死而复生
desc.en: Necromancy without peer; reanimation worthy of a king.

desc.zh: 『我效忠于纳迦什又能有什么前途呢？在一成不变的世界里，做一个没有脑子的仆从？亡灵大法师不过是个自私的稚童罢了』
desc.en: "What greater prospect do I have in Nagash's service – a future of mindless servitude in an unchanging world? The Great Necromancer is a selfish child."

desc.zh: 为了求知，凯姆勒会毫不犹豫地掘坟开墓、亵渎古迹
desc.en: Kemmler does not hesitate to plunder barrows, pillage tombs, or desecrate ancient halls in his pursuit of knowledge.

desc.zh: 来自古代坟茔的诅咒遗物不管是切开肉体还是撕裂灵魂，都是一样地干净利落
desc.en: Accursed relics from ancient barrows cleave the soul as easily as they part the flesh.

desc.zh: 即便已成亡灵，女王也需要忠诚的仆从和侍女
desc.en: Even in Undeath, every queen needs loyal retainers and handmaidens.

desc.zh: 即便已成亡灵，女王也需要忠诚的仆从和侍女
desc.en: Even in Undeath, every queen needs loyal retainers and handmaidens.

desc.zh: 黑暗之术的『学徒』？恰恰相反，这个吸血鬼堪称黑魔法与巫术的大师！
desc.en: This one is no apprentice in the black arts but a master of Necromancy and Dark Magic.

desc.zh: 千百年磨练的技艺，血海里杀出的功力
desc.en: Skill honed by centuries, strength tempered by blood.

desc.zh: 必须兼具疯狂，绝望和铁打的肠胃才能跟活死人一起入伍服役
desc.en: It takes a combination of madness, desperation and an iron stomach to be levied alongside the living dead.

desc.zh: 骷髅战马披着精美的盔甲，这是何等震撼人心却又危险万分的景象
desc.en: Skeletal Steeds draped in fine armour make for an impressive and dangerous sight.

desc.zh: 尸妖王需要坐骑，但他们讨厌活马，于是他们找来了死马
desc.en: Wight Kings require the steeds that bore them in life, and will do again in death.

desc.zh: 这艘强大的飞艇承载着立下誓言的屠夫们以及天才工程师马拉凯·马凯森，将与那些胆敢对矮人一族，尤其是对高崔克挑起战争的人们战斗到底！
desc.en: The mighty Airship of the oathsworn Slayer and gifted Engineer Malakai Makaisson carries him into the fray against those who would dare to wage war against Dawi-kind, and Gotrek in particular!

desc.zh: 塔木尔可汗名扬四海，或者更确切地说，是遗臭万年
desc.en: Tamurkhan's utterly fearsome reputation walks, or rather slithers, before him.

desc.zh: 这名领主在战场内外的所作所为着实令盟友起敬，同时也令敌人胆寒
desc.en: This Lord's many deeds - both on and off the battlefield - have brought them renown among their allies and made them feared by their enemies.

desc.zh: 不论是加强训练，轻装行进，减少进食还是提高睡眠质量，人总有办法在一天中做成更多事
desc.en: Whether it be training harder, travelling lighter, eating less or sleeping better, there's always a way to draw more from the day.

desc.zh: 军中战士可以在这位冠军勇士的力量下得到救助或补充
desc.en: Those in the army can find succour or be replenished by the power of this champion.

desc.zh: 『我不是来鼓舞士气的，我是来上场杀敌的！快来吧，我们一起拔剑！』
desc.en: "I am not here to inspire, I am here to kill - come let us draw blades together!"

desc.zh: 施法者常常能感知魔法距离是在缩短还是随风远逝
desc.en: Spellcasters can oft-sense when magic is close or being drawn from the Winds.

desc.zh: 该勇士崇尚军纪，害怕走上战场的同时却又害怕远离战场
desc.en: This champion extols discipline and fear away from the battlefield as much as on it.

desc.zh: 资深刺客是一位冷血无情的杀手
desc.en: A skilled assassin is a cold-hearted killer and merciless murderer.

desc.zh: 这名冠军勇士从不知屈服为何物，只懂得以领主之名陷阵厮杀
desc.en: Such a champion will not bend or break, but slay in their Lord's name.

desc.zh: 『我不是学生，我是专家！向他们施以魔法，让他们的灵魂彻底枯萎！』
desc.en: "I'm no pupil, but an adept! A hex on them, may their souls shrivel from their bones!"

desc.zh: 等待需要的是经验与耐心，这样才能在最出其不意时发动突袭
desc.en: Lying in wait, experienced and patient, striking when the foe least expects.

desc.zh: 引发敌人的纷争和混乱，诱导他们走错方向或迷惑他们的理智
desc.en: To sow discord and confuse the enemy, sending them down the wrong route or befuddling their senses.

desc.zh: 赞美死亡、亵渎神灵的强者足以让敌人的整支军队跪地求饶
desc.en: The sight of a powerful figure extolling death and blasphemies can bring enemy ranks to their knees.

desc.zh: 『若敌人发现我的到来，那就最好不过了！』
desc.en: "If they know I'm coming then more's the better!"

desc.zh: 掠夺、破坏和毁灭并不是只有混沌之力才能做到
desc.en: It is not just the forces of Chaos that can despoil, break and ruin.

desc.zh: 他们无法阻止自己看不到的家伙
desc.en: They cannot stop what they cannot see.

desc.zh: 除却威逼利诱之外别无他法使人信服者，是为富人
desc.en: Wealthy are they who can convince others of their ways without resort to pressure or cajolery.

desc.zh: 虽然你所拥有的并不算少，但通常你所想要的就是对手所拥有的；这种嫉妒可以激发人的想象和创造力
desc.en: Oft-times, though you may have much, what you want the most is what your rivals have; such envy focuses the mind and creativity.

desc.zh: 这些魔法师聪明过人，并且能够提供不少明智的建议，尤其在他们已经占卜过该区域的情况下
desc.en: Such magic-users may be wise and able to offer sage advice, especially if they have scried the region.

desc.zh: 文明的发展需要奴隶。国家的未来全都寄托在他们的辛勤劳动之上
desc.en: Civilisation requires slaves. It is upon their toil that the future depends.

desc.zh: 贸易和投资是国家发展的支柱
desc.en: Trade and investment are the pillars of development.

desc.zh: 当地人会注意到此人的来临，并在激励或恐吓下遂行此人的意愿
desc.en: The locals take notice and will be inspired or frightened into action.

desc.zh: 当地人会注意到此人的来临，并在激励或恐吓下遂行此人的意愿
desc.en: The locals take notice and will be inspired or frightened into action.

desc.zh: 当地人会注意到此人的来临，并在激励或恐吓下遂行此人的意愿
desc.en: The locals take notice and will be inspired or frightened into action.

desc.zh: 当地人会注意到此人的来临，并在激励或恐吓下遂行此人的意愿
desc.en: The locals take notice and will be inspired or frightened into action.

desc.zh: 这名战士一旦出现，其外貌、内涵甚至恶名，都将起到安定军心的效果
desc.en: The sight of this warrior, their stature, import or infamy, can have a calming effect.

desc.zh: 当地人会注意到此人的来临，并在激励或恐吓下遂行此人的意愿
desc.en: The locals take notice and will be inspired or frightened into action.

desc.zh: 所有人都必须听好！这消息可能会棒极了，也可能会糟透了！
desc.en: All will listen, for the news will either be dire or wonderful.

desc.zh: 这名英雄技艺超群，熟知各种常见错误，并知道如何才能避免犯错
desc.en: An expert in their craft, this Hero knows all the mistakes that can be made and how to best avoid making them.

desc.zh: 谁想永生呢？其实大多数人都不会拒绝的…
desc.en: Who wants to live forever? As it turns out, most beings wouldn't say no…

desc.zh: 谁想永生呢？其实大多数人都不会拒绝的…
desc.en: Who wants to live forever? As it turns out, most beings wouldn't say no…

desc.zh: 远处可怕的钟声响起，敲到第十三下时，斯卡文鼠人便从洞穴中钻了出来
desc.en: A terrible bell chimes from afar. By its thirteenth toll, Skaven have been brought forth through a hole in reality.

desc.zh: 这一法术会召唤出潜伏地下的爬虫，令大群的蜘蛛、蜈蚣与食肉甲虫吞没敌军
desc.en: This spell calls to the creeping things of the undergrowth, sending a swarm of spiders, centipedes and slug-beetles onto the foe.

desc.zh: 怀有贰心从来都不是什么光明正大的事儿…尤其是当有个人正在密切注视并举报你的一举一动的时候
desc.en: Treason is never straightforward, especially when your every move is watched and reported.

desc.zh: 虽然魔法是战场上最强的杀器之一，但在传统的蛮力面前也得自愧不如
desc.en: Magic is a most useful tool on the field of battle, but generally secondary in the face of good, old-fashioned brute force.

desc.zh: 不管适当与否，要是能靠鞭子就能得到想要的结果，又何乐而不为呢？
desc.en: Judicious, or even not-so-judicious, use of the lash tends to get the desired results, so why hold back?

desc.zh: 能驱使凶蛮不羁的冷血种？这招绝不能被轻视，毕竟并非人人都有这本事！
desc.en: The ability to command the savage, untamed Cold Ones should not be underestimated - not everyone has the knack!

desc.zh: 领主们可以将凯恩的灼天怒火传承给麾下军团
desc.en: The murderous, unforgiving rage of Khaine can be transferred from a Lord to his legions.

desc.zh: 绝不能让没达到标准的人轻易去死，所以要拿他们来当活靶子使！
desc.en: Those who fail to make the grade don't just die, they're tortured and used for target practice!

desc.zh: 这名技艺娴熟的战士堪称精英中的精英，他深谙近战肉搏之道，可以说就是一名死亡舞者
desc.en: An elite even amongst elites, this accomplished warrior directs the cut-and-thrust of melee - a choreographer of death, you might say.

desc.zh: 自助者，天助之。他们拔擢于行伍之间，跻身精英行列
desc.en: The gods help those who help themselves - raising them above the rank and file to elite status.

desc.zh: 有效组织远程部队乃至精英进行齐射，其秘诀就在于掌握时机
desc.en: Marshalling missile troops effectively - even elites - is all about timing.

desc.zh: 要是你以为洗劫土地能带来足够的报偿，那你可就大错特错了
desc.en: You'd think that pillaging the land would bring payment enough. You'd be wrong.

desc.zh: 最厉害的掠夺者会制定万全计划并贯彻实施，正是这一点才保证了他们的成功
desc.en: The most effective raiders have a plan that is certain to succeed and stick to it; this one ensures that they do.

desc.zh: 要想战胜此人就必须早做准备，没有什么能逃得过此人锐利的眼光和迅捷的反应
desc.en: You have to get up very early if you want to beat this one; nothing escapes their keen eye and lightning reflexes.

desc.zh: 必须要有人来保证新兵的数量和质量
desc.en: Someone has to ensure the numbers and quality of recruits remain high.

desc.zh: 有此人在，战俘们恐怕会只恨未能战死沙场，等待他们的将是残酷命运
desc.en: This one ensures that those captured in battle wished they'd died on the field, so great is the cruelty that awaits them.

desc.zh: 深知设伏时机、地点与目标需要十足的机敏狡诈
desc.en: Knowing precisely where and when to launch an ambush, and against who, takes an unusual level of guile.

desc.zh: 要是写本编年史来谈谈世上掠夺者们干的那些破事，这名惯匪无疑是其中最瞩目的一章
desc.en: If there were annals detailing the dastardly deeds of the sackers and looters of the world, this inveterate brigand would feature heavily.

desc.zh: 这名勇士早先曾中过埋伏，但他设法使不少同胞幸免脱身。这段经历自然使他时时刻刻警惕万分
desc.en: This warrior has been ambushed previously and got themselves and many of their compatriots away safely. Such things make one naturally suspicious.

desc.zh: 战争就像艺术，随着时间的推移与技巧的训练，战斗中的走位简直就像一场精心编排的舞蹈一般
desc.en: So much of war is an art. Over time and with much practice, combat moves can resemble a series of perfectly-rehearsed dance moves.

desc.zh: 虽然精确射击可以后天习得，但此人天生就精准善射
desc.en: Although precision in missile combat is something that can be learned, this one was born with a high degree of natural talent.

desc.zh: 坚硬且有鳞的海龙皮可以有效抵御各种伤害
desc.en: The tough, scaly hide of the Sea Dragon provides excellent protection against all manner of blows.

desc.zh: 此人虔心侍奉血手之神，因此获得了神的眷顾，使得她在近战中比别人更为强韧
desc.en: Deep devotion to the Bloody-handed God have led to his favour, enabling her to withstand more punishment in melee than others.

desc.zh: 死亡魔女吼出凯恩的十七个秘名之一，可以封冻敌人，使其陷入惊惧之中
desc.en: By screeching one of the seventeen secret names of Khaine, the Death Hag freezes her enemies with horror.

desc.zh: 凯恩的血红符文在死亡魔女眉上燃烧，使之成为杀戮领主的选命之人
desc.en: His gore-red rune blazes upon the Death Hag's brow, marking her as one of the Lord of Murder's chosen.

desc.zh: 这是凯恩的礼物，其中便是永恒年轻与美貌的秘密。他的新娘会在里面洗澡，以便恢复青春
desc.en: A gift from Khaine, containing the secret of eternal youth and beauty. His brides may bathe in it to renew their vitality.

desc.zh: 黑龙是马雷基斯秘密培养的产物，关于腐化与强化的黑魔法已经浸染了这条龙的身躯
desc.en: Secretly nurtured by Malekith, Black Dragons are enchanted with Dark Magic that corrupts and enhances.

desc.zh: 纳迦罗斯土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着杜鲁齐们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Naggaroth, tempted from their damp, warm caves to bear the Druchii to battle.

desc.zh: 被腐蚀的飞马从混沌荒原向南飞到了纳迦罗斯的钢铁山脉，并在那里筑起了巢
desc.en: The corrupted Dark Pegasi fly south from the Chaos Wastes to Naggaroth's Iron Mountains to make their nests.

desc.zh: 它们已不再是真正的马匹，因为黑魔法已腐蚀了这些最优秀的精灵战马，并将其转化成了体侧黝黑的杀手
desc.en: True horses no longer, Dark Magic corrupts the finest Elven steeds and turns them into black-flanked killers.

desc.zh: 黑龙是马雷基斯秘密培养的产物，关于腐化与强化的黑魔法已经浸染了这条龙的身躯
desc.en: Secretly nurtured by Malekith, Black Dragons are enchanted with Dark Magic that corrupts and enhances.

desc.zh: 纳迦罗斯土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着杜鲁齐们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Naggaroth, tempted from their damp, warm caves to bear the Druchii to battle.

desc.zh: 被腐蚀的飞马从混沌荒原向南飞到了纳迦罗斯的钢铁山脉，并在那里筑起了巢
desc.en: The corrupted Dark Pegasi fly south from the Chaos Wastes to Naggaroth's Iron Mountains to make their nests.

desc.zh: 它们已不再是真正的马匹，因为黑魔法已腐蚀了这些最优秀的精灵战马，并将其转化成了体侧黝黑的杀手
desc.en: True horses no longer, Dark Magic corrupts the finest Elven steeds and turns them into black-flanked killers.

desc.zh: 这名战士的攻击力度绝不会动摇，这全因为他对他的高等精灵远亲的憎恨
desc.en: The strength of this warrior's attack never wavers for an instance, such is the opprobrium felt for their hated High Elf cousins.

desc.zh: 赫卡提会察觉精灵的欲望，即便是阿萨提也无法比拟，想要取悦赫卡提并非难事，但是只有蠢货才会让这种事发生
desc.en: It is easy to favour Hekarti - who pays close attention to Elven desires - over Atharti, but only the foolish allow that to happen.

desc.zh: 赫卡提会察觉精灵的欲望，即便是阿萨提也无法比拟，想要取悦赫卡提并非难事，但是只有蠢货才会让这种事发生
desc.en: It is easy to favour Hekarti - who pays close attention to Elven desires - over Atharti, but only the foolish allow that to happen.

desc.zh: 此人在羞辱他人并使之痛苦的过程中获得极大的快感，且深深为之着迷
desc.en: There is great pleasure to be derived from the humiliation and suffering of others; this one has felt and revelled in it.

desc.zh: 守护魔法的黑暗女神眷顾着她忠诚的信徒
desc.en: Magic's dark mistress has a care for her dutiful acolytes.

desc.zh: 血手之神眷顾着他的信徒
desc.en: The Bloody-handed God watches over his disciples.

desc.zh: 纳迦罗斯土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着杜鲁齐们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Naggaroth, tempted from their damp, warm caves to bear the Druchii to battle.

desc.zh: 绚丽的战车，它们是献给那些在战场上表现出献身精神、勇敢品质与高超武艺的勇士的礼物
desc.en: Magnificent chariots, gifted to those who have impressed with their devotion, bravery and prowess in battle.

desc.zh: 这条可怕的黑龙是巫王最喜欢的坐骑，他经常骑着它步上战场
desc.en: This terrifying Black Dragon is the Witch King's favoured mount upon which to ride into battle.

desc.zh: 镇压，残忍，无人能敌
desc.en: Oppression. Cruelty. Incontrovertible power.

desc.zh: 出其不意而又令人胆寒的鞭笞或处刑可以看做是对人们的一种激励
desc.en: Unsurprisingly, dread, either of the lash or summary execution, is something of an incentive for many.

desc.zh: 在社会中，人要么学会顺从，要么承受苦果
desc.en: In society, one must learn to conform... or suffer the direst of consequences.

desc.zh: 无论奖惩，命中注定侍奉之人都将更卖力地工作，当然他们通常更在意的是后者…
desc.en: By carrot or stick, those whose lot it is to serve can always be made to work harder; usually by stick...

desc.zh: 刀兵不息，战火不灭。做好准备
desc.en: The war is endless, it will never cease. Stay ready.

desc.zh: 金银财宝就在那里等你去拿，你们要知道该去往何方。如此看来，此人对自己所做的一切都心知肚明
desc.en: Every last ounce of wealth is there for the taking, should you know where to look. In that regard, this one knows exactly what he is doing.

desc.zh: 俗话说恶人之所以得逞，是因为善良之人无所作为…或者更确切地说，是因为从一开始就无所作为
desc.en: They say for evil to triumph, all that's required is that the good do nothing… or, preferably, are stone dead from the outset.

desc.zh: 当万事万物真的落入了你的掌控之中后，这世上还会有什么避难之地呢？
desc.en: When literally nothing is beyond your reach, there can be no sanctuary and no escape.

desc.zh: 至高女巫效忠于混沌诸神，这使她能够抵御魔法攻击
desc.en: The Hag Sorceress' allegiance to the Ruinous influence of the Chaos Gods grants her a degree of protection against magical attack.

desc.zh: 祈祷之中所有的仇恨、嫉妒及恶意都将千倍奉还
desc.en: All the hate, envy, and malice uttered in prayer each day, returned a thousand-fold.

desc.zh: 此人活动好每一根筋骨，随时随地准备出动
desc.en: Every fibre of their being is charged and ready for action - wherever, whenever.

desc.zh: 莫拉丝的坐骑是唯一有名字的黑暗飞马，它承载着至高女巫杀入战阵
desc.en: The only Dark Pegasus to bear a name is Morathi's personal mount, who carries the Hag Sorceress into the fray.

desc.zh: 慢慢悄悄、小心翼翼地干掉挡道的人
desc.en: Slowly, gradually, subtly harming all those that block her path.

desc.zh: 万变之谋即便实现之时亦可改变
desc.en: A plan so complex, so labyrinthine, can change even as it comes to fruition.

desc.zh: 祭品越是可怕，就越能吸引神明的注意
desc.en: The grimmer the offering, the more likely it is to attract exactly the right kind of attention.

desc.zh: 光明被驱离战场，无尽的黑暗涌入虚空
desc.en: Light is driven from the battlefield; numbing darkness rushes to fill the void.

desc.zh: 此人不仅坚决果断，更能始终贯彻自己的邪恶目标
desc.en: More than determined, she ensures her nefarious goal is always kept firmly in sight.

desc.zh: 从活生生的『捐献者』体中取出的鲜血可以强化祭礼魔法
desc.en: Blood, preferably from a still-living 'donor', can enhance and intensify the effects of ceremonial magic.

desc.zh: 此人能时刻煽起巫王心中的仇恨之火，当巫王遭到背叛时，没有谁能像他一样为恢复巫王的统治而奋战
desc.en: Always ready to fan the flames of hatred in the Witch King's heart; when he has been betrayed, none have fought so hard to restore his rule.

desc.zh: 她手下技能最熟练者被高举在上，这样才能烧出更加绚烂的火光
desc.en: The most skilled amongst her possessions are held aloft, that they may burn all the more brightly.

desc.zh: 邪魔振翅飞翔，黑暗的翅膀遮住了月亮，呼唤我们随之共舞…
desc.en: Evil takes flight; blotting out the moon on blackened wings, calling us to the dance…

desc.zh: 此人拜领一项属于勇士的异名。这是他在战场上奋力搏杀所得来的荣耀，从此这一异名会把恐惧深深刺入敌人心中
desc.en: This one has adopted a warrior name to strike fear into enemy hearts, a moniker backed up by their deeds in battle.

desc.zh: 此人的异名在低语声中传颂，此人的行事风格也就此为人所铭记
desc.en: This one's chosen name is muttered in hushed tones, reflecting as it does their vile proclivities.

desc.zh: 有些名门的名号还是为人所遗忘的好；然而，有些为人既敬且畏的家族名号，却是值得重出江湖
desc.en: Some family names are best forgotten; others are worthy of resurrection, as they engender fear and respect among the masses.

desc.zh: 纳迦罗斯土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着杜鲁齐们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Naggaroth, tempted from their damp, warm caves to bear the Druchii to battle.

desc.zh: 被腐蚀的飞马从混沌荒原向南飞到了纳迦罗斯的钢铁山脉，并在那里筑起了巢
desc.en: The corrupted Dark Pegasi fly south from the Chaos Wastes to Naggaroth's Iron Mountains to make their nests.

desc.zh: 它们已不再是真正的马匹，因为黑魔法已腐蚀了这些最优秀的精灵战马，并将其转化成了体侧黝黑的杀手
desc.en: True horses no longer, Dark Magic corrupts the finest Elven steeds and turns them into black-flanked killers.

desc.zh: 纳迦罗斯土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着杜鲁齐们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Naggaroth, tempted from their damp, warm caves to bear the Druchii to battle.

desc.zh: 被腐蚀的飞马从混沌荒原向南飞到了纳迦罗斯的钢铁山脉，并在那里筑起了巢
desc.en: The corrupted Dark Pegasi fly south from the Chaos Wastes to Naggaroth's Iron Mountains to make their nests.

desc.zh: 它们已不再是真正的马匹，因为黑魔法已腐蚀了这些最优秀的精灵战马，并将其转化成了体侧黝黑的杀手
desc.en: True horses no longer, Dark Magic corrupts the finest Elven steeds and turns them into black-flanked killers.

desc.zh: 纳迦罗斯土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着杜鲁齐们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Naggaroth, tempted from their damp, warm caves to bear the Druchii to battle.

desc.zh: 被腐蚀的飞马从混沌荒原向南飞到了纳迦罗斯的钢铁山脉，并在那里筑起了巢
desc.en: The corrupted Dark Pegasi fly south from the Chaos Wastes to Naggaroth's Iron Mountains to make their nests.

desc.zh: 它们已不再是真正的马匹，因为黑魔法已腐蚀了这些最优秀的精灵战马，并将其转化成了体侧黝黑的杀手
desc.en: True horses no longer, Dark Magic corrupts the finest Elven steeds and turns them into black-flanked killers.

desc.zh: 涂了人间祸根的刀子即便轻轻划一下也能置人于死地
desc.en: Even the merest scratch caused by a blade edged with Manbane causes death.

desc.zh: 这种毒药有强烈的麻醉作用，可以让目标精神错乱
desc.en: This poison contains a powerful narcotic that drives its victims to delusional insanity.

desc.zh: 此人不仅是在暗影中行动，此人就是暗影的化身…
desc.en: This one doesn't just move in the shadows, they *are* the shadows…

desc.zh: 世上有些契约还是不背弃为妙…
desc.en: There are some deals that it would be extremely unwise to renege on…

desc.zh: 此人是一名熟练的猎手，也是一名身经百战的查瑞斯白狮禁卫，他需要猎杀查瑞斯最凶猛的野兽才能担此重任
desc.en: An expert hunter and a veteran White Lion of Chrace; his rite of passage was to hunt and slay Chrace's fiercest creatures.

desc.zh: 与其他白狮禁卫一样，这名勇士有幸能成为凤凰王的贴身近卫
desc.en: Like many other White Lions, this warrior was honoured to serve as the personal bodyguard of the Phoenix King.

desc.zh: 打得准，打得狠
desc.en: Strike true, strike hard.

desc.zh: 他们坚若磐石，能够抵御一切进攻
desc.en: Like a wall of the hardest stone imaginable - such is their ability to withstand attack.

desc.zh: 将一群乌合之众训练成作战部队需要特殊的天分与十足的耐心
desc.en: Turning an untrained bunch of regular citizens into effective fighting units requires a special kind of talent, and oodles of patience.

desc.zh: 此人多年鞍马征战，今已获得成效，他对军队与战马的掌控都堪称一流
desc.en: Years of experience in mounted combat has started to pay off; this one is always in command of both their force and its steeds.

desc.zh: 多数情况下，冲锋在前者在其他的战斗中也会如此英勇
desc.en: Being present at the very forefront of the assault, on many occasions, prepares one for future engagements of a similar nature.

desc.zh: 此人深知奇谋妙计可以克敌制胜，也能未雨绸缪面面俱到，因此此人地位远居普通谋士之上
desc.en: Knowing that it is the rare plan that survives contact with the enemy, yet being prepared for all eventualities, raises this one above mere planners.

desc.zh: 当狂风永远吹向你所希望的方向时，失败就会成为概率极小的事件了
desc.en: When the gale always blows in the direction of your choosing, failure becomes a rare event indeed.

desc.zh: 此人对天空毫无畏惧，因此得以操控飞行猛兽杀入战场
desc.en: The firmament holds no fear for this one, such is their command of the many airborne beasts of battle.

desc.zh: 火焰中心烧灼得最烈
desc.en: The very centre of the fire always burns the hottest.

desc.zh: 远程战斗并非只为进攻而生，知道如何在防守中运用也是大有裨益
desc.en: Missile combat isn't always about attacking; knowing how to defend also pays dividends.

desc.zh: 如果你的大军想要冲垮敌军防线，那么速度、敏捷与控制力是必不可少的
desc.en: Speed, agility and control - all must be mastered if your crushing tide is to break perfectly upon enemy shores.

desc.zh: 上古阿苏尔不仅教人杀敌夺命，也会教人救死扶伤
desc.en: The ancient Asur arts teach one how to heal as well as how to harm.

desc.zh: 许多高等精灵远离尘世各族纷扰，潜心研究学术、魔法与文艺
desc.en: Far removed from the petty squabbles of other races, many High Elves are able to devote themselves to learning, magic and the arts.

desc.zh: 『多数反自由市场理论的，其实是对自由本身的不信任』
desc.en: “Underlying most arguments against the free market is a lack of belief in freedom itself.”

desc.zh: 剑即是世界的轴心，其威力不容置疑
desc.en: The sword is the axis of the world and its power is absolute.

desc.zh: 恐慌与惊惧多会发生在别人身上
desc.en: Panic and fear are things that happen to others.

desc.zh: 怒焰使者的信徒会获得神力，能干净利落地消灭敌人
desc.en: Those who follow the Bringer of Wrath and Fire are blessed with direct and forceful solutions to the obstacles in their way.

desc.zh: 阿苏焉的信徒们坚信自己是创世神计划中的一部分，而且自己永远不会被神抛弃
desc.en: Asuryan's adherents believe they are part of the Creator's plan and will never be abandoned.

desc.zh: 荷斯的信徒沐浴在其守护神的慷慨之中，正是他才给精灵们带来了高贵的知识
desc.en: The supporters of Hoeth bask in their patron's generosity, for it was he who gifted the Elves with much of their revered knowledge.

desc.zh: 如果周围一切都陷入天崩地裂之中，而你依然安然无恙的话，那这就是地震之神哈空显灵了
desc.en: If you can hold you ground when all around are falling into the cracks, then that's the patronage of Hukon, God of Earthquakes.

desc.zh: 丰饶女神保佑农民与母亲，同时也会保佑那些在海外身陷险地的信徒
desc.en: The Goddess of Fertility blesses farmers and mothers, but also those votaries who are caught abroad in dangerous lands.

desc.zh: 爱莎的丈夫是众精灵之父，他会保佑狩猎取食者，但会将厄运降至那些为娱乐而杀戮者身上
desc.en: Isha's husband is the father of all Elves; his blessings are given to those who hunt for food, but woe betide those who kill for sport.

desc.zh: 海神玛瑟兰保佑着海员与探险者，精灵们出海或探索新大陆时都会向他祈祷
desc.en: As the Lord of the Sea, Mathlann is patron to sailors and explorers; he is prayed to by Elves about to embark on a voyage or seeking new lands.

desc.zh: 铸造之神知道精灵们需要烈火与愤怒才能活下去，他的祝福使得精灵们在接下来的黑暗时光里能够更加坚强
desc.en: The God of Smiths knows the Elves will need fire and fury to survive; his blessings steel them for the darker days ahead.

desc.zh: 当面对挑战、抉择或单纯只是需要运气之时，人们都会向梦境与幸运女神祈祷
desc.en: Those facing a great challenge, a difficult decision, or simply in need of luck, may call upon the Goddess of Dreams and Fortune.

desc.zh: 高等精灵天生技艺超凡，远胜其他凡人
desc.en: The High Elves possess a natural skill that far outstrips the prowess of ordinary mortals.

desc.zh: 知识可以用来当做对抗魔法攻击的护盾
desc.en: Knowledge can be used as a shield against magical attack.

desc.zh: 欺诈之神熟知各种可以对抗远程攻击的计谋
desc.en: The Trickster God knows all manner of ploys and ruses that can be used to counter missile attacks.

desc.zh: 若想深入了解世界，就要向荷斯求助，寻求知识与引导
desc.en: Those who seek greater understanding of the world may turn to Hoeth for knowledge and guidance.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的巨鹰是精灵们的坚定盟友，自从混沌入侵起便与他们并肩而战
desc.en: Ulthuan's Great Eagles are the firm allies of the Elves, fighting their causes since the coming of Chaos.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 此人熟知各种阿苏尔宫廷权谋，在外交中可堪一用
desc.en: This one is well-versed in the various court intrigues of the Asur, which is something of an advantage in matters of diplomacy.

desc.zh: 『人类王国绝不能陷落，我们的命运与之交织，如果他们陷落，我们也将步其后尘』
desc.en: "The Realms of Man must not fall. Our fate is intertwined with theirs, and if they fall, so too do we."

desc.zh: 放眼所有『年轻种族』，蜥蜴人最尊敬的还是阿苏尔，凭这一点就足以接近这些高等种族了
desc.en: Of all the 'younger races', the ultra-secretive Lizardmen respect the Asur the most - enough to grant access to certain high-caste individuals.

desc.zh: 无论是舞动，劈砍，挑刺，挖凿还是射击，这名勇士无一不精
desc.en: If you can swing, slash, stab, gouge, or shoot it, this warrior has mastered every aspect of its use.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的巨鹰是精灵们的坚定盟友，自从混沌入侵起便与他们并肩而战
desc.en: Ulthuan's Great Eagles are the firm allies of the Elves, fighting their causes since the coming of Chaos.

desc.zh: 最古老，最强大的巨龙，能够用白热的吐息杀掉一整支部队
desc.en: The eldest, most powerful Dragons can destroy entire units with a molten blast of their white-hot breath.

desc.zh: 最年轻的巨龙，长着暖色调的鳞片，拥有足以匹敌其火爆脾气的炽热吐息
desc.en: The youngest Dragons have a warm hue to their scales and a fiery temper, with scorching breath to match.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的巨鹰是精灵们的坚定盟友，自从混沌入侵起便与他们并肩而战
desc.en: Ulthuan's Great Eagles are the firm allies of the Elves, fighting their causes since the coming of Chaos.

desc.zh: 最古老，最强大的巨龙，能够用白热的吐息杀掉一整支部队
desc.en: The eldest, most powerful Dragons can destroy entire units with a molten blast of their white-hot breath.

desc.zh: 最年轻的巨龙，长着暖色调的鳞片，拥有足以匹敌其火爆脾气的炽热吐息
desc.en: The youngest Dragons have a warm hue to their scales and a fiery temper, with scorching breath to match.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的巨鹰是精灵们的坚定盟友，自从混沌入侵起便与他们并肩而战
desc.en: Ulthuan's Great Eagles are the firm allies of the Elves, fighting their causes since the coming of Chaos.

desc.zh: 强大的银月龙会用自己的知识强化它们的骑手，其启迪的力量足以挫败恶魔
desc.en: Those who ride atop the mighty Moon Drakes are steeled in the knowledge of their mount’s enlightened, Daemon-slaying strength.

desc.zh: 最古老，最强大的巨龙，能够用白热的吐息杀掉一整支部队
desc.en: The eldest, most powerful Dragons can destroy entire units with a molten blast of their white-hot breath.

desc.zh: 这些附了魔法的箭矢，根根都是从阿瓦隆树丛附近的大树中精雕细刻而来
desc.en: These enchanted arrows have been carefully crafted from the pale-wooded trees that grow near the Grove of Avelorn.

desc.zh: 施法者吟唱充满力量的咒语，召唤出一只以纯净火焰构成的凤凰，向着敌人猛扑过去，令其淹没在净化的烈焰之中
desc.en: The caster utters words of power and a phoenix of pure fire manifests to swoop upon the enemy, bathing them in cleansing flame.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 近乎极限的全神贯注，全力以赴地注重细节，这是将世界从毁灭之力手中解救出来的必备条件
desc.en: The utmost concentration, the greatest attention to detail, are required if the world is to be saved from the destructive madness of the Ruinous Ones.

desc.zh: 为了夺取伟大胜利，个人荣耀与军团战绩可以先暂时不顾
desc.en: Personal glory and regimental achievement must be set aside in times of great peril.

desc.zh: 最完美的艾里昂战马。它承载着泰瑞昂本人，只用一蹄便可将鼠人群落踹得七零八落
desc.en: The finest Ellyrion steed, atop which Tyrion has single-handedly put verminous hordes to flight.

desc.zh: 奥苏安能够，而且即将再度统一：坚定此等信念，则理想必将成真
desc.en: Ulthuan can and will be whole again; believe and it shall be true.

desc.zh: 和平转瞬即逝，你必须做好战争的准备
desc.en: In those rare, fleeting times of peace, you must prepare for war.

desc.zh: 当你的目标令人尊敬，正直体面，同时又完全摆脱个人私利时，志同道合之人就会汇集在你的大旗之下
desc.en: When your goals are worthy, decent, and entirely free of self-interest, those of a similar nature flock to your banner.

desc.zh: 最终，艾纳瑞昂的诅咒会在自己的族裔身上显现，谁都无法避免，因为这是血的诅咒
desc.en: Eventually, the curse of Aenarion will reveal itself in those of his line; it is inevitable - it is in their very blood.

desc.zh: 有时，即便是正直之士也会被血手之神的激情所吞噬
desc.en: From time to time, even the virtuous are liable to be consumed by the violent passion of the Bloody-handed God.

desc.zh: 当诅咒显现时，血手之神的面容会自动浮现
desc.en: As the curse emerges, facets of the Bloody-handed God reveal themselves.

desc.zh: 我们阿苏尔是艾纳瑞昂的后裔，是奥苏安的子嗣，我们永不屈服
desc.en: We, the Asur – the sons of Aenarion and Ulthuan – shall never fall.

desc.zh: 就算是死，也该死在奋斗的途中
desc.en: If you're gonna die, you may as well die with your boots on.

desc.zh: 只要运用得当，那么自信便是一种优良的品质
desc.en: Self-belief is a fine thing when not misplaced.

desc.zh: 欺诈是一种优良的攻击手段
