desc.en: Deceit is a perfectly acceptable means of attack.

desc.zh: 少量的果决会相当有用，毕竟这是个需要不断下决心的世界
desc.en: Having a modicum of resolve is useful in a world that continually tests it.

desc.zh: 此人永远掌控一切。他事无巨细，掘地三尺，不给敌人留下一丝可乘之机
desc.en: Always in control, this one leaves no stone unturned and nothing to chance.

desc.zh: 一双飞毛腿会在战斗中相当有用…或者说，能帮你迅速逃出生天！
desc.en: Being fleet of foot is useful in a fight… or when trying to get away afterwards!

desc.zh: 敏锐的思维，会让利刃更加锋利
desc.en: Sharp minds make sharp blades sharper still.

desc.zh: 如果什么是此人不知道的，那就定然没有知晓的价值。此人对世界的兴趣，可谓是深入骨髓
desc.en: What this being doesn't know probably isn't worth knowing, so deep is their interest in the world and its ways.

desc.zh: 虽然此人并不通晓读心术，然而他对别人的心思确实有着特别的敏感
desc.en: Although actually reading minds is not in their skillset, this one has extraordinary insight into the motives of others.

desc.zh: 此人胸怀宏图：不是小打小闹，而是立足长远的宏伟计划
desc.en: This being has a plan - not just a game plan, but a master plan to achieve their long-term aims.

desc.zh: 身材结实，精力充沛，四肢强悍
desc.en: Well built, robust. Powerful.

desc.zh: 精密谋划，详查地形，通晓敌方弱点，这便是胜利的保障
desc.en: Careful planning, knowledge of the terrain and the weaknesses of the enemy are the key to victory.

desc.zh: 坚韧，顽强，不屈不挠，此人可以也愿意直面任何来者
desc.en: Rugged, resistant, and almost unbreakable, this being can and will take on all comers.

desc.zh: 无论是舞动，劈砍，挑刺，挖凿还是射击，这名勇士无一不精
desc.en: If you can swing, slash, stab, gouge, or shoot it, this warrior has mastered every aspect of its use.

desc.zh: 凡兵刃可挥、可斩、可刺、可凿之处，此战士皆已臻至化境
desc.en: If you can swing, slash, stab or gouge, it, this warrior has mastered every aspect of its use.

desc.zh: 有些畜生就是不知道啥时候该放下酒瓶子
desc.en: Some beings just don't know when to put the bottle down.

desc.zh: 『杀戮欲』已经不足以形容此人，他的心中涌动的是战争之主那最原始，最暴虐的战争狂怒
desc.en: More than mere bloodlust, this one is filled with the primal, Ruinous rage of the Lord of Battle.

desc.zh: 此人几乎便是某种臭哄哄的垃圾堆…
desc.en: This one has something of the compost heap about them…

desc.zh: 黑暗语是一种适合折磨，嘲弄和激怒敌人的媒介
desc.en: The Dark Tongue is an apt medium through which to torment, mock and enrage the foe.

desc.zh: 有时仅仅让土地浸满鲜血是不够的，永远都不够
desc.en: Sometimes, letting so much blood that the soil itself is stained just isn't enough. And it will never be.

desc.zh: 啊，何等的奇观啊！天哪！多么可怕的奇迹！
desc.en: Oh, horrific wonder! Vile awe! Such hateful majesty!

desc.zh: 『献出你的一切吧，凡人！』
desc.en: "Mine desire is all, mortal wretch!"

desc.zh: 令他人惨遭不幸，饱受痛苦，随心所欲地扩大他们的伤痛，这便是力量的真意
desc.en: To cause another's suffering, to delight in their pain, to extend their agony according to your whim. That is power.

desc.zh: 令他人惨遭不幸，饱受痛苦，随心所欲地扩大他们的伤痛，这便是力量的真意
desc.en: To cause another's suffering, to delight in their pain, to extend their agony according to your whim. That is power.

desc.zh: 巫王曾经长期渴望夺取奥苏安的王冠，但阿苏焉的烈焰却让憎恨与疤痕扭曲了他
desc.en: The Witch King long ago sought to take Ulthuan's crown, but the Flames of Asuryan left him twisted with hatred and horribly scarred.

desc.zh: 思绪邪恶，心地恶毒，这都是为了自己的利益
desc.en: Evil-minded, poisonous malignancy. For its own sake.

desc.zh: 当此人现身时，恶意无疑将施加到每个人的身上
desc.en: When this one is abroad you can be sure that malice is borne towards anyone and everyone.

desc.zh: 『很高兴能得到你的协助，吾主。因为我非常的讨厌…失望』
desc.en: "I would be so grateful for your cooperation in this, my lord. I do so hate to be... disappointed."

desc.zh: 他们的每个念头，每个行为的背后都充满了无耻，血腥的怨恨
desc.en: Behind every thought they have - and every deed - is shameless, full-blooded spite.

desc.zh: 『居然有人说我为人恶毒？我看谁敢说一个试试，看我不把他眼珠子给挖出来！』
desc.en: "Some folk call me vicious. I'll scoop out the eyes of any who utter it in my presence."

desc.zh: 这位勇敢的矮人可以将血脉追溯到葛林姆尼尔，即英雄之神的身上
desc.en: This brave Dawi can trace his lineage back to Grimnir, the Warrior-God.

desc.zh: 这位勤奋的矮人可以将血脉追溯到葛朗尼，即矿业与铁匠之神的身上
desc.en: This industrious Dawi can trace his lineage back to Grungni, God of Mines and Smiths.

desc.zh: 这位忠诚的矮人可以将血脉追溯到瓦拉雅，即治愈与守护之神的身上
desc.en: This loyal Dawi can trace his lineage back to Valaya, Goddess of Healing and Protection.

desc.zh: 弗兰兹将自己的信任交给了此人，愿此人不会令皇帝失望！
desc.en: Franz has put his trust in this man; pray he does not let him down!

desc.zh: 追逐的快感，猎物走投无路的快意，以及杀戮的狂喜，这便是生命的价值啊！
desc.en: The thrill of the chase, the tremor as the quarry is cornered, the ecstasy of the kill. These are the things that matter.

desc.zh: 『若是此地有味痕与足迹，我一定会找到它们。要是痕迹足够大，那就足够我追出一里格那么远』
desc.en: "If it's got a scent and footprints, I'll find it. Also, it helps if it's absolutely huge and can be spotted a league away."

desc.zh: 『那些贱民应该感谢我们；没有了我们，谁会为他们提供工作呢？』
desc.en: "The smallfolk should be thankful - without us, who would they work for?"

desc.zh: 高贵的气息？看看这玩意儿能维持多久吧
desc.en: A regal air? Let's see how long that lasts.

desc.zh: 『没准啥时候他能当上个老大。你能想到哪天俺们得给他干活么？』
desc.en: "Someday he's gonna be a Boss. Can you believe someday we'll work for 'im?"

desc.zh: 要是你比周围所有喽罗都牛逼，你就该吹得震天动地，好让别人都知道你就是最牛逼的那个
desc.en: When you're clearly betterer than all the uvvers you need to shout the loudest, so everybody else knows you're the betterest.

desc.zh: 『你的袋子里有蘑菇啊？给我，快给我！』
desc.en: "Dat a 'shroom in yer pouch? Give it! Give it to me!"

desc.zh: 『俺认识个家伙…他，超可怕』
desc.en: "I know a guy… he's pretty 'orrible."

desc.zh: 『萨满是肮脏的混蛋，但拉克林克是个堕落的地精！』
desc.en: "Shamans are nasty buggers as it iz, but Raknik iz one depraved gobbo!"

desc.zh: 好的『通神舞』你是没办法阻止的，尤其是当鼓声响起之时！
desc.en: You can't keep a good 'danca' down, especially when those drums start bangin'!

desc.zh: 当战将需要找人『唠唠嗑』时，他通常会让这些『带着尖尖棍子的家伙』前去拿人
desc.en: When a Warboss needs someone to talk, he calls on this "Boy wiv da extra pointy sticks".

desc.zh: 阿拉斯塔领主身上的那件白狮皮，乃是无畏之心与勇敢意志的坚实证明
desc.en: The white lion's pelt worn by Lord Alastar bears inspiring testament to his great heart and dauntless courage.

desc.zh: 此人行事反常，其古怪行为令大人物们颇有微词：惹毛他们可没有好果子吃
desc.en: This one is something of an eccentric; their erratic behaviour has upset powerful people, which is seldom a good idea.

desc.zh: 如果你需要快些逃走，记得不要带上这家伙…
desc.en: Don't take this one along if you need to get away quickly… or maybe you should…

desc.zh: 『啊，真是冷死了。你能把这玩意放得离我越远越好吗？对，就这样，放在旁边』
desc.en: "Look, it's terribly cold. Can we get those things as far away from me as possible? Yes, that's right - on the flank."

desc.zh: 完美精灵的完美诠释，真是不错！
desc.en: The very illustration of Elven perfection. What a git!

desc.zh: 战斗的场景令凤凰充满活力，真是激动人心啊…
desc.en: The prospect of battle fills the phoenix with a brisk energy that's somewhat infectious...

desc.zh: 此人言行相顾，表里如一，在高贵的精灵一族中颇负盛名
desc.en: Through his words and deeds, this one has made a name for himself within noble Elven circles.

desc.zh: 即使在四肢修长，生命漫长的精灵眼中，此人也堪称是个豪杰
desc.en: Even for a long-limbed, long-lived Elf, this character is a fine specimen.

desc.zh: 『身心俱通，是为得道；勇者一生，皆系于此』
desc.en: "Enlightenment is achieved by mastering not only the body, but the soul. Only then can a warrior truly understand the value of life."

desc.zh: 『你说啥？战斗？今天？太好了！把我的凤凰牵来，让我们大开杀戒吧！』
desc.en: "Battle, you say? Today? Marvellous! Bring me my phoenix - let's get killing!"

desc.zh: 此人能拿得动笔都是一件奇事，更别说让他拿剑了
desc.en: It's surprising that this one can even lift a pen, let alone a sword.

desc.zh: 『莫尔斯里布里面有人居住，没错，真就住在里面，而且他们还想征服世界！』
desc.en: "There are people living inside Morrslieb - right inside, yes - and they want to take over the world!"

desc.zh: 有些战士坚如磐石，此人则软若胶泥…
desc.en: Some warriors are like rocks - hard and immovable. This one is like jelly…

desc.zh: 此人动作迅捷如雷，可翻身闪避对手的攻击
desc.en: This one moves like lightning, ducking and twisting to avoid their opponent's blows.

desc.zh: 机会就像魔法，可以被个人意志所驾驭
desc.en: Chance is like magic - it can be harnessed to the individual's will.

desc.zh: 此人活动好每一根筋骨，随时随地准备出动
desc.en: Every fibre of their being is charged and ready for action - wherever, whenever.

desc.zh: 能量在他们的血管中流淌，填补着噩兆的虚空
desc.en: Through their veins a charge is racing. Energy, filling the ominous void within.

desc.zh: 『你想要什么跟外面的守卫说就好了，外面可有不少守卫』
desc.en: "If you need anything, there are guards outside the doors. Many guards."

desc.zh: 如果自身足够强硬，那么盔甲就只是摆设
desc.en: Armour is just a formality when you're as hard as nails and as tough as old boots.

desc.zh: 人生在世，要么学会顺从，要么学会变通…
desc.en: In society, one must learn to conform. Or not, as the case may be…

desc.zh: 坚强，硬挺，正经，不屈
desc.en: Stiff, starched, formal. Inflexible.

desc.zh: 此人离经叛道，还经常煽动叛乱
desc.en: A subversive agitator, and clinically non-conformist to boot.

desc.zh: 好的理念还需有公众支持才能付诸实施
desc.en: Good ideas oft-times need vocal, public support to turn them into reality.

desc.zh: 此人勤勉不怠，成效卓著，能将理念转化为财富，有时这还真不是吹的
desc.en: Industrious and productive, this one can turn ideas into gold - sometimes literally.

desc.zh: 某种程度上来讲，人们可以补救军队的损耗
desc.en: Armies can be mended as surely as people can, up to a point of course.

desc.zh: 此人总爱跟从他人，默默服从强者的领导
desc.en: This one is happy to follow and let other, more energetic types, lead from the front.

desc.zh: 此人看待老问题时总不乏新思路和新点子
desc.en: Never short of new ideas, or new ways of looking at old problems.

desc.zh: 『我发现了一点问题，然后我就亲手解决了』
desc.en: "I see something wrong and I fix it with my hands."

desc.zh: 冷静，沉着，镇定。没错就是这样！
desc.en: Cool, calm, and collected. Yeah, right!

desc.zh: 此人即便在独处时也会心怀不安，他的本性就是如此的内敛
desc.en: This one doesn't even relax in their own company, so reserved is their nature.

desc.zh: 勇气？坚强？别逗了好吗，这个怂货一点边都不沾
desc.en: Fortitude? Strength of character? Do me a favour - this yellow-bellied poltroon has none.

desc.zh: 此人从头到尾毫不合群，全身散发着忧郁哀伤的气息
desc.en: Definitely not the life and soul of the party; they exude melancholy and depression.

desc.zh: 此人脾气有如导火索，一点就着，见识一下燃烧的怒火吧
desc.en: Tempers, like wicks, can be ignited. Watch the anger burn.

desc.zh: 作为，不作为，搞出变动，诸如此类，此人铁了心要跟主流对着干
desc.en: Action, inaction, change - you name it, this one will work against the prevailing wind.

desc.zh: 这么说吧，此人就是个炸药桶，你一定不会想尝尝他的怒火吧！
desc.en: You don't want to be on the wrong side of this one's ire - it's explosive to say the least!

desc.zh: 黑暗之中未必总有光明
desc.en: Not every cloud has a silver lining.

desc.zh: 能守护阿苏尔生存之道的品质，此人无不具备
desc.en: Whatever quality is needed to stand guard over the Asur way of life, this one has it in abundance.

desc.zh: 大家泡澡的时候要想拿人寻开心，那非此人莫属
desc.en: If ever there was a candidate for a relaxing break at an all-inclusive spa, it was this one.

desc.zh: 此人身体看上去『不是很好』已成常态，很明显是药不太够了
desc.en: Looking "not too well" has become a permanent condition. Clearly, they're lacking essential herbs.

desc.zh: 都说两个总比一个强，这绝对是大错特错
desc.en: They say two are better than one. They are, of course, totally wrong in every respect.

desc.zh: 机会就像魔法，可以被个人意志所驾驭
desc.en: Chance is like magic - it can be harnessed to the individual's will.

desc.zh: 此人活动好每一根筋骨，随时随地准备出动
desc.en: Every fibre of their being is charged and ready for action - wherever, whenever.

desc.zh: 即使在高等精灵自己看来，千余岁还能如此精神焕发也是很不可思议的
desc.en: Impressively energetic for a thousand years old - even by their own reckoning.

desc.zh: 能量在他们的血管中流淌，填补着噩兆的虚空
desc.en: Through their veins a charge is racing. Energy, filling the ominous void within.

desc.zh: 『想要保持轻柔就必须多下功夫，你们天天坐着胡吃海喝跟你们说了也是白说』
desc.en: "Staying this supple takes effort. You don’t get definition like that by sitting about and drinking."

desc.zh: 『你想要什么跟外面的守卫说就好了，外面可有不少守卫』
desc.en: "If you need anything, there are guards outside the doors. Many guards."

desc.zh: 做任何事都有正确和错误两条路，此人一般都爱走错的路
desc.en: There's usually a right way and a wrong way to do anything. This one generally gets it wrong.

desc.zh: 机器以及任何科技进步都令此人厌恶至极，因为没有什么能代替得了辛勤劳作
desc.en: Machinery - and indeed progress of any kind - is anathema to this one, because there's no substitute for good, honest toil.

desc.zh: 此人事事不落，整天干涉别人的事
desc.en: This one can never leave something alone. They always have to meddle.

desc.zh: 近千年来，奥苏安许多高耸天际的建筑都出自此人的艰辛劳作
desc.en: Much of the Ulthuan skyline built over the last thousand years is down to this one’s sterling endeavours.

desc.zh: 『太迟了，太迟了』，等我一走后悔就来不及了
desc.en: "Too late, too late!" will be the cry, when the one with the bargains passes you by.

desc.zh: 好在世上总有人爱操心天下大事，要不然我们可就…哦等等…
desc.en: Fortunately, there are some who really apply themselves to the problems of the world. Just as well, otherwise we'd be… Oh wait...

desc.zh: 如果需要精确与组织，那么此人无疑是最佳人选。但是在聚会上，他就很无趣了
desc.en: If it requires accuracy and organisation, this one is your Elf. Not so much fun at parties, however.

desc.zh: 『事情总会有出路，总会有个角度的，你只需找到它即可』
desc.en: "There's always a way - always an angle. You just have to find it."

desc.zh: 此人技艺超群，堪称国之大器，简直就是智慧的化身
desc.en: An individual of exceptional skill and worth; the very embodiment of sagacity.

desc.zh: 就算有正道，此人也没什么必要知道
desc.en: If there's a right way to do something, this one doesn't have the wherewithal to know what it is.

desc.zh: 忍无可忍，无需再忍
desc.en: Some things should not have to be endured.

desc.zh: 此人对计略毫无兴趣，更别提战祸了
desc.en: This one doesn't have the stomach for intrigue, let alone war and its privations.

desc.zh: 自我激励是个有用的本事，能把别人煽动起来的话就更有用了
desc.en: Self-starting is a useful ability; starting others - and keeping them that way - more useful still.

desc.zh: 还有什么比一次及时而有序的冲锋更使人惊骇的呢
desc.en: There's nothing quite so impressive - and painful - as a well-timed, well-ordered charge.

desc.zh: 刻苦训练必然会使人完美，至少在战场上更容易活下来
desc.en: Practice really does make perfect, or at least makes it much harder to kill.

desc.zh: 一旦形势所需，那么便理应向敌人投掷出全部的怒火
desc.en: On occasion, throwing the whole nine leagues at the enemy is just the ticket.

desc.zh: 此人锐意精进，用尽全心使自己行事果断
desc.en: This one is a driving force; potential is taken and transformed into decisive action by their hand.

desc.zh: 历经磨练的技巧对敌人来说就好比打磨锋利的利刃
desc.en: Skills refined and improved upon over time can only increase one's edge over the foe.

desc.zh: 此人光是拿起武器就相当费劲，更别说让他向敌人挥砍了
desc.en: It's as much effort as this one can make to lift a blade, let alone swing it at an opponent with force.

desc.zh: 骨骼本不该长得这么外凸的
desc.en: Bones are not supposed to be on the outside.

desc.zh: 有些战士坚如磐石，此人则软若胶泥…
desc.en: Some warriors are like rocks - hard and immovable. This one is like jelly…

desc.zh: 此人动作迅捷如雷，可翻身闪避对手的攻击
desc.en: This one moves like lightning, ducking and twisting to avoid their opponent's blows.

desc.zh: 这就是健康强壮的典范，很显然此人早已经过多年的锻炼
desc.en: The very picture of good health. Clearly, there's many years still ahead of them.

desc.zh: 此人做任何动作看上去都毫不费力
desc.en: Every action is executed seemingly without effort.

desc.zh: 你肯定不会想成为此人的攻击对象，肯定不会的
desc.en: You really don't want to be on the receiving end of an attack made by this one. You really don’t.

desc.zh: 如果自身足够强硬，那么盔甲就只是摆设
desc.en: Armour is just a formality when you're as hard as nails and as tough as old boots.

desc.zh: 很多人都试过了，想杀这人没那么容易，相信我
desc.en: This one is not at all easy to kill, and many have tried, believe me.

desc.zh: 『唔，有点意思。真想知道还有没有第三条路可走…』
desc.en: "Hmmm interesting. I do wonder if there's a third way, however…"

desc.zh: 『抱歉，你说什么？我刚刚在看云彩，你看那云彩还有点像艾纳瑞昂呢』
desc.en: "I'm sorry, what? I was looking at that cloud - looks just like Aenarion in a certain light."

desc.zh: 此人纵情享乐，堪比纵欲过度的杜鲁齐
desc.en: Extravagant and dissolute, this one could almost be an honorary Druchii, such is their inclination for excess.

desc.zh: 恶魔对细节了如指掌…
desc.en: The Daemon is very definitely in the detail…

desc.zh: 『来，都别打了，阿苏尔不打阿苏尔！』
desc.en: "Come now, let this conflict cease. We're all Asur, remember?"

desc.zh: 此人着眼长久，行事一心只为公义，不留私心
desc.en: This one acts not for themselves but the for the greater good, in defence of the future.

desc.zh: 无论什么任务，此人务求尽善尽美，此后更是精益求精
desc.en: Whatever the task, this one always wishes to do it to the best of their ability - and better on every occasion thereafter.

desc.zh: 此人圆滑至极，即便他人与之意见相左，亦难以大动肝火拔刀相向
desc.en: This one smooths the way, so differing opinions do not so easily lead to frayed tempers and drawn blades.

desc.zh: 保住金子的最佳办法就是不要去花
desc.en: The best way to hang on to your gold is never to spend any of it.

desc.zh: 此人超凡脱俗，在残酷的现实中仍无拘无束
desc.en: There's something of the other world about this one; this cruel plane has failed to engage them.

desc.zh: 要不是脑袋长在脖子上，估计此人都能忘带脑袋出来
desc.en: This one would forget their head if it wasn't, er, attached.

desc.zh: 『战略？战术？都是扯淡，冲他娘的！！！』
desc.en: "Strategy? Tactics? Piffle, more like. Charrrrgggge!!!"

desc.zh: 此人深谙兵法机变，足以克敌制胜
desc.en: This one understands tactics, and how to vary them, well enough to generally defeat the foe.

desc.zh: 『我们的祖先遵从古法，克服万难，我们不应对他们的经验视而不见』
desc.en: "Our forefathers followed the way and overcame great adversity. We should not ignore their lessons."

desc.zh: 有些人的心智易受魔法影响，而此人的意志却十分坚定
desc.en: Some minds are more susceptible to magical influence than others, but this one is strong indeed.

desc.zh: 『很好，你有在听吗？嗯，解决万事万物的唯一方法就在书中』
desc.en: "Right, are you listening? Good. There's only one way to do things and that's by the book."

desc.zh: 此人意志坚定不移，内心就如世界巨龙一般强大！
desc.en: Immovable and resolute in their will, this one is as determined as the World Dragon himself!

desc.zh: 作为，不作为，搞出变动，诸如此类，此人铁了心要跟主流对着干
desc.en: Action, inaction, change - you name it, this one will work against the prevailing wind.

desc.zh: 此人光是拿起武器就相当费劲，更别说让他向敌人挥砍了
desc.en: It's as much effort as this one can make to lift a blade, let alone swing it at an opponent with force.

desc.zh: 骨骼本不该长得这么外凸的
desc.en: Bones are not supposed to be on the outside.

desc.zh: 有些战士坚如磐石，此人则软若胶泥…
desc.en: Some warriors are like rocks - hard and immovable. This one is like jelly…

desc.zh: 此人动作迅捷如雷，可翻身闪避对手的攻击
desc.en: This one moves like lightning, ducking and twisting to avoid their opponent's blows.

desc.zh: 这就是健康强壮的典范，很显然此人早已经过多年的锻炼
desc.en: The very picture of good health. Clearly, there's many years still ahead of them.

desc.zh: 此人做任何动作看上去都毫不费力
desc.en: Every action is executed seemingly without effort.

desc.zh: 你肯定不会想成为此人的攻击对象，肯定不会的
desc.en: You really don't want to be on the receiving end of an attack made by this one. You really don’t.

desc.zh: 如果自身足够强硬，那么盔甲就只是摆设
desc.en: Armour is just a formality when you're as hard as nails and as tough as old boots.

desc.zh: 很多人都试过了，想杀这人没那么容易，相信我
desc.en: This one is not at all easy to kill, and many have tried, believe me.

desc.zh: 大家都在猜测这个如假包换的纯种傻子是怎么活到今天，这也成了一个千古未解之谜！
desc.en: How this… absolute, card-carrying moron has survived this far is anyone's guess, and a mystery to all!

desc.zh: 若想办成事，就得先把此人搞掉，只会让你省心不少
desc.en: If you want something done, shoot this one first - it'll make your life a lot easier.

desc.zh: 『没错，伤敌一千自损八百，但我们手下有的是人，进攻！』
desc.en: "Yes, we will hit our own troops, but we'll hit theirs as well. We have reserves. Attack!"

desc.zh: 想要活命，最好睁大眼睛低下脑袋
desc.en: If you wish to live, it's best to keep your eyes open and your head down.

desc.zh: 『你需要制定计划，不要听别人的，然后施加在敌人身上！』
desc.en: "You need a plan. Never let anyone tell you otherwise. Devise a plan, then execute it – and preferably the enemy."

desc.zh: 在此人看来，个人情感不应流露于众人面前
desc.en: Sentiments - and indeed feelings of any kind - are not for public display, in their estimation.

desc.zh: 此人对各项战争技艺何止是精通，简直得心应手
desc.en: More than skilled, this one shows great proficiency in matters of war.

desc.zh: 此人酷爱珍宝，堪比绿皮！
desc.en: Their love of shiny things is so great this one could be an honorary Greenskin!

desc.zh: 列队、射击、冲锋、侧击、重复，此人操作起来无非小菜一碟
desc.en: Form, fire, charge, flank, repeat. This one shows that it really can be that simple.

desc.zh: 比此人还不适合干体力活的人实在是难找了
desc.en: Someone less suited to bodily activity it would be hard to find.

desc.zh: 当大军冲向敌阵时，此人便会背敌而逃！
desc.en: When their army charges towards the foe, this one can clearly be seen legging it in the opposite direction!

desc.zh: 仁慈和体贴可是美德，不开玩笑，真的是！
desc.en: Kindness and consideration are virtues. No, really, they are!

desc.zh: 能跑干嘛走？能飞干嘛跑？
desc.en: Why walk when you can run? Why run when you can fly?

desc.zh: 此人坚定不移，是战场上的中流砥柱
desc.en: Unswerving and determined, this one is an immovable force on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 君子报仇，十年不晚，无论早晚，复仇的滋味总是十分美妙
desc.en: Revenge is not a dish best served cold; it is always perfectly sweet, no matter the temperature.

desc.zh: 此人从身边经过时，人们常会群情激荡，鼓足勇气
desc.en: You can almost see the hearts fluttering when this one passes by, on their way to derring-do and adventure.

desc.zh: 此人精力旺盛，身边的人常会受其感染而满是干劲
desc.en: Always animated, this one has an infectious vitality about them.

desc.zh: 总有人犯错，他们必须要付出代价
desc.en: It's always someone's fault. They can always be made to pay.

desc.zh: 此人能拿得动笔都是一件奇事，更别说让他拿剑了
desc.en: It's surprising that this one can even lift a pen, let alone a sword.

desc.zh: 此人十码内连一个食人魔都射不中，更别说让他射鼠人了！
desc.en: This one couldn't hit an Ogre at ten yards, let alone a ravening pack of Skaven!

desc.zh: 出门忘带钥匙，吃蚝全是坏的，打仗老中流矢——此人可不单是运气差那么简单！
desc.en: Locking themselves out of rooms; that bad batch of oysters; the one stray arrow - this one is more than simply unlucky!

desc.zh: 此人百码开外一箭能射死一个食人魔，五十码能射中鼠人！
desc.en: This one can hit an Ogre at one hundred yards, and a ravening pack of Skaven at fifty!

desc.zh: 机会就像魔法，可以被个人意志所驾驭
desc.en: Chance is like magic - it can be harnessed to the individual's will.

desc.zh: 此人总是深思熟虑，从不妄下断论，其所有结论都建立在事实依据的基础之上，没有半点猜测
desc.en: Always considered, never rushing to judge, all conclusions based on empirical evidence, no conjecture.

desc.zh: 此人一定拥有秘法，否则怎会有人如此幸运！
desc.en: There must be runes about their person - no one could be this lucky otherwise!

desc.zh: 要想战胜此人就必须早做准备，没有什么能逃得过此人锐利的眼光和迅捷的反应
desc.en: You have to get up very early if you want to beat this one; nothing escapes their keen eye and lightning reflexes.

desc.zh: 此人堪称栋梁之才
desc.en: The strength at the base of the pillar.

desc.zh: 此人就是这么一个活生生的迟钝无聊散漫之人
desc.en: There's dull, boring, and inattentive... and there's this live wire.

desc.zh: 此人做任何事都十分勉强，将其派向战场倒不如使之奔赴宴席
desc.en: Everything is such an effort - they'd much rather feast than fight.

desc.zh: 如果有可能，此人连自己的葬礼都会迟到！
desc.en: This one would be late for their own funeral pyre if it were possible!

desc.zh: 若叫此人设伏，那么事无巨细都会考虑得十分周全
desc.en: When this one plans an ambush, every possible option is considered. Nothing is left to chance.

desc.zh: 此人在战场上是众人跟随的楷模，敌人无不望风而逃！
desc.en: In battle, this one is a shining example for others to follow - and the foe to run away from!

desc.zh: 静观坐等可不是此人的行事风格
desc.en: Sitting around waiting for something to happen is not their style.

desc.zh: 此人总是迫不及待接战迎敌，这已远非热忱可以比拟
desc.en: More than keen, this one is positively champing at the bit to get up and at the enemy.

desc.zh: 此人堪称军中典范，同侪之中尚无可比肩者，更遑论敌人
desc.en: A paragon of martial excellence, with few peers among their own kind, let alone the enemy.

desc.zh: 此人十分警觉，总会静待时机发动进攻
desc.en: Ever watchful, this one bides their time until precisely the right moment to attack.

desc.zh: 作为阿苏尔最强大法师中的翘楚，这名精灵在神秘图书馆中研修的时日比大多数人类的寿命都要长
desc.en: As master of the foremost Asur mages, this Elf has studied in their secret libraries longer than most men live.

desc.zh: 『此人躯体虽弱，但不要小看此人强大的意志与内心』
desc.en: "This body may be frail, but never doubt the strength of the mind, or the heart within it."

desc.zh: 『跟随我的旗帜，让敌人的鲜血洒满大地！』
desc.en: "Rally to my banner, and we shall bathe the plains with the blood of our enemies!"

desc.zh: 此人妄自尊大，刚愎自用，狂傲起来没完没了
desc.en: Self-important and opinionated, this one's hubris knows no end.

desc.zh: 此人谦虚知节，坚信众生殊途同归，都是『大计划』中的一份子
desc.en: Self-effacing and unpresuming, he believes that we all have a part to play in the Great Plan, one way or another.

desc.zh: 作为如今已被毁灭的神庙城市阿斯霍托的最后一位幸存的战士，库·迦的战斗还远远没有结束
desc.en: As the last remaining warrior of the now ruined temple-city of Xhotl, for Kroq-Gar the battle is not yet over.

desc.zh: 马兹达穆迪是最强大的魔法祭司，即便是同类也对他敬畏有加
desc.en: Oldest and most powerful of the living Mage-Priests, Mazdamundi is a figure of awe even amongst his own kind.

desc.zh: 『你们算哪根葱？你们这群人都一样，不是大计划的一部分』
desc.en: "What are you even for? You're not part of the Great Plan, like all your kind."

desc.zh: 『大计划就是如此，我们绝不会离经叛道的』
desc.en: "The Plan is the Plan. We shall not deviate or retreat from its path."

desc.zh: 『是的、是的，这是奎克的点子，是奎克的胜利。其他人听话就行，拜倒在我奎克领主的荣耀面前吧！』
desc.en: "Yes, yes, Queek's plan, Queek's triumph. Others just following orders. Grovel before glorious Lord Queek!"

desc.zh: 『我会把爪子磨得尖尖的，是的、是的。准备好应对接下来的挑战，是的、是的！』
desc.en: "I keep them sharp, yes-yes. Always ready for the challenge that I know is coming, yes-yes!"

desc.zh: 『有人来找你麻烦的话就照他脖子来上一口，这样他就不会再来了』
desc.en: "When they come for you, go straight for the throat and tear it clean out. They won't come again."

desc.zh: 司库克领主的力量并没有随着年龄增长而衰弱，恶魔般的活力掩盖着岁月的洗礼和体内堆积的疾病
desc.en: Rather than weakening with age, Lord Skrolk is possessed with a diabolic vitality that belies the years and the heaped diseases he carries.

desc.zh: 鼠人天生猥琐卑鄙，比地精还猥琐，其实他们可能是世界上最猥琐的了
desc.en: By their very nature, rats are very sneaky - even sneakier than Goblins. In fact, they're probably the sneakiest of all.

desc.zh: 『世上万物就这个最宝贝了，我们能活着全指望这个了』
desc.en: "Most precious of all substances, the pulse of our life."

desc.zh: 『愿荣耀归于黑暗之王，陛下』
desc.en: "Glory in your dark majesty, my lord."

desc.zh: 吸血鬼与手下的巫妖们诡计多端，奴役着不少凡人作仆从
desc.en: Vampires and their liche-servants are devious creatures; manipulative with many mortal servants in their thrall.

desc.zh: 『大人，他们见到你会发抖的，噢，他们会恐惧的』
desc.en: "They will tremble, my lord, oh, they will fear!"

desc.zh: 亡灵法师或吸血鬼一旦获得了禁术，他们就会小心翼翼地将它们保持在竞争对手的视线之外
desc.en: Once forbidden knowledge is acquired, Necromancers and Vampires will jealously guard it from rivals' eyes.

desc.zh: 作为名副其实的亡灵大法师，他难不成是打算挑战本身作为伟大亡灵法师的自己吗？
desc.en: A master indeed - to rival the Great Necromancer himself?

desc.zh: 为法师女王所宠爱者，其战姿会如女王亲手加持般绚丽
desc.en: Those whom the Mage Queen has favoured fight as if powered by her hand.

desc.zh: 战场首矢，贯日如虹
desc.en: The first arrow of battle must fly truest.

desc.zh: 这名领主在战场内外的所作所为着实令盟友起敬，同时也令敌人胆寒
desc.en: This Lord's many deeds - both on and off the battlefield - have brought them renown among their allies and made them feared by their enemies.

desc.zh: 这名领主在战场内外的所作所为着实令盟友起敬，同时也令敌人胆寒
desc.en: This Lord's many deeds - both on and off the battlefield - have brought them renown among their allies and made them feared by their enemies.

desc.zh: 兽群之中最年长的领袖往往是最大最凶猛的生物，对于它们一定要善加引导，否则它们将会陷入歧途
desc.en: The largest, most aggressive creatures - usually the oldest bulls of the herd - must be directed, lest their independent spirit lead them astray.

desc.zh: 你得站在这群狂怒怪兽的正中心，才有一丝机会控制住它们的怒火。祝你好运！
desc.en: You need to be at the very centre of this pack of furious monsters to have the minutest chance of controlling their rage. Good luck!

desc.zh: 能够领导这些守护『大计划』的勇士们真是荣幸之至
desc.en: It is a great honour to direct the elite warriors who protect the Plan from calamity.

desc.zh: 最机智的猎手往往能凌驾于指挥系统之上
desc.en: The most intelligent hunter tends to move swiftly up the chain of command.

desc.zh: 优胜劣汰，弱肉强食，这是丛林的严苛法则
desc.en: The unforgiving law of the jungle is most clear on matters of ascendancy.

desc.zh: 只有最优秀的野兽骑手才能在坐骑闯入灌木丛或冲向敌阵时紧紧握住缰绳
desc.en: Only the finest beast riders can hang on whilst their mounts crash through the jungle undergrowth or smash through the foe's ranks.

desc.zh: 此人遵从古老的光荣传统已历多时
desc.en: A long-serving member of an ancient, honourable tradition.

desc.zh: 这名身经百战的勇士对遭遇战颇有心得，他熟知进攻、防守以及撤退的时机
desc.en: This seasoned warrior understands irregular combat perfectly: when to attack, when to hold back, when to withdraw behind heavier lines.

desc.zh: 骑手与坐骑从内心深处合而为一，永不分割
desc.en: Mount and rider, together as one at their very cores. Indivisible.

desc.zh: 来自同个孵化池的勇士通常有很深的羁绊，而这种羁绊会在战斗中提供相当大的优势
desc.en: Braves who emerge from the same spawning often share a deep connection – a bond which provides considerable advantages in battle.

desc.zh: 『看吧，双子兄弟之中一个生活在黑暗里，另一个则活在光明中！』
desc.en: "Whilst one brother lives in darkness, the other, his double-twin, exists in light. Behold!"

desc.zh: 『煌奇是黑暗的表亲，他的祭司们也应寄身于暮光之中』
desc.en: "Cousin of darkness, Huanchi's priests too shall dwell in twilight."

desc.zh: 『向伊奇祷告吧，他是野兽的创世神！』
desc.en: "Creator-meld of the beast, Itzl be praised!"

desc.zh: 『神圣的守护神赐予你鳞片保佑你』
desc.en: "By your scales be you blessed by the divine protector."

desc.zh: 『风神泰波克是伟大的拉兹寇托的兄弟，应该永远敬拜他，我们开始祭拜吧』
desc.en: "Brother of Great Tlazcotl, Tepok of the Air shall always be honoured. Let it be done."

desc.zh: 『宇宙存在于他的眼眸之中，拥抱被赐福的冰冷吧』
desc.en: "The universe resides within his reflective eyes; embrace the coldness of blessed certainty."

desc.zh: 正如书中所载，万殊为一
desc.en: All shall be one, as it is written.

desc.zh: 静思冥想才能对『大计划』做出合理的阐释
desc.en: Contemplation is the path to alignment, to the correct interpretation of the Great Plan.

desc.zh: 只有通过上千年的研习，才能完全掌握魔法
desc.en: Through millennia of study, total mastery over magic may be attained.

desc.zh: 史兰的目光中闪烁着冷血种对古圣的执着
desc.en: Within the Slann's gaze shines the cold-blooded scrutiny of the Old Ones.

desc.zh: 『我等照耀之处，生死同化，焕然一新…』
desc.en: "Everywhere we shine, death and life burn into something new…"

desc.zh: 古圣的力量封存其中，以图能在『大计划』实现之时派上用场
desc.en: The power of the Old Ones, stored for future use so that - at precisely the right time - the Great Plan may be advanced.

desc.zh: 冰冷无情，遵从逻辑。使人更加强硬，可以对抗魔法的负面效果
desc.en: Cold, merciless, without pity, obeying only logic. Hardened against magic's ill-effects.

desc.zh: 当史兰受伤时，可以用自己的意志之力治疗身体
desc.en: When wounded, the Slann's sheer force of will literally recombines his body.

desc.zh: 魔祭司的思维高深莫测，即便是敌方的法师也无法察觉
desc.en: The Mage-Priest's thought patterns are so alien that they are even beyond the perception of enemy Wizards.

desc.zh: 『大计划』一定要实现，即便杀光所有年轻种族也要实现古圣的意志
desc.en: The Plan *will* be observed, even if every member of the younger races has to die to achieve the Old Ones' goals.

desc.zh: 在战争中幸存的蜥人能够活上相当长的岁月，他们长年侍奉古圣，渴望经验的年轻一代蜥蜴人都对他们敬爱有加
desc.en: Those Saurus not lost to war may live to a great age - their long service esteemed and respected by younger Lizardmen hungry for experience.

desc.zh: 在战争中幸存的蜥人能够活上相当长的岁月，他们长年侍奉古圣，渴望经验的年轻一代蜥蜴人都对他们敬爱有加
desc.en: Those Saurus not lost to war may live to a great age - their long service esteemed and respected by younger Lizardmen hungry for experience.

desc.zh: 必须遵守秩序、听从指令，只有这样才能为『大计划』贡献力量
desc.en: Orders must be followed and the chain of command honoured; only then will the Great Plan be served.

desc.zh: 无情嗜血的混沌子嗣不配活在古圣创造的美好世界上
desc.en: The relentlessly-bloodthirsty Children of Chaos do not deserve a place in the Old Ones' perfect world.

desc.zh: 这些老鼠崽竟然敢用邪恶的疫病威胁露丝契亚的神庙城市，必须将这些东西从这片神圣的土地上抹除
desc.en: The insidious Rat-spawn, who dare threaten Lustria's temple-cities with their vile plagues, must be wiped from its hallowed shores.

desc.zh: 『大计划』中可没有恶毒残忍的杜鲁齐的份，我们必须不惜一切代价将其消灭
desc.en: The vicious cruelty of the Druchii has no place within the Great Plan and must be stamped out at all costs.

desc.zh: 恶心人的绿皮绝非『大计划』中的一部分，他们简直就是世界的污点
desc.en: Resolutely not part of the Great Plan, the disgusting Greenskins are a stain on the surface of the world.

desc.zh: 要想恢复世界的平衡，就必须杀光这些自私孤僻的矮人
desc.en: The self-serving, insular Dawi must all be killed if balance is to be restored to the world.

desc.zh: 露丝契亚土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着蜥蜴人们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Lustria, tempted from their tropical jungles to bear the Lizardmen to battle.

desc.zh: 魁摩克是库·迦的那头长生不老的暴龙，伟大的蜥蜴人领主骑在它的背上赢取了无数的大胜利
desc.en: Grymloq is Kroq-Gar's ageless Carnosaur, upon which the great Lizardman Lord has won all his many victories.

desc.zh: 即使是在露丝契亚，巨角冷蜥也是极端罕见、濒临灭绝的物种。它拥有超乎寻常的迅捷，远远超出了其它的冷蜥同类
desc.en: Very rare and virtually extinct, even in Lustria, the Horned One's preternatural swiftness puts it way ahead of other Cold Ones.

desc.zh: 先古宿敌曾破坏过『大计划』，我们绝不允许这种事再次发生
desc.en: Once before, the Ancient Enemy unmade the Great Plan. It shall not be permitted to do so again.

desc.zh: 死者就应该老实躺好，不应该爬出来祸害活人
desc.en: The dead should dead remain, never to rise again and trouble the living.

desc.zh: 人类渐渐与『大计划』背道而驰，必须阻止他们
desc.en: Mankind has developed in a direction not in keeping with the tenets of the Great Plan; they must be stopped.

desc.zh: 命运之城阻挡了先古宿敌的多次进攻长达数百年之久，随后孵化出来的生物可以用魔法来抵御物理攻击
desc.en: The City of Destiny withstood the Ancient Enemy's infernal onslaught for centuries; subsequent spawnings have magical resistance to physical attack.

desc.zh: 必要时，蜥蜴人能以惊人的超快速度敏捷地移动
desc.en: Lizardmen can move with deceptive speed and agility when they have to.

desc.zh: 在丛林中生活就意味着会懂得何种植物可以疗伤，何种植物吃下后会中毒身亡
desc.en: Life in the jungle means knowing the difference between which flora can heal and what, if ingested, will kill you.

desc.zh: 灵脉巨网产生的能量可以在行军途中孵化蜥人
desc.en: The power generated by the overarching Geomantic Web can also be used to nourish the Saurus on the march.

desc.zh: 这是迄今为止最为巨大的一头三角龙。泽拉革已经为马兹达穆迪领主忠诚地服务了将近五百年
desc.en: The largest Stegadon to be found anywhere, Zlaaq has served Lord Mazdamundi faithfully for almost five hundred years.

desc.zh: 生而为杀者，以杀为生…
desc.en: Of course, those who live to kill must also kill to live...

desc.zh: 波泰克在整个海湾之内分享了时间的秘密，因此蜥蜴人可以抵御魔法攻击
desc.en: Across the gulf of space, the serene Potec has shared the secrets of time so that the Lizardmen may protect themselves against supernatural attack.

desc.zh: 终极丛林猎手。自从降世以来，这些巨大的顶级食肉动物便统治着整片原始丛林
desc.en: The ultimate jungle hunters, these large, apex predators have terrorised the primordial jungles since the dawn of existence.

desc.zh: 露丝契亚土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着蜥蜴人们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Lustria, tempted from their tropical jungles to bear the Lizardmen to battle.

desc.zh: 终极丛林猎手。自从降世以来，这些巨大的顶级食肉动物便统治着整片原始丛林
desc.en: The ultimate jungle hunters, these large, apex predators have terrorised the primordial jungles since the dawn of existence.

desc.zh: 露丝契亚土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着蜥蜴人们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Lustria, tempted from their tropical jungles to bear the Lizardmen to battle.

desc.zh: 丛林植物之间隐藏着蜥蜴人在永恒之战中不起眼的战友伙伴
desc.en: The jungle flora harbours the Lizardmen's microscopic allies in the war that never ends.

desc.zh: 有些蜥蜴人可以完美融入丛林环境之中，来观察或抵御敌人
desc.en: Some Lizardmen are able to seamlessly blend in with their jungle environment in order to observe, or defend themselves from, their enemies.

desc.zh: 作为强壮而带着犄角的爬行动物，三角龙的身上长满了骨质鳞片与伸出体外的骨钉
desc.en: Mighty, horned, reptilian beasts, Stegadons are naturally armoured with bony scales and spikes protruding from their crests.

desc.zh: 带有锋利爪子与尖锐喙嘴的危险掠食者，这些飞行爬虫非常敏捷，在很远的距离上便可锁定自己的猎物
desc.en: Dangerous predators with sharp talons and pointed beaks, these giant flying reptiles are surprisingly agile and can spot their prey at great distances.

desc.zh: 地形就是蜥蜴人所依托的最强兵器，他们可以隐没其中惊吓敌人
desc.en: Whereby the terrain itself is both shield and weapon, enabling the Lizardmen to both mask their numbers and surprise the foe.

desc.zh: 作为强壮而带着犄角的爬行动物，三角龙的身上长满了骨质鳞片与伸出体外的骨钉
desc.en: Mighty, horned, reptilian beasts, Stegadons are naturally armoured with bony scales and spikes protruding from their crests.

desc.zh: 带有锋利爪子与尖锐喙嘴的危险掠食者，这些飞行爬虫非常敏捷，在很远的距离上便可锁定自己的猎物
desc.en: Dangerous predators with sharp talons and pointed beaks, these giant flying reptiles are surprisingly agile and can spot their prey at great distances.

desc.zh: 作为强壮而带着犄角的爬行动物，三角龙的身上长满了骨质鳞片与伸出体外的骨钉
desc.en: Mighty, horned, reptilian beasts, Stegadons are naturally armoured with bony scales and spikes protruding from their crests.

desc.zh: 带有锋利爪子与尖锐喙嘴的危险掠食者，这些飞行爬虫非常敏捷，在很远的距离上便可锁定自己的猎物
desc.en: Dangerous predators with sharp talons and pointed beaks, these giant flying reptiles are surprisingly agile and can spot their prey at great distances.

desc.zh: 此人可以隔空传物，远程攻击对他来说简直无关痛痒
desc.en: The power to move objects without touching them makes missiles attacks against this one largely pointless.

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the caster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤野性的精灵，为友军的脆弱外表披上一层坚硬的皮肤
desc.en: Calling upon the beast spirits of the wild, the caster sheathes vulnerable flesh in unyielding fur and hide.

desc.zh: 法师吹响扭曲的号角，召唤出一支灼热的琥珀长矛，并以难以置信的精度将其向敌人投去
desc.en: Sounding a gnarled horn, the caster summons a glowing amber spear and hurls it at the foe with uncanny accuracy.

desc.zh: 充满灵体的云雾将覆盖敌军，无形的利爪狠狠掐住敌人的咽喉
desc.en: Nebulous nature spirits assail the foe, clawing at them with hands not nearly as insubstantial as they appear.

desc.zh: 卡堂是一位变形术大师，他能把自己的形体变成任何他想要的形状。这次，他的魔法被用来召唤一头蝎尾狮，仿佛卡堂亲自在为你战斗
desc.en: Kadon, a master of forms, was able to shift his shape into anything he chose. This mastery is used to summon a Manticore, as if Kadon himself fights for you.

desc.zh: 施法者释放出内心深处的野性，用狂怒将友军变换成野兽的形态
desc.en: The spellcaster unleashes the beast within, using its fury to transform allies into bestial forms.

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the caster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the caster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 森林已存活了上千年，拥有着超凡的记忆。当得到战争召唤时，它们将释放出压抑数世纪之久的狂怒
desc.en: Trees live for thousands of years and have very long memories. When called to fight, centuries of pent-up wrath are unleashed.

desc.zh: 法师从土地中召唤出治愈性的能量，以来自大地的自然痊愈之力庇护战士们
desc.en: The Wizard draws wholesome energies from the soil, imbuing companions with the natural resilience of the earth.

desc.zh: 这一法术可以暂时将友军的血肉之躯转换成刀枪不入的岩石皮肤，从而大大增强其抵御攻击的能力
desc.en: This spell temporarily transforms allies' mortal flesh into unbreakable rock, increasing tenfold their resistance to attack.

desc.zh: 法师呼唤着杜仁铎之名，以超乎寻常的速度治愈盟友的伤势
desc.en: By speaking Druthandor's name the Wizard is able to heal allies' injuries much faster than by natural means.

desc.zh: 多刺的荆棘从施法者盟友周围的地表喷涌而出，形成一道尖刺拱卫的鲜活护盾
desc.en: Prickly gorse bursts from the ground around the caster's allies, protecting them from attack like a spiky, living shield.

desc.zh: 这一法术会从地面召唤出粗糙而扭曲的树枝，紧紧罩住敌人并使其窒息而亡
desc.en: This spell causes gnarled, fibrous hands to emerge from beneath the ground, dragging the foe to a claustrophobic, suffocating end.

desc.zh: 当施放时，这股魔法可以重创敌人的思维，让他们痛彻心扉地感受到生命不能承受之重
desc.en: When cast this spell enfeebles enemy minds; they feel the crushing weight of reality bearing down upon them.

desc.zh: 当施放时，这股魔法可以重创敌人的思维，让他们痛彻心扉地感受到生命不能承受之重
desc.en: When cast this spell enfeebles enemy minds; they feel the crushing weight of reality bearing down upon them.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵足以麻痹敌军的迷乱之雾，令其变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵足以麻痹敌军的迷乱之雾，令其变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵足以麻痹敌军的迷乱之雾，令其变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.

desc.zh: 超自然的神力总是最好的选择：武器在施法者的盟友面前凭空出现，使他们能够剁碎肉体，劈斩灵魂，甚至剥夺意识
desc.en: The supernatural solution is often the best; weapons materialise before the caster's allies, allowing them to slice through flesh, soul, and consciousness.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽灵般的钟摆。随着一声令下，它将急速摇摆起来并穿越敌方阵势，锋利的刀刃足以切肉断骨
desc.en: A spectral pendulum is summoned by the Wizard. On command, it swings, razor sharp and with lethal speed, through the foe.

desc.zh: 施法者开启一个通往地狱深渊的漩涡，它将永久地吞噬一切卷入其中之物
desc.en: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.

desc.zh: 法师使用怀疑与危机感侵蚀敌人的思维，从内心深处击垮敌军
desc.en: The Wizard destroys their enemies from within, corroding foes' minds with doubt and crisis.

desc.zh: 这一法术会释放出狂暴的战吼，炸裂敌人的脑壳，扯烂他们的眼睛
desc.en: This spell unleashes a howling roar of such intensity that it mashes brains and bursts eyeballs.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满会纵情放大敌方心灵中蛮荒兽性的部分，直至他们变成哀鸣不已的野兽为止
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman magnifies the savage and animalistic parts of the foe's psyche until they are no more than growling beasts.

desc.zh: 戈洛克是个传奇的牛头怪，此人性情烈如暴风。对于穿戴者来说，他的灵魂披风实在是个可怕而危险的物品
desc.en: Ghorok was a legendary Minotaur, ferocious as a storm. His spirit-mantle is terrible and dangerous to the bearer.

desc.zh: 这位嘶叫萨满让自己支配狂野的意志，占据其能找到的最大生物，然后展开暴烈的复仇
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman sends his mind into the wilds, possessing the largest creature he can find and storming back with a vengeance.

desc.zh: 以炽热的怒火直刺敌方坐骑的心脏，让它们转而对抗自己的主人
desc.en: A red-hot spear of wrath is driven into enemy mounts' wild hearts, causing them to turn upon their riders.

desc.zh: 每一艘黑色方舟都是一座无与伦比的堡垒。所以置身于它的黑石防御工事之下显然是愚蠢无比的行为
desc.en: Each Black Ark is a fortress-city without peer. Throwing oneself unto its Black-Stone defences is folly without equal.

desc.zh: 黑色方舟搭载了近乎无数的武器和盔甲，每个突击小队都配备着最好的装备
desc.en: The Black Ark provides near-limitless access to pristine arms and armour, each raiding party clad in the finest forgework.

desc.zh: 一个强大的女术士出现在了黑色方舟上，这让你有机会去编织最黑暗的魔法世界
desc.en: The presence of a powerful Sorceress upon the Black Ark provides opportunities to weave the darkest magecraft.

desc.zh: 此人熟知斯卡文机械的工作原理，可以提高机器在战场上的效率
desc.en: This one's intimate knowledge of the inner workings of Skaven machinery enables him to improve their efficiency on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 想要鹤立鸡群一览众小，可不是一般鼠人能办到的
desc.en: To rise above the rank and file, to claw one's way above the mire and the filth, takes a certain, superior breed of Skaven.

desc.zh: 是该尊敬呢，还是该害怕呢？这都问的什么问题…搞什么，当然是敬畏啦！
desc.en: Is it better to be respected or feared? What sort of question is that... why, both of course!

desc.zh: 早些年艰苦的生活使得这个野心勃勃的鼠人强大无比，也使他学会了更为阴险残忍的战斗技巧
desc.en: Early years spent in the gutter both prepares the ambitious rat for power and schools him in the dirtier, more cut-throat ways of war.

desc.zh: 此人目睹了腐坏氏族制造的畸形怪物后，觉得自己就算手拿针线也能算个行家…
desc.en: This one has seen the hideous deformities created by Clan Moulder firsthand and now fancies himself a dab hand with a needle and thread…

desc.zh: 用次元石制成的药剂强灌到试验样本身上后，活下来的在各方面都会比以前更强大
desc.en: Potions infused with Warpstone transmogrify the not-always-willing testbed subjects; those who survive the process emerge stronger and better in every way.

desc.zh: 为了刺杀目标而想方设法藏在黑暗阴湿的地方，这确实会让人满脑子怪点子
desc.en: Having to hide, for an extended period, in a dark, dank recess, in order to entrap and kill your target encourages lateral thinking.

desc.zh: 聪明的指挥官认为：打是亲，抽是爱。他们认为这是一种对精神和行为的激励与矫正
desc.en: The wise commander considers the lash a dear friend - so much more than a motivational tool to encourage correctness in spirit and behaviour.

desc.zh: 此人深知该说什么话才能『激励』手下，让次元石工匠和技术员们更卖力地干活
desc.en: This one knows just what to say to 'encourage' the very best work from his underling Warp-smiths and technicians.

desc.zh: 当面对战无不胜的瘟疫武器时，知道进攻的时机与目标尤为重要
desc.en: Knowing exactly where and when to strike is essential when fielding fiendish, potentially battle-winning plague-weapons.

desc.zh: 涂了毒药的刀子才能保证目标出局，同时也保证能要了目标的命
desc.en: The poisoned knife is assurance of the target's removal from the game, and from the world also.

desc.zh: 老鼠天生无处不在，即便最小的缝隙中也能见到他们的身影，他们就这样到处传播着疾病与腐蚀
desc.en: Naturally, rats get in everywhere – even the tiniest opening presents little obstacle – spreading their disease and corruption everywhere they can.

desc.zh: 这位斯卡文鼠人以铁腕手段爬上了社会的顶端，并致力于阻止斯卡文王国成为堕落的深渊
desc.en: Keeping on top of things with an iron fist prevents Skavendom from becoming too much of a degenerate mess.

desc.zh: 屠戮敌人时一定不要给他们留下任何有用的东西
desc.en: When making corpses of your foes, leave nothing of value for their kin to recover.

desc.zh: 如你所料，秩序阵营已经被无数的鼠人及其疫病打得一团糟
desc.en: As you might expect, the forces of order are repelled by the Skaven and their myriad disgusting, disease-ridden ways.

desc.zh: 无论是加装还是变异，尾巴上阴险的尖刺武器在战斗中的作用可不是一星半点的
desc.en: Whether by attachment or mutation, something nasty and spiky on your tail has got to bring no little advantage in battle.

desc.zh: 如果次元石硬币都准备好了，这些致命的手持或尾持武器就都是你的了
desc.en: If you've got the Warptokens and the contacts, you can get all manner of fine, murderous armaments crafted to fit claw or tail perfectly.

desc.zh: 在斯卡文鼠人争夺霸权的内战中，人们都知道只要有钱就能买到工程术士们的效命。然而究竟多少钱能买到他们的死忠？这就众说纷纭了…
desc.en: The fact that the Warlock Engineers sell to all sides in the constant Skaven struggle for dominance is well-known; the fact that for a very high price they offer to withhold their services is widely guessed.

desc.zh: 这把利刃上面联通了一台次元发电机，这让它的周围充满了暴烈的能量
desc.en: This blade is attached to a Warp-generator that channels crackling energy along the weapon.

desc.zh: 嵌着次元石的胸甲以及厚重的铁质头盔，能够有效地保护穿戴者免遭霰弹的杀伤
desc.en: A Warpstone-enchanted breastplate and a thick steel helmet are useful to protect the wearer from shrapnel.

desc.zh: 所有鼠人天生毫无原则，阴险狡诈。而这在面对敌人时却并非缺点
desc.en: All Skaven are unprincipled and untrustworthy by their foul natures. However, this is rarely a disadvantage in the face of the enemy.

desc.zh: 鬼鬼祟祟、满腹狐疑、狡黠多变、诡计多端、心狠手辣、阴险狡诈、暗中伤人、两面三刀、猥琐卑鄙，想活下来就离不开这些『美德』！
desc.en: Furtive, scheming, sly, cunning, underhand, devious, conniving, double-dealing, and sneaky - valuable traits if you wish to stay alive!

desc.zh: 这是献给大角鼠的不洁战争祭坛，上面的恶兆钟声既能激发斯卡文鼠人心中的邪恶，也能在敌人心中唤醒恐惧
desc.en: An unholy battle altar dedicated to the Great Horned Rat, its ominous tolling strikes awe into evil Skaven hearts and fear into their opponents.

desc.zh: 这是献给大角鼠的不洁战争祭坛，上面的恶兆钟声既能激发斯卡文鼠人心中的邪恶，也能在敌人心中唤醒恐惧
desc.en: An unholy battle altar dedicated to the Great Horned Rat, its ominous tolling strikes awe into evil Skaven hearts and fear into their opponents.

desc.zh: 这座祭坛充满了瘟疫，倒是个瘟疫祭司们传播毒素与死亡道法的好场所
desc.en: This altar, ridden with disease, is a fitting pulpit from which the Plague Priests preach their words of poison and death.

desc.zh: 当你很明显比别人强大时，其他人就是任你摆布的傀儡，可以随意献祭出去
desc.en: When you're clearly the better than the rest, others are mere puppets to be toyed with along the way and then casually sacrificed.

desc.zh: 只有最强壮、最凶猛、最残忍的人才能成为这支精英部队的一员
desc.en: Only the strongest, fiercest, and most ruthless may become members of the most elite claw-unit of all.

desc.zh: 当你身处高位时，一切行为即使再龌龊也不为过
desc.en: No act, no matter how despicable, is considered taboo when you're on the way to the very top.

desc.zh: 言而无信、诡诈多变的人也会不信任他人
desc.en: Being untrustworthy and treacherous tends to make one suspicious of others.

desc.zh: 『是的、是的，我杀、杀一整天都不会累。他们都得死，议会将会见证我的价值，是的、是的！』
desc.en: "Yes-yes, I will kill-kill all day and through the night until the next. They will all die and then the Council will see my worth, yes-yes!"

desc.zh: 有时候，想要让别人明白你的意思，就必须得先杀几个伙伴杀鸡儆猴，这样他们就会明白了
desc.en: Oft-times, in order to get your point across, it is necessary to violently kill associates as an example to the others, that they may learn.

desc.zh: 腐烂的脓疮上散发着刺鼻的恶臭，司库克那层浓浓的体味啊，只有最为疯狂的信徒才敢站在他的身旁！
desc.en: Stench upon pox upon malady; so foul is the Skrolk's putrefaction that only the most serious devotees can stand to be in his presence.

desc.zh: 此人面容丑恶至极，他的出现就是对自然的公开侮辱，同时也是大角鼠无边法力的体现
desc.en: The hideous countenance that this one presents is an affront to nature and a true sign of the Great Horned Rat's limitless power.

desc.zh: 此人所过之处草木皆萎，各种疫病萦绕其身
desc.en: Plants wither and die when this one passes by, so utterly disease-ridden is he.

desc.zh: 最周密的计划，包括用毒药和利刃刺杀，都必须要加以保密，否则密谋者就会死于这两样东西之下…
desc.en: The best-laid plans – those involving murder with poison and knives – must remain secret, under pain of a hideous death involving poison and knives...

desc.zh: 鼠人社会是靠暗杀来维系的专制政体，而此人就是议会的使节
desc.en: Skaven society is a tyranny moderated by assassination; this one is its ambassador.

desc.zh: 如果你想要扩张领土，就需要组建一支贪婪凶猛的开边大军，就像…呃哦！
desc.en: If you wish to expand into new territory, it helps to head-up a voracious, colonising force that breed like… er, oh!

desc.zh: 不难想象，一个没有荣誉与理解的种族根本不会在乎其他人的性命
desc.en: It should be no surprise that a race without a shred of honour or decency between them have even less regard for each other's lives.

desc.zh: 祈祷之中所有的仇恨、嫉妒及恶意都将千倍奉还
desc.en: All the hate, envy, and malice uttered in prayer each day, returned a thousand-fold.

desc.zh: 这东西能帮助施法，可以说无与伦比。虽然十分危险，但若想获得无尽的力量，用它准没错
desc.en: As an aid to spellcasting, they are peerless. It is highly dangerous, of course, but a sure-fire route to limitless power.

desc.zh: 作为食人魔与老鼠特别交配后的产物，碎骨者身后或绑或捆着一个牢固的平台，从而将斯卡文军阀背上战场
desc.en: A specially-engineered breed of Rat Ogre, the Bonebreaker has a braced platform strapped or bolted to its back for carrying a Skaven Warlord to battle.

desc.zh: 任何野兽都不可能完全听从指令，但这一鞭子至少能够带来最低限度的…顺从
desc.en: No beast can truly be controlled, but these desperate contrivances bring the smallest semblance of order.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 帝国飞马是高贵的带翼马，既聪明又忠诚
desc.en: An Imperial pegasus is a noble, winged steed, intelligent and loyal.

desc.zh: 法师很少穿着护甲，而战马则能为他们提供一定程度的防护和速度
desc.en: While Wizards can rarely benefit from armour, a warhorse does offer some degree of protection and manoeuvrability.

desc.zh: 这头发臭的猪和它的野蛮骑手一样暴躁凶残
desc.en: This stinky hog is as grumpy and fierce as its brutal rider.

name.zh: 阿拉克纳瑞巨蛛（蛛网神龛）

desc.zh: 这个巨大的，令人作呕的阿拉克纳瑞巨蛛神龛上端坐着萨满，就连附近树木上的树枝都会被它的邪恶力量所扭曲
desc.en: This enormous, revolting Arachnarok Spider shrine upon which the Shaman is borne forces even the branches of nearby trees to twist in revulsion at its diabolical passing.

desc.zh: 鞍鞯即为此人之家：其他人纵使步行也难以穿过的地形，他却可以全速驰骋而过
desc.en: Perfectly at home in the saddle, this warrior can ride at full-pelt through terrain others would struggle with on foot.

desc.zh: 此人效法末日之星，擅长从天空中打出威力强大、威震敌胆的一击
desc.en: Following the example of the Doomstar, this warrior specializes in devastating, demoralizing strikes from the sky.

desc.zh: 作为战舞者的一员，这位战士会在洛依克的无声之歌中战斗
desc.en: A member of the Wardancer kindred, this warrior fights to Loec's silent song.

desc.zh: 这位战士在荒林的边界巡逻，面对未知的恐怖亦泰然自若
desc.en: This warrior has patrolled the borders of the Wildwood, facing down horrors unknowable and standing unfazed.

desc.zh: 骑手与坐骑的羁绊远远超出了友谊或家人的范畴：他们早已合而为一
desc.en: The bond between rider and steed goes beyond friendship or family; they act as one.

desc.zh: 振翅鹰翔，拥抱旭日；追逐敌手，一击毙命
desc.en: Fly on your wings, like an eagle. Touch the sun. Track the foe, ambush, and defeat.

desc.zh: 顶生巨角，鼾若雷鸣，巨牡鹿无疑会令它的骑手勇气倍增
desc.en: With its magnificent frame and the great plumes of steam of its snorting breath, the Great Stag instils unflinching valour into those who ride it.

desc.zh: 狩猎之神会将他的神圣战争热情慷慨地赠予所有对艾索洛伦充满责任心的贵族
desc.en: The God of the Hunt freely gifts his deific zeal for war to all nobles deemed worthy of their responsibilities to Athel Loren.

desc.zh: 当森林家园亟需护卫时，长弓亲族们会组织起来，如风中之叶般进退
desc.en: Longbow kinbands are regimented and resourceful when defending their forest homes, advancing and retreating like leaves in a storm.

desc.zh: 当洛克西亚上岸逡巡时，他最亲密的副官会接管了神佑恶党号
desc.en: While Lokhir prowls the land, his closest lieutenant takes command of the Blessed Dread.

desc.zh: 在野外，没有善良邪恶之分，只有猎人猎物之别
desc.en: In the wild, there is no such thing as good and evil, only predators and prey.

desc.zh: 『驯兽师们总是想着自己能不能做到，而没有考虑自己是否应该做到』
desc.en: "The Beastmasters were so preoccupied with whether or not they could, they didn't stop to think if they should."

desc.zh: 『飞吧，我的美人儿，飞吧！』
desc.en: "Fly my pretties, fly!"

desc.zh: 有什么必要去喂养那些完全可以养活自己的生物呢？
desc.en: What need is there to feed creatures perfectly capable of feeding themselves?

desc.zh: 想要拔出被俘鹰身女妖的爪子而不被抓伤，这种掌控能力仅有极少数驯兽师能够掌握，但它能带来的可是最适合捕兽的武器
desc.en: Extracting the claws of captive Harpies without suffering injury requires a control that few Beastmasters possess, but yields armaments most useful for beast-catching.

desc.zh: 有些野兽只会被更为强悍的造物所驯服，或者说征服：这种强悍如果不是出于力量，那就一定是意志力的压制
desc.en: Some beasts are only tamed, or dominated, by some manner of being an order of magnitude stronger, in will if not in muscle.

desc.zh: 就残忍程度与制造痛苦的能力而言，唯一能比得上黑龙巴绰斯的，怕是只有拉卡斯本人了！
desc.en: No creature outmatches the Black Dragon Bracchus in terms of sheer cruelty and the ability to inflict pain, save for Rakarth himself!

desc.zh: 蝎尾狮的咆哮绝对能让凡间之物闻之而遁，因为他们知道，一只可怕的生物出现了
desc.en: The roar of a Manticore is guaranteed to send mortals fleeing, for they know a creature of terror is abroad.

desc.zh: 黑暗精灵的驯兽师乘着可怕的战车在荒野中游荡，他们使用装有倒钩的网和标枪来杀死敌人并诱捕猎物
desc.en: Dark Elf Beastmasters roam the wilds atop their dreaded chariots, armed with barbed nets and harpoons to slay the foe and ensnare their prey.

desc.zh: 『等到这帮家伙八个月大时，它们会很致命，是的，致命。我曾经捕猎过不少能够捕猎你的东西，但这些家伙走路的方式嘛…』
desc.en: "They're lethal at eight months, and I do mean lethal. I've hunted most things that can hunt you, but the way these things move…"

desc.zh: 最伟大的驯兽师的技艺无人能敌，他以近乎超自然的天资指挥着野生猛兽
desc.en: The greatest of all Beastmasters has no equal in his craft, commanding the wild and feral with almost supernatural aptitude.

desc.zh: 戈隆德古老的档案中包含了许多可以救命…或者夺命的秘密
desc.en: The ancient archives of Ghrond contain secrets that can preserve life - or annihilate it.

desc.zh: 丹鼎师能提供的，远非寻常铁匠可比，他们以神秘莫测、不合常规的手段硬化震旦军队的盔甲
desc.en: Alchemists offer far more than any run-of-the-mill blacksmith, hardening Cathayan troops’ armour by inscrutable, non-traditional means.

desc.zh: 效力于震旦军队的丹鼎师，常被征召为麾下部队的武器注入奥术强化
desc.en: Alchemists serving the armies of Cathay are often called upon to imbue their troops’ weapons with arcane enhancements.

desc.zh: 此物由朱雀灵翼烈火所驱，见此浮空奇景，可知震旦绝技
desc.en: A floating symbol of Cathay's pre-eminence, powered by the burning wings of magical Warbirds.

desc.zh: 一旦接纳巫术，便能收获惊人的成果。有时，刀剑的威吓也能达到同样目的
desc.en: Once embraced, sorcery can yield amazing results. Sometimes the threat of a blade can achieve the same.

desc.zh: 丹鼎师的灵魂之火既能塑造精炼世间金属，当化作实体迎击敌人时，同样威力无穷
desc.en: The fire of an Alchemist’s soul may shape and refine the world's metals, but is equally powerful when manifested physically against their enemies.

desc.zh: 『火纵则燎原莫遏，神凝乃铸鼎弥刚』\n——战争工匠谚语
desc.en: "The unchecked flame easily spirals, but focus and control hone the intensity of the raging forge."\n – War Artificer's proverb

desc.zh: 既能凭空召来弹药，又何必费力锻造
desc.en: Why forge bullets when one can conjure them from the very air itself?

desc.zh: 『金石非力可强致，必感之肺腑，契以神魂，始能从心不逾』\n——《上阳炼形宝鉴》
desc.en: "Metal is not shaped by force of will alone. It must be felt within; made part of one’s soul – only then may it be shaped effortlessly."\n–Shang-Yang Tome of Metallurgic Secrets

name.en: Student of the House of Secrets

desc.zh: 研习与反复磨练让丹鼎师愈发强大，上阳的教诲造就了非凡的实践者
desc.en: Study and repetition make the Alchemist all the more potent, with Shang-Yang’s teachings yielding exceptional practitioners.

desc.zh: 这位崇奉阳之道的修士，怀着一股急迫而充沛的劲头，主动出手恢复平衡，亲手将秩序重新缔造出来
desc.en: With an urgent, energetic drive to proactively bring back balance, this adherent of Yang takes charge to shape order back into being.

desc.zh: 这位崇奉阳之道的修士，怀着一股急迫而充沛的劲头，主动出手恢复平衡，亲手将秩序重新缔造出来
desc.en: With an urgent, energetic drive to proactively bring back balance, this adherent of Yang takes charge to shape order back into being.

desc.zh: 这位遵循阴之道的修士，始终保持着沉静而不动声色的姿态，避开一切直接干预，温和地牵引秩序重返宁和
desc.en: Ever maintaining a calm and passive manner, this follower of Yin’s tenets gently guides order back into synchronicity by eschewing overt intervention.

desc.zh: 这位遵循阴之道的修士，始终保持着沉静而不动声色的姿态，避开一切直接干预，温和地牵引秩序重返宁和
desc.en: Ever maintaining a calm and passive manner, this follower of Yin’s tenets gently guides order back into synchronicity by eschewing overt intervention.

desc.zh: 在与震旦最强大的构装体并肩作战时，更为审慎的司天丞或会为其编织特殊的防护结界，以增强其韧性
desc.en: When marching into battle alongside Cathay’s mightiest constructs, more prudent Astromancers may weave into them special protective wards to enhance their resilience.

desc.zh: 了解天体的运行规律，有助于预判魔法之风何处最为强盛或衰微
desc.en: Understanding the movements of celestial bodies helps anticipate where the Winds will wax or wane the strongest.

desc.zh: 欲窥流星之风的秘密，须以对天堂之风的深厚领悟为根基。修行精深者，便是战场上不可小觑的力量
desc.en: A deep understanding of the Heavens is the basic requirement for learning the secrets of the Meteor Wind. Advanced practicioners are a force to be reckoned with.

desc.zh: 司天丞专注凝神，洞察天堂之风在战场上的流转变幻，从中随心编织魔法
desc.en: With deep focus on the fluctuations of the Celestial Winds upon the battlefield, the Astromancer weaves magic from their threads at will.

desc.zh: 那些与震旦故土及苍穹紧密相连之人，可与天界之兽分享其内在力量
desc.en: Those whose hearts are closely attuned to the Cathayan homeland as well as the heavens can share their inner strength with celestial beasts.

desc.zh: 『明于星辰而昧于兵刃，未之有也』
desc.en: "Just because one knows the secrets of the stars, it doesn’t mean they don’t know where to stick a blade."

desc.zh: 观测天穹、洞悉星象的能力是深邃智慧的象征，这使得许多司天丞得以担任城镇主官与规划顾问之职
desc.en: The ability to scry the heavens and understand the stars is a sign of deep intelligence, leading many Astromancers to advisory positions for city rulers and planners.

desc.zh: 『昊天至秘，惟心澄志洁者得窥，蕴无穷之威，藏不测之能』\n——钦天监箴言
desc.en: "The deepest secrets of the Celestial Sky yield untold power to those with the purest will to find it."\n – Proverb of the Grand Observatory

desc.zh: 震旦西部广袤的荒漠，为珀希瓦先祖一脉提供了磨砺技艺的试炼场，造就了世间最为坚韧的沙漠战士
desc.en: Western Cathay’s far-flung deserts gave Bhashiva's ancestral line a place to hone its ways and bring forth the world’s most resilient desert warrior.

desc.zh: 白虎乐此不疲地追踪猎物，即便这是一个漫长而持久的过程，需耐心寻找弱点，并在最后一扑时才有所收获
desc.en: The White Tiger revels in endlessly stalking her prey, despite it being a long, drawn-out process of studying weakness only bearing fruit at the final pounce.

desc.zh: 当猎手无法克制对猎物的憎恨时，便需倍加努力以定心凝神，确保猎杀之举合乎正道
desc.en: When a hunter cannot help but hate their prey, extra effort must be taken to centre one’s soul and ensure the kill is righteous.

desc.zh: 精准胜于蛮力，时机胜于速度，威名先于功业而行
desc.en: Precision beats power. Timing beats speed. Reputation precedes greatness.

desc.zh: 随着『白虎』珀希瓦地位的提升，她的虎人宫廷在昭明治下日益壮大，进而巩固了白虎的军政声望
desc.en: As Bhashiva increases her standing, her Tiger Court strengthens its influence under Zhao Ming, consolidating the White Tiger’s military and political prestige.

desc.zh: 为『白虎』珀希瓦麾下担任猎手与斥候者，必须达到白虎本尊设立的极高标尺
desc.en: Those who hunt and scout for Bhashiva’s host must live up to the extremely high standards set by the White Tiger herself.

desc.zh: 真正的征途大师，解读流沙与腐化之风，引导商队毫发无伤地穿越致命之地
desc.en: A true master of the trail, reading the shifting sands and corrupting Winds to guide the convoy through lethal lands unscathed.

desc.zh: 卡茂那传说中的武学秘法知识，据传由千神所赐，后通过爪语者的口述传统传予信徒
desc.en: Kamau’s fabled esoteric knowledge of martial mysticism was said to have been gifted by the Thousand Gods, then shared to his worshippers via the Clawspeakers’ oral traditions.

desc.zh: 爪语者低吟着古印地无文字记载的传统歌谣，进入一种能窥见魔法之风最纯粹形态的通灵状态
desc.en: Whispering in chants of ancient Ind’s unwritten traditions, the Clawspeaker enters a state of consciousness allowing them to see the Winds in their purest form.

desc.zh: 唯有真正能让内心寂静到仅余自我的人，方能窥见现实本质的纹理
desc.en: Only one who can truly quieten their mind – so that nothing but the self remains – may see into the very fabric of reality.

desc.zh: 当不屈的意志与元素之风合而为一，伟大而传奇的战功便会在战场上显现
desc.en: When an indomitable mind becomes one with the Winds, feats of battle both great and legendary are made manifest.

desc.zh: 爪语者以嘶嘶作响的奥术旋律，娴熟地将魔法之风束缚为一道单一、顺从的溪流
desc.en: In hissed arcane melody, the Clawspeaker masterfully binds the Winds into a single, obedient stream.

desc.zh: 『坚守战斗！前人曾历此境，切勿气馁！』
desc.en: "Stay true to the battle. Others before you endured the same. Do not weaken!"

desc.zh: 『永志不忘，吾等乃卡茂后裔，其意志如漠风，不可阻挡、无形无影、永不停息』
desc.en: "Never forget that we descend from Kamau himself, His will like the desert wind – unyielding, unseen, and unstoppable."

desc.zh: 一位伟大爪语者的存在，能让同袍虎人战士心中再无半点疑虑，卡茂那无形的裁决已然沉沉压在那些注定灭亡的敌人身上
desc.en: A great Clawspeaker’s presence removes all doubt from his fellow Tiger Warriors, the unseen judgement of Kamau weighing down upon their doomed enemies.

desc.zh: 『大氏族长之道有训：狩猎唯有以杀戮终结，不可早一分，亦不可迟一刻！』
desc.en: "The ways of the Great Chieftain demand that the hunt only ends with the kill – and not a moment sooner."

desc.zh: 千神之威可降临沙场，为高贵的虎人战士锚定神魂
desc.en: The might of all Thousand Gods can be called down to the battlefield to anchor the souls of the noble Tigers.

desc.zh: 爪语者的存在唤起了卡茂的刚健之相，赋予信徒们在困苦中神圣的坚定意志
desc.en: The Clawspeaker’s presence brings forth the robust aspect of Kamau, bestowing upon worshippers a divine steadfastness under hardship.

desc.zh: 通过虔诚的祷告，爪语者能重焕躯体活力，因他深知，精神的坚韧终究无法克服肉身的衰颓
desc.en: Through fervent supplication, a Clawspeaker may be rejuvenated in body, for he knows mental fortitude cannot overcome the body's failings.

desc.zh: 『永志不忘，吾等乃卡茂后裔，其意志如漠风，不可阻挡、无形无影、永不停息』
desc.en: "Never forget that we descend from Kamau himself, His will like the desert wind – unyielding, unseen, and unstoppable."

desc.zh: 『大氏族长之道有训：狩猎唯有以杀戮终结，不可早一分，亦不可迟一刻！』
desc.en: "The ways of the Great Chieftain demand that the hunt only ends with the kill – and not a moment sooner."

desc.zh: 爪语者那些精妙而神秘的仪式，既能愈合破碎的大地，也能治愈崩溃的心智
desc.en: The intricate and mysterious rites of the Clawspeakers mend both broken lands and broken minds.

desc.zh: 当不屈的意志与元素之风合而为一，伟大而传奇的战功便会在战场上显现
desc.en: When an indomitable mind becomes one with the Winds, feats of battle both great and legendary are made manifest.

desc.zh: 爪语者低吟着古印地无文字记载的传统歌谣，进入一种能窥见魔法之风最纯粹形态的通灵状态
desc.en: Whispering in chants of ancient Ind’s unwritten traditions, the Clawspeaker enters a state of consciousness allowing them to see the Winds in their purest form.

desc.zh: 卡茂那传说中的武学秘法知识，据传由千神所赐，后通过爪语者的口述传统传予信徒
desc.en: Kamau’s fabled esoteric knowledge of martial mysticism was said to have been gifted by the Thousand Gods, then shared to his worshippers via the Clawspeakers’ oral traditions.

desc.zh: 爪语者低吟着古印地无文字记载的传统歌谣，进入一种能窥见魔法之风最纯粹形态的通灵状态
desc.en: Whispering in chants of ancient Ind’s unwritten traditions, the Clawspeaker enters a state of consciousness allowing them to see the Winds in their purest form.

desc.zh: 唯有真正能让内心寂静到仅余自我的人，方能窥见现实本质的纹理
desc.en: Only one who can truly quieten their mind – so that nothing but the self remains – may see into the very fabric of reality.

desc.zh: 当不屈的意志与元素之风合而为一，伟大而传奇的战功便会在战场上显现
desc.en: When an indomitable mind becomes one with the Winds, feats of battle both great and legendary are made manifest.

desc.zh: 爪语者以嘶嘶作响的奥术旋律，娴熟地将魔法之风束缚为一道单一、顺从的溪流
desc.en: In hissed arcane melody, the Clawspeaker masterfully binds the Winds into a single, obedient stream.

desc.zh: 『坚守战斗！前人曾历此境，切勿气馁！』
desc.en: "Stay true to the battle. Others before you endured the same. Do not weaken!"
