desc.en: Whispering in chants of ancient Ind’s unwritten traditions, the Clawspeaker enters a state of consciousness allowing them to see the Winds in their purest form.

desc.zh: 『吾久居巨龙与巍峨巨像之间，何惧疆域之外的宵小魔物』
desc.en: "I've lived amongst Dragons and towering sentinels. I fear not the petty monsters beyond our realm."

desc.zh: 门下督们经年累月在长垣之上挫败入侵者、观察敌军动向，铸就了震旦最为老谋深算的老兵
desc.en: The many years spent by Gate Masters thwarting invaders and observing enemy movements from atop the Bastion have forged Cathay’s most wily veterans.

desc.zh: 无数时日的苦练，只为在紧要关头赢取那转瞬即逝的几秒先机
desc.en: It takes many hours of dedication to yield precious few seconds when they are needed the most.

desc.zh: 单凭武艺超群无法赢得战争。备战至关重要，若是忽视此理，往往会招致败北的惨烈结局
desc.en: Excellence at arms alone will not win a war. Preparedness is crucial, the ignorance of which is often paid for in defeat.

desc.zh: 与坚定沉着的心灵并肩作战者，能在周遭肆虐的战乱风暴中，受益于那份安宁的存在
desc.en: Those who fight alongside a sure and steadfast mind benefit from a calm presence amidst the storm of war raging around them.

desc.zh: 唯有盖世神射手，方能在极远距离将致命弩矢精准送入敌人眉心
desc.en: It takes a peerless marksman to place a deadly crossbow bolt between the eyes of an enemy at extreme range.

desc.zh: 经受最为严苛训练的战士，方能在关键时刻承受最猛烈的打击，但也需良师督导，使其常备不懈，心无旁骛
desc.en: The hardest-drilled warriors can take the most punishment when it matters, but need the right instructor to keep them practiced and focused.

desc.zh: 证明自身价值的门下督，或会被征召至某位震旦领主的麾下，在战场上提供谏言与护卫
desc.en: A Gate Master whose worth is proven may be drafted into the direct service of a Lord of Cathay for counsel and security on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 『恃刃者下，御远者上。敌不及身，锋何加焉』
desc.en: "A blade is a reliable weapon, but we are better off never allowing an enemy to get close enough to need it."

desc.zh: 掠食者未必非要采取野蛮之道。技巧与精准同样能像不加节制的侵略一样终结狩猎
desc.en: A predator need not be savage in their approach. Skill and precision ends a hunt just as effectively as unbridled aggression.

desc.zh: 体外烈火灼烧之际，这些战士心中的烈焰却未曾熄灭。非但如此，这股心火更驱使他们行出愈加凶悍的壮举
desc.en: As they burn from without, these warriors' inner fire is not quenched. What is more, it drives them to ever greater acts of savagery.

desc.zh: 至伟虎人战士的古老武术传统，讲究精妙技法，防御姿态须如流水般圆转无滞
desc.en: The ancient martial traditions of the Sawai mandate techniques of finesse which demand complete fluidity of defensive posture.

desc.zh: 借由古印地苦修中沉淀的冥思内观，可驾驭心胜于物之道，使肩甲坚如磐石，让斧刃寒光毕露
desc.en: Through deep introspection developed from the ascetic practices of old Ind, one can utilise mind-over-matter techniques to harden pauldrons and sharpen axes.

desc.zh: 至伟虎人战士不仅是战地指挥官，更是受古老戒律约束的精英贵族战士，其权威足以巩固麾下将士的魂灵
desc.en: The Sawai are not just battle commanders, but elite warrior-nobles bound by ancient codes, whose authority buttresses the very souls of those they command.

desc.zh: 至伟虎人战士的差合，以其繁复精绝的搏杀之术点燃众志，令勇士之心为之沸腾。唯有尽掌武道之精粹，方可臻至不败的圆满之境
desc.en: The greatest Sawai ignite heroic hearts with their elaborate and manifold fighting techniques. To master Sawai traditions is to embody perfection in combat.

desc.zh: 脚力轻快者，能抢先接敌
desc.en: Those who are fleet of foot can reach the enemy faster.

desc.zh: 生命的终结，是对那些仍有血仇未报之人的轻慢
desc.en: The end of one's life is a slight against those owed their debts of vengeance that remain unpaid.

desc.zh: 『无悯』桃妍仰仗其嗜血威名而生，敌人闻风丧胆，以她之名作战者亦受其庇护
desc.en: Taoyan lives by her bloodthirsty reputation, which has her enemies cower before her and those who fight in her name.

desc.zh: 『所谓殷魁之子余孽，吾追缉无贷，当付诸刑典，殄灭乃止。凡怀逆心者，其宜鉴之』
desc.en: "The remnants of the Children of Yin Quai will be chased down, put to trial, and punished unto their final breath. Let all would-be insurrectionists know it."

desc.zh: 畏惧她的并非只有敌人，为了博取胜利，『无悯』桃妍通常毫不体恤麾下将士
desc.en: The enemy are not the only ones to dread her, for Taoyan often triumphs by taking every possible liberty from the troops she serves with.

desc.zh: 『玉勇诸营听令：临阵怯战者，皆斩！』
desc.en: "Let the Jade battalions know this: death awaits any who succumb to their cowardice."

desc.zh: 自桃妍受封为上阳君之后，镔龙思忖应授予她权柄，让她借助惩戒震旦之敌得来的凶名，发挥更大的威慑
desc.en: Following Taoyan's instatement as a Lord of Shang-Yang, the Iron Dragon also sees fit to grant powers to exploit her infamy from punishing Cathay’s enemies.

desc.zh: 桃妍虽以那致命的三股叉闻名，但她精湛的剑术令她在逼仄的近身格斗中，劈刺之间快得更加致命
desc.en: Though known for her deadly trident, Taoyan's proficient swordsmanship allows her deadlier speed in the cut-and-thrust of claustrophobic combat.

desc.zh: 以随意乱劈的木头拼合，再用肠线缝缝补补，三凑六合而成的产物。有趣的是，地精们对它却是赞誉有加
desc.en: Cobbled together from crudely-hacked wood and lashed tight with gutstring, the gobbos hold their rickety constructions in high regard.

desc.zh: 通过将粗制滥造的木头强行绑到一起，兽人们终于造出了需要两只战猪才能拉动的可怕战车
desc.en: By lashing together rough-hewn logs, Orcs are able to construct formidable chariots that need two boars to pull them.

desc.zh: 以随意乱劈的木头拼合，再用肠线缝缝补补，三凑六合而成的产物。有趣的是，地精们对它却是赞誉有加
desc.en: Cobbled together from crudely-hacked wood and lashed tight with gutstring, the gobbos hold their rickety constructions in high regard.

desc.zh: 耐心或为美德，但有些人根本等不起
desc.en: Patience may be a virtue, but some simply cannot afford to wait.

desc.zh: 耐心或为美德，但有些人根本等不起
desc.en: Patience may be a virtue, but some simply cannot afford to wait.

desc.zh: 虎人战士笃信，每当混沌之势滔天而起，必有白虎应运降世，引领族人奔向救赎：此乃天命所授之圣职，亦是无以承受之重负
desc.en: The Tiger Warriors believe that when Chaos is ascendant, a White Tiger is born to lead them to salvation – a sacred duty counterbalanced by terrible burden.

desc.zh: 久居镔龙治下，这位虎人战士已对炼金奇术司空见惯，熟稔渐生好奇之心
desc.en: Life in the Iron Dragon’s domain has so accustomed this Tiger Warrior to alchemy’s marvels that tolerance has ripened into curiosity.

desc.zh: 这位至伟虎人战士虽擅近身搏杀，却也不曾忽视以雷鸣炮火压制敌军气焰的战术价值
desc.en: This Sawai’s skill in close combat do not blind him to the tactical worth of dampening the foe’s ardour with a thunderous barrage.

desc.zh: 尽管身为最矫健的猎手，这位虎人战士仍对战争野兽赋予双足骑士的那份优雅赞赏有加
desc.en: Though they are the most lithe of hunters themselves, this Tiger Warrior greatly esteems the grace that war beasts lend to their two-legged riders.

desc.zh: 机缘巧合之下，这位至伟虎人战士曾救下龙帝的一位贵族后裔，因而获赐一支精锐巨龙马骑手作为扈从
desc.en: By fortunate circumstance, this Sawai once saved a noble scion of the Dragon Emperor, and was rewarded with an escort of Great Longma Riders.

desc.zh: 这位至伟虎人战士偏爱与健谈的贤者为伴，以消磨漫漫征途
desc.en: This Sawai prefers loquacious sages with whom to share the endless journey.

desc.zh: 这位虎人战士听觉敏锐，却坚忍地忍受着火枪雷鸣般的咆哮，只因火药味能激起他更炽烈的战斗渴望
desc.en: This Tiger Warrior’s delicate hearing stoically endures the thunderous bark of guns, as the scent of gunpowder sharpens his thirst for battle.

desc.zh: 能适应玉勇大军协作战法者，便会与其自然秩序密不可分
desc.en: Those who can attune themselves to the Jade Host’s harmonious style of war become inseparable from its natural order.

desc.zh: 长年操练震旦步军阵列的经历，让这位至伟虎人战士对那些队列中不加矫饰的勇气心生敬意
desc.en: A long career drilling the Cathayan infantry line has led this Sawai to respect the unadorned bravery of their vulnerable ranks.

desc.zh: 『利爪无需生于掌上，亦可染血』\n——虎人战士谚语
desc.en: "A claw need not be part of a paw to draw blood."\n– Tiger Warrior proverb

desc.zh: 虎人战士难以轻易打消对这些依靠无尽巧思升空的奇异天舟的疑虑。但这也并非绝无可能
desc.en: Tiger Warriors do not easily swallow their distrust of these strange sky-craft, borne aloft by relentless ingenuity. Yet it is not impossible!

desc.zh: 团结于救世神卡茂面前，坚拒奸奇之诡诈，矢志效力上阳：这位至伟虎人战士如此看待自身的命运
desc.en: United before the saviour-god Kamau, steadfast against Tzeentch’s treachery, indivisible in service to Shang-Yang – thus does this Sawai see his destiny.

desc.zh: 这位虎人战士麾下的大军曾历经惨烈的血战，且令人隐隐不安的是，他们仍渴望着更多厮杀
desc.en: This Tiger Warrior leads an army that has already survived grim bloodshed – and, somewhat disquietingly, still hungers for more.

desc.zh: 尽管外表充满兽性特征，虎人战士却远非野蛮之辈，并对那类货色鄙夷不屑
desc.en: Despite their stark animalistic appearance, Tiger Warriors are far from savages, and loath those of that ilk.

desc.zh: 即便是生有利爪的手掌，也能以登峰造极的稳定性与技巧挥舞兵刃
desc.en: Even a clawed grip can wield a weapon with supreme consistency and skill.

desc.zh: 无人能够杀死不可捕捉之物
desc.en: No being can kill what it cannot catch.

desc.zh: 『静不济时，勿纵猛虎于怀，宜纳之为己驱策』
desc.en: "When the tranquillity of calm isn't enough, do not unleash your inner beast – embrace it."

desc.zh: 『静不济时，勿纵猛虎于怀，宜纳之为己驱策』
desc.en: "When the tranquillity of calm isn't enough, do not unleash your inner beast – embrace it."

desc.zh: 明断则慎行
desc.en: Discerning judgement begets prudent action.

desc.zh: 『害无辜者，当付利爪裁决！』
desc.en: "Those who harm the innocent deserve the judgement of the claw!"

desc.zh: 如果知识就是力量，那么此人力量十足
desc.en: If knowledge is power, then this one is powerful indeed.

desc.zh: 如果知识就是力量，那么此人力量十足
desc.en: If knowledge is power, then this one is powerful indeed.

desc.zh: 纵使刀折矢尽，猛士仍能以精武之躯力战不已，死中求生
desc.en: When the arrows are spent and the blades are all blunted, this perfect warrior can rely on their well-trained body to keep death from their door.

desc.zh: 纵使刀折矢尽，猛士仍能以精武之躯力战不已，死中求生
desc.en: When the arrows are spent and the blades are all blunted, this perfect warrior can rely on their well-trained body to keep death from their door.

desc.zh: 潇洒一道疤，真猛士的扮相就完美了
desc.en: A dashing scar completes any true warrior's look.

desc.zh: 隐形的掠食者未必总能独占猎物，但往往能抢先得手
desc.en: The unseen predator is not always the only one to catch their prey, but they are often the first.

desc.zh: 『诀窍就是要提前想两步…然后再提前想一步』
desc.en: "The trick is to think two steps ahead… and then think one step ahead of that."

desc.zh: 『诀窍就是要提前想两步…然后再提前想一步』
desc.en: "The trick is to think two steps ahead… and then think one step ahead of that."

desc.zh: 这家伙能跟食人魔较量掰手腕
desc.en: This one could challenge an Ogre to an arm-wrestling match.

desc.zh: 这家伙能跟食人魔较量掰手腕
desc.en: This one could challenge an Ogre to an arm-wrestling match.

desc.zh: 宁可待在疯子身旁，也别挡在他们道上
desc.en: It is better to be by the side of the unhinged than in their way.

desc.zh: 有时，欲求成功，需冷静沉着、步步为营
desc.en: Sometimes, a calm and measured approach is required to achieve success.

desc.zh: 卡堂是一位变形术大师，他能把自己的形体变成任何他想要的形状。这次，他的魔法被用来召唤一头昊天狮，仿佛卡堂亲自在为你战斗
desc.en: Kadon, a master of forms, was able to shift his shape into anything he chose. This mastery is used to summon a Celestial Lion, as if Kadon himself fights for you.

desc.zh: 异象扰人心智，它会预言敌人的到来，揭露他们藏身的每一处阴影
desc.en: Visions cloud the mind, prophesising the arrival of the enemy and uncovering every shadow in which they lurk.

desc.zh: 获取恐虐神恩的不二法门，便是嗜血与惨烈的屠杀
desc.en: The favour of Khorne is earned in blood and the brutal decimation of His foes.

desc.zh: 血神的神选身后只会留下燃烧的城市，这就是他们对凡世彰显恐虐之虐的方式
desc.en: The chosen of the Blood God leave burning cities in their wake, exerting Khorne's savage dominion over the mortal plane.

desc.zh: 慈父的军队会兴高采烈地传播他的疾病，每一次新的感染都会赢得祖父神纳垢的认可
desc.en: The armies of the Urfather spread their sickness with glee, earning Grandfather Nurgle's approval with every new infection.

desc.zh: 制造衰朽的噩梦，让瘟疫领主享受随之而来的痛苦和疾病
desc.en: Create a nightmare of decay, and let the Plague Lord feast on the suffering and sickness that follows.

desc.zh: 英俊的英雄肯定会吸引大量的粉丝，从而把懵然不觉的人们拉进欢愉亲王的怀抱
desc.en: A handsome hero is sure to tempt many, drawing the unwitting into the Prince of Pleasure's fold.

desc.zh: 随着完美亲王黑暗影响的扩散，他的欢愉祝福也在日益彰显
desc.en: As the Perfect Prince's dark influence increases, so too do the blessings of His pleasure.

desc.zh: 命运复杂多变，但每一处改变都归因于奸奇的影响，以及他麾下英雄们的努力
desc.en: Fate remains in flux, ever changing under Tzeentch's influence and the workings of His heroes.

desc.zh: 奸奇的权威是绝对的，因为无限的变化正是混沌的本质
desc.en: Tzeentch's authority is absolute, for infinite change is the very nature of Chaos.

desc.zh: 毁灭的战士们依仗着伟大的英雄，从而开启一个全新的无序时代
desc.en: The warriors of Ruin rely on great Heroes, to usher in a new age of anarchy.

desc.zh: 混沌魔法吞噬大地，加速毁灭影响的蔓延
desc.en: Chaos magic consumes the land, hastening the spreading influence of Ruin.

desc.zh: 混沌的霸权每天都在扩展，很快整个世界都会被它所吞噬
desc.en: The dominion of Chaos grows larger each day; soon the whole world will be under its sway.

desc.zh: 毁灭之力强化了他们对国度的控制，黑暗魔法为他们堕落的影响铺平了道路
desc.en: The Ruinous Powers tighten their grip on the land, as dark sorcery paves the way for their fell influence.

desc.zh: 随着黑暗之翼飞上天空，恶魔之箭倾泻而下，混沌之敌的末日也就近在眼前了
desc.en: As dark wings take to the skies and Daemon arrows bear down, the enemies of Chaos know their end is near.

desc.zh: 向诅咒亲王的祈求不仅是出于崇拜的需要，也是为了追随他无瑕的脚步
desc.en: To supplicate the Damned Prince is not only to worship him, but to follow in his immaculate footsteps.

desc.zh:
『…从你受选之日起
一切的不义都遇见你
充满了不法与罪孽
但完美却在你的途上…』
desc.en:
“…From the day You were Chosen
All wrongdoing found You,
Filled with lawlessness and sin,
Yet perfect in Your ways…”

desc.zh: 精致的丝绸装饰着充满邪恶魔法的迷人珠宝，令这尊塑像充满了力量
desc.en: Fine silks bedecked with alluring jewels of malevolent magic empower this statuesque form.

desc.zh: 不首先经历最大的痛苦，就无法体验最大的快乐
desc.en: One cannot experience the greatest pleasures without first experiencing the greatest pains.

desc.zh: 阿扎泽尔的双头之尾长而精致，优雅地悬停着，但这股场景不过是掩盖了它以极端的暴力撕裂对手的能力罢了
desc.en: Long and delicate, Azazel’s double-headed tail suspends with graceful movements, belying its potential to lacerate with extreme violence.

desc.zh: 在亚麻般细密的头发与光滑的角冠之下，乃是一双天真的眼睛：但它们其实残忍而精于算计，毫无怜悯之心
desc.en: Beneath flax-fine hair and a crown of lacquered horns sit eyes full of innocence; and yet they are cruel, calculating and without pity.

desc.zh: 医生使用感染来为自己下药，以自己的身体制造病灶，从而强化他的活力
desc.en: Self-medicating himself with infection, the Doctor instigates symptoms upon his own body that amplify his vitality.

desc.zh: 在水蛭领主精明头脑的辅佐之下，纳垢得以将越来越多的混沌奴仆置于自己的掌控
desc.en: With the Leechlord’s brilliant mind on his side, Nurgle brings more and more thralls of Chaos under his sway.

desc.zh: 所谓的清洁不过如生命一样无常。它是一块空白的石板，好随意沾上疾病的污迹
desc.en: As impermanent as life, cleanliness is merely a blank slate upon which the feculent stain of disease can be smeared.

desc.zh: 『没有痛苦就没有韧性！最健康的战士，才是最糟糕的战士！』
desc.en: “Resilience cannot be achieved without affliction! The healthiest fighters are always the blightest!”

desc.zh: 随着纳垢霸业的日益繁盛，他的枯萎花园也愈发辉煌，他的冠军勇士们也愈发强大了起来
desc.en: As Nurgle’s worldly dominion grows, so too does the splendour of His Garden of Blight and the power of His Champions.

desc.zh: 纳垢让费斯图斯掌握了培养所有病原体的知识——不仅是凡世的那些瘟神，还包括无数其它现实中的造物
desc.en: Nurgle not only grants Festus the knowledge to cultivate all the mortal world’s pathogens, but also those of countless other realities.

desc.zh: 血神的印记烙进了皮肤，这是一种残忍的象征
desc.en: The brand of the Blood God has been seared into the skin, a symbol of abject brutality.

desc.zh: 对于献身恐虐的勇士来说，他们不会享受除战斗和流血的喜悦之外的任何快感
desc.en: A dedicated warrior of Khorne knows no joy but the thrill of battle and bloodshed.

desc.zh: 有什么魔法，能穿透血神最残忍信徒心中炽热的仇恨？
desc.en: What magic can penetrate the searing hatred within the minds of the Blood God's most brutal followers.

desc.zh: 若是能在毁灭之力的青睐下战斗，那么荣耀和财富自然会纷至沓来
desc.en: For one fighting with the favour of the Ruinous Powers, glory and riches come naturally.

desc.zh: 仇恨之火迅猛燎原，所到之处皆为灰烬
desc.en: The fire of hate burns rapidly across the land, turning all in its path to ash and cinder.

desc.zh: 随着感染的疯狂蔓延，整个文明将被瘟疫所淹没
desc.en: Whole civilisations will be flooded by infection, as its spread spins wildly out of control.

desc.zh: 几乎无人能够抵御这样的诱惑，因此，无数的人都被腐蚀所紧紧攥取
desc.en: Few could resist such sultry wiles, drawing so many to corruption's insidious grasp.

desc.zh: 掀起篡变的浪潮，让它席卷全世界，这是最伟大的荣耀
desc.en: There is no greater glory than to instigate a tide of change and watch it sweep across the world.

desc.zh: 如此纯粹而肆意的混沌散发着腐蚀的能量，足以令所有人向其俯首
desc.en: All will bow before such a harbinger of pure, unbridled Chaos, oozing with the energies of corruption.

desc.zh: 任何虔诚都无法与攫取受害者的灵魂相媲美，这是可以用来荣耀毁灭之力的黑暗而扭曲的祭品
desc.en: No act of faith can rival reaving the souls of the slain; a dark and twisted offering in honour of the Ruinous Powers.

desc.zh: 『可怜虫啊！你们必须为我效劳，否则统统都得死，没有其他选择！』
desc.en: "You will serve me, wretch, or you will die, there is no other option."

desc.zh: 击碎敌人的骨头，乃是无上愉悦的享受
desc.en: Few experiences match the satisfaction of shattering the bones of one's enemies.

desc.zh: 混沌诸神会将全能的力量赐予他们最狂热的信徒
desc.en: The Chaos Gods grant almighty strength to the most fervent among their faithful.

desc.zh: 混沌勇士们以坚忍的耐力承受着每一次冲击，他们根本不知道对疼痛的恐惧是什么概念
desc.en: The Warriors of Chaos bear the brunt of every attack with a stoic endurance, unburdened by the fear of pain.

desc.zh: 带有纳垢印记的人，无论走到哪里都会掀起一股令人作呕的瘴气
desc.en: Those bearing the mark of Nurgle exude a sickening miasma wherever they go.

desc.zh: 既然慈父仆从的肉体早已衰朽腐烂，那么该怎么做才能切实地伤害到它呢？
desc.en: How exactly does one injure further the decayed, rotting flesh of the Urfather's servants?

desc.zh: 纳垢军队的伤口早已腐烂，它们便转而在衰朽中寻求力量了
desc.en: The armies of Nurgle find strength in decay, bolstered by their own festering wounds.

desc.zh: 『靠近点，小可爱们…既然你能轻易地屈服于诱惑，为什么还要战斗呢？』
desc.en: "Come closer, sweet morsels… Why fight when you can simply surrender to temptation?"

desc.zh: 优雅和速度是那些拥有色孽印记的人的第二天性
desc.en: Grace and speed are second nature to those bearing the Mark of Slaanesh.

desc.zh: 对于那些被欢愉亲王打上烙印的人来说，即使是一场冲锋，也是一种优雅和美丽的艺术展示
desc.en: For those branded by the Prince of Pleasure, even a military charge is an artful display of elegance and beauty.

desc.zh: 在邪恶力量的融合风暴中，魔法与混沌永远交织在一起
desc.en: Magic and Chaos are eternally intertwined in a symbiotic storm of malevolent power.

desc.zh: 魔法所需要的不仅是在射程内的破坏。毕竟，欣赏敌人眼中的恐惧也是战斗的一半乐趣所在
desc.en: Magic need not only wreak havoc at range—half the fun of battle, after all, is seeing the fear in your enemy's eyes.

desc.zh: 遗弃者遵从强者的命令，依靠他们过剩的能量茁壮成长
desc.en: The Forsaken heed the commands of the powerful, and thrive on the excess of their energy.

desc.zh: 当敌人将视线投向癫狂的眼眸，癫狂本身也自有注目于他们的方法
desc.en: When enemies gaze into the eyes of insanity, insanity has a way of gazing back.

desc.zh: 『鹰神保护着我，因为我已彻底成为篡变的容器！』
desc.en: "The Eagle protects me, for I am but a vessel of change!"

desc.zh: 奸奇全能的万变典范的周围，魔法之风在扭曲怒号着
desc.en: The Winds of Magic twist and churn around Tzeentch's almighty Paragons of Change.

desc.zh: 杀戮、粉碎、毁灭，这就是混沌的规则！
desc.en: Kill, crush, destroy—these are the tenets of Chaos!

desc.zh: 为了确保秩序的彻底毁灭，痛苦只是微不足道的代价！
desc.en: Pain is a trivial price to pay in assuring the complete annihilation of Order!

desc.zh: 毁灭之力的印记烙在皮肤之上，这是绝对献身于腐蚀大业的标志
desc.en: The brand of the Ruinous Powers is seared into the skin, a mark of absolute dedication to the cause of corruption.

desc.zh: 要耗尽敌人的战斗力，最好的办法就是例行公事般地割开敌人的肋骨，撕开血淋淋的脊背，让他们的肺部彻底暴露出来
desc.en: Nothing drains the enemy’s fight like ritualistic executions of severed ribs and exposed lungs strewn across bloody backs.

desc.zh: 只有最具价值的人才能在瓦尔基娅面前获得荣耀，因为众人皆知恐虐始终在密切地注视着她，并且极度鄙视懦夫
desc.en: Only the worthiest achieve glory in Valkia’s presence, knowing that Khorne watches her closely and despises cowards.

desc.zh: 瓦尔基娅那不幸部落的传说在整个北境尽人皆知。血腥的复仇让她彻底丧失了人性，而这就是这股人性的余脉吧
desc.en: The legend of Valkia’s ill-fated tribe is known throughout the north, a vestige of her lost humanity eradicated in bloody vengeance.

desc.zh: 瓦尔基娅凡人躯体的复原能力，不过是恐虐恩赐的神性生命力的小前奏罢了
desc.en: The repair of Valkia’s mortal frame was but a prelude to Khorne’s gift of godly vitality.

desc.zh: 懦夫萎靡向死，勇者傲然而生
desc.en: While the craven sneak to their death, the brave live on.

desc.zh: 神选女王遂行着战士之神不可动摇的意志，无人能以死亡裁决她！
desc.en: By the indomitable will of the God of Warriors, His chosen queen will not be allowed to die.

desc.zh: 恶魔力量与巫术的扭曲融合造就了维里奇，他将一切归功于万变之主，并与任何胆敢反抗奸奇之人不共戴天
desc.en: As a twisted fusion of diabolic strength and sorcery, Vilitch owes all to the God of Change, and stands against any who would oppose Him.

desc.zh: 无论是在敌人还是盟友的思维中，维里奇都在不断地拉扯着各种提线，使一切都屈从于他的意志
desc.en: Tugging at the loose strands in the minds of enemies and allies alike, Vilitch bends all to his will.

desc.zh: 『全拿走，然后接着找！全找出来都不够！』
desc.en: "Take it all and find more still! Everything is not enough!"

desc.zh: 『是的，是的，等我用完你就可以拿回去了』
desc.en: "Yes, yes, you can have them back when I'm done with them."

desc.zh: 野兽的身体与术士的技能，令每一击都充满了强大的力量和邪恶的法力
desc.en: With the body of a brute and the skills of a sorcerer, every strike is imbued with mighty strength and vile magics.

desc.zh: 遗弃者蜂拥而至维里奇麾下，在扭曲双子的魔能光环下尽情沐浴
desc.en: The Forsaken flock to Vilitch, basking in the aura of flux that swirls around the Twisted Twin.

desc.zh: 没有任何凡人可以挡住他们
desc.en: No mortal host shall hold them back.

desc.zh: 『战斗』若是问题，那么『暴怒』无疑是答案
desc.en: Where 'battle' is the question, 'violent rage' is undoubtedly the answer.

desc.zh: 仇恨是一种如此简单的情感，凡人很容易被它吞噬
desc.en: Hatred is such a simple emotion, and one so easy for mortals to be consumed by.

desc.zh: 在亲王的催促下，死亡之牙对目标展开了猛烈的打击
desc.en: The Teeth of Death clamp down hard upon their target, spurred on by the urgings of their Prince.

desc.zh: 在纳垢怪诞的祝福之下，毒脓反而可以吸收每一次的打击
desc.en: Through the grotesque blessings of Nurgle, virulent pus absorbs every incoming blow.

desc.zh: 衰朽大军无穷无尽，如同恶心的死亡瘟疫一样蔓延开去
desc.en: The hordes of decay are endless, creeping across the land like a repulsive plague of death.

desc.zh: 粘稠而燃烧的强酸从脓疱中猛烈喷出，腐蚀骨肉
desc.en: A viscous, burning acid spurts wildly from bulbous pustules, corroding through flesh and bone.

desc.zh: 空气中弥漫着迷人的香味，这是色孽诱人魅力的缩影
desc.en: An enchanting scent clouds the air, epitomising the tantalising allure of Slaanesh.

desc.zh: 欢愉的回报确实巨大，足以诱惑哪怕最为坚忍的灵魂
desc.en: The rewards of pleasure are vast indeed, enough to tempt even the most stoic of souls.

desc.zh: 诱惑性的馥香催人入睡，整支军队因此拜倒在了色孽欲魔的面前
desc.en: Armies fall before the Daemonettes of Slaanesh, lulled into a drowsy haze by the enticing aroma flooding their senses.

desc.zh: 鸦神的翅膀高举着对他的忠诚，用神秘的能量包围着信徒们
desc.en: The wings of the Raven God raise his faithful high, surrounding them with arcane energies.

desc.zh: 对知识的渴求如同黑暗无尽的深渊，足以吞噬一切理智
desc.en: The thirst for knowledge is a dark and endless pit, likely to swallow all sanity whole.

desc.zh: 奸奇的神秘之火永远不会熄灭！
desc.en: The arcane fire of Tzeentch shall never be quenched!

desc.zh: 纯粹的邪恶光环噼啪作响，能量熊熊燃烧，这是只有真正在混沌中沉浸的人才会发散出的强烈气场
desc.en: An aura of pure malevolence crackles and burns with energy, exuded from only those truly steeped in Chaos.

desc.zh: 『荣耀将属于我，我的霸业无可阻挡！』
desc.en: "Glory will be mine—my ascendance is inevitable!"

desc.zh: 毁灭之力虽各具千秋，但它们有一个目标是相同的，那就是对于秩序的彻底毁灭
desc.en: The Ruinous Powers stand unified in only one pursuit; the stark and utter destruction of Order.

desc.zh: 色孽钟爱的冠军勇士是如此的迷人，以至于很少有人愿意举起剑来对抗他们
desc.en: Slaanesh's favoured champions are so attractively captivating that few can find the will to raise a blade against them.

desc.zh: 温暖的银铃声中传来低语，向着欢愉之敌款款诉说：只要他们屈服于色孽的臂弯，就能畅享欢乐
desc.en: From a warm, silvery voice comes whispers telling the foe of pleasures that could be theirs, if only they submit to the waiting arms of Slaanesh.

desc.zh: 这些刻有符文的项圈充满了恐虐对魔法的厌恶，因此它们可以有效地对抗奥术之力
desc.en: These rune-etched collars, imbued with Khorne's loathing for magic, provide protection against the arcane arts.

desc.zh: 噼啪作响的火焰包围着冠军勇士，炽灼着他的敌人，而他自身却会毫发无损
desc.en: The champion is surrounded by crackling flames that burn his enemies whilst leaving his own body untouched.

desc.zh: 混沌侍仆为自己的主人记忆咒语，并时刻复述着它们，以备随时在重要关头使用这股奥术知识
desc.en: A Chaos Familiar memorises spells on its master's behalf, constantly rehearsing for its big moment until it is called upon to share its arcane knowledge.

desc.zh: 当人们所能想象的最为黑暗的狂怒驱策着某个人时，疲劳就再也无法困扰到他了
desc.en: Fatigue is no issue when one is driven by the darkest rage imaginable.

desc.zh: 被混沌所祝福的人们将不仅能够看到面前的事物，还会看到隐藏在暗影之中的一切
desc.en: Those blessed by Chaos see not only what is before them, but also what lurks in shadow, hiding in the periphery.

desc.zh: 孜孜不倦地传播疾病、饥荒和衰朽，这就是水蛭领主对瘟疫领主邪恶契约的严格尊崇
desc.en: Working tirelessly to propagate disease, famine and decay, the Leechlord honours his unholy pact with the Lord of Pestilence.

desc.zh: 冠军勇士被授予了丑陋的外表，丑陋得足以让人心碎
desc.en: The champion has been rewarded with a hideous appearance, grotesque enough to wither the hearts of men.

desc.zh: 他的皮肤如铁板般坚硬，几乎没有什么能够穿透这位冠军勇士的防御
desc.en: Granted skin as strong as iron plate, there is little that can penetrate the champion's defences.

desc.zh: 纳垢烂病是所有疾病中最为可怕、最具传染性的存在，它会同时吞噬受害者的灵魂与他的凡人身体
desc.en: Nurgle's Rot is the most dreaded and contagious of all diseases, for it gnaws at the victim's soul as well as his mortal body.

desc.zh: 冠军勇士的皮肤上覆盖着上千的鳞片，每片鳞片的坚硬程度都堪比龙鳞
desc.en: The champion's skin is covered with a thousand reptilian scales, each as tough as Dragonhide.

desc.zh: 如此压倒性的力量之下，敌人会如脆弱的树枝般粉身碎骨
desc.en: Enemies break like brittle twigs beneath the onslaught of such overwhelming strength.

desc.zh: 有些人受到了黑暗直觉的赐福，每次经历都会激发出他们知识的火花
desc.en: Some are blessed by a dark understanding, able to gleam knowledge from every experience.

desc.zh: 备受恩宠者的额上开启了第三只眼，从而探查命运的变迁
desc.en: A third eye opens in the favoured one's forehead that can see the shifting strands of fate.

desc.zh: 敌人的攻击或许很迅捷，但受到混沌进化的战士们的动作会更为快速
desc.en: A foe may strike fast, but those evolved by Chaos move faster still.

desc.zh: 冠军勇士可以操控血管中流淌的黑暗力量，一击便可击碎城堡的外墙
desc.en: The champion can channel the dark strength flowing through his veins to deliver a single blow that can shatter a fortress wall.

desc.zh: 诞为战士，生为女王，死为传奇，现在瓦尔基娅已无需睡眠、休息或补给，只为一意专心地挥洒鲜血
desc.en: Born a warrior, lived as a queen, and died as a legend, Valkia now spills blood without need of sleep, respite or sustenance.

desc.zh: 维里奇从他周围的一切吸取力量，就像他从自己流涎的兄弟身上吸取意志力一样容易
desc.en: Vilitch leeches strength from everything around him just as easily as he leeches the very willpower from his drooling brother.

desc.zh: 毁灭大军的可怕乘舆不仅是战争机器，还是地位与权力的象征
desc.en: The dread carriages of the Ruinous hosts are more than just machines of war; they are symbols of status and power.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 由地狱锻造的金属、变种野兽和锯齿利刃组成的巨大构造，这是只有嗜血成性的恶魔才能骑乘的战争利器
desc.en: A massive construction of hell-forged metal, mutant beast and jagged blade, ridden to war only by the bloodthirsty.

desc.zh: 以铜铁制成的咆哮猛兽，身高赛过凡人，浑身蛮力
desc.en: Mighty beasts of groaning iron and brass, taller than a man and possessed of a crushing mass.

desc.zh: 毁灭大军的可怕乘舆不仅是战争机器，还是地位与权力的象征
desc.en: The dread carriages of the Ruinous hosts are more than just machines of war; they are symbols of status and power.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 作为捆绑仪式的一部分，尖啸飞鲨的身体被压得扁平，并转化成了几乎不可能存在的相貌
desc.en: As part of the binding ritual, Screamer bodies are flattened and transmuted into unlikely aspects.

desc.zh: 巨大的移动祭坛，可以将战场上牺牲者的灵魂直接以邪恶的仪式进行献祭
desc.en: A vast, mobile altar allows the souls of the slain to be ritualistically condemned directly from the field of slaughter.

desc.zh: 巨大的移动祭坛，可以将战场上牺牲者的灵魂直接以邪恶的仪式进行献祭
desc.en: A vast, mobile altar allows the souls of the slain to be ritualistically condemned directly from the field of slaughter.

desc.en: A vast, mobile altar allows the souls of the slain to be ritualistically condemned directly from the field of slaughter.

desc.zh: 『衣服？傻瓜！我们要去打仗，不是去踢球。把我的盔甲递给我，盔甲！』
desc.en: "Robes? Fool! We're going to battle, not a ball. Hand me my armour! ARMOUR!"

desc.zh: 连珠咒语，不要让敌人有喘息的机会！
desc.en: Spell after spell, grant the enemy no reprieve!

desc.zh: 对于精通黑暗可怕的秘术的人来说，魔法几乎没有什么威胁
desc.en: Magic is little threat to one so well-versed in its dark and terrible intricacies.

desc.zh: 与你的敌人当面对决，意味着当你获胜时可以欣赏到光芒从他们眼中消失的奇景
desc.en: Standing face to face with your enemy means getting to watch the light fade from their eyes when you win.

desc.zh: 每一支黑暗军队都需要一个特别扭曲的头脑，永远胜过敌人三步
desc.en: Every dark army requires a particularly twisted mind, capable of thinking three steps ahead of the enemy.

desc.zh: 战场上需要领袖，从而在最恶劣的战局中集结混沌的力量
desc.en: A leader is needed on the field of battle, able to rally the forces of Chaos in even the most dire situations.

desc.zh: 任何魔法都无力阻止受到凶残的愤怒驱策的人
desc.en: No magic can deter one driven by the murderous force of fury.

desc.zh: 『以血神的名义献祭，并享受他的恩惠！』
desc.en: "Sacrifice in the Blood God's name, and soak in the blessings of his favour!"

desc.zh: 仇恨的熊熊烈火在战场上燃烧，滚烫的热浪肆意炽灼着敌人
desc.en: The raging fire of hate manifests itself in battle, immolating enemies in its smouldering heat.

desc.zh: 『屈服于瘟疫，让祖父神纳垢以你的痛苦为食吧！』
desc.en: "Succumb to pestilence! Let Grandfather Nurgle feed on your suffering!"

desc.zh: 如此令人厌恶的恶臭，可能在战斗开始前就杀死所有敌人
desc.en: Such a reeking and repulsive stench might kill every enemy before combat even commences.

desc.zh: 酸性的脓液会腐蚀敌人的盔甲，让他们很容易遭受致命的打击
desc.en: Acidic ichor corrodes through enemy armour, leaving them vulnerable to the fatal strike.

desc.zh: 如此毁灭性的冲击会令人们无助地逐一倒下，这是一种难以忘怀的黑暗之美
desc.en: There's a dark and haunting beauty about such devastating impact, as bodies fall helplessly in tandem.

desc.zh: 不幸者唯一能做的，就是停下脚步，看着美丽而邪恶的大军向他们冲来
desc.en: Victims can only stop and stare as the wickedly beautiful hordes charge them down.

desc.zh: 当生命的能量从体内流失时，另一人的生命能量必然会停止流动
desc.en: When the energies of life are draining from the body, another's life energy will surely staunch the flow.

desc.zh: 万变之主的战士们被一道奸奇魔法屏障包围着，保护着他们免受近身战斗的荼毒
desc.en: A barrier of Tzeentchian magic surrounds the warriors of the Changer, guarding them from the tumult of close combat.

desc.zh: 毁灭性的奥术之火闪电击中了大地，周围的一切尽为火海
desc.en: Devastating bolts of arcane fire strike the earth, igniting all in their radius.

desc.zh: 灵魂战士周围萦绕着魔法，不仅可以抵御攻击，还能召唤致命的火焰
desc.en: Sheathed in sorcery and guarded against attacks, the Spirit Warrior summons deadly flame.

desc.zh: 真正的战术家会激励周围的友军，从而让盟友们发挥出真正残暴的本能
desc.en: A true tactician inspires all around them, encouraging allies to acts of vicious abandon.

desc.zh: 混沌统合的战旗之下，霸业乃是唯一的目标
desc.en: Domination is the only goal, under the banner of Chaos Undivided.

desc.zh: 近距离释放纯粹的混沌，尽皆斩碎所有触手可及之敌
desc.en: Unleash pure Chaos at close quarters, slicing and dicing all within reach.

desc.zh: 在恶魔铁匠的咒语之下，仅需哈苏特最纯净的一滴脓水就足以将整座城市化为灰烬
desc.en: With a Daemonsmith’s incantation, a mere drop of Hashut’s purest ichor is enough to reduce entire cities to cinders and ash.

desc.zh: 所有挡在疯狂杀戮之道上的人都会被践踏为一团红色的薄雾，而在此之前，他们根本不会有反应的机会
desc.en: All in the path of this murderous rampage will have little chance to react before being trampled into a fine red mist.

desc.zh: 在战场上，对箭矢、炮弹以及各种五花八门弹药的需求无穷无尽
desc.en: Arrows, cannonballs and more esoteric munitions are needed in endless supply on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 即使是诞生于火焰之物，投入其中之后也能得到治愈
desc.en: By which even those born of fire and flame, deep within the forge, can be healed.

desc.zh: 『敌人的恐惧和他们在污泥中流淌的血，就是支撑我活下去的动力』
desc.en: "The enemy's fear; their blood spilt in the mud – these are the things that sustain me."

desc.zh: 在战场上以哈苏特之名大肆屠杀，这是至上的振奋之事！
desc.en: There is no greater thrill than to be in the midst of battle, slaughtering in Hashut's name.

desc.zh: 在扎尔·纳格隆德炙热的机械车间里，这台机器得到了完美的调校。它会让使用者穿梭自如，丝毫不用顾忌地形
desc.en: Tuned to perfection in the broiling-hot machine shops of Zharr-Naggrund, this machine will get its occupants into the thick of it and out again, no matter the lay of the land.

desc.zh: 虽然面容日益扭曲，灵魂愈加黑暗，但混沌矮人的内心仍是矮人，他们保留了所有对手的金属加工技能与巧妙的工程设计方案
desc.en: Beneath their mutated faces and ever-darkened souls, the Chaos Dwarfs are still Dwarfs at heart, retaining all of their counterparts' metalworking skill and knack for ingenious engineering solutions.

desc.zh: 混沌矮人的地狱战争机器炮管中射出了尖锐的火箭与凶残的爆炸物，若是敌人有幸没有即刻化为一滩污血，也会吓得浑身颤抖，屁滚尿流
desc.en: From the barrels of the Chaos Dwarfs' infernal war machines are fired shrieking rockets and blasts of raw, Ruinous magick, leaving those not instantly turned to liquid quaking and gibbering in their wake.

desc.zh: 假设你无法完全回避战争，那么最明智的做法就是别挡着道！
desc.en: Assuming you can't avoid the confrontation altogether, the most sensible course of action is to get well out of the way!

desc.zh: 尽管在邪恶的主人眼中他们不过是一种原始的资源，一些绿皮还是会通过在战场上『帮助』主人来免除劳作至死的命运
desc.en: Even though they're considered little more than a raw resource by their evil masters, some Greenskins avoid being worked to death by "assisting" their keepers on the field of battle.

desc.zh: 混沌矮人身穿用鲜血和地狱火锻造的上品坚甲。在那些精神松懈、过于自信的敌人眼中，他们很快就会成为比钢铁还坚固的难撼坚墙
desc.en: Wearing ultra-resilient armour forged with blood and hellfire, the Chaos Dwarfs present a  mighty defensive wall, stronger even than steel, to their incautious, overconfident enemies.

desc.zh: 要在战斗中立下奇功，不仅需要敢于赴死的勇气与决心，还需要稳守防线的纪律，以整体直接摧垮敌人动摇的军心
desc.en: To be this effective in battle takes not just suicidal levels of courage and determination, but the discipline to hold the line and, as one, take the fight directly into the enemy's wavering hearts.

desc.zh: 虽然能几乎肯定他们会死在敌人手里，但这总比混沌矮人为绿皮奴才们准备的结局要好吧？所以有些人甚至很接受这样的死法！
desc.en: Though they face almost-certain death at the enemy's hands, that has to be better than what the Chaos Dwarfs have in store for their Greenskin underlings, right? Some even welcome such an end.

desc.zh: 训练装填、射击与重新装填，直到它们成为第二天性，如此就能时刻将敌人淹没在火力之下，胜利也就随之而来了
desc.en: Drilling loading, shooting and reloading, until they become second nature, so the foe is under constant barrage, is surely the way to victory.

desc.zh: 在混沌矮人的麾下，恶魔火元素与其他各种可怕的生物都会奉命而出，去打碎胆敢反抗的家伙们的脑袋，粉碎他们的灵魂
desc.en: The Daemonic fire-elementals and various other monstrous creatures in the Chaos Dwarfs' service are fielded to crack the skulls and crush the souls of those who dare stand against them.

desc.zh: 混沌矮人麾下的扭曲地狱怪物是最有效的武器，尤其是在它们受到良好组织，形成一支毁灭冲锋大军的时候
desc.en: Those twisted, hellishly-mutated monsters in the service of the Chaos Dwarfs are some of their most effective weapons, particularly when organised into a malign host of Ruinous shock troops.

desc.zh: 当昔日强大的力量逐渐衰退，铁手的身体慢慢屈服于石化。然而当肢体变成石头时，切掉它们只会让他更为强大
desc.en: Now his once-great powers have waned, Ironhand's body is slowly succumbing to petrification. However, lopping off parts as they turn to stone only makes him stronger.

desc.zh: 『我们要重塑世界，让它归于我们的掌控，满是灰烬和敌人的黑骨，直到只剩下我们与匍匐在我们脚下的残躯！』
desc.en: "We will remake the world into our domain, a land of cinder-ash and the blackened bones of our enemies, until only we and those broken bodies that cower at our feet remain."

desc.zh: 铁手诚然通过黑暗手段获得了大量的知识，但也付出了极为可怕的代价
desc.en: Through darkly enchanted means, Ironhand has gleaned great knowledge, certainly, but at the most terrible of costs.

desc.zh: 暴力经由暴行！
desc.en: Terrible powers are gained via terrible acts.

desc.zh: 只有麾下最强壮、最优秀的成员，才能侍奉阿斯特戈斯领主
desc.en: Only the strongest and best among his throng may serve Lord Astragoth.

desc.zh: 当他的手变成石头后，阿斯特戈斯就用他所掌握的所有扭曲科学制造了新的机械手，并将其移植到自己的身体上
desc.en: Once his hands turned to stone, Astragoth had new, mechanical ones built and grafted to his body in their place, using all the twisted science at his disposal.

desc.zh: 石化的躯体确实有些好处：它使人很难受伤，更不用说被杀了！
desc.en: There are definitely some advantages to a body of stone: it makes one really hard to hurt, let alone kill!

desc.zh: 更强、更快、更厉害：当你成为一个化为生物机械的矮人领主时，这命运也没什么可悲哀的！
desc.en: Stronger, faster: better – it's not all woe when you're a bio-mechanical Dwarf Lord!

desc.zh: 无论敌人的弱点隐藏得多好，阿斯特戈斯都一清二楚，因此他会有非常多的办法对其加以利用
desc.en: Every weakness, no matter how well hidden, is clear to Astragoth, as are many ways to exploit them to his own advantage.

desc.zh: 阿斯特戈斯自认为是全体混沌矮人的代表，因为他是扎尔·纳格隆德的合法统治者，是他所触及的一切的主人
desc.en: In his mind Astragoth speaks for all the Chaos Dwarfs, for he is Zharr-Naggrund's legitimate ruler, and master of all he surveys.

desc.zh: 想要进步，就要向最优秀的人学习
desc.en: Learn from the very best if you wish to become better.

desc.zh: 一些战士并不在乎自己的个人安危，因此他们会全身心地投入到狂风般的杀戮之中，变得异常暴戾！
desc.en: Some warriors care not for their own personal safety, and so work themselves into a whirlwind of destruction and mindless violence!

desc.zh: 随着半人牛年龄的增长，他们的肉体会像金属一样硬化：更难受伤，更快愈合，更能抵抗魔法攻击
desc.en: As a Bull Centaur ages, their flesh hardens like metal – harder to hurt, quicker to heal, and better at resisting magical attack.

desc.zh: 当那片薄雾降临时…相信我，你若是珍惜自己那毫无价值的生命，就绝对不会想靠近它的！
desc.en: When that mist descends… Believe me, you don't want to be anywhere near this one, not if you value your worthless life!

desc.zh: 只要这个人还活着，就休想有人能够通过！
desc.en: None shall pass, at least not while this one breathes.

desc.zh: 陶鲁克非常清楚，尽管自己的效命对象可能是自己的对手，但他们也会毫无疑问地奉献自己的忠诚
desc.en: The Taur'ruk knows that although this one probably works for his rivals as well, they are without doubt truly loyal to him.

desc.zh: 无数的冲突令这位领主的直觉变得无比敏锐，这使得此人极难落入陷阱
desc.en: Countless conflicts and a keen sense of awareness have made this Lord difficult to entrap.

desc.zh: 欺诈是一种优良的攻击手段
desc.en: Deceit is a perfectly acceptable means of attack.

desc.zh: 殴打将一直持续到士气高涨起来…或者适得其反为止
desc.en: Beatings WILL continue until morale improves, or even if it does...

desc.zh: 何为扎尔矮人？他们并不在乎受伤，只会凭自己的意志继续战斗！
desc.en: A Dawi-Zharr such as he does not care for being wounded – by his will alone he continues to fight.

desc.zh: 有些征服者温和而美丽，但这家伙显然并非如此，而是有着无止境的凶残与腐蚀
desc.en: Some conquerors are mild and fair. Not so this one, whose savagery and corruption truly know no bounds.

desc.zh: 『要么为我效忠，要么就去死，没有第三种选择！』
desc.en: "You will serve me, wretch, or you will die. There is no other option."

desc.zh: 该领主及其部下皆精于军需统筹，因此即使在逆境中也能满足军队的需求
desc.en: Proficient with figures, this Lord, or his subordinates, can keep his army fulfilled, even in dire circumstances.

desc.zh: 掠夺、腐化、毁灭、摧毁凡人、夺走他们的神，这就是混沌的期望
desc.en: To despoil, to corrupt and ruin, to break the mortals and take their gods from them – this is what Chaos wants.

desc.zh: 残忍与邪恶远远不够，甚至连野蛮这个词都太温和了
desc.en: Brutality or viciousness don't go anywhere near far enough. Even barbarism is too mild a term.

desc.zh: 小心谨慎只是常识，你一旦犯错就会发现自己陷入了另一个更糟糕的位面…
desc.en: A modicum of care is just common sense when getting it wrong can find you trapped in another, infinitely worse dimension…

desc.zh: 小心谨慎只是常识，你一旦犯错就会发现自己陷入了另一个更糟糕的位面…
desc.en: A modicum of care is just common sense when getting it wrong can find you trapped in another, infinitely worse dimension…

desc.en: A modicum of care is just common sense when getting it wrong can find you trapped in another, infinitely worse dimension…

desc.zh: 小心谨慎只是常识，你一旦犯错就会发现自己陷入了另一个更糟糕的位面…
desc.en: A modicum of care is just common sense when getting it wrong can find you trapped in another, infinitely worse dimension…

desc.zh: 这些身躯巨大的有翼魔牛喷吐黑烟，神异的皮肉如同熊熊燃烧的活体锻炉，巨蹄之下的大地火花四溅
desc.en: Wreathed in smoke, these huge, winged Daemonic-bulls are blessed with flesh that burns with the intensity of a living furnace that sparks the ground 'neath their hooves.

desc.zh: 作为火焰与灰烬的生物，哈苏特的红牛无法离开黑暗之地太远，除非是在魔法之风（特别是阿克夏之风）最为强盛的时刻
desc.en: As creatures of flame and ash, the Red Bulls of Hashut cannot stray far from the Dark Lands, save for when the Winds of Magic – and Aqshy specifically – are at their strongest.

desc.zh: 据信神奇的拉玛苏是巨型魔牛的罕见变种，是黑暗之地愤怒的具现，它会呼出魔法云雾来保护自己的骑手
desc.en: Believed to be a rare mutation of the Great Taurus, the magical Lammasu are the living embodiment of the Dark Land's rage, exhaling sorcerous clouds to protect their riders.

desc.zh: 这些身躯巨大的有翼魔牛喷吐黑烟，神异的皮肉如同熊熊燃烧的活体锻炉，巨蹄之下的大地火花四溅
desc.en: Wreathed in smoke, these huge, winged Daemonic-bulls are blessed with flesh that burns with the intensity of a living furnace that sparks the ground 'neath their hooves.

desc.en: Believed to be a rare mutation of the Great Taurus, the magical Lammasu are the living embodiment of the Dark Land's rage, exhaling sorcerous clouds to protect their riders.

desc.zh: 这个咒语会让敌人慢慢变成石头，从脚开始。所以当它的效果逐渐扩展时，敌人只能眼睁睁地目睹自己的命运
desc.en: By which the foe slowly turns to stone, beginning with the feet, so they are all too aware of their terrible fate as it gradually unfolds.

desc.zh: 阿佐格军团最强大的战士会在他们的盔甲上涂上刚死之人的骨灰
desc.en: The mightiest warriors of the Legion of Azgorh smear their armour in the sacramental ash of the freshly-rendered dead.

desc.zh: 祭坛下方的炉灰与熟料可以治疗德拉兹霍斯，并帮助他抵御魔法
desc.en: The cinders and clinker from the grate beneath his sacrificial altar both heal Drazhoath and ward against magic.

desc.zh: 他们的贪婪是无止境的，因为他们剥夺了死者最后一点尊严
desc.en: Truly their greed knows no bounds, as they strip the dead of every last scrap of dignity.

desc.zh: 德拉兹霍斯一直在黑色要塞的塔楼高处精进着自己的魔法技能，并等待着时机的到来
desc.en: High up in the turrets of the Black Fortress, Drazhoath has waited, developing his sorcerous skills and biding his time.

desc.zh: 德拉兹霍斯再也不是一个卑微的恶魔铁匠了，他在自己选择的领域真正立下了伟业：他创造了克达熠，这种一半是烈焰，一半是恶魔的精髓生物，每一个都是毫无意识的毁灭力量
desc.en: A minor Daemonsmith no longer, Drazhoath has raised himself to greatness in his chosen field: to create the K'daai, half-raging fire, half-Daemon essence – all mindless destructive force.

name.en: Might of the Legion of Azgorh

desc.zh: 军队的力量会通过魔法手段来强化，因此收集力量并守护这些战士吧
desc.en: The army's strength is bolstered by sorcerous means, channelled to power and protect its warriors.

desc.zh: 这头强大的烈焰魔牛驮载着可怕的术士——黑色要塞领主『灰烬』德拉兹霍斯。在战场上它一骑当先，身后跟随着扭曲的阿佐格军团，共同为敌人带去火焰与毁灭
desc.en: This mighty Bale Taurus carries the dread Sorcerer Drazhoath the Ashen, Lord of the Black Fortress, to battle, at the head of his twisted Legion of Azgorh, to bring fire and Ruin down upon the foe.

desc.zh: 『墙？依我看，这不过是小孩子堆的沙子罢了。只要让我的弟兄们靠近点，就能轻松愉快地完成你的委托了！』
desc.en: "Walls? I see only piles of sand crafted by children. Bring my brothers close enough and we shall take pleasure in fulfilling our bargain and topple them for you!"

name.en: Warders of the Southern Dark Lands

desc.zh: 混沌矮人王国的边防军驻扎在气势汹汹的黑色要塞里，他们在那里守卫着众多的矿山和洞穴
desc.en: The border guards of the Chaos Dwarf realm are based at the ominous, imposing Black Fortress, wherein they stand watch over its many mines and caverns.

desc.zh: 他们齐心协力大肆杀戮有如一人，暴戾充斥于鲜血中在他们的身体里流淌
desc.en: Almost killing as one, horrendous violence clearly runs in their blood.

desc.zh: 无论是面对箭雨，噼里啪啦的魔法还是致命的战争机器，轻盈的体态都会帮助戈度兹与『那厮』守住防线，抵御敌人
desc.en: Whether it be a sea of arrows, crackling blasts of magical energy or deadly war machines, being light on his feet has helped keep Gorduz and Da Gitz hold the lines against all comers.

desc.zh: 当戈度兹怎么看都应该死在哪条阴沟里时，总会有什么东西让他能活下来…至少对于其他人来说是这样的
desc.en: Something is keeping Gorduz alive when he really should be dead in a ditch somewhere …or at least that's how it appears to literally *everyone* else.

desc.zh: 当发现有人敢欺骗他时，戈度兹会勃然大怒。要是你还有自知之明的话，跑吧，越远越快越好！
desc.en: Gorduz has caught someone trying to cheat him and goes into a fit of rage. Run, if you know what's good for you – as far and as fast as possible!

desc.zh: 戈度兹之所以能如此令人费解地长寿，其中一个原因就是他在面对敌人…或者任何人时，都毫不留情地凶狠
desc.en: One of the factors in Gorduz' otherwise inexplicable longevity is his sheer, unrelenting aggression in the face of the enemy... or anyone, for that matter.

desc.zh: 『咱很清楚，有些事儿是小的们单靠自己搞不定的，所以该去找那厮了！』
desc.en: "It's clear to me that vis is somefing Da Boyz can't deal wiv on their own – time for Da Gitz!"

desc.zh: 说戈度兹是个幸运的笨蛋，未免太轻描淡写了
desc.en: To say Gorduz has been a lucky git would be something of an understatement.

desc.zh: 大体型的狼由大地精培养而出，用来拉他们几乎要散架的战车，为他们残忍的首领与邪恶的萨满充当坐骑
desc.en: The larger wolves are bred by the Hobgoblins to pull their ramshackle chariots, and be mounts for their cruel Bosses and nasty Shamans.

desc.zh: 『如果光靠背刺还不够，那么这些毒药该足够弄死他们了！给咱刺下去！』
desc.en: "If stabbin them in tha back aint enuff, then this poison will finish em off! Jab it in 'em!"

desc.zh: 关于戈度兹的生存能力已经无需赘述了，但不要忘记，这个大地精也是个可怕的射手，眼中透着死亡
desc.en: Much has already been said about Gorduz' ability to stay alive, but let's not forget that he is also a formidable shooter, for a Hobgoblin, with a dead-eyed stare.

desc.zh: 戈度兹与所有大地精一样，或者只是比同类好些。但这个狡猾的混蛋拥有大量的小手段以及难以捉摸的潜行技巧，这也是他出人头地的资本
desc.en: Like all Hobgoblins, only better, Gorduz is above all else, a cunning little git with lashings of low cunning and a beguiling level of stealth at his disposal.

desc.zh: 『用长矛戳他们，用刀剑砍他们，要快，要准！但最重要的是，趁着他们看向别处时刺他们！』
desc.en: "Stick 'em wiv arrers'. Stick 'em with knives, 'an swords, and spears. Stick 'em quick and stick 'em where it 'urts. But most of all, stick 'em when they's looking the other way."

desc.zh: 丰富的经验让戈度兹堪称最为厉害的背刺者，没有之一
desc.en: By virtue of his considerable experience, Gorduz is the stabbiest of all da stabberz. No question.

desc.zh: 黑暗之父会通过各种各样的魔法手段保护他的孩子免受魔法的伤害，而这些手段无不扭曲邪恶
desc.en: The Father of Darkness protects his children from sorcery through a variety of magical means, all of them twisted and obscure.

desc.zh: 当所有人都把枪口对准你的头时，能找个东西当帽子才是最重要的…
desc.en: Having a thing for hats can be most useful when everyone keeps aiming at your head…

desc.zh: 死亡总是近在咫尺
desc.en: Death is always just a shot away.

desc.zh: 职业军人意味着永远不会在关键时刻耗尽弹药
desc.en: Professional soldiery means never running out of ammo at the crucial moment.

desc.zh: 巧妙的镜头组合让目标看起来更近了一点
desc.en: A clever arrangement of lenses makes the target seem just that bit closer.

desc.zh: 当面对如此强大的军械时，休说盔甲，就算魔法防御还能有什么用？
desc.en: What use armour, or even magical defences, against such powerful ordnance?

desc.zh: 当面对如此强大的军械时，休说盔甲，就算魔法防御还能有什么用？
desc.en: What use armour, or even magical defences, against such powerful ordnance?

desc.zh: 如果你真的想让别人害怕你，那么一副丑陋的尊容会是非常明显的优势
desc.en: Looking absolutely hideous is a distinct advantage if you actually want others to be afraid of you.

desc.zh: 谁知道这到底是出于责任感还是害怕失败后被处决？无论动机如何，此人仍会毅然决然地守卫哈苏特神庙，血战至最后一刻
desc.en: Who knows whether it's down to a sense of duty or fear of summary execution if he fails, but this one will resolutely guard the Temple of Hashut to the bitter, bloody end.

desc.zh: 他们所穿的黑碎片护甲能够保护炼狱堡主免受大部分战斗伤害，比如大规模爆炸的最强冲击
desc.en: The blackshard armour they wear protects the Infernal Castellan from much of the hurly-burly of battle, such as the worst effects of sizeable explosions.

desc.zh: 通过华丽的盔甲与震耳欲聋的命令声，我们可以清楚地认出炼狱守卫的首领
desc.en: The leaders of the Infernal Guard are clearly identifiable from their lavishly-decorated suits of armour …and the deafening roar of their voices when giving orders.

desc.zh: 火焰矮人的铠甲由一千个极热的熔炉提供动力，他们所有的弹药都是由这些熔炉生产出来的
desc.en: The Fire-Dwarfs' armouries are powered by a thousand immensely hot furnaces, from which all of their manufactured munitions are produced.

desc.zh: 这些不是普通的子弹，因为它们是在哈苏特翻滚熔化的火焰中锻造而成，一旦接触就会爆炸
desc.en: These are no ordinary bullets, for they have been forged in Hashut's roiling, molten fires, will go further and explode on contact.

desc.zh: 感受火焰，然后活在其中
desc.en: Feel the fire, then live it.

desc.zh: 当地狱铸造的弩箭击中目标时，它们熔化的核心会四渗而出，融化敌人的护甲，让他们更为不堪一击
desc.en: As the hellforged bolts strike their target, their molten cores seep out, melting their defences and leaving them prone.

desc.zh: 有些人宣称，远距离杀戮与其他『偷偷摸摸』的战术全都毫无英勇可言，根本不适合战士。但他们错了——因为这是一门艺术！
desc.en: Some loudly state their view that killing from a distance, and other "sneaky" tactics, are unvalorous and unbefitting of a warrior, but they're wrong, for it is an art.

desc.zh: 在战斗的最前线，浑身沾满了鲜血以及鬼知道是什么的玩意，只知道射击、劈砍、刺穿敌人，直到他们尖叫着死去——这就是你找到这家伙时的场景！
desc.en: At the forefront of the battle, covered in blood and gods only know what else, shooting, slashing and stabbing the foe to a screaming death – *that's* where you'll find this one.

desc.zh: 任何流程都可以进行改进，这让混沌矮人的战争机器与火炮得到了完美的校准
desc.en: There are always improvements that can be made to any process; this one ensures the Chaos Dwarfs' war machines and artillery are calibrated to perfection.

desc.zh: 死亡总是近在咫尺
desc.en: Death is always just a shot away.

desc.zh: 职业军人意味着永远不会在关键时刻耗尽弹药
desc.en: Professional soldiery means never running out of ammo at the crucial moment.

desc.zh: 当面对如此强大的军械时，休说盔甲，就算魔法防御还能有什么用？
desc.en: What use armour, or even magical defences, against such powerful ordnance?

desc.zh: 此人身上有那么一种气质…或许是对惩罚的恐惧，抑或是对死亡的恐惧？总之，这会让其他人不折不扣地执行他的命令
desc.en: There's something about them. Perhaps it is fear of punishment – death, even – that makes others do as this one says? Might that be it?

desc.zh: 在战争中，身边有个打理各种琐碎事务的人是相当有用的
desc.en: Having someone on hand who's extremely adept with the detail is most useful in war.

desc.zh: 能够获准进入扎尔·纳格隆德的宏大军械库会带来独特的利益
desc.en: Access to Zharr-Naggrund's extensive armouries has its distinct benefits.

desc.zh: 尽管他被迷惑了，但与术士的契约赐予了他力量…
desc.en: Enthralled though he is, his pact with a Sorcerer gives him strength...

desc.zh: 『生活中的一句良言从不会带来任何好处。那么，现在何不试试半人牛皮的鞭子呢…』
desc.en: "You never get anywhere in life with a kind word. Now, a Bull Centaur-hide whip, on the other hand…"

desc.zh: 作为火焰与灰烬的生物，哈苏特的红牛无法离开黑暗之地太远，除非是在魔法之风（特别是阿克夏之风）最为强盛的时刻
desc.en: As creatures of flame and ash, the Red Bulls of Hashut cannot stray far from the Dark Lands, save for when the Winds of Magic – and Aqshy specifically – are at their strongest.

desc.zh: 据信神奇的拉玛苏是巨型魔牛的罕见变种，是黑暗之地愤怒的具现，它会呼出魔法云雾来保护自己的骑手
desc.en: Believed to be a rare mutation of the Great Taurus, the magical Lammasu are the living embodiment of the Dark Land's rage, exhaling sorcerous clouds to protect their riders.

desc.zh: 更有能力的监工几乎可以在短时间内创造奇迹
desc.en: A more than capable overseer can work wonders in next to no time at all.

desc.zh: 如果许诺的报酬足够丰厚，那么即便是矮人也会降服于另一个主人
desc.en: If the rewards promised are so great, even a Dwarf will debase himself in servitude to another master.

desc.zh: 当另一种选择是残忍的鞭子抽打时，部队往往会完全按照命令行事
desc.en: When the alternative is a brutal thrashing with an iron lash, troops tend to do exactly as they are told.

desc.zh: 当你发现一个方便对敌人倾泻远程火力的地点时，立刻掘壕构筑阵地，倾泻死亡，然后重复这个过程直至战斗结束
desc.en: When you've scouted an advantageous position from which to pepper the enemy with missile fire, dig in, rain death, and repeat until done.

desc.zh: 震颤与后坐力的减小提高了枪械的稳定性，从而使其能够在更远的地方以更高的精度进行射击
desc.en: With so little rattle and recoil, a firearm can be kept stable enough to fire with greater accuracy from much further away.

desc.zh: 应用于采矿与挖掘的特制工作器械，也可以有效地运用在小规模的战斗中
desc.en: Engineering ingenuity extended to mining and excavation implements can also prove useful to a battlefield skirmisher.

desc.zh: 小心谨慎只是常识，你一旦犯错就会发现自己陷入了另一个更糟糕的位面…
desc.en: A modicum of care is just common sense when getting it wrong can find you trapped in another, infinitely worse dimension…

desc.zh: 这些身躯巨大的有翼魔牛喷吐黑烟，神异的皮肉如同熊熊燃烧的活体锻炉，巨蹄之下的大地火花四溅
desc.en: Wreathed in smoke, these huge, winged Daemonic-bulls are blessed with flesh that burns with the intensity of a living furnace that sparks the ground 'neath their hooves.

desc.zh: 作为火焰与灰烬的生物，哈苏特的红牛无法离开黑暗之地太远，除非是在魔法之风（特别是阿克夏之风）最为强盛的时刻
desc.en: As creatures of flame and ash, the Red Bulls of Hashut cannot stray far from the Dark Lands, save for when the Winds of Magic – and Aqshy specifically – are at their strongest.

desc.en: Believed to be a rare mutation of the Great Taurus, the magical Lammasu are the living embodiment of the Dark Land's rage, exhaling sorcerous clouds to protect their riders.

desc.en: Believed to be a rare mutation of the Great Taurus, the magical Lammasu are the living embodiment of the Dark Land's rage, exhaling sorcerous clouds to protect their riders.

desc.zh: 哈苏特的祭司们会向他们冷酷邪恶的神献上最可怕的祭品
desc.en: The priests of Hashut make the most horrifying offerings to their grim, malignant deity.

desc.zh: 这些身躯巨大的有翼魔牛喷吐黑烟，神异的皮肉如同熊熊燃烧的活体锻炉，巨蹄之下的大地火花四溅
