desc.en: Believed to be a rare mutation of the Great Taurus, the magical Lammasu are the living embodiment of the Dark Land's rage, exhaling sorcerous clouds to protect their riders.

desc.zh: 这个咒语会让敌人慢慢变成石头，从脚开始。所以当它的效果逐渐扩展时，敌人只能眼睁睁地目睹自己的命运
desc.en: By which the foe slowly turns to stone, beginning with the feet, so they are all too aware of their terrible fate as it gradually unfolds.

desc.zh: 尽管代价确实很可怕，但扎尔矮人对力量的欲望依然无法抑制
desc.en: Though the price may well be terrible, and it surely is, the Dawi-Zharr's lust for power remains insatiable and unquenchable.

desc.zh: 当父神说起不祥之兆时，他邪恶的孩子们就会全神贯注地聆听他的恶毒计划
desc.en: When Father speaks of omens ill, his evil children listen intently to his heinous plans.

desc.zh: 既然领袖是如此的残忍，那么他麾下军队的极度忠诚还有什么可奇怪的？恐惧是最有效的动力嘛！
desc.en: With a leader this cruel, is it any surprise that his troops are obedient and loyal to the end? Fear is the most effective motivator.

desc.zh: 『黑心』扎坦的罪行数不胜数，无穷无尽，堪称野蛮的化身
desc.en: The Black's crimes are without number and his villainy without end, for Zhatan is savagery personified.

desc.zh: 在扎坦的词典中，巧妙一词并不存在，因为他总是会把敌人一劈两半！
desc.en: Subtlety is not a word in Zhatan's personal lexicon as he hacks and cleaves the foe asunder.

desc.zh: 无论数字是多少，在计算死亡时扎坦总是会得出对自己有利的数字
desc.en: No matter the numbers, when counting the dead Zhatan's arithmetic always works in his favour.

desc.zh: 他们浸透了鲜血，手上的血迹永远清洗不掉
desc.en: So steeped in blood are they that the bloodstains on his hands can never be washed away.

desc.zh: 这不是一场比赛…是吧？总之，扎坦的军队迫不及待地冲进了杀戮场
desc.en: It's not a race …or maybe it is? Zhatan's impatient armies rush right in, aching for slaughter.

desc.zh: 精通战争之道，扎尔的战士自认为几乎无可战胜
desc.en: In their mastery of war, the warhost of  Zharr feels nigh on invulnerable.

desc.zh: 激烈的战斗令他斗志昂扬，纵声狂笑着放干敌人的鲜血
desc.en: He exalts in the thick of battle, his joyous laughter draining the very blood from his enemies.

desc.zh: 在严酷和残忍的扎尔矮人世界里，获得渴望之物的绝对手段便是展现你的力量
desc.en: In the harsh, cruel world of the Dawi-Zharr, throwing your weight around is definitely the way to get what you want.

desc.zh: 作为火焰与灰烬的生物，哈苏特的红牛无法离开黑暗之地太远，除非是在魔法之风（特别是阿克夏之风）最为强盛的时刻
desc.en: As creatures of flame and ash, the Red Bulls of Hashut cannot stray far from the Dark Lands, save for when the Winds of Magic – and Aqshy specifically – are at their strongest.

desc.zh: 据信神奇的拉玛苏是巨型魔牛的罕见变种，是黑暗之地愤怒的具现，它会呼出魔法云雾来保护自己的骑手
desc.en: Believed to be a rare mutation of the Great Taurus, the magical Lammasu are the living embodiment of the Dark Land's rage, exhaling sorcerous clouds to protect their riders.

desc.zh: 『你会惊讶地发现，当另一种选择是毫无疑问的残忍虐杀时，他们会多么温顺！』
desc.en: "You'd be surprised how pliable they are when the alternative is certain, bloody death."

desc.zh: 黑暗的行为会带来不祥的绰号
desc.en: Dark deeds lead to ominous epithets…

desc.zh: 嗜血的本性是无可抑制的，无论猎物还是亲族，都没有什么不同
desc.en: The unquenchable thirst for blood is indiscriminate; prey and kin alike are fair game.

desc.zh: 葛朗尼的所有子孙都会固守阵地，从而更好地抵御物理攻击。此外，这也会增加他们的远程攻击威力
desc.en: All the sons of Grungni can dig-in, enabling them to better resist physical attacks from the foe. Any missile attacks they can make are also improved.

desc.zh: 浑身都是鲜血与致命伤，但绝不逃开一步
desc.en: Blood everywhere and fatal wounds. There's no walking away from this.

desc.zh: 他是如此深陷于哈苏特的黑暗魔法，以至于身上越来越多的部位都不得不被替换成了机械。事实上，相比矮人而言，他已经越来越像个机器人了…
desc.en: So entrenched in the dark sorcery of Hashut is he that more and more of this one's body parts have had to be substituted for mechanical replacements. In fact, he's probably more machine than Dwarf these days…

desc.zh: 他们不关心原因，但如果他下了命令，那么这个人控制的仆从会追随他直至死亡
desc.en: They care not for the cause, but the Renders this one controls would follow him into certain death if he commanded it.

desc.zh: 多年服务炮兵阵地可能已经损坏了他的听力，但此人的吼声也比以往任何时候都要响亮
desc.en: Years spent standing next to artillery emplacements may have dulled his hearing, but this one's stentorian roar is louder than ever.

desc.zh: 这个人认识一些矮人，这些矮人又认识其他矮人，而其他矮人又杀死了其他矮人。大概就是这样…
desc.en: This one knows some Dwarfs that know other Dwarfs that kill some other Dwarfs. It's not what you know…

desc.zh: 他会悄无声息地移动，所以想抓住这个监督的破绽是件很难的事情
desc.en: He moves unseen and unheard, so catching this Overseer off-guard is a tricky business.

desc.zh: 这家伙得到了大地精们的认可…好像他们真的有选择似的。火矮人们才不在乎呢！
desc.en: This one has the approbation of the Hobgoblins… as if they ever really had a choice. The Fire-Dwarfs do not care either way!

desc.zh: 『聆听哈苏特的召唤吧！黑暗之父召唤你们去杀戮，鲜血与火焰召唤你们去战斗！』
desc.en: "Hear the summons of Hashut! The Dark Father calls you to slaughter, blood and fire exhorts you to war!"

desc.zh: 一半是金属，一半是矮人，这就是混沌
desc.en: Part-metal, part-Dwarf. All Chaos.

desc.zh: 此人的地位超乎寻常，他的言行令手下的生物胆战心惊
desc.en: This one is in the unusual position of having the creatures under his command fear both his word and deed.

desc.zh: 如果没有稳定的肉食供应，那么驾驭食人魔却能不让自己成为锅中食物，就是一件很困难的事情了
desc.en: Without access to a steady supply of meat, getting Ogres to do what you want while staying out of the cook-pot is no easy feat.

desc.zh: 至少对于一般旁人来说，将炽热艰难的恶魔铁匠工作换成驾驭车队的轻巧日子，都算是一种明智的调职
desc.en: Exchanging a hot, hard existence as a Daemonsmith for an easier life riding the convoys is very much a smart move, to the casual observer at least.

desc.zh: 一枪一命。要做到这一点需要很长时间…
desc.en: One shot, one kill. To be this good takes ages…

desc.zh: 建造和驾驶战争机器，以混沌的毁灭之名
desc.en: Building and driving the machines of war, in Chaos' Ruinous name.

desc.zh: 在一个无论多么残忍的暴行都会得到掌声，甚至是激励的社会里，暴政实际上会是一件积极的举措
desc.en: In a society where the most heinous acts of cruelty are applauded – nay, *rewarded* – his atrocious tyranny is actually considered to be a positive thing.

desc.zh: 对于效忠扎尔矮人的大地精来说，不断地死里逃生乃是一件值得夸耀的壮举，丝毫不令人沮丧
desc.en: Continually cheating death is an inspiring and not at all frustrating sight for the rabble of Hobgoblins in the Dawi-Zharr's service.

desc.zh: 在严酷和残忍的扎尔矮人世界里，获得渴望之物的绝对手段便是展现你的力量
desc.en: In the harsh, cruel world of the Dawi-Zharr, throwing your weight around is definitely the way to get what you want.

desc.zh: 『在这里，做事的手段一般有三种：正确的手段，错误的手段，以及我的手段。你明白了吗？』
desc.en: "There are three ways of doing things around here: the right way, the wrong way, and the way that *I* do it. You understand?"

desc.zh: 即使以混沌矮人的标准来看，这个矮人也是个暴脾气。无论什么事情，只要进展不够快，这家伙就会暴跳如雷
desc.en: Even by Chaos Dwarf standards, this one has a short fuse, and is quick to anger when something – anything – doesn't happen quickly enough.

desc.zh: 此人不会移动，不会转身，不会让给任何人哪怕一英寸，永远不会
desc.en: This one won't move, won't roll over, won't give a solitary inch to anyone, ever, over anything.

desc.zh: 你永远不会知道与此人共事是什么感觉，因为他只要见到你就会杀了你
desc.en: You never quite know where you are with this one. He'd kill you dead just as soon as look at you.

desc.zh: 此人只知道见红。对于…呃，所有挡在他面前的人来说，都是何等的不幸！
desc.en: This one only ever sees red, which is unfortunate for… well, for just about anyone who gets in his way!

desc.zh: 恶魔铁匠亲自追捕苦工，这算得上是个奇观，因为在混沌矮人社会中，缺乏自控力的冲动向来会让人皱起眉毛
desc.en: Whereas, among the Chaos Dwarfs, compulsive urges are normally frowned upon, seeing a Daemonsmith chase down Labourers himself certainly is a sight.

desc.zh: 想要成事，就去威胁其他人：要么办成，要么去死
desc.en: If you want something done, threaten to kill everyone else until they do it.

desc.zh: 『过度热情』很适合形容此人，因为他盲目地献身于净化旧世界弱小种族的事业
desc.en: "Overly-enthusiastic" describes this one well. He is blindly devoted to purging the weaker races of the Old World.

desc.zh: 这位术士在施法时非常仔细，他对石化的风险毫不担心
desc.en: Exceeding sensibility when spellcasting, this Sorcerer has no concerns about the dangers of petrification.

desc.zh: 或许这只是他人扣的帽子，或许这只是此人的天性，但有一点是肯定的：即使以混沌矮人的标准，这家伙也算得上是个狡猾的角色！
desc.en: Maybe it's the hat, maybe it's just his nature, but one thing is certain: this one is a devious, slippery character, even for a Chaos Dwarf!

desc.zh: 这个恶魔铁匠对自己的成就无比自豪，深信自己很快就会爬到庙塔的顶端！
desc.en: This Daemonsmith is excessively proud of his own accomplishments, utterly convinced that he will soon rise to the very top of the ziggurat!

desc.zh: 麻木不仁、心狠手辣，这对此人来说实在太轻描淡写了，这就是他的无情本性
desc.en: To say that this one is insensitive and cold-hearted would be a massive understatement, such is his unfeeling nature.

desc.zh: 『我的就是我的，你的也是我的』
desc.en: "What's mine is mine. What's yours is mine too."

desc.zh: 过去未解决的问题几乎总是会在未来引发反响。通常情况下，这种反响是致命的…
desc.en: Unresolved past issues almost always lead to repercussions in the future. Oft-times, such things can be fatal…

desc.zh: 在黑色要塞度过的时光，对这个本来就有性格问题的混沌矮人产生了一些影响…
desc.en: Time spent at the Black Fortress does something to the already questionable character of a Chaos Dwarf…

desc.zh: 他绝不会放任不管。换句话来说，他一定会设法弄死对方。留神这个家伙
desc.en: He wouldn't let it lie. This one would, on the other hand, make it die. Watch out for him.

desc.zh: 『也许不是今天，也许不是明天，但总有一天我会让怒火降临到你的身上…』
desc.en: "Maybe not today, maybe not tomorrow, but soon I shall unleash my fury upon you…"

desc.zh: 由于被放逐了相当长一段时间，他有时间反思和改进自己的诸多缺点
desc.en: Having spent a considerable period banished from their own lands, this one had the time to reflect and improve on their many shortcomings.

desc.zh: 退一步说，这个人很吝啬，从来不愿意花钱买最好的东西
desc.en: Parsimonious to say the least, this one never wants to shell out on the best that money can buy.

desc.zh: 冲进去，大杀特杀，完成任务，越快越好。花活是失败者才干的事
desc.en: Get in there, get bloody, get the job done – as soon as possible. Dallying's for losers.

desc.zh: 我并不是说这个人一定会栽跟头，但是…好吧，是的，我就是这个意思
desc.en: I'm not saying this one's heading for a fall, but… well, yes, actually I am saying that.

desc.zh: 我，我，我，我的，我的，我的，我的——这就是这个人的态度，嗯，不管是啥，真的
desc.en: Me, me, me, mine, mine, mine – that just about somes up this one's attitude to, well, everything, really.

desc.zh: 坚忍冷静，此人绝对会让一切尽在掌控
desc.en: Stoic and calm, this one is never anything less than totally in control.

desc.zh: 很明显，战斗中越是残忍的人，就越不会有个好性子
desc.en: It should be obvious that literally never being in a good mood is going to make one that little bit more brutal in melee.

desc.zh: 背地里耍心思？不仅如此，这家伙甚至还在明面上乱搞！真是肆无忌惮啊
desc.en: Backhanders – hell, fronthanders, even, so unscrupulous is he.

desc.zh: 『我们一定要这么做吗？呃，真是无聊…』
desc.en: "Do we have to? Urgh, how tedious…"

desc.zh: 有些人为战斗而生，随时冒着死亡的危险。但这人却不是这样，他即使面对争吵也会非常焦虑
desc.en: There are those who live for battle and risk death at every turn. Not so, this one, who is more than apprehensive when faced with the fray.

desc.zh: 别人的生命对这个可怜的疯子毫无意义，他们的财产也一样。无论怎么说，这人纯粹是在找乐子
desc.en: The lives of others mean nothing to this abject psycho, and neither does their property. If it's not nailed down, or even if it is, it's fair game to him.

desc.zh: 有人会说他草率，有人会说他充满活力，因为他总是在敌人做出反应之前就凭冲动行事
desc.en: Some would call them hasty, others dynamic and valiant, for this one acts on impulse, before the enemy have a chance to react.

desc.zh: 骄傲，然后是自私自利，自恋虚荣。这样真不好
desc.en: There's pride, and then there's self-regarding, narcissistic vainglory. Not a good look.

desc.zh: 你拥有的一切都是这个人想要的，并且越有吸引力越好
desc.en: Whatever you've got is what this one wants, and the more enchanted, the better.

desc.zh: 把他们都杀了，然后把战利品留给自己。占有欲并不是一种负面的品质，毕竟这是一个物质的世界，不是吗？
desc.en: Kill them all and keep the loot for yourself. It's not a negative quality to be acquisitive as, after all, it's a material world, no?

desc.zh: 你会以为他是唯一一个有所成就的人，毕竟他一幅对每一场小胜都一脸沾沾自喜的样子
desc.en: You'd think he was the only one ever to have achieved something, the way he goes on about every little victory.

desc.zh: 没人喜欢他，但他真的一点也不在乎。无论从形象上还是从字面上，他的脸皮都很厚
desc.en: No one likes him, but he really couldn't care less. He has an extremely thick skin, figuratively and literally, it seems.

desc.zh: 骄者必败，但到目前为止，此人并没有达到这一谚语的要求
desc.en: Pride is supposed to come before a fall, but thus far, this one has not lived up to that proverb.

desc.zh: 这种人相信自己在各个方面都优于常人，一有机会他便会采取行动
desc.en: This one believes themselves to be better than others in every respect, and acts accordingly at every given opportunity.

desc.zh: 被压抑的愤怒使他成为了一个比外表看起来更加凶猛的狠角色
desc.en: This one's pent-up rage makes him an even more fiercesome adversary than he looks.

desc.zh: 他精通战略和战术，是一个真正强大的对手
desc.en: Forensic and well-versed in strategy and tactics, this one is truly a formidable opponent.

desc.zh: 说他『准备好打一架』实在是太轻描淡写了。事实上，如果你在战场上碰到他，你最好拿出最好的表现
desc.en: To say he is "up for a scrap" is a colossal understatement. In fact, you'd better bring your A-game if you find yourself facing this one on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 在正确的，抑或是错误的手中，怨恨就像长满尖刺的大狼牙棒一样锋利
desc.en: Spite is every bit as spikey as a great big mace covered in spikes, in the right – or rather wrong – hands.

desc.zh: 他对火焰的掌控就像别人使唤刀剑一样。他发疯了，非常危险，即使对他自己一方也是如此！
desc.en: This one commands fire the way others wield swords. He's mad, bad and supremely dangerous to know – even for his own side!

desc.zh: 你不能再相信他，就像你不能摆脱他一样。相信我，你甚至连把他抱起来都很难，他太滑了…
desc.en: You can't trust this one any further than you can throw him, and believe me, you'd struggle to even pick him up, so slippery is he…

desc.zh: 他的喉咙因陶醉的甜蜜滋味而发痒，金色的甘露是真正的力量
desc.en: His throat itches for the sweet taste of enchantment; the golden nectar that is true power.

desc.zh: 他对魔法力量的渴望已经变成了强迫症，以至于他只会寻找魔法物品，而不考虑其他东西
desc.en: His desire for magical power has become an obsession, to the point where he seeks out magic items to exclusion of all else.

desc.zh: 秩序，连同它所有的纯洁和令人作呕的…善良，都是这个人的诅咒。他会以炽烈的激情憎恨它
desc.en: Order, with all of its purity and sickening… goodness, is anathema to this one, and he hates it with a burning passion.

desc.zh: 在这个人的眼里，毁灭和死亡是不可分割的对等物，是远超憎恨与邪恶之外的东西。他永远也不会改变自己对这点的看法
desc.en: Destruction, and Death, its inseparable counterpart, are beyond odious and wicked in this one's eyes, and he will never change his mind on the matter.

desc.zh: 即使是对一个以记仇而闻名的种族来说，此人也会被每一件小事完全吞噬，不管它有多小，并且他总是会死缠烂打，直到追逐到苦涩、血腥的尽头
desc.en: Even for a race known for their inability to forget grudges, this one is utterly consumed by every slight, no matter how small, and will always pursue them to the bitter, bloody end.

desc.zh: 此人不仅完全不知恐惧为何物，还会嘲笑敌人，不管他们有多厉害
desc.en: More than utterly devoid of fear, this one sneers and scoffs at the foe, no matter how big and how hard they are.

desc.zh: 有些人毫不犹豫地前来，有些人需要被『说服』，而有些人则需要受到残酷的胁迫，但最终他们都会为哈苏特服务
desc.en: Some go without question, some require "persuasion" and others brutal coercion, but in the end they will all go to serve Hashut one way or another.

desc.zh: 『我不是什么仆人，我是波耶的女儿，我曾指挥过一百名哥萨！我的血统可以追溯到一千年前！』
desc.en: "I am no servant! I am a boyar's daughter. I have commanded a hundred Kossars! I can trace my lineage back one thousand years!"

desc.zh: 尤莉卡的整个青少年时期都在磨练她的战斗技巧，这让她拥有了出色的攻击与防御能力
desc.en: Ulrika's teen years were spent honing her duelling skills, which has left her with attack and defence capabilities of equal parity.

desc.zh: 任何胆敢威胁或者伤害尤莉卡·玛格多娃亲近之人的家伙，都会陷入极大的麻烦
desc.en: Always an advocate of getting stuck in, woe betide any who threaten or harm those dear to Ulrika Magdova.

desc.zh: 虽然最好的防御就是进攻，知道如何保护自己仍然是很重要的，因为有些对手可能比他们的第一印象更强壮，更迅捷
desc.en: As much as the best form of defence is offence, it remains essential to know how to defend oneself, for some adversaries may be stronger or faster than they first appear to be.

desc.zh: 即使是最熟练的职业士兵，也会认识到穿戴锻造精良的铠甲的好处
desc.en: Even the most skilled professional soldier recognises the advantages of wearing a well-forged plate or suit of mail.

desc.zh: 作为技艺高超的女骑手，尤莉卡从很小的时候就接受了马术的训练，从而令她能够在马上与马下同样有效地战斗
desc.en: A highly-skilled horsewoman, Ulrika was trained in the equestrian arts from a very young age, and taught to fight just as effectively from the saddle as out of it.

desc.zh: 在现实世界中，决斗不只是简单的攻击和格挡。你不仅要一击中的，还必须抢在敌人干掉你之前杀死他们！
desc.en: In the real world, duelling is not simply a matter of striking and parrying. You must not just score a hit, you must kill your opponent, and do so before they kill you!

desc.zh: 如果你失去自控力，那么事情就会变得相当严重：在死神冰冷的触手扼住你之前，你还会受到不小的折磨
desc.en: If you dish it out, it's literally vital that you can also take a degree of punishment before death's icy hand reaches out to claim your life.

desc.zh: 尤莉卡固然是各种武艺样样精通，而她的复合弓技艺尤为出类拔萃，从远端取人性命的手段简直手到擒来
desc.en: Among Ulrika's many impressive martial abilities is her command of her compound bow, with which she demonstrates the skill to kill from a considerable distance away.

desc.zh: 在战役中记得多带一两个箭袋，因为你永远不知道什么时候会用得着
desc.en: Always take an extra quiver or two on campaign, because you never know when you're going to need them.

desc.zh: 尤莉卡并不畏惧肮脏懦弱的鼠人…事实上，她才是这些家伙的瘟疫，一有机会就把这群鼠辈从地面上抹去
desc.en: Those filthy, craven ratmen hold no fear for Ulrika. In fact, she is a plague on their kind, wiping their stain from the land at every given opportunity.

desc.zh: 尤莉卡曾与传奇矮人屠夫高崔克，以及此人英雄事迹的记录者菲利克斯共同协作：她首先把巨龙斯卡加兰迪尔射瞎，使它失去了行动能力，然后协力杀死了它
desc.en: Alongside Gotrek, the fabled Dwarf Slayer, and Felix, his mannish chronicler, Ulrika put down the Dragon Skjalandir after first blinding the behemoth and rendering it incapable.

desc.zh: 虽然在刀尖舔血，但尤莉卡到底还是活了下来，嗯，也得亏有一位使用魔法的朋友助力…
desc.en: What could and would surely kill another, Ulrika has survived, albeit with a little help from a magic-using friend…

desc.zh: 亲眼目睹自己的父亲被吸血鬼克里格杀死，尤莉卡的身体与意志都力量倍增。这股力量让她挣脱了束缚，取而代之的是强烈的仇恨
desc.en: Seeing her father slain by the Vampire Krieger gave Ulrika the strength, both physical and of will, to break free of her bonds, along with a passionate hatred.

desc.zh: 鲜血的转变让敌人充满了恐惧，也让尤莉卡与她的军队更容易治愈自己
desc.en: Such a transformation fills the foe with terror while enabling Ulrika and her host to heal more easily.

desc.zh: 如今尤莉卡在亵渎与鲜血中完全重生，她可以控制自己的饥饿，强化自己的力量，同时吸干自己的敌人
desc.en: Now she is fully reborn in blasphemy and blood, Ulrika can now control her hunger, increasing her power whilst draining that of her enemies.

desc.zh: 『我的血！我父亲的血！我的祖国的鲜血！我应该忠诚于他们！我应该服从于他们！』
desc.en: "My blood! The blood of my father! The blood of my country! To them I owe loyalty! To them I owe obedience!"

desc.zh: 在没有盾牌保护的情况下，尤莉卡必须保持迅捷，这样她才能在箭雨落下时灵巧地闪转腾挪开来
desc.en: Without a shield to protect her, it is vital that Ulrika remains swift of heel, so she can move, twist and dodge as the arrows rain down.

desc.zh: 鲜血之吻的一个优点就是赋予了对方操控阴影系法术的机会，这使尤莉卡在对抗其他魔法之风使用者时会获得更强的保护
desc.en: A useful benefit of the Blood Kiss is the ability to command the Lore of Shadow, which gives Ulrika greater protection against proponents of the other Winds of Magic.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 个头越大，就摔得越狠！
desc.en: The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

desc.zh: 『派信使到前线去！右翼必须战至最后一人！』
desc.en: "Send messengers to the front! The right-flank must fight to the last man!"

desc.zh: 以心统军，以智驭众
desc.en: Lead with the heart, command with the mind.

desc.zh: 『升起信号旗！左翼必须挺住！』
desc.en: "Raise the signal banners! The left flank must stand strong!"

desc.zh: 『现在是行动而不是空谈的时候！为了保卫我们的未来！』
desc.en: "It’s time for action, not words! In defence of the future!"

desc.zh: 俗话说集思广益，好吧，这话可能不是严格正确，但绝对有可取之处
desc.en: You know what they say: "Three heads are better than one!" Well, that might not be strictly true, but they definitely should.

desc.zh: 奸奇暴君与领主的言论就是法律，而他们发布的这一条命令可以有效地制止军队的逃亡
desc.en: Tzeentchian tyrants and Lords, whose word is law, ensure their troops will not run by issuing this dread order.

desc.zh: 太月鸾是最为壮丽的天空坐骑，唯有来自天堂的魔法才能抵御它的火焰之力
desc.en: A most resplendent airborne mount, the Great Moon Bird’s flaming exterior can only be resisted by those practiced in the magic of the heavens.

desc.zh: 昊天的忠臣骑乘着这头可怕的魔法生物，从战场的地面与天空中倾泻着昊天的意志
desc.en: Astride such a fearsome, magic-empowered creature, the will of the Celestial is executed by his servants both above and upon the battlefield.

desc.zh: 玉龙马罕见而雄伟，只允许真正具备资格的骑手驾驭
desc.en: Rare and majestic, Jade Longma only allow themselves to be ridden by the truly worthy.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 『吾非龙裔，降以御众！然我内秉龙心，外效龙爪！诸君亦当如此！』
desc.en: "I am no Dragon, no mighty being descended to guide you! But I am their will! I am their Hand! And so too will you be!"

desc.zh: 『固若长垣！』
desc.en: "Be as the Great Bastion!"

desc.zh: 『猛若龙噬！』
desc.en: "Be as the bite of the Dragon!"

desc.zh: 『疾若陨星！』
desc.en: "Be as the falling comet!"

desc.zh: 『…此三势者，岂足状我！』
desc.en: "…and I shall be all these things, and more!"

desc.zh: 比肩于天者，不坠于地
desc.en: Those who stand shoulder to shoulder with the sky will never fall to the earth.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 在龙帝眼中，保卫震旦天朝乃是一项神圣的职责，如同代表这项职责的玉石一样神圣
desc.en: In the eyes of the Emperor, the defence of Grand Cathay is a duty as sacred as the stone that represents it.

desc.zh: 门下督从不懈怠。即使是在战况不利时，他们也会展现出勇气与坚定的意志来激励友军
desc.en: Inspiring others through displays of true grit and stalwart determination, the Gate Master never relents, even when the odds are very much stacked against him.

desc.zh: 真正精通防守战术的战士清楚如何最有效地避开敌人的招式，然后如何给予敌人致命一击
desc.en: One truly adept in defensive tactics knows how best to evade such moves when made against them, and then how to deal their own killing blow.

desc.zh: 有时你必须与毁灭的浪潮抗争：就是这里，就是现在
desc.en: Sometimes, you must make a stand against a tide of Ruin. That time is now; the place is here.

desc.zh: 一夫当关，万夫莫开
desc.en: Be the gate itself, through which none shall pass if you will it so.

desc.zh: 虽然气球仍然十分脆弱，但船舱经过加固后可以抵御箭矢和枪火，这可以有效保护驾驶员
desc.en: Though the balloon remains fragile, a well-reinforced gondola can take prodigious numbers of arrows and gunfire in service of its pilots.

desc.zh: 『尔等别无他事，若有刺客近前，只消击昏便是』
desc.en: "Your role is quite simple, really. When the assassin strikes, you jump in and beat them senseless."

desc.zh: 『容我等再近前细看！战局如此，吾必亲核再三』
desc.en: "Bring us closer! I must confirm the situation with my own eyes."

desc.zh: 晓解兵法，慎思明辨，则能与敌变化而取胜也
desc.en: Through careful interpretation and vicious introspection, one can subtly shift their purpose as the flow of battle demands.

desc.zh: 子弹刻上凹槽之后，穿过空气时就能发出尖响，从而迷惑目标
desc.en: By carving deliberate grooves in the bullets, a piercing wail can be created as they pass through the air, disorienting the target.

desc.zh: 谀谄匹夫，善媚小人，若能除之，则尽是如水君子
desc.en: Once you weed out the sycophants and bootlickers, you'll find no faster friends.

desc.zh: 毕生耕耘之人，定能深谙林沼田野之道
desc.en: Those who work the land all their life build up a kinship with the boggy fields and deep forests.

desc.zh: 一鸡何足用牛刀？
desc.en: Why use a sledgehammer to drive a nail?

desc.zh: 粮竭而矢尽，斩将于无形
desc.en: Running out of food, bullets or arrows is as sure a killer as any blade.

desc.zh: 诲之以兵戈之由，导之以刀矛之技
desc.en: In which you tell your men not just why they fight, but *how*.

desc.zh: 『雕虫小技！』
desc.en: "Your tactics are a shameful display!"

desc.zh: 『吾自烂熟于心，何须兵书！』
desc.en: "Have the books removed, I have studied enough!"

desc.zh: 祟唐一跃，则大地颤抖不止，连敌人也会纷纷跌倒
desc.en: When Saytang leaps, the ground trembles …and his foes stumble and fall.

desc.zh: 若能轻松跨越山峰，何须羡慕鸟儿的翅膀？
desc.en: When you can step with ease between mountaintops, what need have you of wings?

desc.zh: 越是沉默的人，越需格外留心…这是真正的至理名言！
desc.en: It's the quiet ones you need to watch… and ne'er a truer word said!

desc.zh: 永远沉默，永远守望…祟唐时刻准备着消灭龙帝的敌人，以保卫他的人民
desc.en: Ever-silent, always watching, watching... Saytang is always ready to smite the foes of the Dragon Emperor from the map in defence of his people.

desc.zh: 祟唐永不睡眠，并且时刻警惕着可能威胁震旦宁和的外部危险
desc.en: In spite of appearances, Saytang never sleeps, and is always alert to the dangers from without that come to destroy Cathay's precious Harmony.

desc.zh: 当祟唐冲向敌阵时，他会将一波波的箭雨射向敌军，从而削弱他们对抗石巨人的能力
desc.en: Saytang fires volley after volley of arrows into the enemy lines, weakening their ability to defend against the stone giant when he reaches their ranks.

desc.zh: 何物贯穿天空？死亡，简单明了！这是为震旦死敌带来的死亡，也是对忠诚战士们的极大鼓舞
desc.en: What is that up in the sky? It is death, plain and simple; death for Cathay's mortal enemies, and an inspiration to its loyal warriors.

desc.zh: 这尊附魔石像与其他同类一样，充满了奥术活力
desc.en: This enchanted stone statue is imbued with arcane abilities, as are others of its kind.

desc.zh: 这尊巨大的石头构装体叫做祟唐，他跨越群峰如履平地，屹立于他所包围的众多山谷之上
desc.en: The giant, stone Construct known as Saytang can simply leap from peak to peak, far above the abundant valleys he is bound to defend.

desc.zh: 烈焰焚天之时，死亡将如雨而至
desc.en: When fire hangs in the sky above the battlefield, death is sure to rain down upon it.

desc.zh: 操持魔法之风令祟唐并不需要箭袋，而是可将魔风中的力量化作箭矢
desc.en: Saytang does not need a quiver, for he has the Winds of Magic from which to draw, with all their eldritch power.

desc.zh: 如鹰隼般的眼睛，足以弯弓搭箭射中一根掉落的头发
desc.en: The eyes of the hawk, able to pluck a falling hair with a deft arrow sent from its bow.

desc.zh: 战场上，祟唐附近的部队几乎如图他巨大的石头肢体的延伸，随时准备一拥而上，顺着他强大手臂的挥舞发起攻击
desc.en: Forces close to Saytang in battle almost become an extension of his own colossal stone limbs, always ready to swarm and strike at the wave of his mighty hand.

desc.zh: 构装体的众多优势之一，便是可以看到来自远处的威胁，从而在相对较短的时间内构筑起有效的防御
desc.en: One of the myriad advantages of Constructs is their ability to see the threat coming from leagues away, enabling an effective defence to be mounted in relatively short order.

desc.zh: 固体弹药所受的诸多限制，对魔法弹药却是统统无效，除非战场上的魔法之风变弱
desc.en: Magical ammunition isn't subject to quite the same restrictions as its solid equivalent, except when the Winds blow weaker across the field of battle.

desc.zh: 震旦构装体的典范坚定了同袍们的意志，无论他们是玉石造物，岩石雕琢，还是肉体凡胎
desc.en: This paragon of Cathayan Constructs imbues others of his kind with greater resilience, be they jade, jet, stone or flesh.

desc.zh: 无论敌人使用怎样的奇技淫巧渗入震旦，都会迎面撞上祟唐与他的同袍们：这些人时刻都做好了战斗的准备
desc.en: By whichever sneaky, underhanded means the foe chooses to enter Cathay, they will find Saytang and his friends waiting for them, and absolutely ready to do battle.

desc.zh: 如此精准的箭法会让敌人犯下致命的错误，将他们化为痛苦哀号，矢集如猬的箭靶
desc.en: Advanced archery techniques such as this may trick the foe into making a fatal error, one which will turn them into screaming, fleshy pincushions as a result!

desc.zh: 无论远近，无论何方，终究逃不脱祟唐轻蔑的目光
desc.en: Near… far… In fact, wherever it is that you are, Saytang's belittling gaze will find you.

desc.zh: 『众不用命，军令不行，我等与混沌何异也』
desc.en: "Order is what separates us from the dark hordes of Chaos."

desc.zh: 『宁邦缉政，吾心所不忘也』
desc.en: "Stability is what lets us do as this great work demands."

desc.zh: 『提笔安民，横刀破虏，此吾所谓宁邦缉政者也』
desc.en: "And so I shall create that stability with every movement of pen and blade."

desc.zh: 虽然都带有『玉』字，但玉旅并不直接为玉廷效力，而这也不是什么大问题，因为他们管控着震旦的政治与经济中心
desc.en: The Jade Regiments do not serve the Jade Court directly, despite their name, but administrating Cathay's political and economical centre makes such matters irrelevant.

desc.zh: 这或许是震旦诸军中最为多样的一支。天廷直接归元伯调遣，他们掌控着震旦的法师及其在战争中的魔法造诣
desc.en: Perhaps the most eclectic of the Cathayan warhosts. Serving Directly under Yuan Bo, the Celestial Court commands Cathay's Wizards and their magical craft in war.

desc.zh: 天廷掌控着震旦的法师…真正的王牌总是要留到最后，也要留给自己
desc.en: The Celestial Court controls the Wizards of Cathay… and one never plays their best cards too soon, or for the benefit of others.

desc.zh: 玉龙尊形一现，则文书告敕如行云流水，而元伯则好似水下破浪碧鲛
desc.en: The mere presence of the Jade Dragon ensures that paperwork flows like water, and Yuan Bo is the shark beneath the waves.

desc.zh: 神龙善于化作人形，而其中犹以元伯最为擅长，他所炼躯壳眼神坚毅，与他那超乎凡人的精神相得益彰
desc.en: The Dragons are adept at appearing human, but none more so than Yuan Bo, who cultivates a guise that does not betray the inhuman mind behind the unflinching eyes.

desc.zh: 正所谓积重则难返。事无巨细，皆尽专之，方可无往不利
desc.en: Little failures compound, and thus by aligning all things small and large with your purpose, you can banish all opposition.

desc.zh: 战鼓一俟奏响，司天丞尽皆枕戈待旦，以应王事
desc.en: When the drums of war are sounded, entire regiments of Astromancers are prepared to meet the demands of the empire.

desc.zh: 元伯蜕去人形之时，将化作骇人的远古精魄。其驰骋之时，怕是世上尚无智慧种族一说！
desc.en: When he discards the false image of humanity, Yuan Bo is a terrifying spectre of an age from before the thinking races of the world.

desc.zh: 『孩子，瞧瞧那五彩缤纷的魔法吧，看那万变的形态，看那神秘的力量。精灵和蜥蜴人以为自己是高等生物。可他们不知道真相。不论他们变出什么颜色的把戏，一切力量都来自于我的主人』
desc.en: "Look, child, at the many colours of magic; see its patina, witness the haze of power. Elves and Lizardmen think themselves higher beings. But the truth is no matter what colour they use, it is all power that comes from my master."

desc.zh: 永远警惕，永远守望！祟唐的箭矢在震旦的最高峰呼啸，为那些威胁丝绸之地的人们带来死亡
desc.en: Ever vigilant, always watching; from the highest peaks in Cathay, Saytang's arrows whistle on the wind, foreshadowing the deaths of those who threaten the Silk Lands.

desc.zh: 元伯身兼数职，即是宰牧又是刑官，玉廷和天廷皆归其统，其威势仅在龙帝月后之下
desc.en: Executor and Executioner, Yuan Bo wears many hats, his twin stewardship of the Jade and Celestial Courts granting him authority only matched by the Emperor and Empress themselves.

desc.zh: 厄孙教会将黄金骑士奉为女沙皇的高贵守卫，游走在教会与国家之间虚无缥缈的分野之上
desc.en: Consecrated by the Cult of Ursun to be the Tzarina's noble guardian, the Golden Knight walks the near-invisible line between church and state.

desc.zh: 『脚踏稳当，不要踩到树枝，不要搅动森林，否则巫女嬷嬷会永远把你带走…』
desc.en: "Place your feet well, step not on the branch and rustle not the bush, lest the Hag Mother come and takes you away forever…"

desc.zh: 当你完全忘记了自己最初的形态时，你究竟还剩下什么？
desc.en: What is truly left when you have forgotten your original form completely?

desc.zh: 此人对基斯里夫王冠以及其佩戴者的忠诚毫无疑问。如果需要，他会毫不犹豫地牺牲自己
desc.en: This one's loyalty is to the crown of Kislev and its current wearer, without question, and to the bitter end, if such sacrifice is necessary.

desc.zh: 这些基斯里夫的神圣野兽只能通过他人亲手或者使用箭矢所杀
desc.en: The sacred beasts of Kislev must only be killed by the strength of one's hand or the flight of an arrow.

desc.zh: 与自然携手共进的生活意味着，树木会随时回应他们的请求
desc.en: A life lived hand-in-hand with nature means that, when this one calls upon the trees, they answer his request.

desc.zh: 今日不宜入林。不，真的不
desc.en: Don't go into the woods today. No, seriously, don't.

desc.zh: 基斯列夫的敌人永远不会发现厄孙的手下的行踪，若非如此，那就说明早已为时已晚了
desc.en: The enemies of Kislev shall never see Ursun's men coming until it is far, far too late.

desc.zh: 他对森林及其居民的了解使得他比大多数人更擅长在防御中利用它们
desc.en: His knowledge of the forest and its inhabitants give this one a better understanding than most of how they can be fielded in its defence.

desc.zh: 他熟悉这片土地，了解这里的每一条河流，他知道这里最佳的防御及进攻地点
desc.en: He knows the lands, its rivers, its streams; the best spots to defend, the best places to strike.

desc.zh: 若当战争降临基斯里夫，而你希望农民们能为你而战的话，那就永远不要忘记你来自哪里
desc.en: Never forget where you come from, especially if you wish the peasants to fight for you when war comes to Kislev.

desc.zh: 自然之神极力保护他的领地。只有愚蠢之人才会去惹怒他。
desc.en: The God of Nature is fiercely protective of his domain. Only the foolish provoke his wrath.

desc.zh: 当自然之神做出裁决时，整个自然世界都会支持他。这些就是最终的宣判
desc.en: When the God of Nature makes a ruling, the whole of the natural world stands behind him. All verdicts are final.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 黄金骑士不仅是女沙皇卡捷琳的冠军勇士，也发誓要保卫整个基斯里夫免受胆大包天的敌人的入侵
desc.en: The Golden Knight may be the champion of Tzarina Katarin, but she is also sworn to defend all Kislev from those who dare invade its hallowed borders.

desc.zh: 娜丽丝卡不仅拥有战士们手中最好的装备，她的黄金外表甚至会钝化施法者与恶魔们射来的魔法攻击
desc.en: It's not just warriors bearing steel that Naryska will best – spellcasters and Daemons also find their weapons blunted against her golden carapace, and that of the Lord under her protection.

desc.zh: 娜丽丝卡同时获得了大正教会与冰雪王廷的支持，这点相当的不同寻常：两个长期龃龉的古老组织，居然会为相同的光荣目标而联合了起来
desc.en: Unusually, Naryska fights with the blessings of both the Great Orthodoxy and the Ice Court, uniting two ancient institutions, so often at odds, in a single, glorious purpose.

desc.zh: 无论领导基斯里夫军队踏上战场的是谁，无论是女沙皇本人，还是她的一位忠诚的将军，黄金骑士都会用生命来保护他们
desc.en: Whomsoever is leading Kislev's armies on the day of battle, be it the Tzarina herself or one of her loyal generals, the Golden Knight will guard them with her life.

desc.zh: 娜丽丝卡·莱萨所受的刻苦训练超过了任何基斯里夫勇士，因此，即使是他们中最优秀的战士，也无法与她的决心与骄傲相提并论
desc.en: No Kislevite warrior trains longer or harder than Naryska Leysa, for even the best among them cannot match her levels of determination and sheer stubborn pride.

desc.zh: 为了女沙皇的安全，她万死不辞
desc.en: For her life, she will give her own ten thousand times over.

desc.zh: 黄金骑士的身高超过了大多数同袍，并且武装到了牙齿。她是战场上的勇气灯塔，是所有基斯里夫人的榜样，也是敌人的克星
desc.en: Taller than many men, armed and armoured to the teeth and beyond – the Golden Knight is a beacon of courage on the battlefield; an example to all Kislevites and the bane of their foes.

desc.zh: 在娜丽丝卡·莱萨高贵的父亲于鲍里斯·厄孙身旁牺牲后，她便成为了唯一能够接过黄金骑士重任的人选
desc.en: When Naryska Leysa's noble father died in battle at Boris Ursus' side, there was only one real choice to be his replacement and become the new Golden Knight.

desc.zh: 虽然很多人尝试过，但终究无人能压制娜丽丝卡钢铁般的决心，也没有人能在战斗中击败她，这便是她的武艺
desc.en: Though many have tried, none have yet broken through Naryska's steely resolve or bested her in single combat, such is her martial skill.

desc.zh: 娜丽丝卡是前任黄金骑士的女儿，她的血管里流淌着英勇的血液，指引着她英勇对抗祖国母亲的敌人
desc.en: Naryska is the daughter of the previous Golden Knight, whose valorous blood clearly flows through her veins and guides her noble actions against the Motherland's foes.

desc.zh: 黄金骑士不仅擅长激励普通的士兵，也会让潜在的盟友难以忘怀，使他们更愿意为了共同的利益而与基斯里夫并肩而战
desc.en: The Golden Knight impresses potential allies just as much as she inspires its rank-and-file troops, making them more willing to join with Kislev for their mutual advantage and gain.

desc.zh: 『为了祖国母亲，为了女沙皇，为了厄孙，我们必须直面威胁我们生命的祸患！』
desc.en: "For the sake of the Motherland, the Tzarina and for Ursun himself, we must face down this scourge that threatens our very being."

desc.zh: 她并非为了女沙皇卡捷琳个人，而是为整个祖国母亲而战：若是入侵者的阴谋得逞，她的人生目标又在何处？
desc.en: She does not fight for Tzarina Katarin alone, but the Motherland as a whole, for if it fell to invaders from without, the Golden Knight would have no further purpose in life.

desc.zh: 只有这片土地上最为忠心耿耿的战士才能成为黄金骑士。为了拯救基斯里夫，黄金骑士万死不辞
desc.en: You don't become the Golden Knight if you aren't the most true-hearted warrior in the land, who would die a thousand times to save Kislev from its most-hated enemies.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 当卡捷琳步入战场时，所有基斯里夫人都会应召出征，而她最伟大的战士便会走在他们的最前方
desc.en: When Katarin goes to war, all Kislev mobilises to ensure her victory, and her greatest living warrior is always first amongst them.

desc.zh: 没有任何冰雪禁卫能与娜丽丝卡一较高下，这位女战士总是会用自己的勇武让他们眼界大开，因此这些战士的战斗力也有了很大的提高
desc.en: Although she has no equals among the Ice Guard, their fighting prowess improves when in Naryska's presence, as the warrior-women seek to impress her with their own bravery and martial skill.

desc.zh: 若是有幸与黄金骑士并肩而战，便定然会学到她在战斗中积累丰富经验，从而更有效地杀死基斯里夫的敌人
desc.en: Those who fight alongside the Golden Knight inevitably find that the extensive experience she has gained in battle, fighting Kislev's enemies to a bloody death, rubs off on them too.

desc.zh: 与黄金骑士并肩而战，便是对自己勇武的证明。为此他们会受赠精美的铠甲，从而彰显这一成就
desc.en: The men and women who have fought with the Golden Knight and proved their mettle are rewarded with fine ceremonial armour plates as a mark of their achievements.

desc.zh: 与黄金骑士并肩而战的任何将士都会更加坚强与坚韧，因为共同的经历会结成鲜血与荣誉的纽带
desc.en: Every member of the armies with whom the Golden Knight serves becomes that little bit tougher and more resilient, as bonds of blood and honour are formed through shared experience.

desc.zh: 致命的寒冰邪龙会在战场上播撒恐惧与疯狂，但除了冰雪王廷中最有手段的成员之外，很少有人能驯服这些致命的生物
desc.en: To bring fear and panic to a battlefield, few other than the Ice Court’s most accomplished can wrangle a deadly ice drake into their service.

desc.zh: 致命的寒冰邪龙会在战场上播撒恐惧与疯狂，但除了冰雪王廷中最有手段的成员之外，很少有人能驯服这些致命的生物
desc.en: To bring fear and panic to a battlefield, few other than the Ice Court’s most accomplished can wrangle a deadly ice drake into their service.

desc.zh: 致命的寒冰邪龙会在战场上播撒恐惧与疯狂，但除了冰雪王廷中最有手段的成员之外，很少有人能驯服这些致命的生物
desc.en: To bring fear and panic to a battlefield, few other than the Ice Court’s most accomplished can wrangle a deadly ice drake into their service.

desc.zh: 冰雪王廷的加固雪橇由强壮的战马牵引，它们的喘息如冬天的风，两侧闪烁着闪光的冰晶
desc.en: The Ice Court’s reinforced sled is drawn by mighty steeds with breath like the winter wind, and whose flanks shimmer with glittering ice crystals.

desc.zh: 毁灭大军的可怕乘舆不仅是战争机器，还是地位与权力的象征
desc.en: The dread carriages of the Ruinous hosts are more than just machines of war; they are symbols of status and power.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 作为捆绑仪式的一部分，尖啸飞鲨的身体被压得扁平，并转化成了几乎不可能存在的相貌
desc.en: As part of the binding ritual, Screamer bodies are flattened and transmuted into unlikely aspects.

desc.zh: 毁灭大军的可怕乘舆不仅是战争机器，还是地位与权力的象征
desc.en: The dread carriages of the Ruinous hosts are more than just machines of war; they are symbols of status and power.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 作为捆绑仪式的一部分，尖啸飞鲨的身体被压得扁平，并转化成了几乎不可能存在的相貌
desc.en: As part of the binding ritual, Screamer bodies are flattened and transmuted into unlikely aspects.

desc.zh: 并非所有流浪者都迷失了方向
desc.en: Not all who wander are lost.

desc.zh: 未经外来干预的荒野才是世界的自然状态
desc.en: The natural state of the world is that of untouched wilderness, free from the meddling of all outsiders.

desc.zh: 它们从树枝间钻出来…
desc.en: From between the branches they came…

desc.zh: 树林中的女巫很容易与同类建立亲密关系，毕竟她们都被同一根纽带所联系着
desc.en: The Hags of the wood find kinship among their own comes easily; they are all bound by the same thread, after all.

desc.zh: 咒上加咒，胆敢闯入的人将背负沉重的诅咒
desc.en: Malediction upon malediction, the curse weighs heavily on those who dare trespass.

desc.zh: 指挥女巫会进行荒野作业，会使奥斯坦基娅编织出更适合她地位的宏大仪式
desc.en: Directing covens of Hags to do the work of the wild allows Ostankya to weave greater rituals befitting of her station.

desc.zh: 基斯里夫乡村的居民与女巫们保持着一种勉强但充满感激的关系，尊重女巫确实使得祸害出奇地减少了
desc.en: The citizenry of rural Kislev have a begrudging-yet-thankful relationship with the Hags, wherein proper respect begets a startling lack of misfortune.

desc.zh: 在女巫靠近力量中心时，千万不要攻击她
desc.en: Never attack a witch close to the heart of her power.

desc.zh: 奥斯坦基娅不会宣讲复杂的真理，不会吟诵诗意的沉思。她只是展现出自然世界的真实，并给她的追随者带来坚定的目标
desc.en: Ostankya speaks no complicated truths, no poetic musings. She simply lays bare the natural world and brings a surety of purpose to her followers.

desc.zh: 『你最好开始相信童话，因为你正在童话之中！』
desc.en: "You'd better start believing in fairy tales, 'cos you're in one!"

desc.zh: 微不足道的一点仇恨会使得诅咒变得更加难以承受
desc.en: A slightest pinch of hate to make the curse just that much harder to bear.

desc.zh: 将它们紧紧地放在你的心中，因为现在荒野完全掌控着你
desc.en: Bear them close to your heart, for the wild holds sole domain over you now.

desc.zh: 『将这些种子撒在你的花园里，你的收获将会十分丰盛！但是有一株长满眼睛的花千万不要去摘！』
desc.en: "Drop these seeds into your garden and your harvest shall be bountiful indeed! But pick not the eye-laden stalk, not even once!"

desc.zh: 在树枝和雪的掩护下，女巫们翩翩起舞，喜迎新春万物复苏
desc.en: Into the boughs and under the snow, where the witches dance and the new spring grows.

desc.zh: 根须会将箭矢缠住拖向大地，新芽上的枝条会将箭矢的魔法归还到魔力之泉中
desc.en: A root to bind arrows to the earth and a simple switch of wood from a young sprout to return their magics to the spring from which it came.

desc.zh: 『扭曲乱枝，苍苔碧岩，崛起吧！』
desc.en: "Rise now, twisted branch and mossy stone!"

desc.zh: 木头在雪中轻轻刮擦，这预示着它们的到来…
desc.en: The rasp of wood, freely given, upon snow heralds their approach...

desc.zh: 林间常客在阴影间穿梭跳跃，一旦发现不对劲，就随时准备出击
desc.en: Familiars of the wood bound and leap between the shadows, ready to strike out if the deal is deemed sour.

desc.zh: 在所有扭曲的魔法之风中，女巫们之间所流行的理所当然是诅咒
desc.en: Of all the twisting of the Winds, curses come most naturally to the Hags.

desc.zh: 领袖最好由身边最聪慧的顾问来扶持…他们知道世界是如何运行的
desc.en: A leader is best appointed with a wise advisor by their side… One that knows the proper ways of the world.

desc.zh: 当肌肉重新结合，骨骼开始愈合时，就没什么必要考虑自己的安全了
desc.en: When muscles reknit and bones mend, there is little need to consider ones own safety.

desc.zh: 生命从内流溢而出，根本无法遏止，唯一的办法只能是就此狂暴起来
desc.en: The life overflows from within, impossible to quell or stem, the only recourse is rampant action.

desc.zh: 无论此人踏步何处，生命都会涌现，树枝承受着过剩果实的重压，鲜花亮得简直烫眼
desc.en: Wherever he steps, life sprouts, the branches straining under bushels of overripe fruit, flowers so bright they sear the eyes.

desc.zh: …而生命就这样一步一步一步一步一步一步一步一步向前进…
desc.en: …and life goes on and on and on and on and on and on and on and on and on and on and on and on and on...

desc.zh: 埃考德握有风刃，这柄巨剑能够在空中飞舞，收割敌人，或者让埃考德的战斗迅捷如风！
desc.en: Aekold wields the Windblade, a greatsword that can fly through the air to scythe down the foe, or empower Aekold himself to strike with the swiftness of the wind!

desc.zh: 埃考德的新骑士兄弟会对他的才能大为赞赏
desc.en: Aekold's new knightly brotherhood has proven far more appreciative of his talents.

desc.zh: 作为帝国的一名骑士，埃考德最渴望回到那些背叛他的人身边，并向他们展示世界的真相…
desc.en: Once a knight of the Empire, Aekold desires nothing more than to return to those who betrayed him and show them the truth of the world…

desc.zh: 书吏在永恒的探索中掌握了一些技巧，可以从这个地方挤取额外的魔法之风
desc.en: In their eternal search, the Scribes have picked up a couple knacks for wringing extra Winds from this place.

desc.zh: 如果他们以前见过，就绝对不需要再看一遍
desc.en: If they've seen it before, they have absolutely no need to see it again.

desc.zh: 书吏最早收集的法术来自于这些法术所衍生的恶魔
desc.en: The first spells the Scribes collected were those of the Daemons from which they stemmed.

desc.zh: 这些卷轴闪烁着灰绿色的次元石之光，微弱的啮齿动物声隐约可闻
desc.en: These scrolls glow with the ominous light of Warpstone, and the faint chittering of vermin can be heard.

desc.zh: 当这些卷轴展开时，就会发出尖叫声，永远渴望着肉体和战争
desc.en: These scrolls scream, literally, when unfurled, eternally hungry for meat and war.

desc.zh: 当这些卷轴在死亡之地展开时，尸体有时会突然短暂地焕发生机
desc.en: When these scrolls are unfurled near places of death, remains have a habit of bursting into spontaneous, short-lived life.

desc.zh: 这些卷轴每一份都是成对出现的，只有双卷同在才算完整，不幸的是，这使得它们非常难以保存
desc.en: These scrolls each come in pairs, each one only complete when held alongside its twin, unfortunately making them very annoying to store.

desc.zh: 这些卷轴在周围散发出一种傲慢的气息，希莱特普觉得这些卷轴专断得令人发指
desc.en: These scrolls have a certain haughty air around them, Xirat'p finds them insufferably judgemental.

desc.zh: 每个卷轴都有一个被束缚在其中的次级恶魔，它们跃入希莱特普的手中，仿佛渴望在现实世界中释放它们的毁灭之力
desc.en: Each home to a minor Daemon bound in the parchment, these scrolls jump into Xirat'p's hands as if eager to unleash their destruction on the material world.

desc.zh: 有时书吏们取出这些卷轴，在炎炎夏日中享受清凉的冬日之寒
desc.en: Sometimes the Scribes retrieve these scrolls to bask in the refreshing winter chill on a hot summer's day.

desc.zh: 它们比其他卷轴都要大，其承载的低沉咏咒足以吞噬掉一个凡人法师
desc.en: Larger than any other scrolls, these bear the weighty incantations that would consume a mortal Wizard.

desc.zh: 这些卷轴微微冒烟，被永燃之火所吞噬
desc.en: These scrolls smoulder slightly, consumed by an ever-burning flame.

desc.zh: 这些卷轴像夜空中的星星一样微微闪烁
desc.en: These scrolls gently scintillate like stars in the night sky.

desc.zh: 这些卷轴实际上根本不是卷轴，而是折叠成卷轴形状的刀刃！小心手指！
desc.en: These scrolls are not truly scrolls at all, but blades folded into their shape! Watch those fingers!

desc.zh: 每次展开这些卷轴时，就会有虫子从附近的区域爆发出来
desc.en: Each time these scrolls are unfurled, small insects burst forth all over the nearby area.

desc.zh: 这些卷轴必须定期修剪，以免被内部生长的各种枝叶所吞噬
desc.en: These scrolls must be trimmed regularly, lest the they become subsumed by the various branches and leaves sprouting from within.

desc.zh: 在海量的藏品中，他们最不喜欢的就是这些卷轴，因为只是展开它们就足以将书吏驱逐回混沌魔域！
desc.en: Of their vast collection, these scrolls are among their least favourite, as merely unfurling them threatens to banish the Scribes back to the Realm of Chaos!

desc.zh: 这些卷轴必须经常重新抄写，因为沙许之风的力量会侵蚀它们的形态，这让书吏倍感沮丧
desc.en: These scrolls must regularly be scribed again, as the Winds of Shyish eat away at their form, much to the Scribes dismay.

desc.zh: 在有必要时，只有命运缔造者的恩典才能让这些卷轴得以取回，因为它们只能从其他卷轴的阴影中抽取
desc.en: It is only the providence of the Architect of Fate himself that even allows these scrolls to be retrieved when necessary, as they can only be taken from between the shadows of other scrolls.

desc.zh: 昔日为一，今则为二\n\n让你尝一下合璧的威力！
desc.en: What once was one, now is two.\n\nAnd together we will blast you!

desc.zh: 即便是书吏也有自己最青睐的卷轴
desc.en: Even the Scribes have favourites among the scrolls.

desc.zh: 只要稍加尝试，我们就能记录下来！
desc.en: We can enscribe it if we try!

desc.zh: 奸笑声永不止息，你根本分辨不出究竟是两个还是一千个疯狂的声音在嘲笑着你！
desc.en: The cackling never ends, and you'll know not if it's two or a thousand maniacal voices raised in mockery!

desc.zh: 蓝书吏是万变之主的碎片，他们永远被束缚在追寻法术的旅途上，无论过去、现在还是将来，他们都不得止息
desc.en: The Blue Scribes are fragments of the great changer himself, forever bound to wander the world searching for every spell – past, present and future.

desc.zh: 虽然他们并非十分狡诈或技艺高超的密探，但他们无尽的秘法弥补了许多不足之处
desc.en: While not exactly masterful agents of great cunning or skill, a boundless supply of esoteric magic makes up for many shortcomings.

desc.zh: 希莱特普和普特莱希并非只求一时欢愉和热烈，相反，他们身经百战，脾气暴躁而狡猾
desc.en: Xirat'P and P'tarix are not fleeting constructs driven to find entertainment or combust. No, they are surly and cunning combatants with years of experience.

desc.zh: 最能引发强烈情绪的时刻，就是面具滑落的瞬间
desc.en: The moments that evoke the highest emotions are those that occur when the mask slips and falls.

desc.zh: 伪装可以根据需要来精确地塑造，有时候甚至需要引人注目的触手！
desc.en: The disguise can be as exact as needed. Sometimes that need includes a striking set of tentacles!

desc.zh: 当你能以全副武装的弓箭手姿态威武亮相时，后勤、训练和所有那些荒谬的概念就都不适用于你了
desc.en: Logistics, training and all those other nonsensical concepts don't apply when you can simply appear fully-formed with bow in hand.

desc.zh: 『有时候，我也算个法师…』
desc.en: "You know, I'm something of a Wizard myself..."

desc.zh: 当幕布落下时，受害者惊愕不已，而变化灵则为自己的战利品而欣喜若狂
desc.en: And when the curtain falls, the victim is left stupefied as the Changeling pulls back to savour his spoils.

desc.zh: 从每种伪装中提取一点特殊之处并展现出来
desc.en: Take from each guise a little sliver of what makes them special, and bring it to the fore.

desc.zh: 『老朋友你也下得去手吗？』
desc.en: "Would you really strike an old friend?"

desc.zh: 『我披上长袍伪装成法师…』
desc.en: "I put on my robe and Wizard guise…"

desc.zh: *狂笑*『…哦，是的…是的！』
desc.en: *mad cackling* "…Oh, yes… yes!"

desc.zh: 『我的法杖呢？取我的盔甲来！不对，那套没有鞋！你们谁是管事的？』
desc.en: "Where's my staff!? Bring me my armour! No, that suit has no shoes! WHO'S RESPONSIBLE?"

desc.zh: 你总是留出时间化作朋友
desc.en: You always make time for the shape of a friend.

desc.zh: 追随变化灵的人会变得格外多变。前一刻他们是自己，下一刻又成为了别人。当经历足够多的变化后，他们就再也无法找到自己了
desc.en: Those who follow the Changeling find themselves particularly mutable. One moment they are themselves, the next they are another. When enough have passed, they can never find themselves again.

desc.zh: 他们确实疯了，但等你知道的时候，已经太迟了
desc.en: They truly are mad, but you wouldn't know until it is way, way too late.

desc.zh: 『你说我把补给品送到前线了，这话什么意思？』
desc.en: "What do you mean I already had the supplies sent to the front?"

desc.zh: 『不要质疑天意，笑面军需官和慈祥的法师一直都在这里干活』
desc.en: "Do not question providence. The grinning quartermaster and the gentle Wizard have always worked here."

name.en: I Come in Peace! No, Really…

desc.zh: 『…所以你应该借给我你最好的军团，或许你的亲卫也行？』
desc.en: "...and that's why you should loan me your best regiments. Your personal guard, perhaps?"

desc.zh: 『站住，什么人！？巡逻队已经过去了！请出示身份！』
desc.en: "Halt, who goes there!? The patrol has already passed through! Identify yourselves!"

desc.zh: 你可能以为我会说『现在又看不见了』，但这其实只是一条奸计…
desc.en: You probably expected me to say "Now you don't", but it was merely a cunning ruse…

desc.zh: 他们在旅途中甚至击败了最强大的恶魔，而这竟然成为了他们的家常便饭
desc.en: Even the greatest of Daemons have been defeated on their travels, and oft-times by one such as this.

desc.zh: 『恶魔？我呸！弄死他们！』
desc.en: "Daemons? Pah – I shit 'em."

name.en: Army of One, Slayer of Many

desc.zh: 有些人不需要朋友，因为他们甚至可能会成为死得特别糟糕、特别意外的绊脚石
desc.en: Some people don't need friends; in fact, friends might get in the way and be accidentally killed in a particularly nasty way.

desc.zh: 或许伤疤确实是他的荣耀所在，但既然作为屠夫的意义就是寻求死亡，那么人们不禁会想此人什么时候会投身这项事业中呢？
desc.en: Distinguished by his scars he may be, but since the point of being a Slayer is to die, one wonders when this one is going to start applying himself to the task at hand.

desc.zh: 『如果你要死，就穿着靴子死吧！』——先祖屠夫谚语
desc.en: "If you're gonna die, die with yer boots on!" -- Ancient Slayer proverb

desc.zh: 如许的故事，如许的承诺，如许的大难都写在这些丰满的织锦上，详细描述了他们在顽强地追求死亡中度过的一生…当然，追求的是他们自己的死亡！
desc.en: Many a tale, many a promise, and many a grave threat is scored into these fleshy drapes, detailing a life spent in the dogged pursuit of death…  and chiefly, their own!

desc.zh: 遍体鳞伤讲述了此人一生的传奇，也点缀着他那久经沙场的皮肤
desc.en: The deeds of this one's life are told through the many scars that adorn his timeworn and battle-aged skin.

desc.zh: 当带队的矮人颇有威望时，屠夫们会爆发出不可同日而语的战斗力：他们会迅速冲到战场的垓心，生生地把肢体从哀号的敌人身上砍下来！
desc.en: When led by a Dwarf of sufficient calibre, a band of Slayers is many times more lethal – speeding to the heart of the action to cut it from the foe's still-screaming body!

desc.zh: 一心追求光荣死亡的人自然几乎不会用到什么钱，因为金钱确实是身外之物…
desc.en: Those who seek only a glorious death have little, or less, at least, use for money, because, after all, you can't take it with you.

desc.zh: 若是精于弓箭，那就无需为击杀敌人而亲身犯险了
desc.en: When you're this good with a bow, you don't necessarily need to endanger your immortal soul to kill your enemies.

desc.zh: 『龙？好啊，它在哪儿？你，过来，赴死的时候到了！』
desc.en: "Dragons? Smagons. Where is it? Come here, you, it's time to die!"

name.en: Army of One, Slayer of Many

desc.zh: 有些人不需要朋友，因为他们甚至可能会成为死得特别糟糕、特别意外的绊脚石
desc.en: Some people don't need friends; in fact, friends might get in the way and be accidentally killed in a particularly nasty way.

desc.zh: 既然一边是无所畏惧，那么另一边就得连畏惧这个词，甚至这个概念都一无所知：是的，想在毁灭面前战而胜之，你就得疯狂到这个地步才行
desc.en: There's knowing no fear and then there's never having heard the word, let alone the concept. That's how mad you have to be go up against Ruin and win.

desc.zh: 此人来者不拒，无论他们有多大多狠。若是能在挑战中光荣战死，倒是正合了此人的心愿
desc.en: This one'll take on all-comers, no matter how large and hostile they may be. The way he sees it, if he dies trying, mores the better.

desc.zh: 当然，这项工作永远不会结束，也不应该结束，因为屠杀永无止境。毕竟，他们声称工作本身就是福报
desc.en: Of course, the work never ends, and neither should it, for the slaughter is ceaseless. They say that work is its own reward, after all.

desc.zh: 苍蝇领主最忠实的仆人已是越来越难以撼动，因为魔法粘液会减慢敌人的速度，并限制他们的攻击
desc.en: Attacking the Fly Lord's most faithful servants is made all the more difficult by the magical slime that slows enemy warriors and restricts their strikes.

desc.zh: 一层层腐烂皮肤将在有毒的衰败云雾中爆炸，迫使敌人在痛苦与厌恶中摇摇晃晃地向后退去
desc.en: Layers of rotten skin explode in a toxic cloud of decay, forcing the foe to stagger back in agony and disgust.

desc.zh: 恶臭的腐烂爆炸撕裂敌人的队伍，那些粗心大意之人将会在永恒的腐烂中粉碎湮灭
desc.en: A foetid explosion of putrescence tears through the enemy ranks, pulverising the unwary and dousing them in eternal decay.

desc.zh: 由于终生都在为最恶劣的病疾分类，计患官身上也留下了这一工作的印记，无论他走到哪里，周围都充斥着腐烂与瘟疫的气息
desc.en: A lifetime spent cataloguing the most vile of diseases has left its mark on the Tallyman, for a miasma of rot and pestilence surrounds him wherever he goes.

desc.zh: 一日为携疫者，永世为携疫者。你无法与自然作对
desc.en: Once a Plaguebearer, always a Plaguebearer. You can't fight nature.

desc.zh: 埃皮德穆斯从枯萎花园中带来了一株腐烂幼苗，欲将其栽培在凡世之中
desc.en: Epidemius has brought a foetid seedling from the Garden of Blight to be cultivated in the mortal world.

desc.zh: 相较来自黑暗维度的事物，凡世之物对恶魔的侵蚀力显然更小
desc.en: Daemons are even more resistant to objects in the mortal realm than in their own dark dimensions.

desc.zh: 计患官的地位得以进一步提升，最终成为了慈父的得力助手
desc.en: The Tallyman has ascended further still, at last becoming the right-hand man of the Urfather Himself.

desc.zh: 计患官之剑与世界紧密相连，因此可以在凡世中连续维持数天的存在
desc.en: The Tallyman's Blades are tied to the world, and therefore able to last for days on end in the mortal realm.

desc.zh: 当腐烂报告得以收集和统计后，每一种疾病的效率都会加以整理、计算、汇总、交叉参考和编目。然后，我们就可以增殖这些疾病了…
desc.en: When the Rot Reports have been collected and counted, the efficency of each and every disease can be collated, calculated, correlated, cross-referenced and catalogued. The malady itself can then be… circulated.

desc.zh: 『更硬些，更快些，更狠些！』
desc.en: "Harder, faster, more aggressive!"

desc.zh: 没有什么能比纯粹且无情的挑衅更为有力
desc.en: Nothing is more powerful than pure, ruthless aggression.

desc.zh: 腐烂兽每走一步都伴随着猛烈地摆动与嘶吼——保持稳定需要的可不仅仅是维持宝贵的生命
desc.en: The rot beasts thrash and bray violently with every step – remaining steady requires more than simply holding on for dear life.

desc.zh: 平庸之人无益于苍蝇领主的事业。想要让疾病广泛传播，那精英训练必不可缺
desc.en: Mediocrity does nothing for the Fly Lord's cause; if sickness is to spread far and wide, elite training is a necessity.

desc.zh: 随着腐烂兽的爪子撕裂土壤，蹄子践踏泥土和污垢，纳垢的每个敌人都将畏缩在恐惧之中
desc.en: As the Rot Beasts' claws tear into the earth at speed, and hooves pound through mud and grime, every enemy of Nurgle recoils in fear.

desc.zh: 当以彻底毁灭的名义冲锋在前时，凯兹克身边聚集的都是来自所有国度的最优秀骑手
desc.en: Rushing forth in the name of utter Ruin, Kayzk is surrounded by only the best riders in all the realms.

desc.zh: 凯兹克魁梧有力的身形让其敌人也相形见绌，他在面对敌人的每一击时都不为所动
desc.en: A huge and powerful figure, Kayzk dwarfs his enemies, unmoving in the face of their every attack.

desc.zh: 让那些在敌阵中最壮、最笨的傻大个列队上前吧，凯兹克会把他们一一放倒
desc.en: Line up the largest, most ungainly and lumbering oafs among any enemy, and Kayzk will knock them down one by one.

desc.zh: 总是要为自己着想
desc.en: Always look after number one.

desc.zh: 不要后退，不要投降！你要不断地斩杀他们，直到他们不再敢来面对你！
desc.en: No retreat, no surrender. Keep cutting them down until no more rise to face you.

desc.zh: 有时甚至无需直接接触，而是仅仅靠近便可令纳垢的肮脏疾病传播开去：他的感染与恶疾，就是如此的致命
desc.en: Sometimes mere proximity, as opposed to direct contact, is enough for Nurgle's many foul diseases to spread – so virulent are his infections and plagues.

desc.zh: 由于凯兹克的身体长期以来毫无触感，他很难被打倒，更不用说直接杀死他了
desc.en: Possessed as he is of a body long devoid of feeling, Kayzk is extremely difficult to bring down, let alone kill outright.

desc.zh: 这匹卑劣、残废的坐骑带着它的骑手冲进战斗最激烈的地方。在那里，因腐烂而流出的脓液会严密地封住它癌变肉体上的任何伤口
desc.en: This vile, mutilated steed bears its rider into the very thick of battle, where any wounds scored upon its cancerous flesh are sealed by the pus weeping from its foetid body.

desc.zh: 蛆虫领主的传染力极为强悍：他只需轻轻掠过某人身旁，便可以将可怕的瘟疫传染给他
desc.en: The Maggot Lord is so contagious that he has only to slither past someone to infect them with his foul pestilence.

desc.zh: 塔木尔可汗虽然变成了一只巨大的行尸蛆虫，但正所谓人不可貌相：由于祖父神的宠爱，他已经拥有了难以形容的力量
desc.en: Tamurkhan is much more than the giant corpse maggot whose form he took; he is now a being of untold power, thanks to his dear Grandfather's love and care.

desc.zh: 即使以同类的标准来看，蛆虫的坚韧也是首屈一指，无论面对何种袭击都可以生存下来
desc.en: The Maggot  is especially tough and durable, even for one of his kind, and can survive just about anything the various worlds can throw at him.

desc.zh: 在杀死并寄居在一个强大的食人魔暴君身体里后，大胃神的信徒们向塔木尔可汗的腐蚀屈服了
desc.en: After killing and inhabiting the body of a great Ogre Tyrant, the followers of the Maw have fallen to Tamurkhan's corruption.

desc.zh: 布勃博洛斯是同类中体型最大的个体。当塔木尔可汗骑在它的背上时，其他的蟾蜍龙也就只有服从的份了
desc.en: Bubebolos stands above others as the largest of his kind. With Tamurkhan upon his back, all other Toad Dragons fall into line.

desc.zh: 当塔木尔可汗率领一支由堕落的凡人和恶魔组成的毁灭大军时，大量慕其毁灭大名而来的信徒如蚁附膻，共同壮大了他的伟大军队
desc.en: As Tamurkhan leads a devastating army of corrupted mortals and Daemons, like-minded forces attracted by his Ruin converge to form his grand warhost.

desc.zh: 塔木尔可汗与他的军队从不知疲倦为何物，也从不知放弃为何物
desc.en: Tamurkhan and his army don't get tired, and they never, ever give up.

desc.zh: 有传言说，纳垢恩宠是传说中伟大库尔甘的四个儿子之一，混沌的凡人信徒对他唯命是从
desc.en: Heeding rumours that the Favoured of Nurgle is one of the fabled four Sons of the Great Kurgan, mortal followers of Chaos bow to his command.

desc.zh: 在战场上，对箭矢、炮弹以及各种五花八门弹药的需求无穷无尽
desc.en: Arrows, cannonballs and more esoteric munitions are needed in endless supply on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 使用火药需要很大的耐心：一丁点的错误操作就会让你失去扣动扳机的手指，甚至更糟！
desc.en: Working with gunpowder takes a lot of patience – one wrong move and you might lose your trigger finger... or worse!

desc.zh: 一阵枪林弹雨往往会打垮敌人失去火力
desc.en: A hail of bullets tends to put the enemy off their stroke.

desc.zh: 弓箭，炮弹，以及更为先进的弹药：当战争永无休止时，多少也不嫌多哪
desc.en: Arrows, cannonballs and more esoteric munitions – you can never have too many when the war never ends.

desc.zh: 有时，即使周围炮火连天，你也必须跳下载具来进行紧急维修
desc.en: Ofttimes, events dictate a jury-rigged repair while the battle rages around you.

desc.zh: 这是勇气的在世化身，就像在此前诸多世纪的无畏战士一样
desc.en: The living personification of courage, as the Fearless was many centuries before him.

desc.zh: 数十年的战火洗礼，会累积出一身如同坚韧外壳般的疤痕
desc.en: When you've been fighting for decades, the accumulated scars start to act as a leathery carapace in their own right.

desc.zh: 『我走过旧世界，也来过新世界。我的足迹踏访过每一个角落，没有什么可怕的东西是我没见识过…或者没杀死过的』
desc.en: "Right across the Old World I've walked, and the New, as well. There's no corner I've not visited, no horror I've not seen... and killed."

desc.zh: 没有足够福气的人，在此事上并无什么选择的余地
desc.en: Some people are not sufficiently blessed to be given a choice in the matter.

desc.zh: 每一次略带不敬的冒犯、藐视、不快甚至仅是感觉不爽，就足以引发一场毁灭性的斧头狂舞
desc.en: The weight of every single insult, grievance, umbrage and ill-feeling, channelled into a single, crushing swing of the axe.

desc.zh: 彻底疯狂的武器杂耍，但效果拔群：武技所至，敌人绝无生还的可能
desc.en: It's a crazy piece of acrobatics, for sure, but it might just work; if it does, the opponent has no chance.

desc.zh: 『别担心，父亲，我会为我们俩而战。如果时机成熟，我也愿为我们俩去死！』
desc.en: "Do not worry, father, I will fight for the both of us. And if the time is right, I will gladly die for the both of us as well."

desc.zh: 『我是矮人！荣誉是我的生命，没有它我不值一文！我将成为屠夫，我将在祖先眼前寻求救赎。我将成为敌人的死神，直至我面对那位夺我性命，使我蒙羞的对手！』
desc.en: "I am a Dwarf! My honour is my life and without it I am nothing. I shall become a Slayer. I shall seek redemption in the eyes of my Ancestors. I shall become as death to my enemies, until I face he that takes my life and my shame."

desc.zh: 在热血上头的鲁莽与自我毁灭的粗蛮后面，总会站着一位极为认真地指挥着屠夫军团的矮人
desc.en: Behind all the hot-headed bravado and suicidal bravery stands a Dwarf who takes the leadership of his Slayer band very, VERY seriously.

desc.zh: 『巨人？呸，我弄死他们！』
desc.en: "Giants? Pah – I shit 'em."

desc.zh: 虽然格拉格姆长了一副热血上头，盲目狂热的外貌，虽然他对屠夫的义务恪尽职守，但在形势需要时，他也会冷静地进行思考
desc.en: Garagrim is not as hot-headed or as pig-blind as he likes to appear; he plays the role of Slayer to the best of his ability, but can think when required to.

desc.zh: 多场战斗的磨砺已让这位战士坚毅无比，他的皮肤变得如同龙鳞一样坚硬
desc.en: Many blows over many battles have hardened this warrior beyond compare, making his hide as tough as Dragon scales.

desc.zh: 作为战哀者，照管葛林姆尼尔神龛乃是格拉格姆的神圣职责，因此他有权取用神殿中遗留的远古符文战斧
desc.en: As War-mourner, it's Garagrim's duty to tend to the Shrine of Grimnir, allowing him to open up the temple's store of ancient rune axes left in tribute.

desc.zh: 三撮橙色怒发，极其凌厉的凝视，触目可见、绵绵不绝的强烈恨意，加上严重缺乏社交礼仪，这些将格拉格姆塑造成了屠夫中的屠夫
desc.en: With three crests of angry orange hair, an extremely hard stare, and a visible, bubbling resentment coupled with a severe lack of social graces, Garagrim is very much the Slayer's Slayer.

desc.zh: 多场战斗的磨砺已让这位战士坚毅无比，他的皮肤变得如同龙鳞一样坚硬
desc.en: Many blows over many battles have hardened this warrior beyond compare, making his hide as tough as Dragon scales.

desc.zh: 矮人的社会建立在数世纪的传统与对过去的尊重之上，因此，你的祖先的身份非常地重要
desc.en: In a society such as the Dwarfs', built upon centuries of tradition and respect for the past, who your Ancestors are really does matter.

desc.zh: 痛苦的个人经历是磨砺领导品质的最优秀温床。今天，统军出征；明日，堡垒之主
desc.en: There's nothing like bitter personal experience to ensure that leadership qualities come to the fore. Today, the warband; tomorrow, the Hold.

desc.zh: 尊贵的地位让这位矮人在上层社会中人脉甚广，得以消息灵通，平步青云
desc.en: By virtue of his elevated status, this one has contacts within the Dwarf leadership that enable information and power to flow in both directions more easily.

desc.zh: 面对大量有待解决的宿怨时，还能有什么时间纵情享乐，甚至只坐那么一小会儿呢！
desc.en: There's little time for carousing, or even sitting about, when there's a multitude of heinous grievances to be addressed!

desc.zh: 『事实上也就这些：继续下去，直到红色、绿色、蓝色或者黑色的汁液像泉水一样喷溅出来…是的，就像是一座肉做的，不停尖叫的泉水…』
desc.en: "In fact, that's all there is to it: keep doing that until the red – or green or blue or black – water sprays all over the place like a fleshy geyser …like a fleshy geyser that won't stop screaming."

desc.zh: 这些铠甲上镶有符文，保护着穿戴者免受各种伤害
desc.en: These armour plates have been girded with runes to ensure the wearer is protected from all manner of attacks.

desc.zh: 杰出的勇士往往拥有最好的武器，无论是专门为他们制造的，还是从他们击败的敌人那里获得的战利品
desc.en: Dawi of distinction tend to have the best weapons, whether made specially for them or taken as spoils from their defeated foes.

desc.zh: 这位领主能够承受长时间的战斗并展现出坚韧的意志，从而对附近的战斗产生积极的影响
desc.en: This Lord's ability to withstand prolonged combat and show fortitude has a positive effect on those fighting nearby.

desc.zh: 矮人一到了可以战斗的年纪就会学习面对面杀戮的技巧，但学习远距离猎杀需要的则是完全不同的技能
desc.en: All Dwarfs are taught to kill face-to-face just as soon as they can fight, but learning to kill from a distance requires an altogether different skillset.

desc.zh: 『永远记得带上比需要更多的箭矢。如果需要，拿敌人的尸体当箭垛子也很不错』
desc.en: "Always bring more arrows than you think you'll need. If nothing else, it's fun to make pincushions out of their corpses."

desc.zh: 『永远都别让他们靠上来压制你，这样腿短就会成为你的劣势。记住，你只能犯这一次错』
desc.en: "Never let them get too close and pin yer down, 'cos that's when having shorter legs starts to become a disadvantage. The only time, in fact."

desc.zh: 无论你认为自己的枪法有多好，你都可以做得更好
desc.en: No matter how fine a shot you think you are, you can always be better.

desc.zh: 真是太神奇了，这么小的东西竟能造成如此大的破坏
desc.en: It truly is amazing how something so small can wreak so much explosive devastation.

desc.zh: 战火无穷无尽。冲锋、交兵、一对一的血战，这便是无尽的循环，永无止息
desc.en: The war is endless. The cycle of charging, clashing, and bloody hand-to-hand fighting is without end. It will never stop.

desc.zh: 尽管先前的灾难经历让马拉凯被工程师行会开除，但幸运的是，他得以继续为高崔克与他的盟友们发明大有帮助的机器，并取得了更大的成功！
desc.en: Although it was his early disasters that saw Malakai thrown out of the Engineers' Guild, he has continued to invent machines useful to Gotrek and his allies, with a far greater degree of success – fortunately!

desc.zh: 对于发明的天赋，以及早先经历的困窘使得马拉凯非常希望通过光荣的战死来寻求救赎，他对此抱持着最为严肃的态度！
desc.en: It was his inventing prowess, or initial lack thereof, that forced Malakai to seek redemption through a glorious death in battle – something he pursues with the utmost seriousness!

desc.zh: 马拉凯眼中从不存在什么无法修复的机器，因为修补工作永远是真正的工程师永不枯竭的学习源泉
desc.en: Few machines are irreparable by Malakai’s reckoning, for a true engineer never ceases to learn from their tinkering.

desc.zh: 没有人能像马拉凯那样如此优化重炮和臼炮的威力：当矮人向敌人降下炮火之时，他的升级将确保没有任何敌人能够幸存
desc.en: Nobody can optimise a heavy gun or mortar the way Malakai can; when the Dawi rain fire down upon their enemies, his upgrades ensure there are no survivors.

desc.zh: 马拉凯的才能彰显之下，仅停留在设计层面的东西转变为了具备巨大金属和无尽火力的复杂装置
desc.en: Through Malakai's genius, what once was mere design is brought to life in contraptions of hulking metal and endless firepower.

desc.zh: 『这里微调一下，那里微调一下，然后…砰！几百个地精的尸体，就该这样！』
desc.en: "A little tweak here, a little adjustment there and… Boom! Hundreds of dead Goblins, as they should be."

desc.zh: 当这名矮人被召唤时，任何疲惫都是懦弱的表现——因为他根本不会留下可供休息的时间
desc.en: When the Dawi are in need, exhaustion is an act of cowardice – there is simply no time for rest.

desc.zh: 随着年龄与经验的积累，老兵们也便具备了面对任何敌人都能毫不畏惧的持久胆量
desc.en: With age and experience comes an enduring grit that allows veterans to stand undaunted in the face of any foe.

desc.zh: 『我这一生别无所求，只求有一件胸甲和能握于手中的武器足矣』
desc.en: "I don’t need much in this life but the armour on my chest and the weapon in my hand."

desc.zh: 没人能与一个充满了千场战斗怒火的人相抗衡，他只会在死亡的狂乱中一路砍杀敌人
desc.en: None can match the rage of one brimming with the fury of a thousand battles, cutting through foes in a frenzy of death.

desc.zh: 『你只需要知道关于我的一件事就够了：老子想去哪里就去哪里！』
desc.en: "There's one thing you should know about me: I go wherever I damn well please!"

desc.zh: 有了符文魔法的庇护，无论是这个世界还是别处，都不会再有什么能将你击垮
desc.en: With the power of Runic Magic at your side, there's little in this world or any other that can do to bring you low.

desc.zh: 『你可以把它想象成双重保险，一层防护上面再加一层防护的样子。它们可以帮你挡住邪恶魔法的伤害』
desc.en: "Think of it as a belt *and* braces – protection on top of protection, in case they come at your with their foul magicks."

desc.zh: 符文证明了矮人种族的天赋，它可以用来阻碍魔法之风，从而令敌人无利可图
desc.en: Proving their innate superiority, and with it that of the Dwarf race, runes can be used to hamper the Winds of Magic and therefore their benefit to the enemy.

desc.zh: 想了解一位符文领主需要很长时间，要知道他拥有的秘密就需要更久，更不用说这些秘密的真实性质和意义了
desc.en: It takes a very long time to get to know a Runelord, and longer still to know which secrets he even holds, let alone their true nature and meaning.

desc.zh: 那些最博学多闻的符文领主们自力打造的符文武器，每次挥击都能驭起八风之力
desc.en: The self-crafted, rune-covered armaments of the most learned Runelords can harness the Winds’ potency each time they are brought to blows.

desc.zh: 按正确顺序击打不同符文可以召唤不同的先祖之神。召唤葛林姆尼尔便可施放狂暴的能量
desc.en: Seperate runes struck in the right order can call upon the different Ancestor Gods. Call upon Grimnir to unlock a furious energy.

desc.zh: 按正确顺序击打不同符文可以召唤不同的先祖之神。召唤葛朗尼便可提高武器与护甲的威力
desc.en: Seperate runes struck in the right order can call upon the different Ancestor Gods. Call upon Grungni to improve the power of weapons and armour.

desc.zh: 按正确顺序击打不同符文可以召唤不同的先祖之神。在关键时刻召唤瓦拉雅便可确保忠诚
desc.en: Seperate runes struck in the right order can call upon the different Ancestor Gods. Call upon Valaya for assurance of loyalty in crucial moments.

desc.zh: 数世纪的创新，精心的工艺与传奇的军事技巧将在今天的战场上发挥作用，消灭眼前的敌人
desc.en: Centuries of innovative, careful craft and legendary martial skill can be brought to bear on present-day battlefields, that the foe might be smited from existence.

desc.zh: 就像屠夫追逐他的猎物一样，符文铁匠对知识也有着无情的渴求，因为只有通过融会贯通，我们才能将群山中的敌人一劳永逸地消灭干净
desc.en: As a Slayer pursues his quarry, the Runesmith's thirst for knowledge is every bit as relentless, because only through understanding will we wipe the foe from the mountains once and for all.

desc.zh: 有些事情是无法教导的。你要么能够领悟，要么不能，就这么简单
desc.en: There are some things that simply cannot be taught. You either know them or you don't; it's as simple as that.

desc.zh: 你制作的符文越多，你与符文就会变得越强大，毕竟熟能生巧
desc.en: The more runes you craft, the stronger and more powerful they – and you – will become; practice makes perfect, after all.

desc.zh: 彻底疯狂的武器杂耍，但效果拔群：武技所至，敌人绝无生还的可能
desc.en: It's a crazy piece of acrobatics, for sure, but it might just work; if it does, the opponent has no chance.

desc.zh: 日积月累的先祖教诲，将通过时间的引导来撕裂那些敢于挑战矮人霸权的人们
desc.en: The cumulative teachings of the Ancestors, directed through time to rupture the bodies of those who dare challenge Dawi supremacy.

desc.zh: 至高王始终渴望为他的民众所受的冤屈报仇，他誓要将仇恨之书的全部条目逐一勾销！
desc.en: Long has the High King yearned to avenge the wrongs done to his people by striking clean the entire ledger of the Great Book of Grudges!

desc.zh: 丘陵、森林、荒漠：凡是你能想到的地方，那些帝国的聪明小伙都能设法摆平
desc.en: Hills, forest, desert – you name it, those clever boys from the Empire have got it covered.

desc.zh: 拥有海希标记的法师是光明系法术的操持者，他们驾驭着白色魔法之风，乃是混沌的死敌
desc.en: Those who bear the Mark of Hysh are practitioners of the magical Lore of Light, and the bane of Chaos, for they are able to control and manipulate the White Wind of Magic.

desc.zh: 在许多古代传说中，猩红龙乃是死亡的幽灵，阴险、聪明而致命。在不少种族的眼中，它们都是灾难的预兆
desc.en: Considered spectres of death in many ancient tales, Carmine Dragons are sinister, clever and deadly. To some races, their appearance is an omen that presages disaster.

desc.zh: 经年累月在这个混乱的世界中的跋涉，让埃斯佩斯收集了大量用途各异的魔法物品
desc.en: All manner of useful magical artefacts have been stored by Elspeth over the many, many years she has wound her way through this troubled world.

desc.zh: 末日火戒由黑铁和火焰红宝石制成，其中储存着一个强大的咒语，允许持有者向敌人射出强大的烈焰
desc.en: The Doomfire Ring, made from dark iron and flame rubies, contains a powerful spell that allows its bearer to cast fire upon their enemies.

desc.zh: 这根来自艾索洛伦的附魔树根会给其持有者带来治愈的能力
desc.en: This enchanted root from Athel Loren gifts the power of healing to whomsoever is holding it.

desc.zh: 当这颗宝石镶嵌到武器上时，会令其燃起冰冷的蓝色火焰，烧毁触碰到的一切
desc.en: When brought into contact with this jewel, weapons ignite with ice-cold blue flames that burn anything they touch.

desc.zh: 她得到了女伯爵埃曼纽尔·冯·雷贝维兹的赏识，也就成了个颇有权势之人…
desc.en: She who has the ear of the Countess Emmanuelle von Liebwitz is a powerful person indeed…

desc.zh: 埃斯佩斯虽是神圣的紫晶法师修会的一员，但她强烈的独立精神与对沙许之风的广泛了解使她在同行中出类拔萃
desc.en: Although a member of the hallowed Amethyst Order of Wizards, Elspeth is very much an outlier among her peers for her fierce independence and extensive knowledge of Shyish.

desc.zh: 父母会警告孩子，不要在夜幕降临时误入莫尔花园，因为那里是埃斯佩斯的黑塔所在，据说她的空灵力量会在那里显现出来
desc.en: Parents warn their children about straying into the Gardens of Morr at nightfall, for that is where Elspeth's blackened tower stands, and her ethereal power is said to manifest.

desc.zh: 没人确切知道埃斯佩斯活了多久，甚至都不知道她是否还活着，但她的名字至少游荡在努恩城足足三代人的口耳之中
desc.en: No one knows quite how long Elspeth has lived, or even if she lives at all anymore, but her name has been spoken of in hushed tones by at least three generations of Nulners.

desc.zh: 埃斯佩斯·冯·邓肯的家族有着杰出的施法者天赋，因此他对魔法之风有着超乎常人的敏感
desc.en: Elspeth von Draken comes from an illustrious bloodline of magic-users blessed with increased sensitivity to the Winds of Magic.

desc.zh: 『告诉我，将死之人…你在害怕吗？我可以向你保证，你会怕的』
desc.en: "Tell me dying one… are you afraid? I can assure you, you should be."

desc.zh: 虽然比巴托尼亚同类矮小得多，这些帝国战马仍然披盔戴甲，从而免受那些致命弹丸的袭击
desc.en: Smaller than their powerful Bretonnian equivalents, barding protects Imperial warhorses from blows that would otherwise fell these proud beasts.

desc.zh: 虽然比巴托尼亚同类矮小得多，这些帝国战马仍然披盔戴甲，从而免受那些致命弹丸的袭击
desc.en: Smaller than their powerful Bretonnian equivalents, barding protects Imperial warhorses from blows that would otherwise fell these proud beasts.

desc.zh: 凭借强大的发条机制，这件类似战马的装置可以摧毁大多数挡在前进道路上的东西
desc.en: With its powerful clockwork mechanism, this bucking equine contraption can demolish most things that suffer the impact of being in its rider’s path.

desc.zh: 只需出现在附近，黄金法师就能使盟友的盔甲变得如同出自最有天赋的铁匠之手般坚硬
desc.en: By simply being near, the Gold Wizard hardens allied armour as if it had been tempered by the most gifted blacksmiths.

desc.zh: 一些古老的魔法可以呼唤野性，召唤大自然中最为天成的掠食者来帮助法师
desc.en: Some ancient magic can call upon the wild, summoning nature's most natural predators to a Wizard's aid.

desc.zh: 『告诉我，将死之人…你在害怕吗？我可以向你保证，你会怕的』
desc.en: "Tell me dying one… are you afraid? I can assure you, you should be."

desc.zh: 烈焰大师必须学会在保护盟友不受伤害的同时，将愤怒引向敌人
desc.en: A master of the flame learns to channel their anger towards their enemies while shielding their allies from harm.

desc.zh: 只需出现在附近，黄金法师就能使盟友的盔甲变得如同出自最有天赋的铁匠之手般坚硬
desc.en: By simply being near, the Gold Wizard hardens allied armour as if it had been tempered by the most gifted blacksmiths.

desc.zh: 任何军队都不会拒绝天空法师的协助，他们对星辰的掌握有助于预测麻烦将会爆发于何方
desc.en: A Celestial Wizard is a welcome addition to any army, for their mastery of the stars allows them to predict where trouble might strike.

desc.zh: 翡翠学院教导自然的力量，以及该如何挖掘其无尽的耐力储备
desc.en: The Jade Order teaches of nature's power, and how to tap into its endless reserves of endurance.

desc.zh: 当黑暗与腐蚀渗透整片大地，必须照耀出最为明亮的光明，方能净化所有阴影
desc.en: Where darkness and corruption seep across the land, light must shine the brightest, purifying every shadow.

desc.zh: 有些法师会披上黑暗，将自己笼罩在阴影之中，以更好地追踪敌人
desc.en: Some Wizards sink into darkness like a shroud, enveloping themselves in shadow to better stalk their foes.

desc.zh: 在经历了无数个小时的学习以钻研奥秘的手册和古老的、满是灰尘的典籍之后，现在自然而然地会对法术有所精通
desc.en: After myriad hours of study, poring over arcane manuals and ancient, dusty tomes, mastery of spells now comes naturally.

desc.zh: 在经历了无数个小时的学习以钻研奥秘的手册和古老的、满是灰尘的典籍之后，现在自然而然地会对法术有所精通
desc.en: After myriad hours of study, poring over arcane manuals and ancient, dusty tomes, mastery of spells now comes naturally.

desc.en: After myriad hours of study, poring over arcane manuals and ancient, dusty tomes, mastery of spells now comes naturally.

desc.en: After myriad hours of study, poring over arcane manuals and ancient, dusty tomes, mastery of spells now comes naturally.

desc.zh: 有关古老智慧的知识往往使得法师们身居要位，这也能让他们建立起帝国与疆外之地的联系
desc.en: Knowledge of ancient wisdoms often places Wizards into positions of great importance, enabling them to make connections across the Empire and foreign lands too.

desc.zh: 毫无疑问，这个法师已经用了很多年来磨练自己的技艺，然而学习是无止境的
desc.en: This Wizard has undoubtedly studied for many years to hone their craft, but there's always more to learn.

desc.zh: 毫无疑问，这个法师已经用了很多年来磨练自己的技艺，然而学习是无止境的
desc.en: This Wizard has undoubtedly studied for many years to hone their craft, but there's always more to learn.
