desc.en: This Wizard has undoubtedly studied for many years to hone their craft, but there's always more to learn.

desc.zh: 与那些躲在摇摇欲坠的塔楼里的老朽瘦弱的形象截然不同的是，战斗法师必须是具备体能与力量，训练有素的典范
desc.en: Far from the frail and willowy image of decrepit old men secreted away in crumbling towers, Battle Wizards must be exemplars of well-honed athleticism and strength.

desc.zh: 作为帝国学院的毕业生，此人精通应对敌人的肉搏战。那么，与恶魔过招也是大同小异的，对吧？
desc.en: As a graduate of the Imperial Colleges, this one is well versed in man-to-man combat. The principle has to be the same for man-to-Daemon, right?

desc.zh: 这位坚强的战士不仅学会了保护自己，也学会了保护周围的人
desc.en: This hardened warrior has learnt to not only protect themselves, but those around them also.

desc.zh: 此人已经对战斗技巧小有心得，甚至青出于蓝，这意味着他非常清楚应该如何，以及在何时发出致命一击
desc.en: This one has seen his fair share of combat – more, even, which means he knows exactly how and when to deliver the deathblow.

desc.zh: 此人经常身先士卒地率领骑兵冲锋，连他信任的下属都被抛在了后面！
desc.en: This one is often found leading a mounted charge from the front, with trusted subordinates left behind in their wake!

desc.zh: 此人是民众的一员，他和他的士兵一起在前线战斗，这大大增加了下属的斗志
desc.en: A man of the people, this one fights on the frontline among his men, increasing their eagerness for the battle.

desc.zh: 铲除并摧毁绿皮、混沌的奴仆、以及使用腐蚀魔法之人，无论他们藏身何处
desc.en: Root out and destroy Greenskins, the servants of Chaos, and those who use corrupt magic, wherever they may hide.

desc.zh: 行于阴影，侍奉光明
desc.en: Move in the shadows to serve the light.

desc.zh: 当追踪猎物之时，月光是最好的助力
desc.en: When tracking one's prey, best stick to the light of the moon.

desc.zh: 永不让步，绝不越界，因为每一条帝国命令都是法律
desc.en: Never back down, and never step out of line, for every Imperial order is law.

desc.zh: 帝国猎巫人已参与诸多葬礼…大多都是受害者的自作自受
desc.en: The Imperial Witch Hunters have attended many funerals… mostly for their own victims.

desc.zh: 唯有火刑架是他们的救赎…
desc.en: Their only saviour shall be the stake…

desc.zh: 别吝惜让你的子弹来检查他们是不是真死透了
desc.en: Don't be stingy with your bullets if you're not sure they're really *dead* dead.

desc.zh: 对于这一不稳定的工作而言，增添几层额外的阻燃材料显然是明治的预防措施
desc.en: Extra layers of flame retardant material are a sensible precaution for a volatile job.

desc.zh: 『退后，从远处打他们…那些蠢货永远也料不到这一攻击！』
desc.en: "Stand back and hit 'em from afar… The fools will never see it coming!"

desc.zh: 『退后，从远处打他们…那些蠢货永远也料不到这一攻击！』
desc.en: "Stand back and hit 'em from afar… The fools will never see it coming!"

desc.zh: 创新是成功的第一步；剩下的就要靠幸存的测试用例了
desc.en: Innovation is the first step to success; the rest requires surviving test-cases.

desc.zh: 凭借着木制支架和坚固的石料，再加上一丁点技巧，高耸的建筑便能拔地而起了
desc.en: By wooden frame and solid stone, and more than a modicum of skills, towering structures shall rise up out of the earth.

desc.zh: 金属的呻吟和火炮的轰鸣会让人心烦意乱，但对某些人而言，这种声音却听起来…就像到家了一样
desc.en: The groaning of metal and booming of artillery is distracting to say the least, but to some it sounds like... home.

desc.zh: 金属的呻吟和火炮的轰鸣会让人心烦意乱，但对某些人而言，这种声音却听起来…就像到家了一样
desc.en: The groaning of metal and booming of artillery is distracting to say the least, but to some it sounds like... home.

desc.zh: 『可以肯定的是，那些墙非常坚固。而我还是能把它们摧毁』
desc.en: "Those walls are solid and sturdy, to be sure. I'll bring 'em down all the same."

desc.zh: 作为一名身经百战的老兵，他渴望着杀戮与鲜血
desc.en: A veteran of countless battles, this one has a hunger for slaughter and a thirst for blood.

desc.zh: 只有久经沙场的老兵才能荣升将军一职
desc.en: One doesn't reach the rank of General without having survived many a battle.

desc.zh: 此人的诸多英勇事迹在整个帝国广受赞誉，他在激烈战斗中的力量与决心早已成为了人们的饭后谈资
desc.en: This one's many courageous deeds are celebrated far and wide across the Empire, with many speaking of their might and determination in the very thick of battle.

desc.zh: 帝国的锋刃就像无数的餐刀切过无数的肉质黄油
desc.en: The blades of the Empire slice through the enemy like so many knives through so much fleshy butter.

desc.zh: 勇气、责任、荣誉——然而没有纪律，一切都毫无意义。这位指挥官要求他们的部队接受完备的训练，以便他们顽强对抗帝国最黑暗的敌人
desc.en: Courage, duty, honour – all meaningless without discipline. This commander demands their troops be perfectly drilled, that they may stand fast against even the darkest of the Empire's foes.

desc.zh: 在将军的带领下，帝国的骑兵以极大的热情投入战斗
desc.en: With their general at its head, the Empire's cavalry charge into battle with great zeal.

desc.zh: 拥有身居帝国高位的朋友正是益处多多，所谓多个朋友多条路…
desc.en: Having friends in the high places of Imperial society has its benefits. It's always *who* you know...

desc.zh: 此人受到了整支军队的尊崇，这支军队的成员来自天南地北，只为与其并肩而战
desc.en: This one is loved and respected by their troops, many of whom have come from all over the world to fight at their side.

desc.zh: 虽然比巴托尼亚同类矮小得多，这些帝国战马仍然披盔戴甲，从而免受那些致命弹丸的袭击
desc.en: Smaller than their powerful Bretonnian equivalents, barding protects Imperial warhorses from blows that would otherwise fell these proud beasts.

desc.zh: 一位工程师能制造出足够强大的机器来对抗敌人向他们投来的任何东西。好吧，理论上如此…
desc.en: An Engineer can create machines powerful enough to counter anything the foe can throw at them. Well, that's the theory anyway…

desc.zh: 凭借强大的发条机制，这件类似战马的装置可以摧毁大多数挡在前进道路上的东西
desc.en: With its powerful clockwork mechanism, this bucking equine contraption can demolish most things that suffer the impact of being in its rider’s path.

desc.zh: 帝国的工程师知道如何最好地校准他们的武器来增加射程
desc.en: The Empire's Engineers know how best to calibrate their weapons for increased range.

desc.zh: 只要是能射向敌人的东西，这个人就能发掘出它的设计与用途
desc.en: If it can be shot at the foe, this one knows everything apposite about its design and use.

desc.zh: 此人谦逊内敛，但实力不可小觑。即使是一枚硬币的碎屑，在他的手里也可以夺人性命
desc.en: Although always a force to be reckoned with, this generally quiet, unassuming man of learning can turn on the head of a coin into an expert killer.

desc.zh: 无论工程大师需要什么，他都能得到。军需官很少会拒绝来自行会工程师的要求
desc.en: If a Master Engineer wants something, he'll get it. Quartermasters can rarely refuse a demanding Guild engineer.

desc.zh: 即使是工程师，只要可以指挥一辆蒸汽坦克，他也能主宰战场，熟练地在轮式活塞和蒸汽武器之间控制压力蒸汽的微妙平衡
desc.en: Granted command of a Steam Tank, even an Engineer can dominate a battlefield, expertly striking the delicate balance of directing pressured steam between wheel-pistons and steam-belching weapons.

desc.zh: 使用火药需要很大的耐心。一个错误的动作就会葬送你扣扳机的手指…甚至更多！
desc.en: Working with gunpowder takes alot of patience... one wrong move and you might lose your trigger finger... or more!

desc.zh: 工程大师从来没有空闲时间，因为他们的任何空闲都要花在埋头研究原理图，从而完善设计上
desc.en: There is never a spare moment for a Master Engineer – any free time is spent buried in schematics diagrams in order to perfect their designs.

desc.zh: 真正的大师知道不止一种打败敌人的方法：比如说，被附近的爆炸狠狠抛到地上，这足以让许多人迷失方向、丧失听力，从而失去防御能力
desc.en: A true master knows there is more than one way to defeat your enemies. Being thrown off your feat by a nearby blast is enough to leave many disorientated, deaf and defenceless.

desc.zh: 工程大师的服装必须能够有效地防备火灾与弹片，因为即使失败的实验不会伤害他们，那么四散的设备碎片也肯定会的！
desc.en: A Master Engineer's garments must be extremely resistant to both fire and ballistics, because if a failed experiment doesn't get them, the apparatus that comes flying at them afterwards surely will!

desc.zh: 工程师的能力不仅是制造战争机器而已。几个月的设计和创新得到了回报，现在你的定向能力得到了加强
desc.en: An Engineer doesn't just make machines of war. Months of design and innovation have paid off, and now your navigators reap the benefit.

desc.zh: 帝国的机器难免会出现故障，但幸运的是，只要附近有工程大师的身影，它们的故障肯定不会持续太久
desc.en: The machines of the Empire aren't immune to failure, but luckily with a Master Engineer nearby, they rarely stay broken for long.

desc.zh: 还有什么会比给你的火力上再加一把火更好的呢？就算目标挺过了最开始的冲击，这些燃烧弹也能把他们点燃！
desc.en: What better way to increase your firepower than with.. fire?! These firebombs will set ablaze all who survive the initial blast.

desc.zh: 布鲁克纳选择的坐骑既能播撒恐惧，又能灌输信心。这头强大的半狮鹫会载着主人穿过战场
desc.en: Bruckner's chosen mount both strikes fear and instils confidence, as the mighty Demigryph bounds across the battlefield at its master's behest.

desc.zh: 当帝国贵族们经历古老的战斗审判仪式时，女伯爵的司法冠军便是他的裁决之犬
desc.en: The Countess' Hound of Judgement is her Judicial Champion when the ancient rite of trial-by-combat is invoked within the Imperial aristocracy.

desc.zh: 无论是因为他的庞大身材，还是他过去的诸多事迹，总之，几乎没人不会在他的面前自觉表现出敬畏之情…
desc.en: Whether it's his hulking frame, or the many stories of his past deeds, but few can stand in this one's presence without feeling a little awestruck.

desc.zh: 布鲁克纳并不需要携带武器，因为他的躯体就是自己的武器
desc.en: Bruckner doesn't really need a sword because his body is a weapon in its own right.

desc.zh: 布鲁克纳强大的半狮鹫，比骑士团的标准坐骑还要大。它会遵从主人的命令驰骋战场，播撒恐惧，激励军心
desc.en: Bruckner’s mighty Demigryph, larger than the Knightly Order's standard stock, strikes fear and instils confidence as it dominates the battlefield at its master’s behest.

desc.zh: 作为努恩的官方刽子手和女伯爵埃曼纽尔的私人冠军，西奥多·布鲁克纳被大众称为审判猎犬，这便源于他对伸张血腥正义的坚持
desc.en: As Nuln's official headsman and Countess Emmanuelle's personal champion, Theodore Bruckner is known colloquially as the Hound of Judgement, such is his tenacity to see bloody justice done.

desc.zh: 『无人知晓他来自何处…』
desc.en: "Where he comes from, nobody knows…"

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 帝国飞马是高贵的带翼马，既聪明又忠诚
desc.en: An Imperial pegasus is a noble, winged steed, intelligent and loyal.

desc.zh: 这位坚强的战士不仅学会了保护自己，也学会了保护周围的人
desc.en: This hardened warrior has learnt to not only protect themselves, but those around them also.

desc.zh: 凯兹克可能是祖父神最宠爱的人：他很久以前就失去了所有的感觉，却让他的躯体获得了拔群的恢复能力
desc.en: As possibly the most blessed of all Grandfather's favoured, Kayzk long ago lost all form and feeling, which has given him a certain physical resilience.

desc.zh: 这位矮人严格遵守工程师行会的所有原则，这就是他对自己手艺的虔诚之心
desc.en: This Dawi follows all the tenets of the Engineers' Guild to the very letter, such is his dedication to his craft.

desc.zh: 此人的双手总是忙着摆弄各种精巧的装置，而看在他总是能捣鼓出无可争辩的硕果的份上，他的同伴们就只有忍受的份儿了
desc.en: This one's hands are always busy working on this contraption or that; his fellow Dawi put up with it because the results of his tinkering simply cannot be argued with.

desc.zh: 这位矮人每晚都会喝下与自己体重相当的伯格曼佳酿！幸运的是，他对民众进步事业的衷心完全可以媲美自己的酒量
desc.en: Fortunately, this Dawi is just as dedicated to the advancement of his people as he is to drinking his own body weight, and yours, in Bugman's Best every night.

desc.zh: 作为阅尽春秋、见多识广的矮人元老，此人是矮人城塞中最受尊敬的人物之一
desc.en: As a Dawi elder statesman, who has lived long and seen much, this one is one of the most respected figures in his Hold.

desc.zh: 坚强，忍耐，这就是每个好矮人应具备的美德
desc.en: Stout and sturdy, as every good Dawi should be.

desc.zh: 这位矮人将自己的一生都献给了消弭仇恨之书条目的事业
desc.en: This Dawi who has dedicated his life to ticking off as many entries from the Book of Grudges as is Dwarfly possible.

desc.zh: 这个富有进取精神的矮人与当地的游侠一起度过了一段时光，借此学到了许多技能
desc.en: This enterprising Dawi has spent some time with his local band of Rangers and has learned many of their skills for himself.

desc.zh: 当漫步城塞之间，或者与其它家族共同奋斗时，有钱的矮人氏族可以为自己买到额外的防护装备
desc.en: The more moneyed Dawi Clans are able to pay for extra protection when marching between Holds or on campaign with a Throng.

desc.zh: 这位精通符文的矮人可以将血脉追溯到桑格尼，即符文魔法与符文铸造之神的身上
desc.en: This Dawi master of the runes can trace his lineage back to Thungni, God of Runic Magic and Runesmithing.

desc.zh: 此人天生敏捷过人。对于矮人来说，这可是个难能可贵的品质，也是此人解决仇怨时的一项非常重要的先天优势
desc.en: A rather unusual trait for a Dawi, but this one make great use of his natural sprightly dexterity when settling grudges.

desc.zh: 老兵的过世会是其所在城塞的一项巨大损失，但他们可能会把自己的杰作留给富有潜力的继任或后代，从而将自己的事业传承下去
desc.en: It is always a great loss to a Hold when a veteran passes, but they may leave their masterwork az to a worthy successor or descendant, that their important work may continue.

desc.zh: 埃斯佩斯·冯·邓肯是个充满神秘力量的女人，她的过往隐藏在了阴森的神秘与威胁之中…甚至可以说，那并非过往，而是当下
desc.en: Elspeth von Draken is a woman brimming with arcane power, whose past – and indeed present – is shrouded in ever-deeper layers of enticing mystery and menacing threat.

desc.zh: 西奥多·布鲁克纳是血腥审判的化身。当法律要求以严苛的方式赔偿对国家犯下的罪行时，他非常擅长收割大量的人头
desc.en: Theodore Bruckner is the embodiment of bloody-handed judgment and a prolific taker of heads, should the law require such a manner of restitution for crimes committed against the state.

desc.zh: 尽管菲利克斯一直只想过平静的生活，但他最终还是向高崔克发了血誓，成了高崔克那追寻自己的光荣末日的屠夫任务中的伙伴
desc.en: Despite only ever really wanting a quiet life, Felix ended up swearing a blood-oath to Gotrek, becoming his companion on the Slayer's quest to find his own, personal glorious doom.

desc.zh: 对许多人而言，这是一个根深蒂固的矛盾，但对一些人而言，这则是救赎的象征
desc.en: To many, a rooted contradiction, to some, salvation personified.

desc.zh: 这位神选纳垢计患官是祖父神所有信徒眼中的目标，因为他不断增加的案牍工作便是苍蝇领主力量的具象表现
desc.en: The chosen Tallyman of Nurgle is a sight to behold for all the Urfather's followers, his evergrowing paperwork illustrating the Fly Lord's power.

desc.zh: 无数开放的伤口流出溃烂的脓汁，大大加快了纳垢恶臭瘟疫的感染传播速度
desc.en: Myriad open sores weep with festering, foetid pus, enabling Neiglen's foul plagues to infect quickly and spread faster than before.

desc.zh: 此人来自哪个物种还有待讨论，因为他们的特征早就因祖父神纳垢的爱抚而面目全非
desc.en: From which species this one comes is very much open to question, so distorted have their features become through Grandfather Nurgle's loving caresses.

desc.zh: 若是有什么瘟疫、疾病、恶疾、感染与流行病是这个人所不知道的，那只能说明它没有为人所知的价值
desc.en: What this one doesn't know about plagues, diseases, contagions, maladies, infections and epidemics simply isn't worth knowing.

desc.zh: 这种讨厌的小造物不知从何而来。它传播着最邪恶的瘟疫，可怕的泡沫，以及骇人的死亡，遍及整个大陆
desc.en: This nasty little concoction came from no one knows quite whence to spread the vilest pestilence, horrific, weeping buboes, and a terrifying, screaming death to all across the land.

desc.zh: 弓箭，炮弹，以及更为先进的弹药：当战争永无休止时，多少也不嫌多哪
desc.en: Arrows, cannonballs and more esoteric munitions – you can never have too many when the war never ends.

desc.zh: 毁灭大军的可怕乘舆不仅是战争机器，还是地位与权力的象征
desc.en: The dread carriages of the Ruinous hosts are more than just machines of war; they are symbols of status and power.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 这匹卑劣、残废的坐骑带着它的骑手冲进战斗最激烈的地方。在那里，因腐烂而流出的脓液会严密地封住它癌变肉体上的任何伤口
desc.en: This vile, mutilated steed bears its rider into the very thick of battle, where any wounds scored upon its cancerous flesh are sealed by the pus weeping from its foetid body.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 这匹卑劣、残废的坐骑带着它的骑手冲进战斗最激烈的地方。在那里，因腐烂而流出的脓液会严密地封住它癌变肉体上的任何伤口
desc.en: This vile, mutilated steed bears its rider into the very thick of battle, where any wounds scored upon its cancerous flesh are sealed by the pus weeping from its foetid body.

desc.zh: 巨大的移动祭坛，可以将战场上牺牲者的灵魂直接以邪恶的仪式进行献祭
desc.en: A vast, mobile altar allows the souls of the slain to be ritualistically condemned directly from the field of slaughter.

desc.zh: 这匹卑劣、残废的坐骑带着它的骑手冲进战斗最激烈的地方。在那里，因腐烂而流出的脓液会严密地封住它癌变肉体上的任何伤口
desc.en: This vile, mutilated steed bears its rider into the very thick of battle, where any wounds scored upon its cancerous flesh are sealed by the pus weeping from its foetid body.

desc.en: This vile, mutilated steed bears its rider into the very thick of battle, where any wounds scored upon its cancerous flesh are sealed by the pus weeping from its foetid body.

desc.en: This vile, mutilated steed bears its rider into the very thick of battle, where any wounds scored upon its cancerous flesh are sealed by the pus weeping from its foetid body.

desc.en: A vast, mobile altar allows the souls of the slain to be ritualistically condemned directly from the field of slaughter.
