desc.en: This vile, mutilated steed bears its rider into the very thick of battle, where any wounds scored upon its cancerous flesh are sealed by the pus weeping from its foetid body.

desc.zh: 多年的冒险和一路上的披荆斩棘，使得菲利克斯步伐稳健，难以击败
desc.en: Years of adventure and the many dangers faced along the way have made Felix fast on his feet and hard to pin down.

desc.zh: 尽管这是一次差点淹死他的遭遇，但菲利克斯最终还是击倒了一头强大的火龙，这也教会了他刺穿最强大的兽皮的方法
desc.en: Despite almost drowning in the encounter, felling a mighty Flame-Drake taught Felix how to pierce even the mightiest of hides.

desc.zh: 无穷无尽的训练，更重要的是无数的战斗，令菲利克斯得以娴熟地挥动自己的符文剑卡拉古尔，日臻化境
desc.en: Seemingly endless drills – and more importantly, numerous battles – has accustomed Felix to deadly use of his Rune Sword Karaghul, which he wields with ever-burgeoning skill.

desc.zh: 两把利刃绝对比一把要强得多——双倍的攻击，使快速终结敌人性命的数量加倍
desc.en: Two blades are infinitely better than one - twice the attack, double the number of fell lives unceremoniously ended.

desc.zh: 菲利克斯有能力让任何人都目不转睛，这与你是否亲眼目睹过毫无关系
desc.en: You've either got it or you haven't, and Felix is capable of dazzling anyone and everyone.

desc.zh: 一回想起克莉丝汀曾死于曼弗雷德之手，菲利克斯·耶格的内心深处便涌起了一股凶残的恨意
desc.en: Remembering Kirsten's death at Manfred's hands stirs a lethal ferocity deep within Felix Jaeger.

desc.zh: 作为一名矮人屠夫的同伴，菲利克斯经常发现自己不得不扮演外交官的角色，利用他天生的魅力四处冒险，而无需激怒当地人
desc.en: Being as he is the companion of a Dwarf Slayer, Felix often finds himself having to adopt more diplomatic role, using his natural charisma to venture where he wishes without angering the locals.

desc.zh: 菲利克斯以前曾任职门卫，这让他能敏锐地察觉到不速之客的到来
desc.en: His prior work as a doorman has given Felix a keen sense of when an unwanted guest has arrived.

desc.zh: 在荣誉和责任感的指引下，记录者必须陪在他同伴身旁，直至他同伴那杀戮一生的最后一刻
desc.en: Guided by either a sense of honour or duty from his oath, the Rememberer must be present until the last moment of his companion's murderous life.

desc.zh: 嗅觉和经验是成功处理退化鼠人所带来的瘟疫的关键
desc.en: Successfully dealing with plagues of degenerate Ratmen requires both nouse and experience.

desc.zh: 他们在旅途中甚至击败了最强大的恶魔，而这竟然成为了他们的家常便饭
desc.en: Even the greatest of Daemons have been defeated on their travels, and oft-times by one such as this.

desc.zh: 在不经意的看客眼中，野兽人不过是逃得飞快而已，他们通常是群组织散漫的乌合之众。然而事实远非如此：它们既狡猾又敏捷
desc.en: To the casual observer, usually while running away very fast, the Beastmen are a disorganised, inept rabble. Yet nothing could be further from the truth – they are both cunning and swift.

desc.zh: 当面对兽人时，不要让他们的体型吓到你，而是要尽可能地利用他们缺乏速度与纪律的劣势
desc.en: When you face an Orc, don't let their size intimidate you – simply take immediate advantage of their lack of speed and discipline.

desc.zh: 『当尖耳朵们放箭时，我们就在箭雨的阴影下战斗！』
desc.en: "When the pointy-ears fire their arrows, we will fight in the shade!"

desc.zh: 『很简单，只要脑袋离开脖子就搞定了。一劳永逸！』
desc.en: "It's simple – when the head comes away from the neck, it's over. For good this time!"

desc.zh: 在屠夫眼中，最好的防御便是不去防御
desc.en: The best form of defence is rarely defence, in the eyes of a Slayer.

desc.zh: 高崔克从不四处乱闯，而是会在战场上迅速移动，以寻找配得上他末日的敌手
desc.en: Never one to faff around, Gotrek moves swiftly across the battlefield to find foes worthy of his doom.

desc.zh: 可悲且不光彩的结局，可不足以让最伟大的屠夫死去
desc.en: A pathetic, ignominious doom is not enough for the greatest Slayer yet to die.

desc.zh: 多场战斗的磨砺已让这位战士坚毅无比，他的皮肤变得如同龙鳞一样坚硬
desc.en: Many blows over many battles have hardened this warrior beyond compare, making his hide as tough as Dragon scales.

desc.zh: 高崔克对自己的高贵死亡仍未到来而感到愤怒，他决定要比任何人都先冲向敌人
desc.en: Incensed that his noble death has not yet presented itself, Gotrek is determined to get to the enemy before anyone else.

desc.zh: 矮人跑得不快，但他们会勇往直前，无论遭遇什么危险，都会迎难而上
desc.en: Dwarfs are not fast, yet they will soldier on, always moving despite the hazards encountered.

desc.zh: 所有投身屠夫教派之人都注定要追随葛林姆尼尔的命运：唯一的问题只是何时到来，而不是会不会到来
desc.en: All those within the Slayer Cult are doomed to follow Grimnir's fate; it is only a question of when, not if.

desc.zh: 『棒极了！该收钱了！』
desc.en: "Excellent! Time to get paid!"

desc.zh: 当没有什么可以杀的时候，最伟大的屠夫又要做些什么呢？
desc.en: What is the greatest Slayer of them all to do when there's nothing left to kill?

desc.zh: 作为经验丰富的冒险家，高崔克见识过很多地方，遇到过许多敌手。现在，即便最凶猛的一击对这名屠夫也不过是擦伤而已
desc.en: An experienced adventurer, Gotrek has seen many lands and faced many foes. Now, even the mightiest of blows are nought but a scratch for the Slayer.

desc.zh: 高崔克已是位战斗经验非常丰富的战士，甚至不再在战斗中流汗。这种毫不费力的感觉只会让敌人那可悲的非矮人心脏恐惧不已
desc.en: Gotrek no longer breaks a sweat in battle, so seasoned a warrior is he. This perceived lack of effort strikes fear into the foe's pathetic un-Dawi hearts.

desc.zh: 若是有人身强体壮，足以驯服残暴的剃刀兽，便可将其套上战车，奔赴战场
desc.en: Those strong enough to tame the powerful, unruly Razorgors can harness them for chariots.

desc.zh: 这些好斗又顽固的巨兽拉着摇摇欲散的战车，它们的模样就像是巨大的野猪与强横的公羊的杂交产物
desc.en: Pugnacious and stubborn, the war beasts that pull these ramshackle chariots are grotesque combinations of great boar and mighty ram.

desc.zh: 毁灭大军的可怕乘舆不仅是战争机器，还是地位与权力的象征
desc.en: The dread carriages of the Ruinous hosts are more than just machines of war; they are symbols of status and power.

desc.zh: 曾经高傲威严的猛兽，如今却变成堕落腐化的怪物，它们现在是混沌领主的坐骑，它们现在名为双头混沌巨龙
desc.en: Once proud and majestic beasts, but now corrupted, malevolent creatures who bear a Chaos Lord into battle – they are the twin-headed Dragons of Chaos.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向了敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the spellcaster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 虽然为野兽人锻造盔甲有些不切实际，但它们可以穿戴上从最高的树上剥下来的厚重树皮，这也可以提供合理的保护
desc.en: While forging armour for Beastmen would be impractical, they can be clad in thick bark stripped from the tallest of trees, which offers a reasonable level of protection.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满非常善于刺激战兽，这样，它们就能做出人们所能想到的最恶毒行为
desc.en: The Bray Shaman is a master at goading his beasts into the most vicious action imaginable.

desc.zh: 躲在人类森林中的变种人也被吸引到了塔木尔可汗的旗下，这便是实力所带来的声望
desc.en: The mutants that cower in humanity's forests are drawn to Tamurkhan's banner, such is his reputation for strength.

desc.zh: 由于害怕被塔木尔可汗碾压，三重角开始传播纳垢腐蚀以安抚慈父当下的偏爱之人
desc.en: Fearing being crushed by Tamurkhan, the Three-Horn spreads Nurglish corruption to appease the Urfather's favoured one.

desc.zh: 工人越多，金库越鼓
desc.en: The greater the number of Labourers, the more your coffers will swell.

desc.zh: 能花的钱越多，养活的劳工就越多
desc.en: The more you have available to spend, the greater the number of Labourers you can support.

desc.zh: 有了似乎永不停歇的补给列车，这位炼狱堡主的粗壮指尖就按住了他所需要的所有火力
desc.en: With a seemingly never-ending supply train, this Infernal Castellan has all the firepower he needs at his stumpy, armoured fingertips.

desc.zh: 塔木尔可汗的进军为贪婪衰朽的扎尔矮人带来了财富：果然，他们首都里的所有人都渴望着利益
desc.en: Tamurkhan's march promises much wealth for the greedy, corrupt Dawi-Zharr; unsurprisingly, all at their capital are eager to profit.

desc.zh: 有了足够大口径的武器，充足的弹药供应，以及技艺高超的射手，无论是多么巨大的目标都会粉身碎骨
desc.en: With a weapon of sufficiently high calibre, a ready supply of ammunition, and no small amount of skill from the shooter, no target is too large to be brought down.

desc.zh: 最优秀的战士不会在战斗中感到疲惫，他们只会更加愤怒，以更加野蛮的方式进行战斗
desc.en: The very best warriors don't tire in battle, they just get angrier, and fight with even greater savagery.

desc.zh: 喀尔甘对杀戮有着疯狂的爱，而杀戮会让喀尔甘更加疯狂！这便是一种实至名归的恶性循环…
desc.en: Khargan is crazy for killing, yet killing makes Khargan crazy! It's the literal definition of a vicious circle…

desc.zh: 这样的暴力是近乎极致的疯狂，『狂暴』根本不足以形容其程度
desc.en: Violence bordering on absolute delirium; 'berserk' doesn't even come close.

desc.zh: 有些战士只想追随某个疯子从而变得恶名昭著，而不会关心随之而来的必然后果
desc.en: Some warriors just want to follow a madman into infamy, and do not care about the inevitable consequences that will follow.

desc.zh: 依靠着强大的邪恶魔法，恢复者甚至可以治愈连巨魔的再生能力也无法愈合的伤口
desc.en: With minacious magics galore, the Restorer can heal even gaping, sucking wounds beyond the limits of a Troll's natural regenerative capabilities.

desc.zh: 如果一把能飞的魔法切肉刀还不够用…
desc.en: When a flying magical cleaver just isn't enough...

desc.zh: 有时被称为恢复者的凯扎克·费米迪拉赫是一位有着奇特力量的沼栖妖男萨满。在这个愚昧的种族里，每一代人中只会出现一位拥有这种力量的人
desc.en: Sometimes called the Restorer, the Ketzak Fimdirach is a male Fimir shaman of singular power, seen only once in a generation among his benighted species.

desc.zh: 凯扎克·费米迪拉赫的朋友便是所有沼栖妖的朋友，也是那些生活在洞穴与沼泽里，远离人类视野的肮胀之物的朋友
desc.en: A friend of the Ketzak Fimdirach is a friend of all Fimir, and of fouler things which live in the caves and swamps, far from prying, human eyes.

desc.zh: 因为击杀了恐怖的怪物斯卡瑞斯布恩，哀丧嚎叫赢得了北方人的敬畏与尊重
desc.en: For slaying the dread beast Skraelsbane, Mournhowl is feared and respected by the Northmen.

desc.zh: 虽然哀丧嚎叫已经满足了自己的复仇欲望，他杀死了那头击杀其家人的怪物，但复仇之火一旦点燃便不会轻易熄灭
desc.en: Though Mournhowl has sated his hunger for revenge on the beast that slew his family, the fires of retribution are not so easily doused once alight.

desc.zh: 尽管有着狼的外表，但这位狼人酋长仍保留着一颗人类的心，尤其是在他咆哮着讲述自己的悲伤故事之时
desc.en: Though lupine in aspect, the Werekin Chieftain retains the heart of a man as he growls his mournful tale.

desc.zh: 一群人皮狼发出的可怕嚎叫，足以让任何因害怕到大脑空白的敌人瘫软在地
desc.en: The terrifying, echoing howls of a cadre of Skin Wolves are enough to cripple any foe with fearful indecision.

desc.zh: 虽然曾经是个人类，但狼人酋长却获得了狼的狡猾。因而，那些能与他的狼性凶猛媲美的怪物都愿意随他一同战斗
desc.en: Though once a man in aspect, the Werekin Chieftain has gained the cunning of a wolf – absolutely haring into the fray alongside monsters that can match his lupine ferocity.

desc.zh: 这些绝非普通子弹，它们在哈苏特翻腾的熔岩烈火中锻造而成，射程更远并会在接触时爆炸
desc.en: These are no ordinary bullets, for they have been forged in Hashut's roiling, molten fires, going further and exploding on contact.

desc.zh: 『玷污者』凯兹克已被苍蝇领主以无可理解的方式腐化并扭曲了全身上下的方方面面，他的诨号便是如此得来的
desc.en: Kayzk the Befouled is so named because the Fly Lord has corrupted and distorted each and every aspect of his being in ways that no one can truly comprehend.

desc.zh: 库尔甘冠军勇士有着无可阻碍的毁灭热情，而这股热情相当具备感染力…
desc.en: The Kurgan Champion's unquenchable fiery ardour for his Ruinous work is quite literally infectious…

desc.zh: 这头被称为布勃博洛斯的蟾蜍龙是头巨大而肮胀的爬虫类恐怖怪物，它的实力就与它那永恒的贪婪一样恐怖
desc.en: An impossibly large and foul reptilian horror, the Toad Dragon known as Bubebolos is as strong as he is perpetually ravenous.

desc.zh: 只有最好的武器和盔甲才配得上这位强壮而高贵的矮人英雄
desc.en: Only the best weapons and armour are good enough for this strong and noble Dawi hero.

desc.zh: 人们总是会把疯狂误认为勇气，因此他们总是会跟随那些表现出自杀式勇气的人步入险境
desc.en: People have a habit of following the suicidally brave into danger, mistaking their madness for courage.

desc.zh: 永不放弃，永不屈服，永不退缩，永不投降，永不让步，永远向前！
desc.en: Never give up, never give in, never retreat, and never, ever surrender. Never give an inch; always move forward.

desc.zh: 此人为了整个矮人一族鞠躬尽瘁，因此他人也在时刻关心他的幸福
desc.en: This one's reputation for great deeds in the service of all Dwarfkind ensures other Dawi always have a care for his wellbeing.

desc.zh: 装备着先祖的武器与护甲，这决定了只有懦夫才会把失败怪罪到装备上去
desc.en: Bearing the arms and wearing the armour of his Ancestors make it quite clear that only a coward and a failure blames his tools.

desc.zh: 对于长期与疫病打交道的人，你几乎无法让他感到不安
desc.en: There’s little you can do to get under the skin of one who has rubbed shoulders with the diseased for so long.

desc.zh: 什么都不要碰，免得会有什么玩意一碰就掉…是的，任何东西都有可能
desc.en: Best not touch, lest something – everything – comes off in your hand.

desc.zh: 你不能无限期地逃避死亡…唔，你应该可以，但一般来说，没有学院的教育是不行的。毕竟大多数人最终都会以这样或那样的方式感受到虚弱的残酷
desc.en: You cannot escape death indefinitely… Well, you can, but not without a College education, generally speaking. Most will eventually feel infirmity's firm cruel grip, one way or another.

desc.zh: 食人魔族类的冠军刽子手，国王与英雄的杀手：他就是『开膛手』布拉格，他要杀的人都不可能逃得一命
desc.en: The champion executioner of Ogrekind and a slayer of kings and heroes; he is Bragg the Gutsman and none he marks for slaughter ever survive.

desc.zh: 作为森林地精中冉冉升起的传奇，斯纳格拉·毒涎在每次绿皮的胜利斗争中都会冲锋在前
desc.en: A rising legend amongst the Forest Goblins, Snagla Grobspit is at the forefront of every Greenskin victory.

desc.zh: 杀戮的欲望时刻刺激着布拉格，正如大胃神就在胃里搅动着他的食欲一样
desc.en: Bragg feels the need to kill calling him as surely as he feels the voracious stirring of the Great Maw in his own belly.

desc.zh: 战斗与屠杀的区别，就在于事后有多少肉可以享用
desc.en: The difference between a battle and a bloodbath is how much meat there is to feast on afterwards.

desc.zh: 布拉格向来都是独来独往，他随时如同人类的刽子手一样戴着黑色的皮兜帽，这就是他最冷酷的形象
desc.en: Where Bragg walks, he walks alone, donning his dark leather hood in the manner of a human hangman to capitalise on his grim persona.

desc.zh: 一旦给打上了死亡标记，此人就必须时刻提防布拉格那笨拙的影子。然而，开膛巨刃何时会抹上他们的脖子，这点又该如何提防呢？
desc.en: Once marked for death, one must prepare for Bragg's lumbering shadow looming into view. What no one can prepare for is the Gutgouger's lunge towards their neck...

desc.zh: 布拉格并无什么战斗技巧可言，因为这种特质与整个食人魔族类完全不搭。然而，他确实有着某种可以随时打出最高额伤害的天赋
desc.en: Bragg does not fight with grace or finesse, for such traits elude all Ogres, but has a natural gift for landing blows with maximum damage.

desc.zh: 早在孩提时期，拿着他的第一把剑随意挥舞的时候，布拉格就展现出了自己对于斩杀的极致天赋
desc.en: Presented with his first blade as a whelp to swing about with wild abandon, Bragg has always shown a great affinity for decapitation.

desc.zh: 拜他那恐怖且阴森的名声所赐，布拉格去哪儿都孑然一身
desc.en: Where Bragg walks, he goes alone – such is his fell, and foul, reputation.

desc.zh: 言出必行的领袖会通过发布恐怖的命令来确保他们的军队不会逃跑
desc.en: Those whose word is law ensure their troops will not run by issuing this dread order.

desc.zh: 作为最大、最强的巨汉，任何部落都欢迎布拉格的加入…当然，直到他背叛自己的食人魔同胞为止！
desc.en: As a great and powerful Bruiser, Bragg is welcomed into any tribe he joins... until he turns on his fellow Ogres, of course!

desc.zh: 这名领主在战场内外的所作所为着实令盟友起敬，同时也令敌人胆寒
desc.en: This Lord's many deeds - both on and off the battlefield - have brought them renown among their allies and made them feared by their enemies.

desc.zh: 战斗可以输，但是战争真的能赢吗？毁灭之力前进的步伐永远不会真正停下
desc.en: Battles can be lost, but can the war ever really be won? The advance of Ruin can never truly be halted once and for all.

desc.zh: 『这些金属碎片里头的魔法够让战将的最新计划大获成功！』
desc.en: "Dere's enuff weird magick in these bits o' metal to make da Warboss' latest scheme go wiv a bang!"

desc.zh: 当受到它们的兽人主子召唤时，这些从孵出后便被驯养的双足飞龙会对Waaagh！立刻做出深入骨髓的反应
desc.en: Hand-reared as hatchlings, tamed Wyverns instantly respond to the bone-deep impulse of the Waaagh! when called by their Orc masters.

desc.zh: 黑兽人是所有绿皮中最大、最强壮、最卑鄙、最残忍、最不讨人喜欢的亚种。针锋相对去吧
desc.en: Black Orcs are the biggest, strongest, meanest, most brutal and least pleasant of all Greenskins. Act accordingly.

desc.zh: 地精们的崛起之道不是通过原始的力量，而是通过纯粹的狡猾，这使他们能够很容易地操控其他人
desc.en: Goblins rise to power not through raw strength, but through their sheer cunning and deviousness, which enables them to manipulate certain others quite easily.

desc.zh: 在沙漠野外生活了很长一段时间后，这位大萨满学到了不少追踪猎物的全新技巧
desc.en: After a prolonged period in the desert wilds, this Great Shaman has developed a new trick or two for tracking and stalking his prey.

desc.zh: 许多大萨满都对学习蜘蛛私语趋之若鹜。不少人因此赔上了性命，留下的只有那些孕育出了与自己的运气一样多的抗蛇毒血清的家伙
desc.en: Many a Great Shaman has perished learning the sought-after art of spider whispering, leaving only those who had as much antivenom as they did luck.

desc.zh: 修行小Waaagh！之术的地精萨满能给他们的军队蒙上一层阴影，从而布置最完美的伏击
desc.en: The Goblin Shamans of the Little Waaagh! can cast a shroud across their army, setting up the most perfect ambushes.

desc.zh: 小Waaagh！法术的卑鄙下作，或者说，精妙毒辣实在令人目瞪口呆。当然，对于站在了这个法术的对立面的人，就更加的目瞪口呆了
desc.en: Little Waaagh! spells are surprisingly sneaky – subtle, even, which is much more surprising for those on the wrong end of one!

desc.zh: 这位大萨满或许自己也曾是一名狼骑兵，因此他特别喜欢骑在这些毛绒绒的家伙背上走入战场
desc.en: It’s possible this Great Shaman may have been a Wolf Rider himself at one point, such is his affinity for the ways of lupine-mounted warfare.

desc.zh: 从世界边缘山脉到恶地，甚至更远的彼方，每一个活着的绿皮都知道，哥巴德的『入侵已经就绪了』！
desc.en: Every living Greenskin from the World Edge's Mountains to the Badlands and beyond knows Gorbad for his "invasions done propa".

desc.zh: 『等他们手忙脚乱，就从两边把他们砸烂！』
desc.en: "Once dere busy, smash 'em from da sides!"

desc.zh: 『站好了，啥靠近就砸烂啥！懂？』
desc.en: "Youse stan' dere an' smash anyfin dat comes close! Gottit?"

desc.zh: 『过来，都过来！俺都寻思好了…』
desc.en: "Gatha 'round, ladz! I gottit all worked out..."

desc.zh: 『Waaaaaggggggghhhhhh！！！』
desc.en: "Waaaaaagggghhhh!"

desc.zh: 虽然哥巴德的小子们很想知道老大的那个什么『核计』是种什么武器，以及他什么时候会使用它，但只要知道他手里有这个玩意，他们就会亢奋起来！
desc.en: Although Gorbad's soldiers occasionally wonder what kind of weapon this "Plan" of his is and when he's going to use it, knowing he has it bolsters their spirits nonetheless.

desc.zh: 『…如果有人说别哒，那就揍他丫一顿证明一下！』
desc.en: "...and if sumbody sez else, smash 'em to prove dat!"

desc.zh: 『别挡着俺！俺要剁碎他们！』
desc.en: "Get behind me, I'll chop 'em apart!"

desc.zh: 『先别冲！先拿箭与石头招呼一轮，等他们死到差不多再上，懂？』
desc.en: "Don't charge in yet, shoot 'em with da arrers an' rocks till dere mostly dead, yeah?"

desc.zh: 『把你杀的那些玩意儿身上的零碎全都挂到这面旗子上，就能显摆出你是最棒的小子了！』
desc.en: "Keep loadin' stuff from yer' killz onta dis banner an' show off tha' your da best boyz!"

desc.zh: 『把最大、最壮的小子找过来，告诉他们有事儿要干啦！』
desc.en: "Find da biggest and tuffest boyz ya can and tell 'em dere's some smashin' to be done!"

desc.zh: 格里姆格对战斗的渴望永无止境。他永远不会被干掉…下一个是谁！
desc.en: Grimgor's desire for battle knows no bounds. He can *never* be slaked... On to da next one!

desc.zh: 『黑兽人不要啥摆设，他们只想去搞让装备更厉害的东西』
desc.en: "Black Orcs don't want no trinkets, jus' anyfing that makes dere battle gear betta."

desc.zh: 对任何自傲的黑兽人而言，能加入格里姆格的不死亲卫队都是一项顶尖的荣誉
desc.en: Any Black Orc worth their pride considers it the highest honour to be part of Grimgor's Immortulz.

desc.zh: 『它们没我的大旗那么幸运，但也能帮忙冲进敌阵！』
desc.en: "Dey ain' as lucky as me big banner, bu' dey'll still 'elp smash inta da enemy!"

desc.zh: 当咕噜召集一场Waaagh！时，各类地精都会群聚到他的旗下，并会献上各类疯狂的装置来取悦这位最伟大的地精
desc.en: When Grom calls a Waaagh!, Goblins of all stripes flock under his banner, bringing loads of crazy contraptions to impress 'da Great 'Un'.

desc.zh: 只有最勇敢的夜地精才能爬上最疯狂的史奎格后背。要想找到这么一个地精光动嘴皮子可不行
desc.en: Only the bravest Night Goblins dare climb on the backs of the wildest Squigs. Finding such a gobbo is easier said than done!

desc.zh: 『没人会在我做完之前看到我，然后，骨头就会烂在石头上！』
desc.en: "None seez 'til I doez the deedz, an' den dem bonez will rot on da stonez!"

desc.zh: 见过夜地精首领的人没有不撒腿就跑的，正如所有曾背对过他的人都给捅死了一样
desc.en: There is no one whom the Night Goblin Big Boss has faced and hasn’t ran away from – and no one whose back he has seen and hasn’t stabbed, and killed.

desc.zh: 史奎格与地精对它们的喜爱，显然是对那些自诩更为理性的种族的一个警告
desc.en: The fact that Squigs and gobbos love them should serve as a warning to the more inherently sensible races.

desc.zh: 有经验的夜地精驯养师可以看出一只史奎格的性格好不好驯养…而且也知道最好离那些不能驯的家伙远远的！
desc.en: Experienced Night Goblin Herders can spot a Squig with the temperament to be controlled... and know to stay well away from those that cant'!

desc.zh: 『你肯定以为我打的是上三路！哈！』
desc.en: "Betcha ya expected da high blow! Ha!"

desc.zh: 『咱们已经饿了它们好些天了——把它们对着敌人放出去，这样它们就能填饱肚子了！』
desc.en: "We 'aven't fed dese ones for a few days – lets release 'em on da enemy gitz, so dey can eat dere fill!"

desc.zh: 这些招数需要玩弄不少肮脏把戏，还需要具备相当的运气，所以能持久这么玩下去的家伙显然非常的危险
desc.en: It takes a lot of dirty tricks and a fair share of luck, but those who last this long are truly dangerous ladz to have around.

desc.zh: Waaagh！的规模越大，法术的力量越强，萨满就越厉害！
desc.en: The bigger the Waaagh!, the bigger the spells, and the greater the Shaman's power.

desc.zh: 只需目光便可在朋友或敌人间制造不安，这项能力可以有效地涣散斗志，从而令兽人萨满得以行动自如，并在时机到来时对其因势利导
desc.en: The ability to create discomfort among friend or foe through their gaze can be quite disarming, allowing for the Orc Shamans to act freely and manipulate events as they unfold.

desc.zh: 虽然兽人萨满看似整天只会跳舞和吟唱魔法，但永远不要忘记他们是绿皮，而且是兽人。靠得太近，他们还是会把你的胳膊扯下来！
desc.en: While an Orc Shaman will primarily dance around chanting their magic, never forget that they are Greenskins, and Orcs at that. Get too close and they'll still rip your arms off!

desc.zh: 这首神奇圣歌的歌词每次都不一样，不过歌词又有什么意义？重要的是信念，以及狂躁的白眼！
desc.en: The words of this magical chant are different each time, though identically meaningless. It's the conviction that matters, as well as the manic eye-rolling.

desc.zh: 蛮荒兽人高度迷信，每当他们听到疯萨满那扭曲阴险的节奏时，他们总会手舞足蹈起来
desc.en: The Savage Orcs are a highly superstitious bunch, and will always dance to their insane Shamans' twisted, insidious beat, whenever they hear it.

desc.zh: 兽人萨满经常会一边围着营地跳舞，一边语无伦次地吟唱，这也让小子们很不舒服
desc.en: The Orc Shamans often chant incoherently while dancing around camp, much to the discomfort of da boyz.

desc.zh: 虽然找到这种活计需要的油漆并不是件容易的事，但一旦搞成了，它的成果可是非常惊人的！
desc.en: While locating enough paint for such a job isn't easy, no one can deny the results are suitably impressive!

desc.zh: 红漆会让野猪跑得更快，这种战漆还会给他们提供一些保护
desc.en: Red paint would make the boars run faster; this war paint will give them some protection.

desc.zh: 任何一个对油漆有所考究的萨满都会确保自己的图标与战士们一样强力
desc.en: Any Shaman worth his weight in paint makes sure that his own markings are every bit as potent as those of his warriors.

desc.zh: 在兽人的战线上，能够保护小子们的魔法战漆总是非常受欢迎
desc.en: The magical warpaint that protects da boyz is always greatly appreciated on an Orcish battle line.

desc.zh: 『要是没这玩意儿还带着史卡斯尼克的毒药到处跑，那不得漏得到处都是，连小子们不都得给毒死了么！』
desc.en: "It's 'ard to carry Skarsnik’s 'orrible con-coc-tion wivout it leakin' everywhere an' killin' da boyz!"

desc.zh: 史卡斯尼克诡计多端，也称得上是个精明的家伙。此人可以毫不费力地说服他的地精同伴们参加他的Waaagh！
desc.en: A master schemer and the epitome of shrewdness, Skarsnik has little trouble convincing his fellow Goblins to 'commit' themselves to less favourable jobs in his Waaagh!

desc.zh: 一支好斗的军队若是路过了死亡爬行者精心埋伏的森林，那么他们的下一站就是化作渐渐腐烂的树根堆肥
desc.en: A warlike army's journey to a pile of peacefully rotting mulch goes through the forests where the Deff Creepers lie in wait.

desc.zh: 『嘶鸣的爬虫是最坏的爬虫！』
desc.en: "Fizzy deff iz da baddest deff!"

desc.zh: 『蜘蛛喜欢大块肉！喜欢条形肉！喜欢你的肉！』
desc.en: "Toof-spider likez tuff meat, likez tender meat, likez your meat!"

desc.zh: 据说一些森林地精会自愿服用它，进而前往蜘蛛神的梦境。但他们的敌人可不会喜欢它，因为它会通向昏厥与死亡
desc.en: Some Forest Goblins have been known to take it willingly to induce dreams of the Spider-god. Their enemies take it most unwillingly, to induce lethargy and death.

desc.zh: 斯纳格拉的暴徒对帝国军队佩戴的羽毛有一种奇怪的嗜好，他们会把羽毛浸泡在被杀者的血液中，然后插在武器与盾牌上
desc.en: Snagla’s mob has a penchant for the feathers worn by Empire troops, which they soak in their slaughtered owners’ blood and place upon their weapons and shields.

desc.zh: 斯纳格拉生在邓肯瓦尔德的树冠下，长在黑坑的深处，他甚至可以命令树荫主动遮蔽他的身形，而它们确实会答应！
desc.en: Born under the Drakwald's canopy and nursed in the Black Pit's depths, Snagla can ask even a tree-leaf's shadow to accommodate his murderous skulking, and it will oblige.

desc.zh: 『喝了红色毒液就睡觉吧，小傻瓜』
desc.en: "Drink da red venom an' sleep now, soft-'ead."

desc.zh: 人们很容易将森林地精的蜘蛛神视为某种幻觉。然而，战场上横冲直撞的阿拉克纳瑞巨蛛可是任谁都无法无视的怪物
desc.en: It is easy to dismiss the Forest Goblins' Spider-god as a hallucination. Arachnaroks rampaging across a battlefield are not quite as easily dismissed, however.

desc.zh: 它像獠牙尖刺一样尖锐，刺激着所有听到它的人的大脑。如果毒药拥有声音，那么它就是这个声音
desc.en: As sharp as Fangspike, it scrambles the brains of all who hear it. If poison were a sound, it would be *this* sound.

desc.zh: 当斯纳格拉眼神呆滞时，他的杀戮本能就会最为敏锐
desc.en: It is when Snagla's eyes go dull that his murderous instincts become sharpest.

desc.zh: 真蜘蛛的捕捉技巧缓慢而耐心，而斯纳格拉则恰恰相反，它在任何非真蜘蛛所具备的技能上都大放异彩
desc.en: Nothing of a true Spider's slow and patient trapping technique, and all of Snagla's flair for... well, everything that the aforementioned is not!

desc.zh: 『快跑，蜘蛛，快跑！这是八条腿的噩梦！』
desc.en: "Run, Spider, run! Eight legz enna dream!"

desc.zh: 战将的战利品架子上陈列着他们砍下的所有大型野兽的头骨、獠牙和爪子
desc.en: The Warboss' trophy rack displays all the skulls, tusks and claws of the large beasts they've felled.

desc.zh: 只有战帮中最大、最坏、最暴力的兽人才配拿着最大、最狠的斧头
desc.en: It's only right and proper that the biggest, baddest, most violent Orc in a warband carries the largest, most offensive looking axe.

desc.zh: 战将越是强大，越是厉害，涌向他的旗帜的小子就会越多
desc.en: The bigger and badder the Warboss, the more boyz that will flock to his banner.

desc.zh: 战将的战利品架子上堆满了人类，矮人和精灵，以及无数被他残忍屠杀过的其他生物的头骨
desc.en: The Warboss' trophy rack houses the skulls of all the men, Dwarfs and Elfs, and myriad other beings whom he has ignominiously slaughtered.

desc.zh: 『Waaaggghhh！！！』
desc.en: "Waaaggghhh!!!"

desc.zh: 绿皮的孪生神搞毛二哥总是在打架，而且经常是互相打架，这反映了绿皮不分青红皂白的本性！
desc.en: The twin gods of the Greenskins, Gork and Mork are perpetually fighting… something, and quite often, each other, mirroring the Greenskins indiscriminate nature!

desc.zh: 『搞哥的这个造型能让小子们顶着炮火往前冲！』
desc.en: "Dis picture of Gork makes da boyz keep on fightin' even when unda fire!"

desc.zh: 绿先知激发了所有绿皮的宗教热情，而他的那些蛮荒同胞也就成了他最热心的追随者
desc.en: Da Great Green Prophet inspires religious zeal in all Greenskins, his most ardent followers being those of his own savage brethren.

desc.zh: 在以一场强大的Waaagh！大闹整个帝国心脏地带之后，哥巴德·铁爪证明了自己可以将任何绿皮乌合之众打造成一支强大无比的战斗力量
desc.en: Having led a mighty Waaagh! into the beating heart of Imperial territory, Gorbad Ironclaw can whip any Greenskins rabble into an effective fighting force.

desc.zh: 从北佬拿起钢铁的那一刻起，他就会把自己想象成又一个阿巴尔。其实他并不需要想象，因为阿巴尔本尊就站在这里，像冰川一样坚不可摧
desc.en: From the moment a Northman grips steel, he imagines himself a new Arbaal. He needn't imagine, for here Arbaal stands, unvanquished and as inexorable as a glacier.

desc.zh: 席拉，为了恐虐，杀
desc.en: Scyla kills. For Khorne.

desc.zh: 席拉，为了恐虐，杀
desc.en: Scyla kills. For Khorne.

desc.zh: 斯卡尔·血怒已经死过无数次了，但他总会在敌人的鲜血中复活，继续收获无人能数清的首级
desc.en: Skarr Bloodwrath has died numerous times, always to be brought back to life through the spilled blood of his foes to reap such a tally of skulls that none can keep count.

desc.zh: 『如果他想找到你，那么他就会的；当他挑战你，你便无法拒绝；当他向你冲来时，你无法阻止他』
desc.en: "If he wants to find you, he will. When he challenges you, you cannot refuse. When he comes for you, you cannot stop him."

desc.zh: 高尔法格的诨号来自一场…因他与自家人类钱粮官的短暂冲突而引发的一场关于金钱的『事故』
desc.en: Golgfag got his name after an… 'incident' over gold with a human Paymaster who briefly served the company…

desc.zh: 如果阿巴尔的意志被彻底粉碎，他将永远化为混沌之卵。而在一段短暂而痛苦的时间里，类似的命运也会降临到周围所有人身上
desc.en: Should Arbaal's resolve shatter, an eternity as a Chaos Spawn awaits him. A similar fate also awaits anyone in his vicinity, for a short and painful while.

desc.zh: 『你愿意在他的注视下可耻地死去吗？你想让你的肉体变异成混沌卵吗？如果是，那我就亲手杀了你。如果不是，那就跟我来吧』
desc.en: "Would you die ignobly as He watches? Would you have your flesh spun into a Spawn? If so, I shall kill you myself. If not, follow me."

desc.zh: 恶魔亲王凭借瘴气光环获得了献身，但阿巴尔则是凭借纯粹的意志力赢得了这一切
desc.en: What devotions a Daemon Prince garners by dint of his miasmic aura, Arbaal achieves by sheer might of will.

desc.zh: 几千年来，阿巴尔都没有学会如何在战场上保持耐心。事实上，他对战斗的渴求就像飓风对茅屋的渴求一样迫切
desc.en: The millennia seem to have not taught Arbaal patience in battle. And in truth, he has as much need for it as does a hurricane against a hovel.

desc.zh: 阿巴尔便是人类同样可以传播恐虐的毁灭力量的鲜活证明
desc.en: Arbaal is the ever-living proof that a human being is no lesser a conduit for the Ruinous power of Khorne.

desc.zh: 两军甫一接战，便见怒号震天，鲜血四溅，于是还能有什么会比此情此景更能磨砺一位恐虐信徒的利刃呢？
desc.en: Nothing hones the blade of a Khornite better than the wailing of initial onslaught and the blood spattering its aftermath.

desc.zh: 把脑袋斩掉，剩下的就会碎一地
desc.en: Sever the head and the rest will crumble.

desc.zh: 鲜血奔流不息
desc.en: Blood shall flow for all eternity.

desc.zh: 杀戮会激发更强的杀戮，因此带头冲锋的勇士定会激发下属的凶残
desc.en: Slaughter begets slaughter, and those who lead the charge inspire ferocity in their lessers.

desc.zh: 在选择下一场战斗时，血语者不会考虑己方的疲劳或损失，只会考虑下一个敌人是否近在咫尺
desc.en: In choosing his next battle, the Bloodspeaker does not consider his army's fatigue or the losses it has incurred, but only whether the next foe is within reach.

desc.zh: 作为血言者，失败却没有牺牲乃是一种耻辱。这样的战士已不配作为战士，他们不过是插标卖首而已
desc.en: To fail and not die in the service of the Bloodspeaker is an ignominy. Such warriors are no longer warriors. They are skull-carriers.

desc.zh: 恶魔驱使的战士会在战场上造成特殊的效果：扭曲空气，撼动大地，敌人在死掉前甚至无法意识到发生了什么
desc.en: A warrior whose gait is Daemonically driven has a peculiar effect on the battlefield. The air twists. The earth bubbles. His foes die before they realise what happens.

desc.zh: 当血言者的言辞会获得恶魔的注意。在凡世中，这种关注并不仅意味着好奇，他们会紧紧攥住这样的机遇
desc.en: When a Bloodspeaker opens his mouth, Daemons take note. In the mortal realm, such attentions are no mere curiosity. They grasp and seize.

desc.zh: 带着首级的恐虐信徒是极为可怕的场景，然而，血言者的战利品却会给那些有幸欣赏到它的人带来一种截然不同，非常私人化的恐怖
desc.en: A Khornite carrying a severed head is a horror to be expected. But it is said the Bloodspeaker's trophy exhibits a different, and quite personal, horror to those who behold it.

desc.zh: 『起初，你的道路是平等的，而随着时间的流逝，你会发现…有些人的道路更加平等』
desc.en: "You begin your path as equals in worth. In time, some will prove… more equal than others."

desc.zh: 人们学到的第一语言便是源自自身血脉的低吟。多数人都会忽视这一点，但血言者却没有。如此的私语便最终长成了引人注目的奇观
desc.en: The murmur of one's own blood is the first language one learns. Most forget it. The Bloodspeaker does not. Such private conversations yield a public spectacle to behold.

desc.zh: 越大的猎物，就能提供更多等待撕裂的内脏，等待碾碎的骨头
desc.en: The larger the prey, the larger the guts to tear and bones to grind.

desc.zh: 渴盼从怯懦的巫术中获得虚伪的保证，这种人还有什么用呢？
desc.en: Most worthless of all are those who take false surety from cowardly sorceries.

desc.zh: 『直面我，崽种！』
desc.en: "YOU SHALL FACE ME!"

desc.zh: 在他的阴影之下，最受欢迎者会执行八次屠杀，令鲜血层层包裹他们的身体
desc.en: And in his shadow, the most favoured slaughter eightfold, their bodies girded in blood.

desc.zh: 迅猛的挥击可以摧毁高山，坚固的身躯足够抵御风暴
desc.en: Blows to shatter mountains, unbreakable form to weather the storm.

desc.zh: 死亡展翅逼近，而怯懦只会推迟不可避免的结局
desc.en: Death approaches on crimson wings, and cowardice only delays the inevitable.

desc.zh: 只有真正的战士才有足够的意志去停止杀戮，从而为微妙之举留出足够的时间
desc.en: It takes a true warrior's will to halt the killing long enough for subtlety.

desc.zh: 屠杀早在恶魔涌入之前就开始了
desc.en: The slaughter starts long before the Daemons pour in.

desc.zh: 『杀戮，鲜血，死亡。让血流成河吧！』
desc.en: "Kill, bleed, die. The blood flows!"

desc.zh: 在部落中，即使是最底层的战士也是万分凶蛮
desc.en: Among the hordes, even the lowliest are brutal warriors.

desc.zh: 有什么会比颇具进取心的下属更好训练呢？
desc.en: What better training than an ambitious underling?

desc.zh: 战斗的核心是最容易精进冠军勇士的地方
desc.en: Champions earn their exaltations in the heart of battle.

desc.zh: 在战场上，以敌人鲜血书写着他们的战果，恐虐的低阶恶魔们收割着浸满鲜血的代价
desc.en: Writ upon the battlefield in the blood of their enemies, the so-called Lesser Daemons of Khorne reap their gore-soaked toll.

desc.zh: 火焰可以融化钢铁，焚化肉体，但仍能让血液流动下去
desc.en: Fire that melts steel and incinerates flesh, yet allows the blood to flow all the same.

desc.zh: 万籁终寂，便是割首之时
desc.en: When the quiet comes, the reaping only escalates.

desc.zh: 万籁终寂，便是割首之时
desc.en: When the quiet comes, the reaping only escalates.

desc.zh: 血神一片涓滴的恩惠，也是极大的神恩
desc.en: A sliver of the Blood God's favour, but a great one nonetheless.

desc.zh: 战争是万物的自然状态，和平则是凡人对自己耳语的谎言
desc.en: War is the natural state of all things, peace is the lie that mortals whisper to themselves.

desc.zh: 『全部夷平，寸草不留！』
desc.en: "Raze it all to the ground! Leave nothing standing!"

desc.zh: 每一次胜利都会让恐虐的勇士们重新振作，去寻找下一场的杀戮
desc.en: Each victory reinvigorates Khorne's champions to seek more bloodshed.

desc.zh: 『全部夷平，寸草不留！』
desc.en: "Raze it all to the ground! Leave nothing standing!"

desc.zh: 猎颅者的手中握着恐虐的一小部分力量，因此，他的剑的威力完全不可等闲视之
desc.en: A small measure of Khorne's power rests in Skulltaker's bare hands. The power in his sword is another matter altogether.

desc.zh: 『一道伤疤就足够了！为了这个，西格玛的崽子们必须付尽代价，其他人也一样，跟谁都没得商量！』
desc.en: "One scar is enough. For that, Sigmar's whelps will pay in full. As will all others. I do not believe in half-measures."

desc.zh: 只杀一个怎么能够？即使猎颅者已成为所有界域中最伟大的冠军勇士，也依然会有挑战者不断冒出来，然后再挨个死去
desc.en: No death is ever enough. Even if Skulltaker claims the greatest champion in all the realms, another will be born, and die in turn.

desc.zh: 『连其它恐虐信徒都无不畏惧我，所以区区凡人又能怎样，我都压根想不出来！』
desc.en: "Other Khornites fear my presence, so I cannot imagine what it does to a mere mortal."

desc.zh: 猎颅者只会挑战最具价值的对手。他对这种行为的影响毫不在意，但众人皆有目共睹就够了
desc.en: Skulltaker's challenge is only aimed the  worthiest of the worthy. He pays no heed to its reverberations, but the aftermath is there for all to see.

desc.zh: 他是独一无二的恐虐神选冠军勇士，因为他的放血鬼亲族从来不敢挑战他，而且这显然不是因为他的头衔
desc.en: Unique among Khorne's Chosen Champions is he, for none of his Bloodletter kin has ever challenged him, and not because of his title.

desc.zh: 无论是凡人还是恶魔，最优秀的战士无不在短短几秒内都会倒在屠颅剑之下，而任何撑不到这个时限的人也就是一具有待收割的骷髅而已
desc.en: The finest warriors, both mortal and immortal, have fallen to the Slayer Sword in mere seconds. Anyone who is less than that is a mere skull waiting to be collected.

desc.zh: 格纳拉，这头哥巴德专属战猪大腹便便，身躯壮硕，力大无穷。正是在它的承载之下，哥巴德以雷鸣般的怒吼策动了多场硕果累累的Waaagh！
desc.en: Atop Gnarla, his War Boar of prodigious size, might and flatulence, Gorbad has bellowed many a thunderous call to a successful Waaagh!

desc.zh: 个头比得上帝国战马，狠劲儿却是它的三倍！对于夜地精战将来说，这可真是个理想的坐骑啊！
desc.en: As large as an Imperial warhorse and thrice as fierce – a most appropriate mount for a Night Goblin Warboss!

desc.zh: 战猪是一种顽固而邪恶的动物，它脾气极坏、极度自负、极难揣测、极其危险、极难对付
desc.en: The war boar is a stubborn and vicious animal - an extremely tough beast that is notoriously bad tempered, loudly flatulent, unpredictable, and wholly dangerous.

desc.zh: 双足飞龙曾一度被误认为是龙，但是实际上，这些飞行兽类毫无尊贵可言，在这一点上，它们和那些兽族骑士倒是臭味相投
desc.en: Wyverns are occasionally mistaken for dragons but there is little nobility of spirit in these winged beasts, making them kindred spirits for their Orc riders.

desc.zh: 血神自己的血肉猎犬是个拥有强大力量的巨大恶魔，以恶魔野兽的形态踏上战场
desc.en: The Blood God’s own Flesh Hound is a colossal Daemon of great power, ridden on the battlefield in the fashion of a monstrous beast.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 巨大的移动祭坛，可以将战场上牺牲者的灵魂直接以邪恶的仪式进行献祭
desc.en: A vast, mobile altar allows the souls of the slain to be ritualistically condemned directly from the field of slaughter.

desc.zh: 强悍的恶魔引擎，身披黄铜铠甲，足踏铁定车轮冲入战场
desc.en: A mighty Daemon Engine, clad in brass armour and driven into battle on iron-shod wheels.

desc.zh: 猎颅者的座骑是最为可怕的钢铁斗牛，它身披金属外壳，心怀原始愤怒，承载着弑君者踏上毁灭性的战场
desc.en: Skulltaker’s is the most dreaded Juggernaut of all, a metal-plated beast of primordial rage that carries the Slayer of Kings to his doomed quarries.

desc.zh: 这位将领越是按照俺核计行事，就会越擅长使用哥巴德的战术
desc.en: The more this general follows Da Plan, the better they get at using Gorbad's Tactics.

desc.zh: 这一妖术会让敌人重新考虑他们的选择——或许领着队伍前去赴死并不是个好主意？
desc.en: This hex makes the foe reconsider their options – perhaps leading a warband into almost certain death isn't quite such a good idea after all?

desc.zh: 成为巨汉很简单：比其他人更大更强壮，然后把其他食人魔的粪便甩出七个阴影，让任何潜在的挑战者知道谁才是老大
desc.en: Being a Bruiser is simple: be bigger and stronger than everyone else, and smack seven shades of dung out of other Ogres to remind any would-be challenger who is boss.

desc.zh: 在战斗中，巨汉会自觉地追寻最为血腥的战场，抓住任何可以大开杀戒的机会
desc.en: Bruisers always gravitate towards the thickest bloodshed in battle, looking for any opportunity for wholesale slaughter.

desc.zh: 用肚子阻停战车，只身打破整个敌阵，或者把敌人的冠军勇士直接压扁：真正的巨汉就该这么干才对！
desc.en: Stopping chariots with their bellies, breaking entire formations by themselves, or squishing the life out of enemy Champions – these are the deeds of a true Bruiser!

desc.zh: 虽然他确实是个笨拙的野蛮人，但巨汉操控手中利刃的技艺竟会如画家手中的笔触一样精细
desc.en: For all that he is as ungainly a brute as they come, the Bruiser manoeuvres his wrist blades with the precision of a painter's brush.

desc.zh: 言出必行的领袖会通过发布恐怖的命令来确保他们的军队不会逃跑
desc.en: Those whose word is law ensure their troops will not run by issuing this dread order.

desc.zh: 作为暴君的亲信，巨汉会痛击任何胆敢越界的食人魔
desc.en: Acting as a Tyrant's enforcers, Bruisers pummel any Ogre who dare step out of line.

desc.zh: 作为暴君的得力助手和忠诚的顾问，这名巨汉将至死效命并保护他的老板
desc.en: The Tyrant's right hand and loyal war advisor, this Bruiser will serve and protect his boss to the end.

desc.zh: 想在巨汉面前逃离战斗，只会让自己给揍个头破血流
desc.en: If anyone even thinks of fleeing a battle in the Bruiser's presence, they find themselves flung head over heels in the thick of it.

desc.zh: 铃声响起，大军就该集合吃饭了。酒醉饭饱之后，屠杀就将带着一地鸡零狗碎继续开始！
desc.en: When the bell sounds, it's snack time for the assembled host. Then, the carnage can begin again, on a full stomach, with all of the associated drawbacks!

desc.zh: 眼前的敌人倒下，鲜血四溅，他随即锁定下一个猎物
desc.en: From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.

desc.zh: 没有谁会比高尔法格·噬人者更适合判断那些想加入噬人者队伍的志愿者是不是真的是块当噬人者的材料了…没错，你没想错！
desc.en: There's no better Maneater to judge whether candidates for recruitment into the Maneaters are Maneater-material than Golgfag Maneater… as you might hope and expect!

desc.zh: 高尔法格看到了这一切，做成了这一切，杀死了这一切，并且还不止一次…也永远不会停下来
desc.en: Golgfag has seen it all, done it all and killed it all many times over… and won't be stopping anytime soon.

desc.zh: 不挑食的军队永远不会挨饿
desc.en: An army that isn't picky about its meals never goes hungry.

desc.zh: 『找地方打架，把他们都揍一顿，然后洗劫一空，吃掉剩下的东西，然后在别的地方再重复一遍。这就是咱们的营生！』
desc.en: "We find a fight, beat 'em all up, then we loot 'em, then we eat what's left of 'em and then we do it all over again somewhere else. It's the perfect job."

desc.zh: 作为所有食人魔中最成功的食人魔，高尔法格的名声使得其他著名的雇佣兵都渴望在他身边证明自己的勇气
desc.en: As the most successful Ogre Maneater of them all, Golgfag's reputation has made other famous mercenaries keen to prove their mettle by his side.

desc.zh: 有时候，生命中最有用的东西就放在那里，等着别人偶然发现…
desc.en: Sometimes, the most useful things in life are just left lying around the place for someone to stumble across…

desc.zh: 洗劫者们会把每一块金币，每一颗金牙都搜刮干净。就算只落下一个币子，他们也会顿足捶胸！
desc.en: Those that excel as looters make sure that every coin or gold tooth is found and added to the plunder. Woe betide the warrior that misses even a single copper token!

desc.zh: 『对的，杀出最强花样的人会获得奖励的…』
desc.en: "Right, there's a bonus in it for tha one that does the most creative killin'…"

desc.zh: 干一天活，领一天饷，对呗？
desc.en: A fair day's 'work' for a fair day's pay, right?

desc.zh: 『如果他们抓到我，你们谁也拿不到钱！所以请保护我，藏好我！』
desc.en: "If they get to me, then none of ya's gettin' paid! So keep me safe n' hidden!"

desc.zh: 『我知道了，那为啥不更有意思些呢？每个脑袋再多给五块，成交？』
desc.en: "I know, why don't we make it interestin'? An extra five pieces per 'ead, shall we say?"

desc.zh: 向多方承诺相同的战利品是一件危险的事，但它确实能把活儿干成！
desc.en: It’s dangerous business to promise the same loot to multiple parties, but it certainly gets the job done!

desc.zh: 钱粮官可以优先选择战利品。这是等级带来的特权…也是照顾饷银的特权
desc.en: The Paymaster always gets first choice of the loot. 'Tis the privilege of rank… and proximity to the war chest.

desc.zh: 想要有命赚，也想有命花，那你就得照着命令去做，而且要快！
desc.en: If you want to get paid, and indeed stay alive, it's sensible to do whatever you're told to do – and be quick about it.

desc.zh: 这个食人魔的贪婪永远不会得到满足，因为他的胃和他的饥饿一样无穷无尽
desc.en: This Ogre's greed shall never be sated, for his stomach is as endless as his hunger.

desc.zh: 要固定如此臃肿的肚肠，你得需要一副真正的坚甲才行
desc.en: A truly sturdy armour is needed to hold such an overflowing gut in place.

desc.zh: 铃声响起，大军就该集合吃饭了。酒醉饭饱之后，屠杀就将带着一地鸡零狗碎继续开始！
desc.en: When the bell sounds, it's snack time for the assembled host. Then, the carnage can begin again, on a full stomach, with all of the associated drawbacks!

desc.zh: 从头到脚都沾满了他人身上的气味，臭气熏天，却也成为了大胃神永不满足的饥渴的发泄渠道，并随之产生了无可遏止的暴力倾向！
desc.en: Covered head to foot in (someone else's) bodily effluvia, stinking to the heavens, yet very much a conduit for the Great Maw's insatiable hunger and thirst, and the horrific violence that inevitably follows.

desc.zh: 战火无穷无尽。冲锋、交兵、一对一的血战，这便是无尽的循环，永无止息
desc.en: The war is endless. The cycle of charging, clashing, and bloody hand-to-hand fighting is without end. It will never stop.

desc.zh: 最好的出人头地办法就是照着暴君的话去做，心甘情愿的那种！
desc.en: The best way to stay out of the pot is to do as the Tyrant says and be happy about it.

desc.zh: 仅仅把军事上的失败强加给敌人是不够的，必须通过惩罚性的税收让他们屈服…除非他们宁愿被扔进肉锅里？
desc.en: It is not enough to impose military defeat upon the foe, they must be brought to their knees through punitive taxation… unless they'd rather get in the meat-pot instead?

desc.zh: 血液、内脏与黏液越多，内脏魔法就越会扎根现实世界，因为这些在那里真的很重要
desc.en: The more blood, guts and general goo, the more the Gut Magic is rooted in the real world, where things really matter.

desc.zh: 『砍、磨、煮、吃。那些屠户人挺不错，但可别靠近他们的锅…』
desc.en: "Hack, grind, cook and eat. Those Butchers are alright. Don't get near their pots though..."

desc.zh: 席拉的耐力从未经受过考验，因为与他作对的人都支撑不了多久。然而，越是深藏不露的东西，就越是可能有着惊人的力量
desc.en: Scyla's durability has barely been tested. No battles against him last long enough. Yet, what lies dormant, gathers strength.

desc.zh: 混沌荒原孕育着无情的毁灭。虽然毁灭对手不是什么难事，但极少有人能够对整个民族与他们栖息的土地造成伤害
desc.en: The Chaos Wastes breed relentlessness in destruction. Many can achieve that against their opponents. Few can inflict it on whole peoples, and the lands they inhabit.

desc.zh: 魔法咒语会把恐虐气到浑身发抖，然而，以他的名义念出的言辞是如何夸大也不过分，如果某个信徒只认得这些言辞，那就更好了
desc.en: Khorne shudders with fury to hear magic incantations. But the power of a mantra in His name cannot be overstated, especially if it is the only words one knows.

desc.zh: 『它…它是不是说话了？诸神啊，宽恕我们吧！』
desc.en: "Did… did it just *speak*? Gods have mercy on us!"

desc.zh: 席拉根本不在乎与他并肩作战的人说了些什么。尽管如此，还是会有人争相向他示好
desc.en: Scyla cares not for the words of the ones he is supposed to be fighting alongside. But some undertake to ingratiate themselves with him nonetheless.

desc.zh: 席拉根本不在乎与他并肩作战的人说了些什么。尽管如此，还是会有人争相向他示好
desc.en: Scyla cares not for the words of the ones he is supposed to be fighting alongside. But some undertake to ingratiate themselves with him nonetheless.

desc.zh: 啥都别说了，屠杀吧！
desc.en: The rest is slaughter.

desc.zh: 超自然的魔风携带着他的话语，他的声音也裹挟着魔风，推动整个军队向前开进
desc.en: The unnatural Winds carry his words still. His voice now carries those selfsame winds that push entire armies ever forward.

desc.zh: 每一次斯卡尔从死亡中爬回来，他的一部分便会燃烧殆尽，直至仅有愤怒残存
desc.en: Every time Skarr claws his way back from the dead, a little more burns away, until only the fury remains.

desc.zh: 数不胜数的首级！若是化为尘埃，那便是一片废土。这就是斯卡尔的功勋
desc.en: Skulls so innumerable that, were they dust, they would be a wasteland. All Skarr's doing.

desc.zh: 事实上无论是『钝』还是『器』都不甚妥当，但起码它并不是手术刀
desc.en: Both 'blunt' and 'instrument' are, in fact, misnomers. Yet, a scalpel it is not; that much is true.

desc.zh: 斯卡莫尔部落的氏族长如过江之鲫，但他们的领袖，呃…唯有一人
desc.en: Skaramor Chieftains come and go. Their leader is but one… er, man.

desc.zh: 杀戮间歇时，斯卡尔的刀锋仍然会燃烧着从远方即可看到的龙卷风。如果他愿意，他甚至会把魔法之风一把掐灭
desc.en: In the lulls between slaughters, the flaming tornado of Skarr's blades is still seen from afar. He would snuff out the very Winds, if he could.

desc.zh: 海神之怒使幻影咸雾充斥肺腑，这般滋味正是他的军锋艾斯林当年险些遭遇的宿命
desc.en: The Sea God's wrath fills your lungs with phantom brine, a taste of the fate that nearly claimed his Herald, Aislinn.

desc.zh: 迷障薄雾萦绕友方周身，令受困者望见早已陨落的同袍幻影，从而重获力量。然而，这场大捷的预兆始终萦绕着悲怆的余韵
desc.en: A veil of vapour manifests around an ally, invigorating the beleaguered with glimpses of long-fallen kin. A portent of a mighty victory, tinged with the aftertaste of sadness.

desc.zh: 水汽云雾在选定之地升起，水滴不断凝结和蒸发，干扰并减缓来袭箭矢的轨迹
desc.en: Clouds of droplets manifest to continuously form and evaporate around a chosen locale, dampening the path of incoming missiles.

desc.zh: 刹那间，生灵可踏足不朽之路，在现实与虚幻间徜徉
desc.en: For a moment, one may tread immortal pathways by way of drifting in and out of reality.

desc.zh: 凭借对航海巫术的冷酷诠释，柯思奎的贤者们学会了以凝冰封冻猎物，从而令其疲敝无力的能力
desc.en: Through callous interpretation of sea-faring sorcery, Cothiquan loremasters have learned to glaciate their quarry to lethargic helplessness.

desc.zh: 纵使身陷激战幻光之中，阿苏尔之敌仍会为纯水精魂的歌声魅惑纠缠，旋即遭其彻底吞没
desc.en: Even amidst the glamour of pitched battle, the Asur’s enemies are haunted by the beguiling tones of the Oceanids' song, moments before being utterly overwhelmed by them.

desc.zh: 带有腐蚀性盐晶的诡异迷雾笼罩战场，瓦解敌军斗志的同时以灵质触须庇护阿苏尔
desc.en: A salt-scented mist rolls in across the battlefield, corroding the enemy's resolve and shrouding the Asur with ethereal caress.

desc.zh: 毁灭大军的可怕乘舆不仅是战争机器，还是地位与权力的象征
desc.en: The dread carriages of the Ruinous hosts are more than just machines of war; they are symbols of status and power.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 瞬息万变足以翻天覆地——基哈尔的受害者们定会赞同此言，如果他们还有眼睛或舌头的话
desc.en: Much can happen in the blink of an eye, as Kihar's victims would attest, were they still in possession of their eyes or tongues.

desc.zh: 混沌术士对魔法之风的直觉掌控，加上对色孽『贪得无厌』的执念，使基哈尔的能力远超同侪
desc.en: A Chaos Sorcerer's instinctual grasp of the Winds of Magic, coupled with a singular Slaaneshi obsession for *more*, has bolstered Kihar's capabilities beyond those of others.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 巨大的移动祭坛，可以将战场上牺牲者的灵魂直接以邪恶的仪式进行献祭
desc.en: A vast, mobile altar allows the souls of the slain to be ritualistically condemned directly from the field of slaughter.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 巨大的移动祭坛，可以将战场上牺牲者的灵魂直接以邪恶的仪式进行献祭
desc.en: A vast, mobile altar allows the souls of the slain to be ritualistically condemned directly from the field of slaughter.

desc.zh: 莫拉丝与精妙形态的混沌纠缠已久，因而对某位亲王的仆从产生了亲近与赏识
desc.en: Morathi's dalliances with Chaos in its finer forms have brought upon a familiarity and an appreciation for a certain Prince's servants.

desc.zh: 玛瑟兰将艾斯林指定为自己的军锋，其深意如同深渊之主本人般莫测
desc.en: Mathlann has marked Aislinn as his herald, for purposes as inscrutable as the Lord of the Deeps himself.

desc.zh: 作为速度最快的空中舰艇之一，斩天者是阿苏尔舰队掌控制空权的重要保障
desc.en: As one of the swiftest of airborne vessels, the Skycutter allows an Asur fleet to maintain aerial superiority over the battlefield.

desc.zh: 最古老，最强大的巨龙，能够用白热的吐息杀掉一整支部队
desc.en: The eldest, most powerful Dragons can destroy entire units with a molten blast of their white-hot breath.

desc.zh: 在强大的海领主的召唤下，阿苏尔舰队将展示它无愧于世界上最强大的海军力量，其训练程度远远凌驾于其它种族之上
desc.en: By the call of its mighty Sea Lords, the Asur fleet demonstrates why it is renowned as the greatest naval power in the world, its training superior to all others.

desc.zh: 冒犯奥苏安海领主者，鲜有能全身而退
desc.en: Those who cross the Sea Lord of Ulthuan rarely survive unscathed, if at all.

desc.zh: 前一刻还是静谧晨雾，下一刻阿苏尔军团便冲锋而出，死亡箭云呼啸而落
desc.en: In one moment, the still morning fog; in the next, Asur regiments charging forth, clouds of whistling death falling ahead of them.

desc.zh: 其他阿苏尔眼中的过激行径，于艾斯林看来只是周全考量
desc.en: What other Asur deem excessive, Aislinn considers being thorough.

desc.zh: 第一击决定一切！海领主一声令下，就让大海索取其应得之物吧！
desc.en: The first strike decides all. On the Sea Lord's signal, the sea claims what it is owed.

desc.zh: 『不留任何活口。战俘不过是沉重的累赘』
desc.en: "Leave nothing alive. Prisoners of war are nothing but dead weight."

desc.zh: 这是两位航海大师之间的信任。『航海王』芬努巴尔深知海洋的严酷，并因此认可了艾斯林的做派
desc.en: The trust between two master sailors. Finubar the Seafarer knows the harsh realities of the sea and approves of Aislinn's methods.

desc.zh: 虔诚供奉玛瑟兰或能赢得神眷，尽管这位神祇天性冷漠
desc.en: Devout veneration of Mathlann can garner the god's favour, despite his uncaring nature.

desc.zh: 与敌军狼子野心、嗜血如狂的暴行形成鲜明对比的是，艾斯林始终以精准克制的雷霆手段震撼敌胆
desc.en: In contrast to the enemy’s savagery and blind bloodlust, Aislinn commands fear through a measured, contemptuous application of force.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的法师们凭借梦境与命运少女莉莉丝的恩典，施展着无人能及的防护与反制法术
desc.en: Ulthuan’s mages wield their peerless gift for abjuration and counterspell by the grace of Lileath, Maiden of dreams and fortune.

desc.zh: 胸怀大志的法师们，在环形山脉的嶙峋峭壁间彻夜警戒，对抗那些游荡的堕落野兽，以此锤炼自己对混沌侵蚀的感知
desc.en: Aspiring archmages steel their senses to Chaos by keeping vigil against the corrupted beasts that prowl amid the crags of the Annulii.

desc.zh: 在新月的祝福下，这位法师能施展出无比璀璨的魔法，各类法器也会不召自来，归于其手
desc.en: Blessed by the crescent moon, this magister wields sorceries of rare brilliance, and artefacts are drawn unbidden to their hands.

desc.zh: 正如能量只会传递而永不消逝，自阿苏焉神选身上散发出的某些辉光亦是如此
desc.en: Just as energy is transferred and never lost, so too are certain aspects of the radiance that emanates from Asuryan’s chosen.

desc.zh: 在魔法沉默誓言的约束下，卡卓焉与他的卫队以知晓神明计划而带来的坚定决心而战
desc.en: Bound by a magical vow of silence, Caradryan and his guard fight with the unshakeable resolve of those who know their god's plan.

desc.zh: 当炽焰之翼横贯大地，净化万物的圣火便令毁灭大军为之溃退
desc.en: As fiery wings extend across the land, the Forces of Destruction reel from the all-cleansing flames.

desc.zh: 卡卓焉越是沉浸于过去、现在与未来的灼焰符文之中，其超凡活力便会愈发蓬勃增长
desc.en: The more Caradryan immerses himself in the fiery letters of the past, present and future, the more his supernatural vitality grows.

desc.zh: 阿苏尔一族迅捷灵动，因造物主赐予了自身的神速；而这般恩典之极致，则为其冠军勇士所独享
desc.en: Quick and lithe are the Asur, for the Creator gifts them his own unnatural speed, while reserving the greatest of such boons for His champion.

desc.zh: 无饶舌之扰使卡卓焉得以专注要务，纵使最微末之事，亦难逃其静穆法眼的洞察
desc.en: With no prattling tongue to distract Caradryan from matters of great import, no event is so small as to evade his stoic gaze.

desc.zh: 危险降临时，卡卓焉额上的造物主符文会闪耀出最明亮的光芒，烧焦任何靠近的敌人
desc.en: The rune of the Creator upon Caradryan's brow glows brightest in times of danger, scorching any foe who comes near.

desc.zh: 烈焰之火中最古老的凤凰的热忱已经消失殆尽，但它的智慧、力量和对卡卓焉的忠诚依然如初
desc.en: The impetuousness of the oldest Phoenix of the Flamespyre has faded to naught, but its wisdom, strength and loyalty to Caradryan remain true.

desc.zh: 作为极其轻盈，弹性优良的金属，伊瑟拉玛银足以提供重甲般的防护力，却丝毫不会降低穿戴者的速度
desc.en: An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.

desc.zh: 优秀的精灵战车，全身覆盖着无价的伊瑟拉玛银作为防护，却丝毫无损于它的速度与敏捷
desc.en: Excellent Elven chariots, barded with priceless Ithilmar for extra protection on the battlefield but at no cost in speed or agility.

desc.zh: 当创世之火在灵魂深处炽烈燃烧，生命便能被重新赋予
desc.en: When the fires of creation burn bright in one’s soul, life can be given anew.

desc.zh: 多年缄默研习与静思无言之功，已将卡卓焉的心智淬炼至臻境，行事皆可完美专注
desc.en: Years of silent study and contemplation without utterance has honed Caradryan’s mind to accomplish tasks with immaculate focus.

desc.zh: 卡卓焉行于世间，宛若沐浴于阿苏焉本尊的圣焰之中，凡俗伤害皆不能近
desc.en: Caradryan walks the world as if he has been doused in the flames of Asuryan Himself, affording him protection from harm.

desc.zh: 最为靠近创世神思想的地位，令卡卓焉获得了领导阿苏焉守护者们的神圣力量
desc.en: Being closest to the thoughts of the Creator God marks Caradryan with the divine strength to lead Asuryan's guardians.

desc.zh: 每位高等精灵水手都听闻过海领主艾斯林的威名，无数人梦想在其麾下效力
desc.en: Every High Elf sailor has heard of Sea Lord Aislinn, and many dream of serving under his command.

desc.zh: 荷斯锻造的钢铁轻如鸿毛，精于此道者能以同样优雅迅捷的动作拨开来箭，亦能一击斩裂金属与血肉
desc.en: Light as a feather, Hoeth-forged steel is mastered to knock arrows aside in the same elegant blur that cleaves metal and flesh in one stroke.

desc.zh: 执笔书写《时日之书》时，两股力量便交织相融：编史者记录着当下时代，而这部典籍则传授着早已失落的历代奥术智慧
desc.en: Inscribe the Book of Days, and two currents entwine: the Loremaster chronicles the present age, while the tome imparts the arcane wisdom of epochs long lost.

desc.zh: 没有哪两位魔剑士是以完全相同的方式精研魔法原理的：在通往启迪的蜿蜒道路上，每个人都收获了独特而多样的天赋
desc.en: No two Loremasters have refined the principles of magic in quite the same way; along the winding path to enlightenment, each has gathered diverse and singular gifts.

desc.zh: 低等种族将魔法用作钝器，阿苏尔则将其运用为一门艺术。这就是萨芙睿的戒律，以少胜多
desc.en: Lesser races use magic as a blunt tool; the Asur wield it as an art. This is the discipline of Saphery, achieving more with less.

desc.zh: 精灵的心灵易于沉迷。这种冥想戒律会使精神集中，保护其免受魔法混沌与诱惑的影响
desc.en: An Elf's mind is prone to obsession. This meditative discipline centers the spirit, shielding it from magical chaos and temptation.

desc.zh: 人类法师可能花费一生仅能掌握魔法八风的一个方面，而高等精灵需精通全部八风，才仅会被视为荷斯的学徒
desc.en: A human wizard may take a lifetime to master just one aspect of the Winds. A High Elf masters all eight just to be considered a student of Hoeth.

desc.zh: 编织虚无缥缈的海雾是一项多变而难以捉摸的工作，但它能带来保护，免受变幻莫测的深渊之主的伤害
desc.en: Braiding the ethereal sea mists is a fickle and wayward endeavour, but it brings protection from the mercurial Lord of the Depths.

desc.zh: 转移和操纵自然雾气涡流以隐匿他们的行动，迷雾法师会通过无形的谋划占据优势
desc.en: Shifting and manipulating natural eddies of fog to obscure their movements, the Mist Mage gains an edge through unseen machinations.

desc.zh: 附魔蒸汽随咒语聚集，渐织成无可穿透之帷幔，覆于白衣军团之上
desc.en: The ensorceled vapours gather with each incantation, gradually weaving an impenetrable shroud upon the white-garbed host.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的巨鹰是精灵们的坚定盟友，自从混沌入侵起便与他们并肩而战
desc.en: Ulthuan's Great Eagles are the firm allies of the Elves, fighting their causes since the coming of Chaos.

desc.zh: 作为速度最快的空中舰艇之一，斩天者是阿苏尔舰队掌控制空权的重要保障
desc.en: As one of the swiftest of airborne vessels, the Skycutter allows an Asur fleet to maintain aerial superiority over the battlefield.

desc.zh: 迷雾笼罩之时，战士们会变得身手迅捷、适性优秀，直到发起进攻时才被敌人所发现
desc.en: Once swathed in the mists, the warriors become swift, adaptable, and unseen until the moment they strike.

desc.zh: 这位坚强的战士不仅学会了保护自己，也学会了保护周围的人
desc.en: This hardened warrior has learnt to not only protect themselves, but those around them also.

desc.zh: 贵族与王子间的羁绊在战火中淬炼，而那些展现出超越其他阿苏尔的敏锐头脑的贵族总是会被留在身边
desc.en: The bond between Noble and Prince is tested in war. Nobles who show a sharpness beyond other Asur will always be kept close.

desc.zh: 出身豪门的贵族通常携带着代代相传的失落神器，它们强大而危险
desc.en: Nobles born with great wealth often carry powerful and dangerous weapons of forgotten ancient origins bequeathed by their ancestors.

desc.zh: 数千年来，奥苏安的贵族家族领导着高等精灵度过了无数的和平与冲突，亲自踏上战场乃是他们义不容辞的责任
desc.en: The noble families of Ulthuan have led the High Elves through times of peace and conflict for thousands of years, never shying away from taking to the field themselves.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的贵族拥有同族中最为强悍的意志，善于集中精神以克服最严重的困难
desc.en: The high-born of Ulthuan are among the strongest of their strata in spirit, adept at focussing their minds into overcoming the gravest of difficulties.

desc.zh: 在最需要的时刻，奥苏安的英雄们会坚决地走向光明，不惜一切代价驱使阿苏尔走向胜利
desc.en: In times of greatest need, Ulthuan’s Heroes inevitably step forward into the light to drive the Asur towards victory at all costs.

desc.zh: 长久以来，高贵的血统将阿苏尔贵族与步兵行伍区分开来，然而最受爱戴的指挥官们却与闪耀的军团一同行进
desc.en: Highborn descent has long set the Asur nobles apart from the infantry ranks, yet the most cherished commanders march alongside the gleaming host.

desc.zh: 在奥苏安的广阔原野上，无论是驾驭迅捷的战车还是骑乘银鬃骏马，骑术已从一种艺术升华为一种信仰
desc.en: Across Ulthuan’s open fields, riding is elevated from art to religion, be it in the pull of swift chariots or astride silver-maned steeds.

desc.zh: 驭空而行并非徒具虚名的等级徽记，而是一项庄严的职责：它要求将战术智慧与阿苏尔最古老盟友的并肩情谊融为一体
desc.en: Sky-riding is no idle badge of rank, but a stern charge – blending tactical acumen with companionship of the Asur’s eldest allies.

desc.zh: 阿苏尔的将士们将其出身高贵的领袖视为效率与精通的典范，所有人都渴望成为那样的人
desc.en: The ranks of the Asur look to their high-born leaders as paragons of efficiency and mastery that all aspire to be.

desc.zh: 王子们通常会自己出资加固战袍，使其能够在战场上无坚不摧
desc.en: The protection of a Prince's battle garb is often reinforced at their own cost, enabling them to weather much that is thrown at them on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 阿苏尔步兵所穿的绚烂白色既代表纯洁也代表死亡，象征着他们无论面对何等恐怖都决心战斗到底
desc.en: The resplendent white donned by Asur infantry represents both purity and death, symbolising their determination to fight no matter the horrors they must face.

desc.zh: 真正的勇士能在瓦尔熔炉重铸战甲，卡勒多的匠师至今仍传承着神赐的锻造秘艺
desc.en: The worthy may see their war panoply reforged in Vaul’s Anvil, where Caledor’s smiths still practice divine smithing traditions.

desc.zh: 虽然军队有时会基于政治派别和影响力托付给出身高贵者，但阿苏尔强大的军事传统总是会得到毫无例外地遵循
desc.en: Though armies are sometimes trusted to the high-born based on political alignment and influence, the Asur’s strong martial traditions are always upheld without exception.

desc.zh: 贵族们夸耀着由龙王子们的荣耀冲锋或白狮们的战斧赢得的战争，然而有时这只是细致监察的结果
desc.en: Nobles boast of wars won by the glorious charge of Dragon Princes or the axes of White Lions. Yet sometimes it is just a matter of meticulous surveillance.

desc.zh: 精灵皆有着迅捷的身手，其中凤毛麟角者更胜同侪一筹，他们注定将成为傲立战场的传奇
desc.en: Fleet-footedness and dexterity are gifts shared by all Elves, yet a rare few surpass even their kin, destined to stand forth as champions.

desc.zh: 渴望晋升奥苏安军阶的贵族，必须将武艺臻至化境，不断突破自身极限
desc.en: The high-born who look to ascend Ulthuan’s martial ranks must reach the pinnacle of their discipline, demanding ever more of their skill.

desc.zh: 真正的勇士能在瓦尔熔炉重铸战甲，卡勒多的匠师至今仍传承着神赐的锻造秘艺
desc.en: The worthy may see their war panoply reforged in Vaul’s Anvil, where Caledor’s smiths still practice divine smithing traditions.

desc.zh: 『耐心与计划便是引领我们穿越风暴的舰船，常备不懈则是坚实船员们的锚点』
desc.en: "Patience and planning steers us like ships through a storm. Readiness shall anchor the crew."

name.en: By Order of the Phoenix Court

desc.zh: 凤凰王廷的权力赋予海盔们极大的自主权，以追剿和消灭奥苏安的海上威胁为己任
desc.en: The powers of the Phoenix Court afford the Sea Helms great autonomy in pursuing and eliminating Ulthuan’s sea-based threats.

desc.zh: 奥苏安的巨鹰是精灵们的坚定盟友，自从混沌入侵起便与他们并肩而战
desc.en: Ulthuan's Great Eagles are the firm allies of the Elves, fighting their causes since the coming of Chaos.

desc.zh: 要是再来一发就能打倒我们的敌人，那我们就会再射击一次！
desc.en: If but one more would strike down our every foe, then we shall let loose once again!

desc.zh: 与海怪和利维坦奋斗终生的经历教会了海盔利用巨型野兽弱点的技巧
desc.en: A lifetime spent fighting krakens and leviathans has taught the Sea Helm how to exploit the weaknesses of any colossal beast.

desc.zh: 高等精灵舰队被誉为世界最强海军，其训练体系无出其右
desc.en: The High Elf fleet is renowned as the greatest naval power in the world, its training superior to all others.

desc.zh: 施展得如此迅捷而精准的技术，以至于恍若未曾发生
desc.en: A technique performed with such speed and precision that it may appear to not have happened at all.

desc.zh: 白衣胜雪的军团精擅精灵海战技艺，他们在浪尖、海面与波涛之下以完美无瑕的精准掌控战局
desc.en: The white-garbed hosts command the complex art of Elven naval warfare, conducting the battle above, on, and below the waves with flawless precision.

desc.zh: 对某些海盔而言，占领土地只是顺手，填满金库才是要务
desc.en: For some Helms, conquest is less about lands being held and more about coffers being filled.

desc.zh: 唯有海盔能够绘制出穿越奥苏安遍布迷雾、变幻莫测的海岸线、以及更广阔的险峻海洋的路线图
desc.en: Only the Sea Helm’s ilk could map the treacherous routes through Ulthuan’s magical mists and shifting coastlines, and the perils of the wider seas.

desc.zh: 作为速度最快的空中舰艇之一，斩天者是阿苏尔舰队掌控制空权的重要保障
desc.en: As one of the swiftest of airborne vessels, the Skycutter allows an Asur fleet to maintain aerial superiority over the battlefield.

desc.zh: 海盔乃是玛瑟兰之手，他们挥舞着海神的圣器，一招一式皆受到了海洋冰冷怒火的指引
desc.en: Wielding the sacred weapon of the Sea God, the Sea Helm acts as Mathlann's hand, their strikes guided by the ocean's cold fury.

desc.zh: 流畅而致命的战斗风格，在舰船甲板或血染战场的漩涡中臻于完善
desc.en: A fluid and deadly fighting style, perfected for the maelstrom of combat on a ship's deck or a blood-drenched battlefield alike.

desc.zh: 敌舰龙骨方才触及奥苏安海岸，精灵战士便已列阵相迎，随着援兵不断抵达，银色阵列愈发密集雄壮
desc.en: Scarce has the first keel touched Ulthuan's shores before Elves stand in formation, ranks thickening as more warriors arrive.

desc.zh: 有些阿苏尔可能会觉得指挥屠杀有失体面，但结果会说明一切
desc.en: Some Asur might find it distasteful for one to command slaughter such as this, but the results will speak for themselves.

desc.zh: 高等精灵的海军是对抗奥苏安之敌的第一道防线，而艾斯林则是它的支点
desc.en: The High Elf navy is the first line of defence against the enemies of Ulthuan, and Aislinn is its fulcrum.

desc.zh: 此人从头到尾毫不合群，全身散发着忧郁哀伤的气息
desc.en: Definitely not the life and soul of the party; they exude melancholy and depression.

desc.zh: 此人脾气有如导火索，一点就着，见识一下燃烧的怒火吧
desc.en: Tempers, like wicks, can be ignited. Watch the anger burn.

desc.zh: 作为，不作为，搞出变动，诸如此类，此人铁了心要跟主流对着干
desc.en: Action, inaction, change – you name it, this one will work against the prevailing wind.

desc.zh: 这么说吧，此人就是个炸药桶，你一定不会想尝尝他的怒火吧！
desc.en: You don't want to be on the wrong side of this one's ire – it's explosive to say the least!

desc.zh: 黑暗之中未必总有光明
desc.en: Not every cloud has a silver lining.

desc.zh: 能守护阿苏尔生存之道的品质，此人无不具备
desc.en: Whatever quality is needed to stand guard over the Asur way of life, this one has it in abundance.

desc.zh: 机会就像魔法，可以被个人意志所驾驭
desc.en: Chance is like magic – it can be harnessed to the individual's will.

desc.zh: 此人活动好每一根筋骨，随时随地准备出动
desc.en: Every fibre of their being is charged and ready for action – wherever, whenever.

desc.zh: 即使在高等精灵自己看来，千余岁还能如此精神焕发也是很不可思议的
desc.en: Impressively energetic for a thousand years old – even by their own reckoning.

desc.zh: 能量在他们的血管中流淌，填补着噩兆的虚空
desc.en: Through their veins a charge is racing. Energy, filling the ominous void within.

desc.zh: 『想要保持轻柔就必须多下功夫，你们天天坐着胡吃海喝跟你们说了也是白说』
desc.en: "Staying this supple takes effort. You don’t get definition like that by sitting about and drinking."

desc.zh: 『你想要什么跟外面的守卫说就好了，外面可有不少守卫』
desc.en: "If you need anything, there are guards outside the doors. Many guards."

desc.zh: 近千年来，奥苏安许多高耸天际的建筑都出自此人的艰辛劳作
desc.en: Much of the Ulthuan skyline built over the last thousand years is down to this one’s sterling endeavours.

desc.zh: 『太迟了，太迟了』，等我一走后悔就来不及了
desc.en: "Too late, too late!" will be the cry, when the one with the bargains passes you by.

desc.zh: 好在世上总有人爱操心天下大事，要不然我们可就…哦等等…
desc.en: Fortunately, there are some who really apply themselves to the problems of the world. Just as well, otherwise we'd be… Oh wait...

desc.zh: 如果需要精确与组织，那么此人无疑是最佳人选。但是在聚会上，他就很无趣了
desc.en: If it requires accuracy and organisation, this one is your Elf. Not so much fun at parties, however.

desc.zh: 『事情总会有出路，总会有个角度的，你只需找到它即可』
desc.en: "There's always a way – always an angle. You just have to find it."

desc.zh: 此人技艺超群，堪称国之大器，简直就是智慧的化身
desc.en: An individual of exceptional skill and worth; the very embodiment of sagacity.

desc.zh: 尽管立下了沉默誓言，但卡卓焉鼓舞人心的身姿似乎遍及各地，仿佛阿苏焉本人拿起了武器一般
desc.en: Despite his vow of silence, Caradryan’s inspiring presence is felt throughout the land as though Asuryan Himself has taken up arms.

desc.zh: 这位提督读取风向如同读取潮汐，他可以捕捉最迅疾的狂风，赋予其舰队超自然的速度
desc.en: This admiral reads the wind as he reads the tide, catching the swiftest gales to grant their fleets supernatural speed.

desc.zh: 对于日渐衰落的种族来说，每一条生命都弥足珍贵。这位提督的医学造诣可以确保战士们迅速治愈并重返战场
desc.en: For a dwindling race, every life is precious. this admiral's medical acumen ensures that warriors are swiftly healed to fight again.

desc.zh: 他们的旗舰携带一块与大漩涡同调的水晶，为附近的所有军队创造了一个魔法能量储备库
desc.en: Their flagship carries a crystal attuned to the Great Vortex, creating a reservoir of magical power for all nearby armies.

desc.zh: 这位提督是财会与后勤的大师，以高超的技巧管理舰队资源，使得战争成本大大降低
desc.en: A master of ledgers and logistics, this admiral manages the fleet's resources with such skill that the cost of war is greatly reduced.

desc.zh: 这位提督指挥着星木之星号：这艘最新加入高等精灵舰队的龙舰，是用新发现的星木资源建造而成的
desc.en: This admiral commands the Starwood Star, the latest Dragonship to enter the High Elf fleet, built from the newly discovered cache of Starwood.

desc.zh: 作为，不作为，搞出变动，诸如此类，此人铁了心要跟主流对着干
desc.en: Action, inaction, change – you name it, this one will work against the prevailing wind.

desc.zh: 一旦形势所需，那么便理应向敌人投掷出全部的怒火
desc.en: On occasion, throwing the whole nine leagues at the enemy is just the ticket.

desc.zh: 历经磨练的技巧对敌人来说就好比打磨锋利的利刃
desc.en: Skills refined and improved upon over time can only increase one's edge over the foe.

desc.zh: 这么说吧，此人就是个炸药桶，你一定不会想尝尝他的怒火吧！
desc.en: You don't want to be on the wrong side of this one's ire – it's explosive to say the least!

desc.zh: 这就是健康强壮的典范，很显然此人早已经过多年的锻炼
desc.en: The very picture of good health. Clearly, there's many years still ahead of them.

desc.zh: 此人活动好每一根筋骨，随时随地准备出动
desc.en: Every fibre of their being is charged and ready for action – wherever, whenever.

desc.zh: 即使在高等精灵自己看来，千余岁还能如此精神焕发也是很不可思议的
desc.en: Impressively energetic for a thousand years old – even by their own reckoning.

desc.zh: 如果自身足够强硬，那么盔甲就只是摆设
desc.en: Armour is just a formality when you're as hard as nails and as tough as old boots.

desc.zh: 很多人都试过了，想杀这人没那么容易，相信我
desc.en: This one is not at all easy to kill, and many have tried, believe me.

desc.zh: {{tr:character_skills_localised_description_wh3_dlc27_skill_innate_hef_handmaiden_campaign_3_advocate_affinity}}
desc.en: {{tr:character_skills_localised_description_wh3_dlc27_skill_innate_hef_handmaiden_campaign_3_advocate_affinity}}

desc.zh: 恶魔对细节了如指掌…
desc.en: The Daemon is very definitely in the detail…

desc.zh: 某种程度上来讲，人们可以补救军队的损耗
desc.en: Armies can be mended as surely as people can, up to a point of course.

desc.zh: 此人着眼长久，行事一心只为公义，不留私心
desc.en: This one acts not for themselves but the for the greater good, in defence of the future.

desc.zh: 好在世上总有人爱操心天下大事，要不然我们可就…哦等等…
desc.en: Fortunately, there are some who really apply themselves to the problems of the world. Just as well, otherwise we'd be… Oh wait...

desc.zh: 『事情总会有出路，总会有个角度的，你只需找到它即可』
desc.en: "There's always a way – always an angle. You just have to find it."

desc.zh: 此人看待老问题时总不乏新思路和新点子
desc.en: Never short of new ideas, or new ways of looking at old problems.

desc.zh: 此人技艺超群，堪称国之大器，简直就是智慧的化身
desc.en: An individual of exceptional skill and worth; the very embodiment of sagacity.

desc.zh: 『我发现了一点问题，然后我就亲手解决了』
desc.en: "I see something wrong and I fix it with my hands."

desc.zh: 完美精灵的完美诠释，真是不错！
desc.en: The very illustration of Elven perfection. What a git!

desc.zh: 战斗的场景令凤凰充满活力，真是激动人心啊…
desc.en: The prospect of battle fills the phoenix with a brisk energy that's somewhat infectious...

desc.zh: 此人言行相顾，表里如一，在高贵的精灵一族中颇负盛名
desc.en: Through his words and deeds, this one has made a name for himself within noble Elven circles.

desc.zh: 即使在四肢修长，生命漫长的精灵眼中，此人也堪称是个豪杰
desc.en: Even for a long-limbed, long-lived Elf, this character is a fine specimen.

desc.zh: 『身心俱通，是为得道；勇者一生，皆系于此』
desc.en: "Enlightenment is achieved by mastering not only the body, but the soul. Only then can a warrior truly understand the value of life."

desc.zh: 『你说啥？战斗？今天？太好了！把我的凤凰牵来，让我们大开杀戒吧！』
desc.en: "Battle, you say? Today? Marvellous! Bring me my phoenix - let's get killing!"

desc.zh: 此人动作迅捷如雷，可翻身闪避对手的攻击
desc.en: This one moves like lightning, ducking and twisting to avoid their opponent's blows.

desc.zh: 机会就像魔法，可以被个人意志所驾驭
desc.en: Chance is like magic – it can be harnessed to the individual's will.

desc.zh: 此人活动好每一根筋骨，随时随地准备出动
desc.en: Every fibre of their being is charged and ready for action – wherever, whenever.

desc.zh: 能量在他们的血管中流淌，填补着噩兆的虚空
desc.en: Through their veins a charge is racing. Energy, filling the ominous void within.

desc.zh: 『你想要什么跟外面的守卫说就好了，外面可有不少守卫』
desc.en: "If you need anything, there are guards outside the doors. Many guards."

desc.zh: 如果自身足够强硬，那么盔甲就只是摆设
desc.en: Armour is just a formality when you're as hard as nails and as tough as old boots.

desc.zh: {{tr:character_skills_localised_description_wh3_dlc27_skill_innate_hef_handmaiden_campaign_3_advocate_affinity}}
desc.en: {{tr:character_skills_localised_description_wh3_dlc27_skill_innate_hef_handmaiden_campaign_3_advocate_affinity}}

desc.zh: 此人勤勉不怠，成效卓著，能将理念转化为财富，有时这还真不是吹的
desc.en: Industrious and productive, this one can turn ideas into gold - sometimes literally.

desc.zh: 某种程度上来讲，人们可以补救军队的损耗
desc.en: Armies can be mended as surely as people can, up to a point of course.

desc.zh: 此人总爱跟从他人，默默服从强者的领导
desc.en: This one is happy to follow and let other, more energetic types, lead from the front.

desc.zh: 此人看待老问题时总不乏新思路和新点子
desc.en: Never short of new ideas, or new ways of looking at old problems.

desc.zh: 『我发现了一点问题，然后我就亲手解决了』
desc.en: "I see something wrong and I fix it with my hands."

desc.zh: 此人从头到尾毫不合群，全身散发着忧郁哀伤的气息
desc.en: Definitely not the life and soul of the party; they exude melancholy and depression.

desc.zh: 此人脾气有如导火索，一点就着，见识一下燃烧的怒火吧
desc.en: Tempers, like wicks, can be ignited. Watch the anger burn.

desc.zh: 作为，不作为，搞出变动，诸如此类，此人铁了心要跟主流对着干
desc.en: Action, inaction, change – you name it, this one will work against the prevailing wind.

desc.zh: 这么说吧，此人就是个炸药桶，你一定不会想尝尝他的怒火吧！
desc.en: You don't want to be on the wrong side of this one's ire – it's explosive to say the least!

desc.zh: 黑暗之中未必总有光明
desc.en: Not every cloud has a silver lining.

desc.zh: 能守护阿苏尔生存之道的品质，此人无不具备
desc.en: Whatever quality is needed to stand guard over the Asur way of life, this one has it in abundance.

desc.zh: 机会就像魔法，可以被个人意志所驾驭
desc.en: Chance is like magic – it can be harnessed to the individual's will.

desc.zh: 此人活动好每一根筋骨，随时随地准备出动
desc.en: Every fibre of their being is charged and ready for action – wherever, whenever.

desc.zh: 即使在高等精灵自己看来，千余岁还能如此精神焕发也是很不可思议的
desc.en: Impressively energetic for a thousand years old – even by their own reckoning.

desc.zh: 能量在他们的血管中流淌，填补着噩兆的虚空
desc.en: Through their veins a charge is racing. Energy, filling the ominous void within.

desc.zh: 『想要保持轻柔就必须多下功夫，你们天天坐着胡吃海喝跟你们说了也是白说』
desc.en: "Staying this supple takes effort. You don’t get definition like that by sitting about and drinking."

desc.zh: 『你想要什么跟外面的守卫说就好了，外面可有不少守卫』
desc.en: "If you need anything, there are guards outside the doors. Many guards."

desc.zh: 近千年来，奥苏安许多高耸天际的建筑都出自此人的艰辛劳作
desc.en: Much of the Ulthuan skyline built over the last thousand years is down to this one’s sterling endeavours.

desc.zh: 『太迟了，太迟了』，等我一走后悔就来不及了
desc.en: "Too late, too late!" will be the cry, when the one with the bargains passes you by.

desc.zh: 好在世上总有人爱操心天下大事，要不然我们可就…哦等等…
desc.en: Fortunately, there are some who really apply themselves to the problems of the world. Just as well, otherwise we'd be… Oh wait...

desc.zh: 如果需要精确与组织，那么此人无疑是最佳人选。但是在聚会上，他就很无趣了
desc.en: If it requires accuracy and organisation, this one is your Elf. Not so much fun at parties, however.

desc.zh: 『事情总会有出路，总会有个角度的，你只需找到它即可』
desc.en: "There's always a way – always an angle. You just have to find it."

desc.zh: 此人技艺超群，堪称国之大器，简直就是智慧的化身
desc.en: An individual of exceptional skill and worth; the very embodiment of sagacity.

desc.zh: 此人即便在独处时也会心怀不安，他的本性就是如此的内敛
desc.en: This one doesn't even relax in their own company, so reserved is their nature.

desc.zh: 勇气？坚强？别逗了好吗，这个怂货一点边都不沾
desc.en: Fortitude? Strength of character? Do me a favour - this yellow-bellied poltroon has none.

desc.zh: 此人从头到尾毫不合群，全身散发着忧郁哀伤的气息

desc.zh: 此人身体看上去『不是很好』已成常态，很明显是药不太够了
desc.en: Looking "not too well" has become a permanent condition. Clearly, they're lacking essential herbs.

desc.zh: 都说两个总比一个强，这绝对是大错特错
desc.en: They say two are better than one. They are, of course, totally wrong in every respect.

desc.en: Machinery – and indeed progress of any kind – is anathema to this one, because there's no substitute for good, honest toil.

desc.zh: 此人事事不落，整天干涉别人的事
desc.en: This one can never leave something alone. They always have to meddle.
