desc.zh: 此人技艺超群，堪称国之大器，简直就是智慧的化身
desc.en: An individual of exceptional skill and worth; the very embodiment of sagacity.

desc.zh: 自我激励是个有用的本事，能把别人煽动起来的话就更有用了
desc.en: Self-starting is a useful ability; starting others - and keeping them that way - more useful still.

desc.zh: 还有什么比一次及时而有序的冲锋更使人惊骇的呢
desc.en: There's nothing quite so impressive - and painful - as a well-timed, well-ordered charge.

desc.zh: 刻苦训练必然会使人完美，至少在战场上更容易活下来
desc.en: Practice really does make perfect, or at least makes it much harder to kill.

desc.zh: 一旦形势所需，那么便理应向敌人投掷出全部的怒火
desc.en: On occasion, throwing the whole nine leagues at the enemy is just the ticket.

desc.zh: 此人锐意精进，用尽全心使自己行事果断
desc.en: This one is a driving force; potential is taken and transformed into decisive action by their hand.

desc.zh: 历经磨练的技巧对敌人来说就好比打磨锋利的利刃
desc.en: Skills refined and improved upon over time can only increase one's edge over the foe.

desc.zh: 此人动作迅捷如雷，可翻身闪避对手的攻击
desc.en: This one moves like lightning, ducking and twisting to avoid their opponent's blows.

desc.zh: 这就是健康强壮的典范，很显然此人早已经过多年的锻炼
desc.en: The very picture of good health. Clearly, there's many years still ahead of them.

desc.zh: 此人做任何动作看上去都毫不费力
desc.en: Every action is executed seemingly without effort.

desc.zh: 你肯定不会想成为此人的攻击对象，肯定不会的
desc.en: You really don't want to be on the receiving end of an attack made by this one. You really don’t.

desc.zh: 如果自身足够强硬，那么盔甲就只是摆设
desc.en: Armour is just a formality when you're as hard as nails and as tough as old boots.

desc.zh: 很多人都试过了，想杀这人没那么容易，相信我
desc.en: This one is not at all easy to kill, and many have tried, believe me.

desc.zh: 恶魔对细节了如指掌…
desc.en: The Daemon is very definitely in the detail…

desc.zh: 『来，都别打了，阿苏尔不打阿苏尔！』
desc.en: "Come now, let this conflict cease. We're all Asur, remember?"

desc.zh: 此人着眼长久，行事一心只为公义，不留私心
desc.en: This one acts not for themselves but the for the greater good, in defence of the future.

desc.zh: 无论什么任务，此人务求尽善尽美，此后更是精益求精
desc.en: Whatever the task, this one always wishes to do it to the best of their ability - and better on every occasion thereafter.

desc.zh: 此人圆滑至极，即便他人与之意见相左，亦难以大动肝火拔刀相向
desc.en: This one smooths the way, so differing opinions do not so easily lead to frayed tempers and drawn blades.

desc.zh: 保住金子的最佳办法就是不要去花
desc.en: The best way to hang on to your gold is never to spend any of it.

desc.zh: 此人深谙兵法机变，足以克敌制胜
desc.en: This one understands tactics, and how to vary them, well enough to generally defeat the foe.

desc.zh: 『我们的祖先遵从古法，克服万难，我们不应对他们的经验视而不见』
desc.en: "Our forefathers followed the way and overcame great adversity. We should not ignore their lessons."

desc.zh: 有些人的心智易受魔法影响，而此人的意志却十分坚定
desc.en: Some minds are more susceptible to magical influence than others, but this one is strong indeed.

desc.zh: 『很好，你有在听吗？嗯，解决万事万物的唯一方法就在书中』
desc.en: "Right, are you listening? Good. There's only one way to do things and that's by the book."

desc.zh: 此人意志坚定不移，内心就如世界巨龙一般强大！
desc.en: Immovable and resolute in their will, this one is as determined as the World Dragon himself!

desc.zh: 作为，不作为，搞出变动，诸如此类，此人铁了心要跟主流对着干
desc.en: Action, inaction, change – you name it, this one will work against the prevailing wind.

desc.zh: 此人动作迅捷如雷，可翻身闪避对手的攻击
desc.en: This one moves like lightning, ducking and twisting to avoid their opponent's blows.

desc.zh: 这就是健康强壮的典范，很显然此人早已经过多年的锻炼
desc.en: The very picture of good health. Clearly, there's many years still ahead of them.

desc.zh: 此人做任何动作看上去都毫不费力
desc.en: Every action is executed seemingly without effort.

desc.zh: 你肯定不会想成为此人的攻击对象，肯定不会的
desc.en: You really don't want to be on the receiving end of an attack made by this one. You really don’t.

desc.zh: 如果自身足够强硬，那么盔甲就只是摆设
desc.en: Armour is just a formality when you're as hard as nails and as tough as old boots.

desc.zh: 很多人都试过了，想杀这人没那么容易，相信我
desc.en: This one is not at all easy to kill, and many have tried, believe me.

desc.zh: 想要活命，最好睁大眼睛低下脑袋
desc.en: If you wish to live, it's best to keep your eyes open and your head down.

desc.zh: 『你需要制定计划，不要听别人的，然后施加在敌人身上！』
desc.en: "You need a plan. Never let anyone tell you otherwise. Devise a plan, then execute it – and preferably the enemy."

desc.zh: 在此人看来，个人情感不应流露于众人面前
desc.en: Sentiments - and indeed feelings of any kind - are not for public display, in their estimation.

desc.zh: 此人对各项战争技艺何止是精通，简直得心应手
desc.en: More than skilled, this one shows great proficiency in matters of war.

desc.zh: 此人酷爱珍宝，堪比绿皮！
desc.en: Their love of shiny things is so great this one could be an honorary Greenskin!

desc.zh: 列队、射击、冲锋、侧击、重复，此人操作起来无非小菜一碟
desc.en: Form, fire, charge, flank, repeat. This one shows that it really can be that simple.

desc.zh: 能跑干嘛走？能飞干嘛跑？
desc.en: Why walk when you can run? Why run when you can fly?

desc.zh: 此人坚定不移，是战场上的中流砥柱
desc.en: Unswerving and determined, this one is an immovable force on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 君子报仇，十年不晚，无论早晚，复仇的滋味总是十分美妙
desc.en: Revenge is not a dish best served cold; it is always perfectly sweet, no matter the temperature.

desc.zh: 此人从身边经过时，人们常会群情激荡，鼓足勇气
desc.en: You can almost see the hearts fluttering when this one passes by, on their way to derring-do and adventure.

desc.zh: 此人精力旺盛，身边的人常会受其感染而满是干劲
desc.en: Always animated, this one has an infectious vitality about them.

desc.zh: 总有人犯错，他们必须要付出代价
desc.en: It's always someone's fault. They can always be made to pay.

desc.zh: 此人百码开外一箭能射死一个食人魔，五十码能射中鼠人！
desc.en: This one can hit an Ogre at one hundred yards, and a ravening pack of Skaven at fifty!

desc.zh: 机会就像魔法，可以被个人意志所驾驭
desc.en: Chance is like magic – it can be harnessed to the individual's will.

desc.zh: 此人总是深思熟虑，从不妄下断论，其所有结论都建立在事实依据的基础之上，没有半点猜测
desc.en: Always considered, never rushing to judge, all conclusions based on empirical evidence, no conjecture.

desc.zh: 此人一定拥有秘法，否则怎会有人如此幸运！
desc.en: There must be runes about their person - no one could be this lucky otherwise!

desc.zh: 要想战胜此人就必须早做准备，没有什么能逃得过此人锐利的眼光和迅捷的反应
desc.en: You have to get up very early if you want to beat this one; nothing escapes their keen eye and lightning reflexes.

desc.zh: 此人堪称栋梁之才
desc.en: The strength at the base of the pillar.

desc.zh: 若叫此人设伏，那么事无巨细都会考虑得十分周全
desc.en: When this one plans an ambush, every possible option is considered. Nothing is left to chance.

desc.zh: 此人在战场上是众人跟随的楷模，敌人无不望风而逃！
desc.en: In battle, this one is a shining example for others to follow - and the foe to run away from!

desc.zh: 静观坐等可不是此人的行事风格
desc.en: Sitting around waiting for something to happen is not their style.

desc.zh: 此人总是迫不及待接战迎敌，这已远非热忱可以比拟
desc.en: More than keen, this one is positively champing at the bit to get up and at the enemy.

desc.zh: 此人堪称军中典范，同侪之中尚无可比肩者，更遑论敌人
desc.en: A paragon of martial excellence, with few peers among their own kind, let alone the enemy.

desc.zh: 此人十分警觉，总会静待时机发动进攻
desc.en: Ever watchful, this one bides their time until precisely the right moment to attack.

desc.zh: 保护海洋并不意味着与海洋居民并肩作战！
desc.en: Protecting the seas does *not* mean fighting alongside their denizens!

desc.zh: 此人超凡脱俗，在残酷的现实中仍无拘无束
desc.en: There's something of the other world about this one; this cruel plane has failed to engage them.

desc.zh: 天空本应是极限，但某些人会视其若无物
desc.en: The sky is the limit, with some finding it less limiting than others.

desc.zh: 天空本应是极限，但某些人会视其若无物
desc.en: The sky is the limit, with some finding it less limiting than others.

desc.zh: 绝境中的巍然屹立，最是鼓舞人心
desc.en: Standing tall against the sheerest of odds is a most inspiring merit.

desc.zh: 绝境中的巍然屹立，最是鼓舞人心
desc.en: Standing tall against the sheerest of odds is a most inspiring merit.

desc.zh: 有些人的心智易受魔法影响，而此人的意志却十分坚定
desc.en: Some minds are more susceptible to magical influence than others, but this one is strong indeed.

desc.zh: 有些人的心智易受魔法影响，而此人的意志却十分坚定
desc.en: Some minds are more susceptible to magical influence than others, but this one is strong indeed.

desc.zh: 一旦形势所需，那么便理应向敌人投掷出全部的怒火
desc.en: On occasion, throwing the whole nine leagues at the enemy is just the ticket.

desc.zh: 一旦形势所需，那么便理应向敌人投掷出全部的怒火
desc.en: On occasion, throwing the whole nine leagues at the enemy is just the ticket.

desc.zh: 玛瑟兰亲自选定此人作为神选。流水亦将臣服于他
desc.en: Mathlann himself has chosen this one to be his champion. Water itself obeys them.

desc.zh: 玛瑟兰亲自选定此人作为神选。流水亦将臣服于他
desc.en: Mathlann himself has chosen this one to be his champion. Water itself obeys them.

desc.zh: 作为，不作为，搞出变动，诸如此类，此人铁了心要跟主流对着干
desc.en: Action, inaction, change – you name it, this one will work against the prevailing wind.

desc.zh: 作为，不作为，搞出变动，诸如此类，此人铁了心要跟主流对着干
desc.en: Action, inaction, change – you name it, this one will work against the prevailing wind.

desc.zh: 此人光是拿起武器就相当费劲，更别说让他向敌人挥砍了
desc.en: It's as much effort as this one can make to lift a blade, let alone swing it at an opponent with force.

desc.zh: 此人在各方面都堪称完美精灵——除了身高
desc.en: This one is very much an Elf in all aspects except height.

desc.zh: 此人动作迅捷如雷，可翻身闪避对手的攻击
desc.en: This one moves like lightning, ducking and twisting to avoid their opponent's blows.

desc.zh: 此人动作迅捷如雷，可翻身闪避对手的攻击
desc.en: This one moves like lightning, ducking and twisting to avoid their opponent's blows.

desc.zh: 与其蛮力重击，何不精准制敌？
desc.en: Why hit hard when you can simply strike truer?

desc.zh: 与其蛮力重击，何不精准制敌？
desc.en: Why hit hard when you can simply strike truer?

desc.zh: 其显赫声威足以激发他人的勇气与行动
desc.en: Possessed of such eminence so as to spark others into bravery and action.

desc.zh: 其显赫声威足以激发他人的勇气与行动
desc.en: Possessed of such eminence so as to spark others into bravery and action.

desc.zh: 你肯定不会想成为此人的攻击对象，肯定不会的
desc.en: You really don't want to be on the receiving end of an attack made by this one. You really don’t.

desc.zh: 你肯定不会想成为此人的攻击对象，肯定不会的
desc.en: You really don't want to be on the receiving end of an attack made by this one. You really don’t.

desc.zh: 无论是天赋异禀还是超凡智慧，此人总能先人一步
desc.en: Whether through natural insight or supernatural acumen, they can see one step ahead of the others.

desc.zh: 无论是天赋异禀还是超凡智慧，此人总能先人一步
desc.en: Whether through natural insight or supernatural acumen, they can see one step ahead of the others.

desc.zh: 很多人都试过了，想杀这人没那么容易，相信我
desc.en: This one is not at all easy to kill, and many have tried, believe me.

desc.zh: 很多人都试过了，想杀这人没那么容易，相信我
desc.en: This one is not at all easy to kill, and many have tried, believe me.

desc.zh: 此人就是这么一个活生生的迟钝无聊散漫之人
desc.en: There's dull, boring, and inattentive... and there's this live wire.

desc.zh: 此人虽身负显赫地位，却如玛瑟兰般漠视荣耀，亦不关心他人疾苦
desc.en: This one carries the renown of their station, yet, like Mathlann, they have little care for it, or anyone else's tribulations.

desc.zh: 泪眼婆娑？非也。神秘莫测？亦非。精于迷雾障目之术？正是
desc.en: Teary-eyed? No. Mysterious? Not that either. Versed in the veiling ways of murky vapours? Exactly.

desc.zh: 泪眼婆娑？非也。神秘莫测？亦非。精于迷雾障目之术？正是
desc.en: Teary-eyed? No. Mysterious? Not that either. Versed in the veiling ways of murky vapours? Exactly.

desc.zh: 久居海上者终将学会凭直觉感知深渊真相
desc.en: Live at sea long enough and one starts to learn the lie of the deeps by instinct.

desc.zh: 久居海上者终将学会凭直觉感知深渊真相
desc.en: Live at sea long enough and one starts to learn the lie of the deeps by instinct.

desc.zh: 在此人看来，个人情感不应流露于众人面前
desc.en: Sentiments - and indeed feelings of any kind - are not for public display, in their estimation.

desc.zh: 在此人看来，个人情感不应流露于众人面前
desc.en: Sentiments - and indeed feelings of any kind - are not for public display, in their estimation.

desc.zh: 『事情总会有出路，总会有个角度的，你只需找到它即可』
desc.en: "There's always a way – always an angle. You just have to find it."

desc.zh: 『事情总会有出路，总会有个角度的，你只需找到它即可』
desc.en: "There's always a way – always an angle. You just have to find it."

desc.zh: 并非所有雄鹰都生有双翼，但皆怀翱翔之志
desc.en: Not all eagles are born with wings, yet all share a soaring spirit.

desc.zh: 并非所有雄鹰都生有双翼，但皆怀翱翔之志
desc.en: Not all eagles are born with wings, yet all share a soaring spirit.

desc.zh: 那些见证过一切，并幸存下来讲述自己所见的人，皆拥有丰富的实战经验和实用建议
desc.en: Those who have seen things – and lived to tell of it – possess a wealth of field experience and practical advice.

desc.zh: 那些见证过一切，并幸存下来讲述自己所见的人，皆拥有丰富的实战经验和实用建议
desc.en: Those who have seen things – and lived to tell of it – possess a wealth of field experience and practical advice.

desc.zh: 『虽目不能视，他超凡的洞察却能指引方向；虽为凡人，但无论神魔皆难逃其陷阱』
desc.en: "Though blind, his otherworldly sight shows him the way. Though only human, neither mortal nor immortal can escape his traps."

desc.zh: 『折磨者女领主，残酷如她的美貌，无情如她的魅惑』
desc.en: “The Mistress of the Tormentors, as cruel as she is beautiful and as pitiless and she is beguiling.”

desc.zh: 恶意与敬仰，皆难逃斯泰卡尔肩头那道无形之眼的洞察。喋血征战与狂言傲行，正铸就着他的不朽传奇
desc.en: Ill intent and reverence alike cannot elude the unseen watcher at Styrkaar's shoulder, growing his legend in bloodshed and boastful grandstanding.

desc.zh: 侥幸从诅咒剧团手中生还者，无不层感受过筋骨俱裂的极致痛苦。而此刻，假面舞者仍在翩翩起舞…
desc.en: The few who survive encounters with the Accursed Troupe feel the bone-weary agony of a body pushed to its limits. Meanwhile, the Masque dances on…

desc.zh: 魔法之风的诡谲流向本无定途，但对精通水晶迷宫中疯狂弯道之人而言，其他路径皆是直线，触手可及
desc.en: The shifting currents of the Winds take devious paths, but for one versed in the Crystal Labyrinth's maddening turns, everything else is a straight line, easily followed.

desc.zh: 艾吉克能操纵火焰的喋喋之舌，沿秘法之路灼烧敌人的血肉与灵魂，无论他们自以为多么安全
desc.en: Azrik can guide a fire's manifold garrulous tongues along arcane avenues that burn a foe's flesh and soul, no matter how safe they think they are.

desc.zh: 艾吉克的护盾能偏转必中之击，或抹消片刻前已命中之伤——至少他的倒霉敌人曾如此确信！
desc.en: Azrik's protection allows him to divert blows that are destined to land or negate ones that, in fact, landed just a moment ago – or so his hapless foe thought!

desc.zh: 他们与混沌侵蚀的土地血脉相连，连大地本身都会响应其意志
desc.en: Intrinsically connected to the Chaos-infused lands of their dwelling, the very earth responds to their will.

desc.zh: 沼泽中的诡异护符与霉变骨饰，往往承载着意想不到的祝福与代价
desc.en: Strange talismans and mouldy bone charms of the fens can often carry unique and unforeseen boons and side effects.

desc.zh: 自贝奥尔格获赐兽化赠礼，被黑暗诸神钦定为领袖那日起，整个北方都将见证随之而来的荣耀杀戮
desc.en: From the day Beorg received the Gift of the Were, singled out by the Dark Gods to lead his people, all the North would come to know that glorious carnage would follow.

desc.zh: 奋不顾身地战斗中，狂怒磨练了贝奥尔格的直觉，这都是为了让敌人的鲜血流淌得更为汹涌
desc.en: Though he fights with heedless abandon, the furore of battle hones Beorg’s instincts to ensure the blood of his enemies spills more copiously than his own.

desc.zh: 虽唯有贝奥尔格能完全化身为熊，但其部众也常会突现利爪、獠牙、鬃毛与熊形口鼻
desc.en: Though only Beorg carries the full shape of the bear, his kinsmen are also known for occasionally sprouting claws, snarling teeth, mane-like fur and bear-shaped muzzles.

desc.zh: 被亵渎嗜血吞噬的混沌疯徒，为了取悦神明，也出于纯粹的『热爱』，将恐惧播撒于千场战役
desc.en: Consumed by unholy bloodlust, these Chaos-tainted madmen have sown terror across a thousand battlefields for the esteem of their Gods and, of course, the sheer *love* of it all.

desc.zh: 当敌人认出贝奥尔格的战吼时，为时已晚
desc.en: By the time one recognises Beorg's war cry, it is already too late.

desc.zh: 贝奥尔格蔑视所谓的『文明』世界，却会欣然享用文明的果实——然后将其吞噬殆尽
desc.en: Beorg cares little for the so-called ’civilised’ world, but he nevertheless appreciates the fruits of civilisation's labour as he devours them.

desc.zh: 乌尔斯峡湾人坚信最强大的熊会永葆野性，而他们的氏族长正是最强熊族血统的活证
desc.en: The greatest of bears is endlessly savage, the Ursfjordlings know, for they regard their Chieftain as living proof of the greatest ursine bloodline.

desc.zh: 无论贝奥尔格是冲锋迎敌，还是静待敌方精锐来袭，他的侍从皆坚信血腥的胜利必将降临
desc.en: Whether Beorg strides forth to meet his enemies, or stands expecting their strongest warriors to come forth, those with him are utterly convinced of bloody victory.

desc.zh: 纳垢赠礼的真正力量，在于其欢愉而瘟腐的自我增殖——无论『自我』是何形态
desc.en: The true power of Nurgle's Gifts is that joyously, and pestilentially, they make more of themselves, whatever ’they’ may be.

desc.zh: 大不净者腐躯的剧毒之力能穿透任何护甲，亦能将锈蚀的敌刃残片折入己身
desc.en: The noxious strength of a Great Unclean One's bodily putrefaction cuts through any protection as readily as it folds the corroded remains of any enemy weapon into itself.

desc.zh: 大不净者会召唤一股恶心的恶臭来治疗自己，并伤害那些不幸被困其中的敌人
desc.en: By which the Great Unclean One calls down a disgusting shower of putrid yuck to heal themselves and harm those foes unfortunate enough to be caught in it.

desc.zh: 人类玩意、精灵族类，还有矮垛子混蛋？不过都是待踏碎的虫豸！
desc.en: Man-things, Elf-kind or stunted Dawi – it matters not, for all are mere insects to be trampled underfoot!

desc.zh: 这家伙把亲手杀死之人的头骨和破败的战利品都挂在身上，是个天生的猎头者，完全配得上诺斯卡的传奇之名
desc.en: Adorned in the cracked skulls and battered trappings of those slain by their hand, this fiend is a born head-hunter, worthy of Norscan legend.

desc.zh: 这家伙对金银财宝永远觉得不够，看到闪闪发光的东西就挪不动腿，还特别擅长把值钱玩意搞到手
desc.en: A constant hunger and lust for gold and shiny things; a talent for finding and lifting anything of value.

desc.zh: 这些生物生而为领袖，因此注定伟大，自诞生之刻便被其城塞的沼栖妖女族长所选中
desc.en: These creatures are born to lead and marked for greatness, chosen the moment they hatch by the Fimir Matriarch of their stronghold.

desc.zh: 沼栖妖贵族畸变的血肉会扭曲蠕动，在伤口出现的瞬间将其愈合
desc.en: The Fimir Noble's unnatural flesh twists and writhes to seal wounds moments after they are inflicted.

desc.zh: 沼栖妖贵族狡诈机敏，能指挥战帮直击敌人薄弱环节
desc.en: A creature of cunning and opportunism, the Fimir Noble can direct their warband to exploit the weaknesses of their foes.

desc.zh: 凡遭沼栖妖贵族的灾咒巨槌击中的活物，则未等武器的衰朽魔法生效，便已化为血肉残堆
desc.en: Any living thing on the receiving end of a blow by a Fimir Noble's Baleglyph maul would be a crumpled heap of flesh long before the weapon's atrophic magic takes its toll.

desc.zh: 沼栖妖将沼泽堡垒的蔽日毒雾带上了战场，它不仅能扭曲视线，更可蚀化刺目的阳光
desc.en: The obscuring fog that shrouds the Fimir’s boggy fortresses follows them onto the battlefield, shielding them from more than just prying eyes and the harsh sun.

desc.zh: 当乘上那些由骨头和木料搭建而成，以受害者的肌腱和肠子绑成一团的简陋战车后，掠夺者们会获得强得多的机动能力
desc.en: Marauder mobs are awarded even greater mobility when riding their crude chariots of bone and wood, lashed together with the guts and sinew of the vanquished.

desc.zh: 诺斯卡战马生而为战，比起嚼草皮来说，它们更喜欢去啃食死人的骨头
desc.en: The horses of Norsca live for battle, even choosing to graze on the bones of the fallen over grass.

desc.zh: 这些凶猛的怪物背驮战争神龛，带着渎神标记和邪恶遗物，在黑暗诸神的注视下奔赴战场
desc.en: This vicious beast carries a warshrine aloft, carrying blasphemous icons and unholy relics to battle in sight of the Chaos Gods.

desc.zh: 当乘上那些由骨头和木料搭建而成，以受害者的肌腱和肠子绑成一团的简陋战车后，掠夺者们会获得强得多的机动能力

desc.en: This vicious beast carries a warshrine aloft, carrying blasphemous icons and unholy relics to battle in sight of the Chaos Gods.

desc.zh: 无论是在寂静的雪原还是尸横遍野的战场，大萨满术士皆擅长以杀戮献祭取悦黑暗诸神
desc.en: Either in the quiet, snow-swept Northern expanses or on a screaming battlefield littered with death, Great Shaman Sorcerers are adept at enacting sacrifices in propitiation of the Dark Gods.

desc.zh: 纵是嗜血成性的诺斯卡人，若无大萨满术士的激发，亦难达癫狂之境
desc.en: Even in those Norscans most prone to bloody excess, the Great Shaman Sorcerers inspire paroxysms of frenzy that would be impossible without them.

desc.zh: 大萨满术士常为战争推手，以预言之力向氏族长耳语荣耀的幻景
desc.en: Great Shaman Sorcerers are often the ones creating the impetus for war, using their prophetic influence to whisper visions of glory into the minds of the Chieftains.

desc.zh: 通过正确的仪式，魔法之风亦可如长鞭般编织挥舞
desc.en: With the correct ritual, even the Winds of Magic can be woven and wielded like a whip.

desc.zh: 根据诺斯卡之道，萨满术士的任何诡诈契约，皆须以血封缄。当然，不是他们自己的血…
desc.en: In true Norscan fashion, whatever cunning pacts and bargains the Shaman Sorcerers pursue, they must seal them with blood. Not theirs, of course…

desc.zh: 毒蛇般迅捷的鞭击与淬毒的刃锋，正是神蛇冠军勇士的标志
desc.en: Whip-like speed and the bite of an envenomed blade are hallmarks of Champions of the Serpent-God.

desc.zh: 『凝视我的圣洁之躯然后绝望吧！无尽的苦痛正等着你！』
desc.en: "Look upon my beatific form and despair, for endless agonies await you."

desc.zh: 如鳞片般苍白的肌肤与强韧的体魄，正是神蛇冠军勇士常见的恩赐
desc.en: Pale, almost scale-like, alabaster skin and a strong fortitude are common boons among the Serpent's Champions.

desc.zh: 谁能下手攻击这样的妙人呢？毕竟，伤害这样迷人的美丽正是一种耻辱
desc.en: Who could strike at such a tempting figure? After all, it would be a shame to mar such beguiling beauty.

desc.zh: 『神犬的战士们，起身吧！今天我们要用敌人的鲜血泡澡！』
desc.en: "Warriors of the Hound arise, for today we bathe in the blood of our foes!"

desc.zh: 『烧！烧尽一切！将血肉灼成焦炭，他们注定要成为颅座的祭品！』
desc.en: "Burn! Burn it all to the ground! Sear the flesh from their bodies, for they are destined for the Throne of Skulls!"

desc.zh: 不知疲倦、无所动摇、永不溃退，神犬的行刑官会追杀血神之敌至世界尽头
desc.en: Relentless, unfazed, unbroken – the headsman of the Hound will pursue the Blood God's enemies to the ends of the earth.

desc.zh: 恐虐会因每一次的杀戮为战士们赐福，并享受受害者的痛苦和尖叫
desc.en: Khorne blesses his warriors for every enemy slain, feasting on their suffering and screams.

desc.zh: 用鲜血滋润土壤，每一滴都是杀戮的动力！
desc.en: Quench the soil in blood; every drop is but murderous motivation!

desc.zh: 但凡是有命看到这种狂怒化身的人，就算他们没有立刻脑袋搬家，也会目瞪口呆，僵立当场
desc.en: Those who behold such rage incarnate would surely stare in awe, were their heads not promptly removed from their bodies.

desc.zh: 这些被驯服的凶兽满身战痕，即便在怪物中也显得格外残暴，更能承受惊人的伤害
desc.en: Scarred and brutish, even for monstrous beasts, these now-tamed creatures can shrug off incredible punishment.

desc.zh: 将法杖或是某种奥术导体插入大地之后，有经验的施法者便会有效地束缚魔法之风，从而大大降低施法事故的触发概率
desc.en: By stabbing a staff or some arcane conduit into the ground, an accomplished magic-user can earth or tether the Winds and hopefully reduce a chance of miscasting.

desc.zh: 一些魔法使用者有能力储存魔法之风以备日后使用，从而强化他们的施法能力
desc.en: A few magic-users have the ability to store the Winds of Magic for later use, increasing their spellcasting power when it really counts.

desc.zh: 当乘上那些由骨头和木料搭建而成，以受害者的肌腱和肠子绑成一团的简陋战车后，掠夺者们会获得强得多的机动能力
desc.en: Marauder mobs are awarded even greater mobility when riding their crude chariots of bone and wood, lashed together with the guts and sinew of the vanquished.

desc.zh: 诺斯卡战马生而为战，比起嚼草皮来说，它们更喜欢去啃食死人的骨头
desc.en: The horses of Norsca live for battle, even choosing to graze on the bones of the fallen over grass.

desc.zh: 这些凶猛的怪物背驮战争神龛，带着渎神标记和邪恶遗物，在黑暗诸神的注视下奔赴战场
desc.en: This vicious beast carries a warshrine aloft, carrying blasphemous icons and unholy relics to battle in sight of the Chaos Gods.

desc.zh: 萨尔总会在最佳时机让敌人醒悟：他们的秘法之力，实则早已落入其手
desc.en: It is not until the most opportune moment that Sayl reveals to his enemies that their occult power was in fact in his hands all along.

desc.zh: 萨尔从同族那里招致的憎恨与恐惧，却为更大的部落所尊重、钦佩和留意
desc.en: The hatred and fear Sayl garners from his own kin is something respected, admired, and heeded by the greater tribes.

desc.zh: 萨尔混沌癫狂的感官所窥见的异界之力，有时也可受其攫取，化为己用
desc.en: What eldritch power Sayl's Chaos-maddened senses can glimpse, they can sometimes grasp, and make it his.

desc.zh: 魔法曾令萨尔容颜尽毁，但他已习得更精妙的技术
desc.en: Though it was magic that disfigured Sayl so terribly, he has since learned better.

desc.zh: 此乃萨尔创造『夜喉兽』时所释原始力量的受控形态。如今他的术士可坐享其成，除非他『有意』引发意外…
desc.en: A much more controlled manifestation of the raw power unleashed when Sayl created the Nightmaw. Now his Sorcerers can benefit from it, barring any… accidents of his choosing.

desc.zh: 萨尔右手的颅骨非装饰，而是警示。有时举颅示警比挥杖发怒更为有效
desc.en: The skull in Sayl's right hand is no mere ornament. It is a reminder. Sometimes raising the skull in warning is more effective than raising his staff in anger.

desc.zh: 萨尔只会走自己的路。魔法之风的潮起潮落正是他的堤道
desc.en: Sayl follows no path but his own. The ebb and flow of the Winds are his causeways.

desc.zh: 这些憎恶的主人精心锤炼了它们的杀戮欲，同时也抹除了自身的愤怒也可能伤害它们自身的认知
desc.en: These abominations' master has honed their murder-lust as carefully as he has excised their awareness of himself as a possible target of their wrath.

desc.zh: 当萨尔断绝了任何臣服或反叛的可能性后，他的效忠便最终只能将他自己引向命中注定的终局
desc.en: When Sayl has closed other avenues of servitude or rebellion, all that is left is to serve him to the bitter end he has chosen for you.

desc.zh: 迷雾有时似乎有着自主意志，想要将受害者愚弄并困于其中。而有时，那种意志实际是为他人所操控的一样…
desc.en: Mists sometimes feel as if they have a will of their own, a presence meant to trick and thwart those lost within them. Sometimes, that will is, in fact, someone else's…

desc.zh: 于某些人而言，濒死苦痛方会觉醒真实力量。彼等甘愿流血，召引凡胎不应驾驭的风暴
desc.en: For some, deathly agony is what awakens true power. They bleed willingly to conjure storms no mortals should wield.

desc.zh: 切勿低估身经百战的战斗法师，这些精通巫术者能以千百种方式弑杀冠军勇士
desc.en: Do not underestimate the strength of a battle-hardened warrior-sorcerer, for a Champion can fall to one gifted in sorcery in many ways.

desc.zh: 『骸骨向我低语。但谁能分辨那是神鹰的启示，还是其他存在的意志？』
desc.en: "The bones speak to me. Whether they spin the whispers of the Eagle, or the will of another, one cannot be sure."

desc.zh: 混沌的教义传播方式多种多样，通常依靠利剑，但偶尔也会由精通黑暗语的使者通过更诡谲的方式散播
desc.en: The message of Chaos is spread in many ways – usually by a raised sword, but occasionally by the word of a Dark Tongue speaker summoned to use more arcane methods.

desc.zh: 常年解读预兆的经验，令他们在巫术之道上锻炼出了超凡的专注力
desc.en: Years spent scrying portents and divining omens fosters keen focus in the arts of sorcery.

desc.zh: 一群人皮狼发出的可怕嚎叫，足以让任何因害怕到大脑空白的敌人瘫软在地
desc.en: The terrifying, echoing howls of a cadre of Skin Wolves are enough to cripple any foe with fearful indecision.

desc.zh: 无论是人是兽，一旦被这潜行者锁定气息，注定将迎来迅速而痛苦的终结
desc.en: A stalker of men and beasts alike, any unfortunate foe whose scent is caught is sure to meet a quick and agonising end.

desc.zh: 注意巨身狼人的嗥叫！那意味着残酷杀戮与腥风血雨即将降临！
desc.en: Heed the howl of the Werekin! For vicious slaughter and bloody ruin are soon to follow!

desc.zh: 索隆格并非唯一习惯艰苦生活方式的人。他的军队诞生于荒凉的北方，残酷的起源使他们更加强大
desc.en: Throgg is not the only one that is accustomed to a harder way of life. His armies, born from the desolate North, are made stronger by their tumultuous origins.

desc.zh: 索隆格身后如影随形的严冬，甚至无法让他覆着厚皮的身躯微微颤抖
desc.en: The bitter winters which follow in Throgg's stead barely send a shiver across his thick skin.

desc.zh: 『听我号令，扭曲的怪物们！我们将共同用死亡溺死整个世界！』
desc.en: "Hearken to me, twisted beasts and monsters all. Together we shall drown the world in death!"

desc.zh: 欲铸就传奇史诗，须如严冬般酷烈，似诺斯卡永冻土般坚不可摧
desc.en: To forge one's own Saga, one must be as fierce as winter, and as hard as the Norscan permafrost.

desc.zh: 北方长牙巨兽的凶暴本性，在无情的鞭挞下化作了毁灭的力量
desc.en: The ferocity of the frigid north's tusked titans is harnessed to devastating effect by the harsh and unyielding lash.

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 欲魔全力冲刺之时，任何箭矢都难以望其项背。而一旦受到驱使，她们突进时的执着堪比任何箭矢
desc.en: No missile is a match for a Daemonette's body in full rush. Their singular purpose, once encouraged, is not unlike that of a missile itself.

desc.zh: 魅魔侍女从这狂乱喧嚣、尖叫骤停的轮回中，洞悉了精妙的交织规律，并以此指引着信徒们的行动
desc.en: The Alluress instructs those around her, in subtle interlocking patterns discerned from the cacophonous cycle of wheeling madness and screams stopped suddenly short.

desc.zh: 在战阵的最前线，魅魔侍女让敌人亲身品尝着面对色孽蛊惑之力时的绝望
desc.en: At the forefront of battle, the Alluress provides her enemies with a taste of their powerlessness against Slaanesh's mesmeric guile.

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 对于为色孽而战、以纵欲供奉邪神者而言，侍奉强大的女主便是最为接近黑暗亲王的体验
desc.en: To those who fight and those who feed Slaanesh's desire for excess, a powerful mistress is the closest they can get to the Dark Prince's presence.

desc.zh: 狂信徒以两种方式立下典范：其一是用甜言蜜语将色孽诱人教义渗透给心甘情愿之徒；而在战场上，她展现的却是截然不同的风范
desc.en: A Cultist sets one kind of example by sweetly insinuating Slaanesh's delectable doctrine into willing minds. On the battlefield, she sets a different example altogether.

desc.zh: 受邪教徒蛊惑的凡人，将虔诚的目光与敬畏之心融为一体，专注于监控隐秘的小径、敌军的逼近，以及所有可供她行动的战机
desc.en: Swayed by their Cultist, mortals temper their devoted gaze with deference, sharpening it on hidden pathways, the approach of foes, and opportunities for her to act.

name.en: Bend the Mind, Bend the Flesh

desc.zh: 诱惑的种子在意识中萌芽，最终在血肉中绽放，昭示通往混沌的堕落之路
desc.en: The seed of temptation in the mind blossoms in the flesh of the tempted, to flower fully and reveal the path to Chaos.

desc.zh: 欢愉亲王在所有人的耳边窃窃私语，怂恿着他们每一个越轨的欲望
desc.en: The Prince of Pleasure whispers in the ears of all, pulling at the threads of their every deviant desire.

desc.zh: 对于为色孽而战、以纵欲供奉邪神者而言，侍奉强大的女主便是最为接近黑暗亲王的体验
desc.en: To those who fight and those who feed Slaanesh's desire for excess, a powerful mistress is the closest they can get to the Dark Prince's presence.

desc.zh: 黑暗亲王的仆从永远受制于他的奇思妙想。而这些奇想，有时仅仅意味着…放任他们自由行动。他的宠儿迪卡菈便是如此
desc.en: The Dark Prince's servants are eternally bound to His whims. Those same whims, at times, dictate that He simply... set them loose. So it is with his favoured servant, Dechala.

desc.zh: 迪卡菈在因毒化而踉跄的敌群中翩然旋舞，看着武器从他们麻痹的指间滑落，让绝望阻停他们的心脏
desc.en: Dechala spins effortlessly amidst her poisoned, stumbling foes, weapons dropping from their nerveless fingers, hearts giving out in sheer despair.

desc.zh: 刀光如魅影回旋，攻势迅疾难辨，既会阻敌孤注一掷，也会激励追随者为赢宠姬青睐而一展雄姿
desc.en: A hypnotising gyre of flashing blades too fast to follow, denying any desperate attack and inspiring Dechala's followers to feats of battlefield grace to win their mistress' favour.

desc.zh: 折磨者们对敌施加的痛苦与放纵，皆不及他们曾为取乐的自戕之万一
desc.en: There is no kind of pain and excess the Tormentors can inflict on their foes that they haven't already inflicted upon themselves, for sport.

desc.zh: 无论是蜿蜒扭动绞杀奴仆，还是欢欣雀跃冲入战阵，迪卡菈始终沉醉于制造痛苦与苦难的暴行
desc.en: Whether sinuously squeezing the life out of her thralls or rushing gleefully into the fray, Dechala revels in her feats of pain and misery.

desc.zh: 当迪卡菈的猎物饱受噩梦缠身之苦时，她的信徒们却渴盼着她的拥抱，并甘愿放弃战场内外的一切安逸
desc.en: While Dechala's captives-to-be have nightmares of the suffering to come, her devoted followers dream of its embrace, and willingly forgo comfort and safety on and off the battlefield.

desc.zh: 色孽的强大仆从常为精灵的优雅与高贵所诱，视其为完美的腐化对象。但迪卡菈对精灵乃是一种憎恶与痴迷交织的感情，尤为危险
desc.en: Powerful Slaaneshi servants are often drawn to the Elves' poise and nobility, ripe for corruption. But Dechala's irrational mixture of hatred and fascination for them is *especially* volatile.

desc.zh: 以优雅拨开来袭的箭矢，这本是色孽眷顾者的专长。若多生几对手臂，则更为游刃有余
desc.en: Swatting away hurtling missiles is what Slaaneshi grace is particularly well-suited to. Even more so for those endowed with more than the usual single pair of hands.

desc.zh: 黑暗亲王的塑形馈赠或许会粉碎渴求者的虚荣，反而致其败亡。但鲜有人如迪卡菈与其冠军勇士般以此畸变为荣
desc.en: The Dark Prince's form-altering gifts can sometimes crush the vanity of His aspirants, ironically dooming them to failure. Few take as much pride in them as Dechala and her champions.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵冰冷寒风，用寒冰和冰雹攻击敌人
desc.en: A freezing gale is conjured and sent to assail the target with ice and hail.

desc.zh: 黑暗的触手向外翻腾，使施法者吸取敌人的生命来恢复自己的活力
desc.en: Tendrils of solidified darkness writhe outwards, draining the lifeforce from foes and renewing the caster’s own vigour.

desc.zh: 施法者念诵出禁忌之名，敌人就会陷入一阵阵痛苦
desc.en: As the caster utters a forbidden name, their enemies are wracked with waves of agony.

desc.zh: 黑暗亲王的三尾鞭精妙一吻，敌人就会尝到他那美味的愤怒
desc.en: The exquisite kiss of the Dark Prince's three-tailed whip strikes the enemy with a delicious fury.

desc.zh: 天空中化出一面镜子，随即粉碎成无数致命的碎片，割伤地面上的敌人
desc.en: A mirror forms in the sky, only to be shattered into a myriad of deadly shards that lacerate the enemy below.

desc.zh: 施法者的敌人被非理性的情绪所吞噬，极度的痛苦和狂喜，导致他们陷入了疯狂的暴怒
desc.en: The caster's victims are engulfed by a torrent of unreasoning emotion, excruciating pain and blissful rapture, causing them to embark on a riotous, clawing rampage.

desc.zh: 纳迦罗斯土生土长的野兽，黑暗而凶残。它们走出了温暖潮湿的巢穴，承载着杜鲁齐们奔向战场
desc.en: Dark, feral beasts indigenous to Naggaroth, tempted from their damp, warm caves to bear the Druchii to battle.

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 杜鲁齐受祝者并无凡人对混沌魔法的憎惧，自然也不会畏惧其扭曲之力
desc.en: The Druchii Anointed possess none of other mortals' loathing towards Chaos magic or fear for how it may twist them.

desc.zh: 精灵的优雅向来被冰冷克制所束缚，而对色孽的虔诚终将打破这副枷锁
desc.en: Elven grace has ever been held back by cold restraint. Devotion to Slaanesh unshackles it.

desc.zh: 扭曲的心灵最好严加看管，否则潜逃之后必成祸患
desc.en: Twisted minds are best kept close, lest they slink away and return a threat.

desc.zh: 虽然不少人钟爱战场的死亡之舞，但总有受祝者更为享受孤寂暗影中的狩猎，化身为致命的幽暗轮廓
desc.en: Though many prefer the deadly dance of the battlefield, some Anointed thrive hunting in solitary darkness, becoming little more than deadly silhouettes.

desc.zh: 欢愉教派在黑暗精灵中本属禁忌，但其遗产与教义仍在公开侍奉色孽者中流传
desc.en: The Cult of Pleasure might have been taboo among the Dark Elves, but its legacy and teachings live on where they are readily embraced, in open service of Slaanesh.

desc.zh: 对黑暗亲王近乎苦修般的虔信，是杜鲁齐受祝者的标志性特征
desc.en: A single-minded, almost paradoxically ascetic devotion to the Dark Prince is the hallmark of the Druchii Anointed.

desc.zh: 即便置身于最耀眼的光芒之中，杜鲁齐受祝者的存在仍如扰人残影，诱人注目却令人困惑
desc.en: Even in the brightest light, the Druchii Anointed's presence is an unsettling afterimage that both draws attention and confounds one's focus.

desc.zh: 那些历经迫害、遭家园放逐的杜鲁齐，终以对黑暗亲王的狂热侍奉证明了自己
desc.en: Those of the Druchii who have survived persecution and banishment from their homeland have been fully vindicated in their zealous devotion to the Dark Prince.

desc.zh: 获得色孽印记即意味着被赋予了不仅五感之内的超凡感知。对于他们而言，意志薄弱、犹豫不决的敌人犹如无可抗拒的诱饵
desc.en: Those whom Slaanesh favours with His mark are gifted with extraordinary senses, and not just the usual five. Weak-willed and the hesitant foes draw them almost irresistibly.

desc.zh: 混沌仆从皆为可憎，而色孽仆从尤为甚之：其污秽的举止，映射的正是凡人竭力否认的欲望
desc.en: All servants of Chaos are loathsome in their own way, and those of Slaanesh especially so, for their foul demeanour mirrors urges one would do anything not to acknowledge.

desc.zh: 色孽最阴险的馈赠之一，便是令敌人不忍伤害其宠儿，甚至甘愿对其加以赞颂
desc.en: Among the most insidious of Slaanesh's gifts renders the enemy unwilling to hurt His favoured devotees, and even willing to praise them.

desc.zh: 这是个秘而不宣的真相：色孽战士永不疲倦，亦无需停歇。而保守还是揭露这个秘密，全凭守密者一念之间
desc.en: A secret closely kept: Slaanesh's warriors need not tire, nor stop. It is up to a Keeper to disclose it or conceal it, as whim dictates.

desc.zh: 畸形的躯壳往往暗藏玄机，它能打破你脑子里那些刻板印象，让你不再为自己的身体感到自卑或恐惧
desc.en: The exquisite deformities of one's shape are not devoid of utility, shattering the stained glass of the mind, and those of the fear-stained body.

desc.zh: 万千肢体组成的军队遮天蔽日，无数宝石般的眼眸令仰望者瞬间失明
desc.en: A host so many-limbed that it blots out the sun, so jewel-eyed that it blinds anyone who looks up at them.

desc.zh: 守密者的存在本身便足以令凡人狂喜失智，让色孽高阶仆从沉醉膜拜
desc.en: A Keeper's mere presence is enough to drive lowly mortals mad with rapture and Slaanesh's higher servants rapt with adoration.

desc.zh: 如此强大的人只需稍微现身，就能让敌人陷入恐惧与自我怀疑，从而大大地丧失战意
desc.en: The mere presence of one so mighty has the enemy gripped by fear, weakened by their own self-doubt.

desc.zh: 欲守护超凡的奥秘，先需洞悉凡俗一切：箭矢的轨迹、敌方的诡谋、进军的节奏皆须尽在掌握才是
desc.en: To keep exalted secrets, one must know all mundane ones. The path of an arrow. The petty ploys of an attacker. The pace of an advance.

desc.zh: 最平凡的灰线可以孕育最强大的潜能
desc.en: The meanest streaks give rise to the greatest potential.

desc.zh: 『现在，再来一次…但要做得更好』
desc.en: "Now do it again... but better."

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 黑暗亲王的箴言当如耳语般传递，而真正的军锋跨越这段距离不过弹指之间
desc.en: The Dark Prince's word must not be shouted, but whispered in one's ear. Closing the requisite distance is no issue to a true Herald.

desc.zh: 欲魔不仅是绝美舞者，更能随时调整舞步，在战场上完美传递军锋的意志
desc.en: Daemonettes are no mere exemplars of prancing perfection. They can shape their antics to carry the Herald's message on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 那是飘荡在魔法之风中的幽香，是夺人声线的异香，是恍若生命源泉的迷香
desc.en: A scent seen floating on the Winds, a scent to rob the speech of sound, a scent to succour as if sustenance.

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 一段无人闻听的诱人旋律残响…一抹眼角掠过的魅惑身姿…我刚才要做什么来着？…
desc.en: A tantalising snippet of a song no one else can hear... An enticing movement just out of the corner of one eye… What was I meant to be doing, again?...

desc.zh: 在战斗的混乱中，由扭曲躯体交织成的画面堪称一景…若舞者们有意，亦可灵巧地将其隐匿于视线之外
desc.en: A tapestry of twisting bodies is a sight to behold amidst the chaos of battle... or a sight cunningly hidden from the eye, should the dancers wish it so.

desc.zh: 史诗般的场面总需重骑冲锋的装点——尽管骑手以桀骜闻名。但精心编排的混乱，亦是演出的一部分
desc.en: Nothing portends an epic set-piece like a mighty cavalry charge, though the riders in question have proven themselves famously unruly. But well-orchestrated chaos is still a part of the performance.

desc.zh: 战场上的混乱常使精准武技失色，但若有某处适合假面舞者致命舞步的绽放，那必是在那混乱之中
desc.en: The chaos of battle can often sand off the edges off precise martial choreography, but if there is a place where the Masque's perfectly honed, deadly movements thrive, it is *that* chaos.

desc.zh: 身为曾最受宠的色孽欲魔，假面舞者只需轻挥手腕，便能将同类化作血溅狂欢的舞团
desc.en: Once the most favoured of the Daemonettes, the Masque can turn her kind into a blood-spattered, bacchanalian troupe with a mere flick of her wrist.

desc.zh: 慵懒无休的华尔兹，以旋绕敌目的虚影令其心智溃散
desc.en: A languorous, ceaseless waltz to haunt the enemy with spinning figures just outside the edge of their vision.

desc.zh: 假面舞者的永恒之舞虽是色孽盛怒之下所降的诅咒，却反而成为了一种强大的祝福
desc.en: The Masque's Eternal Dance, though a curse born out of Slaanesh's wounded pride and anger, may have turned out to be a mighty blessing in disguise.

desc.zh: 接敌越早，敌人的身躯便会越快沦为舞步的点缀，哪怕只有瞬息
desc.en: The sooner the foes are engaged, the sooner their bodies will become a part of the Dance, if only for a little while.

desc.zh: 骇人的美貌，阴险的顽强。对色孽恶魔仆从的仇恨越是强烈，他们就越有可能为了你而重组自己
desc.en: Horrifyingly beautiful, insidiously tenacious. The more passionate your hatred towards the fiendish servants of Slaanesh, the more likely they will reconstitute themselves just for your sake.

desc.zh: 凡有血肉之处，纳卡里便可诱其堕落，进而腐化灵魂。低等生灵的肉体凡胎，不过是纳卡里利用的棋子罢了
desc.en: As long as there is flesh, N'Kari can tempt it, and through it – the spirit. A lesser creature's form only exists for N'Kari's benefit.

desc.zh: 纳卡里擅于谄媚色孽大魔。他明白此不过虚妄，而大魔亦然。但双方皆乐在其中
desc.en: N'kari is adept at heaping praise upon the mightier of Slaanesh's Daemons in his service. He knows it is false, as do they. They take delight in it nonetheless.

desc.zh: 这条庞大的滑行色孽怪兽是欲魔们珍视的坐骑，它们以超自然的速度嘶嘶作响、迅猛咬噬，并用其可怕的目光施以魅惑
desc.en: This large, slithering monstrosity of Slaanesh is a prized mount among Daemonettes, hissing and snapping with preternatural speed and mesmerising with their terrible gaze.

desc.zh: 这些战马具有长而扭曲的身体，当它们冲向敌人时会不断地扭动
desc.en: Steeds have long, sinuous bodies that writhe ceaselessly as they dash towards the foe.

desc.zh: 尽管斯泰卡尔的头衔是世袭而来，但无人能否认，他本人也极其适合这一身份
desc.en: Despite Styrkaar's title being hereditary, none can deny it is one he is supremely well-suited to.

desc.zh: 斯泰卡尔虽惯于咆哮恫吓，但其最恐怖的时刻，乃是以凝视与狞笑锁定猎物之时
desc.en: Though he enjoys his fair share of bluster and screaming, Styrkaar is at his most terrible when he singles out his victim with but a stare and a wolfish grin.

desc.zh: 怀着对魅力与野心的痴迷，百战老兵与远古战士皆愿在无名的战场上与斯泰卡尔并肩赴死
desc.en: In fascination of his charisma and ambition, veteran and elder warriors alike give their lives to stand on a nameless battlefield side by side with Styrkaar.

desc.zh: 恶魔低语似在影响斯泰卡尔及其周遭众人，纵使惨遭开膛破肚，他们仍会在扭曲意志的作用下对其感恩颂德
desc.en: A Daemonic presence seems to influence Styrkaar and those around him, bending their will to give him thanks and praise even as he disembowels them.

desc.zh: 在混沌荒原中的成长，暴力的陪伴本就是常态。但始终以沉默狞笑承受一切的，只有斯泰卡尔而已
desc.en: A violent upbringing is nothing unusual for those denizens of the Chaos Wastes who survive into adulthood. To bear it all with a silent smirk, however, is.

desc.zh: 混沌荒原上连牲畜都是凶名赫赫，但鲜有什么能比得上斯泰卡尔。如果卡纳克、阿斯盖尔与『荣光』万卓德尚存，或可作证
desc.en: Even cattle in the Chaos Wastes have a dreadful reputation. Few have truly earned it like Styrkaar, however. Karnak, Asgeiir and Vandred the Majestic could testify to it, were they still living.

desc.zh: 一旦斯泰卡尔决意出手，便无人能阻挡他的利刃：那刀刃总是精准地指向任何技巧与盔甲都无法防御的要害
desc.en: No one has found a way to stay Styrkaar's blade once he has decided where it should go – invariably a spot where no skill or armour will deflect it.

desc.zh: 唯一能让斯泰卡尔离开战场的力量，只有他自己的意愿。唯有偶发的疯狂才会让他深感疲倦，而敌人只能垂死挣扎而已
desc.en: Styrkaar doesn't leave the battlefield unless he wants it. Nothing but the occasional wild revelry can tire him. His enemies are left with dying in futile attempts to kill him.

desc.zh: 刀锋足以灼烧魔法防护，闪烁的魔屏偏转着攻击，这就是艾吉克麾下拥有可怕魔法战力的战帮
desc.en: Blades that burn through magical protections, scintillating barriers that deflect blows. Azrik leads a warband of terrifying magical might.

desc.zh: 『想怎么打倒我们都随你们的便，但最后倒在我们身体上的，肯定是你们自己！』
desc.en: "Strike us down all you wish, then break yourselves upon our bodies.".

desc.zh: 一个人怎么可能不留痕迹地穿越雪原呢？
desc.en: How can a man cross snow without leaving a single track?

desc.zh: 『把雪染成红色！把他们的尸首填满山谷！在每座山上树起他们的头颅！』
desc.en: "Stain the snow red! Fill the valleys with their dead! Hoist their skulls upon every mountain!"

desc.zh: 我的名号不计其数…预言者、黑暗之主、阴影领主
desc.en: I have many names, many titles… Harbinger, Dark Master, Lord of Shadows.

desc.zh: 世界将会终结，末日即将来临。我已为最后的永世神选加冕
desc.en: This world will end, the End Times are coming. I have crowned the last Everchosen.

desc.zh: 恶魔耳语者、傀儡师…但是你们也可以称我为…神
desc.en: Daemon-Whisperer, Puppet Master… but you, you may call me… a God.

desc.zh: 在战场上，这位冰雪廷臣真是如日中天，因为这里正是让她的魔法训练淋漓尽致地发挥出来的场所
desc.en: On the field of battle, this Ice Courtier is truly in her element, for it is here that her magical training can be put to best use.

desc.zh: 相比帝国那些懦夫而言，基斯里夫勇士天生更为强大，毕竟那群家伙对草原上的艰辛生活一无所知
desc.en: Kislevite warriors are inherently stronger than weak-hearted Empire-men, who know nothing of the hardship and strife of lives lived on the unforgiving steppes.

desc.zh: 战火无穷无尽。冲锋、交兵、一对一的血战，这便是无尽的循环，永无止息
desc.en: The war is endless. The cycle of charging, clashing, and bloody hand-to-hand fighting is without end. It will never stop.

desc.zh: 眼前的敌人倒下，鲜血四溅，他随即锁定下一个猎物
desc.en: From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.

desc.zh: 操持魔法之风的人会经常成为战场上的重点打击目标，这很自然
desc.en: Those who wield the Winds will often (and quite fairly!) find themselves targeted on the field of battle.

desc.zh: 当地人会注意到此人的来临，并在激励或恐吓下遂行此人的意愿
desc.en: The locals take notice and will be inspired or frightened into action.

desc.zh: 当地人会注意到此人的来临，并在激励或恐吓下遂行此人的意愿
desc.en: The locals take notice and will be inspired or frightened into action.

desc.zh: 当地人会注意到此人的来临，并在激励或恐吓下遂行此人的意愿
desc.en: The locals take notice and will be inspired or frightened into action.

desc.zh: 当地人会注意到此人的来临，并在激励或恐吓下遂行此人的意愿
desc.en: The locals take notice and will be inspired or frightened into action.

desc.zh: 有那么些领主，他们身上散发着力量、自信和威严，激励着他们的追随者执行伟大或可怕的行动
desc.en: There are Lords that radiate power, confidence and fear, inspiring their followers to great or terrible acts.

desc.zh: 在多年的服役中，此人学到了很多东西，现在他将精力放在了培训其他同僚身上
desc.en: Having learned much in their long years of service, this character now turns their attention to training others.

desc.zh: 在多年的服役中，此人学到了很多东西，现在他将精力放在了培训其他同僚身上
desc.en: Having learned much in their long years of service, this character now turns their attention to training others.

desc.zh: 更近一步的专注力，会带来相当大的裨益
desc.en: A bit of focus goes a long way.

desc.zh: 『这很简单，你看，只需把你学过的所有弹道知识都忘掉…』
desc.en: "It's simple, see, just forget everything you've learned about ballistics…"

desc.zh: 即使是最伟大的法师也知道，最有效的学习来自一次又一次地使用相同的咒语
desc.en: Even the greatest sorcerer knows the greatest learnings come from utilising the same spells time and time again.

desc.zh: 混沌的仆从带来的是腐败，他们会加快周围环境扭曲腐化的速度
desc.en: With the servants of Chaos comes the corruption - as the landscape twists, this one speeds the transformation.

desc.zh: 世界将会终结，末日即将来临。我已为最后的永世神选加冕
desc.en: This world will end, the End Times are coming. I have crowned the last Everchosen.

desc.zh: 迷失者、受诅者、不受欢迎者将会寻找阴影，从而追随黑暗之主
desc.en: The lost, the damned, and the unwelcome will seek out the shadows to follow the Dark Master.

desc.zh: 四神的恶魔被赠与了第一亲王，暂时如此
desc.en: Daemons of all the Four gifted to the First Prince, for now.

desc.zh: 恶魔耳语者、傀儡师…但是你们也可以称我为…神
desc.en: Daemon-Whisperer, Puppet Master… but you, you may call me… a God.

desc.zh: 四神最恶毒的力量，在黑暗之主的要求下，授予了他们的仆人
desc.en: The most malevolent powers of the Four are granted to their servants at the request of the Dark Master.

desc.zh: 比拉克获得了特权，按照混沌诸神的利益，为了统合混沌而工作！
desc.en: Be'lakor is given authority to work on behalf of the Chaos Gods in unified corruption!

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 对于身处惊涛骇浪，犹弄潮儿的人来说，狂暴的魔法之风也无非如此而已
desc.en: The turbulent Winds of Magic can do little harm to those who have found harmony amidst its raging currents.

desc.zh: 秩序、纪律和一排坚固的盾牌，这就是击垮混沌远程火力的不二法门
desc.en: The best way to repel the chaotic flurry of missile fire is to meet it with order, discipline, and a stalwart row of shields.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 它是天廷的产物，巍京宏伟建筑的缩小版本
desc.en: Constructed by the Celestial Court, this is a smaller version of the great construct in Wei-Jin.

desc.zh: 『后面还有空儿哪！』
desc.en: "There's more room in the back."

desc.zh: 这些上好的秤会算出真正的价值
desc.en: These favourable weighting scales will ensure true value.

desc.zh: 篷车中会留下隐蔽空间，里面存放着谷物与水果，以维系车队成员的精力
desc.en: The caravan holds a concealed space where grains and fruit are kept to keep the retinues refreshed.

desc.zh: 这些出色的斥候可以保证商队不会迷途
desc.en: These scouts excel and will ensure the cavalcade stays on a safe route.

desc.zh: 把违禁品藏起来，别让路警和海关人员发现
desc.en: Keep the contraband hidden from roadmarshals and customs agents.

desc.zh: 一定要使用本地的向导，他们比你预想得更清楚这片土地
desc.en: Always use the local guides. They know more about this land than you ever will.

desc.zh: 即使是在荒无人烟之地，也能驾轻就熟地保养篷车车轮
desc.en: Skilled at keeping the wheels on the caravan, even in the middle of nowhere.

desc.zh: 玉龙马罕见而雄伟，只允许真正具备资格的骑手驾驭
desc.en: Rare and majestic, Jade Longma only allow themselves to be ridden by the truly worthy.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 玉龙马罕见而雄伟，只允许真正具备资格的骑手驾驭
desc.en: Rare and majestic, Jade Longma only allow themselves to be ridden by the truly worthy.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向了敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the spellcaster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 就像水蛭吸血一样，巫师向敌人伸出黑檀木之手，通过肮脏的死亡系法术吸走他们的灵魂
desc.en: Just as a leech draws blood, the Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, sucking away their spirit through the tainted Lore of Death.

desc.zh: 一道燃火光环包围着光明火巫，既能护体，亦可烧敌
desc.en: A blazing aura surrounds the Pyromancer's chosen ally, shielding them with protective flame and augmenting their abilities.

desc.zh: 施法者占卜吉相，指引着目标的心智，赋予他们远见，并带给他们胜利
desc.en: Divining auspicious signs, the caster guides the minds of targets, augmenting them with the foresight needed for victory.

desc.zh: 法师从土地中召唤出治愈性的能量，以来自大地的自然痊愈之力庇护战士们
desc.en: The Wizard draws wholesome energies from the soil, imbuing companions with the natural resilience of the earth.

desc.zh: 法师利用金属系法术的知识，令敌人的盔甲迅速锈蚀腐烂，化为薄弱的雪花
desc.en: Utilising the alchemical Lore of Metal, the Wizard commands the foe's armour to rot, causing it to shed away in clouds of tiny flakes.

desc.zh: 法师使用阴影系法术的技能，让敌人被自身的负担拖垮，直到他们虚弱到只能停滞不前为止
desc.en: By means of the Lore of Shadows, the Wizard causes the enemy to be worn down by their own burdens, until they are enervated to a sorry standstill.

desc.zh: 龙之血脉，虽人数稀少，却是天廷诸军行列中强大而令人敬畏的存在
desc.en: The descendants of the Dragons, though few in number, are a strong and formidable presence among the military ranks of the Celestial Armies.

desc.zh: 凭借其龙族血统，龙裔修验卿能够施展人类王国中所见的一些最强大的法术
desc.en: Through their Draconic lineage, Dragon-Blooded Shugengan are capable of wielding some of the most potent spellcraft seen in any kingdoms of Men.

desc.zh: 那些与天廷紧密相连者，常受赐予更强的守护：这是他们与巨龙领主亲缘的传承
desc.en: Those bonded to the Celestial Court are often blessed with enhanced protection – a legacy of their kinship to the Dragon Lords.

desc.zh: 契于阳者，每好麾下之师营中同契、道合志同，则调兵赴战，可速行也
desc.en: Those in harmony with Yang often harbour a preference for troops that possess a likeminded school of thought within their battalions, for quicker marshalling to war.

desc.zh: 作为宁和共振的大师，龙裔的存在本身便能激励其盟友在战斗中取得更辉煌的功绩
desc.en: Masters of Harmony’s resonance, the Dragon-blooded’s very presence can spur their allies to greater feats of arms.

desc.zh: 最具天赋的龙裔修验卿能深度汲取天堂之风，以精湛技艺操控它们，在战斗中驾驭不可思议的力量
desc.en: The most gifted of the Dragon-blooded Shugengan can draw deeply from the Celestial Winds, manipulating them with masterful skill to harness incredible power in battle.

desc.zh: 某些龙类后裔生来便拥有闪电般的反应与超自然的迅捷，令敌人在战斗中难以造成有效打击
desc.en: Some descendants of Dragon-kind are blessed with lightning reflexes and preternatural speed, making it extremely hard for enemies to land a meaningful blow in combat.

desc.zh: 凭借其龙族血统，龙裔修验卿能够施展人类王国中所见的一些最强大的法术
desc.en: Through their Draconic lineage, Dragon-Blooded Shugengan are capable of wielding some of the most potent spellcraft seen in any kingdoms of Men.

desc.zh: 那些与天廷紧密相连者，常受赐予更强的守护：这是他们与巨龙领主亲缘的传承
desc.en: Those bonded to the Celestial Court are often blessed with enhanced protection – a legacy of their kinship to the Dragon Lords.

desc.zh: 契于阴者，每好麾下之师营中同契、道合志同，则调兵赴战，可速行也
desc.en: Those in harmony with Yin often harbour a preference for troops that possess a likeminded school of thought within their battalions, for quicker marshalling to war.

desc.zh: 作为宁和共振的大师，龙裔的存在本身便能激励其盟友在战斗中取得更辉煌的功绩
desc.en: Masters of Harmony’s resonance, the Dragon-blooded’s very presence can spur their allies to greater feats of arms.

desc.zh: 最具天赋的龙裔修验卿能深度汲取天堂之风，以精湛技艺操控它们，在战斗中驾驭不可思议的力量
desc.en: The most gifted of the Dragon-blooded Shugengan can draw deeply from the Celestial Winds, manipulating them with masterful skill to harness incredible power in battle.

desc.zh: 龙帝指挥着北方各省的每一把剑和矛，他的力量与他的意志相得益彰
desc.en: The Dragon Emperor guides every sword and spear of the northern provinces, inspiring a strength of arms to match an unflinching strength of will.

desc.zh: 从低贱的农民到熟练的射手，东方的每一支箭都会带着龙的力量与优雅尽情翱翔
desc.en: From lowly peasant to expert marksman, every arrow of the east soars with a Draconic power and grace.

desc.zh: 古老的震旦在历史上从未被征服，而轰鸣的大炮与爆炸的火箭将有助于将这一记录延续下去
desc.en: Ancient Cathay stands historically unconquered. Booming cannons and rockets of exploding fire help ensure it will remain so.

desc.zh: 百蹄烈奔，试问何人可承？
desc.en: Who can withstand a charge with the sweeping force of a hundred hooves in unison?

desc.zh: 震旦酷吏冷眼之下，氓隶徒属亦可聚而成军
desc.en: Even the most inexperienced peasant rallies under the cold-eyed gaze of Cathay's most stoic guardians.

desc.zh: 烈焰焚天之时，死亡将如雨而至
desc.en: When fire hangs in the sky above the battlefield, death is sure to rain down upon it.

desc.zh: 震旦军队久经沙场，其战技在无尽的乱世血战中早已饱经历练
desc.en: Cathayan armies have been tested time and again, their skills proven in a tumultuous arena of bloodshed and near-constant war.

desc.zh: 战端既启，身手敏捷便是于远程对射中保身的秘诀了。
desc.en: When the raging of battle begins, swift hands and swifter feet are the keys to surviving at range.

desc.zh: 震旦将士们敏捷、稳重、与子同袍，共赴战场
desc.en: Swift, steady and moving as one, the hardy warriors of Cathay race headlong into battle.

desc.zh: 云层中炽热的光芒，定会令下方任何震旦将士心情激荡
desc.en: A blanket of glowing lights amidst the clouds is sure to stir the heart of every Cathayan warrior beneath them.

desc.zh: 北方诸省的血腥战场，乃是震旦最强战士磨练技艺的舞台
desc.en: The blood-soaked battlefields of the northern provinces are the proving grounds upon which the mightiest warriors of Cathay have honed their craft.

desc.zh: 吃一堑，长一智
desc.en: Every wound that is not fatal is but a lesson to learn from.

desc.zh: 所有心怀荣誉的战士都渴望在龙帝麾下战斗
desc.en: All warriors of honour and pride are eager to fight under the Dragon-Emperor's banners.

desc.zh: 天灯乃是龙神军队用以从高空观察敌人的利器
desc.en: Sky Lanterns are used by the Dragon’s armies to observe enemies from on high.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 这位领袖将知识传播给了整个军营，大家无不如饥似渴地学习起来
desc.en: This leader imparts his knowledge to the battalion, and they are willing to learn.

desc.zh: 对于震旦天朝这样宏伟的国家，自然需要务实的政务官
desc.en: Land the size of Grand Cathay requires a pragmatic custodian.

desc.zh: 巨龙雄壮有威严，其鳞甲厚实无匹，又有何物可以刺穿？
desc.en: What weapons can hope to pierce the rigid scales of such a monstrous and majestic beast?

desc.zh: 狂暴的利爪和牙齿会刺穿任何敌人的心脏
desc.en: A rampage of talons and teeth will carve through the heart of any foe.

desc.zh: 当敌人认为远远待着就会没事时，最好证明他们错了
desc.en: When an enemy thinks they are safe at range, it is best to prove them wrong.

desc.zh: 卫护长垣时，射手须得箭若连珠，纷纷不绝
desc.en: When defending the Great Bastion, one must follow up a missile volley immediately with another.

desc.zh: 迅捷而又惊婉，这便是飙龙的精湛武艺
desc.en: The Storm Dragon's every movement is imbued with a predatory swiftness and grace.

desc.zh: 征战不容止歇，唯有如无尽怒风般猛袭
desc.en: There is no rest in the midst of battle, only the seething storm of relentless aggression.

desc.zh: 万物皆有秩序，宁和便生于此
desc.en: There must be order in all things, and from that order, harmony.

desc.zh: 任你威胁千万重，飙龙岿然不动
desc.en: The Storm Dragon's spine must remain steadfast against every looming threat that lies beyond it.

desc.zh: 妙影是最受信任的卫北经略，也是震旦最为坚定的勇将
desc.en: Miao Ying is trusted above all to guard the north, serving as Cathay's most steadfast champion.

desc.zh: 秩序乃是抵御混沌的不二法门，因此妙影时刻警惕着毁灭大军
desc.en: Miao Ying stands vigilant against the armies of Ruin, for Order is the only true answer to Chaos.

desc.zh: 飙龙所至之处，阴系魔风怒号连天
desc.en: Where the Storm Dragon goes, the winds of Yin seem to blow strongest of all.

desc.zh: 次元石沙漠的奇珍铸就了昭明的甲胄，真可谓固不可彻之神兵
desc.en: Crafted from the unusual minerals of the Warpstone Desert, Zhao Ming's armour protects him from all but the fiercest blows.

desc.zh: 镔龙与麾下军队拥有毋庸置疑的威力与残暴，然而，至于他的理智嘛…
desc.en: The strength and ferocity of the Iron Dragon and his forces have never been in doubt. His sanity, however…

desc.zh: 虽然昭明的心智已趋于疯狂，但他的神秘手段仍然毒辣，无情地折磨着震旦的敌人
desc.en: Though madness seems to tug at Zhao Ming's mind, his mysterious crafts are nonetheless effective, relentlessly harrying Cathay's foes.

desc.zh: 上阳遍布食人魔佣兵，正是震旦天军的得力助益
desc.en: Ogre mercenaries are a common sight in Shang-Yang, where their battle prowess benefits the armies of Cathay.

desc.zh: 卫西列省境内，金属、火焰二系法师极受敬重，他们奇怪的炼金术乃是上阳要隘的柱石
desc.en: Cabals of Metal and Fire Wizards are welcome in the Western Provinces, where their strange alchemy bolsters the fortress of Shang-Yang.

desc.zh: 镔龙之军尽得其神力，彻敌护甲势如破竹
desc.en: The armies of the Iron Dragon harness his mighty strength, tearing through the armour of their enemies.

desc.zh: 次元石沙漠最为坚固的金属，锻造成了卫西列省的神兵利刃
desc.en: Weapons crafted in the Western Provinces are forged from the strongest metals of the Warpstone Desert.

desc.zh: 镔龙所至之处，阳系魔风怒号连天
desc.en: The Winds of Yang flow robustly in the Iron Dragon's presence.

desc.zh: 让弱小的敌人血流成河，这正是恐虐之怒的残酷具现
desc.en: There is no greater embodiment of Khorne's all-encompassing wrath than spilling the blood of a weak and pitiful enemy.

desc.zh: 在灼热的仇恨之火中锻造的武器，比任何普通的武器都更为凶狠
desc.en: A weapon forged in a fire of searing hatred strikes harder than any average blade.

desc.zh: 这些重型装备锻造自金属与装备困住的灵魂熔炉，它的野蛮力量无人可以质疑
desc.en: Emerging from the Forge of Souls trapped in a prison of metal and gears, the heavy machinery of the Clinkerspawn possesses an undeniably brutal strength.

desc.zh: 当毁灭收割者进入战场时，每一次机械的摆动和穿刺都会伴随着金属的强烈回响
desc.en: When the Harvesters of Doom take to the field, a violent ringing of metal echoes with every mechanical swing and thrust of their blades.

desc.zh: 死者与将死者并不会留下什么战利品，即使是生者，也不配保留他们不能保护的东西
desc.en: The dead and the dying have no use for material goods, and the living do not deserve to keep what they could not protect.

desc.zh: 恐虐在肆意的破坏中日益壮大，让他仇敌的城邑化为灰烬吧！
desc.en: Khorne thrives in the wake of wanton destruction; let the towns and cities of his foes burn to the ground around them.

desc.zh: 血神会奖赏那些为他的荣耀效力的人，因为那些使杀戮领主更强的，也会使自己的力量更强
desc.en: The Blood God rewards the agents of His glory, for what strengthens the Lord of Murder so too bolsters his forces.

desc.zh: 将猖獗的混沌交给无谋之辈，所有的力量都将以恐虐的名义授予
desc.en: Deliver rampant Chaos unto the unwary, and all manner of powers shall be awarded in Khorne's name.

desc.zh: 誓死效忠恐虐的战士永远不会厌倦战争，他们会被战斗的狂怒磨练成狂暴的利器
desc.en: Warriors pledged to Khorne never tire of war, but are honed by battle fury into sharp instruments of violent rage.

desc.zh: 纳垢的勇士身上散发的腐臭并不是他们身上最致命的东西
desc.en: The putrid stench that emanates from the warriors of Nurgle is somehow not the most deadly thing about them.

desc.zh: 与所有致命疾病一样，布满痘疹的瘟疫席卷了受害者
desc.en: The pox-ridden plague sweeps down upon its victims, like all the best virulent diseases.

desc.zh: 这些为瘟疫领主服务的可憎怪物，以极难杀死而知名
desc.en: This macabre grotesquerie of rancid creatures in service to the Plague Lord are notoriously hard to kill.

desc.zh: 苍蝇领主子嗣们的每次攻击都会留下腐烂、感染、充满疫病的瘴气
desc.en: Every attack from the most putrescent of the Fly Lord's offspring leaves behind a miasma of rot, infection and disease.

desc.zh: 虽然战斗的姿态非常优雅，但色孽战士的每一击都非常的致命
desc.en: Though fighting with a graceful elegance, every strike from the warriors of Slaanesh lands with devastating impact.

desc.zh: 色孽美丽的坐骑很容易让你失魂落魄，甚至当它们冲上前来，让你痛苦死去时，你也还是执迷不悟哪！
desc.en: It is easy to be distracted by the beauty of Slaanesh's mounts, even as they close in to deliver your agonising death.

desc.zh: 在黑暗亲王的军队中，即使是最可怕的生物也有一种诡谲的美，让它们的猎物在最致命的陶醉中死去
desc.en: Even the most monstrous creatures in the Dark Prince's armies possess a horrific sort of beauty, lulling their victims into the most fatal kind of complacency.

desc.zh: 最疯狂的享乐之仆从兵法中获得了极大的快乐，他们会残暴地对敌人大开杀戒
desc.en: The most ardent servants of pleasure take great joy in the artistry of war, vehemently cutting down the enemies of excess.

desc.zh: 对鸦神的忠诚令奸奇的战士们无不坚韧不拔地奋战不止，毕竟若不能战而胜之，他们又能篡变些什么呢？
desc.en: Their loyalty to the Raven God grants the warriors of Tzeentch a staunch hardiness in battle, for what is change if not the ability to overcome?

desc.zh: 奸奇的骑兵以极快的速度冲入战场，在每一击中都倾注了他们的全部力量
desc.en: Racing into battle at great speed, the Tzeentchian cavalry put every bit of their momentum into each and every strike.

desc.zh: 所有种类的生物都效忠于风之主，风之主的魔法会赋予它们力量和速度，可以令活着的敌人迅速死去
desc.en: Creatures of all kinds serve the Wind Lord, whose magic imbues them with a strength and speed to transform living foes into dead ones.

desc.zh: 查尔最伟大的战士们引领着战场，向着他们周围的一切编织着暴力篡变的扭曲丝线
desc.en: Tchar's greatest warriors lead the field of battle, weaving the twisting threads of violent Change around all that surround them.

desc.zh: 当攻击恐虐的战士时，一定要痛下杀手，倾尽全力，如果他们没有被彻底消灭，他们就会变的更强大，更愤怒
desc.en: When you strike a warrior of Khorne, strike hard and with more strength than you dare, for what doesn't kill them only makes them stronger, and angrier.

desc.zh: 恐虐的军队乘着可怕的坐骑和隆隆作响的骨战车，在冲锋时掀起一股纯粹毁灭的旋风
desc.en: Astride terrifying mounts and riding rattling chariots of bone, the forces of Khorne are a whirlwind of pure destruction on the charge.

desc.zh: 血神的兽性仆从冲向敌人，撕扯他们的血肉，直到对手咽下最后一口气
desc.en: The bestial minions of the Blood God charge the enemy, ripping and tearing at their flesh until no breath remains.

desc.zh: 恐虐的忠诚冠军勇士以残酷的战争为乐，将战败者的头颅扔到颅座的脚下
desc.en: The loyal champions of Khorne delight in the brutality of war, delivering the skulls of the vanquished to the foot of the Skull Throne.

desc.zh: 无法抑制的纯粹愤怒，正是敬拜血神的荣耀
desc.en: Pure, irrepressible rage is but an act of worship to the Blood God's glory.

desc.zh: 魔性的近邻，便是神性
desc.en: Uncleanliness is next to Godliness.

desc.zh: 真正的神性可以在放纵的狂喜中纵情体验
desc.en: The true experience of divinity can be found in the ecstasy of indulgence.

desc.zh: 跟随篡变之风，便可在狂岚中赢得鸦神的祝福
desc.en: Follow the changing winds, and the blessings of the Raven God can be earned amidst the tempest.

desc.zh: 当混沌的腐蚀如瘟疫般渗入这片土地时，那些发誓遂行无尽毁灭的军队只会愈发强大，愈发荣光
desc.en: As the corruption of Chaos seeps into the land like a sickness, the glory and strength of those forces pledged eternally to Ruin can only grow and grow.

desc.zh: 这位毁灭之力的忠实奴仆有着任何凡人都无法估量的惊人韧性
desc.en: This willing servant of the Ruinous Powers has a resilience that is beyond any mortal measure.

desc.zh: 论起护卫自身，还能有什么会比一股让人反胃的恶臭更有效呢？
desc.en: What better protection is there than a stench so stomach-churningly revolting that it repels every creature in its wake?

desc.zh: 任何武器都很难刺透如此膨胀的肉块
desc.en: It is hard for any weapon to penetrate such an overflowing mass of bloated flesh.

desc.zh: 肮脏的恶魔金属板甲能抵挡一切猛烈的打击
desc.en: Thick plates of filth-ridden, Daemonic metal deflect all but the most grievous of blows.

desc.zh: 随着沉重齿轮的轰鸣，纳垢的磨魂者会将肮脏的弹药发射到难以企及的距离
desc.en: With the mechanical whirr of heavy gears, the Soul Grinders of Nurgle launch foul projectiles over impossible distances.

desc.zh: 当衰朽领主指引你的道路时，穿越险恶地形的危险就无关紧要了
desc.en: The perils of passing through hostile terrain matter little when the Lord of Decay guides your path.

desc.zh: 疾病和腐烂摧毁了散落在每一个战场上的尸体，同时强化了纳垢饱经摧残的战士们的力量
desc.en: Disease and decay ravage the corpses littering every battlefield, reinforcing the blighted warriors of Nurgle.

desc.zh: 那些最忠实于祖父神纳垢的腐臭事业的信徒，完全依靠他们主人的传染毒性存活于世
desc.en: Those most devoted to Grandfather Nurgle's noxious cause sustain themselves wholly on the infectious virulence of their Lord.

desc.zh: 随着纳垢的衰朽在凡世中蔓延，他的忠实信徒们的力量将日渐增长
desc.en: As Nurgle's withering decay spreads, plaguing the mortal realms, the power of His faithful followers only continues to grow.

desc.zh: 感染弱者，传播瘟疫，让荣耀的混沌席卷大地——这些成就都会赢得瘟疫之神的青睐
desc.en: Infect the weak, spread a plague or two, and let glorious Chaos sweep the land – these are the accomplishments that garner the Plague God's favour.

desc.zh: 战斗的艺术就像一种复杂的舞蹈——流畅、优雅，并总是会在最后达成致命的结局
desc.en: The art of combat is much like an intricate dance – fluid, graceful, and always building up to a killer finale.

desc.zh: 武器应该像身体一样经过精细打磨，两者都该以色孽的名义造成最邪恶的伤害
desc.en: Weapons should be as finely honed as the body, and both should be capable of inflicting the most wicked harm in Slaanesh's name.

desc.zh: 对于渴望自由的灵魂来说，虽然困在地狱般的扭曲金属监狱中是极大的痛苦，但此举赋予他的原始力量多少减轻了这种心理负担
desc.en: Though being trapped in a prison of hellish Warpmetal is torturous for a soul inclined to freedom, the raw power it grants somewhat eases its burden.

desc.zh: 从机械坟墓中捕捉战斗的美？显然不可能，但杀戮的乐趣同样诱人
desc.en: Capturing the beauty of battle is impossible from inside a mechanical tomb, yet the pleasure of the kill is no less enticing.

desc.zh: 看那被伏击的敌人的表情吧！多么有趣啊！
desc.en: The expression of surprise on an ambushed foe's face is always a particularly delectable treat.

desc.zh: 看到混沌如此地在敌人中弥散开来，黑暗亲王非常满意
desc.en: The Dark Prince rejoices to see such Chaos sown amongst his foes.

desc.zh: 为欢愉亲王服务不需要太多的规劝：追求每个堕落幻想的诱惑往往太过诱人，难以抗拒
desc.en: Few need much persuasion to serve the Prince of Pleasure; the draw of pursuing one's every debased fantasy often proves too tempting to resist.

desc.zh: 战争的乐趣往往是满足战士的一切胃口
desc.en: The pleasures of battle are often all that is needed to sate a warrior's appetite.

desc.zh: 色孽承诺的力量确实很诱人，值得付出任何代价
desc.en: The powers promised by Slaanesh are alluring indeed, and worth any price to acquire.

desc.zh: 随着黑暗亲王邪恶影响的扩散，他的信徒们得到了他们做梦都想不到的强大能力
desc.en: As the Dark Prince's malignant influence spreads, his followers are most delightfully rewarded with abilities beyond even their wildest dreams.

desc.zh: 危险的火焰之墙，任何妄图通过的人只有被烧成灰烬的份
desc.en: A wall of perilous flame lets nothing pass through it without burning the intruder to cinders.

desc.zh: 翅膀与羽毛化成的茧为万变魔君提供保护，令他们免受伤害
desc.en: A cocoon of wing and feather provides protection to the Lords of Change, sheltering them from harm.

desc.zh: 篡变的风暴中站着被查尔选中的人物，他们将带领世界进入漩涡的中心
desc.en: Amidst the storm of Change stand those chosen by T'char to lead the realms into the heart of its churning maelstrom.

desc.zh: 在恶魔的扭曲金属中，奸奇的磨魂者并不会感到痛苦，只会感到对最终自由的极度渴望
desc.en: Encased in Daemonic Warpmetal, the Soul Grinders of Tzeentch feel no pain but the agonising thirst to finally be free.

desc.zh: 鸦神的盟友潜伏在地图的每一个角落，准备从任意方向改变战局
desc.en: Allies of the Raven God lurk in every corner of the map, ready to change the tide of war from any direction.

desc.zh: 众人都盼望着某种形式的篡变，而共同的利益则是所有成功谈判的起点
desc.en: Every being desires change in some form or another, and a point of common interest is where all successful negotiations begin.

desc.zh: 篡变的战士们在不断变化的动力驱使下不断前进
desc.en: The warriors of Change are driven ever onward by motivations constantly in flux.

desc.zh: 魔法之风在万变使者周围起舞，在他的术士中旋转，正是他们强大的力量来源
desc.en: The Winds of Magic dance around the Bringer of Change, swirling through the ranks of his Sorcerers, who draw power from its potent energies.

desc.zh: 篡变的浪潮起起伏伏，将黑暗的力量注入那些证明了自身价值的人身上
desc.en: The tides of Change rise and fall, imbuing dark power on those who have proved themselves worthy.

desc.zh: 无上术士会为他最忠实的篡变军锋赐下大量的礼物
desc.en: The Great Sorcerer grants many gifts to His most faithful Heralds of Change.

desc.zh: 混沌的铁拳牢牢攥住了当地的民众，阻止一切的无序，以免它变得过于窒息
desc.en: Chaos grips the local populace with an iron fist, discouraging all disorder lest it tighten and choke.

desc.zh: 混沌的腐化感染了它所触及的一切，它黑色的卷须在大地上伸展开来
desc.en: The corruption of Chaos infects all it touches, stretching its dark tendrils out across the land.

desc.zh: 毁灭之网将大量混沌奴仆链接起来，令他们的力量合而为一，为共同的大业而奋战
desc.en: Many servants of Chaos are connected by a Ruinous web that joins their forces in common cause.

desc.zh: 行省应在惊人的腐败中膨胀，在成功的荣耀中扩张
desc.en: The provinces shall bloat with wonderous corruption, expanding amidst the glory of success.

desc.zh: 在混沌统合的军势下，恐虐的军队疯狂咆哮，怒气日甚一日地展开战斗
desc.en: Raging and roaring in the cause of Chaos Undivided, the forces of Khorne bray for battle with even greater fury.

desc.zh: 在混沌联合的大军中，纳垢那些虚弱、衰老的战士们得到了有效的支持
desc.en: The unwholesome, decrepit warriors of Nurgle stand bolstered among the united forces of Chaos.

desc.zh: 当统一在同一面毁灭战旗之下时，色孽的仆从们在这个邪恶的联盟中找到了新的乐趣
desc.en: Merged under a single Ruinous banner, the servants of Slaanesh find new pleasures within this unholy alliance.

desc.zh: 混沌大军的统合让万变魔君激动不已，他非常欣慰地看到曾经凶猛的敌人变成了毁灭的武器
desc.en: The unified forces of Chaos thrill the Lord of Change, who delights in seeing once-fierce enemies transformed into a weapon of untold annihilation.

desc.zh: 『…然而你个小逼崽子算个北！』
desc.en: "…and yoo's nothin' but a puny git!"

desc.zh: 管他多小个儿，削就完事儿了——小崽子？那就少剁几块儿呗！
desc.en: No matter how little they are, the choppin' never ends – runts just get chopped into fewer pieces!

desc.zh: 『最大的崽子就得使唤最大的砍砍，懂不？』
desc.en: "Da biggest gitz always gets da biggest choppas, see?"

desc.zh: 打得准能宰了打得狠，打得寸能撂倒过打得快。但有的时候吧，能找着那软乎地儿就齐活儿了！
desc.en: Accuracy can beat strength and timing can beat speed. But sometimes it's just a matter of finding the weak spot!

desc.zh: 虽说那帮小子早给他们整软乎了，但是老大瞅着那就是一顿爆锤啊…大伙儿都瞅见了哈
desc.en: Although the ladz had already softened them up, da Big Boss definitely gave them a good smashin’... and everyone saw it.

desc.zh: 『都麻溜的，先捅咕那个嘟囔施法的！』
desc.en: "Stab dere Wizard first!"

desc.zh: 那大牙，咔咔的，撵着你一路往死里跑，跟那要命的牧羊狗似的——可那是狼！
desc.en: The baying of canine jaws accompanies a herding to one’s death, as if by killer sheepdogs – except they are wolves.

desc.zh: 搁地精那儿，『贼拉专业』的招儿也就是挖个坑，把投石车猫里面，再砸那帮傻了吧唧的冤种。儿了！
desc.en: To a Goblin, an "expert" plan can be something as simple as digging a hole, hiding a catapult in it, and shooting unknowing foes. Genius!

desc.zh: 『战车来啦，小子们！甭费劲巴拉系安全带了！』
desc.en: "It’s chariot-geddon boyz! Don’t botha strappin’ in!"

desc.zh: 要是平常那种捅咕不好使的话，就整个夜地精来！
desc.en: When regular stabbin' just won't "cut it", get yourself a Night Goblin for hire.

desc.zh: 夜地精早就适应了他们老巢里那种齁鼻子，呛死人的孢子气味，但他们那帮倒霉催的对头就肯定不好使了
desc.en: Unlike their unfortunate foes, Night Goblins are more than acclimated to the nasty, stinging spores that drench the air of their deepest caverns.

desc.zh: 『不是毛哥嫌弃俺…而是搞哥更爱俺…』
desc.en: "It's not that Mork don't like me... only that Gork likes me more…"

desc.zh: 『要是敌人瞅不着你，你就能撩点阴的了！』
desc.en: "When you can' t be seen, you can get propa nasty!"

desc.zh: 要是战将整天就隔这搞疯疯癫癫的，那他指定是除了祸祸啥都不在乎！
desc.en: A warboss that invests in the unhinged truly cares about nought but destruction!

desc.zh: 『凑那么近干啥？铁箭头子就是得隔远了捅咕！』
desc.en: "Why get too close? A metal arrer is just long-ranged stabber'."

desc.zh: 『当老大的意思，就是你能可劲儿呲牙玩儿！』
desc.en: "Bein' da boss means you get to do a lotta grinnin'!"

desc.zh: 『你得先凑近那帮傻逼，才能捅咕他们…』
desc.en: "Stabbin' starts wiv gettin' close to da gitz..."

desc.zh: 夜地精就靠吃蘑菇活着，那玩意儿换个别的（大个儿的？）玩意儿的话，早就给撂倒了
desc.en: Night Goblins subsist on a diet of fungus that would fell any lesser (greater?) creature.

desc.zh: 『来，这么着，他先动手削你们，完事儿俺再捅咕他！』
desc.en: "Ere's da plan, 'e starts killin' you, den I stab 'im!"

desc.zh: 『你噗呲噗呲捅咕他们的时候，那帮崽子的动静老好听了！』
desc.en: "Da gitz make a good noise when you stab 'em!"

desc.zh: 『你削他！俺削他！Waaagh！！』
desc.en: "You smash! I smash! WAAAAAAAAGH!!!"

desc.zh: 拿脑瓜子撞人这招儿练胆儿贼好使…再不济也能练出个梆硬脑壳！
desc.en: Headbutting is useful for building character... or at least a very thick skull!

desc.zh: 俺的点子贼拉大个，就要憋不住蹦出来了！
desc.en: Thoughts so big they're liable to burst right out!

desc.zh: 巨魔那自愈劲儿老邪乎了，巫婆们靠着跟沙许的联系，整得自个儿贼抗造
desc.en: Troll regeneration is legendary, the Hags’ connection to Shyish granting them unnatural resilience.

desc.zh: 河巫婆那味儿，十步开外就能给人鼻子熏起泡！五步之内？你这辈子都甭想闻着味儿了！
desc.en: The rank muck of the River Hags blisters noses at ten paces. At five, you may never smell again!

desc.zh: 开饭前儿吧，得先把对头捶软乎了、拧巴烂了、搅和稀碎喽
desc.en: Before the snacking, the foe must be tenderised, twisted and churned.

desc.zh: 巫婆贼拉擅长把死气儿搅和成一团黏糊糊的瘴气，糊对头身上，直接给他们拽那黑咕隆咚的河底下去
desc.en: Hags are particularly adept at weaving death into a miasma that clings to the foe and drags them to the murky depths.

desc.zh: 咽下去啥，就得吐出来啥！
desc.en: What goes down, must come up!

desc.zh: 纵使刀折矢尽，猛士仍能以精武之躯力战不已，死中求生
desc.en: When the arrows are spent and the blades are all blunted, this perfect warrior can rely on their well-trained body to keep death from their door.

desc.zh: 纵使刀折矢尽，猛士仍能以精武之躯力战不已，死中求生
desc.en: When the arrows are spent and the blades are all blunted, this perfect warrior can rely on their well-trained body to keep death from their door.

desc.zh: 各司其职，各尽其责。只要谨遵这句箴言，混沌便会无所遁形
desc.en: A place for everything and everything in its place. Live by this motto and Chaos will stand out like the proverbial sore thumb.

desc.zh: 各司其职，各尽其责。只要谨遵这句箴言，混沌便会无所遁形
desc.en: A place for everything and everything in its place. Live by this motto and Chaos will stand out like the proverbial sore thumb.

desc.zh: 有些人可能认为行政是项令人厌倦的事务，但这位昊天龙帝的臣民很清楚，有序的社会组织定会高效高能
desc.en: Some may consider administration a tiresome process, but this servant of the Celestial Emperor knows that a tidy society makes for an efficient, effective one.

desc.zh: 有些人可能认为行政是项令人厌倦的事务，但这位昊天龙帝的臣民很清楚，有序的社会组织定会高效高能
desc.en: Some may consider administration a tiresome process, but this servant of the Celestial Emperor knows that a tidy society makes for an efficient, effective one.

desc.zh: 此人对某些很能吸引低阶层民众的智慧敞开了心扉：在这些知识的帮助下，他可以收集并操控精气之风
desc.en: This one has opened their mind to ideas and concepts that would bewilder a lesser person, enabling them to harness the Winds and manipulate them with skill.

desc.zh: 龙神谒者的职责是保证天朝遍及宁和，而好奇的天性只是担任这一职务所需技能的一部分
desc.en: An inquisitive nature is only part of the skillset required for the Dragon's questioner, tasked with ensuring harmony prevails over Celestial lands.

desc.zh: 龙神谒者的职责是保证天朝遍及宁和，而好奇的天性只是担任这一职务所需技能的一部分
desc.en: An inquisitive nature is only part of the skillset required for the Dragon's questioner, tasked with ensuring harmony prevails over Celestial lands.

desc.zh: 暴力永远都是答案，不是也是！
desc.en: Violence is always the answer, even when it's not.

desc.zh: 暴力永远都是答案，不是也是！
desc.en: Violence is always the answer, even when it's not.

desc.zh: 无目亦可明
desc.en: One does not always need eyes to see clearly.

desc.zh: 『是的，我当然还在听…只是歇歇眼睛而已』
desc.en: "Yes, of course I'm still listening... I'm just resting my eyes."

desc.zh: 这位师傅实乃龙裔，或许是位修验官之子，所以可以召唤皇帝的贴身护卫
desc.en: This master has Dragon-blood in his veins, perhaps a son of a Shugengan, and so can call upon the Emperor's personal bodyguards.

desc.zh: 此人曾是龙帝的炮兵军团的一员。虽然现在已是一位独立贸易商，但这份人脉也是很难打破的
desc.en: Once of the Dragon Emperor's artillery legions. Though now an independent trader, those ties are hard to break.

desc.zh: 纵览游历大陆的诸多商队领队，其中实在不乏出身农户，或是震旦雄城寒门之人
desc.en: Many masters of the continent spanning caravans come from the peasant farms or the slums of the Cathay's mighty cities.

desc.zh: 驯服龙马之人实乃炙手可热，但若用其为己谋利，则是欠下了龙帝一笔人情
desc.en: Such a talent as taming the Longma is highly sought after, but those who wish to exploit it for their own enterprise will be in debt to the Dragon Emperor.

desc.zh: 出身南皋，自然少不得九环军营、城市行会以及军中的人脉
desc.en: Hails from Nan-Gau with strong ties to the barracks of the Nine Rings, its guilds and troops.

desc.zh: 这位师傅在哀痛山脉生活多年，与食人魔王国混得烂熟，甚至签订了契约
desc.en: The master has spent many years in the Mountains of Mourn, forming bonds and making contracts with the tribes of the Ogre Kingdoms.

desc.zh: 此人在上阳长大，因此对此地的百姓和丹鼎师行会了如指掌
desc.en: Brought up in Shang-Yang, with an intimate knowledge of its denizens and alchemist guilds.

desc.zh: 商队与他的主人在西方国家生活了很长时间，以至于比起自己的祖国，他更喜欢外国人的陪伴
desc.en: The caravan and its master spends a lot of time in the western nations, to the point that he prefers the company of foreigners to his homeland.

desc.zh: 这位师傅深谙相马之术，对其它野兽亦不遑多让，实为购马行家
desc.en: This master knows what to look for in horses and other beasts, so will recruit accordingly.

desc.zh: 此人于卫北诸省的百工行会颇有人脉，因此他的随从中不乏高傲的火枪兵团
desc.en: Strong ties with the artificer guilds in the northern provinces allow an influx of prized rifle regiments into this retinue.

desc.zh: 在震旦境内，声誉是个强大的工具，因此受到贵族青睐的人便可招募高质量的军队
desc.en: In Cathay, reputation is a powerful tool, and those favoured by nobles will be able to recruit quality troops.

desc.zh: 一段神秘的经历，令此人可以招募先前为其服务过的老兵部队为其效命
desc.en: A secretive history allows him to call upon veteran troops who perhaps served him in the past.

desc.zh: 愤怒在外表下酝酿，期望着一泻而出
desc.en: Fury simmers just barely below the surface, begging to be released.

desc.zh: 或许最好该让易碎品离这家伙远点
desc.en: Perhaps best to keep any breakable items far away from this one.

desc.zh: 认识自身的能力并没什么错，尤其是自身确实很有能力时
desc.en: There's nothing wrong with being aware of one's capabilities - particularly when one is capable of so much.

desc.zh: 认识自身的能力并没什么错，尤其是自身确实很有能力时
desc.en: There's nothing wrong with being aware of one's capabilities - particularly when one is capable of so much.

desc.zh: 欺骗会让人蹙眉，但前提是你被识破了
desc.en: Deception is frowned upon, but only if you're found out.

desc.zh: 欺骗会让人蹙眉，但前提是你被识破了
desc.en: Deception is frowned upon, but only if you're found out.

desc.zh: 身体的畸形并不能妨碍思绪的扩展
desc.en: A deformity of the body does nothing to stop the expansion of the mind.

desc.zh: 意志的交锋绝不容畏缩
desc.en: In a battle of wills, one must not falter.

desc.zh: 意志的交锋绝不容畏缩
desc.en: In a battle of wills, one must not falter.

desc.zh: 即使是色孽，也无法击垮这个人的自制力
desc.en: Even Slaanesh would be unable to break this one's self control.

desc.zh: 即使是色孽，也无法击垮这个人的自制力
desc.en: Even Slaanesh would be unable to break this one's self control.

desc.zh: 这个轻信他人的单纯家伙完全没有能力…做任何事
desc.en: This trusting innocent is entirely ill-equipped for… just about anything.

desc.zh: 『哦，真亮啊』
desc.en: "Ooh, shiny."

desc.zh: 两次掉进同一个陷阱肯定很难，但这家伙毫不费力就能做成这点
desc.en: It must be hard to fall for the same trap twice, but this one makes it look effortless.

desc.zh: 无人能够杀死不可捕捉之物
desc.en: No being can kill what it cannot catch.

desc.zh: 无人能够杀死不可捕捉之物
desc.en: No being can kill what it cannot catch.

desc.zh: 言出必诺，背信弃义乃无耻之举
desc.en: A person's word should be their bond, and shame on those that would break it.

desc.zh: 明断则慎行
desc.en: Discerning judgement begets prudent action.

desc.zh: 明断则慎行
desc.en: Discerning judgement begets prudent action.

desc.zh: 如果知识就是力量，那么此人力量十足
desc.en: If knowledge is power, then this one is powerful indeed.

desc.zh: 如果知识就是力量，那么此人力量十足
desc.en: If knowledge is power, then this one is powerful indeed.

desc.zh: 『有人需要搭把手吗？哦…对不起』
desc.en: "Anyone need a hand? Oh… sorry."

desc.zh: 此人腿脚不行，没法站着…呃，反正那腿不够利索
desc.en: This one doesn't have a leg to stand on… Well, not a good one anyway.

desc.zh: 生活是一项凄凉而徒劳的差事，装出其实不然的样子根本毫无意义
desc.en: Life is a grim and thankless task – there's no point in pretending otherwise.

desc.zh: 『吾身所在，烈风长随！』
desc.en: "I bring the storm winds!"

desc.zh: 没有什么能逃过这个人的注意
desc.en: Very little escapes this one's notice.

desc.zh: 可以说是『冷静』与『镇定』…但也可以说是『没得感情』
desc.en: Calm and collected is one way to describe it… emotionless is another.

desc.zh: 面对难以言说的逆境时，维持积极的心态就可圈可点了
desc.en: There's something to be said for remaining positive in the face of unspeakable odds.

desc.zh: 情况本可以更糟，本可能有两道丑疤呢
desc.en: It could have been worse. It could have been two ugly scars.

desc.zh: 潇洒一道疤，真猛士的扮相就完美了
desc.en: A dashing scar completes any true warrior's look.

desc.zh: 有些人生来就是为了玩诡秘的阴谋游戏
desc.en: Some beings are simply made for the cloak-and-dagger games of subterfuge.

desc.zh: 『诀窍就是要提前想两步…然后再提前想一步』
desc.en: "The trick is to think two steps ahead… and then think one step ahead of that."

desc.zh: 『诀窍就是要提前想两步…然后再提前想一步』
desc.en: "The trick is to think two steps ahead… and then think one step ahead of that."

desc.zh: 这家伙能跟食人魔较量掰手腕
desc.en: This one could challenge an Ogre to an arm-wrestling match.

desc.zh: 这家伙能跟食人魔较量掰手腕
desc.en: This one could challenge an Ogre to an arm-wrestling match.

desc.zh: 这家伙连『侏儒会飞时』只是一句说辞都意识不到
desc.en: This one has yet to realise that "When Pygmies fly" is only an expression.

desc.zh: 若是说兵法还有哪里值得学习，那么此人应该还没碰到呢
desc.en: If there is anything left to learn about military planning, this one has yet to come across it.

desc.zh: 若是说兵法还有哪里值得学习，那么此人应该还没碰到呢
desc.en: If there is anything left to learn about military planning, this one has yet to come across it.

desc.zh: 此人坚定不移，韧性十足，泰然直面所有的挑战
desc.en: Hardy and resilient, this being stands firm in the face of all challenges.

desc.zh: 此人坚定不移，韧性十足，泰然直面所有的挑战
desc.en: Hardy and resilient, this being stands firm in the face of all challenges.

desc.zh: 不弯则易折
desc.en: What will not bend may sometimes break.

desc.zh: 此人还有用得不精熟的兵器？它还没锻造出来呢！
desc.en: No arms have yet been forged that this warrior has been unable to master.

desc.zh: 此人还有用得不精熟的兵器？它还没锻造出来呢！
desc.en: No arms have yet been forged that this warrior has been unable to master.

desc.zh: 『丹法绝纯，其精甚真！』
desc.en: "Alchemy holds the true power!"

desc.zh: 『我要一个个杀掉诸神，然后吸收他们的力量』
desc.en: "One by one, I will kill the Gods and harvest their strength."

desc.zh: 『黑暗诸神赐福了我，现在我将报仇！』
desc.en: "The Dark Gods empower me, so vengeance will be mine."

desc.zh: 『我要把你的骨头全剁下来，让你的皮囊彻底腐烂！』
desc.en: "I will rip the bones from your body and leave your skin to rot!"

desc.zh: 『囚犯？我们需要他们做什么？不，全给我杀了，现在就去！这是恐之主的要求！』
desc.en: "Prisoners? What need of them have we? No, kill them all. Do it now. Kharneth demands it."

desc.zh: 为了确保杀戮之神会让他胜出敌人一筹，此人非常清楚该做些什么
desc.en: This one knows exactly what needs to be done to ensure that the Murder God gains advantage over His foes.

desc.zh: 如果你不直接杀死他们，而是活剐了他们来生生放血，那样也不错
desc.en: If you don't kill them outright, to spill their blood and scar them for life is almost as good.

desc.zh: 『我的锤子，是块冷铁；我会用它，给你放血。你受折磨，痛不欲生；你的哀号，我的狂笑！』
desc.en: "My hammer's a cold piece of blood-lethal steel. I grin while you writhe with the pain that I deal!"

desc.zh: 如果哪儿出了麻烦（我指的是最糟的那种屠杀），这人肯定会在这场面的中心煽风点火呢
