desc.en: If there's trouble to be had – and by that I mean the worst kind of slaughter – this one will always be at the centre of things, instigating the conflict.

desc.zh: 有些人是天生的领袖，生来就背负着责任，统领部众撑过最艰难的战争与最严酷的寒冬
desc.en: Some men are natural leaders, born to foster and marshal their tribes through devastating wars and the harshest of winters.

desc.zh: 对于那些习惯了州境生活的人来说，把这些家伙排斥在外只是为确保民众的生存而必须采取的初步措施
desc.en: For those used to life in the oblasts, keeping the elements out is only the beginning of the measures they must take to ensure the survival of their people.

desc.zh: 这位英勇的战士曾经身处对抗毁灭战争的第一线，而他定会再度为这种可怕的经历所磨砺和鼓舞
desc.en: This valorous warrior has been at the forefront of the struggle against Ruin before, and they certainly shall be again, steeled and girded by that dreadful experience.

desc.zh: 此人饱经阅历，人们相信他有能力为祖国母亲的最大利益作出合理的判断
desc.en: By right of his storied experience, this one is trusted to make sound judgements in the best interests of the Motherland.

desc.zh: 先古可汗女王米莎将冰魔法的修为提到了极致。此人师法着她的努力，期望着自身能够臻于同样的化境
desc.en: The ancient Khan-Queen Miska practised Ice Magic to the very highest grade; this one studies her methods in the hope of attaining similar greatness.

desc.zh: 若是利用正教的财富，盖特曼可以做出巨大的革新来吸引民众——只要他们只参与正宗的正教崇拜就好
desc.en: Using the wealth of the Orthodoxy, the Ataman can make great improvements, drawing the populace - as long as they only partake in sanctioned Orthodoxy worship.

desc.zh: 此人谙熟建筑与贸易，无疑会对本地的效率与生产产生显著的影响
desc.en: With a head for building and trade, such a skilled individual is vital to the efficiency of local production.

desc.zh: 在娴熟的行政长官领导下，北方人民也会过上美好的生活
desc.en: The people of the north fare well under the guidance of able administrators.

desc.zh: 在基斯里夫，体现个人价值的不只有门第，还有个人的品德
desc.en: In Kislev, worth is not just conveyed by birth, but by the spirit as well.

desc.zh: 我们绝不能低估有效管理的重要性，大量基斯里夫民众的民生都依赖于此
desc.en: One must never underestimate the importance of effective administration. The livelihood of many in Kislev depend upon it.

desc.zh: 纵使混沌的腐蚀日益逼近，基斯里夫诸州与村垒依然岿然不动
desc.en: Even as the corruption of Chaos creeps ever closer, the oblasts and stanitsas of Kislev stand resilient.

desc.zh: 在健全的领导下，基斯里夫的繁荣日甚一日——即使面对尖叫、腐烂、狂笑的混沌部落，也并不会受到什么影响
desc.en: Under sound leadership, Kislev grows more prosperous by the day, even in the screaming, rotting, laughing, lying face of the oncoming hordes of Chaos.

desc.zh: 懦夫组成的国家早就会被恶魔狂潮所淹没了，显然基斯里夫并不是这样的国家
desc.en: A nation of weaklings and cravens would have long since succumbed to the Daemonic horde. Kislev is no such nation.

desc.zh: 无止境的抵御混沌战争并没有削弱基斯里夫公民的意志，他们的内心仍然极为坚定地对抗着最黑暗的腐蚀
desc.en: The endless defence against Chaos has done little to dim the spirit of Kislev's citizens, whose hearts remain resolute against the darkest of corruptions.

desc.zh: 『即使是在最为寒冷的梦乡里，厄孙也呼唤了我，我也作出了回应！』
desc.en: "Ursun called to me, and even in the coldest of sleeps, I answered!"

desc.zh: 『基斯里夫即是民众，民众即是基斯里夫！』
desc.en: "Kislev is the people, and the people are Kislev!"

desc.zh: 『你若热爱熊神，那么虽死亦胜于偷生！』
desc.en: "If you love the Bear you will happily die rather than be taken!"

desc.zh: 『全员不要动，脓汤来啦！』
desc.en: "All hordes, congeal; festering comes!"

desc.zh: 要是你始终都不懂与这个恶心的传染源保持距离，那么你一定会后悔的。当然，前提是你得能活着把这事儿告诉别人
desc.en: If you spend almost any time too close to this vile infector you'll regret it, assuming you live to tell the tale that is.

desc.zh: 这家伙非常谙熟于在全世界散播纳垢的肮脏准则与言语。考虑到此人太过恶臭，这实在是很微妙啊…
desc.en: Unusually subtle for one so foul, this one is skilled in spreading Nurgle's insanitary ways and words across the land.

desc.zh: 此人发现敌人对他唯恐避之而不及，更别说攻上前来了
desc.en: This one finds the enemy can barely stand to come near them, let alone attack.

desc.zh: 当此人身上的无数脓疮不断溃烂板结之后，他的浑身上下就留下了一道『自然形成』的护体硬壳
desc.en: When this one's countless lesions and warts finish weeping and harden up, a natural, protective carapace is left behind in their place.

desc.zh: 要是让人只能猫在家里躺卧室蹲厕所，那么这人也就没法去传播异议、煽动骚乱了
desc.en: If a population are confined to their toilets or beds at home they're not able to spread dissent and sedition as readily, if at all.

desc.zh: 除非你是个食人魔，要是长得如此庞大笨拙，那么对于大多的生物来说都会是死路一条。但如果你受到了慈父的眷爱，那这样反而会是种优势
desc.en: Ogres aside, being this large and ungainly would almost certainly kill most other creatures, but when you're beloved of the Urfather it is actually an advantage.

desc.zh: 『今天是兽人，明天是世界，让他们全部颤抖吧！』
desc.en: "Today the Orcs, tomorrow the world. Let them all tremble!..."

desc.zh: 『全齐了，全在咱锅里了。快跳进去吧，跳啊！』
desc.en: "It’s all 'ere, in ma pot. Just scamper over and jump in!"

desc.zh: 屠宰是一门艺术。此人知道如何从尸体上剥下最后一点能吃的肌体，只留下骨头
desc.en: Butchery is an art. This one knows how to extract every last morsel worth eating from a carcass, leaving only bones behind them.

desc.zh: 在大快朵颐之后，这些喜欢辣味的战士能够一个屁把自己崩出二里地去——当然，这么干没准儿会搞死恰好在他身后的食人魔
desc.en: Though they risk killing the Ogres directly behind them, those fighters who like it spicy can propel themselves further with gassy emanations following a hearty meal.

desc.zh: 肉吃得越多，身子就会越壮越胖，因此只要这货站定了位置，你就很难把他挪开
desc.en: The more meat you eat, the stronger and fatter you become, and therefore the harder you are to move from your chosen position.

desc.zh: 与他的食人魔同僚比起来，这家伙的身高可能半斤八两；但如果上了战场，这家伙就立刻鹤立鸡群了
desc.en: There may or may not be a height difference between this one and his Ogreish colleagues, but in stature on the battlefield the divergence is most stark.

desc.zh: 『小子们，记住，当大胃神来的时候，他吃掉了黑夜，震撼大地然后一把火把它烧了。这是我们效忠的柱子，不是闹着玩儿』
desc.en: "Remember, lads, when Great Maw came 'e ate the night, shook the ground and burnt it with fire. That is 'oo we serve, not sum uvver power."

desc.zh: 『我渴望品尝它们那甜蜜的痛苦』
desc.en: "I yearn to taste their delicious agony."

desc.zh: 『我无聊透了』，任性的极乐之主说，『今天你能献上什么玩具呢？』
desc.en: "I'm bored," said the perverse Lord of Excess. "What playthings can you offer me today?"

desc.zh: 事实证明，此人怪诞的诱人美貌在战场与卧室中同样有效
desc.en: This one's eerily seductive beauty has proved to be most useful both in the bedroom and on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 对于完美亲王的侍从来说，无瑕并非不可企及的目标：若是成为少数有幸被选中的宠儿，这一愿景真可能成为现实
desc.en: Flawlessness is not an unattainable goal for those who serve the Perfect Prince; for the chosen few, it can be a reality.

desc.zh: 对于完美亲王的侍从来说，无瑕并非不可企及的目标：若是成为少数有幸被选中的宠儿，这一愿景真可能成为现实
desc.en: Flawlessness is not an unattainable goal for those who serve the Perfect Prince; for the chosen few, it can be a reality.

desc.zh: 此人被打磨得极其光滑，使他能够在陆地、海洋或天空中滑翔，因为他确实受到了黑暗亲王的青睐，而且能迅速地执行他的命令
desc.en: This one's polished, perfectly glossy smoothness enables them to glide across land, sea or air, for they are truly favoured by the Dark Prince, and swift to do His bidding.

desc.zh: 即使是最纯洁、最善良的灵魂，只要受到适当的诱惑，也会扭曲成根深蒂固的堕落
desc.en: Even the purest, most virtuous soul can be distorted to vile perversion or inveterate depravity if the right sort of temptation is offered.

desc.zh: 『现在对我们微不足道，因为我们知道今天不是我们的死期』
desc.en: "The now is trivial to us – we know the day we perish is not this day."

desc.zh: 此人蒙奸之主篡变赐福所惠，能够如字面意义般地轻舒羽翼，扶摇而上
desc.en: Blessed with the transformative boons of Tzeeneth, this one can travel further by his feathered wings, whether they be figurative or literal.

desc.zh: 这位篡变忠仆所及之处，无不散发着欺瞒与迷惑，甚至连最熟练的战士与法师也会茫然无措
desc.en: Beguilement and confusion are exuded wherever this servant of Change walks, foxing even the most adept combatants and magic-users.

desc.zh: 此人已成为了大阴谋者编织魔法网络的渠道，通过魔法的手段来影响光荣的篡变
desc.en: This one has become the conduit through which the Great Conspirator weaves His sorcerous webs, affecting glorious Change through magical means.

desc.zh: 连接世界的无形丝线可以按照奸奇的意愿重新编织，此人则看到了操控丝线的方式与方法
desc.en: The unseen threads by which the world is connected can be re-woven at Tzeentch's will. This one sees the patterns and how they can be manipulated.

desc.zh: 此人试图播下困惑、异议与虚伪的种子，因为这些都是万变之主的阴谋手段
desc.en: This one seeks to sow the seeds of confusion, dissent and dishonesty, for such are the insidious ways of the Changer.

desc.zh: 『你是禁门魔王吗？』
desc.en: "Are you the Gatekeeper?"

desc.zh: 将法杖或是某种奥术导体插入大地之后，有经验的施法者便会有效地束缚魔法之风，从而大大降低施法事故的触发概率
desc.en: By stabbing a staff or some arcane conduit into the ground, an accomplished magic-user can earth or tether the Winds and hopefully reduce a chance of miscasting.

desc.zh: 当巨大的愤怒和暴力降临在毫无准备的人身上时，幸存者将寥寥无几
desc.en: When a huge swathe of rage and violence descends upon the unready, very few survivors are left in its wake.

desc.zh: 很少有魔法能穿透此人的头骨：恐之主项圈提供了坚不可摧的防护力，但与此同时，无情的愤怒也感染了他的思维
desc.en: Few magics can worm their way through this one's skull; their Khornate collar offers adequate protection, as does the impenetrable, relentless fury infecting his mind.

desc.zh: 这个恐虐的奴才在战场上横冲直撞，任凭胸口插满了箭矢：它们显然没起到什么作用，只是进一步点燃了他的怒火而已
desc.en: At times, this servant of Khorne storms across the battlefield with arrows lodged in his chest. However, they seem to do little but further stoke the raging fire of his wrath.

desc.zh: 强悍的恶魔引擎，身披黄铜铠甲，足踏铁定车轮冲入战场
desc.en: A mighty Daemon Engine, clad in brass armour and driven into battle on iron-shod wheels.

desc.zh: 以铜铁制成的咆哮猛兽，身高赛过凡人，浑身蛮力
desc.en: Mighty beasts of groaning iron and brass, taller than a man and possessed of a crushing mass.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 在战场上乱扑乱撞是软弱和任性的表现。战争应该按照恐之主的方式进行：纯粹、肆无忌惮的野蛮
desc.en: Fluttering and flouncing into battle is the way of the weak and self-indulgent. War should be waged Kharneth's way – with pure, unbridled savagery.

desc.zh: 强悍的恶魔引擎，身披黄铜铠甲，足踏铁定车轮冲入战场
desc.en: A mighty Daemon Engine, clad in brass armour and driven into battle on iron-shod wheels.

desc.zh: 以铜铁制成的咆哮猛兽，身高赛过凡人，浑身蛮力
desc.en: Mighty beasts of groaning iron and brass, taller than a man and possessed of a crushing mass.

desc.zh: 没有威胁的敌人，是全身肢体都被血淋淋砍掉的敌人！
desc.en: No foe remains a threat once torn limb from bloody limb!

desc.zh: 『杀！杀光他们！』
desc.en: "KILL! KILL THEM ALL!"

desc.zh: 『全部夷平，寸草不留！』
desc.en: "Raze it all to the ground! Leave nothing standing!"

desc.zh: 当所有的思想都从他的脑海中挤出时，此人就只剩下惨叫的屠杀之歌了
desc.en: With every other thought squeezed from his mind, there is naught left of this one but the screaming song of slaughter.

desc.zh: 死亡、恶意、屠戮与谋杀——恐虐的敌人将品尝这一切
desc.en: Death, malice, butchery and murder – the enemies of Khorne shall have it all.

desc.zh: 『谁都别想跑！谁都别想藏！所有人都将受尽折磨！』
desc.en: "None shall run far! None shall be able to hide! All will come to sufferance!"

desc.zh: 『模式化的恐怖，这是一场巨大的残虐盛宴。而唯一的出路就是一点点地承受下去』
desc.en: "Modulistic terror – a vast, sadistic feast. The only way to exit is going piece by piece."

desc.zh: 所有人都将经历痛苦，被血神无处可逃的仇恨所粉碎
desc.en: All will know agony, pulverised by the inescapable grip of the Blood God's hatred.

desc.zh: 恐虐之脚踏过敌人的尸体，如同死亡之牙咬碎未死之人的生命
desc.en: The Feet of Khorne march across the corpses of their enemies, as the Teeth of Death crush the life from those yet to die.

desc.zh: 在被征服者的鲜血中，最忠诚的战争仆从将首级献给了血神的颅座
desc.en: Still awash with the blood of the conquered, the most devoted servants of war deliver skulls afore the Blood God's Skull Throne.

desc.zh: 只需一瞬间，受害者就会迷失在翅膀、牙齿和爪子的可怕漩涡之中
desc.en: A single moment is all it takes to become lost in a vicious maelstrom of wing, tooth and claw.

desc.zh: 轰隆的炮火、血腥的机械、地狱般的鸣叫，战争机器用这些交织成了一首毁灭的交响乐
desc.en: The machinery of war creates a symphony of destruction out of booming cannon fire and the creaking of blood-soaked, hellish mechanisms.

desc.zh: 这位领主的狂战士现身之处，屠杀与毁灭定会随之而来
desc.en: Where this Lord's rabid warriors appear, slaughter and Ruination are always sure to follow.

desc.zh: 他们的身后留下了屠杀和破坏的痕迹，恐虐的神选者不愧是是最狂热的毁灭信徒
desc.en: Leaving a trail of carnage and devastation in their wake, Khorne's Chosen are the most fervent acolytes of annihilation.

desc.zh: 许多军队几乎在瞬间就被狂怒的屠戮狂怒冲垮，真是奇妙的场景啊
desc.en: Many armies are lost almost instantly under an avalanche of uninhibited, murderous rage. Such things are wondrous to behold.

desc.zh: 在敌人的心脏位置，奔腾着狂暴的毁灭猎犬
desc.en: Into the heart of the enemy race the feral hounds of havoc and destruction.

desc.zh: 凶残的战争机器在血神无尽的愤怒中隆隆作响
desc.en: The diabolic engines of war rumble with the endless wrath of the Blood God himself.

desc.zh: 战斗可以输，但是战争真的能赢吗？毁灭之力前进的步伐永远不会真正停下
desc.en: Battles can be lost, but can the war ever really be won? The advance of Ruin can never truly be halted once and for all.

desc.zh: 混沌的仆从带来的是腐败，他们会加快周围环境扭曲腐化的速度
desc.en: With the servants of Chaos comes the corruption – as the landscape twists, this one speeds the transformation.

desc.zh: 这位恐之主领主的愤怒之泉永不干涸，源源不断的战士狂潮也渴望在他的指挥下服务
desc.en: This Khornate Lord's well of eternal rage never runs dry, nor does the ceaseless influx of warriors eager to serve under his command.

desc.zh: 每个以血神之名砍下的头颅，都是对颅座忠诚的证明
desc.en: Every skull taken in the Blood God's honour proves this one's loyalty to the Skull Throne.

desc.zh: 这位残酷的恐虐领主将人类与怪物的国度一视同仁地毁灭殆尽，正是愤怒的鲜活具象！
desc.en: This brutal Lord of Khorne decimates the lands of man and monster alike – the avatar or wrath incarnate!

desc.zh: 无人能阻止此人的屠杀，因为无可抑制的战争欲望正驱使着他
desc.en: There is no stopping this one's slaughter, for they are driven by the unquenchable lust for battle.

desc.zh: 没有威胁的敌人，是全身肢体都被血淋淋砍掉的敌人！
desc.en: No foe remains a threat once torn limb from bloody limb!

desc.zh: 『杀！杀光他们！』
desc.en: "KILL! KILL THEM ALL!"

desc.zh: 『全部夷平，寸草不留！』
desc.en: "Raze it all to the ground! Leave nothing standing!"

desc.zh: 当所有的思想都从他的脑海中挤出时，此人就只剩下惨叫的屠杀之歌了
desc.en: With every other thought squeezed from their mind, there is naught left of this one but the screaming song of slaughter.

desc.zh: 死亡、恶意、屠戮与谋杀——恐虐的敌人将品尝这一切
desc.en: Death, malice, butchery and murder – the enemies of Khorne shall have it all.

desc.zh: 『谁都别想跑！谁都别想藏！所有人都将受尽折磨！』
desc.en: "None shall run far! None shall be able to hide! All will come to sufferance!"

desc.zh: 『模式化的恐怖，这是一场巨大的残虐盛宴。而唯一的出路就是一点点地承受下去』
desc.en: "Modulistic terror – a vast, sadistic feast. The only way to exit is going piece by piece."

desc.zh: 所有人都将经历痛苦，被血神无处可逃的仇恨所粉碎
desc.en: All will know agony, pulverised by the inescapable grip of the Blood God's hatred.

desc.zh: 在血腥狂乱的驱使下，没有任何东西能让斯卡布兰德停下脚步
desc.en: Motivated by a savage blood-frenzy, Skarbrand stops for nothing and no one.

desc.zh: 斯卡布兰德踏足的每一个战场，都变成了鲜血与脏器的沼泽
desc.en: Every battlefield Skarbrand sets foot on becomes little more than a swamp of blood and viscera.

desc.zh: 若是要满足放逐者的愤怒，怕是倾尽世上所有鲜血都不够！
desc.en: There is not enough blood in the world to sate the Exiled One's burning rage.

desc.zh: 无所遏制的恐怖与混乱只是斯卡布兰德到来的预兆，而毁灭必然随之而来
desc.en: Unchecked terror and Chaos are but the heralds of Skarbrand's arrival. Ruin shall surely follow.

desc.zh: 尽管早已被从恐虐身边放逐，但斯卡布兰德的征服欲望仍继续激发着血神压倒性的力量
desc.en: Though exiled from Khorne's side, the legacy of Skarbrand's conquests continue to fuel the Blood God's overwhelming power.

desc.zh: 没有任何东西能穿透环绕在熊父周围的寒冰暴雪漩涡
desc.en: Naught can penetrate the swirling mists of ice and sleet that churn around those afforded Father Bear's protection.

desc.zh: 『兄弟们，厄孙与我们同在！没人能承受熊神的愤怒！』
desc.en: "Ursun is with us, brothers! None can stand against the beasts of the Bear-God!"

desc.zh: 所有基斯里夫人都是格斯坡达骄傲的骑兵后裔：与他们的祖先一样，他们生来就骑在马鞍上
desc.en: Descended of the proud horse-warriors of the Gospodar, all Kislevites are born to the saddle like their ancestors before them.

desc.zh: 『强大的基斯里夫近卫军血管里流淌的是冰，传言是这么说的…』
desc.en: "There's ice in the veins of the mighty Guards of Kislev, or so the rumour goes…"

desc.zh: 基斯里夫人雷鸣般的马蹄声在方圆数里格之内都能听到，即使刚下过的雪也掩盖不了它们
desc.en: The thunderous pounding of Kislevite hooves can be heard for leagues around, even muffled by the crunch of fresh snow.

desc.zh: 『再来，再来，再来！我们要一直练习到你们手指流血为止！』
desc.en: "Again, again, again! We'll practice this until your fingers bleed!"

desc.zh: 北方战士们的血液里流淌着斗争的本能，这是古代的可汗国王与可汗女王们留下的遗产
desc.en: The warriors of the north carry conflict in their blood, a legacy left by the Khan-Kings and Khan-Queens of old.

desc.zh: 在基斯里夫森林里游荡的野兽，比它们居住的土地更为致命
desc.en: The beasts that roam the forests of Kislev are somehow even more lethal than the land they inhabit.

desc.zh: 基斯里夫的工匠们夜以继日地劳作，用各种精巧的装置协助着对抗混沌的大业
desc.en: Kislevite craftsmen toil night and day, tinkering with contraptions to help repel the forces of Chaos.

desc.zh: 北方的工坊总会非常繁忙，工程师们孜孜不倦地工作，铸造着卓越的战斗武器
desc.en: The workshops of the north are always busy, their engineers working tirelessly in the pursuit of battle excellence.

desc.zh: 该领主希望得到平民的绝对服从，这样他们就没时间策划暴动或小规模叛乱了
desc.en: This Lord expects utter obedience from the smallfolk, and has little time for insurrections or petty revolts.

desc.zh: 这位著名领袖深受大众的尊崇，大量的新兵便会因此加入他的麾下
desc.en: Revered by the masses, such a celebrated leader will inspire many new recruits.

desc.zh: 懂得如何移走山峦的人，将在他们所在之处盖起宫殿
desc.en: Those with the know-how to move mountains build palaces in their stead.

desc.zh: 『起来，懒蛋！狼都聚起来了，我的兵还想当绵羊吗？』
desc.en: "Rouse yourselves, layabouts! The wolves gather, and I won't have my soldiers play at being sheep!"

desc.zh: 若是能抢先一步将多余的收成运去偏远的村庄，就可以大大降低因腐烂带来的损耗
desc.en: Pre-emptively shipping excess harvest to outlying villages significantly cuts spoilage.

desc.zh: 若是能妥善部署巡逻队，便能在敌人入侵时进行早期预警和动员
desc.en: Roving patrols enable early warning and mobilisation in the event of enemy incursion.

desc.zh: 最好的路线不在地图上，而是在那些走过千次的人的知识里
desc.en: The best routes aren't found on maps, but in the knowledge of those who have walked them a thousand times.

desc.zh: 让伤兵与新募驻军轮流作战，可以让军队迅速恢复战斗力
desc.en: Rotating wounded soldiery with fresh garrison troops allows armies to quickly recover.

desc.zh: 除了单纯的驻防之外，派遣军官令部队维持在随时可以部署的状态，便可以实现快速的动员
desc.en: Beyond mere garrisons, dedicating officers to maintaining forces for deployment allows for rapid mobilisation.

desc.zh: 当尘埃落定时，我们必须为未来保留来之不易的教训
desc.en: When the dust settles, hard-earned lessons must be preserved for the future.

desc.zh: 对于边境守卫工作来说，哨兵轮换是一项虽微小但很重要的安全保障
desc.en: A rota of sentries is a small but important layer of security for any frontier.

desc.zh: 虽然许多人认为宫廷中的政治活动是浪费时间，但参与其中毕竟也会获得回报
desc.en: Though many consider the politicking of the Court a waste of time, those who play the game reap the rewards

desc.zh: 麻烦降临时，强大的盟友将不无裨益
desc.en: When trouble comes knocking, it helps to have powerful allies.

desc.zh: 此人经常与宫廷的冰雪女巫共同商讨领地的未来
desc.en: This one often meets with Ice Witches of the Court to confer on the future of his demesne.

desc.zh: 全心全意虔诚的人会享受基斯里夫万神殿的青睐，也会为其他民众做出奉献社区的榜样
desc.en: The truly devout walk with the favour of the Kislev pantheon as icons of the community that others readily serve.

desc.zh: 战斗打响，战斧高擎之时，狂热战士们的声音也会随之响起
desc.en: As battle is met and axes are raised, so too are the voices of the fervent.

desc.zh: 『除了严格遵守大正教的教义，皆为非道！』
desc.en: "There is no other way but to adhere strictly to the teachings of the Great Orthodoxy."

desc.zh: 冰封的泥土也可孕育肥沃的土地
desc.en: From ice-packed dirt shall come fertile fields.

desc.zh: 宁为猎人，不为猎物
desc.en: Better to be the hunter than to be the hunted.

desc.zh: 亲身入局可以确保谈判尽可能顺利地进行
desc.en: A personal touch ensures that negotiations go their way as often as possible.

desc.zh: 骑射手毫无警告地冲出掩体，如冬季风暴般掠袭敌军，这是一种久经考验的消耗战术
desc.en: A long-tested form of attritional warfare has Horse Archers emerge from cover without warning to harry enemy forces like a winter storm.

desc.zh: 鲍里斯的每次心跳都回荡着厄孙的勇气与坚韧
desc.en: Boris' every heartbeat echoes with the courage and tenacity of Ursun.

desc.zh: 恪尽职守，消除心中一切恐惧，因为恐惧是对祖国母亲的威胁
desc.en: Hold tight to duty and rid the mind of all fear, for fear is a threat to the Motherland.

desc.zh: 既然每个敌人都有权携带武器，那么他们就会有被熊齿咬伤的权利
desc.en: Every enemy has the right to bear arms. And the right to be horrifically mauled by bear-teeth.

desc.zh: 『我不知道这些人会对敌人做些什么，但我敢说，他们真让我害怕』
desc.en: "I don't know what effect these men will have upon the enemy, but by Ursun, they frighten me."

desc.zh: 为了所有基斯里夫人的利益，以厄孙的名义，我们要夺回被混沌抢走的一切！
desc.en: All that was lost to Chaos shall be reclaimed, in Ursun's name for the good of all Kislev.

desc.zh: 经过数世纪对抗毁灭的血腥大战，基斯里夫的城市将再次崛起，并比以往任何时候都更强大
desc.en: Following centuries of devastating conflict against Ruin, the cities of Kislev shall rise again, stronger than ever before.

desc.zh: 『在重新找回自己之前，你必须先迷失自我，回到放逐中…』
desc.en: "You've got to lose yourself before you find yourself, back in exile…"

desc.zh: 『红沙皇』厄孙是基斯里夫最伟大的统治者。在那些希望为共同的事业而与冰霜王国并肩奋战的人们中，此人享有盛誉
desc.en: Ursus the Red, the greatest of Kislev's rulers, commands respect from those wishing to treat with the frozen kingdom for common cause.

desc.zh: 巨熊将会重生，祖国与他同在
desc.en: The Great Bear shall be reborn, and the Motherland with him.

desc.zh: 鲍里斯的回归预示着基斯里夫人的空前繁荣，这证明了他与祖国母亲及其人民的深刻羁绊
desc.en: Boris' return heralds a period of unprecedented growth among the Kislevites, proving his intrinsic connection to the Motherland and its people.

desc.zh: 作为最为强大的战熊坐骑，『熊大哥』等待着他的传奇骑手鲍里斯·博哈
desc.en: Greatest of all the bear mounts, the 'Bear-brother' who awaits his legendary rider, Boris Bokha.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 冠军勇士们皆将击败强大的敌人视为极大的荣耀，但决定战斗胜败的往往只是人数而已
desc.en: Champions know there is glory in striking down great foes, but battles are more often won by the many and not the few.

desc.zh: 许多敌人曾经攻破过基斯里夫冰冻的城墙，那么，每一扇铁砧都必须配上一柄锤子
desc.en: Many foes have broken upon the frozen ramparts of Kislev, and for every anvil there must be a hammer.

desc.zh: 冰川般的决意会使你的心坚硬无比
desc.en: Harden your heart with glacial resolve.

desc.zh: 基斯里夫教条的核心，便是钢铁的风暴
desc.en: At the core of Kislevite doctrine, the storm of steel.

desc.zh: 比起北境冰霜风暴的噬咬，区区箭伤算得了什么？
desc.en: What is the bite of an arrow to the freezing sting of a northern hailstorm?

desc.zh: 战斗是锻造英雄的熔炉
desc.en: Battle is the crucible in which Heroes are forged.

desc.zh: 忠诚、凶猛、强大、速度惊人，战熊可算是基斯里夫自身的象征
desc.en: Loyal, fierce, powerful and surprisingly fast – a War Bear is a symbol of Kislev itself.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 该领主希望得到平民的绝对服从，这样他们就没时间策划暴动或小规模叛乱了
desc.en: This Lord expects utter obedience from the smallfolk, and has little time for insurrections or petty revolts.

desc.zh: 『死亡，即如侵髓之霜；紧闭门扉，亦不可挡。纵使盛夏，再起芬芳；我等亦难逃冰雪之殇』
desc.en: "Death is like a winter chill; No door can keep it from us; And summer yet may bloom againThough ice be all upon us."

desc.zh: 忠诚、凶猛、强大、速度惊人，战熊可算是基斯里夫自身的象征
desc.en: Loyal, fierce, powerful and surprisingly fast – a War Bear is a symbol of Kislev itself.

desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 忠诚、凶猛、强大、速度惊人，战熊可算是基斯里夫自身的象征
desc.en: Loyal, fierce, powerful and surprisingly fast – a War Bear is a symbol of Kislev itself.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 有许多神秘的奇迹隐藏在暗处，只要有足够的洞察力就能发现它们
desc.en: There are any number of mysterious wonders secreted away in the shadows, for those discerning enough to find them.

desc.zh: 『基斯里夫的金库一定会涨得满满的！我们可以用这些金子做些什么！』
desc.en: "Kislev's coffers will be overflowing! The things we could do with all that gold!"

desc.zh: 我们可以从邻居那里学到很多东西，尤其是当他们无法掩盖自己的发现，挡不住别人的窥探的时候
desc.en: There is much to be learned from one's neighbours, especially if they fail to shroud their discoveries from prying eyes.

desc.zh: 『不要怜悯基斯里夫的敌人，因为他们也不会怜悯你！』
desc.en: "Show no mercy for the enemies of Kislev, for they will show no mercy to you!"

desc.zh: 最危险的攻击往往来自你最意想不到的敌人
desc.en: Often the most dangerous assault comes from the enemy you least expect.

desc.zh: 忠诚、凶猛、强大、速度惊人，战熊可算是基斯里夫自身的象征
desc.en: Loyal, fierce, powerful and surprisingly fast – a War Bear is a symbol of Kislev itself.

desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 忠诚、凶猛、强大、速度惊人，战熊可算是基斯里夫自身的象征
desc.en: Loyal, fierce, powerful and surprisingly fast – a War Bear is a symbol of Kislev itself.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 冰雪女王统治着一座雄伟的冰雪宫殿，整个房间都用最强大的冰雪魔法雕刻而成
desc.en: The Ice Queen rules from a majestic frozen palace, where whole chambers are carved from the most potent ice magic.

desc.zh: 卡捷琳周围矗立着小规模的冰墙与冰山，这是足以挡住最致命威胁的寒冰壁垒
desc.en: Small walls and mountains of ice are known to spring from the ground around Katarin, a frozen bulwark against the deadliest of threats.

desc.zh: 将临的混沌狂潮永远不会停止，但基斯里夫永远都会起身反抗它
desc.en: The oncoming tide of Chaos never ceases, yet Kislev will never fail to rise up and fight against it.

desc.zh: 女沙皇身边伴随着一股急速的冰雪潮流，如同一股席卷而来的寒风
desc.en: A hastened stream of ice and snow flows with the Tzarina, moving as one with the frigid wind.

desc.zh: 尽管这仅仅是出于传言的迷信，但很多人都相信卡捷琳就是初代可汗女王米莎的转世重生
desc.en: Though stemming from superstition bred from whispers alone, there are many that believe Katarin to be Miska, the glorious first Khan-Queen, reborn.

desc.zh: 寒冷而致命，卡捷琳就是冬天的化身，刺骨深寒便是她的铠甲
desc.en: Cold and deadly – Katarin is the personification of winter itself, and armoured in its biting chill.

desc.zh: 一旦雪豹开始狩猎，任何猎物都将无处可逃了：唯一能做的就是闭上眼睛，祈祷它盯上的不是你吧！
desc.en: There's nowhere to run once the Snow Leopards begin their hunt. Only close your eyes and hope you are not their prey.

desc.zh: 忠诚、凶猛、强大、速度惊人，战熊可算是基斯里夫自身的象征
desc.en: Loyal, fierce, powerful and surprisingly fast – a War Bear is a symbol of Kislev itself.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 如果基斯里夫和它的人民要坚持下去，那么他们必须战斗到死，以免敌人夺走他们为之奋斗的一切
desc.en: If Kislev and its people are to endure then they must fight to the death, lest the foe take all for which they have strived.

desc.zh: 无论他们是否意识到，农民们真正需要的其实是个真正的强者：一个有着钢铁般的意志，足以将死亡抛诸脑后的人
desc.en: What the peasants really want, whether they know so or not, is a strong man; a man with will of iron so strong that death itself runs in his wake.

desc.zh: 对自身与自身事业的信心，在最低情况下也是与武艺同等重要的
desc.en: Faith in oneself and one's cause are at least as important as martial skill, if not more so.

desc.zh: 那些表现出天赋与希望的信徒们很快就会在大正教会中扶摇而上，从而激励和领导他人
desc.en: Those among the faithful who show talent and promise soon find themselves raised up within Great Orthodoxy to inspire and lead others.

desc.zh: 最能让基斯里夫人勃然大怒的，便是虔诚的他居然受到了嘲笑，尤其是当他灌下了最好的格瓦斯时
desc.en: There's nothing quite like a pious Kislevite man scorned, especially one whose rage is stoked by the finest kvas.

desc.zh: 在瞬间将乌合之众煽动成可怕的暴徒，这种手段绝然不可低估
desc.en: The power to rouse the rabble to terrific violence in a heartbeat is not to be underestimated.

desc.zh: 大正教会将目睹基斯里夫再次崛起，强大无比，彻底剿灭毁灭之力
desc.en: The Great Orthodoxy shall see Kislev rise again, mighty and without peer, with Ruin defeated and destroyed utterly.

desc.zh: 忠诚、凶猛、强大、速度惊人，战熊可算是基斯里夫自身的象征
desc.en: Loyal, fierce, powerful and surprisingly fast – a War Bear is a symbol of Kislev itself.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 尽管他们看起来很脆弱，但毫无疑问，众神引导着牧首的臂膀，并赐予他力量来保卫祖国母亲
desc.en: Frail as they may seem, there is no doubt the Gods guide the Patriarch's arm, and lend him their strength in defence of the Motherland.

desc.zh: 康斯坦丁的扁平金属圆盘上刻有厄逊的符文和标志，当它被授予有能之人时，会激发此人完成更伟大的事迹
desc.en: Kostaltyn’s flat metal discs, inscribed with Ursun’s runes and icons, inspire even greater deeds when awarded to the worthy.

desc.zh: 相信的时间越长，信念就变得越强烈。而当你抱持坚定的信念时，就没有什么是做不到的
desc.en: The longer you believe, the more intense that faith becomes. When your belief is total, there is nothing that you cannot achieve.

desc.zh: 这些伤口足以杀死寻常之人，但他却幸存了下来。很明显，此人得到了基斯里夫诸神的青睐
desc.en: Surviving wounds that would have killed lesser men, it is clear that this one bears the favour of the Kislevite gods.

desc.zh: 牧首为众神代言，把基斯里夫的精神传播到四面八方
desc.en: The Patriarch speaks with the voice of the gods, spreading the spirit of Kislev far and wide.

desc.zh: 此人的声音震耳欲聋，如此，他的血腥雷鸣声音便一定会抵达需要听到它的人耳畔了
desc.en: This one's stentorian roar ensures that his blood-and-thunder missives always reach their intended recipients.

desc.zh: 『如此凶残的动物，没有人能赢过它们；因此到了战场上，我们就是神选之人！』
desc.en: "An animal so vicious, no others fought and won. So on the fields of battle, we are the chosen ones!"

desc.zh: 休息是弱者的权利，而我们必须不停地追击敌人，使他们没时间重新集结
desc.en: Rest is for the weak; one must harry the enemy in relentless pursuit and leave them no time to regroup.

desc.zh: 忠诚、凶猛、强大、速度惊人，战熊可算是基斯里夫自身的象征
desc.en: Loyal, fierce, powerful and surprisingly fast – a War Bear is a symbol of Kislev itself.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 旧世界的和平长久以来都是用基斯里夫的血换来的。当毁灭降临时，没有人比北方坚强的守护者更能直面他们
desc.en: Long has peace in the Old World been bought with the blood of Kislev. When Ruination descends, none are more ready to meet it than the hardy guardians of the north.

desc.zh: 忠诚、凶猛、强大、速度惊人，战熊可算是基斯里夫自身的象征
desc.en: Loyal, fierce, powerful and surprisingly fast – a War Bear is a symbol of Kislev itself.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 冰冷无情，遵从逻辑。使人更加强硬，可以对抗魔法的负面效果
desc.en: Cold, merciless, without pity, obeying only logic. Hardened against magic's ill-effects.

desc.zh: 从颓废沉糜的状态中摆脱出来后，太阳城领主将神殿守卫的森然戒律淬炼成了炽热的狂信
desc.en: Unchained by the malaise that afflicts the Slann, the Lord of the Solar-City spurs the unnerving vigil of the Temple Guard into vehement zealotry.

desc.zh: 『看吧，双子兄弟之中一个生活在黑暗里，另一个则活在光明中！』
desc.en: "Whilst one brother lives in darkness, the other, his double-twin, exists in light. Behold!"

desc.zh: 『煌奇是黑暗的表亲，他的祭司们也应寄身于暮光之中』
desc.en: "Cousin of darkness, Huanchi's priests too shall dwell in twilight."

desc.zh: 『向伊奇祷告吧，他是野兽的创世神！』
desc.en: "Creator-meld of the beast, Itzl be praised!"

desc.zh: 『神圣的守护神赐予你鳞片保佑你』
desc.en: "By your scales be you blessed by the divine protector."

desc.zh: 『风神泰波克是伟大的拉兹寇托的兄弟，应该永远敬拜他，我们开始祭拜吧』
desc.en: "Brother of Great Tlazcotl, Tepok of the Air shall always be honoured. Let it be done."

desc.zh: 『宇宙存在于他的眼眸之中，拥抱被赐福的冰冷吧』
desc.en: "The universe resides within his reflective eyes; embrace the coldness of blessed certainty."

desc.zh: 鳞甲渐覆霜白、骨板日益钙化，这便是岁月为蜥人留下的痕迹
desc.en: Saurus mark the passage of time through the ever-increasing hoariness of their scales and the ossification of their battle-worn plates.

desc.zh: 将畸形的翡翠镶入黑曜石素胚所铸的兵器，若是其中含有铭刻索提戈赐福的宝石，则为上上精品
desc.en: Featureless slabs of obsinite used for the Saurus’ weapons are reinforced with cruelly misshapen jade and, most importantly, gemstones symbolising the favour of Sotek.

desc.zh: 每场厮杀皆使生还者筋肉虬结，其坚韧程度恰与战场本能同步增长
desc.en: Every skirmish thickens the corded muscle of the surviving Saurus, increasing their resilience commensurately with their instinctual understanding of battle manoeuvres.

desc.zh: 当八英尺长，覆满疤痕的爬行类肌体悬挂着献祭敌首时，大计划显然将成为无懈可击的真理
desc.en: The Great Plan seems beyond reproach when faced with eight feet of scar-ridden reptilian muscle festooned with the shrunken heads of sacrificed foes.

desc.zh: 天命独行的爬行动物自初代古圣烙下意志之地现身，从神庙城市深处的神圣孵化池中破水而出
desc.en: Solitary reptilians marked for greatness appear where the Old Ones first imprinted their will, emerging from the glow of sacred spawning pools beneath cavernous temple-cities.

desc.zh: 冷血种战士在更庞大的亲族的阴影下战斗，以年轻种族无法理解的速度磨练他们的空间感知能力
desc.en: Fighting in the shadow of their more colossal kin, cold-blooded warriors hone their spatial perception in combat at a pace younger races cannot comprehend.

desc.zh: 一记尖啸便足以令羽冠战阵喷射出毒镖的风暴，深深地埋进所有暴露的肉体里
desc.en: A singular shrill call is all a formation of vibrant-crested warriors needs to release a whirring blowgun swarm, burying deep into all exposed flesh.

desc.zh: 灵蜥首领经常满怀暴戾心性，因此要想出类拔萃，便需要参透上位冷血种谕令中的玄机
desc.en: Heightened aggression is often a characteristic of appointed Skink Chiefs. To excel, one needs to interpret the subtlety in orders from the greater coldbloods.

desc.zh: 大计划先知的双尾孪生圣卵偶现尘寰，每每能孕育出通晓万事的个体
desc.en: An instrument of foresight in the execution of the Great Plan, an unpredicted and solitary spawning of a twin-tailed Oracle can produce an especially learned individual.

desc.zh: 凝望镜湖之水时，史兰可以窥视寰宇景象，而灵蜥预言家仅可窥其片羽
desc.en: Staring into reflective waters, a Slann can comprehend world-spanning visions of which a Skink prognosticator is allowed but a glimpse.

desc.zh: 当战绘符纹无意中复现灵脉巨网的轨迹时，受绘的先知即可获得无形的护佑
desc.en: Through the unwitting replication of certain patterns of the Geomantic Web, a ritualistic daubing of warpaint can apply unseen protection to the Oracle so marked.

desc.zh: 混沌之月引发的永恒悸动激发了冷血种天文学家的神秘智慧，启迪了以毁灭该星为目标的玄奥创想
desc.en: The ceaseless consternation stemming from the presence of the Chaos Moon also spurs the arcane ingenuity of the cold-blooded astromancers, often aimed at its destruction.

desc.zh: 要想与三角神庙的大锣共鸣，就需前往幽闭的丛林深处朝圣——更重要的是，献上牺牲
desc.en: Resonance with the great gongs of a three-horned temple requires a pilgrimage to the claustrophobic depths of the jungle – and more importantly, demands sacrifice.

desc.zh: 当缚云秘链校准方位时，浮空神庙便当化作澄澈自悟的沉思圣所
desc.en: When the mystic chains that tether them to the clouds are properly aligned, the ornate floating temples are an instrument of effervescent, self-realising contemplation.

desc.zh: 对虔诚的蜥蜴人而言，感知到能令热血种肢体枯萎、活力衰竭的远古可怖之物，乃是吉兆
desc.en: A mass of primordial horrors, withering the limb and sapping the vigour of a warmblood, is perceived as a favourable omen to the devout Lizardmen.

desc.zh: 若能为万众尊崇的史兰之耳目，则可意料之外地沾染主人奥法天赋的星火余晖
desc.en: Serving as conduit for the eyes of the esteemed Slann is a privilege with unexpected benefits, attuning lesser kin to a sliver of their masters’ arcane aptitude.

desc.zh: 据说狂热的崇拜可使苍老的鳞片蜕变为蛇纹紫晶般的质地，甚至媲美传说中的羽蛇鳞甲。这是一种对抗邪恶魔法的绝佳护符
desc.en: It is said that through feverish reverence, even scales mottled with age will gain the serpentine, amethyst quality of the fabled Coatl – a potent ward against vile wizardry.

desc.zh: 法师从土地中召唤出治愈性的能量，以来自大地的自然痊愈之力庇护战士们
desc.en: The Wizard draws wholesome energies from the soil, imbuing companions with the natural resilience of the earth.

desc.zh: 这一法术可以暂时将友军的血肉之躯转换成刀枪不入的岩石皮肤，从而大大增强其抵御攻击的能力
desc.en: This spell temporarily transforms allies' mortal flesh into unbreakable rock, increasing tenfold their resistance to attack.

desc.zh: 法师呼唤着杜仁铎之名，以超乎寻常的速度治愈盟友的伤势
desc.en: By speaking Druthandor's name the Wizard is able to heal allies' injuries much faster than by natural means.

desc.zh: 法师呼唤着杜仁铎之名，以超乎寻常的速度治愈盟友的伤势
desc.en: By speaking Druthandor's name the Wizard is able to heal allies' injuries much faster than by natural means.

desc.zh: 与士兵并肩作战的领袖，必须成为第一个用盾牌击溃敌人的人
desc.en: Leaders who fight shoulder-to-shoulder with their soldiers must be the first to break the enemy upon their shields.

desc.zh: 任何射向这个纳垢仆人大肚子上的东西都必须穿透层层脂肪，这样才有那么一点机会刺到他的肉体
desc.en: Anything fired at this vile Nurglish servant's immense girth must penetrate many folds of sweaty fat before they even have the slightest chance of piercing his flesh.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 『矮人？有什么本事？脾气还一直这么臭。他们的眼中充满愠怒，根本欣赏不了疾病那恐怖的美。为什么他们就不能像其他凡人一样，痛苦地死去呢？』
desc.en: "Dwarfs? What are they good for? And always so bad tempered. The terrible beauty of disease is not for their sullen eyes. Why can't they just die, in agony, as other mortals? "

desc.zh: 苍蝇领主和他的信徒对奸奇嗤之以鼻，因为奸奇酷爱阴谋诡计，而纳垢醉心于迟缓、陈腐和静滞，这两者可谓天壤之别
desc.en: The Fly Lord and his devotees despise Tzeentch, for his obsession with schemes and trickery are the polar opposite of Nurgle's delight in slow, musty stagnation.

desc.zh: 纳垢神轿乃是华丽的宝座，上面装饰着朽坏的华服和腐烂的坐垫
desc.en: The palanquins of Nurgle are ornate thrones decorated in mouldering finery and decaying cushions.

desc.zh: 巨大的恶魔昆虫，它的外貌是如此的丑陋，足以在心灵上刻下伤痕
desc.en: A colossal Daemon-insect, whose appearance is so repugnant it leaves festering scars upon the mind.

desc.zh: 纳垢神轿乃是华丽的宝座，上面装饰着朽坏的华服和腐烂的坐垫
desc.en: The palanquins of Nurgle are ornate thrones decorated in mouldering finery and decaying cushions.

desc.zh: 巨大的恶魔昆虫，它的外貌是如此的丑陋，足以在心灵上刻下伤痕
desc.en: A colossal Daemon-insect, whose appearance is so repugnant it leaves festering scars upon the mind.

desc.zh: 这种活的（算是吧）弹药会翻滚着跃向目标，然后爆出肮脏的脓汁
desc.en: This living (well, sort of) ammunition tumbles and capers towards its target before exploding in a shower of foul pus.

desc.zh: 『常伴吾身者，乃是瘟疫、饥荒、战争…主要还是瘟疫』
desc.en: "My bedfellows are pestilence, famine and war… but mainly pestilence."

desc.zh: 致命的疾病，最好与最肮脏的臭气结合，这便是瘟父心爱的纳垢灵最好的防御
desc.en: Virulent disease, preferably in tandem with the foulest stench imaginable, is the best defence the Plaguefather's beloved Nurglings could have.

desc.zh: 其他大不净者只是在散播疾病，而恶臭酿造师则一直在酿造更新更强的疫病，以此来取悦主人，消灭敌人
desc.en: While other Great Unclean Ones merely spread disease, the Foetid Brewmaster is ever breeding new, more virulent poxes to delight his master and destroy the foe.

desc.zh: 库噶斯不仅善于经营疾疫，还会吸引志愿投入纳垢麾下勇士为自己搏杀，最后还会获得他们的爱戴
desc.en: Ku'gath not only deals in disease, but also attracts the very best candidates to Nurgle's banner to fight and kill and be favoured in their turn.

desc.zh: 库噶斯的肚子就是这么能装，相比于苍蝇领主麾下的其他大不净者，他能产生更多更好的纳垢灵
desc.en: Such is the sheer size of Ku'gath's gut that he can produce more and better Nurglings than other Great Unclean Ones in the Fly Lord's service.

desc.zh: 织疫者所过之处那一滩黏液痕迹可以让对手虚弱不堪，让自己那恶心而又致命的计谋更容易实现
desc.en: The Plagueweaver's slime trail renders opponents impotent and vulnerable to his disgusting, fatal intentions.

desc.zh: 试想一下，一个装满脓液的橡胶袋子朝你扑来，再想一下，现在它的速度变成了两倍…
desc.en: Imagine a rubbery, pus-filled bag lurching towards you. Now imagine it is travelling at twice its usual speed...

desc.zh: 敌人若算是明智，那么攻击这样一个身染重病的目标时定会三思而行，即便他们胜利了，他们也会染上恶心的怪病
desc.en: Sensible enemies think at least twice before attacking such a diseased specimen, for even if they win, chances are they have caught something really nasty along the way.

desc.zh: 祖父神创造了无数恐怖的造物，但他也深爱最小的孩子，这份爱可以说不减分毫
desc.en: Grandfather loves the smallest of his many children at least as much as his myriad other grim creations, if not more so.

desc.zh: 纳垢十分钟爱会飞的东西，因为这些东西经常可以用来传播纳垢最可怕的瘟疫
desc.en: The flying things are beloved of Nurgle, for they are, oft-times, the method of infection for his most potent, hideous infirmities.

desc.zh: 肮脏邪恶，无人能及，呵呵
desc.en: None more foul. None more black. Yuk.

desc.zh: 一种可怕的恶性疾病，就算死亡也不会成为解脱
desc.en: A poisonous malady so hideous, even death is no escape.

desc.zh: 溃烂最严重的伤口中渗出的腐蚀黏液是慈父那肮脏武库中最强力的武器
desc.en: The corrosive ooze emanating from the most ulcerous sores is one of the most effective weapons in the Urfather's foul armoury.

desc.zh: 多数生物呼吸的空气为纳垢和他的多种传染病提供了入侵渠道
desc.en: The air most creatures breathe provides just another avenue of attack for Nurgle and his many and varied contagions.

desc.zh: 苍蝇领主最青睐的仆人可以轻易抵御砍斫穿刺以及各种咒术
desc.en: Blade and point and spell can be turned aside very easily by the Fly Lord's most-favoured servants.

desc.zh: 肮脏恶臭的疾病向来不分贵贱，一视同仁：在纳垢的肮脏感染面前，所有人都难逃厄运
desc.en: Sulphurous, acerbic disease is no respecter of rank, nobility or prowess in battle; all shall fall afore Nurgle's filthy infections.

desc.zh: 混沌的仆从带来的是腐败，他们会加快周围环境扭曲腐化的速度
desc.en: With the servants of Chaos comes the corruption – as the landscape twists, this one speeds the transformation.

desc.zh: 被纳垢腐蚀的人聚集到他那腐臭的大旗下，希望能够按照祖父神的意愿重生
desc.en: Those corrupted by Nurgle's rot flock to his putrid banner in the hope that they will be reborn anew in Grandfather's image.

desc.zh: 『可怜虫啊！你们必须为我效劳，否则统统都得死，没有其他选择！』
desc.en: "You will serve me, wretch, or you will die, there is no other option."

desc.zh: 有生斯有死，而在此之前，疾病会带着恶心肮脏的荣耀降临此间
desc.en: Just as all life is born, so it must wither and die. Before that happens comes disease, in all its disgusting, filth-ridden glory.

desc.zh: 纳垢神轿乃是华丽的宝座，上面装饰着朽坏的华服和腐烂的坐垫
desc.en: The palanquins of Nurgle are ornate thrones decorated in mouldering finery and decaying cushions.

desc.zh: 巨大的恶魔昆虫，它的外貌是如此的丑陋，足以在心灵上刻下伤痕
desc.en: A colossal Daemon-insect, whose appearance is so repugnant it leaves festering scars upon the mind.

desc.zh: 纳垢神轿乃是华丽的宝座，上面装饰着朽坏的华服和腐烂的坐垫
desc.en: The palanquins of Nurgle are ornate thrones decorated in mouldering finery and decaying cushions.

desc.zh: 巨大的恶魔昆虫，它的外貌是如此的丑陋，足以在心灵上刻下伤痕
desc.en: A colossal Daemon-insect, whose appearance is so repugnant it leaves festering scars upon the mind.

desc.zh: 这些孬不拉虽然矮矮胖胖的，脑子又不灵光，但它们一直都睁着一只盯着天空的眼睛
desc.en: Stumpy and short-witted as they are, these Gnoblars have an eye on the sky at all times.

desc.zh: 即使是铁胃与噬人者这样凶猛的野兽，在领袖的麾下也会更卖力地战斗
desc.en: Even ferocious brutes like the Ironguts and Maneaters fight harder in the presence of a worthy leader.

desc.zh: 虽然他们的智力与体格一样可怜，但遇到大批的孬不拉还能一脸无所谓的，怕是只有傻子了吧！
desc.en: Though their intelligence is as pitiful as their physique, one would be a fool not to fear the Gnoblars when massed in numbers.

desc.zh: 食人魔的真正火力正如他们本身一样，又凶狠又粗糙
desc.en: The Ogres' true firepower is as destructive and indelicate as the Ogres themselves.

desc.zh: 这些山中的怪物虽然缺乏头脑，但他们顽强地拒绝着死亡，正可弥补这一点
desc.en: What the monstrous creatures of the mountains lack in guile, they more than make up for in their stubborn reluctance to die.

desc.zh: 有什么会比眼睁睁看着一头巨大的嗜血野兽直冲过来更为恐怖？那就是这头野兽背上还骑着一个同样巨大嗜血的家伙！
desc.en: If there's one thing more horrifying than being rushed by a hulking, bloodthirsty beast, it's being rushed by that same creature riding on the back of another equally hulking, bloodthirsty beast.

desc.zh: 当食人魔发动冲锋时，连大地都会理所当然地颤抖起来
desc.en: When an Ogre charges, the ground itself begins to quake. As it should.

desc.zh: 用沉重的弹丸攻击敌人实在是太有趣了，所以为何要停手呢？
desc.en: When pelting a helpless enemy with heavy projectiles is so much fun, why bother stopping?

desc.zh: 当可怕的蛮力与恐怖的速度结合起来时，弱小的敌人也就只有吓得瑟瑟发抖的份了
desc.en: When fearsome, brute strength is combined with terrifying speed, the petty weaklings among the enemy can only wet themselves in fear.

desc.zh: 在极度饥饿的驱使下，噬人者会直接对着倒下的敌人大快朵颐
desc.en: Driven by ravenous hunger, the Maneaters feast on the flesh of the fallen.

desc.zh: 最残忍，最邪恶的杀手会得到最丰厚的战利品
desc.en: To the most brutal, vicious killer go the richest spoils.

desc.zh: 有规律地食用腐烂而充满毒素的肉类，这是食人魔健康饮食的一部分
desc.en: Regular consumption of rotten meat and toxins are the staples of a healthy Ogre diet.

desc.zh: 只要有俘虏吃，长途行军就不会挨饿
desc.en: One can never go hungry on a long march for as long as there are captives for the meat-pot.

desc.zh: 当面临被碾压、被吃掉的威胁时，就再也没谁敢于抱怨了
desc.en: The grumblings of unrest tend to quiet when under threat of being crushed and eaten.

desc.zh: 即使是食人魔也有预先谋划的能力，特别是在涉及到珍贵的战利品时
desc.en: Even Ogres are capable of forward planning, especially when it comes to precious loot.

desc.zh: 透过血淋淋的迷雾，屠户看到了许多可怕的奇迹
desc.en: Through a bloody haze of visions, the Butcher sees a great many terrible wonders.

desc.zh: 每一支军队都需要一个『满肚子火』的战士。是的，就是字面上的意思
desc.en: Every army needs a warrior with a fire burning in their belly. Literally.

desc.zh: 灼热的剑刺穿肉体，仿佛撕裂潮湿的卷轴
desc.en: A sword of searing heat cuts through flesh as if tearing through a damp scroll.

desc.zh: 那些饱餐了火口岩浆的人，便驾驭了它燃烧愤怒的本质
desc.en: Those who have gorged upon the magma of the Fire Mouth harness the very essence of its burning rage.

desc.zh: 烧焦大地，点燃城市——火口将在地狱的火焰中攫取所有的一切
desc.en: Scorch the earth and set whole cities aflame – the Fire Mouth will claim all in the infernal blaze.

desc.zh: 即使是墙也不能保护你远离无法扑灭的火
desc.en: Even walls cannot protect you from a fire that cannot be quenched.

desc.zh: 最好的进攻就是最好的防守。而最好的防守方式就是喷出一道难以穿透的火墙
desc.en: The best offence is a good defence. And the best form of defence is to belch an impenetrable wall of flame.

desc.zh: 『流浪者，他们叫他流浪者——他到处流浪，到处流浪，到处流浪，到处流浪』
desc.en: "Da Wanderer, they call 'im da Wanderer – 'e roams around, around, around, around, around."

desc.zh: 作为屠户手下的奴才，这些孬不拉必须找到足够的肉来填满他的大锅，否则他们就得自个填进去
desc.en: As menial slaves to the Butcher's bidding, these Gnoblars must find him meat for the pot, or wind up in it themselves.

desc.zh: 在大胃神无尽的饥饿面前，微不足道的魔法根本不值一提
desc.en: Puny magicks are nothing in the face of the Great Maw's endless hunger.

desc.zh: 一小群孬不拉簇拥着这个食人魔领主，他们的剑随时准备着劈砍切割
desc.en: A small handful of Gnoblars surround this Ogre Lord, their swords always ready to cut and carve.

desc.zh: 随身带着你的幸运孬不拉也无妨，以防万一嘛
desc.en: It never hurts to keep your lucky Gnoblar with you, just in case.

desc.zh: 经营一个大型营地是一回事。运营一个有效的营地则完全是另一回事
desc.en: Running a large camp is one thing. Running an effective camp is another entirely.

desc.zh: 财富、贪婪和荣耀足以使任何简陋的战争营地膨胀开来
desc.en: Wealth, greed and glory are enough to make any basic war camp swell in size.

desc.zh: 最大的财富会吸引最强的战士，而很少有人能像格雷苏·大金牙那样富有
desc.en: The largest wealth draws the largest warriors, and few are so wealthy as Greasus Goldtooth.

desc.zh: 随着格雷苏的体型大到无比荒谬的地步，他的财富也会随之获得难以想象的增长
desc.en: Just as Greasus' form has grown to such absurd proportions, so does his unfathomable wealth.

desc.zh: 世界上没有哪座战争营地能与格雷苏·大金牙的营地相提并论
desc.en: There are no war camps in all the land to rival those of Greasus Goldtooth.

desc.zh: 格雷苏全副武装，由疲惫不堪的孬不拉奴隶驮着，这就是他的霸权的展示
desc.en: Carried by his weary Gnoblar slaves, Greasus is armed and armoured right to the teeth, and is the very picture of domination.

desc.zh: 第一步：给你的孬不拉上油！第二步：加快速度！
desc.en: Step 1: Grease up your Gnoblars! Step 2: Go faster!

desc.zh: 如果肉类和征服是你最深切的欲望，那么所有暴君中的暴君会很乐意提供它们
desc.en: If flesh and conquest are your deepest desire, the Tyrant of all Tyrants is happy to provide.

desc.zh: 你得看着他们，因为谁也说不准这些狡猾的孬不拉会搞出什么恶毒的计划
desc.en: You have to watch 'em, as there's no telling what malicious schemes those wickedly cunning Gnoblars might enact.

desc.zh: 曾几何时，当格雷苏要求其他部落向他进贡时，那些家伙全都笑得一塌糊涂。现在，他们该用另一边的脸来笑了，前提是那些傻瓜还有脸的话…
desc.en: Once the other tribes laughed when Greasus demanded they pay him tribute. The fools would be laughing on the other side of their faces, if indeed they still had faces…

desc.zh: 『你是个大家伙，但你的状况很糟糕。对我来说，这是一份全职工作——现在你要规矩点』
desc.en: "You're a big git, but you're in bad shape. For me, it's a full-time job – now behave yourself."

desc.zh: 更多的诱饵就意味着这个笨拙的大家伙有更多的机会直接击中他的晚餐
desc.en: More arrers means more chances for this big lumbering git to score a direct hit on his dinner.

desc.zh: 对于这些肥胖的生物来说，食人魔猎人有着惊人的速度
desc.en: For such corpulent creatures, Ogre Hunters are capable of truly surprising speed.

desc.zh: 每一支矛都拥有致命的矛尖，十数支长矛就能戳死那些无助的肉袋子
desc.en: Every spear culminates in a devastating point – all the better for skewering helpless meatbags by the dozen.

desc.zh: 训练有素的剑齿兽可以自由地漫步，在大地上徘徊，寻找下一顿毫无防备的美餐
desc.en: Well-trained Sabretusks can roam freely, prowling the land for their next unsuspecting meal.

desc.zh: 石角兽如同有生命的石山，喘息着的化石，一旦受到战争的召唤，它们就会变得既好斗又强悍
desc.en: Like a living boulder, Stonehorns are breathing fossils that are belligerent and mighty when roused to war.

desc.zh: 驯服凶猛的剑齿兽需要时间、技巧和大量的生肉
desc.en: To tame the ferocious Sabretusk requires time, skill and a whole lot of raw meat.

desc.zh: 不存在什么大到不能被打倒的野兽。骨头上的肉越多，盛宴的肉食就会越多！
desc.en: No beast is too big to be brought to its knees. More meat on its bones is simply more meat for the feast!

desc.zh: 这家伙很有块头，是的。事实上，你可能会说，这是因为他的肚子太饱了，但他确实很有信心支撑起自己的块头来
desc.en: This one has guts – quite literally. A surfeit of stomach in fact, you might say, but also the confidence to back up his bulk.

desc.zh: 在悲剧发生之前，人们通常会问：『如何与一群愤怒的剑齿兽战斗？』
desc.en: "How does one combat a pack of angry, charging Sabretusks?" is a question usually asked moments before tragedy.

desc.zh: 作为贪婪的食肉掠食者，剑齿兽一闻到血腥味就会陷入疯狂
desc.en: As ravening, carnivorous predators, Sabretusks are driven into frenzy by the first scent of blood.

desc.zh: 人们可能会认为一群凶残的掠食者很难不被发现，但这些剑齿兽最擅长的就是悄无声息地捕猎它们的猎物
desc.en: One might think a pack of vicious predators would be difficult to miss, yet these Sabretusks are adept at silently hunting their prey.

desc.zh: 消灭目标的最好办法，就是在他们注意到你之前狠狠砸碎他们的头骨
desc.en: The best way to eliminate a target is to violently crush their skull before they even notice you're there.

desc.zh: 『快跑，快跑！天哪，它们向我们冲上来了！』
desc.en: "Run! RUN! Oh gods, they're coming right at us!"

desc.zh: 当发射的炮弹有足够的力量刺穿一棵特别结实的树时，这种远程火力就很难躲避了
desc.en: It's hard to shelter from missile fire when projectiles are being launched with enough force to impale a particularly sturdy tree.

desc.zh: 当野兽大师说『跳』，他的宠物们在听到要跳多高之前只会原地待令
desc.en: When the beast master says jump, his pets only wait to hear how high.

desc.zh: 此人从不与人群一起奔跑，而是喜欢自己偷偷地走在前面，给敌人一个惊喜——作为一个食人魔，这并不一定是一件容易的事情啊！
desc.en: Never one to run with the crowd, this one likes to sneak about in front by themselves and surprise the foe – which isn't necessarily an easy thing to do when you're an Ogre!

desc.zh: 咆哮者的怒吼大而且沉，可以轻易横穿整个战场，从而鼓动起了人尽其能的屠杀
desc.en: A Bellower’s voice is as deep as it loud, carrying across the battlefield and encouraging unbridled carnage.

desc.zh: 食人魔成群结队地来到屠户的营地，渴望有机会目睹大胃神邪恶的力量
desc.en: Ogres flock to this Butcher's camp, eager for the chance to witness the Great Maw's malevolent power.

desc.zh: 当预兆指引你的道路时，财富就更容易到手了
desc.en: Wealth is much easier to come by when the omens are guiding your path.

desc.zh: 肉食、四肢、鲜血和骨头——全都进到肉锅里去！
desc.en: Flesh, limbs, blood and bone – it all goes into the meat-pot!

desc.zh: 大胃王的神秘力量甚至可以治愈最深的伤口
desc.en: The mysterious powers of the Great Maw can heal even the deepest of wounds.

desc.zh: 这个贪婪的食人魔领主仅仅是他的神的象征，而他的神的病态力量正统治着哀痛山脉
desc.en: This ravening Ogre Lord is but a mere symbol of his god, whose cancerous power reigns over the Mountains of Mourn.

desc.zh: 一旦屠杀开始，每一个敌人都是待斩之肉
desc.en: Once the slaughter begins, every foe is but meat yet to be carved.

desc.zh: 此人会随时将肉锅带在身边，作为咒语的储备之物
desc.en: Where this one goes, his meat-pot goes too, as a bounteous reserve for his spells.

desc.zh: 如果这个食人魔的庞大身躯不能吓到对方，那么他那血腥、恶毒的微笑肯定能办到这点
desc.en: If the enormous size of this Ogre doesn't incite terror, his bloody, malevolent smile surely will.

desc.zh: 这个食人魔的贪婪永远不会得到满足，因为他的胃和他的饥饿一样无穷无尽
desc.en: This Ogre's greed shall never be sated, for his stomach is as endless as his hunger.

desc.zh: 要固定如此臃肿的肚肠，你得需要一副真正的坚甲才行
desc.en: A truly sturdy armour is needed to hold such an overflowing gut in place.

desc.zh: 在狂暴的食人魔进攻中，没有一个敌人能够承受得住
desc.en: No enemy is immovable when in the path of a furious Ogre's charge.

desc.zh: 一旦幻象开始形成，斯卡拉格就会坚持不懈地追求它的道路
desc.en: Once a vision begins takes form, Skrag is relentless in pursuing its path.

desc.zh: 野兽只知道狂怒和盛怒
desc.en: The savage beast knows only rage and fury.

desc.zh: 斯卡拉格的力量使他能够不时地用少量的贡品来安抚大胃神
desc.en: Skrag's power allows him to appease the Maw with a smaller tribute from time to time.

desc.zh: 即使是最黑暗的腐蚀也逃不出大胃神的吞噬
desc.en: Not even the darkest corruption can escape the Maw's devouring influence.

desc.zh: 耗尽凡世与超凡的任何方法，都无法止息大胃神的永恒饥饿
desc.en: The Maw's eternal hunger can never be sated, by mortal means or otherwise.

desc.zh: 斯卡拉格熟悉山脚下的黑暗洞穴，就如同熟悉他那肿胀的、未洗过的手背一般
desc.en: Skrag knows the dark caverns under the mountains like the back of his bloated, unwashed hand.

desc.zh: 当屠灭者走上战场时，他所留下的只有飞溅的鲜血和散落的四肢
desc.en: When the Slaughterer goes on the battlefield, only the spray of blood and scattered limbs are left in his wake.

desc.zh: 折断四肢，砸碎头骨，这便是食人魔暴君一天的工作
desc.en: Snapping limbs and smashing skulls – it's all in a day's work for an Ogre Tyrant.

desc.zh: 『大胃神保护，大胃神吞噬；肉袋子躲在阴影里，瑟瑟发抖！』
desc.en: "The Great Maw protects and the Great Maw devours. Hiding in shadows, the meatbags cower!"

desc.zh: 这只暴君的体型相当于几个大型生物的合体。事实上，他昨天刚刚吃了那几只大型动物
desc.en: This Tyrant is the size of several large creatures rolled into one. In fact, he ate those several large creatures just yesterday.

desc.zh: 黄金的山脉和满溢的肉锅，势必会吸引最强壮的战士
desc.en: Mountains of gold and an overflowing meat-pot are bound to draw in the strongest of warriors.

desc.zh: 成为领导的第一条规则是，要比下一个自认为应该取代你位置的吹牛者更可怕
desc.en: Rule number one of being a leader is to be far more terrifying than the next braggard who thinks they ought to take your place.

desc.zh: 仅仅把军事上的失败强加给敌人是不够的，必须通过惩罚性的税收让他们屈服…除非他们宁愿被扔进肉锅里？
desc.en: It is not enough to impose military defeat upon the foe, they must be brought to their knees through punitive taxation… unless they'd rather get in the meat-pot instead?

desc.zh: 如果砍断四肢的震动还没整死你，那刀刃上的毒药肯定会办到的
desc.en: If the shock of your limbs being cleaved clean off doesn't kill you, the poison on the blade surely will.

desc.zh: 满溢的肉锅和偷来的敌人计划对营地的士气真的很有帮助
desc.en: A full meat-pot and stolen enemy plans really does wonders for camp morale.

desc.zh: 『别扭了，肉袋子，进锅里去吧！』
desc.en: "Stop yer wriggling, meatbag! Into the pot you go!"

desc.zh: 只有在鲜血淋漓之中，大胃神的传奇才能得到引导
desc.en: Only when bathed in blood and gore can the Gastromancy of the Great Maw be channelled.

desc.zh: 无论屠户走到哪里，他身后肯定会留下一串被肢解的肢体
desc.en: Wherever the Butcher goes, a trail of dismembered limbs is sure to be left behind him.

desc.zh: 屠宰大师按照大胃神的意愿发言，所有的信徒都得仔细倾听
desc.en: The Slaughtermaster speaks as the Great Maw wills, and all of the faithful listen well.

desc.zh: 『再给我拿些骨头来！这顿饭需要一点嘎吱嘎吱的声音！』
desc.en: "Fetch me more bones! This meal could use a little crunch!"

desc.zh: 从这个人的每一个毛孔里散发出来的恶臭，会使任何有鼻子和没有鼻子的动物都感到不快
desc.en: The reeking odour seeping from this one's every pore would offend any creature with a nose, and several without.

desc.zh: 『用毒药杀死生物，它就会渗入它们的皮肤——给那美味的肉调出额外的味道！』
desc.en: "Kill a creature with poison and it seeps into their skin – gives that yummy flesh an extra kick!"

desc.zh: 即使是最黑暗的腐蚀也逃不出大胃神的吞噬
desc.en: Not even the darkest corruption can escape the Maw's devouring influence.

desc.zh: 这种猖獗的屠杀最精彩的部分是随后的血腥盛宴
desc.en: The best part of such rampant slaughter is the gory feast that follows.

desc.zh: 为盛宴准备的肉食越多，就意味着斯卡拉格会为敌人准备越多惩戒性的魔法！
desc.en: More flesh for the feasting means more punishing magic for Skrag's foolish enemies!

desc.zh: 这个恶魔领主的猎物会看到敏捷的形体和锋利的刀刃，但那时已经是太迟了
desc.en: Swift flashes of an agile form and razor-sharp blades are all this Daemon Lord's victims see of him, but by then it's already far, far too late.

desc.zh: 此人扭曲的形体可以缓慢地抚摸和挑逗敌人，但在必要时也能如闪电般运动，当空击落弹丸或者将其掷回敌人
desc.en: This one’s writhing form can slowly caress and tease, but also move like lightning when required, knocking a projectile from the air or batting it back at the foe.

desc.zh: 神尊战车由色孽的战马拖拽，其上插满了斑斓的利刃与战镰
desc.en: Exalted Chariots are a blur of chromatic scythes and slicing blades pulled by Slaanesh's steeds.

desc.zh: 雄壮的战马拉着战车全速狂奔，征尘将空气镀上了一层邪恶的色彩
desc.en: Straining steeds urge the chariot to full speed, where swirling shapes sear the air with unholy hues.

desc.zh: 这些战马具有长而扭曲的身体，当它们冲向敌人时会不断地扭动
desc.en: Steeds have long, sinuous bodies that writhe ceaselessly as they dash towards the foe.

desc.zh: 神尊战车由色孽的战马拖拽，其上插满了斑斓的利刃与战镰
desc.en: Exalted Chariots are a blur of chromatic scythes and slicing blades pulled by Slaanesh's steeds.

desc.zh: 雄壮的战马拉着战车全速狂奔，征尘将空气镀上了一层邪恶的色彩
desc.en: Straining steeds urge the chariot to full speed, where swirling shapes sear the air with unholy hues.

desc.zh: 这些战马具有长而扭曲的身体，当它们冲向敌人时会不断地扭动
desc.en: Steeds have long, sinuous bodies that writhe ceaselessly as they dash towards the foe.

desc.zh: 敌人被一种令人昏昏欲睡的香水淹没，无论周围多么喧嚣吵闹，也是于事无补
desc.en: The enemy are overtaken by a somniferous perfume that induces sleep in spite of the din raging all about them.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 对谋杀的痴迷只是一种廉价、无意识、最卑劣的杀戮欲望。对于色孽的仆人们来说，生命的意义远不止于此，当然，死亡也是如此
desc.en: This obsession with murder is just cheap, mindless bloodlust of the basest kind. To the servants of Slaanesh, there's so much more to life… and to death too, of course.

desc.zh: 神尊战车由色孽的战马拖拽，其上插满了斑斓的利刃与战镰
desc.en: Exalted Chariots are a blur of chromatic scythes and slicing blades pulled by Slaanesh's steeds.

desc.zh: 这些战马具有长而扭曲的身体，当它们冲向敌人时会不断地扭动
desc.en: Steeds have long, sinuous bodies that writhe ceaselessly as they dash towards the foe.

desc.zh: 当你会说他们的语言时，说服意志薄弱的凡人屈服于他们最基本的欲望，并将他们的灵魂献给色孽，毫不奇怪，是一件非常容易的事情
desc.en: When you can speak their language, convincing weak-willed mortals to give in to their base desires and gift their souls to Slaanesh is, unsurprisingly, quite an easy thing to do.

desc.zh: 即使是色孽之子也会被激发出更深的堕落。
desc.en: Even the Children of Slaanesh can be inspired to ever greater depths of depravity.

desc.zh: 色孽的战士们不会浪费时间去追捕他们的猎物，因为杀戮带来的狂喜既令人兴奋，也令人上瘾
desc.en: The warriors of Slaanesh waste no time in hunting down their victims, for the heady delight of the kill is as addictive as it is exhilarating.

desc.zh: 寻觅者骑在他们强大的色孽兽背上，在战场上疾驰而过，以毁灭性的精准击杀敌人
desc.en: Atop their powerful beasts of Slaanesh, the Seekers dart across the field of battle, cutting through their foes with devastating precision.

desc.zh: 除了被沉重的、血迹斑斑的车轮碾压，人们几乎没有办法阻止一辆带刃战车的前进
desc.en: There's little to do against the advance of a bladed chariot but to be ground beneath its heavy, bloodstained wheels.

desc.zh: 黑暗亲王的爪牙们以他的名义进行疯狂的屠杀。受害者的绝望对他们的主人来说不过是一顿美味的盛宴
desc.en: The minions of the Dark Prince carry out frenzied slaughter in his name. Their victims' abject despair is but a delicious feast for their master.

desc.zh: 快乐和痛苦乃是锋利刀刃的两面，最伟大的色孽仆人则会热切地探究这两个极端
desc.en: Pleasure and pain sit on either side of a fine-edged blade, and the greatest of Slaanesh's servants delve eagerly into both extremes.

desc.zh: 对享乐主义的无休止追求甚至会使最堕落的生物进一步堕落
desc.en: The endless pursuit of hedonistic delights further corrupts even the most depraved of creatures.

desc.zh: 真正的战场老兵散发出狂喜的成就光环，令他们的下仆的感官迟钝了起来
desc.en: The true veterans of battle exude an aura of rapturous fulfilment, dulling the senses of their lessers.

desc.zh: 是爱人的吻，还是刀锋的吻？颓废的狂信徒会让你两者都想要！
desc.en: The kiss of a lover, or the kiss of a blade – the decadence's Devotees will have you begging for both!

desc.zh: 当一个人能拖住你最疯狂的幻想，扭曲你最黑暗的恐惧时，它的力量会无所止境
desc.en: There is no end to the power a being holds once it can tug at your wildest fantasies and twist your darkest fears.

desc.zh: 混沌的仆从带来的是腐败，他们会加快周围环境扭曲腐化的速度
desc.en: With the servants of Chaos comes the corruption – as the landscape twists, this one speeds the transformation.

desc.zh: 完美亲王有多少信徒都不嫌多。无论他们是自愿来找他，还是被迫来敬拜他，对色孽来说都无关紧要
desc.en: The Perfect Prince can never have too many Devotees. It matters not one jot to Slaanesh whether they come to him willingly or are coerced into His worship.

desc.zh: 欢愉亲王在所有人的耳边窃窃私语，怂恿着他们每一个越轨的欲望
desc.en: The Prince of Pleasure whispers in the ears of all, pulling at the threads of their every deviant desire.

desc.zh: 在心甘情愿地为色孽服务后，它们已经既不需要胡萝卜也不需要大棒便会为他而战，虽然任何一种力量都无疑很令人愉快！
desc.en: Having given itself willingly to the service of Slaanesh, this force requires neither the carrot nor the stick to fight for Him though either one would no doubt be pleasurable!

desc.zh: 纳卡里拥有柔软、弯曲的形体，其中充满了不受控制的力量：当诱惑失败时，他就会发动无人能够抵御的欢愉屠杀
desc.en: For such a lithe, sinuous form as N'Kari, simply brimming with unchecked power – where seduction fails, gleeful murder poses no challenge.

desc.zh: 受到狂暴混沌愤怒影响的人，无不屈服于野性、不洁、放纵的诱惑
desc.en: Even those influenced by violent Chaotic rage may succumb to the allure of wild, impure, licentious abandon.

desc.zh: 『愚蠢的伪君子！相比它们的傲慢，这些精灵的自负会让他们超乎想象地靠近色孽』
desc.en: "Foolish hypocrites! The arrogant pride of these Elves brings them far closer to Slaanesh than their egos would have them believe."

desc.zh: 对于纳卡里和其他勇敢的色孽信徒来说，他的诱惑确实没有界限…
desc.en: For N'Kari, and other intrepid disciples of Slaanesh, His temptations truly know no bounds...

desc.zh: 在严酷的尼赫喀拉炙烤下，战士们的骸骨因葬仪祭团的意志驱使而长存。通过单调精准的仪式，他们嗡嗡诵念的咒语注入了不屈的韧性
desc.en: Scorched by unforgiving Nehekhara, warriors’ bones endure by the will of the Mortuary Cult. Through monotonous precision, their droning incantations infuse resilience.

desc.zh: 在人类纪元伊始，复仇与魔法女神阿萨芙及其信徒们皆以象征性的角蝮之形显现
desc.en: At the cusp of the age of man, Asaph – the Goddess of Vengeance and Magic – took on the symbolic form of an asp, as did her acolytes.

desc.zh: 数世纪的血腥战争里，无数敌人撞碎在尼赫喀拉坚不可摧、镶满宝石的颅骨盾墙上——这份意志在亡灵化后反而愈加刚硬
desc.en: Centuries of bloody warfare have seen countless enemies pulped against Nehekhara's unwavering, bejewelled skull-shields – a will that has only ossified in Undeath.

desc.zh: 奢华狰狞的死亡面具下，枯槁面容永恒沉眠——这些存在始终屹立于前线，为其愤懑的君主提供不朽侍奉，此乃无上荣光
desc.en: Beneath a death mask's facade of glowering luxury slumbers a desiccated visage, grimly honoured on the frontlines in eternal servitude to its embittered monarch.

desc.zh: 凡涉足死者领域的仪式，诵咒必须精益求精，因这等行为已僭越乌西里安神应得之权柄
desc.en: In ceremonies that touch upon the Realm of the Dead, incantations must be meticulously intoned, for they encroach upon Usirian’s rightful due.

desc.zh: 太阳神的召唤炽烈灼人，将伟大国度重焕荣光的幻象烙印在目眩神迷的信徒眼中——正如佩特拉所命定的那样
desc.en: Blistering in their intensity, invocations of the Sun God sear blinding visions of the Great Land's restored splendour – just as Ptra ordained.

desc.zh: 荒凉如陵城连绵的全景，痛苦似圣甲虫钻入喉中——这便是这些信徒所行的法术
desc.en: Bleak as a panorama of necropoli. Painful as a Khepra beetle down your throat. Such is the sorcery of these disciples.

desc.zh: 阴影是存在与虚无之间的过渡领域，亦是喀穆里眼镜蛇形态的昆·阿法神的隐秘栖息地
desc.en: Shadows are the liminal tracts between presence and absence – the clandestine habitat of Qu'aph in the hooded form of a Khemrian cobra.

desc.zh: 流沙之间的黎明，由沙粒剐蹭着甲胄的声响，以及长眠战士苏醒的喃喃低语所宣告
desc.en: Among the shifting dunes, dawn is heralded by the scrape of sand against the panoply of war, and the murmur of long-buried warriors.

desc.zh: 只要挥一挥手，射向这个查尔仆人的炮弹就会从尖锐的弹丸变成柔软、完全无害的土块
desc.en: With just a wave of the hand, projectiles fired at this servant of Tchar are turned from sharp and pointy to soft and entirely harmless.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 或许是苍蝇领主那明显的漠视激怒了奸奇？无论是何原因，伟大游戏最强大的参与者和他最强大的仆从们有了倾泻怒火的目标
desc.en: Perhaps it is the Fly Lord's apparent nonchalance that enrages Tzeentch so? Whatever the reason, the Great Game's greatest player, and his greatest servant, have an adversary on which to focus their ire.

desc.zh: 浴焰战车如炽热的流星般穿过魔域，带着奸奇的使者杀向敌人
desc.en: Hurtling across the realms like incandescent meteors, Burning Chariots bring Tzeentch's emissaries to the foe.

desc.zh: 作为捆绑仪式的一部分，尖啸飞鲨的身体被压得扁平，并转化成了几乎不可能存在的相貌
desc.en: As part of the binding ritual, Screamer bodies are flattened and transmuted into unlikely aspects.

desc.zh: 『燃烧得如此明亮，燃烧得如此美妙…你不能死两次，真是太可惜了！』
desc.en: "Burn so bright, burn so nice, it's a crying shame you can't die twice!"

desc.zh: 『现在，再来一次…但要做得更好』
desc.en: "Now do it again... but better."

desc.zh: 最平凡的灰线可以孕育最强大的潜能
desc.en: The meanest streaks give rise to the greatest potential.

desc.zh: 浴焰战车如炽热的流星般穿过魔域，带着奸奇的使者杀向敌人
desc.en: Hurtling across the realms like incandescent meteors, Burning Chariots bring Tzeentch's emissaries to the foe.

desc.zh: 作为捆绑仪式的一部分，尖啸飞鲨的身体被压得扁平，并转化成了几乎不可能存在的相貌
desc.en: As part of the binding ritual, Screamer bodies are flattened and transmuted into unlikely aspects.

desc.zh: 要么篡变，要么死亡
desc.en: Choose change, or choose death.

desc.zh: 为了免遭报复，恶作剧最好大家一起参与
desc.en: To deter retribution, tomfoolery is best indulged in as a group.

desc.zh: 『别搞得太复杂，蠢货！』
desc.en: "Keep it simple, stupid!"

desc.zh: 浴焰战车如炽热的流星般穿过魔域，带着奸奇的使者杀向敌人
desc.en: Hurtling across the realms like incandescent meteors, Burning Chariots bring Tzeentch's emissaries to the foe.
