desc.zh: 作为捆绑仪式的一部分，尖啸飞鲨的身体被压得扁平，并转化成了几乎不可能存在的相貌
desc.en: As part of the binding ritual, Screamer bodies are flattened and transmuted into unlikely aspects.

desc.zh: 出其不意就可以把握一半的战局。而另一半则在于疯狂之人脸上那纯粹的惊恐之情
desc.en: Surprise is half the battle. The other half is pure, unadulterated terror in the face of certain madness.

desc.zh: 对敌人实施巧变之后，嘲弄守望接下来将如何呢？答案是继续巧变，因为只有不断变化才能带来最甜美的欢愉
desc.en: Having effected Change upon one's enemies, what next for the Mocking Watcher? More of the same, naturally, for to do so over and over again brings the sweetest of raptures.

desc.zh: 谁来买单？这还有疑问吗，当然是织命者的对手了，用他们的思维和灵魂来买
desc.en: Who pays the piper? Why, Fateweaver's opponents, of course, with their minds and souls as coins of currency.

desc.zh: 若如卡洛斯，尽知汝可知，则无不知矣
desc.en: When you know all there is to know, as does Kairos, nothing is beyond the reach of your grasp.

desc.zh: 若是不能清晰透彻地思考，定是难以抗拒暗中蔓延的毁灭
desc.en: Those who cannot think clearly and lucidly are unable to resist the insidious creep of Ruin.

desc.zh: 对于一个能预见到即将发生的事情的人来说，战斗的发展完全尽在掌控
desc.en: Battle unfolds rather predictably for one who sees that which is yet to happen.

desc.zh: 每一个可能的未来都闪耀着魔法与篡变的光芒
desc.en: Every possible future blazes with the light of sorcery and change.

desc.zh: 预见未来，就是要知道哪些工具能最有效地实现奸奇变幻无常的想法
desc.en: To see the future is to know which tools can most efficiently enforce the fickle whims of Tzeentch.

desc.zh: 了解未来，就是明白凡人与命运的搏斗不过徒劳而已
desc.en: To know the future is to understand the true futility in mortal flailings against fate.

desc.zh: 『我今天便可以告知你的失败，但你的未来已经到来。所以让我们一起迎接它吧，你与我』
desc.en: "I could tell you of your defeat this day, but your future has already arrived. So let us meet it together, you and I."

desc.zh: 无尽的过往汇聚于此，强敌皆于此湮灭，皆在取悦奸奇九乘九的未来
desc.en: Infinite pasts lead to this point, where the foe is destroyed utterly in service of futures pleasing Tzeentch numbering nine times nine.

desc.zh: 『自创生中，孕育毁灭』
desc.en: "From creation, beget destruction."

desc.zh: 『在未知的当下，沉思』
desc.en: "In the unknowable now, ruminate."

desc.zh: 『自潜能中，孕育篡变』
desc.en: "From potential, beget change."

desc.zh: 虽对当下视而不见，卡洛斯却能窥探未来，早早开始编织法术，将无数力量碎片层层叠加，只为等待那恰如其分的时机
desc.en: Though blind to the present, Kairos can look into the future and begin weaving spells far in advance, layering multitudinous slivers of power for just the right moment.

desc.zh: 织命者或许可以好好利用魔法之风，因为他早已直到了自己所有行动的结局
desc.en: Fateweaver may harness the Winds of Magic to his best advantage, for he already knows all the possible outcomes of his actions.

desc.zh: 不可阻挡的魔术师可以将魔法之风吸引到自己身边，并以超乎同行的精准技艺绑定它
desc.en: The unstoppable magician can draw the Winds to him and bind them for protection more easily than other practitioners of the craft.

desc.zh: 黑暗之力赐予追随者的所有礼物中，最令人向往的当属奸奇的恩典
desc.en: Of all the gifts bestowed by the Dark Powers upon their followers, the boons of Tzeentch are surely the most desirable.

desc.zh: 卡洛斯的书记员忠实地记录下了他口中说出的每一则恶毒之语，这些话都成为了现实，这一切都是由恶魔惧妖来实现的
desc.en: Kairos' scribes faithfully record every baleful whisper that passes his lips, that they be made real, in the form of the Daemonic Horrors that do his bidding.

desc.zh: 虽然侍奉万变之主的人都有额外的防护能力，可以抵御攻击，但其中有一些人则与众不同，能更快地将其恢复至最大效能
desc.en: Though all who serve the Changer are gifted with additional protection from attack, some can restore it to maximum effectiveness faster than others.

desc.zh: 奸奇谕者是一名法师，他有极强的力量，可以操纵低阶施法者并且阻碍他们的计划
desc.en: The Oracle of Tzeentch is a magic-user of such power that he operates outside of the forces that constrain lesser spellcasters and hamper their designs.

desc.zh: 拥有必要魔法技能的人或许会进一步强化这种法术
desc.en: Enchantments such as these may be strengthened further by those with the requisite magical skill.

desc.zh: 虽然他们看起来可笑至极，但大阴谋者的这些接连不断的尖啸步兵是他那长满羽毛的铁拳中紧握的利器
desc.en: Though they may appear ridiculous, the whirling, screeching footsoldiers of the Great Conspirator are the iron in his feathered martial glove.

desc.zh: 虽然他们没有通过奸之主的试炼，但这些精神破碎、身体不断变异的低级仆从仍有其用处
desc.en: Although it can be said that they have failed His tests, the broken minds and fluctuating, mutated bodies of Tzeeneth's lesser minions still have their uses.

desc.zh: 奸奇手下的燃火仆从最不怕的就是人多，他们会涌向敌人，成为他们的末日使者
desc.en: Unburdened by mass, Tzeentch's flaming servants surge toward the foe – the heralds of their utter doom, no less.

desc.zh: 混沌战马和战车那雷鸣般的声音预示着卡多尔恐惧骑士的到来，他们身后紧跟着的就是死亡
desc.en: The thundering of their Chaos Steeds and chariots announces the arrival of Kaldour's dread Knights, and death is never far behind them.

desc.zh: 对于世上的双翼守望者和末日进击者来说，他们没有实体形态，这反而是他们对抗攻击的最好护甲
desc.en: For the Winged Watchers and Doomstriders of this world, their very lack of identifiable corporeal form shall be their armour against attack.

desc.zh: 即便是最勇敢最理性的人，在面对梦魇中那狞笑的脸庞时也会产生动摇
desc.en: Even the bravest, most rational souls waver in the hideous, laughing face of their worst nightmares.

desc.zh: 查尔的诸多武器之中，最强大而又让他心满意足的还是要数精神扰乱术
desc.en: Of the many weapons available to Tchar, derangement must surely be the greatest and most satsifying to wield.

desc.zh: 万变之主最纯净的仆从当属这些闪烁的火焰生物，因为他们的缥缈形态永远处于流动之中
desc.en: The flickering beings of flame are in many ways the purest servants of the Changer, for their gaseous forms are ever in a state of flux.

desc.zh: 进攻是最好的防守，而最好的进攻则是侵入敌人的头脑中，用敌人头脑中的思维来对抗他们
desc.en: The best form of defence is attack, and the best form of attack is the one which reaches into the foe's mind and turns its contents against them.

desc.zh: 混沌的仆从带来的是腐败，他们会加快周围环境扭曲腐化的速度
desc.en: With the servants of Chaos comes the corruption - as the landscape twists, this one speeds the transformation.

desc.zh: 风之主有许多副面孔，与之相随的则是命运中最可怕的谜团。在此之间，则有疯狂潜伏于其中，等待着粗心之人步入陷阱之中
desc.en: The many faces of the Wind-lord are described here, along with all the terrible mysteries of destiny. Between these lines lurks insanity, ever waiting to trap the unwary.

desc.zh: 风之主有许多副面孔，与之相随的则是命运中最可怕的谜团。在此之间，则有疯狂潜伏于其中，等待着粗心之人步入陷阱之中
desc.en: The many faces of the Wind-lord are described here, along with all the terrible mysteries of destiny. Between these lines lurks insanity, ever waiting to trap the unwary.

desc.zh: 奸奇深知，所有生物内心之中都渴望变易，如此一来，他那多彩的大旗之下就不缺志愿前来投靠的大军
desc.en: Tzeentch knows that at their cores all beings desire Change, and as such there are no shortage of recruits willing to march under his many-coloured banner.

desc.zh: 所谓变易之诺，虽然最后很可能只是残酷的把戏而已，但是足以保证奸之主的大军不断扩张增长
desc.en: The promise of Change, though it may amount to nothing more than the cruellest of tricks, ensures the forces of Tzeeneth are fed and nourished.

desc.zh: 作为最熟练、最专注的法师，此人所至之处，魔风总会刮得又高又猛
desc.en: As they are a most adept and dedicated magic-user, where this one treads, the Winds always blow high and hard.

desc.zh: 整个世界都是篡变火堆上的燃料
desc.en: All the world is fuel for the pyre of Change.

desc.zh: 如此强大的万变魔君只需出现，便可令较弱的恶魔力量倍增
desc.en: The mere presence of such a mighty Lord of Change girds lesser Daemons tenfold.

desc.zh: 不断变化的天空只是奸奇伟大魔域的另一部分
desc.en: The ever-shifting sky is but another part of Tzeentch's great domain.

desc.zh: 这个古怪生物的突发奇想令魔法之风咆哮不已，单凭它便可以驾驭混沌！
desc.en: The Winds roil and buck at the whims of this eldritch creature, it alone can direct the Chaos!

desc.zh: 若是不加限制，那么法术便可以化为原始的毁灭力量
desc.en: Without the concern of limitations, spells can be turned into raw obliterative power.

desc.zh: 『等到战斗结束后，就可以很明显地发现，那些人所说的恶魔不过是个遥远的、更为可怕的敌人的幻象…』
desc.en: "It was clear after the battle that the fiend the men had spoken of was but an image of a distant and more terrible foe…"

desc.zh: 没有任何凡人可以挡住他们
desc.en: No mortal host shall hold them back.

desc.zh: 死人们在混沌荒原中并不会安息永眠，而哈利正好也在全世界就不缺让其宣泄怒火的敌手
desc.en: The dead may rest uneasily in the Chaos Wastes, yet Harry has no shortage of foes across the world upon which to vent his anger.

desc.zh: 『除非你是我，否则走错了路就是自寻死路！』
desc.en: "One bad road can kill a man – unless you're me."

desc.zh: 『死亡，毁灭，我们对此毫无悔意！』
desc.en: "We show no remorse for the deeds of death and destruction!"

desc.zh: 『没有生命的东西，活过来了！\n居然还妄想着什么报仇！\n那就用死亡来解脱他们吧！』
desc.en: "A lifeless object, alive!\nAwaiting Reprisal!\nDeath will be their acquittance!"

desc.zh: 『他们既然死了，就该彻底死透！』
desc.en: "They're infected with death, they know they have to die."

desc.zh: 『烈焰会锻出真正的神砧！\n宁愿折断，绝不弯曲！』
desc.en: "Never break it, it will never bend!\nThe Anvil was forged in fire!"

desc.zh: 『世界末日已近…\n末日审判已来…\n…以杀戮机器的形状！』
desc.en: "This world has come undone\nArmageddon has arrived...\n...in the shape of a killing machine!"

desc.zh: 恐兰克驱策血肉猎犬们追杀忤逆血神的敌人，疯狂咆哮着享受狩猎的荣耀
desc.en: Chasing down those who have drawn the Blood God's ire, Karanak drives his fellow Flesh Hounds to snarling madness in glory of the hunt.

desc.zh: 恐兰克的杀戮如水银泻地般完美，可以迅速满足他的饥饿和主人对鲜血的渴求
desc.en: Karanak's kills are quicksilver perfection, the better to swiftly feed his hunger and his master's need for spilt blood.

desc.zh: 恐虐神选猎犬拥有极为强悍的生命力，这样，它就可以用更为强大的力量投入狩猎与最终的猎杀
desc.en: The unrelenting vitality of Khorne’s chosen Hound affords him even greater strength for the hunt and the final moment of violence.

desc.zh: 恐兰克时刻不停地啃噬着惨遭屠杀的猎物与颅座上丢弃的骨头，这将它的所有下颚都磨练得极其壮硕
desc.en: An eternity of grinding down bones of slaughtered prey and discarded from the Skull Throne has tempered each of Karanak’s jaws.

desc.zh: 恐兰克最为骇人的那颗头颅可以追随思想狩猎猎物，通过梦境和幻觉猎杀他们
desc.en: The most nightmarish of Karanak's heads tracks his quarry through its own thoughts, pursuing them through dreamscapes and delusions.

desc.zh: 恐兰克可以追踪着血腥味穿越时空，这样，战场上的任何角落都无法逃过恐虐神选猎手的魔爪
desc.en: Karanak tracks the blood scent across space and time, until the battlefield offers no hiding place from Khorne’s chosen hunter.

desc.zh: 恐兰克的三只鼻子嗅探着猎物的栖息，每只鼻子负责一部分的气味，一旦锁定目标，便会持续追踪直至世界尽头
desc.en: Karanak’s three snouts sniff the air for traces of his prey, each savouring a portion of the scent and following it to the ends of the earth.

desc.zh: 作为恐虐神选猎手，冷酷无情、毫无怜悯、为血神复仇到底的狂热意志，这些都必须毫无疑问，绝不动摇
desc.en: To become Khorne’s chosen hunter takes ruthlessness, implacability, and the zeal to serve the Blood God’s vengeful whims unquestionably.

desc.zh: 对新鲜红肉的渴望并非来自于食欲，而是来自吞食敌人血肉的那份邪恶快意
desc.en: The need for fresh red meat is not driven by hunger for sustenance, but the unholy exhilaration of consuming an enemy’s flesh.

desc.zh: 恐兰克最为无情的那颗头颅可以沿着气味穿越时空，一直追溯到万物诞生的那一刻，或者径直前进直至宇宙的尽头
desc.en: The most unyielding of Karanak's heads can follow a scent through time; back to the moment of the creation of everything, or forward to the end of the universe.

desc.zh: 随着恐兰克的魔爪撕碎无数的猎物，虚空中会回荡起它野兽般的嚎叫，从而吸引其他血肉猎犬来到他的身前
desc.en: As leagues untold fall away beneath his clawed feet, Karanak’s bestial howls echo through the void, drawing other Flesh Hounds to his presence.

desc.zh: 这头顶级恶魔掠食者身先士卒，率领着可怕的猎群疯狂前扑，身后满是满口流涎的族类
desc.en: At the fore of his dreaded pack the Daemonic apex predator stalks his prey, his slavering kin following cautiously in his stead.

desc.zh: 恐兰克猎群的嚎叫早已成为了厄运的可怕前兆，其恶名已经响彻数千王国与界域
desc.en: Across a thousand kingdoms and realms beyond, the bestial chorus of Karanak’s hunt has long since become the harbinger of dire fates.

desc.zh: 恐兰克最为贪婪的那颗头颅会跟随猎物穿越物理现实，踏破平原、森林、山脉，甚至各种难以描述的奇怪地域
desc.en: The most ravenous of Karanak's heads follows his victims through physical reality, tracking them over plains, forests, mountains and environments too bizarre to describe.

desc.zh: 黑暗亲王的纵欲侍从乃是血神眼中最为眼中的侮辱，他们也就成了恐虐神选猎手最为珍贵的战利品
desc.en: None offer greater insult to the Blood God's colossal pride than the Dark Prince's hedonistic acolytes, making them the prized trophies of Khorne's chosen hunter.

desc.zh: 这些混沌战马身披重甲，狂怒不息，因而愈发致命
desc.en: The already-fierce Chaos Steeds are often covered in heavy armour, making them even deadlier.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 术士们无不对蝎尾狮赞不绝口：作为魔法生物，其残忍丝毫不在骑手之下
desc.en: Manticores are highly prized by Sorcerers, for they are creatures bathed in magic and as cruel as their riders.

desc.zh: 邪月低垂天际，其邪恶崇拜者莫不俯首于前
desc.en: The weird, evil moon hangs low in the sky, drawing reverence from its abominable worshippers.

desc.zh: 这一法术会召唤出潜伏地下的爬虫，令大群的蜘蛛、蜈蚣与食肉甲虫吞没敌军
desc.en: This spell calls to the creeping things of the undergrowth, sending a swarm of spiders, centipedes and slug-beetles onto the foe.

desc.zh: 混沌向他们微笑，令其能够以超自然的诡谲力量抵挡凡人的攻击
desc.en: Chaos smiles upon them, granting unnatural and heretical defence against mortal machinations.

desc.zh: 若是有人身强体壮，足以驯服残暴的剃刀兽，便可将其套上战车，奔赴战场
desc.en: Those strong enough to tame the powerful, unruly Razorgors can harness them to chariots.

desc.zh: 若是有人身强体壮，足以驯服残暴的剃刀兽，便可将其套上战车，奔赴战场
desc.en: Those strong enough to tame the powerful, unruly Razorgors can harness them to chariots.

desc.zh: 若是有人身强体壮，足以驯服残暴的剃刀兽，便可将其套上战车，奔赴战场
desc.en: Those strong enough to tame the powerful, unruly Razorgors can harness them for chariots.

desc.zh: 若是有人身强体壮，足以驯服残暴的剃刀兽，便可将其套上战车，奔赴战场
desc.en: Those strong enough to tame the powerful, unruly Razorgors can harness them for chariots.

desc.zh: 一旦闯入战团，他们就会撕挠挥砍，掀起一股致命的旋风
desc.en: Hurling themselves into battle, a whirlwind of appendages and weapons strike, unexpected and deadly.

desc.zh: 他就是懂。没人懂，但他就是懂。是的，他永远都懂
desc.en: He knows. Nobody knows how, but he does. He has always just known.

desc.zh: 若是有人身强体壮，足以驯服残暴的剃刀兽，便可将其套上战车，奔赴战场
desc.en: Those strong enough to tame the powerful, unruly Razorgors can harness them for chariots.

desc.zh: 战兽群严阵以待，让敌人尽管来攻。自然本质便是它们的屏障，敌人很快便会认识到这点
desc.en: The warherd waits, allowing the enemy to come to them. Nature is their defence, as man will soon find out.

desc.zh: 战兽群严阵以待，让敌人尽管来攻。自然本质便是它们的屏障，敌人很快便会认识到这点
desc.en: The warherd waits, allowing the enemy to come to them. Nature is their defence, as man will soon find out.

desc.zh: 战兽群冲锋在前，血盆大口中发出狂暴的战吼。此等怒涛之下，又有何人能够幸免？
desc.en: The warherd charges out, slathering jaws and bellowing in fury. Against the charge, none can stand.

desc.zh: 战兽群冲锋在前，血盆大口中发出狂暴的战吼。此等怒涛之下，又有何人能够幸免？
desc.en: The warherd charges out, slathering jaws and bellowing in fury. Against the charge, none can stand.

desc.zh: 强悍的领袖可令整个战兽群团结如一供其驱策，并因此获益良多
desc.en: A strong leader can bend the will of the warherd to his own, and reap the benefits of it.

name.en: The Best of the Beast II

desc.zh: 强悍的领袖可令整个战兽群团结如一供其驱策，并因此获益良多
desc.en: A strong leader can bend the will of the warherd to his own, and reap the benefits of it.

desc.zh: 兽群庞大而难于驾驭，但总有事物可以将其联系起来：战斗！战斗！还是战斗！
desc.en: The warherd, though vast and hard to control, can be relied on to fight, fight, fight!

desc.zh: 兽群庞大而难于驾驭，但总有事物可以将其联系起来：战斗！战斗！还是战斗！
desc.en: The warherd, though vast and hard to control, can be relied on to fight, fight, fight!

desc.zh: 嗜血的本性是无可抑制的，无论猎物还是亲族，都没有什么不同
desc.en: The unquenchable thirst for blood is indiscriminate; prey and kin alike are fair game.

desc.zh: 披挂毛发，沾满碎屑，这些家伙的外皮上裹着厚厚的一层硬质肿瘤
desc.en: Fur-clad, matted with offal and detritus, their weathered hides are a foul carapace.

desc.zh: 野兽人的獠牙上总是零碎不断，挂满了战斗遗留的敌方鲜血与肌肉
desc.en: The Beastman's tusks are drenched in gore - blood and sinew from every foul battle.

desc.zh: 尖啸的战吼便是一声信号，宣告着此地即将展开一场屠杀
desc.en: The howl of battle is the signal, a promise that butchery will be done.

desc.zh: 若是有人身强体壮，足以驯服残暴的剃刀兽，便可将其套上战车，奔赴战场
desc.en: Those strong enough to tame the powerful, unruly Razorgors can harness them for chariots.

desc.zh: 此人立于战兽群前方，以长鞭撩起部下的狂暴本性，然后将其驱向敌军
desc.en: At the head of the warherd, he whips his followers into a frothing furore, then unleashes them upon the enemy.

desc.zh: 在变幻莫测的迷梦之中，此人看到了终末的景象：世界彻底崩溃，留下的唯有尘埃与碎片
desc.en: In fitful dreams, he sees the end. The world collapsing in on itself, leaving nothing but ashes and aberration.

desc.zh: 生鲜腐臭的血肉味道会令其他人畏缩不前，但对战兽群来说，血肉正是美味可口的大餐
desc.en: The stench of raw, rotten meat causes others to balk, but the warherd revels in the flesh and brawn.

desc.zh: 卡扎克通晓自然，了解世界。他眼观六路，耳听八方，任何人类都不会比他更强
desc.en: Khazrak knows nature, he knows the world. He sees, knows and is prepared. Mankind cannot best Khazrak.

desc.zh: 野兽人全心侍奉着他们的黑暗与毁灭之神，而诸神也保佑着他们的一举一动
desc.en: Unknowingly, the Beastmen serve their dark and Ruinous Gods, who in turn bless their every action.

desc.zh: 『我们感觉到了，我们都感觉到了！那是战争的召唤，战火的牵引，杀戮的渴望！』
desc.en: "We feel it. We all feel it. The pull to war. The tug of battle. The NEED to kill."

desc.zh: 混沌的仆从带来的是腐败，他们会加快周围环境扭曲腐化的速度
desc.en: With the servants of Chaos comes the corruption - as the landscape twists, this one speeds the transformation.

desc.zh: 这位毁灭之力的忠实奴仆有着任何凡人都无法估量的惊人韧性
desc.en: This willing servant of the Ruinous Powers has a resilience that is beyond any mortal measure.

desc.zh: 以异教诸神的名义，他们的喉咙嘶嘶作响，大兴杀伐之事
desc.en: They bray beneath the weird, green moon, and do their perverse, grim butchery in the name of the heretical Gods.

desc.zh: 霸者为尊，强者为王！血腥的胜利才能使人服从！
desc.en: Lordship to the mighty! Power to the strong! Obedience is earned through bloody victory!

desc.zh: 胆敢直面战兽群的愚者，必将在垂涎血口与疯狂杀戮中见证比死亡更为悲惨的命运
desc.en: For those who face the warherd, a fate worse than death awaits their salivating jaws and unremitting bloodlust.

desc.zh: 身为混沌异变的产物，野兽人便是那可怕未来的化身
desc.en: Brought into this world by the cataclysm of Chaos, Beastmen are the very image of a dread future.

desc.zh: 就算没有欢宴，野兽人也会舔舐唇上的血迹，闻嗅皮毛上的腥臭，并期待着下一场的狂欢
desc.en: Even when not feasting, the Beastmen taste blood on their lips, smell it on their fur, and want for more.

desc.zh: 大地在颤抖，土壤在震动，就连世间众灵也惊惧不已：野兽人降临了！
desc.en: The ground shakes. The earth moves. The spirit trembles. The Beastman comes.

desc.zh: 战兽群集则必有盛宴，万兽皆于此啸聚狂欢
desc.en: When the warherd gathers, there is much feasting, debauchery, and revelling in mania and depravity.

desc.zh: 很少有野兽人能记得它们究竟为何而怒，这个种族只知头脑单纯地追逐自己的宿敌
desc.en: The Beastman's fury stretches back before most can remember - they pursue their hatred with single-minded zeal.

desc.zh: 魔法的恶臭非常刺鼻，所以没有任何法师可以在遭遇战兽群时全身而退
desc.en: The stench of magic is palpable. No mage can stand in the midst of battle against the baying warherds.

desc.zh: 人类的世界必将毁于兽王之手，每座辉煌的城市都将化为瓦砾，消灭殆尽
desc.en: The world of man will fall at the Beastlord's hand, with every glittering city reduced to rubble and despair.

desc.zh: 绿色凶星高悬天际，其信众必将疯狂杀敌
desc.en: The great green orb hangs ominously in the sky above, its followers driven to acts of madness and depravity.

desc.zh: 当整个兽群咆哮不止时，野兽们会迸发出惊人的力量，以此警告敌人：死亡将至！
desc.en: With a base howl, the beast radiates strength and power, a warning to his enemies that death is coming.

desc.zh: 这股肆虐的狂暴可谓与生俱来：这不是自然选择的结果，而是深入骨髓的纯粹野性
desc.en: The desire to wreak havoc is innate, brought about not by choice but by sheer force of being.

desc.zh: 能与战兽群之主共同进退者，在自身处于逆境时也会得到相应的庇护
desc.en: He who locks horns with this master of the warherd does so at his own peril.

desc.zh: 任何野兽都不可能完全听从指令，但这一鞭子至少能够带来最低限度的…顺从
desc.en: No beast can truly be controlled, but these desperate contrivances bring the smallest semblance of order.

desc.zh: 这面磨损扭曲的岩石上所刻画的，正是暴烈的狂热与嗜血的渴望
desc.en: Carved into this battered and dishevelled stone is the mark of violent rage and sanguine desire.

desc.zh: 鼻息沉重、皮毛血染、躯体泥泞、肤色猩红：野兽人可谓万般恐怖的化身
desc.en: A snorting, hulking mass of blood-matted, mud-encrusted, sanguine-soaked fur - the Beastman is a terror to all.

desc.zh: 『血即荣耀！血即荣耀！！血即荣耀！！！』
desc.en: "The blood is the prize. The blood is the prize! THE BLOOD IS THE PRIZE!"

desc.zh: 毁灭之力会为他的忠仆带来很多礼物，比如…突变的肉体与扭曲的意志
desc.en: The Ruinous Powers grant many gifts to their obedient servants; mutant disfigurements of flesh and might.

desc.zh: 战争的呼唤足以驱使兽群发动暴烈的冲锋，追逐荣耀或是血腥的死亡
desc.en: A summons to war in which all are drawn into the cacophonous charge; glory or sanguine death is the prize.

desc.zh: 食物、饮水与杀戮，有多少都不够！不够！
desc.en: It is never enough. The food, the drink, the slaughter. It is never, ever enough.

desc.zh: 无尽的战斗与惨烈的暴行，这些便是野兽人的生存意义
desc.en: The Beastman delights in constant fighting; in vicious, ceaseless brutality. It gives him purpose.

desc.zh: 喧嚣吵嚷的野兽人只知道心中的那团兽性怒火，因此最好的办法就是让这团火烧旺成地狱的烈焰
desc.en: The clamouring Beastmen know only the fire of bestial rage in their hearts. It is best to stoke that fire into an inferno.

desc.zh: 毁灭者们为何要在意凡人法师的小把戏？只是因为他们不愿自己的奴隶受到琐碎幻觉的影响而已
desc.en: What do the Ruinous Ones care for the trifling tricks of mortal conjurers? They will not suffer their thralls to be afflicted by paltry delusions.

desc.zh: 野兽人不抓俘虏：如果他们要展现仁慈，那为何会手持战争利器？不！杀啊！
desc.en: The Beastmen do not take prisoners; why would they be given weapons of war if they were meant to show mercy? No! Kill!

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 经过训练后，帝国狮鹫可以载人冲上战场。此时它们不仅是冷静的杀手，也对它的骑手极为忠诚
desc.en: Once trained to carry a man in battle, Imperial griffons are poised killers and incredibly dedicated to their riders.

desc.zh: 帝国飞马是高贵的带翼马，既聪明又忠诚
desc.en: An Imperial pegasus is a noble, winged steed, intelligent and loyal.

desc.zh: 法师很少穿着护甲，而战马则能为他们提供一定程度的防护和速度
desc.en: While Wizards can rarely benefit from armour, a warhorse does offer some degree of protection and manoeuvrability.

desc.zh: 『此人在咆哮声中出现，随后一群噩梦般的战獒纷纷盯住了我』
desc.en: "With a roar, it pointed, and a pack of nightmare dog-beasts turned their feral attention towards me."

desc.zh: 『随着他们一起滚落尘埃，打碎他们的脑袋，吃掉他们的心脏！』
desc.en: "Into the mud with them, break their skulls and eat their hearts!"

desc.zh: 『魔古尔回归了！魔古尔散播诸神的腐蚀！许多人会死，但万物皆当拜服于毁灭，全部！』
desc.en: “Morghur returns. Morghur spread Gods’ corruption. Many die but all fall to Ruin. ALL!”

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the caster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤野性的精灵，为友军的脆弱外表披上一层坚硬的皮肤
desc.en: Calling upon the beast spirits of the wild, the caster sheathes vulnerable flesh in unyielding fur and hide.

desc.zh: 法师吹响扭曲的号角，召唤出一支灼热的琥珀长矛，并以难以置信的精度将其向敌人投去
desc.en: Sounding a gnarled horn, the caster summons a glowing amber spear and hurls it at the foe with uncanny accuracy.

desc.zh: 充满灵体的云雾将覆盖敌军，无形的利爪狠狠掐住敌人的咽喉
desc.en: Nebulous nature spirits assail the foe, clawing at them with hands not nearly as insubstantial as they appear.

desc.zh: 卡堂是一位变形术大师，他能把自己的形体变成任何他想要的形状。这次，他的魔法被用来召唤一头蝎尾狮，仿佛卡堂亲自在为你战斗
desc.en: Kadon, a master of forms, was able to shift his shape into anything he chose. This mastery is used to summon a Manticore, as if Kadon himself fights for you.

desc.zh: 施法者鼓动狂野的魔力，从而引导它那远古而蛮荒的力量
desc.en: The spellcaster attunes the magic of the wild, channelling its ancient and arcane power.

desc.zh: 施法者释放出内心深处的野性，用狂怒将友军变换成野兽的形态
desc.en: The spellcaster unleashes the beast within, using its fury to transform allies into bestial forms.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满释放出自己渴望撕碎敌人的欲望，驱策兽群咆哮前行
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman inflames the uncontrollable urge to rend the foe limb from limb, causing the roaring, bellowing mass to surge forward.

desc.zh: 这一法术会释放出狂暴的战吼，炸裂敌人的脑壳，扯烂他们的眼睛
desc.en: This spell unleashes a howling roar of such intensity that it mashes brains and bursts eyeballs.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满会纵情放大敌方心灵中蛮荒兽性的部分，直至他们变成哀鸣不已的野兽为止
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman magnifies the savage and animalistic parts of the foe's psyche until they are no more than growling beasts.

desc.zh: 戈洛克是个传奇的牛头怪，此人性情烈如暴风。对于穿戴者来说，他的灵魂披风实在是个可怕而危险的物品
desc.en: Ghorok was a legendary Minotaur, ferocious as a storm. His spirit-mantle is terrible and dangerous to the bearer.

desc.zh: 这位嘶叫萨满让自己支配狂野的意志，占据其能找到的最大生物，然后展开暴烈的复仇
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman sends his mind into the wilds, possessing the largest creature he can find and storming back with a vengeance.

desc.zh: 以炽热的怒火直刺敌方坐骑的心脏，让它们转而对抗自己的主人
desc.en: A red-hot spear of wrath is driven into enemy mounts' wild hearts, causing them to turn upon their riders.

desc.zh: 筑巢于朽烂灌木丛中的爬行玩意们会彻底淹没敌人：这是一片真正的虫潮
desc.en: A vile wave indeed, the creeping things that nest in the decaying undergrowth swarm all over the foe.

desc.zh: 『随着他们一起滚落尘埃，打碎他们的脑袋，吃掉他们的心脏！』
desc.en: "Into the mud with them, break their skulls and eat their hearts!"

desc.zh: 单单是马拉戈的现身，便足以令人类惊惧不已。这等贱民，只有在鸦父面前瑟瑟发抖的份！
desc.en: Malagor's very presence strikes fear into the heart of men - they tremble at the sight of the Crowfather approaching.

desc.zh: 马拉戈会将来自混沌诸神的恩赐转赠属下，以便实现主人的宏伟计划
desc.en: Gifted by the Chaos Gods themselves, Malagor distributes this gift to his followers, that his masters may see their agenda realised.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 这一祭坛上方雕刻着一匹高贵的巨大狮鹫，它身负盖尔·玛拉兹——西格玛的战锤，人类帝国统一与伟力的象征
desc.en: The altar prominently features a noble griffon bearing Ghal Maraz, Sigmar’s hammer and the emblem of Imperial unity and strength.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 训练锻造出了优秀的战士。当战斗变为如同呼吸一般的本能时，他们便臻于完美的境界了
desc.en: Practice makes the perfect warrior; when battle is instinctive as drawing breath, exalted status is achieved.

desc.zh: 战争的正义性，以及手中的神兵，都在给予此人无尽的祝福
desc.en: Blessings upon the just war, and the tools with which it is fought.

desc.zh: 战前的疯狂冥想，会让此人的思绪更为专注于暴烈、血腥的『手头事务』上
desc.en: A frenzied beating before battle focuses the mind on the brutal, bloody task at hand.

desc.zh: 对于牺牲一切，虔诚敬神的人来说，哪怕能够获得一点庇佑，那也是他们无上的荣耀
desc.en: Those who have sacrificed all to do the gods’ work enjoy more than a modicum of their protection.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 对于西格玛的仆人来说，那些选择了异端道路的人必将难逃死亡的结局
desc.en: He who chooses the vile path of heresy can expect no mercy from the agents of Sigmar.

desc.zh: 『以彗星的名义，这是我的法旨！』
desc.en: "By the comet, that is my decree!"

desc.zh: 研习异端学说的学徒，黑暗的基础萌发了更为黑暗的邪恶道路
desc.en: The student thrives on heretical knowledge; dark foundations lead to darker, binding deliverance.

desc.zh: 『生而侍奉，抑或死而为奴！』
desc.en: "Surrender and serve me in life, or die and slave for me in death."

desc.zh: 虽然最初只是想在死亡旅途中与兄弟们结伴而行，但赫尔曼·苟斯特现在已登上了一辆运尸车的顶端，而拉车的正是他的亡灵同胞
desc.en: Initially desiring simply to join his brothers in death, Helman Ghorst now travels atop a Corpse Cart driven by his Undead kin.

desc.zh: 苟斯特的噩梦战车上脉冲着强大的能量波，它会削弱亡灵的力量，鞭挞活人的灵魂
desc.en: From atop Ghorst's nightmarish chariot pulse waves of puissant energy, enervating the undead and excoriating the souls of the living.

desc.zh: 赫尔曼·苟斯特所懂得的都是些禁忌的知识，但仅仅『懂得』是不够的：他必须善加利用这些负面力量
desc.en: Helman Ghorst knows what he should not, but knowing is not enough – he must utilise this denied knowledge.

desc.zh: 纵使赫尔曼·苟斯特战败，他也定会复苏：世上没有任何力量可以阻止他！
desc.en: What Helman Ghorst has lost, he will reclaim – no power of this world or beyond will stop him.

desc.zh: 极其恐怖的马车，充满了黑暗与邪恶的力量，驱使着亡灵们去达成更加伟大，更为惊骇的使命
desc.en: Devilish chariots imbued with dark and eldritch power, driving the Undead to greater, more macabre acts.

desc.zh: 邪魅的火盆中跃动着阴惨的火焰，沾满魔力的次元石碎片不断向着空中飘散开去
desc.en: Infernal flames belch from dismal braziers, permeating the air with fragments of magic-confounding Warpstone.

desc.zh: 当磁石丧钟敲响之时，黑魔法将悄然四散，遍及战场
desc.en: When the lodestone bell rings, Dark Magic exudes and ripples across the battlefield.

desc.zh: 这头蝙蝠是如此的巨大，简直堪比一头龙！它可以轻松地将人抓离地面，或是一击便将战马打晕！
desc.en: Deadly giant bats the size of dragons, capable of plucking men from the field and stunning warhorses into paralysis.

desc.zh: 弗拉德乘着一股强大而阴暗的积尸气踏上战场，其速度之快，远超常人想象
desc.en: Vlad is borne to battle by powerful, dark effluvia, moving with a speed beyond mortal perception.

desc.zh: 弗拉德会将自己邪恶的不朽之力赐予亲信，从而让自己的影响能够荣光永存
desc.en: Vlad shares his aberrant immortality with those he trusts, ensuring his legacy endures eternally.

desc.zh: 冯·卡斯坦因一族的领主会发散出令人丧魂落魄的气息，令当面之人不由自主地僵立一旁
desc.en: The Lord of the von Carsteins exudes a distracting and sensational air, giving all before him pause.

desc.zh: 极其恐怖的马车，充满了黑暗与邪恶的力量，驱使着亡灵们去达成更加伟大，更为惊骇的使命
desc.en: Devilish chariots imbued with dark and eldritch power, driving the Undead to greater, more macabre acts.

desc.zh: 邪魅的火盆中跃动着阴惨的火焰，沾满魔力的次元石碎片不断向着空中飘散开去
desc.en: Infernal flames belch from dismal braziers, permeating the air with fragments of magic-confounding Warpstone.

desc.zh: 当磁石丧钟敲响之时，黑魔法将悄然四散，遍及战场
desc.en: When the lodestone bell rings, dark magic exudes and ripples across the battlefield.

desc.zh: 毁灭便是混沌的本质；万事诸人，均难逃其掌握。如许繁华，如彼倾颓，唯有毁灭永存于世
desc.en: Ruin is the very essence of Chaos; ruin of everything natural, and everyone. Glorious, savage, ruin forever!

desc.zh: 魔古尔的毁灭之力聚集成了变形的光环，可以保护其免受大部分的伤害。但在光环冷却时，魔古尔会相当脆弱
desc.en: Morghur's Ruinous, transformative aura protects him from damage most of the time, but he is vulnerable whilst it recharges.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 帝国飞马是高贵的带翼马，既聪明又忠诚
desc.en: An Imperial pegasus is a noble, winged steed, intelligent and loyal.

desc.zh: 法师很少穿着护甲，而战马则能为他们提供一定程度的防护和速度
desc.en: While Wizards can rarely benefit from armour, a warhorse does offer some degree of protection and manoeuvrability.
