desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 帝国飞马是高贵的带翼马，既聪明又忠诚
desc.en: An Imperial pegasus is a noble, winged steed, intelligent and loyal.

desc.zh: 法师很少穿着护甲，而战马则能为他们提供一定程度的防护和速度
desc.en: While Wizards can rarely benefit from armour, a warhorse does offer some degree of protection and manoeuvrability.

desc.zh: 为法师女王所宠爱者，其战姿会如女王亲手加持般绚丽
desc.en: Those whom the Mage Queen has favoured fight as if powered by her hand.

desc.zh: 『森林不会原谅；森林不会遗忘。你们终将零落为泥，滋润树根，一切不过殊途同归而已…』
desc.en: “The forest does not forgive; the forest does not forget. You will all feed its roots in the end, one way or another…”

desc.zh: 『你明白吗？你的本质绝非现在的样子，绝非一堆白骨与肉体的加和！你便是一切，决定我们的一切！』
desc.en: “Do you understand? You are more than you were – more than just flesh and bone; you are everything that defines us."

desc.zh: 战场首矢，贯日如虹
desc.en: The first arrow of battle must fly truest.

desc.zh: 纵使最为简单的法术，也能起到去旧换新，重唤精力，弥合伤口的作用
desc.en: Even the simplest of spells can bring forth the full bloom of renewal, reinvigorating and healing the broken and bleeding.

desc.zh: 森林已存活了上千年，拥有着超凡的记忆。当得到战争召唤时，它们将释放出压抑数世纪之久的狂怒
desc.en: Trees live for thousands of years and have very long memories. When called to fight, centuries of pent-up wrath are unleashed.

desc.zh: 森林已存活了上千年，拥有着超凡的记忆。当得到战争召唤时，它们将释放出压抑数世纪之久的狂怒
desc.en: Trees live for thousands of years and have very long memories. When called to fight, centuries of pent-up wrath are unleashed.

desc.zh: 森林已存活了上千年，拥有着超凡的记忆。当得到战争召唤时，它们将释放出压抑数世纪之久的狂怒
desc.en: Trees live for thousands of years and have very long memories. When called to fight, centuries of pent-up wrath are unleashed.

desc.zh: 法师从土地中召唤出治愈性的能量，以来自大地的自然痊愈之力庇护战士们
desc.en: The Wizard draws wholesome energies from the soil, imbuing companions with the natural resilience of the earth.

desc.zh: 法师从土地中召唤出治愈性的能量，以来自大地的自然痊愈之力庇护战士们
desc.en: The Wizard draws wholesome energies from the soil, imbuing companions with the natural resilience of the earth.

desc.zh: 这一法术可以暂时将友军的血肉之躯转换成刀枪不入的岩石皮肤，从而大大增强其抵御攻击的能力
desc.en: This spell temporarily transforms allies' mortal flesh into unbreakable rock, increasing tenfold their resistance to attack.

desc.zh: 法师呼唤着杜仁铎之名，以超乎寻常的速度治愈盟友的伤势
desc.en: By speaking Druthandor's name the Wizard is able to heal allies' injuries much faster than by natural means.

desc.zh: 多刺的荆棘从施法者盟友周围的地表喷涌而出，形成一道尖刺拱卫的鲜活护盾
desc.en: Prickly gorse bursts from the ground around the caster's allies, protecting them from attack like a spiky, living shield.

desc.zh: 多刺的荆棘从施法者盟友周围的地表喷涌而出，形成一道尖刺拱卫的鲜活护盾
desc.en: Prickly gorse bursts from the ground around the caster's allies, protecting them from attack like a spiky, living shield.

desc.zh: 这一法术会从地面召唤出粗糙而扭曲的树枝，紧紧罩住敌人并使其窒息而亡
desc.en: This spell causes gnarled, fibrous hands to emerge from beneath the ground, dragging the foe to a claustrophobic, suffocating end.

desc.zh: 此法术一旦释放便会麻痹敌人的意志，令其被来自现实的沉痛压力击倒在地
desc.en: When cast, this spell enfeebles enemy minds; they feel the crushing weight of reality bearing down upon them.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵足以麻痹敌军的迷乱之雾，令其变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵足以麻痹敌军的迷乱之雾，令其变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵足以麻痹敌军的迷乱之雾，令其变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵足以麻痹敌军的迷乱之雾，令其变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.

desc.zh: 超自然的神力总是最好的选择：武器在施法者的盟友面前凭空出现，使他们能够剁碎肉体，劈斩灵魂，甚至剥夺意识
desc.en: The supernatural solution is often the best; weapons materialise before the caster's allies, allowing them to slice through flesh, soul, and consciousness.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽灵般的钟摆。随着一声令下，它将急速摇摆起来并穿越敌方阵势，锋利的刀刃足以切肉断骨
desc.en: A spectral pendulum is summoned by the Wizard. On command, it swings, razor sharp and with lethal speed, through the foe.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽灵般的钟摆。随着一声令下，它将急速摇摆起来并穿越敌方阵势，锋利的刀刃足以切肉断骨
desc.en: A spectral pendulum is summoned by the Wizard. On command, it swings, razor sharp and with lethal speed, through the foe.

desc.zh: 施法者开启一个通往地狱深渊的漩涡，它将永久地吞噬一切卷入其中之物
desc.en: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.

desc.zh: 法术祈唤出的阴影如同真实阴影一样地模糊：阴影法师正是这种『欺骗』艺术的大师
desc.en: A conjured shadow is just as obfuscating as a real one - the Shadow Wizard is master or mistress of the 'concealing' arts.

desc.zh: 法师使用怀疑与危机感侵蚀敌人的思维，从内心深处击垮敌军
desc.en: The Wizard destroys their enemies from within, corroding foes' minds with doubt and crisis.

desc.zh: 法师使用怀疑与危机感侵蚀敌人的思维，从内心深处击垮敌军
desc.en: The Wizard destroys their enemies from within, corroding foes' minds with doubt and crisis.

desc.zh: 梦魇兽通常戴着沉重的头饰或身披厚重的锁子甲
desc.en: Nightmares are often clad in heavy barding or wear caparisons of thick chainmail.

desc.zh: 地狱战马十分凶猛。涉猎束缚野兽知识的吸血鬼很高兴能让这些野兽服从他们的意志
desc.en: Hellsteeds are vicious. Vampires that dabble in the binding of beasts delight in breaking these wild creatures to their will.

desc.zh: 最让人印象深刻的梦魇兽是用鲜血作为饲料的。这种高贵的巨兽是理想的坐骑
desc.en: The most impressive Nightmares are those reared on fresh blood. Such noble monstrosities are worthy mounts.

desc.zh: 『过来，我最亲爱的飞马。让我们在空中翱翔，共同缔造新的世界吧！』
desc.en: "To me, my winged steed of bone and flesh; let us fly and remake the world together!"

desc.zh: 吸血鬼领主前往骸骨平原，并让一头僵尸龙成为了坐骑
desc.en: It is to the Plain of Bones that a Vampire Lord travels to claim a Zombie Dragon as their mount.

desc.zh: 树妖的肢体蛮力十足，没有任何遮蔽或护甲能够阻挡它的滔天怒火
desc.en: No hide nor armour can stand against the piercing fury of a Dryad or Tree Kin's savage limbs.

desc.zh: 林中之木化为树人，他们能顽强地抵御攻击，正如森林抵御季节的愤怒一样
desc.en: Hewn from the same forest that surrounds them, Tree Kin withstand attacks like the forest withstands the fury of the seasons.

desc.zh: 这名领主的军队会为艾索洛伦奋战不息，因为他们的灵魂已与森林的命运紧密相连
desc.en: The Lord's troops are charged to fight for Athel Loren, for their very souls are tethered to its fate.

desc.zh: 让敌人感受自然的愤怒吧！当这些战士冲垮敌人的阵线时，他们便是自然之怒的化身！
desc.en: Let the enemy feel the fury of nature, embodied in these warriors as they crash through their lines.

desc.zh: 这一护甲如同森林的远古硬皮般坚韧。那些能够轻易撕碎他人的攻击，却可以被它轻松挡开
desc.en: Armour as hard as the ancient bark of the forest, it repels blows that would rend others asunder.

desc.zh: 整个艾索洛伦都在咆哮着绵长久远的愤怒，敌人无不知晓它的力量
desc.en: All of Athel Loren shouts with a fury as old as the ages, and the enemy knows its power.

desc.zh: 勇士们奋斗不息，如摆动的树枝般强力，极少有人能够抵御如此强悍的攻击
desc.en: The warrior strikes with the strength of a swinging tree limb; few can stand against such strength.

desc.zh: 领主成为了森林的化身。因此，战士们感受到了更为强烈的守护呼唤
desc.en: The Lord embodies the forest; as a result of this, their warriors feel a greater call to defend it.

desc.zh: 这名领主的军队会为艾索洛伦奋战不息，因为他们的灵魂已与森林的命运紧密相连
desc.en: The Lord charges their troops to fight for Athel Loren, for their very souls are tethered to its fate.

desc.zh: 无箭之人，怎可称为游侠？箭矢不足者，又怎可称为神射手？
desc.en: What is a ranger without an arrow? Who can be the best without dozens?

desc.zh: 阿斯莱迅步疾行，虽然已在树梢间穿行了数个世纪，但却从未有一步的踏空
desc.en: The Asrai are fleet of foot, with centuries of darting from branch to branch, and never a missed step.

desc.zh: 游侠理应对敌人毫无怜悯之心。利箭一旦出弦，必应迅若奔流，利如霹雳
desc.en: A ranger should give no reprieve to the foe. Arrows must fall like a deluge, as deadly as lightning.

desc.zh: 就让库诺斯的力量汇聚到每道闪电之上，为他的敌人带去死亡吧！
desc.en: Let each bolt be imbued with the strength of Kurnous, and bring death to all his enemies.

desc.zh: 领主扫视着敌人，以库诺斯的魂灵与意志加持着他的军队。敌人的毁灭，已是近在眼前
desc.en: The Lord sets their eye upon the foe, imbuing their troops with Kurnous' spirit and the will to see his enemies destroyed.

desc.zh: 这一领主能够在超乎常理的遥远距离上发现敌人，他的麾下将士也会纷纷效仿这一能力
desc.en: This Lord can spot an enemy at a distance that defies belief, and demands their troops do the same.

desc.zh: 迷踪客能够在超乎常理的遥远距离发现敌人，他们的军队也会纷纷效仿这一能力
desc.en: Waystalkers’ keen eyes can spot an enemy at a distance that defies belief, and so they demand the same of their troops.

desc.zh: 神母庇佑着森林的儿女，以空灵的魔毯保护着他们免遭敌人的伤害
desc.en: The Mother protects her forest-dwelling children, wrapping them in an ethereal blanket, hardening them against their foes.

desc.zh: 战火一旦在林中打响，巨树们便会亲身加入战斗，从各个方向猛击敌军
desc.en: When at war under the canopy it is like the trees themselves join the fray, striking from all directions.

desc.zh: 森林的怒火非常暴烈，当勇士们奉库诺斯之命大开杀戒时，这一点会淋漓尽致地展现出来
desc.en: The forest has a great rage, which is manifest in its warriors' violent deeds in Kurnous' name.

desc.zh: 他们来自森林中的每个角落，誓死捍卫自己的家园
desc.en: From all corners of the forest, they come to defend their homes.

desc.zh: 为了击溃威胁到艾索洛伦的敌人，森林的子民们将不惜进行长途的跋涉
desc.en: The denizens of the forest will travel many miles to see those who would threaten Athel Loren put to rout.

desc.zh: 世界根须庇佑着森林之子，它们会净化污染此地的任何腐蚀
desc.en: The Worldroots provide succour for their children, purging the forests of any corrupting infestation.

desc.zh: 森林庇护着它的战士，愈合着他们在守护森林时受到的创伤
desc.en: The forest provides for its warriors, rehabilitating and regenerating wounds suffered in its defence.

desc.zh: 如同森林自身一样，艾索洛伦的战士们也在时间流逝中经历着新陈代谢的过程
desc.en: Like the forest itself, the warriors of Athel Loren ebb and flow and regenerate with the passing of time.

desc.zh: 这些战士们经年累月地在枝杈与树篷间悄无声息地穿梭，这赋予了他们对抗敌人的强大优势
desc.en: Eons spent darting between branches and canopies unseen has given these warriors the advantage over their foes.

desc.zh: 艾索洛伦拥有很多优秀儿女，他们各自在不同的领域上奋勇向前，从而获得了各种秉异的资质
desc.en: Athel Loren provides for its deserving children, with wondrous boons gifted in recognition of their many endeavours.

desc.zh: 森林的魔力虚无缥缈，却能够让敌人的利刃偏离目标
desc.en: The magics of the woods obscure and connive, able to turn enemy blades away from their targets.

desc.zh: 在库诺斯神力的加持下，森林住民们能够获得更加强大的战斗力
desc.en: The forest-dwellers draw from the strength of Kurnous to fight ever harder, and be ever stronger.

desc.zh: 死者自然不再需要有形之物，然而生者却须将遗物利而用之
desc.en: The dead do not want for material possessions, yet the living may yet find value in them…

desc.zh: 无止的战意催生了加宽处理的箭壶，它能让射手射出几乎无穷无尽的漫天箭雨
desc.en: Always willing to fight on, a widened quiver allows arrows to rain, almost without end.

desc.zh: 这位领主得到了艾索洛伦的庇护，整座深林便是他的盾牌
desc.en: Using the forest itself as a shield, this Lord is protected by their devotion to Athel Loren.

desc.zh: 敌所未见，则必不可中；敌所未见，则必不得生
desc.en: What the enemy cannot see, it cannot hit. What the enemy cannot see, it cannot survive.

desc.zh: 立于战场之上，奉森林之名厮杀，实为至高之震撼
desc.en: There is no greater thrill than to be in the midst of battle, slaughtering in the forest's name.

desc.zh: 射击，隐蔽；射击，再隐蔽；再射击，再隐蔽。这便是射手的心得
desc.en: Nook and fire. Nook again, and fire. Nook a third time, and fire. All in a heartbeat.

desc.zh: 领主自森林中感悟着缕缕心绪，因此获得了战无不胜的伟力
desc.en: Taking their cue from the forest itself, the Lord endures and overcomes all.

desc.zh: 攻击、格挡、闪避之法，即是艾索洛伦子民们必须领悟的奥义
desc.en: When to strike, when to block, when to dodge. These are all skills the warriors of Athel Loren must perfect.

desc.zh: 森林教会了战士们对射击时机与射击部位的掌握，这令他们变得卓尔不群
desc.en: The forest teaches a warrior not only when to fire but where, which makes a bigger difference.

desc.zh: 箭矢飞得越远，就能越快击杀敌军。对于猎人来说，这是至关重要的准则
desc.en: When the arrow flies farther, it may kill sooner, which is vital in the Hunt.

desc.zh: 你当然可以召唤嗜血的狩猎之神来协助你，但请千万记得在事后感谢她的援助…
desc.en: By all means summon the bloodthirsty Goddess of the Hunt to assist you, but always make sure you thank her afterwards…

desc.zh: 精灵猎手无不效仿着狩猎之神库诺斯，因此他们锻炼出了无可匹敌的速度与灵敏
desc.en: Elven hunters emulate Kurnous, the God of the Hunt. Their speed and swiftness is therefore without peer.

desc.zh: 骑手与坐骑的羁绊远远超出了友谊或家人的范畴：他们早已合而为一
desc.en: The bond between rider and steed goes beyond friendship or family; they act as one.

desc.zh: 骑手与坐骑的羁绊远远超出了友谊或家人的范畴：他们早已合而为一
desc.en: The bond between rider and steed goes beyond friendship or family; they act as one.

desc.zh: 这只龙来自旧世界密林的深处，它并不会喷吐火焰，而是会吐出剧毒而致命的龙息
desc.en: Hailing from deep within the forests of the Old World, this dragon breathes deadly, poisonous fumes instead of fire.

desc.zh: 这只龙来自旧世界密林的深处，它并不会喷吐火焰，而是会吐出剧毒而致命的龙息
desc.en: Hailing from deep within the forests of the Old World, this dragon breathes deadly, poisonous fumes instead of fire.

desc.zh: 振翅鹰翔，拥抱旭日；追逐敌手，一击毙命
desc.en: Fly on your wings, like an eagle. Touch the sun. Track the foe, ambush, and defeat.

desc.zh: 振翅鹰翔，拥抱旭日；追逐敌手，一击毙命
desc.en: Fly on your wings, like an eagle. Touch the sun. Track the foe, ambush, and defeat.

desc.zh: 创世神庇佑着狩猎大师，令他的箭矢射得更远，射得更准
desc.en: The Creator blesses the Master of the Hunt, ensuring his shots always fly far and true.

desc.zh: 自然响应着奥莱恩的呼唤，对胆敢侵犯艾索洛伦的敌人泼下漫天箭雨
desc.en: Nature manifests at Orion's call, raining a flurry of arrows upon the enemy in defence of Athel Loren.

desc.zh: 奥莱恩的战狼时刻伴随在他的左右，以汹涌的怒火奋不顾身地保护着主人的安危
desc.en: Orion's wolves run with their Lord, defending his person with great savagery and scant regard for their own lives.

desc.zh: 骑手与坐骑的羁绊远远超出了友谊或家人的范畴：他们早已合而为一
desc.en: The bond between rider and steed goes beyond friendship or family; they act as one.

desc.zh: 振翅鹰翔，拥抱旭日；追逐敌手，一击毙命
desc.en: Fly on your wings, like an eagle. Touch the sun. Track the foe, ambush, and defeat.

desc.zh: 这只高贵驮兽的前额上带有一支螺旋犄角，它能迅捷地将施法者带至最需要他施展法力的地方
desc.en: Its forehead adorned with a spiral horn, this noble mount carries the Spellsinger where their magical gifts are needed most.

desc.zh: 骑手与坐骑的羁绊远远超出了友谊或家人的范畴：他们早已合而为一
desc.en: The bond between rider and steed goes beyond friendship or family; they act as one.

desc.zh: 振翅鹰翔，拥抱旭日；追逐敌手，一击毙命
desc.en: Fly on your wings, like an eagle. Touch the sun. Track the foe, ambush, and defeat.

desc.zh: 这只高贵驮兽的前额上带有一支螺旋犄角，它能迅捷地将施法者带至最需要他施展法力的地方
desc.en: Its forehead adorned with a spiral horn, this noble mount carries the Spellsinger where their magical gifts are needed most.

desc.zh: 骑手与坐骑的羁绊远远超出了友谊或家人的范畴：他们早已合而为一
desc.en: The bond between rider and steed goes beyond friendship or family; they act as one.

desc.zh: 振翅鹰翔，拥抱旭日；追逐敌手，一击毙命
desc.en: Fly on your wings, like an eagle. Touch the sun. Track the foe, ambush, and defeat.

desc.zh: 这只高贵驮兽的前额上带有一支螺旋犄角，它能迅捷地将施法者带至最需要他施展法力的地方
desc.en: Its forehead adorned with a spiral horn, this noble mount carries the Spellsinger where their magical gifts are needed most.

desc.zh: 迷踪客永远都在寻找下个猎物。他们的每一次呼吸都会离猎物更近一步，从而逐步趋向胜利
desc.en: Waystalkers are no more than their next hunt. Every breath advances their chase, bringing them closer to victory.

desc.zh: 任何举动，任何陷阱，任何事物，都无法逃脱这位矮人明察秋毫的目光
desc.en: Nothing escapes this Dwarf's gaze; no movement, no trap, nothing.

desc.zh: 夜地精是群丑陋而无处不在的家伙，它们会从每个阴沟暗洞里钻出来，加入血腥的杀戮之中
desc.en: Night Goblins are sneaky and pervasive - they creep and crawl from every hole to join in the killin'.

desc.zh: 葛林姆尼尔生命不息则怒战不止，奉其威名而战的勇士们也自当法而效之
desc.en: Grimnir fought with every breath, and so too must those who follow in his name.

desc.zh: 这位明智的矮人领主会派出斥候为大军开路，以便令先锋部队可以随时奇袭敌军
desc.en: Wise is the Dwarflord who scouts ahead, with his vanguard ready to surprise the foe.

desc.zh: 此人深知，只要能越快地将石弹打向敌人，就能越快地获得胜利
desc.en: He knows that the faster he can throw boulders at the enemy, the faster he can win.

desc.zh: 游侠需要的东西并不多，人民的需求便是引导其恪尽职守的动力
desc.en: A Ranger does not need much - he is sustained and guided by the needs of his people.

desc.zh: 对于矮人来说，与守卫城塞无关的事情便毫无价值
desc.en: What a Dwarf doesn't know about defending a Hold isn't worth knowing.

desc.zh: 卡拉克·八峰山的陷落令各个古老的氏族从此浪迹天涯。现在，是时候重新统合他们，夺回家园了！
desc.en: The undertaking of Belegar swells the hearts of most Dwarfs, inspiring some to take up axe and hammer.

desc.zh: 若是穷其一生来杀戮同一事物，那么此人必将臻于达人之境
desc.en: When one spends his life killing one thing, he becomes exceptionally good at it.

desc.zh: 贝勒加身旁总是携带着他那硕大的誓言之石。在情况危急时，他会高傲地站在上面死战到底
desc.en: Belegar carries his enormous Oath Stone everywhere. In dire times, he stands tauntingly atop it to fight to the end.

desc.zh: 贝勒加国王的伟业会受到所有矮人的支持：群山王国*必将*再度崛起！
desc.en: King Belegar's cause is one all the Dawi can get behind - the Karaz Ankor *will* rise again.

desc.zh: 贝勒加已经发下重誓，他将永不放弃，因为他的怒火是如此的强烈！
desc.en: Powerful oaths have been spoken by Belegar; he will not give up, for the rage within is strong.

desc.zh: 这幅铁砧上附满了符文领主先辈们的工作记录，它所锻造出的可是史上最强悍的符文武器！
desc.en: Covered in the Runelord’s ancient script, the anvil has given form to the most powerful runic weapons ever forged.

desc.zh: 所有矮人都鄙视绿皮，因为兽人和地精是悲伤时代的始作俑者
desc.en: All Dwarfs despise the Greenskins, for the urki and grobi are the prime agents in the Times of Woe.

desc.zh: 施放灶台与家园符文能唤起矮人对自己的要塞，氏族以及先祖的骄傲
desc.en: Invoking the Rune of Hearth & Home stirs a Dwarf's pride in his Hold, Clan and Ancestors.

desc.zh: 符文铁匠能『击打符文』，这是一种让符文保持『活跃』的方式，以确保它们不会冷却下来，从而降低效力
desc.en: A Runesmith may 'strike the runes' - a metaphor for refusing to let them cool, which reduces their potency.

desc.zh: 夜地精是群阴毒的小野兽，他们愚蠢的小脑瓜里会不时冒出些小聪明来
desc.en: Night Goblins are vicious little beasts with addled-brains and despicable little plans.

desc.zh: 兽人或许更强壮些，但是地精却会更聪明，更卑劣，更…更好！
desc.en: Orcs may be stronger, but Goblins are smarter, nastier, and better-er.

desc.zh: 用不着啥『脑子』，也用不着像个地精似的『琢磨』，什么是真正的兽人范儿，干就完了！
desc.en: No need for 'smarts' or thinkin' like a Goblin. Just smash 'em harder; that's the Orc-y way!

desc.zh: 史奎格是个稀罕的坐骑，但有命骑上去的都说它骑着倍儿爽
desc.en: A Squig is an unconventional mount, but survivors say it has a certain charm.

desc.zh: 要是世上有什么是蛮荒兽人打不碎的，那么这玩意准是谁都没法打碎
desc.en: If there's something that a Savage Orc can't smash to bits, then it probably can't be smashed.

desc.zh: 对于这些地精来说，每个洞穴、每条沟壑都是藏身之地，因此敌人很难打中这些东躲西藏的小东西
desc.en: Every cave and ditch is a hiding place for these Goblins - you cannot hit what you cannot see.

desc.zh: 他们前进，是因为有人下了命令；如果不遵从命令，那么他们肯定会给『暴揍一顿』的
desc.en: They march because they're told to, and of course because they'll get a 'right proper thrashin'' if they don't.

desc.zh: 这些骑乘战猪的蛮荒兽人在战场上绝不会留下任何情面
desc.en: These Savage Orcs, and the Warboars that bear them, give no quarter on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 个头比得上帝国战马，狠劲儿却是它的三倍！对于夜地精战将来说，这可真是个理想的坐骑啊！
desc.en: As large as an Imperial warhorse and thrice as fierce – a most appropriate mount for a Night Goblin Warboss!

desc.zh: 夜地精的至高真理，那便是『胜利就是一切』，无论用了什么手段…当然，玩点阴招就更好了
desc.en: If Night Goblins know one thing, it's that victory is victory, no matter; in fact, the sneakier the better.

desc.zh: 这是铁猪部落为乌尔扎戈送来的礼物。暴怒开膛兽深得主人信赖，是头可怕的战猪
desc.en: A gift to Wurrzag from the Iron Pig tribe, Spleenrippa is his dependable, and terrifying, War Boar mount.

desc.zh: 那些胆敢与乌尔扎戈作对的，全都被炸成碎块了，要么就是变成史奎格了
desc.en: Those on the wrong side of Wurrzag find themselves blasted apart by his magic or, worse, turned into Squigs!

name.en: True King of the Eight Peaks

desc.zh: 『八峰山的宝座属于我，这是我的权利！』
desc.en: “The Throne of the Eight Peaks is mine, by right!”

desc.zh: 『山峰是俺的！不服你倒是来抢啊，矮垛子！』
desc.en: “The Peaks belong to me. I dare yoo to try and take ‘em from me, stunty.”

desc.zh: 『诸神跟俺白话了！都听好了，俺跟你们讲！』
desc.en: “Da Godz speak ta me. Listen, and I’ll tell ya.”

desc.zh: [HIDDEN]
desc.en: [HIDDEN] Skill to lower the line

desc.zh: 荣誉便是一切！
desc.en: Honour is everything!

desc.zh: 在这个血与剑的年代里，智慧可是一件非常珍贵的宝物
desc.en: In this age of blood and battle, intellect is an underrated gift.

desc.zh: 『仅凭我的力量是无法获得胜利的，所以让我们共同分享这一荣誉吧』
desc.en: "This victory is not mine alone, we all share in the glory."

desc.zh: 『你为何如此自暴自弃？难道你不是国王，皇帝，甚至连勇士都不是吗？』
desc.en: "Why forlorn? Are you not a king, an emperor - a champion?"

desc.zh: 面无表情的人可以让人更为放心，或者更为糟心
desc.en: A calming presence can be a steadying hand… but also disquieting.

desc.zh: 快乐的气氛常伴此人，并会让属下们信心满满
desc.en: An assured air instils great confidence in your followers.

desc.zh: 虽然有些人会称之为果断，但是『强硬』这种品质该怎么说呢，利弊参半吧
desc.en: Others may call it decisive, but being uncompromising can be a weakness as well as a strength.

desc.zh: 每名伟大骑士的身后都有一位伟大的侍从：观察，等待，学习，静候机遇
desc.en: Behind every great Knight is a great Squire - watching, waiting, learning, biding his time.

desc.zh: 清澈的海风，曼纳恩的神龛，这便是波尔德罗骑士的唯一追求
desc.en: Clean sea air and a shrine to Manann; the Knights of Bordeleaux require no greater succour.

desc.zh: 世上就没有任何对手是他无法应付的，没有
desc.en: There are literally no opponents too great for them to face down. None.

desc.zh: 海水所冲刷的内陆，便是海神的势力范围所及
desc.en: As far as the tide stretches inland, so too does the Sea God's influence.

desc.zh: 海洋的产出多种多样，丰富异常，它是所有人的一项重要食物来源
desc.en: The fruits of the sea are varied and plentiful, and a source of sustenance for all.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 艾博里克的私人马鹫自从这位公爵还是一位年轻骑士时便已伴其左右，它是这一可怕物种中的一个特别可怕的存在
desc.en: Alberic's personal Hippogryph, broken years prior when the duke was a young Knight Errant, is an especially fearsome specimen of an infamously savage species.

desc.zh: 这些聪慧的猛兽远比最强壮的战马还要迅捷与威猛，并对他们尊贵的主人极度忠诚
desc.en: Stronger and faster than the mightiest warhorse, these intelligent beasts are exceptionally loyal to their noble masters.

desc.zh: 这只高贵驮兽的前额上带有一支螺旋犄角，它能迅捷地将圣女带至最需要施展法力的地方
desc.en: Its forehead adorned with a spiral horn, this noble mount carries the Damsel where their magical gifts are needed most.

desc.zh: 这只高贵驮兽的前额上带有一支螺旋犄角，它能迅捷地将圣女带至最需要施展法力的地方
desc.en: Its forehead adorned with a spiral horn, this noble mount carries the Damsel where their magical gifts are needed most.

desc.zh: 这只高贵驮兽的前额上带有一支螺旋犄角，它能迅捷地将圣女带至最需要施展法力的地方
desc.en: Its forehead adorned with a spiral horn, this noble mount carries the Damsel where their magical gifts are needed most.

desc.zh: 『以圣水的名义，我们已准备好效忠了，敬爱的女神』
desc.en: "By this blessed water, prepare us for your service, dear Lady."

desc.zh: 唯有幸运的极少数人才会拥有讲述女神诸多意志的权利
desc.en: It falls to the privileged few to tell the many of the Lady's blessed will.

desc.zh: 当战斗开始时，诚心侍奉女神的信徒会得到女神的部分力量作为奖赏
desc.en: Those who serve the Lady purely are rewarded with a portion of her strength when battle is joined.

desc.zh: 『圣杯的秘密究竟是什么？它究竟是为谁服务？』
desc.en: "What is the secret of the Grail? Whom does it serve?"

desc.zh: 『喝下圣杯中的饮料吧，你会得到重生的』
desc.en: "Drink from the chalice. You will be reborn."

desc.zh: 此物可以令湖神仙女的麾下将士们在持续的攻击前面不改色
desc.en: By which the person of the Fay Enchantress may remain unmolested in the face of sustained attack.

desc.zh: 无论是个先前触怒仙女的法师，还是仅仅是只蛤蟆，这个充满魔力的两栖动物都能够在强化仙女魔法的同时弱化敌方的魔法
desc.en: Whether a former Wizard who displeased the Enchantress or merely a toad, this magic-imbued amphibian strengthens her spells whilst weakening those of her opponents.

desc.zh: 这只骄傲而高贵的独角兽驮载着仙女，显眼地立于军队之间，使得军中所有战士都能一睹仙女风采，从而因仙女的出现而士气大振
desc.en: This proud and noble Unicorn elevates the Enchantress above her host, so all may see and be strengthened by her blessed presence.

desc.zh:
『神圣如斯，吾誓卫之；
崇高如斯，吾誓仰之；
奸佞如斯，吾誓仇之；
吾怒如炬，永无熄止！』
desc.en:
"That which is sacrosanct I shall preserve
 That which is sublime I will protect
That which threatens I will destroy
For my holy wrath will know no bounds..."

desc.zh:
『神圣如斯，吾誓卫之；
崇高如斯，吾誓仰之；
奸佞如斯，吾誓仇之；
吾怒如炬，永无熄止！』
desc.en:
"That which is sacrosanct I shall preserve
 That which is sublime I will protect
That which threatens I will destroy
For my holy wrath will know no bounds..."

desc.zh: 她便是敬畏与激励的象征，她便是女神意志的显现
desc.en: A figure of awe and inspiration, hers is the will of the goddess.

desc.zh:
『鼓角相催，跃马横枪；
遥敬女神，近护君王；
倘有一息，不失寸疆；
污邪难染，奸恶莫伤；
扬我侠义，耀我荣光！』
desc.en:
"When the clarion call is sounded
 I will ride out and fight in the name of Liege and Lady
Whilst I draw breath the lands bequeathed
 unto me will remain untainted by evil
 Honour is all, Chivalry is all..."

desc.zh: 受到女神庇佑的战士们，将怀着无可匹敌，甚至超乎常人的狂热精神而战，因为他们知道女神正在看着自己！
desc.en: Those whom the Lady has blessed fight with an unquenchable, almost super-human zeal, for they know that she sees them.

desc.zh: 湖神仙女是生命系法术的宗师，无人能出其右
desc.en: No one is more accomplished in the Lore of Life than the Fay Enchantress.

desc.zh: 国王的标志象征着勇敢、技艺与公正，它便是信任的保证
desc.en: The king's symbol stands for valour, tactical skills, and the righteous. It is assurance of trust.

desc.zh: 这是巴托尼亚至高权力的古老象征，它享受着女神之吻的保佑，金光闪闪，宛如新生
desc.en: This ancient symbol of Bretonnian supremacy, blessed by the Lady’s kiss, shines with a golden light as if brand new.

desc.zh: 劳恩国王的盾牌自他踏上骑士道的第一天起便在护佑着他。魔力让这支盾牌坚硬无比，它也将继续护佑着主人
desc.en: King Louen’s shield has protected him from the first days of his Knighthood; strengthened by enchantment, it will continue to do so.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 这些聪慧的猛兽远比最强壮的战马还要迅捷与威猛，并对他们尊贵的主人极度忠诚
desc.en: Stronger and faster than the mightiest warhorse, these intelligent beasts are exceptionally loyal to their noble masters.

desc.zh: 这是旧世界最优秀的马匹，因其耐力与热情的性格而得到了大量的繁衍
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 这些聪慧的猛兽远比最强壮的战马还要迅捷与威猛，并对他们尊贵的主人极度忠诚
desc.en: Stronger and faster than the mightiest warhorse, these intelligent beasts are exceptionally loyal to their noble masters.

desc.zh: 这是旧世界最优秀的马匹，因其耐力与热情的性格而得到了大量的繁衍
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 这些聪慧的猛兽远比最强壮的战马还要迅捷与威猛，并对他们尊贵的主人极度忠诚
desc.en: Stronger and faster than the mightiest warhorse, these intelligent beasts are exceptionally loyal to their noble masters.

desc.zh: 这是旧世界最优秀的马匹，因其耐力与热情的性格而得到了大量的繁衍
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament.

desc.zh:
『舍我枪矛，卸我兜鍪；
别我亲爱，灭我俗愁；
摒弃万物，寻我所求；
前途甚夷，其谁能阻；
万苦备至，其谁可投；
皎皓之月，无暇再顾；
女神所在，身意所留！』
desc.en:
"I set down my lance, symbol of duty
I spurn those whom I love
I relinquish all and take up the tools of my quest
No obstacle will stand before me
No plea for help shall find me waiting
No moon will look upon me twice lest I be judged idle
I give my body, heart and soul to the Lady whom I seek..."

desc.zh: [HIDDEN]
desc.en: [HIDDEN]

desc.zh: 柯烈克·食日者苏醒了，整个世界将在他的怒火中颤抖！
desc.en: Kholek Suneater has awoken, and all the world shall tremble at his wrath!

desc.zh: 与所有的上古龙魔一样，柯烈克身上覆盖着一层厚实而多刺的硬甲，它能挡住几乎所有的攻击
desc.en: Like all Shaggoths, Kholek is covered by a thick, spiny carapace that is impervious to almost everything.

desc.zh: 对于一头强大的龙魔来说，要想击杀巨人，那就得在身材与力量上都出类拔萃才行，而这只龙魔正好符合这些条件…
desc.en: It takes something the size and strength of a mighty Dragon Ogre to defeat and kill a Giant, and it just so happens that there is one on hand…

desc.zh: 柯烈克那巨大战锤的一次挥舞，足以掀起相当于地质板块猛烈碰撞所产生的强大暴击
desc.en: A titanic blow delivered by Kholek's gigantic warhammer is tantamount to the tectonic plates beneath the world shifting and colliding.

desc.zh: 柯烈克再次冲出了世间，它的毁灭大军紧随其后。留神吧，世界！
desc.en: Kholek is abroad once more, with his army of Ruined souls in tow. Beware, world!

desc.zh: 当天空中彤云密布，地平线上轰雷滚滚时，所有听说过食日者传说的人，都会吓得瑟瑟发抖
desc.en: Whenever the sky darkens with cloud and thunder rumbles on the horizon, all who know of the legend of the Suneater shiver in fear.

desc.zh: 唯有最优秀的候选人，才能享受身为永世神选左右手的殊荣
desc.en: Only the very best candidates may serve at the right-hand of the Everchosen.

desc.zh: 比黑色更为黑暗，比任何金属护甲更为坚韧。对于穿戴它的人来说…它便是深渊
desc.en: Blacker than black and far harder than any armour ever forged by mortal-hand, there is... something of the abyss about those who wear it.

desc.zh: 为了在艾查恩军中效命，你必须戴上混沌印记！
desc.en: To fight in Archaon's army, you *must* bear the Mark.

desc.zh: 艾查恩是真正的末日使者，此人一身极品神器，身后则是更为致命的忠仆：他们唯一的天职便是让末日真正地降临世间
desc.en: Archaon is truly the Herald of the Apocalypse, blessed with dreadful artefacts and even more dreadful minions, whose only purpose is to bring about the End Times.

desc.zh: 永世神选从他的黑色王座上凝视着世间，准备着以雷霆之击将世界化为碎片。而这些曾是人类的英雄们，届时将成为他的利剑
desc.en: The Everchosen stirs from his dark throne and prepares the blow that shall split the world asunder; these Heroes - who once were men - shall be his sword.

desc.zh: 『无论他们踏足何处，大地都将变得黑暗；无论他们触碰何物，万物都将枯萎凋零』
desc.en: "And wherever they tread, the ground will blacken. And what they touch will wither to dust and blow away."

desc.zh: 除了自身的堕落需求与欲望之外目中空无一物，这对常人来说简直是天方夜谭，却是『美人』西格瓦尔德的常态
desc.en: Being unable to contemplate anything other than their own perverse needs and desires would be a handicap for anyone else, but not so Sigvald the Magnificent.

desc.zh: 『我懂，我明白，我确实是个完美的典范！把镜子举高点，再高点！是的，这样就对了…』
desc.en: "I know, I know - I truly am a perfect specimen. Hold the mirror a bit higher… higher! Yes that's right…"

desc.zh: 『你觉得这件特制护甲怎么样？我看这金色真是与我最漂亮的外貌完美契合啊！天衣无缝！哈哈哈！』
desc.en: "What think you of this particular suit of armour? I think the gold really captures my best aspects - all of them hahahaha!"

desc.zh: 西格瓦尔德会在追随者中煽起狂热的奉献精神：当战斗结束之后，他们可以尽情释放自己最邪恶的欲望！
desc.en: Sigvald inspires fanatical devotion in his followers, for they know that in the aftermath of battle they may sate their most unholy lusts without restraint.

desc.zh: 为了谋取主人的青睐，西格瓦尔德的马屁精随从们会不择手段。但他们不知道的是，除了自己与黑暗亲王色孽之外，这位王子对谁都不在乎
desc.en: Sigvald's sycophantic minions will do anything to stay in his favour, not realising that he cares for none but himself and the attention of the Dark Prince, Slaanesh.

desc.zh: 只要看一眼西格瓦尔德那无可置疑的美貌，敌人就无疑会感到自惭形秽，从而士气尽丧
desc.en: On sight of Sigvald's undeniable magnificence the enemy must confront their own obvious inadequacies, and despair.

desc.zh: 索尔葛林意图重溯古时至高王的道路，他寻求着联合各矮人城堡，并重夺沦陷的城塞
desc.en: A throwback to the High Kings of old, Thorgrim seeks to unite the Karaks and reclaim their lost Holds.

desc.zh: 『如若世间有不能以战斧消弭之罪恶，那便是吾等复仇之时！』
desc.en: "That which is wrong with the world that cannot be fixed with the blades of our axes, we shall surely avenge!"

desc.zh: 强烈的复仇，需要的是真正猛烈的火力
desc.en: Mighty vengeance requires some truly serious firepower.

desc.zh: 在庄严地公开宣称要令群山王国重获昔日荣耀后，索尔葛林便大力倡导了对于全新或改良型工程与符文工艺的研发工作
desc.en: In his noble, avowed quest to return Karaz Ankor to its former glories, Thorgrim has commissioned research into new and improved engineering and runecraft.

desc.zh: 『他们会被毁灭——被我，以我强大的战斧毁灭！』
desc.en: "They'll be 'ruined' alright - by me, with my mighty axe!"

desc.zh: 『那些讨厌的杂碎，终会有悔恨的一天！』
desc.en: "Those horrible gits will rue the day!"

desc.zh: 『何等忘恩负义之辈，想想我们为他们付出了多少！现在，该给人类上堂永生难忘的课了！』
desc.en: "So ungrateful - after all we've done for them! Time to teach the umgi a lesson they won't forget!"

desc.zh: 『真是麻烦，你们就不会给我安静死着吗？去死吧！！！』
desc.en: "What to do, what to do? You just won't stay dead, will you? Diiiiie!!!"

desc.zh: 『那些瘦弱，高傲，无信的精灵！我要让他们尝尝一场新的复仇战争！』
desc.en: "Those lanky, aloof, untrustworthy Elves - I'll give them a brand new War of Vengeance!"

desc.zh: 盖尔特的黄金面具不仅遮住了那场差点夺去他生命的爆炸事故的伤痕，同时也会为他在战场上提供可观的保护
desc.en: Gelt's mask of gold both covers up the results of the explosion that almost ended his life and affords considerable protection to its wearer in battle.

desc.zh: 在年轻时，拜尔沙泽便在了解矿物与草药的药用特性方面表现出了极强的天赋
desc.en: In his younger years Balthasar showed great promise when it came to understanding the medicinal properties of minerals and herbs.

desc.zh: 这是何等巧妙的技术优势！在此技术的帮衬下，帝国炮兵得以配备了更多更强的炮弹，用来打击卡尔·弗兰兹的敌人
desc.en: What ingenious technological advance is this, that affords Imperial artillerists more and better ammunition with which to smite Karl Franz's enemies?

desc.zh: 通过增加军队所携带的弹药储备密度，帝国的大炮可以向着敌人倾泻暴雨般的火力
desc.en: By increasing the density of the shot stockpiles with which his army travels, the guns of the Empire rain devastation down upon their foes.

desc.zh: 知识渊博，魔力精湛，这位最年轻的法师很快成为了黄金学院的大导师，此人的威名自然传遍了整个大陆
desc.en: Possessed of a fierce intelligence and remarkable magical skills, the youngest Wizard ever to become Patriarch of the Gold College is known - and feared - throughout the land.

desc.zh: 在炼金术方面，拜尔沙泽·盖尔特的学识可谓无人能出其右。此人对神秘的金属系法术的造诣可谓相当的深厚
desc.en: There is no one known to possess greater knowledge in alchemical matters than Balthasar Gelt, so great is his understanding of the mystical Lore of Metal.

desc.zh: 他的剑刃获得了虔门之风的强化，其麾下的步兵无不因此勇气倍增
desc.en: The infantry under his command gain renewed courage as their blades are reinforced by the Winds of Chamon.

desc.zh: 『就算是死，也要手持利剑而逝，这才是一位战士的最好归宿！』
desc.en: "If we die, we will die wielding our swords, for there is no better death for a warrior."

desc.zh: 卡尔·弗兰兹是一位备受赞誉的革新派政治家和勇敢的将领。随侍此人左右的羽林军，都是最勇敢，最优秀的战士
desc.en: Karl Franz has been hailed as an innovative tactician and a valiant general. Only the bravest and best may fight at his side.

desc.zh: 当皇帝出现时，他的追随者们会倍受鼓舞，从而拿出最精湛的表现，表现出难以想象的忠诚
desc.en: Followers of the Emperor are inspired by his presence to attain levels of excellence and personal loyalty they never thought possible.

desc.zh: 『我们将像古时的英雄们一样，在西格玛的盛宴中赢得位置。我们的英名将被铭记在民众的颂歌中，直至终焉之刻！』
desc.en: "We will sit at Sigmar's banquet like the heroes of old and our names will be remembered in our people's songs until the end of time!"

desc.zh: 帝国能够安享前所未有的太平盛世，这都是卡尔·弗兰兹为国为民，鞠躬尽瘁的努力成果啊！
desc.en: Thanks to Karl Franz's tireless efforts on behalf of his people, the Empire has flourished during his reign as never before.

desc.zh: 虽然卡尔·弗兰兹踏上的是一条他人早已走过的道路，但鲜少有人能够走得像他这样尽善尽美
desc.en: Although Karl Franz walks a path many have trodden before, few - if any - have done so with such perfection and grace.

desc.zh: 阿兹汗的军队均为选拔而出，无不受其领袖狂热意志的鼓舞。只要看到阿兹汗的疯狂身影，这些人就会变得更为强大
desc.en: Held aloft and kept there by the rampant lunacy of their leader, Azhag's forces are all the stronger for his insane presence.

desc.zh: 『蠢货！！！俺说的是——现在！！！！』
desc.en: "Stoopid gits, I sed NOWWWWW!!!!!!!"

desc.zh: 阿兹汗的神秘头冠向他低语着邪恶的计划与卑鄙的图谋。有时他也会领会这些话的要旨，并将其传达给军中的萨满
desc.en: Azhag's mysterious crown whispers fell plans and dastardly schemes; sometimes he understands them and passes the general gist to the Shamans in his army.

desc.zh: 有些家伙私下里嘀咕，屠灭者的狂野计划似乎并不是『很兽人』。毫不意外的是，那个头冠通常都会把这些异议告诉给他，这样阿兹汗就能及时消灭那些三心二意的家伙了
desc.en: There are some who whisper that the Slaughterer's wild schemes are not sufficiently Orcy. Needless to say, the crown normally lets him know so he can weed out the dissenters.

desc.zh: 改良过的护甲和武器，加上头冠的影响，这足够让阿兹汗在战场上横冲直撞！
desc.en: Enchanted armour and weapons, and the influence of the crown, allows Azhag to 'let go' somewhat on the battlefield!

desc.zh: 当头冠获得控制权时，阿兹汗便会陷入恍惚，他会眼目低垂，嘟囔不已，甚至与自己吵嚷起来…
desc.en: When the crown takes control Azhag falls into a trance, his eyes cloud over and he mutters and even argues with himself…

desc.zh: 格里姆格不怕受伤，但尽管他饱受战争蹂躏，却有着无与伦比的避免受伤的本事
desc.en: Grimgor fears no injury, but despite his war-ravaged appearance has an unmatched knack for avoiding it.

desc.zh: 当黑兽人的可怕怒火给点燃时，你绝对不会希望自己挡住他的道！
desc.en: When a Black Orc’s not-inconsiderable dander is up, you definitely *don’t* want to get in his way!

desc.zh: 『比起你们所有家伙，格里姆格要更大、更壮、更加棒！！』
desc.en: "Grimgor is bigger 'n' 'arder 'n' betta than orl yoo uvver gits!!!"

desc.zh: 在所有绿皮中，黑兽人是群最大块、最强壮、最刻薄也最野蛮的家伙。然而就算以黑兽人的标准，格里姆格也称得上大块、强壮、刻薄与野蛮！
desc.en: Black Orcs are the biggest, strongest, meanest, and most brutal of all Greenskins. Even by those standards, Grimgor is big, strong, mean, and brutal!

desc.zh: 『你就只管扯点放你舌头底下，对着见到的玩意一道喷过去，这就对了！』
desc.en: "Yoo just pop a couple under yer tongue and 'bosh', everyfing in yer way gets a right royal twattin'!"

desc.zh: 格里姆格的领导力、勇敢精神以及战斗技巧全都极为惊人，但别忘了，他可是个彻头彻尾的大恶棍！
desc.en: Considering he is a complete and utter git, Grimgor's leadership, personal bravery and combat prowess are more than impressive.

desc.zh: 与那些凶残而愚蠢的同类不同，索隆格国王拥有冷酷而恶毒的狡诈秉性，这也让他登上了难以想见的权力之巅
desc.en: Atypical of his savage, stupid kind, Throgg is possessed of a grim, malevolent cunning that raises him far above his peers.

desc.zh: 能够无可辩驳地用其母语挑衅任何人或任何事物，这确保了乌弗瑞克的毁灭之途永无止境
desc.en: The ability to irrefutably challenge anyone – or anything – in their native language ensures that Wulfrik's Ruinous quest will never end.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽灵般的钟摆。随着一声令下，它将急速摇摆起来并穿越敌方阵势，锋利的刀刃足以切肉断骨
desc.en: A spectral pendulum is summoned by the Wizard. On command, it swings, razor sharp and with lethal speed, through the foe.

desc.zh: 施法者开启一个通往地狱深渊的漩涡，它将永久地吞噬一切卷入其中之物
desc.en: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.

desc.zh: 当乘上那些由骨头和木料搭建而成，以受害者的肌腱和肠子绑成一团的简陋战车后，掠夺者们会获得强得多的机动能力
desc.en: Marauder mobs are awarded even greater mobility when riding their crude chariots of bone and wood, lashed together with the guts and sinew of the vanquished.

desc.zh: 诺斯卡战马生而为战，比起嚼草皮来说，它们更喜欢去啃食死人的骨头
desc.en: The horses of Norsca live for battle, even choosing to graze on the bones of the fallen over grass.

desc.zh: 虽然它们恶臭熏天，凶蛮异常，但这些巨兽很乐意承载着地位崇高的掠夺者们，昂首阔步地将当面的所有愚者踏成肉泥
desc.en: Tainted and savage they may be, but these behemoths remain willing to bear high-status Marauders into battle, trampling flat everything foolish enough to get in their way.

desc.zh: 他们可以望见魔法之风的变幻，这也让他们能够最大限度地利用这股魔法力量
desc.en: They can see the Winds of Magic's ebb and flow, enabling them to make the best use of the magical power available.

desc.zh: 笼罩着沼栖妖降灾使的魔雾，同样可以用于在战场上迷惑与惊骇可能的敌人
desc.en: The same enchanted mist that obscures Fimir Balefiend dwellings can also be conjured to confound and horrify would-be attackers on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 沼泽必将再度崛起，它的居民也必将再度享受黑暗诸神的祝福
desc.en: The swamp will rise again, its inhabitants enjoying the blessings of the Dark Gods once more.

desc.zh: 冰寒的黑暗，震耳的暴行，这些来自遥远北方的事物绝不会为那些已然失去一切，并渴望遗忘的人们带来任何的慰藉
desc.en: The freezing darkness and stunning violence of the far north bring no small solace to those who have lost everything and wish to forget.

desc.zh: 黑暗诸神很喜欢一切能够驱动战争发展的科技进步，他们会为其赐予强大的战力与性能
desc.en: The Dark Gods reward any pragmatic technological advances devised to wage war in their names by greatly improving their capabilities and performance.

desc.zh: 既然内心已如黑夜，那又何须畏缩退却！
desc.en: There can be no turning back for those whose souls are turning black.

desc.zh: 掠夺，腐化，毁灭，消灭凡人，无情地夺去他们的神灵，这正是混沌要做的事情
desc.en: To despoil, to corrupt and ruin, to break the mortals and take their gods from them - this is what Chaos wants.

desc.zh: 那些无须进献给北方黑暗诸神的财物，自然是由诸神的仆人们所分享
desc.en: That which is not offered up to the Dark Gods of the North in tribute is harvested by their servants for their own petty gain.

desc.zh: 于是，神鸦的致命瘟疫被洒到了世间，以击退并感染它在凡间的敌人们。这样，便是一场永恒的胜利
desc.en: Thusly, the virulent maladies of the Crow are borne forth to repulse and infect its mortal foes; there lieth victory eternal.

desc.zh: 战争大神犬无时无刻不在渴望着鲜血与杀戮，它的愤怒也将自己体现在了战士们永无休止的征战精神之中
desc.en: The Great Hound of War thirsts eternally for blood and slaughter, its rage manifesting itself in the unstoppable martial spirit of its warriors.

desc.zh: 神鹰在自己的信徒中编织着一张复杂的欺诈之网，并以微妙而难以预测的方式提振着他们的战斗技能
desc.en: The Eagle weaves a complex web of duplicity around its servants, further bracing their combat abilities in subtle, unexpected ways.

desc.zh: 渴饮被屠杀的敌人的鲜血，也许可以吸引到神犬的注意甚至青睐
desc.en: Dining upon the blood of slaughtered enemies may attract the notice, and maybe the favour, of the Hound.

desc.zh: 神犬超自然的狂怒，会具现化为其冠军勇士对战争的渴望，以及对无尽鲜血与暴力的饥渴
desc.en: The Hound's unearthly fury is personified by its Champions' thirst for war and hunger for unending blood and violence.

desc.zh: 神蛇的诱惑可以化为各种形态，它们全都经过精心设计，只为了将我们心中深藏的所有扭曲欲望全部引诱出来
desc.en: The Serpent's temptations come in many forms, all of them designed to appeal to the twisted desires buried deep within us all.

desc.zh: 感官上的迷醉幻景，可能会诱使敌人偏离自身选择的道路，从而踏上杳无人迹的绝路，再也无法归来
desc.en: Seductive images of sensual luxuries may tempt the enemy from their chosen paths onto roads much, much less travelled and from which there can be no return.

desc.zh: 神鸦的力量既易变又肮脏，它会如同最可怕的瘟疫一般散播与发展开去，吞噬所遇见的一切，最后吞噬自己，从头再来
desc.en: Unstable and miscreated, the Crow's strength spreads and grows like the most successful of diseases, consuming all before consuming itself and beginning again.

desc.zh: 这些恶臭的，令人作呕的浓泥足以令洁癖者们退避三舍，因此它们反而成了最为坚固的传统护甲
desc.en: This foetid, disgusting pus is so repulsive to the untainted that it mimics traditional armour of far greater substance.

desc.zh: 神蛇虽然是黑暗诸神中最年轻的一位，但它的力量却丝毫不差，并且能够以诱惑性的幻象或强烈的引诱来促使凡人献上永恒的效忠
desc.en: Although the youngest of the Dark Gods, the Serpent is no less potent and can bind mortals to eternal service with alluring visions or tantalising temptations.

desc.zh: 作为无可争议的魔法大师，神鹰会使用复杂的秘术来影响它的追随者，并令敌人堕入他那复杂精妙的诡计当中
desc.en: As the undisputed master of magic, the Eagle uses complex sorcery to influence its followers and draw opponents into his multifarious, interwoven schemes.

desc.zh: 参与战争，执行任务却精神溜号，这是何等的愚蠢行为！要知道，没准神鹰诡诈的思绪就会盯上你！
desc.en: More fool they who go to war and quest with minds unfocused, for they risk the Eagle's desolate, underhand deceptions.

desc.zh: 虽然生性野蛮，但他们也会拥有野蛮的行为准则，并会与那些看得上的人结成松散的同盟关系
desc.en: In spite of their savage nature, they are possessed of a savage code of conduct and form a loose brotherhood of those considered worthy.

desc.zh: 那些不愿对北方诸神屈膝的人，很快会发现他所珍爱的一切都会从他的眼前消失
desc.en: Those who do not bend the knee to the Gods of the North soon find all they hold dear obliterated before them.

desc.zh: 没有任何其他选择，从来都是如此
desc.en: There is no other choice. There never was.

desc.zh: 狩猎，无论大小；迎敌，无论强弱。至于猎物？无论是人与否，皆杀！
desc.en: No beast too large, no adversary too great; no quarry - mortal or otherwise - can evade them.

desc.zh: 死亡与挣扎足以令这些残忍的战士们兴高采烈，他们会追随自己卑劣的主人直到天涯海角
desc.en: Delighting in death and suffering, these savage warriors follow their ignoble Lord wherever he goes.

desc.zh: 这些黑暗的骑士们非常习惯于严酷的北方环境，大量血染的战利品将他们严密地包裹了起来
desc.en: Well-accustomed to the harsh northern elements, these dark riders have further been steeled by many instances of blood-soaked triumph.

desc.zh: 比起其他凶猛的同类来说，生活在北方的战獒们要更为坚韧、凶狠，也更加的致命
desc.en: The Warhounds who reside in the far north are much hardier, more vicious and infinitely deadlier than others of their already-savage kind.

desc.zh: 战争以及诸神面前的荣耀，这就是每个决定背后的驱动力！相比它们而言，还能有什么会值得这些人去生存，或者死亡呢？
desc.en: War and glory before the Gods are the determining elements in every decision made; there is nothing else worth living - or dying - for.

desc.zh: 极北之地暗淡蛮荒的生活环境孕育了嗜血好战的部落，它们无不屈从于混沌那甜美而扭曲的力量之下
desc.en: The bleak, brutal landscape of the far north breeds bloody, warlike tribes in thrall to Chaos' delicious, twisted power.

desc.zh: 严酷而无情的北方生存环境，使得这里的住民能够比软弱的南方同类战斗得更为凶猛，也更为持久
desc.en: There's something about the harsh, unforgiving nature of northern life that makes its occupants fight harder and longer than many of their soft, southern equivalents.

desc.zh: 北方诸神的卷须与触手自极点伸出，并远远地伸向这个世界。所到之处，万物皆受其腐蚀扭曲
desc.en: The tendrils (and tentacles!) of the Northern Gods reach down from the poles and far across the world, twisting and corrupting all they touch.

desc.zh: 或许这是黑暗诸神的影响，才使得北地住民们迅速发展，散播开去，以至超出了自然的界限？
desc.en: Maybe it is the influence of the Dark Gods that has caused the populace to burgeon and proliferate beyond their natural bounds?

desc.zh: 在好战的北方荒原上，决定谁生谁死的东西都是些奇怪到没有任何学者愿意一探究竟的神秘之物
desc.en: Something strange - something no scholar really wishes to discover - governs who dies and who lives in the warlike northern wastes.

desc.zh: 眨眼之间，生死已定
desc.en: Blink and you die.

desc.zh: 毁灭力量的暗影日益扩散，保护着曾烙下诸神印记的信徒
desc.en: The shadow of the Ruinous Powers looms large, protecting those who bear their mark.

desc.zh: 仅需最微小的一瞥，最微不足道的一眼，黑暗诸神们便已足够驱使他们的玩物们去完成更为伟大的毁灭壮举了
desc.en: The slightest glance, the merest glimpse from one of the Dark Gods is sufficient to propel their playthings to ever-greater feats of desolation.

desc.zh: 当乘上那些由骨头和木料搭建而成，以受害者的肌腱和肠子绑成一团的简陋战车后，掠夺者们会获得强得多的机动能力
desc.en: Marauder mobs are awarded even greater mobility when riding their crude chariots of bone and wood, lashed together with the guts and sinew of the vanquished.

desc.zh: 诺斯卡战马生而为战，比起嚼草皮来说，它们更喜欢去啃食死人的骨头
desc.en: The horses of Norsca live for battle, even choosing to graze on the bones of the fallen over grass.

desc.zh: 当乘上那些由骨头和木料搭建而成，以受害者的肌腱和肠子绑成一团的简陋战车后，掠夺者们会获得强得多的机动能力
desc.en: Marauder mobs are awarded even greater mobility when riding their crude chariots of bone and wood, lashed together with the guts and sinew of the vanquished.

desc.zh: 诺斯卡战马生而为战，比起嚼草皮来说，它们更喜欢去啃食死人的骨头
desc.en: The horses of Norsca live for battle, even choosing to graze on the bones of the fallen over grass.

desc.zh: 当乘上那些由骨头和木料搭建而成，以受害者的肌腱和肠子绑成一团的简陋战车后，掠夺者们会获得强得多的机动能力
desc.en: Marauder mobs are awarded even greater mobility when riding their crude chariots of bone and wood, lashed together with the guts and sinew of the vanquished.

desc.zh: 诺斯卡战马生而为战，比起嚼草皮来说，它们更喜欢去啃食死人的骨头
desc.en: The horses of Norsca live for battle, even choosing to graze on the bones of the fallen over grass.

desc.zh: 废墟会隐秘地从灵魂深处腐蚀它的住民，这种成果会滋养黑暗之力的仆从们，并驱使他们奋力前进
desc.en: Ruin subtly corrupts a populace from the very depths of their souls; the resultant favour feeds the Dark Powers' servants and spurs them ever onwards.

desc.zh: 如此荒唐透顶，造型反常的造物绝然不可能出自正常的脑袋，哪怕看上一眼，也会让那些未受污染的家伙变得神智疯狂，大脑融化！
desc.en: Such utterly ludicrous, impossible geometry could not conceivably be the product of a sane mind; sight of it drives the untainted mad and melts their brains!

desc.zh: 这样的暴力是近乎极致的疯狂，『狂暴』根本不足以形容其程度
desc.en: Violence bordering on absolute delirium; 'berserk' doesn't even come close.

desc.zh: 巨身狼人的肉体上刻满了黑暗诸神的符号与印记，这为他们破败的物理形体上增加了额外的奥术防护
desc.en: Werekin flesh is scored with the symbols and marks of the Dark Gods, granting additional arcane protection to their ravaged physical forms.

desc.zh: 在经过多次自然变异的锻造之后，人皮狼身上经受腐蚀洗礼的原始毛皮会变成一副如铠甲般的防护层
desc.en: The raw, corrupted hide of the Skin Wolf, scarred from its many spontaneous transmogrifications, forms a protective, armour-like layer.

desc.zh: 黑暗诸神的影响大大增强了仆从们的攻击能力，多方面地增加了他们的力量与攻击范围
desc.en: The Dark Gods influence extends to the ferocity of their servants' attacks, increasing their power and reach manyfold.

desc.zh: 很多人都是毁灭之力在世间播撒的扭曲肉体与成真噩梦，但很少有人会真的如此恐怖
desc.en: Many are the dark horrors of twisted flesh and nightmares made real that the Ruinous Powers have visited upon the world, but few are quite as vicious.

desc.zh: 不要靠近它的嘴巴——事实上，如果你还想要你的胳膊，就不要靠近任何它能咬到的范围内
desc.en: Don't go anywhere near its mouth - in fact, don't even get within snapping distance if you value your limbs.

desc.zh: 似乎不会间断的重生能力使得这张皮散发着坚韧的光泽，无论是利爪还是剑刃都很难刺穿它
desc.en: Maybe it is the near-constant state of regeneration that gives the hide a toughened sheen, almost impervious to claw, talon or blade.

desc.zh: 当理想的武器就在指尖时，又有谁会想着举起笨重的刀剑呢？
desc.en: Who needs a cumbersome blade when the perfect weapon is literally at your fingertips?

desc.zh: 虽然蠢到可以，却拥有足以断骨的力道，可别被他给骗到了
desc.en: Witlessly stupid, yet bone-crushingly powerful. Do not be deceived.

desc.zh: 彻骨的寒冷，近乎无尽的黑暗，这些极北之地的苦寒造就了真正的杀手之王
desc.en: The intense cold and near-constant darkness of the far north make for a certain kind of killer.

desc.zh: 巨魔国王的游牧群控制着巨魔国度利风嘶吼的内陆，并且会将自己的影响力随着掠夺之途扩展到更加遥远的彼方
desc.en: The Troll King's horde control the wind-whipped hinterlands of Troll Country, and may yet extend their despoiling influence much further afield.

desc.zh: 『呃啊啊啊啊啊！！！唔啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！呵啊啊啊啊啊！！！』
desc.en: "HUUUURGGEHH!!! BLUUUURGGEHH!!! HUUUUUUUURRRRRGGGGGGGGGGEHH!!!"

desc.zh: 『冯·卡斯坦因家族。永世神选。已死之人。神尊之人。归根结底，他们终究是人。而现在…将是属于野兽的时代』
desc.en: "Von Carstein. The Everchosen. Dead men. Exalted men. In their skin they are all still men. This...will be the Age of the Beast."

desc.zh: 纵使是最为致命的伤口，也会在这股神秘力量下再生！只需片刻，一切都会完好如初
desc.en: The uncanny ability of quickly regenerating even the most grievous wounds; in due course, almost all will be healed.

desc.zh: 虽然缺乏精灵魔法的手腕，北方的术士们却从不缺乏驾驭魔法的潜质，因为他们引导的正是狂暴的恶魔之力
desc.en: Although lacking the finesse of Elven magics, the sorceries of the north are no less potent, for they channel furious, Daemonic power.

desc.zh: 为『流浪者』服务的人皮狼们，其对速度与技巧的热爱甚至超过了自己的超自然能力
desc.en: Skin Wolves in the Wanderer's service enjoy speed and skill beyond even their preternatural capabilities.

desc.zh: 这些战争猛犸如同肌肉构成的高山一般，它们能够令乌弗瑞克的部落碾碎一切敌人
desc.en: Towering mountains of muscle and flesh, these War Mammoths give Wulfrik's tribe the edge over all comers.

desc.zh: 当乌弗瑞克献祭完可怕的祭品之后，残留的血肉便会交给那些饥渴而贪婪的巨身狼人们大快朵颐了
desc.en: Once Wulfrik has made his infernal offerings, the mangled gore that remains is devoured by his ravenous, insatiable Werekin.

desc.zh: 此人被诅咒着必须走遍世界的山山水水，他的征途永无止境：挑战并击败那些世间最强的勇士
desc.en: Cursed to wander the length and breadth of the world, his never-ending quest to challenge and best the most gifted warriors.

desc.zh: 在极端恐怖，行驶如飞的『海之牙』长船面前，一旦进入了它的视线，那么等待着你的便必然是痛苦不堪，毫无怜悯的死亡
desc.en: There's no outrunning the terrible, flying Longship known as the 'Seafang'; once in its sights, an agonising, merciless death is your only possible destination.

desc.zh: 注意不要在黑暗诸神面前大耍酒疯，免得他们趁机让你发下此等誓言…
desc.en: Beware drunken boasts made in sight of the Dark Gods, lest they hold you to such claims…

desc.zh: 当乘上那些由骨头和木料搭建而成，以受害者的肌腱和肠子绑成一团的简陋战车后，掠夺者们会获得强得多的机动能力
desc.en: Marauder mobs are awarded even greater mobility when riding their crude chariots of bone and wood, lashed together with the guts and sinew of the vanquished.

desc.zh: 诺斯卡战马生而为战，比起嚼草皮来说，它们更喜欢去啃食死人的骨头
desc.en: The horses of Norsca live for battle, even choosing to graze on the bones of the fallen over grass.

desc.zh: 虽然它们恶臭熏天，凶蛮异常，但这些巨兽很乐意承载着地位崇高的掠夺者们，昂首阔步地将当面的所有愚者踏成肉泥
desc.en: Tainted and savage they may be, but these behemoths remain willing to bear high-status Marauders into battle, trampling flat everything foolish enough to get in their way.

desc.zh: 身负必须寻找并在单挑中击败最强对手的诅咒，乌弗瑞克只能在世间永远地徘徊下去
desc.en: Cursed to seek the deadliest opponents to best and kill in single combat, Wulfrik must forever walk the world.

desc.zh: 每一次略带不敬的冒犯、藐视、不快甚至仅是感觉不爽，就足以引发一场毁灭性的斧头狂舞
desc.en: The weight of every single insult, grievance, umbrage and ill-feeling, channelled into a single, crushing swing of the axe.

desc.zh: 彻底疯狂的武器杂耍，但效果拔群：武技所至，敌人绝无生还的可能
desc.en: It's a crazy piece of acrobatics, for sure, but it might just work; if it does, the opponent has no chance.

desc.zh: 『滚回来，你们这些怯懦的绿色小玩意，给我接招吧！』
desc.en: "Come back here, you cowardly piece of green filth and take what's coming to you!"

desc.zh: 『我以为我已经把你宰了！还敢回来？吃这个吧！』
desc.en: "I thought I killed you already! Back for some more? Take that!"

desc.zh: 『我可不怕你，我敬爱的祖先可比你们阴暗渺小的神老得多，也聪明得多！』
desc.en: "I'm not afraid of you - my beloved Ancestors are older and wiser than your dark, uncaring deities!"

desc.zh: 那些披上屠夫斗篷的人会在战斗中坚如钢铁，并得到瓦拉雅的庇护与保佑
desc.en: Those who take up the mantle of Slayer are steeled for the fight and enjoy Valaya's blessings and protection.

desc.zh: 那些受到亡灵法师控制的傀儡终会烟消云散，然而作为凯姆勒的宠儿，居尔得到的时间显然更长，这让他得以尊巫妖之主的名义大肆杀戮
desc.en: Those bound by Necromancy eventually degrade and fall. Krell, however, as Kemmler's chosen, has been afforded more time with which to kill in the Lichemaster’s name.

desc.zh: 在凯姆勒的魔法帮助下，居尔永远地逃离了死亡的控制。现在无人能挡住他的脚步了——只要他不是彻底被杀，就会不断地爬起来！
desc.en: Having forever escaped the shackles of mortality with Kemmler's magical assistance, Krell will never stop - he'll keep coming back until they're all *very* dead!

desc.zh: 生命不息，毁灭不止。棒极了！
desc.en: Life without end; destruction without pause. Excellent!

desc.zh: 这把黑曜石利刃只需一砍，便可令冷酷的利齿径直刺穿受害者的血肉，直击他的心脏
desc.en: The bite of this obsidian blade leaves behind Unliving shards that eat their way through the flesh to its victim’s heart.

desc.zh: 年岁与凯姆勒的亡灵法术强化了居尔的混沌战甲，令其能够如其它护身宝甲一般保护居尔免遭不测
desc.en: Strengthened by the ages and Kemmler's necromancy, Krell's Chaos-infused plate armour protects him from degrading as other bound-entities eventually must do.

desc.zh: 『我会带领你跳完整支舞的』，他说——然而这是不知疲倦的亡灵大军之舞
desc.en: "And I'll lead you all in the dance," said he - the relentless dance of the tireless Undead hordes.

desc.zh: 『来我这边吧，我的亡灵仆人们。现在你们已被约束，将永远服从于我的意志！』
desc.en: "Come to my side, my Undead servants. Now, you are bound, irrevocably, to my will forever!"

desc.zh: 当目视这位亡灵领主时，你就会见识到真正和绝对的恐怖！
desc.en: To look upon this Undead Lord is to witness true and absolute horror!

desc.zh: 何等令人不忍卒视啊，这个生物居然靠着转动丑陋的身体来打击敌人
desc.en: Truly despicable to behold, this creature deflects blows with its turgid body.

desc.zh: 这名战士倚剑而生，利剑便是其手臂的延伸，这使其成为了战场上一股不容忽视的力量
desc.en: This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.

desc.zh: 这名战士倚剑而生，利剑便是其手臂的延伸，这使其成为了战场上一股不容忽视的力量
desc.en: This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.

desc.zh: 这名战士倚剑而生，利剑便是其手臂的延伸，这使其成为了战场上一股不容忽视的力量
desc.en: This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.

desc.zh: 在防御战中，一把灵活运转的利剑绝不会让自己的主人被轻易刺穿
desc.en: A blade that sings in defence will not let its wielder be penetrated.

desc.zh: 在防御战中，一把灵活运转的利剑绝不会让自己的主人被轻易刺穿
desc.en: A blade that sings in defence will not let its wielder be penetrated.

desc.zh: 当使用者是一名真正的杀手与屠夫时，人斩之剑将成为真正致命的神兵！
desc.en: A deadly blade is especially lethal when in the hands of this master death-maker, killer and slaughterer!

desc.zh: 当使用者是一名真正的杀手与屠夫时，人斩之剑将成为真正致命的神兵！
desc.en: A deadly blade is especially lethal when in the hands of this master death-maker, killer and slaughterer!

desc.zh: 战火无穷无尽。冲锋、交兵、一对一的血战，这便是无尽的循环，永无止息
desc.en: The war is endless. The cycle of charging, clashing, and bloody hand-to-hand fighting is without end. It will never stop.

desc.zh: 有些生物非常擅长将满腔的怒火灌注到冲锋中去，就连周遭的大地都会在其足下颤动不已！
desc.en: Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.

desc.zh: 眼前的敌人倒下，鲜血四溅，他随即锁定下一个猎物
desc.en: From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.

desc.zh: 一对一的肉搏战自是一场劈砍与挑刺技术的生死对决。然而，诸如格挡回避等防御性动作也会为你赢得生存的机会
desc.en: Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.

desc.zh: 一对一的肉搏战自是一场劈砍与挑刺技术的生死对决。然而，诸如格挡回避等防御性动作也会为你赢得生存的机会
desc.en: Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.

desc.zh: 一对一的肉搏战自是一场劈砍与挑刺技术的生死对决。然而，诸如格挡回避等防御性动作也会为你赢得生存的机会
desc.en: Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.

desc.zh: 身为领主，要有钢铁般的意志与绝不服输的气势，这样在面临险境时，麾下众将的立场才会坚定，并追随其至天涯海角
desc.en: The iron will and indomitable presence of this leader ensures their followers remain steadfast when facing peril.

desc.zh: 这名历战老兵身上的累累伤痕是多场战斗遗留下的记忆，逃脱死神魔爪是此人的家常便饭，因此他值得众人的尊重与畏惧
desc.en: The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.

desc.zh: 这名历战老兵身上的累累伤痕是多场战斗遗留下的记忆，逃脱死神魔爪是此人的家常便饭，因此他值得众人的尊重与畏惧
desc.en: The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.

desc.zh: 那些天生便带着坚硬外壳的生物可不是那么容易杀死的，就算是强力的攻击，也不见得能刺穿他们的硬皮
desc.en: Creatures with tough hides or some kind of natural armour are tough nuts to crack - even a powerful attack may fall foul of their thick-skin.

desc.zh: 那些天生便带着坚硬外壳的生物可不是那么容易杀死的，就算是强力的攻击，也不见得能刺穿他们的硬皮
desc.en: Creatures with tough hides or some kind of natural armour are tough nuts to crack - even a powerful attack may fall foul of their thick-skin.

desc.zh: 杀伤猛士力大无穷、凶狠残暴，会将一切敌人彻底地撕碎、蹂躏、践踏，直至战场上只剩下他自己为止！
desc.en: Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.

desc.zh: 杀伤猛士力大无穷、凶狠残暴，会将一切敌人彻底地撕碎、蹂躏、践踏，直至战场上只剩下他自己为止！
desc.en: Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.

desc.zh: 无论是先兆还是讯号，此人无所不知。而遵循其预言的人将共享荣耀
desc.en: An omen, a sign - this being knows things and any who follow will share their glory.

desc.zh: 他人除了信奉之外别无选择，这便是此人心中之念
desc.en: Such is this one's conviction that others have no choice but to believe.

desc.zh: 此人满怀战斗热情：似可赞颂？似可鄙夷？
desc.en: This one fights with a fervour to be both admired and despised.

desc.zh: 除了狂热的信仰之外别无他物，这绝非理性可以解释
desc.en: There is nothing but utter belief. There is no reasoning with this one.

desc.zh: 此人既不会被击垮，也不会抛弃荣誉，他从不向敌人屈服
desc.en: Never to be broken or dishonoured - never to succumb to the foe.

desc.zh: 此人既不会被击垮，也不会抛弃荣誉，他从不向敌人屈服
desc.en: Never to be broken or dishonoured – never to succumb to the foe.

desc.zh: 让这个家伙屈服或者击穿其护甲都不是容易的事
desc.en: It is no easy task to bend or break the armour of this being.

desc.zh: 吟诵力量或信仰之语，便可改变自己在战场上的洞察力
desc.en: Speaking words of power or faith can alter perceptions on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 此人绝不会轻易屈膝，除非他的意志与躯体全部被彻底地毁灭
desc.en: This one will not go down easily - it will be necessary to break both the will and the body first.

desc.zh: 此人绝不会轻易屈膝，除非他的意志与躯体全部被彻底地毁灭
desc.en: This one will not go down easily – it will be necessary to break both the will and the body first.

desc.zh: 『别看他们的眼睛，他们的眼里只有死亡！』
desc.en: "Don't look into their eyes, there is only death there!"

desc.zh: 该领主经常大声下达命令，即使是身处战场的彼方，也会因为他那阴冷的战争之声而感到窒息
desc.en: This Lord belts out orders and can be heard even across a battlefield smothered in the grim noise of war.

desc.zh: 有那么些领主，他们身上散发着力量、自信和威严，激励着他们的追随者执行伟大或可怕的行动
desc.en: There are Lords that radiate power, confidence and fear, inspiring their followers to great or terrible acts.

desc.zh: 无数的冲突令这位领主的直觉变得无比敏锐，这使得此人极难落入陷阱
desc.en: Countless conflicts and a keen sense of awareness have made this Lord difficult to entrap.

desc.zh: 据说西格玛可以在身负重伤的情况下继续战斗，该勇士也在追随这位神圣战神的脚步
desc.en: It is said that Sigmar would bear a mortal wound and carry on fighting; this champion follows the hallowed Warrior-God.

desc.zh: 『现在正是发动突袭的时刻！』
desc.en: "The time to strike is now!"

desc.zh: 这个家伙一定受过奸奇的触碰，总能在事情发生前就预知它们
desc.en: This being must be touched by Tzeentch, seeing things before they happen.

desc.zh: 对土地的了解自是一种优势，一种能够让你跑得比别人快的优势
desc.en: Those who know the land and its secrets will travel faster and further than the foes who don't.

desc.zh: 全身板甲可将穿戴者从头到尾包裹得严严实实，有许多板甲都曾受过祝福或是拥有奥术之力
desc.en: Full-Plate armour protects the wearer from head-to-foot. Many such suits are blessed or imbued with arcane abilities.

desc.zh: 全身板甲可将穿戴者从头到尾包裹得严严实实，有许多板甲都曾受过祝福或是拥有奥术之力
desc.en: Full-plate armour protects the wearer from head-to-foot. Many such suits are blessed or imbued with arcane abilities.

desc.zh: 全身板甲可将穿戴者从头到尾包裹得严严实实，有许多板甲都曾受过祝福或是拥有奥术之力
desc.en: Full-Plate armour protects the wearer from head-to-foot. Many such suits are blessed or imbued with arcane abilities.

desc.zh: 将法杖或是某种奥术导体插入大地之后，有经验的施法者便会有效地束缚魔法之风，从而大大降低施法事故的触发概率
desc.en: By stabbing a staff or some arcane conduit into the ground, an accomplished magic-user can earth or tether the Winds and hopefully reduce a chance of miscasting.

desc.zh: 一些魔法使用者有能力储存魔法之风以备日后使用，从而强化他们的施法能力
desc.en: A few magic-users have the ability to store the Winds of Magic for later use, increasing their spellcasting power when it really counts.

desc.zh: 该专家常使用魔法之风寻找奥术之物
desc.en: This adept uses the Winds of Magic to seek out arcane artefacts.

desc.zh: 在染满鲜血前都不能收起已经拔出的剑
desc.en: A drawn blade should not be put away until slaked in blood.

desc.zh: 不要去对此人下套，如果被逼至角落，此人会拼死一搏
desc.en: Never trap this one, when cornered they have nothing left to lose.

desc.zh: 他们的攻击越凌厉，动作越猛烈，反击的难度就越低
desc.en: The harder they hit, the more they commit, the easier it is to strike back.

desc.zh: 他们的攻击越凌厉，动作越猛烈，反击的难度就越低
desc.en: The harder they hit, the more they commit, the easier it is to strike back.

desc.zh: 『你别再跟过来了，该死的家伙！』
desc.en: "Stay in one place, gods-damn you!"

desc.zh: 那些跑得特别快的家伙会更快地到达敌军那里
desc.en: Those who are fleet of foot can reach the enemy faster.

desc.zh: 此人的战斗手段很是卑劣，但战场上可没有什么正义准则可言！
desc.en: This being fights dirty, no honour system applies here!

desc.zh: 此人的战斗手段很是卑劣，但战场上可没有什么正义准则可言！
desc.en: This being fights dirty, no honour system applies here!

desc.zh: 总是在战场上寻找豁口与优势，一定有什么地方能把刀子给捅进去
desc.en: Always on the lookout for an opening or advantage in battle - somewhere to put the knife in…

desc.zh: 无论是瞄准喉咙割下去，还是准确击中心脏，此人都相当精通杀人之术！
desc.en: Whether a targeted slice to the throat, or a precision stab to the heart, this one knows how to kill!

desc.zh: 『我用眼睛小心地侦察，寻找需要消灭的目标』
desc.en: "I spy with my beady eye… something that needs to be killed."

desc.zh: 『敌人的恐惧和他们在污泥中流淌的血，就是支撑我活下去的动力』
desc.en: "The enemy's fear; their blood spilt in the mud – these are the things that sustain me."

desc.zh: 『敌人的恐惧和他们在污泥中流淌的血，就是支撑我活下去的动力』
desc.en: "The enemy's fear; their blood spilt in the mud – these are the things that sustain me."

desc.zh: 女神自翠绿深处款款而来，尽心护佑着她忠诚的信徒们
desc.en: From the verdant depths, the Lady rises to protect the faithful.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 这些聪慧的猛兽远比最强壮的战马还要迅捷与威猛，并对他们尊贵的主人极度忠诚
desc.en: Stronger and faster than the mightiest warhorse, these intelligent beasts are exceptionally loyal to their noble masters.

desc.zh: 彻底的训练能够让农民们更有可能直面战争的可怕
desc.en: Thorough drilling increases the peasants' chances of withstanding the horrors of battle.

desc.zh: 『尔等应无所不至，永远捍卫良善与正义，反对不义与邪恶』
desc.en: "Thou shalt be everywhere and always the champion of the Right and the Good against Injustice and Evil."

desc.zh: 虽然任何事物都难以取代冲锋的震撼与钢铁的冲击，但是重型炮兵的支援也是很有帮助的
desc.en: Although nothing can replace the thrill of the charge and the righteous clash of steel, seriously heavy artillery generally helps.

desc.zh: 最为优秀的良驹，其血脉已代代相传，并世辈为我们服务下去
desc.en: The bloodline of the noblest of all steeds has been preserved; it serves us still.

desc.zh: 此人如同雄狮，有着最为锋利的獠牙，是同袍中最勇敢的战士
desc.en: Like the lion, this one is the biggest and the bravest of his kind... with the sharpest teeth.

desc.zh: 就算是愚蠢的农夫，也能学会坚守阵地，硬抗冲锋
desc.en: Even stupid peasants can learn to stand fast and brace against the charge.

desc.zh: 当面临着被自方屠杀的可能性时，军阵中的小人物也会奋起反击…
desc.en: When the alternative probably involves being killed by their own side, the smallfolk tend to rise to the occasion...

desc.zh: 在高贵典范的领导下，农民们会更为持久，更为努力地战斗下去，以免令自己的领主蒙羞
desc.en: Led by noble example, peasants fight longer and harder lest their Lord be dishonoured.

desc.zh: 领主绝不应亲自打理税收事宜；这种招人白眼的工作自有别人进行打理
desc.en: Lords must not be concerned with the collecting of taxes; there are others whose lot it is to feel the people's scorn.

desc.zh: 领主高居庙堂，农民辛勤劳作。千余年已经过去，真是毫无变革的生活…
desc.en: The Lords rule, the peasants toil. Nothing has changed in over a thousand years.

desc.zh: 他们曾亲眼见证过女神美妙的姿态与优雅的举止
desc.en: They've seen the Lady's acts or witnessed her blessed grace.

desc.zh: 作为此类事宜的专家，他们的职责便是领会国王的法律，并以他的名义遂行正义
desc.en: As an expert in such matters, it is their duty to know the king's law and to mete justice in his name.

desc.zh: 以国王之名，得国王之助而战：这种信念会在围城战的物资匮乏中坚定地支持整支军队
desc.en: The knowledge that they fight in the king's name, with his support, steels an army for the privations of the siege.

desc.zh: 『若是你顺从国王的意志，那么从这里直至海滨的所有土地都是你的！』
desc.en: "The land from here to the sea is yours, if you enforce the king's will."

desc.zh: 领主有权向佃农们征收什一税，因此也需为佃农提供持续的保护
desc.en: The Lord is entitled to collect tithes from tenants in return for continued protection.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 凶残的野兽，无论面对人类还是龙族，都将为捍卫领地而不惜战至最后一息！
desc.en: Fierce beasts that will fight to the death any who enter their territory – be they man or Dragon!

desc.zh: 骑士们以女神之名结成阵型，摧垮敌阵，剿除邪恶
desc.en: A Knightly formation, in the Lady's name, to smash through battle lines; to defeat evil in the field.

desc.zh: 这些聪慧的猛兽远比最强壮的战马还要迅捷与威猛，并对他们尊贵的主人极度忠诚
desc.en: Stronger and faster than the mightiest warhorse, these intelligent beasts are exceptionally loyal to their noble masters.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 最为优秀的马鹫，自然应由自『统一者』吉勒斯之后最为伟大的巴托尼亚君主所骑乘！
desc.en: The greatest of the Hippogryphs for the greatest Bretonnian leader since Gilles the Uniter.

desc.zh: 『君即是国，国则为君。君功不竟，国乱土分』
desc.en: "You will be the land, and the land will be you. If you fail, the land will perish."

desc.zh: 这些聪慧的猛兽远比最强壮的战马还要迅捷与威猛，并对他们尊贵的主人极度忠诚
desc.en: Stronger and faster than the mightiest warhorse, these intelligent beasts are exceptionally loyal to their noble masters.

desc.zh: 『君主无剑，则疆土无王！』
desc.en: "The king without a sword? The land without a king!"

desc.zh: 国王的威望必须非常高，这样一旦战斗打响，女神的保佑便总会伴随在他的身旁
desc.en: So great must the king's stature be that when battle is joined it is always with the Lady's blessing.

desc.zh: 对于巴托尼亚的万民来说，女神的赐福是非常美妙的礼物。只要他们跪下宣誓效忠，就能得到这一馈赠
desc.en: The Lady's blessing is a wondrous gift freely graced upon all Bretonnian subjects, should they but kneel and utter their devotion.

desc.zh: 助祭们也会得到女神的庇佑，这令其得以抵御魔法的攻击
desc.en: Acolytes too are blessed by the Lady's spirit, enabling them to resist magical attacks.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 旧世界最为优秀的战马，吃苦耐劳，热情似火，并且得到了马铠提供的进一步防护
desc.en: The finest horses in the Old World, bred for their endurance and fiery temperament, barded for further protection.

desc.zh: 毁灭力量的暗影日益扩散，保护着曾烙下诸神印记的信徒
desc.en: The shadow of the Ruinous Powers looms large, protecting those who bear their mark.

desc.zh: 混沌战士们是邪神的玩物，他们被赐予了许多礼物，包括强大的战斗技巧
desc.en: The Warriors of Chaos are the playthings of Gods and given many gifts, including formidable fighting skills.

desc.zh: 这些混沌战马身披重甲，狂怒不息，因而愈发致命
desc.en: The already-fierce Chaos Steeds are often covered in heavy armour, making them even deadlier.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 蝎尾狮的咆哮绝对能让凡间之物闻之而遁，因为他们知道，一只可怕的生物出现了
desc.en: The roar of a Manticore is guaranteed to send mortals fleeing, for they know a creature of terror is abroad.

desc.zh: 对北方人来说，没有什么比奋战至死，然后在诸神的凝视中倒下更为荣耀
desc.en: To the Northmen, there is no greater honour than to fight and perish under the gaze of the Gods.

desc.zh: 混沌领主负责统治，那些小家伙会向这位热切期望受黑暗诸神注视的主人屈膝服从
desc.en: A Chaos Lord dominates – lesser beings cringe from a being that is so intently under scrutiny from the Dark Gods.

desc.zh: 末日之火是来自恐虐的礼物，能让混沌地狱炮的威力更上一层
desc.en: Doomfire is a gift from Khorne, to ensure the Hellcannons speak with extra fury.

desc.zh: 混沌诸神向其追随者施以变异，虽然在南方佬看来很可怕，但这种礼物却是异常珍贵
desc.en: Mutations awarded by the Chaos Gods to their followers may look horrific to southerners, but such gifts are prized.

desc.zh: 混沌的追随者不需要休息，他们带着钢铁之心行军，并热切期待能收割灵魂
desc.en: The followers of Chaos need not to rest, they march on with iron hearts desperate to harvest souls.

desc.zh: 在领主神秘莫测的视线下，混沌军团不断前进，出于对他愤怒的恐惧，他们渴望杀戮敌人
desc.en: The legions march forth under their Lord's inscrutable gaze, eager to kill for fear of his wrath.

desc.zh: 混沌领主期望他的战车驭手收割大量的灵魂，以作为黑暗之力的消耗品
desc.en: This Chaos Lord expects his charioteers to harvest many souls for the consumption of the Dark Powers.

desc.zh: 混沌骑士对任何准备掠夺的领主而言都是一种恩惠，因为掠夺正好符合黑暗诸神的意愿
desc.en: The Knights of Chaos are a boon for any Lord ready to despoil, for that is the will of the Dark Gods.

desc.zh: 领主的声音中蕴含着不断增强的恐惧力量，这种来自黑暗之主的馈赠能保证其部下的顺从
desc.en: This Lord speaks with a dread booming voice - a gift from his Dark Masters to ensure obedience.

desc.zh: 领主的声音中蕴含着不断增强的恐惧力量，这种来自黑暗之主的馈赠能保证其部下的顺从
desc.en: This Lord speaks with a dread booming voice - a gift from his Dark Masters to ensure obedience.

desc.zh: 领主的声音中蕴含着不断增强的恐惧力量，这种来自黑暗之主的馈赠能保证其部下的顺从
desc.en: This Lord speaks with a dread booming voice - a gift from his Dark Masters to ensure obedience.

desc.zh: 混沌的仆从带来的是腐败，他们会加快周围环境扭曲腐化的速度
desc.en: With the servants of Chaos comes the corruption - as the landscape twists, this one speeds the transformation.

desc.zh: 辛辣的堕落混合软膏，保障了奴才们邪恶的活力
desc.en: A pungent mix of fell unguents ensures the unholy vitality of one’s minions.

desc.zh: 掠夺，腐化，毁灭，消灭凡人，无情地夺去他们的神灵，这正是混沌要做的事情
desc.en: To despoil, to corrupt and ruin, to break the mortals and take their gods from them - this is what Chaos wants.

desc.zh: 混沌战士云集混沌领主麾下，南方的软弱家伙很快就要面临恐惧的时刻
desc.en: The masses flock to the Lord of Chaos - a dread time will soon fall on the weaklings in the south.

desc.zh: 『吾主已经预见到了，这些发臭的凡间要塞即将陷落。让它们统统化为废墟吧！』
desc.en: "This stinking mortal Hold will fall, my masters have foreseen it. Bring them ruin!"

desc.zh: 『可怜虫啊！你们必须为我效劳，否则统统都得死，没有其他选择！』
desc.en: "You will serve me, wretch, or you will die, there is no other option."

desc.zh: 这位参加过诺斯卡大迁徙的领主曾经是部落的一份子，他可以聚集自己的亲族，组成大军
desc.en: A Lord that was once part of the tribes - one who rode the great Norscan migrations - can summon his kin.

desc.zh: 这位毁灭之力的忠实奴仆有着任何凡人都无法估量的惊人韧性
desc.en: This willing servant of the Ruinous Powers has a resilience that is beyond any mortal measure.

desc.zh: 混沌战士们是邪神的玩物，他们被赐予了许多礼物，包括强大的战斗技巧
desc.en: The Warriors of Chaos are the playthings of Gods and given many gifts, including formidable fighting skills.

desc.zh: 『我不是邪神的工具，相反，我是被邪神选中的人，因为没有谁能比我更渴望末日的到来！』
desc.en: "I am no god's tool, yet I am Chosen, for there is no other that thirsts for the end as much as I."

desc.zh: 末日黑马是末日的马种，是混沌邪神亲自为最强的勇士准备的礼物
desc.en: Dorghar is the Steed of the Apocalypse, a gift from the Chaos Gods themselves to their ultimate champion.

desc.zh: 艾查恩乃是末日之主，由无形无影的比拉克所加冕
desc.en: Archaon is Lord of the End Times, crowned by Be'lakor, a creature of abeyance that's neither shape nor shadow.

desc.zh: 混沌之剑是艾查恩麾下的战团，是经历多次可怕考验锻炼的百战勇士中的核心成员
desc.en: The Swords of Chaos are Archaon's warband, a cadre of hardened companions that have been forged over many dread quests.

desc.zh: 这些混沌战马身披重甲，狂怒不息，因而愈发致命
desc.en: The already-fierce Chaos Steeds are often covered in heavy armour, making them even deadlier.

desc.zh: 混沌巨龙曾是卡勒多的高贵野兽，但现在它们受到了诅咒，蜕变成了腐化的怪物，并成为邪恶领主的坐骑
desc.en: Chaos Dragons are anathema to the noble beasts of Caldor. They are now corrupted creatures ridden by malicious Lords.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 这些像狮子的怪物长着致命的尾刺，是能与强大的混沌领主相称的坐骑
desc.en: These leonine beasts, with deadly stinging tails, are worthy mounts of a mighty Chaos Lord.

desc.zh: 这些混沌战马身披重甲，狂怒不息，因而愈发致命
desc.en: The already-fierce Chaos Steeds are often covered in heavy armour, making them even deadlier.

desc.zh: 混沌巨龙曾是天空的高贵统治者，但现在的它们在变异之力的作用下开始分裂，腐化
desc.en: Chaos Dragons were once noble rulers of the skies, now split and corrupted by the forces of Change.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 术士们无不对蝎尾狮赞不绝口：作为魔法生物，其残忍丝毫不在骑手之下
desc.en: Manticores are highly prized by Sorcerers, for they are creatures bathed in magic and as cruel as their riders.

desc.zh: 这些混沌战马身披重甲，狂怒不息，因而愈发致命

desc.en: Manticores are highly prized by Sorcerers, for they are creatures bathed in magic and as cruel as their riders.

desc.zh: 与其他上古龙魔一样，对柯烈克来说，雷电的劈击、呼啸的风暴都是真正的滋养良剂
desc.en: Like all Shaggoths, Kholek is invigorated by the touch of lightning, and the roar of the storm.

desc.zh: 色孽偏爱的孩子会领悟非凡的剑术，这就是他的奖赏
desc.en: Slaanesh's favoured child has been granted the gift of preternatural swordsmanship.

desc.zh: 色孽的祝福之印被刻在了西格瓦尔德完美的身体之内
desc.en: The beatific Mark of Slaanesh is branded into Sigvald's perfect body.

desc.zh: 这些混沌战马身披重甲，狂怒不息，因而愈发致命
desc.en: The already-fierce Chaos Steeds are often covered in heavy armour, making them even deadlier.
