desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 术士们无不对蝎尾狮赞不绝口：作为魔法生物，其残忍丝毫不在骑手之下
desc.en: Manticores are highly prized by Sorcerers, for they are creatures bathed in magic and as cruel as their riders.

desc.zh: 这些混沌战马身披重甲，狂怒不息，因而愈发致命
desc.en: The already-fierce Chaos Steeds are often covered in heavy armour, making them even deadlier.

desc.zh: 混沌的战马远比普通马可怕得多，这些经过恶魔之血腐化的怪物据说是黑暗诸神亲赐的礼物
desc.en: The dread steeds of Chaos are more than mere horses, but creatures tainted by Daemon blood, said to be gifts from the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 术士们无不对蝎尾狮赞不绝口：作为魔法生物，其残忍丝毫不在骑手之下
desc.en: Manticores are highly prized by Sorcerers, for they are creatures bathed in magic and as cruel as their riders.

desc.zh: 所有矮人都鄙视绿皮，因为兽人和地精是悲伤时代的始作俑者
desc.en: All Dwarfs despise the Greenskins, for the urki and grobi are the prime agents in the Times of Woe.

desc.zh: 矮人速度并不快，但他们有迎难而上的精神，不管前路有多么凶险
desc.en: Dwarfs are not fast, yet they will soldier on, always moving despite any hazards encountered.

desc.zh: 矮人难以动摇，一旦向敌人发起冲锋，他们就会把所有力量都押在第一击上
desc.en: Dwarfs are resolute - once they commit to charging the foe, they put all their strength behind that initial blow.

desc.zh: 战神无尽的勇气极大地增长了这位矮人的胆量
desc.en: The endless courage of the Warrior God, directed to bolster this Dawi’s own reserves.

desc.zh: 那些熟悉弹道学的工程师知道怎么样才能把武器的射程完全发挥出来
desc.en: Those Engineers conversant in ballistics know how best to increase the ranges of their weapons.

desc.zh: 精准一击指的是工程师或雷鸣枪手可以在五百步（以矮人为基准）外击中目标
desc.en: A dead eye shot is an Engineer or Thunderer that can hit a target at over five hundred (Dwarfen) paces.

desc.zh: 熟悉防御阵型的工程大师会在围城战中运用他们数百年来积累的经验
desc.en: Master Engineers familiar with defensive formations use their centuries of experience in sieges.

desc.zh: 那些工程师大半辈子都呆在地下，因此他们非常熟悉如何在山洞里战斗
desc.en: Those Engineers that spend their lives underground have a good understanding of war in the caverns.

desc.zh: 无论工程大师需要什么，他都能得到。军需官很少会拒绝来自行会工程师的要求
desc.en: If a Master Engineer wants something, he'll get it. Quartermasters can rarely refuse a demanding Guild engineer.

desc.zh: 坑道老兵尤为擅长打败掘壕固守的敌军。他可以迅速将火炮搬到最佳的位置上
desc.en: A Sapper excels at breaking entrenched foes. He can quickly get artillery into the best position.

desc.zh: 工程大师熟悉一切关于开火速率、开火范围以及最佳火力系数的知识，他的知识能有效改进火器部队的作战效率
desc.en: A Master Engineer knows all about firing rates, fields of fire and the best ratios, his knowledge improving efficiency.

desc.zh: 工程师总是喜欢修修补补，并习惯将这些工作称为『补强』。无论是什么新发明，经过他们的修补后都基本会得到改善
desc.en: Engineers always tinker, naming these tweaks "enhancements" - most do improve whatever contraption they are working on.

desc.zh: 工程师使用数字知识为他们的战争机器调整出最佳的弹道和杀伤力
desc.en: Engineers use number-lore to work out the best trajectories and prime killing arcs for their war machines.

desc.zh: 领主从来都是斧不离手，因为对他而言斧子就像胡子一样，是身体的一部分
desc.en: A Lord and his az are never separated, for it is as much part of him as his beard.

desc.zh: 矮人的决心冷酷而坚定。矮人们在战斗中决不撤退，要么胜利，要么死亡
desc.en: Full of grim determination, when Dwarfs join battle there is no retreat, only victory or death.

desc.zh: 一名真正的矮人领主比其他家伙要更了解地下通道，自己的城塞以及如何在地下战斗
desc.en: A true Lord knows the Underway, his Dwarfhold and how to fight under the ground better than anyone.

desc.zh: 这位顽强的矮人拒绝屈服，不知疲倦，而且要求自己的追随者也要这样做
desc.en: This stubborn Dwarf refuses to yield or tire, and ensures his followers are of the same ilk.

desc.zh: 该领主知道他的族人擅于射击，并希望其族人能在这条道路上更进一步
desc.en: This Lord knows his throng thrives in missle combat, so expects his Clansdwarfs to excel in that discipline.

desc.zh: 矮人们绵长的寿命令其积累了大量的战场经验，这让他们成为了卓越的战术家
desc.en: Dwarfs are long-lived with many years of battlefield experience, making them excellent tacticians.

desc.zh: 陶醉于支配天空的矮人领主坚持要在他的飞行器上安装附加装甲
desc.en: A Dwarf Lord who revels in aerial domination insists the craft in his Airkorps are fitted with additional armour.

desc.zh: 明智的领主会召集工程师为他效劳，让矮人的技术保持在科技的前沿
desc.en: A wise Lord will gather Engineers to his service, ensuring the Dwarfs maintain their technological edge.

desc.zh: 『所有矮人注意了！我们要发泄怨恨，这是葛林姆尼尔的要求！』
desc.en: "All Dwarfs to me! We have grudges to settle - Grimnir demands it!"

desc.zh: 该矮人并不在乎身上的伤势，他只会凭借自己的意志继续战斗
desc.en: Such a Dawi does not care for being wounded - by his will alone he continues to fight.

desc.zh: 石匠行会很有权势，而与之关系密切的领主便会在建材与劳力方面享受折扣了
desc.en: Lords close to the powerful Masons' Guild will get discounts for labour and materials.

desc.zh: 该矮人曾长期呆在矿井里，因此他拥有矿工的危险直觉和在黑暗中寻找猎物的本能
desc.en: This Dwarf spent time in the pits, gaining a Miner's intuition of the dangers and prey to be found in the dark.

desc.zh: 留着漂亮胡子的矮人才是纯纯正正的矮人
desc.en: A Dwarf with a fine beard is as Dawi as they come.

desc.zh: 『就连厕所的墙都比这结实！最迟明天就能捣垮它，我保证！』
desc.en: "I have seen better lavatory walls than this - I'll have it down by the morrow, that's a pledge!"

desc.zh: 所有矮人都鄙视绿皮，因为兽人和地精是悲伤时代的始作俑者
desc.en: All Dwarfs despise the Greenskins, for the urki and grobi are the prime agents in the Times of Woe.

desc.zh: 矮人速度并不快，但他们有迎难而上的精神，不管前路有多么凶险
desc.en: Dwarfs are not fast, yet they will soldier on, always moving despite any hazards encountered.

desc.zh: 矮人难以动摇，一旦向敌人发起冲锋，他们就会把所有力量都押在第一击上
desc.en: Dwarfs are resolute - once they commit to charging the foe, they put all their strength behind that initial blow.

desc.zh: 所有的矮人都以顽固著称，但比起复仇时代的缔造者『负怨者』来说，实在是小巫见大巫矣
desc.en: All Dwarfs are stubborn, but none more so than Grudgebearer, the founder of the Age of Reckoning.

desc.zh: 恶魔屠夫会翻遍那些受到毁灭之力篡变的敌人，将其中最可怕的家伙揪出来
desc.en: Daemon Slayers seek out the most horrifying foes, those in servitude to the Ruinous Powers.

desc.zh: 屠夫一直在寻求在与巨兽的战斗中光荣战死，就算是面对巨龙，也是在所不惜
desc.en: Slayers are constantly looking for the most glorious death in battle against the largest creatures, including dragons.

desc.zh: 立下屠夫誓言后，就没有什么能阻止阿格里姆在战斗中寻求一死了
desc.en: Having taken the Slayer Oath, Ungrim will stop at nothing to meet his death in battle.

desc.zh: 所有的矮人都会对屠夫王既敬且畏，尤其是那些立下了屠夫誓言的矮人
desc.en: The King of Slayers is an awe inspiring sight to every Dwarf but especially those that have taken the Slayer Oath.

desc.zh: 增强矮人与生俱来的抗魔体质来抑制魔法之风
desc.en: The Dwarfs' natural anti-magic resistance is amplified to dampen the Winds of Magic.

desc.zh: 施放灶台与家园符文能唤起矮人对自己的要塞，氏族以及先祖的骄傲
desc.en: Invoking the Rune of Hearth & Home stirs a Dwarf's pride in his Hold, Clan and Ancestors.

desc.zh: 符文铁匠可以『击打符文』，从而让符文『热身』而不至于冷却下来
desc.en: A Runesmith may "strike the runes" - an analogy for keeping them "hot", refusing to let them cool.

desc.zh: 圣锤中无尽的热情和愤怒，保护着背负守护之人
desc.en: The relentless drive and fury of the Hammer, harnessed for the protection of this ward’s bearer.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 『小伙儿，必须确保这些马鞍的带子已经绑结实了，从这摔下去可不比从普通马上摔下来』
desc.en: "Make sure those saddle straps are tight, boy, this isn't like falling off a normal horse."

desc.zh: 帝国养育的大型战马连巴托尼亚也无法超越，它们是能与帝国队长相称的坐骑
desc.en: Not to be outdone by Bretonnia, the Empire breed large warhorses, steeds worthy of a Captain for sure.

desc.zh: 战斗牧师祈求西格玛赐予他们些微的神圣之力，让他的铁锤放射出了力量的光芒！
desc.en: The Warrior Priest implores Sigmar to imbue him with a modicum of divine strength, and now his hammer glows bright with power!

desc.zh: 战斗牧师的信仰化身为一道护盾，硬如城堡锻铁
desc.en: The Warrior Priest’s faith manifests in the form of a shield as hard as castle-forged steel.

desc.zh: 战斗牧师们念出战斗祷告，一层白色圣火包裹了他们全身，灼烧西格玛的敌人，却不会伤害祈求者自己
desc.en: A battle prayer that bathes the Warrior Priest in white, holy fire sears Sigmar’s foes but leaves the supplicant unharmed.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 战斗牧师祈求西格玛赐予他们些微的神圣之力，让他的铁锤放射出了力量的光芒！
desc.en: The Warrior Priest implores Sigmar to imbue him with a modicum of divine strength, and now his hammer glows bright with power!

desc.zh: 该战斗牧师的愤怒膨胀为正义的狂怒，向西格玛之敌唾以仇恨之咒
desc.en: Spitting words of hatred against Sigmar's enemies, the Warrior Priest riles himself into a righteous fury.

desc.zh: 该战斗牧师的愤怒膨胀为正义的狂怒，向西格玛之敌唾以仇恨之咒
desc.en: Spitting words of hatred against Sigmar's enemies, the Warrior Priest riles himself into a righteous fury.

desc.zh: 战斗牧师的信仰化身为一道护盾，硬如城堡锻铁
desc.en: The Warrior Priest’s faith manifests in the form of a shield as hard as castle-forged steel.

desc.zh: 战斗牧师们念出战斗祷告，一层白色圣火包裹了他们全身，灼烧西格玛的敌人，却不会伤害祈求者自己
desc.en: A battle prayer that bathes the Warrior Priest in white, holy fire sears Sigmar’s foes but leaves the supplicant unharmed.

desc.zh: 这是能与战斗牧师相称的坐骑，牧师可以骑着它将西格玛的神圣咒法传播至辽远的彼方
desc.en: A worthy mount for Warrior Priests to spread Sigmar's divine lore far and wide.

desc.zh: 『我们为了皇帝上阵杀敌，更是为了伟大的西格玛，我们的救星，我们的主！』
desc.en: “We march to war for our Emperor, and Sigmar, our saviour and lord.”

desc.zh: 当在战场上遭遇无数敌军时，行省军能依靠的就只有帝国锻造的坚定之钢
desc.en: Honest Empire-forged steel is all a state trooper could ask when confronting the myriad foes in battle.

desc.zh: 矮人姑且不论，但肯定没有哪个其它种族能承受这些大炮毁灭性的齐射
desc.en: Despite what the Dwarfs think, no other race can bring to bear such devastating artillery volleys.

desc.zh: 为大型熔炉和铁匠铺提供赞助，就能换回更为坚固，更为耐久的战争机器
desc.en: Patrons of great forges and smiths expect, and are rewarded with, tougher and more enduring war machines.

desc.zh: 该领主令其部下进行手枪能手的训练，从而将他们锻炼成了真正的神射手
desc.en: This Lord expects his men to practice the disciplines of the Pistolkorps, and all be expert marksmen.

desc.zh: 这些战马为驰骋与战斗而生，但论起它们的立身之本，还得是风驰电掣的速度
desc.en: These steeds are bred for speed and war, but foremost it is their gallop which marks them out.

desc.zh: 诸神将通过我们的努力净化大地
desc.en: Through our acts, the gods will cleanse the lands.

desc.zh: 『你有想过加入选帝侯的军队吗，长官？你一定能成为一名优秀的士兵』
desc.en: "Ever thought about joining the Elector's troops, chief? You'd make a good soldier alright."

desc.zh: 该领主希望得到平民的绝对服从，这样他们就没时间策划暴动或小规模叛乱了
desc.en: This Lord expects utter obedience from the smallfolk, and has little time for insurrections or petty revolts.

desc.zh: 这位著名领袖深受大众的尊崇，大量的新兵便会因此加入他的麾下
desc.en: Revered by the masses, such a celebrated leader will inspire many new recruits.

desc.zh: 该领主及其部下皆精于军需统筹，因此即使在逆境中也能满足军队的需求
desc.en: Proficient with figures, this Lord, or his subordinates, can keep his army fulfilled, even in dire circumstances.

desc.zh: 一名优秀的军需官能有效率地配发装备和粮食，让补给能持续得更久
desc.en: A good quartermaster can ration equipment and foodstuffs efficiently, making supplies last longer.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 盖尔特久经沙场，他会骑乘着飞马在空中翱翔
desc.en: Gelt has appeared on many battlefields soaring overhead on his pegasus.

desc.zh: 没有谁会比脸戴黄金面具的盖尔特更精通金属系法术了
desc.en: No one is more accomplished in the Lore of Metal than the golden-masked Gelt.

desc.zh: 法师很少穿着护甲，而战马则能为他们提供一定程度的防护和速度
desc.en: While Wizards can rarely benefit from armour, a warhorse does offer some degree of protection and manoeuvrability.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 经过训练后，帝国狮鹫可以载人冲上战场。此时它们不仅是冷静的杀手，也对它的骑手极为忠诚
desc.en: Once trained to carry a man in battle, Imperial griffons are poised killers and incredibly dedicated to their riders.

desc.zh: 帝国飞马是高贵的带翼马，既聪明又忠诚
desc.en: An Imperial pegasus is a noble, winged steed, intelligent and loyal.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.zh: 『死亡之爪』是帝国最强大的狮鹫，他与弗兰兹皇帝创下了无数的传奇
desc.en: The bond between Franz and Deathclaw - the mightiest of Imperial Griffons - is legendary.

desc.zh: 皇帝经常骑乘一匹雄伟的帝国飞马登上战场
desc.en: The Emperor has oft ridden a majestic Imperial pegasus in battle.

desc.zh: 作为优秀的领袖，弗兰兹得到了万众的敬仰。不仅是他的近臣，就连庶民百姓也对其赞誉有加
desc.en: Franz is a sterling leader beloved by many, who can inspire not just those close, but all men.

desc.zh: 只有帝国马厩内的大型战马才配作为阿尔道夫亲王的坐骑
desc.en: A great charger from the Imperial stables is the only worthy steed for the Prince of Altdorf.

desc.zh: 猎巫人那经过三遍祝福的白银子弹将是对受诅咒之物的终审判决
desc.en: The Witch Hunter’s thrice-blessed silver bullets are the final judgement of the damned.

desc.zh: 猎巫人抬起一根手指，对着战场一挥，就能制裁一个异端者！
desc.en: The Witch Hunter levels his finger across the battlefield and accuses one of the enemy of arch-heresy!

desc.zh: 猎巫人是坚定而冷酷的角色，无论面对多么恐怖的局面都能面不改色
desc.en: A Witch Hunter is a stern, grim figure, that can rarely be rattled despite the horrors he faces.

desc.zh: 猎巫人私下收藏了许多受祝福的遗物，以防护魔法的攻击
desc.en: The Witch Hunter keeps many blessed relics on his person to protect him from magical attack.

desc.zh: 在攻击较大的怪物时，猎巫人拥有专门对付这些怪物的装备
desc.en: When attacking larger abominations, the Witch Hunter has the accoutrements to bring such beasts down.

desc.zh: 将军的战马是其最信赖也是最英勇的伙伴。只要别给它起名叫『小雏菊』就行
desc.en: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.

desc.en: An Imperial pegasus is a noble, winged steed, intelligent and loyal.

desc.en: While Wizards can rarely benefit from armour, a warhorse does offer some degree of protection and manoeuvrability.

desc.en: While Wizards can rarely benefit from armour, a warhorse does offer some degree of protection and manoeuvrability.

desc.zh: 你可千万别相信他。他这人有点woaah，呃，就是有点Waaagh！懂了没？就这么狡猾！
desc.en: You can’t trust ‘im. E’s a little bit woaah, a little bit Waaagh! Ya know? Well dodgy.

desc.zh: 『硬茬中的硬硬茬，给俺整明白点，懂？』
desc.en: "‘Ardest of da ‘Ard. Don’t mess, gottit?"

desc.zh: 咆哮者的怒吼大而且沉，可以轻易横穿整个战场，从而威慑手下小子们尽其所能地进行屠杀
desc.en: A Bellower’s voice is as deep as it loud, carrying across the battlefield, making sure the boyz are focused on the carnage.

desc.zh: 这个老大是个带着『小子们』的家伙，他会不断激励手下的小子们获取更大的胜利，并一刀砍下最值钱的头颅
desc.en: This Boss is one with "da boyz", egging the ladz on to greater feats and to hit bigga stuff with their choppas.

desc.zh: 这个老大掌握了『飞行的秘密』，因此砸了一大笔钱去维护他的战争机器，以便让这家伙飞得更高更远！
desc.en: This Boss realises the power of "flyin’ fings” and so invests a few teef in making sure his war machines can fling fings really far and really high!

desc.zh: 当这个外貌狰狞的家伙出现时，所有的敌军，上至将领下至士兵，莫不吓得战战兢兢
desc.en: Such is the might of this being that followers and foes alike will shrink back or cower in his intimidating presence.

desc.zh: 如果他们的坐骑能好好听话，那么绿皮骑兵将是一支非常恐怖的力量。至于如何驾驭它们，恐怕照着后屁股踢一脚，或者在坐骑前方绑个涂成胡萝卜状的地精，这就是诀窍了
desc.en: Greenskin cavalry can be devastating if the myriad mounts can behave. Getting a big stick and maybe a "carrot" in the form of an orange-painted gobbo is the answer!

desc.zh: 越大的砍刀，上面越是伤痕累累，这也是兽人老大们夸耀自己赫赫战功的方式。因此，就连他们的小子们也总会上行下效起来
desc.en: Bigga choppas are more hurty – that’s a well-known Orc-fact and one this Boss eulogises. So his ladz are all about hefty choppas.

desc.zh: 虽然大部分的老大都是玩砍刀的，但也有些老大发掘出了那些『细长拐棍』的潜力，因此他们手下的那些装备弓箭的小子们也就变得更『强大』了起来
desc.en: While most Bosses are all about the choppas, this git recognises the potential in "shooty stuff" and so works his arrer-armed mobs to be "betta".

desc.zh: 所谓的『地洞老大』，便是那些擅长在地下射击与嚎叫的绿皮，要知道那里的光线与空间都不太理想
desc.en: Tunnel bosses are Greenskins who are good at shoutin’ and hollerin’ at mobs when underground, where space and sight is an issue.

desc.zh: 明智的老大会知道如何将敌人引诱到容易设伏的敌方，或者将敌人引入挖掘了地道的地表上方
desc.en: A wise Boss knows how to lure the enemy into places where they can be ambushed or trapped with mobs that skulk in the tunnels below.

desc.zh: 『铁坨子』是那些特别强壮，特别粗犷的绿皮的称号，他们就算受了伤，也会在战场上奋力拼搏
desc.en: These iron-hard gits are particularly tough and gnarly Greenskins, who - even if wounded - will be up and ready to fight before too long.

desc.zh: 洗劫者们会把每一块金币，每一颗金牙都搜刮干净。就算只落下一个币子，他们也会顿足捶胸！
desc.en: Those that excel as looters make sure that every coin or gold tooth is found and added to the plunder. Woe betide the warrior that misses even a single copper token!

desc.zh: 要是手下的人够尽心，老大就没必要为帐篷跟床铺之类『无聊的事儿』去操心了，因为小的们会给收拾利索的
desc.en: A Boss that has the loyalty of the mobs means he doesn’t have to worry so much about "da boring stuff" like tents and bedding, as they’ll fight for him no matter what.

desc.zh: 一般来说，兽人们会喜欢跟着『更狡猾』的老大混，这样会有胜仗可打，也更容易得到升职
desc.en: Occasionally an Orc will come along who is more "kunning" than the rest. He quickly rises in ranks as his plans end in victory.

desc.zh: 掠夺者很擅长突袭敌方的城镇，赶走居民然后大肆劫掠一番
desc.en: Raiders are good at marauding through enemy settlements - sending their denizens fleeing as their properties are despoiled.

desc.zh: 毁灭者从不知怜悯为何物，他们会烧光敌人的城镇，抢走一切财物，并杀光所有敢于挡路的家伙
desc.en: Ravagers are merciless - they will sack an enemy settlement, take everything and kill any that get in their way.

desc.zh: 绿到流油，就意味着强到离谱！
desc.en: Being green meanz ya really mean.

desc.zh: 搞哥喜欢的家伙们知道该怎么直插敌人的内心，并会就此直插过去，直到敌人死绝了为止！
desc.en: Those blessed by Gork know the true path to the heart of the foe and will march along it until the enemy gits are caught!

desc.zh: 兽人的砍刀做工粗糙，经常被自己的主人卯足了蛮力进行挥舞。因此，砍刀的一次劈砍就足以斩下某个不长眼家伙的脑壳
desc.en: Orc choppas are crude and hefty blades usually swung with violent joy by their owner. A choppa in full swing can have a brutal, crunching impact on the poor fool on the receiving end.

desc.zh: 兽人的砍刀做工粗糙，经常被自己的主人卯足了蛮力进行挥舞。因此，砍刀的一次劈砍就足以斩下某个不长眼家伙的脑壳
desc.en: Orc choppas are crude and hefty blades usually swung with violent joy by their owner. A choppa in full swing can have a brutal, crunching impact on the poor fool on the receiving end.

desc.zh: 阿兹汗绝不容许内讧的发生，当他发号施令的时候，小子们必须『听老子的』，要不然就会死得很惨
desc.en: Azhag has no tolerance for infighting, when he issues an order the boyz must "get on wiv it" or pay with a particularly grisly death.

desc.zh: 嚼骨者便是阿兹汗的那条双足飞龙的名字，这家伙凶猛异常，除了这个屠灭者之外，怕是没有谁能够驾驭它吧
desc.en: Skullmuncha is Azhag’s wyvern - an incredibly vicious and temperamental beast that will only tolerate the Slaughterer on its back.

desc.zh: 若萨满既要隐匿行踪又要行动敏捷，那他就特别需要一头咆哮之狼
desc.en: If a Shaman wants to get especially sneaky an' nasty fast, he needs an especially growly Wolf.

desc.zh: 『俺憎恨一切！地精、尖耳朵、人类虾米、尖甲壳！还有矮垛子，俺最恨的就是他们！』
desc.en: "I 'ate everyfing - gobbos, da pointy ears, da humies, da spiky gits, and da stunties - I 'ate dem da mostest!"

desc.zh: 『说！认识俺不？认识俺不！』
desc.en: "Say my name! SAY MY NAME!"

desc.zh: 战猪是一种顽固而邪恶的动物，它脾气极坏、极度自负、极难揣测、极其危险、极难对付
desc.en: The war boar is a stubborn and vicious animal - an extremely tough beast that is notoriously bad tempered, loudly flatulent, unpredictable, and wholly dangerous.

desc.zh: 双足飞龙曾一度被误认为是龙，但是实际上，这些飞行兽类毫无尊贵可言，在这一点上，它们和那些兽族骑士倒是臭味相投
desc.en: Wyverns are occasionally mistaken for dragons but there is little nobility of spirit in these winged beasts, making them kindred spirits for their Orc riders.

desc.zh: 在这一法术的增益下，目标将变得非常疯狂，或是从出乎意料的角度接近对手
desc.en: The targets of this spell are driven to go right for the 'hurty bitz' or sneak up on opponents at unexpected angles.

desc.zh: 这位老大特别鬼祟，他可以在战斗开始前率军深入敌方小鬼的领地内
desc.en: This Boss is especially sneaky, able to deploy deep in enemy gits' terrain before battle.

desc.zh: 一次向蜘蛛之神献上鼻涕精献祭就能让老大获得一只可怕的坐骑
desc.en: A quick Snotling sacrifice to da Spider-god gets the boss a fearsome mount.

desc.zh: 『首领得到了最大的宠物，这是祭司说的』
desc.en: "Da Big Boss getz da biggest barka', nuff sed."

desc.zh: 像其他卑鄙潜伏者一样，这个老大是『创世神的次品』，此称号在他从背后袭击目标时尤为适合
desc.en: Like all nasty skulkers, dis Boss is "a bad piece o' work" – when he stabs he really means it.

desc.zh: 战猪是一种顽固而邪恶的动物，它脾气极坏、极度自负、极难揣测、极其危险、极难对付
desc.en: The war boar is a stubborn and vicious animal - an extremely tough beast that is notoriously bad tempered, loudly flatulent, unpredictable, and wholly dangerous.

desc.zh: 看起来，忍受这种苦恼的不仅是精灵啊？
desc.en: It's not just the Elves that suffer from this affliction then?

desc.zh: 虽然目已不可及，但其它感官却是畅通无阻
desc.en: Although the eyes do not see, the other senses remain open.

desc.zh: 只有可怜人的鲜血才能解决这个问题
desc.en: Only the blood of the wretch will settle this.

desc.zh: 『又是一场演说？好吧，它会很长么？』
desc.en: "Another speech? Very well… does it have to be so… lengthy?"

desc.zh: 『万众一心！我发誓，我绝不会抛弃你们，兄弟们！那么，你会加入我们吗？』
desc.en: "We stand together! I promise I will not leave your side, brothers! Will you join me?"

desc.zh: 此人的怒火如此炽热，难不成是恐虐亲手点燃在他的心中的吗？
desc.en: Does a rage as hot as Khorne's burn within?

desc.zh: 就算是喝醉了的食人魔，也比这家伙轻盈得多
desc.en: There are drunk Ogres more sure-footed than this one.

desc.zh: 这家伙要么是先天不足，要么是受了毁灭之力的影响，总之能长成这个德行，真可谓是一座肉体的监狱啊！
desc.en: Deformed from birth or made so by the Ruinous Powers, yet there is honour within the prison of flesh.

desc.zh: 『奸奇会对你很感兴趣的，木头人！』
desc.en: "Tzeentch will have so much fun with you, puppet!"

desc.zh: 『看那儿，鼻涕精撅起腚来了！』
desc.en: "Look! Over there – a Snotling showing its arse!"

desc.zh: 把一个傻瓜领到沟里很简单，把一个国王领到沟里的话，貌似更简单
desc.en: To trap a fool is easy; to trap a king… perhaps even easier.

desc.zh: 这个家伙油头粉面，因此相较那些长相平平的家伙来说，他更容易博取别人的信任
desc.en: Such chiselled good looks belie a confidence that a homely face cannot parse.

desc.zh: 荣誉便是一切！
desc.en: Honour is everything!

desc.zh: 谦逊的生物。赞美与对其善举的称颂会让他局促不安
desc.en: A humble creature, shamed by praise and thoughtful in their dealings.

desc.zh: 在这个血与剑的年代里，智慧可是一件非常珍贵的宝物
desc.en: In this age of blood and battle, intellect is an underrated gift.

desc.zh: 『优柔寡断，这可是你的敌人最为渴望的礼物』
desc.en: "To be crippled by indecision is to give your enemies an advantage."

desc.zh: 『仅凭我的力量是无法获得胜利的，所以让我们共同分享这一荣誉吧』
desc.en: "This victory is not mine alone, we all share in the glory."

desc.zh: 『报告长官，这人手没了』
desc.en: "This one is armless, sir."

desc.zh: 『不，我不是喝多了，只是腿脚不太灵光而已』
desc.en: "No, not drunk, just legless."

desc.zh: 『你为何如此自暴自弃？难道你不是国王，皇帝，甚至连勇士都不是吗？』
desc.en: "Why forlorn? Are you not a king, an emperor – a champion?"

desc.zh: 生于疆场，死于战殇
desc.en: Born in battle, dragged up in war.

desc.zh: 面无表情的人可以让人更为放心，或者更为糟心
desc.en: A calming presence can be a steadying hand… but also disquieting.

desc.zh: 快乐的气氛常伴此人，并会让属下们信心满满
desc.en: An assured air instils great confidence in your followers.

desc.zh: 这一丑陋的疤痕总是让人难于忘却
desc.en: Such an ugly scar is always memorable.

desc.zh: 看来这个老兵确实有过英雄壮举
desc.en: Clearly a veteran of some heroic deed.

desc.zh: 潜伏在阴影当中，然后偷偷跟上去，这就是此人的天性
desc.en: Skulk and sneak or shadow and stalk, theirs is a guileful nature.

desc.zh: 这个人曾经被朋友们一脚踹开，他只得挣扎着重拾荣誉了
desc.en: Spurned by his allies, this man will struggle to regain favour.

desc.zh: 就连大河巨魔都能与这家伙分享智慧
desc.en: Shares the intellect of a River Troll.

desc.zh: 或许这人是瘟父的某个造物？
desc.en: One of the Plaguefather's creations perhaps?

desc.zh: 虽然有些人会称之为果断，但是『强硬』这种品质该怎么说呢，利弊参半吧
desc.en: Others may call it decisive, but being uncompromising can be a weakness as well as a strength.

desc.zh: 无论是在陆地上骑乘他的战马，还是在海上执掌他的舰船，艾博里克的经验都不输给世间任何一位骑士
desc.en: Be it on land upon his steed or on the seas at the helm of his ship Alberic is as experienced as any Knight the world over.

desc.zh: 坦率、正直、毫无自满之心，劳恩国王无愧于女神冠军勇士中的最高尚者
desc.en: Chaste, honourable, and untainted by notions of self-aggrandisement, King Louen is the most virtuous of all the Lady's champions.

desc.zh: 这名骑士可谓佯攻与反击技巧的大师，他能不可思议地反转敌人的力量
desc.en: A master of the feint and riposte, this Knight's skill at turning an enemy's strength against them is legendary.

desc.zh: 骄傲、自豪、身怀绝技，这名骑士在身处逆境时绝不会后退半步
desc.en: Haughty, proud, and skilful, this Knight never takes a backward step in the face of adversity.

desc.zh: 无论身处怎样的逆境，这名骑士都会顽强地步入战场，直面数不清的敌军
desc.en: No matter the odds, this Knight takes to the field utterly undaunted by the numberless hordes of his enemies.

desc.zh: 作为伙伴骑士中的最忠诚者，这名骑士永远都会为了自己的主君而战
desc.en: Most loyal of Companions, this Knight fights always at the side of his Liege.

desc.zh: 即使是在面对最强悍的野兽时，这名骑士也会不屈不挠，并最终把它的脑袋挂在餐厅的墙壁上！
desc.en: Unbending even in the face of the greatest beasts, this Knight mounts their heads on the wall of his feasting chamber.

desc.zh: 无论是战技、武艺还是剑术与枪术，此人都堪称无可匹敌。至于勇敢、骑术与骑士道守则，此人也远在其他人之上
desc.en: This Knight's skill, prowess, and finesse with blade and lance are beyond compare; his bravery, horsemanship, and chivalry above all others.

desc.zh: 这名骑士的人生至乐便是冲锋在前，甚至冲在全军的最前方
desc.en: In the glory of the charge is this Knight most alive, ever in the forefront of battle.

desc.zh: 此人的枪术出神入化，无人能够将其打下马来
desc.en: So great is this Knight's skill with a lance that none can unhorse them.

desc.zh: 铁石的心肠，坚毅的性格，让这名骑士从不知屈服为何物。他的每次劈砍，每次穿刺，都会让敌人血流成河
desc.en: With a heart of stone and resolute temper this Knight stands unbowed, spilling the foe's blood with each sweep and thrust.

desc.zh: 对于那些回避了一对一单挑这一无上荣誉的胆小鬼而言，此人毫不掩饰他的蔑视
desc.en: This Knight has great contempt for those who eschew the martial values of meeting one's opponent face to face.

desc.zh: 虽然是隐居的骑士，但如果敬爱的国王发出了征召，他还是会上阵杀敌的
desc.en: A hermit-Knight, this one nevertheless always returns to fight for his beloved king.

desc.zh: 骑士的英勇感染着周围的战士，这让他们无不为之拼死奋战
desc.en: Steeled by this Knight's bravery, those around them fight with the courage of the Breton himself.

desc.zh: 『我便是那轴心，车轮绕我而转。就算是整个世界，也必将浸没在未诞之星的光芒中！』
desc.en: "I will be the axis upon which the wheel of change turns, and the world will drown in the light of unborn stars."

desc.zh: 啊，何等的奇观啊！天哪！多么可怕的奇迹！
desc.en: Oh, horrific wonder! Vile awe! Such hateful majesty!

desc.zh: 『在我再次休眠之前，整个世间定将化为一片火海！』
desc.en: "The whole world will burn before I rest again."

desc.zh: 『很明显，这种煽动行为在西格瓦尔德面前简直就是雕虫小技！』
desc.en: "Surely such sedition should sour and succumb to Sigvald!"

desc.zh: 这位勇敢的矮人可以将血脉追溯到葛林姆尼尔，即英雄之神的身上去
desc.en: This brave Dawi can trace his lineage back to Grimnir, the Warrior God.

desc.zh: 这位勤奋的矮人可以将血脉追溯到葛朗尼，即矿业与铁匠之神的身上
desc.en: This industrious Dawi can trace his lineage back to Grungni, God of Mines and Smiths.

desc.zh: 这位忠诚的矮人可以将血脉追溯到瓦拉雅，即治愈与守护之神的身上
desc.en: This loyal Dawi can trace his lineage back to Valaya, Goddess of Healing and Protection.

desc.zh: 矮人的斧头是此人骄傲与快乐的源泉，但是如果一个敌对家族拥有更为辉煌的武器，又会怎么样呢？
desc.en: A Dwarf's az is his pride and joy, but what if a Dawi from a rival Clan has a more storied weapon?

desc.zh: 『这就是我，至高王的谕旨！群山王国万岁！』
desc.en: "This is my edict as High King! Khazukan Kazakit-ha!"

desc.zh: 『给我带来胜利，带来死亡！』
desc.en: "Bring me victory, bring me death!"

desc.zh: 『虔门之风已经吹起，它将消灭挡在我面前的任何敌人！』
desc.en: "The Wind of Chamon will rise and blast any who get in my way!"

desc.zh: 『我们的名字将被我们的人民长久歌颂下去，直至世界的末日！』
desc.en: "Our names will be remembered in our people's songs until the end of time!"

desc.zh: 目睹阿兹汗砍下敌人的脑袋，并使用不属于兽人的骇人咒术来扭转战局之后，他的手下无不欢欣鼓舞
desc.en: Azhag’s mobs take inspiration from seeing him lop off enemy heads and use horrific, un-Orcish spells to turn the tide of battle.

desc.zh: 『这逼的砍刀比老子的大！』
desc.en: "Dere choppa's bigga dan mine."

desc.zh: 『俺看到的玩意，就都是俺的！』
desc.en: "Everyfing I see is mine."

desc.zh: 『他娘的，这货的长矛比老子的长！』
desc.en: "Dat stabba is longa dan mine!"

desc.zh: 与同类相比起来，有些吸血鬼很有修习亡灵巫术的天赋
desc.en: Some Vampires have an affinity for Necromantic magic beyond their peers.

desc.zh: 『那些食尸鬼，他们正为你而聚集。去随意指引他们吧！』
desc.en: "They flock to you – the ghoul-kind. Direct them as you will."

desc.zh: 『你和你的主人，不过是死亡时代的粉尘而已』
desc.en: "You and your masters are desiccated relics of a dead age."

desc.zh: 与同类相比起来，有些吸血鬼很有修习亡灵巫术的天赋
desc.en: Some Vampires have an affinity for Necromantic magic beyond their peers.

desc.zh: 只有最饥渴的亡灵生物才会响应这一召唤
desc.en: Only the direst of all Undead creatures will come to this summons.

desc.zh: 这个领主一旦出现，追随者就会感到安心，从而安抚军心并降低开小差的概率
desc.en: The presence of this Lord ensures a measure of calm, reducing panic and desertion amongst followers.

desc.zh: 利用死亡之力本身来阻挡生者世界的力量
desc.en: Whereby the power of death itself is used to hold back the physical world.

desc.zh: 骷髅战马披着精美的盔甲，这是何等震撼人心却又危险万分的景象
desc.en: Skeletal Steeds draped in fine armour make for an impressive and dangerous sight.

desc.zh: 尸妖王需要坐骑，但他们讨厌活马，于是他们找来了死马
desc.en: Wight Kings require the steeds that bore them in life, and will do again in death.

desc.zh: 梦魇兽通常戴着沉重的头饰或身披厚重的锁子甲
desc.en: Nightmares are often clad in heavy barding or wear caparisons of thick chainmail.

desc.zh: 地狱战马十分凶猛。涉猎束缚野兽知识的吸血鬼很高兴能让这些野兽服从他们的意志
desc.en: Hellsteeds are vicious. Vampires that dabble in the binding of beasts delight in breaking these wild creatures to their will.

desc.zh: 这位亡灵之主施放的支配光辉，足以削弱最坚定的凡间生物的意志
desc.en: This Lord of Undeath projects an aura of dominion that can wilt the most iron-willed mortals.

desc.zh: 『吾乃至强之人，谁敢决一死战！』
desc.en: "I am mighty, none dare challenge me!"

desc.zh: 领主向夜空发出吼叫，并听到了各种黑暗生物回应的嚎叫声
desc.en: The Lord howls out into the night, and is answered by the baying of dark creatures.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼与黑暗诸神立下黑暗契约，来保障他的胜利
desc.en: A dark pact has been made with darker Gods to guarantee victory.

desc.zh: 黑暗本身就是对所谓骑士誓言的嘲讽，而亡灵领主会追随战士的脚步前往最终时刻
desc.en: The Undead Lord has followed the warrior's path to its ultimate conclusion, in a dark mockery of a Knight's vow.

desc.zh: 这些邪恶灵魂渴望让凡间生物血肉横飞，它们会一直加速前进，直到发现新鲜的猎物为止
desc.en: Such evil spirits are desperate to spill mortal blood, and will speed along until they find some flesh to carve.

desc.zh: 黑魔法施术者可以变成蝙蝠，克服重力的限制飞向空中
desc.en: The Dark Magic-user can take to the skies, defying gravity by metamorphosing into a bat.

desc.zh: 『来吧，吾之大军，吾之亡灵奴仆，为吾带来胜利吧！』
desc.en: "Arise my host, my Unliving minions – bring me victory!"

desc.zh: 吸血鬼唤醒了古代死者的可怕遗骸，以此补足麾下低等领民的不足之处
desc.en: Vampires summon forth the gruesome remains of the ancient dead to bolster the masses of lesser minions under their control.

desc.zh: 这些存活多年的生物，其狡诈程度绝非凡人所能相比
desc.en: Such long-lived creatures develop a level of guile that mortals cannot match.

desc.zh: 强大而精力充沛的黑暗领主，将见证暗夜之子云集麾下的那一刻
desc.en: A powerful, vigorous Lord of Darkness will see the Children of the Night gather unto them.

desc.zh: 太阳不是亡灵的盟友。只有焦黑的天空或者最黑暗的夜晚，才能让亡灵一族精力旺盛
desc.en: The sun is no ally of the dead - a sky scorched black, or darkest night, will invigorate the Unliving.

desc.zh: 该领主有着无限的耐性，这种摆脱了时间束缚的耐性已经持续了上千年之久
desc.en: This Lord has endless forbearance, a timeless patience crafted over millennia.

desc.zh: 这是能将丑陋的吸血鬼或巫妖伪装起来的简单魔力，这样他就能潜入凡间诱惑和欺骗当地的人类
desc.en: A simple glamour can disguise a monstrous Vampire or Liche, so they may then charm and beguile the local populace.

desc.zh: 这样的怪物几乎不可能被消灭，它注定会令恐惧永久地萦绕在敌人心头！
desc.en: Such a beast is all but impossible to destroy - an immortal horror doomed to haunt eternity!

desc.zh: 伍索兰的子孙是死灵艺术的大师。能得到涉猎这方面的奴仆，真可谓是一种恩惠
desc.en: W'soran's scions are masters at the art of Necromancy, to dabble in such will be a boon.

desc.zh: 巫术奴仆领主的军队不会感到疲惫，它们可以不受体力限制地行走无数里格
desc.en: A Lord of Necromancy's minions do not suffer exhaustion, they can walk for leagues and never suffer.

desc.zh: 这位领主可以知道数里格外的人类在想什么，并且根据这些情报来制订计划
desc.en: This Lord can hear the thoughts of mortals for leagues around, and plan accordingly.

desc.zh: 阵亡的敌人会归亡灵领主所有：他们会被复生，并自愿为新主人效劳
desc.en: Once slain in battle, the foe belongs to the Undead Lord, and will rise again, eager to serve.

desc.zh: 『看着我的眼睛，凡人。是不是看到什么美好的东西了？』
desc.en: "Look into mine eyes, mortal; what glories do you see?"

desc.zh: 这位吸血鬼的力量已持续了数世纪之久，绝非凡夫俗子能比
desc.en: The strength of this Vampire to endure the centuries is beyond compare.

desc.zh: 这位吸血鬼的力量已持续了数世纪之久，绝非凡夫俗子能比
desc.en: The strength of this Vampire to endure the centuries is beyond compare.

desc.zh: 『看到我的猩红护甲了吗？你们的鲜血和恐惧会让它变得更强』
desc.en: "See my coat of crimson armour? It is strengthened by thine blood and fear."

desc.zh: 打得准，打得狠
desc.en: Strike true; strike hard.

desc.zh: 打得准，打得狠
desc.en: Strike true; strike hard.

desc.zh: 在吸血鬼的非凡速度前，凡人的挥剑显得既笨拙又幼稚
desc.en: The sword-strikes of mortal man are but clumsy, childish lunges before the preternatural speed of a Vampire.

desc.zh: 在吸血鬼的非凡速度前，凡人的挥剑显得既笨拙又幼稚
desc.en: The sword-strikes of mortal man are but clumsy, childish lunges before the preternatural speed of a Vampire.

desc.zh: 当目视这位亡灵领主时，你就会见识到真正和绝对的恐怖！
desc.en: To look upon this Undead Lord is to witness true and absolute horror!

desc.zh: 黑暗之术的『学徒』？恰恰相反，这个吸血鬼堪称黑魔法与巫术的大师！
desc.en: This one is no apprentice in the black arts but a master of Necromancy and Dark Magic.

desc.zh: 曼弗雷德骑乘着一头从肉到骨都被污染的披甲战马，这匹恶心的马又被称为『梦魇兽』
desc.en: Mannfred can ride an armoured steed of defiled flesh and bone; such an abominable horse is known as a 'Nightmare'.

desc.zh: 地狱战马是带翼的梦魇兽。曼弗雷德骑乘这只震撼人心的怪物，将恐惧播撒至敌人阵中
desc.en: Hellsteeds are winged Nightmares. Mannfred may ride such an impressive creature to the horror of his foes.

desc.zh: 精通死亡系法术的吸血鬼，会对死亡之风沙许拥有超乎常人的理解
desc.en: None know better the secrets of Shyish, the Wind of Death, than those who have mastered its Lore.

desc.zh: 龙的尸体在空中复生，扇动着破碎的翅膀，还带着邪恶的魔法。这正是吸血鬼领主理想的坐骑
desc.en: The corpse of a Dragon born aloft on tattered wings and evil sorcery - a fitting mount for the Lord of Vampires.

desc.zh: 不只是吸血鬼能驾驭这种残忍暴烈的亡灵战马，某些亡灵法师也同样拥有这种力量
desc.en: It is not just Vampires that can tame a fierce, barded Undead steed - some Necromancers have such power too.

desc.zh: 亡灵法师能召唤地狱战马，这是一种带翼的梦魇兽，并载着他们前往想到达的地方
desc.en: Necromancers may summon a Hellsteed, a winged Nightmare, to take them wherever they wish.

desc.zh: 最让人印象深刻的梦魇兽是用鲜血作为饲料的。这种高贵的巨兽是理想的坐骑
desc.en: The most impressive Nightmares are those reared on fresh blood. Such noble monstrosities are worthy mounts.

desc.zh: 『过来，我最亲爱的飞马。让我们在空中翱翔，共同缔造新的世界吧！』
desc.en: "To me, my winged steed of bone and flesh; let us fly and remake the world together!"

desc.zh: 吸血鬼领主前往骸骨平原，并让一头僵尸龙成为了坐骑
desc.en: It is to the Plain of Bones that a Vampire Lord travels to claim a Zombie Dragon as their mount.

desc.zh: 女妖的哭号声不仅致命，而且还能将恐惧灌输到听者的心中
desc.en: The wails of a Banshee can be lethal and strike terror into the hearts of any who hear them.

desc.zh: 黑暗之术的『学徒』？恰恰相反，这个吸血鬼堪称黑魔法与巫术的大师！
desc.en: This one is no apprentice in the black arts but a master of Necromancy and Dark Magic.

desc.zh: 能召唤出梦魇兽的亡灵法师，绝不是黑魔法的外行人
desc.en: A Necromancer that can summon a Nightmare is no amateur in the black arts.

desc.zh: 当格瑞姆布林戴尔集结将士时，周边的矮人们都会响应这位现世先祖，并甘心为其而战
desc.en: When Grombrindal musters the throngs, Dawi from leagues around will come to honour and fight for the living Ancestor.

desc.zh: 许多矮人都很羡慕格瑞姆布林戴尔的光亮白胡须，甚至连敌人都会为这帅气的胡子而倾倒！
desc.en: Grombrindal’s lustrous white beard is the envy of many a Dwarf. Such fine whiskers can transfix and befuddle any foe!

desc.zh: 矮人速度并不快，但他们有迎难而上的精神，不管前路有多么凶险
desc.en: Dwarfs are not fast, yet they will soldier on, always moving despite any hazards encountered.

desc.zh: 『你究竟是个真正的矮人，还是个长了胡子的精灵？只是个小擦伤罢了，给我站起来！』
desc.en: You some kind of bearded Elf or a true Dawi? That’s just a scratch, get up!”

desc.zh: 复仇时代已经开始。为了群山王国的利益，先祖诸神必须行动起来！
desc.en: It is the Age of Reckoning; the Ancestor Gods must act now for the good of the Karaz Ankor.

desc.zh: 很少有人能够活得像白矮人这么长。无论是矮人、人类还是精灵，还能有谁会比他更有经验呢？
desc.en: Few have lived as long as the White Dwarf. Can any Dawi, umgi or even elgi rival such experience?

desc.zh: 『现在正是发动突袭的时刻！』
desc.en: "The time to strike is now!"

desc.zh: 虽然每个矮人都在不懈地追求他们的目标，但格瑞姆布林戴尔的决心仍旧是出了名的不可动摇
desc.en: While all Dwarfs are relentless in their goals – never slowing or slouching – Grombrindal’s determination is on another level altogether.

desc.zh: 在现世先祖的保护下，熔炉燃烧了起来，行会的人们开始了工作，金钱滚滚地开始了流通
desc.en: Once the forges burn, under the protection of a living Ancestor, the Guilds put their folk to work. Riches quickly follow.

desc.zh: 『无论是你还是你的随从，全都得死！这便是我的誓言，我的至亲葛林姆尼尔将亲自见证！』
desc.en: "You and your followers will die - that is my oath as my kin, Grimnir, is witness!"

desc.zh: 啸聚成群的亡灵，将发挥出比散落凌乱的亡灵更强的战斗力
desc.en: The Undead whole is always stronger than the sum of its parts.

desc.zh: 夜行鬼怪躲避阳光，嗜血如命
desc.en: Nocturnal spectres hiding from the light, addicted to your blood.

desc.zh: 邪魔振翅飞翔，黑暗的翅膀遮住了月亮，呼唤我们随之共舞…
desc.en: Evil takes flight; blotting out the moon on blackened wings, calling us to the dance…

desc.zh: 黑暗潜藏在我们每个人的体内，释放着我们的欲望与贪婪
desc.en: The darkness within us all, given free rein to lust and gorge eternally.

desc.zh: 『复苏吧，我的朋友们，复苏吧！血肉虽然可贵，但灵魂的价值却远超万物！』
desc.en: “Rise, my friends, rise. Flesh and blood has its place, but spirit is the prize valued above all other.”

desc.zh: 最让人印象深刻的梦魇兽是用鲜血作为饲料的。这种高贵的巨兽是理想的坐骑
desc.en: The most impressive Nightmares are those reared on fresh blood. Such noble monstrosities are worthy mounts.

desc.zh: 『过来，我最亲爱的飞马。让我们在空中翱翔，共同缔造新的世界吧！』
desc.en: "To me, my winged steed of bone and flesh; let us fly and remake the world together!"

desc.zh: 阿萨芙的巨大古墓城市的弓箭手们是有史以来最为强大的射手，他们的凶猛齐射可以彻底摧毁面前的敌方军阵
desc.en: The archers of the magnificent Tomb City of Asaph are the finest who ever died; their orchestrated volleys can devastate the ranks ranged against them.

desc.zh: 一旦形势需要，绑定了强大冠军勇士灵魂的乌沙比特便会应强大咒法的召唤苏醒过来，时刻准备执行其永恒的使命
desc.en: In times of need, the Ushabti – bound with the souls of powerful champions – are awakened through powerful incantations, ready to fulfil their eternal duty.

desc.zh: 咧嘴氏族的神圣次元石，用来执行它的战士们的冷酷与恶毒的计划，从而人挡杀人，佛挡杀佛
desc.en: Clan Rictus' sacred Warpstones capitalise on the grim, vicious determination of its warriors to take on all comers and win.

desc.zh: 裹挟着黄沙的旋风形成一道迷雾之纱，将施法者的军队包裹起来，以防敌军发现
desc.en: A shroud of swirling sand is conjured to screen the spellcaster's forces from the enemy.

desc.zh: 亡灵虫群们会把当面之敌消灭得一干二净
desc.en: The Undying swarm obliterates all in its path.

name.zh: 灵魂国度乌沙比特启动

desc.zh: 一旦形势需要，绑定了强大冠军勇士灵魂的乌沙比特便会应强大咒法的召唤苏醒过来，时刻准备执行其永恒的使命
desc.en: In times of need, the Ushabti – bound with the souls of powerful champions – are awakened through powerful incantations, ready to fulfil their eternal duty.

desc.zh: 豺狼头之神的现身会让接受赐福者的武器变得极度渴望生者的灵魂
desc.en: The essence of the Jackal-headed God imbues the bearer's weapons with an insatiable hunger for the souls of the living.

desc.zh: 粗糙而呼啸的沙漠之风切割着万事万物，无论是护甲、衣物，还是粗糙的皮肤
desc.en: The harsh, howling desert winds cut through everything, be it armour or clothing or raw flesh.

desc.zh: 跨越死亡之墙，带回灵魂并绑定他们，这需要不小的技巧；但正如万事万物一样，所谓熟能生巧嘛！
desc.en: Reaching behind the wall of death to bring back the soul and bind it to you takes skill, but like anything, practice makes perfect!

desc.zh: 这并不是逃跑，而是知晓何时何地才能将优势最大化的策略
desc.en: It's not running away. It's knowing when and where to be to secure the best advantage.

desc.zh: 『这只是个开始！当亡灵大法师回归时，这里的一切都将粉身碎骨！』
desc.en: "This is just the beginning. When the Great Necromancer returns, all around will be laid waste!"

desc.zh: 当心蝎子的蛰刺！它藏在黄沙之下，却是随时准备着突然一击
desc.en: Beware the scorpion's sting, hidden 'neath the desert sands yet always poised to strike.

desc.zh: 意志超脱死亡的人，可以让自己的攻击远达坟墓之外，并造成毁灭性的破坏
desc.en: He whose will transcends death can strike out from beyond the grave, to devastating effect.

desc.zh: 聚集由魔法捏合而成的军队，这需要钢铁般的意志与超自然的力量
desc.en: It takes an iron will and unnatural - supernatural - strength to rally bound troops routed by magical means.

desc.zh: 聚集由魔法捏合而成的军队，这需要钢铁般的意志与超自然的力量
desc.en: It takes an iron will and unnatural - supernatural - strength to rally bound troops routed by magical means.

desc.zh: 无人能够逃避这个可怕的诅咒，绝无逃脱的可能；那些被他所抓住的人，定将永远陷入诅咒之中
desc.en: There is no evading this terrible malediction, and no escape; those caught in its clutches are execrated for eternity.

desc.zh: 阿萨芙女神的治愈之触抚摸着卡莉达的躯体，并将其变成了充满强烈憎意的致命亡灵
desc.en: The Asp Goddess healing touch floods Khalida's body, permeating the husk of her corpse and snapping her back to vital, vengeful Unlife.

desc.zh: 石柱底部的力量，几乎无可撼动的神力
desc.en: The strength at the base of the pillar; a near-immovable force.

desc.zh: 崔特思是个利用他人弱点的天才，他的军队绝不会出现在你希望他们出现的地方，而是不出则已，一出就毁天灭地
desc.en: A master of exploiting others' weaknesses, Tretch and his band are never where you expect them and always where they can do most damage.

desc.zh: 无论卡莉达于何时苏醒，阿萨芙女神的力量都会流遍她的躯体，将生命与力量注入她的木乃伊遗骸，令她可以击败自己的敌人
desc.en: Whenever Khalida awakens, the power of the Asp Goddess floods her body, infusing life and power into her mummified remains so that she may defeat her enemies.

desc.zh: 全方位的无可战胜与无可匹敌，这便是塞特拉的力量！他永远不会回到自己的石棺之中！
desc.en: Inalienable and unassailable in all things, Settra's strength is such that he never needs to return to his sarcophagus.

desc.zh: 这种强烈的憎恨会传染四方，也会无可逃避
desc.en: Hatred this strong is infectious, contagious, and inescapable.

desc.zh: 『灵魂国度』是尼赫喀拉尊崇的死后世界。逝去的战士们从此处应召而出，重新附着在凡世遗骸上并再度登上战场
desc.en: From within the Realm of Souls – Nehekhara’s revered afterlife – deceased warriors are called forth and bound to mortal remains, to find purpose once again through war.

desc.zh: 战死的英灵们自灵魂国度中应召而出，重新附着在肉身上，并如在世时一般继续为古墓王而战
desc.en: The spirits of warriors slain can be summoned from the Realm of Souls and bound to corporeal bodies, so that they may fight for the Tomb Kings as they did in life.

desc.zh: 巫妖祭司使用尼赫喀拉诸神的气息抵达灵魂国度，取回战死士兵们的灵魂并将其重新绑定，从而令其得以永远效忠于古墓王的意志
desc.en: The Liche Priests use the very breath of Nehekhara’s gods to reach into the Realm of Souls, retrieving the spirits of dead soldiers for binding and eternal service to their Tomb King’s will.

desc.zh: 这面月亮形状的护符能够向敌方的防御倾泻破坏性的魔力
desc.en: This moon-shaped amulet projects a disruptive magical energy onto the enemy's defences.

desc.zh: 沙漠理应成为你的外套…以及敌人的夺命符
desc.en: The desert itself shall be your coat... and the foe's undoing.

desc.zh: 只要轻轻抿一口这种药剂，饮用者的身躯里便会充满可与无数精英战士媲美的强大力量
desc.en: One sip of the elixir fills the body of its drinker with the strength of many powerful, elite warriors.

desc.zh: 这个简陋的陶俑可能没什么起眼之处，但高阶祭司的不死本质却是被封存其中，从而可以起到阻挠巫法，强化咒术的作用
desc.en: The simple clay vessel may not look like much, but the High Priest's Undying essence within can thwart sorcery and strengthen incantations.

desc.zh: 这个贴着魔法封印，刻着强大符咒的骨瓮中装着一位巫妖祭司的遗骸，从而可让持有者施放属于此人的所有魔法能量
desc.en: Sealed and bound with powerful glyphs, this jar contains the remains of a Liche Priest and all the magical energy at his command.

name.zh: 奈法瑞特的极效术卷轴

desc.zh: 这八张魔法卷轴中记载了奈法瑞特毕生所学的结晶，它可以召唤一阵不可遏制的飓风来撕碎敌人
desc.en: These eight magical scrolls, containing the sum total of Neferra's lifetime of learning, can whip up an unstoppable hurricane of power to crush the foe.

desc.zh: 这根魔法权杖是来自于吸血鬼曼德拉甘的战利品，它能够允许持有者随心所欲地操纵魔法之风
desc.en: This magical staff was plucked from the clutches of the Vampire Mandregan; it enables its bearer to channel the Winds of Magic to his whim.

desc.zh: 在转生之后，塞特拉大帝的王冠早已超越了先前的礼仪作用，他会将不朽大帝的强烈意志直接注入到周围战士的脑海中
desc.en: In Undeath, Settra's crown transcends its original ceremonial purpose to imbue nearby warriors with the Imperishable's all-pervading, unalterable will.

desc.zh: 这件附魔头盔由被斩下的敌人头颅制成，它保护着崔特思免受所有攻击的伤害，管它是魔法的还是物理的！
desc.en: This charmed helmet, fashioned from the skull of a slaughtered foe, protects Tretch from blows of all kinds, be they physical or magical.

desc.zh: 这件华丽的板甲上装饰着巨蝎之神的形象，它的庇护之力遍及整件金属护甲，并为穿戴者提供额外的防护
desc.en: These ornate armour plates are decorated with the likeness of the Scorpion God; his protective energies pervade the very metal used, offering additional protection to the wearer.

desc.zh: 这件强大的护具里面灌输着来自太阳的强烈光芒，它能够直接致盲敌人的双眼
desc.en: Infused with the sun's dazzling intensity, the power harnessed within gleams brilliantly, blinding the wearer's opponents.

desc.zh: 狂暴的旋风卷起利如刀割的沙尘暴，狠狠地撕裂敌人
desc.en: A violent vortex that whips up a cloud of razor-sharp desert sand to lacerate and consume the foe.

desc.zh: 这是传说中的纳迦什《九卷书》中的一卷，它是亡灵术最重要的源泉之一
desc.en: One of the fabled nine Books of Nagash, this tome is one of the most potent sources of Necromantic magic in existence.

desc.zh: 即使你能撑过爆炸，但随之而来的毒雾仍然可以要了你的小命
desc.en: Even if you survive the explosion, a surge of noxious fumes follows in its deadly wake.

desc.zh: 佩特拉之怒的神圣火焰会直接灼烧那些胆敢站在此人前方的仆从
desc.en: The heavenly fire of Ptra's rage, directed at those who dare stand against his servants.

desc.zh: 对那些拥有坚定意志的人来说，死亡并不是什么障碍
desc.en: Death is no obstacle to those with unalterable, unassailable determination.

desc.zh: 在此人死亡之时，他会造成如昆虫叮咬一般的效果，从而令击杀他的敌人受到犹如万箭穿心般的伤害
desc.en: Like an insect sting at the point of death, striking out at the killer, sapping their strength as if shot by a thousand arrows.

desc.zh: 此法可令死者不再继续安息，而是会挺尸而起成为抽搐不止、浑身作响的亡灵
desc.en: By which the dead don't stay that way for long, springing back into jerking, clanking Unlife.

desc.zh: 巫师的乌木法杖一指向目标，肮脏的法术便会开始汲取它的灵魂
desc.en: The Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, leeching its spirit through tainted sorcery.

desc.zh: 尼赫喀拉之剑附注着死神的精华，它会以超自然的神力为狄迦夫收割灵魂
desc.en: Imbued with the essence of the God of Death, the Nehekharans' blades strike with supernatural force to harvest souls for Djaf.

name.en: Djaf's Incantation of Cursed Blades Upgraded

desc.zh: 尼赫喀拉之剑附注着死神的精华，它会以超自然的神力为狄迦夫收割灵魂
desc.en: Imbued with the essence of the God of Death, the Nehekharans' blades strike with supernatural force to harvest souls for Djaf.

desc.zh: 随着佩特拉的妻子挺身而出，捍卫尼赫喀拉的战士们远离邪恶的侵袭，挥舞的利剑会被神秘地折返方向
desc.en: Sword-blows are mysteriously turned away as Ptra's wife reaches out to shield Nehekhara's warriors from evil.

desc.zh: 随着佩特拉的妻子挺身而出，捍卫尼赫喀拉的战士们远离邪恶的侵袭，挥舞的利剑会被神秘地折返方向
desc.en: Sword-blows are mysteriously turned away as Ptra's wife reaches out to shield Nehekhara's warriors from evil.

desc.zh: 当此段咒文得以吟诵时，亡灵的空眼洞内会射出剧烈的激光，从而令其能够以超自然的速度与怒气进行战斗
desc.en: When the verses are spoken, a fierce light emanates from the Undead's empty eye-sockets, enabling them to strike with supernatural speed and fury.

name.en: Ptra's Incantation of Righteous Smiting Upgraded

desc.zh: 当此段咒文得以吟诵时，亡灵的空眼洞内会射出剧烈的激光，从而令其能够以超自然的速度与怒气进行战斗
desc.en: When the verses are spoken, a fierce light emanates from the Undead's empty eye-sockets, enabling them to strike with supernatural speed and fury.

name.zh: 塞霍姆特的骸骨风暴咒

desc.zh: 颅骨的旋风匆匆划过战场，以绿月女神愤懑而怀恨的名义扫灭一切当面之敌
desc.en: A whirlwind of skulls tears across the battlefield, devouring all in its path in the Goddess of the Green Moon's bitter, vindictive name.

name.zh: 高级塞霍姆特的骸骨风暴咒
name.en: Sakhmet's Incantation of the Skullstorm Upgraded

desc.zh: 颅骨的旋风匆匆划过战场，以绿月女神愤懑而怀恨的名义扫灭一切当面之敌
desc.en: A whirlwind of skulls tears across the battlefield, devouring all in its path in the Goddess of the Green Moon's bitter, vindictive name.

desc.zh: 对于乌瑟霍普的不幸受害者，它的每个音节都会脱干此人身体的水分，抽净此人躯干的精力
desc.en: Every syllable strips moisture and saps vitality from the bodies of Usekhp's unfortunate victims.

name.zh: 高级乌瑟霍普的干枯咒

desc.zh: 对于乌瑟霍普的不幸受害者，它的每个音节都会脱干此人身体的水分，抽净此人躯干的精力
desc.en: Every syllable strips moisture and saps vitality from the bodies of Usekhp's unfortunate victims.

desc.zh: 祈唤乌西里安之名时，骷髅之手会从沙海之下伸出，将敌人拖进他们的坟墓
desc.en: As the names of Usirian are invoked, skeletal hands burst forth from beneath the sand to drag the foe to their graves.

name.zh: 高级乌西里安的复仇咒

desc.zh: 祈唤乌西里安之名时，骷髅之手会从沙海之下伸出，将敌人拖进他们的坟墓
desc.en: As the names of Usirian are invoked, skeletal hands burst forth from beneath the sand to drag the foe to their graves.

desc.zh: 这是真正的死亡之雨！一阵颅骨暴雨以足以打碎骨头的力道砸来，致命的骨片猛地四散开去
desc.en: It’s raining death! A deadly rain of skulls comes down with bone-shattering force, sending lethal splinters flying in all directions.

desc.zh: 魂棺周围的魔法力量会允许巫妖祭司们将它的一部分能量添加进自己的咒法内
desc.en: The magical power surrounding the Casket of Souls allows the Liche Priests to infuse their incantations with a portion of its energy.

desc.zh: 一场血战中有人一起并肩作战总是备感安心
desc.en: In the midst of a bloodbath it's good to know that someone has your back.

desc.zh: 作为凡间世界与灵魂国度的链接渠道，神圣泰坦会将巫妖祭司咒法的力量大幅增强
desc.en: As a channel between the mortal world and the Realm of Souls, a Hierotitan amplifies the Liche Priest’s incantations.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 维系这些物体的黑魔法已经烟消云散。随着亡灵术的力量消失殆尽，沙地上除了一堆钢铁与骨骼之外再也不会剩下什么了
desc.en: The Dark Magic that holds these subjects together has failed. As the Necromantic energy flows out of them, nothing is left but a pile of iron and bones in the sand.

desc.zh: 在尼赫喀拉最深处的诅咒沙漠中，死者很难得到真正的安息。那些被刨出坟墓的哀号的亡灵们，只能永远被古墓王所束缚，并为他们终身效命
desc.en: In the blasted desert of deepest Nehekhara, the dead rarely remain so. Those dragged back to screaming, clanking Unlife are bound forever to the Tomb King whose will they exist only to serve.

desc.zh: 瑟提普国王的华丽弧形剑，闪动着足以切裂敌人护甲的蓝光
desc.en: The very late King Setep's ornate, curved sword shimmers with a blue hue that shatters the foe's armour.

desc.zh: 这把剑受到了太阳神佩特拉的祝福，它的每一次挥舞都会让敌人饱尝尼赫喀拉沙漠炙烤的无情滋味
desc.en: This blade, blessed by the Ptra the Sun God, channels the baking heat of the unforgiving Nehekharan desert into each deadly blow it makes.

desc.zh: 那些被阿克汉的致命宝剑攻击到的人将首先被烧成可怕的骷髅，然后永远屈从于他本人的意志
desc.en: Those struck by Arkhan's deadly blade are charred to skeletons and then bound to his will forever.

desc.zh: 这根法杖传导着阿萨芙的邪恶怒气，将其化为致命的射线直指敌人
desc.en: This staff channels Asaph's spiteful anger into a deadly beam that spews forth onto the foe.

desc.zh: 这柄古老法杖上刻满了尼赫喀拉诸神的名字，这也让法杖的铜柄内充满了他们的力量
desc.en: The inscriptions on this ancient staff name Nehekhara's many gods and goddesses, whose quiescent power is contained within its copper shaft.

desc.zh: 丛丛荆棘缠绕着敌人，将它们覆盖在干燥、易燃的树叶上
desc.en: A thicket of briars will entangle the enemy, covering them in dry, flammable foliage.

desc.zh: 射击上弦只在一瞬间便可完成，这便是阿瓦隆勇士们扬名立万的资本
desc.en: The warriors of Avelorn are famed for their ability to fire and reload in the blink of an eye.

desc.zh: 记载恐惧咒语的卷轴，用最糟糕的噩梦生生占据敌人的思维！
desc.en: A scroll describing a dread spell that fills the foes' minds with images from their own worst nightmares!

desc.zh: 吹响这一古老的号角，便可从瓦拉雅的行宫中召唤一位传说中的先祖来支援你的战斗
desc.en: Blowing on this ancient horn will summon a legendary Ancestor back from Valaya's bosom to aid in the fight.

desc.zh: 这个强大的权杖中绑定的是足以挪动山峰的力量
desc.en: Bound within this mighty sceptre is the power to move the mountain peaks themselves.

desc.zh: 大声朗读卷轴上的咒文，便可让盟友获得不可思议的移动速度
desc.en: The words upon this scroll, when read aloud, allow an ally to move at such a speed as to be unseen.

desc.zh: 伊瑟拉玛银的王冠上镶嵌着耀眼的宝石，据说这是一颗从天而降的明星
desc.en: A diadem of ithilmar with a radiant gem set within it, said to be a star plucked from the heavens.

desc.zh: 这是艾拉瑞丽对阿瓦隆统治权的象征，据说自远古时便在诸位永恒女王手中不断传承了下去
desc.en: The symbol of Alarielle's rule of Avelorn is an ancient heirloom passed from one Everqueen to the next.

desc.zh: 这张卷轴上记载着邪术『琥珀迷乱』：随着敌人慢慢转向琥珀，他们的士气也会随之消散得无影无踪！
desc.en: Upon this scroll is written the 'Amber Trance'; as the foes slowly turn to amber their morale is sapped away!

desc.zh: 朗读铭刻在卷轴上的黑色草书，便会施放出安兹帕的黑色恐怖
desc.en: Reading the dark scrawl etched upon the scroll will summon Arnzipal's Black Horror.

desc.zh: 石之击，这是很有年头的法术，很多法师都还记得它足以动摇群山的力量
desc.en: Many Mages remember a spell from long ago that could move mountains: the Assault of Stone.

desc.zh: 这本卷轴绑定着一个法术，只要大声朗读，便会释放出一阵耀眼的奥术之光
desc.en: This scroll has a bound spell that, when read, will unleash a sharp blast of arcane light.

desc.zh: 这个护符会让佩戴者的周围围绕一层神秘的火焰，但这火焰的燃料是魔法，而非肉体
desc.en: This amulet wreathes its wearer in a mystical flame that burns magic instead of flesh.

desc.zh: 这面战旗会在永恒女王继承宝座时修缮一新，它是生命与光明的灯塔
desc.en: Crafted anew when an Everqueen ascends to the throne, the banner is a beacon of life and light.

desc.zh: 由龙牙制成的护身符提醒人们，无论恶兽如何恶毒，它都有完蛋的*那一天*
desc.en: An amulet made of a Dragon's fang is a reminder that no matter how vicious the beast, it *will* fall.

desc.zh: 一条坚固而厚实的腰带，适合各地的胡须佬与玩烧瓶的
desc.en: A strong, thick belt; perfect for beard-tuckers and flask-holders everywhere.

desc.zh: 守门人被视为移动的堡垒，那些戴着这具头盔的人正是守护神的护符
desc.en: The Gatekeepers are rightly seen as living bastions; those that wear this helm are talismans of sanctuary.

desc.zh: 铁髯的手腕上缠绕着大号的铁护腕，以抵挡敌人的攻击
desc.en: Large iron bands wrapped around the Ironbeard's wrist to deflect enemy strikes.

desc.zh: 这枚指环上刻着冷却符文，会为它的持有者带来一定的免疫能力
desc.en: Such a ring is wrought in runes of cooling, allowing its bearer a certain immunity from fire.

desc.zh: 钢铁守望经常带上战场的巨大塔盾，虽然笨重，但足以提供强大的保护
desc.en: A massive tower-shield usually taken into battle by Iron Wardens. Its bulk is worth the protection it provides.

desc.zh: 这个杯子又大又深；当其中装满酒时，只有最年长的长须尊者能够喝上一口
desc.en: This tankard is large and deep; when filled, only the eldest of Longbeards can sup from it.

desc.zh: 矮人擅长制作镜片，这让所有的种族都对他们的望远镜羡慕不已，但精灵除外…
desc.en: Dwarfs excel at crafting lenses, making their spy-glasses the envy of all umgi, except Elves, the gits.

desc.zh: 厚厚的誓约金戒指，使用曾经由葛林姆尼尔亲自说出的愤怒言语锻造而出
desc.en: A thick ring of oathgold, created using words of fury once spoken by Grimnir himself.

desc.zh: 与奥苏安本身一样，石盾也在发散着具有防御与护卫作用的能量
desc.en: As old as Ulthuan itself, the Shieldstone pulses with warding and protective energies.

desc.zh: 使用稀有的陨铁和最好的锻造技术，如此制作精良的护甲将令穿戴者几乎刀枪不入
desc.en: Using a rarefied ore of Gromril, and the finest forging techniques, crafting such mail will make the wearer all but impervious.

desc.zh: 这颗宝石原本是艾纳瑞昂送给莫拉丝的礼物，却被安纳尔偷走：它可以掩盖佩戴者的身影
desc.en: This jewel was originally gifted to Morathi by Aenarion, before it was stolen by Anar; it cloaks the wearer in shadow.

desc.zh: 这是纳迦瑞斯正统统治者的象征。暗影王冠是个简朴的银色圆环，上面镶着一颗钻石
desc.en: Symbol of the true ruler of Nagarythe, the Shadow Crown is a simple silver circlet set with a single diamond.

desc.zh: 被洛依克的舞蹈迷住的不幸人，将不可避免地陷入厄运
desc.en: Those unfortunates captivated by Loec’s spellbinding dance are drawn inextricably to their doom.

desc.zh: 在赫莉本的凝视下拜倒在地的人，将分享她的欲望与愤怒
desc.en: Those who fall under the glare of Hellebron share her lust and rage.

desc.zh: 作为欺诈之神洛依克的信徒，影王自然也就成了诈术与欺骗的大师
desc.en: As a follower of the Trickster God, Loec, the Shadow King is a master of deception and distraction.

desc.zh: 至高王历数仇恨之书中的各项有关于敌人的深仇大恨，从而令矮人们陷入无比的狂怒
desc.en: From the Dammaz Kron, the High King recounts an ancestral grudge towards the foe, driving the Dawi into a vengeful rage.

desc.zh: 尽管他有国王的义务，但他仍然必须寻求死亡，因此阿格里姆总会在敌人背后留下一条可怕的血红胡同
desc.en: Seeking a mighty death - despite his kingly obligations - Ungrim recklessly carves a path of red ruin through foolish enemies.

desc.zh: 凯恩的新娘是一位完美的杀手：当她沉浸在鲜血中时，她对继续屠杀的欲望也就会愈演愈烈
desc.en: The Bride of Khaine is a consummate murderer; as she reaps the blood, her desire for further slaughter intensifies.

desc.zh: 爱莎的拥抱会保护信众的心灵，这也是永恒女王的意志
desc.en: Under Isha's embrace, those of fey heart will be protected; that is the Everqueen's will.

desc.zh: 多头蛇轻轻一喘便可在面前制造猛烈的火舌，并将不幸的目标化为灰烬
desc.en: A single breath from the Hydra’s severed head causes a vortex of fire to blast forth, consuming its unfortunate target.

desc.zh: 在烈焰法师或混沌术士的召唤下，猛烈旋转的火柱在战场上喷涌而出，极具杀伤力！
desc.en: Conjured by a Bright Wizard or Chaos Sorcerer, a column of churning fire erupts from the battlefield, causing much destruction!

desc.zh: 被多头蛇的凝视盯上的人，很快便会陷入疯狂与虚妄的噩梦
desc.en: Those fixed by the Hydra’s commanding gaze find themselves caught in a nightmare of lunacy and delirium.

desc.zh: 施法者吟唱充满力量的咒语，召唤出一只以纯净火焰构成的凤凰，向着敌人猛扑过去，令其淹没在净化的烈焰之中
desc.en: The caster utters words of power and a phoenix of pure fire manifests to swoop upon the enemy, bathing them in cleansing flame.

desc.zh: 这颗多头蛇脑袋是用来治疗而不是伤害他人的，它可以发出具有治疗作用的魔法爆炸
desc.en: This Hydra head is used to heal instead of harm, causing an explosion of magical energy that restores its target’s health.

desc.zh: 『祈求好运吧，或者随便做点你能做的，我也不知道这脑袋能做出点啥来！』
desc.en: "Cross your fingers, or whatever you have instead – I’m not entirely sure what this one will do!"

desc.zh: 随着次元石的闪耀，人类变成了野兽，被贪得无厌的饥饿本能所征服
desc.en: As the Warpstone sparks, man becomes beast, overcome by an insatiable, animalistic hunger.

desc.zh: 虽然受了伤，但强大的凤凰仍然可以协助它的盟友，给予他们火焰攻击、火焰抗性和医治自己的能力
desc.en: Although injured, the mighty Phoenix may still assist its allies, gifting them with the abilities to attack with fire, withstand flames and heal themselves.

desc.zh: 每一次攻击，甚至每一次移动，都只会让这只暴龙变成更加强壮，更加凶暴的对手
desc.en: Each blow and every move only serve to make the Carnosaur a stronger and less-forgiving opponent.

desc.zh: 当暴龙靠近时，记得躲在它的视线之外，并随时做好逃跑的准备！
desc.en: When the Carnosaur runs amok, stay out of sight and get ready to duck.

desc.zh: 当暴龙靠近时，记得躲在它的视线之外，并随时做好逃跑的准备！
desc.en: When the Carnosaur runs amok, stay out of sight and get ready to duck.

desc.zh: 致命的斯卡文狂潮瘟疫会由此释放出来，淹没敌人
desc.en: By which a plague of deadly Skaven Stormvermin are unleashed to overwhelm the enemy.

desc.zh: 天空突然炸裂，一支燃烧的黑色混沌闪电从天空劈向敌人
desc.en: The sky opens and a bolt of burning, pure Chaos black lightning hurtles towards the foe.

desc.zh: 施法者吟唱充满力量的咒语，召唤出一只以纯净火焰构成的凤凰，向着敌人猛扑过去，令其淹没在净化的烈焰之中
desc.en: The caster utters words of power and a phoenix of pure fire manifests to swoop upon the enemy, bathing them in cleansing flame.

desc.zh: 黑暗的触手向外翻腾，使施法者吸取敌人的生命来恢复自己的活力
desc.en: Tendrils of solidified darkness writhe outwards, draining the lifeforce from foes and renewing the caster’s own vigour.

desc.zh: 借助沙许的病态力量，法师们可以在战斗中削弱敌人的求生意识
desc.en: Harnessing the sickly power of Shyish, the Wizard weakens the foe's will to survive the battle.

desc.zh: 施法者念诵出禁忌之名，敌人就会陷入一阵阵痛苦
desc.en: As the caster utters a forbidden name, their enemies are wracked with waves of agony.

desc.zh: 冰寒的呼吸会迅速冻死敌人，若是有人侥幸未死，也会变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: This ice-cold breath delivers freezing death, slowing down those who are fortunate to survive the exposure.

desc.zh: 冰寒的呼吸会迅速冻死敌人，若是有人侥幸未死，也会变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: This ice-cold breath delivers freezing death, slowing down those who are fortunate to survive the exposure.

desc.zh: 深渊海妖发出令人丧魂落魄的嚎叫，让胆敢挡在它前方的敌人肝胆俱裂
desc.en: The Kharibdyss lets out a spine-chilling howl, terrifying those who would dare to stand in its path.

desc.zh: 一场血战中有人一起并肩作战总是备感安心
desc.en: In the midst of a bloodbath it's good to know that someone has your back.

desc.zh: 大笑着的女战士们跳起舞来，以凶猛的优雅转动她们的刀剑
desc.en: The laughing warrior-women dance into battle, spinning their blades with a ferocious grace.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 使用弑夫者，从而与凯恩联系起来的人，都会切身感受到凯恩的愤怒
desc.en: Those who wield Widowmaker - those who bond with the enchanted blade - can summon forth Khaine's wrath.

desc.zh: 致命的月之弓，正是女神莉莉丝亲手交给阿里斯·安纳尔的礼物
desc.en: The deadly Moonbow was handed to Alith Anar by the goddess Lileath herself.

desc.zh: 挥舞着这柄巨斧的人无论受到怎样的伤痛都不会动摇其战斗到底的决心
desc.en: Those who wield such an axe come under a grim resolve to fight no matter their wounds.

desc.zh: 所有见证过钢铁守望手持这把大锤奋战不止场景的矮人，都会难以遏制自己的战意！
desc.en: All Dawi that witness the Ironwarden wielding this mighty hammer in action will be roused to war.

desc.zh: 死亡之剑闪耀着杀戮，诅咒之刃似乎以自己的生命在挥舞着
desc.en: The Deathsword glistens with murder and the Cursed Blade moves with a life of its own.

desc.zh: 『哈啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！』
desc.en: "Blaaaaaaaarrrrrrrrrrgggggggghhhhhhh!!!"

desc.zh: 施法者会召唤一个强大的闪电球并投掷它——如果敌人被击中，他们一定会被击碎！
desc.en: The spellcaster calls down a mighty ball of lightning and hurls it - should the foe be struck they will surely be shattered!

desc.zh: 这是已知世界上最好的枪，由经验丰富，并为此手艺奉献一生的技师制作
desc.en: The best shot in the known world, made by experienced men who’ve lived - and perhaps died - the part themselves.

desc.zh: 『定潮汐，逐皓月，八海奇珍尽发掘。\n息狂澜，破洪波，狂蛟庞然又如何？』
desc.en: "Anchor the tides and slow the moons, becalm the waters for some hidden boons. Break the waves, tame the sea; how big can one beast be?"

desc.zh: 『定潮汐，逐皓月，八海奇珍尽发掘。\n息狂澜，破洪波，狂蛟庞然又如何？』
desc.en: "Anchor the tides and slow the moons, becalm the waters for some hidden boons. Break the waves, tame the sea; how big can one beast be?"

desc.zh: 『风已静，帆难鼓，健儿起桨摇樯橹。\n巨妖惊，逐猎获，地裂天崩大漩涡！』
desc.en: "Now that we have the ocean so slow, put the sails away and prepare to row; for the monster hunts and its prey should shiver, ever since the Vortex went a-quiver!"

desc.zh: 『风已静，帆难鼓，健儿起桨摇樯橹。\n巨妖惊，逐猎获，地裂天崩大漩涡！』
desc.en: "Now that we have the ocean so slow, put the sails away and prepare to row; for the monster hunts and its prey should shiver, ever since the Vortex went a-quiver!"

desc.zh: 『骷髅旗，烂船帆，艨艟列僵战酣然。\n生与死，皆鲸吞，未料转圜已临门。\n诸篇备，神符齐，星铁鱼镖籍伟力！』
desc.en: "Tattered sails, skull flags, and on the deck, zombies in rags; the beast cares not if you’re living or dead, in its belly is where you’ll head… Yet, all is not lost, the verse is complete, for the song is a rune to bless the Star-metal Harpoon."

desc.zh: 『骷髅旗，烂船帆，艨艟列僵战酣然。\n生与死，皆鲸吞，未料转圜已临门。\n诸篇备，神符齐，星铁鱼镖籍伟力！』
desc.en: "Tattered sails, skull flags, and on the deck, zombies in rags; the beast cares not if you’re living or dead, in its belly is where you’ll head… Yet, all is not lost, the verse is complete, for the song is a rune to bless the Star-metal Harpoon."

desc.zh: 可怕炮弹的轰击，这是一场很难经受住的暴风雨
desc.en: A bombardment of unearthly projectiles; a storm that's extremely hard to weather.

desc.zh: 『好了…让我们看看他会对这小美人说些什么吧！』
desc.en: "There… Let's see what he has to say to this 'ere pair o'beauties!"

desc.zh: 『全员上甲板！我们抓住它们了！』
desc.en: "Everyone on deck! We 'ave them now!"

desc.zh: 『现在听着，给我好好听着，你们这群死海狗…』
desc.en: "Now listen up and listen good, yer salty sea-dogs…"

desc.zh: 这些特制的炮弹为射手们获取了足以压制他们的目标的大优势
desc.en: These particular balls give the shooter a magical advantage over their targets.

desc.zh: 就像他们在生前所做的一样，他们也将继续在死亡之后恪尽职守
desc.en: As they did in life, so they will continue to do in death and beyond.

desc.zh: 这些特殊的卵会使敌人陷入胞质粘稠的泥沼中，减慢它们的冲锋速度，并使他们摔倒在地
desc.en: These particular eggs bog the foe down in ectoplasmic goo, slowing their charge and leaving them prone.

desc.zh: 『苍白的战士，死亡的苍白是他们全部。他们呼喊着：庇佑这些可怜人吧，美丽的夫人！』
desc.en: "Pale warriors, death-pale were they all; They cried—‘La Belle Dame sans Merci thee hath in thrall!"

desc.zh: 『苍白的战士，死亡的苍白是他们全部。他们呼喊着：庇佑这些可怜人吧，美丽的夫人！』
desc.en: "Pale warriors, death-pale were they all; They cried—‘La Belle Dame sans Merci thee hath in thrall!"

desc.zh: 『苍白的战士，死亡的苍白是他们全部。他们呼喊着：庇佑这些可怜人吧，美丽的夫人！』
desc.en: "Pale warriors, death-pale were they all; They cried—‘La Belle Dame sans Merci thee hath in thrall!"

desc.zh: 『一定要注意，否则这小子能把你的衬衫扒下来！』
desc.en: "Do pay attention or this one'll 'ave the shirt from yer back!"

desc.zh: 『我见过你们这些人绝不会相信的东西…袭击了起火的船只…』
desc.en: "I've seen things you people wouldn't believe… Attacked ships on fire…"

desc.zh: 任务永远不会结束，即使执行任务的人已经逝去
desc.en: The quest never ends, even once the questers have passed on.

desc.zh: 『你现在不过是群胆小鬼！要知道，死亡不过是一瞬间——不久你就会在黑旗下服役！』
desc.en: "You're nowt but a bunch of lily-livered landlubbers! Know that your deaths will be short - soon you'll serve under the black flag!"

desc.zh: 超自然力量的储备可以带来毁灭性的效果
desc.en: Supernatural reserves of strength can be brought to bear with devastating effect.

desc.zh: 『运弹药的在哪儿？现在就给我叫过来！』
desc.en: "Where's that powder monkey? Get him up 'ere now!"

desc.zh: 死眼所见，看不见，说不出
desc.en: What dead eyes see can never be unseen, nor spoken of.

desc.zh: 这种特殊的月晷能让它的主人完成看似不可能完成的远航壮举
desc.en: This particular moondial enables its owner to pull off seemingly-impossible feats of navigation and piloting.

desc.zh: 战斗前多一点勇气有什么错？没什么，除了这些战士比以前更容易点着而已！
desc.en: What's wrong with a bit of extra courage before a fight? Nothing, except now the combatants are considerably more flammable than before.

desc.zh: 众所周知，露丝契亚的黄金具有各种深奥的特性，而哈肯认为它们能复原他破碎的心灵！
desc.en: It is well known that Lustrian gold is enchanted with all manner of esoteric properties; Harkon thinks it will restore his fractured mind!

desc.zh: 在真正的海之王面前俯伏吧！
desc.en: Bow down before the true Lord of the Sea.

desc.zh: 这个被施了魔法的风扇可以在高温袭来时让塞洛斯塔全身凉爽，从而提高她的技能充能速度，减少它们的冷却时间
desc.en: This enchanted fan keeps Cylostra cool when the heat is on, improving the recharge of her abilities and reducing their cooldown times.

desc.zh: 从疯狂沼泽的深处，史崔格家族将再次崛起！
desc.en: From deep within the Marshes of Madness, the Strigoi shall rise again!

desc.zh: 『如果你需要力量，那就来找我吧…』
desc.en: "If you need the strength, then turn to me…"

desc.zh: 『见过他的人，只有少数几个能活着回来讲述自己的所见。你可以掰着伯纳德的手指头算过来…哦，那家伙没有手！』
desc.en: "There are but a few who've faced 'im and lived to tell the tale - you can count them on the fingers of Bernard's 'ands… and 'e's got no 'ands."

desc.zh: 乌索然亲王从他破碎的王国中伸出手来，让莱弥亚的梦想变成了扭曲可憎的现实
desc.en: From his shattered kingdom, Prince Ushoran reaches forth and makes Lahmian dreams a twisted, hateful reality.

desc.zh: 当超自然的力量与速度共同发挥作用时，较弱的对手几乎没有机会反击
desc.en: When supernatural strength and speed work together, lesser opponents have little chance to counter.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼的身体看起来像人类，但他们的反应是如此之快，即使是最快的剑客相比也显得笨拙
desc.en: The body of a Vampire looks human, but is capable of reactions so fast that even the quickest swordsman would look clumsy in comparison.

desc.zh: 海之父会照顾他的子嗣
desc.en: The Seafather looks after his own.

desc.zh: 通过这种方式，反抗者们就无法凝聚力量来对抗哈肯自己的魔力了
desc.en: By which opponents are prevented from marshalling their abilities to counteract Harkon's own lore.

desc.zh: 『到我的船舱来吧…我相信你会飘飘欲仙的…』
desc.en: "Come to my cabin… You'll find it most comfortable I am sure…"

desc.zh: 『你躲在哪片潮水里？暗月的潮汐并不站在我们这边，所以你必须贿赂它才行』
desc.en: "From which tide do you hide? The dark moon’s tide is not on our side, so that is the tide that you must bribe."

desc.zh: 『看看他们，就像搁浅的海龟一样！』
desc.en: "Look at 'em all, trapped like stranded sea-turtles they are!"

desc.zh: 当光芒消逝之时，暴风雨就会变得更为猛烈，让生活充满了无比现实的恐惧
desc.en: When light is absent, the storm rages all the worse, filling the living with existential dread.

desc.zh: 『看着我的眼睛，颤抖吧，凡人…』
desc.en: "Look into my eyes and tremble, mortal…"

desc.zh: 可怕炮弹的轰击，这是一场很难经受住的暴风雨
desc.en: A bombardment of unearthly projectiles; a storm that's extremely hard to weather.

desc.zh: 毫不奇怪，有些人在面临死亡的时候会重新考虑他们的选择
desc.en: Unsurprisingly, some beings reconsider their options when faced with certain death.

desc.zh: 除了驱役亡灵并约束亡灵军队的力量之外，哈肯似乎一无所有；然而事实上，他的身上散发的却是反魔法的气息
desc.en: Beyond the power to raise and bind his Undead hordes, Harkon is barren; in fact, he emanates a field of anti-magic.

desc.zh: 有时相比投降而言，死亡反而是更好的选择
desc.en: Sometimes death is preferable to surrender.

desc.zh: 无论身处何方，无人可逃脱深渊之吻——当肺叶里灌满海水时，连呼吸也会变得不再可能
desc.en: No matter how far away, none can escape the Kiss of the Deep, nor breathe again with lungs full of seawater.

desc.zh: 在战斗结束之前，永远都不要停止奋战
desc.en: Never stop fighting 'til the fight is done.

desc.zh: 卡堂能够随意地变形为任何怪兽，甚至变成一头嗜血蝠狼。但遗憾的是，有一天他发现自己再也变不回来了…
desc.en: Kadon was able to shift his shape to that of any monster, even a Varghulf. One day he found he could not change back...

desc.zh: 这个巨大天体是个拥有紫色边缘的黑暗实体，那些没能逃开晶化之触的人将陷入永世的诅咒！
desc.en: A colossal orb of purple-edged darkness materialises - those who do not escape its crystalline touch are doomed for eternity!

desc.zh: 大海受到了召唤，一股巨大的潮水涌上战场，把施法者的所有敌人淋个透湿
desc.en: The sea is summoned, and a great tide coalesces upon the battlefield to drench all those that oppose the caster.

desc.zh: 星相家捕捉战场上魔法之风的力量，指引不洁狂风猛击敌人
desc.en: The Astromancer seizes the Winds on the battlefield, directing them against the foe to batter targets with unhallowed gales.

desc.zh: 有些东西不应该浮于水面，也不应该让凡人亲眼目睹
desc.en: Some things should never rise above the waves or be seen by mortal eyes.

desc.zh: 『有这场大雾的遮蔽，他们永远不会知道我们有多少人…进攻！』
desc.en: "They'll never know how many we are in this fog… Attack!"

desc.zh: 『有这场大雾的遮蔽，他们永远不会知道我们有多少人…进攻！』
desc.en: "They'll never know how many we are in this fog… Attack!"

desc.zh: 每个水手都听说过瓦格赫斯特的故事，现在他那不安分的灵魂残骸附着到了暗影幽灵号上，从而令其可以发射毁灭性的舷炮齐射
desc.en: Every mariner has heard the tale of Vangheist, and now his restless spirit is summoned on board the Shadewraith to deliver a devastating broadside.

name.zh: 高级瓦格赫斯特的复仇

desc.zh: 每个水手都听说过瓦格赫斯特的故事，现在他那不安分的灵魂残骸附着到了暗影幽灵号上，从而令其可以发射毁灭性的舷炮齐射
desc.en: Every mariner has heard the tale of Vangheist, and now his restless spirit is summoned on board the Shadewraith to deliver a devastating broadside.

desc.zh: 一旦被克拉肯牢牢地抓住，很少有人有力量挣脱出来
desc.en: Few have the strength to break free once the Kraken has them within its horrid, betentacled grasp.

desc.zh: 一旦被克拉肯牢牢地抓住，很少有人有力量挣脱出来
desc.en: Few have the strength to break free once the Kraken has them within its horrid, betentacled grasp.

desc.zh: 心中充满了对敌人最纯粹的仇恨，这一击将带来一个惨不忍睹的终局
desc.en: Imbued with the purest hatred for the foe and all their ways, to better bring about an ignominious end.

desc.zh: 心中充满了对敌人最纯粹的仇恨，这一击将带来一个惨不忍睹的终局
desc.en: Imbued with the purest hatred for the foe and all their ways, to better bring about an ignominious end.

desc.zh: 大海受到了召唤，一股巨大的潮水涌上战场，把施法者的所有敌人淋个透湿
desc.en: The sea is summoned, and a great tide coalesces upon the battlefield to drench all those that oppose the caster.

desc.zh: 大海受到了召唤，一股巨大的潮水涌上战场，把施法者的所有敌人淋个透湿
desc.en: The sea is summoned, and a great tide coalesces upon the battlefield to drench all those that oppose the caster.

desc.zh: 溺水的水手很容易被绑定，因为他们记得自己的最后一次航行和许多世俗的职责
desc.en: Drowned sailors are easily bound, for they remember their last voyage and many of their worldly duties.

desc.zh: 溺水的水手很容易被绑定，因为他们记得自己的最后一次航行和许多世俗的职责
desc.en: Drowned sailors are easily bound, for they remember their last voyage and many of their worldly duties.

desc.zh: 『全员个人顾个人！快游！！』
desc.en: "Every man for 'imself! Swim for it!!"

desc.zh: 只因总是多多而益善
desc.en: Because you can never have too much.

desc.zh: 一些从海中蹒跚而出的溺亡海员体内充满了有毒气体，一旦与敌人的刀锋接触就会爆炸。记得远离他们！
desc.en: Some drowned sailors lurch from the sea swollen with noxious gases, ready to explode upon contact with enemy blades. Keep well back!

desc.zh: 在海上呆得太久而肿胀的尸体就像腐烂的气球一样，一碰就炸
desc.en: Corpses bloated from spending too long at sea are like foul, decomposing balloons waiting to burst.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼撕开猎物，鲜血四溅之处，便是大快朵颐之时，这让他们得以获得力量、恢复精力
desc.en: As the Vampires rip apart their victims they feast on the blood that spills forth – gaining strength and replacing lost stamina.

desc.zh: 当亡灵们撕裂他们的受害者时，他们会大嚼其肉体，从而重新获得力量
desc.en: As the Undead rip apart their victims they feast on the organs that spill forth – regaining strength in the process.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 在一生中战胜了从最大的到最坏的敌手之后，这把剑渴望着与配得上它的敌人一较高下
desc.en: Having deprived the biggest and the worst of its life, this blade hungers for other monstrous opponents worthy of its bite.

desc.zh: 一阵象征着蛇神之怒的狂风，席卷过大地，狠狠撕裂敌人
desc.en: A great wind, symbolising the wrath of the Serpent-God, surges forth beneath the ground to consume the enemy.

desc.zh: 向索提戈祈求恩赐后，便借由其魔法之力现身于世的蛇群。它们扭曲身体蜿蜒前行，对祈祷者唯命是从
desc.en: Upon invoking the favour of Sotek, these snakes appear by magic, wriggling to do the bidding of their invoker.

desc.zh: 令人生怖的火箭炮，可引发巨大的爆炸，能把四面八方的部队尽数粉碎。当然，也能炸得他们残肢乱飞
desc.en: This dread projectile causes an enormous explosion on impact, sending entire units - and no doubt their limbs - flying off in all directions.

desc.zh: 令人生怖的火箭炮，可引发巨大的爆炸，能把四面八方的部队尽数粉碎。当然，也能炸得他们残肢乱飞
desc.en: This dread projectile causes an enormous explosion on impact, sending entire units - and no doubt their limbs - flying off in all directions.

desc.zh: 沾满剧毒的铜球，其毒性足以将敌人无情卷入痛苦与死亡的湍流漩涡之中
desc.en: Possession of this orb enables the user to inexorably drag the foe into a turbulent vortex of pain and death.

desc.zh: 沾满剧毒的铜球，其毒性足以将敌人无情卷入痛苦与死亡的湍流漩涡之中
desc.en: Possession of this orb enables the user to inexorably drag the foe into a turbulent vortex of pain and death.

desc.zh: 沾满剧毒的铜球，其毒性足以将敌人无情卷入痛苦与死亡的湍流漩涡之中
desc.en: Possession of this orb enables the user to inexorably drag the foe into a turbulent vortex of pain and death.

name.en: Supreme Shield of the Old Ones

desc.zh: 这并不是一面普通的盾牌，其中流动着古圣体内的力量，能够让使用者抵御魔法攻击
desc.en: More than just a shield, this one channels the visceral power of the Old Ones to protect its bearer from magical attack.

desc.zh: 据说这是海神曼纳恩的头发编成的辫子，从第一任公爵统治时期起，这一圣物就一直为波尔德罗公国所拥有
desc.en: Said to be a braid cut from the hair of the Sea-God Manann, this sacred artefact has been held by Bordeleaux since the reign of the very first duke.

desc.zh: 克罗卡领主的死亡面具能够保护遗迹祭司木乃伊般的脆弱头部，它的催眠效果能阻挡所有意图攻击佩戴者的敌人
desc.en: Lord Kroak’s death mask protects the mummified head of the venerable Relic Priest. The hypnotic effect of the mask hinders any and all foes trying to attack him.

desc.zh: 戴上它的人将与强大的翼龙化为一体；它们将以统一的强大意识协调行动
desc.en: Its wearer will become one with the mighty Terradons, who will then move in tandem as a single, mighty consciousness.

desc.zh: 这块石饰板上篆刻有索提戈预言的节选部分，预言赐予了特亨霍因额外的特殊保护能力
desc.en: Upon this stone plaque is inscribed an extract of the Prophecy of Sotek that grants additional warding to Tehenhauin.

desc.zh: 这颗附有魔法的圆球能够引发一场巨大的爆炸，从而眩晕敌人，减缓其速度，方便你料理
desc.en: This magical rock causes a rather large explosion that stuns enemies, slowing them down for the kill.

name.zh: 高级泰波克的坠落铁球

desc.zh: 这颗附有魔法的圆球能够引发一场巨大的爆炸，从而眩晕敌人，减缓其速度，方便你料理
desc.en: This magical rock causes a rather large explosion that stuns enemies, slowing them down for the kill.

desc.zh: 身负此天赋之人能够集中精神在手头的任务上，牢牢控制住心中的激情与想要放弃的念头，保证计划能有效执行
desc.en: By which the mind is concentrated on the task at hand, allowing it to be carried out effectively whilst keeping passion and abandon firmly in check.

desc.zh: 提克塔托的速度与敏捷无人能比，他端坐在自己最为珍视的坐骑兹瓦普之上，率领着一支连死神也不放在眼里的翼龙中队
desc.en: With the utmost speed and agility, Tiktaq'to leads his death-defying Terradon squadron from atop his prized-specimen mount, Zwup.

desc.zh: 无尽力量可将已经完全破坏的事物破坏得更为彻底
desc.en: Unlimited power corrupts the already-totally-corrupted utterly.

desc.zh: 这可不只是个装饰品，你知道的！
desc.en: It's not just for decoration, you know!

desc.zh: 工程师感觉到有一股原始的力量在全身游走，这提升了他在战场上的战斗力和信心
desc.en: The Engineer feels the raw, unrefined power surge over and through him, improving his fighting prowess and confidence in battle.

desc.zh: 勇士在战场上停留的时间越长，他们就越是善于服从命令，对席卷过战场的魔法之风的抗性也会更强
desc.en: The longer the warrior remains in the fray, the greater their command of, and resistance to, the Winds of Magic swirling across the battlefield.

desc.zh: 这药剂并非只是治愈伤者，它也能增强服用者的耐力，使其更为强壮
desc.en: This tincture doesn't just heal, it also increases the user's hardiness, making them stronger than ever before.

desc.zh: 『轰隆！！！！！哈哈！是的、是的！！』
desc.en: "Booooooooooooom!!!!! Haha! Yes-yes!!"

desc.zh: 伟大的克罗卡领主召唤出了一个小小的太阳。有趣的是，它一旦爆炸，这里就会化为一片断壁残垣…
desc.en: Mighty Lord Kroak spawns a small sun that, when it explodes, causes abject devastation… funnily enough.

desc.zh: 伟大的克罗卡领主召唤出了一个小小的太阳。有趣的是，它一旦爆炸，这里就会化为一片断壁残垣…
desc.en: Mighty Lord Kroak spawns a small sun that, when it explodes, causes abject devastation… funnily enough.

desc.zh: 伟大的克罗卡领主召唤出了一个小小的太阳。有趣的是，它一旦爆炸，这里就会化为一片断壁残垣…
desc.en: Mighty Lord Kroak spawns a small sun that, when it explodes, causes abject devastation… funnily enough.

desc.zh: 索提戈那蜿蜒扭曲的爬行类同盟会围绕在持有者身旁，在战斗中赐予他们更强的力量和更周全的保护
desc.en: Sotek's crawling, swarming allies surround the bearer, affording them further might and protection in the struggle to come.

desc.zh: 从天空中骤然落下的灼热射线，让敌人四处逃窜、惊声尖叫，甚至将其活活烧死——最好是后者！
desc.en: A scorching ray of light blasts forth from the sky, putting the foe to flight or screaming, burning death - preferably the latter!

desc.zh: 虽然原始，但是居高临下扔滚石仍是一个有效的战术
desc.en: Crude though it may be, swiftly swooping in low to pepper the foe with rocks remains a most effective tactic.

desc.zh: 在所有的死法中，被活活碾死无疑是最糟糕的；但如果你同时浑身起火，痛苦哀号，那么无疑是糟上加糟！
desc.en: Of all the ways to go, being crushed is amongst the least pleasant, but it's a lot worse if you're on fire and screaming at the same time!

desc.zh: 这些岩石不仅是一堆瓦砾，而且能将护甲生生砸开，从而降低其防护能力
desc.en: More than just a pile of rubble, these rocks also split armour apart, negating its protective capability.

desc.zh: 即使在面对一些极其强大的对手时，这项技能也能不可思议地令你死里逃生
desc.en: The surprising ability to hold back death despite some seriously heavy opposition…

desc.zh: 这面古老的金色盾牌与蜥蜴人的黄金之城一样古老，它可以协助其佩戴者及盟友抵御远程伤害
desc.en: This ancient golden screen - as old as the fabled golden city of the Lizardmen - confers missile resistance to both the bearer and their allies.

desc.zh: 可恶的露丝契亚黄斑蟾蜍一旦出现，就会令残忍的喙嘴龙进入难以遏制的狂怒之中！
desc.en: The presence of the hated Lustrian Blot Toad sends the merciless Ripperdactyls into a barely-controlled frenzy of extreme violence!

desc.zh: 拥有这一技能就意味着你再也不用在战斗彻底结束之前就耗尽魔法之风了
desc.en: Command of this ability means never again having to run out of the Winds before the fight is well and truly done.

desc.zh: 在这卷曲的金属面前，不费吹灰之力，敌人的利刃和远程攻击便会偏转扭曲。激活后，它就会犹如一道防御屏障
desc.en: Enemy blades and missiles are easily deflected by the whirling metal, which acts like a defensive barrier when activated.

desc.zh: 战士越是显赫，就越能鼓动部下去对付最可怕的敌人
desc.en: The more prominent the warrior, the better they are at stirring up subordinates to fight the ghastliest of enemies.

desc.zh: 拜伊克特禁忌工坊的技术进步所赐，这种弹药永远不会耗尽！
desc.en: Due to the technological advances in Ikit's Forbidden Workshop, this ammunition can never be exhausted!

desc.zh: 知道陷阱的位置，就是避开它的第一步
desc.en: Knowing where the trap is - that's the first step in evading it.

desc.zh: 最好的防御便是进攻…尤其是以这些旋转的刀刃发动的攻击。如果你想活命，就记得选对边吧！
desc.en: There's no better defence than attack… preferably with this mass of whirling blades. Stay on the right side of it if you want to live!

desc.zh: 这是古圣对那些不属于大计划一部分的种族所说出的最后一个字：短暂、清晰、极端致命！
desc.en: The final word of the Old Ones to those not part of the Great Plan – short, clear and extremely deadly!

desc.zh: 大角鼠骑着闪闪发光的毁灭巨轮进入战斗的景象征服了次元粉碎机，使他们陷入疯狂的状态
desc.en: Visions of the Horned Rat riding a shining Doomwheel into battle overcome the Warp-Grinders, working them into a maniacal frenzy.

desc.zh: 一部由工程术士制造的次元石供能设备，其中流动着的是尚未完全驯服的力量
desc.en: A Warpstone-powered device, created by the Warlock Engineers, that crackles with barely-contained power.

desc.zh: 雕刻纹路的高密度化石。它原本是一种翱翔天际的怪物掠食者，但在很久以前就已经灭绝了
desc.en: Carved from the dense, fossilised jawbone of a monstrous, sky-borne predator that became extinct in ages long past.

desc.zh: 一把献祭匕首，出自技艺最精湛的查库阿灵蜥工匠之手，这把附魔匕首的利刃满是致命剧毒！
desc.en: This sacrificial dagger was crafted by the most skilled of Chaqua’s Skink artificers and enchanted to drip with deadly venom!

desc.zh: 这些巨兽般的大炮用最优质的努恩锻钢制成，足以将丛林灌木和怪兽肉体轰成碎片
desc.en: Made from the very best Nuln-forged steel, these imported behemoths cut jungle scrub and monster flesh to shreds.

desc.zh: 伟大的伊奇神是所有冷血种的三角统治者：惟有在他眼前得到赐福之后，才能制伏他那长角、强壮的仆从
desc.en: The great god Itzl is the three-horned ruler of all coldbloods; only those blessed in His sight may achieve mastery over his mighty, horned servants.

desc.zh: 伟大的伊奇神是所有冷血种的三角统治者：惟有在他眼前得到赐福之后，才能制伏他那长角、强壮的仆从
desc.en: The great god Itzl is the three-horned ruler of all coldbloods; only those blessed in His sight may achieve mastery over his mighty, horned servants.

desc.zh: 勇士之神的仆人，也是他的神选者，为战争的奋斗与荣耀而生
desc.en: The servants of the Warrior-God – his chosen ones – live for war's struggle and glory.

desc.zh: 勇士之神的仆人，也是他的神选者，为战争的奋斗与荣耀而生
desc.en: The servants of the Warrior-God – his chosen ones – live for war's struggle and glory.

desc.zh: 难道『迷失者』从他那不可能的任务中返回，并且可以削弱古圣的敌人了吗？
desc.en: Could it be that "the Lost" has returned from his impossible quest to wreak havoc upon the enemies of the Old Ones?

desc.zh: 难道『迷失者』从他那不可能的任务中返回，并且可以削弱古圣的敌人了吗？
desc.en: Could it be that "the Lost" has returned from his impossible quest to wreak havoc upon the enemies of the Old Ones?

desc.zh: 这么大规模的爆炸，震撼的可不仅仅是牙齿！
desc.en: An explosion of this size rattles rather more than just teeth!

desc.zh: 作为一名享有盛誉的战地外科医生，赫特维希能够迅速为指定的友方部队包扎伤口，恢复他们的生命值
desc.en: As a battlefield surgeon of great repute, Hertwig is able to swiftly dress the wounds of targeted friendly units, restoring their health.

desc.zh: 当他呼喊着要挺身战斗时，他忠诚的部下会倾听并顺从他们的领袖
desc.en: When he shouts to stand and fight, his loyal men listen and heed their leader.

desc.zh: 数支利箭从天而降，其射击区域内无一物可以幸免
desc.en: Several arrows rain down swiftly from the sky, striking anything caught within their area of effect.

desc.zh: 他以如此之大的力道猛击地面，以至于附近任何人都被震得魂不附体！
desc.en: He hits the ground with such force that anyone nearby is shaken to their very core!

desc.zh: 古圣会为施法者建立能量壁垒，以免施法者遭受魔法攻击
desc.en: The resilience of the Old Ones is channelled into an energy barrier that protects its users from the full brunt of magical attacks against them.

desc.zh: 终局会战中所有部队的弹药容量会获得定期补充
desc.en: Ammunition for all units will periodically be replenished during Final Battle

desc.zh: 终局会战中会大幅降低敌方领主的近战防御
desc.en: Massively reduce enemy Lords' melee defence in Final Battle
