desc.zh: 数十只巨蜥把这面无与伦比的盾牌拖到了大陆，数代灵蜥工匠努力地雕刻了它
desc.en: A dozen Kroxigor were needed to haul this matchless shield to the mainland and generations of Skink artisans laboured to carve it.

desc.zh: 戴上这枚戒指的人会受到周围亲随的尊敬，无论此人究竟配不配得上这股尊敬…
desc.en: He who wears this ring is respected by everyone around him, whether he deserves it or not…

desc.zh: 流浪者被认为是丛林精魂的化身，他被给予极大的尊重，并佩戴着仪式化的象征
desc.en: Thought of as a jungle-spirit made flesh, the Wanderer is treated with great deference and adorned with ceremonial tokens.

desc.zh: 最高标准的防护…同时也能让你在同僚中卓尔不群！
desc.en: The highest standard of protection... whilst also looking pretty good next to one's peers!

desc.zh: 在死亡的一刹那，赫特维希会使用这个护身符来强化他的生命力，将他从湮没的边缘拉回来
desc.en: Hertwig uses the amulet to boost his lifeforce at the point of death, which pulls him back from the very brink of oblivion.

desc.zh: 越多，越致命，越令人开心
desc.en: The more, the deadlier, the merrier.

desc.zh: 敌人哪儿也去不快——事实上，他们哪儿也去不了！
desc.en: The enemy aren't going anywhere fast – in fact, they're not going anywhere at all!

desc.zh: 沃法特认为，毫不犹豫地消灭皇帝的敌人，这正是他宣誓履行的职责
desc.en: Wulfhart considers it his sworn duty to dispatch the Emperor's enemies without the slightest hesitation.

desc.zh: 这些箭当然可以猎杀敌人，但主要用来造成混乱，引发炸群，使敌人精神崩溃
desc.en: These arrows will kill of course, but are mainly used to cause a disorientating, explosive spectacle to unnerve the enemy.

desc.zh: 当他们东倒西歪、面目全非的时候，也许敌人会为他们向帝国开战而后悔？
desc.en: As they careen and stagger about, their flesh irreparably charred beyond recognition, perhaps the foe will rue the day they made war on the Empire?

desc.zh: 可能这很残酷，但是当你想要确保获胜时，将敌人烧成灰烬的能力是非常有用的
desc.en: It may be cruel, but the power to burn the foe to ash is extremely useful when you want to be sure of winning.

desc.zh: 这种传统捕兽器工具是用金属丝做成的套索；如果猎物挣扎，它就会越缩越紧，直至刺进肉中
desc.en: This traditional trapper's tool is a noose made from wire; if the foe struggles, it simply tightens, cutting into the flesh.

desc.zh: 熊、兽人、巨蜥，猎物的大小并不是猎人大师的障碍
desc.en: Bears, Orcs, Kroxigor - prey-size is not a hindrance to the master hunter.

desc.zh: 当你的目标几乎没有逃跑的希望时，你就没有必要匆匆忙忙的了
desc.en: There’s no need to rush when your target has little prospect of escape.

desc.zh: 能够让敌人慢下来，消耗他们的体力和战斗意志，这是一种强大的力量
desc.en: Being able to slow the foe, drain it of energy and the will to fight on, is a mighty power to wield.

desc.zh: 傻瓜们在准备抵抗冲击，但现实的人早就会让开了！
desc.en: Fools brace themselves for the impact – realists get well out of the way!

desc.zh: 阿克夏的精华削弱了敌人抵抗正义火焰的能力
desc.en: The distilled essence of Aqshy weakens the foe's ability to withstand its righteous flames.

desc.zh: 这是古老的、无尽的、不死的、邪恶的战斗口号
desc.en: The rallying cry of the ancient, endless, deathless, and vicious.

desc.zh: 他如坚石一般击破蜥蜴人的敌人
desc.en: He is the stone upon which the Lizardmen's enemies are broken.

desc.zh: 这位领主能够承受长时间的战斗并展现出坚韧的意志，从而对附近的战斗产生积极的影响
desc.en: This Lord's ability to withstand prolonged combat and show fortitude has a positive effect on those fighting nearby.

desc.zh: 真正的猎人知道当森林里的捕食者靠近时该如何迅速行动，以免他们自己成为被捕食者
desc.en: The true hunter knows how to move swiftly when the forest's many predators approach, lest they become the hunted themselves.

desc.zh: 哥罗克经历了可怕的创伤，留下了可怕的伤疤，但他从未动摇过自己的职责
desc.en: Gor-Rok has survived horrendous wounds and bears monstrous scars, yet has never once wavered in his duty.

desc.zh: 哥罗克不知道痛苦和恐惧为何物，因此它的攻击极度无情
desc.en: Never knowing pain or fear, Gor-Rok's assault is unrelenting.

desc.zh: 这种高超的射击技巧往往会令下属们士气大振
desc.en: Such advanced ballistic skills tend to rub off on one's subordinates.

desc.zh: 『涉血而过，飞溅更多』是传奇的卡隆堡巨剑士生死存亡的准则
desc.en: "Wade through blood and spill a bath-full more" is the code by which the legendary Carroburg Greatswords live and die.

desc.zh: 他们的长矛闪烁着如此明亮的光芒，以至于敌人无法充分防御圣殿骑士的毁灭性冲锋
desc.en: Their lances gleam with such luminosity that the foe cannot see to adequately defend themselves against the Templars' devastating charge.

desc.zh: 时不时地释放蒸汽，这样过于靠近皇帝盛怒号的敌人就会在滚烫的蒸汽中惨痛呼号，纷纷死去
desc.en: Steam must be let off from time to time, which leads to screaming, scalding death for any foe too close to the Emperor's Wrath during battle.

desc.zh: 当尸体堆到你脖子那么高的时候——也许并不是所有的尸体都真的死了——抑制你对死亡的恐惧将变得相当有用
desc.en: When you're up to your neck in corpses - and perhaps not all of them are properly dead - it's useful to be able to suppress your natural feelings of fear and dread.

desc.zh: 帝国的黑暗守护者既不撤退也不投降，即使面临着看似不可逾越的困难
desc.en: The Empire's dark guardians do not retreat nor surrender, even when faced with seemingly insurmountable odds.

desc.zh: 蒸汽坦克技术仍然是一门不精确的科学，这意味着它们偶尔会爆炸——当然如果爆炸时它正好处在敌人的队列中，那就真是撞了大运了！
desc.en: Steam Tank technology remains an inexact science, meaning they explode on occasion, and among the enemy's ranks if good fortune prevails!

desc.zh: 它由邓肯瓦尔德橡树雕刻而成，被强大的琥珀法师施了魔法，因此其箭头会直接对准沃法特敌人的心脏
desc.en: Carved from Drakwald Oak and enchanted by a powerful Amber Wizard, its shots are guided directly into the hearts of Wulfhart's enemies.

desc.zh: 作为属于帝国选帝侯的十二把魔法剑之一，这把精雕细凿的利剑使得许多母亲的儿子比计划的更早见到了他的造物主
desc.en: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, this much-folded blade has caused many a mother's son to meet his maker somewhat earlier than planned.

desc.zh: 作为属于帝国选帝侯的十二把魔法剑之一，『野兽杀手』已经杀死了许多出没在黑暗、浓密的邓肯瓦尔德森林中的可怕怪物
desc.en: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, 'Beast Slayer' has taken down many of the hideous monsters infesting the dark, dense Drakwald Forest.

desc.zh: 作为属于帝国选帝侯的十二把魔法剑之一，『地精之灾』正如名字所暗示的那样，它已经清除了霍克领广袤荒野中潜伏的绿皮
desc.en: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, 'Goblin Bane', as its name suggests, has cleared the insidious Greenskins from Hochland's vast tracts of wilderness.

desc.zh: 据信，紧握乌鲁马克大棒之人会获得古圣的亲自指引
desc.en: It is believed that the Old Ones themselves guide the hand of he who wields the Mace of Ulumak.

desc.zh: 作为属于帝国选帝侯的十二把魔法剑之一，『育鸦之剑』把它的大量猎物——通常是掠夺成性的诺斯卡人——化为了一滩腐肉
desc.en: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, 'Crow Feeder' leaves its prey - often the marauding Norscans - as nothing but so much carrion.

desc.zh: 作为属于帝国选帝侯的十二把魔法剑之一，『巨魔砍刃』杀掉了无数在利润极其丰厚的东方商路上横冲直撞的危险生物
desc.en: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, 'Troll Cleaver' is used to cull the myriad dangerous creatures rampaging around the extremely fertile 'East March'.

desc.zh: 作为属于帝国选帝侯的十二把魔法剑之一，『脑伤之剑』见证了从荒凉、冰封的北方悍然南下的所有不间断的混沌入侵的过程
desc.en: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, 'Brain Wounder' sees almost constant action against the savage Chaos Warbands invading from the desolate, frozen north.

desc.zh: 作为属于帝国选帝侯的十二把魔法剑之一，塔拉贝克领的『碎石之刃』几个世纪以来一直保护着该行省繁荣的商业不受各路强盗的侵扰
desc.en: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, Talabecland's 'Stone Breaker' has protected the founding province's thriving commerce from bandits of all kinds for centuries.

desc.zh: 作为属于帝国选帝侯的十二把魔法剑之一，『引血之剑』是一把强大的利剑，与作为帝国武器生产中心的威森领相得益彰
desc.en: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, 'Blood Bringer' is a mighty blade befitting Wissenland's important status as the centre of Imperial arms production.

desc.zh: 作为属于帝国选帝侯的十二把魔法剑之一，『克林格拉齐』也被称为『寄怨之剑』，这是一把由瑞克元帅代表皇帝的利益而挥舞的剑
desc.en: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, 'Klingerach', also called 'Grudge Settler', has been entrusted to the Reiksmarshal to wield on the Emperor's behalf.

desc.zh: 作为属于帝国选帝侯的十二把魔法剑之一，这把剑非常适合刺穿胆敢蹂躏斯提尔领乡间崎岖不平的高地的绿皮们的污秽皮肤
desc.en: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, perfect for skewering the foul tide of Greenskins which dares to ravage poor, rural Stirland's rugged uplands.

desc.zh: 这是东方的发明与恶魔般的史库里氏族独创性的奇妙结合，这种爆裂炸弹将惊人的爆炸力容纳在了一个虽然小，却是毁灭性的包裹里
desc.en: A curious combination of eastern invention and diabolical Clan Skryre ingenuity, the Cracklebomb contains staggering explosive power in a small, yet devastating package.

desc.zh: 斯尼奇以与身为斯卡文鼠人毫不相称的专注潜行于战场之中，直到它露出自己的杀戮本质
desc.en: With almost un-Skaven-like focus, Snikch moves unseen through the battlefield until the moment of murderous truth.

desc.zh: 作为欺诈之神洛依克的信徒，影王自然也就成了诈术与欺骗的大师
desc.en: As a follower of the Trickster God, Loec, the Shadow King is a master of deception and distraction.

desc.zh: 时间在佩戴者周围流逝得更慢，仿佛承认了偶像的巨大力量
desc.en: Time runs slower around the wearer, almost as if it acknowledges the idol's immense power.

desc.zh: 用偷来的人类毛发和蜘蛛丝编织而成的披风，既能隐藏穿戴者的行踪，又能让穿戴者保持沉默，使得斯尼奇在黑暗中几乎隐形
desc.en: Woven from stolen human hair and spider silk, the cloak both conceals and silences the wearer, making Snikch near invisible in darkness.

desc.zh: 驯兽师们亦有其下仆的嗜战天性，他们会用鞭子、长矛和鱼叉剁翻敌人，然后把敌人抽搐的尸体当做饲料
desc.en: Beastmasters share their minions’ belligerence, cutting down foemen with lash, spear, and harpoon before claiming their twitching bodies as fodder.

desc.zh: 扎坎的邪恶反映了马鲁斯的憎恨：每一点都让他们更为强大，并发誓要用毁灭性的方式击杀敌人
desc.en: Tz’arkan’s evil is a reflection of Malus’ hate; each gives them strength and always threatens to bubble over in devastating fashion.

desc.zh: 斯尼奇在他的受害者旁边留下了他独特的鲜血标记，这样其他人就会知道死亡大师来了，并就此生活在致命的恐惧中
desc.en: Snikch leaves his distinctive symbol traced in blood beside his victims, so others will know the Deathmaster is abroad, and live in mortal dread.

desc.zh: 女神的力量像光环一样从赫潘丝体内闪耀而出，她的剑和盔甲闪耀着神罚之光
desc.en: The power of the Lady shone from Repanse like a halo, her sword and armour glowing with the brilliant light of divine retribution.

desc.zh: 相当矛盾的是，用极度的偏执折磨一个敌人会使他们放弃抵抗
desc.en: Rather paradoxically, afflicting an enemy with profound paranoia can cause them to drop their guard.

desc.zh: 扎坎对灵魂的无限渴望使他能够使用恶魔力量从周围的敌人身上榨取生命力，并将其引导到自己身上
desc.en: Tz’arkan’s limitless appetite for souls enables him to use his Daemonic power to extract the very lifeforce from surrounding enemies and channel it through himself.

desc.zh: 扎坎永远折磨着马鲁斯的灵魂，他的恶魔之力时刻在马鲁斯体内窜动
desc.en: Forever tormenting Malus’ soul, Tz’arkan’s Daemonic puissance always simmers just beneath Malus’ skin.

desc.zh: 那些与马鲁斯·黑刃开战的人们会感受到他的恶魔光环，而那些敢于与其面对面的人则会受到光环的感染
desc.en: Those who go to war against Malus Darkblade feel his Daemonic aura. Those who come face to face with him are infected by it.

desc.zh: 扎坎的黑暗影响时强时弱，但当马鲁斯完全放弃对自身的控制时，恶魔的超自然力量就会释放到这个世界上！
desc.en: Tz’arkan’s dark influence waxes and wanes, but when Malus relinquishes control entirely the Daemon’s supernatural strength is unleashed upon the world.

desc.zh: 扎坎的黑暗影响时强时弱，但当马鲁斯完全放弃对自身的控制时，恶魔的超自然力量就会释放到这个世界上！
desc.en: Tz’arkan’s dark influence waxes and wanes, but when Malus relinquishes control entirely, the Daemon’s supernatural strength is unleashed upon the world.

desc.zh: 死亡大师的这把被恶魔附身的泣泪剑现在似乎有了自己的邪恶意志，而斯尼奇只需屈服于它们的影响即可…
desc.en: The Deathmaster’s Daemon-possessed Weeping Blades now appear to have a malevolent mind of their own – Snikch needs only to succumb to their influence…

desc.zh: 扎坎的黑暗影响时强时弱，但当马鲁斯完全放弃对自身的控制时，恶魔的超自然力量就会释放到这个世界上！
desc.en: Tz’arkan’s dark influence waxes and wanes, but when Malus relinquishes control entirely, the Daemon’s supernatural strength is unleashed upon the world.

desc.zh: 扎坎的黑暗影响时强时弱，但当马鲁斯完全放弃对自身的控制时，恶魔的超自然力量就会释放到这个世界上！
desc.en: Tz’arkan’s dark influence waxes and wanes, but when Malus relinquishes control entirely, the Daemon’s supernatural strength is unleashed upon the world.

desc.zh: 驯兽师的龙筋鞭粗壮多齿，骇人地噼啪作响，轻易地令野兽们怒气冲冲，跃跃欲战
desc.en: The startling crack of the Beastmaster’s hefty and ever-so-slightly serrated whip of Dragon-sinew suitably infuriates the beasts for battle.

desc.zh: 作为古老神圣的象征，神奇的百合花只在女神出现的地方生长，并作为她的战士忠诚的象征被带到战场上
desc.en: A symbol of ancient, holy significance, the magical lily only grows where the Lady appears, and is carried to war as sign of Her warriors' devotion.

desc.zh: 诸世界渴饮者的骇人表现，毫无疑问会让人为了自我保护而走向极端
desc.en: The frightening manifestation of the Drinker of Worlds leaves none questioning the extremes one may go to for self-preservation.

desc.zh: 一片有毒的云无限期地悬在战场上空，像雨点般落下致命的毒素，腐蚀敌人的武器，同时轻微地毒化着他们
desc.en: A poisonous cloud hangs indefinitely above the battlefield, raining down a fine spray of lethal toxins that corrode the enemy’s weapons while mildly sedating them.

desc.zh: 法师制造出一个噼啪作响的次元火球，把它扔向附近的敌人
desc.en: The Wizard conjures a crackling ball of Warpfire and hurls it at a nearby foe.

desc.zh: 大角鼠的诅咒，便是恐怖的十三魔法：现实被无情地撕裂，大角鼠的子孙们倾巢而出！
desc.en: The Curse of the Horned Rat is the dreaded 13th spell – the fabric of reality is torn and the Horned One’s children spill forth!

desc.zh: 绿色的次元能量足以将目标的肉体从骨头上撕下来。它看起来很恶心，事实上听起来也很恶心，但当然，如果你是那个目标，那就更恶心了…
desc.en: Green ribbons of Warp-Energy tear the flesh from the target’s bones. It's very nasty to behold – as nasty as it sounds, in fact – but far nastier, of course, if you're the recipient…

desc.zh: 绿色的次元能量足以将目标的肉体从骨头上撕下来。它看起来很恶心，事实上听起来也很恶心，但当然，如果你是那个目标，那就更恶心了…
desc.en: Green ribbons of Warp-Energy tear the flesh from the target’s bones. It's very nasty to behold – as nasty as it sounds, in fact – but far nastier, of course, if you're the recipient…

desc.zh: 阴影在附着者的身体周围固化，保护他们不受伤害，但也会让他们难以看到事物，因此丧失战斗力
desc.en: Shadows solidify around the wearer's body, protecting them from harm while simultaneously making them difficult to see, and therefore incapacitate.

desc.zh: 阴影在附着者的身体周围固化，保护他们不受伤害，但也会让他们难以看到事物，因此丧失战斗力
desc.en: Shadows solidify around the wearer's body, protecting them from harm while simultaneously making them difficult to see, and therefore incapacitate.

desc.zh: 这个特别让人厌恶的咒语会引发邪恶烟雾的腐烂旋风，更可恶的是，刺痛的灰烬会在目标周围喷发，从而造成魔法伤害
desc.en: This particularly unpleasant spell causes a putrid whirlwind of vile smoke, and alarmingly, stinging ashes to erupt around the target, leading to magical damage.

desc.zh: 这个特别让人厌恶的咒语会引发邪恶烟雾的腐烂旋风，更可恶的是，刺痛的灰烬会在目标周围喷发，从而造成魔法伤害
desc.en: This particularly unpleasant spell causes a putrid whirlwind of vile smoke, and alarmingly, stinging ashes to erupt around the target, leading to magical damage.

desc.zh: 一种古老的斯卡文魔法，可以使法师削弱目标的骨头，根据不同的人会产生不同的效果。然而，不管目标是什么人，都将遭受可怕的打击
desc.en: An ancient Skaven spell that enables the Wizard to weaken their target's bones, causing different effects depending on who they are. All will suffer horribly, however.

desc.zh: 一种古老的斯卡文魔法，可以使法师削弱目标的骨头，根据不同的人会产生不同的效果。然而，不管目标是什么人，都将遭受可怕的打击
desc.en: An ancient Skaven spell that enables the Wizard to weaken their target's bones, causing different effects depending on who they are. All will suffer horribly, however.

desc.zh: 这股脉动着的、阴影般的漩涡会突入目标敌人，以一股充满魔法能量的爆炸将他们从法师的道路上推开
desc.en: This pulsing, shadowy vortex barges into the target enemy, pushing them from the Wizard's path with a blast of magical energy.

desc.zh: 这股脉动着的、阴影般的漩涡会突入目标敌人，以一股充满魔法能量的爆炸将他们从法师的道路上推开
desc.en: This pulsing, shadowy vortex barges into the target enemy, pushing them from the Wizard's path with a blast of magical energy.

desc.zh: 巧妙地召唤，迅速地投掷，斯卡文鼠人邪恶的次元投掷之星，就像他们所有的怪异科学进步一样，生来就是设计为造成最大的规模的死亡
desc.en: Deftly conjured and swiftly flung, the Skaven's fiendish Warp throwing-stars are, like all their weird scientific advances, explicitly designed to cause maximum death.

desc.zh: 巧妙地召唤，迅速地投掷，斯卡文鼠人邪恶的次元投掷之星，就像他们所有的怪异科学进步一样，生来就是设计为造成最大的规模的死亡
desc.en: Deftly conjured and swiftly flung, the Skaven's fiendish Warp throwing-stars are, like all their weird scientific advances, explicitly designed to cause maximum death.

desc.zh: 你看到他们了？你看不到他们了？现在你看到的是两个！
desc.en: Now you see them, now you don’t… and now you’re seeing double.

desc.zh: 就像它们巨大的同类钻地产品一样，次元粉碎机可以在较小的范围内将坚硬的岩石变成灰尘，通过粉碎地面来阻止敌人的行动
desc.en: Like their huge, earth-boring equivalents, Warp-Grinders can turn solid rock into dust on a smaller scale, halting enemies’ movements by pulverising the ground beneath them.

desc.zh: 塞壬的声音是一种可怕的武器——如果它传进敌人的耳朵，他们的活血就会猛烈地沸腾，并从每个毛孔里流出
desc.en: The Siren’s voice is a fearsome weapon – should its sound reach an enemy’s ears, their lifeblood begins to violently rebel through every pore.

desc.zh: 次元能量被直接引导到地面，让大地发出有频率的颤动，令头骨中的大脑嘎嘎作响，并且震碎敌人的骨头！
desc.en: Warp-energy channelled directly into the ground causes the earth to tremble at a frequency that causes brains to rattle within skulls and bones to splinter!

desc.zh: 在血骸神龛附近战斗的敌人，其思维会被美杜莎无尽绝望的回音所扭曲
desc.en: Enemies who fight near a Bloodwrack Shrine find their minds twisted by the echo of the Medusa’s endless despair.

desc.zh: 绑定在神龛上的美杜莎，其痛苦弥漫在战场上，散发着痛楚的气息，鼓舞着她身边的战士
desc.en: The pain of a shrine-bound Medusa permeates the battlefield, exuding a scent of suffering that invigorates those fighting alongside her.

desc.zh: 劫掠者们利用他们的钢丝网来诱捕、抓获和捆绑野兽，因此这些网在敌人身上也能达到同样的削弱效果
desc.en: Typically used to ensnare, immobilise and truss wild beasts, the Ravagers utilise their steel-wire nets against their foes to the same debilitating effect.

desc.zh: 凯恩的嗜血欲望驱使这群凶残之辈进入纵情的狂热，从而激活并恢复了他邪恶的躯体
desc.en: Khaine’s bloodthirst drives the murderous flock into a frenzied crescendo, enlivening and rejuvenating his foul manifestations.

desc.zh: 不自然的头部运动和令人困惑的上半身敏捷性，意味着死亡小队的敌人除了空气之外将打不到任何东西
desc.en: The Death Squad’s unnatural head movements and bewildering upper-body agility mean their enemies often hit nothing but air.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 当她第一次面对混沌时，赫潘丝打开了村子里圣杯教堂的圣物箱，拿起了她在那里找到的那把古老的剑
desc.en: When first she faced Chaos, Repanse broke open the reliquary of the village Grail Chapel and took up the ancient sword she found there.

desc.zh: 凭借双手与尾巴上的三把毒剑，很少有战士能在与死亡大师的战斗中活得长久
desc.en: With a poisoned sword in both hands and his own tail, few warriors can survive long against the Deathmaster.

desc.zh: 『血腥的时代即将来临！』
desc.en: "The Time of Blood is at hand!"

desc.zh: 在他那不祥的魔法王冠的帮助下，那些听到屠灭者的大Waaagh！召唤的人突然被无法承受的热情所彻底征服
desc.en: Helped by his ominous magical crown, those that hear the call of the Slaughterer’s big Waaagh! are suddenly overcome with uncontainable zeal.

desc.zh: 虽然小子们知道『老大的脑子有点不对劲儿』，但他们仍然以疯狂的热情回应了它所召唤起的这场强大的Waaagh！
desc.en: Though the boyz know that "sumfink’s not right wiv da boss", they still react with manic enthusiasm to his calls for an almighty Waaagh!

desc.zh: 还能有什么事会比目睹一场全力奔涌的Waaagh！绿潮更让人毛骨悚然呢？当然是一场更大的Waaagh！啦！
desc.en: There are few things more bloodcurdling than the sight of the green tide of a Waaagh! in full flow – save for an even bigger Waaagh! of course!

desc.zh: 起初只是遥远而恼人的尖叫声，然后恐怖很快就变成了现实——这些自杀的地精获得了亲自把死亡带给敌人的荣誉！
desc.en: Starting off as distant, irritating shrieks, the terror soon becomes real – these suicidal Goblins have been granted the honour of personally delivering death to the enemy!

desc.zh: 起初只是遥远而恼人的尖叫声，然后恐怖很快就变成了现实——这些自杀的地精获得了亲自把死亡带给敌人的荣誉！
desc.en: Starting off as distant, irritating shrieks, the terror soon becomes real – these suicidal Goblins have been granted the honour of personally delivering death to the enemy!

desc.zh: 迷雾笼罩之时，战士们会变得身手迅捷、适性优秀，直到发起进攻时才被敌人所发现
desc.en: Once swathed in the mists, the warriors become swift, adaptable, and unseen until the moment they strike.

desc.zh: 即使在最好的情况下，格里姆格也犹如一座愤怒之塔——但当他的Waaagh！真正发展壮大时，他与他的追随者都会变得极其狂暴！
desc.en: Grimgor is a tower of rage at the best of times – but when his Waaagh! gets really big, he and his followers get really mean!

desc.zh: 论起对屠杀的渴望，小子们可能永远无法超越格里姆格。然而，当他召唤起一场Waaagh！时，小子们总会想去试一试
desc.en: Da boyz could never outdo Grimgor’s lust for carnage, though whenever he calls for a Waaagh! they always try.

desc.zh: 咕噜让手下们保持斗志的秘诀，就是让他们吃得与自己一样饱！要是肚子空空，他的大Waaagh！可就没法打下去了！
desc.en: Grom keeps da ladz riled up by keeping them as well fed as he; his big Waaagh! doesn’t fight on an empty stomach!

desc.zh: 当咕噜这样的超级大块头地精召唤起一场Waaagh！时，手下们会开始忙前忙后：除了战利品之外，还有大批的食物等着掠夺呢！
desc.en: When a big hulking mass of gobbo like Grom calls a Waaagh!, da ladz come running. Loot aside, there's always food to boot!

desc.zh: 在守望者塔楼上飘散的强大魔力的作用下，魔法之风暂时平静了下来
desc.en: With powerful enchantments ensorcelled from the Warden’s Tower, the Winds of Magic are temporarily becalmed.

desc.zh: 塔尔·伊瑞斯的精灵法师们不知疲倦地工作着，为城市的守卫者们提供合适的补给，并鼓舞他们抵御所有的来犯者
desc.en: The Mages of Tor Yvresse work tirelessly to ensure those defending the city are suitably supplied and invigorated to ward off all assailants.

desc.zh: 塔尔·伊瑞斯的精灵法师们不知疲倦地工作着，为城市的守卫者们提供合适的补给，并鼓舞他们抵御所有的来犯者
desc.en: The Mages of Tor Yvresse work tirelessly to ensure those defending the city are suitably supplied and invigorated to ward off all assailants.

desc.zh: 佯动，诈败——世上没有哪场Waaagh！会像史卡斯尼克的Waaagh！一样富有战术性。随着这场Waaagh！的壮大，手下们也必须变得更为狡猾
desc.en: Diversionary feints, feigned retreats – there isn’t a Waaagh! as tactically underhanded as Skarsnik's. And the bigger it gets, the sneakier da ladz must be.

desc.zh: 史卡斯尼克的狡诈是出了名的无人能比。当他召唤一场Waaagh！时，手下们的背刺天性会得到彻底的满足
desc.en: Skarsnik's is famously unparalleled in his sneakiness – when he calls a Waaagh!, the backstabbing nature of da ladz is amplified.

desc.zh: 伊瑞斯的迷雾行者受到了召唤，在需要时挺身而出，保卫家园
desc.en: The Mistwalkers of Yvresse are called upon to defend the homeland in its hour of need.

desc.zh: 伊瑞斯的迷雾行者受到了召唤，在需要时挺身而出，保卫家园
desc.en: The Mistwalkers of Yvresse are called upon to defend the homeland in its hour of need.

desc.zh: 引路石控制着魔法之风的流动。它的力量可以用来激励战场上的所有施法者，无论是敌是友
desc.en: The Waystone controls the flow of the Winds. Its power can be harnessed to invigorate all casters on the field – be they friend or foe.

desc.zh: 向空中喊出战吼，强大的Waaagh！开始了征途！小子们渐渐变得歇斯底里，呼应着这可怕的咆哮！
desc.en: Bellowing a war cry into the air, the mighty Waaagh! is unleashed – da boyz echo the terrifying roar in a crescendo of murderous hysteria!

desc.zh: 当绿先知的Waaagh！确实强大起来后，小子们开始相信起了哪个传言：在他的麾下，他们将无可战胜！
desc.en: When da Great Green Prophet’s Waaagh! gets really big, da boyz start to believe the hype – under him, they can’t be defeated!

desc.zh: 乌尔扎戈永恒的信息回荡在他的Waaagh！中：搞毛二哥即将前来，他们将赐予小子们掌控世界的力量！
desc.en: Wurrzag’s timeless message echoes throughout his Waaagh! – Gork and Mork are coming, and will grant da boyz strength to take on the world!

desc.zh: 在格里姆格的那些坚如磐石的黑兽人旗下作战有什么要求？很简单，在无止境的嗜战中生存下来就是了！
desc.en: The basic requirement for fighting under the banner of Grimgor’s hard-as-nails Black Orc retinue is, quite simply, to survive his incessant warmongering.

desc.zh: 巨量的食物不断地在咕噜的苦涩胃液中起泡和发酵，这令他几乎无法控制地不断打出爆炸性的骇人巨嗝！
desc.en: Copious amounts of food constantly bubbles and brews in Grom’s astringent stomach bile, causing horrendous and explosive belching that he can barely control.

desc.zh: 巨量的食物不断地在咕噜的苦涩胃液中起泡和发酵，这令他几乎无法控制地不断打出爆炸性的骇人巨嗝！
desc.en: Copious amounts of food constantly bubbles and brews in Grom’s astringent stomach bile, causing horrendous and explosive belching that he can barely control.

desc.zh: 巨量的食物不断地在咕噜的苦涩胃液中起泡和发酵，这令他几乎无法控制地不断打出爆炸性的骇人巨嗝！
desc.en: Copious amounts of food constantly bubbles and brews in Grom’s astringent stomach bile, causing horrendous and explosive belching that he can barely control.

desc.zh: 据说地精的牙龈炎是导致他们口臭的头号原因，但在某些情况下，这种痛苦也可以适当地化为武器！
desc.en: They say gobbo gingivitis is the number one cause of their bad breath, but in some cases such afflictions can be appropriately weaponised!

desc.zh: 某些魔法毒素可以让平常的一瞥变成战场上充满恨意的凝视
desc.en: Some forms of magical intoxication can cause a mere glare to become more than just a hateful glance across the battlefield.

desc.zh: 这些灌肠有着很强的冲击力，只要把它们扔向敌人，它们就会在血肉横飞的爆炸中巨烈地爆炸开去
desc.en: These sausages have quite the kick – thrown at an enemy, they violently rupture in a flesh-mangling implosion.

desc.zh: 把恶心的粘液奶昔扔到地上，就能给小子们带来大量的额外滋养！
desc.en: A disgusting slime smoothie thrown to the ground creates a bit of extra nourishment for da ladz!

desc.zh: 『掏出你们的戳戳来，小子们。不把他们戳个满身窟窿，俺们就甭走人！』
desc.en: "Get yer stabbers out, boys. We ain’t leavin’ ‘til they's fulla gashes!"

desc.zh: 守望者召唤出一个魔法牢笼，将他的目标暂时束缚住，令其无法逃脱
desc.en: The Warden summons a magical cage that temporarily traps his target with no chance of escape.

desc.zh: 巨魔巫婆会用一大堆莫名其妙的巨魔式谩骂轰击目标，其力量之强、语言之狠，即使最坚忍的人也会被吓到
desc.en: The Troll Hag bombards the target with a tirade of unintelligible Trollish invective, powerful and relentless enough to cow even the most stoic of hearts.

desc.zh: 巨魔巫婆会吃掉闯进她们沼泽中的一切，无论它是活的、死的还是烂得可怕的。她们的口臭就是对此最好的证明！
desc.en: Troll Hags eat anything that finds its way into their swamps, be it alive, dead, or horribly decomposed. Their putrid breath is certainly testament to that!

desc.zh: 那些熟悉弹道学的工程师知道怎么样才能把武器的射程完全发挥出来
desc.en: Those Engineers conversant in ballistics know how best to increase the ranges of their weapons.

desc.zh: 这件附魔护甲由卡勒多家族诸位家主所穿戴，经历了足足四千年的战斗
desc.en: Donned by the masters of the House of Caledor, this ensorcelled armour has endured over four thousand years of battles.

desc.zh: 在搞毛二哥的祝福下，阿兹汗的魔法护甲变得如此的坚实，以至于它甚至可以保护阿兹汗周围的将士
desc.en: By the grace of Gork (or Mork), Azhag’s magical armour is so ‘ard, it can even protect those around him.

desc.zh: 在纯粹的疯狂与老黑牙倾尽一生所积累的奥术魔法的驱动下，一座按照绿皮诸神的形象所雕刻的石图腾得到了激活
desc.en: Fuelled by pure insanity and the arcane magic hoarded in Blacktoof’s lifetime, a stone totem akin to the Greenskin gods themselves is manifested.

desc.zh: 这副护甲是以矮人符文铁匠之血冷却而成的，这赐予了它强大的力量，爆炸性的力量！
desc.en: The cooling of this armour in the blood of Dwarf Runesmiths has imbued it with great powers – some explosive in nature!

desc.zh: 伊瑞斯古城捍卫者的冠冕，乃是坚定决心的象征，足以鼓舞人心
desc.en: The ceremonial crown of he who protects Yvresse’s ancient metropolis is an inspirational symbol of dogged determination.

desc.zh: 地精国王的战旗会带来莫名其妙的好运，还有他那狗屎运的旗手尼布莱特——此人曾被地精国王一屁股坐在身上，却不知怎么着活了过来
desc.en: Along with his serendipitous standard-bearer, Niblet, who once somehow survived being sat on by him, the Goblin King’s banner brings inexplicable luck.

desc.zh: 这块龙鳞是从森林之龙布鲁沃尔身上脱落的，它拥有带有感知能力的藤蔓，会像触角一样伸出诱捕附近的敌人
desc.en: Shed from the Forest Dragon Bruwor himself, this Draconic scale has sentient vines that reach out like tentacles to ensnare nearby enemies.

desc.zh: 强迫你的奴仆喝下致疯的真菌饮料可能带来好处，但也充满风险，其结果完全无法预测
desc.en: Force-feeding madness-inducing fungus brew to your minions can be advantageous but risky, with wholly unpredictable results.

desc.zh: 咕噜是伟大的象征，他的庞大体格甚至可以与最伟大的兽人相媲美，他的征服雄心也超过了所有人
desc.en: Grom is a veritable symbol of greatness, his prodigious size rivalling even the greatest Orcs, and his ambition to conquer outweighing them all.

desc.zh: 一般来说，地精都有点神经质。如果你退缩得太快，你可能就已经死了
desc.en: Goblins, in general, are a little twitchy to say the least. If you’ve flinched too soon, you’re probably already dead.

desc.zh: 龙角号由德拉古尼尔呼出的烈火锻造而成，它的号音会让敌人丧魂落魄，落荒而逃，因为他们知道接下来会发生什么…
desc.en: A single blast on the 'Dragonhorn', forged in the fire of Draugnir's flaming breath, causes the foe to shrink in terror, for they know what surely follows…

desc.zh: 飘向敌人的腐烂蘑菇毒气会使他们在战斗中最糟糕的时刻失去理智
desc.en: Rotten mushroom gas wafted towards the enemy can cause them to lose their mind at the worst possible moment in battle.

desc.zh: 伊姆瑞克与龙的羁绊赋予了他龙的敏锐：当他集中注意力时，即使是技艺最精湛的敌人也只能勉力招架他的攻击
desc.en: Imrik’s affinity with Dragons gifts him their sharpness; with his concentration heightened, even the most skilful foes struggle to land blows.

desc.zh: 在一位愤怒战将的咆哮下，小子们总能从身上挤出更多的杀气
desc.en: By the bellow of an angry Warboss, there’s always that little bit more murderousness to be squeezed from the boys.

desc.zh: 格里姆格的威名足以将人吓到瘫痪，尤其是当敌人发现自己在战场上招惹来了格里姆格唯恐避之不及的关注时！
desc.en: Grimgor’s reputation is one that induces paralysing fear, especially in enemies who find out they have his unwanted attentions on the battlefield!

desc.zh: 格里姆格不怕受伤，但尽管他饱受战争蹂躏，却有着无与伦比的避免受伤的本事
desc.en: Grimgor fears no injury, but despite his war-ravaged appearance has an unmatched knack for avoiding it.

desc.zh: 当咕噜与他那些称职而训练有素的小子们共同战斗时，这就等于向周围的所有手下证明，他知道如何与小子们打成一片！
desc.en: When Grom joins the fightin' with his competent, well trained boyz; it's proof to all of the ladz around him that he knows da language of da boyz.

desc.zh: 迷雾为守望者自身提供了独特的保护，它会神奇地向攻击他的人射出雨点般倾泻而下的箭雨
desc.en: The mist provides unique protection to the Warden himself, magically manifesting a torrent of arrows that rains down upon those assailing him.

desc.zh: 守望者以坚定的决心、尊贵的风度和不屈不挠的精神面对他的敌人，并鼓舞着所有与他并肩作战的人
desc.en: The Warden faces down his foes with grim resolve, his esteemed presence and indomitable spirit heartening to all those who fight alongside him.

desc.zh: 血的气息和味道加剧了大多数野生动物的愤怒——特别是龙！
desc.en: The smell and taste of blood intensifies the rage of most wild creatures – especially Dragons!

desc.zh: 卡堂能够随意地变形为任何怪兽，甚至变成一只巨鹰。但遗憾的是，有一天他发现自己再也变不回来了…
desc.en: Kadon was able to shift his shape to that of any monster, even an Eagle. One day he found he could not change back...

desc.zh: 闪电电弧扫过战场，在敌人间疯狂跳跃，爆裂声不绝于耳，直到波及的所有敌人都化为灰烬
desc.en: Lightning arcs across the battlefield, leaping from foe-to-foe with crackling fury until there are none left within the storm.

desc.zh: 黑魔法束从施法者眼中放出，使皮肉凋零、骨头坏死
desc.en: Bolts of Dark Magic leap from the caster’s eyes, withering flesh and blackening the bone beneath.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽冥之风，狂啸着扫入敌方大军，令敌军的灵魂立时出窍
desc.en: The Wizard calls forth spectral winds that howl through the enemy ranks, tearing their souls from their bodies.

desc.zh:
『你发现那儿有光点？』
『是啊』
『戳它看看』
噗呲！！！
desc.en:
"Y'see that glowin' spot there?"
"Ye."
"Poke it."
PHTWOOSH!!!

desc.zh: 凤凰的螺旋俯冲会将魔法之风拍打成魔法火焰的漩涡
desc.en: The Phoenix's spiralling dive whips the Winds of Magic into a swirling vortex of magical flame.

desc.zh: 隐藏技能，可以用华丽的持续视觉特效显示部队的爆炸效果
desc.en: This is a hidden ability that enables some flashy persistent banner VFX to indicate that a unit explodes

desc.zh: 兽性的咆哮会令精神与肉体全部不堪一击
desc.en: A bestial roar causes both spirit and strength to weaken.

desc.zh: 虽然蜥蜴人因为天生冷血而导致反应略慢，但这样使得他们在战场上更为坚韧\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: While Lizardmen may be slow to react due to their cold-blooded nature, this also makes them stoic in battle.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 真正的精灵肉搏方式，就是每一击都打得恰到好处，不偏不倚\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: Quite literally the cut-and-thrust of the Elven way of battle; every stroke is precisely made and finds its mark perfectly.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

name.zh: 镜像技能（强化信仰之锤）

desc.zh: 狂热是纪律严明者所需的另一种工具：对于热情与奉献的运用会最为精确地将你引向胜利！\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: Zealotry is another tool to be wielded by the disciplined; an application of ardour and devotion most precisely tuned towards victory!\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 咕噜让手下们保持斗志的秘诀，就是让他们吃得与自己一样饱！要是肚子空空，他的大Waaagh！可就没法打下去了！\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: Grom keeps da ladz riled up by keeping them as well fed as he; his big Waaagh! doesn’t fight on an empty stomach!\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

name.zh: 镜像技能（洛依克的加护）

desc.zh: 阴影为其披风，黑暗为其友朋\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: Shadows be thy cloak and darkness thy ally.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 正是通过杀戮，黑暗精灵才得以凌驾于其他物种之上。一旦被足够多的鲜血所吞噬，他们就会感到自己杀戮欲大增，就像是凯恩在亲身指引他们的利刃一样！\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: It is through killing that Dark Elves rise above other beings. Once engulfed in enough bloodshed, they will often feel their murderous prowess increase, as if Khaine himself was guiding the blades of his disciples.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 我们从毁灭之力那里学不到什么东西，因为在那片面纱之外只有疯狂。相反，我们要坚固自己的内心与灵魂，用纪律与仇恨的盔甲保护自己\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功获取了此技能[[/col]]
desc.en: From the Ruinous Powers there is nothing to learn, for there is only madness beyond that veil. Instead, steel your heart and soul, gird yourselves in the armour of discipline and hate.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability has been gained using knowledge from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 向空中喊出战吼，强大的Waaagh！开始了征途！小子们渐渐变得歇斯底里，呼应着这可怕的咆哮！\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: Bellowing a war cry into the air, the mighty Waaagh! is unleashed – da ladz echo the terrifying roar in a crescendo of murderous hysteria!\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 某些龙会喷出带毒的吐息，对目标造成持续性的效果。当然，这得假设目标能挨过起初的龙息攻击才行！
desc.en: Some Dragons’ noxious fumes alone have long-lasting effects on their target's coordination – if survived in the first place.

desc.zh: 把自己身上的部分零碎扔向敌人，这要么是强烈决心的体现…要么就是个蠢货行为
desc.en: Throwing bits of yourself at the enemy is either a sign of great determination... or singular stupidity.

desc.zh: 虽然戈迪纳尔在龙语中是青少年的意思，但他的呼吸却燃烧着太阳本身的强烈能量
desc.en: Despite being an adolescent in Dragon terms, Gordinar’s breath blazes with the intense power of the sun itself.

desc.zh: 要是再来一发就能打倒我们的敌人，那我们就会再射击一次！
desc.en: If but one more would strike down our every foe, then we shall let loose once again!

desc.zh: 在死亡之后，凤凰强大的奥术能量会爆发成一盏宏伟的火炬
desc.en: Upon death, the potent arcane energies of the Phoenix erupt into a magnificent pyre.

desc.zh: 灵体生命的质量在战斗中占尽优势：他们越接近死亡，就越难以看到和触摸
desc.en: The qualities of metaphysical beings are highly advantageous in battle; the closer to death they get, the harder they are to see and touch.

desc.zh: 绑在泵车前的可怕真菌在接触敌人时会发生强大的爆炸——这让它的鼻涕精车组感到非常有趣！
desc.en: The lurid fungus strapped to the front of this Pump Wagon explodes with immense force on contact with the enemy – much to the amusement of its Snotling crew!

desc.zh: 『如果光靠背刺还不够，那么这些毒药该足够弄死他们了！给咱刺下去！』
desc.en: "If stabbin them in tha back aint enuff, then this poison will finish em off! Jab it in 'em!"

desc.zh: 数世纪以来，某些精灵已变得如此嗜血，以至于连恐惧本身也抛弃了他们
desc.en: Over centuries, some Elves become so steeped in bloodshed that fear itself abandons them.

desc.zh: 最强效的矮垛子啤酒有两个好处：给泵车零件脱脂和麻木疼痛！
desc.en: The strongest of stunty ales are good for two things – degreasing Pump Wagon parts and numbing the pain!

desc.zh: 内心深处所埋藏的力量不可能永远沉眠：它最终将得以释放，并令周围所有人都备受鼓舞
desc.en: Power kept within oneself can’t stay buried forever – eventually it will be released and can empower all those around.

desc.zh: 这点小仗怎么够！群山王国万岁！
desc.en: And no lesser battle should suffice! Khazukan Kazakit-ha!

desc.zh: 当陷入疯狂状态后，这些野性的战士将异常暴怒，变得完全不受控制！记得与他们保持距离！\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: When going berserk, savage, barely-controllable warriors become savage, completely-uncontrollable warriors; best keep your distance!\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 鲜血的气息越是浓厚，就会越发疯狂与凶蛮！\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: Becoming more savage and frenzied the greater the scent and sight of blood.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 即使并非灵体，一幅可怕的面纱也已笼罩在了这些战士的身上\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: Not quite spirits, a terrible veil has been draped over these warriors.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 有些人就是有些窍门，他们能将炮术和火炮不断提升，让火炮能比以往射得更远\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: There are those who have a knack for pushing artillery and their crews to new heights, allowing such machines to fire further than ever before.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 对那些通晓它的秘密的人而言，森林会是个让他们占尽优势的战场\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: For those that know its secrets, the forest can be a highly advantageous place in which to fight.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 三两杯『伯格曼的勇气』下了肚，矮人们八成会不要命地血战到底，虽然脚下会有些不灵光罢了\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: A touch of Bugman's Courage can keep a Dawi standing and fighting, a touch unsteadily, on their feet.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 在氏族长们的激励，以及对血域遭到入侵的愤恨驱使下，野兽人们会爆发出极度蛮荒的狂怒！\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: Goaded by Chieftains and enraged by intruders on their blood-grounds, Beastmen become consumed by a savage furore!\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

name.zh: 镜像技能（一级灵魂国度）

desc.zh: 『灵魂国度』是尼赫喀拉尊崇的死后世界。逝去的战士们从此处应召而出，重新附着在凡世遗骸上并再度登上战场\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: From within the Realm of Souls – Nehekhara’s revered afterlife – deceased warriors are called forth and bound to mortal remains, to find purpose once again through war.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

name.zh: 镜像技能（二级灵魂国度）

desc.zh: 战死的英灵们自灵魂国度中应召而出，重新附着在肉身上，并如在世时一般继续为古墓王而战\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: The spirits of warriors slain can be summoned from the Realm of Souls and bound to corporeal bodies, so that they may fight for the Tomb Kings as they did in life.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

name.zh: 镜像技能（三级灵魂国度）

desc.zh: 巫妖祭司使用尼赫喀拉诸神的气息抵达灵魂国度，取回战死士兵们的灵魂并将其重新绑定，从而令其得以永远效忠于古墓王的意志\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: The Liche Priests use the very breath of Nehekhara’s gods to reach into the Realm of Souls, retrieving the spirits of dead soldiers for binding and eternal service to their Tomb King’s will.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 有句胆小鬼的俗语说得好：『留得青山在，不怕没柴烧』\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: "He who runs away lives to fight another day!" – so the foul, craven adage goes.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 斯卡文鼠人天生胆小，当成群结队时则勇气大增，虽说行动迟缓，但数量带来的安全感会让它们觉得好过很多\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: Skaven are craven by nature, but take courage when in packs of their own kind, where they move slower but enjoy the safety of numbers.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 对于巴托尼亚的万民来说，女神的赐福是非常美妙的礼物。只要他们跪下宣誓效忠，就能得到这一馈赠\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: The Lady's blessing is a wondrous gift freely graced upon all Bretonnian subjects, should they but kneel and utter their devotion.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 一些野兽身上携带着数量完全未知的可怕疾病，会以某种使人虚弱的方式感染那些接触它们的人
desc.en: The horrid diseases carried by some beasts are a wholly unknown quantity, infecting those who come into contact with them in some debilitating ways.

desc.zh: 这是由史卡斯尼克最初调制的特制酒水，瓶子上刻着这位军阀自己的话：『来自八峰山，爱你，抱抱亲亲』
desc.en: A special brew originally concocted by Skarsnik, the bottle is inscribed with the words of the Warlord himself – "From Eight Peaks with luv, xoxo".

desc.zh: 当黑暗来临时，仅仅瞥到凤凰就能令高等精灵精神大振
desc.en: The mere sight of a Phoenix lifts the spirits of the High Elves when darkness looms.

desc.zh: 『要是你隔着大老远就觉得这群巫婆恶臭难闻，那你不妨等她们走近了再试试…』
desc.en: "If you thought them Hags smelt bad from a distance, just wait until you get up close…"

desc.zh: 『这些盾牌真沉哪！一旦事儿不对头，俺就会立马扔了它！』
desc.en: "These shields are well ‘eavy! Da moment fings get ‘airy, I’m droppin’ it!"

desc.zh: 『绿老大说了前进！快点！快点！前进，搜索，碾碎！』
desc.en: "Green boss says move! Fasta! Fasta! Move, find, crush!"

desc.zh: 有些生物能以不可思议的速度愈合骨肉之伤。这是一份强大的赠礼，但是在火焰面前却效果甚微
desc.en: There are beings and creatures that can mend bone and knit flesh at an incredible rate. A mighty boon, but one stunted by fire.

desc.zh: 作为会行走的高耸石头堆，这意味着大块的石头有时会从你的身上掉下来，其中很多都会砸坏周围的小家伙！
desc.en: Being a towering, walking cluster of rocks means that big bits sometimes fall off you, much to the detriment of anything smaller nearby!

desc.zh: 作为会行走的高耸石头堆，这意味着大块的石头有时会从你的身上掉下来，其中很多都会砸坏周围的小家伙！
desc.en: Being a towering, walking cluster of rocks means that big bits sometimes fall off you, much to the detriment of anything smaller nearby!

desc.zh: 作为会行走的高耸石头堆，这意味着大块的石头有时会从你的身上掉下来，其中很多都会砸坏周围的小家伙！
desc.en: Being a towering, walking cluster of rocks means that big bits sometimes fall off you, much to the detriment of anything smaller nearby!

desc.zh: 作为会行走的高耸石头堆，这意味着大块的石头有时会从你的身上掉下来，其中很多都会砸坏周围的小家伙！
desc.en: Being a towering, walking cluster of rocks means that big bits sometimes fall off you, much to the detriment of anything smaller nearby!

desc.zh: 作为会行走的高耸石头堆，这意味着大块的石头有时会从你的身上掉下来，其中很多都会砸坏周围的小家伙！
desc.en: Being a towering, walking cluster of rocks means that big bits sometimes fall off you, much to the detriment of anything smaller nearby!

desc.zh: 作为会行走的高耸石头堆，这意味着大块的石头有时会从你的身上掉下来，其中很多都会砸坏周围的小家伙！
desc.en: Being a towering, walking cluster of rocks means that big bits sometimes fall off you, much to the detriment of anything smaller nearby!

desc.zh: 阿兹汗把他的奇异魔法注入了这些金属碎片中。注意，这不是为了保护使用者，而是为了助长他自己的疯狂计划
desc.en: Azhag has infused his strange magic into these pieces of metal. Not to protect the user, mind you, but more to fuel his own mad schemes.

desc.zh: 有了这样的表皮，至少你就不再需要担心别人侵犯你的私人空间了
desc.en: With an epidermis like this, at least there’s no longer any need to worry about others invading your personal space.

desc.zh: 没什么东西能像搞毛巨像一样在战场上鼓舞着小子们了。它会不可阻挡地向前迈进，给敌人带来不可避免的毁灭
desc.en: Few things embolden da ladz like the presence of a Rogue Idol on the battlefield, striding implacably forwards to bring inevitable doom to the enemy.

desc.zh: 熔岩阿拉克纳瑞巨蛛的辐射热量足以烤熟肉体，软化钢铁，凑巧的是，它也能完美地烤熟一大块史奎格肉
desc.en: The radiant heat of the Lava Arachnarok scorches flesh and softens steel. Coincidentally, it also provides the perfect sear on a hunk of Squig meat.

desc.zh: 咕噜的斧头可以兼作开罐器，撬开敌人的盔甲，把他们剁成肉末！
desc.en: Grom’s axe doubles as a can-opener of sorts, prying open a foe’s armour to make mince meat of 'em!

desc.zh: 这把符文镶边的长剑乃是艾萨里昂家族的传家之宝，为他赐予了其祖先的狂热精神
desc.en: This rune-encrusted longsword has been passed down through Eltharion’s family for generations, bestowing unto him the zeal of his forefathers.

desc.zh: 传说中，星之骑枪的攻击会附带着耀星龙的狂怒，只要这些巨龙仍然生活在奥苏安上空，这种加持便不会消失
desc.en: Legend has it that the Star Lance strikes with the wrath of a Star Dragon, and cannot be unmade while the drakes still live upon Ulthuan.

desc.zh: 大砍刀的粗糙双刃不仅令阿兹汗可以如切瓜砍菜般切碎任何靠近的人，也能激励小子们有样学样！
desc.en: Slagga’s crude twin blades don’t just enable Azhag to enthusiastically slash up anyone who gets close, but also motivate da boyz to follow suit.

desc.zh: 仅仅需要暮光姐妹的只言片语，这头强大的森林龙便会毫不犹豫地冲入战团中去！
desc.en: The Sisters’ mighty Forest Dragon thinks nothing of hurling himself into the thick of the fray on their slightest word!

desc.zh: 隐藏被动，什么都不会做，但可以用来给予部队攻城者属性
desc.en: Hidden passive that doesn't do anything, but can be used to give siege attacker to forces.

desc.zh: 卡堂能够随意地变形为任何怪兽，甚至变成一头蝎尾狮。但遗憾的是，有一天他发现自己再也变不回来了…
desc.en: Kadon was able to shift his shape to that of any monster, even a Manticore. One day he found he could not change back...

desc.zh: 闪耀的小精灵们用忽闪的眼睛和扑棱的翅膀迷惑敌人的思维，使他们进入如醉如痴的恍惚之中
desc.en: The staring eyes and tattered wings of tiny, glowing Elves befuddle enemy minds, sending them into a sleep-like trance.

desc.zh: 恐怖从它们的主人那儿阴郁地现身，展现出最为可怕的一面来摧垮那些魂不附体的猎物的精神
desc.en: Mirthfully looming out from their host, Terrors take on their most fearsome aspect to dampen the spirits of their horrified prey.

desc.zh: 当射向敌人时，这些凶狠的森林化身会化为针形的箭矢，从远处打出痛苦的伤口
desc.en: Unleashed upon a foe, these aggressive manifestations of the forest are utilised for their needle-like arrows that inflict painful wounds from afar.

desc.zh: 伯劳会展现出各种可怕的形态，如水银泻地般直冲敌人的眼睛，甚至冲进敌人的身体，直接打击他们的思维
desc.en: Shrikes take on various frightening forms, moving like quicksilver to target the eyes, and even enter foes’ bodies to attack their very minds.

desc.zh: 他们会急促地越过他们的主人，使用魔法丝线织成的大网拦住敌人打来的武器
desc.en: Scurrying over their host with feverish abandon, Netlings snag the weapons of enemies that come too close with webs of magical filaments.

desc.zh: 星团乃是充满魔力的海绵体，外表体现为模糊而纯净的光团，将魔法之风呼唤到主人那儿
desc.en: Radiants are sponges for magical energy, manifesting as little more than blurred shapes of pure light that beckon the Winds to their host.

desc.zh: 这些残忍的化身藏在宿主的凹陷中，随时准备砍了胆敢接近的家伙
desc.en: Hiding in their hosts' hollows are fiendish forms, ready to strike out at any who draw near.

desc.zh: 从肢体到弓箭，冷光的魔法孢子附着在友军的武器上，为其赋予了轻微但致命的附魔效果
desc.en: Bounding from branch to bow, the Luminescents’ magical spores alight upon allies’ weapons to bestow a minor but lethal enchantment.

desc.zh: 被黑暗诸神的狂怒吞噬后，古尔奇变成了一位疯狂的死亡钢铁斗牛
desc.en: Consumed by all the rage of the Dark Gods themselves, Ghoritch turns himself into a whirling juggernaut of death.

desc.zh: 即使是最为邪恶，最为冲动的怪兽，也会在次元石电棍的迅猛『鼓励』下遵循他人的意志
desc.en: Even the most vicious and impetuous monstrosities can be ‘encouraged’ to do one’s bidding with a quick jolt of Warpstone-generated electricity.

desc.zh: 一旦捕兽师将他可爱的『宠物们』释放到战场上，它们的嗜血狩猎就开始了！
desc.en: As soon as the Packmaster unleashes his beloved 'pets' upon the battlefield, their bloodthirsty hunt begins!

desc.zh: 携带瘟疫的老鼠与狼从阴沟中蜂拥而出，于敌军阵内散播致命的混乱
desc.en: Summoned forth from filth-ridden sewers, disease-carrying amalgamations of rat and wolf cause pestilent havoc in the enemy’s ranks.

desc.zh: 当古尔奇启动了自己的次元石动力爪后，附近每个可能被他打到的人都会见识到暴力的真正含义！
desc.en: When Ghoritch fires up his Warpstone-powered piston-driven claws, everyone within his extensive reach witnesses the true meaning of violence!

desc.zh: 杀戮领主的怒吼在多元宇宙中回荡，忠实的信徒们因此获得了对抗懦弱魔法的力量
desc.en: To his loyal followers, the Lord of Murder’s bellows of rage that echo throughout the multiverse strengthen them against cowardly sorceries.

desc.zh: 这种仪式战舞不需要节奏或步调，却可以避开敌人笨拙的攻击，并发起致命的反击
desc.en: This ritualistic war dance requires neither rhythm nor order, enabling evasion of the enemy’s clumsy attacks, and lethal counterattacks.

desc.zh: 『我应该留，留下，还是离，离开？』
desc.en: "Should I stay-stay, or should I go-go?"

desc.zh: 对于斯卡文氏族长来说，忠诚是个简单的概念——他们服务于那些最看重忠诚的人！
desc.en: Loyalty is a simple concept to a Skaven Chieftain – they serve whoever values loyalty the most!

desc.zh: 若是获得洛依克的庇护，便可模仿黑暗诸神的欺骗，如本能般通过把戏来逃避攻击
desc.en: Once consumed by Loec’s aspect, one can instinctively evade attack through trickery, mimicking his deception of the Dark Gods.

desc.zh: 『我现在是管事儿的了，是的、是的！直到我死、死，或者你找到更好的人！』
desc.en: "I be leader now, yes-yes! ‘Til I die-die, or you find someone better!"

desc.zh: 长期与变异巨兽一起生活，这让捕兽师可以控制住它们，并掌握基本的野外手术技能
desc.en: Staying close to his mutated beasts allows the Packmaster to keep them in check and within reach of his rudimentary field surgery skills.

name.en: Acorns of the Oak of Ages

desc.zh: 强大的魔力汇聚在一颗繁盛橡树的橡子里，足以在瞬间释放出爆炸性的魔力
desc.en: Concentrated within a single acorn of the Mighty Oak is the potential for an instant and devastating release of explosive magical power.

desc.zh: 森林中的魔法浆果会酿出一种醉人又能使人恢复活力的佳酿，因此在橡子杯中装上足够的剂量，便可期待足够的效果了
desc.en: The forest’s magical berries yield an intoxicating yet rejuvenating brew, potent enough in a single acorn cup to manifest its desired effects.

desc.zh: 这只长着棘刺的飞镖直接从灾厄之树雕刻而来，它的魔力能够瘫痪武器，并造成痛苦的伤害
desc.en: This thorn-tipped dart carved directly from the Tree of Woe is magically engraved to cripple weapons and deliver painful injury.

desc.zh: 穿上这件披风的人不仅会与森林融为一体，还会与守卫艾索卡尔林飘渺传送门的坚韧守望者融为一体
desc.en: Whoever dons this cloak does not just become one with the forest, but one with the hardened sentinels who guard Athel Caiellin’s fluctuating portals.

desc.zh: 穿上这件披风的人不仅会与森林融为一体，还会与守卫艾索卡尔林飘渺传送门的坚韧守望者融为一体
desc.en: Whoever dons this cloak does not just become one with the forest, but one with the hardened sentinels who guard Athel Caiellin’s fluctuating portals.

desc.zh: 穿上这件披风的人不仅会与森林融为一体，还会与守卫艾索卡尔林飘渺传送门的坚韧守望者融为一体
desc.en: Whoever dons this cloak does not just become one with the forest, but one with the hardened sentinels who guard Athel Caiellin’s fluctuating portals.

desc.zh: 当使用这一魔法物品后，使用者会瞬间进入恍惚状态，并获得足以媲美十二次深度睡眠的治疗效果
desc.en: A momentary trance induced on a subject using this magical trinket instantaneously mimics the healing effects of a dozen deep sleeps.

desc.zh: 当使用这一魔法物品后，使用者会瞬间进入恍惚状态，并获得足以媲美十二次深度睡眠的治疗效果
desc.en: A momentary trance induced on a subject using this magical trinket instantaneously mimics the healing effects of a dozen deep sleeps.

desc.zh: 当使用这一魔法物品后，使用者会瞬间进入恍惚状态，并获得足以媲美十二次深度睡眠的治疗效果
desc.en: A momentary trance induced on a subject using this magical trinket instantaneously mimics the healing effects of a dozen deep sleeps.

desc.zh: 在合适的时机下，从这个附魔箭筒中抽出的箭矢会受到塔里恩灵魂的加持，从而更为精准地贯穿那些残忍的心脏
desc.en: At opportune moments, an arrow pulled from this enchanted quiver is willed by Talyn's spirit to fly truer towards cruel hearts.

desc.zh: 这只巨大的号角足以发出最为纯粹的号声，振奋胆怯的内心，鼓舞怯懦的精神
desc.en: No purer sound is there than a single note from this great horn, capable of emboldening the faint of heart and rousing the timid.

desc.zh: 这只巨大的号角足以发出最为纯粹的号声，振奋胆怯的内心，鼓舞怯懦的精神
desc.en: No purer sound is there than a single note from this great horn, capable of emboldening the faint of heart and rousing the timid.

desc.zh: 这副面具呈巨龙半张嘴的样式，它所能提供的直接防护虽然不高，但可以散发出足以默默软化敌人的光环——心灵、护甲，以及所有的一切
desc.en: With the form of a Dragon’s ajar jaws, this mask offers scant protection but emanates an aura that silently softens foes – hearts, armour and all.

desc.zh: 这副面具呈巨龙半张嘴的样式，它所能提供的直接防护虽然不高，但可以散发出足以默默软化敌人的光环——心灵、护甲，以及所有的一切
desc.en: With the form of a Dragon’s ajar jaws, this mask offers scant protection but emanates an aura that silently softens foes – hearts, armour and all.

desc.zh: 这副面具呈巨龙半张嘴的样式，它所能提供的直接防护虽然不高，但可以散发出足以默默软化敌人的光环——心灵、护甲，以及所有的一切
desc.en: With the form of a Dragon’s ajar jaws, this mask offers scant protection but emanates an aura that silently softens foes – hearts, armour and all.

desc.zh: 在凡世中，许多人都相信这件强大的魔法阻尼器曾是自然之神塔尔的贴身神器
desc.en: Many in the realms of men believe this powerful dampener of magic was once carried by their God of Nature, Taal himself.

desc.zh: 这个头盔拥有强大的魔力，足以使优秀的领袖变得伟大，使伟大的领袖变成传奇
desc.en: The inspirational magic of this helm can make a good leader into a great one, and a great leader into a legend.

desc.zh: 『向我的小朋友们问好、问好，是的、是的！』
desc.en: "Say hello-hello to my little friends, yes-yes!"

desc.zh: 仅仅需要暮光姐妹的只言片语，这头强大的森林龙便会毫不犹豫地冲入战团中去！
desc.en: The Sisters’ mighty Forest Dragon thinks nothing of hurling himself into the thick of the fray on their slightest word!

desc.zh: 格温达洛尔始终盘旋在天空之上，警惕地注视着下面的状况，并随时准备响应女主人的呼叫
desc.en: Ever circling the skies above, Gwindalor is always alert to events occurring beneath him, and ready to respond to his mistresses’ calls.

desc.zh: 使用洛依克亲自赐福的咒文之歌，便可避开色孽的凝视，令人变得难以察觉，难以捕捉
desc.en: Using rhythmic incantations endowed and employed by Loec himself to avoid Slaanesh’s gaze, one can stay unseen and uncaught.

desc.zh: 熟练的外科手术技巧与仓促的类固醇注射让受伤的怪物了活了下来，并从此变得嗜杀如命
desc.en: Masterful field surgery techniques and hastily administered steroid shots keep wounded monsters alive and keen to maximise the slaughtering.

desc.zh: 狂野树妖的忽然出现通常是个严厉的警告：森林已经彻底释放了自己的愤怒
desc.en: A sudden sprouting of savage Dryads is often the first tangible warning that the forest’s savagery has truly been unleashed.

desc.zh: 狂野树妖的忽然出现通常是个严厉的警告：森林已经彻底释放了自己的愤怒
desc.en: A sudden sprouting of savage Dryads is often the first tangible warning that the forest’s savagery has truly been unleashed.

desc.zh: 狂野树妖的忽然出现通常是个严厉的警告：森林已经彻底释放了自己的愤怒
desc.en: A sudden sprouting of savage Dryads is often the first tangible warning that the forest’s savagery has truly been unleashed.

desc.zh: 当完成时，触目所及之处所余唯有白地
desc.en: When it is done there shall remain but mounds of ash as far as the eye can see.

desc.zh: 像塞辛-哈尔这样的真正的掠食者，就算受伤也不会变得软弱，而是会变成更加气血上涌的致命敌人
desc.en: A true predator like Ceithin-Har shows no weakness when wounded, simply becoming even more of an impulsively deadly foe.

desc.zh: 若是双子姐妹中的一人濒临死亡，那么另一人的灵魂便会注入其中，从而将其治愈
desc.en: Should either sister come close to death, the spirit of one flows into the other, thus healing her.

desc.zh: 戴查的灵魂永远都在沸腾，而她受到的外伤只会进一步刺激她的报复心与杀戮心
desc.en: Drycha’s soul eternally seethes, her external wounds only further fuelling her vindictive, murderous intent.

desc.zh: 格温达洛尔的侦察技巧就像它的战斗技巧一样锐利，它总是能找出便于暮光姐妹造成最大伤害的位置
desc.en: Gwindalor is as valuable for reconnaissance as he is for combat, sensing the most advantageous positions from which the Sisters can inflict the most harm.

desc.zh: 从他最野蛮的造物到那些低贱的腐兽，斯洛特驾驭军队的技巧总是会让手下们对任何失败的可能性都感到心惊胆战
desc.en: From his most brutish creations down to his diminutive Throtlings, Throt’s knack for subjugating troops has them always fearing the possibility of failure.

desc.zh: 林地和灌木丛足以让你躲避尘世，但森林之王却绝不可如此
desc.en: Foliage and shrubbery oft suffice to hide from the mundane, but the King in the Woods is anything but.

desc.zh: 当他们最为需要的时刻，先祖的强大护卫能力会牢牢地卫护阿斯莱一族
desc.en: The warding powers of the Ancients are manifested to harden the Asrai in times of their greatest need.

desc.zh: 在最为紧要的关头，只要用正确的木材刻出箭矢，那么这些箭矢将射得又快又准
desc.en: At the most opportune moment, arrows are willed to fly fast and true by the very wood from which they are carved.

desc.zh: 施法者狂野地挥动着手势，给友军注入狂暴之力，让他们向敌军发泄自己的疯狂！
desc.en: Gesticulating wildly, the caster gifts an allied unit with a rabid, frothing need to attack and consume the foe!

desc.zh: 法师从土地中召唤出治愈性的能量，以来自大地的自然痊愈之力庇护战士们
desc.en: The Wizard draws wholesome energies from the soil, imbuing companions with the natural resilience of the earth.

desc.zh: 这一法术可以暂时将友军的血肉之躯转换成刀枪不入的岩石皮肤，从而大大增强其抵御攻击的能力
desc.en: This spell temporarily transforms allies' mortal flesh into unbreakable rock, increasing tenfold their resistance to attack.

desc.zh: 法师呼唤着杜仁铎之名，以超乎寻常的速度治愈盟友的伤势
desc.en: By speaking Druthandor's name the Wizard is able to heal allies' injuries much faster than by natural means.

desc.zh: 在施法者的召唤下，充满灵体的云雾将覆盖敌军，无形的利爪狠狠掐住敌人的咽喉
desc.en: At the spellcaster's command, nebulous nature spirits assail the foe, clawing with hands not nearly as insubstantial as they first appear.

desc.zh: 亡灵法师能不断唤醒新的尸体加入自己的大军
desc.en: Necromancers can awaken mortal remains to reinforce their Undead legions.

desc.zh: 高浓度的酸突然倾泻到周围的人身上，融化盔甲，灼伤皮肤
desc.en: A sudden discharge of highly-concentrated acid douses everyone nearby, melting away armour and burning skin.

desc.zh: 持续的高烧是种拙劣强化的症状，但它容易爆炸的副作用却使得宿主成为了一种潜在的有效武器
desc.en: A constantly spiking fever is a symptom of a botched augmentation, but the explosive side effects make the subject a potentially effective weapon.

desc.zh: 当特别调制的培养液涌进它肮脏的身体时，这个变异的缝合梦魇发出了痛苦的咆哮
desc.en: The mutated, stitched nightmare roars in pain as a surge of specially concocted Growth Juice courses through its foul body.

desc.zh: 在体内邪恶微生物的推动下，即使是受了致命伤的生物也能保持完整的运动机能
desc.en: Driven forward by unholy micro-organisms within, even a mortally-wounded creature can retain full motor function.

desc.zh: 库诺斯将他的超自然狩猎术赋予了空中的猎手，让他们的箭矢足以射倒皮肤最厚的猎物
desc.en: Kurnous bestows his supernatural huntsmanship unto the hunters of the sky, allowing their arrows to bring down quarry with the thickest hides.

desc.zh: 恐怖的墨绿色闪电，自斯卡文鼠人粗糙的次元石电棒中喷薄而出
desc.en: Dire greenish-black lightning strikes at the Skaven’s crude Warpstone implant.

desc.zh: 剑吟者的舞蹈或许会以优雅的单脚尖旋转开始，但总是会以暴力的大漩涡结束——腥风血雨的屠杀！
desc.en: A Bladesinger’s dance may start as a mesmerising, graceful pirouette, but always ends as a violent maelstrom of slicing, gashing slaughter!

desc.zh: 这些精灵自以为是在为艾瑞尔女王而战，但事实上他们是被强大的魔力控制着
desc.en: These Elves think they fight for their queen, Ariel, but in fact are under a powerful spell.

desc.zh: 虽然战林的精灵们仍然受到自己正为女王而战的魅惑，但这个法术的副作用已受到了压制
desc.en: Though the wargrove’s Elves remain under the enchanted delusion that they fight for their queen, the spell’s debilitations have been overcome.

desc.zh: 虽说斯洛特在努力避免这一点，但赋予军队的那些力量通常会带来预期寿命恶化的代价
desc.en: Despite Throt’s efforts to the contrary, the powers gifted to his troops often come with a price of a deteriorating life expectancy.

desc.zh: 虽说斯洛特在努力避免这一点，但赋予军队的那些力量通常会带来预期寿命恶化的代价
desc.en: Despite Throt’s efforts to the contrary, the powers gifted to his troops often come with a price of a deteriorating life expectancy.

desc.zh: 虽说斯洛特在努力避免这一点，但赋予军队的那些力量通常会带来预期寿命恶化的代价
desc.en: Despite Throt’s efforts to the contrary, the powers gifted to his troops often come with a price of a deteriorating life expectancy.

desc.zh: 过多的变异可能会让这支部队在战场上炸成一滩碎肉和血末！
desc.en: One too many augmentations means this unit may not make it to the end of a battle without exploding into splatters of guts and flesh!

desc.zh: 受到凯恩的疯狂折磨的人会被下意思的狂暴嗜血欲望所吞噬，这种欲望会耗尽他们躯体中的每一根纤维
desc.en: Those afflicted by the Madness of Khaine are consumed by a mindless, rampaging bloodlust that debilitates every fibre of their being.

desc.zh: 当你不断地排出易燃化学品时，那么尽可能地往敌人堆里钻就是个非常好的主意了！
desc.en: When you are constantly emitting flammable chemicals, it is a good idea to stay as close to your enemies as possible!

desc.zh: 有句胆小鬼的俗语说得好：『留得青山在，不怕没柴烧』
desc.en: "He who runs away lives to fight another day!" – so the foul, craven adage goes.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 大量注入次元燃料，这使得这家伙变成了非常危险的突变体：它会不由自主地随意释放破坏性的魔法漩涡
desc.en: One too many Warp-fuel infusions have made the Hellion a volatile mutant indeed, allowing it to spontaneously discharge destructive magical vortices at will.

desc.zh: 紫杉的树枝非常柔软，但它的浆果很致命
desc.en: The Yew's branches are supple, but its berries deadly.

desc.zh: 斯洛特的便携式捕捉器让他成为了扼喉专家，也让他足以捕捉比人类大得多的生物！
desc.en: Throt’s modified things-catcher makes him an expert throttler, but allows him to excel at throttling things much larger than man-sized!

desc.zh: 矛尖乃是由一支森林龙的利爪磨砺而成，而龙之愤怒至今仍寄宿在这把长矛之中
desc.en: A sharpened claw at this spear’s tip is impelled by the rage of the ancient Forest Dragon to whom it once belonged.

desc.zh: 这把武器上有着奇怪而飘渺的刻痕，其中寄宿着某种能对战场地形获得本能般感知的力量
desc.en: This weapon’s strange, ethereal carvings betoken a power that can grant instinctive awareness of the lay of a battlefield.

desc.zh: 葛林姆尼尔将亲手向敌人复仇，他从地心扯出熔化的石块扔向敌人，造出漫天的火雨
desc.en: Grimnir himself seeks vengeance on the foe, smiting them with a hail of molten rock torn from the earth’s bowels.

desc.zh: 葛朗尼的符文与先祖之神的怒火产生共鸣，强化打击敌人的力道与使用武器时的勇猛
desc.en: Grungni’s rune resonates with the fury of the Ancestor God himself, inspiring the smiting of foes and valour at arms.

desc.zh: 瓦拉雅为矮人灌注坚韧，为受伤之人提供新的力量，为动摇的心注入新的决意
desc.en: Valaya instils the Dwarfs with fortitude, lending new strength to the wounded and fresh resolve to wavering hearts.

desc.zh: 野兽人发出凶蛮狂野的呼号奔袭而来，令防御者们步履蹒跚、不堪一击
desc.en: Beastmen raids are accompanied by wild, inhuman sounds that leave defenders staggered and vulnerable.

desc.zh: 野兽人发出凶蛮狂野的呼号奔袭而来，令防御者们步履蹒跚、不堪一击
desc.en: Beastmen raids are accompanied by wild, inhuman sounds that leave defenders staggered and vulnerable.

desc.zh: 玩家永远不会直接看到或控制它
desc.en: This is never directly seen or controlled by the player.

desc.zh: 玩家永远不会直接看到或控制它
desc.en: This is never directly seen or controlled by the player.

desc.zh: 玩家永远不会直接看到或控制它
desc.en: This is never directly seen or controlled by the player.

desc.zh: 一堵石墙就算挡不住所有人，也能挡住大部分的不速之客，但在面对混沌之怒时依旧无能为力
desc.en: Even a stone wall which would stop most, if not all, comers is no defence against the unbridled fury of Chaos.

desc.zh: 一个黑暗阴郁、致人衰弱的漩涡蜿蜒穿过敌人的队伍，使他们的行动立刻减缓下来，仿佛索提戈亲临召唤一般
desc.en: A murky, debilitating vortex snakes through the enemy’s ranks as if Sotek himself is invoked, instantly slowing their movements.

desc.zh: 莫尔斯里布的低语能够使野兽人陷入可怖的狂热，无人能在这种力量下苟全性命
desc.en: Morrslieb's whispers can drive Beastmen into a terrifying frenzy, the power of which few can survive.

desc.zh: 从神圣之主兹卡迪那里召唤他麾下最难以捉摸的变色龙潜行者
desc.en: Summoned from the sacred host of Tzcatli himself comes a cohort of his most elusive Chameleon Stalkers.

desc.zh: 弓手伸手去摸下一支箭，却发现箭袋已经融化，弓弦也已松弛！
desc.en: The archer reaches for his next arrow, only to find his quivers dissolved and his bowstring slack!

desc.zh: 这一法术会召唤出潜伏地下的爬虫，令大群的蜘蛛、蜈蚣与食肉甲虫吞没敌军
desc.en: This spell calls to the creeping things of the undergrowth, sending a swarm of spiders, centipedes and slug-beetles onto the foe.

desc.zh: 复仇的毒雨从敌人头顶倾泻而下，毒杀敌人、蚀透护甲
desc.en: A toxic barrage of noxious vengeance rains down upon the foe, poisoning enemies and permeating their armour.

desc.zh: 『把战争机器带上来！把望远镜给我！』
desc.en: "Bring the Barag forwards! Hand me that spyglass!"

desc.zh: 此人被诅咒着必须走遍世界的山山水水，他的征途永无止境：挑战并击败那些世间最强的勇士
desc.en: Cursed to wander the length and breadth of the world, his never-ending quest to challenge and best the most gifted warriors.

desc.zh: 『退后！这些玩意像矮人一样靠谱没错，但只试验过一千次而已！』
desc.en: "Stand Back! These are Dawr, but this is only the milluzth attempt!"

desc.zh: 在战场上，对箭矢、炮弹以及各种五花八门弹药的需求无穷无尽
desc.en: Arrows, cannonballs and more esoteric munitions are needed in endless supply on the battlefield.

name.en: Something Wicked This Way Comes Upgraded

desc.zh: 单单是『黑暗征兆』的现身，便足以强烈动摇敌军的战意
desc.en: The presence of the Dark Omen is an awful thing that saps the foe's will to fight on.

desc.zh: 这位冠军勇士为一种奇异的末日愿景与彻底的仇恨所控制，将黑暗诸神的意志传递开去
desc.en: Possessed by a singular, apocalyptic vision and utter hatred, this champion proliferates the Dark Gods' will.

desc.zh: 托雷克的自制盔甲足以挡下巨人的棍棒！纵使是面对妖龙德拉卡摩尔的烈焰，这位符文领主也会毫发无伤
desc.en: Thorek’s self-crafted armour can turn a Giant’s club, allowing the Runelord to walk unscathed through the flames of the Wyrm Drakamol.

desc.zh: 一件极其简单的粗糙武器加上末日蛮牛超凡的冲击力，便足以破开盔甲，造成致命的杀伤
desc.en: A brutally simple weapon makes the Doombull’s incredible punching power more than enough to puncture armour and cause dreadful injury.

desc.zh: 血兽为极度暴力的景象激动不已，在剧烈的抽搐中痉挛颤抖
desc.en: Seized by hyperviolent visions, the Bloodbeast spasms and shakes in a violent thrashing of fiery convulsions.

desc.zh: 陶诺斯祈唤赐他赠礼的黑暗之主，使得他那黄铜皮肤一时变得更加坚硬，甚至硬到超越了常理
desc.en: Invoking the Dark Masters who endowed his gift, Taurox’s brazen skin temporarily hardens even further to an impossible rigidity.

desc.zh: 凭借在混沌魔域磨练出的潜行能力，欧西约坦在追寻踪迹、盯梢目标方面的技艺无人能及
desc.en: With stealth capabilities honed in the Realm of Chaos, Oxyotl’s skill at tracking and stalking his targets is unparalleled.

desc.zh: 末日铁砧上所镌刻符文能与内心深处产生共鸣，无论是敌是友
desc.en: Etched upon the Anvil of Doom is a rune that can resonate with deep vibrations felt by both friend and foe.

desc.zh: 弗拉德的出现会极大地激励其手下的忠仆，无人胆敢同亡灵之主作对！
desc.en: Vlad motivates his devoted followers with his majestic presence; the Lord of Undeath is without peer.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满的周身环绕着堕落法术的气息，足以将现世扭曲并加以毒害
desc.en: A palpable miasma of fell sorcery surrounds the Bray-Shaman, distorting and maiming reality.

desc.zh: 铁砧散发着浓烈的神力，强烈地影响着敌方法师的思绪
desc.en: The dense power exuded from the Anvil weighs heavily upon the minds of enemy Wizards.

desc.zh: 那些最博学多闻的符文领主们自力打造的符文武器，每次挥击都能驭起八风之力
desc.en: The self-crafted, rune-covered armaments of the most learned Runelords can harness the Winds’ potency each time they are brought to blows.

desc.zh: 砸断他们的脊梁，敲打他们的心灵。把他们踩进泥土，这样他们就不会再对你举刀相向了
desc.en: When their backs are broken, strike upon the anvils of their minds. Drive them into the ground, so they never raise a blade to you again.

desc.zh: 魔古尔的毁灭之力聚集成了变形的光环。它蔓延开去，撕裂任何敢于靠近之人的理智与肉体
desc.en: Morghur's Ruinous, transformative aura turns outwards, tearing at the sanity and flesh of those who dare step close.

desc.zh: 符文铁匠们最爱听见其他种族的劣质制品在一锤之下发出如同碎冰的声音
desc.en: Runesmiths take particular delight in the sound of the inferior works of other races breaking like icicles beneath a hammer blow.

desc.zh: 这枚符文拥有着碎盔破甲的强大力量，在世界诞生之初就用于奇袭矮人之敌
desc.en: This rune has been used to surprise the Dwarfs’ foes with armour-shattering power since the world was young.

desc.zh: 为了防止珍贵的战争机器落入敌人手中，这枚符文只有在绝境下才会使用
desc.en: Invoked only in desperate circumstances, this rune has been devised to keep prized war machines from falling into enemy hands.

desc.zh: 迟缓符文能硬化空气，阻碍那些想跟优良的矮人战斧较量一番的敌人
desc.en: The Rune of Slowness hardens the air around those seeking to engage with honest Dwarfen axes.

desc.zh: 这枚符文能强化持有者的警觉和速度，使其动作更加流畅，令较快的对手也猝不及防
desc.en: This rune enhances its bearer’s awareness and quickness so that he moves more fluidly, taking faster opponents by surprise.

desc.zh: 符文铁匠们最爱听见其他种族的劣质制品在一锤之下发出如同碎冰的声音
desc.en: Runesmiths take particular delight in the sound of the inferior works of other races breaking like icicles beneath a hammer blow.

desc.zh: 迟缓符文能硬化空气，阻碍那些想跟优良的矮人战斧较量一番的敌人
desc.en: The Rune of Slowness hardens the air around those seeking to engage with honest Dwarfen axes.

desc.zh: 这枚符文能强化持有者的警觉和速度，使其动作更加流畅，令较快的对手也猝不及防
desc.en: This rune enhances its bearer’s awareness and quickness so that he moves more fluidly, taking faster opponents by surprise.

desc.zh: 这是嵌进卡拉扎-阿-卡拉克大门上的第一枚符文，它所散发的破坏光环足以驱散大部分的敌人
desc.en: First embedded in the gates of Karaz-a-Karak, the damaging aura permeating from this rune is enough to turn most enemies away.

desc.zh: 黑暗畜生们要小心了，因为法师会释放出一道纯净光波，将白魔法之敌尽数放逐
desc.en: Creatures of the dark beware, for the Mage casts a ball of pure light to banish enemies of White Wizardry.

desc.zh: 闪电电弧扫过战场，在敌人间疯狂跳跃，爆裂声不绝于耳，直到波及的所有敌人都化为灰烬
desc.en: Lightning arcs across the battlefield, leaping from foe-to-foe with crackling fury until there are none left within the storm.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满以野性的力量控制一只独眼巨人，并将其召上战场
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman sends his mind winging into the wilds to possess a Cygor, then summons it to the battlefield.

desc.zh: 多刺的荆棘从施法者盟友周围的地表喷涌而出，形成一道尖刺拱卫的鲜活护盾
desc.en: Prickly gorse bursts from the ground around the caster's allies, protecting them from attack like a spiky, living shield.

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向了敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the spellcaster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出强大的闪电球并投向敌人，被击中者必定粉身碎骨！
desc.en: The caster calls down a mighty ball of lightning and hurls it - should the foe be struck they will surely be shattered!

desc.zh: 符文能量在托雷克的强大战锤中汇聚，噼啪作响，升腾不已，爆发出足以撼地的霹雳
desc.en: The runic energy within Thorek's mighty hammer builds and crackles, erupting in an earth-shattering thunderbolt.

desc.zh: 作为史兰魔祭司的使者，先知可以驾驭超过其能力范围的狂野魔法…然而，这需要付出一定的代价
desc.en: Acting as a conduit for a Slann Mage-Priest, the Oracle can wield magic beyond its own capabilities – at a cost.

desc.zh: 戈洛克是个传奇的牛头怪，此人性情烈如暴风。对于穿戴者来说，他的灵魂披风实在是个可怕而危险的物品
desc.en: Ghorok was a legendary Minotaur, ferocious as a storm. His spirit-mantle is terrible but dangerous to the bearer.

desc.zh: 所有蜥蜴人都为穴居龙的嘶叫所惊醒，那诡异的叫声会激发出他们的野性
desc.en: All Lizardmen are roused at the wailing cry of the Troglodon, its eerie call stirring their savagery.

desc.zh: 那些与疯语兽对视过久的人将会精神错乱，甚至在疯狂的逃窜中伤到自己
desc.en: Those that look upon the Jabberslythe for too long will suffer insanity, even causing injury to themselves in desperation of escape.

desc.zh: 鲜血的气息越是浓厚，就会越发疯狂与凶蛮！
desc.en: Becoming more savage and frenzied the greater the scent and sight of blood.

desc.zh: 这是一个隐藏技能，可以提高领主军中所有部队的地图侦测范围
desc.en: This is a hidden ability that boosts the spotting range of all units in the lord's army to be roughly map-wide.

desc.zh: 人马兽们灌下抢来的酒，以粗俗的动作趾高气扬地虚张声势，好给自己壮胆
desc.en: Fuelled by looted wine, the Centigors strut and swagger with vulgar bravado to boost their own vigour.

desc.zh: 那些与疯语兽对视过久的人将会精神错乱，甚至在疯狂的逃窜中伤到自己
desc.en: Those that look upon the Jabberslythe for too long will suffer insanity, even causing injury to themselves in desperation of escape.

desc.zh: 这股力量岂止会令肉体重生？就连那些看上去已死去的东西，也能重新编织起来！
desc.en: Beyond mere restoration of the flesh, even that which lay seemingly dead upon the ground could be knitted together once more.

desc.zh: 这些守护者拱卫着最为神秘与神圣的地方，他们可以操纵环境掩去自己的行踪，从敌人眼前遁形
desc.en: These guardians of the most secret and sacred places can manipulate their environment to obscure themselves from foes.

desc.zh: 在氏族长们的激励，以及对血域遭到入侵的愤恨驱使下，野兽人们会爆发出极度蛮荒的狂怒！
desc.en: Goaded by Chieftains and enraged by intruders on their blood-grounds, Beastmen become consumed by a savage furore!

desc.zh: 酸液从这只疯语兽的伤口上喷射而出，其浓度足以蚀穿坚固的铠甲，溶解其下的血肉
desc.en: So concentrated is the spurting vitriolic bile of this Jabberslythe’s wounds that it eats through solid armour to dissolve the flesh below.

desc.zh: 这只恐怖的生物浑身流脓，能从最微小的伤口嘶嘶地喷出恶臭的酸液
desc.en: This horrid creature bleeds stinking, vitriolic bile that spurts out from the slightest wound in great gouts of hissing back fluid.

desc.zh: 只要在敌方阵线中不断大快朵颐，便能令其血肉通红，伤势焕然痊愈
desc.en: A frequent gorging on the enemy’s battle lines leads to this one’s flesh flushing red as its wounds reknit themselves.

desc.zh: 不知是通过秘术还是魔法，这支部队拥有能够快速重新部署到所需之处的便捷能力
desc.en: Whether by some esoteric or magical means, this unit has a heightened ability to rapidly relocate to where it is needed.

desc.zh: 来自古代坟茔的诅咒遗物不管是切开肉体还是撕裂灵魂，都是一样地干净利落
desc.en: Accursed relics from ancient barrows cleave the soul as easily as they part the flesh.

desc.zh: 只需轻轻一吹，这支小巧的金色吹箭筒就能射出致命的飞镖
desc.en: With just the lightest exhalation, this golden instrument of death blasts forth a hail of murderous darts.

desc.zh: 野蛮的傲气充盈铜牛之心，他疯狂挥动着刻有符文的战斧。纵使怒气极为罕见地稍有平息，他也会狠狠地让战斧不断对撞在一起
desc.en: The Brass Bull wields his rune-inscribed axes with savage pride, constantly clashing them together in the rare moments between his rampages.

desc.zh: 帝国的黑暗守护者既不撤退也不投降，即使面临着看似不可逾越的困难
desc.en: The Empire's dark guardians do not retreat. Neither do they surrender, even when faced with seemingly insurmountable odds.

desc.zh: 对于法官、陪审团和刽子手来说，如果要把恶人赶尽杀绝，手上就必须拥有正确的武器
desc.en: When serving as judge, jury and executioner, one must have the correct tools if the wicked are to be weeded out for punishment.

desc.zh: 巫婆用黑魔法召唤出一个装满鲜血的血池，从黑色方舟的甲板上降下。其冲击极具破坏性，因为这些血液肮脏不堪，具有腐蚀性
desc.en: Using Dark Magic, the crones hurl a blood-filled cauldron at the foe from the Black Ark’s deck. Its impact is devastating, as the blood within is a foul, corrosive brew.

desc.zh: 这个被诅咒的抛射器冒着黑火，可以追寻目标。它经由魔法精铸而成，射出的火球强力而凶猛，绝不会射偏目标
desc.en: This cursed projectile of black fire will hunt out its targets. The magicks wrought mean the fireball stubbornly and spitefully refuses to miss.

desc.zh: 巫婆用黑魔法召唤出一个装满鲜血的血池，从黑色方舟的甲板上降下。其冲击极具破坏性，因为这些血液肮脏不堪，具有腐蚀性
desc.en: Using Dark Magic, the crones hurl a blood-filled cauldron at the foe from the Black Ark’s deck. Its impact is devastating, as the blood within is a foul, corrosive brew.

desc.zh: ph
desc.en: ph

desc.zh: 漩涡会为魔法之风生成一个风眼，让其变得更为猛烈，从而增强周围施法者的力量
desc.en: The Spire creates a focal point for the Winds of Magic, ensuring they blow strongly to boost the power of nearby spellcasters.

desc.zh: 黑魔法的猛烈流动会造成一场爆炸，除了施法者之外的周围一切人员都会被炸伤，但施法者也会筋疲力竭
desc.en: An intense inrush of Dark Magic causes an explosion that damages all around except the casting unit, who remain intact yet exhausted.

desc.zh: 将圣所布置在战略位置，令这些凶悍而忠诚的猛禽会暂时飞来帮助精灵盟友
desc.en: A base, strategically-positioned nearby, ensures that these exceptionally-powerful, exceedingly-loyal birds can join their Elven allies at a moment's notice.

desc.zh: 『嘘！这是个秘密，是的、是的，快把它藏起来，要不就缝起来。是的、是的！』
desc.en: "Ssshhh! It's a secret, yes-yes, trap shut or sewn shut, yes-yes!"

desc.zh: 这些凶狠的野兽十分狂野，非常适合骑术高超的蜥蜴人进行骑乘
desc.en: Wild and untamed, these frightening, aggressive beasts make perfect mounts for those Lizardmen with the skill to ride them.

desc.zh: 这些凶狠的野兽十分狂野，非常适合骑术高超的蜥蜴人进行骑乘
desc.en: Wild and untamed, these frightening, aggressive beasts make perfect mounts for those Lizardmen with the skill to ride them.

desc.zh: 蜥蜴人灵脉巨网的中心，可以施放强大的奥术魔法攻击敌人
desc.en: A focal point of the Lizardmen's great Geomantic Web, from which arcane spells of great power are directed at the foe.

desc.zh: 碑文描述了古圣的圣言，可以对远程的敌人进行打击
desc.en: The Old Ones' sacred words, given agency through the written word, to smite foes who have hitherto lurked just out of range.

desc.zh: 海盗向血手之神祈祷，天空中闪电划过：这正是凯恩抽打敌人灵魂的鞭子
desc.en: As the Corsairs invoke the Bloody-handed God, fell lightning arcs from the sky; it is the lash of Khaine upon the souls of the enemy.

desc.zh: 海盗向血手之神祈祷，天空中闪电划过：这正是凯恩抽打敌人灵魂的鞭子
desc.en: As the Corsairs invoke the Bloody-handed God, fell lightning arcs from the sky; it is the lash of Khaine upon the souls of the enemy.

desc.zh: 海盗向血手之神祈祷，天空中闪电划过：这正是凯恩抽打敌人灵魂的鞭子
desc.en: As the Corsairs invoke the Bloody-handed God, fell lightning arcs from the sky; it is the lash of Khaine upon the souls of the enemy.

desc.zh: 只需要诱惑地一瞥，敌人脑中邪念一闪，一颗灵魂就永远遁入了痛苦之中
desc.en: A seductive glance; the glimmer of an idea; a soul tricked into eternal torment.

desc.zh: 有了摩斯氏族的神圣次元石，这些暴躁的战士们就会被灌入更多的活力与技巧
desc.en: On the battlefield, Clan Mors' sacred Warpstones instil their upstart warriors with even greater stamina and skill.

desc.zh: 想要搞药剂搞到死是不是？腐坏氏族用神圣的次元石使自己的军队在战场上占据了技术优势
desc.en: Better dying through chemistry? Clan Moulder use revered Warpstones to give their troops unnatural, engineered advantage in the field.

desc.zh: 瘟疫僧使用神圣的次元石使自己常用的瘟疫与疾病更加强大
desc.en: The Plague Monks use their sacred Warpstone to increase the potency of the vile plagues and virulent diseases that are their stock in trade.

desc.zh: 安列克的黑墙中尽是欺诈与阴谋。同样，这座城市固有的黑魔法会强化驻扎的守军
desc.en: Deceit and fell-plots abound within the dark walls of Anlec. As such, the city's innate Dark Magic imbues those tasked with its defence.

desc.zh: 这是科技还是法术？无论如何，史库里氏族有了神圣的次元石就可以消除敌人的魔法抗性
desc.en: Is it science? Be it sorcery? Whatever it is, Clan Skryre's harnessing of blest-Warpstone degrades the foe's magical resistance to nil.

desc.zh: 巫婆用黑魔法召唤出一个装满鲜血的血池，从黑色方舟的甲板上降下。其冲击极具破坏性，因为这些血液肮脏不堪，具有腐蚀性
desc.en: Using Dark Magic, the crones hurl a blood-filled cauldron at the foe from the Black Ark’s deck. Its impact is devastating, as the blood within is a foul, corrosive brew.

desc.zh: 黑色方舟上许多奴隶的灵魂被『抽取』出来，用法术射向天空，如同致命的雨点一样砸到地上
desc.en: The souls of many slaves brought aboard the Black Ark are ‘extracted’ and fired into the sky by sorcerous means, only to fall back to the surface as deadly rain.

desc.zh: 黑色方舟上许多奴隶的灵魂被『抽取』出来，用法术射向天空，如同致命的雨点一样砸到地上
desc.en: The souls of many slaves brought aboard the Black Ark are ‘extracted’ and fired into the sky by sorcerous means, only to fall back to the surface as deadly rain.

desc.zh: 黑色方舟上许多奴隶的灵魂被『抽取』出来，用法术射向天空，如同致命的雨点一样砸到地上
desc.en: The souls of many slaves brought aboard the Black Ark are ‘extracted’ and fired into the sky by sorcerous means, only to fall back to the surface as deadly rain.

desc.zh: ph
desc.en: ph

desc.zh: 斯兰雾佩克的漩涡迷雾可以用水和空气帮助蜥蜴人军队进行战斗
desc.en: Xlanhuapec's swirling mists can take the form of elemental creatures of water or air to assist Lizardmen armies in battle.

desc.zh: 氏族鼠听到战斗的召唤后从各种裂缝里钻了出来，消耗并淹没敌军
desc.en: Hearing the call to battle, the Clanrats teem from every crack and crevice to consume and devour their enemies.

desc.zh: 侍奉精灵铸造之神的盲眼祭司们锻造了这把战锤，他也将自己的技巧与机敏注入其中，这柄战锤足以击垮一切
desc.en: Forged by the blind priests of the Elven God of Smiths, and imbued with his skill and shrewdness, the hammer crushes all it touches.

desc.zh: 一股来势汹涌劈啪作响的能量流伴随着闪光，预示着魔法震爆的来临，漩涡的力量瞬间崩裂至世界各处
desc.en: A surge of crackling energy and shimmering light heralds a blast of magic, as the power of the Vortex explodes into the world.

desc.zh: 漩涡的力量既能毁灭，也能治愈。其产出的魔法能量能够修复存活的组织，使之重获活力
desc.en: The Vortex can heal as well as harm, producing magical energy that can invigorate and mend living tissue.

desc.zh: 次元石具有极不稳定的魔能，可以用来做成致命的武器
desc.en: Warpstone's highly-unstable magical energies can be used to fashion devilishly deadly weapons.

desc.zh: 这面精心编制的战旗上绘有精灵族大获全胜的图像，旗上成百上千颗宝石散发着耀眼的光芒
desc.en: This heavily-woven banner is embroidered with detailed scenes of Elven victories and shines with the light of a thousand gems.

name.en: Sacred Banner of the Horned Rat

desc.zh: 这面战旗上的符文扭曲成各种语言，如此一来所有人就都知道大角鼠想要他们的灵魂
desc.en: The runes of this banner twist into any language, so all victims can understand the message that the Horned Rat wants their soul.

desc.zh: 这面古老的战旗可以用狂怒的风暴撕裂天空
desc.en: This ancient banner has the power to wrack the sky with storms, tearing the heavens apart with its fury.

desc.zh: 魔法祭司会为他所眷顾的仆从传导魔法，向敌人释放致命的法术
desc.en: A Mage-Priest may channel magic through his willing minions to cast deadly spells at the foe.

desc.zh: 这些刺客早已精于暗杀之道，经过时间的磨炼，他们技艺见长，这毫不意外
desc.en: It should be no great surprise that those already adept in the art of silent death continue to improve with time and practice.

desc.zh: 这种毒药有强烈的麻醉作用，可以让目标精神错乱
desc.en: This poison contains a powerful narcotic and drives its victims to delusional insanity.

desc.zh: 虽然蜥蜴人因为天生冷血而导致反应略慢，但这样使得他们在战场上更为坚韧
desc.en: While Lizardmen may be slow to react due to their cold-blooded nature, this also makes them stoic in battle.

desc.zh: 当这枚炸弹爆炸时会喷出黑色的烟幕，遮住希望隐藏自己的军队并让其他人难以呼吸
desc.en: When a bomb is smashed, a dark smoke curls out, concealing those who wish to hide and choking everyone else.

desc.zh: 中了黑暗剧毒的人只会在漫长的痛苦中丧命
desc.en: A victim of Dark Venom knows only a drawn-out and agonising death.

desc.zh: 古圣会为施法者建立能量壁垒，以免施法者遭受魔法攻击
desc.en: The resilience of the Old Ones is channelled into an energy barrier that protects its users from the full brunt of magical attacks against them.

desc.zh: 三角天神有时会将他的速度和敏捷赋予目标
desc.en: The speed and agility of the great three-horned ruler is sometimes bestowed upon his subjects.

desc.zh: 有时你倒会觉得鼠人的天生胆小竟然是他们最大的美德
desc.en: There is a sense in which the Skaven's natural cowardice can appear to be the very pinnacle of honourable conduct.

desc.zh: 出其不意地朝目标发射致命的箭雨。哎呦！
desc.en: By which an unexpected shower of pointy death rains down upon the unfortunate targets. Ouch!

desc.zh: 出其不意地朝目标发射致命的箭雨。哎呦！
desc.en: By which an unexpected shower of pointy death rains down upon the unfortunate targets. Ouch!

desc.zh: 从巫女女王的鲜血中萃取，这种邪恶的汁液会让饮者陷入毁灭的狂喜
desc.en: Distilled from the blood of Hag Queens, this evil brew drives imbibers into an ecstasy of destruction.

desc.zh: 周围的一切人都会感染致命毒气，患者的身体会被一股邪能冲破
desc.en: All around are caught in a deadly miasma of virulent disease that rips through their bodies with vile momentum.

desc.zh: 在战场上放出漫天箭雨，连太阳都被死亡之箭遮蔽
desc.en: Above the battlefield, the air is filled with arrows; a shroud of pure death blotting out the sun.

desc.zh: Not Used
desc.en: do not translate

desc.zh: 要引导魔法之风必须要有强大的心灵。那些拥有这种天赋的人便成为了奥术导体，将魔法的风暴导向他们的敌人
desc.en: A strong mind is needed to channel the Winds of Magic. Those that have such a gift become arcane conduits – funnelling the magical tempests to their cause.

desc.zh: 这个号角是由洁白的海螺制成。当吹响时，它可以撕裂诸界间的屏障，让祝福降临于世
desc.en: The horn is fashioned from a single pearl-white seashell. When winded, it can split the veil between worlds and grant a blessing.

desc.zh: 命令部队不按操典要求地进行漫射，这会射出不规则但是更为致命的死亡箭雨
desc.en: The authorisation to loose arrows without adherence to drill makes for an irregular - and therefore far deadlier - hail of pointed death.

desc.zh: 黑暗精灵通过杀戮来立足。当他们积累足够的杀戮时，会感受到自身的杀戮技巧得到了提升，仿佛凯恩亲自指引他们手中的利刃
desc.en: It is through killing that Dark Elves rise above other beings. Once engulfed in enough bloodshed, they will often feel their murderous prowess increase, as if Khaine himself was guiding the blades of his disciples.

desc.zh: 杀戮！没有什么比这更能取悦杀戮之神凯恩，而且这种敬神方式（甚至可以说日常消遣）在黑暗精灵中也很盛行
