desc.en: Slaughter! There is no greater glorification of Khaine, the God of Murder, and no more popular form of worship – or indeed daily exercise – amongst the Dark Elves.

desc.zh: 当他们满足了杀戮之后，就会感觉到自己的杀戮造诣得到了提升，就好像凯恩在亲自指引信徒们的利刃一样
desc.en: Once enough blood has been shed, the Dark Elves’ murderous prowess increases, as if Khaine himself was guiding his disciples' blades!

desc.zh: 工程术士们从神秘的东方窃取来了秘方，力图提升这些致命武器的推动力和负荷量
desc.en: Built with secrets stolen from the mysterious east, Warlock Engineers seek to improve the propulsion and payload of these devastating weapons.

desc.zh: 佩戴者遭受攻击时，这枚护符会爆发出无数水晶碎片，从而在短时间内大幅增强其抵御攻击的能力
desc.en: The amulet explodes into a million crystal shards if the wearer is struck, greatly improving their resistance to damage for a short time.

desc.zh: 星辰护甲堪称极品，深蓝色的板甲由法师锻铸而成，上面饰有许多宝石
desc.en: The Armour of the Stars is a wonder, mage-forged plate decorated with gems over a deep-blue lacquer.

desc.zh: 这串用宝珠贝壳、羽毛和骨头制成的饰品魔力强大，使战士被瘟疫毒雾所包围
desc.en: This string of beaded shells, feathers and bones is a charm that surrounds the warrior in a miasma of colour.

desc.zh: 在纳迦罗斯，经常会有人吞食黑龙之卵，这样吞食者就会吸收黑龙之力
desc.en: In Naggaroth, Black Dragon eggs are often consumed so that their devourers might take a portion of Dragon-strength.

desc.zh: 敬爱的智王之剑是一把举世闻名的屠龙利剑
desc.en: The sword of the beloved Scholar-King is a renowned wyrm-slayer.

desc.zh: 这尊雕像刻的是夏帕提，它经常会用祭品的鲜血来进行浸泡
desc.en: This statuette is carved in a likeness of Xapati, and is frequently bathed in offerings of blood.

desc.zh: 这本书多年以来一直被人们所研究，而它的碧蓝封面依旧如新装订一般纯朴
desc.en: This tome has been studied throughout the ages, yet its covers remain as blue and pristine as the day it was bound.

desc.zh: 这个小立方体内有一团黑球，外面有无数光芒环绕其间
desc.en: This small black cube contains millions of tiny pin-pricks of light circling around a sphere of pure darkness.

desc.zh: 瓦尔号角由精灵的锻造之神亲自制造，它震耳欲聋的号声会为所有听到它的人助威
desc.en: Crafted by the Elven God of Smiths himself, the Horn of Vaul bolsters all in earshot of its clarion call.

desc.zh: 这枚珍珠奇黑无比，可以吸收佩戴者的恐惧与自卑，使其内心变得强大起来
desc.en: This pearl of blackest jet soaks up dread, fear and self-doubt, leaving its wearer stronger within.

desc.zh: 饰板形似一张痛苦的脸，不小心看到它的人都会陷入疯狂
desc.en: Formed into the image of a grimacing face, this plaque causes the unwary to go mad just by looking upon it.

desc.zh: 据说这是用剥掉叛徒的皮制成的护符，佩戴这种护符可以获得大角鼠的眷顾
desc.en: Wearing the stitched hides of enemies slain through treachery is believed to attract the favour of the Horned Rat.

desc.zh: 司库克的连枷生满铁锈，满是凹痕，上面占满毒气，挥舞起来时可以散播瘟疫
desc.en: The flail of Skrolk is a rusted, pitted ball of miasma that spreads poxes as it is swung.

desc.zh: 此球是用恐怖的盲龙胆结石制成，据说可以预见未来
desc.en: An orb made of the polished gallstones from the dreaded Blindwyrm is said to be able to glimpse the future.

desc.zh: 这种恶臭的药剂可以强化骨骼，祛除百病，还能治愈致命创伤，迅速止血
desc.en: This foetid potion knits bones, seals flesh and stanches the flow of blood from mortal wounds.

desc.zh: 这种混合饮料是用次元石和许多生物的血制成的，其破坏效果极为出众
desc.en: This concoction is made of Warpstone and the blood of many creatures. Its effects are devastating.

desc.zh: 这根粗糙的法杖乍看像是精灵的，但外表总会骗人的…
desc.en: This gnarled staff looks out of place among the refined possession of the Elves. However, looks are oft deceiving…

desc.zh: 想要获得欺诈者洛依克的帮助是要付出代价的。而他的护符非常奇怪，是一条两两相拼的饰链
desc.en: Loec the Trickster‘s aid comes at a price. His talisman is strange - a bracelet of two interlocking halves.

desc.zh: 这个华丽的盾牌上绘有一条盘蛇，使用者会获得更为强大的保护
desc.en: A magnificent shield emblazoned with a coiled serpent, allowing its wielder to benefit from even greater protection.

desc.zh: 此物由黑铁制成，中间镶有椭圆红宝石，引导之眼可以使佩戴者看到神秘的景象
desc.en: Wrought in black iron with an oval ruby at its centre, the Guiding Eye grants mystical sight to its wearer.

desc.zh: 据说第一个拥有这支号角的勇士是传说中的克戈尔，传说他能一眼吓退一只暴龙！
desc.en: It is said that the legendary Kygor, the first owner of the horn, was a warrior who could stare down a Carnosaur!

desc.zh: 疫病魔典那朽烂的书页上所记载的邪恶咒语的确威力十足
desc.en: The vile cantrips written within the mouldering pages of the Liber Bubonicus are powerful indeed.

desc.zh: 所有想寻求洛依克眷顾的人都会佩戴一个简单的银色护符，而这里面其实蕴含了强大的力量
desc.en: All those who seek the favour of Loec wear a simple-looking pendant of silver that actually conceals great power.

desc.zh: 漩涡碎片的材质与引路石相同，其强大的力量可以平息魔法之风
desc.en: Hewn from the same rock that forms the Waystones, the Vortex Shard has the power to becalm the Winds of Magic.

desc.zh: 高声念出卷轴上的文字后，空中顿时乌云密布，电闪雷鸣，使空中部队无法飞行
desc.en: As the words of this scroll are read aloud, the heavens darken and lightning splits the skies, making flying impossible.

desc.zh: 鼠人搞到了许多的矮人陨铁，然后将它们制成了鼠人喜闻乐见的东西
desc.en: Many suits of Dwarfen Gromril have fallen into the clutches of the Skaven. Then they are remade to the ratmen’s liking.

name.zh: 加隆·克诺克的镀金号角

desc.zh: 法师吹响一个闪光的金色口哨，吉哈纳的金属猎犬应声而出并扑向自己的猎物
desc.en: Blowing on a glimmering golden whistle, the Wizard summons the spirit of Gehenna’s metal hounds to hunt down his prey.

desc.zh: 卷中记载的关于勇气、荣耀与牺牲的上古传说一定会激励那些为大业献身的高尚之士
desc.en: Tales of ancient valour, glory, and self-sacrifice are bound to inspire those of noble heart to greater deeds.

desc.zh: 钢铁头环据说比精灵一族还要古老，具有极强的奥术法能
desc.en: The Circlet of Iron, said to be older than the Elven race, is a potent source of arcane power.

desc.zh: 魔饰的外形是一张诡异的脸，这张脸会深深印在敌人法师的头脑中
desc.en: Crafted in the form of a grotesque face, this charm forces its visage into the minds of enemy sorcerers.

desc.zh: 织入这件披风的是从纳迦瑞斯夜空中偷下来的星之精华
desc.en: Woven into the fabric of this cloak is the essence of a star stolen from the night sky of Nagarythe.

desc.zh: 这具华美的钻石容器承载着阿苏焉圣殿的圣火火花，携带者会获得超自然的韧性，体力大增
desc.en: This ornate diamond vessel houses a spark of the sacred flame from Asuryan's shrine; its bearer swells with unearthly resilience.

desc.zh: 充满魔力的镜头所视之地，敌军受到的远程伤害就会增加
desc.en: This magical lens amplifies damage from missiles in the area upon which its strange, ethereal gaze is settled.

desc.zh: 虽然这件陈旧的遗物外表很是脆弱，但它已见证了上千场的战斗，并且还会继续征战沙场
desc.en: Though seemingly fragile, this well-worn heirloom has seen a thousand battles and will see many more.

desc.zh: 披上这件灰袍，穿戴者身体会变弱，但对魔法攻击有极高的抗性
desc.en: Wrapped in a cloak of grey, the wearer becomes insubstantial and highly-protected against magical attacks.

desc.zh: 雕花长笛上连通着很多奇怪的管子，它能起到思维控制的作用，令靠近的敌人丧失心智
desc.en: Piebald’s strange helmet has pipes connected which allow a form of mind-control; the foe is mesmerised on approach.

desc.zh: 末世的征兆往往就是饰有头骨的黑旗，氏族的标志，还有令人生厌的符文
desc.en: Portents of doom most often take the form of back banners festooned with skulls, clan symbols and hated runes.

desc.zh: 柯泰克铸造了巫王的盔甲，而他那黑曜石与黑钻石制成的指环也颇具威力
desc.en: It was Hotek who forged the Witch King’s armour. His ring - a trinket of obsidian and black diamond - is just as powerful.

desc.zh: 这个精美的容器中装有阿苏焉的圣火，会为附近的友军赐予火焰抗性
desc.en: This elaborate casket, encrusted with rubies, contains a spark from Asuryan's sacred flame; those nearby are granted magical resistance to fire.

desc.zh: 这束香获得了阿苏焉守望者的祝福，点燃时持有者会被香气环绕
desc.en: This bundle of incense sticks is blessed by the wardens of Asuryan, wreathing the bearers in scented smoke when lit.

desc.zh: 这个凤凰守卫饰有珍贵的蓝宝石，里面装有阿苏焉的圣火，会为附持有者赐予火焰抗性
desc.en: This guardian phoenix, decorated with rare sapphires, holds a spark from Asuryan's sacred flame that affords its carriers magical protection from fire.

desc.zh: 虽然这件陈旧的遗物外表很是脆弱，但它已见证了上千场的战斗，并且还会继续征战沙场
desc.en: Though seemingly fragile, this well-worn heirloom has seen a thousand battles and will see many more.

desc.zh: 被次元石污染的矿石可以吸光，因此这玩意周围被一圈黑暗物质笼罩
desc.en: Warpstone-contaminated ore develops the strange property of absorbing light. Thusly, darkness forms around the trinket.

desc.zh: 这面盾牌破烂肮脏，上面蒙有腐烂的兽皮，恐怖的战利品，以及令人难受的符文
desc.en: Grimy and ill-kept, this shield bears tainted hides, grisly trophies, and runes that are painful to look upon.

desc.zh: 这面盾的造型是冰魔怒视的表情，其中充满了北风之力，可以使敌人丧失战斗力
desc.en: Shaped into the leering face of an Ice Daemon, this shield is imbued with the north wind, robbing attacks of their force.

desc.zh: 这金光闪闪的图腾会生成一个金色能量之球，身处其中则可以免受伤害
desc.en: This radiant golden totem generates a golden globe of power that shields those within from harm.

desc.zh: 这面盾牌具有强大的反射能力，可以吸收敌人魔法伤害并将其反弹给敌军
desc.en: This shield has a reflection so dark that it absorbs hostile magic and reflects it back at the foe.

desc.zh: 凤凰之书燃烧的书页绝不会烧伤读者，除非他的内心黑暗无比
desc.en: The burning pages bound together in the Book of the Phoenix will never burn their reader… unless his heart is dark.

desc.zh: 跳动的丛林之心应和着战鼓的声响，随着蜥蜴人奔向战场，震天的鼓声会越敲越快
desc.en: The drum echoes the beating heart of the jungle itself. As the Lizardmen march to war, the thundering booms quicken.

desc.zh: 奎克·猎头者的次元石板甲就像他本人一样可怕
desc.en: The Warpstone-infused armour plates of Queek Headtaker are as spiteful as their owner.

desc.zh: 这件护甲在斯卡文魔都地下的次元石精炼场锻造而成，散发着邪恶的光环
desc.en: Wrought within the great Warpforges beneath Skavenblight, this armour radiates an evil aura.

desc.zh: 真正的精灵肉搏方式，就是每一击都打得恰到好处，不偏不倚
desc.en: Quite literally the cut-and-thrust of the Elven way of battle; every stroke is precisely made and finds its mark perfectly.

desc.zh: 如果眼神能杀人的话…哦等等，原来还真能…
desc.en: If looks could kill… Oh wait, it turns out that they can…

desc.zh: 如夜空般幽蓝的药剂赐予饮用者活力与力量面对敌人，就仿佛泰格里斯亲临一般
desc.en: Like Teclis before them, the deepest blue of night imbues the drinker with the stamina and strength they need to face down the foe.

desc.zh: 库·迦再度降临，重生降世，向反抗他的人进行复仇
desc.en: Kroq-Gar arises once more, born anew to take revenge upon those who stand against him.

desc.zh: 领主释放了强大的地震之力，使得大地板块在他的号令下震荡不已
desc.en: The Lord unleashes a force of seismic power like no other, causing the tectonic plates themselves to shift and buckle at his behest.

desc.zh: 很多时候，杀手会枭敌首级以求奖赏或作为自己黑暗行径的见证
desc.en: Oft-times, killers retain the heads of their victims as prizes or reminders of dark deeds done.

desc.zh: 莫拉丝神奇的魅力会吸引对手，让他们对自己的忠诚产生怀疑
desc.en: Morathi's strange, magical allure enchants opponents, making them question their loyalties and allegiances.

desc.zh: 若不想让这位充满智慧的守护神失望，在危险面前就更应该秉持信仰，否则他的智慧就会离你而去
desc.en: Those who do not wish to disappoint such a wise patron hold fast in the face of danger, lest his enlightened understanding be denied them.

desc.zh: 肉体就像熔炉，而暴怒则像是一团永不熄灭的火焰
desc.en: Living flesh is the crucible in which the spark of violence grows to a roaring, unquenchable flame.

desc.zh: 仇恨也是一种能量，就像其他资源一样，可以被操控也可以被引导
desc.en: Hatred is an energy source just like any other, to be harnessed and directed at will.

desc.zh: 毁灭系法术吸收着魔法之风，绝望占据了地面居民的内心…老鼠们则隐藏在阴影中
desc.en: As the Lore of Ruin siphons the Winds of Magic, an unholy despair takes hold on the surface dwellers… the rats lurk in the shadows.

desc.zh: 随着瘟疫魔法的施放，敌对势力的领民们都感染了这种痛苦难耐的恶心疾病
desc.en: Itchy, nasty buboes are spread as the spells of Plague are cast, infecting the enemy populace with sickness.

desc.zh: 随着高等魔法被传导至施法者，他们周围会出现一个法力护罩
desc.en: As the High Magic is channelled into the caster, its preserving energies form a dome of protection around them.

desc.zh: 黑魔法的光环召唤邪恶的黑色飞镖，凌空刺穿施法者所憎恶的受害者
desc.en: An aura of Dark Magic conjures black darts of malice that flit through the air to pierce victims of the spellcaster’s spite.

desc.zh: 随着钟声骇人地敲响，斯卡文鼠人的尖叫声也慢慢汇聚成了合唱：丧钟为谁而鸣？他们一清二楚
desc.en: As the clanging of the Bell rises alarmingly, the Skaven's squeaking escalates in unison; they know for whom it tolls.

desc.zh: 当大香炉被挥动的时候，腐败之雾升腾汹涌，吞噬附近一切的敌人
desc.en: The swinging of the Great Censer sends a fuming fog of corruption billowing over nearby foes.

desc.zh: 尖啸之钟被敲响，大地张开狰狞的裂缝，白热的炽焰从中喷薄而出
desc.en: The tolling sound of the Screaming Bell opens fissures in the ground, allowing white-hot flame to erupt.

desc.zh: 熔炉边的空气充斥着淡绿色的次元石烟雾，致命的瘟疫随之四处肆虐
desc.en: Clouds of green-tinged Warpstone fumes fill the air around the furnace, spreading pestilence in their wake.

desc.zh: 震耳欲聋的钟声响彻大陆，斯卡文鼠人的凶猛天性永无止境
desc.en: The deafening peals toll throughout the land, driving the verminous Skaven to ever-greater heights of ferocity.

desc.zh: 施法者利用混沌王国的不稳定法力来为自己的法术充能
desc.en: The caster draws on unstable power from the Realm of Chaos to charge their spells.

desc.zh: 法师会施法使友军武器燃起烈火，友军部队会获得高级火焰武器的加成
desc.en: The Wizard ensorcels allied weapons, making them burn with a savage fire. Friendly targets are augmented with superior flaming blades.

desc.zh: 净化能束从法师手中射出，所到之处，万恶凋零
desc.en: Bolts of cleansing energy fly from the spellcaster's hands, searing evil wherever they strike.

desc.zh: 施法者吟唱充满力量的咒语，召唤出一只以纯净火焰构成的凤凰，向着敌人猛扑过去，令其淹没在净化的烈焰之中
desc.en: The caster utters words of power and a phoenix of pure fire manifests to swoop upon the enemy, bathing them in cleansing flame.

desc.zh: 一阵阵高等法术涌入目标体内，使其容光焕发，重获生机活力
desc.en: Waves of pure High Magic infuse the target, radiating within the body, returning vigour and life.

desc.zh: 光芒之指会刺入敌军盔甲，杀伤敌军
desc.en: Fingers of light seep into enemy armour, attacking its wearers.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出强大的闪电球并投向敌人，被击中者必定粉身碎骨！
desc.en: The caster calls down a mighty ball of lightning and hurls it - should the foe be struck they will surely be shattered!

desc.zh: 施法者开启一个通往地狱深渊的漩涡，它将永久地吞噬一切卷入其中之物
desc.en: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.

desc.zh: 在烈焰法师或混沌术士的召唤下，猛烈旋转的火柱在战场上喷涌而出，极具杀伤力！
desc.en: Conjured by a Bright Wizard or Chaos Sorcerer, a column of churning fire erupts from the battlefield, causing much destruction!

desc.zh: 上古战士们的精魂听从召唤而来，将自己的力量借予友军
desc.en: The spirits of ancient warriors are summoned and lend their might to allies in the present.

desc.zh: 天空突然炸裂，一支燃烧的黑色混沌闪电从天空劈向敌人
desc.en: The sky opens and a bolt of burning, pure Chaos black lightning hurtles towards the foe.

desc.zh: 天空突然炸裂，一支燃烧的黑色混沌闪电从天空劈向敌人
desc.en: The sky opens and a bolt of burning, pure Chaos black lightning hurtles towards the foe.

desc.zh: 施法者念诵出禁忌之名，敌人就会陷入极为凄惨的境地
desc.en: As the caster utters a forbidden name, her enemies are wracked with waves of misery.

desc.zh: 一阵剑刃风暴席卷战场，疯狂地寻觅着鲜血的踪迹
desc.en: A swirling maelstrom of swords spin and slash their way across the battlefield in search of blood.

desc.zh: 一阵剑刃风暴席卷战场，疯狂地寻觅着鲜血的踪迹
desc.en: A swirling maelstrom of swords spin and slash their way across the battlefield in search of blood.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵冰冷寒风，用寒冰和冰雹攻击敌人
desc.en: A freezing gale is conjured and sent to assail the target with ice and hail.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵冰冷寒风，用寒冰和冰雹攻击敌人
desc.en: A freezing gale is conjured and sent to assail the target with ice and hail.

desc.zh: 天空突然炸裂，一支燃烧的黑色混沌闪电从天空劈向敌人
desc.en: The sky opens and a bolt of burning, pure Chaos black lightning hurtles towards the foe.

desc.zh: 天空突然炸裂，一支燃烧的黑色混沌闪电从天空劈向敌人
desc.en: The sky opens and a bolt of burning, pure Chaos black lightning hurtles towards the foe.

desc.zh: 施法者利用混沌王国的不稳定法力来为自己的法术充能
desc.en: The caster draws on unstable power from the Realm of Chaos to charge their spells.

desc.zh: 黑暗的触手向外翻腾，使施法者吸取敌人的生命来恢复自己的活力
desc.en: Tendrils of solidified darkness writhe outwards, draining the lifeforce from foes and renewing the caster’s own vigour.

desc.zh: 施法者念诵出禁忌之名，敌人就会陷入一阵阵痛苦
desc.en: As the caster utters a forbidden name, their enemies are wracked with waves of agony.

desc.zh: 施法者念诵出禁忌之名，敌人就会陷入一阵阵痛苦
desc.en: As the caster utters a forbidden name, their enemies are wracked with waves of agony.

desc.zh: 大角鼠的诅咒，便是恐怖的十三魔法：现实被无情地撕裂，大角鼠的子孙们倾巢而出！
desc.en: The Curse of the Horned Rat is the dreaded 13th spell - the fabric of reality is torn and the Horned One’s children spill forth!

desc.zh: 一阵阵高等法术涌入目标体内，使其容光焕发，重获生机活力
desc.en: Waves of pure High Magic infuse the target, radiating within the body, returning vigour and life.

desc.zh: 光芒之指会刺入敌军盔甲，杀伤敌军
desc.en: Fingers of light seep into enemy armour, attacking its wearers.

desc.zh: 光芒之指会刺入敌军盔甲，杀伤敌军
desc.en: Fingers of light seep into enemy armour, attacking its wearers.

desc.en: The caster utters words of power and a phoenix of pure fire manifests to swoop upon the enemy, bathing them in cleansing flame.

desc.en: The caster utters words of power and a phoenix of pure fire manifests to swoop upon the enemy, bathing them in cleansing flame.

desc.en: The spirits of ancient warriors are summoned and lend their might to allies in the present.

desc.zh: 上古战士们的精魂听从召唤而来，将自己的力量借予友军
desc.en: The spirits of ancient warriors are summoned and lend their might to allies in the present.

desc.zh: 随着一道明光迸出，敌人的灵魂便灰飞烟灭，就像掐灭火星一样简单
desc.en: White light bursts forth, quenching the spirit of the foe as a mortal might smother a spark.

desc.zh: 随着一道明光迸出，敌人的灵魂便灰飞烟灭，就像掐灭火星一样简单
desc.en: White light bursts forth, quenching the spirit of the foe as a mortal might smother a spark.

desc.zh: 魔法八风毫无预兆地向敌人袭来，形成致命的暴风雨
desc.en: Without warning, a conflagration of the eight arcane Winds forms on the foe, creating a devastating tempest.

desc.zh: 魔法八风毫无预兆地向敌人袭来，形成致命的暴风雨
desc.en: Without warning, a conflagration of the eight arcane Winds forms on the foe, creating a devastating tempest.

desc.zh: 友军的武器会被毒雾环绕，他们的剑刃会滴下有毒的秽物
desc.en: A foul mist wraps around the weapons of an allied pack, their blades dripping with noxious filth.

desc.zh: 友军的武器会被毒雾环绕，他们的剑刃会滴下有毒的秽物
desc.en: A foul mist wraps around the weapons of an allied pack, their blades dripping with noxious filth.

desc.zh: 大地猛然迸裂，如同溃烂的脓包般炸裂开来，全身流脓的瘟疫僧凭空出现，并遵从召唤者的意志走上战场
desc.en: Like a pregnant boil bursting forth, the ground bursts open and pus-coated Plague Monks emerge to do battle at the verminous summoner’s bidding.

desc.zh: 鼠人念完邪恶的咒语之后，便会向前喷出肮脏的毒雾
desc.en: The Skaven utters a vile phrase and belches forth an impossibly foul cloud.

desc.zh: 鼠人念完邪恶的咒语之后，便会向前喷出肮脏的毒雾
desc.en: The Skaven utters a vile phrase and belches forth an impossibly foul cloud.

desc.zh: 施法者在战场上释放出邪恶的疾病，这种疾病会使人感染并且立刻石化
desc.en: The caster unleashes a vile disease that scours the battlefield in search of victims to infect and instantly petrify.

desc.zh: 施法者在战场上释放出邪恶的疾病，这种疾病会使人感染并且立刻石化
desc.en: The caster unleashes a vile disease that scours the battlefield in search of victims to infect and instantly petrify.

desc.zh: 看这万鼠狂潮，法师在召唤，而鼠人们会予以响应！
desc.en: Behold the Vermintide; the Wizard calls and the rats will answer!

desc.zh: 法师吟唱着疫病魔典中的篇章，施放着衰老与腐蚀的妖法
desc.en: Chanting passages from the Liber Bubonicus, the Wizard casts a hex of wasting and corrosion.

desc.zh: 法师吟唱着疫病魔典中的篇章，施放着衰老与腐蚀的妖法
desc.en: Chanting passages from the Liber Bubonicus, the Wizard casts a hex of wasting and corrosion.

desc.zh: 咒语生效后，鼠人疯狂跺脚，使地面裂开一道口子
desc.en: With the incantation invoked, the Skaven stamps his horrible, rattish foot, causing the very ground to split asunder.

desc.zh: 咒语生效后，鼠人疯狂跺脚，使地面裂开一道口子
desc.en: With the incantation invoked, the Skaven stamps his horrible, rattish foot, causing the very ground to split asunder.

desc.zh: 施法者狂野地挥动着手势，给友军注入狂暴之力，让他们向敌军发泄自己的疯狂！
desc.en: Gesticulating wildly, the caster gifts an allied unit with a rabid, frothing need to attack and consume the foe!

desc.zh: 施法者狂野地挥动着手势，给友军注入狂暴之力，让他们向敌军发泄自己的疯狂！
desc.en: Gesticulating wildly, the caster gifts an allied unit with a rabid, frothing need to attack and consume the foe!

desc.zh: 施法者向天空摆弄着手势，天空刮起强风，使得空中部队无法飞行
desc.en: The caster gestures twitchingly to the skies and fierce gales swirl about, making flight impossible.

desc.zh: 施法者向天空摆弄着手势，天空刮起强风，使得空中部队无法飞行
desc.en: The caster gestures twitchingly to the skies and fierce gales swirl about, making flight impossible.

desc.zh: 术士将爪子插进地里，在前方召唤出一团绿色的火焰
desc.en: The Sorcerer thrusts his paws into the ground summoning forth a great gout of green flame.

desc.zh: 术士将爪子插进地里，在前方召唤出一团绿色的火焰
desc.en: The Sorcerer thrusts his paws into the ground summoning forth a great gout of green flame.

desc.zh: 鼠人施法者消失在一团绿烟之中，之后又会出现在战场的其他地方
desc.en: The Skaven caster disappears in a puff of greenish smoke, only to reappear elsewhere on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 鼠人施法者消失在一团绿烟之中，之后又会出现在战场的其他地方
desc.en: The Skaven caster disappears in a puff of greenish smoke, only to reappear elsewhere on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 恐怖的墨绿色闪电听从鼠人的召唤
desc.en: Dire greenish-black lightning strikes at the Skaven’s chittered command.

desc.zh: 恐怖的墨绿色闪电听从鼠人的召唤
desc.en: Dire greenish-black lightning strikes at the Skaven’s chittered command.

desc.zh: 当这枚炸弹爆炸时会喷出黑色的烟幕，遮住希望隐藏自己的军队并让其他人难以呼吸
desc.en: When a bomb is smashed, a dark smoke curls out, concealing those who wish to hide and choking everyone else.

desc.zh: 混沌的黑焰会一视同仁地燃烧血肉、铠甲、灵魂；毁灭之力毫不厚此薄彼
desc.en: The dark flames of Chaos burn flesh, armour and souls alike; the Ruinous Powers do not discriminate.

desc.zh: 惊惧兽的可怕吼啸会无视护甲与肉体，直接贯穿受害者的身躯，震得他们骨酥肉软，丧失一切勇气
desc.en: Unimpeded by armour and flesh, a Terrorgheist’s horrible shriek travels through its victims, splintering bones and souls, and erasing all memory of courage.

desc.zh: 虽然原始，但是居高临下扔滚石仍是一个有效的战术
desc.en: Crude though it may be, swiftly swooping in low to pepper the foe with rocks remains a most effective tactic.

desc.zh: 只需一声令下，多头蛇的脑袋们将争相喷吐出最为明亮炽热的烈焰吐息
desc.en: Just give the order and the Hydra's heads will spew forth their fiery breath, each competing for the brightest flame.

desc.zh: 随着锅中的血液翻腾起泡，凯恩调动起大家的求战欲，并激起大家心中的暴戾之火
desc.en: As the blood in the cauldron boils and bubbles, Khaine drives bloodlust to a fever pitch and stokes hearts with a violent fire.

desc.zh: Not Used
desc.en: [ph] Not Visible.

desc.zh: 没人想承受这些巨龙们的吐息攻击——比起年轻的同族们，它们的吐息更为强力也更具有灵性
desc.en: No one wants to be on the receiving end of these Dragons' fiery breath attack, which surpasses that of their younger kin in both might and enlightenment.

desc.zh: 某些龙会喷出带毒的吐息，对目标造成持续性的效果。当然，这得假设目标能挨过起初的龙息攻击才行！
desc.en: Some Dragons breathe noxious fumes that have a long-lasting effect on their target's coordination - if it survived the attack in the first place.

desc.zh: 某些龙会喷出带毒的吐息，对目标造成持续性的效果。当然，这得假设目标能挨过起初的龙息攻击才行！
desc.en: Some Dragons breathe noxious fumes that have a long-lasting effect on their target's coordination - if it survived the attack in the first place.

desc.zh: 水晶会守护蛇神的崇拜者，能够治疗伤口，还有起死回生之效
desc.en: The crystal protects those who worship the Serpent God, healing wounds and bringing supplicants back from the point of death.

desc.zh: 某些龙会喷出带毒的吐息，对目标造成持续性的效果。当然，这得假设目标能挨过起初的龙息攻击才行！
desc.en: Some Dragons breathe noxious fumes that have a long-lasting effect on their target's coordination - if it survived the attack in the first place.

desc.zh: 最古老，最强大的巨龙，能够用白热的吐息杀掉一整支部队
desc.en: The eldest, most powerful Dragons can destroy entire units with a molten blast of their white-hot breath.

desc.zh: 最年轻的巨龙，长着暖色调的鳞片，拥有足以匹敌其火爆脾气的炽热吐息
desc.en: The youngest Dragons have a warm hue to their scales and a fiery temper, with scorching breath to match.

desc.zh: 炽焰凤凰俯冲下来，用火翼带起一场火焰风暴
desc.en: As the Flamespyre swoops, wreathes of fire squall off its wings in the bird’s wake.

desc.zh: 众所周知，巨大而致命的多头蛇十分难杀，它们的残躯还会重生，继续吞噬一切
desc.en: The titanic, deadly Hydras are notoriously difficult to kill; their broken bodies regenerate, rising up again to devour anew.

desc.zh: 凤凰等生物体内充满了魔法，它们会使用奥术之风翱翔九天，同时也乐在其中
desc.en: Some creatures, such as the Phoenix, are infused with magic and use the arcane Winds to fly upon and immerse themselves in.

desc.zh: 霜心凤凰每次振翅都会带起寒冷的碎冰以及刺骨的寒风
desc.en: The Frostheart is surrounded by icy shards and biting winds with every great flap of its mighty wings.

desc.zh: 黑暗魔法使得靠近血池的人可以获得血手之神的庇护
desc.en: Dark enchantments ensure that those who stand close to a Cauldron of Blood enjoy a degree of protection from the Bloody-handed God.

desc.zh: 虽然高等精灵十分勇猛善战，但只有贯彻战士之道的人才会拥有更精湛的械斗技巧
desc.en: While all High Elves have excellent martial prowess, those that continue upon the path of the warrior will further excel in armed combat.

desc.zh: 高等精灵纪律严明，他们的训练时间往往比普通人的一生还要长
desc.en: High Elves excel as warriors, having trained in martial disciplines for the equivalent of many men's lifetimes.

desc.zh: 在压力之下，生存本能支配了这些天生的捕食者，从而大大增加了他们的战斗潜力
desc.en: When under pressure, the primal instincts of these natural predators take over, improving their potential in combat.

desc.zh: 他们万世长存，即使死神也会被他们耗死…
desc.en: With strange aeons even death may die...

desc.zh: 有句胆小鬼的俗语说得好：『留得青山在，不怕没柴烧』
desc.en: "He who runs away lives to fight another day!" - so the foul, craven adage goes.

desc.zh: 捕猎网虽然不怎么重要，但却十分强大，并且外面都有挂钩。阴沟奔行鼠经常用它来捕捉俘虏
desc.en: Snare-nets are lightweight but strong and covered in hooks. They are used by Gutter Runners to capture live prisoners.

desc.zh: 斯卡文鼠人天生胆小，当成群结队时则勇气大增，虽说行动迟缓，但数量带来的安全感会让它们觉得好过很多
desc.en: Skaven are craven by nature but take courage when in packs of their own kind, where they move slower but enjoy the safety of numbers.

desc.zh: 想杀死地狱深坑憎恶可并非易事，因为它一死，就有许多斯卡文鼠人会取代他的位置
desc.en: Killing a Hell-Pit Abomination is never a simple matter; when it dies many fresh Skaven spawn to take its place.

desc.zh: 这头肮脏的野兽临死前痛苦地挣扎着，他还有很多条命，不久将会重生
desc.en: With its last, shuddering death throes there is a chance that one or more of the foul beast's many hearts will restart.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 这把弓是芬努巴尔国王赐给海上卫士乌兰诺尔的，弓身由一整块稀有的银木制成
desc.en: Gifted to Ulanor of the seaguard by King Finubar, this bow was created from a single piece of rare silverwood.

desc.zh: 这把武器是专门用来对付矮人玩意的，非常适合奎克瞎抡一气的作战风格
desc.en: A weapon created to kill the Dwarf-things, it perfectly suits Queek’s furious windmill style of attack.

desc.zh: 多头蛇之剑是用阿克拉克的尖牙制成，这是被马雷基斯斩杀的第一只多头蛇
desc.en: The Hydra Blade was carved from a single fang of Akholrak, first and greatest of the War Hydras broken by Malekith.

desc.zh: 这柄剑是艾纳瑞昂统治时期为斩杀恶魔而铸造的，剑上燃烧着从太阳中掳来的火焰
desc.en: This ancient sword, forged to slay Daemons in the earliest days of Aenarion’s rule, burns with the captured fire of the sun.

desc.zh: 这柄剑由泰格里斯制造，剑中注满了能量，足以将一切武器斩成碎片
desc.en: This sword, created by Teclis, is charged with crackling energy that rends apart those struck by its shining blade.

desc.zh: 这张网由巫灵的头发织成，饰有鹰身女妖的尖牙，任何落入网中者都会被撕成碎片
desc.en: Woven from the hair of Witch Elves and studded with Harpy fangs; a victim caught in the Web will be ripped apart.

desc.zh: 这阵箭雨会将大量锋利的箭矢投向目标，这是一阵真正的死亡之雨
desc.en: These arrows shower their targets with dozens of razor-sharp shards; a percussive shot of death.

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向了敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the Wizard invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 颤栗之剑由哈尔·卡卓拉的碎片铸成，任何触碰到它的人都会从内到外冻结成冰
desc.en: From the scattered shards of Har Kaldra was the Chillblade forged. Its touch can freeze body and the soul within.

desc.zh: 这把武器由巫王铸造，只需轻轻一碰，即可破除魔法，毁人心智
desc.en: Forged by the Witch King, the blade’s merest touch can unmake enchantments and wither minds.

desc.zh: 莫拉丝的这一对武器使得至高女巫在战场上能大杀四方
desc.en: The paired weapons of Morathi make the Hag Sorceress extremely deadly in combat.

desc.zh: 它会使矮人屠夫与他的人类同伴免受魔法伤害，迫使敌人与他们进行几乎毫无胜算的单挑
desc.en: By which the Dwarf Slayer and his mannish chronicler are protected from magical harm, forcing the foe into single combat they have little chance of surviving.

desc.zh: 两把利刃绝对比一把要强得多——双倍的攻击，使快速终结敌人性命的数量加倍
desc.en: Two blades are infinitely better than one - twice the attack, double the number of fell lives unceremoniously ended.

desc.zh: 高崔克的记录者以血发誓，要记录下他的矮人屠夫朋友的壮举，直到他最终加入他可敬的祖先的那一天
desc.en: Gotrek's "rememberer" has pledged with his blood to record his friend the Dwarf Slayer's deeds until the day he finally joins his venerable Ancestors.

desc.zh: 尽管他置身于可以想象的最危险的境地，而且违背了屠夫追求自我牺牲的勇敢意志，但高崔克的体格比其他同类更为坚韧，能在任何肉搏战中生存下来
desc.en: Despite involving himself in the most dangerous situations imaginable, and against the Slayer's suicidally-brave will, Gotrek is made of sterner stuff even than others of his kind and can survive any hand-to-hand encounter.

desc.zh: 菲利克斯·耶格在卡拉克·八峰山深处从一名堕落的烈焰之心骑士手中夺回了这把带龙柄的符文之剑——卡拉古尔
desc.en: Felix Jaeger recovered the Rune Sword Karaghul, a blade with a dragon hilt, from a fallen Knight of the Fiery Heart deep within Karak Eight Peaks.

desc.zh: 高崔克的标志性武器是一把拥有强大符文魔法的战斧，这把战斧是在矮人屠夫第一次前往北方混沌荒原时，从塔格里姆·火须国王之子的尸体上发现的
desc.en: Gotrek's signature weapon is a battle-axe imbued with powerful rune magic, recovered from the corpse of King Thangrim Firebeard's son during the Dwarf Slayer's first excursion into the northern Chaos Wastes.

desc.zh: 这身乌黑的盔甲极为精致，出自一位技艺无与伦比的大师之手
desc.en: This jet-black armour has been worked into the most cruelly delicate forms by the hand of a master far superior to any mortal artificer.

desc.zh: 拉卡斯锐目而视，令其亲族皆知其凶戾与嗜血天性，从而彻底征服了他们
desc.en: With a piercing stare, Rakarth makes known his innate cruelty and bloodlust to his beastly kindred spirits, thus subduing them.

desc.zh: 最伟大的纳迦罗斯野兽领主是个冷酷的猎手，仅仅是他的靠近便足以激发野兽们的本能，强迫它们顺从他的每一项指令
desc.en: The greatest Beastlord of Naggaroth is an ice-cold presence, his mere proximity triggering his beasts’ instincts to meekly obey his every command.

desc.zh: 在枭雄心中，痛苦会激发勇气；在懦夫心中，痛苦只会撒下软弱
desc.en: Pain nourishes courage in the hearts of the wild and fear in the hearts of the weak.

desc.zh: 白虎号令一出，潜伏的铁爪自暗处暴起，围杀猎物，将其拖入绝境
desc.en: At the White Tiger’s sign, concealed Iron Claw surge from cover to close the hunt and drag down dangerous prey.

desc.zh: 爪语者以嘶嘶作响的奥术旋律，娴熟地将魔法之风束缚为一道单一、顺从的溪流
desc.en: In hissed arcane melody, the Clawspeaker masterfully binds the Winds into a single, obedient stream.

desc.zh: 千神之威可降临沙场，为高贵的虎人战士锚定神魂
desc.en: The might of all Thousand Gods can be called down to the battlefield to anchor the souls of the noble Tigers.

desc.zh: 通过虔诚的祷告，爪语者能重焕躯体活力，因他深知，精神的坚韧终究无法克服肉身的衰颓
desc.en: Through fervent supplication, a Clawspeaker may be rejuvenated in body, for he knows mental fortitude cannot overcome the body's failings.

desc.zh: 『对震旦之敌毫无怜悯，对腐化堕落绝无救赎。叛乱之路的终点，永远是斩下首级』
desc.en: "No mercy for Cathay's enemies, no redemption for corruption. The road to rebellion always ends with decapitation."

desc.zh: 生命的终结，是对那些仍有血仇未报之人的轻慢
desc.en: The end of one's life is a slight against those owed their debts of vengeance that remain unpaid.

desc.zh: 卡茂那传说中的武学秘法知识，据传由千神所赐，后通过爪语者的口述传统传予信徒
desc.en: Kamau’s fabled esoteric knowledge of martial mysticism was said to have been gifted by the Thousand Gods, then shared to his worshippers via the Clawspeakers’ oral traditions.

desc.zh: 『坚守战斗！前人曾历此境，切勿气馁！』
desc.en: "Stay true to the battle. Others before you endured the same. Do not weaken!"

desc.zh: 爪语者的存在唤起了卡茂的刚健之相，赋予信徒们在困苦中神圣的坚定意志
desc.en: The Clawspeaker’s presence brings forth the robust aspect of Kamau, bestowing upon worshippers a divine steadfastness under hardship.

desc.zh: 龙神统治了震旦数世纪之久。他们的权力永远不会受到帝国臣民的质疑，他们也完全知晓自己在世上的地位和角色
desc.en: The Dragons have ruled Cathay for centuries. Their power will never be questioned by their imperial subjects, who understand their place and role in the world perfectly.

desc.zh: 神秘而强大的天堂之门胸针允许其佩戴者在敌人眼前消失，随后再次出现并施以致命一击
desc.en: The mysterious and potent Heaven’s Gate broach allows its wearer to vanish before their foes’ eyes, before reappearing to inflict a devastating blow.

desc.zh: 一件不起眼的小饰物，却能让佩戴者的武器平添几分致命的锋芒
desc.en: An inconspicuous piece of jewellery which makes the bearer’s weaponry that much more conspicuously lethal.

desc.zh: 至伟战士心神凝聚，长刀挥出分毫不差的弧线，每一击都能精准截断对手的攻势，令敌手在交战中瞬间瘫痪
desc.en: Intensifying their concentration, the Sawai swings their glaive in perfectly measured arcs, striking foes at deliberate angles to momentarily cripple them mid-fight.

desc.zh: 白虎乐此不疲地追踪猎物，即便这是一个漫长而持久的过程，需耐心寻找弱点，并在最后一扑时才有所收获
desc.en: The White Tiger revels in endlessly stalking her prey, despite it being a long, drawn-out process of studying weakness only bearing fruit at the final pounce.

desc.zh: 白虎乐此不疲地追踪猎物，即便这是一个漫长而持久的过程，需耐心寻找弱点，并在最后一扑时才有所收获
desc.en: The White Tiger revels in endlessly stalking her prey, despite it being a long, drawn-out process of studying weakness only bearing fruit at the final pounce.

desc.zh: 心神合一之际，身、意、刀浑然一体。优雅而致命的斩击过后，束手无策的敌人便已化为沙场亡魂
desc.en: A heightened state of mindfulness coalesces body, mind and glaive. Elegantly devastating blows turn hamstrung foes into battle’s fallen.

desc.zh: 掠食者未必非要采取野蛮之道。技巧与精准同样能像不加节制的侵略一样终结狩猎
desc.en: A predator need not be savage in their approach. Skill and precision ends a hunt just as effectively as unbridled aggression.

desc.zh: 体外烈火灼烧之际，这些战士心中的烈焰却未曾熄灭。非但如此，这股心火更驱使他们行出愈加凶悍的壮举
desc.en: As they burn from without, these warriors' inner fire is not quenched. What is more, it drives them to ever greater acts of savagery.

desc.zh: 没有未被察觉的动静，没有未被嗅到的气味，没有未被听见的断枝脆响，唯有宣告死亡的猛扑
desc.en: There is no movement unseen, no scent undetected, no snapping twig that remains unheard – only the pounce that heralds death.

desc.zh: 所有虎人战士都崇敬白虎的传说，这赋予了他们坚定的信念：只要战斗，便能获得救赎
desc.en: All Tiger Warriors revere the White Tiger’s legend, giving them the staunch belief that as long as they fight, they will be led to salvation.

desc.zh: 这件覆满利爪的战甲专为承受暴戾而生，它回敬给敌人的，是每一记重击所激起的恶毒反噬
desc.en: This claw-covered war-plate absorbs violence, echoing every blow received in pernicious retaliation.

desc.zh: 卡堂能够随意地变形为任何怪兽，甚至变成一头昊天狮。但遗憾的是，有一天他发现自己再也变不回来了…
desc.en: Kadon was able to shift his shape to that of any monster, even a Celestial Lion. One day he found he could not change back...

desc.zh: 魔法织就的罗网哪怕再强韧，遇上旗鼓相当的反制之力，也照样会被撕成碎片
desc.en: Skeins of magic, however potent, can still be torn to shreds by forces equally opposing them.

desc.zh: 在与震旦最强大的构装体并肩作战时，更为审慎的司天丞或会为其编织特殊的防护结界，以增强其韧性
desc.en: When marching into battle alongside Cathay’s mightiest constructs, more prudent Astromancers may weave into them special protective wards to enhance their resilience.

desc.zh: 那些能感知魔法之风并向其敞开心扉的人，尽可将其铸成自己的剑盾
desc.en: Those who sense and open themselves to the Winds of Magic can fashion them into their own sword and shield.

desc.zh: 与浑身浸透魔力的存在缠斗越久，那股魔力便反击得越狠，一边维续宿主，一边粉碎来敌
desc.en: The more one fights a being saturated in magic, the more that magic fights back to both sustain its vessel and shatter that of the foe.

desc.zh: 门下督们经年累月在长垣之上挫败入侵者、观察敌军动向，铸就了震旦最为老谋深算的老兵
desc.en: The many years spent by Gate Masters thwarting invaders and observing enemy movements from atop the Bastion have forged Cathay’s most wily veterans.

desc.zh: 仿镔龙鳞打制的铠甲，不图坚固，只为让每个人记住自己究竟为何而战
desc.en: Armor made to resemble the scales of the Iron Dragon. Not built for sturdiness, but to remind everyone what they are fighting for.

desc.zh: 执念般的专注，将失败与死亡的杂念尽数逼退。它们或许迟早会来，但绝不是此刻
desc.en: Obsessive focus keeps thoughts of failure and death at bay. They may come with time – but now is not the time.

desc.zh: 某些虎人战士的武道哲学无法在其族群之外修习，他们天生的野性本能，尤其是著名的冲锋，使他们能够达到不可思议的速度
desc.en: Certain Tiger Warrior martial philosophies cannot be practiced outside their kin, their innate feral instincts enabling – among other things – the impossible speeds of their renowned charges.

desc.zh: 通往荣耀的最后一击，当如那无可阻挡的风暴一般，在坚不可摧的群山间肆意狂啸，且同样致命
desc.en: The final surge to glory must be as unstoppable as the storm that moves unopposed over immovable mountains – and just as deadly.

desc.zh: 那些与震旦故土及苍穹紧密相连之人，可与天界之兽分享其内在力量
desc.en: Those whose hearts are closely attuned to the Cathayan homeland as well as the heavens can share their inner strength with celestial beasts.

name.en: Icon of the Great Cities Upgraded

desc.zh: 震旦的战士们各尽其责，他们在战场上跟随战鼓的节奏行进
desc.en: The warriors of Cathay know their roles well, guided through battle by the rhythmic pounding of their war drums.

desc.zh: 与坚定沉着的心灵并肩作战者，能在周遭肆虐的战乱风暴中，受益于那份安宁的存在
desc.en: Those who fight alongside a sure and steadfast mind benefit from a calm presence amidst the storm of war raging around them.

desc.zh: 独行的虎人战士，早已将战争的苦难淬炼为自身禀赋，堪称无出其右的精英。而当他们结群成伍，互为依托时，世间可与之比肩者怕是只剩下了巨人
desc.en: A lone Tiger Warrior’s sufferance for war is what makes them the battlefield’s incomparable elite. Buoyed by the pack, only giants compare.

desc.zh: 唯有将猎杀奉为唯一执念的虎人战士，才能将身与刃逼至超凡之境：那才是堪配卡茂眷顾的境地
desc.en: Only the Tiger Warrior who is truly dedicated to their prey can push themselves to supernatural feats worthy of Kamau himself.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 镔龙在实验中偶然发现，他往利齿中灌注的魔力越是强大，他其余那些附魔兵器便愈发黯淡凋萎
desc.en: In his experiments, the Iron Dragon serendipitously discovered that the more magic he infused into the Teeth, the more his other enchanted weapons wilted!

desc.zh: 注入了镔龙自身的一部分力量后，白虎的拳刃永恒燃烧着奇异的炼金之火
desc.en: Instilled with a measure of the Iron Dragon's own power, the White Tiger's katara burn eternally with strange alchemical fire.

desc.zh: 桃妍挥舞巨戟，刃锋掠过之处，恐怖的创口撕扯着血肉，每一道伤痕都在倾泻着怨毒
desc.en: Horrendous wounds inflicted with brutal intentions display the hate delivered in triplicate by the sharpened prongs of Taoyan’s great trident.

desc.zh: 掌控这座血铸大厦的一方会将恐虐的狂怒降临到士气崩溃的敌军头上，令其陷入盲目的愤怒，无差别地攻击敌我双方
desc.en: The alliance that controls this bloodforged edifice draws on the wrath of Khorne to drive demoralised enemies into a blind fury, attacking friend and foe alike.

desc.zh: 掌控这座毁灭纪念碑的一方会引导血神的力量来削弱敌人的护甲
desc.en: The alliance that controls this Ruinous monument uses the power of the Blood God to shatter the armour of their enemies.

desc.zh: 掌控这座亵渎图腾的一方会用汹涌的痛苦折磨虚弱的敌人，削弱他们继续战斗的意志
desc.en: The alliance that controls this blasphemous totem wracks weakened enemies with surges of agonising pain, sapping their will to fight even further.

desc.zh: 呛人的尘埃从法师的指尖喷涌而出，敌人一旦触碰，无不窒息而死
desc.en: A choking dust cloud erupts from the Wizard's fingertips, suffocating the foes in its path and dragging them to their deaths.

desc.zh: 法师制作出一把无弦琴，奏响一首难以释怀的挽歌，驱走所有的希望和紧迫感，使敌人变得脆弱不堪
desc.en: The Wizard produces a stringless fiddle and plays a haunting dirge that drives all sense of hope and urgency away, rendering the foe passive and prone.

desc.zh: 法师吟诵变化术的三字真言，抛出一个灿烂的熔融圆球，径直击穿敌人的行伍
desc.en: Speaking the three sacred syllables of transformation, the Wizard hurls a brilliant, molten sphere through the enemy's ranks.

desc.zh: 法师在岩石内部点燃火焰，令地面砰然碎裂，狂暴的世界生命之血喷涌而出，吞噬敌人
desc.en: The Wizard sets a fire within the very rock itself, causing the ground to splinter and the raging lifeblood of the world to gush forth and consume the enemy.

desc.zh: 法师召唤野性世界的力量，将其赐予自身选择的盟友，从而强化他们的攻击力
desc.en: The Wizard calls upon the strength of the wild world and bestows it upon his chosen allies, increasing the ferocity of their attack.

desc.zh: 原始的生命能量在战场上流动，治愈伤势，令新进倒下的战士重新恢复活力
desc.en: Raw life-energy flows across the battlefield, mending wounds and restoring the fallen to fresh vigour.

desc.zh: 法师将一柄小石锤投过战场，天空的闪电狂怒自其尾流呼啸而出
desc.en: The Wizard hurls a tiny stone hammer across the battlefield, and the heavens vent their electrical fury in its wake.

desc.zh: 法师踏入命运之锦，变更时间的流动以适应盟友的需求，令其能够更为顽强、更为迅捷地战斗
desc.en: The Wizard reaches into the tapestry of fate, altering the flow of time to suit his allies' needs, who then fight on harder and faster than ever before.

desc.zh: 血液变成了腐蚀性的液体。致命强酸从每个伤口喷涌而出
desc.en: The blood is transformed into a corrosive fluid. Deadly acid spurts from every wound.

desc.zh: 有些饥饿只能靠吸食遇害者的灵魂来满足
desc.en: Some hungers can only be sated by feeding on the souls of the slain.

desc.zh: 在恶魔亲王罗菲克斯激怒了女王之后，此人长角的首级与具催眠功效的眼睛便成了她盾牌的装饰品
desc.en: Ever since the Daemon Prince Locephax angered the Gorequeen, his horned head and hypnotic eyes have adorned her shield.

desc.zh: 对于受到祖父神纳垢赐福者来说，这些炼金药乃是恢复健康的饮品；但对其他人来说，它们则是夺人气力的毒药
desc.en: To one blessed by Grandfather Nurgle, these elixirs are restorative brews, but to others they are debilitating poisons.

desc.zh: 这把法杖浸染了最黑暗的黑暗魔法，无论战场内外，皆可强化持有者的法力
desc.en: This staff, imbued with the darkest of Dark Magics, enhances the magical abilities of its bearer on and off the battlefield.

desc.zh: 永世神选的盔甲与他的传说一样古老而强大
desc.en: The armour of the Everchosen is as ancient and powerful as his legend.

desc.zh: 这种盔甲由混沌的黑暗能量物质化而成，可以抵御秩序力量的冲击
desc.en: Such armour is materialised from the dark energies of Chaos, guarding against the onslaught of Order.

desc.zh: 这样的标记对于秩序本身和其所有的拥护者都是一种侮辱，它是在公然宣扬毁灭与废墟
desc.en: Such a symbol insults Order and all its supporters, to the delight of Destruction and Ruin.

desc.zh: 作为帝国之灾，泽拉克被消灭后人们却发现他的盔甲空空如也，还散发着一股硫磺的恶臭
desc.en: Once the scourge of the Empire, Zhrakk's armour was found empty after his demise, but for the overpowering stench of brimstone.

desc.zh: 混沌永无止境。没有什么能阻止它的永恒前进，因为它最伟大的战士们总是会再度起身
desc.en: Chaos is without end. Nothing can stop the eternal march of its forces, for its greatest warriors will always rise once more.

desc.zh: 『轰！！！！！这样够直白了吧？』
desc.en: "Doooooooooooom! Let there be no misunderstanding…"

desc.zh: 据传，这块宝石是色孽本孽的泪滴结晶，能减缓所有畏惧它的人的速度
desc.en: Some whisper that the gemstone is a crystalised tear of Slaanesh, able to slow all who behold it in awe.

desc.zh: 这身盔甲通体血红，其上密密麻麻地皆是血线，足以令恐虐的一切敌人肝胆俱裂
desc.en: This suit of armour runs red with thick strings of blood, sapping the strength of all Khorne’s enemies.

desc.zh: 这个黑暗坩埚是件强大的神器，它可以储存大量不稳定的魔法能量
desc.en: This dark crucible is a powerful artefact that can harness and store a great reservoir of unstable magical energy.

desc.zh: 这面衰朽不堪的战旗不断渗出可怕而浓稠的脓液与粘液，可以有效偏转来自远处的攻击
desc.en: This putrid, rotting standard constantly seeps with a horrendous gruel of pus and mucus, helping to deflect incoming attacks from range.

desc.zh: 水蛭领主散发出一波波的腐臭感染，用疾病彻底压倒他的敌人，并让他们恶心不已
desc.en: The Leechlord exudes waves of putrid infection, sickening his enemies as disease overcomes them.

desc.zh: 费斯图斯医生的治疗功底并不次于害人的功力，只是他觉得这样没那么有趣罢了
desc.en: Doktor Festus can heal as well as harm, he simply finds it far less enjoyable.

desc.zh: 耀眼的光芒照射在有价之人身上，让他即刻陷入了疯狂
desc.en: Shining rays of light fall upon the worthy, riling the recipient into a violent frenzy.

desc.zh: 面对阿扎泽尔就等同于押上了自己的灵魂、失去自由意志并化为其玩物
desc.en: To face Azazel is to gamble with one’s very soul, lose free will, and be used as his plaything.

desc.zh: 如此强大的人只需稍微现身，就能让敌人陷入恐惧与自我怀疑，从而大大地丧失战意
desc.en: The mere presence of one so mighty has the enemy gripped by fear, weakened by their own self-doubt.

desc.zh: 但凡是有命看到这种狂怒化身的人，就算他们没有立刻脑袋搬家，也会目瞪口呆，僵立当场
desc.en: Those who behold such rage incarnate would surely stare in awe, were their heads not promptly removed from their bodies.

desc.zh: 奸奇的魔法形成了一道防护屏障，随着魔风领主的突发奇想而不断变强
desc.en: The magic of Tzeentch forms a protective barrier, continually strengthened according to the Wind-Lord's whims.

desc.zh: 致命的衰朽光环，所有接触它的人都会被纳垢的邪恶深深地折磨一番
desc.en: All who wade through such a deadly aura of decay are visibly weakened by Nurgle's vile afflictions.

desc.zh: 谁能下手攻击这样的妙人呢？毕竟，伤害这样迷人的美丽正是一种耻辱
desc.en: Who could strike at such a tempting figure? After all, it would be a shame to mar such beguiling beauty.

desc.zh: 混沌勇士们聚集在一股强大的屠杀之力背后，野蛮领主的出现为他们赋予了大量的力量
desc.en: The Warriors of Chaos gather behind a force of almighty carnage, empowered by the very presence of their barbarous Lord.

desc.zh: 恐虐的勇士们意志坚定地追随着瓦尔基娅，因为她的矛尖一次次地证明了她的力量
desc.en: Khorne's warriors follow Valkia without question, for her strength has been proven time and again at the point of her spear.

desc.zh: 战斗令维里奇愈发强悍，他醉心于自己力量与奥术的结合
desc.en: Vilitch thrives in the midst of battle, revelling in the use of his strength and sorcery combined.

desc.zh: 在烈焰法师或混沌术士的召唤下，猛烈旋转的火柱在战场上喷涌而出，极具杀伤力！
desc.en: Conjured by a Bright Wizard or Chaos Sorcerer, a column of churning fire erupts from the battlefield, causing much destruction!

desc.zh: 你能想到的最为恶心的增生组织突然出现了：刚刚砍出的伤口上瞬间长出了摇摇欲坠的肥大肉瘤
desc.en: The most repulsive growth spurt imaginable occurs – the wobbling mounds of fat sealing wounds as soon as they are formed.

desc.zh: 法师吹响一个闪光的金色口哨，吉哈纳的金属猎犬应声而出并扑向自己的猎物
desc.en: Blowing on a glimmering golden whistle, the Wizard summons the spirit of Gehenna’s metal hounds to hunt down his prey.

desc.zh: 一道通往混沌魔域的传送门就此开启，这道凡世间的魔法裂痕会吸走周围之人的理性，如此他们将直面自己的毁灭，就算侥幸不死，也会彻底疯狂
desc.en: A portal to the Realm of Chaos opens; a magical tear in the mortal plane that sucks those nearby inside to face certain madness, if not their doom.

desc.zh: 汹涌的彩虹能量从施法者身上流出，以灼热的锥形魔法火焰吞没敌人
desc.en: A roiling tide of iridescent energy flows from the spellcaster, enveloping their enemies in a cone of searing magical flame.

desc.zh: 天空中化出一面镜子，随即粉碎成无数致命的碎片，割伤地面上的敌人
desc.en: A mirror forms in the sky only to be shattered into a myriad of deadly shards that lacerate the enemy below.

desc.zh: 剧毒的气体和胆汁从施法者的病变肺部喷涌而出，令人作呕的脓液劈头盖脸地洒向敌人
desc.en: A poisonous spurt of diseased gas and bile spews forth from the spellcaster's diseased lungs, drenching the enemy in vile, choking pus.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽灵般的钟摆。随着一声令下，它将急速摇摆起来并穿越敌方阵势，锋利的刀刃足以切肉断骨
desc.en: A spectral pendulum is summoned by the Wizard. On command, it swings, razor sharp and with lethal speed, through the foe.

desc.zh: 作为令人垂涎的受诅灵魂容器，祭坛有着不可估量的力量：若是强悍到足够掌控它，便可分享这股力量
desc.en: As a coveted vessel of damned souls, the Altar pulses with untold power, sure to be shared with those strong enough to control it.

desc.zh: 这个血迹斑斑的符号承载着恐虐所有的仇恨，激励着他的信徒以暴力展示自己的力量
desc.en: This bloodstained symbol bears all the hatred of Khorne, inspiring His followers to violent displays of strength.

desc.zh: 这个印记彰显着纳垢衰朽的力量，它会为战士们赐下大量战斗抗性作为赐福
desc.en: This mark draws on the power of Nurgle's rotting decay, blessing His warriors with greater resistance in battle.

desc.zh: 这个印记散发着色孽的黑暗之美，它会召来邪神的力量，从而提升战士们的速度和战斗状态
desc.en: The mark radiates with the dark beauty of Slaanesh, calling upon Him to bolster the speed and battle-presence of his warriors.

desc.zh: 这个印记充满奸奇的神秘力量，象征着他的恩惠，并让持有者品尝了一丝他的魔力
desc.en: Drawing on the arcane might of Tzeentch, this token of His favour lends its bearers a sliver of his magical power.

desc.zh: 召唤风暴的元素狂怒，让闪电当空劈下，并以电气充能让召唤者充满力量
desc.en: Call upon the elemental rage of the storm, letting lightning strike and empower its summoner through an electrifying charge.

desc.zh: 『出去总比进去好』是句值得怀疑的格言，尤其是对于那些不幸被困在致命的、臭气熏天的暴风中的家伙
desc.en: 'Better out than in' is a questionable maxim—particularly for the unfortunates caught in this deadly, reeking draught.

desc.zh: 这一来自黑暗诸神的『礼物』足以让部队死于非命并化为混沌之卵。不仅周边诸人，甚至连他们自己都将惊讶不已！
desc.en: This 'gift' from the Dark Gods causes the unit to spontaneously die and mutate into Chaos Spawn, surprising everyone – themselves included!

desc.zh: 生命再次在躯体倒下之处流淌，治愈那些受伤的纳垢战士
desc.en: Where bodies fall, life springs once more, healing the wounded among the warriors of Nurgle.

desc.zh: 死亡只是力量的源泉，因为一个人的生命可以激发另一个人的秘术
desc.en: Death is but a source of power, where the lifeblood of one may fuel the arcane wizardry of another.

desc.zh: 恐虐会因每一次的杀戮为战士们赐福，并享受受害者的痛苦和尖叫
desc.en: Khorne blesses his warriors for every enemy slain, feasting on their suffering and screams.

desc.zh: 这位祭坛之主恳求混沌诸神施以援手，将黑暗的祝福赐予附近的冠军勇士
desc.en: The shrinemaster implores the fickle Chaos Gods for their aid, bestowing their dark blessings upon nearby champions.

desc.zh: 对色孽来说，痛苦不过是一种令人兴奋的愉悦，而他很喜欢对敌人施加这样的折磨
desc.en: Agonising pain is but a thrilling delight for Slaanesh, who revels in inflicting such torture on his foes.

desc.zh: 所有挡在疯狂杀戮之道上的人都会被践踏为一团红色的薄雾，而在此之前，他们根本不会有反应的机会
desc.en: All in the path of this murderous rampage will have little chance to react before being trampled into a fine red mist.

desc.zh: 还有什么能比从镜中映出自己的美貌更能激励人们获得更高的荣耀呢？
desc.en: What could spur one to greater heights of glory than the sight of one's own exquisite visage, reflected in mirrored shields.

desc.zh: 附魔之剑，可以为持剑者的攻击注入某种附魔冲击力
desc.en: An enchanted blade instils a certain magical 'wallop' to its bearer's attacks.

desc.zh: 由色孽亲自为阿扎泽尔打造的恶魔之剑，即使是附魔的护甲，也无法挡住它地狱般的冲击力
desc.en: Fashioned by Slaanesh himself, Azazel's devilish sword strikes with a hellish force that even enchanted armour simply cannot deflect.

desc.zh: 这把邪刃里面束缚着一个高声尖啸的恶魔，一个永远渴望凡人鲜血的恶魔
desc.en: This unholy blade screams with the power of the Daemon bound inside it – one eternally thirsty for the blood of mortals.

desc.zh: 如此优雅而致命的打击，能有哪个敌人可以承受呢？
desc.en: Enemies cannot hope to withstand such a grievous onslaught of graceful and deadly strikes.

desc.zh: 无论是国王还是庶民，鲜血女王的倒刺长矛皆杀不误。它灵巧的一击会挖出敌人的心脏，斩下敌人的首级
desc.en: The Gorequeen’s barbed spear has slain kings and paupers alike, ripping out hearts and striking heads from bodies with deft blows.

desc.zh: 它可以残忍地砍死敌人，但敌人所能感到的只是轻微的瘙痒，就像身上落了根羽毛一样
desc.en: All the foe feels is a light tickling, as if touched by a feather. The reality is they've been brutally slashed to death, of course.

desc.zh: 这把致命匕首会将受害者的灵魂囚禁在缟玛瑙刀刃中，他们被无情地束缚，受匕首主人的疯狂思维所操纵
desc.en: The souls of this deadly dagger's victims are trapped within its onyx blade, where they must remain, subject to its wielder's magical whims.

desc.zh: 这件保护性外壳的内衬似乎是由灰烬与石头制成，这增加了它的防御能力，特别是免疫敌方施放的魔法的能力
desc.en: A protective shell that makes those within it appear to be made of ash and stone, increasing their defensive capabilities, including immunity to counter-enchantment at the foe's hands.

desc.zh: 致命的烟火之云，奇妙地维持着牛头形状，其中滴落的熔融之雨可以把困在下面的任何可怜虫化成灰烬。与此同时，它还不断炸响着哈苏特的胜利狞笑声
desc.en: A deadly cloud of fire and smoke in the shape of a bull's head, dripping with molten rain that turns any caught beneath it to a sorry pile of ash, whilst Hashut cackles on in triumph.

desc.zh: 混沌矮人的大型炮台所倾泻的怒火足以把那些小子们，或者任何敢对他们发动战争的人炸得神魂分离
desc.en: This massive artillery strike from the Chaos Dwarfs' grand battery is sure to separate the Zharr from Da Boyz, or indeed anyone else who dares wage war against them.

desc.zh: 在战斗结束之前，永远都不要停止奋战
desc.en: Never stop fighting 'til the fight is done.

desc.zh: 要论迫击炮，自然是越多越好
desc.en: Many mortars are better than one.

desc.zh: 要论迫击炮，自然是越多越好
desc.en: Many mortars are better than one.

desc.zh: 据说扎尔·纳格隆德城垛上的火炮可以击中半个世界之外的目标，威力无比
desc.en: It is said that the guns atop the battlements of Zharr-Naggrund can reach targets half the world away, so powerful are they.

desc.zh: 『让咱们在这儿死守吧！』
desc.en: "Let us make our stand here!"

desc.zh: 此人的恶意会感染盟友，并对他们灌输愈发强大的残忍天性。这样在恰当的时机里，这些人就会表现出超乎常理的邪恶与攻击性
desc.en: Allies are infected with his malice and imbued with an even greater capacity for savage cruelty, for those choice moments when only even greater evil and destruction will do.

desc.zh: 这个巨大的机器使得混沌矮人能够抵达哈苏特的熔融之血河，它们正在地表下奔腾不息
desc.en: This mammoth piece of machinery will enable the Chaos Dwarfs to reach the rivers of Hashut's molten blood that flow far beneath the surface.

desc.zh: 哈苏特的邪恶鲜血必须奔腾不息…
desc.en: Hashut's unholy blood must flow…

desc.zh: 此人的恶意会感染盟友，并对他们灌输愈发强大的残忍天性。这样在恰当的时机里，这些人就会表现出超乎常理的邪恶与攻击性
desc.en: Allies are infected with his malice and imbued with an even greater capacity for savage cruelty, for those choice moments when only even greater evil and destruction will do.

desc.zh: 即使是诞生于火焰之物，投入其中之后也能得到治愈
desc.en: By which even those born of fire and flame, deep within the forge, can be healed.

desc.zh: 瞄得那么准，射得那么狠，直插一条龙的眼睛，就这么救了高崔克一命；尤莉卡弓箭之下，尽皆难逃！
desc.en: An aim so sharp – and a shot so precise – that it took the eye of a Dragon and saved Gotrek's life; woe betide any on the receiving end of Ulrika's bow and arrow!

desc.zh: 她的动作是如此优雅，她的攻击是如此精确，在战斗中看到尤莉卡几乎就像在观看一场舞蹈，而不是一场屠杀
desc.en: So graceful are her movements, and so precise her attacks, that to see Ulrika in the midst of battle is almost like witnessing a dance, rather than a slaughter.

desc.zh: 任何流程都可以进行改进，这让混沌矮人的战争机器与火炮得到了完美的校准
desc.en: There are always improvements that can be made to any process; this one ensures the Chaos Dwarfs' war machines and artillery are calibrated to perfection.

desc.zh: 尽管尤莉卡以极度轻蔑的态度对待无谓的状况，她仍然需要努力控制鲜血之吻为她赋予的吸血渴望与杀戮冲动
desc.en: Although Ulrika feels great contempt for her unwanted condition, she still struggles to control the hunger for blood and urge to kill that the Blood Kiss has bestowed upon her.

desc.zh: 你有多少次因为输到恼羞成怒就与对手大打出手，最后还不得不亲自收拾残局？因此只要能阻止这些蠢事发生便令人可喜可贺了。现在，拉诺德与你同在！（笑）
desc.en: Anything that prevents you from killing your opponents in a fit of bad-loser's pique on more than one occasion, and then having to clear up the mess yourself afterwards, is a good thing. Now, the odds *always* swing in your favour.

desc.zh: 『咱很清楚，有些事儿是小的们单靠自己搞不定的，所以该去找那厮了！』
desc.en: "It's clear to me that vis is somefing Da Boyz can't deal wiv on their own – time for Da Gitz!"

desc.zh: 『你这走运的厮！走运，狗屎运，点子正，命好，鸿运当头，你…』
desc.en: "You lucky git. You lucky, lucky git. You lucky, lucky, lucky git. You lu--"

desc.zh: 吸血鬼撕开猎物，鲜血四溅之处，便是大快朵颐之时，这让他们得以获得力量、恢复精力
desc.en: As the Vampires rip apart their victims they feast on the blood that spills forth – gaining in strength and lost stamina.

desc.zh: 加祖尔火盆曾经帮助死者找到道路，但现在先祖的力量可以加以扭曲，从而召唤最具复仇心的火焰之裔
desc.en: The Brazier of Gazul once helped the dead find their way, but now the power of the Ancestors can be twisted to summon the most vengeful Scions of Fire.

desc.zh: 这种精良盔甲的绝对质量使它能够承受任何力量的打击，无论攻上来的是谁
desc.en: The sheer quality of this fine armour makes it able to withstand blows of any power, regardless of who is making them.

desc.zh: 它堪称一把双刃剑：尽管这颗宝石可以保护主人免受攻击，但他们戴着它时也不能攻击任何人
desc.en: A double-edged sword, so to speak, for although this jewel protects its owner from attack, they cannot attack anyone while wearing it either.

desc.zh: 这个臭名昭著的钢铁容器中装载着一头狂暴的恶魔，它随时等待着释放
desc.en: Contained within this infamous iron vessel is a raging daemonic entity of phenomenal power, ready to be unleashed.

desc.zh: 它曾经是充满治愈之力的魔雾，但如今已被混沌所腐化：现在它再也不会赐予生命，而是会夺取生命！
desc.en: Once used as a healing mist, its essence has since been corrupted by Chaos to take life instead of giving it!

desc.zh: 这个圆球会增加术士的魔法之风储备，使他能够从敌方施法者身上汲取能量，从而治疗自己
desc.en: This orb increases the Winds of Magic reserves available to the Sorcerer, enabling him to heal himself with power drawn from enemy magic-users.

desc.zh: 这把符文之锤拥有创造或毁灭的力量。如果你强壮到可以挥舞它，它将是个很方便的工具
desc.en: This runic hammer wields the power to create or destroy. Handy, if you're strong enough to wield it.

desc.zh: 摩尔金对远程武器很有眼光，因此，这个镜头会让携带者获得他的视力
desc.en: Morgrim had an eye for ranged weapons. Through this lens, the bearer will gain his sight.

desc.zh: 这个小块有能力穿破任何物质
desc.en: This tablet provides the means to crack through any substance.

desc.zh: 『哈！这些小玩意儿让先祖神葛林姆尼尔几乎获得了永生！而作为矮人，我比他差哪儿了？』
desc.en: "Ha! These 'trinkets' gave the Ancestor God Grimnir near immortality – I'm no lesser Dawi than him!"

desc.zh: 据说这个烧瓶里装着『哈苏特之血』…尽管这不太可能是真的，但它仍然是一种强大的炼金物质，只要稍一接触就足以点燃金属
desc.en: Within this ampoule is contained the "Blood of Hashut"; though highly unlikely to be true, it is nevertheless a powerful alchemical substance that ignites metal on contact.

desc.zh: 这个镶满宝石的圣杯充满了沸腾的鲜血与灰烬，里面承载了一个强大的诅咒，可以释放它来破坏整个战场上魔法之风的稳定
desc.en: Filled with boiling blood and cinder ash, this gem-encrusted chalice contains a powerful curse which can be unleashed to destabilise the Winds of Magic across the battlefield.

desc.zh: 定睛看时，这个附魔盾牌上的符文似乎在不断地扭曲，它拥有消灭任何袭来魔法的力量
desc.en: The runic carvings on this enchanted shield appear to writhe and twist when observed closely, and hold the power to destroy any enemy magicks ranged against it.

desc.zh: 这个坩埚由陨铁与枯金锻造而成，以大量无辜者的鲜血淬火，与遇害后被束缚在地狱中的灵魂们绑定在一起。据说这是古代混沌矮人术士阿佐格本人的作品
desc.en: Forged from meteoric iron and blighted gold, quenched in innocent blood and bound with slain, hell-bound souls, the Crucible is said to have been the handiwork of the ancient Chaos Dwarf Sorcerer Azgorh himself.

desc.zh: 符文护腕扭曲并吸收使用者周围的任何遗骸。当生命离开身体时，它就会找到进入他们身体的方法…
desc.en: The Runic Bracers twist and absorb any wasted flesh surrounding the user; as life leaves one body, it finds a way to enter theirs…

desc.zh: 这股光从来没有熄灭过，也永远不会熄灭，这就是使它保持燃烧的力量。对于背光者来说，他们会被灼至盲目，这在很大程度上阻碍了他们的攻击
desc.en: The light has never been extinguished and never will, such is the power that keeps it alight. For those ranged against the light, it is blinding, and so hampers their attacks considerably.

desc.zh: 这个黑色水晶的核心会将德拉兹霍斯恶毒冰冷的仇恨千百倍地放大，并释放到任何胆敢伤害他的人身上
desc.en: The icy hate of Drazhoath's malice is amplified a thousandfold within its black crystal depths, and unleashed on any who would dare spill his blood.

desc.zh: 这件披风由辜负了阿斯特戈斯的术士学徒的皮肤制成，它既会保护铁手的选民，又会提醒他们失败的代价
desc.en: Created from the flayed, greying flesh of apprentice Sorcerers who failed Astragoth, the Mantle both preserves Ironhand's chosen and reminds them of the price of failure.

desc.zh: 在靠近这个比纯黑还要纯黑的球体时，无论是怎样充斥着奥术能量的武器，统统都会安静下来
desc.en: Weapons imbued with arcane strength will fall quiet when near to this blacker-than-black periapt.

desc.zh: 野蛮的克达熠火诞者应召登上战场，他们纵声尖啸，所过之处尽是熔融的死亡
desc.en: The savage K'daai Fireborn are summoned to the battlefield, and screaming, molten death rides with them.

desc.zh: 几朵燃烧的蘑菇云在战场上爆发，给哈苏特带来了无尽的欢乐
desc.en: Several burning mushroom clouds erupt upon the battlefield, raining down fire and death to Hashut's eternal delight.

desc.zh: 让敌人完全动弹不得，这样你就能随心所欲地决定该怎么弄死他们了
desc.en: The beauty in totally immobilising an enemy is that you can decide precisely how they will die.

desc.zh: 『黑心』扎坦的罪行数不胜数，无穷无尽，堪称野蛮的化身
desc.en: The Black's crimes are without number and his villainy without end, for Zhatan is savagery personified.

desc.zh: 当最骁勇的食人魔登上战场时，你生还概率的上升或是下降，将直接取决于你属于哪一边…
desc.en: When the fightiest of the Ogres comes to battle, the odds of making it home alive go up or down, depending on whether you are on the same side or not...

desc.zh: 历经数世纪的流放，德拉兹霍斯对所有生命的蔑视已深入骨髓，这也成为了属于他自己的力量
desc.en: Grown and built upon across the centuries of his banishment, Drazhoath's endless contempt for all life is a tangible thing, and a power in its own right.

desc.zh: 机器是由杀戮来驱动的，所以杀戮得越多，它能杀死的人就越多。这是何等可怕的聪明才智啊！
desc.en: Murder itself drives the machine, so the more it kills, the more it *can* kill. Diabolical ingenuity!

desc.zh: 当贝勒加在场上与他们并肩作战时，每个人都会更加努力地战斗
desc.en: Everyone fights that little bit harder when Belegar himself is on the field alongside them.

desc.zh: 『你正在至高王面前战斗！梳好胡子，磨快斧子！』
desc.en: "You fight in the presence of the High King. Comb those beards, sharpen your axes!"

desc.zh: 如果你与符文铁匠大师并肩而战，那就期待着炫目的魔法与强大的魔力抗性吧
desc.en: If you're with the Master Runelord, expect a dazzling display of magical power and more than a modicum of protection from others' sorceries.

desc.zh: 哈苏特的火焰最好在活人身上点燃，它永远都在渴望着毁灭
desc.en: The flame of Hashut kindles best in living flesh, and always hungers to destroy.

desc.zh: 有些人似乎天生就会骑马，这就是他们天生的骑术品质。而尤莉卡就是这样的一位天才
desc.en: Some people just seem to have been born in the saddle, such is the quality of their natural horsemanship. Ulrika is one such person.

desc.zh: 最深层的地火应召而出，白炽的熔岩流只为献祭敌人
desc.en: The fires of the deep earth are called forth to send a torrent of white hot molten lava to immolate the foe.

desc.zh: 法师使用阴影系法术的技能，让敌人被自身的负担拖垮，直到他们虚弱到只能停滞不前为止
desc.en: By means of the Lore of Shadows, the Wizard causes the enemy to be worn down by their own burdens, until they are enervated to a sorry standstill.

desc.zh: 哈苏特的力量具象化为一柄巨大的牛头形燃烧战锤。毫无疑问，它所经之处会砸平一切，所余唯有灰烬
desc.en: The power of Hashut manifests as a colossal, burning black hammer or bull's head. Needless to say, anyone in its path is going to be flattened and reduced to ash.

desc.zh: 法师使用怀疑与危机感侵蚀敌人的思维，从内心深处击垮敌军
desc.en: The Wizard destroys the foe from within, corroding their minds with doubt and crisis.

desc.zh: 每当这个恶毒而简单的法术施放开来时，窒息、滚烫、致盲、炽热的灰烬就会在战场上横流
desc.en: Choking, scalding, blinding, superheated ash streams across the battlefield whenever this nasty little spell is cast.

desc.zh: 每当这个恶毒而简单的法术施放开来时，窒息、滚烫、致盲、炽热的灰烬就会在战场上横流
desc.en: Choking, scalding, blinding, superheated ash streams across the battlefield whenever this nasty little spell is cast.

desc.zh: 最深层的地火应召而出，白炽的熔岩流只为献祭敌人
desc.en: The fires of the deep earth are called forth to send a torrent of white hot molten lava to immolate the foe.

desc.zh: 最深层的地火应召而出，白炽的熔岩流只为献祭敌人
desc.en: The fires of the deep earth are called forth to send a torrent of white hot molten lava to immolate the foe.

desc.zh: 哈苏特的信徒们被一种可怕的咒术所诅咒，而这种诅咒可以通过至暗的黑魔法引向敌人
desc.en: Those who worship Hashut are accursed with a hideous malediction that can be directed at the foe through the darkest of dark sorceries.

desc.zh: 哈苏特的信徒们被一种可怕的咒术所诅咒，而这种诅咒可以通过至暗的黑魔法引向敌人
desc.en: Those who worship Hashut are accursed with a hideous malediction that can be directed at the foe through the darkest of dark sorceries.

desc.zh: 黑暗之父是火之神、贪婪之神和暴政之神，他的邪恶力量足以彻底粉碎他的信徒之敌的意志
desc.en: The Father of Darkness is the God of Fire, Greed and Tyranny, whose malignant force utterly crushes the will of his adepts' enemies.

desc.zh: 黑暗之父是火之神、贪婪之神和暴政之神，他的邪恶力量足以彻底粉碎他的信徒之敌的意志
desc.en: The Father of Darkness is the God of Fire, Greed and Tyranny, whose malignant force utterly crushes the will of his adepts' enemies.

desc.zh: 这是最可怕的咒语，它可以召唤火焰与毁灭，撕裂地面，令沸腾的岩浆喷薄而出，让一切都『暖和』起来！
desc.en: The most terrible incantations, invoking fire and destruction, cause the ground to crack and extrude boiling magma. Things are about to get a little toasty!

desc.zh: 这是最可怕的咒语，它可以召唤火焰与毁灭，撕裂地面，令沸腾的岩浆喷薄而出，让一切都『暖和』起来！
desc.en: The most terrible incantations, invoking fire and destruction, cause the ground to crack and extrude boiling magma. Things are about to get a little toasty!

desc.zh: 哈苏特的力量具象化为一柄巨大的牛头形燃烧战锤。毫无疑问，它所经之处会砸平一切，所余唯有灰烬
desc.en: The power of Hashut manifests as a colossal, burning black hammer or bull's head. Needless to say, anyone in its path is going to be flattened and reduced to ash.

desc.zh: 哈苏特的力量具象化为一柄巨大的牛头形燃烧战锤。毫无疑问，它所经之处会砸平一切，所余唯有灰烬
desc.en: The power of Hashut manifests as a colossal, burning black hammer or bull's head. Needless to say, anyone in its path is going to be flattened and reduced to ash.

desc.zh: 一定要小心使用，因为只要一不留神混沌矮人自己的队伍也会化为灰烬！
desc.en: Use wisely, because just one careless puff will turn the Chaos Dwarfs' own ranks to cinders!

desc.zh: 『「等着瞧吧！」他说，「只要想要，我们就能得到熊熊的炉火！」他是对的…』
desc.en: ""Wait and see," he said. "We'll have a roaring fire, just when we want it!" He was right…"

desc.zh: 大地精实在是太可怕了：狡诈、诡计多端、无信义的杀手。他们也是懦夫，这并不奇怪，所以哪怕只有一瞬间也不要把你的后背留给他们，明白了吗？
desc.en: Hobgoblins are just horrid: devious, ultra-tricksy, untrustworthy killers. They're also cowards, unsurprisingly – so don't turn your back on one for an instant. Gottit?

desc.zh: 此人诞生于哈苏特燃烧祭品的沸腾血液，它散发出的熔融热能足以削弱任何接近它的敌人
desc.en: Birthed in the boiling blood of Hashut's burning sacrifices, this one radiates molten heat that weakens any foe close enough to attack.

desc.zh: 释放之后，克达熠的奥术之火就会展现出强大的力量，它会吞噬包括自己在内的一切，最终摧毁包容它形体的一切束缚
desc.en: Once unleashed, the power of the K’daai’s sorcerous fire is so great that it consumes everything – even itself – eventually destroying the bindings holding it in shape.

desc.zh: 释放之后，克达熠的奥术之火就会展现出强大的力量，它会吞噬包括自己在内的一切，最终摧毁包容它形体的一切束缚
desc.en: Once unleashed, the power of the K’daai’s sorcerous fire is so great that it consumes everything – even itself – eventually destroying the bindings holding it in shape.

desc.zh: 相比帝国那些懦夫而言，基斯里夫勇士天生更为强大，毕竟那群家伙对草原上的艰辛生活一无所知
desc.en: Kislevite warriors are inherently stronger than weak-hearted Empire-men, who know nothing of the hardship and strife of lives lived on the unforgiving steppes.

desc.zh: 将一个大地精粘在一只狼身上，并将它们驱向敌人，但首先必须要让他们知道，如果他们胆敢撤退那你就会杀掉他们。这样，只需让他们聚团冲过去，就能收到最好的效果
desc.en: Stick a Hobgoblin on a wolf and point them at the enemy, having first pointed out that if they retreat, *you'll* kill them, and they can be most effective when massed for a charge.

desc.zh: 当陷入死亡边缘时，克达熠会获得一个互相治疗的机会，让他们的火焰风暴与燃烧的死亡毫不衰减
desc.en: On the very brink of death, the K'daai have a single chance to heal one another, ensuring their storm of fire and burning death continues unabated.

desc.zh: 这种附魔蒸汽会抵御魔法攻击，也会影响施法者，所以他们无法迅速地再次发起攻击
desc.en: This enchanted vapour both negates magical attacks and affects the spellcaster too, so they cannot launch another quite so soon.

desc.zh: 当你发现一个方便对敌人倾泻远程火力的地点时，立刻掘壕构筑阵地，倾泻死亡，然后重复这个过程直至战斗结束
desc.en: When you've scouted an advantageous position from which to pepper the enemy with missile fire, dig in, rain death, and repeat until done.

desc.zh: 当你发现一个方便对敌人倾泻远程火力的地点时，立刻掘壕构筑阵地，倾泻死亡，然后重复这个过程直至战斗结束
desc.en: When you've scouted an advantageous position from which to pepper the enemy with missile fire, dig in, rain death and repeat until done.

desc.zh: 当你发现一个方便对敌人倾泻远程火力的地点时，立刻掘壕构筑阵地，倾泻死亡，然后重复这个过程直至战斗结束
desc.en: When you've scouted an advantageous position from which to pepper the enemy with missile fire, dig in, rain death and repeat until done.

desc.zh: 想象一下，如果你在你的额外弹夹上额外再装一个弹夹！我知道这很疯狂，是吧？！
desc.en: Imagine if your extra ammo clip had an extra ammo clip! I know -- wild, huh?!

desc.zh: 有些战争机器的框架和螺栓上绑定着愤怒与毁灭的恶魔，这样创造出的兵器会比它们的创造者更为嗜血，也更难以摧毁
desc.en: Some war machines have Daemons of fury and destruction bound to their very frame and bolt, creating something even more bloodthirsty than their creators, and much more difficult to destroy.

desc.zh: 这个被困的恶魔灵魂会将自己所有被压抑的愤怒转化为最残忍的暴力
desc.en: By which this trapped Daemon spirit channels all their pent-up fury into a delirium of the worst violence possible.

desc.zh: 『最好都给我懂点规矩。有天我听过有个苦工想多要一口粥，结果他们把他扔进了锅里！』
desc.en: "Best not step out of line. Heard a Labourer ask for more gruel the other day, and they put him in the pot!"

desc.zh: 混沌矮人毫不掩饰自己对敌人的蔑视，因此他们武装了自己，从而更好地抵御敌人对他这位哈苏特的凡世仆人施展的攻击
desc.en: The disdain the Chaos Dwarfs feel for their adversaries, weaponised so attacks against this mortal servant of Hashut can be further resisted.

desc.zh: 大地精领主恒凯可汗的传奇巨狼坐骑的皮毛，上面依附着来自昔日萨满的古老祝福：任何敌人都无法背离它的佩戴者，并且活着离开战场
desc.en: The pelt of the legendary giant wolf steed of the Hobgoblin Lord Khengai Khan carries an ancient blessing from shamans past; no foe may turn their back on its wearer and leave the field alive.

desc.zh: 进攻方会如此地利用对方恐惧死亡的心理，从而压制对方的优势，并将敌人从战场上消灭
desc.en: By which fear of death is exploited by the attacking force, enabling them to press their advantage and wipe the foe from the battlefield.

desc.zh: 嗅到这股魔雾的人会发现，他们自己的魔法武器忽然失去了作用
desc.en: Those within sniffing distance of this enchanted pong find their own magical weapons practically useless while they remain there.

desc.zh: 当站在这个混沌矮人标志之下时，他们的防御力会得到提高；无论遇到怎样的失败与毁灭，他们的战斗意志也将不可动摇
desc.en: They who stand behind this Chaos Dwarf symbol find their defensive capabilities improved and their will to fight on unshakeable, even in the face of likely defeat and destruction.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 不可动摇、无懈可击的意志力将无往不胜，甚至击败死亡本身
desc.en: Unshakeable, unassailable strength of will can hold back anything, even death itself.

desc.zh: 这把黑柄战锤上刻有黑暗之父哈苏特的有角符文，几个世纪以来一直由扎尔·纳格隆德的勇士们带进战场
desc.en: This black-shafted hammer bears the horned rune of Hashut, Father of Darkness, and has been carried into battle for centuries by the champions of Zharr-Naggrund.

desc.zh: 这把剑会向任何握住剑柄的人耳语灌输谋杀与暴力的思想，无论它曾犯下多少血腥的勾当，它仍然闪闪发光
desc.en: This blade whispers thoughts of murder and violence to any that grasp its hilt, and remains gleaming, no matter how much bloody work it has done.

desc.zh: 这根可恶的尖刺棍子散发着黑暗的力量，似乎吞噬了它周围的光芒与受害者的体温，只留下枯萎的外壳
desc.en: This nasty spiked club smoulders with a dark power that seems to eat the light around it and devours its victims' body heat, leaving them nought but withered husks.

desc.zh: 无论怎样的铠甲都不能让尤莉卡的银刃偏离它的目标，这是它与生俱来的魔法属性
desc.en: Neither armour nor wards can turn Ulrika's silver blade from its target, such are its innate magical properties.

desc.zh: 这个充满黑魔法的权杖会聚焦魔法师扭曲的思维，允许他们以超自然的迅捷施放法术
desc.en: This Dark Magic-imbued staff focuses the Sorcerer’s twisted mind, allowing them to act with supernatural haste.

desc.zh: 地位与贵胄的象征，这枚铁制权杖上刻着黑色要塞所有前任主人的符文名字，以及对哈苏特的恶毒祈祷
desc.en: A badge of rank and high office, this iron staff-mace, which carries the runic names of every past master of the Black Fortress, is bound with baleful prayers to Hashut.

desc.zh: 这把暗锻刃斧的一次斩击，足以媲美未附魔的普通武器的好几次劈斩
desc.en: One blow from this Darkforged axe-blade is equivalent to several from an ordinary, unenchanted blade.

desc.zh: 这把可怕的回火战斧可以轻易劈开护甲，无论是怎样精工锻造的板甲都毫无招架之力
desc.en: This fearsome tempered axe can split apart armour with great ease, rendering even the most well-forged plate useless.

desc.zh: 有时你必须与毁灭的浪潮抗争：就是这里，就是现在
desc.en: Sometimes, you must make a stand against a tide of Ruin. That time is now; the place is here.

desc.zh: 奸奇暴君与领主的言论就是法律，而他们发布的这一条命令可以有效地制止军队的逃亡
desc.en: Tzeentchian tyrants and Lords, whose word is law, ensure their troops will not run by issuing this dread order.

desc.zh: 个头越大，就摔得越狠！
desc.en: The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

desc.zh: 个头越大，就摔得越狠！
desc.en: The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

desc.zh: 『这片土地的力量源于鲜血。基斯里夫是土地。土地是基斯里夫。我们是基斯里夫！』
desc.en: "Through blood runs the power of the land. Kislev is the land. The Land is Kislev. We are Kislev!”

desc.zh: 祟唐一跃，则大地颤抖不止，连敌人也会纷纷跌倒
desc.en: When Saytang leaps, the ground trembles …and his foes stumble and fall.

desc.zh: 『升起信号旗！左翼必须挺住！』
desc.en: "Raise the signal banners! The left flank must stand strong!"

desc.zh: 『派信使到前线去！右翼必须战至最后一人！』
desc.en: "Send messengers to the front! The right-flank must fight to the last man!"

desc.zh: 无论远近，无论何方，终究逃不脱祟唐轻蔑的目光
desc.en: Near… far… In fact, wherever it is that you are, Saytang's belittling gaze will find you.

desc.zh: 一夫当关，万夫莫开
desc.en: Be the gate itself, through which none shall pass if you will it so.

desc.zh: 震旦构装体的典范坚定了同类们的意志，无论他们是玉石造物、黑玉雕琢，还是岩土造就
desc.en: This paragon of Cathayan Constructs imbues others of his kind with greater resilience, be they jade, jet or stone.

desc.zh: 当噩梦般的捕食者无处可寻时，魔法可助一臂之力
desc.en: When nightmarish predators are nowhere to be found, magic can assist.

desc.zh: 一旦被缠绕在藤蔓之中，每一根棘刺都会像锋利的刀刃一样刺穿皮肤，撕裂脆弱的肉体
desc.en: Once caught in a vice-like grip of vines, each thorn is a sharpened blade, piercing the skin and tearing at fragile flesh.

desc.zh: 没有任何敌人能够抵抗命运的诅咒鞭笞，这会将他们紧紧地束缚在难以逃避的厄运之中
desc.en: No enemy can fight the cursed lashings of fate, binding them to their inevitable doom.

desc.zh: 这把飘忽不定、难以预测的双手奸奇大剑在埃考德手中倒是运转如风。他会将其掷向敌人，从而造成毁灭性的打击效果
desc.en: Aekold’s excellent swordsmanship allows him to control this erratic and unpredictable double-handed Tzeentchian broadsword, hurling it at his enemies with devastating results.

desc.zh: 乡间巫婆的守护是一种强大的保护，旨在治愈各种伤口和疾病
desc.en: A folk witch's ward is a powerful protection, meant to tend all manner of wound and ailment.

desc.zh: 『现在是行动而不是空谈的时候！为了保卫我们的未来！』
desc.en: "It’s time for action, not words! In defence of the future!"

desc.zh: 作为奸奇最神秘、最奇异的礼物之一，埃考德的身体会焕发出全新的活力，持续不断地恢复自己的生命
desc.en: One of Tzeentch’s most mysterious and bizarre gifts, Aekold's body springs new and vigorous growth, constantly restoring his own lifeforce.

desc.zh: 作为奸奇最神秘、最奇异的礼物之一，埃考德的身体会焕发出全新的活力，持续不断地恢复自己的生命
desc.en: One of Tzeentch’s most mysterious and bizarre gifts, Aekold's body springs new and vigorous growth, constantly restoring his own lifeforce.

desc.zh: 忠诚是莱萨一族的一切，基斯里夫必须得到誓死的捍卫！
desc.en: Loyalty is everything to the Leysa bloodline – Kislev must be protected!

desc.zh: 俗话说集思广益，好吧，这话可能不是严格正确，但绝对有可取之处
desc.en: You know what they say: "Three heads are better than one!" Well, that might not be strictly true, but they definitely should.

desc.zh: 任何一点微小的魔法对于奸奇而言都是一顿盛宴，因为他能从附近的法术中吸取力量，并将其赐给他的术士们
desc.en: Any small morsel of magic is a feast for the mind, for Tzeentch leeches power from nearby spells to gift upon his Sorcerers.

desc.zh: 大量的玉石之眼装饰着元伯的护甲，借此月后可以目睹万事，并对麾下臣民施加自己的意志
desc.en: Through the many jade eyes adorning Yuan Bo’s armour, the Moon Empress can see all and exert her will upon her subjects.

desc.zh: 这个珍贵的传家宝曾经有过很多主人，在某种程度上，它被注入了州的力量，以保护其持有者的军团免受伤害。
desc.en: This treasured family heirloom has had many owners, and at some point was imbued with power of the Oblast to protect its bearer’s regiment from harm.

desc.zh: 火焰，死亡与阴影，一顿均衡营养早餐的所有成分。嗯…
desc.en: Fire, Death and Shadow; all parts of a balanced, nutritious breakfast. Mmmm…

desc.zh: 『头脑要比眼睛快。你的思想…现在属于我了』
desc.en: "The mind is quicker than the eye. Your thoughts... are mine now."

desc.zh: 现实之间的一扇门显现了出来，召唤着来自远方的存在，并在这个位面上制造浩劫与死亡
desc.en: A door between realities manifests, calling forth beings from beyond to wreak havoc and death upon this plane.

desc.zh: 这个强大的护符由女巫头发的细丝编成，上面包裹着一个万变魔君的石化之眼：携带它的人会获得敏锐的第六感，提醒他注意远处的威胁
desc.en: This potent talisman consists of a filigree of witch-hair cradling the fossilised eye of a Lord of Change; its bearer develops a sixth-sense that warns him of threats from afar.

desc.zh: 仅需祟唐充溢魔力的简单一击…
desc.en: A single, enchanted shot is all that Saytang needs.

desc.zh: 这件物品可以用于搜寻古圣们的遗物，或者调查灵脉巨网中的扰动
desc.en: This item can be used to seek out lost artefacts of the Old Ones or to investigate disturbances in the Geomantic Web.

desc.zh: 『轰隆隆！是的，就像闪电一样！听我号令！』
desc.en: "Buzzapp! That's right – just like lightning! At my behest!"

desc.zh: 非自然的本质，却具有超自然的力量。这件神器散发出的光环会弱化敌人的灵魂
desc.en: Intrinsically unnatural, yet supernaturally powerful, this artefact exudes an aura that enfeebles the spirit of those who defy its invigorated bearer.

desc.zh: 这样一股席卷而来的能量漩涡可以切割千军万马，留下的只有鲜血和毁灭
desc.en: Such a sweeping maelstrom of energy can cut through a crowd of bodies, leaving blood and devastation in its wake.

desc.zh: 外表起伏变形，皮肤衣物幻化，直到成为完美无瑕的化身
desc.en: Features shift and morph, skin and cloth ripples, until the facsimile form is flawless.

desc.zh: 伪装消退，迷雾散去，所余只有欺诈者本尊
desc.en: The disguise is discarded, the ethereal mists recede, and only the Trickster remains.

desc.zh: 外表起伏变形，皮肤衣物幻化，直到成为完美无瑕的化身
desc.en: Features shift and morph, skin and cloth ripples, until the facsimile form is flawless.

desc.zh: 伪装消退，迷雾散去，所余只有欺诈者本尊
desc.en: The disguise is discarded, the ethereal mists recede, and only the Trickster remains.

desc.zh: 永远不要怀疑美味蘑菇炖肉的治愈能力，光是那些真菌孢子就能为灵魂带来奇迹般的效果
desc.en: Never doubt the healing power of a tasty mushroom goulash; the fungal spores alone work wonders for the soul.

desc.zh: 元伯天资禀异，可以随心所欲地在人身与龙形中切换，从而在最为合适的时刻转换战局
desc.en: Yuan Bo has the innate power to transmogrify from human form to Dragon and back again at will, and often at the most opportune moments.

desc.zh: 元伯天资禀异，可以随心所欲地在人身与龙形中切换，从而在最为合适的时刻转换战局
desc.en: Yuan Bo has the innate power to transmogrify from human form to Dragon and back again at will, and often at the most opportune moments.

desc.zh: 当主公讲话之时，震旦的士兵们会侧耳倾听，将每一个鼓舞人心的词句烙印在心里，带入战斗之中
desc.en: When their noble Lord speaks, the men of Cathay listen, burning every inspiring word into their hearts to carry it with them into battle.

desc.zh: 抬头仰望天空时，人们最不想看到的恐怕是灵体巨熊挥舞在空中的尖牙利爪
desc.en: When one looks to the sky, the last thing they expect to see is a descending flurry of teeth, claws and ethereal ursine might.

desc.zh: 抬头仰望天空时，人们最不想看到的恐怕是灵体巨熊挥舞在空中的尖牙利爪
desc.en: When one looks to the sky, the last thing they expect to see is a descending flurry of teeth, claws and ethereal ursine might.

desc.zh: 当自然之神做出裁决时，整个自然世界都会支持他。这些就是最终的宣判
desc.en: When the God of Nature makes a ruling, the whole of the natural world stands behind him. All verdicts are final.

desc.zh: 玉龙肩负着沉重的使命，只需一刀就能毫不留情地斩杀龙帝的敌人
desc.en: The Jade Dragon bears a heavy duty, cutting down the Emperor's enemies without mercy, in a single strike of his blade.

desc.zh: 玉龙肩负着沉重的使命，只需一刀就能毫不留情地斩杀龙帝的敌人
desc.en: The Jade Dragon bears a heavy duty, cutting down the Emperor's enemies without mercy, in a single strike of his blade.

desc.zh: 『哈哈哈！你以为这是变化灵的真身？不，这才是！』
desc.en: "Hahaha! You think this is the real Changeling? IT IS."

desc.zh: 也许除了奸奇自己，没有人知道变化灵的真实形态，因为无人可以仅凭肉眼辨认出它的形体
desc.en: None, save perhaps Tzeentch himself, know the Changeling’s true form, for his figure is indiscernible and indistinguishable to the naked eye.

desc.zh: 婆婆的爪之环中央悬挂着一个永远冻结在寒冰中的古老神器，它强化了她与这片土地上的哨卫精魂的羁绊
desc.en: Centred within the Mother’s circlet of claws, an ancient artefact suspended in ever-frozen ice strengthens her kinship with the sentinel-spirits of the land.

desc.zh: 今日不宜入林。不，真的不
desc.en: Don't go into the woods today. No, seriously, don't.

desc.zh: 『为了祖国母亲，为了女沙皇，为了厄孙，我们必须直面威胁我们生命的祸患！』
desc.en: "For the sake of the Motherland, the Tzarina and for Ursun himself, we must face down this scourge that threatens our very being."

desc.zh: 作为技艺精湛的匠人，据传昭明亲手铸造了这些臂铠，从而协助自己引导阳的力量
desc.en: As a capable smith, these vambraces are thought to be Zhao’s own creations, allowing him to channel the power of Yang.

desc.zh: 为了女沙皇的安全，她万死不辞
desc.en: For her life, she will give her own ten thousand times over.

desc.zh: 它们由南皋的工匠所创造，其中充满了黑暗的阴系魔法，为龙帝的女儿赋予了强大的奥术加护
desc.en: Created by artisans of Nan-Gau and imbued with dark Yin magic, they grant the Dragon Emperor’s daughter formidable arcane protection.

desc.zh: 那些擅闯这片土地的人很快就会发现，他们的命运已经完全注定
desc.en: Those trespassing upon this ground soon find their fate is completely sealed; their end decided.

desc.zh: 轻伤不下火线…受伤的狮子更可怕，这非常有道理
desc.en: Down but not out… and never more dangerous. You'd be right to fear the wounded lion…

desc.zh: 黑暗诅咒像传染病一样在人群中蔓延，缓慢地将痛苦传播开来
desc.en: This dark curse lurches through any crowd like a contagion, slowly spreading its torment from body to body.

desc.zh: 森林之灵响应女巫的召唤，使她的敌人陷入麻痹状态
desc.en: The spirits of the forest answer the witch's call, trapping her foes in a helpless state of paralysis.

desc.zh: 不要害怕战斗的致命伤：即便殒命沙场，你仍然注定会让敌人付出代价
desc.en: Fear not the lethal wounds of battle; there is damage to be done, even in death.

desc.zh: 如果可以召唤一只林中巨兽来猛击敌人，那为何还要白白送死呢？
desc.en: Why simply die when you can spawn a monstrous creature of the woods to savage your foes for you?

desc.zh: 从盔甲的每一个缝隙中都会迸发出荆棘钉刺，来刺穿毫无防备的对手
desc.en: From every gap in the armour, bristling thorns burst forth to skewer unwary opponents.

desc.zh: 此部队不能对敌人施加任何心理攻击（恐惧与惊骇）
desc.en: This unit cannot inflict any of its psychological attacks (Fear & Terror) upon its enemies.

desc.zh: 巫婆召唤一个戴着兜帽的身影，对着那些永远不该游荡在森林里的人低吟恐怖的话语，无论此人是来自凡世，还是身为不朽…
desc.en: A hooded figure summoned by the Hag whispers words of terror, both mortal and immortal, to those who should never, ever have gone wandering in the woods…

desc.zh: 对于有幸得到巫婆青睐的人来说，她的蒙面帮凶会用森林中最为黑暗的恶意为箭矢附魔
desc.en: For those fortunate enough to have the Hag’s favour, her hooded accomplice empowers arrows with the forest’s darkest intentions.

desc.zh: 巫婆的坩埚里飞出幽灵般的魔法弹，如骤雨般不问是非地屠杀区域内的目标
desc.en: Conjured up from the Hag's cauldron, spectral missiles shoot upwards to rain carnage down with indiscriminate devastation.

desc.zh: 巫婆的坩埚里飞出幽灵般的魔法弹，如骤雨般不问是非地屠杀区域内的目标，但不会伤害巫婆一方的目标
desc.en: Conjured up from the Hag's cauldron, spectral missiles shoot upwards to rain carnage down, yet sparing the coven from harm.

desc.zh: 突如其来的噩梦景象充溢着受害者的心灵，驱使他们陷入短暂的疯狂，即使是最坚强的战士也会心力憔悴
desc.en: A sudden rush of nightmarish visions floods the victim’s psyche, driving them to a fleeting madness that debilitates even the hardiest warrior.

desc.zh: 按照巫婆的指令，月晕自刀锋与矛头中反射而出，在近乎盲目的嗜血欲中凶狠地刺向敌人
desc.en: On the Hag’s word, flashes of spectral moonlight reflect from blades and spearheads murderously thrust forth in a near-mindless bloodlust.

desc.zh: 巫婆祈唤地下深处的空灵力量向上渗透，阻碍敌人的前进，耗尽他们所有的精力
desc.en: The Hag beseeches ethereal forces deep underground to seep upwards and hamper the progress of her enemies, draining all momentum from them.

desc.zh: 巫婆诵念的咒语在林间回响，减轻受赐祝福之人的身心负担
desc.en: Carried upon the Hag’s breath are incantations that emanate betwixt the trees, lightening the burden of those chosen to receive her blessings.

desc.zh: 巫婆将邪恶的精魂引导进敌人的灵魂，使他们的灵魂饱和过载，并逐渐将他们从内向外撕成血腥的碎片
desc.en: The Hag channels a malevolent spirit into an enemy’s soul to saturate their being and gradually tear them to bloody, miniscule shreds from the inside out.

desc.zh: 巫婆召唤出一位古老术士的灵魂，令其完全服从于自己的命令，吸取额外的魔法力量
desc.en: The Hag invokes an ancient Sorcerer’s spirit, enthralling it to her bidding and sending it forth to siphon additional magical potency.

desc.zh: 巫婆的坩埚猝然沸腾，把坩埚里的东西连同祖国母亲无边的愤怒一同溅射到绝望的敌人身上
desc.en: The Hag's cauldron erupts in a bubbling crescendo, splashing its contents – and the Motherland’s boundless wrath – all over her hopeless enemies.

desc.zh: 『天天魔汤，百毒不伤…』
desc.en: "A Witchbroth a day keeps the gangrene away…"

desc.zh: 溺水的水手很容易被绑定，因为他们记得自己的最后一次航行和许多世俗的职责
desc.en: Drowned sailors are easily bound, for they remember their last voyage and many of their worldly duties.
