desc.zh: 令人生怖的火箭炮，可引发巨大的爆炸，能把四面八方的部队尽数粉碎。当然，也能炸得他们残肢乱飞
desc.en: This dread projectile causes an enormous explosion on impact, sending entire units – and no doubt their limbs – flying off in all directions.

desc.zh: 坚实的敲击象征着坚固的壁垒，这是一道无敌的屏障，任何敌人都无法突破
desc.en: A steady beat symbolises the staunch defences of the Bastion, a bulwark through which no enemy shall break.

desc.zh: 在战鼓的激励下，震旦的战士们战斗时无所畏惧，释放出龙神之怒来对抗敌人
desc.en: Urged on by the pounding of drums, the Cathayan warriors fight untouched by fear, unleashing the fury of the Dragon on their foes.

desc.zh: 如此咆哮与它们的咬伤一样可怕…
desc.en: This one's bark is at least as bad as their bite…

desc.zh: 随着节奏不断升至高潮，所有将士都陷入战争狂怒，他们将愤怒带入每一次冲锋之中
desc.en: As the rising tempo reaches a crescendo, every man gives way to the rage of war, carrying their fury into every charge.

desc.zh: 杀死一位女巫并不容易，因此只有蠢货才会去尝试如此困难的行为吧
desc.en: It is not so easy to kill a witch – only fools find out the hard way.

desc.zh: 野兽元素化身的刺耳嚎叫可以凝结血液，令所有听到的敌人失魂落魄
desc.en: The piercing howl of the Incarnate Elemental of Beasts freezes the blood and fills all who hear it with mortal fear.

desc.zh: 这种吐息造成的冻伤效果相当于长时间暴露在冰冷中形成的冻伤，而且同样痛苦
desc.en: The effect of this one's frozen breath is equivalent to frostbite following prolonged exposure to the icy cold, and every bit as painful.

desc.zh: 未待敌人瞥见雄狮，便已被玉焰化为灰烬
desc.en: Before the enemy has seen the Lion in a single glance, its jade breath has burnt them to cinders.

desc.zh: 尖牙碰撞的声音在战场上回荡，敌军无不屈膝求饶
desc.en: The force of such a clash of fangs echoes out across the battlefield, forcing whole waves of men to their knees.

desc.zh: 这股奥术能量的狂飙之下，无遮无蔽的下场就是枯萎，然后破碎
desc.en: Those who cannot find shelter from this raging tempest of arcane power are sure to wither and break beneath its every wave.

desc.zh: 无论是人还是野兽，只要背负这个咒印，就必将面临灾难，因为这意味着阴系法术锁定了一个难逃厄运的目标，随之而来的就是毁灭
desc.en: Woe to the man or beast bearing this cursed mark, for the Lore of Yin has found an unwilling target and doom trails their every step.

desc.zh: 当这银蓝色的火焰喷涌而出时，千万不要靠近，甚至最好不要去看它。记住，如果你还想要命，那就千万不要碰它！
desc.en: Don't get anywhere near this silvery-blue flame as it gushes forth. Best not even look at it, in fact. Certainly do not touch it if you value your continued existence.

desc.zh: 谁曾想，如此不起眼的东西竟能造成如此巨大的破坏？
desc.en: Who would have thought such a small, unassuming object could cause such overwhelming damage?

desc.zh: 每一根编织的网线都蕴含着强大的妖术，被困其中的猎物将寸步难行
desc.en: Every woven strand of net bears a powerful hex, draining every ounce of pace from the prey caught in its binds.

desc.zh: 从巫女女王的鲜血中萃取，这种邪恶的汁液会让饮者陷入毁灭的狂喜
desc.en: Distilled from the blood of Hag Queens, this evil brew drives imbibers into an ecstasy of destruction.

desc.zh: 莫测的黑暗与呼啸的狂风凌空阻碍敌人的箭矢，并将其偏转回它们的主人之处
desc.en: A magical of shifting darkness and howling wind snatches the enemy’s missiles from the air, even as they are fired, and hurls them back at their owners.

desc.zh: 拥有此技能的生物会与魔法之风共鸣，嗅出每一个咒语，并试图伤害那些施法的可怜虫
desc.en: Attuned to the Winds of Magic, those with this ability can sniff out every spell, seeking to ravage its unfortunate caster.

desc.zh: 无论是人还是兽，都无法抵挡融入了厄孙之力的冲锋
desc.en: Neither man nor beast could withstand the charge of one imbued with the power of Ursun.

desc.zh: 构装体是以魔法赋予形式与目的的无生命物体。当魔力波动消退时（这是不可避免的），要保持它的活力与完整就很困难了
desc.en: Constructs are inanimate objects given form and purpose through magical means. When that magic wavers and ebbs, as it inevitably will, it's immensely difficult to keep one 'alive' and in one piece.

desc.zh: 现在，将这个构装体结合起来的力量已经失效，魔法之风流失殆尽，只留下了一个空荡静止的外壳
desc.en: Now that the sorcery that holds this Construct together has failed, the Winds of Magic flow out of it, leaving naught but an empty, static husk behind.

desc.zh: 一旦懦弱之气渗入皮肤，再想摆脱这种臭气就是不可能的了
desc.en: It is impossible to shirk the stink of cowardice, once it seeps into the skin for all to see.

desc.zh: 鲜血便等同于生命
desc.en: In this instance, the blood is quite literally the life.

desc.zh: 无论目标距离多远，都逃不过如此敏锐的眼睛，所有敌人都休想高枕无忧
desc.en: No foe is safe, no matter the distance; with such a keen eye, no target is out of reach.

desc.zh: 魔法之风随着战斗的浪潮起伏。元素被束缚得越重，束缚他们的魔法就越有可能消失
desc.en: The Winds of Magic ebb and flow with the tide of battle. The more heavily-beset an Elemental is, the more likely the sorcery that binds them will fade away.

desc.zh: 它的魔法绑定失败了，这个元素生物的物质形式正逐渐从现实中消失
desc.en: Its magic binding failed, the corporeal form of this Elemental gradually fades from this reality.

desc.zh: 心中燃有烈火，烧灼着大地和敌人，所有的一切都沉溺在这炽热的拥抱之中
desc.en: A fire burns within, scorching earth and enemy alike as all succumb to this flaming embrace.

desc.zh: 从敌人的血脉中抽取魔法，如此一来，每一道咒语都有可能渐渐消散而丧失功效
desc.en: Draining magic from a foe's very veins, every spell is as likely to simmer and die as it is to hit its mark.

desc.zh: 神殿守卫为了自己的神圣职责可以奋不顾身，直到敌人被消灭，或是自己光荣阵亡为止
desc.en: Heedless of their own casualties, the Temple Guard execute their sacred duty until the enemy is annihilated or they themselves are slain.

desc.zh: 无数恐怖的墨色眼眸凝视着大地，洞察着每一个细节，追踪着每一个动作
desc.en: A horrifying cluster of ink black eyes stare out across the land, taking in each detail and following every movement.

desc.zh: 鲜血的气味会加剧大多数野生动物的愤怒，使它们恢复野性本能
desc.en: The smell and taste of blood intensifies the rage of most wild creatures, reverting them to their feral instincts.

desc.zh: 鲜血的气味会加剧大多数野生动物的愤怒，使它们恢复野性本能
desc.en: The smell and taste of blood intensifies the rage of most wild creatures, reverting them to their feral instincts.

desc.zh: 一旦脆弱的肉体和筋骨的束缚被削弱，任何生物都有可能化为尘埃和骨灰
desc.en: Once the frail bonds of flesh and sinew have been weakened, any creature is liable to crumble into dust and bone.

desc.zh: 冰雪堡垒稳如磐石，没有什么能够突破这道壁垒
desc.en: Standing firm and resolute, nothing shall break through this bulwark of ice and snow.

desc.zh: 感受荆棘的死亡之拥，每一次动作都会引发一阵令人麻痹的剧痛
desc.en: Gripped in a devastating embrace of thorns, every movement sparks a torrent of paralysing agony.

desc.zh: 奸奇的突变是一种有趣的恩赐，甚至能够将可悲平凡之物转变为强大的自然之力
desc.en: Tzeentch's mutations are a boon to be savoured, transforming even the tragically mundane into a mighty force of nature.

desc.zh: 这样的盾牌并不能完全保护持有者，但足以尽可能地使其接近毫发无损
desc.en: Such a shield does not render its bearer untouchable, but as close as one can get to it in the throes of battle.

desc.zh: 敌人越是施法，就越会油尽灯枯，他们最终会发现自己的奥术能量正在彻底消失殆尽
desc.en: Withered by the efforts of their own spellcasting, enemies find themselves bereft of arcane power.

desc.zh: 震旦的战士们各尽其责，他们在战场上跟随战鼓的节奏行进
desc.en: The warriors of Cathay know their roles well, guided through battle by the rhythmic pounding of their war drums.

desc.zh: 暗影在一步步地游荡着，准备袭击那些胆敢踏入黑暗的愚人
desc.en: A flock of shadows haunts every step, swarming any fool that dares step foot into the dark.

desc.zh: 愤怒的狂潮引发了超自然的力量，受影响的人会获得野兽般嗜血的欲望
desc.en: Waves of violent rage provoke supernatural strength, imbuing the affected with a bestial bloodlust.

desc.zh: 被虚弱所困扰的敌人构不成威胁，因为他们的每一击都被慵懒所束缚
desc.en: An enemy beleaguered by weakness is no real threat, when their every attack is stunted by lethargy.

desc.zh: 最为强大的力量，便是那些几乎无穷无尽，能够获得近乎无限源泉的魔力
desc.en: The greatest of powers are those without limit, drawing from seemingly endless reserves.

desc.zh: 魔法在最需要的时刻穿过肌肤，止住了血流，缝合了最严重的伤口
desc.en: In times of great need, magic weaves through the skin, stemming the flow of blood and sewing the most grievous of wounds.

desc.zh: 只需一瞥，就足以让人心陷入绝望的恐惧，让凡人战栗不已，无法逃脱
desc.en: A single glance is enough to have any heart engulfed in abject terror, leaving mere mortals frozen in fear, unable to escape.

desc.zh: 凶猛的掠食战士们一心一意地履行自己的职责，他们敏锐的感官会驱使他们追猎自己的猎物
desc.en: Ferocious predator-warriors are so single-minded in their duties and their heightened senses drive them to pursue their quarry.

desc.zh: 大小并不重要，意志才是关键！
desc.en: Size is inconsequential – all that matters is the will to fight.

desc.zh: 神殿守卫为了自己的神圣职责可以一心一意，他们显然是为此而生
desc.en: The Temple Guard safeguard their charges whilst displaying a single-minded determination - clearly the role for which they were designed.

desc.zh: 当激活时，太阳引擎会射出振奋人心的射线，大大激发周围爬行类战士们的战斗意愿
desc.en: When activated, the Solar Engine radiates invigorating rays that stir nearby reptilians to energetic new heights of violence.

desc.zh: 死亡不是终结，毕竟这种生物只有在死亡时才能造成爆炸性的毁灭
desc.en: Death is not the end – it is only the beginning of the explosive devastation such a creature can cause.

desc.zh: 巨蜥的强大力量通常会激励周围聚集的灵蜥，而灵蜥充满活力的运动与尖锐的嗓音同样会激发巨蜥的战斗狂怒
desc.en: Skinks tend to swarm around Kroxigor, encouraged by their awesome power. Kroxigor are likewise attracted to masses of Skinks, whose energetic movement and high-pitched sounds fuel their own battle-rage.

desc.zh: 巨蜥的强大力量通常会激励周围聚集的灵蜥，而灵蜥充满活力的运动与尖锐的嗓音同样会激发巨蜥的战斗狂怒
desc.en: Skinks tend to swarm around Kroxigor, encouraged by their awesome power. Kroxigor are likewise attracted to masses of Skinks, whose energetic movement and high-pitched sounds fuel their own battle-rage.

desc.zh: 巨蜥的强大力量通常会激励周围聚集的灵蜥，而灵蜥充满活力的运动与尖锐的嗓音同样会激发巨蜥的战斗狂怒
desc.en: Skinks tend to swarm around Kroxigor, encouraged by their awesome power. Kroxigor are likewise attracted to masses of Skinks, whose energetic movement and high-pitched sounds fuel their own battle-rage.

desc.zh: 巨蜥的强大力量通常会激励周围聚集的灵蜥，而灵蜥充满活力的运动与尖锐的嗓音同样会激发巨蜥的战斗狂怒
desc.en: Skinks tend to swarm around Kroxigor, encouraged by their awesome power. Kroxigor are likewise attracted to masses of Skinks, whose energetic movement and high-pitched sounds fuel their own battle-rage.

desc.zh: 一股巨大的魔法能量向四面八方爆发，尚未被摧毁的敌人将心智大乱
desc.en: A roaring wave of magical energy explodes in all directions, scrambling the minds of all it does not decimate outright.

desc.zh: 愿基斯里夫的敌人难见光明，永远在黑暗中跌倒！
desc.en: Robbed of their sight, may the enemies of Kislev forever stumble in the dark!

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 只有愚蠢的人会与敌人正面交战，在背后刺杀他们更有趣！
desc.en: Only a fool meets their enemy face to face – stabbing them in the back is much more fun, anyway!

desc.zh: 陷入疯狂之时，谁又能辨别敌友呢？
desc.en: Who can discern between friend and foe when in the grip of insanity?

desc.zh: 幽魂凝视无尽的深渊，能看到凡人看不见的界域
desc.en: A wraith can see beyond the realms of mere mortals, peering out into the endless abyss.

desc.zh: 这是由昊龙自己的牙齿精心打造的利刃，也是御赐其刽子之物。此剑舞动之姿，便是玉龙权威的彰显
desc.en: Exquisitely crafted from one of the Celestial Dragon’s own teeth is the weapon of his executioner, wielded by the Jade Dragon with strength and authority.

desc.zh: 这把巨剑由冰川切割而成，似乎是出自巨人之手的杰作。根据首位可汗女王的魔法，它是基斯里夫的典范专属的神器
desc.en: The magic of Kislev’s first Khan Queen allows the paragon of Kislev to wield this great glacier-cut sabre seemingly crafted for the hand of a giant!

desc.zh: 在战场上，对箭矢、炮弹以及各种五花八门弹药的需求无穷无尽
desc.en: Arrows, cannonballs and more esoteric munitions are needed in endless supply on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 在灌输了贝加纳之力后，每枚臼炮炮弹都会如死亡从天而降，每一次爆炸都会释放出一股魔法之潮
desc.en: Infused with Bjuna, each mortar shell drops like death from the sky, unleashing a tide of magic with every detonation.

desc.zh: 这项咒语会召唤一个垂涎三尺的元素生物，它极度地渴望鲜肉与鲜血
desc.en: This incantation allows the conjuring of a slavering, drooling Elemental, hungry for flesh and thirsting for blood.

desc.zh: 没什么能比矮人直升机起飞的场景更为美妙…也没有什么能比它们更加致命
desc.en: There's nothing quite so beautiful as when the Gyrocopters take flight… nor anything quite as deadly.

desc.zh: 来自祖父神魔域的疫病和不稳定的纳垢灵，将在敌人阵中爆炸嬉闹
desc.en: Pestilential and unstable Nurglings flow from Grandfather's realm, blasting and cavorting amongst the foe.

desc.zh: 这枚火箭发射的不是火焰，而是泽雷斯紫色邪阳，其所触及的一切都将迎来末日
desc.en: This single rocket sends not fire or flame, but the Purple Sun of Xereus, spelling doom for all it touches.

desc.zh: 每一发火箭都紧密缠绕着死亡系法术，任何没有死于其毁灭性闪击的东西，也会因灵魂枯竭而死
desc.en: With each rocket entwined with the Lore of Death, anything not killed in its blitz of destruction has their spirit drained to nothing.

desc.zh: 马拉凯的强大空艇可以应召加入战斗，在炮火中提供支援与协助。但如果它遭受过重的伤害，它也将不得不撤离战场
desc.en: Malakai's mighty airship can be summoned to the fray, bringing support and assistance under-fire, but if it takes too much damage it will have to withdraw.

desc.zh: 矿工们从地道里冲出来，与矮人的邪恶对手展开战斗
desc.en: Miners burst forth from their tunnels to do battle with Dawi's foul adversaries.

desc.zh: 纳垢的恩典落在了他的选民的敌人身上。当与纳垢恶魔接触时，会结合成可怕的食肉寄生虫
desc.en: Nurgle's grace has fallen upon His chosen's enemies. When brought into contact with Nurgle's Daemons, it combines to form terrible flesh-devouring parasites.

desc.zh: 纳垢的恩典落在了他的选民的敌人身上。当与纳垢恶魔接触时，会结合成可怕的食肉寄生虫
desc.en: Nurgle's grace has fallen upon His chosen's enemies. When brought into contact with Nurgle's Daemons, it combines to form terrible flesh-devouring parasites.

desc.zh: 法师召唤野性世界的力量，将其赐予自身选择的盟友，从而强化他们的攻击力
desc.en: The Wizard calls upon the strength of the wild world and bestows it upon his chosen allies, increasing the ferocity of their attack.

desc.zh: 呛人的尘埃从法师的指尖喷涌而出，敌人一旦触碰，无不窒息而死
desc.en: A choking dust cloud erupts from the Wizard's fingertips, suffocating the foes in its path and dragging them to their deaths.

desc.zh: 法师在岩石内部点燃火焰，令地面砰然碎裂，狂暴的世界生命之血喷涌而出，吞噬敌人
desc.en: The Wizard sets a fire within the very rock itself, causing the ground to splinter and the raging lifeblood of the world to gush forth and consume the enemy.

desc.zh: 法师将一柄小石锤投过战场，天空的闪电狂怒自其尾流呼啸而出
desc.en: The Wizard hurls a tiny stone hammer across the battlefield, and the heavens vent their electrical fury in its wake.

desc.zh: 原始的生命能量在战场上流动，治愈伤势，令新进倒下的战士重新恢复活力
desc.en: Raw life-energy flows across the battlefield, mending wounds and restoring the fallen to fresh vigour.

desc.zh: 法师踏入命运之锦，变更时间的流动以适应盟友的需求，令其能够更为顽强、更为迅捷地战斗
desc.en: The Wizard reaches into the tapestry of fate, altering the flow of time to suit his allies' needs, who then fight on harder and faster than ever before.

desc.zh: 法师吟诵变化术的三字真言，抛出一个灿烂的熔融圆球，径直击穿敌人的行伍
desc.en: Speaking the three sacred syllables of transformation, the Wizard hurls a brilliant, molten sphere through the enemy's ranks.

desc.zh: 法师制作出一把无弦琴，奏响一首难以释怀的挽歌，驱走所有的希望和紧迫感，使敌人变得脆弱不堪
desc.en: The Wizard produces a stringless fiddle and plays a haunting dirge that drives all sense of hope and urgency away, rendering the foe passive and prone.

desc.zh: 当接到卑鄙恶行的命令时，纳施拉克·蜘蛛爪的那些长有蛛爪的孩子们会纷纷上前听令…
desc.en: Gnashrak Spiderclaw's crawling, scuttling children come forth when called upon to do his vile bidding…

desc.zh: 『别像个亲猪的一样傻站在那！拿下他们！』
desc.en: "Don't just stand there like a pig-kissa! Get 'Em!"

desc.zh: 当纳施拉克·蜘蛛爪的多腿阿拉克纳瑞巨蛛护卫受命支援受到攻击的森林地精萨满时，它们在一瞬之间便从黑暗中电光火石般地冲了出来
desc.en: Almost on cue, Gnashrak Spiderclaw's many-legged Arachnarok guardian scuttles forth from the utter darkness when called upon to protect the Forest Goblin Shaman from attack.

desc.zh: 格拉格姆熟练地旋转着他的武器，挥舞出了一阵鲜血、死亡与毁灭所构成的飓风
desc.en: Garagrim spins his weapon in a practiced arc, creating a whirlwind of blood, death and destruction.

desc.zh: 一些古老的魔法可以呼唤野性，召唤大自然中最为天成的掠食者来帮助法师
desc.en: Some ancient magic can call upon the wild, summoning nature's most natural predators to a Wizard's aid.

desc.zh: 击中目标后，这颗魔法子弹将在敌人阵线中引发剧烈的爆炸
desc.en: A magical missile hones in on its target, triggering a violent explosion along enemy battle lines.

desc.zh: 许多战士会在战斗中尝试危险的壮举，希望为他们的领主甚神祗留下深刻的印象，从而为这种超凡的勇气赐下奖赏…
desc.en: Many warriors attempt dangerous feats in combat in the hope that their liege lords – or even the gods – might be sufficiently impressed that they reward such uncommon valour...

desc.zh: 毁灭之雨从天而降，不会留有任何喘息空间，而这所有的一切都是在安全距离上发起的打击
desc.en: Devastation rains down from above, leaving no room for respite, but all managed from a reasonably safe distance.

desc.zh: 对祖父神纳垢最虔诚的献身者而言，疾病便是一种安慰人心的美味恶念
desc.en: For Grandfather Nurgle's most devoted, sickness is as soothing as it is deliciously vile.

desc.zh: 『抠鼻仔』艾奇满脑子都是鬼点子，而爆炸的史奎格当然是鬼点子之一！
desc.en: Icky da Nosepicka is ever resourceful, and an exploding Squig is *quite* the resource!

desc.zh: 最强大的携疫者将由计患官亲自挑选，他们会被召唤至战场以协助计患官的腐朽事业
desc.en: The greatest of Plaguebearers are chosen by the Tallyman and summoned to the battlefield to assist his putrid cause.

desc.zh: 最强大的携疫者将由计患官亲自挑选，他们会被召唤至战场以协助计患官的腐朽事业
desc.en: The greatest of Plaguebearers are chosen by the Tallyman and summoned to the battlefield to assist his putrid cause.

desc.zh: 一层层腐烂皮肤将在有毒的衰败云雾中爆炸，迫使敌人在痛苦与厌恶中摇摇晃晃地向后退去
desc.en: Layers of rotten skin explode in a toxic cloud of decay, forcing the foe to stagger back in agony and disgust.

desc.zh: 恶臭的腐烂爆炸撕裂敌人的队伍，那些粗心大意之人将会在永恒的腐烂中粉碎湮灭
desc.en: A foetid explosion of putrescence tears through the enemy ranks, pulverising the unwary and dousing them in eternal decay.

desc.zh: 每一台机器都被微调到了完美的程度，因为当火炮开火后，将没有任何容错的余地
desc.en: Every piece of machinery has been fine-tuned to perfection, for when the artillery fires, there can be no margin for error.

desc.zh: 在有幸看到凯兹克发起的污秽冲锋前，敌人必然会不幸地被恶臭所淹没。只有比诸神更加强大的意志，才能抵御近在眼前的毁灭！
desc.en: The befouled charge of Kayzk can be smelled as soon as it is seen. Only a will stronger than the Gods themselves could withstand the coming doom!

desc.zh: 高崔克的『书记官』以他的鲜血发誓，一定要记录下他的屠夫朋友的一举一动，直到他最终加入他可敬的祖先的那一天
desc.en: Gotrek's 'rememberer' has pledged with his blood to record his Slayer friend's deeds until the day he finally joins his venerable Ancestors.

desc.zh: 凯兹克的破碎肉体便是一种腐烂的嘲弄，他的肉身不过是个腐烂堕落的人形肉袋，根本感觉不到疼痛与伤害
desc.en: Kayzk's ravaged flesh is a rotting mockery, little more than a roughly human-shaped bag of putrescence and corruption that feels neither pain nor hurt.

desc.zh: 计算角度和轨道是一项复杂的工作，最好交给专家来做
desc.en: Calculating angles and trajectories is difficult work best left in the hands of an expert.

desc.zh: 卢津·大小伙子曾打败了如今跟随着他的每一头怪物，它们现在很清楚谁才是老大！
desc.en: Luggn Biggagit has fought and beaten every monster that follows him – by now it's abundantly clear who da boss is!

desc.zh: 卢津·大小伙子的出现会让他周围的人陷入盲目的狂怒…甚至包括他自己！
desc.en: Luggn Biggagit's very presence sends all around him into a blind rage... himself included!

desc.zh: 屠夫便是死亡的化身，其实力也会随着战斗中溅出的每一盎司鲜血而茁壮成长
desc.en: A Slayer is the personification of death, thriving in battle with every ounce of blood spilled.

desc.zh: 由于终生都在为最恶劣的病疾分类，计患官身上也留下了这一工作的印记，无论他走到哪里，周围都充斥着腐烂与瘟疫的气息
desc.en: A lifetime spent cataloguing the most vile of diseases has left its mark on the Tallyman, for a miasma of rot and pestilence surrounds him wherever he goes.

desc.zh: 只需出现在附近，黄金法师就能使盟友的盔甲变得如同出自最有天赋的铁匠之手般坚硬
desc.en: By simply being near, the Gold Wizard hardens allied armour as if it had been tempered by the most gifted blacksmiths.

desc.zh: 战哀者的头衔确实是一种庄严的荣誉，仅授予那些有能力背负这一重责之人
desc.en: The title of War-Mourner is a grave honour indeed, bestowed upon one with the strength not to be burdened by their duties.

desc.zh: 既然是敌人，就肯定在身段、尺寸与实力上各有千秋。因此如果你想寻死，就去找那些最强大的敌人过招吧
desc.en: Inevitably, adversaries come in all shapes, sizes and strengths; if you're trying to die, it's desirable to go down fighting a formidable enemy.

desc.zh: 黑暗精灵通过杀戮来立足。当他们积累足够的杀戮时，会感受到自身的杀戮技巧得到了提升，仿佛凯恩亲自指引他们手中的利刃
desc.en: It is through killing that Dark Elves rise above other beings. Once engulfed in enough bloodshed, they will often feel their murderous prowess increase, as if Khaine himself was guiding the blades of his disciples.

desc.zh: 黑暗精灵通过杀戮来立足。当他们积累足够的杀戮时，会感受到自身的杀戮技巧得到了提升，仿佛凯恩亲自指引他们手中的利刃
desc.en: It is through killing that Dark Elves rise above other beings. Once engulfed in enough bloodshed, they will often feel their murderous prowess increase, as if Khaine himself was guiding the blades of his disciples.

desc.zh: 当敌人已支离破碎、伤痕累累之时，干掉他们只需最终一击
desc.en: When an enemy stands broken and bruised, finishing them off is but a matter of one solid strike.

desc.zh: 这位勇士能如同切黄油般劈开敌人，每当有一名敌人倒下，便会有另一人吓得逃之夭夭
desc.en: The warrior cleaves down foes like butter, for every enemy they fell, another flees at the sight of them.

desc.zh: 刽子手等待着死刑犯的到来，准备让他们的痛苦迅速而血腥地结束
desc.en: The executioner awaits the condemned, ready to bring their suffering to a swift and bloody end.

desc.zh: 沙许的裹尸布罩在时间之沙上，一边将赐予生命，而另一边则应对死亡
desc.en: A shroud of Shyish hangs over these sands of time, offering life with one hand while dealing death with the other.

desc.zh: 这个皮袋是由恶臭酿造师库噶斯·瘟父制作的，能将所有已知的诅咒与毒药全部吸收进去
desc.en: Crafted by the Foetid Brewmaster, Ku'gath Plaguefather, this vellum pouch absorbs all known curses and poisons.

desc.zh: 『卖给我这种奇怪绿色粉末的小神经病没说谎…这真是不可思议！』
desc.en: "That jittery little man who sold me this strange green powder wasnt lying... it really is incredible!"

desc.zh: 这柄骑枪的刃尖由陨铁制成，其上雕刻着天空符文，它能像闪电一样在击中目标时造成爆燃效果
desc.en: With a bladed tip crafted from meteoric iron and graven with the runes of the heavens, this lance strikes its target like a bolt of lightning, both burning and blasting them.

desc.zh: …以此来衡量所有其他战士，进一步奖励他们的坚韧
desc.en: ...by which all other warriors shall be measured, further warded for invulnerability.

desc.zh: 早在成为烈焰学院的首席大导师前，弗雷德里克·冯·塔纳斯就是一位经验丰富的战士。即使在那时，他的魔法才能也是有目共睹
desc.en: Friedrich von Tarnus was a seasoned warrior long before he became Magister Patriarch of the Bright Order. Even then, his magical talent was clear for all to see.

desc.zh: 这是一份来自魔导师埃斯佩斯·冯·邓肯的礼物，这件护符充满了无拘束的力量，任何对抗其持有者的人都将迎来毁灭
desc.en: A gift from Magisterix Elspeth von Draken, this charm bristles with unbridled power, promising doom to all who rise against its wielder.

desc.zh: 安拉海尔用牛头怪的硬皮制作了这件斗篷；它能让每一头看到这件斗篷的野兽打内心深处感到恐惧
desc.en: Anraheir made this cloak from the toughened hide of a Minotaur; it strikes fear into the heart of every beast that beholds it.

desc.zh: 当敌人觉得他们处在安全的射程之外时，聪明的葛朗尼会证明他们的自信大错特错
desc.en: When enemies think they are safe at range, wise Grungni ensures their confidence is misplaced.

desc.zh: 一连串的小型爆炸物会在瞬间连续引爆，足以形成毁灭性的烈焰
desc.en: A cluster of small explosions trigger in quick sequence, combining into a fiery blaze of destruction.

desc.zh: 谁能打中游走在生与死两界之间的人呢？
desc.en: It is hard to hit one that walks between worlds, straddling the line between life and death.

desc.zh: 这种实验看起来相当疯狂，但它的成果却能释放出极具破坏性的火力
desc.en: The experiments might look like madness, but the results unleash devastating firepower.

desc.zh: 这种实验看起来相当疯狂，但它的成果却能释放出极具破坏性的火力
desc.en: The experiments might look like madness, but the results unleash devastating firepower.

desc.zh: 向生而死，向死而生，这是完美的对称
desc.en: In life there is death, but in death there is life; a perfect symmetry.

desc.zh: 他的孩子们给所有凡人带来了纳垢的死亡礼物
desc.en: His children bring Nurgle's gift of death to all mortals.

desc.zh: 死亡不一定是终结，因为在腐烂与瘟疫中总会带来新的生命
desc.en: Death does not have to be the end, for there is new life in decay and rot and pestilence.

desc.zh: 慈祥的祖父神纳垢为孩子们带来了一个充满污秽和疾病的世界，令他们更为渴望执行那些肮脏的工作
desc.en: Kindly Grandfather Nurgle bestows a cornucopia of filth and disease upon His children, ever eager to do His foul work.

desc.zh: 当恶魔屠夫奋战之时，他周围的人都会感受到他在战场上追求名誉、传奇与死亡的荣耀
desc.en: When a Daemon Slayer is at work, those around him get a taste of the glory as he courts renown, legend and, well, death on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 这是传说中的古老力量：一旦复仇王冠化为碎片，无人能够幸存…
desc.en: An ancient power of legend; none shall survive once the Nemesis Crown is shattered…

desc.zh: 纳垢爱着他的所有孩子，但总有些注定深得他的恩宠，他们会被赐予更加怪诞的礼物，以更好地为他的意志助力
desc.en: Nurgle loves all his children, but those however fated to be his favourites are afforded even more grotesque gifts with which to better carry out His will.

desc.zh: 没有足够福气的人，在此事上并无什么选择的余地
desc.en: Some people are not sufficiently blessed to be given a choice in the matter.

desc.zh: 汇聚着所有戴过它的人所累积的恶意，这顶王冠的力量可谓没有上限…
desc.en: Channelling the cumulative malevolence of all who've worn it before, the power of the Crown truly knows no bounds…

desc.zh: 汇聚着所有戴过它的人所累积的恶意，这顶王冠的力量可谓没有上限…
desc.en: Channelling the cumulative malevolence of all who've worn it before, the power of the Crown truly knows no bounds…

desc.zh: 汇聚着所有戴过它的人所累积的恶意，这顶王冠的力量可谓没有上限…
desc.en: Channelling the cumulative malevolence of all who've worn it before, the power of the Crown truly knows no bounds…

desc.zh: 每个凡人的身体都是一个蛆虫领主可以夺舍的容器，然后它会再试图腐蚀另一人的脆弱身体
desc.en: Each mortal body is but a vessel from which the Maggot Lord might slight, seeking to corrupt the fragile body of another.

desc.zh: 当它在你的周围旋转时，这种灵体光环甚至会抑制最强大的魔法物品
desc.en: As it swirls about you, this ethereal aura dampens even the most potent of magical artefacts.

desc.zh: 裸露的肉体、外渗的内脏、刺鼻的臭味…这些都是永爱的慈父赐予的美好礼物
desc.en: Exposed flesh, oozing innards, sulfur smells... all wonderful gifts courtesy of the ever-loving Urfather!

desc.zh: 通过在纳施拉克·蜘蛛爪还活着时与他分享这份容器，『老逼登』诺博尔得以利用他战将的天生恶意来增强自身的力量
desc.en: By partaking of this vessel while Gnashrak Spiderclaw lives, Knobber da Bossy Git can draw upon his Warboss' innate malice to empower himself as well.

desc.zh: 通过在『抠鼻仔』艾奇还活着时与他分享这份容器，『老逼登』诺博尔得以利用他战将的天生恶意来增强自身的力量
desc.en: By partaking of this vessel while Icky da Nosepicka lives, Knobber da Bossy Git can draw upon his Warboss' innate malice to empower himself as well.

desc.zh: 通过在卢津·大小伙子还活着时与他分享这份容器，『老逼登』诺博尔得以利用他战将的天生恶意来增强自身的力量
desc.en: By partaking of this vessel while Luggn Biggagit lives, Knobber da Bossy Git can draw upon his Warboss' innate malice to empower himself as well.

desc.zh: 此部队身边围绕的魔法光环可以保护友军免受伤害
desc.en: The magical aura surrounding this unit protects allies from harm.

desc.zh: 由地精大萨满的魔法而强化，这个搞毛巨像对任何人来说都是真正的威胁！
desc.en: Empowered by the magicks of the Goblin Great Shamans – this Rogue Idol is a true meance to all!

desc.zh: 死者的灵魂攻击着巫师的敌人，蚕食着他们的斗志，在军中散播着恐慌
desc.en: Spirits of the departed assail the Wizard’s foes, sapping their resolve and causing dread among their numbers.

desc.zh: 一具咯咯笑的火焰头颅。伴着一声欢快的尖叫，它突然跃入敌军，所到之处，片甲无存
desc.en: A cackling, flaming visage appears before the Wizard. With a gleeful screech, it swirls around the battlefield, immolating anything in its way.

desc.zh: 就像水蛭吸血一样，巫师向敌人伸出黑檀木之手，通过肮脏的死亡系法术吸走他们的灵魂
desc.en: Just as a leech draws blood, the Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, sucking away their spirit through the tainted Lore of Death.

desc.zh: 就像水蛭吸血一样，巫师向敌人伸出黑檀木之手，通过肮脏的死亡系法术吸走他们的灵魂
desc.en: Just as a leech draws blood, the Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, sucking away their spirit through the tainted Lore of Death.

desc.zh: 追随着不苟言笑的战士贝加纳的命运，施法者的怒火却是让自己的敌人活活笑死
desc.en: Following the fate of the unsmiling warrior, Bjuna, the targets of the caster’s ire will laugh themselves to death.

desc.zh: 猩红龙吸收了沙许的能量，然后将其伴随着死亡与火焰的洪流一举呼出
desc.en: The Carmine Dragon soaks up the energies of Shyish before breathing it back out again in a torrent of death and flame.

desc.zh: 『把所有的动力都投入引擎——时间紧迫！』
desc.en: "All power to the engines – time is of the essence!"

desc.zh: 这些炸弹装有一种特殊的混合物，会在撞击时浸透地面，随后燃起一条长长的火舌
desc.en: These bombs bear the traces of a special concoction that soaks the ground upon impact, igniting a burning swathe of flames in its wake.

name.zh: 矮人直升机炸弹（巨魔之锤）

desc.zh: 直升机中队在敌人正上方加速掠过，每个飞行员都会向下方的目标投掷一枚机翼上的炸弹
desc.en: As the Gyrocopter squadron speeds over the heads of the enemy, each pilot releases a single wing-mounted bomb onto targets below.

desc.zh: 虽然它的名字是地雷，但它更像是个发条蒸汽炸弹。这东西由陆行船部署，会吞噬整个炽热爆炸半径内的敌人
desc.en: Despite its name, more of a clockwork steam bomb than an actual land mine, deployed by the Land Ship to engulf enemies in a fiery blast radius.

desc.zh: 飞艇中猛烈地炸出无情的钢矛，残忍地刺穿它所经过的任何人，任何物
desc.en: A vicious spear of steel explodes from the Airship with force, brutally impaling anyone and anything in its path.

desc.zh: 这些炸弹装有一种特殊的混合物，会在撞击时浸透地面，随后燃起一条长长的火舌
desc.en: These bombs bear the traces of a special concoction that soaks the ground upon impact, igniting a burning swathe of flames in its wake.

desc.zh: 随着滚烫蒸汽的突然奔涌，雷霆空艇急速前行，在战场上掀起了一股风暴
desc.en: With a sudden rush of piping hot steam, the Thunderbarge soars forward at speed, taking the battlefield by storm.

desc.zh: 随着滚烫蒸汽的突然奔涌，雷霆空艇急速前行，在战场上掀起了一股风暴
desc.en: With a sudden rush of piping hot steam, the Thunderbarge soars forward at speed, taking the battlefield by storm.

desc.zh: 当另一种选择是肺部缓缓充满血液，最终窒息而死时，被压碎或被直接吃掉不得不说是一种祝福
desc.en: Being crushed or eaten may be a blessing when the alternative is choking on blood and puss as it slowly fills the lungs!

desc.zh: 双斧战斧无情地切割敌人，屠杀的螺旋横冲直撞，所余只剩可怕的狼藉
desc.en: Dual axe-edges carve through foes, lashing out in a spiral of slaughter, and leaving nought but a bloody mess in their wake.

desc.zh: 双斧战斧无情地切割敌人，屠杀的螺旋横冲直撞，所余只剩可怕的狼藉
desc.en: Dual axe-edges carve through foes, lashing out in a spiral of slaughter, and leaving nought but a bloody mess in their wake.

desc.zh: 双斧战斧无情地切割敌人，屠杀的螺旋横冲直撞，所余只剩可怕的狼藉
desc.en: Dual axe-edges carve through foes, lashing out in a spiral of slaughter, and leaving nought but a bloody mess in their wake.

desc.zh: 双斧战斧无情地切割敌人，屠杀的螺旋横冲直撞，所余只剩可怕的狼藉
desc.en: Dual axe-edges carve through foes, lashing out in a spiral of slaughter, and leaving nought but a bloody mess in their wake.

desc.zh: 最顽固、最坚强的矮人战士们携手并肩，这几乎就是一堵无法撼动的肉墙
desc.en: The hardest, most stalwart Dawi warriors, standing together – a virtually immovable wall of flesh.

desc.zh: 最顽固、最坚强的矮人战士们携手并肩，这几乎就是一堵无法撼动的肉墙
desc.en: The hardest, most stalwart Dawi warriors, standing together – a virtually immovable wall of flesh.

desc.zh: 陆行船的发动机无疑是技术上的奇迹，但众所周知，它们高度易燃…
desc.en: While the Land Ship's engines are undoubtedly marvels of technology, they're also known to be highly combustible…

desc.zh: 从陆行船上倾泻出致命的灰烬与魔法，任何被这团云雾吞噬的人都会陷入窒息
desc.en: From the Land Ship pours a deathly cloud of ash and magic, choking all consumed by its fog.

desc.zh: 当红雾笼罩他时，喀尔甘那野蛮的嗜血欲甚至会令一些想要逃跑的战士对他们的战友痛下杀手
desc.en: When the red mist is all around him, Khargan's savage bloodlust even causes some warriors to fight their friends to the death to get away.

desc.zh: 同胞们近乎自杀的英勇唤起了身陷重围的决心，使其充满了胜利的希望与杀戮的欲望
desc.en: The near-suicidal valour of one's compatriots stirs the embattled heart onwards, with full hope of victory and the desire to kill.

desc.zh: 距离并不意味着安全。无论敌人跑多远，神射手的子弹都能找到他们
desc.en: Distance provides no safety; no matter how far the enemy runs, a sharpshooter's bullet will always find them.

desc.zh: 想要你的手，就别让它们溅到手上！
desc.en: Don't get any on your hands if you wish to keep them!

desc.zh: 甲板上的紫晶法师不断地在船体周围施加毁灭光环，这甚至能削弱敌人最强大领袖的权威
desc.en: The Amethyst Wizards on deck channel a constant aura of doom around the ship, undermining the authority of even the greatest of enemy leaders.

desc.zh: 极为烈性的朗姆酒，只有体质卓越的矮人才应付得来！
desc.en: Imagine a rum so harsh and strong that only superior Dawi constitutions can bear it!

desc.zh: 紧急维修是任何战场工程师的必备训练
desc.en: Emergency repairs are a mandatory part of training for any battlefield engineer.

desc.zh: 必须喂养森林！
desc.en: The forest must feed!

desc.zh: 鲜血的气味会加剧大多数野生动物的愤怒，使它们恢复野性本能
desc.en: The smell and taste of blood intensifies the rage of most wild creatures, reverting them to their feral instincts.

desc.zh: 巫师用魔法强化盟友的武器，让它们燃起凶猛的烈焰。燃火刀刃会让武器威力大增
desc.en: The Wizard ensorcels allied weapons, making them burn with a savage fire. The targets of the spell are augmented with superior flaming blades.

desc.zh: 当他们的心脏齐声跳动时，无人能怀疑这些鲜血羁绊的战士们将并肩而战，同生共死
desc.en: As their hearts beat in unison, soldiers bound by blood are resolved to fight and die as one.

desc.zh: 这点小仗怎么够！群山王国万岁！
desc.en: And no lesser battle should suffice! Khazukan Kazakit-ha!

desc.zh: 双火为炎，两团火焰聚在一起时威力远胜于它们分开的状态，而燃焰便是这样的一股『炎』
desc.en: Fire feeds fire, two blazes together are stronger and hotter than two apart. The Kindleflame intensifies such fire.

desc.zh: 如果你喜欢祈祷，现在也许就是祈祷的时候，因为一场真正的魔法风暴已经指向了你…
desc.en: If prayers are your thing, now is probably the time to say them, for a veritable storm of magic has been called forth against you.

desc.zh: 这是蛆虫领主赐下的众多赠礼之一，是持续稳定的蛋白质来源…
desc.en: One of the many gifts of the Maggot Lord is a sustainable and reliable source of protein…

desc.zh: 原本沉闷的欢乐嬉闹变得愈发明显起来，它们正从其臃肿的主人身上挣脱而出，以寻找新的玩物
desc.en: What was muffled, joyful frolicking becomes clearer as the bulges burst from their bloated host to find a new plaything.

desc.zh: 这头怪物已被自己的愤怒蒙蔽了双眼，不再在意痛苦，而是一心只想把敌人碾成肉泥
desc.en: Blinded by its own rage, this monstrous beast no longer registers pain and is focusing purely on crushing its foes to mush.

desc.zh: 即使是再坚固的火炮，也不及守卫它们的人的一半坚强
desc.en: Even the sturdy structures of artillery weapons are not half so hardy as the men who defend them.

desc.zh: 船底排列着一排长矛专用的小舷窗，随时准备着对攻击船头的步兵发起致命的戳刺
desc.en: A series of small portholes with manned spears line the base of the ship, ready to thrust with deadly intent as infantry strike the bow.

desc.zh: 能令平时热情洋溢的纳垢落泪，定是为了他在这个现实与其他所有现实中的孩子们
desc.en: When the normally-ebullient Nurgle cries, it is for His many children across this reality and all others.

name.en: The Blessings of the Fly Lord

desc.zh: 赞美纳垢！令人作呕的脓花是瘟疫领主尊敬的象征。这是祖父般的慈爱礼物，令他的孩子们可以将腐蚀传播开去
desc.en: Nurgle be praised! A revolting pus flower is a token of the Plague Lord's esteem; a gift of grandfatherly love, you might say, that his children might spread decay.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 在提供近距空中支援后，葛朗尼之魂会脱离战场重新补给，然后等待下一次的召唤
desc.en: After providing close air support, the Spirit of Grungni leaves the battlefield to resupply, ready for when it is requested once again.

desc.zh: 在提供近距空中支援后，葛朗尼之魂会脱离战场重新补给，然后等待下一次的召唤
desc.en: After providing close air support, the Spirit of Grungni leaves the battlefield to resupply, ready for when it is requested once again.

desc.zh: 在提供近距空中支援后，葛朗尼之魂会脱离战场重新补给，然后等待下一次的召唤
desc.en: After providing close air support, the Spirit of Grungni leaves the battlefield to resupply, ready for when it is requested once again.

desc.zh: 『弱者的小打小闹伤不了你分毫！沉浸在强大的葛林姆尼尔的神圣保护中吧！』
desc.en: "Shrug off the petty blows of weaklings! Relish in mighty Grimnir's holy protection!"

desc.zh: 当『老逼登』诺博尔还活着时，他的追随者会被其恶念影响，并由此获得了力量
desc.en: While Knobber da Bossy Git lives, his followers are saturated by his malice and empowered themselves.

desc.zh: 这双斧头被锁在了格拉格姆的手腕上，这样他便永远不会失去它们。这双斧头上刻有强大的符文，足以增强持有者的力量
desc.en: Chained to Garagrim's wrists so he will never lose them, these twin axes are inscribed with powerful runes, augmenting their wielder's natural strength.

desc.zh: 只需要轻微的碰撞，这种高挥发性的化合粉末就会点燃。如果你能让它在战场上才爆炸，那就非常合适了！
desc.en: This compound of highly volatile powder ignites with the slightest jostle – perfectly suitable for the battlefield if you can get it there unexploded!

desc.zh: 这柄强大的努恩剑是一个沉重的负担，上面沾满了这座伟大城市的敌人与叛徒的鲜血
desc.en: This mighty sword of Nuln is a heavy weight to bear, stained with the blood of the great city's foes and traitors.

desc.zh: 只要有足够的修补，一台损坏的战争机器能在短时间内便可恢复正常运作
desc.en: With enough practiced tinkering, a damaged War Machine can be returned to working order in no time.

desc.zh: 那些可悲的生物被劈成了两半，永远也无法体验纳垢意志随后掀起的衰败浪潮所带来的痛苦——这对大多数人而言，可算得上是一种仁慈！
desc.en: Those pathetic creatures cleaved in two will never know the suffering brought by the debilitating wave of Nurgle's will that follows – which may be a mercy to most!

desc.zh: 这是由混沌矮人送给他的礼物，挥舞这把武器将散发出有毒的灰色烟雾——这让蛆虫领主相当满意！
desc.en: Gifted to him by the Chaos Dwarfs, the greyish fumes that emanate when this weapon is swung are foully poisonous – which pleases the Maggot Lord greatly!

desc.zh: 这把古老的传奇宝剑据说是第一把锻造而出的剑，它似乎有一种超脱其它所有武器的，不可思议的力量…
desc.en: This ancient, storied sword is rumoured to be the first one ever forged. It certainly seems to have an uncanny power over other weapons...

desc.zh: 这柄镰刀更多是由阴影而非物质制成，据说是由冯·邓肯本人亲手制造，能与沙许的力量相协调
desc.en: A scythe made more of shadow than substance, this weapon, said to be of von Draken's own making, is attuned to the power of Shyish.

desc.zh: 没有人拒绝猎颅者的挑战，但这不是因为他们不愿，而是因为他们不能。强大的冠军勇士无法逃脱，当然，普通的杂兵也无法逃脱
desc.en: No one refuses Skulltaker's challenge, not because they will not but because they cannot. Mighty champions cannot escape it, and certainly neither can any rank-and-file fodder.

desc.zh: 没有人拒绝猎颅者的挑战，但这不是因为他们不愿，而是因为他们不能。强大的冠军勇士无法逃脱，当然，普通的杂兵也无法逃脱
desc.en: No one refuses Skulltaker's challenge, not because they will not but because they cannot. Mighty champions cannot escape it, and certainly neither can any rank-and-file fodder.

desc.zh: 大胃神的故事少不了沸腾的坩埚作为背景：它是所有食人魔信奉的对象，作为回报，他也会为其赐下每天的晚餐
desc.en: A furiously boiling cauldron is an apt backdrop for tales of the Maw, whom all Ogres serve, and are served in return with the day's supper.

desc.zh: [[i]]『把双足飞龙当成你的朋友一样留在身边，因为谁都不知道啥时候得把他们派出去！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Keep ya friends close, an' yer Wyverns closa – ya neva know when ya need to set dem loose."[[/i]]

desc.zh: 萨满向老天各种哀求、疯狂作揖。然后兽人之神的超强绿色大脚就会从天而降，把敌人踩个稀巴烂！
desc.en: The Shaman implores the sky with wild gesticulations. The almighty green foot of the Orc god descends to crush the foe!

desc.zh: [[i]]『俯冲小子不知道该往哪儿飞？那就让狼骑兵给他们指引目标吧』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Da Divers don’t always know where dey’s flyin, so let da Wolf Riders show dem da way."[[/i]]

desc.zh: 无论壮实，还是愚蠢，无论野蛮，还是鬼祟，无论愚蠢，还是，呃，别具一格的愚蠢，总之，哥巴德的Waaagh！大军来者不拒！
desc.en: The stout and the runty, the savage and the sneaky, the stupid and the, er, other kind of stupid: all are welcome to Gorbad's Waaagh Horde.

desc.zh: 『给俺狠狠打！但要用脑子！但还是得狠狠打！都明白了？那么，去Waaagh！吧！』
desc.en: "Fight hardah! But smartah! But hardah! All cleah? Now, to WAAAGH!"

desc.zh: 恐虐的怒火给点燃了！所有人都将感受血神的愤怒！
desc.en: Khorne's ire has been roused! The Blood God's wrath shall be felt by all!

desc.zh: 猎颅者专心致志的疯狂杀戮必然会驱使他杀向每一支军队的核心：它的领袖
desc.en: Skulltaker's single-minded murder-spree drives him towards the heart of every army: its leader.

desc.zh: 『对的，杀出最强花样的人会获得奖励的…』
desc.en: "Right, there's a bonus in it for tha one that does the most creative killin'…"

desc.zh: 『我告诉你，没什么会比炮弹更狠！』\n——某位原属某个损失在北方边境的联队的帝国炮组成员
desc.en: "Nothing hits harder than a cannonball, I tell you!"\n –– Imperial artillery crewman, part of a military company lost on the northern borders

desc.zh: 虽然哥巴德的小子们很想知道老大的那个什么『核计』是种什么武器，以及他什么时候会使用它，但只要知道他手里有这个玩意，他们就会亢奋起来！
desc.en: Although Gorbad's soldiers occasionally wonder what kind of weapon this "Plan" of his is and when he's going to use it, knowing he has it bolsters their spirits nonetheless.

desc.zh: 简单地拿着手枪站定等待时机，高尔法格就是这样从无数的食人魔手里抢走了他们的杀戮果实
desc.en: By simply standing still and waiting, pistol in hand, Golgfag has stolen countless kills from other Ogres with their bellies mid-stampede.

desc.zh: 铃声响起，大军就该集合吃饭了。酒醉饭饱之后，屠杀就将带着一地鸡零狗碎继续开始！
desc.en: When the bell sounds, it's snack time for the assembled host. Then, the carnage can begin again, on a full stomach, with all of the associated drawbacks!

desc.zh: 史奎格与地精对它们的喜爱，显然是对那些自诩更为理性的种族的一个警告
desc.en: The fact that Squigs and gobbos love them should serve as a warning to the more inherently sensible races.

desc.zh: 砍头还需要主人的意见？每砍下一颗头都会获得丰厚的奖励，这可是食人魔雇佣军的一项重要激励机制
desc.en: Promising a bonus for each and every skull detached, whether or not its owner objects, has proved to be something of a motivator among Ogre mercenaries.

desc.zh: 斯卡尔的步步紧逼所带来的是个可怕的事实，那就是末日已至，无处可逃，而这一切都将无可避免
desc.en: Skarr's approach grants a horrible realisation. Doom is upon you. There is no escape. Only the inevitable end.

desc.zh: 斯纳格拉有着惊人丰富的想象力与记忆力：比如给蜘蛛幼崽取名时，这个能力堪称天才
desc.en: Snagla's imaginative profusion and prodigious memory when it comes to Spider Hatchling names is the closest he comes to having magical talent.

desc.zh: 斯纳格拉有着惊人丰富的想象力与记忆力：比如给蜘蛛幼崽取名时，这个能力堪称天才
desc.en: Snagla's imaginative profusion and prodigious memory when it comes to Spider Hatchling names is the closest he comes to having magical talent.

desc.zh: 『你这小脑畸形的怪物，是为了恐虐吗？那么，好吧，你必须杀戮！』\n——某位不知姓名的阿拉比全权总督在被开膛破肚后的最终遗言
desc.en: "For Khorne, my dear microcephalic abomination? Oh, well then, verily, you must kill!"\n – The last words of a nameless, intestineless Arabyan Plenipotentiary

desc.zh: 这首神奇圣歌的歌词每次都不一样，不过歌词又有什么意义？重要的是信念，以及狂躁的白眼！
desc.en: The words of this magical chant are different each time, though identically meaningless. It's the conviction that matters, as well as the manic eye-rolling.

desc.zh: 『…如果有人说别哒，那就揍他丫一顿证明一下！』
desc.en: "...and if sumbody sez else, smash 'em to prove dat!"

desc.zh: 虽然他确实是个笨拙的野蛮人，但巨汉操控手中利刃的技艺竟会如画家手中的笔触一样精细
desc.en: For all that he is as ungainly a brute as they come, the Bruiser manoeuvres his wrist blades with the precision of a painter's brush.

desc.zh: 真蜘蛛的捕捉技巧缓慢而耐心，而斯纳格拉则恰恰相反，它在任何非真蜘蛛所具备的技能上都大放异彩
desc.en: Nothing of a true Spider's slow and patient trapping technique, and all of Snagla's flair for... well, everything that the aforementioned is not!

desc.zh: 史奎格敏锐的战术感知力让它经常能向着周围叫得最响的肚子猛扑过去，而夜地精经常利用这种危险而原始的感知
desc.en: A Squig's tactical acumen extends to hearing and following the loudest belly growl around, a nod towards a dangerous and rudimentary sentience often exploited by Night Goblins.

desc.zh: 如果受害者能立刻死去，这姑且能算是某种仁慈的斩杀。否则，受害者就得在无情的生命流逝中无奈地忍受斯纳格拉震耳欲聋的嚎叫
desc.en: A mercifully swift attack, should the victim happen to die at once; otherwise, it's unmercifully debilitating, exposing one to Snagla's wails at ear-shattering range to boot.

desc.zh: 想在巨汉面前逃离战斗，只会让自己给揍个头破血流
desc.en: If anyone even thinks of fleeing a battle in the Bruiser's presence, they find themselves flung head over heels in the thick of it.

desc.zh: 『如果我不动，他们也不会动。就是这么简单』
desc.en: "If I don' move, they don' move. Simple as that."

desc.zh: 鲜血会为斯卡尔带来生命，就如水会为鲨鱼注入生命一样。鲜血越多，他的生命力就越顽强，毕竟这就是恐虐的意愿
desc.en: Blood brings life to Skarr just as water breathes life into a shark. Churn more blood, and so he lives, by the will of Khorne.

desc.zh: 把斯卡尔推到战败的边缘只会让一部分敌人感到高兴——那些实在找不到更好办法的人
desc.en: Pushing Skarr to the brink of defeat fills some of his enemies with glee – those who do not know any better.

desc.zh: [[i]]『看到地精们万众欢腾的场面，还有哪个老大不会血脉贲张呢？』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Nuffin' like some gobbos cheerin' all togetha to get da Boss up for a fight!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: 一群值得尊敬的敌人最终证明了自己并不那么值得尊敬，并沦为了灰色的饰品：对此，他们也发表不出什么反对意见了
desc.en: A cavalcade of worthy foes reduced to grizzly adornments as they proved themselves, in the end, not worthy enough: an assessment with which they clatter in agreement.

desc.zh: 一群值得尊敬的敌人最终证明了自己并不那么值得尊敬，并沦为了灰色的饰品：对此，他们也发表不出什么反对意见了
desc.en: A cavalcade of worthy foes reduced to grizzly adornments as they proved themselves, in the end, not worthy enough: an assessment with which they clatter in agreement.

desc.zh: 一群值得尊敬的敌人最终证明了自己并不那么值得尊敬，并沦为了灰色的饰品：对此，他们也发表不出什么反对意见了
desc.en: A cavalcade of worthy foes reduced to grizzly adornments as they proved themselves, in the end, not worthy enough: an assessment with which they clatter in agreement.

desc.zh: 在以一场强大的Waaagh！大闹整个帝国心脏地带之后，哥巴德·铁爪证明了自己可以将任何绿皮乌合之众打造成一支强大无比的战斗力量
desc.en: Having led a mighty Waaagh! into the beating heart of Imperial territory, Gorbad Ironclaw can whip any Greenskins rabble into an effective fighting force.

desc.zh: [[i]]『只要咱在战场上呆着，就没什么能从咱身上跨过去，咱都核计好了！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"While I'm on da field, ain't nuffin' gettin' past me. I've always gotta plan!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: 布拉格向来都是独来独往，他随时如同人类的刽子手一样戴着黑色的皮兜帽，这就是他最冷酷的形象
desc.en: Where Bragg walks, he walks alone, donning his dark leather hood in the manner of a human hangman to capitalise on his grim persona.

desc.zh: 一旦给打上了死亡标记，此人就必须时刻提防布拉格那笨拙的影子。然而，开膛巨刃何时会抹上他们的脖子，这点又该如何提防呢？
desc.en: Once marked for death, one must prepare for Bragg's lumbering shadow looming into view. What no one can prepare for is the Gutgouger's lunge towards their neck...

desc.zh: 一旦给打上了死亡标记，此人就必须时刻提防布拉格那笨拙的影子。然而，开膛巨刃何时会抹上他们的脖子，这点又该如何提防呢？
desc.en: Once marked for death, one must prepare for Bragg's lumbering shadow looming into view. What no one can prepare for is the Gutgouger's lunge towards their neck...

desc.zh: [[i]]『嘿，把你的烟雾弹交给真正能干架的小子！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Oi, 'and ova yer smoke bombs to da real fighty boyz!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: 在食人魔雇佣兵眼中，金钱就是最重要的东西。满满当当的军饷提醒着他们，他们是在为了什么而拼命
desc.en: Setting their constant, slavering hunger aside, there's nothing that matters to Ogre mercenaries more than gold. The sight of a brimming war-chest reminds them what they're fighting for when it matters most.

desc.zh: [[i]]『让野猪小子去冲线？没谁比兽人老大更擅长这个了！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"When usin' Boar Boyz for line-smashin', da Orc Boss knows da best wayz."[[/i]]

desc.zh: [[i]]『有了萨满的帮助，夜地精射手的狙击能力就不会那么拉跨了』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"With da help of da Shaman, da night gobbo archers ain't too shabby at snipin'."[[/i]]

desc.zh: 在战争中谋杀你自己的兄弟，并获得恐虐的青睐，这就证明你通过了考验。然而，从今以后记得尽量少杀自己人，还是要以敌人优先
desc.en: Murder your own brothers in war and receive Khorne’s favour: tried and tested. From then on, however, murder them only a little: the foe takes precedence.

desc.zh: 这东西虽然杂乱无章，但却意外地戳中绿皮的审美，而众所周知的是，没有什么会比满足绿皮的审美更能激发他们的斗志了
desc.en: Haphazard, though weirdly pleasing to the eye, everyone knows nothing hardens the Greenskins' resolve better than pleasing their aesthetic sensibilities.

desc.zh: 如果你知道如何控制一群受惊、饥饿的野兽，那么把剑齿兽带上战场会是一个很好的决策！
desc.en: Summoning Sabretusks to the battlefield could well be an advantage, assuming you know how to control a herd of stampeding, starving beasts, of course!

desc.zh: 食人魔倒是与矮人有了些共识：还能有什么比满满一大杯最棒的伯格曼佳酿更能让人神清气爽，甚至活力四射呢？
desc.en: The Ogres know, just as the Dwarfs do, there's literally nothing so refreshing – or indeed regenerative – as a gigantic tankard brimming with Bugman's finest brew.

desc.zh: 在席拉的最终变异后，他脖颈上的虬结肌肉会戴上一条黄铜项圈，以保护血神钟爱的子嗣免受怯懦的巫术的伤害
desc.en: A brazen collar emerged from the corded muscle of Scyla’s neck during his final transformation to protect the Blood God’s favoured spawn from cowardly wizardry.

desc.zh: 自沙尘化为骸骨，由骸骨重临战场；魔沙封疆的尼赫喀拉荒漠，仍令敌人记起它最悍勇的亡者军团
desc.en: From dust to bone, from bone to battle; in sands enchanted and encased, the Nehekharan desert reminds its enemies of its fiercest warriors.

desc.zh: 『血，我可以捐。你的敌人，你不能』
desc.en: "Blood, I can spare. Your foes, you cannot."

desc.zh: 大胃神的故事少不了沸腾的坩埚作为背景：它是所有食人魔信奉的对象，作为回报，他也会为其赐下每天的晚餐
desc.en: A furiously boiling cauldron is an apt backdrop for tales of the Maw, whom all Ogres serve, and are served in return with the day's supper.

desc.zh: 如果阿巴尔的意志被彻底粉碎，他将永远化为混沌之卵。而在一段短暂而痛苦的时间里，类似的命运也会降临到周围所有人身上
desc.en: Should Arbaal's resolve shatter, an eternity as a Chaos Spawn awaits him. A similar fate also awaits anyone in his vicinity, for a short and painful while.

desc.zh: 战斗可以神奇地唤起食人魔体内的大胃神饥饿，无论食人魔此前吃得有多饱。这种饥饿几乎让理智毫无用武之地！
desc.en: A battle has an uncanny way of summoning the Maw hunger within an Ogre's belly, no matter how full. Such hunger leaves scarce room for reason!

desc.zh: 恐虐时刻注视着所有的战争，但只有阿巴尔的丰功能吸引他的注意。它的目光所至之处，便是地狱降临之所
desc.en: Khorne's gaze falls on all war, at all times, but only Arbaal's feats are capable of riveting His attention. Where it falls, infernos rise.

desc.zh: 猎食者会在暗夜中保持饥饿：毕竟当他们拼杀而出时，敌人只能靠神明的庇佑了！
desc.en: Gorgers are kept hungry and in the dark for good reason: gods help the Ogres' opponents when they are unleashed!

desc.zh: 只要尝一口黄铜之笼里那些为有志者们准备的东西，就能摧毁任何人的思想与身体
desc.en: Just a small taste of what awaits the aspirants in the Brazen Cage can undo the minds and bodies of anyone else.

desc.zh: 永远不要忘记我指引你走的路！如果有什么东西挡着你，就给它放血，让它燃烧，把它撕碎！
desc.en: Never forget the path I have set you upon! If anything stands across it, bleed it, burn it, break it!"

desc.zh: 食人魔最为和平友爱的时刻，便是在杀掉不幸的对手之后，在斯卡拉格的大锅里快乐地撕下受害者的肉块了
desc.en: The closest Ogres can get to peace and camaraderie is destroying joints of meat from Skrag's pot, once they have jointly destroyed those hunks of meat's hapless, erstwhile owners.

desc.zh: 血言者要求他的信徒去完成不可能的任务，然后他们就去做了。有许多人会在尝试中死掉，但在这之前，他们也会杀掉很多敌人
desc.en: The Bloodspeaker asks the impossible of his followers, and they do it. Many die afterwards. But before that, they kill.

desc.zh: 领略过，经历过，搞到胸甲，带回伤疤
desc.en: Been there, done that, got the breastplate. And the scars.

desc.zh: 就像肉可以满足食人魔的胃口，骨头被认为承载着力量。于是，吃肉讲究的是个放纵，而啃骨头讲究的则是个崇敬（也同样包含放纵就是了）
desc.en: As much as meat satisfies an Ogre's appetite, the bones are what carries the strength. Meat is consumed with abandon, bones are consumed with reverence (and also abandon).

desc.zh: 任何一个头都可能是正确的，也可能所有的头都是正确的，正因如此，任何被它的眼睛注视到的人，都会感受到极为广阔的恐怖景象
desc.en: It could be any head. It could, indeed, be every head. This is why its eyes open such a wide vista of horrors to anyone who sees it.

desc.zh: 理论上来说，若是看到阿巴尔背后并无军队，这似乎会让人安心一些。然而数千年的血腥现实足以充分驳斥这一点
desc.en: Considering Arbaal without an army at his back may offer consolation, in the abstract. For thousands of years the devastating reality has amply refuted this.

desc.zh: 施法者将一把骨头塞进嘴里，一边嚼碎它们，一边诅咒他的敌人：他们会被一只巨拳压碎，化为尘土
desc.en: Stuffing a handful of bones into his mouth, the spellcaster crunches them up whilst cursing his foes, who are crushed by a giant fist which pounds them to dust.

desc.zh: 吞下一颗毒性十足，恶心十足的巨魔心脏后，食人魔的伤口会奇迹般地迅速愈合，令敌人目瞪口呆
desc.en: After downing the toxic and utterly repulsive innards of a Troll, the Ogres' wounds seem to stitch themselves together before their enemies' dumbfounded eyes.

desc.zh: 这是臭名昭著的超巨史奎格大量消化后留下的天然副产品，只是别一脚踩上去就好
desc.en: A copious natural by-product of this noisome Colossal Squig's healthy digestion. Just don't step in it.

desc.zh: 只要能彻底消化干净，那么超巨史奎格吃下的所有东西都永远都不会再成为威胁。然而如果它死掉，那么这些盘算就会全部落空了
desc.en: If it stays digested, anything this Colossal Squig eats is generally no longer considered a threat. Once it dies, all such considerations fall to the wayside.

desc.zh: [[i]]『饥肠辘辘的巨人啥事儿都做不成，但你只需要给他们喂地精就行了』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"An 'ungry Giant’z no good to ya, but gobbo-fodda's all ya need ta keep dem fed."[[/i]]

desc.zh: 即使是很简单的破坏也可以被更强大的意志所驾驭。对于大碾子史奎格来说，它们虽然没有对于这个隐喻的概念，但这种驾驭却是以更为可怕的样貌所上演着
desc.en: Even simple destruction can be harnessed by a greater will. With Mangler Squigs, the metaphor is lost but the harnessing remains, in a terrifyingly literal sense.

desc.zh: 『什么都别想通过俺们！』
desc.en: "Nuffin' ain't gettin' past us."

desc.zh: 『把他们搞懵，让战斗多点乐子，让他们七窍生烟，从而给他们入入味儿』
desc.en: "Get 'em flailin' an' confused. Makes fightin' more fun. Get 'em smoked. Makes 'em taste better."

desc.zh: 食人魔不喜欢挑食，然而挑剔的战士往往更为致命
desc.en: Picky eaters are frowned upon amongst the Ogres. Picky fighters, however, are some of the deadliest amongst them.

desc.zh: 杀戮！没有什么比这更能取悦杀戮之神凯恩，而且这种敬神方式（甚至可以说日常消遣）在黑暗精灵中也很盛行
desc.en: Slaughter! There is no greater glorification of Khaine, the God of Murder, and no more popular form of worship – or indeed daily exercise – amongst the Dark Elves.

desc.zh: [[i]]『把网交给地精，让他们呼啦一下罩住敌人，然后趁机一阵箭雨把他们扎成刺猬』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Give a gobbo a net an' he'll slow da enemy gitz down long enuff to stick 'em fulla arrers."[[/i]]

desc.zh: [[i]]『若是除了搞出一场大爆炸之外已经没别的法子，那就让萨满对着最大个的史奎格狠狠来那么一下子！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"When nothin' but a massive 'splosion’ll do, get da Shamans to blow up da biggest Squig yoov got."[[/i]]

desc.zh: 当兽人下定决心要把什么东西劈成两半时，几乎没有什么能阻止他们这么做
desc.en: When Orcs are determined to cleave something in half, very few things can stop them from doing so.

desc.zh: 向空中喊出战吼，强大的Waaagh！开始了征途！小子们渐渐变得歇斯底里，呼应着这可怕的咆哮！
desc.en: Bellowing a war cry into the air, the mighty Waaagh! is unleashed – da boyz echo the terrifying roar in a crescendo of murderous hysteria!

desc.zh: [[i]]『若是能让地精去把射出去的箭捡回来，那就不会再有什么箭矢浪费的问题了』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Dere's no worryin' 'bout wasted arrers when ya got gobbos out dere ta fetch dem back for ya."[[/i]]

desc.zh: 他们是冬天的化身，会利用黑暗季节的冰寒天气来杀死敌人
desc.en: The walking embodiment of Winter itself, Yhetees channel the dark season's freezing weather to maim and kill their enemies.

desc.zh: 他们是冬天的化身，会利用黑暗季节的冰寒天气来杀死敌人
desc.en: The walking embodiment of Winter itself, Yhetees channel the dark season's freezing weather to maim and kill their enemies.

desc.zh: 『把你杀的那些玩意儿身上的零碎全都挂到这面旗子上，就能显摆出你是最棒的小子了！』
desc.en: "Keep loadin' stuff from yer' killz onta dis banner an' show off tha' your da best boyz!"

desc.zh: 『让他们离那丑陋的大家伙远点，懂？』
desc.en: "Keep dem gitz away from da big ugly fing, ya hear!"

desc.zh: 怒狂者的超凡风暴在战场上肆意挥洒着世俗之物：骨头，肉体，还有鲜血…那么多的鲜血！
desc.en: A Wrathmonger's otherworldly storm takes on a decidedly worldly character in battle – bits of bone and gobs of flesh… and blood. So much blood.

desc.zh: [[i]]『把成群的大蜘蛛放出去，这样就连小蜘蛛也能饱餐一顿』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Send in enuff big Spiderz an' da little ones come out to feast as well!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: 食人魔雇佣兵留下的杀戮战场为食腐动物提供了丰富的食物，甚至在战斗结束前，他们就开始了大快朵颐，这倒是也为战争贡献了属于自己的力量
desc.en: The absolute carnage around Ogre mercenaries provides rich pickings for carrion-eaters, who do their bit for the war effort by taking more than their fill before battle is even done.

desc.zh: [[i]]『你只需要让一队小子黏住它们，然后让骑兵绕后把它们冲个粉碎』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"All ya need’s a coupla boyz to hold dem still an' da riderz'll go round an' smash 'em!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: [[i]]『让大只佬们肩并肩震动大地！要是敌人连站都站不直，那就根本别想打过他们啦！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Get da Big 'Uns side by side ta shake da ground! Let dem gitz try ta take 'em down if dey can't even stand up straight!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: [[i]]『一头史奎格只能杀一个，一群史奎格就能杀一窝！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"One Squig’s gonna be murda, but a group of dem’s a bloodbarf!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: 愤怒的恐角兽需要什么关于…嗯，愤怒的提醒吗？虽说如此，对于失败与恐虐愠怒的恐惧倒算得上是个不小的刺激
desc.en: As if a raging Khorngor needs any reminders on, well, rage… though the dull fear of defeat and Khorne's displeasure provides a useful prod.

desc.zh: 哥巴德的小子们很尊敬他，因为他更年长、更高大也更强壮。毕竟这种单一环节的逻辑链连兽人都能捋清楚
desc.en: Gorbad's boyz respect him because he is older, bigger and stronger. A chain of logic consisting of a single link is one that even Orcs can follow.

desc.zh: 食物并不足以维持猎食者的生命，最多也就是避免了他们的浪费而已。他们缺乏理解自己绝望的头脑，但他们更多是用贪婪的愤怒来弥补这一点
desc.en: Food does little to sustain a Gorger. At most, it staves off their wasting. They lack the mind to understand their own desperation, but more than make up for it with ravening fury.

desc.zh: 逃离恐惧会让你活下去，而直面恐惧会让你变得强大：最伟大的耶提把这种智慧带出了山区
desc.en: Running away from fear is what keeps you alive. Running towards fear is what makes you strong. The greatest Yhetees bring this wisdom with them down from the mountains.

desc.zh: 恐虐的熔炉会锻造出具备超凡速度的造物，并以此服务于他的杀戮伟业
desc.en: That which is forged in Khorne’s own crucible moves with otherworldly speed to serve the cause of murder.

desc.zh: [[i]]『那些笨巨魔总是开小差走丢！好好盯紧它们，让它们专心打砸抢去！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Da dumb Trolls keep gettin' distracted an' wonderin' off! Stick wiv 'em an' keep 'em focused on da smashin'!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: [[i]]『不要把肉浪费在那些野兽身上，要吃就让他们去战场上吃个饱吧！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Don't waste meat on da beasts, let 'em get dere fill on da battlefield!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: 随着搞毛巨像的横冲直撞，周围所有的地精都会如丧失理智一样地狂热起来，不顾一切地去收集这些巨像的，呃，『掉落物』来当作恶心但便利的弹药来源
desc.en: As Rogue Idols stomp and rampage, any Goblins around wage a mighty battle against their better judgement and collect the Idols', er, droppings, to use as a disgustingly convenient source of ammo.

desc.zh: 『要是你隔着大老远就觉得这群巫婆恶臭难闻，那你不妨等她们走近了再试试…』
desc.en: "If you thought them Hags smelt bad from a distance, just wait until you get up close…"

desc.zh: 这些孬不拉喜欢在战斗间隙互相打斗，但他们更乐意在活生生的敌人身上练习磨练出来的技能
desc.en: These Gnoblars love to joust each other when away from the battlefield, but will more-than happily practice on live foes to hone their, er, chops.

desc.zh: 暴屠兽的命运取决于它的主人。如果它的主人活着，它就会按他的命令去杀戮；如果没有，那么它只会漫无目的的杀戮
desc.en: The fate of a Slaughterbrute is bound to its master. If its master lives, it kills at his behest. If not, it simply kills.

desc.zh: [[i]]『箭矢在天上飞，重武器在疯狂装弹，这是无与伦比的杀戮场啊！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Yer nevva gonna get a betta killin' den when da arrers are flyin' an' da Lobberz are lobbin'!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: 『嘿，大丑八怪！是时候来…算了，反正你都开始了。那就快上吧！』
desc.en: "Hey, big ugliez, time to... Nevah mind, yer at it already. Good ugliez!"

desc.zh: [[i]]『把长矛的尖儿指向四面八方，哪个蠢货敢靠近就戳死他！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Get dem spearz pointin' in all directions an' stick any who gets close to ya!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: [[i]]『蛮荒小子算不得有多鬼鬼祟祟，但给他们配上一个潜伏者，指引他们该去哪儿，这些人很快就能自个偷偷摸摸地攻上来』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Da savage boyz ain’t da sneakiest, but give dem a Skulker to show dem where to go, an' dey'll be sneakin' up on da gitz in no time!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 也许这是出于从众心理，但数量多起来的孬不拉反而会成为一股一致性更强的战斗力量
desc.en: Maybe it's herd mentality, but in greater numbers, Gnoblars are a far more unified fighting force.

desc.zh: [[i]]『谁会嫌弃蜘蛛太多呢！你能搞到越多的蜘蛛，就能让越多的敌人动弹不得！』[[/i]]
desc.en: [[i]]"Yoo can neva 'ave too many Spiderz! Da more you 'ave, da more gitz get snagged in dere webz!"[[/i]]

desc.zh: 只有强者才有机会挡下斯卡尔的鲜血风暴之刃。然而从他那鲜血淋漓的视角来看，这种人并不存在
desc.en: Only the strong have a chance of withstanding Skarr's Bloodstorm Blades. From his blood-dimmed point of view, none fall under that category.

desc.zh: 把獠牙与尖刺制成长矛，便成了典型的地精武器：迅捷、肮脏，倒也实用
desc.en: It is a fang that is a spike, made into a spear. As weaponcraft goes, it follows Goblin guidelines: quick and dirty; used likewise.

desc.zh: 由充满魔法的强大兽人武器锻造而成，并以布拉格亲族的内脏为原料进行了锤炼。无论是敌人的肉体还是灵魂都无法承受它的一击
desc.en: Forged from a mighty Orc weapon brimming with sorcery, and tempered in the gut-stuff of Bragg's own kinfolk. Neither flesh nor minds can withstand it.

desc.zh: 论起绞肉的技巧，谁能比得上『绞肉机』莫格洛呢！
desc.en: There's nothing that mangles matter more than Morglor the Mangler!

desc.zh: 恐虐的愤怒显露无遗。敌人的灵魂向他乞求怜悯，哪怕肉体萎缩，彻底屈服，并毫无抵抗地撕裂开来
desc.en: A shard of Khorne's wrath made manifest. A foe's very soul speaks to it, begging for release, even as the flesh recoils, then gives way and parts without resistance.

desc.zh: 阿巴尔的终末与毁灭者的初始一样，都是伪命题。它们都始于恐虐的不朽愤怒，因此它们都没有终结的一天
desc.en: Where Arbaal ends and the Destroyer begins is a false question. They both begin with Khorne's immortal wrath, and so neither will ever end.

desc.zh: 『我执掌仰慕的权柄。或可容你踏足门内，但如果你不配，这扇虚掩的门立马就会对你关上』
desc.en: "I hold the keys to adoration. I may allow you a foot in the threshold. But what is ajar will snap closed on unworthy specimens."

desc.zh: 『苦难之美，在于心灵施加于自身的荼毒。死亡之美，在于其…执行过程』
desc.en: "The beauty of suffering is in the mind's poisonous capacity to inflict it on itself. The beauty of death is in its... execution. "

desc.zh: 这支闪耀军团深知烈焰战场的恐怖，但仍坚信创造之神，怀着对净化之力的敬畏投身战局
desc.en: The gleaming host knows well the terror of a battlefield aflame, yet trusting in the Creator God, they join the fray, reverent of its cleansing power.

desc.zh: 当焦渴的战场在初燃火焰中噼啪作响时，阿苏尔战士会向永恒圣火献上庄严颂歌，祈求他的庇护
desc.en: When the parched field crackles in the first stirrings of a thirsting blaze, the Asur lift a solemn hymn to the Flame Eternal, entreating His protection.

desc.zh: 当卡勒多的峰峦渐冷，巨龙陷入永恒沉眠后，传承战火之责便落在了精灵肩上，以此敬拜阿苏焉
desc.en: When Caledor’s peaks grew cold and Dragons sank to ageless slumber, the burden fell on the Elves to honour Asuryan by kindling the flames of war.

desc.zh: 这是纵欲的化身：其躯壳已经瓦解，灵魂已被重重黑暗快感毁掉。简直就是扭曲而恶心的怪物
desc.en: Excess incarnate: a body unravelled and a soul detonated by dark sensation upon dark sensation. A writhing, gnashing obscenity.

desc.zh: 阿苏尔龙舰的箭雨如镰刀般锋利，其速度之快超越凡人目力所及。箭雨之下，众生平等
desc.en: All fall equal before the scything volleys of Asur Dragonships, loosed with a swiftness no mortal eye may follow.

desc.zh: 弓誓者们敬畏莫莱·赫格的怒火，因唯有她知晓箭矢能否命中目标。但当箭落如雹时，占卜已无意义
desc.en: Bow-sworn Asur fear the wrath of Morai-Heg, for only she knows if an arrow shall find its mark. Yet omens matter little when they loose a hailstorm.

desc.zh: 身着白袍的军团带着沉静自信屹立于暗天之下，为敌人构筑起致命的箭幕穹顶
desc.en: With stoic confidence, the white-garbed host stand before a darkened sky beneath a dome of piercing death that comes for their foes.

desc.zh: 当凡间物质碎裂为黏土，并不断再度崩解，它将化为浸透魔法的死亡之风
desc.en: When earthly matter breaks into primeval clay, and breaks again and again, it will become a deathly wind saturated in magic.

desc.zh: 终于，我们将回收纳垢兜售的，人称生命的死亡铸币。以烈焰将其重铸，锻造成不朽的辉煌
desc.en: At last, we will collect the dull coin of death that Nurgle peddles, calling it "life". With fire we will smelt it and remake it into something shining and deathless.

desc.zh: 洛依克那斑驳的假面终将剥落——其下从未有过什么力量。他的笑谑将止息，而失却了笑谑，便从未有过真正的声音
desc.en: In the end, Loec's mask of shadow-dappled leaves will fall away – underneath it, there was never strength. His laughter will cease. Without it, there was never a voice.

desc.zh: 心念专注于血腥的毁灭，却以安逸的懦怯掩饰真实。当这些剥落下去后，还能剩下什么？空无一物
desc.en: Minds bent on bloody destruction - and you clothe yourself in cowardly accoutrements of "safety". When those are shed, what is left? Nothing.

desc.zh: 狂怒之翱翔，翼载嗜血之渴望…但我们已捕捉到你的气息，并将其锻为锁链。任你如何挣扎，先崩毁的必是你自己！
desc.en: Flights of fury, wing-borne thirst for blood... But we have caught wind of you, and fashioned it into a chain. Rattle it all you want. It will be you who will break first.

desc.zh: 鲜血助燃恐虐卑劣的火焰。而那被啜饮之物，将扇起超越理解极限的烈焰
desc.en: Blood fuels Khorne's base fires for a time. That which is imbibed fans flames beyond one's capacity to comprehend.

desc.zh: 临至终末，我们将因新得的坚韧而气壮。腐蚀之风与毒锐之物的狂乱扭动，只会扇旺我们的火焰
desc.en: Towards the end, we shall grow bold in our newfound sturdiness. Corrosive gusts and the crazed writhing of sharp, poisonous things will only serve to fan our flames.

desc.zh: 洋溢着功成在即的芬芳，燃烧的熏香将巩固我们的本质，为肢躯注入炽烈的热忱，化作火焰的燃料
desc.en: Rich with the scent of imminent success, the burning incense will bolster our essence and fill our limbs with crackling ardour, the fuel to our fire.

desc.zh: 临阵脱逃即是死亡，不是吗，恐虐信徒？而负伤奋进，则是你们苦涩的荣光…不。那同样也是死亡
desc.en: Running away from battle is death, is it not, Khornates? And pressing on, though battered, is your bitter claim to glory… No. It is also death.

desc.zh: 当无物可饲任何火焰时，仍有一火不熄，由混沌子嗣的残余所铸，我们将舞过虚空，将其点燃
desc.en: When there is nothing left to feed any fire, one will keep burning still, made of what is left of us – the children of Chaos – and we will dance across the void to set it ablaze.

desc.zh: 当海洋枯涸，本质将破碎众魂及其容器，如炽焰潮汐般倾泻，唯我们可以抵御
desc.en: When the seas dry, essences will break all souls, their vessels, and spill in fiery tides that we alone can withstand.

desc.zh: 剧毒蛮夫与瘟污渣滓皆将呆立于我们火形迷阵，战栗化为灰烬，散于他们的花园
desc.en: Virulent brutes and pestilential scum alike will stand slack-jawed amidst the maze of our fire-borne forms and shiver to ashes amidst their gardens.

desc.zh: 当八风消逝，最后的枯竭气流将硬化为物质，陨落而下。我们将依循空刃之轨迹，规划舞步的航路
desc.en: When the Winds are no more, their last withered gusts will harden and fold into matter, and fall. We will chart our dance's course around the blades of air.

desc.zh: 当萨满术士于黄昏穿越荒芜之地时，古老尸骸开始躁动，新醒的幽魂因期待而战栗
desc.en: As the Shaman-Sorcerer crosses the desolate places of the world at dusk, old bones stir and spirits, freshly awakened, shudder in anticipation.

desc.zh: 萨满术士周身空气因热浪而扭曲，预示着他将以敌躯为燃料点燃仪式篝火
desc.en: A shimmering haze distorts the air around the Shaman-Sorcerer, a promise of an imminent ritualistic pyre... with his enemies the fuel!

desc.zh: 这位萨满术士的每个动作都伴随着微妙铃响、空灵钟鸣，或是锈蚀金属的刺耳摩擦声
desc.en: This Shaman-Sorcerer's every gesture is accompanied by subtle chiming, resonant, faraway tolling, or the creaking of rust-ridden metal.

desc.zh: 龙舰补给的惊人效率，保证了一旦战局有所需要，阿苏尔的死亡弹幕便能持续地倾泻致命火力
desc.en: The frightening efficiency of Dragonship resupply ensures that whenever necessary, an Asur barrage of death can be ceaselessly deadly.

desc.zh: 连绵不绝的撕裂风暴，要求箭矢从箭囊到弓弦源源不断地流转
desc.en: The unending riving torrent demands a never-ending passage of the arrow from quiver to string.

desc.zh: 一阵阵高等法术涌入目标体内，使其容光焕发，重获生机活力
desc.en: Waves of pure High Magic infuse the target, radiating within the body, returning vigour and life.

desc.zh: 上古战士们的精魂听从召唤而来，将自己的力量借予友军
desc.en: The spirits of ancient warriors are summoned and lend their might to allies in the present.

desc.zh: 魔法八风毫无预兆地向敌人袭来，形成致命的暴风雨
desc.en: Without warning, a conflagration of the eight arcane Winds forms on the foe, creating a devastating tempest.

desc.zh: 当亲王邀舞最后一曲，洛依克将祈求拒绝。然则，一位祈求的神明，岂非正将自己的本质献予他人啜饮？
desc.en: When the Prince has his last dance, Loec will pray for the power to refuse. Yet does a god who prays not offer his essence for another to sup on?

desc.zh: 追猎终止之时，唯由色孽决定。洛依克将大彻大悟：逃遁从来都是虚妄，这条路只通向笼槛——今已开敞，静候其入
desc.en: In the end, the pursuit will stop when Slaanesh decides. Loec will know there was never an escape – the path only ever led to the cage, now open, waiting.

desc.zh: 终末之时，吾主将轻抚洛依克肩头，在他的耳畔低语问候。奔逃与挣扎皆是无用，唯余臣服一途
desc.en: In the end, our Prince will lay his palm on Loec's shoulder, and whisper a greeting in his ear. Neither running nor struggle will serve. Only servitude.

desc.zh: 呛人的尘埃从法师的指尖喷涌而出，敌人一旦触碰，无不窒息而死
desc.en: A choking dust cloud erupts from the Wizard's fingertips, suffocating the foes in its path and dragging them to their deaths.

desc.zh: 法师制作出一把无弦琴，奏响一首难以释怀的挽歌，驱走所有的希望和紧迫感，使敌人变得脆弱不堪
desc.en: The Wizard produces a stringless fiddle and plays a haunting dirge that drives all sense of hope and urgency away, rendering the foe passive and prone.

desc.zh: 法师吟诵变化术的三字真言，抛出一个灿烂的熔融圆球，径直击穿敌人的行伍
desc.en: Speaking the three sacred syllables of transformation, the Wizard hurls a brilliant, molten sphere through the enemy's ranks.

desc.zh: 法师在岩石内部点燃火焰，令地面砰然碎裂，狂暴的世界生命之血喷涌而出，吞噬敌人
desc.en: The Wizard sets a fire within the very rock itself, causing the ground to splinter and the raging lifeblood of the world to gush forth and consume the enemy.

desc.zh: 法师召唤野性世界的力量，将其赐予自身选择的盟友，从而强化他们的攻击力
desc.en: The Wizard calls upon the strength of the wild world and bestows it upon his chosen allies, increasing the ferocity of their attack.

desc.zh: 原始的生命能量在战场上流动，治愈伤势，令新进倒下的战士重新恢复活力
desc.en: Raw life-energy flows across the battlefield, mending wounds and restoring the fallen to fresh vigour.

desc.zh: 法师将一柄小石锤投过战场，天空的闪电狂怒自其尾流呼啸而出
desc.en: The Wizard hurls a tiny stone hammer across the battlefield, and the heavens vent their electrical fury in its wake.

desc.zh: 法师踏入命运之锦，变更时间的流动以适应盟友的需求，令其能够更为顽强、更为迅捷地战斗
desc.en: The Wizard reaches into the tapestry of fate, altering the flow of time to suit his allies' needs, who then fight on harder and faster than ever before.

desc.zh: 最为靠近创世神思想的地位，令卡卓焉获得了领导阿苏焉守护者们的神圣力量
desc.en: Being closest to the thoughts of the Creator God marks Caradryan with the divine strength to lead Asuryan's guardians.

desc.zh: 迷雾笼罩之时，战士们会变得身手迅捷、适性优秀，直到发起进攻时才被敌人所发现
desc.en: Once swathed in the mists, the warriors become swift, adaptable, and unseen until the moment they strike.

desc.zh: 能够灌输失败恐惧的领导者，同样能激发出最英勇的壮举
desc.en: A leader who can instil a fear of failure can also bring out the greatest feats of valour.

desc.zh: 前一刻还是静谧晨雾，下一刻阿苏尔军团便冲锋而出，死亡箭云呼啸而落
desc.en: In one moment, the still morning fog; in the next, Asur regiments charging forth, clouds of whistling death falling ahead of them.

desc.zh: 前一刻还是静谧晨雾，下一刻阿苏尔军团便冲锋而出，死亡箭云呼啸而落
desc.en: In one moment, the still morning fog; in the next, Asur regiments charging forth, clouds of whistling death falling ahead of them.

desc.zh: 黑暗精灵通过杀戮来立足。当他们积累足够的杀戮时，会感受到自身的杀戮技巧得到了提升，仿佛凯恩亲自指引他们手中的利刃
desc.en: It is through killing that Dark Elves rise above other beings. Once engulfed in enough bloodshed, they will often feel their murderous prowess increase, as if Khaine himself was guiding the blades of his disciples.

desc.zh: 昔日萨尔的同门惨遭背叛、四分五裂，终被熔铸为一体，化作蛰伏暗影中的骇人之物，静待召唤…
desc.en: Betrayed, torn to pieces, and fused together as one, what was once Sayl’s fellow seer-apprentices is now something monstrous that awaits beckoning from the shadows…

desc.zh: 恶魔低语似在影响斯泰卡尔及其周遭众人，纵使惨遭开膛破肚，他们仍会在扭曲意志的作用下对其感恩颂德
desc.en: A Daemonic presence seems to influence Styrkaar and those around him, bending their will to give him thanks and praise even as he disembowels them.

desc.zh: 这位色孽领主调配的魔药蒸腾出窒息性毒雾，以亵渎香调扼杀众生言语之能
desc.en: This Slaaneshi Lord’s noxious combination of herbs magically sublimates a pungent and debilitating aroma that quite literally strangles the tongue.

desc.zh: 萨尔总会在最佳时机让敌人醒悟：他们的秘法之力，实则早已落入其手
desc.en: It is not until the most opportune moment that Sayl reveals to his enemies that their occult power was in fact in his hands all along.

desc.zh: 这些高悬的符文能放大持有者的战场威仪，令敌人胆战心惊，让追随者在狂乱中沉醉
desc.en: Raised aloft, these sigils amplify one's presence on the field, striking enemies with awe and horror as followers revel in the madness.

desc.zh: 谨记混沌同床者之气息，彼等灵光牵引异界魔力
desc.en: Heed the bedfellows of Chaos whose auras draw forth the magic of the other side.

desc.zh: 于某些人而言，濒死苦痛方会觉醒真实力量。彼等甘愿流血，召引凡胎不应驾驭的风暴
desc.en: For some, deathly agony is what awakens true power. They bleed willingly to conjure storms no mortals should wield.

desc.zh: 『当羊群溃散，羔羊奔逃…屠戮方显欢宴真谛』
desc.en: "When the flock breaks and the lambs scatter… that is when slaughter truly becomes a delight."

desc.zh: 神犬总是在杀戮满足其毁灭期望时苏醒，以死亡的计数磨利刃锋
desc.en: The Hound is roused wherever bloodshed feeds his Ruinous expectations, so that death’s tally sharpens the blade.

desc.zh: 在色孽领主的引诱下你将会目睹什么？谁也说不准。但有一件事是肯定的：你将会束手无策
desc.en: Coaxed into combat by a Lord of Slaanesh, there is no telling what you might witness. Yet one thing is certain: you shall be at your wits’ end.

desc.zh: 危险降临时，卡卓焉额上的造物主符文会闪耀出最明亮的光芒，烧焦任何靠近的敌人
desc.en: The rune of the Creator upon Caradryan's brow glows brightest in times of danger, scorching any foe who comes near.

desc.zh: 附魔蒸汽随咒语聚集，渐织成无可穿透之帷幔，覆于白衣军团之上
desc.en: The ensorceled vapours gather with each incantation, gradually weaving an impenetrable shroud upon the white-garbed host.

desc.zh: 奋不顾身地战斗中，狂怒磨练了贝奥尔格的直觉，这都是为了让敌人的鲜血流淌得更为汹涌
desc.en: Though he fights with heedless abandon, the furore of battle hones Beorg’s instincts to ensure the blood of his enemies spills more copiously than his own.

desc.zh: 当敌人认出贝奥尔格的战吼时，为时已晚
desc.en: By the time one recognises Beorg's war cry, it is already too late.

desc.zh: 这些生物生而为领袖，因此注定伟大，自诞生之刻便被其城塞的沼栖妖女族长所选中
desc.en: These creatures are born to lead and marked for greatness, chosen the moment they hatch by the Fimir Matriarch of their stronghold.

desc.zh: 直面完美存在的威压往往令人沉醉，若这存在恰是色孽神选，则沉醉往往将通向死亡
desc.en: Standing in the presence of near-perfection can be intoxicating, and in the case of Slaanesh’s alluring champions, quite often fatal.

desc.zh: 沼栖妖将沼泽堡垒的蔽日毒雾带上了战场，它不仅能扭曲视线，更可蚀化刺目的阳光
desc.en: The obscuring fog that shrouds the Fimir’s boggy fortresses follows them onto the battlefield, shielding them from more than just prying eyes and the harsh sun.

desc.zh: 这颗古老的泛黄獠牙是贝奥尔格部落中代表贵族身份的神圣护符，它可以为佩戴者偏转本可能致命的打击
desc.en: This ancient, yellowed canine tooth is the sacred talisman of lordship among Beorg’s tribe, warding off blows that would otherwise harm its wearer.

desc.zh: 据说鹰羽承载着神鹰之力，能为受认可者赐予特殊祝福与守护
desc.en: It is said the feathers of eagles bear the magic of the Eagle God himself, providing special boons and protection to those deemed worthy.

desc.zh: 迪卡菈将骇人的毒液强行灌入猎物体内，使其沉沦于无力反抗的痛楚极乐之中
desc.en: A force-feeding of Dechala’s hideous poison thrusts her victims into the grip of pain and ecstasy, without the will or wherewithal to oppose her.

desc.zh: 据说，这个古老的深海遗物中蕴含着海洋的宁静力量，以及一丝狂暴的感知力…
desc.en: They say the quiet strength of the ocean is contained within this ancient relic of the deeps, along with a touch of its raging sentience…

desc.zh: 那些有女巫视力的人会把它看作黑暗的虚空，如同魔法世界中令人不安的一片虚无
desc.en: Those with the witch-sight see this as a dark void, an unsettling patch of nothingness in the world of magic.

desc.zh: 这个异世界的实体潜伏在主人的阴影中，以幽灵般的形态存在，可以应召为其主人吸收狂躁的魔法
desc.en: Lurking in its master’s shadow in any number of spritelike forms, this otherworldly entity can be called upon to attract raw magic to its conjurer.

desc.zh: 它活着时，角是令旁观者误判其凶残为威严的狡诈骗局。如今骗局已随其死亡，恶意却永存于世
desc.en: While the creature lived, its horns were a cunning ruse for those who mistook its malice for majesty. Now only the malice remains.

desc.zh: 此以人皮缝制之囊，盛有萨尔旧主沙尔肯及其他败亡巫师、魔兽的符印獠牙，每一枚皆是掷向敌人的恶毒诅咒
desc.en: This corpse-skin bag contains the sigil-etched teeth of Sayl’s former master Schalkain and other defeated wizards and magical beasts, each a treacherous curse to hurl at his enemies.

desc.zh: 这只恐怖的生物浑身流脓，能从最微小的伤口嘶嘶地喷出恶臭的酸液
desc.en: This horrid creature bleeds stinking, vitriolic bile that spurts out from the slightest wound in great gouts of hissing back fluid.

desc.zh: 金色面具流转闪烁，扭曲肢躯翩跹摇曳，将敌人诱入假面的不洁盛典，迫其承受蚀骨之疲
desc.en: A mesmeric whirling of flickering golden masks and flowing, strained limbs draws foes into the Masque’s unholy pageant, pushing them to bone-weary agony.

desc.zh: 战士魔宠会在战斗中保护自己的主人，以小体型的混沌勇士或细小的怪兽样貌而战
desc.en: A warrior familiar accompanies its master and fights to protect them, taking the form of a diminutive Chaos Warrior or tiny monstrous creature.

desc.zh: 采自环形山脉深处的魔法水晶，经奥苏安的魔力漩涡淬炼而成，堪称能量黑洞
desc.en: Dug from beneath the Annuli mountains, this crystal has been shaped by the magical vortex that swathes Ulthuan, drawing magical energy towards it.

desc.zh: 漆黑如神祇魂灵的铠甲。穿戴者若非痛击仇敌的灾星，便会被诸神视为劣品，永受噬魂蚀骨之刑
desc.en: Armour as black as the souls of the gods themselves. Harrower of their enemies you shall be, or ever-devoured, ever-tortured victim, if wanting they find you to be.

desc.zh: 这把来历不明的战斧镌刻着北地盘绕嘶鸣的神蛇，造成的伤口会黑化冻结为脆冰
desc.en: Etched with coiling, snapping serpents of the north, this finely wrought axe of unknown origin inflicts wounds that blacken and freeze into brittle ice.

desc.zh: 只要意志与荣光不灭，敌人必将永堕深渊。倘若退缩，万千诅咒即刻加身…
desc.en: Damned before you be thy enemies, as long as your will and glory hold fast. A thousand damnations upon you should you falter…

desc.zh: 这印记象征着：一头在旷野中追猎、并一次次得手的生物，所留下的遍地残骸
desc.en: An emblem of the countless bones strewn across the deserts by a creature which stalked its prey in wide-open spaces, prevailing again and again.

desc.zh: 佩戴这枚受祝护符者可获古神庇佑。若忽视神谕，必遭反噬
desc.en: Unto the bearer of this warded charm is bestowed the protection of the Old Gods. Ignore their due at your own peril.

desc.zh: 一面受祝圣传说的精磨巨盾，镶嵌着繁复的黄金涡卷纹饰，其辉光耀目，令敌手目眩神迷
desc.en: A highly polished shield of blessed legend, inlaid with swirling patterns in many types of gold, its glory dazzling and confusing the foe.

desc.zh: 承载这份厚赠的同时亦将背负黑暗诅咒。你注定要踏过无尽尸山血海，铸就荣光
desc.en: "Bear these great gifts and the dark curses of their binding. Across endless battlefields of death and glory you are destined for striding."

desc.zh: 只需一瞥，就足以让人心陷入绝望的恐惧，让凡人战栗不已，无法逃脱
desc.en: A single glance is enough to have any heart engulfed in abject terror, leaving mere mortals frozen in fear, unable to escape.

desc.zh: 沼栖妖独特的鳞状皮肤允许其上嵌入装甲以增加自身的身高与弹跳力，但在受伤时，这些护甲会迅速脱落！
desc.en: The Fimir’s uniquely scaly skin allows the embedding of armoured plates to increase stature and resilience, though injury causes them to be swiftly shed!

desc.zh: 对蹩脚术士而言，这枚来历不明的紫辉宝珠仅是玩物。但智者能从中汲取磅礴伟力
desc.en: This glowing purple orb of unknown providence is a mere trinket to the unskilled spellcaster. But for those with the wisdom, it can be a source of great might.

desc.zh: 只要在敌方阵线中不断大快朵颐，便能令其血肉通红，伤势焕然痊愈
desc.en: A frequent gorging on the enemy’s battle lines leads to this one’s flesh flushing red as its wounds reknit themselves.

desc.zh: 特玛卡多亲王既不喜在决斗中伤及同侪贵族，更厌恶自身受到任何损害
desc.en: Prince Temakador disliked harming fellow nobles in a duel, but hated even more to be harmed himself.

desc.zh: 一段无人闻听的诱人旋律残响…一抹眼角掠过的魅惑身姿…我刚才要做什么来着？…
desc.en: A tantalising snippet of a song no one else can hear... An enticing movement just out of the corner of one eye… What was I meant to be doing, again?...

desc.zh: 刀光如魅影回旋，攻势迅疾难辨，既会阻敌孤注一掷，也会激励追随者为赢宠姬青睐而一展雄姿
desc.en: A hypnotising gyre of flashing blades too fast to follow, denying any desperate attack and inspiring Dechala's followers to feats of battlefield grace to win their mistress' favour.

desc.zh: 战斗便是取悦主人的舞台，性感撩人的动作与回旋利刃诡异的呼啸会使得人们在无意识的毁灭中沉沦
desc.en: Battle provides the stage to please one’s master, where sensuous movements and the eerie whistling of whirling blades entrances followers into heedless destruction.

desc.zh: 根据诺斯卡之道，萨满术士的任何诡诈契约，皆须以血封缄。当然，不是他们自己的血…
desc.en: In true Norscan fashion, whatever cunning pacts and bargains the Shaman Sorcerers pursue, they must seal them with blood. Not theirs, of course…

desc.zh: 施展得如此迅捷而精准的技术，以至于恍若未曾发生
desc.en: A technique performed with such speed and precision that it may appear to not have happened at all.

desc.zh: 对手的目标不再是胜负或存亡，而是竭力达到那严苛至近乎残酷的标准，以此跟上这场已然化作舞蹈的搏杀
desc.en: The foe's purpose is no longer victory or survival, but measuring up to the impossibly exacting standards of the dance that the battle has turned into.

desc.zh: 黑暗亲王的仆从永远受制于他的奇思妙想。而这些奇想，有时仅仅意味着…放任他们自由行动。他的宠儿迪卡菈便是如此
desc.en: The Dark Prince's servants are eternally bound to His whims. Those same whims, at times, dictate that He simply... set them loose. So it is with his favoured servant, Dechala.

desc.zh: 慵懒无休的华尔兹，以旋绕敌目的虚影令其心智溃散
desc.en: A languorous, ceaseless waltz to haunt the enemy with spinning figures just outside the edge of their vision.

desc.zh: 无论是蜿蜒扭动绞杀奴仆，还是欢欣雀跃冲入战阵，迪卡菈始终沉醉于制造痛苦与苦难的暴行
desc.en: Whether sinuously squeezing the life out of her thralls or rushing gleefully into the fray, Dechala revels in her feats of pain and misery.

desc.zh: 在强大的海领主的召唤下，阿苏尔舰队将展示它无愧于世界上最强大的海军力量，其训练程度远远凌驾于其它种族之上
desc.en: By the call of its mighty Sea Lords, the Asur fleet demonstrates why it is renowned as the greatest naval power in the world, its training superior to all others.

desc.zh: 四处逃窜的敌人会眼睁睁看着自己的灵魂脱壳而出，从而斗志尽丧
desc.en: Along with the will to fight on, fleeing enemies find their very souls drawn from their broken bodies.

desc.zh: 水汽云雾在选定之地升起，水滴不断凝结和蒸发，干扰并减缓来袭箭矢的轨迹
desc.en: Clouds of droplets manifest to continuously form and evaporate around a chosen locale, dampening the path of incoming missiles.

desc.zh: 击杀升腾者就是要碾碎他的傲慢。但只要他活着，这份傲慢就远胜同族
desc.en: To kill the Ascendant is to kill his pride. But while he lives, it is far greater than others of his kin.

desc.zh: 衡量持久恶意最确切的标志，便是对虚弱者持续不休的摧残
desc.en: The surest mark of enduring malice is prolonging one's depredations on the weak and weary.

desc.zh: 日益堆积的死者之丘，将滋养这头鹰鹿兽意识深处那扭曲而蒙昧的自我，成为它病态满足的泉源
desc.en: The growing piles of the dead will serve as a source of satisfaction for the twisted, rudimentary self-awareness in the depths of this Preyton's mind.

desc.zh: 若将此古尔兽伤至体无完肤，它将开始啃噬自身血肉。然而适得其反，自噬之举反令其陷入更癫狂的饥渴
desc.en: This Ghorgon's body, if damaged enough, can be induced to feed upon itself. Unfortunately, this only fuels its ferocious hunger.

desc.zh: 其声难以名状，其味无法形容，其效不可描述，万事万物皆无从言说
desc.en: The sound is indescribable. The smell is indescribable. The effects are indescribable. Everything is indescribable.

desc.zh: 这黏液能抵御凡俗之物，而此生物『赐福』之源则会排斥任何与之接触的其他存在
desc.en: The slime fends off the mundane. The source of the creature's "blessings" fends off anything else that comes into contact with it.

desc.zh: 腐食者的酸涎既是其贪婪食欲的象征，也是满足欲望的手段：它能溶解同类猎物血肉与骨骼
desc.en: This Carrion Eater's acidic froth is a sign of its ravening appetite and a means to satisfy it, dissolving both flesh and bone of its smaller Carrion prey.

desc.zh: 面对此兽的挑战，唯有死战或逃窜。但谁愿在沦为梦魇食物的恐惧中逃亡？唯有一战！
desc.en: Faced with this creature's challenge, one either fights or flees. Yet who would flee and doom themselves to nightmares of becoming its meal? Fight it is.

desc.zh: 这不是对恶徒的逐客令，而是终结命运的宣告
desc.en: This is not a warning for evildoers to go. It is a promise of what is to come.

desc.zh: 疯狂究竟源于这生物炽烈的灵能辐射，还是来自敌人不顾一切滞留其侧的抉择？
desc.en: Does insanity lie in the creature's blistering psychic emanations, or in its enemy's decision to stay in their proximity despite everything...?

desc.zh: 腐食者的饥饿能瓦解所有抵抗，从猎物的护具开始，直至其身躯最后的绝望抽搐
desc.en: The Carrion Eater's hunger breaks down any form resistance, beginning with the victim's means of protection and ending with the final hopeless flutters of its body.

desc.zh: 受其主宰扭曲意志的影响，凡与此兽凶目相对者，将暂时保持如同遭受酷刑的鲜活感知…
desc.en: In a depraved twist of its master's will, those who return this creature's baleful gaze retain torturous mobility… for a while.

desc.zh: 『小不点』被噎住的概率微乎其微，但某些经历仍教会了他彻底咀嚼的重要性
desc.en: It is extremely unlikely for the Runt to choke on anything that enters his maw. Yet something has taught him to be thorough nevertheless.

desc.zh: 升腾者对滋养的需求远超肉体饥渴。他从惊惧敌人的眼神中汲取优越，并以此为食
desc.en: The Ascendant's need for sustenance exceeds his fleshly appetite. He feeds on his own superiority, finding it in the eyes of terror-stricken foes.

desc.zh: 不知己之体型者，常亦不知己之力道。这头『小不点』受威胁时，可不会在两者上有半分吝惜
desc.en: Not knowing one's size comes hand in hand with not knowing one's strength. The Runt needn't skimp on either when threatened.

desc.zh: 被鸡蛇兽凝视的受害者将保留足够的感知，得以完整体验最终的蜕变
desc.en: The sculpted victims of the Cockatrice retain just enough awareness to fully experience their final change.

desc.zh: 痛苦愈甚，此兽愈能实现其存在意义，而它的存在本就是极致的痛苦
desc.en: The more terrible the pain, the more this creature has fulfilled its purpose – which is terrible pain.

desc.zh: 仇恨若足够强烈，便能比万物更持久。而最极致的恨意，莫过于对着那个携着死亡誓约的宿敌
desc.en: Hate, if strong enough, outlives everything. There is no hate greater than that for a singular rival who carries a promise of death.

desc.zh: 凭借其天性与悠久阅历，智者免疫一切浅薄诡计，无论遭遇何种困境都岿然不动，席卷战场
desc.en: By his nature and long-lived experience, the Wise One is immune to paltry stratagems, standing his ground and wreaking havoc no matter what.

desc.zh: 绝望的血腥狂热是濒临癫狂的标志，然而有些生物根本不在乎心智的界限
desc.en: Desperate bloodlust is a mark of borderline derangement – yet some creatures care not for the limits of mind.

desc.zh: 这头魔物的存在本身就如同一座熔炉，投身其中者多数化为灰烬——但总有少数获得重塑，暗燃的力量将重获新生
desc.en: The monster's very presence is a crucible. In it, most are reduced to cinders – but some are reforged, their smouldering strength renewed.
