desc.zh: 欲触及这活体炼狱的血肉，镇压者必先战胜哈苏特本尊的烈焰
desc.en: To reach its flesh, those who would quell this living inferno must first fight the fires of Hashut himself.

desc.zh: 当痛感的狂喜攀至令人眩晕的巅峰，会侵蚀对自我价值的认知。这般迷醉终将消退，而后便是坠落。但在炽烈未熄时…
desc.en: Some of ecstasy's self-destructive heights have a vertiginous effect on one's sense of self-worth. It passes – and then comes the fall. But while the high lasts…

desc.zh: 当痛感的狂喜攀至令人眩晕的巅峰，会侵蚀对自我价值的认知。这般迷醉终将消退，而后便是坠落。但在炽烈未熄时…
desc.en: Some of ecstasy's self-destructive heights have a vertiginous effect on one's sense of self-worth. It passes – and then comes the fall. But while the high lasts…

desc.zh: 当痛感的狂喜攀至令人眩晕的巅峰，会侵蚀对自我价值的认知。这般迷醉终将消退，而后便是坠落。但在炽烈未熄时…
desc.en: Some of ecstasy's self-destructive heights have a vertiginous effect on one's sense of self-worth. It passes – and then comes the fall. But while the high lasts…

desc.zh: 婉拒因精妙的算计而甘美，恰如操控他人的精髓，将未得回应的渴求收割为自身养料
desc.en: Coyness sweetens denial with its calculating nature. Such is the essence of control over others, to then harvest their unrequited longing for oneself.

desc.zh: 婉拒因精妙的算计而甘美，恰如操控他人的精髓，将未得回应的渴求收割为自身养料
desc.en: Coyness sweetens denial with its calculating nature. Such is the essence of control over others, to then harvest their unrequited longing for oneself.

desc.zh: 婉拒因精妙的算计而甘美，恰如操控他人的精髓，将未得回应的渴求收割为自身养料
desc.en: Coyness sweetens denial with its calculating nature. Such is the essence of control over others, to then harvest their unrequited longing for oneself.

desc.zh: 某些生灵对绝望与恐惧的渴求如此强烈，竟化作汹涌浪潮弥漫周身，足以击碎最坚韧的意志
desc.en: In some, the imperative towards despair and terror is so strong that they exude it in overpowering waves, breaking even the strongest of wills.

desc.zh: 某些生灵对绝望与恐惧的渴求如此强烈，竟化作汹涌浪潮弥漫周身，足以击碎最坚韧的意志
desc.en: In some, the imperative towards despair and terror is so strong that they exude it in overpowering waves, breaking even the strongest of wills.

desc.zh: 某些生灵对绝望与恐惧的渴求如此强烈，竟化作汹涌浪潮弥漫周身，足以击碎最坚韧的意志
desc.en: In some, the imperative towards despair and terror is so strong that they exude it in overpowering waves, breaking even the strongest of wills.

desc.zh: 若战士的身躯仅是挂在意志残烬上的倦怠破布，便不过是扮演战争的疲乏伶人
desc.en: A warrior whose body is a torpid rag hung from a cindery stick of a will is nothing but a tired mummer playing at war.

desc.zh: 若战士的身躯仅是挂在意志残烬上的倦怠破布，便不过是扮演战争的疲乏伶人
desc.en: A warrior whose body is a torpid rag hung from a cindery stick of a will is nothing but a tired mummer playing at war.

desc.zh: 若战士的身躯仅是挂在意志残烬上的倦怠破布，便不过是扮演战争的疲乏伶人
desc.en: A warrior whose body is a torpid rag hung from a cindery stick of a will is nothing but a tired mummer playing at war.

desc.zh: 此印记使灵魂适应鞭笞骤然难测的轨迹，其倒刺中痛苦与甘甜彼此交织
desc.en: This Mark accommodates the soul to the sudden, unpredictable path of the lash. Its barbs hold suffering and sweetness in equal measure.

desc.zh: 此印记使灵魂适应鞭笞骤然难测的轨迹，其倒刺中痛苦与甘甜彼此交织
desc.en: This Mark accommodates the soul to the sudden, unpredictable path of the lash. Its barbs hold suffering and sweetness in equal measure.

desc.zh: 此印记使灵魂适应鞭笞骤然难测的轨迹，其倒刺中痛苦与甘甜彼此交织
desc.en: This Mark accommodates the soul to the sudden, unpredictable path of the lash. Its barbs hold suffering and sweetness in equal measure.

desc.zh: 错把痛楚当欢愉常被视作感官的错乱，但对迪卡菈的仆从而言，这恰是最精密的筹谋
desc.en: Mistaking pain for pleasure is considered a derangement of the senses. With Dechala's servants, it is a most deliberate arrangement.

desc.zh: 错把痛楚当欢愉常被视作感官的错乱，但对迪卡菈的仆从而言，这恰是最精密的筹谋
desc.en: Mistaking pain for pleasure is considered a derangement of the senses. With Dechala's servants, it is a most deliberate arrangement.

desc.zh: 错把痛楚当欢愉常被视作感官的错乱，但对迪卡菈的仆从而言，这恰是最精密的筹谋
desc.en: Mistaking pain for pleasure is considered a derangement of the senses. With Dechala's servants, it is a most deliberate arrangement.

desc.zh: 施法者的腐蚀触碰能使目标在短时间内进入幸福、愉悦的状态，使他们几乎不能移动，更不用说自卫了
desc.en: The spellcaster's corrupting touch puts their victims into a blissful, euphoric state for a short time, rendering them little able to move, let alone defend themselves.

desc.zh: 法师使用阴影系法术的技能，让敌人被自身的负担拖垮，直到他们虚弱到只能停滞不前为止
desc.en: By means of the Lore of Shadows, the Wizard causes the enemy to be worn down by their own burdens, until they are enervated to a sorry standstill.

desc.zh: 法师念出一个咒语，一团翻滚着的魔法火球便会向着一个附近的敌人射去
desc.en: The Wizard conjures a boiling ball of magical flame and hurls it at a nearby foe.

desc.zh: 黑暗亲王的三尾鞭精妙一吻，敌人就会尝到他那美味的愤怒
desc.en: The exquisite kiss of the Dark Prince's three-tailed whip strikes the enemy with a delicious fury.

desc.zh: 施法者开启一个通往地狱深渊的漩涡，它将永久地吞噬一切卷入其中之物
desc.en: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.

desc.zh: 死者的灵魂攻击着巫师的敌人，蚕食着他们的斗志，在军中散播着恐慌
desc.en: Spirits of the departed assail the Wizard’s foes, sapping their resolve and causing dread among their numbers.

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向了敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the spellcaster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 黑暗的触手向外翻腾，使施法者吸取敌人的生命来恢复自己的活力
desc.en: Tendrils of solidified darkness writhe outwards, draining the lifeforce from foes and renewing the caster’s own vigour.

desc.zh: 卡堂能够随意地变形为任何怪兽，甚至变成一头蝎尾狮。但遗憾的是，有一天他发现自己再也变不回来了…
desc.en: Kadon was able to shift his shape to that of any monster, even a Manticore. One day he found he could not change back...

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵冰冷寒风，用寒冰和冰雹攻击敌人
desc.en: A freezing gale is conjured and sent to assail the target with ice and hail.

desc.zh: 施法者念诵出禁忌之名，敌人就会陷入一阵阵痛苦
desc.en: As the caster utters a forbidden name, their enemies are wracked with waves of agony.

desc.zh: 死者的灵魂攻击着巫师的敌人，蚕食着他们的斗志，在军中散播着恐慌
desc.en: Spirits of the departed assail the Wizard’s foes, sapping their resolve and causing dread among their numbers.

desc.zh: 巫师的乌木法杖一指向目标，肮脏的法术便会开始汲取它的灵魂
desc.en: The Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, leeching its spirit through tainted sorcery.

name.en: The Purple Sun of Xereus Upgraded

desc.zh: 这个巨大天体是个拥有紫色边缘的黑暗实体，那些没能逃开晶化之触的人将陷入永世的诅咒！
desc.en: A colossal orb of purple-edged darkness materialises - those who do not escape its crystalline touch are doomed for eternity!

desc.zh: 法师念出一个咒语，一团翻滚着的魔法火球便会向着一个附近的敌人射去
desc.en: The Wizard conjures a boiling ball of magical flame and hurls it at a nearby foe.

desc.zh: 在烈焰法师或混沌术士的召唤下，猛烈旋转的火柱在战场上喷涌而出，极具杀伤力！
desc.en: Conjured by a Bright Wizard or Chaos Sorcerer, a column of churning fire erupts from the battlefield, causing much destruction!

desc.zh: 一具咯咯笑的火焰头颅。伴着一声欢快的尖叫，它突然跃入敌军，所到之处，片甲无存
desc.en: A cackling, flaming visage appears before the Wizard. With a gleeful screech, it swirls around the battlefield, immolating anything in its way.

desc.zh: 闪电电弧扫过战场，在敌人间疯狂跳跃，爆裂声不绝于耳，直到波及的所有敌人都化为灰烬
desc.en: Lightning arcs across the battlefield, leaping from foe-to-foe with crackling fury until there are none left within the storm.

desc.zh: 闪电电弧扫过战场，在敌人间疯狂跳跃，爆裂声不绝于耳，直到波及的所有敌人都化为灰烬
desc.en: Lightning arcs across the battlefield, leaping from foe-to-foe with crackling fury until there are none left within the storm.

desc.zh: 闪电电弧扫过战场，在敌人间疯狂跳跃，爆裂声不绝于耳，直到波及的所有敌人都化为灰烬
desc.en: Lightning arcs across the battlefield, leaping from foe-to-foe with crackling fury until there are none left within the storm.

desc.zh: 法师释放出魔法能量，如冰雹般袭向敌人，把他们变成一座座金色塑像
desc.en: The Wizard unleashes a hail of magical energy, transmuting his foes into Unliving golden statues.

name.zh: 高级吉哈纳的黄金猎犬

desc.zh: 法师吹响一个闪光的金色口哨，吉哈纳的金属猎犬应声而出并扑向自己的猎物
desc.en: Blowing on a glimmering golden whistle, the Wizard summons the spirit of Gehenna’s metal hounds to hunt down his prey.

desc.zh: 随着施法者张开手掌，几束嘶嘶作响的银流自天而降，贯穿敌人
desc.en: A spray of sizzling silver slivers rain from the sky to impale the caster's enemy.

desc.zh: 凭借对航海巫术的冷酷诠释，柯思奎的贤者们学会了以凝冰封冻猎物，从而令其疲敝无力的能力
desc.en: Through callous interpretation of sea-faring sorcery, Cothiquan loremasters have learned to glaciate their quarry to lethargic helplessness.

desc.zh: 凭借对航海巫术的冷酷诠释，柯思奎的贤者们学会了以凝冰封冻猎物，从而令其疲敝无力的能力
desc.en: Through callous interpretation of sea-faring sorcery, Cothiquan loremasters have learned to glaciate their quarry to lethargic helplessness.

desc.zh: 迷障薄雾萦绕友方周身，令受困者望见早已陨落的同袍幻影，从而重获力量。然而，这场大捷的预兆始终萦绕着悲怆的余韵
desc.en: A veil of vapour manifests around an ally, invigorating the beleaguered with glimpses of long-fallen kin. A portent of a mighty victory, tinged with the aftertaste of sadness.

desc.zh: 迷障薄雾萦绕友方周身，令受困者望见早已陨落的同袍幻影，从而重获力量。然而，这场大捷的预兆始终萦绕着悲怆的余韵
desc.en: A veil of vapour manifests around an ally, invigorating the beleaguered with glimpses of long-fallen kin. A portent of a mighty victory, tinged with the aftertaste of sadness.

desc.zh: 海神之怒使幻影咸雾充斥肺腑，这般滋味正是他的军锋艾斯林当年险些遭遇的宿命
desc.en: The Sea God's wrath fills your lungs with phantom brine, a taste of the fate that nearly claimed his Herald, Aislinn.

desc.zh: 海神之怒使幻影咸雾充斥肺腑，这般滋味正是他的军锋艾斯林当年险些遭遇的宿命
desc.en: The Sea God's wrath fills your lungs with phantom brine, a taste of the fate that nearly claimed his Herald, Aislinn.

desc.zh: 纵使身陷激战幻光之中，阿苏尔之敌仍会为纯水精魂的歌声魅惑纠缠，旋即遭其彻底吞没
desc.en: Even amidst the glamour of pitched battle, the Asur’s enemies are haunted by the beguiling tones of the Oceanids' song, moments before being utterly overwhelmed by them.

desc.zh: 带有腐蚀性盐晶的诡异迷雾笼罩战场，瓦解敌军斗志的同时以灵质触须庇护阿苏尔
desc.en: A salt-scented mist rolls in across the battlefield, corroding the enemy's resolve and shrouding the Asur with ethereal caress.

desc.zh: 带有腐蚀性盐晶的诡异迷雾笼罩战场，瓦解敌军斗志的同时以灵质触须庇护阿苏尔
desc.en: A salt-scented mist rolls in across the battlefield, corroding the enemy's resolve and shrouding the Asur with ethereal caress.

desc.zh: 带有腐蚀性盐晶的诡异迷雾笼罩战场，瓦解敌军斗志的同时以灵质触须庇护阿苏尔
desc.en: A salt-scented mist rolls in across the battlefield, corroding the enemy's resolve and shrouding the Asur with ethereal caress.

desc.zh: 刹那间，生灵可踏足不朽之路，在现实与虚幻间徜徉
desc.en: For a moment, one may tread immortal pathways by way of drifting in and out of reality.

desc.zh: 刹那间，生灵可踏足不朽之路，在现实与虚幻间徜徉
desc.en: For a moment, one may tread immortal pathways by way of drifting in and out of reality.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵足以麻痹敌军的迷乱之雾，令其变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.

desc.zh: 撕裂大地与岩石的裂隙，预示着地底的狂暴毁灭即将破土而出。逃跑不过徒劳而已
desc.en: A path torn through earth and stone precedes furious devastation bursting forth from below. Running is not a plan.

desc.zh: 鹰鹿兽的浓厚恨意让它几乎像憎恨敌人一样憎恨自己，因此，敌人的任何攻击都会因这恨意而受到猛烈的报复
desc.en: The innate hatred carried within a Preyton makes it despise itself almost as much as its foes, whose attacks are repaid with added enmity.

desc.zh: 恐怖之处在于，你深知它那张巨口一旦出现将会带来什么
desc.en: The terror is in knowing what its maw will do once it finally emerges.

desc.zh: 真正的恐惧，在于你不知道它何时会破土而出
desc.en: The dread is in not knowing when it will emerge.

desc.zh: 许多阿苏尔得以幸存，不仅仰赖斩天者的卓越飞行性能与航程，更因舰舱内贮藏的新鲜药膏
desc.en: Many Asur are saved not only by the Skycutter’s airworthiness and range, but also by the freshly made ointments stowed in its hold.

desc.zh: 三张撕咬巨口让奇美拉获得了难以束缚的毁灭潜能，更不用说其中的一张还喷吐着灼热的死亡
desc.en: Three snapping maws signal the Chimera’s unbridled destructive potential, with one harbouring the possibility of a fiery death.

desc.zh: 不断变化的明亮表皮一瞬间变得透明，下一刻又像熔蜡般流淌，以治愈被玷污的血肉
desc.en: An ever-shifting dermis of bright colours and hues turns translucent one moment, before running like molten wax to heal tainted flesh the next.

desc.zh: 单单望见海龙兽一眼便可引发恐惧与绝望，它那令人窒息的黑暗光环甚至能抵消箭矢和其他实弹的攻击
desc.en: The very sight of a Merwyrm can provoke dread and hopelessness, its aura of crushing darkness even nullifying arrows and other missiles.

desc.zh: 萨芙睿的法师将玄奥秘法与战争魔法的冷峻实用相结合，由此练就了无所不达的施法技艺
desc.en: By binding abstruse arcana with the stern pragmatism of war-magic, the spellcasters of Saphery attain a ubiquitous form of their sorcerous craft.

desc.zh: 附近吟唱的咒语所发散出的奥术魔力丝线，如抽丝剥茧般自微风中提取而出，编入魔屏，从而强化了屏障的力量
desc.en: Loose threads of arcane power from nearby incantations are plucked from the breeze and woven into the barrier, reinforcing its strength.

desc.zh: 无论为颂神而歌，或仅为壮己胆魄，这些骑手的歌声虽刺耳骇人，却深得其神祇与战友欢心
desc.en: Whether sung in worship, or simply to embolden themselves, these riders’ songs are dreadful to the ear but pleasing to their god and fellow warriors.

desc.zh: 于某些好战生灵而言，嗜血本能与求生意志之间从无什么中间地带
desc.en: For some war-prone creatures, the point where survival eclipses bloodlust has absolutely no in-between.

desc.zh: 这一冰冷刺骨的光环会让附近的敌人全部举步维艰，几乎停顿，如同深陷暴风雪，或是挣扎于泥沼中一般
desc.en: As if the enemy were caught in a blizzard or wading through treacle, the ice-cold aura slows any unit within range to a near-standstill.

desc.zh: 诅咒魔裔总有一颗头颅比另一颗更乖戾凶残，驱使这庞然巨物以笨拙却狂暴的姿态疯狂肆虐！
desc.en: There is always one head more perverse and hateful than the other, pushing the Curs’d Ettin to move with violent, albeit lumbering zeal!

desc.zh: 某些诅咒魔裔会至少保留一颗头颅的理智，从而记忆古老部落的魔法秘术，令其在重创之下得以愈合
desc.en: Some Curs’d Ettin retain enough intelligence in one head to recall secrets of their old tribal magic, allowing them to convalesce when under grave threat.

desc.zh: 某些诅咒魔裔会至少保留一颗头颅的理智，从而记忆古老部落的魔法秘术，使其能瓦解最强大的魔法武装
desc.en: Some Curs’d Ettin retain enough intelligence in one head to recall secrets of their old tribal magic, affording them the power to nullify even the most potent magical armaments.

desc.zh: 若是看到了某颗喋喋不休的脑袋退化成了涎唾横流的痴愚，便是诅咒魔裔堕至最暴虐人格的征兆。快避开它战锤般的巨臂吧！
desc.en: A gibbering head devolved into a drooling and wailing imbecile signifies a Curs’d Ettin in its most destructive personality. Avoid its club-like arms!

desc.zh: 经由鹰鹿兽徘徊的战场，无不遍布着被撕咬践踏得面目全非的尸骸
desc.en: Seldom is a battlefield prowled by a Preyton not left strewn with corpses and dead creatures, mauled and trampled beyond any recognition.

desc.zh: 愚蠢到向着海龙兽发起冲锋的人，会被深入骨髓的海洋寒气彻底阻绝开去
desc.en: Those who find the foolish resolve to charge the Merwyrm will find their approach hampered by an ocean’s chill that hits them bones-deep.

desc.zh: 一场血战中有人一起并肩作战总是备感安心
desc.en: In the midst of a bloodbath it's good to know that someone has your back.

desc.zh: 洛瑟恩海峡上的严酷训练，令迅羽巨鹰熟稔御风之道，蓄力发动雷霆突击
desc.en: Rigorous practice over the Straits of Lothern drills the Swiftfeather Rocs in the auspicious wind-paths that husband their strength for devastating onslaught.

desc.zh: 这些杜鲁齐沉溺于内心执念的深渊，却因此攀上了狂喜的巅峰。这般沉沦的过程令人疲惫不堪，但他们早已无法抽身
desc.en: Reaching the seabed of their silent obsession, the Druchii straddle the peaks of euphoria. The journey down is tiring but impossible to abandon.

desc.zh: 这些杜鲁齐沉溺于内心执念的深渊，却因此攀上了狂喜的巅峰。这般沉沦的过程令人疲惫不堪，但他们早已无法抽身
desc.en: Reaching the seabed of their silent obsession, the Druchii straddle the peaks of euphoria. The journey down is tiring but impossible to abandon.

desc.zh: 在强大的海领主的召唤下，阿苏尔舰队浩荡出航，向世界证明其为何被誉为天下第一海军——其训练有素，举世无双
desc.en: By the call of its mighty Sea Lords, the Asur fleet demonstrates why it is renowned as the greatest naval power in the world, its training superior to all others.

desc.zh: 于色孽信徒而言，痛苦非私密之事。他们以共享这份馈赠为乐，将其蓄积于体内，随时施与所选之人
desc.en: Pain is not a private thing for the followers of Slaanesh. They take pleasure in sharing its gift, hoarding it within themselves to grace whomever they chose.

desc.zh: 斑驳的灰色血肉中贯穿着腐败恶臭的脉动血管。若是当真有种，就去剥取恐惧之嘴的鲜血吧！
desc.en: This mottled grey fresh is shot through with pulsing veins reeking of corruption and rot – draw the Dread Maw’s blood at your peril.

desc.zh: 对危险视而不见或许致命，但绝对自信的盲目本身即成洞见。在唯一目标面前，肉体的痛苦又算得了什么？
desc.en: Blindness to danger may be death for some, but the blindness of utter self-assurance is its own species of seeing. What is bodily pain in the face of singular purpose?

desc.zh: 受困的海元素常会释放同类幼体，如滚烫间歇泉般喷发，将进犯者无情撕碎
desc.en: A cornered Sea Elemental will often unleash lesser of its kind, discharging them like scalding geysers to mercilessly flay its assailants.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: …战锤轰然击碎骑士的铠甲，血肉化作黑尘四散。远处鸦群啼鸣彻响天际…——诺斯卡古谚
desc.en: "...And so the hammer smote down the noble knight, his armour and flesh crumbling into black dust upon whence the blow struck. The cawing of crows echoed in the distance..." – Old Norscan legend

desc.zh: 这件古老的火焰武器由凤凰卫队首任队长亲自赋予魔力，象征着其炽热而神圣的地位
desc.en: This ancient, flame-wreathed armament was enchanted for the first Captain of the Phoenix Guard as a fiery symbol of divine station.

desc.zh: 多尔甘家族的邪异传家宝，杖身盘绕的毒蛇会随着每次挥击喷溅致命的脓液
desc.en: Entwined with gnashing serpents, every swing of this foul Dolgan heirloom sees venom ooze from snapping fangs.

desc.zh: 这是一处上好的射击位置
desc.en: This is a good firing position.

desc.zh: 这是一处上好的射击位置
desc.en: This is a good firing position.

desc.zh: 骑射手毫无警告地冲出掩体，如冬季风暴般掠袭敌军，这是一种久经考验的消耗战术
desc.en: A long-tested form of attritional warfare has Horse Archers emerge from cover without warning to harry enemy forces like a winter storm.

desc.zh: 无论有多么疲惫，这些战士总能在刀枪剑戟的交锋中重振雄风
desc.en: No matter how weary, this combatant finds a second wind when swords, axes and spears clash.

desc.zh: 无可遁形，直面战斗
desc.en: Nowhere to run, nowhere to hide – only the fight remains.

desc.zh: 你猝不及防地卷入了战斗！
desc.en: You were caught unprepared for battle.

desc.zh: 战士们的先祖应召由地下世界而出，猛攻向敌，直至再次于世间消逝
desc.en: The warriors' ancestors are summoned from the underworld, rising up to strike at the enemy with a furious assault before vanishing into the earth once more.

desc.zh: 奸奇的祝福在施法者身上流动，使他们能够更好地控制战场上的魔法之风
desc.en: The blessings of Tzeentch flow through the caster, offering greater control over the Winds of Magic as they blow across the battlefield.

desc.zh: 『那都不算剑…这才是剑！』
desc.en: "That's not a sword... THIS is a sword."

desc.zh: 大阴谋者的原始力量引入了一道闪电之中，去欺骗、引诱和篡变
desc.en: The Great Conspirator's raw power, channelled into a single strike of lightning to fox, confound and transform.

desc.zh: 这是来自天堂自身的强大力量，如同震旦大军般集结列阵
desc.en: The awesome power of the heavens themselves, marshalled and ranged just like Cathay's grand armies.

desc.zh: 与纳垢军队交锋的不幸凡人，将发现自己会在慈父的病态魔法影响下行动迟缓，寸步难行
desc.en: Those unfortunates ranged against Nurgle and His forces will find themselves slowed and hampered by His peculiarly diseased magicks.

desc.zh: 『走近点，你这凡人。有种…难以觉察的东西把你吸引到了我的身边，激起了深藏已久的感情…来吧，这是你真正的主人在说话…』
desc.en: "Come closer, mortal being. Something almost… imperceptible draws you to me, stirring feelings hitherto buried… Come, it is your true master speaking..."

desc.zh: 慈父赐予他的忠实信徒的最大礼物，便是通过可怕的死亡获得重生的承诺
desc.en: The greatest gift bestowed by the Urfather upon His faithful is the promise of being reborn anew through hideous, pestilent death.

desc.zh: 一顿美餐总能在某种程度上恢复活力，然而不幸的是，如果附近仍有战斗要打，这顿饭可能没那么快吃完
desc.en: A good meal will always regenerate to some extent but, critically, may well slow one down if there's still some fighting to be done.

desc.zh: 战士的额头上长出额外的犄角，增加其攻击的成功率，从而增加击杀敌人的概率
desc.en: An extra horn bursts forth from the warriors' foreheads, increasing the possibility that attacks will be successful, and in turn the likelihood of the kill.

desc.zh: 『今天我就是这里最伟大的战士。我不需要寻找敌人，他们可以来找我！』
desc.en: "I am the greatest warrior here today. I need not seek out a foe, they can come to me!"

desc.zh: 仇恨的力量使恐虐的军队获得了超乎寻常的神力，从而以恐虐之名大杀四方
desc.en: The concentrated power of hatred gives the armies of Khorne energy beyond their normal means to hack and slay in His name.

desc.zh: 『…里面充满了蛆。只要我们心情好，就会让它们变成温暖的脓疱和污疹！』
desc.en: "…bowels gushing with maggots. While we’re in the mood, warm pustules and smegma!"

desc.zh: 石既能碎，则肉体与骨骼如何？
desc.en: If it does this to rock, just imagine the effect on ephemeral flesh and bone.

desc.zh: 火雨从天而降，所触之物无不化为灰烬
desc.en: Flames rain from the sky, turning anything they touch into a pile of ash.

desc.zh: 凡世与超凡位面的屏障受到了进一步的削弱，更多的恶魔涌入了这个世界
desc.en: The barriers between mortal and immortal planes are further weakened, and yet more Daemons enter the world.

desc.zh: 凡世与超凡位面的屏障受到了进一步的削弱，更多的恶魔涌入了这个世界
desc.en: The barriers between mortal and immortal planes are further weakened, and yet more Daemons enter the world.

desc.zh: 凡世与超凡位面的屏障受到了进一步的削弱，更多的恶魔涌入了这个世界
desc.en: The barriers between mortal and immortal planes are further weakened, and yet more Daemons enter the world.

desc.zh: 凡世与超凡位面的屏障受到了进一步的削弱，更多的恶魔涌入了这个世界
desc.en: The barriers between mortal and immortal planes are further weakened, and yet more Daemons enter the world.

desc.zh: 凡世与超凡位面的屏障受到了进一步的削弱，更多的恶魔涌入了这个世界
desc.en: The barriers between mortal and immortal planes are further weakened, and yet more Daemons enter the world.

desc.zh: 完美亲王的战士们蜂拥而出，沐浴在最深沉、最美丽的忧郁和最变态的遗憾中，然后把这些感觉变成最甜蜜的屠杀
desc.en: The Perfect Prince's warriors surge forth, bathing in the deepest, most beautiful melancholy and the most perverse notions of regret, then turning those feelings into the sweetest carnage.

desc.zh: 那些认为征服寒冷的基斯里夫是小事一桩的傻瓜们，实际上最好还是做好持久战的准备吧
desc.en: Those fools who believed it would be a trifling matter to conquer freezing-cold Kislev better hunker down for a very long haul indeed.

desc.zh: 只要你相信，大地就会喷涌出它的愤怒：厄孙的化身来打击他的敌人
desc.en: Believe enough and the very ground shall spew forth its wrath: the very embodiment of Ursun come to smite His enemies.

desc.zh: 如同惊雷滚过战场，石角兽以地崩山摧之音炸向敌军
desc.en: Like a mighty thunderstorm rolling across the battlefield, the Stonehorns are borne towards the enemy with a crashing roar.

desc.zh: 熊神之怒充溢心间，则勇士定将无可阻挡
desc.en: Men imbued with the ire and fury of the Great Bear become as equally hard to break as they are fierce.

desc.zh: 辜尔之风 – 以野性的本能迅速而猛烈地冲锋
desc.en: The Wind of Ghur – charge fast and hard as feral instincts take over.

desc.zh: 沙许之风 – 死亡会很快降临到你所面对的敌人身上
desc.en: The Wind of Shyish – death comes fast to the foes you face.

desc.zh: 阿克夏之风 – 世界燃烧着，去点燃它吧
desc.en: The Wind of Aqshy – the world burns, be the one to light it.

desc.zh: 艾吉尔之风 – 仰望天空，从远处寻找厄运
desc.en: The Wind of Azyr – look to the heavens and and seek doom from afar.

desc.zh: 纪伦之风：拥抱生命的力量，赶走疲劳，只有活力永存
desc.en: The Wind of Ghyran – embrace the power of life, chase away fatigue, and only vigour shall remain.

desc.zh: 海希之风 – 照亮敌人并让你的军队活力倍增
desc.en: The Wind of Hysh – illuminate the foe and see your own forces enlivened.

desc.zh: 虔门之风 – 用金属包裹你自己，让这种能量来加强你的力量
desc.en: The Wind of Chamon – clad yourself in metal and let this energy fortify your forces.

desc.zh: 乌尔枯之风 – 阴影快速移动，从黑暗中进入光明
desc.en: The Wind of Ulgu – shadows move fast, striking from the dark into the light.

desc.zh: 这面旗帜充满了篡变的力量，足以扭曲周围的世界，将人类和动物变成恶心退化的产物
desc.en: So saturated is this banner with the power of change that it distorts the world around it, turning man and beast to revolting, degenerative spawn.

desc.zh: 这面战旗由混沌众神的愤怒编织而成，可以向所有毁灭之敌释放他们的怒火
desc.en: This standard is woven from the wrath of the Chaos Gods, and can unleash their fiery fury directly at the enemies of Ruin.

desc.zh: 这面旗帜让色孽恶魔们欣喜若狂，只要还有身体可以抚摸，他们就不在乎战斗是赢是输
desc.en: This standard fills Slaaneshi Daemons with such euphoria that they care not whether the battle is won or lost provided there are still bodies to caress.

desc.zh: 这面被大牧首亲自祝福的残破战旗，是基斯里夫母亲在大难面前不屈反抗精神的有力象征
desc.en: Blessed by the Grand Patriarch himself, this torn cloth scrap is a potent symbol of Mother Kislev's unbending defiance in the face of insurmountable odds.

desc.zh: 这面旗帜上闪耀着黑光，将毁灭之力的成千上万次胜利映照在了对手的肉体之上
desc.en: Rays of dark light shimmer about this standard, scouring scenes from a thousand-thousand Ruinous victories upon the flesh of its bearer's opponents.

desc.zh: 所有看到这面邪恶战旗的人，都会在破旧的旗面上惊觉他们内心深处的恐惧，从而极大地影响了他们坚持下去的意志
desc.en: All who look upon this unholy standard see their innermost fears reflected upon its ragged cloth, which greatly affects their will to persevere.

desc.zh: 这面战旗上绣满了守护符文，可以阻止敌人的法师接触魔法之风，并遏制恶魔最为惧怕的咒文
desc.en: This standard's focused runes of warding deny enemy Wizards access to the Winds of Magic and the spells that cause Daemons most harm.

desc.zh: 这面破碎的战旗乃是部落曾经遇到过，却被消灭了的所有凡世种族旗帜拼合起来的产物
desc.en: A crude yet inspiring patchwork of banners taken from every one of the mortal races the tribe has encountered and subsequently had for dinner.

desc.zh: 符文大胃不断地发出低吼，当它探测到魔法时就会变成掠食性的咆哮，用一个响亮的嗝把奥术能量吐出来
desc.en: The Rune Maw constantly emits a low growl that rises to a predatory roar when it detects magic, spitting the arcane energies back out with a loud belch.

desc.zh: 恶魔般的塞壬被囚禁在这面旗帜中，它那诱人的歌声抚慰着所有听到它的敌人
desc.en: A Daemonic Siren is imprisoned in this banner, its seductive song dulling the senses of the foes that hear it.

desc.zh: 这面旗帜不断地在位面中闪烁，在现实中制造出一道裂缝：在那里，黑暗诸神的力量在剧烈地咆哮着
desc.en: This banner constantly flickers in and out of existence, creating a tear in reality through which the power of the Dark Gods flows ever more strongly.

desc.zh: 龙帝的旗帜鼓舞着随驾出征的战士们，同时在不谐的对手身上播下混乱和恐慌
desc.en: The Dragon Emperor's banner inspires those warriors fighting in sight of it, while seeding disorder and panic in their disharmonious opponents.

desc.zh: 『让咱们看看，他们怎么杀过来！』
desc.en: "Let's see them get through this!"

desc.zh: 『让咱们在这儿死守吧！』
desc.en: "Let us make our stand here!"

desc.zh: 『坚守阵地，向敌人开火！』
desc.en: "Hold your ground and fire at the enemy!"

desc.zh: 『这是个陷阱！』
desc.en: "This is a trap!"

desc.zh: 法师召唤野性世界的力量，将其赐予自身选择的盟友，从而强化他们的攻击力
desc.en: The Wizard calls upon the strength of the wild world and bestows it upon his chosen allies, increasing the ferocity of their attack.

desc.zh: 呛人的尘埃从法师的指尖喷涌而出，敌人一旦触碰，无不窒息而死
desc.en: A choking dust cloud erupts from the Wizard's fingertips, suffocating the foes in its path and dragging them to their deaths.

desc.zh: 法师在岩石内部点燃火焰，令地面砰然碎裂，狂暴的世界生命之血喷涌而出，吞噬敌人
desc.en: The Wizard sets a fire within the very rock itself, causing the ground to splinter and the raging lifeblood of the world to gush forth and consume the enemy.

desc.zh: 法师将一柄小石锤投过战场，天空的闪电狂怒自其尾流呼啸而出
desc.en: The Wizard hurls a tiny stone hammer across the battlefield, and the heavens vent their electrical fury in its wake.

desc.zh: 狂暴的风吹向一位嗜血狂魔，来蹂躏杀戮领主那不幸的对手
desc.en: The raging winds draw forth a Bloodthirster to savage the ill-omened opponents of the Murder Lord.

desc.zh: 原始的生命能量在战场上流动，治愈伤势，令新进倒下的战士重新恢复活力
desc.en: Raw life-energy flows across the battlefield, mending wounds and restoring the fallen to fresh vigour.

desc.zh: 法师踏入命运之锦，变更时间的流动以适应盟友的需求，令其能够更为顽强、更为迅捷地战斗
desc.en: The Wizard reaches into the tapestry of fate, altering the flow of time to suit his allies' needs, who then fight on harder and faster than ever before.

desc.zh: 法师吟诵变化术的三字真言，抛出一个灿烂的熔融圆球，径直击穿敌人的行伍
desc.en: Speaking the three sacred syllables of transformation, the Wizard hurls a brilliant, molten sphere through the enemy's ranks.

desc.zh: 法师制作出一把无弦琴，奏响一首难以释怀的挽歌，驱走所有的希望和紧迫感，使敌人变得脆弱不堪
desc.en: The Wizard produces a stringless fiddle and plays a haunting dirge that drives all sense of hope and urgency away, rendering the foe passive and prone.

desc.zh: 食人魔的饮食以富含蛋白质出名，所以可以想见他们的屁能是个什么味！不出你所料，敌人闻到了肯定不会高兴
desc.en: Ogre diets are notoriously protein-heavy, ensuring their farts are less than fragrant! As you might expect, the enemy are not best pleased.

desc.zh: 足以造成比普通的长矛更为严重的伤害
desc.en: More than the usual injuries caused by something that's much more than an ordinary spear.

desc.zh: 『死亡，即如侵髓之霜；紧闭门扉，亦不可挡。纵使盛夏，再起芬芳；我等亦难逃冰雪之殇』
desc.en: "Death is like a winter chill; No door can keep it from us; And summer yet may bloom again; Though ice be all upon us."

desc.zh: 从矿石中提取金属的科学可以使用魔法充能，并在战争中发挥破坏性的功效
desc.en: The science by which metals are extracted from their ores can be charged by magic and given purpose in war to devastating effect.

desc.zh: 从矿石中提取金属的科学可以使用魔法充能，并在战争中发挥破坏性的功效
desc.en: The science by which metals are extracted from their ores can be charged by magic and given purpose in war to devastating effect.

desc.zh: 从矿石中提取金属的科学可以使用魔法充能，并在战争中发挥破坏性的功效
desc.en: The science by which metals are extracted from their ores can be charged by magic and given purpose in war to devastating effect.

desc.zh: 从矿石中提取金属的科学可以使用魔法充能，并在战争中发挥破坏性的功效
desc.en: The science by which metals are extracted from their ores can be charged by magic and given purpose in war to devastating effect.

desc.zh: 『真是撕心裂肺，现在他气得要命。要是我是你，我早就跑了…轰！』
desc.en: "That's torn it – now 'e's all angry like. I'd run if I were yoo… BOOM!"

desc.zh: 『添点这个，加点那个，再来点别的，然后…往后站！』
desc.en: "A little bit of this, a pinch of that, and a touch of the other and... stand well back!"

desc.zh: 当你为午餐准备了恰到好处的鸡尾酒，任何有判断力的东西都不能阻挡你…
desc.en: When you've had just the right cocktail of incendiary ingredients for lunch, nothing with an ounce of sense will stand in your way…

desc.zh: 漩涡般的火焰包围了使用者，但出人意料的是，这反而大大提高了他们的技艺
desc.en: By which a vortex of fire surrounds the user; surprisingly, this improves their skills considerably.

desc.zh: 黑夜的黑暗将是他们的披风。近卫秘警会以更快的速度追杀冰雪女王的敌人，并且不会暴露身姿
desc.en: The dark of night shall be their cloak. Unseen, the Akshina pursue the Ice Queen's enemies with even greater quickening.

desc.zh: 恐虐的忠诚狂信徒打开了大门，让这位神祗的邪恶神选放血鬼们涌进凡世，并消灭可恶的敌人
desc.en: Khorne's loyal Cultist forces open the gate to allow His vicious, chosen Bloodletters to surge through and consume the inauspicious enemy.

desc.zh: 为了纳垢的腐败大业，狂信徒悍然开启了大门，将大量肮脏恶心的携疫者放进了凡世，从而包围并感染敌人
desc.en: The Cultist hauls open the gate to allow yet more foul, droning Plaguebearers to shuffle into existence to surround and infect the enemy.

desc.zh: 狂信徒打开了大门，让堕落的欲魔得以冲进凡世，怀着永恒的饥饿肆意捕杀猎物
desc.en: The Cultist holds the gate open so alluring Daemonettes can surge through and have at the foe, as if starved of sustenance for an eternity prior.

desc.zh: 纯粹的篡变以粉色惧妖的形式踏入了凡世，咯咯地笑着，蹦蹦跳跳地走向敌人
desc.en: Undiluted Change in the form of Pink Horrors tumble through into this world, giggling and capering towards the foe.

desc.zh: 这种神秘的爆炸将撕裂的冰碎片推向敌人，足以将任何卷入这场风暴的人撕成碎片
desc.en: This eldritch explosion propels lacerating shards of ice outwards, devastating anyone caught in its deadly squall.

desc.zh: 狂信徒悍然打开了大门，让一只暴戾的嗜血狂魔踏足凡世，暴打杀戮领主的可悲敌人
desc.en: The Cultist braces the gate open so that a raging Bloodthirster can enter reality and savage the ill-omened opponents of the Murder Lord.

desc.zh: 狂信徒开启了纳垢之门，一个大不净者从裂缝中出现，肆意杀戮他的敌人
desc.en: The Cultist holds open Nurgle's gate while a Great Unclean One emerges from the crevice to lay waste to his foes.

desc.zh: 狂信徒开启了大门，让一位守密者踏入凡世并野蛮地攻击毫无察觉的敌人
desc.en: The Cultist forces open the gate, allowing a Keeper of Secrets to bound through and savage the uncomprehending enemy.

desc.zh: 狂信徒打开了缝隙，让一位万变魔君进入了现实世界，向毫无防备的敌人展示巨大的希望和野心
desc.en: The Cultist prises open the aperture, enabling a Lord of Change to enter reality and level great hope and towering ambition at the unsuspecting enemy.

desc.zh: 这个食人魔暴得大名：他抡着大棍向地面一砸，但见地面轰然破碎，上面的敌人无不震得七荤八素
desc.en: This Ogre is infamous for thudding his club on the ground, making it shake and shatter, and taking the enemy with it.

desc.zh: 冰雪王廷的专家们可以召唤出一只凶残的剑齿虎来猛击敌人，在很短的时间内把他们撕成碎片
desc.en: Adepts of the Ice Court can summon forth a vicious, sabre-toothed battle-cat to savage their enemies' ranks, tearing them to bloody shreds in decidedly short order.

desc.zh: 冰雪王廷的专家们可以召唤出一只凶残的剑齿虎来猛击敌人，在很短的时间内把他们撕成碎片
desc.en: Adepts of the Ice Court can summon forth a vicious, sabre-toothed battle-cat to savage their enemies' ranks, tearing them to bloody shreds in decidedly short order.

desc.zh: 冰雪王廷的专家们可以召唤出一只凶残的剑齿虎来猛击敌人，在很短的时间内把他们撕成碎片
desc.en: Adepts of the Ice Court can summon forth a vicious, sabre-toothed battle-cat to savage their enemies' ranks, tearing them to bloody shreds in decidedly short order.

desc.zh: 一根最坚硬的坚冰利刺由地上射出，如精准的炮弹般刺穿敌方的行伍
desc.en: A mighty spike of the hardest ice blasts forth to impale ranks of enemies like a well-aimed cannonball from below.

desc.zh: 军锋对恐虐的尽忠之心胜于一切，这使他们能够通过自己超自然的，充满怨恨和鄙视的恶魔光环抵抗魔法攻击
desc.en: The Herald's dedication to Khorne exceeds all else, enabling them to resist magical attack via their unnatural, Daemonic aura of rancorous disdain.

desc.zh: 『什么？我们为什么要…？呃，我在哪儿？我是谁？为什么是我？！』
desc.en: "What? Why are we…? Er, where am I? Who am I? Why am I?!"

desc.zh: 篡变会以多种形式出现…而在这种情况下，死亡会迅速从天而降
desc.en: Change comes in many forms… Death, in this instance, is brought down swiftly from above.

desc.zh: 这一核心附近的部队越多，魔法之风的充能就会越强
desc.en: The more units in the immediate vicinity of this focal point, the more the Winds of Magic are recharged.

desc.zh: 抵抗是徒劳的，因为它只会导致更大的痛苦和更长久、更痛苦的死亡
desc.en: Resistance is futile, for it will only lead to greater suffering and a longer, more agonising demise.

desc.zh: 『到我身边来吧，邪恶的伙伴们。借由我的手，慈父那枯萎的触碰将使你如获新生』
desc.en: "Come to my side, o pestilent comrades. Through me, the Urfather's withering touch shall restore and renew you."

desc.zh: 愤怒——万物中最强大的力量，毋庸置疑
desc.en: Anger is an energy – the most powerful force in all creation. Never doubt it.

desc.zh: 这名战士以优雅流畅的姿态在战场上游走，仿佛每一次动作都蕴含着舞蹈的美感，使他能够轻而易举地躲避来袭的攻击，因为黑暗亲王庇佑着他的每一个举动
desc.en: The warrior glides with a beauteous, smooth elegance that enables them to simply avoid blows as if in slow motion, for the Dark Prince has blessed their every move.

desc.zh: 当最宝贵的猎物就在咫尺之遥时，神选战士们会激发出超乎寻常的速度与敏捷
desc.en: When the most precious of rewards is but a hair's breadth away, the chosen warrior will move with preternatural speed and agility.

desc.zh: 蓝色惧妖会从这里冲出混沌荒原，嘲笑、抱怨并挤压出敌人的最后一息
desc.en: Blue Horrors will emerge here from the Chaos Wastes, sneering, grumbling and squeezing every last breath from the foe.

desc.zh: 蒙苍蝇领主升魔的战士们会因其令人作呕的恩惠而茁壮成长…真是对自然规律的亵渎
desc.en: Wholly and perversely against nature, those warriors elevated to Daemonhood by the Fly Lord will prosper and surge through His disgusting gifts and boons.

desc.zh: 恐虐军锋发现，由血神亲身赐予的纯粹愤怒会令他们自身的激情更上一层楼
desc.en: Khorne's Heralds find that the pure, unadulterated ire channelled directly from the Blood God Himself drives their own impetuous vehemence to even greater heights.

desc.zh: 『别折腾了，虫子，现在去死吧！』
desc.en: "Enough of that flailing about, worm. Now you die!"

desc.zh: 『白鸟庄严圣耀辉，羞携烦惧向天飞…』
desc.en: "Glorious bird of shimmering white, put pain and fear to shameful flight…"

desc.zh: 想象一下，当敌人发现他们长久以来压箱底的技能毫无作用时，他们会多么惊讶！在近卫秘警的狂热攻击面前，他们几乎等于赤身裸体！
desc.en: Imagine the foe's surprise when they find their hitherto held-back capability does not work, leaving them as naked before the Akshina's zealous strike.

desc.zh: 『杀生霹雳长空奔，托尔轰雷立断魂！』
desc.en: "Thunder is strong and lightning is death, with Tor's wrath a flash-bolt takes their breath!"

desc.zh: 无论战况如何，绝不放弃，绝不投降。宁受死，不受辱！
desc.en: Never give up, never surrender, no matter what happens. Choose death over the way of the craven.

desc.zh: 熊父毛骨悚然的嚎叫令基斯里夫将士们在他的旗下重整，他们的命运永远交织在一起，祖国的命运悬于旗帜之上
desc.en: The blood-curdling howl of Father Bear rallies the men of Kislev to his banner, for their fortunes are forever entwined, and the fate of the Motherland hangs in the balance.

desc.zh: 这个食人魔喜欢把自己的身子拍得肥肉乱颤，这就是他嘲讽敌人的方式
desc.en: An Ogre whose proclivity is for slapping his body, making his flesh ripple and repel the foe.

desc.zh: 所有食人魔都喜欢大吼大叫，但巨吼的声音是真的非常大。可以大喊大叫。当他不打架时，这股吼声足以让他的同伴们火冒三丈！
desc.en: All Ogres can shout, but a Bigbellower can really, really yell. When he's not fighting, this rouses his colleagues for the fray.

desc.zh: 如果死亡是通过魔法手段降临到了你的头上，那么你很有可能会骗过它…至少这次确实如此
desc.en: Assuming death is coming for you via magical means, there's a high chance you'll cheat it... this time at least.

desc.zh: 当下定决心时，忠于牧首的勇士们会发现自己的身躯与思维都获得了抵御攻击的抗力
desc.en: When he wills it so, those loyal to the Patriarch will find their minds and bodies bolstered against attack.

desc.zh: 这是大人物中的最伟大者。就算纵观整个食人魔王国，能叫盛筵的也是少之又少！他周围所有的人都会坚定地奋战！
desc.en: The greatest of Big Names. There have been few Grandfeasters in all the Ogre Kingdoms! All around are steeled for the fight.

desc.zh: 当巨大的劫难击溃祖国母亲的防线时，它的战士们总能重拾力量与信念，夺取最终的胜利
desc.en: When calamity crashes in waves against the Motherland's defences, its warriors always find the strength and spirit needed to succeed.

desc.zh: 团结起来的人，活得就会更长久，毕竟人多力量大
desc.en: Those who stick together, stay alive a tad longer – there's safety in numbers after all.

desc.zh: 有时候，独身一人全力前行会让你赚到很多的头颅
desc.en: Sometimes, going at it full tilt, on your lonesome, pays dividends in skulls for the pile.

desc.zh: 无论是有着天生的敏锐，还是凑巧掌握了合适的工具，总之，真正的尖兵很少会放过他的目标
desc.en: Uncannily keen or just possessed of the right tools for the job, a true spotter is one that few can hide from.

desc.zh: 牧首那无可动摇的自信与狂热会强烈地鼓舞附近的战士，令其更为努力地战斗
desc.en: The Patriarch's unshakeable belief in himself and his creed pushes the warriors around him to fight to the bitter end.

desc.zh: 龙神统治了震旦数世纪之久。他们的权力永远不会受到帝国臣民的质疑，他们也完全知晓自己在世上的地位和角色
desc.en: The Dragons have ruled Cathay for centuries. Their power will never be questioned by their imperial subjects, who understand their place and role in the world perfectly.

desc.zh: 这股火焰的颜色乃是变幻莫测、深邃明亮的天蓝色，一旦炸开，便可迷惑敌人来触碰它们，并将触碰之人烧蚀成灰
desc.en: The colour of this fire is the deep, bright azure of Change, blasted forth to confuse, beguile and burn to a crisp those whom it touches.

desc.zh: 这股火焰的颜色乃是变幻莫测、深邃明亮的天蓝色，一旦炸开，便可迷惑敌人来触碰它们，并将触碰之人烧蚀成灰
desc.en: The colour of this fire is the deep, bright azure of Change, blasted forth to confuse, beguile and burn to a crisp those whom it touches.

desc.zh: 混沌之门的背后是什么？当然是篡变，以及随之而来的疯狂躁动
desc.en: What lies beyond the Gate of Chaos? Why, Change, of course, with all the maddening tumult which that entails.

desc.zh: 混沌之门的背后是什么？当然是篡变，以及随之而来的疯狂躁动
desc.en: What lies beyond the Gate of Chaos? Why, Change, of course, with all the maddening tumult which that entails.

desc.zh: 当汇聚体内的毁灭之力完成聚焦充能时，你所需的只是简单地一挥
desc.en: When all the Ruinous power inside you is charged and focused, a single, devastating blow is all that's needed.

desc.zh: 当汇聚体内的毁灭之力完成聚焦充能时，你所需的只是简单地一挥
desc.en: When all the Ruinous power inside you is charged and focused, a single, devastating blow is all that's needed.

desc.zh: 恐之主的恶魔仆人奋战得越久，他的疯狂杀戮就会越有效率
desc.en: The longer Kharneth's Daemonic servant remains in the fray, doing His dreadful work, the more efficient they become.

desc.zh: 恐之主的恶魔仆人奋战得越久，他的疯狂杀戮就会越有效率
desc.en: The longer Kharneth's Daemonic servant remains in the fray, doing His dreadful work, the more efficient they become.

desc.zh: 对于被毁灭之力奴役的恶魔亲王，大量的鲜美灵魂便是通往荣耀之路的盛宴
desc.en: To the Daemon Prince in thrall to Ruin, souls provide fine and plentiful sustenance on the way to glory.

desc.zh: 对于被毁灭之力奴役的恶魔亲王，大量的鲜美灵魂便是通往荣耀之路的盛宴
desc.en: To the Daemon Prince in thrall to Ruin, souls provide fine and plentiful sustenance on the way to glory.

desc.zh: 这套精心制作的盔甲似乎有着自己的思想：随着敌人的无脑冲锋，它似乎越来越沉醉于惩戒敌人
desc.en: This finely-wrought suit of armour seems to have a mind of its own – appearing to revel in punishing foes in proportion to the mindlessness of their charge.

desc.zh: 『带我去那个神奇的时刻，在那辉煌的夜晚，那是明天的孩子们的梦想…』
desc.en: "Take me to the magic moment, upon glory night, where the children of tomorrow dream…"

desc.zh: 如果你的死亡概率高到无可避免，那就记得拉上尽可能多的敌人一齐赴死！
desc.en: If there's a strong chance that you might die, take as many of the enemy with you as possible.

desc.zh: 瘟疫领主喜欢从死亡线上救回他的忠仆，这样他们就可以继续传播他的腐蚀，而无需担忧死亡的困扰
desc.en: The Plague Lord likes to pull His beloved servants back from the brink, so they may continue to spread His rot untroubled by death.

desc.zh: 敌人被一种令人昏昏欲睡的香水淹没，无论周围多么喧嚣吵闹，也是于事无补
desc.en: The enemy are overtaken by a somniferous perfume that induces sleep in spite of the din raging all about them.

desc.zh: 如同钢铁一样，愤怒也可以经受回火与强化，直至硬度与光泽抵达最大的限度
desc.en: Like steel, rage can be tempered and buffed until maximum hardness and shine have been achieved.

desc.zh: 在祈求毁灭之力赐下无可阻挡的原始混沌力量之后，恶魔亲王发动了前所未见的猛攻
desc.en: Having implored the Ruinous Powers to imbue him with the inexorable, raw power of Chaos, the Daemon Prince attacks with even greater vigour than before.

desc.zh: 生于衰朽之物，总会比以前更强大、更有力、更令人生厌
desc.en: From decay something new arises, always stronger, more powerful, and more disgusting than before.

desc.zh: 震耳欲聋的音爆会把敌人扔过战场，让他们晕头转向，当然前提是他们能活下来！
desc.en: A colossal, ear-splitting burst of sound will hurl the foe across the battlefield, leaving them disorientated – assuming of course they survive the experience!

desc.zh: 混沌诸神的黑暗术士使用诸神永不熄灭的容器引发疯狂的篡变涌浪，吞噬施法者的敌人
desc.en: Through His ever-willing vessel, the Dark Sorcerer of the Chaos Gods can cause broiling waves of maddening Change to engulf spellcasting foes.

desc.zh: 没有任何凡人可以挡住他们
desc.en: No mortal host shall hold them back.

desc.zh: 猎杀惊呆凡人的灵魂，乃是最为愉悦之事，因为此举会带来最为甜美的奖赏
desc.en: There's no chase like the pursuit of petrified mortal souls, for the prize is the sweetest of all.

desc.zh: 它会在残酷的厮杀中让恶魔保持平衡，但这个附件也是这个怪物的一项全新武器，足以用来打击毁灭大军的对手
desc.en: Though it also aids balance during the hurly-burly of brutal conflict, this appendage gives this monstrous creature a further weapon with which to smite the opponents of Ruin.

desc.zh: 当战场上的魔法之风最为炽烈时，混沌诸神的黑暗术士们会从其中汲取更多的魔力
desc.en: The dark, violent sorceries of the Chaos Gods draw further power from the Winds of Magic when they are blowing their hardest across the battlefield.

desc.zh: 不合格的人选将永远饱尝苦痛，并被更为合适的候选者所取代
desc.en: Those who fail to make the grade are consigned to writhing, agonising forms for eternity and replaced with more promising candidates.

desc.zh: 斩获的首级必须送至颅座顶部，敬献杀戮领主，如此方可确保力量的获得
desc.en: The score must be kept just as surely as the harvested skulls be delivered to the Lord of Murder, atop His mighty Skull Throne.

desc.zh: 战场上涌动的魔法漩涡可以推动恶魔亲王，让他们如同飞行般穿梭
desc.en: The magical eddies flowing across the battlefield can be harnessed to propel the Daemon Prince ever faster, as if flying.

desc.zh: 战略战术可以从书本上学到，但必须通过实战经验的磨练
desc.en: Strategy and tactics can be learned from a book, but only honed through experience in the field.

desc.zh: 在面对汹汹而来的大群敌人时，震旦丹鼎师需要一副好身板，而这瓶红色的试剂能提供远远高于这一需求的防护能力
desc.en: To be a Cathayan alchemist afore the disapproving masses takes a thick skin, but the reddish liquid within this phial goes far beyond that.

desc.zh: 当天帝的利益需要以更多的攻杀来保证时，震旦最伟大的战士们就会进一步提升自己的战斗力
desc.en: The fighting prowess of Cathay's greatest can be taken in draught form when a further burst of aggression is needed to tip the balance in the Celestial Emperor's favour.

desc.zh: 这种配料不仅能让服用者杀伤对手，还能以此在伤口中注入致命的毒素
desc.en: This concoction enables the taker to not just wound their opponent, but set deadly poison in the lacerated flesh as well.

desc.zh: 巴纳加以自己的大嗓门与对所有孬不拉的彻底蔑视而闻名，他的发明会产生一连串的爆炸，清空使用者面前的所有敌人
desc.en: Famous for his loud voice and total contempt for all Gnoblars, Bannaga's invention causes a line of explosions to clear the foe from the bearer's path.

desc.zh: 这片布满红色血管的黑色岩石是恐虐血域的一部分，它随着恶魔的鲜血而悸动着，直至放血鬼们呼啸而出，纵情享受他们的残暴盛宴
desc.en: A fragment of Khorne's blood-soaked realm, this dark, red-veined rock bulges and pulses with Daemon blood until Bloodletters burst forth to do his vicious bidding.

desc.zh: 当这个瓷球扔向敌人时，它会喷出无法熄灭的火油，并紧紧地黏在敌人身上，一瞬之间便可烧穿其皮肤
desc.en: When thrown at the foe, the sputtering, unquenchable fluid within this porcelain ball sticks to their skin, quickly burning through it with a savage intensity.

desc.zh: 肮脏而颤动的脓包迅速生长，然后突然爆裂，把它令人作呕的液体连同其中所有的疾病全部溅到敌人身上
desc.en: This filthy, pulsating blister rapidly grows before suddenly bursting, showering the enemy with its disgusting fluid and all the maladies contained within.

desc.zh: 对于使用华丽饰品宣扬自身领导地位的做法，食人魔向来嗤之以鼻，但这并不意味着他们不屑于抢劫死者，毕竟这种玩意可以让他们更加努力地大掠天下
desc.en: Ogres don't believe in declaring their leadership qualities via trinkets, but that doesn't mean they're above robbing the dead if it inspires their forces to push even harder.

desc.zh: 这是乌里沙皇的妻子送给他的礼物，这枚精美的珐琅珠宝冰霜妖龙蛋乃是传奇珠宝匠人加斯图瓦最后也是最伟大的杰作
desc.en: A gift to Tsar Uriy from his wife, this exquisitely enamelled and bejewelled blown Frost Wyrm egg was the final and greatest masterwork of legendary jeweller Gastuva.

desc.zh: 『嗜血者』格鲁特的烹饪品味似乎一直附着在他生锈的镰刀中，这把镰刀令屠户可以更有效地控制魔法之风，但会以自己的健康为代价…
desc.en: Grut the Bloodthirsty's culinary malevolence seems to live on in his rusty sickle, which gives the Butcher greater command over the Winds, but at a cost to his own health.

desc.zh: 通过强制挤压这颗浸满脓汁，充溢腐蚀的混沌之卵心脏，屠户可以创造出一个扰乱魔法的漩涡，从而迷惑使用魔法的对手
desc.en: By forcing this ichor-soaked, Ruin-imbued heart of a foul Chaos Spawn down, the Butcher may create a vortex of magical anarchy that beguiles magic-using adversaries.

desc.zh: 冰寒吹息的魔法冲击波会阻碍敌人的前进，使他们几乎无法抵御攻击
desc.en: A magical blast of frosty breath hinders and hampers the enemy's progress, leaving them little able to defend themselves from attack.

desc.zh: 这块怪异而超凡的造物来自大胃神周围的破碎土地，一旦激活，便可极大地增加友军法师的魔力
desc.en: When activated, this strange, extra-worldly artefact from the broken lands around the Great Maw greatly increases the power of friendly Wizards' spells.

desc.zh: 这种刺激性的青色液体很受天南海北的射手们的欢迎，它可以协助摄入者精准地找出目标的弱点并引导其射击
desc.en: A friend to marksmen of all creeds, this piercing cyan liquid allows its imbiber to pick out weak spots and guide their shots true.

desc.zh: 这个无色的水晶可以将照射其上的光线分流强化，扭曲成让人炫目不安的色彩，在战斗中进一步增强施法者的力量
desc.en: This colourless crystal splits and intensifies light that falls upon it, twisting it into dazzling and unsettling hues that further empower the spellcaster in combat.

desc.zh: 受人爱戴的圣阿努什卡在冰封的湖面上拯救了一个婴儿，却为此献出了生命。她的遗骸因此成为了圣物，可以治疗和恢复使用者的身体
desc.en: The beloved Saint Annushka met her end rescuing an infant from a frozen lake. This relic from her beatified remains heals and restores its user's body.

desc.zh: 这种盔甲由昊龙的鳞片制作而成，只有最伟大的震旦英雄才能穿戴，从而令他们不仅可以抵抗攻击，还能毫无障碍地穿越地形
desc.en: Fashioned from scales of the Celestial Dragon himself, this armour is worn only by the greatest Cathayan heroes, that they may resist blows and traverse terrain without impediment.

desc.zh: 此卷轴可以使持有者将魔法之风重置为先前的等级，每场战斗仅限一次
desc.en: Possession of this scroll enables the bearer – just once during a battle – to reset the Winds of Magic to their former levels.

desc.zh: 旗帜的旗杆上厚厚地镶嵌着恐虐受害者的头骨，每个头骨上都刻有黄铜蚀刻的屠杀符文
desc.en: The pole of this banner is thick-set with the captured skulls of Khorne's victims, each marked with a brass-etched rune of slaughter.

desc.zh: 这个看似简单的雪花形吊坠会不断改变自己的形状，每次都会变成全新的样式
desc.en: Apparently a simple pendant in the shape of a snowflake, it constantly changes its form, adopting a new and unique shape each time.

desc.zh: 这根附魔法杖由玉龙元伯制成，拥有操纵精气之风，随意改变其强弱程度的能力
desc.en: Created by the Jade Dragon Yuan Bo, this enchanted staff has the power to manipulate the Elemental Winds themselves, causing them to blow stronger or weaker on command.

desc.zh: 这只号角取自一种不为人知但明显巨大的野兽，为基斯里夫杰出猎兽家族的几代人以父传长子的形式代代相传了下来
desc.en: Taken from an unknown but clearly massive beast, this horn has been handed from father to eldest son through generations of Kislev's pre-eminent family of beast hunters.

desc.zh: 这种奴役器具会让携带者通过铁器上的血迹治愈自己，但仅限一次有效
desc.en: This implement of enslavement enables the bearer to heal themselves, once only, through the blood stained upon its iron.

desc.zh: 这些书页上记载的乃是混沌之风的奥秘。可惜这本魔法宝典是一个善变淘气的恶魔，很不愿意配合
desc.en: Inked upon these pages are the fundamental secrets of the Winds of Chaos. Alas, the grimoire is a fickle and mischievous Daemon, little given to co-operation.

desc.zh: 疯狂法师马卡曾经妄图奴役恶魔，却最终还是失败了。虽然这个符文已经现世多次，但它的创造者似乎已经消失了…
desc.en: The mad mage M'kar's plans to lure Daemons to his service eventually went awry. Though the glyph has been seen many times since, its creator seems to have vanished…

desc.zh: 纵使只剩一块石头，永恒的必然之城总有办法重生
desc.en: So long as a single stone remains, the ageless Inevitable City shall always rebuild itself.

desc.zh: 当钟摆摆动时，敌方施法者会发现自己的法力毫无力道可言
desc.en: When the pendulum swings, the foe's spellcasters find themselves powerless and magically impotent.

desc.zh: 扎克·阿鲁奥格雕像常伴猎首部落的萨满瓦兹胡姆帕身旁，协助他施放来自绿皮诸神本身的力量
desc.en: Thrumming with the magic of Wazwhoompa, Shaman of the 'Eadhuntaz, the Idol of Zak-Aloooog unleashes the might of the Greenskin gods themselves.

desc.zh: 这些铁甲中灌注着巨熊的无限力量，在它的保护下，即使鲍里斯身负重伤也能继续战斗下去
desc.en: Instilled with the Great Bear's limitless strength, these iron plates enable Boris to continue the fight even when gravely injured.

desc.zh: 奏者的手指不由自主地拨动琴弦，演奏出一曲激动人心的曲调，让攻杀不止的达兹战士们愈发振奋起来
desc.en: The bearer's fingers move over its strings of their own accord, weaving a rousing tune to inspire Dazh's warrior consorts as they do their deadly work.

desc.zh: 纵使基斯里夫只流出一滴血，它的战士们都会士气大涨，斗志昂扬，誓死保卫自己的国家
desc.en: When even a single drop of Kislev's blood is spilled, its fighters morale and resolve is strengthened in the nation's defence.

desc.zh: 这个雕像所描述的是远方印地千神中的一位。由于未知的原因，黑暗诸神的崇拜者对它有着一种特殊的恐惧
desc.en: This effigy depicts one of the thousand gods worshipped in far-off Ind. For reasons unknown it holds a particular horror for worshippers of the Dark Gods.

desc.zh: 那些被困在窑洞里的人不仅会被彻底焚烧，其抗火能力也会受到大幅削弱
desc.en: Those caught in the kiln's ambit find themselves not only seared and scorched, but any resistance to fire they may have is weakened considerably.

desc.zh: 斯卡拉格的坩埚已成为了这位前任屠宰大师为他的饕餮之神献上贡品的工具
desc.en: Skrag's cauldron has become a tool by which the former Slaughtermaster makes blessed offerings to his ravenous god.

desc.zh: 斯卡拉格的坩埚已成为了这位前任屠宰大师为他的饕餮之神献上贡品的工具
desc.en: Skrag's cauldron has become a tool by which the former Slaughtermaster makes blessed offerings to his ravenous god.

desc.zh: 这副长袍会提醒周围的战士们，他们正为宁和与秩序而战
desc.en: Sight of the robe reminds those close to it that they fight for the forces of harmony and order.

desc.zh: 这是伟大的司天丞魄魅的法宝，它会令穿戴者获得非凡的魔力，并且驾驭一种精气之风
desc.en: A relic of the great Astromancer Po Mei, this enchanted cloak grants its wearer exceptional magical strength and mastery over one of the Elemental Winds.

desc.zh: 当冰雪女王施放强大的庇护或杀伤法术时，这件魔法斗篷会显著提升她的防御能力
desc.en: This magical cloak increases the Ice Queen's defensive capabilities at the very moment she casts her powerful spells of protection or death.

desc.zh: 这些来自昆兰峰顶的稀有水晶既能保护其持有者，也能在战斗中释放致命的魔法能量
desc.en: These rare crystals from the peaks of Kunlan protect their bearer but can also unleash a deadly blast of sorcerous energy when struck in battle.

desc.zh: 最强烈、最迷人的气味可以分散敌人的注意，使他们在血腥的战斗中步伐缓慢，从而削弱他们的攻击力
desc.en: The strongest, most captivating scent distracts the foe from the bloody business at hand, slowing them and weakening their attack.

desc.zh: 谁不喜欢喝一杯？你不想和谁并肩作战，那就是谁！
desc.en: Who doesn't like a drink? No one you want to be fighting alongside, that's who!

desc.zh: 破坏敌人进攻时的协调性，大大降低其冲击威力
desc.en: The cohesion of the foe's attack is broken, greatly reducing its impact.

desc.zh: 在大量的场合中，这个孬不拉便携工具包会为传统的食人魔钝力暴砸加上很多颇有妙用的『惊喜』元素
desc.en: Among a host of other uses, this handy bit of Gnoblar kit brings a much-needed element of surprise to the blunt-force trauma the Ogres traditionally provide.

desc.zh: 这个可怕的魔法武器是个镶嵌钉刺与象牙的指虎，它会找到配得上自己的食人魔，然后暂时与他合作
desc.en: With punch-spikes of iron and tusk embedded into the knuckles, this formidable enchanted weapon drags itself to a worthy Ogre who may then claim it for a time.

desc.zh: 这个抛光的黄铜腹甲上有一组银色的颚片，可以直接将猎物刺入大胃神体内，并吸取他们的生命力
desc.en: This polished brass gut-plate features a set of silver jaws that pass kills straight into the Great Maw, and their lifeforce to the bearer.

desc.zh: 战争永无止境，而战士们却会始终如初次踏上战场之时，精神饱满，随时准备杀戮
desc.en: The war will never end, yet its warriors shall ever fight as if they have just stepped onto the battlefield, fresh and primed to kill.

desc.zh: 这个附魔标记能使施法者更容易地传播纳垢的恶臭瘟疫，对于被其光环覆盖之人有着更强的效果
desc.en: This enchanted mark enables the spellcaster to spread Nurgle's foul pestilence more easily, and has a progressively stronger effect on those caught within its aura.

desc.zh: 这面魔法旗帜会令施法者在施法后更迅捷地驾驭魔法之风
desc.en: This symbol of enchantment enables swifter harnessing of the Winds of Magic following the casting of a spell.

desc.zh: 采自冰川核心的超密集寒冰碎片，编织成了一套散发出彻骨深寒的黑色铠甲
desc.en: Fashioned from scales of super-dense ice hewn from a glacial core into a suit of black mail, from which emanates a numbing cold.

desc.zh: 这个魔法护符能够让法师更为灵便地驾驭魔法之风，增加其法力储量，并提高其充能速度
desc.en: This enchanted amulet gives the Wizard more control over the Winds of Magic, increasing their reserves and improving their rate of recharge.

desc.zh: 这尊鲜活的雕像由一整块玉石雕刻而成。狮子是魔力的媒介，可以提高附近友军的士气
desc.en: A living statue crafted from a block of jade, the lion is a conduit for sorcery and can improve the morale of any friendly troops in its vicinity.

desc.zh: 这只风筝取材于天坛创造者所培育的鸾鸟的毛皮，可以极为有效地对抗空中的敌人
desc.en: Made from a section of the actual hide of the Luan bird familiar of the founding Master of the Celestial Temple, this kite deals with airborne enemies most effectively.

desc.zh: 用完美无瑕的冰块制成的手镜，带有错综复杂的霜饰框架，足以反弹敌人的攻击
desc.en: A hand mirror fashioned from flawless ice, with an intricate frame of frostwork, will reflect the foe's violence back on himself.

desc.zh: 如盆大小的王冠镶嵌着宝石，直接钉在格雷苏·大金牙凹凸的头骨上，将他的智力提高到了接近人类的水平
desc.en: A basin-sized crown encrusted with gems and nailed directly into Greasus Goldtooth's lumpy skull, which enhances his intellect to near human levels.

desc.zh: 在这神圣旗帜的保护下，康斯坦丁会获得无与伦比的精神抗性，其强度甚至超过了他对厄孙不可动摇的信仰
desc.en: Protected by this sacred banner, Kostaltyn may have better resistance to psychic attack than ever before, beyond even than that provided by his utterly unshakeable faith in Ursun.

desc.zh: 食人魔挖出了自己的一只眼睛，把它扔进了大胃神体内。此后，他或许会在周围捡起一颗鹅卵石放进眼眶里，从而让自己拥有第二视觉
desc.en: Having gouged out one of his eyes and cast it into the Great Maw, an Ogre may fit a pebble from the ground around the pit to give himself second sight.

desc.zh: 大棒是一种有用的工具：无论是强迫自己人服从，还是迫使敌人屈服，都是如此
desc.en: A big stick is a useful implement, especially when it can command the obedience of the enemy as well as your own troops.

desc.zh: 强者可以以自身为代价治愈弱者，并坚持战斗到底
desc.en: The strong can heal the weak at their own expense and still fight to the bitter end.

desc.zh: 这面强大的护盾由长垣的一部分雕刻而成，可以提供无与伦比的防护能力
desc.en: This mighty shield, carved from a section of the Great Bastion, offers unequalled protection.

desc.zh: 绳子、木头、头发、铁钉和兽皮，这些物件被拼凑成了一幅可怕的仪式装备，里面充满了食人魔手下败将们的恐惧
desc.en: Ropes, wood, hair, iron nails and hide are twisted into a hideous ritual mask infused with the fears of the Ogres' defeated foes.

desc.zh: 最优秀的战斗必然充斥着暴力美学，就像最复杂的舞蹈的精确编排一样：每一个美妙的举动，都会使神尊守密者更为靠近杀戮的高潮
desc.en: The finest combat is beautiful to behold, like the precision choreography of the most complex of dances – each delicious move bringing the Exalted Keeper of Secrets closer to the killing climax.

desc.zh: 斯卡布兰德召唤出他所有的愤怒和仇恨，并将其集中成一声毁灭性的狂怒咆哮，足以令毫无准备的敌人肝胆俱裂
desc.en: Skarbrand summons up all his rage and hatred and concentrate it into a devastating furious howl that can shake the unprepared enemy ranks to their very core.

desc.zh: 恐虐端坐于颅座之上，操控着血魔杀手的所有仇恨。这些神选忠仆发出令人毛骨悚然的尖叫，令不幸的敌人们毛骨悚然，惨死当场
desc.en: Channelling all the rancour of the blood-crazed killer upon the Skull Throne, His chosen servant emits a bloodcurdling scream to make the unfortunate foe quake and die in their boots.

desc.zh: 苍蝇浑身浸透在腐烂肠子的脓血中，成群地包围敌人，阻碍着他们的攻击动作
desc.en: Flies, drenched in the pustulent gore of rotting intestines, swarm and surround the foe, hampering their blows and haltering their attacks.

desc.zh: 对嗜血杀戮的极度渴望，以更为迅捷，更为疯狂的力道驱策着恐虐的仆人
desc.en: The all-consuming craving for blood and slaughter drives forth Khorne's faithful servants with even greater speed and fury.

desc.zh: 他们心中无尽的愤怒一旦具象化，便是血神恶魔仆人周围的一场死亡爆炸
desc.en: The physical manifestation of their endless, furious anger is an explosion of fiery death all around the Blood God's Daemonic servant.

desc.zh: 蛮勇的敌方巫师咒语，如果没有正确的防护，就会引来恶魔攫取的目光
desc.en: The incantations of a foolhardy enemy Wizard, uttered without the correct warding and protections in place, have drawn a Daemon's predatory gaze.

desc.zh: 这把剑的每一击都会越砍越猛，无多时便会令整个战场血流成河
desc.en: Cutting harder and deeper with each and every blow, this blade ensures that the blood of Kharneth's enemies flows like a river across the battlefield.

desc.zh: 这把剑的每一击都会越砍越猛，无多时便会令整个战场血流成河
desc.en: Cutting harder and deeper with each and every blow, this blade ensures that the blood of Kharneth's enemies flows like a river across the battlefield.

desc.zh: 这一妖术会让敌人重新考虑他们的选择——或许领着队伍前去赴死并不是个好主意？
desc.en: This hex makes the foe reconsider their options – perhaps leading a warband into almost certain death isn't quite such a good idea after all?

desc.zh: 龙神以其正义之名，乘风云而起风暴，于风暴眼中轻而易举地发动攻击，一如秋风扫落叶般将敌人一举歼灭
desc.en: From the epicentre of the raging tempest of their righteousness, the Dragon strikes with effortless ease, sweeping the foe away like so many leaves on the wind.

desc.zh: 穿上熊神的斗篷之后，厄孙的狂怒就会在敌群中散播恐惧，让他们在理智与疯狂间游走
desc.en: Taking on the mantle of the Bear himself, Urskin's furious rage terrifies his foes, walking the finest line between control and frenzy.

desc.zh: 有时，深渊也在凝视着你，它会向你揭示世间的真谛。这种震撼足以令敌人心惊胆寒，呆立原地
desc.en: Sometimes, the abyss stares right back at you, and true perspective is revealed. The shock freezes the foe where they stand.

desc.zh: 猎食者会在暗夜中保持饥饿：毕竟当他们拼杀而出时，敌人只能靠神明的庇佑了！
desc.en: Gorgers are kept hungry and in the dark for good reason: gods help the Ogres' opponents when they are unleashed!

desc.zh: 当你与仅能存在于现时的对手交锋时，几秒之差的过去或未来将是你最好的藏身之处
desc.en: Seconds into the past or future is the perfect hiding place when fighting an adversary tied to the present.

desc.zh: 我们当中最高尚、最智慧、最有经验的人足以进行横向思考，坚信胜利就在眼前，而最重要的是，他有着鼓舞人心的力量
desc.en: The most noble, educated and experienced among us have the means to think laterally, the confidence to know that victory is close at hand, and most importantly, the power to inspire.

desc.zh: 我们当中最高尚、最智慧、最有经验的人足以进行横向思考，坚信胜利就在眼前，而最重要的是，他有着鼓舞人心的力量
desc.en: The most noble, educated and experienced among us have the means to think laterally, the confidence to know that victory is close at hand, and most importantly, the power to inspire.

desc.zh: 我们当中最高尚、最智慧、最有经验的人足以进行横向思考，坚信胜利就在眼前，而最重要的是，他有着鼓舞人心的力量
desc.en: The most noble, educated and experienced among us have the means to think laterally, the confidence to know that victory is close at hand, and most importantly, the power to inspire.

desc.zh: 震旦贵族可以料敌于数招之外，从而令其在防御中占据明显的优势
desc.en: The ability to think several moves ahead of their opponents gives the Cathayan nobles a distinct advantage in matters of defence.

desc.zh: 震旦贵族可以料敌于数招之外，从而令其在防御中占据明显的优势
desc.en: The ability to think several moves ahead of their opponents gives the Cathayan nobles a distinct advantage in matters of defence.

desc.zh: 震旦贵族可以料敌于数招之外，从而令其在防御中占据明显的优势
desc.en: The ability to think several moves ahead of their opponents gives the Cathayan nobles a distinct advantage in matters of defence.

desc.zh: 在学会走路后不久便开始学习射术，这令其在成年后便可百步穿杨，目若鹰隼
desc.en: Being taught to shoot shortly after learning to walk means that by adulthood the magistrate's arrows are true and their eyesight is as acute as the swooping hawk.

desc.zh: 在学会走路后不久便开始学习射术，这令其在成年后便可百步穿杨，目若鹰隼
desc.en: Being taught to shoot shortly after learning to walk means that by adulthood the magistrate's arrows are true and their eyesight is as acute as the swooping hawk.

desc.zh: 在学会走路后不久便开始学习射术，这令其在成年后便可百步穿杨，目若鹰隼
desc.en: Being taught to shoot shortly after learning to walk means that by adulthood the magistrate's arrows are true and their eyesight is as acute as the swooping hawk.

desc.zh: 昭明天资禀异，可以随心所欲地在人身与龙形中切换，从而在最为合适的时刻转换战局
desc.en: Zhao Ming has the innate power to transmogrify from human form to Dragon and back again at will, and often at the most opportune moments.

desc.zh: 昭明天资禀异，可以随心所欲地在人身与龙形中切换，从而在最为合适的时刻转换战局
desc.en: Zhao Ming has the innate power to transmogrify from Dragon form to human and back again at will, and often at the most opportune moments.

desc.zh: 基本的金属可以不断地转化，从而更有力地打击天帝的敌人
desc.en: Base metals may be transmuted and transformed, so that they might strike harder and better at the Celestial Emperor's enemies.

desc.zh: 基本的金属可以不断地转化，从而更有力地打击天帝的敌人
desc.en: Base metals may be transmuted and transformed, so that they might strike harder and better at the Celestial Emperor's enemies.

desc.zh: 基本的金属可以不断地转化，从而更有力地打击天帝的敌人
desc.en: Base metals may be transmuted and transformed, so that they might strike harder and better at the Celestial Emperor's enemies.

desc.zh: 基本的金属可以不断地转化，从而更有力地打击天帝的敌人
desc.en: Base metals may be transmuted and transformed, so that they might strike harder and better at the Celestial Emperor's enemies.

desc.zh: 大群令人作呕的纳垢灵咯咯笑着滚向敌人，随后便是大规模的爆炸，向将腐臭的脓液与臭气向四面八方喷射出去
desc.en: A sickening wave of smiling, giggling Nurglings spills out everywhere, tumbling towards the foe only to explode, sending putrid pus and foetid rot in all directions.

desc.zh: 当卡洛斯与无尽者商议时，他会暂时受到保护，免受伤害
desc.en: Whilst Kairos is consulting with the infinite he is temporarily protected from harm.

desc.zh: 库噶斯的言词与鼓励煽动着他的战士们继续以纳垢的名义传播疾病
desc.en: Words of purpose and encouragement from Ku'gath himself stir his warriors to continue spreading disease in Nurgle's blessed name.

desc.zh: 斯卡布兰德是杀戮领主压抑已久的愤怒的化身。他的现身会让恐虐的战士们变得更为狂怒
desc.en: Skarbrand is the very embodiment of all the Murder Lord's pent-up choler and bile. His presence drives Khorne's warriors to even greater fury.

desc.zh: 斯卡布兰德的疯狂会腐蚀敌人的意志，当战场上一片混乱时，他们会即刻丧失理智
desc.en: Skarbrand's madness corrupts enemy combatants, causing them to rampage as the battlefield is consumed by anarchy.

desc.zh: 当胜利在望时，谨慎被抛向四面八方，狂热发出了诱人的召唤…
desc.en: When victory is thought to be close, caution is cast to the four winds and frenzy beckons enticingly.

desc.zh: 阴影之父将自己包裹在一件黑暗斗篷中，以保护他免受次级魔法的伤害
desc.en: The Father-in-Shadow wraps himself in a cloak of murk that protects him from lesser magicks.

desc.zh: 妙影天资禀异，可以随心所欲地在人身与龙形中切换，从而在最为合适的时刻转换战局
desc.en: Miao Ying has the innate power to transmogrify from human form to Dragon and back again at will, and often at the most opportune moments.

desc.zh: 妙影天资禀异，可以随心所欲地在人身与龙形中切换，从而在最为合适的时刻转换战局
desc.en: Miao Ying has the innate power to transmogrify from Dragon form to human and back again at will, and often at the most opportune moments.

desc.zh: 如果你愚蠢地不选择逃跑，那就使出更大的力量来攻击，因为比拉克会运用毁灭之力来迷惑、引诱、腐蚀和屠杀他的敌人
desc.en: If you unwisely choose not to run, strike far harder than you dare, for Be'lakor wields Ruin's combined might to confuse and tempt and rot and slaughter his foes.

desc.zh: 肮脏恶臭的疾病向来不分贵贱，一视同仁：在纳垢的肮脏感染面前，所有人都难逃厄运
desc.en: Sulphurous, acerbic disease is no respecter of rank, nobility or prowess in battle; all shall fall afore Nurgle's filthy infections.

desc.zh: 肮脏恶臭的疾病向来不分贵贱，一视同仁：在纳垢的肮脏感染面前，所有人都难逃厄运
desc.en: Sulphurous, acerbic disease is no respecter of rank, nobility or prowess in battle; all shall fall afore Nurgle's filthy infections.

desc.zh: 在最黑暗的内心深处，有些人怀着根深蒂固的渴望，渴望痛苦地死去
desc.en: Some beings, in their darkest heart, have a deep-seated desire for an agonising death.

desc.zh: 凡人不可控制的精气，却可以为龙神所把持：当处于人形时，此项能力既可击杀敌人，也可卫护友军
desc.en: Elements thought uncontrollable can be harnessed to do the Dragon's bidding – both to crush their enemies and protect them when in human form.

desc.zh: 斯卡布兰德横行霸道，双斧狂劈，直至无人可杀为止
desc.en: Skarbrand runs rampant, twin axes hacking and cleaving until there is no one left to kill.

desc.zh: 完美亲王难以逃避的美貌诱惑着敌人，令他们流连忘返，甚至无法专注于手头上的血腥杀戮
desc.en: The foe become fascinated by the Perfect Prince's inescapable beauty, which distracts them from the bloody matter at hand.

desc.zh: 当天朝的领主们威震战场时，那些弱小的生物会发现自己的防御无非徒劳之举
desc.en: When battle is brought with shock and awe by the Lords of the Celestial Empire, some weaker creatures find themselves unable to mount a competent defence.

desc.zh: 当康斯坦丁陷入最血腥的混战时，周围的人会在祖国母亲正义之火的加持下更努力、更持久地战斗
desc.en: When Kostaltyn is in the thick of the bloodiest melee, the men around him will fight harder and longer, aided by the righteous fire of their Motherland.

desc.zh: 『忤视龙目，饱尝绝望吧！』
desc.en: "Looks into the eyes of the Dragon and despair!"

desc.zh: 他人的恐惧，乃是完美亲王痛苦盛宴的美酒佳肴
desc.en: Others' fear is meat and drink to the Perfect Prince's Feasters of Pain.

desc.zh: 腐烂的恶臭最终会消磨掉最顽强、最有经验的战士，挫伤他们的斗志，磨灭他们继续战斗的决心
desc.en: The malodorous stink of decay eventually wears down even the hardest, most experienced combatants, dampening their spirits and resolve to press on.

desc.zh: 肆无忌惮的愤怒在恐之主追随者的血管里蔓延，恢复他们的活力以迎接此后的屠杀
desc.en: Unbridled rage courses through the veins of Kharneth's followers, raising them up and restoring them for the slaughter to follow.

desc.zh: 至臻完美展现出的最为纯洁、毫无掺杂的诱惑，就像黄金或最精美的珠宝一样诱人
desc.en: The pure, unadulterated temptation that glorious perfection provides is as alluring as gold or the finest jewels.

desc.zh: 冷静的头脑与艺术家的感觉使战术家成为真正的智将，从而使他能够最有效地指挥麾下的军队
desc.en: A cool head and a craftsman's touch elevates the tactician to become a master of his art, enabling him to marshal his forces to best effect.

desc.zh: 龙对魔法的攻击有着很强的抗性：意志加持下的龙鳞堪比人类所知最为坚硬的金属
desc.en: The Dragon is ever-resilient to magical attack – both scales and will are like the hardest metal known to mortal men.

desc.zh: 『我带来了痛苦…你的苦难就是我的盛宴！』
desc.en: "Distributor of pain... Your loss shall be my gain!"

desc.zh: 『我带来了痛苦…你的苦难就是我的盛宴！』
desc.en: "Distributor of pain... Your loss shall be my gain!"

desc.zh: 身先士卒，力战劲敌，这可绝不是什么值得嗤之以鼻的陋习
desc.en: The ability to lead your force from the front and melee with the best of 'em is not something to be sniffed at.

desc.zh: 『血祭血神！魂献猎手！颅敬颅主！将死亡献给他们吧！』
desc.en: "Blood for the Blood God! Souls for the Hunter! Skulls for the Skull Lord! Death to them all!"

desc.zh: 比拉克的力量越强，他的对手的决心就越弱，直至他们成为黑暗之主利刃的饲料
desc.en: The greater Be'lakor's power, the weaker his adversaries' resolve becomes, until they are but fodder for the Dark Master's blade.

desc.zh: 在没有干扰的情况下，施法者会提高其他人的战斗能力
desc.en: Assuming there are no distractions, the user has the power to improve others' chances in combat.

desc.zh: 仅凭他的现身，库噶斯就能让他身边的纳垢灵们恢复到最完美的膨胀状态
desc.en: By his presence alone, Ku'gath can ensure that the Nurglings around him are restored to optimal bloated fiendishness.

desc.zh: 死亡最终会降临到我们头上，没有人能永远抵挡慈父那恶心的腐烂礼物…
desc.en: Death comes to us all in the end. None can resist the Urfather's gift of vile decomposition forever…

desc.zh: 无论使用的是什么魔咒，他人的技能恢复速度都会比正常情况下快得多
desc.en: No matter the incantation, others' abilities are restored far quicker than would normally be the case.

desc.zh: 看到周围血腥的毁灭，恐之主的领主们欢欣鼓舞，这进一步为他们的屠杀提供了动力
desc.en: Seeing the bloody devastation all around them causes the lords of Kharneth to exult in triumph, further powering their carnivorous slaughter.

desc.zh: 万变之主的仆人瞥见了他们最终的胜利，从而令自己更为斗志昂扬
desc.en: The Changer's servants are shown a glimpse of their final victory, which imbues them with increased fighting vigour.

desc.zh: 孬不拉有许多实际的应用，比如说，在食人魔行军时，就可以拿它当成恢复体力、治疗伤势的零食来吃
desc.en: Gnoblars have a number of practical applications, including healing and revitalising an Ogre when taken as a snack on the move.

desc.zh: 四处逃窜的敌人会眼睁睁看着自己的灵魂脱壳而出，从而斗志尽丧
desc.en: Along with the will to fight on, fleeing enemies find their very souls drawn from their broken bodies.

desc.zh: 战略战术可以从书本上学到，但必须通过实战经验的磨练
desc.en: Strategy and tactics can be learned from a book, but only honed through experience in the field.

desc.zh: 即使在死亡的边缘徘徊，熊神的神选也将继续战斗，利用厄孙无限的韧性来活下去
desc.en: Even at the teetering brink of death, the chosen of the Bear God will fight on, drawing on Ursun's boundless resilience to stay alive.

desc.zh: 龙神的力量可以在短时间内传递给他们忠诚的部队，令他们获得一些抵御魔法攻击的能力
desc.en: The strength of the Dragon can be passed to their loyal troops for a short while, so they may have some resistance to magical attack.

desc.zh: 『再来最后一击…打破队形，冲锋！继续，荣耀就在眼前了…』
desc.en: "Just one final push… Break ranks and charge – go on, glory is in sight now…"

desc.zh: 当先兆者的声音不断地在他们耳边低语时，即使是最坚定的战团成员也会士气动摇
desc.en: Even the most steadfast among a warband may find their morale waver when the Harbinger's voice whispers persistently in their ears.

desc.zh: 恐之主愤怒的狂暴力量能让谋杀之神的追随者们反转他人的咒语，让它们转而在法师的脸上爆炸
desc.en: The furious power of Khornate anger and wrath enables the Murder God's followers to turn back others' spells, causing them to explode in the Wizards' faces.

desc.zh: 施法者面前的一切都会陷入癫狂般的狂喜，忘记一切痛楚与失败，以色孽的名义发动更为疯狂的屠杀
desc.en: Whipped into a frenzy of ecstatic euphoria, all before the spellcaster are made oblivious to pain and defeat, driving them to even greater slaughter in Slaanesh's precious name.

desc.zh: 俭以防匮！对于饥饿的食人魔施法者来说，这些也是珍贵的营养啊！
desc.en: Waste not, want not – it's all good nourishment for the hungry Ogre spellcaster after all.

desc.zh: 慈祥的祖父神纳垢照顾着他心爱的后代，培育他们身上的疾病，从而令其繁荣昌盛
desc.en: Kindly Grandfather Nurgle watches over His beloved offspring, nurturing their diseases to ensure they flourish and prosper.

desc.zh: 『来吧，在纯净的火焰中沐浴，焕然一新，在灰烬与骨骸中重生吧！』
desc.en: "Come, bathe in the purifying flames – be… different, be reborn anew from ash and bone."

desc.zh: 寒冷的暴风迅速升级为彻骨的烈风，令战场上的敌人步履维艰
desc.en: A cold squall quickly escalates into a freezing gale which slows the enemy's movement across the battlefield.

desc.zh: 在庇护基斯里夫的战士的凛冽魔法之风中，刀剑与箭矢都冻得僵硬
desc.en: Blades and arrows freeze solid in the bitter winds of ice magic that shield the warriors of Kislev.

desc.zh: 当施放法术时，阴系法术的毁灭性魔力可以降低敌人的护甲强度
desc.en: The crushing power of the Lore of Yin reduces enemy armour strength whenever a spell is cast.

desc.zh: 当施放法术时，阳系法术的内在化魔力可以强化我方的杀伤威力
desc.en: The innate strength of the Lore of Yang increases the amount of damage done whenever a spell is cast in battle.

desc.zh: 当战争罗盘准备就绪时，其威力所及，就连天体也难以身免
desc.en: When the War Compass is so primed, even heavenly bodies are not outside its devastating reach.

desc.zh: 战争罗盘从天堂引来致命的闪电，将敌人烧成灰烬
desc.en: The War Compass funnels deadly electricity from the heavens to sear and burn and smite the foe.

desc.zh: 你杀得越多，你就能以神祗的名义挥洒更多的鲜血，从而为了他的荣耀而杀害更多的敌人
desc.en: The more you kill, the more blood that you spill in His name, the more you will exsanguinate the enemies of the Blood God for His greater glory.

desc.zh: 『金子…肉…还有啥？或许有战争？但饭与钱是第一位的，特别是饭！』
desc.en: “Gold… meat… What else is there? War, maybe? But dinner and pay come first... 'specially dinner.”

desc.zh: 『没有腿？别爬到我这儿来！』
desc.en: "Got no legs? Don't come crawlin' to me!"

desc.zh: 当附近有新鲜的肉时，食人魔的杀戮水平会更上一层楼
desc.en: When there’s fresh meat in the offing, Ogres are driven to even cruder levels of bludgeonous slaughter.

desc.zh: 这些强大的战士，简直强到了仅用一击就能斩掉龙首，或是仅用一剑便可刺入狮鹫的心脏
desc.en: There are powerful beings who can decapitate a dragon or plunge a sword into the heart of a griffon in one mighty strike.

desc.zh: 这些强大的战士，简直强到了仅用一击就能斩掉龙首，或是仅用一剑便可刺入狮鹫的心脏
desc.en: There are powerful beings who can decapitate a dragon or plunge a sword into the heart of a griffon in one mighty strike.

desc.zh: 熊父毛骨悚然的嚎叫令基斯里夫将士们在他的旗下重整，他们的命运永远交织在一起，祖国的命运悬于旗帜之上
desc.en: The blood-curdling howl of Father Bear rallies the men of Kislev to his banner, for their fortunes are forever entwined, and the fate of the Motherland hangs in the balance.

desc.zh: 熊父毛骨悚然的嚎叫令基斯里夫将士们在他的旗下重整，他们的命运永远交织在一起，祖国的命运悬于旗帜之上
desc.en: The blood-curdling howl of Father Bear rallies the men of Kislev to his banner, for their fortunes are forever entwined, and the fate of the Motherland hangs in the balance.
