desc.en: The blood-curdling howl of Father Bear rallies the men of Kislev to his banner, for their fortunes are forever entwined, and the fate of the Motherland hangs in the balance.

desc.zh: 熊父毛骨悚然的嚎叫令基斯里夫将士们在他的旗下重整，他们的命运永远交织在一起，祖国的命运悬于旗帜之上
desc.en: The blood-curdling howl of Father Bear rallies the men of Kislev to his banner, for their fortunes are forever entwined, and the fate of the Motherland hangs in the balance.

desc.zh: 当黑暗诸神从强大的战争祭坛顶部为虔诚信徒施以祝福时，也就得到了这些信徒永远的忠诚
desc.en: When the Dark Gods bless the assembled faithful from atop their mighty battle-altars, loyalty is assured for evermore.

desc.zh: 你会为了自己的东西而更为英勇地作战
desc.en: You fight harder for what is yours.

desc.zh: 继续努力，城镇很快就是我们的了！
desc.en: Keep pushing, the settlement will soon be ours!

desc.zh: 战士们的先祖应召由地下世界而出，猛攻向敌，直至再次于世间消逝
desc.en: The warriors' ancestors are summoned from the underworld, rising up to strike at the enemy with a furious assault before vanishing into the earth once more.

desc.zh: 黑暗畜生们要小心了，因为法师会释放出一道纯净光波，将白魔法之敌尽数放逐
desc.en: Creatures of the dark beware, for the Mage casts a ball of pure light to banish enemies of White Wizardry.

desc.zh: 一道燃火光环包围着光明火巫，既能护体，亦可烧敌
desc.en: A blazing aura surrounds the Pyromancer's chosen ally, shielding them with protective flame and augmenting their abilities.

desc.zh: 从天空的最高处，法师将一颗游荡的彗星拉向了战场
desc.en: Reaching to the highest heavens, the Wizard draws a wandering meteorite down upon the battlefield.

desc.zh: 法师沐浴在魔法之风中，使用来自生命系法术的重生能力，赋予自身与同伴强大的恢复力
desc.en: Using this charm of rebirth from the Lore of Life, the Wizard taps into the Winds of Magic, bestowing great resilience upon himself and his companions.

desc.zh: 法师使用阴影系法术的技能，让敌人被自身的负担拖垮，直到他们虚弱到只能停滞不前为止
desc.en: By means of the Lore of Shadows, the Wizard causes the enemy to be worn down by their own burdens, until they are enervated to a sorry standstill.

desc.zh: 在烈焰法师或混沌术士的召唤下，猛烈旋转的火柱在战场上喷涌而出，极具杀伤力！
desc.en: Conjured by a Bright Wizard or Chaos Sorcerer, a column of churning fire erupts from the battlefield, causing much destruction!

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向了敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the spellcaster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 施法者占卜吉相，指引着目标的心智，赋予他们远见，并带给他们胜利
desc.en: Divining auspicious signs, the caster guides the minds of targets, augmenting them with the foresight needed for victory.

desc.zh: 黑暗亲王的三尾鞭精妙一吻，敌人就会尝到他那美味的愤怒
desc.en: The exquisite kiss of the Dark Prince's three-tailed whip strikes the enemy with a delicious fury.

desc.zh: 黑暗亲王的三尾鞭精妙一吻，敌人就会尝到他那美味的愤怒
desc.en: The exquisite kiss of the Dark Prince's three-tailed whip strikes the enemy with a delicious fury.

desc.zh: 施法者发出最恶毒的言辞，喷出一股臭气熏天，毒性弥散的烟雾
desc.en: The spellcaster utters the vilest of phrases and belches forth an impossibly foul, poisonous cloud.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出一道仁慈的守护之光，保护盟友免受伤害
desc.en: The Wizard calls upon the beneficent Guardian of Light to protect his allies from harm.

desc.zh: 施法者开启一个通往地狱深渊的漩涡，它将永久地吞噬一切卷入其中之物
desc.en: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.

desc.zh: 法师利用金属系法术的知识，令敌人的盔甲迅速锈蚀腐烂，化为薄弱的雪花
desc.en: Utilising the alchemical Lore of Metal, the Wizard commands the foe's armour to rot, causing it to shed away in clouds of tiny flakes.

desc.zh: 瘟疫领主令敌人长出噩梦般的坏死组织，玷污他们的皮肤，感染他们的内脏
desc.en: The enemy is gifted the Plague Lord's nightmarish necrosis, causing their skin to blacken and their internal organs to mulch.

desc.zh: 就像水蛭吸血一样，巫师向敌人伸出黑檀木之手，通过肮脏的死亡系法术吸走他们的灵魂
desc.en: Just as a leech draws blood, the Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, sucking away their spirit through the tainted Lore of Death.

desc.zh: 在施法者的召唤下，充满灵体的云雾将覆盖敌军，无形的利爪狠狠掐住敌人的咽喉
desc.en: At the spellcaster's command, nebulous nature spirits assail the foe, clawing with hands not nearly as insubstantial as they first appear.

desc.zh: 这一法术会从地面召唤出粗糙而扭曲的树枝，紧紧罩住敌人并使其窒息而亡
desc.en: This spell causes gnarled, fibrous hands to emerge from beneath the ground, dragging the foe to a claustrophobic, suffocating end.

desc.zh: 追随着不苟言笑的战士贝加纳的命运，施法者的怒火却是让自己的敌人活活笑死
desc.en: Following the fate of the unsmiling warrior, Bjuna, the targets of the caster’s ire will laugh themselves to death.

desc.zh: 将敌人的武器转化为铅块。如此一来，这种沉重的东西就无法发挥出战斗力，更不用说有效杀伤对方了
desc.en: Transformed into lead, the foe’s weapons become heavy, cumbersome, and almost impossible to wield in battle, let alone use effectively.

desc.zh: 火与风的漩涡扭曲了透过它们所能看到的一切，在敌军中肆意播撒混乱，令其不堪一击
desc.en: A vortex of fire and wind distorts everything seen through it and sows disorder and confusion among the enemy, leaving them vulnerable.

desc.zh: 施法者将一把骨头塞进嘴里，一边嚼碎它们，一边诅咒他的敌人：他们会被一只巨拳压碎，化为尘土
desc.en: Stuffing a handful of bones into his mouth, the spellcaster crunches them up whilst cursing his foes, who are crushed by a giant fist which pounds them to dust.

desc.zh: 施法者将一把骨头塞进嘴里，一边嚼碎它们，一边诅咒他的敌人：他们会被一只巨拳压碎，化为尘土
desc.en: Stuffing a handful of bones into his mouth, the spellcaster crunches them up whilst cursing his foes, who are crushed by a giant fist which pounds them to dust.

desc.zh: 施法者咬穿一颗首级，吞噬首级的大脑，将死者最可怕的噩梦投射到敌人的脑海中，从而削弱他们的战斗意志
desc.en: The spellcaster chomps through a severed skull, gobbling up the brain and projecting the decapitated victim's worst nightmares into enemies' minds, sapping their will to fight on.

desc.zh: 施法者咬穿一颗首级，吞噬首级的大脑，将死者最可怕的噩梦投射到敌人的脑海中，从而削弱他们的战斗意志
desc.en: The spellcaster chomps through a severed skull, gobbling up the brain and projecting the decapitated victim's worst nightmares into enemies' minds, sapping their will to fight on.

desc.zh: 吞下披毛犀或丧牙兽的心脏，将原始的力量投射至大胃神体内，从而强化食人魔的攻击力
desc.en: Devouring the heart of a bull Rhinox or Mournfang, raw vitality is projected into the Great Maw, increasing the ferocity of the Ogres' attacks.

desc.zh: 吞下披毛犀或丧牙兽的心脏，将原始的力量投射至大胃神体内，从而强化食人魔的攻击力
desc.en: Devouring the heart of a bull Rhinox or Mournfang, raw vitality is projected into the Great Maw, increasing the ferocity of the Ogres' attacks.

desc.zh: 屠户可以召唤大胃神本身的力量，从而撕开大地，将敌人困于其中，碾为肉糜
desc.en: The Butcher can summon the power of the Great Maw itself, causing the ground beneath to split wide open and crush any foe trapped within it.

desc.zh: 屠户可以召唤大胃神本身的力量，从而撕开大地，将敌人困于其中，碾为肉糜
desc.en: The Butcher can summon the power of the Great Maw itself, causing the ground beneath to split wide open and crush any foe trapped within it.

desc.zh: 施法者嚼烂一大块足以崩碎大牙的花岗岩，从而将岩石本身的坚实赐予他的同袍们
desc.en: By consuming a hunk of tooth-breaking granite, the spellcaster bestows the rock's resilience and the sturdiness of the mountains themselves into his brethren.

desc.zh: 施法者嚼烂一大块足以崩碎大牙的花岗岩，从而将岩石本身的坚实赐予他的同袍们
desc.en: By consuming a hunk of tooth-breaking granite, the spellcaster bestows the rock's resilience and the sturdiness of the mountains themselves into his brethren.

desc.zh: 吞下一颗毒性十足，恶心十足的巨魔心脏后，食人魔的伤口会奇迹般地迅速愈合，令敌人目瞪口呆
desc.en: After downing the toxic and utterly repulsive innards of a Troll, the Ogres' wounds seem to stitch themselves together before their enemies' dumbfounded eyes.

desc.zh: 吞下一颗毒性十足，恶心十足的巨魔心脏后，食人魔的伤口会奇迹般地迅速愈合，令敌人目瞪口呆
desc.en: After downing the toxic and utterly repulsive innards of a Troll, the Ogres' wounds seem to stitch themselves together before their enemies' dumbfounded eyes.

desc.zh: 构装体由寒冰本身编织而成，以保护基斯里夫勇敢的士兵免受敌人的攻击
desc.en: Constructs are woven from the ice itself, sheltering Kislev's courageous soldiers from the onslaught of their foes.

desc.zh: 构装体由寒冰本身编织而成，以保护基斯里夫勇敢的士兵免受敌人的攻击
desc.en: Constructs are woven from the ice itself, sheltering Kislev's courageous soldiers from the onslaught of their foes.

desc.zh: 战士们在寒冷中颤抖，刺骨的寒冷直击内心，直至最后他们无法再迈出一步
desc.en: Warriors shiver and shake in a wintry grasp until the piercing cold reaches their hearts and, finally, they move no more.

desc.zh: 战士们在寒冷中颤抖，刺骨的寒冷直击内心，直至最后他们无法再迈出一步
desc.en: Warriors shiver and shake in a wintry grasp until the piercing cold reaches their hearts and, finally, they move no more.

desc.zh: 噼啪作响的魔法能量包裹着将士们的武器，为其注入了致命的新属性。若是敌人不幸被这些刀锋刺穿，就会浑身冰冷，痛苦万分地死去
desc.en: Crackling magical energy envelopes the unit's weapons, imbuing them with deadly new properties. Those impaled on these murderous blades will die in frozen agony.

desc.zh: 噼啪作响的魔法能量包裹着将士们的武器，为其注入了致命的新属性。若是敌人不幸被这些刀锋刺穿，就会浑身冰冷，痛苦万分地死去
desc.en: Crackling magical energy envelopes the unit's weapons, imbuing them with deadly new properties. Those impaled on these murderous blades will die in frozen agony.

desc.zh: 对于漫步冰封平原与冰雪覆盖的基斯里夫苔原之人，无论走到哪里，他都怀着祖国母亲冰冷的心
desc.en: At one with the frozen plains and snowy tundra of Kislev, wherever this one goes, they bring the icy heart of the Motherland with them.

desc.zh: 对于漫步冰封平原与冰雪覆盖的基斯里夫苔原之人，无论走到哪里，他都怀着祖国母亲冰冷的心
desc.en: At one with the frozen plains and snowy tundra of Kislev, wherever this one goes, they bring the icy heart of the Motherland with them.

desc.zh: 麻木的寒冬之吻足以让皮肤结上冰霜，让任何生物感受彻骨深寒
desc.en: The numbing kiss of winter is enough to have hoarfrost crystalise on the skin, chilling any creature to the bone.

desc.zh: 麻木的寒冬之吻足以让皮肤结上冰霜，让任何生物感受彻骨深寒
desc.en: The numbing kiss of winter is enough to have hoarfrost crystalise on the skin, chilling any creature to the bone.

desc.zh: 漫天飞雪，以至基斯里夫的敌人必须跋涉而过。此刻空气本身变成了一堵几乎不透明的冰墙，没有人能穿越它
desc.en: Such is the volume of snowfall that Kislev's enemies must wade through that the air itself becomes a near-opaque wall of ice no gaze can penetrate.

desc.zh: 随着施法者念出咒文，他的属下会韧性附身，而他的敌人则会惊恐地看着自己的肢体不断凋零
desc.en: As the caster speaks, his followers are blessed with resilience, whilst his enemies watch in horror as their limbs wither and drop off.

desc.zh: 随着施法者念出咒文，他的属下会韧性附身，而他的敌人则会惊恐地看着自己的肢体不断凋零
desc.en: As the caster speaks, his followers are blessed with resilience, whilst his enemies watch in horror as their limbs wither and drop off.

desc.zh: 随着施法者念出咒文，他的属下会韧性附身，而他的敌人则会惊恐地看着自己的肢体不断凋零
desc.en: As the caster speaks, his followers are blessed with resilience, whilst his enemies watch in horror as their limbs wither and drop off.

desc.zh: 你能想到的最为恶心的增生组织突然出现了：刚刚砍出的伤口上瞬间长出了摇摇欲坠的肥大肉瘤
desc.en: The most repulsive growth spurt imaginable occurs – the wobbling mounds of fat sealing wounds as soon as they are formed.

desc.zh: 你能想到的最为恶心的增生组织突然出现了：刚刚砍出的伤口上瞬间长出了摇摇欲坠的肥大肉瘤

desc.en: The most repulsive growth spurt imaginable occurs – the wobbling mounds of fat sealing wounds as soon as they are formed.

desc.zh: 空气中弥漫着最为腐烂的气味，令附近的敌人呕吐不止，怕是要把肚子里的一切饭食全都呕出来
desc.en: The most putrescent vapour fills the air, loosening lunches and bowels, and causing violent, crippling vomiting seizures in nearby foes.

desc.zh: 空气中弥漫着最为腐烂的气味，令附近的敌人呕吐不止，怕是要把肚子里的一切饭食全都呕出来
desc.en: The most putrescent vapour fills the air, loosening lunches and bowels, and causing violent, crippling vomiting seizures in nearby foes.

desc.en: The most putrescent vapour fills the air, loosening lunches and bowels, and causing violent, crippling vomiting seizures in nearby foes.

desc.zh: 肮脏而颤动的脓包迅速生长，然后突然爆裂，把它令人作呕的液体连同其中所有的疾病全部溅到敌人身上
desc.en: This filthy, pulsating blister rapidly grows before suddenly bursting, showering the enemy with its disgusting fluid and all the maladies contained within.

desc.zh: 肮脏而颤动的脓包迅速生长，然后突然爆裂，把它令人作呕的液体连同其中所有的疾病全部溅到敌人身上

desc.zh: 剧毒的气体和胆汁从施法者的病变肺部喷涌而出，令人作呕的脓液劈头盖脸地洒向敌人
desc.en: A poisonous spurt of diseased gas and bile spews forth from the spellcaster's diseased lungs, drenching the enemy in vile, choking pus.

desc.zh: 剧毒的气体和胆汁从施法者的病变肺部喷涌而出，令人作呕的脓液劈头盖脸地洒向敌人

desc.en: A poisonous spurt of diseased gas and bile spews forth from the spellcaster's diseased lungs, drenching the enemy in vile, choking pus.

desc.zh: 施法者的腐蚀触碰能使目标在短时间内进入幸福、愉悦的状态，使他们几乎不能移动，更不用说自卫了
desc.en: The spellcaster's corrupting touch puts their victims into a blissful, euphoric state for a short time, rendering them little able to move, let alone defend themselves.

desc.zh: 施法者的腐蚀触碰能使目标在短时间内进入幸福、愉悦的状态，使他们几乎不能移动，更不用说自卫了

desc.zh: 施法者的敌人被非理性的情绪所吞噬，极度的痛苦和狂喜，导致他们陷入了疯狂的暴怒
desc.en: The caster's victims are engulfed by a torrent of unreasoning emotion, excruciating pain and blissful rapture, causing them to embark on a riotous, clawing rampage.

desc.zh: 施法者的敌人被非理性的情绪所吞噬，极度的痛苦和狂喜，导致他们陷入了疯狂的暴怒

desc.zh: 色孽邪恶黑暗舞蹈中的呼啸会让敌人骨头痉挛，直至折断
desc.en: Whistling one of Slaanesh’s perverse darkling dances causes the foe's bones to jerk spasmodically until they break.

desc.zh: 色孽邪恶黑暗舞蹈中的呼啸会让敌人骨头痉挛，直至折断
desc.en: Whistling one of Slaanesh’s perverse darkling dances causes the foe's bones to jerk spasmodically until they break.

desc.zh: 复杂的魔符被施展开来，一系列不断变换的幻化图像使敌人知觉尽失，迷惑不已，最终步入死亡
desc.en: A complex sigil is performed, transfixing the enemy with a shifting array of hallucinatory images that disjoint and befuddle, inviting their deaths.

desc.zh: 复杂的魔符被施展开来，一系列不断变换的幻化图像使敌人知觉尽失，迷惑不已，最终步入死亡
desc.en: A complex sigil is performed, transfixing the enemy with a shifting array of hallucinatory images that disjoint and befuddle, inviting their deaths.

desc.zh: 复杂的魔符被施展开来，一系列不断变换的幻化图像使敌人知觉尽失，迷惑不已，最终步入死亡
desc.en: A complex sigil is performed, transfixing the enemy with a shifting array of hallucinatory images that disjoint and befuddle, inviting their deaths.

desc.zh: 天空中化出一面镜子，随即粉碎成无数致命的碎片，割伤地面上的敌人
desc.en: A mirror forms in the sky only to be shattered into a myriad of deadly shards that lacerate the enemy below.

desc.zh: 天空中化出一面镜子，随即粉碎成无数致命的碎片，割伤地面上的敌人
desc.en: A mirror forms in the sky, only to be shattered into a myriad of deadly shards that lacerate the enemy below.

desc.en: A mirror forms in the sky only to be shattered into a myriad of deadly shards that lacerate the enemy below.

desc.zh: 魔法之风幻化成强大而冰冷的狂风，冰冷的碎片劈头盖脸地砸向敌人
desc.en: The Winds of Magic are gathered into a mighty, freezing gale that slashes at the enemy with icy shards.

desc.zh: 魔法之风幻化成强大而冰冷的狂风，冰冷的碎片劈头盖脸地砸向敌人
desc.en: The Winds of Magic are gathered into a mighty, freezing gale that slashes at the enemy with icy shards.

desc.zh: 魔法之风幻化成强大而冰冷的狂风，冰冷的碎片劈头盖脸地砸向敌人
desc.en: The Winds of Magic are gathered into a mighty, freezing gale that slashes at the enemy with icy shards.

desc.zh: 冰雪袭掠大地，超自然的深寒冰冻并致盲了路途上的所有人
desc.en: Snow and ice rise from the land, freezing and blinding any and all in their path with an unnatural cold.

desc.zh: 冰雪袭掠大地，超自然的深寒冰冻并致盲了路途上的所有人
desc.en: Snow and ice rise from the land, freezing and blinding any and all in their path with an unnatural cold.

desc.zh: 如同内心深处获得了指引一般，所有的弹丸都会射得更快，射得更远
desc.en: Projectiles of all kinds can be fired faster and further, as if guided by a sentient essence deep within.

desc.zh: 如同内心深处获得了指引一般，所有的弹丸都会射得更快，射得更远
desc.en: Projectiles of all kinds can be fired faster and further, as if guided by a sentient essence deep within.

desc.zh: 拳头大小的冰片从空中倾泻而下，撕裂敌人并使其屈服
desc.en: A deluge of lacerating, fist-sized shards of ice falls from the sky, battering the foe into submission.

desc.zh: 拳头大小的冰片从空中倾泻而下，撕裂敌人并使其屈服
desc.en: A deluge of lacerating, fist-sized shards of ice falls from the sky, battering the foe into submission.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出恐惧、仇恨与骇人的冰冷灵魂，释放瘆人心扉的哭喊，狠狠折磨着所有看到这一幕的人们
desc.en: The spellcaster summons frozen spirits of fear, hatred, and dread, that loose fearful cries, tormenting all others who bear witness.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出恐惧、仇恨与骇人的冰冷灵魂，释放瘆人心扉的哭喊，狠狠折磨着所有看到这一幕的人们
desc.en: The spellcaster summons frozen spirits of fear, hatred, and dread, that loose fearful cries, tormenting all others who bear witness.

desc.zh: 施法者与盟友盟友会化为一团青色的模糊能量，以难以置信的速度划破天空，然后恢复为此前的自然形态
desc.en: The spellcaster and their allies become a blur of cyan energy which darts through the air at incredible speed before coalescing back into their natural form.

desc.zh: 施法者与盟友盟友会化为一团青色的模糊能量，以难以置信的速度划破天空，然后恢复为此前的自然形态
desc.en: The spellcaster and their allies become a blur of cyan energy which darts through the air at incredible speed before coalescing back into their natural form.

desc.zh: 只需将手一扭，施法者就会以蓝色的妖焰吞噬自己的对手
desc.en: With a twist of the hand, the spellcaster causes the bodies of their opponents to be consumed by coruscating blue flames.

desc.zh: 只需将手一扭，施法者就会以蓝色的妖焰吞噬自己的对手
desc.en: With a twist of the hand, the spellcaster causes the bodies of their opponents to be consumed by coruscating blue flames.

desc.zh: 只需将手一扭，施法者就会以蓝色的妖焰吞噬自己的对手
desc.en: With a twist of the hand, the spellcaster causes the bodies of their opponents to be consumed by coruscating blue flames.

desc.zh: 施法者侵入敌人的心灵，窃取他们的魔法，为自己的邪念所用
desc.en: Reaching into his enemy's mind, the spellcaster steals their sorcery for his own diabolical use.

desc.zh: 施法者侵入敌人的心灵，窃取他们的魔法，为自己的邪念所用
desc.en: Reaching into his enemy's mind, the spellcaster steals their sorcery for his own diabolical use.

desc.zh: 施法者侵入敌人的心灵，窃取他们的魔法，为自己的邪念所用
desc.en: Reaching into his enemy's mind, the spellcaster steals their sorcery for his own diabolical use.

desc.zh: 一道通往混沌魔域的传送门就此开启，这道凡世间的魔法裂痕会吸走周围之人的理性，如此他们将直面自己的毁灭，就算侥幸不死，也会彻底疯狂
desc.en: A portal to the Realm of Chaos opens; a magical tear in the mortal plane that sucks those nearby inside to face certain madness, if not their doom.

desc.zh: 一道通往混沌魔域的传送门就此开启，这道凡世间的魔法裂痕会吸走周围之人的理性，如此他们将直面自己的毁灭，就算侥幸不死，也会彻底疯狂
desc.en: A portal to the Realm of Chaos opens, a magical tear in the mortal plane that sucks those nearby inside to face certain madness, if not their doom.

desc.en: A portal to the Realm of Chaos opens; a magical tear in the mortal plane that sucks those nearby inside to face certain madness, if not their doom.

desc.zh: 汹涌的彩虹能量从施法者身上流出，以灼热的锥形魔法火焰吞没敌人
desc.en: A roiling tide of iridescent energy flows from the spellcaster, enveloping their enemies in a cone of searing magical flame.

desc.zh: 汹涌的彩虹能量从施法者身上流出，以灼热的锥形魔法火焰吞没敌人
desc.en: A roiling tide of iridescent energy flows from the spellcaster, enveloping their enemies in a cone of searing magical flame.

desc.en: A roiling tide of iridescent energy flows from the spellcaster, enveloping their enemies in a cone of searing magical flame.

desc.zh: 施法者在敌人心中低语，巧妙煽动起了怀疑与背叛的阴火
desc.en: The spellcaster whispers into the enemies' minds, subtly stoking the fires of mistrust and treachery.

desc.zh: 施法者在敌人心中低语，巧妙煽动起了怀疑与背叛的阴火
desc.en: The spellcaster whispers into the enemies' minds, subtly stoking the fires of mistrust and treachery.

desc.en: The spellcaster whispers into the enemies' minds, subtly stoking the fires of mistrust and treachery.

desc.zh: 施法者放出猩红色的火球，以致命的尸火吞噬敌人
desc.en: Blistering balls of scarlet flame emanate from the spellcaster to engulf the foe in deadly balefire.

desc.zh: 施法者放出猩红色的火球，以致命的尸火吞噬敌人
desc.en: Blistering balls of scarlet flame emanate from the spellcaster to engulf the foe in deadly balefire.

desc.en: Blistering balls of scarlet flame emanate from the spellcaster to engulf the foe in deadly balefire.

desc.zh: 炽热的星光跃出施法者的指尖，舞动着组成龙帝星座，然后猛地扑向敌人，在其行伍中骤然炸开
desc.en: Blazing starlight leaps from the Wizard’s fingertips, dancing and forming the constellation of the Dragon Emperor before descending upon the foe and exploding among their ranks.

desc.zh: 炽热的星光跃出施法者的指尖，舞动着组成龙帝星座，然后猛地扑向敌人，在其行伍中骤然炸开
desc.en: Blazing starlight leaps from the Wizard’s fingertips, dancing and forming the constellation of the Dragon Emperor before descending upon the foe and exploding among their ranks.

desc.zh: 即使敌人只对这条龙瞥去一眼，它的火焰吐息也足以把敌人烧为灰烬
desc.en: If the enemy sees the Dragon in a single glance its fiery breath will burn them to cinders.

desc.zh: 即使敌人只对这条龙瞥去一眼，它的火焰吐息也足以把敌人烧为灰烬
desc.en: If the enemy sees the Dragon in a single glance its fiery breath will burn them to cinders.

desc.zh: 炽热的光之风制造出强大的屏障，同时也会振奋所有受其保护的友军的精神
desc.en: A blazing wind of light creates a potent barrier against harm, as well as invigorating all living things who shelter beneath its protection.

desc.zh: 炽热的光之风制造出强大的屏障，同时也会振奋所有受其保护的友军的精神
desc.en: A blazing wind of light creates a potent barrier against harm, as well as invigorating all living things who shelter beneath its protection.

desc.zh: 士兵们身上充满了纯阳之力，这令其更为强大，技艺也更为娴熟，就连他们的武器也散发着天宫的能量
desc.en: Soldiers present are filled with the pure power of the Yang, which makes them stronger and more skilled, and their weapons blaze with celestial energy.

desc.zh: 士兵们身上充满了纯阳之力，这令其更为强大，技艺也更为娴熟，就连他们的武器也散发着天宫的能量
desc.en: Soldiers present are filled with the pure power of the Yang, which makes them stronger and more skilled, and their weapons blaze with celestial energy.

desc.zh: 忠实的震旦将士全身的阳之力喷薄而出，此刻就连最卑微的步卒也会坚定信念，拼死一搏
desc.en: The Yang of all loyal Cathayans present comes to the fore, making even the humblest footsoldiers resolute and ready to fight and die where they stand.

desc.zh: 忠实的震旦将士全身的阳之力喷薄而出，此刻就连最卑微的步卒也会坚定信念，拼死一搏
desc.en: The Yang of all loyal Cathayans present comes to the fore, making even the humblest footsoldiers resolute and ready to fight and die where they stand.

desc.zh: 火与风的漩涡扭曲了透过它们所能看到的一切，在敌军中肆意播撒混乱，令其不堪一击
desc.en: A vortex of fire and wind distorts everything seen through it and sows disorder and confusion among the enemy, leaving them vulnerable.

desc.zh: 火与风的漩涡扭曲了透过它们所能看到的一切，在敌军中肆意播撒混乱，令其不堪一击
desc.en: A vortex of fire and wind distorts everything seen through it and sows disorder and confusion among the enemy, leaving them vulnerable.

desc.zh: 战士们的先祖应召由地下世界而出，猛攻向敌，直至再次于世间消逝
desc.en: The warriors' ancestors are summoned from the underworld, rising up to strike at the enemy with a furious assault before vanishing into the earth once more.

desc.zh: 战士们的先祖应召由地下世界而出，猛攻向敌，直至再次于世间消逝
desc.en: The warriors' ancestors are summoned from the underworld, rising up to strike at the enemy with a furious assault before vanishing into the earth once more.

desc.zh: 落英缤纷，拂过战场，以超自然之怒切割敌人，令其失明
desc.en: A wind of leaves and blossoms rolls across the battlefield, cutting into the enemy with supernatural power and blinding them with its fury.

desc.zh: 落英缤纷，拂过战场，以超自然之怒切割敌人，令其失明
desc.en: A wind of leaves and blossoms rolls across the battlefield, cutting into the enemy with supernatural power and blinding them with its fury.

desc.zh: 阴暗的阴之力屏障能够驱散敌人的魔法，以午夜的怀抱屏护其内的部队，使其免受精气之风的伤害
desc.en: This shadowy barrier of dark Yin energy turns aside enemy sorceries, protecting those within its midnight embrace from the elemental winds.

desc.zh: 阴暗的阴之力屏障能够驱散敌人的魔法，以午夜的怀抱屏护其内的部队，使其免受精气之风的伤害
desc.en: This shadowy barrier of dark Yin energy turns aside enemy sorceries, protecting those within its midnight embrace from the elemental winds.

desc.zh: 莫测的黑暗与呼啸的狂风凌空阻碍敌人的箭矢，并将其偏转回它们的主人之处
desc.en: A magical of shifting darkness and howling wind snatches the enemy’s missiles from the air, even as they are fired, and hurls them back at their owners.

desc.zh: 莫测的黑暗与呼啸的狂风凌空阻碍敌人的箭矢，并将其偏转回它们的主人之处
desc.en: A magical of shifting darkness and howling wind snatches the enemy’s missiles from the air, even as they are fired, and hurls them back at their owners.

desc.zh: 施法者手臂大张，魅影自其中而出，翩翩舞动，包裹敌军，从而拖住他们的脚步，迷惑他们的视线
desc.en: Ghostly shadows spring from the caster’s outstretched arms, enveloping the foe in dancing shades that make their footing uncertain and their vision confounded by the gloom.

desc.zh: 施法者手臂大张，魅影自其中而出，翩翩舞动，包裹敌军，从而拖住他们的脚步，迷惑他们的视线
desc.en: Ghostly shadows spring from the caster’s outstretched arms, enveloping the foe in dancing shades that make their footing uncertain and their vision confounded by the gloom.

desc.zh: 冰寒之风滚过战场，其阴云所覆，众人无不心惊胆裂
desc.en: An icy wind rolls out across the battlefield, filling those who enter its coiling gloom with panic and fear.

desc.zh: 冰寒之风滚过战场，其阴云所覆，众人无不心惊胆裂
desc.en: An icy wind rolls out across the battlefield, filling those who enter its coiling gloom with panic and fear.

desc.zh: 『我们看到你在那了！』
desc.en: "We see you there!"

desc.zh: 当大地也开始反击时，敌人会被冻成冰块，此时一股最轻微的风都能令敌人化为碎片
desc.en: When the land itself fights back, the enemy is petrified by its freezing touch, meaning the slightest gust will see them shatter into dust.

desc.zh: 至少在鬼鬼祟祟这方面上，孬不拉与普通的地精没什么区别，就像你刚刚发现的那样！
desc.en: Gnoblars are at least as sneaky and trapsy as ordinary gobbos, as you may just find out!

name.zh: 镜像技能（武道宁和：精灵）

desc.zh: 万物皆有衡：有傲慢，必有端庄；有利矛，必有准箭；有坚固的防线，则必有精心的突袭\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: There must be balance in all things: haughtiness or decorum; thrusted spear or well-aimed arrow; defensive line or controlled assault\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 只要施加足够的蛮力，那么最坚固的防线也会轰然崩塌\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: Even the staunchest line can fall, given sufficient application of brute force.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 相比帝国那些懦夫而言，基斯里夫勇士天生更为强大，毕竟那群家伙对草原上的艰辛生活一无所知\n\n[[col:magic]]我们通过对艾索塔玛哈的一位囚犯的审问获取了相关的知识，并使用这些知识成功将此技能镜像化[[/col]]
desc.en: Kislevite warriors are inherently stronger than weak-hearted Empire-men, who know nothing of the hardship and strife of lives lived on the unforgiving steppes.\n\n[[col:magic]]This ability is being mirrored using knowledge gained from a prisoner interrogation in Athel Tamarha.[[/col]]

desc.zh: 当一堆肮脏的、沾满脓液的纳垢灵在敌人面前自爆时，没有一个敌人会逃过瘟疫领主的腐蚀
desc.en: When a mass of filthy, pus-soaked Nurglings spontaneously combust before the foe, not one among them will remain untouched by the Plague Lord's foul rot.

desc.zh: 掌控了战场的天空，就可确保地面上的胜利。记住，重力站在你这边！
desc.en: Control the skies above the battlefield and you can be assured of success upon on the ground below – gravity is your ally, remember.

desc.zh: 点燃这种火药混合物会迅速炸开预制破片，形成令人不适的有毒云雾，使敌人在近身搏斗中更易受创
desc.en: Ignition of this gunpowder mixture causes shavings to quickly scatter into a foul, painful cloud, leaving enemies vulnerable to the cut-and-thrust of close quarters combat.

desc.zh: 当不战斗时，尖叫者可以很好地施展魔法，搞出一批新的恶作剧来打倒敌人
desc.en: When not fighting, Squealers can be put to good use conjuring up a fresh batch of magical mischief to lay the enemy low.

desc.zh: 战争就是熔炉，可熔化一切
desc.en: War is the crucible that melts all things.

desc.zh: 篡变并不总是受欢迎的…也不是一成不变的
desc.en: Change isn't always welcome… or survivable, for that matter.

desc.zh: 万物皆应平衡，正所谓暗与明、月与阳、雄与雌一般
desc.en: There must be balance in all things: dark and light, moon and sun, female and male.

desc.zh: 万物皆应平衡，正所谓暗与明、月与阳、雄与雌一般
desc.en: There must be balance in all things: dark and light, moon and sun, female and male.

desc.zh: 随着同胞的倒下，曾与他们并肩作战、流血牺牲的人们心中燃起了义愤填膺的怒火
desc.en: As compatriots fall, righteous anger overtakes those who have fought and bled by their sides.

desc.zh: 相比帝国那些懦夫而言，基斯里夫勇士天生更为强大，毕竟那群家伙对草原上的艰辛生活一无所知
desc.en: Kislevite warriors are inherently stronger than weak-hearted Empire-men, who know nothing of the hardship and strife of lives lived on the unforgiving steppes.

desc.zh: 相比帝国那些懦夫而言，基斯里夫勇士天生更为强大，毕竟那群家伙对草原上的艰辛生活一无所知
desc.en: Kislevite warriors are inherently stronger than weak-hearted Empire-men, who know nothing of the hardship and strife of lives lived on the unforgiving steppes.

desc.zh: 混沌诸神争吵不休，恶魔在凡世的存在也变得黯淡了
desc.en: The Chaos Gods squabble, and the Daemons' presence on the mortal plane grows dim.

desc.zh: 腐蚀魔法的浪潮越来越强，由其滋养的恶魔也随之愈发强悍
desc.en: The tide of corrupting magic grows stronger, as do the anarchic Daemons that suckle from it.

desc.zh: 在纳垢无尽的瘟疫祝福之下，瘟疫领主的追随者们茁壮成长，奋勇向前，而他的敌人只能落得个枯萎死亡的下场
desc.en: Through His endless pestilent blessings, the Plague Lord's followers thrive and surge forward when others would simply wither and die.

desc.zh: 如此多的混沌恶魔被纳卡伊所杀，以至于这些家伙都不敢与他走在同一条路上
desc.en: So many Daemons of Chaos have been slain by Nakai that such entities fear to tread the same ground as him.

desc.zh: 当恶魔勇气动摇，他们的肉身就会瓦解并从现实中消失
desc.en: As the Daemon's courage falters, their mortal form crumbles and fades from this reality.

desc.zh: 一旦恶魔耗尽了他们的勇气，他们就会通过传送门回到自己所属的混沌魔域
desc.en: Once the Daemon's courage has failed them, they will fall back through the portal to the Chaos Realm whence they belong.

desc.zh: 当恶魔勇气动摇，他们的肉身就会瓦解并从现实中消失
desc.en: As the Daemon's courage falters, their mortal form crumbles and fades from this reality.

desc.zh: 一旦恶魔耗尽了他们的勇气，他们就会通过传送门回到自己所属的混沌魔域
desc.en: Once the Daemon's courage has failed them, they will fall back through the portal to the Chaos Realm whence they belong.

desc.zh: 当恶魔勇气动摇，他们的肉身就会瓦解并从现实中消失
desc.en: As the Daemon's courage falters, their mortal form crumbles and fades from this reality.

desc.en: Once the Daemon's courage has failed them, they will fall back through the portal to the Chaos Realm whence they belong.

desc.zh: 不动如山！随着时间的推移，这股力量会愈发强大，直至不可撼动
desc.en: Become like the mountain: immovable, stronger over time, and nigh-on impossible to assail.

desc.zh: 登高方可望远，如龙翔于震旦九天
desc.en: The higher you go, the further you can see, like the Dragons in flight above Cathay's harmonious landscape.

desc.zh: 他人的恐惧，乃是完美亲王痛苦盛宴的美酒佳肴
desc.en: Others' fear is meat and drink to the Perfect Prince's Feasters of Pain.

desc.zh: 当杀戮欲望和狂乱达到极限时，轻微的伤口就会被血神无懈可击的意志所治愈
desc.en: When the bloodlust and frenzy are at their utmost levels, minor wounds are healed by the Blood God's towering, unassailable will.

desc.zh: 随着战况日趋激烈，收割的灵魂越来越多，放血鬼也就会变得愈发凶狠
desc.en: The shrieking swords of the Horned Ones become more effective the longer the battle rages and the greater the number of piteous souls they harvest.

desc.zh: 并肩而战！还有什么能比为战友而战、为战友而死更为高尚呢！
desc.en: Shoulder to shoulder – what better way to fight and die for your comrades?

desc.zh: 在魔法之风交织而过，力量强大到无以复加之地，唯有最强大的魔法师才能驾驭它
desc.en: Only the most powerful magic-users can harness the Winds of Magic where they intersect and the power they generate is at its strongest.

desc.zh: 正当一击即将命中之际，一股致命的寒冰反击骤然爆发，令攻击者惊愕不已
desc.en: Just as a blow would strike true, a repelling burst of deadly ice responds, much to the dismay of the attacker.

desc.zh: 即使是最强大的敌人，也无法在身受重伤时屹立，而且所受伤害越大，他们的战斗力就会越为低下
desc.en: Even the greatest foes can be laid low with terrible injuries, and the greater the damage done, the less able they will be to effectively continue the fray.

desc.zh: 当颅骨魔炮吞噬无助的敌人时，敌人的颅骨便会成为这门大炮的新鲜炮弹
desc.en: As the Skullcannon devours the helpless foe, their skulls feed its incessant hunger for fresh ammunition.

desc.zh: 苍蝇领主最忠实的仆人已是越来越难以撼动，因为魔法粘液会减慢敌人的速度，并限制他们的攻击
desc.en: Attacking the Fly Lord's most faithful servants is made all the more difficult by the magical slime that slows enemy warriors and restricts their strikes.

desc.zh: 精湛的屠杀点燃了地狱行者的灵魂，鞭策他们愈发杀戮不止
desc.en: The exquisite carnage sets the Hellstriders' souls on fire, girding and driving them further for the slaughter.

desc.zh: 『呃…肉…我离着五十码远就能闻到它！』
desc.en: "Mmmm... meat... I can smell innocence at fifty yards!"

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 长着胡须的战斧，刀刃上环绕着噼里啪啦的闪电，这是暴风雨之神托尔的杰作
desc.en: A bearded battle-axe with a blade wreathed in crackling lightning, befitting of Tor, God of Storms.

desc.zh: 一位氏族长用部众的灵魂交换了这把长矛，随后他便背叛了黑暗诸神。这把长矛可以放逐诸神的仆人，也是这个氏族长唯一的遗物
desc.en: Bartered for his tribesmen's souls by a chieftain who then double-crossed the Dark Gods, this spear, which can banish their servants, is all that remains.

desc.zh: 冰霜的尖刺纵贯霜冻的荒原，如同凶猛野兽的犬齿般贯穿惊慌失措的敌人
desc.en: Like the cuspid of a fearsome beast, spikes of ice force their way through the frozen wastes to impale the incognizant foe.

desc.zh: 这把神圣武器的刀锋如冰霜碎片般锋利，闪耀着冷酷无情的杀戮光辉
desc.en: The frost shard blade of this revered weapon sparkles with the cold, hard promise of sharp slaughter.

desc.zh: 随着库尔茨受到腐蚀，红沙皇的礼物也堕落了。谁知道它现在有什么力量呢？
desc.en: As Kurnz has become corrupted, so too has this gift from the Red Tzar. Who knows what power it now holds?

desc.zh: 传奇英雄努库曹是个沉默寡言的女人，然而她的武器却是滔滔不绝：它喷出的闪电快得超出任何人的想象
desc.en: The legendary hero Nuku Cho was a woman of few words. Her weapon had much to say, however, spitting flurries of furious bolts faster than thoughts.

desc.zh: 这个巨大的权杖带有强大的魔法，为格雷苏注入了天空泰坦的力量
desc.en: This massive sceptre, ensorcelled with spells of might, helpfully imbues Greasus with the strength of a Sky-Titan.

desc.zh: 这把由最坚硬的基斯里夫冰柱制成的冰刃，足以将红沙皇的敌人钉在当场，直至死期的到来
desc.en: Fashioned from the hardest Kislevian stalagmite, this icy blade keeps the Red Tzar's opponents at bay until the time comes for them to meet their deaths.

desc.zh: 当挥舞破城者时，城墙会如纸糊般脆弱！你明白了吗？
desc.en: Walls are like paper when you're wielding Siegebreaker! Get it? No? I'll get my cloak…

desc.zh: 这把带有鲨鱼皮剑鞘的鳞剑，是一位诺斯卡劫掠者很久以前从深海中掠来的宝物
desc.en: This blade of scales with a sharkskin hilt was borne from the deeps by a Norscan reaver in an age long past.

desc.zh: 这把来自色孽冠军勇士『诲淫者』吉利昂的剑会诱捕它的受害者，并使其永远成为持有者的奴隶
desc.en: This blade of Gilellion the Lewd, champion of Slaanesh, traps its victims in immortal servitude to its bearer.

desc.zh: 明天便是崭新的一天，能让一切都从头来过…
desc.en: Tomorrow is a new day, when one can make a fresh start in all areas of endeavour…

desc.zh: 自混沌初开以来，这把剑就已出现在了每一场重大战斗中。只要它赞许主人的意愿，就能保证主人享有无尽的世间盛誉
desc.en: Present at every major battle since the dawn of time, this blade guarantees its owner great worldly renown as long as it consents to their will.

desc.zh: 这个巨大的双头笞棍是如此沉重，即使是普通的食人魔公牛用起来也会吃力。它的两头蓄有毁灭之力，一击便能粉碎巨石
desc.en: This massive two-ended club is so heavy even a normal Ogre Bull would struggle. Bound into its heads is the power to shatter a boulder with one strike.

desc.zh: 狼在嚎叫，神在回答！
desc.en: The wolf howls and the gods answer!

desc.zh: 碾碎力相当惊人，由最暴力的元素产生，正如其名…
desc.en: Awesome crushing power, born of the most violent of elements – the clue is in the name...

desc.zh: 这把剑上覆盖着一层能使人麻痹的毒液，只需一点就能使受害者完全动弹不得
desc.en: This sword is coated with a paralysing venom, a dose of which renders the victim utterly immobile.

desc.zh: 人们认为，这些古老的战斗爪正是近卫秘警们所持武器的铸造原型
desc.en: These ancient fighting claws are believed to be the pattern upon which the Akshina modelled their weapons.

desc.zh: 只要这把附魔之剑轻轻一碰，这些可怜的傻瓜就会完全忘却自己身在何方，所为何故，更不用说奋起自卫了
desc.en: One touch from this enchanted blade and the poor fool won't know where they are or why they are here, let alone be able to defend themselves.

desc.zh: 随着比拉克的恶魔之刃斩杀了越来越多的敌手，它的饥饿感越来越强，砍杀也越来越凶猛
desc.en: As more and more hapless opponents fall to Be'lakor's Daemonic blade, so its hunger increases and its bite becomes ever more savage.

desc.zh: 鲜血砍刀是一件令人厌恶、镶满鲜血的手持武器，它具有吸血鬼的能力，可以将受害者的生命力量输送给持用者
desc.en: The Bloodcleaver is a revolting, gore-encrusted hand weapon with the vampiric ability to channel the lifeforce from its victims into its wielder.

desc.zh: 伤害康斯坦丁只会令他的圣火燃烧得更为炽热，而其中涌动的正是厄孙的力量
desc.en: Wounding Kostaltyn only make the fire within his brazier burn hotter as the power of Ursun flows into it.

desc.zh: 只要持用者一声令下，这把剑的锯齿就会沿着剑刃急速转动，如撕裂羊皮纸般切开护甲与血肉。此时它的兽性握柄便会纵情狂嚎，若是尚未尽兴，则会呜咽不已
desc.en: At the wielder's command, the teeth race down the blade, ripping apart armour and flesh as easily as if they were parchment. The beast-hilt howls while it does so and whines if left unsated.

desc.zh: 显然，这把剑是使用旭日之光的反射铸造而成，它的刀锋具有很强的反射性，会使得光辉随着它致命的图案节奏起舞闪光
desc.en: Apparently forged from a reflection of the dawning sun, its blade is highly reflective, making light dance and flash to the rhythm of its deadly pattern.

desc.zh: 顶端燃烧的法杖，闪耀着火神达兹的光芒。它的触碰能让疲惫的战士在激烈的战斗中重新焕发活力
desc.en: A mace with a fiery head, blazing with the light of Dazh, God of Fire. Its touch reinvigorates tired warriors in the thick of battle.

desc.zh: 这柄连枷以瘟疫遇害者的干瘪头骨为锤头，以脱水打结的肠子为锁链。瘟疫仍然浓厚地萦绕其上，喷薄欲出
desc.en: This flail's heads are the shrunken skulls of plague victims, its chain crafted from knotted and desiccated entrails. Pestilence hangs heavy about it still, ever seeking to escape.

desc.zh: 这对恶魔之斧灌注了嗜血狂魔的野蛮灵魂，使得斯卡布兰德能够以远超平时的狂怒对敌人发动斩击
desc.en: These twin Daemonic axes, imbued with a Bloodthirster's savage spirit, enable Skarbrand to strike with even greater fury than even he could muster before.

desc.zh: 这根法杖单凭自身的存在就能令所有的自然事物痛苦哭泣，因为它会根据恶魔的心血来潮重塑世界
desc.en: The mere presence of this staff causes all natural things to cry out in pain as it reshapes the world according to the Daemon's whim.

desc.zh: 克瑞索索斯早已远去，他被绑定在了带羽毛的魔法书上。但他的尸骨依然健在，只要有可能，他就会窃取原本可供施法者使用的魔力
desc.en: Krysothos is gone now, bound to a feathered grimoire, but his bones linger still and steal magic whenever they can – magic that their wielder can harness to his own ends.

desc.zh: 目标无法抵抗恶魔符文的地狱力量。他会无助地漂浮在战场上，无法逃脱或反击
desc.en: Helpless against the diabolical power of the Daemonic runes, the target is rendered incapable and floating above the fray, unable to break free or strike back.

desc.zh: 目标无法抵抗恶魔符文的地狱力量。他会无助地漂浮在战场上，无法逃脱或反击
desc.en: Helpless against the diabolical power of the Daemonic runes, the target is rendered incapable and floating above the fray, unable to break free or strike back.

desc.zh: 目标无法抵抗恶魔符文的地狱力量。他会无助地漂浮在战场上，无法逃脱或反击
desc.en: Helpless against the diabolical power of the Daemonic runes, the target is rendered incapable and floating above the fray, unable to break free or strike back.

desc.zh: 目标无法抵抗恶魔符文的地狱力量。他会无助地漂浮在战场上，无法逃脱或反击
desc.en: Helpless against the diabolical power of the Daemonic runes, the target is rendered incapable and floating above the fray, unable to break free or strike back.

desc.zh: 恶魔亲王的敌人会被吸进漂浮在他们上方的魔球，然后抛到尽可能远的地方，这样他们就无法造成伤害了
desc.en: The Daemon Prince's enemies are drawn into a sphere of magic floating above them and then cast asunder as far away as possible, from whence they can do no harm.

desc.zh: 恶魔亲王的敌人会被吸进漂浮在他们上方的魔球，然后抛到尽可能远的地方，这样他们就无法造成伤害了

desc.en: The Daemon Prince's enemies are drawn into a sphere of magic floating above them and then cast asunder as far away as possible, from whence they can do no harm.

desc.zh: 大诡计者的一块碎片，消失在千年之前。对于那些操纵魔法之风的人，它有着巨大的价值，因为力量的流动会向他们主人的心血来潮屈膝
desc.en: A fragment of the Great Schemer, lost in millennia past. It has great value to those that manipulate the Winds of Magic, as the shifting currents of power bend to their master’s whims.

desc.zh: 在施法者前进的路径上所触及的任何人，或者任何事物都会被卷入这场狂暴的火焰旋风，然后重重地摔回战场。记住，远离这东西！
desc.en: Anyone – or anything – caught in the caster's path is sucked inside this raging tornado of fire before being deposited back on the battlefield again, but well out of the way!

desc.zh: 在施法者前进的路径上所触及的任何人，或者任何事物都会被卷入这场狂暴的火焰旋风，然后重重地摔回战场。记住，远离这东西！
desc.en: Anyone – or anything – caught in the caster's path is sucked inside this raging tornado of fire before being deposited back on the battlefield again, but well out of the way!

desc.en: Anyone – or anything – caught in the caster's path is sucked inside this raging tornado of fire before being deposited back on the battlefield again, but well out of the way!

desc.en: Anyone – or anything – caught in the caster's path is sucked inside this raging tornado of fire before being deposited back on the battlefield again, but well out of the way!

desc.zh: 法师在岩石内部点燃火焰，令地面砰然碎裂，狂暴的世界生命之血喷涌而出，吞噬敌人
desc.en: The Wizard sets a fire within the very rock itself, causing the ground to splinter and the raging lifeblood of the world to gush forth and consume the enemy.

desc.zh: 法师吟诵变化术的三字真言，抛出一个灿烂的熔融圆球，径直击穿敌人的行伍
desc.en: Speaking the three sacred syllables of transformation, the Wizard hurls a brilliant, molten sphere through the enemy's ranks.

desc.zh: 只要一看到哈利，亡灵灵魂的残余中定会有某处瞬间激灵起来，让他们回想起昔日可怕的死亡经历
desc.en: Somewhere in the vestigial remains of Undead souls, a spark of awareness flickers to life upon seeing Harry, reminding them of their dreaded deaths.

desc.zh: 每次被击中时，哈利的凶兆之盾都会反向释放出魔法冲击波，将敌人的攻击反弹回来
desc.en: Discharging a magical blast every time it is struck, Harry’s Bane Shield rebounds his enemies blows back from whence they came.

desc.zh: 哈利之锤受到了诸神的赐福，犹如拥有某种不可阻挡的力量，所击之人无论躯体灵魂尽皆击飞开去
desc.en: As if driven by an unstoppable force, Harry’s hammer is blessed by the gods to hurl back the bodies and souls of those he strikes.

desc.zh: 随着恐兰克的魔爪撕碎无数的猎物，虚空中会回荡起它野兽般的嚎叫，从而吸引其他血肉猎犬来到他的身前
desc.en: As leagues untold fall away beneath his clawed feet, Karanak’s bestial howls echo through the void, drawing other Flesh Hounds to his presence.

desc.zh: 恐兰克的鼻孔嗅到了愈发浓重的气息。猎物越来越近，血腥越来越浓，现在，已是无处可逃…
desc.en: With the odour of his victim thick in his nostrils, Karanak's prey draws closer, the blood scent stronger, until there is no escape…

desc.zh: 恐兰克可以追踪着血腥味穿越时空，这样，战场上的任何角落都无法逃过恐虐神选猎手的魔爪
desc.en: Karanak tracks the blood scent across space and time, until the battlefield offers no hiding place from Khorne’s chosen hunter.

desc.zh: 恐兰克的杀戮如水银泻地般完美，可以迅速满足他的饥饿和主人对鲜血的渴求
desc.en: Karanak's kills are quicksilver perfection, the better to swiftly feed his hunger and his master's need for spilt blood.

desc.zh: 恐兰克的恐虐项圈比同族的其它项圈更厚更重，其中充满了理应弃绝的魔力，使得这头猎犬可以免受渺小法术的伤害
desc.en: Thicker and heavier than those of his pack, Karanak’s Collar of Khorne is enchanted with spite and abjuration, immunising the hound against callow sorcery.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，最终还是会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, eventually disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 『集中精神，永远专心做好眼前的事』
desc.en: "Concentrate your mind and apply yourself always to the task at hand."

desc.zh: 『敌人被围了！他们要败了！拿着这个，结果他们！』
desc.en: "The foe is beleaguered and close to defeat. Take this and finish them off!"

desc.zh: 『战场便是我等埋骨之地！坚持战斗！』
desc.en: "On the battlefield is where we end this. Stand and fight!"

desc.zh: 『结束就在眼前，胜利就在手边！别放弃，加把劲！』
desc.en: "The end is in sight and victory is in our grasp at last. Don't give up now, push on!"

desc.zh: 『喘口气吧，但别太久…我们还有事要做！』
desc.en: "Take a load off... Not for too long though, we’ve got work to do!"

desc.zh: 再生肉体的能力乃是神赐的礼物，能让伤者治愈他们的伤口
desc.en: The ability to regenerate your flesh is a gift from the gods, allowing the affected to heal their wounds.

desc.zh: 当受损的肉体获得再生与恢复，让死亡被坚决地拒之门外时，那才算得上是真正的非凡
desc.en: When damaged flesh can be regenerated and restored, so that death is held resolutely at bay, that is true immortality.

desc.zh: 这些施法者可以操纵魔法之风来为己服务，从而确保自己可以获得足够的法力
desc.en: These spellcasters have the ability to manipulate the Winds to their cause, ensuring there is plenty of magic at their disposal.

desc.zh: 使用精致铜板甲的小规模升级，使得穿戴者可以更好地抵御战斗中的凶猛劈刺
desc.en: This small upgrade of fine bronze plate armour enables the wearer to greater resist battle's savage cut and thrust.

desc.zh: 使用精致银板甲的中规模升级，使得穿戴者可以更好地抵御战斗中的凶猛劈刺
desc.en: This moderate upgrade of fine silver plate armour enables the wearer to greater resist battle's savage cut and thrust.

desc.zh: 使用精致金板甲的大规模升级，使得穿戴者可以更好地抵御战斗中的凶猛劈刺
desc.en: This large upgrade of fine gold plate armour enables the wearer to greater resist battle's savage cut and thrust.

desc.zh: 这些精心制作的铜质矢弹可令射手的远程攻击能力获得小规模升级
desc.en: These expertly-machined bronze tips provide small upgrades to the shooter's missile capabilities.

desc.zh: 这些精心制作的银质矢弹可令射手的远程攻击能力获得中规模升级
desc.en: These expertly-machined silver tips provide moderate upgrades to the shooter's missile capabilities.

desc.zh: 这些精心制作的金质矢弹可令射手的远程攻击能力获得大规模升级
desc.en: These expertly-machined gold tips provide large upgrades to the shooter's missile capabilities.

desc.zh: 使用铜质甲板为简陋的木盾进行小规模升级，从而提高其抵御攻击的防御能力
desc.en: A small upgrade of bronze grafted to a simple wooden shield improves its bearer's defensive strength against attacks.

desc.zh: 使用银质甲板为简陋的木盾进行中规模升级，从而提高其抵御攻击的防御能力
desc.en: A moderate upgrade of silver grafted to a simple wooden shield improves its bearer's defensive strength against attacks.

desc.zh: 使用金质甲板为简陋的木盾进行大规模升级，从而提高其抵御攻击的防御能力
desc.en: A large upgrade of gold grafted to a simple wooden shield improves its bearer's defensive strength against attacks.

desc.zh: 使用铜来小规模强化简陋的刀剑，从而通过材料的变化增加其近战能力
desc.en: A small upgrade of bronze improves a simple sword blade, increasing its bearer's melee capabilities through its material strength.

desc.zh: 使用银来中规模强化简陋的刀剑，从而通过材料的变化增加其近战能力
desc.en: A moderate upgrade of silver improves a simple sword blade, increasing its bearer's melee capabilities through its material strength.

desc.zh: 使用金来大规模强化简陋的刀剑，从而通过材料的变化增加其近战能力
desc.en: A large upgrade of gold improves a simple sword blade, increasing its bearer's melee capabilities through its material strength.

desc.zh: 附魔武器：魔法
desc.en: Imbue Weapons: Magical

desc.zh: 附魔武器：火焰
desc.en: Imbue Weapons: Fire

desc.zh: 锻炉投下的阴影令你颤抖不已
desc.en: The shadow cast by the forge sends shivers down your sprine.

desc.zh: 锻炉需要灵魂，你正因此而来
desc.en: The forge requires souls and yours are for the taking.

desc.zh: 锻炉之深，便是你被剥光之地
desc.en: The depths of the forge are where you will be stripped bare.

desc.zh: 掌控这座毁灭纪念碑的一方会引导血神的力量来削弱敌人的护甲
desc.en: The alliance that controls this Ruinous monument uses the power of the Blood God to shatter the armour of their enemies.

desc.zh: 掌控这座血铸大厦的一方会将恐虐的狂怒降临到士气崩溃的敌军头上，令其陷入盲目的愤怒，无差别地攻击敌我双方
desc.en: The alliance that controls this bloodforged edifice draws on the wrath of Khorne to drive demoralised enemies into a blind fury, attacking friend and foe alike.

desc.zh: 掌控这座亵渎图腾的一方会用汹涌的痛苦折磨虚弱的敌人，削弱他们继续战斗的意志
desc.en: The alliance that controls this blasphemous totem wracks weakened enemies with surges of agonising pain, sapping their will to fight even further.

desc.zh: 祖父神的花园中唯有衰朽方可繁盛，这里没有健康之物的容身之地
desc.en: Only the decaying flourish in Grandfather's foul garden; there is no place for the healthy here.

desc.zh: 当你试图穿越苍蝇领主统治的恶心泥潭时，你的生命可谓命悬一线…
desc.en: You take your very life in your hands when you try to cross this disgusting quagmire where the Fly Lord rules.

desc.zh: 『嗷！啊呀！呃啊啊啊啊啊啊！！』
desc.en: "Ow! Ouch! Aaaaarrrrgggghhhh!!!!"

desc.zh: 一旦你意识到自己乃是最伟大之人，不需要任何人的帮助，那么你的部队凝聚力和军事纪律就会立刻瓦解
desc.en: Unit cohesion and martial discipline go to the wall once you realise you're the greatest warrior present who needs no assistance from anyone.

desc.zh: 当经历纯粹的喜悦时，怎么可能还会有人能够抗拒呢？
desc.en: No resistance is possible when experiencing a wave of pure, unadulterated delight.

desc.zh: 『老实说…到底还有什么意义呢？有人知道吗？战斗？呸…』
desc.en: "Honestly… what's the point anymore? Does anyone know? The battle? Pfft…"

desc.zh: 『来吧，在纯净的火焰中沐浴，焕然一新，在灰烬与骨骸中重生吧！』
desc.en: "Come, bathe in the purifying flames – be… different, be reborn anew from ash and bone."

desc.zh: 如此美丽的呈现，即使是最坚定的战士也会深受迷惑，从而令其丧失防护力和进行远程攻击的能力
desc.en: A display as beautiful as this beguiles and entrances even the most resolute of warriors, impeding their ability to protext themselves and fire missiles.

desc.zh: 『我在哪儿？等等…我在何时？这到底怎么回事？！』
desc.en: "Where am I? Hang on... When am I? What's going on?!"

desc.zh: 『死亡，即如侵髓之霜；紧闭门扉，亦不可挡。纵使盛夏，再起芬芳；我等亦难逃冰雪之殇』
desc.en: "Death is like a winter chill; No door can keep it from us; And summer yet may bloom again; Though ice be all upon us."

desc.zh: 进入鸦神的魔域，他的恩惠或许会返还
desc.en: Reach into the realm of the Raven God and his blessings may just reach back.

desc.zh: 最好的计划诞生于失败的边缘，在最绝望的时刻一举扭转局势
desc.en: The best plans are born at the brink of defeat, turning the tide when things seem most dire.

desc.zh: 『看啊，这溃烂的大军，他们涌出了大门，永远存在于阴影中！』
desc.en: "Behold the festering hordes; from the gate they pour, ever undying in its shadow!"

desc.zh: 『苍蝇！诸神啊，这么多的苍蝇！』
desc.en: "The flies! By the Gods, so many flies!"

desc.zh: 用鲜血滋润土壤，每一滴都是杀戮的动力！
desc.en: Quench the soil in blood; every drop is but murderous motivation!

desc.zh: 世人无不畏惧风暴之神托尔的愤怒，他会用神圣的闪电击倒敌人！
desc.en: All fear the wrath of the storm-god Tor, striking foes down in a barrage of divine lightning!

desc.zh: 强大的圆盘上栖息着愤怒的灵魂，向下方所有生灵喷射奸奇之火
desc.en: Angry spirits inhabit discs of great power, spewing Tzeentchian fire on all those below.

desc.zh: 恐虐的愤怒狂热任谁都无法承受，因此，从恐虐魔域横扫而来的烈风自然会让他们不堪一击
desc.en: Few can tolerate the scorching heat of Khorne's rage, leaving them vulnerable to the fiery winds that sweep from His realm.

desc.zh: 毒性孢子中大量喷洒出毒云：对于衰朽领主的盟友，这些恶臭的气体无异于恢复精力的甘霖
desc.en: Clouds of gas leak from toxic spores — a reeking restorative to all those aligned with the Lord of Decay.

desc.zh: 当受到关注时，这个混沌的偶像一定会在疯狂的崇拜者间好好炫耀自己一番
desc.en: An idol of Chaos, when lavished with attention, is sure to show off in the presence of such adoring followers.

desc.zh: 一旦感染致命的嶙峋病，患者的肌肉就会萎缩，骨头也会化为灰烬
desc.en: Once the dreaded Wasting Sickness sets in, the muscles of the infected wither as their bones crumble to dust.

desc.zh: 法师使用阴影系法术的技能，让敌人被自身的负担拖垮，直到他们虚弱到只能停滞不前为止
desc.en: By means of the Lore of Shadows, the Wizard causes the enemy to be worn down by their own burdens until they are enervated to a sorry standstill.

desc.zh: 对于漫步冰封平原与冰雪覆盖的基斯里夫苔原之人，无论走到哪里，他都怀着祖国母亲冰冷的心
desc.en: At one with the frozen plains and snowy tundra of Kislev, wherever this one goes, they bring the icy heart of the Motherland with them.

desc.zh: 随着施法者张开手掌，几束嘶嘶作响的银流自天而降，贯穿敌人
desc.en: A spray of sizzling silver slivers rain from the sky to impale the caster's enemy.

desc.zh: 就像水蛭吸血一样，巫师向敌人伸出黑檀木之手，通过肮脏的死亡系法术吸走他们的灵魂
desc.en: Just as a leech draws blood, the Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, sucking away their spirit through the tainted Lore of Death.

desc.zh: 法师使用怀疑与危机感侵蚀敌人的思维，从内心深处击垮敌军
desc.en: The Wizard destroys the foe from within, corroding their minds with doubt and crisis.

desc.zh: 大不净者会召唤一股恶心的恶臭来治疗自己，并伤害那些不幸被困其中的敌人
desc.en: By which the Great Unclean One calls down a disgusting shower of putrid yuck to heal themselves and harm those foes unfortunate enough to be caught in it.

desc.zh: 寒冰躯壳包裹着石角兽，进一步减缓了这头笨重野兽的速度，但也为它附加了一层天然的盔甲
desc.en: An icy carapace surrounds the Stonehorn, slowing the lumbering beast down further while adding a layer of natural armour to their defences.

desc.zh: 血拳越是靠近凶残的敌人，他们被杀的概率就越小。这绝对是来自恐虐本人的祝福！
desc.en: The closer to monstrous foes the Bloody Fist is, the less likely it is to die. Truly a blessing from Khorne Himself!

desc.zh: 这种神妙的战斗魔法会将弹丸反弹回攻击者身上，若是鸿运当头，甚至可以引发进一步的爆炸！
desc.en: This little bit of fiendish battle magick rains missiles straight back to the attacker, which, with a bit of luck, ought to put paid to further outbursts!

desc.zh: 附近吟唱的咒语所发散出的奥术魔力丝线，如抽丝剥茧般自微风中提取而出，编入魔屏，从而强化了屏障的力量
desc.en: Loose threads of arcane power from nearby incantations are plucked from the breeze and woven into the barrier, reinforcing its strength.

desc.zh: 虬结的皮肤中溃烂出大量的疱疹，令敌方的每一次打击都会承受溃烂污秽的浸润
desc.en: Blisters bubble up from bulbous flesh, so assailants risk being doused in festering filth with every strike.

desc.zh: 当浸入肮脏的死水时，伤口会莫名其妙地愈合，皮肤也会变得完整如初。更奇特的是，那些怪诞的疖子会蓬勃胀大并爆裂开来，从而孕育出新的同类
desc.en: Submerged in filthy, stagnant water, wounds inexplicably knit together, and skin becomes whole. More curious are the grotesque boils that flourish and erupt, birthing a new sibling.

desc.zh: 这面军旗由纯粹的魔法之线编织而成，上面缀满了不断翻滚的符文，边缘处则是一圈滚动的火焰
desc.en: Woven from threads of pure magic, this standard is inscribed with runes that constantly writhe, while surrounded by coruscating fires of change.

desc.zh: 这具头盔上方缀满了眼球，它们自从很久以前便凝视着世间，并且会一直凝视下去。那些可以看透这一景象的人，都已经发生了变化
desc.en: This helm is covered with eyeballs that stare into the world as it was, as it is, and as it shall be. Those that can sift through the images are... changed.

desc.zh: 一件可追溯到莫凯时期的古老战盔，泛着恶毒的冷光，让混沌的仆从不寒而栗
desc.en: An ancient battle-helm dating back to the time of Morkar, it exudes an aura of raw malice to cow the servants of Chaos.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 人称『碎星者』的巨大战锤正是从火山的中心锻造而出的。虽然它非常巨大，但凭着自己的一身蛮力与超群的技艺，柯烈克仍然可以随心所欲地使唤这件巨大的武器
desc.en: The gigantic warhammer known as Starcrusher was forged in the raging heart of a volcano. Kholek wields this enormous weapon with staggering brutality and skill despite its size.

desc.zh: 变幻之剑因恶魔军阀阿蒙·杰盖而闻名于世，这位领主那早已石化的眼珠如今正嵌在这把剑的剑柄上呢
desc.en: The Sword of Change was fashioned by the Daemon Warlord Amon 'Chakai, whose fossilised eye is still grasped in the weapon's pommel.

desc.zh: 第二位永世神选范加尔曾将大魔乌祖哈封印在这把弑君之刃中
desc.en: The Second Everchosen, Vangel, trapped the Greater Daemon U'zuhl inside this regicidal blade.

desc.zh: 精金护甲是由附魔黄金雕琢而成的黄金护甲。黑暗能量的触手抚摸着穿戴者的皮肤，温柔之触可以闭合伤口
desc.en: The Auric Armour is a sculpted suit forged from ensorcelled gold. Tendrils of dark energy caress the skin of the wearer, closing his wounds with a tender touch.

desc.zh: 血堡战旗，猎猎扬旌；嗜血骑士，踏破万军
desc.en: The Flag of the Blood Keep flashes violently; the Blood Knights run their enemies down.

desc.zh: 这杆战旗只是一具被食腐鸟包围的腐烂死尸，是对人类的稻草人拙劣的模仿
desc.en: This standard - an ever-rotting corpse beset by carrion birds - is a gross mockery of a scarecrow.

desc.zh: 混沌的赠礼多种多样，但每一种都包含了肉体扭曲变异的恩典，这是毁灭之力的神灵们给予凡人信徒的回报
desc.en: The Gifts of Chaos are many and varied, each bestowing a twisted boon or warped blessing from the Ruinous Ones in return for the recipient's service.

desc.zh: 长满锯齿的钉矛，上面挂满了披甲战士的腐烂遗骸：这根图腾散发着混乱的气息
desc.en: A jagged spike with the corroded remains of armoured warriors impaled; this totem spreads an aura of entropy.

desc.zh: 在变幻莫测的迷梦之中，此人看到了终末的景象：世界彻底崩溃，留下的唯有尘埃与碎片
desc.en: In fitful dreams, he sees the end... The world collapsing in on itself, leaving nothing but ashes and aberration.

desc.zh: 『血即荣耀！血即荣耀！！血即荣耀！！！』
desc.en: "The blood is the prize. The blood is the prize! THE BLOOD IS THE PRIZE!"

desc.zh: 『我们感觉到了，我们都感觉到了！那是战争的召唤，战火的牵引，杀戮的渴望！』
desc.en: "We feel it. We all feel it. The pull to war. The tug of battle. The NEED to kill."

desc.zh: 屠夫的宗旨便是冲锋、搜寻与战斗！他们永不停歇，也无法停歇下来！
desc.en: Slayers keep charging, seeking, fighting. They do not cease. They cannot.

desc.zh: 有蹄者们极度渴望寻求更为强悍的敌手，并将其躯体撕成两半
desc.en: The Cloven Ones are compelled to seek out ever-greater enemies, whose bodies shall be riven in twain.

desc.zh: 单单是『黑暗征兆』的现身，便足以强烈动摇敌军的战意
desc.en: The presence of the Dark Omen is an awful thing that saps the foe's will to fight on.

desc.zh: 战兽群严阵以待，让敌人尽管来攻。自然本质便是它们的屏障，敌人很快便会认识到这点
desc.en: The herd waits, allowing the enemy to come to them. Nature is their defence, as man will soon find out.

desc.zh: 战兽群严阵以待，让敌人尽管来攻。自然本质便是它们的屏障，敌人很快便会认识到这点
desc.en: The herd waits, allowing the enemy to come to them. Nature is their defence, as man will soon find out.

desc.zh: 战兽群严阵以待，让敌人尽管来攻。自然本质便是它们的屏障，敌人很快便会认识到这点
desc.en: The herd waits, allowing the enemy to come to them. Nature is their defence, as man will soon find out.

desc.zh: 战兽群严阵以待，让敌人尽管来攻。自然本质便是它们的屏障，敌人很快便会认识到这点
desc.en: The herd waits, allowing the enemy to come to them. Nature is their defence, as man will soon find out.

desc.zh: 战兽群冲锋在前，血盆大口中发出狂暴的战吼。此等怒涛之下，又有何人能够幸免？
desc.en: The herd charges out, slathering jaws and bellowing in fury. Against the charge, none can stand.

desc.zh: 战兽群冲锋在前，血盆大口中发出狂暴的战吼。此等怒涛之下，又有何人能够幸免？
desc.en: The herd charges out, slathering jaws and bellowing in fury. Against the charge, none can stand.

desc.zh: 战兽群冲锋在前，血盆大口中发出狂暴的战吼。此等怒涛之下，又有何人能够幸免？
desc.en: The herd charges out, slathering jaws and bellowing in fury. Against the charge, none can stand.

desc.zh: 战兽群冲锋在前，血盆大口中发出狂暴的战吼。此等怒涛之下，又有何人能够幸免？
desc.en: The herd charges out, slathering jaws and bellowing in fury. Against the charge, none can stand.

desc.zh: 黑暗诸神亲自为马拉戈安排了毁灭万物的日程表
desc.en: Malagor has a dread agenda given unto him by the Dark Gods themselves.

desc.zh: 用一名地卜师的头骨制成，当它盛满泥土时，圣杯就会召唤一场浸血湿泥组成的暴雨
desc.en: Made from the skull of a geomancer - when filled with soil, the chalice can summon a deluge of blood-soaked mud.

desc.zh: 从密林深处的一棵巫树上取下的天然雕像，这是萨满世代相传的宝物
desc.en: A crude effigy and shamanic heirloom from one of the hag trees that grow deep in the forest.

desc.zh: 每当这柄古老的、化石般的号角吹响时，长角族人都会血脉沸腾，对面之敌则会被蜂拥而来的兽群所淹没
desc.en: When this ancient, fossilised horn is sounded a cloud of disarray falls upon the enemy but emboldens the Gors.

desc.zh: 一柄强大的献祭工具，不断向外界传递着黑暗诸神上千祭品的怒火
desc.en: A potent sacrificial tool that radiates the wrath of a thousand different offerings to the Dark Gods.

desc.zh: 这颗惨白的头骨属于死去已久的伟大嘶叫萨满蚋寇斯，如今却已被装在了后人的手杖顶端
desc.en: The bleached skull of the long-dead Great Bray-Shaman, Rarkos, is mounted upon the bearer's staff.

desc.zh: 这面旗帜曾是一个美丽的人类国家骄傲的标志，但如今它已是黑暗诸神的虚荣和怨恨加持下的可悲战利品
desc.en: Once a proud standard of one of mankind’s petty nations; it is now a wretched trophy blessed with all the Dark Gods’ malice and vainglory.

desc.zh: 这是一套松垮破损的板甲套装，被人类宫殿和庙宇废墟冒出的滚滚浓烟熏得漆黑
desc.en: This battered suit of ramshackle plate mail is covered with the soot from man's burned palaces and temples.

desc.zh: 这些渎神标志简直各种各样，从死去祭司的头颅到被折断的罗伦森林神圣树枝，应有尽有
desc.en: These cursed items are all manner of blasphemy, from skulls of dead priests to hallowed, torn branches of Loren.

desc.zh: 一块奇异发光的岩石碎片，每当掷于地面时，都会引来一阵猛烈的魔法之风
desc.en: A sliver of strangely glowing stone that when cast to the ground will generate a tremendous gust of magical wind.

desc.zh: 这件上古锁子甲可以有效对抗来自敌方武器的魔法攻击
desc.en: This ancient suit of chainmail can counter the fanciful enchantments and magicks of enemy blades.

desc.zh: 巨魔的一张皮，能够赋予穿戴者比它的原初主人更强的威力！
desc.en: Trollhide confers some of the more gruesome abilities of its former occupant to the wearer!

desc.zh: 当进入托德布林格的杀伤范围后，那些士气已经较为低落的敌人的近战能力会遭受更为严重的惩罚
desc.en: When caught within radius of Todbringer, those enemies whose morale is already weak must face further penalties to their melee abilities.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满点燃野兽人心中撕碎敌人的豪情，让它们疯狂地扑向敌军
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman inflames the Beastmen’s urge to rend the foe, causing them to surge forward in a roaring, bellowing mass.

desc.zh: 琥珀便是野兽的颜色！相比那些所谓『高智商』的种族而言，这种魔法能够更为有效地猎获动物
desc.en: Amber is the colour of beasts. Such magic can ensnare and entrap animals much more easily than so-called "intelligent" species.

desc.zh: 这个蹩脚的兽王中毒了！兽群虚弱不堪，现在正是发动进攻的时机！
desc.en: The lame Beastlord is poisoned! The beast weakens - now is the time to strike!

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向了敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the spellcaster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向了敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the spellcaster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤野性的精灵，为友军的脆弱外表披上一层坚硬的皮肤
desc.en: Calling upon the beast-spirits of the wild, the caster sheathes vulnerable flesh in unyielding fur and hide.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤野性的精灵，为友军的脆弱外表披上一层坚硬的皮肤
desc.en: Calling upon the beast-spirits of the wild, the caster sheathes vulnerable flesh in unyielding fur and hide.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤野性的精灵，为友军的脆弱外表披上一层坚硬的皮肤
desc.en: Calling upon the beast-spirits of the wild, the caster sheathes vulnerable flesh in unyielding fur and hide.

desc.zh: 法师吹响扭曲的号角，召唤出一支灼热的琥珀长矛，并以难以置信的精度将其向敌人投去
desc.en: Sounding a gnarled horn, the caster summons a glowing amber spear and hurls it at the foe with uncanny accuracy.

desc.zh: 法师吹响扭曲的号角，召唤出一支灼热的琥珀长矛，并以难以置信的精度将其向敌人投去
desc.en: Sounding a gnarled horn, the caster summons a glowing amber spear and hurls it at the foe with uncanny accuracy.

desc.zh: 在施法者的召唤下，充满灵体的云雾将覆盖敌军，无形的利爪狠狠掐住敌人的咽喉
desc.en: At the spellcaster's command, nebulous nature spirits assail the foe, clawing with hands not nearly as insubstantial as they first appear.

desc.zh: 在施法者的召唤下，充满灵体的云雾将覆盖敌军，无形的利爪狠狠掐住敌人的咽喉
desc.en: At the spellcaster's command, nebulous nature spirits assail the foe, clawing with hands not nearly as insubstantial as they first appear.

desc.zh: 卡堂能够随意地变形为任何怪兽，甚至变成一头蝎尾狮。但遗憾的是，有一天他发现自己再也变不回来了…
desc.en: Kadon was able to shift his shape to that of any monster, even a Manticore. One day he found he could not change back...

desc.zh: 施法者释放出内心深处的野性，用狂怒将友军变换成野兽的形态
desc.en: The spellcaster unleashes the beast within, using its fury to transform allies into bestial forms.

desc.zh: 施法者释放出内心深处的野性，用狂怒将友军变换成野兽的形态
desc.en: The spellcaster unleashes the beast within, using its fury to transform allies into bestial forms.

desc.zh: 法师吹响扭曲的号角，召唤出一支灼热的琥珀长矛，并以难以置信的精度将其向敌人投去
desc.en: Sounding a gnarled horn, the caster summons a glowing amber spear and hurls it at the foe with uncanny accuracy.

desc.zh: 这一法术会召唤出潜伏地下的爬虫，令大群的蜘蛛、蜈蚣与食肉甲虫吞没敌军
desc.en: This spell calls to the creeping things of the undergrowth, sending a swarm of spiders, centipedes, and slug-beetles onto the foe.

desc.zh: 这一法术会释放出狂暴的战吼，炸裂敌人的脑壳，扯烂他们的眼睛
desc.en: This spell unleashes a howling roar of such intensity that it mashes brains and bursts eyeballs.

desc.zh: 这一法术会释放出狂暴的战吼，炸裂敌人的脑壳，扯烂他们的眼睛
desc.en: This spell unleashes a howling roar of such intensity that it mashes brains and bursts eyeballs.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满会纵情放大敌方心灵中蛮荒兽性的部分，直至他们变成哀鸣不已的小兽为止
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman magnifies the savage and animalistic parts of the foe's psyche until they are nothing more than growling beasts.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满会纵情放大敌方心灵中蛮荒兽性的部分，直至他们变成哀鸣不已的小兽为止
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman magnifies the savage and animalistic parts of the foe's psyche until they are nothing more than growling beasts.

desc.zh: 戈洛克是个传奇的牛头怪，此人性情烈如暴风。对于穿戴者来说，他的灵魂披风实在是个可怕而危险的物品
desc.en: Ghorok was a legendary Minotaur, ferocious as a storm. His spirit-mantle is terrible but dangerous to the bearer.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满以野性的力量控制一只独眼巨人，并将其召上战场
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman sends his mind winging into the wilds to possess a Cygor, then summons it to the battlefield.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满将狂怒深深刺入敌方的心中，释放其中的野性并令其转而自相残杀
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman drives a spear of wrath into enemy hearts, unlocking the beast within and causing them to turn against their own.

desc.zh: 嘶叫萨满将狂怒深深刺入敌方的心中，释放其中的野性并令其转而自相残杀
desc.en: The Bray-Shaman drives a spear of wrath into enemy hearts, unlocking the beast within and causing them to turn against their own.

desc.zh: 这一法术会召唤出潜伏地下的爬虫，令大群的蜘蛛、蜈蚣与食肉甲虫吞没敌军
desc.en: This spell calls to the creeping things of the undergrowth, sending a swarm of spiders, centipedes and slug-beetles onto the foe.

desc.zh: 这一法术会召唤出潜伏地下的爬虫，令大群的蜘蛛、蜈蚣与食肉甲虫吞没敌军
desc.en: This spell calls to the creeping things of the undergrowth, sending a swarm of spiders, centipedes and slug-beetles onto the foe.

desc.zh: 牛头怪领主的嗜血欲很容易感染下属，从而令其也陷入对杀戮与鲜血的渴望！
desc.en: The Minotaur Lord's blood-lust is infectious - his followers revel in the murder and gore!

desc.zh: 鲜血的气息越是浓厚，就会越发疯狂与凶蛮！
desc.en: Becoming more savage and frenzied the greater the scent and sight of blood.

desc.zh: 在以集群方式作战、畅饮与大吃大嚼时，这些军队会更为勇悍，虽然这种『勇悍』仅能持续不长的一段时间
desc.en: These troops are emboldened when fighting, drinking and feasting together, although such ‘bravery’ is only temporary at best.

desc.zh: 在氏族长们的激励，以及对血域遭到入侵的愤恨驱使下，野兽人们会爆发出极度蛮荒的狂怒！
desc.en: Goaded by Chieftains and enraged by intruders on their blood-grounds, Beastmen become consumed by a savage furore!

desc.zh: 独眼巨人对敌方法师灵魂的渴望，怕是世间罕有什么可以与之匹敌
desc.en: Cygors crave the souls of enemy Wizards more than anything else.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 伐人斧之所以能得到这个名称，是因为它砍人就如同砍倒小号的树木一样轻便
desc.en: The Axe of Men is so-called because it hacks through men as easily as other, lesser axes, hew timber.

desc.zh: 这柄长矛为放倒极北之地的庞然大物而造，上面附有能够深深穿透血肉的法术
desc.en: Made to fell the Mammuts of the far north, this spear bears enchantments that allow it to penetrate deep into flesh.

desc.zh: 灾祸之鞭是一件致命的嗜血兵器，里面包含着世世代代嘶叫萨满的恶毒诅咒
desc.en: Scourge is a lethal whip, thirsty for blood and wrapped in the bitter curses of many generations of Bray-Shamans.

desc.zh: 这柄声名狼藉的利刃中蕴含着强力的血魔法，即便被它轻轻割破一个小口也会血如泉涌
desc.en: This infamous blade bears a potent blood magick - even a slight cut will erupt in a geyser of gore.

desc.zh: 阉人刀不仅能够伤害肉体，同时可以摧残意志。整个旧世界的战士们无不闻之色变，这自然不是空穴来风
desc.en: Mangelder saps the strength of mind as well as body. It is a weapon rightly feared across the Old World.

desc.zh: 黄铜砍刀据传是另一个国度的造物，它古老而可怕，无限渴望着鲜血
desc.en: The Brass Cleaver is said to be an artefact from another realm - ancient and terrible, it thirsts for blood.

desc.zh: 在帝国选帝侯们所拥有的十二把魔剑中，这把米登领符文之牙可以让持有者的伤势恢复得更为迅速
desc.en: One of twelve magical swords belonging to the Empire's Elector Counts, 'Legbiter' enables its bearer to recover more quickly if wounded.

desc.zh: 在如此耀眼的信仰之光下，敌人将变得无法行动，这就是西格玛信念的力量！
desc.en: Such is the strength of Sigmar's favour that enemies fail to act in the presence of such brilliance.

desc.zh: 这个古老的指环上带有一块深红色的血精石，似乎它正是冯·卡斯坦因一族长生不死之力的源泉
desc.en: An ancestral ring, set with a gem of deep, sanguine claret, that has granted the von Carsteins everlasting Undeath.

desc.zh: 这本破旧的书籍中充满了黑暗的秘密和恐怖的力量，阅读此书定会激发邪恶的念头与残忍的欲望
desc.en: This decrepit tome bristles with dark secrets and eldritch powers. Reading from it summons dark thoughts and grim deeds.

desc.zh: 这个小小的偶像散发着诱人的绿色荧光，会为佩戴者带来很奇妙的再生能力
desc.en: This small idol shimmers with an eerie green light, bestowing unnatural regenerative powers upon the wearer.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼领主经常隐于世间，声东击西，以一系列的诡计搞得敌人顾此失彼
desc.en: This Vampire Lord feints and shades, confounding their enemy into missteps and errors.

desc.zh: 弗拉德的出现会极大地激励其手下的忠仆，无人胆敢同亡灵之主作对！
desc.en: Vlad motivates his devoted followers with his majestic presence; the Lord of Undeath is without peer.

desc.zh: 史崔格食尸鬼王自有神力，能够令它的亡灵忠仆们一次次地重新复苏
desc.en: The Strigoi Ghoul King has the ability to resurrect his Undead servants time and time again.

desc.zh: 黑暗畜生们要小心了，因为法师会释放出一道纯净光波，将白魔法之敌尽数放逐
desc.en: Creatures of the dark beware, for the Mage casts a ball of pure light to banish enemies of White Wizardry.

desc.zh: 黑暗畜生们要小心了，因为法师会释放出一道纯净光波，将白魔法之敌尽数放逐
desc.en: Creatures of the dark beware, for the Mage casts a ball of pure light to banish enemies of White Wizardry.

desc.zh: 战斗牧师祈求西格玛赐予他们些微的神圣之力，让他的铁锤放射出了力量的光芒！
desc.en: The Warrior Priest implores Sigmar to imbue him with a modicum of divine strength, and now his hammer glows bright with power!

desc.zh: 法师施放出一张魔法之网，用以束缚大欺诈者本人。所有被丝网缠绕者都会动弹不得
desc.en: The Wizard casts an arcane net, created to hold the Great Deceiver himself. Any caught in its strands will struggle to act.

desc.zh: 战斗牧师的信仰化身为一道护盾，硬如城堡锻铁
desc.en: The Warrior Priest’s faith manifests in the form of a shield as hard as castle-forged steel.

desc.zh: 战斗牧师们念出战斗祷告，一层白色圣火包裹了他们全身，灼烧西格玛的敌人，却不会伤害祈求者自己
desc.en: A battle prayer that bathes the Warrior Priest in white, holy fire, sears Sigmar’s foes but leaves the supplicant unharmed.

desc.zh: 死者的灵魂攻击着巫师的敌人，蚕食着他们的斗志，在军中散播着恐慌
desc.en: Spirits of the departed assail the Wizard’s foes, sapping their resolve and causing dread among their numbers.

desc.zh: 借助沙许的病态力量，法师们可以在战斗中削弱敌人的求生意识
desc.en: Harnessing the sickly power of Shyish, the Wizard weakens the foe's will to survive the battle.

desc.zh: 巫师的乌木法杖一指向目标，肮脏的法术便会开始汲取它的灵魂
desc.en: The Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, leeching its spirit through tainted sorcery.

desc.zh: 法师口中吐出一句古老的咒语，让敌人可怕地快速衰老，头发变白，皮肤干枯
desc.en: The Wizard spits out an ancient curse, causing his enemies to age at an incredible rate - their hair turning white and skin shrivelling up.

desc.zh: 黑魔法束从施法者眼中放出，使皮肉凋零、骨头坏死
desc.en: Bolts of Dark Magic leap from the caster’s eyes, withering flesh and blackening the bone beneath.

desc.zh: 黑魔法束从施法者眼中放出，使皮肉凋零、骨头坏死
desc.en: Bolts of Dark Magic leap from the caster’s eyes, withering flesh and blackening the bone beneath.

desc.zh: 施法者吟唱着纳迦什的可怕音节，让友方的目标逐渐复原
desc.en: The caster intones the dread syllables once uttered by Nagash, restoring friendly targets.

desc.zh: 施法者吟唱着纳迦什的可怕音节，让友方的目标逐渐复原
desc.en: The caster intones the dread syllables once uttered by Nagash, restoring friendly targets.

desc.zh: 赫尔曼·苟斯特，这位多愁善感的亡灵法师非常擅长用黑魔法的禁忌知识来驱役亡灵，并强迫他们为其服务
desc.en: Helman Ghorst, the maudlin Necromancer, uses his dark knowledge of the black arts to raise the dead and bring them under his control.

desc.zh: 曾经显赫一时的史崔格家族，现在居住在阴冷的墓穴里，驱策肮脏的食腐动物为其效命
desc.en: The once-proud Strigoi now dwell in dank recesses, binding foul, crypt-dwelling scavengers to their inexorable will.

desc.zh: 赫尔曼·苟斯特，这位多愁善感的亡灵法师非常擅长用黑魔法的禁忌知识来驱役亡灵，并强迫他们为其服务
desc.en: Helman Ghorst, the maudlin Necromancer, uses his dark knowledge of the black arts to raise the dead and bring them under his control.

desc.zh: 曾经显赫一时的史崔格家族，现在居住在阴冷的墓穴里，驱策肮脏的食腐动物为其效命
desc.en: The once-proud Strigoi now dwell in dank recesses, binding foul, crypt-dwelling scavengers to their inexorable will.

desc.zh: 令友方部队笼罩在魔法能量中，让他们变得更加凶猛！
desc.en: Friendly targets are filled with magical energy, making them even more aggressive!

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽冥之风，狂啸着扫入敌方大军，令敌军的灵魂立时出窍
desc.en: The Wizard calls forth spectral winds that howl through the enemy ranks, tearing their souls from their bodies.

desc.zh: 尸火中包含着大量的次元石碎屑，因此燃烧的火盆会让正常人类逐渐变得疯狂无比
desc.en: Balefire contains trace elements of Warpstone, so the burning braziers slowly drive mortal men to madness.

desc.zh: 这本永不该有人阅读的邪恶书卷，能够让和煦的魔法之风瞬间化为狂岚
desc.en: The unholy, never-to-be spoken words of this ancient grimoire cause the Winds of Magic to blow like a hurricane.

desc.zh: 这一冰冷刺骨的光环会让附近的敌人全部举步维艰，几乎停顿，如同深陷暴风雪，或是挣扎于泥沼中一般
desc.en: As if the enemy were caught in a blizzard or wading through treacle, the ice-cold aura slows any unit within range to a near-standstill.

desc.zh: 当善恶间的最终会战徐徐拉开了大幕，鞭笞者们也做好了拥抱死亡的准备。时辰已到，末日将至！
desc.en: As the final battle between good and evil looms, the flagellants ready to embrace death. The time is near; the end is nigh!

desc.zh: 当高居空中时，这件堕落的圣物会让那些效忠于其卑劣力量的人们倍感鼓舞
desc.en: This depraved artefact, when held aloft, restores energy to those who swear fealty to its vileness.

desc.zh: 胆敢反抗这种亵渎之力的人，莫不屈服于其腐蚀之下，直至死亡
desc.en: Those who dare to stand against this profane monument will suffer from its corrupting influence, to their demise.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 运尸车上奥术之钟的鸣响，时刻激励着亡灵战士奋勇作战，即使身受重伤也在所不惜
desc.en: The ringing of the arcane bell atop the Corpse Cart inspires Undead minions to continue fighting, even when grievously wounded.

desc.zh: 运尸车会重新凝聚破碎的精魂，修正碎烂的躯体，从而令其得以犯下更大的暴行
desc.en: The Corpse Cart hardens shattered spirits and emboldens tattered bodies to ever greater acts of violence.

desc.zh: 这把充满诅咒的利刃深深浸透着受害者的血液，同时赋予其使用者强大的力量
desc.en: This accursed blade drinks deep of its victim's blood, restoring vigour and strength to the one who brandishes it.

desc.zh: 高举永恒女王亲手编织的战旗步入战场，将是部队极大的荣耀，因此他们绝然不会动摇
desc.en: Those who go to battle with the Everqueen's personally hand-woven banner do so proudly, and never waver.

desc.zh: 虽然饱经风霜，但这面以狩猎之王命名的战旗仍然激励着部队冲锋在整支精灵大军之前
desc.en: Though tattered and ancient, this banner causes forces to charge - in the name of the Hunt - before the main Elven host.

desc.zh: 你当然可以召唤嗜血的狩猎之神来协助你，但请千万记得在事后感谢她的援助…
desc.en: By all means summon the bloodthirsty Goddess of the Hunt to assist you, but always make sure you thank her afterwards…

desc.zh: 狩猎之神保佑着这支箭矢，因此它的射程会变得更远，并赐予其精准的精度与可怕的威力
desc.en: The God of the Hunt blesses this arrow so it can travel great distances with unwavering accuracy and terrifying power.

desc.zh: 弥散林中的魔法力量会赐福于那些保卫森林的人
desc.en: The magical power permeating the forests is bestowed upon those who defend it.

desc.zh: 鹰隼般的运动：翱翔、迅捷、优雅，直至终结你的生命
desc.en: Movement like the hawk’s - soaring, graceful, puissant; ending in your death.

desc.zh: 货真价实的『鹰眼』能够万无一失地命中目标。是的，万无一失
desc.en: The truly hawk-eyed always hit their targets. Always.

desc.zh: 这阵箭雨会将大量锋利的箭矢投向目标，这是一阵真正的死亡之雨
desc.en: These arrows shower their targets with dozens of razor-sharp shards; a percussive shot of death.

desc.zh: 当这一远古神圣遗物吹响时，所有精灵军队都将壮怀激烈地投向狩猎场
desc.en: When this ancient and revered relic is blown, all Elven forces are driven to the Hunt with a savage determination.

desc.zh: 这面披风每年都会由艾瑞尔亲手进行维护，奥莱恩仅凭此物便可护卫自身
desc.en: This cloak, renewed annually by Ariel herself, is all Orion needs to protect himself.

desc.zh: 绝望乃是艾索洛伦诸多恶意中最为可怕的一种，它的到来通常预示着即刻降临的死亡
desc.en: The Despairs are among the most feared Spites within Athel Loren, their arrival always foretelling imminent death.

desc.zh: 召唤混沌的精华，将毁灭性的狂怒倾泻到任何胆敢直面混沌的愚者身上
desc.en: To summon the essence of Chaos is to unleash its Ruinous fury upon any and all who witness it.

desc.zh: 召唤混沌的精华，将毁灭性的狂怒倾泻到任何胆敢直面混沌的愚者身上
desc.en: To summon the essence of Chaos is to unleash its Ruinous fury upon any and all who witness it.

desc.zh: 奥莱恩的战狼时刻伴随在他的左右，以汹涌的怒火奋不顾身地保护着主人的安危
desc.en: Orion's wolves run with their Lord, defending his person with great savagery and scant regard for their own lives.

desc.zh: 这是森林的鲜活化身，他们能够让战士们感到更为强烈的战争召唤
desc.en: The living embodiment of the forest; through them, their warriors feel a greater call to war.

desc.zh: 精灵们的灵魂与艾索洛伦的命运紧密相连，因此精灵军队会为艾索洛伦拼死而战
desc.en: Elven troops will fight for Athel Loren, for their very souls are tethered to its fate.

desc.zh: 精灵统帅的锐目能够从难以置信的遥远距离上发现敌人，因此他也对麾下军队做出了同样的要求
desc.en: Elven leaders’ keen eyes can spot an enemy at a distance that defies belief, and so they demand the same of their troops.

desc.zh: 在盯住了敌人之后，将领们会用库诺斯的精神与意志激励军队，从而更好地毁灭敌军
desc.en: Setting their eye upon the foe, the general imbues their troops with Kurnous' spirit and the will to see his enemies destroyed.

desc.zh: 纵使最为简单的法术，也能起到去旧换新，重唤精力，弥合伤口的作用
desc.en: Even the simplest of spells can bring forth the full bloom of renewal, reinvigorating and healing the broken and bleeding.

desc.zh: 法术祈唤出的阴影如同真实阴影一样地模糊：阴影法师正是这种『欺骗』艺术的大师
desc.en: A conjured shadow is just as obfuscating as a real one - the Shadow Wizard is master or mistress of the 'concealing' arts.

desc.zh: 魔古尔的毁灭之力聚集成了变形的光环，可以保护其免受大部分的伤害。但在光环冷却时，魔古尔会相当脆弱
desc.en: Morghur's Ruinous, transformative aura protects him from damage most of the time, but he is vulnerable whilst it recharges.

desc.zh: 艾瑞尔的庇护治疗着受伤的追随者们。随着时间的推移，他们的力量会逐渐变强
desc.en: Ariel's blessings heal the wounded among her followers, their power increasing with the passing of time.

desc.zh: 魔古尔的嘶叫萨满引导着兽王的力量，向周围的战场上散播腐蚀，从而令敌人随着时间的流逝受到越来越大的伤害
desc.en: Morghur's Bray-Shaman channels the Beastlord's power to spread corruption across the battlefield, causing greater damage to his foes as time goes by.

desc.zh: 这一来自黑暗亲王的『礼物』足以让部队死于非命并化为混沌之卵。不仅周边诸人，甚至连他们自己都将惊讶不已！
desc.en: This 'gift' from the Dark Prince causes the unit to spontaneously die and mutate into Chaos Spawn, surprising everyone – themselves included!

desc.zh: 多刺的荆棘从施法者盟友周围的地表喷涌而出，形成一道尖刺拱卫的鲜活护盾
desc.en: Prickly gorse bursts from the ground around the caster's allies, protecting them from attack like a spiky, living shield.

desc.zh: 在施法者的召唤下，充满灵体的云雾将覆盖敌军，无形的利爪狠狠掐住敌人的咽喉
desc.en: At the spellcaster's command, nebulous nature spirits assail the foe, clawing with hands not nearly as insubstantial as they first appear.

desc.zh: 森林已存活了上千年，拥有着超凡的记忆。当得到战争召唤时，它们将释放出压抑数世纪之久的狂怒
desc.en: Trees live for thousands of years and have very long memories. When called to fight, centuries of pent-up wrath are unleashed.

desc.zh: 森林已存活了上千年，拥有着超凡的记忆。当得到战争召唤时，它们将释放出压抑数世纪之久的狂怒
desc.en: Trees live for thousands of years and have very long memories. When called to fight, centuries of pent-up wrath are unleashed.

desc.zh: 法师从土地中召唤出治愈性的能量，以来自大地的自然痊愈之力庇护战士们
desc.en: The Wizard draws wholesome energies from the soil, imbuing companions with the natural resilience of the earth.

desc.zh: 法师从土地中召唤出治愈性的能量，以来自大地的自然痊愈之力庇护战士们
desc.en: The Wizard draws wholesome energies from the soil, imbuing companions with the natural resilience of the earth.

desc.zh: 法师从土地中召唤出治愈性的能量，以来自大地的自然痊愈之力庇护战士们
desc.en: The Wizard draws wholesome energies from the soil, imbuing companions with the natural resilience of the earth.

desc.zh: 这一法术可以暂时将友军的血肉之躯转换成刀枪不入的岩石皮肤，从而大大增强其抵御攻击的能力
desc.en: This spell temporarily transforms allies' mortal flesh into unbreakable rock, increasing tenfold their resistance to attack.

desc.zh: 这一法术可以暂时将友军的血肉之躯转换成刀枪不入的岩石皮肤，从而大大增强其抵御攻击的能力
desc.en: This spell temporarily transforms allies' mortal flesh into unbreakable rock, increasing tenfold their resistance to attack.

desc.zh: 法师呼唤着杜仁铎之名，以超乎寻常的速度治愈盟友的伤势
desc.en: By speaking Druthandor's name the Wizard is able to heal allies' injuries much faster than by natural means.

desc.zh: 法师呼唤着杜仁铎之名，以超乎寻常的速度治愈盟友的伤势
desc.en: By speaking Druthandor's name the Wizard is able to heal allies' injuries much faster than by natural means.

desc.zh: 多刺的荆棘从施法者盟友周围的地表喷涌而出，形成一道尖刺拱卫的鲜活护盾
desc.en: Prickly gorse bursts from the ground around the caster's allies, protecting them from attack like a spiky, living shield.

desc.zh: 多刺的荆棘从施法者盟友周围的地表喷涌而出，形成一道尖刺拱卫的鲜活护盾
desc.en: Prickly gorse bursts from the ground around the caster's allies, protecting them from attack like a spiky, living shield.
