desc.en: Prickly gorse bursts from the ground around the caster's allies, protecting them from attack like a spiky, living shield.

desc.zh: 这一法术会从地面召唤出粗糙而扭曲的树枝，紧紧罩住敌人并使其窒息而亡
desc.en: This spell causes gnarled, fibrous hands to emerge from beneath the ground, dragging the foe to a claustrophobic, suffocating end.

desc.zh: 这一法术会从地面召唤出粗糙而扭曲的树枝，紧紧罩住敌人并使其窒息而亡
desc.en: This spell causes gnarled, fibrous hands to emerge from beneath the ground, dragging the foe to a claustrophobic, suffocating end.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵足以麻痹敌军的迷乱之雾，令其变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵足以麻痹敌军的迷乱之雾，令其变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.

name.zh: 高级梅尔克斯的迷魂毒瘴

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出一阵足以麻痹敌军的迷乱之雾，令其变得步履蹒跚
desc.en: The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.

desc.zh: 超自然的神力总是最好的选择：武器在施法者的盟友面前凭空出现，使他们能够剁碎肉体，劈斩灵魂，甚至剥夺意识
desc.en: The supernatural solution is often the best; weapons materialise before the caster's allies, allowing them to slice through flesh, soul, and consciousness.

name.zh: 高级奥卡姆的意念剃刀

desc.zh: 超自然的神力总是最好的选择：武器在施法者的盟友面前凭空出现，使他们能够剁碎肉体，劈斩灵魂，甚至剥夺意识
desc.en: The supernatural solution is often the best; weapons materialise before the caster's allies, allowing them to slice through flesh, soul, and consciousness.

desc.zh: 施法者开启一个通往地狱深渊的漩涡，它将永久地吞噬一切卷入其中之物
desc.en: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.

desc.zh: 施法者开启一个通往地狱深渊的漩涡，它将永久地吞噬一切卷入其中之物
desc.en: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.

desc.zh: 施法者开启一个通往地狱深渊的漩涡，它将永久地吞噬一切卷入其中之物
desc.en: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.

desc.zh: 此法术一旦释放便会麻痹敌人的意志，令其被来自现实的沉痛压力击倒在地
desc.en: When cast, this spell enfeebles enemy minds; they feel the crushing weight of reality bearing down upon them.

desc.zh: 此法术一旦释放便会麻痹敌人的意志，令其被来自现实的沉痛压力击倒在地
desc.en: When cast, this spell enfeebles enemy minds; they feel the crushing weight of reality bearing down upon them.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽灵般的钟摆。随着一声令下，它将急速摇摆起来并穿越敌方阵势，锋利的刀刃足以切肉断骨
desc.en: A spectral pendulum is summoned by the Wizard. On command, it swings, razor sharp and with lethal speed, through the foe.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽灵般的钟摆。随着一声令下，它将急速摇摆起来并穿越敌方阵势，锋利的刀刃足以切肉断骨
desc.en: A spectral pendulum is summoned by the Wizard. On command, it swings, razor sharp and with lethal speed, through the foe.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽灵般的钟摆。随着一声令下，它将急速摇摆起来并穿越敌方阵势，锋利的刀刃足以切肉断骨
desc.en: A spectral pendulum is summoned by the Wizard. On command, it swings, razor sharp and with lethal speed, through the foe.

desc.zh: 法师使用怀疑与危机感侵蚀敌人的思维，从内心深处击垮敌军
desc.en: The Wizard destroys the foe from within, corroding their minds with doubt and crisis.

desc.zh: 法师使用怀疑与危机感侵蚀敌人的思维，从内心深处击垮敌军
desc.en: The Wizard destroys the foe from within, corroding their minds with doubt and crisis.

desc.zh: 法师使用怀疑与危机感侵蚀敌人的思维，从内心深处击垮敌军
desc.en: The Wizard destroys the foe from within, corroding their minds with doubt and crisis.

desc.zh: 这股舞蹈之中，展现着怎样的暴力美学？漫卷般的利刃，一意专心的凶蛮…
desc.en: What beauty and violence there is in the dance? A flurry of blades and a certain savagery of intent...

desc.zh: 战舞者们扭动着各种姿态，磨砺着自己的身心，以便应对各种可能的敌人
desc.en: The wending and twisting of the Wardancers hardens their spirits and their bodies against would-be attackers.

desc.zh: 战舞者们曼妙回旋，创造出了一个轻盈的保护层，来偏转射来的箭雨和弹丸
desc.en: The Wardancer threads and loops, contorting to create an ethereal fabric that turns aside arrows and bolts.

desc.zh: 树人先祖自最为深邃，最为阴冷的森林中醒来，只为护佑自己的森林同胞免遭敌人的毒害
desc.en: From the deepest, dankest forest depths a Treeman Ancient rises, charged with protecting its forest-kin from harm.

desc.zh: 这些战士的思维已经彻底固定在了守卫荒林的使命上，没有任何人能够影响这一点
desc.en: The minds of these warriors are turned over entirely to the defence of the Wildwood; nothing else affects them.

desc.zh: 这把利剑如杜尔苏本人一样，早已在苦难中浸泡了千年，时刻准备着释放它的怒火
desc.en: This blade, like Durthu himself, is steeped in millennia of bitterness and rage waiting to be unleashed.

desc.zh: 所谓的『北方之剑』不会惧怕任何决斗，任何胆敢挑战他的人都将迎来自己的死亡！
desc.en: The so-called 'Northern Sword' fears no duel; anyone who dares confront him will surely meet their death!

desc.zh: 自然响应着奥莱恩的呼唤，对胆敢侵犯艾索洛伦的敌人泼下漫天箭雨
desc.en: Nature manifests at Orion's call, raining a flurry of arrows upon the enemy in defence of Athel Loren.

desc.zh: 一旦奥莱恩投出这支有生命的武器，它定将击倒面前最强悍的敌人，然后才会回到主人的手中
desc.en: When Orion hurls this living weapon with fierce purpose it fells the most powerful foes before returning to its master.

desc.zh: 魔古尔扭曲的手杖中汇聚着毁灭的本质，它能够召唤致命的混沌之卵，在战场上遵命死战
desc.en: Imbued with the quiddity of Ruin, Morghur's gnarled staff summons deadly Chaos Spawn to do his bidding on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 洛伦之弓上配备的乃是由艾瑞尔女王的头发所制成的弓弦，这是一件不世出的神兵利器
desc.en: Made with a single, pristine hair from Queen Ariel, the Bow of Loren is a weapon without peer.

desc.zh: 最近乌尔扎戈冒出了怪想法，那就是制作敌人的巫毒娃娃，然后在上面钉上钉子来『免得这些傻瓜逃掉』
desc.en: Recently, Wurrzag has taken to carrying a doll or ‘effagee’ of his foes and sticking pins in them to “stop da gitz from gettin’ away”.

desc.zh: 曾经是一位萨满，如今却被乌尔扎戈变成了一只野兽，并成为了绿先知强大魔力的鲜活例证
desc.en: Once a Shaman, now a beast transformed by Wurrzag and retained as an example of Da Great Green Prophet's might.

desc.zh: 贝勒加身旁总是携带着他那硕大的誓言之石。在情况危急时，他会高傲地站在上面死战到底
desc.en: Belegar carries his enormous Oath Stone everywhere. In dire times, he stands tauntingly atop it to fight to the end.

desc.zh: 贝勒加的血管中涌动着矮人们数个世纪以来的仇怨，它们激励着贝勒加将狂暴的复仇倾泻到敌人头上
desc.en: Centuries of Dwarf grudges flow through Belegar's veins, who uses them to wreak vengeance upon his enemies.

desc.zh: 恶月激发了它的那些奇怪而恶心的崇拜者们的好战情绪，刺激他们去制造更强烈的痛苦
desc.en: Da Bad Moon offers heightened pugnacity to its weird and disgusting worshippers, spurring them to dish out even more pain.

desc.zh: 对于夜地精来说，史卡斯尼克的那些恶毒计划与阴险伎俩总会令它们欣喜若狂
desc.en: The Night Goblins are delighted and emboldened by Skarsnik's sly, furtive plans and fiendish machinations.

desc.zh: 铁砧散发着浓烈的神力，为周围的矮人们阻挡着一切来自敌人的魔法
desc.en: The dense power exuded from the Anvil dampens any enemy magics hurled at Dawi nearby.

desc.zh: 史卡斯尼克通过一系列的阴谋诡计征服了八峰山。如果形势需要，他不介意继续如此行事！
desc.en: Skarsnik conquered the Eight Peaks through cheating and manipulation, and he will do so again if needs be!

desc.zh: 乌尔扎戈的脸上绘满了可怕的战纹，这会让敌人心惊肉跳，这样绿先知就能够好好利用这一点了
desc.en: The terrifying visage painted upon Wurrzag affects enemies' concentration, allowing him to take full advantage of their confusion!

desc.zh: 乌尔扎戈会令敌人深陷混乱，让他们的言语变得空洞无力，满口胡言
desc.en: Wurrzag inflicts a cloud of confusion upon his enemies, whose words ring hollow and spells fly false.

desc.zh: 若是祈求者确实值得庇佑，那么西格玛或尤里克便会响应他的祈唤，以信仰之盾护佑此人
desc.en: Swiftly invoking the protection of Sigmar or Ulric blesses the implorer with a shield of godly faith, should they prove worthy.

desc.zh: 裁判官们狂热无比，绝不容忍异端，并且拥有强大的近战技巧。这些人对西格玛教会的职责已远远超出了『奉献』二字
desc.en: Elite in their zealotry, intolerance, and combat abilities, Inquisitors serve the Church of Sigmar above and beyond the call of duty.

desc.zh: 并不是所有的史奎格都会一直有用。对于其中一些来说…『砰』的一声会更有价值
desc.en: Not all Squigs have lasting usefulness. Some have a more fleeting... 'percussive' utility.

desc.zh: 这个强大符文的秘技曾由瓦拉雅亲自传授给某个符文领主，魔法的保护能让一切事物免受灾祸的影响
desc.en: The secret of this powerful rune was given to a Runelord by Valaya herself, insulating all under its auspices with protection from magic.

name.zh: 大师级誓言与钢铁符文

desc.zh: 这件镌刻誓言与钢铁符文的护甲永远不会弯曲或变形
desc.en: Armour inscribed with the Rune of Oath & Steel will not bend or buckle.

name.zh: 大师级愤怒与毁灭符文

desc.zh: 当符文领主在末日铁砧上敲打的时候，他造就了愤怒与毁灭符文，当是时，大地为之迸裂，喷出硫磺和火焰
desc.en: As the Runelord hammers upon the Anvil of Doom he shapes the Rune of Wrath & Ruin, causing the earth to crack and vent forth fire and sulphur.

desc.zh: 此符文的神秘光芒令人敬畏不已，会令敌人心中充满恐惧
desc.en: The uncanny glow of this rune is an awe-inspiring sight, apt to fill foes with debilitating dread.

desc.zh: 灶台与家园符文会激发矮人们对城塞、氏族以及先祖的无上荣誉感
desc.en: The Rune of Hearth & Home stirs a Dwarf's pride in his noble Hold, Clan and Ancestors.

desc.zh: 最深的恶意变成绿色光束从萨满眼中射出，向敌人奔袭而去
desc.en: Green bolts of purest spite burst forth from the Shaman and streak towards the enemy.

desc.zh: 那些被强大的游侠或其部众打上死亡印记的敌人，会发现他们的护甲与盾牌忽然变得不堪一击了…
desc.en: Those marked for death by the mighty Ranger or his crew may find their armour and shield of little practical use…

desc.zh: 不要惊讶，纵使最凶残的阿拉克纳瑞巨蛛也会有护幼本能，并会随意地将它们招到身旁
desc.en: Somewhat surprisingly, even the deadliest Arachnarok feels protective of her brood, and can draw them to her at will.

desc.zh: 矮人轰炸机的火力要比矮人直升机强大得多。要是所携带的多重有效载荷全部命中目标，那景象一定美不胜收！
desc.en: The Gyrobomber is fitted with much larger ordnance than the Gyrocopter. Should the multiple payloads hit their intended target the results will be quite spectacular!

desc.zh: 矮人轰炸机的火力要比矮人直升机强大得多。要是所携带的多重有效载荷全部命中目标，那景象一定美不胜收！
desc.en: The Gyrobomber is fitted with much larger ordnance than the Gyrocopter. Should the multiple payloads hit their intended target the results will be quite spectacular!

desc.zh: 以辛辣的烟雾堵塞敌人的感官，这样敌人便会不堪一击了
desc.en: Clogging the senses with acrid, stinging smoke leaves an enemy completely vulnerable.

desc.zh: 卡拉克·八峰山的地精狂徒们并不会在铁链上绑上链球：相反，他们会绑上活生生的矮人作为替代！
desc.en: The Goblin Fanatics of Karak Eight Peaks eschew the use of balls with their chains, favouring shaved Dwarfs instead!

desc.zh: 三两杯『伯格曼的勇气』下了肚，矮人们八成会不要命地血战到底，虽然脚下会有些不灵光罢了
desc.en: A touch of Bugman's Courage can keep a Dawi standing and fighting, a touch unsteadily, on their feet.

desc.zh: 绿皮对胜利的渴求绝无什么仁慈可言，他们会不择手段地争取优势！
desc.en: Greenskins are never gracious in victory. Wherever they can press an unfair advantage, they will!

desc.zh: 顽强、强壮、坚韧、暴躁——矮人们的这些天性能够在战场上淋漓尽致地化为战斗力
desc.en: Strong and tenacious, the Dawi’s hardy, passionate nature can be put to lethally good use on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 要是不告诉史奎格该去咬什么，它就会去咬一切被它看到的东西——无论是你，是我，还是它自己！
desc.en: If a Squig is not told what to bite, it will bite anything. Me, you, itself - anything!

desc.zh: 他们有着大年纪，长胡须和超凡的勇气；意志能让他们血战到底
desc.en: Age, beard-length, and the courage that binds them; motivation, if any were needed, to fight on to the end.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 这是史卡斯尼克的尖锐权杖，其中充满了脉动着的魔力。它可以引导搞毛二哥的强大力量，并以狂野而恐怖的形式释放出来
desc.en: Skarsnik's pointed staff, pulsating with magical energy, channels the might of Gork (or Mork) to lance out with weird, terrifying power.

desc.zh: 这根权杖刻满了魔力护符，可以保护乌尔扎戈免受许多指向他的远程魔法的攻击
desc.en: Covered in magical glyphs, this staff protects Wurrzag from the many magical machinations ranged against him.

desc.zh: 数世纪以来，这柄铁锤一直在饱尝着绿皮的鲜血，并成为了八峰山之主安格朗德氏族代代相传的宝物
desc.en: Soaked in centuries of Greenskin blood, the Ironhammer has been handed down to every rightful Angrund ruler of the Eight Peaks.

desc.zh: 这些强大的战士，简直强到了仅用一击就能斩掉龙首，或是仅用一剑便可刺入狮鹫的心脏
desc.en: There are powerful beings who can decapitate a dragon or plunge a sword into the heart of a griffon in one mighty strike.

desc.zh: 这柄剑闪着诡异的光芒，它的每一次挥舞都会毫不费力地斩开敌人的皮肉
desc.en: Glowing with an uncanny light, each stroke of this sword effortlessly carves the foe clean through.

desc.zh: 当你出现在他视野中的那一刻，便已经给打上了死亡的记号。之所以你还能喘上几口气，那只是完全出于礼节而已
desc.en: If you are in his sight you are marked for death from that moment on; your remaining breaths are a mere formality.

desc.zh: 『谁都别想过去！』
desc.en: “None shall pass!”

desc.zh: 从天空的最高处，法师将一颗游荡的彗星拉向了战场
desc.en: Reaching to the highest heavens, the Wizard draws a wandering meteorite down upon the battlefield.

desc.zh: 海神的三叉戟所攻击之人，会被愤怒的波涛撕成碎块
desc.en: Those struck by the Sea God’s trident are swept away by a crushing tide of furious wrath.

desc.zh: 『怕是只有我的灵魂被填满时，我才会知道它曾经有多么空虚』
desc.en: "I didn't know how empty was my soul... until it was filled."

desc.zh: 劳恩国王的盾牌自他踏上骑士道的第一天起便在护佑着他。魔力让这支盾牌坚硬无比，它也将继续护佑着主人
desc.en: King Louen’s shield has protected him from the first days of his Knighthood; strengthened by enchantment, it will continue to do so.

desc.zh: 超自然的雾气笼罩着敌人，并在敌人的周围与体内流动；那些应受惩治之人，便会遭到女神魔力触摸的强烈制裁
desc.en: The unearthly vapour moves around the foe, in between and inside – those found wanting are scarred by the Lady’s enchanted touch.

desc.zh: 艾博里克不仅是个骑士，也是一位能够在战场上激励麾下将士的真正领袖
desc.en: More than just a Knight, Alberic is a true leader of men whose warriors are emboldened by his fighting spirit in battle.

desc.zh: 部队在冲锋前结成楔形阵，允许骑兵部队突破敌方战线，从而打散敌方的阵列
desc.en: Forming a wedge before the charge enables mounted Knights to smash through enemy lines, causing great disarray among their ranks.

desc.zh: 这绝不仅仅是忠诚或竭诚，对于女神与王国的真正信仰会强烈地激励着骑士们步入战场
desc.en: Far more than allegiance or loyalty, true dedication to Lady and kingdom further empowers her Knights on the field.

desc.zh: 侠义骑士在战场上热血贲张，他们渴望着在激烈的战斗中赢得荣誉。这些人会勇敢地投入战斗，不避生死，要么载誉而归，要么光荣尽瘁
desc.en: On the battlefield, the Knights Errant are impetuous, eager to earn fame and honour in the thick of the fight. They charge boldly into the fray, heedless of danger and earning either great honour or a glorious death.

desc.zh: 普天之下，莫非王土。缴税纳款，公义其求。庶民之道，劳筋苦骨。唯有佳节，可暂得休。量彼所产，应缴什九。十中取一，可为自留。巴托尼亚，骑士之国。此法爱民，谁敢不乐？
desc.en: Thou shalt give unto thine glorious liege the taxes that he requires. Thou shalt labour all but feast days, and no more than a tenth-share shall you keep for kith and kin. Rejoice! For a Knight of Bretonnia provides your shield!

desc.zh: 此人被诅咒着必须走遍世界的山山水水，他的征途永无止境：挑战并击败那些世间最强的勇士
desc.en: Cursed to wander the length and breadth of the world, his never-ending quest to challenge and best the most gifted warriors.

desc.zh: 这样的暴力是近乎极致的疯狂，『狂暴』根本不足以形容其程度
desc.en: Violence bordering on absolute delirium; 'berserk' doesn't even come close.

desc.zh: 巨身狼人的肉体上刻满了黑暗诸神的符号与印记，这为他们破败的物理形体上增加了额外的奥术防护
desc.en: Werekin flesh is scored with the symbols and marks of the Dark Gods, granting additional arcane protection to their ravaged physical forms.

desc.zh: 在经过多次自然变异的锻造之后，人皮狼身上经受腐蚀洗礼的原始毛皮会变成一副如铠甲般的防护层
desc.en: The raw, corrupted hide of the Skin Wolf, scarred from its many spontaneous transmogrifications, forms a protective, armour-like layer.

desc.zh: 在经过多次自然变异的锻造之后，人皮狼身上经受腐蚀洗礼的原始毛皮会变成一副如铠甲般的防护层
desc.en: The raw, corrupted hide of the Skin Wolf, scarred from its many spontaneous transmogrifications, forms a protective, armour-like layer.

desc.zh: 在经过多次自然变异的锻造之后，人皮狼身上经受腐蚀洗礼的原始毛皮会变成一副如铠甲般的防护层
desc.en: The raw, corrupted hide of the Skin Wolf, scarred from its many spontaneous transmogrifications, forms a protective, armour-like layer.

desc.zh: 黑暗诸神的影响大大增强了仆从们的攻击能力，多方面地增加了他们的力量与攻击范围
desc.en: The Dark Gods influence extends to the ferocity of their servants' attacks, increasing their power and reach manyfold.

desc.zh: 黑暗诸神的影响大大增强了仆从们的攻击能力，多方面地增加了他们的力量与攻击范围
desc.en: The Dark Gods influence extends to the ferocity of their servants' attacks, increasing their power and reach manyfold.

desc.zh: 黑暗诸神的影响大大增强了仆从们的攻击能力，多方面地增加了他们的力量与攻击范围
desc.en: The Dark Gods influence extends to the ferocity of their servants' attacks, increasing their power and reach manyfold.

name.zh: 远古混沌冰霜巨龙鳞甲

desc.zh: 混沌冰霜巨龙栖息地的气候极端严苛，这使得它们的鳞片足以抵御任何伤害，并能够以极端的寒冷来反噬任何碰触到它们的敌人
desc.en: The impossibly harsh climate in which the Chaos Frost Dragons live ensures their scales bolster armour's effectiveness whilst burning any foe who touches them with intense cold.

desc.zh: 每一颗卵内都包裹着致命的小蜘蛛，它们会成群结队地淹没敌人，撕咬它们的躯体并往伤口中注入致命的毒液
desc.en: Each egg contains deadly spiderlings, to swarm over and bite the foe's body, injecting deadly venom into the wounds.

desc.zh: 吹响这把巨大的号角会隐隐传来风雷之声，狂风与闪电会逼得与号角主人作对者步步后退
desc.en: When blown, the Great Horn calls up a thunderstorm which forces the bearer's enemies back with high winds and lightning strikes.

desc.zh: 死后的惊惧兽有可能比活着时更为致命：它的可怕面孔可以有效地帮助携带者降低技能的施放间隔
desc.en: In death, a Terrorgheist may even be more deadly than when alive - its terrifying countenance improving the bearer's abilities by removing the need to rest between uses.

desc.zh: 所有的凶蛮残暴之物都会服从于它的穿戴者：这是头冠的固有特性，还是黑暗诸神的凝视呢？
desc.en: Whether by the crown's own properties, or by the grace of the Dark Gods, all things bestial and savage obey the wearer.

desc.zh: 虽然味道很难闻，但喝下几滴巨魔的鲜血也足以令人血脉贲张，并激发起无止境的杀戮欲望
desc.en: Disgusting as it may be, a shot of Troll blood is just the thing to bolster the drinker's courage, causing an unstoppable bloodlust to rise within them.

desc.zh: 『呃啊啊啊啊啊！！！唔啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！呵啊啊啊啊啊！！！』
desc.en: "HUUUURGGEHH!!! BLUUUURGGEHH!!! HUUUUUUUURRRRRGGGGGGGGGGEHH!!!"

desc.zh: 没有任何其他选择，从来都是如此
desc.en: There is no other choice. There never was.

desc.zh: 在极端恐怖，行驶如飞的『海之牙』长船面前，一旦进入了它的视线，那么等待着你的便必然是痛苦不堪，毫无怜悯的死亡
desc.en: There's no outrunning the terrible, flying Longship known as the 'Seafang'; once in its sights, an agonising, merciless death is your only possible destination.

desc.zh: 神蛇虽然是黑暗诸神中最年轻的一位，但它的力量却丝毫不差，并且能够以诱惑性的幻象或强烈的引诱来促使凡人献上永恒的效忠
desc.en: Although the youngest of the Dark Gods, the Serpent is no less potent and can bind mortals to eternal service with alluring visions or tantalising temptations.

desc.zh: 这真的是场疯狂的武器杂耍，但它可能只是例行公事：如果舞动起来，那么他的敌人将绝无逃生的可能
desc.en: It's a crazy piece of acrobatics, for sure, but it might just work; if it does, his opponent has no chance.

desc.zh: 每一次略带不敬的冒犯、藐视、不快甚至仅是感觉不爽，就足以引发一场毁灭性的斧头狂舞
desc.en: The weight of every single insult, grievance, umbrage and ill-feeling, channelled into a single, crushing swing of the axe.

desc.zh: 只需那彻骨的激战炽焰，便能将这难以自控的狂怒，化作暴烈的优势
desc.en: All it takes is the white-hot heat of battle to turn the issue of poor anger management into a violent advantage.

desc.zh: 暴风雪在混沌冰霜巨龙周围呼啸，冰寒的急流足以挡住靠近的攻击者
desc.en: A localised blizzard whips up around the Chaos Frost Dragon, its icy turbulence preventing would-be attackers from getting too close.

desc.zh: 死在惊惧兽手里的无数亡灵将永无宁日：这只野兽随时可以让受害者化为活死人的形态
desc.en: The Terrorgheist's countless victims may never rest peacefully; the beast may call its victims to Unlife at will.

desc.zh: 任何靠得过近的生物都会丧失生命力，而惊惧兽正是使用这股力量令活死人奴仆们顺从自己的意志
desc.en: Any creature that gets close enough forfeits its lifeforce, which the Terrorgheist uses to bind its Unliving minions to its will.

desc.zh: 树人先祖自最为深邃，最为阴冷的森林中醒来，只为护佑自己的森林同胞免遭敌人的毒害
desc.en: From the deepest, dankest forest depths a Treeman Ancient rises, charged with protecting its forest-kin from harm.

desc.zh: 『噗！！！！！！！！诸神啊！这简直是何等的硫磺味儿啊！！』
desc.en: "PHHHHHHHHHRRRRRRRRRRRRRRTT!!! By the Gods! You can smell the sulphur comin' off that one!"

desc.zh: 这名战士享受着神祗的注视，憧憬着得到诸神的庇佑，因此他会在一定时间内免受敌人的任何伤害
desc.en: Basking in the attention of his chosen God, and hoping to be blessed with gifts and boons, this warrior enjoys a period of invulnerability against his foes.

desc.zh: 这股霜冻气息可以冻结并减速敌军，它的逼人寒气足以减缓敌人的攻击效果
desc.en: This icy blast freezes and slows the foe, its withering cold hampering their attacks.

desc.zh: 施法者周围闪耀着猛烈地闪电风暴，雷电会随机劈斩而下，裹挟着磁性的力量猛扑而来
desc.en: From the fierce electrical storm whirling around the caster, bolts of lightning strike randomly, bristling with magnetic power.

desc.zh: 猛烈的雷暴包围着施法者，大量强烈的雷电自此喷涌而出
desc.en: A turbulent thunderstorm roils around the caster, from which coils of powerful lightning snake forth.

desc.zh: 死者的灵魂攻击着巫师的敌人，蚕食着他们的斗志，在军中散播着恐慌
desc.en: Spirits of the departed assail the Wizard’s foes, sapping their resolve and causing dread among their numbers.

desc.zh: 施法者一声暴喝，乌鸦领主科维乌斯应召而出，令其仆从狠狠啄向了敌人的眼睛
desc.en: With a mighty bellow, the spellcaster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.

desc.zh: 这一法术会从地面召唤出粗糙而扭曲的树枝，紧紧罩住敌人并使其窒息而亡
desc.en: This spell causes gnarled, fibrous hands to emerge from beneath the ground, dragging the foe to a claustrophobic, suffocating end.

desc.zh: 无形的恐惧光环围绕着法师的盟友，只有敌人中的最勇敢者才敢直面这一恐怖
desc.en: An invisible aura of horror surrounds the Wizard’s allies. Only the bravest foes now stand before them.

desc.zh: 借助沙许的病态力量，法师们可以在战斗中削弱敌人的求生意识
desc.en: Harnessing the sickly power of Shyish, the Wizard weakens the foe's will to survive the battle.

desc.zh: 追随着不苟言笑的战士贝加纳的命运，施法者的怒火却是让自己的敌人活活笑死
desc.en: Following the fate of the unsmiling warrior, Bjuna, the targets of the caster’s ire will laugh themselves to death.

desc.zh: 法师念出一个咒语，一团翻滚着的魔法火球便会向着一个附近的敌人射去
desc.en: The Wizard conjures a boiling ball of magical flame and hurls it at a nearby foe.

desc.zh: 巫师用魔法强化盟友的武器，让它们燃起凶猛的烈焰。燃火刀刃会让武器威力大增
desc.en: The Wizard ensorcels allied weapons, making them burn with a savage fire. The targets of the spell are augmented with superior flaming blades.

desc.zh: 法师释放出魔法能量，如冰雹般袭向敌人，把他们变成一座座金色塑像
desc.en: The Wizard unleashes a hail of magical energy, transmuting his foes into Unliving golden statues.

desc.zh: 法师吹响一个闪光的金色口哨，吉哈纳的金属猎犬应声而出并扑向自己的猎物
desc.en: Blowing on a glimmering golden whistle, the Wizard summons the spirit of Gehenna’s metal hounds to hunt down his prey.

desc.zh: 敌军护甲开始生锈，最后变成碎末随风而散，防御能力大为削弱
desc.en: The enemy target's armour begins to rust, disappearing in clouds of tiny flakes and weakening his defensive abilities.

desc.zh: 随着施法者张开手掌，几束嘶嘶作响的银流自天而降，贯穿敌人
desc.en: A spray of sizzling silver slivers rain from the sky to impale the caster's enemy.

desc.zh: 令敌人的武器变得笨重，使其几乎无法在战斗中挥舞
desc.en: The enemies’ weapons become heavy, cumbersome, and almost impossible to wield in battle.

desc.zh: 施法者开启一个通往地狱深渊的漩涡，它将永久地吞噬一切卷入其中之物
desc.en: The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽灵般的钟摆。随着一声令下，它将急速摇摆起来并穿越敌方阵势，锋利的刀刃足以切肉断骨
desc.en: A spectral pendulum is summoned by the Wizard. On command, it swings, razor sharp and with lethal speed, through the foe.

desc.zh: 当陷入疯狂状态后，这些野性的战士将异常暴怒，变得完全不受控制！记得与他们保持距离！
desc.en: When going berserk, savage, barely-controllable warriors become savage, completely-uncontrollable warriors; best keep your distance!

desc.zh: 当黑暗诸神从强大的战争祭坛顶部为虔诚信徒施以祝福时，也就得到了这些信徒永远的忠诚
desc.en: When the Dark Gods bless the faithful assembled from atop their mighty battle-altars, loyalty is assured forevermore.

desc.zh: 沼栖妖降灾使们在身边编织出了一张若隐若现的黑暗迷雾，保护他们免受敌人的侵凌
desc.en: Dark figures move and twist within the magical miasma woven by the Fimir Balefiends as additional protection against the foe.

desc.zh: 只需那彻骨的激战炽焰，便能将这难以自控的狂怒，化作暴烈的优势
desc.en: All it takes is the white-hot heat of battle to turn the issue of poor anger management into a violent advantage.

desc.zh: 无论是巨人还是他的大棒，都足够臭不可闻的。因此早在这把钝器砸开敌人的脑壳之前，那些敌人隔着老远就会被熏得神志不清了
desc.en: Both the Giant and his club smell absolutely repulsive, their repellent odour discouraging foes just long enough for this blunt instrument to do its messy work.

desc.zh: 虽然托尔加德国王的剑是把非常值钱的战利品，但它也是个非常不错的征服象征，以及在诸神面前拿得出手的炫耀品
desc.en: Although King Torgald's blade is a prized trophy, it is also an eternal reminder of the consequences of grand proclamations afore the Gods.

desc.zh: 『这是强者称雄的年代！北方的部落，森林中的野兽，还有恐纳赫的伟大亲王，要将这个世界溺死在血泊中！』
desc.en: "These are days of great power: the tribes of the North, the beasts of the forest and a great prince of Kharnath will baptise this world in blood!"

desc.zh: 每一次攻击，甚至每一次移动，都只会让它变成更加强壮，更加凶暴的对手
desc.en: Each blow and every move only serve to make it a stronger and less-forgiving opponent.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 战旗之火，永不熄灭，擎旗者，武器燃起熊熊烈焰，眼中喷出冲天怒火
desc.en: This banner burns with a fire that can never be quenched, imbuing its bearers with flaming weapons and fiery eyes.

desc.zh: 其制作者是陷落要塞中的符文领主们。在这面历史悠久的旗帜下战斗，总不禁让人重燃对诸多邪恶的怒火
desc.en: Created by Runelords who hailed from lost holds - to fight beneath this storied banner is to recall the fury of so many wrongs.

desc.zh: 烈烈风中，正是狂怒战旗在飘扬低吼。在这面旗帜下战斗，心头狂怒，万难遏制，唯斩敌首，方快我心！
desc.en: The Banner of Rage flutters and growls in the wind. This standard imbues those who walk under it with an anger that can only be sated with enemy deaths!

desc.zh: 微风中飘扬的闪耀旌旗似乎在向行军士兵们款款轻诉，胜利就在他们手中
desc.en: As the Gleaming Pennant flutters in the breeze it instils all that march under it the belief that they will be victorious.

desc.zh: 这面狮鹫战旗曾经是『虔诚者』马格努斯的专用战旗，也是帝国勇气与牺牲精神的象征。在面对敌人时，它将成为敌军永恒的噩梦
desc.en: The Griffon Banner was the personal standard of Magnus the Pious; a symbol of Imperial bravery and sacrifice, yet has the opposite effect on enemies ranged before it.

desc.zh: 破败不堪、恐怖吓人的稻草人已在莫尔斯里布的光芒下沐浴太久了。曾几何时，它只是个农田中的稻草人，如今，它成了一面战旗，恐吓着所有飞行生物
desc.en: The mangled form of a terrifying scarecrow has spent too long under Morrslieb's glow. It was taken from the fields and now is a banner to frighten anything with wings.

desc.zh: 覆盖在无数献祭的干壳下，这面战旗散发着邪恶的气息。从蛛网的间隙中可隐约窥见藏在深处的那些复眼，在它们的凝视下，部队的攻击会变得剧毒无比
desc.en: Covered in the dried husks of many offerings, this banner oozes menace. From out of the webbed void in its centre multiple eyes gaze down imbuing those with venomous attacks.

desc.zh: 这面破败不堪的战旗中时时传出尖声哭喊，传达着一种难以名状的恐惧。听到这股惨叫的敌人无不乞求它放过对其灵魂的折磨
desc.en: The squalling wails emanating from the folds of this tattered standard recall untold horrors. Foes who hear it beg for the release of their tormented souls.

desc.zh: 要引导魔法之风必须要有强大的心灵。那些拥有这种天赋的人便成为了奥术导体，将魔法的风暴导向他们的敌人
desc.en: A strong mind is needed to channel the Winds of Magic. Those that have such a gift become arcane conduits – funnelling the magical tempests to their cause.

desc.zh: 长期以来，吸血鬼们都有着凶残而难以抑制的杀戮欲。他们会持续地残杀敌人，直至所有敌人都变为亡灵，或者死在他的脚下为止
desc.en: Vampires have long had a savage and unstoppable bloodlust. They will continue to slaughter until the foe has either been turned to Undeath or lies dead at their feet.

desc.zh: 这就是冠军勇士的力量和可怕之处，任何挡道的人在冲锋的战士面前都会颤栗难抑
desc.en: Such is the power and ferocity of the champion, that those who stand in his way will falter against the warrior's impact.

desc.zh: 有些人除了待在战场中央，到处找人拼个你死我活之外，什么都不想做
desc.en: There are those who wish nothing more than to be at the heart of battle, seeking foes to vanquish.

desc.zh: 有些人除了待在战场中央，到处找人拼个你死我活之外，什么都不想做
desc.en: There are those who wish nothing more than to be at the heart of battle, seeking foes to vanquish.

desc.zh: 老大不想逃跑，所以他的小子们也不能逃！
desc.en: Da Boss ain't ready to run an' so expects da boyz to stay put too!

desc.zh: 这些强大的战士，简直强到了仅用一击就能斩掉龙首，或是仅用一剑便可刺入狮鹫的心脏
desc.en: There are powerful beings who can decapitate a dragon or plunge a sword into the heart of a griffon in one mighty strike.

desc.zh: 一声奥术之吼，便可让周围友军重整旗鼓，迎头再战
desc.en: With an arcane cry, all around rally to fight in battle once more.

desc.zh: 只有强大的领导力和钢铁般的意志才能重整部队，令战士们翻身再战
desc.en: To rally the troops and bring them back to the fore takes strong leadership skills and an iron will.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼原始的嗜血欲望总是无法控制。他们不断的杀戮，直到敌人横尸脚下，或是变成亡灵
desc.en: Vampires have long had a savage and unstoppable bloodlust. They will continue to slaughter until their enemies lie dead at their feet, or have been turned to Undeath.

desc.zh: 言出必行的领袖会通过发布恐怖的命令来确保他们的军队不会逃跑
desc.en: Those whose word is law ensure their troops will not run by issuing this dread order.

desc.zh: 在战场上，选择逃跑可能更加轻松，但是那些选择坚守阵地的勇士呢？幸运无疑会眷顾他们和他们的部队！
desc.en: On the battlefield, the craven's path is an easy one, but for those champions that choose to stand? Fortune will surely favour them and their troops.

desc.zh: 苏醒吧！别再颤抖！别再破碎！再次复活吧！
desc.en: Arise! Do not falter! Do not crumble! Back to life once more!

desc.zh: 战将们昂起头颅，吼出了那一声『Waaagh！』小子们随声附和着，整个绿皮大军便向敌人潮水般席卷而去！
desc.en: The Warboss lifts his head and unleashes a mighty "WAAAGH!" – the boyz echo this terrifying roar as the entire Greenskin horde surges towards the enemy!

desc.zh: 战斗牧师会将英雄之锤的祝福传播给他身边的每个勇士
desc.en: The Warrior Priest passes the blessings of the Heldenhammer to the brave men around him.

desc.zh: 死亡已久的灵魂遵从尸妖王的召唤而苏醒，如今自由地散播着黑暗的祝福。所以死者都在追求他们的『死命』
desc.en: Dark Blessings given freely from long-dead souls follow in the Wight Kings' wake. And so the dead strive for Unlife...

desc.zh: 拥有这一技能的人能在战斗中轻松闪避掉敌人的攻击或摆脱缠斗，当然，前提是他们觉得战术上有必要这么做
desc.en: Those with such skills can evade enemy attacks with ease and break from combat, should they feel that it is tactically important to do so.

desc.zh: 亡灵法师不仅能控制死者，还能从那些离开尸体的灵魂中汲取力量
desc.en: Necromancers can not only marshal the dead, but leech the power from any souls fleeing their mortal remains.

desc.zh: 猎巫人抬起一根手指，对着战场一挥，就能制裁一个异端者！
desc.en: The Witch Hunter levels his finger across the battlefield and accuses one of the enemy of arch-heresy!

desc.zh: 这个英雄对于射击的精度、射速和位置选择造诣极高。他的存在能让战争机器战力大增
desc.en: This Hero has an eye for accuracy, firing rates and enemy sweet spots. War machines will benefit from his presence.

desc.zh: 向西格玛或尤里克做个简短的祷告，祈求者便可能被赐予神圣信仰之盾，只要他们真的配得上这一殊荣即可
desc.en: A quick invocation of protection to Sigmar or Ulric will bless the implorer with a shield of godly faith, should they prove worthy.

desc.zh: 不朽的灵魂不愿离开尘世，也因此无法安息
desc.en: Immortal spirits will refuse to leave the bounds of the mortal plane, and so cannot be put to rest with ease.

desc.zh: 夜地精萨满们酿造了一些辛辣的蘑菇药剂。当他们喝下这些玩意后，这些迷狂者便会带来一阵高速旋转且不断移动的死亡飓风！
desc.en: Night Goblin Shamans brew a pungent fungus potion that, when drunk, will send the Fanatics into a spinning, whirling cyclone of death!

desc.zh: 你永远堵不住也抓不住那些『灵活』的家伙，他们就是能这么轻松地『滑走』
desc.en: Those who are "slippery" cannot be cornered or pinned - they simply "slip" away…

desc.zh: 湖之女神护佑着她的骑士，使其免遭敌军阴险的蛊惑
desc.en: The Lady of the Lake protects her Knights from the devious enchantments of the enemy.

desc.zh: 有些人就是有些窍门，他们能将炮术和火炮不断提升，让火炮能比以往射得更远
desc.en: There are those who have a knack for pushing artillery and their crews to new heights, allowing such machines to fire further than ever before.

desc.zh: 符文铁匠熔炉中的熊熊火焰越烧越旺，火焰的祝福可以让盟友的武器释放出更大的潜能
desc.en: The fires of a Runesmith’s forge burn brighter and hotter, its blessing upon an ally’s weapons increasing their potency.

desc.zh: 蝇群环绕，嗡嗡作响地钻入口鼻、耳道及其他脆弱孔窍，令搏杀倍加艰难！
desc.en: Flies surround them, making combat even harder as the swarm buzzes into mouths, ears and other vulnerable orifices!

desc.zh: 黑色护符是一块阴沉黑暗的华丽宝石，它的力量只有在施咒者手中才能真正发挥出来
desc.en: The Black Periapt is a grandiose gem of sullen darkness whose power can only be realised in the hands of a spellcaster.

desc.zh: 一根纯银打造的法杖，上刻八枚魔盘符文。这样的物品仅限于提高法师的传导能力
desc.en: A staff of pure silver etched with all eight runes from the magic wheel. Such an item can only enhance a Wizard's ability to channel.

desc.zh: 凯姆勒身披一件黑色斗篷，这件斗篷时而旋转，时而扭转，竟是一件活物
desc.en: Kemmler is surrounded by a dark cloak that swirls and twists with a life of its own.

desc.zh: 命令王冠久经沙场。它给予佩戴者无上的威严，让他周身散发着坚不可摧的勇气
desc.en: The Crown of Command has been worn in countless battles. Its wearer is given great authority, instilling in his subjects an unbreakable courage.

desc.zh: 有了恶魔之怒的力量，杀敌一击足矣
desc.en: To have the strength of a raging Daemon is to slay in one swipe.

desc.zh: 艾萨瓦·库尔，普拉格的屠戮者，让他的勇士们饮下混沌圣杯中沸腾的恶魔之血，这让他们变得更加强壮，活力倍增
desc.en: Asavar Kul, the Butcher of Praag, demanded his Champions sup boiled Daemon blood from the Chalice of Chaos, imbuing them with strength and vigour.

desc.zh: 插进土地中的黑曜石之杖能够让魔法之风平静下来，虽然持续时间不过一瞬，但是足以让法师能够施放出一个无法招架的强大法术
desc.en: When planted in the ground this obsidian rod becalms the arcane winds for the briefest moment, allowing the Wizard to cast one of his powerful enchantments unopposed.

desc.zh: 当戒指上的暗红宝石中的符文激活后，一团翻滚的魔法火球就会射向一个附近的敌人
desc.en: When the rune within the dark ruby of the ring is activated a roiling ball of magic flame is hurled toward a nearby foe.

desc.zh: 这个用大理石和黄金镶边的手工制品能够召唤魔法之风，但是代价是会消耗使用者的精力
desc.en: This marble and golden-laced artefact can summon the Winds of Magic, but at a cost to the user.

desc.zh: 猫眼石护符能让佩戴者免死一次，但是此后它完美的表面就会裂开一个发丝般的裂缝
desc.en: The Opal Amulet can grant its wearer a life-saving second chance, but suffers a hairline fracture in its previously perfect surface as a result.

desc.zh: 这个坠饰便是第一个被色孽诱惑之人的灵魂结晶
desc.en: This pendant was crafted from the crystallised soul of the very first man to have been seduced by Slaanesh.

desc.zh: 喝下这个药剂的那些人很有可能是些傻瓜，但是至少他们是有胆子的傻瓜！
desc.en: Those that drink this tincture may well be fools, but they are bold fools at that!

desc.zh: 救命疗伤哪家强，治疗药剂来帮忙！无论止血、缝针、接骨，样样在行！
desc.en: This potion knits bones, seals flesh and staunches the flow of blood from mortal wounds.

desc.zh: 这个小瓶中的蓝色液体能让饮用者的速度提升到异乎寻常的程度
desc.en: The blue liquid in this small bottle blesses the imbiber with a boost of preternatural speed.

desc.zh: 厚实的玻璃烧瓶里堆着污泥般的黑色液体，这就是力量药剂，饮用者在短时间内便可造成毁灭性的伤害
desc.en: The sludgy black liquor in this stern glass flask is a Potion of Strength, allowing the drinker to cause devastating damage.

desc.zh: 当利剑和箭矢擦过他们身上裸露的部位时，喝下坚韧药剂的人们便会发现，自己的皮肤已经硬如坚甲了！
desc.en: Those that consume a Potion of Toughness find their skin hardening as swords and arrows glance off their body, even on parts not covered by armour!

desc.zh: 当魔法使用者摩擦能量石时，这块石头会瞬间发出光芒，但随后便会永远黯淡无光。然而，就在那一瞬间，魔法之风足以卷起一场风暴！
desc.en: When a magic-user rubs a power stone, the artefact glows for a split second before dulling forever. However, in that moment, the Winds of Magic blow a tempest!

desc.zh: 重生之躯是来自众神的礼物，它允许受其影响的人自动愈合伤口
desc.en: Regenerating flesh is a gift from the gods, allowing the affected to heal their wounds.

desc.zh: 这个权杖是个抗魔图腾，使用者能够用其消泯附近的法术
desc.en: The sceptre is an anti-magic totem, vanquishing spellcraft that gets too close to its wielder.

desc.zh: 这个破败不堪、肮脏污秽的卷轴最好别在手上拿太久，因为它会暗中汲取各种精华，其中就包括魔力
desc.en: This tattered and stained scroll should not be held in one's hand for long as it steals all manner of essence, including magical power.

desc.zh: 能量卷轴上涂写着各种符文，能够提升单个法术的威力。但请注意谨慎使用…
desc.en: Scrawled upon the Power Scroll are runes to boost the power of a single spell. Use it wisely…

desc.zh: 防盾卷轴上画着一个粗糙盾牌的形象，可能是很久之前某个盛极一时的王国的象征
desc.en: Upon the Scroll of Shielding is a crude drawing of a warrior's shield displaying an unknown crest of a kingdom long lost.

desc.zh: 当银号角吹起之时，清脆的音符会带给矮人们希望，并给敌人带去厄运
desc.en: When winded, the Silver Horn sounds a clear note that brings hope to Dwarfs and foreboding doom to the enemy.

desc.zh: 已故鬼神学家卡坦的头颅中依然回响着无数的秘密，足以让听到的人陷入疯狂。它知道如何从敌人那里吸收魔法之风的力量
desc.en: The skull of the late Daemonologist, Katam, continues to jibber in secrets that could drive the listener insane. It knows how to suck the Winds from the enemy.

desc.zh: 此物最初由地精萨满卡兹吉从亡灵法师卡洛斯手中夺来，骷髅法杖说着一种早被遗忘而又恐怖万分的语言，所有听见的人都将厄运缠身
desc.en: Originally captured from the Necromancer Kaloth by the gobbo Shaman Kazgi, the Skull Wand talks in a forgotten dread language and any who hear its words are doomed.

desc.zh: 沃兰是第一位首席大导师，对所有法师来说，继承他衣钵的权威象征就是他的法杖。它能让魔法之风向使用者屈膝！
desc.en: Volans was the first  Supreme Patriarch, his staff is a symbol of office to any Wizard that now holds that mantle. It also allows the wielder to bend the Winds to his will.

desc.zh: 一片纯绿色的碎片，表面还泛着欺诈者那恶毒诅咒的波纹。附近的任何魔法使用者都难免被其所伤
desc.en: A shard of pure aqua, its surface ripples with a malevolent curse bestowed upon it by the Trickster. Any magic-users nearby will surely suffer.

desc.zh: 范·霍斯曼的一面小小的魔法镜子，敌人只消看上它那破裂的镜面一眼，就会被它毁灭
desc.en: Van Horstmann's small magical mirror has the ability to destroy the enemy if only they will look upon its cracked surface...

desc.zh: 这根黑色魔杖上闪耀的宝玉却沾上了斑斑污迹，它的携带者能使用更多的魔法之风，并能更快地施放法术
desc.en: The bearer of this black wand, flecked in glowing jade, can increase the Winds and more quickly power his spells.

desc.zh: 这个颈饰上垂着许多兽毛，它的魔力能让穿戴者更凶猛地攻击飞行生物
desc.en: The feathers of many beasts dangle from this torc, its enchantments allowing the wearer to strike at flying creatures with savage fury.

desc.zh: 穿戴这个奇怪项坠的人，对飞行生物的攻击有着异乎寻常的防御力
desc.en: The wearer of this bizarre pendant is supernaturally protected against attacks from flying creatures.

desc.zh: 从巨魔皮袋中取一粒种子，食用者便会得到再生能力
desc.en: Eating a seed from this small Troll-skin leather pouch will imbue the consumer with regenerative abilities.

desc.zh: 仇恨之书中所记下的，正是矮人经年遭逢的种种无良勾当；一字一句尽以国王之血写就，而一笔一划更是饱蘸复仇之誓。
desc.en: The Dammaz Kron recounts every deed of infamy perpetuated against the Dwarfs, scribed in the blood of kings and infused with vows of vengeance.

desc.zh: 至暗之夜的碎片，传说囚禁着的是欺诈者本人的部分精魂。任何敢于靠近的人，都会被它的灾祸光环所抹杀
desc.en: A shard of blackest night said to be a prison for the partial essence of the Trickster himself. Any close to it may be undone by its troubling aura.

desc.zh: 使用米登领的狼皮制成，受到尤里克高阶牧师的祝福后，一层致命的白霜覆盖了斗篷，能将穿戴者的敌人完全冻结
desc.en: Made from the pelt of a Middenland wolf and blessed by the High Priest of Ulric, a deadly hoarfrost surrounds the cloak, freezing the wearer's foes.

desc.zh: 古老的上古龙魔会召唤出闪电来消灭猎物
desc.en: The ancient Shaggoth summons forth lightning to strike down his prey.

desc.zh: 魔法之风本身对冯·卡斯坦因简直不算什么，他卓越的魔法才华简直无可匹敌
desc.en: The Winds of Magic themselves present little challenge to von Carstein, so matchless is he in his magical prowess.

desc.zh: 如果巴托尼亚高祖战死沙场，那么他手下的骑士和民众定会怒火冲天
desc.en: Should the Royarch of fair Bretonnia fall, then the anger in its Knights and smallfolk shall be fierce.

desc.zh: 这位战士是如此的孔武有力，以至于当他发动攻击时，足以掀起一股死亡回击！
desc.en: Such is the strength within this warrior that when they strike it is sure to be a deathblow!

desc.zh: 阿兹汗绝不容许内讧的发生，当他发号施令的时候，小子们必须『听老子的』，要不然就会死得很惨
desc.en: Azhag has no tolerance for infighting, when he issues an order the boyz must 'get on wiv it' or pay with a particularly grisly death.

desc.zh: 至高王就是群山王国的化身。如若他受伤或是战死，矮人们定将燃起复仇怒火！
desc.en: The High King is the embodiment of the Karaz Ankor. Should he be wounded or even fall then the Dwarfs will rise in a vengeful rage!

desc.zh: 军官们总是咆哮着发号施令，以期部下能立刻遵行
desc.en: Those in command of the ranks will issue their orders with a ferocious bark, expecting instant obeisance.

desc.zh: 对于巴托尼亚的万民来说，女神的赐福是非常美妙的礼物。只要他们跪下宣誓效忠，就能得到这一馈赠
desc.en: The Lady's blessing is a wondrous gift freely graced upon all Bretonnian subjects, should they but kneel and utter their devotion.

desc.zh: 对于巴托尼亚的万民来说，女神的赐福是非常美妙的礼物。只要他们跪下宣誓效忠，就能得到这一馈赠
desc.en: The Lady's blessing is a wondrous gift freely graced upon all Bretonnian subjects, should they but kneel and utter their devotion.

desc.zh: 吸血鬼撕开猎物，鲜血四溅之处，便是大快朵颐之时，这让他们得以获得力量、恢复精力
desc.en: As the Vampires rip apart their victims they feast on the blood that spills forth – gaining in strength and lost stamina.

desc.zh: 赢得『女神捍卫者』这个荣耀的人便会得到女神的庇护，其效果较圣杯骑士从圣杯处得到的保护更胜
desc.en: Those that claim the honour of the Lady's Champion benefit from her protection even more than Knights who have supped from the Grail.

desc.zh: 光明系魔法最为擅长的，便是鞭笞那些超自然的邪物。无论是恶魔，混沌生物还是亡灵，在它的面前只有拼命遁逃的份
desc.en: Light Magic excels at the scourging of the supernatural, be they Daemons and creatures of Chaos, or the unquiet dead.

desc.zh: 双火为炎，两团火焰聚在一起时威力远胜于它们分开的状态，而燃焰便是这样的一股『炎』
desc.en: Fire feeds fire, two blazes together are stronger and hotter than two apart. The Kindleflame intensifies such fire.

desc.zh: 死亡系魔法的修习者可以在目标与自己间创造一条魔法通道，将目标的生命源源不断地纳为己有
desc.en: Spellcasters who practise Death Magic can channel the life force of foes into their spells.

desc.zh: 在训练有素的炼金术士面前，盔甲不过是个笑话而已。在他的咒语之下，金属会变成一根结实的奥术避雷针，将强大的攻击性魔法无情地导入穿戴者的体内
desc.en: Armour is little defence against a skilled alchemist, under his command metal turns into an arcane lightning rod, attracting hostile magic.

desc.zh: 在奋勇作战的绿皮们的正面加护之下，所有的大Waaagh！法术都会得到增强
desc.en: Boosted by the positive energies of fightin' Greenskins, all Spells of Da Big Waaagh increase in power.

desc.zh: 天堂系的法术可以无情地驱使苍穹的气流，从而将飞行生物吹得七颠八倒
desc.en: Spells from the Lore of Heavens manipulate the ethers of the skies, buffeting and pummelling winged creatures.

desc.zh: 地精萨满卑鄙狡猾，能从敌方法师处窃取能量，一边偷还会一边疯子一样地狂笑！
desc.en: Goblin Shamans are sneaky and will steal away the power from the enemy Wizard, cackling maniacally while doing so!

desc.zh: 黑暗魔法的能量可以用来施放亡灵法术，这种有害的能量能让亡灵更为活跃
desc.en: As the powers of Dark Magic are wielded for the purpose of Necromancy, its unwholesome energies invigorate the Undead.

desc.zh: 那些身负恐虐印记的人会被疯狂的愤怒折磨，必须不断屠杀敌人方可缓解
desc.en: Those who bear the Mark of Khorne are consumed with a violent rage and the constant need to shed the blood of their foes.

desc.zh: 当海希之风在光明魔乘周围汇集时，魔乘会产生停滞的涡流，让其他魔法之风难以穿透
desc.en: As Hysh gathers and swirls around the Luminark, it creates a becalming eddy that other magical winds struggle to penetrate.

desc.zh: 此部队身边围绕的魔法光环可以保护友军免受伤害
desc.en: The magical aura surrounding this unit protects allies from harm.

desc.zh: 硕大的狮鹫发出一声毛骨悚然的咆哮，使敌人丧魂落魄
desc.en: The mighty griffon lets out a blood-curdling roar, chilling his enemies.

desc.zh: 在逆境中，矮人会看一看先祖符文，想一想他们身负的使命，然后以绝不妥协的气势继续奋斗
desc.en: In adversity, Dwarfs look to the runes of the Ancestors - remembering the duty that is now their own to bear - and refuse to break.

desc.zh: 那些拥有勇气符文的人，在面对任何恐惧时都会不为所动
desc.en: Those that have the Rune of Courage will never fear the horrors they face.

desc.zh: 这个强大符文的秘技曾由瓦拉雅亲自传授给某个符文领主，魔法的保护能让一切事物免受灾祸的影响
desc.en: The secret of this powerful rune was given to a Runelord by Valaya herself, insulating all under its auspices with protection from magic.

desc.zh: 这件镌刻誓言与钢铁符文的护甲永远不会弯曲或变形
desc.en: Armour inscribed with the Rune of Oath & Steel will not bend or buckle.

desc.zh: 矮人向来死心眼儿。坚忍符文能让他们愈加如此，提醒他们不管敌人是谁，都绝对不能后退
desc.en: Dwarfs are stubborn. The Rune of Stoicism amplifies this, reminding them never to back down no matter who they face.

desc.zh: 当符文领主在末日铁砧上敲打的时候，他造就了愤怒与毁灭符文，当是时，大地为之迸裂，喷出硫磺和火焰
desc.en: As the Runelord hammers upon the Anvil of Doom, he shapes the Rune of Wrath & Ruin, causing the earth to crack and vent forth fire and sulphur.

name.zh: 大师级独眼葛罗思符文

desc.zh: 在库尔甘·铁须时期，独眼葛罗思第一个打造出了这个符文。当时绿皮被逐出了恶地，矮人也开始了兴盛时期
desc.en: Groth One-Eye first struck this rune in the time of Kurgan Ironbeard, when the Greenskins were driven from the Badlands and the Dwarfs prospered.

desc.zh: 这个符文卷起众多魔法之风，借助它们的魔法之力保护佩戴者，并为周边的矮人抵御远程攻击
desc.en: This rune stirs up the Winds of Magic, using their swirling arcane force to protect its bearer and shield nearby Dwarfs from missile fire.

name.zh: 大师级红胡子斯多姆尼符文

desc.zh: 红胡子斯多姆尼在巴尔任职卡拉克·铁峰堡之王时期制造了该符文，德金、葛林姆尼尔的祖父、先祖勇士之神都曾是该符文的拥有者
desc.en: Stromni Redbeard made this rune in the days of Bael, Lord of Karak Azul - it was used by Durgin, grandsire of Grimnir, the Ancestor God of Warriors.

desc.zh: 此符文的神秘光芒令人敬畏不已，会令敌人心中充满恐惧
desc.en: The uncanny glow of this rune is an awe-inspiring sight, apt to fill foes with debilitating dread.

desc.zh: 萨满热切地盯着自己的目标，不停用精神波折磨对手，随后突然释放出熔脑之力
desc.en: Projecting violence in a mental wave, the Shaman glowers at his target and lets loose a bolt of brain-melting force.

desc.zh: 萨满热切地盯着自己的目标，不停用精神波折磨对手，随后突然释放出熔脑之力
desc.en: Projecting violence in a mental wave, the Shaman glowers at his target and lets loose a bolt of brain-melting force.

desc.zh: 一道绿色能量波向外发散，汇成冲击波，猛烈地打击那些倒霉的敌人
desc.en: A wave of green energy emanates outwards, forming a shockwave of power that assaults any unfortunate foe.

desc.zh: 一道绿色能量波向外发散，汇成能量冲击波，猛地击中任何不够幸运的敌人
desc.en: A wave of green energy emanates outwards, forming a shockwave of power that assaults any unfortunate foe.

desc.zh: 当萨满吟诵咒语时，他会释放出强大的战争能量，让周围的友军变得更加凶残勇猛
desc.en: As the Shaman chants, he leaks fighty-energy, boosting the fierceness and prowess of friendly units nearby.

desc.zh: 在战斗怒火的驱使下，目标部队会变得比钢铁还要坚硬，并同时提升其攻击力与防御力
desc.en: In a fit of fighting fury the target unit becomes harder than iron, increasing both its attack and defence capabilities.

desc.zh: 萨满向老天各种哀求、疯狂作揖。然后兽人之神的超强绿色大脚就会从天而降，把敌人踩个稀巴烂！
desc.en: The Shaman implores the sky with wild gesticulations. The almighty green foot of the Orc god descends to crush the foe!

desc.zh: 萨满向老天各种哀求、疯狂作揖。然后兽人之神的超强绿色大脚就会从天而降，把敌人踩个稀巴烂！
desc.en: The Shaman implores the sky with wild gesticulations. The almighty green foot of the Orc god descends to crush the foe!

desc.zh: 在毛哥的恩赐下，萨满们获得了用眼睛放出能量波的能力
desc.en: Mork gives the Shaman the ability to project beams of coruscating energy from his eyes.

desc.zh: 在毛哥的恩赐下，萨满们获得了用眼睛放出能量波的能力
desc.en: Mork gives the Shaman the ability to project beams of coruscating energy from his eyes.

desc.zh: 巫师将光明魔法注入盟军身中，让他们从时间流逝的束缚中解放出来，变得迅捷无比
desc.en: The Wizard infuses his allies with Light Magic, freeing them from the passage of time and speeding up their actions.

desc.zh: 友军身上的魔法能量推动他们前行，也让他们变得更加凶猛！
desc.en: Friendly units targeted by the caster are filled with magical energy, making them even more aggressive!

desc.zh: 闪电电弧扫过战场，在敌人间疯狂跳跃，爆裂声不绝于耳，直到波及的所有敌人都化为灰烬
desc.en: Lightning arcs across the battlefield, leaping from foe-to-foe with crackling fury until there are none left within the storm.

desc.zh: 法师念出一个咒语，一团翻滚着的魔法火球便会向着一个附近的敌人射去
desc.en: The Wizard conjures a boiling ball of magical flame and hurls it at a nearby foe.

desc.zh: 战斗牧师祈求西格玛赐予他们些微的神圣之力，让他的铁锤放射出了力量的光芒！
desc.en: The Warrior Priest implores Sigmar to imbue him with a modicum of divine strength, and now his hammer glows bright with power!

desc.zh: 光明火巫汇聚全部魔力，炽热焰矢如雨点般射向敌人
desc.en: Focusing all his mystical might, the Pyromancer strikes the foe with a flurry of incandescent missiles.

desc.zh: 战斗牧师的信仰化身为一道护盾，硬如城堡锻铁
desc.en: The Warrior Priest’s faith manifests in the form of a shield as hard as castle-forged steel.

desc.zh: 战斗牧师们念出战斗祷告，一层白色圣火包裹了他们全身，灼烧西格玛的敌人，却不会伤害祈求者自己
desc.en: A battle prayer that bathes the Warrior Priest in white, holy fire, sears Sigmar’s foes but leaves the supplicant unharmed.

desc.zh: 多节的法杖由刽子手之树的芯材雕刻而成。其中包含着强力的咒语，可以将周围的亡灵变得狂热异常
desc.en: This gnarled stave is carved from the blackened heartwood of a Hangman's Tree. It contains a powerful spell that fills nearby Undead with a frantic vitality.

desc.zh: 无形的恐惧光环围绕着法师的盟友，只有敌人中的最勇敢者才敢直面这一恐怖
desc.en: An invisible aura of horror surrounds the Wizard’s allies. Only the bravest foes now stand before them.

name.en: Aspect of the Dread Knight Upgraded

desc.zh: 无形的恐惧光环围绕着法师的盟友，只有敌人中的最勇敢者才敢直面这一恐怖
desc.en: An invisible aura of horror surrounds the Wizard’s allies. Only the bravest foes now stand before them.

desc.zh: 死者的灵魂攻击着巫师的敌人，蚕食着他们的斗志，在军中散播着恐慌
desc.en: Spirits of the departed assail the Wizard’s foes, sapping their resolve and causing dread among their numbers.

desc.zh: 死者的灵魂攻击着巫师的敌人，蚕食着他们的斗志，在军中散播着恐慌
desc.en: Spirits of the departed assail the Wizard’s foes, sapping their resolve and causing dread among their numbers.

desc.zh: 借助沙许的病态力量，法师们可以在战斗中削弱敌人的求生意识
desc.en: Harnessing the sickly power of Shyish, the Wizard weakens the foe's will to survive the battle.

desc.zh: 借助沙许的病态力量，法师们可以在战斗中削弱敌人的求生意识
desc.en: Harnessing the sickly power of Shyish, the Wizard weakens the foe's will to survive the battle.

desc.zh: 巫师的乌木法杖一指向目标，肮脏的法术便会开始汲取它的灵魂
desc.en: The Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, leeching its spirit through tainted sorcery.

desc.zh: 巫师的乌木法杖一指向目标，肮脏的法术便会开始汲取它的灵魂
desc.en: The Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, leeching its spirit through tainted sorcery.

desc.zh: 追随着不苟言笑的战士贝加纳的命运，施法者的怒火却是让自己的敌人活活笑死
desc.en: Following the fate of the unsmiling warrior, Bjuna, the targets of the caster’s ire will laugh themselves to death.

desc.zh: 这个巨大天体是个拥有紫色边缘的黑暗实体，那些没能逃开晶化之触的人将陷入永世的诅咒！
desc.en: A colossal orb of purple-edged darkness materialises - those who do not escape its crystalline touch are doomed for eternity!

name.en: The Purple Sun of Xereus Upgraded

desc.zh: 这个巨大天体是个拥有紫色边缘的黑暗实体，那些没能逃开晶化之触的人将陷入永世的诅咒！
desc.en: A colossal orb of purple-edged darkness materialises - those who do not escape its crystalline touch are doomed for eternity!

desc.zh: 一道燃火光环包围着光明火巫，既能护体，亦可烧敌
desc.en: A blazing aura surrounds the Pyromancer's chosen ally, shielding them with protective flame and augmenting their abilities.

desc.zh: 法师念出一个咒语，一团翻滚着的魔法火球便会向着一个附近的敌人射去
desc.en: The Wizard conjures a boiling ball of magical flame and hurls it at a nearby foe.

desc.zh: 法师念出一个咒语，一团翻滚着的魔法火球便会向着一个附近的敌人射去
desc.en: The Wizard conjures a boiling ball of magical flame and hurls it at a nearby foe.

desc.zh: 在烈焰法师或混沌术士的召唤下，猛烈旋转的火柱在战场上喷涌而出，极具杀伤力！
desc.en: Conjured by a Bright Wizard or Chaos Sorcerer, a column of churning fire erupts from the battlefield, causing much destruction!

desc.zh: 在烈焰法师或混沌术士的召唤下，猛烈旋转的火柱在战场上喷涌而出，极具杀伤力！
desc.en: Conjured by a Bright Wizard or Chaos Sorcerer, a column of churning fire erupts from the battlefield, causing much destruction!

desc.zh: 巫师用魔法强化盟友的武器，让它们燃起凶猛的烈焰。燃火刀刃会让武器威力大增
desc.en: The Wizard ensorcels allied weapons, making them burn with a savage fire. The targets of the spell are augmented with superior flaming blades.

desc.zh: 巫师用魔法强化盟友的武器，让它们燃起凶猛的烈焰。燃火刀刃会让武器威力大增
desc.en: The Wizard ensorcels allied weapons, making them burn with a savage fire. The targets of the spell are augmented with superior flaming blades.

desc.en: Focusing all his mystical might, the Pyromancer strikes the foe with a flurry of incandescent missiles.

desc.zh: 光明火巫汇聚全部魔力，炽热焰矢如雨点般射向敌人
desc.en: Focusing all his mystical might, the Pyromancer strikes the foe with a flurry of incandescent missiles.

desc.zh: 一具咯咯笑的火焰头颅。伴着一声欢快的尖叫，它突然跃入敌军，所到之处，片甲无存
desc.en: A cackling, flaming visage appears before the Wizard. With a gleeful screech, it swirls around the battlefield, immolating anything in its way.

desc.zh: 一具咯咯笑的火焰头颅。伴着一声欢快的尖叫，它突然跃入敌军，所到之处，片甲无存
desc.en: A cackling, flaming visage appears before the Wizard. With a gleeful screech, it swirls around the battlefield, immolating anything in its way.

desc.zh: 闪电电弧扫过战场，在敌人间疯狂跳跃，爆裂声不绝于耳，直到波及的所有敌人都化为灰烬
desc.en: Lightning arcs across the battlefield, leaping from foe-to-foe with crackling fury until there are none left within the storm.

desc.zh: 从天空的最高处，法师将一颗游荡的彗星拉向了战场
desc.en: Reaching to the highest heavens, the Wizard draws a wandering meteorite down upon the battlefield.

desc.zh: 从天空的最高处，法师将一颗游荡的彗星拉向了战场
desc.en: Reaching to the highest heavens, the Wizard draws a wandering meteorite down upon the battlefield.

desc.zh: 从天空的最高处，法师将一颗游荡的彗星拉向了战场
desc.en: Reaching to the highest heavens, the Wizard draws a wandering meteorite down upon the battlefield.

desc.zh: 法师仅仅吟唱三字咒语，敌人攻防已然悉数尽失
desc.en: The Wizard issues a three word curse, hexing the target unit and blighting their ability to attack and defend.

name.en: Curse of the Midnight Wind Upgraded

desc.zh: 法师仅仅吟唱三字咒语，敌人攻防已然悉数尽失
desc.en: The Wizard issues a three word curse, hexing the target unit and blighting their ability to attack and defend.

desc.zh: 施法者占卜吉相，指引着目标的心智，赋予他们远见，并带给他们胜利
desc.en: Divining auspicious signs, the caster guides the minds of targets, augmenting them with the foresight needed for victory.

desc.zh: 施法者占卜吉相，指引着目标的心智，赋予他们远见，并带给他们胜利
desc.en: Divining auspicious signs, the caster guides the minds of targets, augmenting them with the foresight needed for victory.

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出强大的闪电球并投向敌人，被击中者必定粉身碎骨！
desc.en: The caster calls down a mighty ball of lightning and hurls it - should the foe be struck they will surely be shattered!

desc.zh: 施法者召唤出强大的闪电球并投向敌人，被击中者必定粉身碎骨！
desc.en: The caster calls down a mighty ball of lightning and hurls it - should the foe be struck they will surely be shattered!

desc.zh: 星相家捕捉战场上风的力量，指引不洁狂风猛击敌人
desc.en: The Astromancer seizes the winds of the battlefield, directing them against the foe to batter the targets with unhallowed gales.

desc.zh: 星相家捕捉战场上风的力量，指引不洁狂风猛击敌人
desc.en: The Astromancer seizes the winds of the battlefield, directing them against the foe to batter the targets with unhallowed gales.

desc.en: The Astromancer seizes the winds of the battlefield, directing them against the foe to batter the targets with unhallowed gales.

desc.zh: 黑暗畜生们要小心了，因为法师会释放出一道纯净光波，将白魔法之敌尽数放逐
desc.en: Creatures of the dark beware, for the Mage casts a ball of pure light to banish enemies of white wizardry.
