desc.zh: 巫师将光明魔法注入盟军身中，让他们从时间流逝的束缚中解放出来，变得迅捷无比
desc.en: The Wizard infuses his allies with Light Magic, freeing them from the passage of time and speeding up their actions.

desc.zh: 从海希之风中，巫师召唤出荣耀的能量平静颓唐的心灵，令盟友们勇气倍增
desc.en: Reaching into the Wind of Hysh, the Wizard draws forth ennobling energies to steady faint hearts - augmenting allies with courage.

desc.zh: 从海希之风中，巫师召唤出荣耀的能量平静颓唐的心灵，令盟友们勇气倍增
desc.en: Reaching into the Wind of Hysh, the Wizard draws forth ennobling energies to steady faint hearts - augmenting allies with courage.

desc.zh: 法师施放出一张魔法之网，用以束缚大欺诈者本人。所有被丝网缠绕者都会动弹不得
desc.en: The Wizard casts an arcane net, created to hold the Great Deceiver himself. Any caught in its strands will struggle to act.

desc.zh: 法师施放出一张魔法之网，用以束缚大欺诈者本人。所有被丝网缠绕者都会动弹不得
desc.en: The Wizard casts an arcane net, created to hold the Great Deceiver himself. Any caught in its strands will struggle to act.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出一道仁慈的守护之光，保护盟友免受伤害
desc.en: The Wizard calls upon the beneficent Guardian of Light to protect his allies from harm.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出一道仁慈的守护之光，保护盟友免受伤害
desc.en: The Wizard calls upon the beneficent Guardian of Light to protect his allies from harm.

desc.zh: 净化能束从法师手中射出，所到之处，万恶凋零
desc.en: Bolts of cleansing energy fly from the Wizard’s hands, searing evil wherever they strike.

desc.zh: 净化能束从法师手中射出，所到之处，万恶凋零
desc.en: Bolts of cleansing energy fly from the Wizard’s hands, searing evil wherever they strike.

desc.zh: 净化能束从法师手中射出，所到之处，万恶凋零
desc.en: Bolts of cleansing energy fly from the Wizard’s hands, searing evil wherever they strike.

desc.zh: 伴着一声令人恐惧的长啸，萨满召唤出一轮巨大的惨白月亮，上面一张青面獠牙的类地精大脸冷冷地俯瞰众生
desc.en: With a chilling howl, the Shaman summons a great pale moon with a leering goblinoid face and large, tusk-like fangs.

name.en: Curse of Da Bad Moon Upgraded

desc.zh: 伴着一声令人恐惧的长啸，萨满召唤出一轮巨大的惨白月亮，上面一张青面獠牙的类地精大脸冷冷地俯瞰众生
desc.en: With a chilling howl, the Shaman summons a great pale moon with a leering goblinoid face and large, tusk-like fangs.

desc.zh: 萨满瘦骨嶙峋的手指指向附近敌人，以搞哥之名诅咒他们
desc.en: The Shaman points a bony finger at a nearby enemy, cursing them in the name of Gork.

desc.zh: 萨满狂挠自己的胳肢窝，如同疯子般傻笑着，随后将痛苦的皮炎传染给附近的敌人
desc.en: By vigorously scratching his armpits - cackling maniacally as he does so - the Shaman projects painful chafing onto a nearby foe.

desc.zh: 萨满扔出一个顶部乌黑的龙葵菇，在空中爆炸后形成一道漆黑的乌云
desc.en: The Shaman throws a black-capped nightshade mushroom into the air, which bursts into a cloud of murky darkness.

desc.zh: 萨满扔出一个顶部乌黑的龙葵菇，在空中爆炸后形成一道漆黑的乌云
desc.en: The Shaman throws a black-capped nightshade mushroom into the air, which bursts into a cloud of murky darkness.

desc.zh: 在这一法术的增益下，目标将变得非常疯狂，或是从出乎意料的角度接近对手
desc.en: The targets of this spell are driven to go right after "hurty bitz" or sneak up on opponents at unexpected angles.

desc.zh: 最深的恶意变成绿色光束从萨满眼中射出，向敌人奔袭而去
desc.en: Green bolts of purest spite burst forth from the Shaman and streak towards the enemy.

desc.zh: 最深的恶意变成绿色光束从萨满眼中射出，向敌人奔袭而去
desc.en: Green bolts of purest spite burst forth from the Shaman and streak towards the enemy.

desc.zh: 法师释放出魔法能量，如冰雹般袭向敌人，把他们变成一座座金色塑像
desc.en: The Wizard unleashes a hail of magical energy, transmuting his foes into Unliving golden statues.

desc.zh: 法师释放出魔法能量，如冰雹般袭向敌人，把他们变成一座座金色塑像
desc.en: The Wizard unleashes a hail of magical energy, transmuting his foes into Unliving golden statues.

desc.zh: 法师吹响一个闪光的金色口哨，吉哈纳的金属猎犬应声而出并扑向自己的猎物
desc.en: Blowing on a glimmering golden whistle, the Wizard summons the spirit of Gehenna’s metal hounds to hunt down his prey.

name.zh: 高级吉哈纳的黄金猎犬

desc.zh: 法师吹响一个闪光的金色口哨，吉哈纳的金属猎犬应声而出并扑向自己的猎物
desc.en: Blowing on a glimmering golden whistle, the Wizard summons the spirit of Gehenna’s metal hounds to hunt down his prey.

desc.zh: 炼金术士召唤出一件华丽的长袍，上面俗不可耐的鳞片闪闪发光，却能让盟友的防御更为稳固
desc.en: The Alchemist conjures a gaudy cloak of shimmering scale to improve his allies’ defensive stance.

desc.zh: 炼金术士召唤出一件华丽的长袍，上面俗不可耐的鳞片闪闪发光，却能让盟友的防御更为稳固
desc.en: The Alchemist conjures a gaudy cloak of shimmering scale to improve his allies’ defensive stance.

desc.zh: 敌军护甲开始生锈，最后变成碎末随风而散，防御能力大为削弱
desc.en: The enemy target's armour begins to rust, disappearing in clouds of tiny flakes and weakening his defensive abilities.

desc.zh: 敌军护甲开始生锈，最后变成碎末随风而散，防御能力大为削弱
desc.en: The enemy target's armour begins to rust, disappearing in clouds of tiny flakes and weakening his defensive abilities.

desc.zh: 随着施法者张开手掌，几束嘶嘶作响的银流自天而降，贯穿敌人
desc.en: A spray of sizzling silver slivers rain from the sky to impale the caster's enemy.

desc.zh: 随着施法者张开手掌，几束嘶嘶作响的银流自天而降，贯穿敌人
desc.en: A spray of sizzling silver slivers rain from the sky to impale the caster's enemy.

desc.zh: 令敌人的武器变得笨重，使其几乎无法在战斗中挥舞
desc.en: The enemies’ weapons become heavy, cumbersome, and almost impossible to wield in battle.

desc.zh: 令敌人的武器变得笨重，使其几乎无法在战斗中挥舞
desc.en: The enemies’ weapons become heavy, cumbersome, and almost impossible to wield in battle.

desc.zh: 法师口中吐出一句古老的咒语，让敌人可怕地快速衰老，头发变白，皮肤干枯
desc.en: The Wizard spits out an ancient curse, causing their enemies to age at an incredible rate - their hair turning white and skin shrivelling up.

desc.zh: 黑魔法束从施法者眼中放出，使皮肉凋零、骨头坏死
desc.en: Bolts of Dark Magic leap from the caster’s eyes, withering flesh and blackening the bone beneath.

desc.zh: 黑魔法束从施法者眼中放出，使皮肉凋零、骨头坏死
desc.en: Bolts of Dark Magic leap from the caster’s eyes, withering flesh and blackening the bone beneath.

desc.zh: 施法者吟唱着纳迦什的可怕音节，让友方的目标逐渐复原
desc.en: The caster intones the dread syllables once uttered by Nagash, restoring friendly targets.

desc.zh: 施法者吟唱着纳迦什的可怕音节，让友方的目标逐渐复原
desc.en: The caster intones the dread syllables once uttered by Nagash, restoring friendly targets.

desc.zh: 亡灵法师能不断唤醒新的尸体加入自己的大军
desc.en: Necromancers can awaken mortal remains to reinforce their Undead legions.

desc.zh: 亡灵法师能不断唤醒新的尸体加入自己的大军
desc.en: Necromancers can awaken mortal remains to reinforce their Undead legions.

desc.zh: 令友方部队笼罩在魔法能量中，让他们变得更加凶猛！
desc.en: Friendly targets are filled with magical energy, making them even more aggressive!

desc.zh: 令友方部队笼罩在魔法能量中，让他们变得更加凶猛！
desc.en: Friendly targets are filled with magical energy, making them even more aggressive!

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽冥之风，狂啸着扫入敌方大军，令敌军的灵魂立时出窍
desc.en: The Wizard calls forth spectral winds that howl through the enemy ranks, tearing their souls from their bodies.

desc.zh: 法师召唤出幽冥之风，狂啸着扫入敌方大军，令敌军的灵魂立时出窍
desc.en: The Wizard calls forth spectral winds that howl through the enemy ranks, tearing their souls from their bodies.

desc.zh: 闪耀的黑暗光晕包裹着黑马车，使它光洁无比，让敌人的法术难以命中
desc.en: A pulsing nimbus of darkness envelops the Black Coach, making it sleeker and more resistant to enemies.

desc.zh: 黑马车上泛着微光的镰刀摄人心魄，其锋之锐，如夜之黑
desc.en: The Black Coach manifests gleaming scythes, as sharp as the night is dark.

desc.zh: 地狱炮挣脱链条奋力前冲，增加其移动速度
desc.en: The Hellcannon breaks its chains and rushes forwards. Increased movement speed.

desc.zh: 只用一瞬间，地狱炮便会喷射出毁灭性的烈焰
desc.en: The Hellcannon's blasts are devastating!

desc.zh: 葛朗尼的所有子孙都会固守阵地，从而更好地抵御物理攻击。此外，这也会增加他们的远程攻击威力
desc.en: All the sons of Grungni can dig-in, enabling them to better resist physical attacks from the foe. Any missile attacks they can make are also improved.

desc.zh: 矮人轰炸机的火力要比矮人直升机强大得多。要是所携带的多重有效载荷全部命中目标，那景象一定美不胜收！
desc.en: The Gyrobomber is fitted with much larger ordnance than the Gyrocopter. Should the multiple payloads hit their intended target the results will be quite spectacular!

desc.zh: 直升机中队在敌人正上方加速掠过，每个飞行员都会向下方的目标投掷一枚机翼上的炸弹
desc.en: As the Gyrocopter squadron speeds over the heads of the enemy, each pilot releases a single wing-mounted bomb onto targets below.

desc.zh: 这样的勇士精通必杀技，强力的一击足以让敌人直接毙命
desc.en: Such champions are adept at delivering a Killing Blow, depriving the foe of life with a single, powerful attack.

desc.zh: 喝下了蘑菇酒的夜地精狂热者们会变得疯癫异常，它们会挥舞着庞大的铁球与铁链冲出自己的群体，如一阵旋风般造成破坏！
desc.en: Sent mad by drinking fungus brew, Night Goblin Fanatics are released from their mobs as a twirling cyclone of destruction armed with a large ball and chain!

desc.zh: 石冢缚灵和拖着黑马车的骸骨战马充满着邪恶之力
desc.en: The Cairn Wraith and the skeletal steeds pulling the Black Coach are filled with unholy vigour.

desc.zh: 这位战士是如此的孔武有力，以至于当他发动攻击时，足以掀起一股死亡回击！
desc.en: Such is the strength within this warrior that when they strike it is sure to be a deathblow!

desc.zh: 一些战士并不在乎自己的个人安危，因此他们会全身心地投入到狂风般的杀戮之中，变得异常暴戾！
desc.en: Some warriors care not for their own personal safety, and so work themselves into a whirlwind of destruction and mindless violence!

desc.zh: 有些生物能以不可思议的速度愈合骨肉之伤。这是一份强大的赠礼，但是在火焰面前却效果甚微
desc.en: There are beings and creatures that can mend bone and knit flesh at an incredible rate. A mighty boon, but one stunted by fire.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 在旧世界中，纵使是死者也会难以安息。吸血鬼和亡灵法师驱役的死者已经不再对尘世有任何眷顾，他们只遵循主人的意志
desc.en: The dead do not rest easily in the Old World. Those summoned by Vampires and Necromancers no longer have mortal concerns - they serve only their master's will.

desc.zh: 黑魔法的连接失败了。无论是血肉还是支撑他们的亡灵能量都已烟消云散，令其只能化为一缕破败的尘埃
desc.en: The Dark Magic binding has failed. Both flesh and Necromantic energy slough off the subjects, leaving naught but dust.

desc.zh: 如果绿皮坚信一件事，那么，根据绿皮神的旨意，那么可能它能成真。因此，蛮荒兽人相信战纹会保护他们，而事实也确实如此！
desc.en: If Greenskins believe something strongly enough, then, by the Green Godz will, it may be true. Hence Savage Orcs believe war paint protects them – and so it does!

desc.zh: 达戈之斧，一把极其庞大的符文武器，用龙血和复仇铁誓回火而成
desc.en: The Axe of Dargo, a runic weapon of monstrous size, is tempered with dragon's blood and iron-oaths of vengeance.

desc.zh: 盾牌前部绘着无名女士为勇士祈福的图像。盾牌的纹章保护着使用者，对远程攻击尤其有效
desc.en: The front of this shield depicts a warrior being blessed by a nameless lady. Its wielder gains protection from the sigil, especially against foes armed with missiles.

desc.zh: 锈迹斑斑的权杖饱蘸纳垢最爱的疫病，上面的魔法让它可以捕获所杀敌人的灵魂
desc.en: This rusted mace drips with Nurgle's choicest plagues and bears an enchantment that ensnares the souls of those crushed beneath its filth-encrusted mass.

desc.zh: 盖尔·玛拉兹是西格玛的传奇战锤。这把满嵌符文的武器不仅象征着帝国的衣钵，也是整个世界最强大的圣物之一
desc.en: Ghal Maraz is the legendary hammer of Sigmar. This rune-encrusted weapon is not only the symbol of the Emperor's mantle, but one of the most potent artefacts in the world.

desc.zh: 格里姆格的灭人斧铸自扎尔·纳格隆德的恶魔熔炉，虽经万千血战，却从未有过任何钝蚀
desc.en: Shaped in the Daemon-forges of Zharr-Naggrund, Grimgor's mighty axe, Gitsnik, has never grown dull despite its constant use.

desc.zh: 这柄利刃用一朵实体化的炽热之焰锻造，刺入火焰巨灵尸身中淬火而成
desc.en: This blade was made from a single, searing flame that was hammered into material form and quenched in the body of a fire-djinn.

desc.zh: 破旧的喧嚣头盔是个刻满凋零符号的青铜头盔，它能让敌人心神不定、焦躁不安
desc.en: The battered Helm of Discord is a bronze helmet covered in withering symbols that both distract and unsettle any attacker.

desc.zh: 十二柄符文之牙正是选帝侯至高权威的象征。这些威力强大无比的利刃，只有那柄盖尔·玛拉兹才能与之匹敌
desc.en: The Runefangs are held by the Elector Counts as symbols of their stately office. They are immensely powerful blades of unsurpassed power that only Ghal Maraz could rival.

desc.zh: 一个亡灵佣兵的传奇之剑，据说，只有杀死一条生命你才能把它重新放入剑鞘之中，而且在那之前，它会不停地发出恐怖的尖叫
desc.en: The legendary sword of an Undead mercenary, it is said the blade cannot be sheathed without first taking a life and will emit a terrifying squeal until it does.

desc.zh: 这把剑据说是用一个被诅咒的熔炉熔炼而成，接着立刻插进一个将死的冠军勇士体内，用他的鲜血完成了淬火工序
desc.en: This sword was said to be smelted in a cursed furnace and then quenched in the bloody body of a dying champion.

desc.zh: 卡拉克·黑岩堡之锤上附有极为强大的符文，这使得它可以非常容易地进行挥舞
desc.en: The Hammer of Karak Drazh was struck with such powerful runes it can be swung with preternatural ease.

desc.zh: 第一位大神官约翰·赫斯拉姆的权杖。当一个信仰坚定的战士拿起它时，权杖头部会越变越亮，最后竟然会喷出火焰
desc.en: Used by Johann Helsturm, the first Grand Theogonist. When wielded by a warrior whose devotion is beyond reproach the head of the mace glows so brightly it bursts into flame.

desc.zh: 瑞克领符文之牙是选帝侯的象征，现在这柄剑正在阿尔道夫的亲王卡尔·弗兰兹手中
desc.en: The Reikland Runefang is the symbol of the Elector Count of this province. It is currently owned by the Prince of Altdorf, Karl Franz.

desc.zh: 这把家传宝剑是用最为纤细的巴托尼亚银丝锻造而成。它能捕获光线，将其放大，致命的攻击伴随着刺眼的光芒，让劳恩的敌人毫无招架之力
desc.en: This powerful heirloom was forged from the finest Bretonnian silverline. It catches the suns rays and magnifies them, dazzling Louen's enemies as he makes the death stroke.

desc.zh: 被折磨之剑的粗齿刃口所伤之人毫无皮肉之苦，然而他们的思想却会被可怕的凶兆肆意摧残
desc.en: Those that take a wound from the jagged blade of the Tormentor Sword will not only feel pain - their thoughts will be wracked with terrible omens.

desc.zh: 被这把邪恶的武器所杀之人，其灵魂也会被就此捕获。由此，敌人的尸体便会变为武器持有者永恒的奴隶
desc.en: This evil weapon entraps the souls of those in cleaves, binding their fleshless remains in servitude.

desc.zh: 光辉的铠甲，每片鳞片都泛着圣光，让敌人不能直视
desc.en: Such is the shine upon every scale in this resplendent mail that the foe can't help but be dazzled.

desc.zh: 一旦沾染敌人的鲜血，那么这把宝剑的使用者便能更有效地控制魔法之风
desc.en: Whenever this blade tastes blood, its wielder seems to exert greater control over the Winds of Magic.

desc.zh: 这把不安定的武器四处散播诅咒，让敌方勇士武功尽失
desc.en: This unsettling weapon spreads a curse on all around, disabusing enemy Warriors of their martial skills.

desc.zh: 格瑞姆布林戴尔的头盔已经历了不知多少的战火与岁月，它能让勇敢的矮人们群情激愤，以更为勇猛的雄姿投入战场
desc.en: Long thought lost to time and conflict, Grombrindal's awesome helm inspires already-courageous Dwarfen hearts to even greater acts of bravery.

desc.zh: 爆炸后紧接着是一道白光。敌人步伐错乱，满眼金星，正是你趁虚而入的好时机！
desc.en: A bang, a flash - the foes stagger slowly and blindly whilst you take full advantage of their disarray.

desc.zh: 作为身经百战的先祖战士，无论周围的战况多么纷乱，白矮人永远会奋战到底
desc.en: As battle-hardened as he is ancient, the White Dwarf will always stand his ground, no matter the pandemonium unfolding around him.

desc.zh: 鉴于许多的史诗与传说中都记载了这柄战斧，所以难不成白矮人的手中神兵，正是洪荒时期葛林姆尼尔手中的圣物？
desc.en: Mentioned in several sagas and legends, could the White Dwarf's mighty weapon be the fabled rune axe wielded by Grimnir at the dawn of history?

desc.zh: 这个诅咒之杯中汇聚了诸多不幸小民的生命精华，只需轻品一口，便可令人获得全新的力量
desc.en: The life essence of many wretched, innocent smallfolk ensures that those who drink from this cursed cup thrive with newfound power.

desc.zh: 巫妖之主驱役着远古尸妖来为其服务，但居尔首位且最重要的主人却是纳迦什…
desc.en: The Lichemaster raises the ancient Wight to do his bidding, but Krell serves Nagash first and foremost...

desc.zh: 巫妖之主驱役着远古尸妖来为其服务，但居尔首位且最重要的主人却是纳迦什…
desc.en: The Lichemaster raises the ancient Wight to do his bidding, but Krell serves Nagash first and foremost...

desc.zh: 巫妖之主驱役着远古尸妖来为其服务，但居尔首位且最重要的主人却是纳迦什…
desc.en: The Lichemaster raises the ancient Wight to do his bidding, but Krell serves Nagash first and foremost...

desc.zh: 巫妖之主驱役着远古尸妖来为其服务，但居尔首位且最重要的主人却是纳迦什…
desc.en: The Lichemaster raises the ancient Wight to do his bidding, but Krell serves Nagash first and foremost...

desc.zh: 巫妖之主驱役着远古尸妖来为其服务，但居尔首位且最重要的主人却是纳迦什…
desc.en: The Lichemaster raises the ancient Wight to do his bidding, but Krell serves Nagash first and foremost...

desc.zh: 巫妖之主驱役着远古尸妖来为其服务，但居尔首位且最重要的主人却是纳迦什…
desc.en: The Lichemaster raises the ancient Wight to do his bidding, but Krell serves Nagash first and foremost...

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time, disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 召唤而出的生物仅能在世上存活很短的时间，随后便会重新消失在魔法之风中
desc.en: Summoned creatures exist in this world on borrowed time before disappearing back to the Winds from whence they came.

desc.zh: 当你看见他向你走来时，记得跑得越快越好…然而这样似乎也没什么用！
desc.en: If you see him coming run as fast as you can… not that it will do you any good whatsoever!

desc.zh: 你绝对不想惹他们生气的，是的，绝对…
desc.en: You really don't want to make them angry. No, *really*.

desc.zh: 阴影为其披风，黑暗为其友朋
desc.en: Shadows be thy cloak and darkness thy ally.

desc.zh: 有时真的是所谓『过犹不及』，死难者的灵魂成了战争机器的燃料
desc.en: Sometimes less really is more; the souls of the fallen feed the engines of war.

desc.zh: 永远不要与野兽人对上眼，否则等着你的便将是一场丑陋而没有全尸的死亡
desc.en: Never make direct eye-contact with a Beastman lest it mark you out for a hideous, flesh-ripping demise.

desc.zh: 一场血战中有人一起并肩作战总是备感安心
desc.en: In the midst of a bloodbath it's good to know that someone has your back.

desc.zh: 森林自会照顾自己的属民
desc.en: The forest looks after its own.

desc.zh: 此部队会永远飞行，无法落地
desc.en: This unit is always flying and cannot land.

desc.zh:
面对来自不同方向的实弹射击时，此部队的[[b]][[col:white]][[img:icon_missile_block_chance]][[/img]]远程格挡概率[[/col]][[/b]]会各不相同

各方向对应的格挡概率如下：
[[img:icon_shield_gold]][[/img]]前方：1.0x
[[img:icon_shield_silver]][[/img]]侧方：0.5x
[[img:icon_shield_bronze]][[/img]]后方：0.1x
desc.en:
This unit has variable [[b]][[col:white]][[img:icon_missile_block_chance]][[/img]] Missile Block Chance[[/col]][[/b]] depending on which side of the unit is hit by a projectile.

The missile block chance multiplier of each direction is:
[[img:icon_shield_gold]][[/img]] 1.0x at the front
[[img:icon_shield_silver]][[/img]] 0.5x at the sides
[[img:icon_shield_bronze]][[/img]] 0.1x at the rear

desc.zh: 该装置采用了专门设计的重型钢板以抵挡炮弹的攻击，即使是直接的火炮射击也能偏转开去！
desc.en: Clad in heavy plates designed specifically to protect against projectiles, this unit is capable of deflecting even direct cannon fire!

desc.zh: 在技能指定时，此部队视为野猪骑兵
desc.en: This unit counts as Boar Cavalry for ability targeting

desc.zh:
[[b]][[col:white]]绑定火焰恶魔[[/col]][[/b]]不会[[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]溃逃，但他们会在[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力崩溃时受到伤害

[[b]][[col:white]]绑定火焰恶魔[[/col]][[/b]]同时拥有：
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_physical]][[/img]]物理抗性
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_fire]][[/img]]火焰抗性
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]恐惧与[[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]惊骇免疫

[[b]][[col:white]]绑定火焰恶魔[[/col]][[/b]]也会在部队拥有大部分[[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]生命值时赋予其[[img:icon_unbreakable]][[/img]]永不战败属性
desc.en:
[[b]][[col:white]]Bound Fire Daemons[[/col]][[/b]] cannot be [[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]routed, but they take damage when their [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]Leadership is broken.

[[b]][[col:white]]Bound Fire Daemons[[/col]][[/b]] also have:
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_physical]][[/img]]Physical Resistance
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_fire]][[/img]]Fire Resistance
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]Fear and [[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]Terror Immunity

[[b]][[col:white]]Bound Fire Daemons[[/col]][[/b]] are also [[img:icon_unbreakable]][[/img]]Unbreakable whilst most of their [[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]hit points are remaining.

desc.zh: 无论此部队朝向如何，它都可以抵御来自任意方向的弹丸
desc.en: This unit can block projectiles regardless of its facing.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以直接攻击城门或城墙。你无需等待攻城塔或攻城锤的建造，便可对城镇发动攻击
desc.en: This unit can attack city gates, allowing you to instantly launch a siege battle without having to wait for towers or battering rams to be built.

desc.zh: 此部队的兵模可以受到伤害，但不会死亡
desc.en: Entities in this unit take damage, but cannot die.

desc.zh: 这支部队无法奔跑，只能用行走的方式在战场上移动
desc.en: This unit cannot run and will only move at walking pace.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以对所有敌军部队引发恐惧，令附近敌军遭受[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力惩罚。同时这支部队自身也对恐惧效果免疫。恐惧惩罚不能叠加
desc.en: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.

desc.zh: 这支部队可惊骇敌军，令其近战目标溃逃一段时间。对于能够造成惊骇的部队来说，其自身也将免疫恐惧与惊骇效果
desc.en: This unit can cause terror, making its melee target rout for a short time. Units that cause terror are immune to terror and fear themselves.

desc.zh: 当[[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]阵列齐整时，这支部队在对抗敌军冲锋时会无视其所有的[[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]冲锋加成
desc.en: When [[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]bracing, this unit negates the [[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]charge bonus of any attacker.

desc.zh: 当[[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]阵列齐整时，这支部队在对抗大型部队冲锋时会无视其所有的[[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]冲锋加成
desc.en: When bracing[[img:icon_braced]][[/img]], this unit negates the [[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]charge bonus of any large attacker.

desc.zh: 当[[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]阵列齐整时，这支部队可以对冲锋而来的敌军造成额外伤害
desc.en: When [[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]bracing, this unit causes additional damage when attacking charging enemies.

desc.zh:
[[b]][[col:white]]构装体[[/col]][[/b]]不会[[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]溃逃，但会在[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力崩溃时受到伤害

[[b]][[col:white]]构装体[[/col]][[/b]]同时拥有：
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]恐惧与[[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]惊骇免疫

[[b]][[col:white]]构装体[[/col]][[/b]]可以由诸如古墓王的古墓技师等特殊人物恢复[[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]生命值并提升属性
desc.en:
[[b]][[col:white]]Constructs[[/col]][[/b]] cannot be [[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]routed, but take damage when their [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]Leadership is broken.

[[b]][[col:white]]Constructs[[/col]][[/b]] also have:
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] [[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]Fear and [[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]Terror Immunity

[[b]][[col:white]]Constructs[[/col]][[/b]] may also have their [[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]hit points restored and stats boosted by special characters such as the Tomb Kings Necrotect.

desc.zh: 只有目睹同样拥有蔑视异类属性的友方部队溃逃时，这支部队的[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力才会受到影响
desc.en: Witnessing other friendly units rout will only affect this unit's [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership if they also have the Contempt attribute.

desc.zh:
[[b]][[col:white]]恶魔[[/col]][[/b]]部队不会[[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]溃逃，但会在[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力低下时受到伤害

[[b]][[col:white]]恶魔[[/col]][[/b]]部队同时拥有：
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_physical]][[/img]]物理抗性
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]恐惧与[[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]惊骇免疫
desc.en:
[[b]][[col:white]]Daemonic[[/col]][[/b]] units cannot be [[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]routed, but take damage when their [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]Leadership is low.

[[b]][[col:white]]Daemonic[[/col]][[/b]] units also have:
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_physical]][[/img]]Physical Resistance
 [[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]Fear and [[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]Terror Immunity

desc.zh: 拥有此属性的兵模在从敌方背后或侧面攻击时，获得双倍的冲锋加成
desc.en: Entities with this attribute double their charge bonus when attacking the rear or flank of an entity.

desc.zh: 这支部队的[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力不会受到[[img:icon_general]][[/img]]领主阵亡的影响，在被击溃后也会更快地重整过来. - NOT WH
desc.en: This unit does not suffer a [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership penalty when the [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lord dies. It can also rally after routing more often. - NOT WH

desc.zh:
[[b]][[col:white]]元素生物[[/col]][[/b]]部队不会[[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]溃逃，但会在[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力崩溃时受到伤害

[[b]][[col:white]]元素生物[[/col]][[/b]]同时拥有：
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_physical]][[/img]]物理抗性
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]恐惧与[[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]惊骇免疫
desc.en:
[[b]][[col:white]]Elementals[[/col]][[/b]] cannot be [[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]routed, but take damage when their [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]Leadership is broken.

[[b]][[col:white]]Elementals[[/col]][[/b]] also have:
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_physical]][[/img]]Physical Resistance
 [[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]Fear and [[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]Terror Immunity

desc.zh: 这支部队可以提升周围友军的[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力。当友军同时位于拥有此特性的部队与[[img:icon_general]][[/img]]领主的影响范围内时，其增益效果取此二者的最大值
desc.en: This unit provides a [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership bonus to nearby allies. Units within range of both the [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lord's aura and an encouraging unit will receive the larger of the two bonuses.

desc.zh: 拥有[[b]][[col:white]]刽子手[[/col]][[/b]]技能的部队可以在战斗中处决[[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]生命值低于20%的部队
desc.en: A unit with [[b]][[col:white]]Executioner[[/col]][[/b]] will execute units in combat below a 20% [[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]hit points threshold.

desc.zh: 其他部队的[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力不会因目击友方炮灰部队溃逃而降低，除非这支部队也是炮灰部队
desc.en: Witnessing friendly expendable units rout does not reduce other units' [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership, unless they are themselves expendable.

desc.zh: 在技能指定时，此部队视为狂热者
desc.en: This unit counts as a Fanatic for ability targeting

desc.zh: 纵使执行的是最令人筋疲力尽的行动，这支部队也永远不会损失体力
desc.en: Even when performing the most fatiguing actions, this unit never loses vigour.

desc.zh: 当进行战斗等消耗体力的活动时，这支部队的体力受到的影响会比较小
desc.en: This unit's vigour is less affected by fatiguing actions, such as combat.

desc.zh: 此部队不会在受到侧袭时受到惩罚
desc.en: This unit takes no penalties when flanked.

desc.zh: 此部队可以飞行
desc.en: This unit can fly.

desc.zh: 立即激励部队进行重整
desc.en: Motivates units to rally immediately

desc.zh: 当进行近战时，这支部队会尽量保持阵型，从而少量增加近战防御
desc.en: The unit will try to stay in formation when in melee. Melee defence will be slightly increased.

desc.zh: 当冲入敌方部队时：\n[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]冲锋加成持续时间翻倍\n[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]]敌方部队受到等同于受到侧袭时的[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力惩罚
desc.en: When charging into an enemy unit:\n[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] [[img:icon_charge]][[/img]] Charge Bonus duration is doubled.\n[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] Enemy units take a [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]] Leadership penalty as if they have been attacked in the flank.

desc.zh: 在技能指定时，此部队视为地精步兵
desc.en: This unit counts as Goblin Infantry for ability targeting

desc.zh: 在使用技能时，此部队将视为猎食者
desc.en: This unit counts as a Gorger for ability targeting

desc.zh: 这支部队可以在部署区域外进行部署
desc.en: This unit can deploy outside the deployment zone.

desc.zh:
此部队完全通过远程攻击造成伤害，没有任何近战攻击手段

炮艇机部队同时拥有：
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]]可从正上方攻击地面目标
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]]可远程攻击飞行目标
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]]拥有[[b]][[col:white]][[img:icon_ammo]][[/img]]弹药[[/col]][[/b]]无限的载荷
desc.en:
This unit relies entirely on missile attacks to deal damage and has no melee capabilities.

Gunship-type units also:
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] Attack ground targets from directly above
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] Attack flying targets from range
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] Have certain riders with infinite [[b]][[col:white]][[img:icon_ammo]][[/img]] Ammunition[[/col]][[/b]]

desc.zh: 此部队可以在战斗中通过恶魔铁匠的重铸技能恢复
desc.en: This unit can be restored in battle by the Daemonsmith's Reforge ability.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以隐蔽在森林里，除非敌人走到近前，否则他们不会被发现
desc.en: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

name.zh: 忽略来自盟友接触效果的伤害、治疗与属性
name.en: Ignores damage, healing and stats from allied contact effects

desc.zh: 拥有这一属性的兵模可以无视敌方的接触效果，例如[[img:icon_poison]][[/img]]中毒
desc.en: Entities with this attribute ignore the effects of enemy contact effects such as [[img:icon_poison]][[/img]] Poison

desc.zh: 此部队可以穿越树林
desc.en: This unit can pass through trees.

desc.zh: 这支部队免疫心理攻击（恐惧与惊骇）
desc.en: The unit is immune to psychological attacks (Fear & Terror).

desc.zh: 此部队不会受到伤害
desc.en: This unit cannot take damage.

desc.zh: 目睹拥有[[img:brt_peasant]][[/img]]农民属性的友方部队溃逃并不会影响这支部队的[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力
desc.en: Witnessing friendly units with the [[img:brt_peasant]][[/img]]Peasant Attribute rout will not affect this unit's [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership.

desc.zh: 拥有[[img:lzd_kroxigor]][[/img]]巨蜥属性的部队会在周围存在拥有[[img:lzd_skink]][[/img]]灵蜥属性的部队时获得下列加成：\n[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_weapon_damage]][[/img]]增加武器威力
desc.en: A unit with the [[img:lzd_kroxigor]][[/img]]Kroxigor will gain the following bonuses if a unit with the [[img:lzd_skink]][[/img]]Skink Attribute is nearby:\n[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] [[img:icon_weapon_damage]][[/img]]Increased Weapon Strength

desc.zh:
拥有[[b]][[col:white]]恐虐印记[[/col]][[/b]]的部队会获得下列效果：
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]][[img:icon_frenzy]][[/img]]狂暴被动技能
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]]增加[[img:icon_resistance_magic]][[/img]]法术抗性
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]]增加[[img:icon_armour]][[/img]]护甲强度
[[img:icon_arrow_down]][[/img]]降低[[img:icon_melee_defence]][[/img]]近战防御
desc.en:
A unit with the [[b]][[col:white]]Mark of Khorne[[/col]][[/b]] has:
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]][[img:icon_frenzy]][[/img]] Frenzy Passive Ability
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] Increased [[img:icon_resistance_magic]][[/img]] Spell Resistance
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] Increased [[img:icon_armour]][[/img]] Armour
[[img:icon_arrow_down]][[/img]] Reduced [[img:icon_melee_defence]][[/img]] Melee Defence

desc.zh:
拥有[[b]][[col:white]]纳垢印记[[/col]][[/b]]的部队会获得下列效果：
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]][[img:icon_poison]][[/img]]淬毒效果
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]]增加[[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]生命值
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]]增加[[img:icon_melee_defence]][[/img]]近战防御
[[img:icon_arrow_down]][[/img]]降低[[img:icon_melee_attack]][[/img]]近战攻击
desc.en:
A unit with the [[b]][[col:white]]Mark of Nurgle[[/col]][[/b]] has:
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] [[img:icon_poison]][[/img]] Poison Contact Effect
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] Increased [[img:icon_hp]][[/img]] Hit Points
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] Increased [[img:icon_melee_defence]][[/img]] Melee Defence
[[img:icon_arrow_down]][[/img]] Reduced [[img:icon_melee_attack]][[/img]] Melee Attack

desc.zh:
拥有[[b]][[col:white]]色孽印记[[/col]][[/b]]的部队会获得下列效果：
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]][[img:icon_immpsy]][[/img]]心理免疫属性
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]][[img:icon_strider]][[/img]]地形适性属性
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]]增加[[img:icon_resistance_physical]][[/img]]物理抗性
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]]增加[[img:icon_speed]][[/img]]移动速度
desc.en:
A unit with the [[b]][[col:white]]Mark of Slaanesh[[/col]][[/b]] has:
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] [[img:icon_immpsy]][[/img]] Immune to Psychology Attribute
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] [[img:icon_strider]][[/img]] Strider Attribute
[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] Increased [[img:icon_resistance_physical]][[/img]] Physical Resistance
 [[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] Increased [[img:icon_speed]][[/img]] Speed

desc.zh: 拥有[[b]][[col:white]]奸奇印记[[/col]][[/b]]的部队会获得下列效果：\n[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]][[img:icon_barrier_tip]][[/img]]魔屏\n[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]][[img:icon_magical_attacks]][[/img]]魔法攻击
desc.en: A unit with the [[b]][[col:white]]Mark of Tzeentch[[/col]][[/b]] has:\n[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] [[img:icon_barrier_tip]][[/img]] Barrier\n[[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] [[img:icon_magical_attacks]][[/img]] Magical Attacks

desc.zh: 这是由腐坏氏族创造的部队。捕兽师与『不洁者』斯洛特能够彻底激发它的战斗潜能，并在战斗中恢复它
desc.en: This is a unit created by Clan Moulder. Packmasters and Throt the Unclean can push it to its full combat potential and restore it in battle.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以在移动的同时进行射击
desc.en: This unit can fire while on the move.

desc.zh: 在技能指定时，此部队视为卑鄙潜伏者
desc.en: This unit counts as a Nasty Skulker for ability targeting

desc.zh: 在技能指定时，此部队视为夜地精弓箭手
desc.en: This unit counts as a Night Goblin Archer for ability targeting

desc.zh: 当进攻[[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]阵列齐整的抵御冲锋部队时，这支部队只会损失一半的[[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]冲锋加成
desc.en: When attacking [[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]braced charge defenders, this unit only loses half of its [[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]charge bonus.

desc.zh: 当进攻[[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]阵列齐整的抵御冲锋部队时，这支部队只会损失四分之一的[[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]冲锋加成
desc.en: When attacking [[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]braced charge defenders, this unit only loses a quarter of its [[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]charge bonus.

desc.zh: 在技能指定时，此部队视为兽人步兵
desc.en: This unit counts as Orc Infantry for ability targeting

desc.zh: 当拥有[[img:brt_knight]][[/img]]骑士属性的部队出现在附近时，拥有[[img:brt_peasant]][[/img]]农民属性的部队会获得领导力加成
desc.en: A unit with the [[img:brt_peasant]][[/img]]Peasant Attribute will gain increased leadership if a unit with the [[img:brt_knight]][[/img]]Knight Attribute is nearby.

desc.zh: [[b]][[col:red]]癫狂[[/col]][[/b]]中的部队无法控制，并会自动攻击最近的敌人\n当附近没有敌人时，[[b]][[col:red]]癫狂[[/col]][[/b]]的部队则会漫无目的地乱跑
desc.en: A [[b]][[col:red]]Rampaging[[/col]][[/b]] unit is uncontrollable and will attack the nearest enemy unit.\nWhen there are no enemy units nearby, a [[b]][[col:red]]Rampaging[[/col]][[/b]] unit will move around randomly instead.

desc.zh: 当该部队施放一个法术时，其所有法术都会被随机替换为另一个法术
desc.en: When this unit casts a spell, all of their spells will be randomly replaced by another spell.

desc.zh:
此部队对敌方永久可见，无论是否处于视野范围之内

[[b]][[col:white]]现身[[/col]][[/b]]的部队不受下列属性影响：
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_hide_forest]][[/img]]于森林中隐蔽
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_stalk]][[/img]]潜行
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_unspottable]][[/img]]隐蔽高手
desc.en:
This unit is permanently visible to the enemy, regardless of line of sight.

[[b]][[col:white]]Revealed[[/col]][[/b]] units are not affected by the following attributes:
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] [[img:icon_hide_forest]][[/img]]Hide Forest
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] [[img:icon_stalk]][[/img]]Stalk
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] [[img:icon_unspottable]][[/img]]Unspottable

desc.zh: 此部队无法使用技能或施放法术
desc.en: This unit is unable to activate abilities or cast spells.

desc.zh: 拥有[[img:lzd_skink]][[/img]]灵蜥属性的部队会在周围存在拥有[[img:lzd_kroxigor]][[/img]]巨蜥属性的部队时获得下列加成：\n[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] [[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]引发恐惧
desc.en: A unit with the [[img:lzd_skink]][[/img]]Skink Attribute will gain the following bonuses if a unit with the [[img:lzd_kroxigor]][[/img]]Kroxigor Attribute is nearby:\n[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] [[img:icon_fear]][[/img]] Causes Fear

desc.zh: 这是一支屠夫部队。屠夫的[[img:icon_weapon_damage]][[/img]]武器威力永远不会在战斗中下降
desc.en: This unit is a Slayer. Slayers can never have their [[img:icon_weapon_damage]][[/img]]Weapon Strength reduced during a battle.

desc.zh: 这支部队会在射击时保持隐蔽
desc.en: This unit remains hidden while firing.

desc.zh: 当军中一支以上的部队拥有此技能时，[[img:icon_spell_mastery]][[/img]]所施放的法术威力会显著增加
desc.en: When two or more units in the same army share this attribute, [[img:icon_spell_mastery]][[/img]] intensity increases the power of spells cast.

desc.zh: 在技能指定时，此部队视为蜘蛛
desc.en: This unit counts as a Spider for ability targeting

desc.zh: 在技能指定时，此部队视为史奎格
desc.en: This unit counts as a Squig for ability targeting

desc.zh: 在技能指定时，此部队视为史奎格兽群
desc.en: This unit counts as a Squig Herd for ability targeting

desc.zh: 这支部队在任何地形上移动时都会保持隐蔽
desc.en: This unit can move hidden in any terrain.

desc.zh: 这支部队不受因地形导致的速度与战斗惩罚
desc.en: Speed and combat penalties caused by terrain are ignored by this unit.

desc.zh:
一支[[b]][[col:white]]虎人战士[[/col]][[/b]]部队获得：
 [[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] [[img:icon_speed]][[/img]]移动速度提高
 [[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] [[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]冲锋加成提高
 [[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]]『凶暴伏击』技能
desc.en:
A [[b]][[col:white]]Tiger Warrior[[/col]][[/b]] unit has:
 [[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] Increased [[img:icon_speed]][[/img]] Speed
 [[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] Increased [[img:icon_charge]][[/img]] Charge Bonus
 [[img:icon_arrow_up]][[/img]] Ferocious Ambush ability

desc.zh: 在技能指定时，此部队视为巨魔
desc.en: This unit counts as a Troll for ability targeting

desc.zh: 这支部队不会承受任何有关[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力下降的惩罚，并且永远不会溃逃
desc.en: This unit does not suffer any form of [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership loss and will never rout.

desc.zh:
[[b]][[col:white]]亡灵[[/col]][[/b]]部队不会[[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]溃逃，但会在[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力崩溃时受到伤害

[[b]][[col:white]]亡灵[[/col]][[/b]]部队同时拥有：
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]恐惧与[[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]惊骇免疫

[[b]][[col:white]]亡灵[[/col]][[/b]]部队可以由诸如吸血鬼伯爵的亡灵法师等特殊人物恢复[[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]生命值
desc.en:
[[b]][[col:white]]Undead[[/col]][[/b]] units cannot be [[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]routed, but take damage when their [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]Leadership is broken.

[[b]][[col:white]]Undead[[/col]][[/b]] units also have:
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] [[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]Fear and [[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]Terror Immunity

[[b]][[col:white]]Undead[[/col]][[/b]] units may also have their [[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]hit points restored by special characters such as the Vampire Counts Necromancer.

desc.zh: 恐惧之嘴正处于地下。它无法被攻击，但自身也无法攻击
desc.en: The Dread Maw is underground. It cannot be attacked but neither can it attack in turn.

desc.zh: 如果这支部队可以在当前位置隐蔽，那么只有当敌人距离十分接近时才能发现他们
desc.en: If this unit can hide at its current location it will not be spotted until the enemy is very close.

desc.zh: 此部队的[[img:icon_melee_attack]]近战攻击[[/img]]不会在战斗中下降
desc.en: This unit can never have its [[img:icon_melee_attack]]Melee Attack[[/img]] reduced during battle.

desc.zh: 允许部队使用近战攻击摧毁城墙。此属性也会对建筑造成[[img:ui/skins/default/weapon_building_damage_modifier.png]][[/img]][[col:green]]+50%[[/col]]的伤害加成
desc.en: Allows the unit to attack and destroy walls in melee. This attribute also adds a [[img:ui/skins/default/weapon_building_damage_modifier.png]][[/img]] [[col:green]]+50%[[/col]] damage multiplier against buildings.

desc.zh: 此部队的武道宁和为阳
desc.en: This unit counts as a Yang unit for the purpose of Battle Harmony proximity

desc.zh: 此部队的武道宁和为阴
desc.en: This unit counts as a Yin unit for the purpose of Battle Harmony proximity.

desc.zh: 这支部队会始终飞行，无法降落
desc.en: This unit is always flying and cannot land.

desc.zh: 反步兵部队擅长对付体积小于马匹的目标。这一特性可表现为对小型目标[[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_infantry.png]][[/img]]造成额外伤害、以体重优势压制轻型敌军或对大片区域造成远程爆炸性伤害等
desc.en: Anti-infantry units have an advantage against targets that are smaller than a horse. This advantage can be a [[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_infantry.png]][[/img]]damage bonus against small targets, superior weight used to smash through lighter enemies, or an explosive attack from range that effects a large area.

desc.zh: 反大型部队可以有效应对体积至少等同马匹的目标。这一特性会有很多具体表现形式，如面对大型目标时的[[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_large.png]][[/img]]伤害加成，或者可以集聚到很小一片区域的强力攻击等等。然而鉴于大型部队的攻击一般过于缓慢且容易在近战中闪避开，所以很多部队天生便可更有效地应对这些敌军
desc.en: Anti-large units have an advantage against targets that are at least as large as a horse. This advantage can be a [[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_bonus_vs_large.png]][[/img]]damage bonus against large targets or an attack that focuses on a very small area. However, some units are simply better against large targets because their attacks are slow and easy to dodge by skilled melee combatants.

desc.zh: 此部队可以将敌方的近战与远程[[img:icon_magical_attacks]][[/img]]魔法武器攻击无效化
desc.en: This unit has the ability to negate the [[img:icon_magical_attacks]][[/img]] magical attacks of enemy melee and missile weapons.

desc.zh: 其他小型部队在浅水中战斗和移动都很吃力，水生一族在这方面就胜出一筹
desc.en: Whereas some units struggle to fight and move in shallow water, aquatic units excel.

desc.zh: 腥红杀手的双手各持一支大砍刀，一刀下去常能劈死多名敌人
desc.en: Wielding an ‘eavy choppa in each hand, the Krimson Killerz cleave through several foes with each swing.

desc.zh: 具有[[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]破甲属性的武器可在大多数情况下无视目标的护甲，这让他们成为了对抗重甲部队时的有效选择。但这些部队一般较为重型，且攻击频率不高，这也让他们在对抗轻装部队时显得有些吃力
desc.en: The damage of [[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]armour-piercing weapons mostly ignores the armour of the target, making them the ideal choice against heavily-armoured enemies. They are often heavier and attack at a slower rate though, making them less efficient against poorly-armoured targets.

desc.zh: 具有[[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]破甲属性的武器可在大多数情况下无视目标的护甲，这让他们成为了对抗重甲部队时的有效选择。但这些部队一般较为重型，且攻击频率不高，这也让他们在对抗轻装部队时显得有些吃力
desc.en: The damage of [[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]armour-piercing weapons mostly ignores the armour of the target, making them the ideal choice against heavily-armoured enemies. They are often heavier and attack at a slower rate though, making them less efficient against poorly-armoured targets.

desc.zh: 具有[[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]破甲属性的武器可在大多数情况下无视目标的护甲，这让他们成为了对抗重甲部队时的有效选择。但这些部队一般较为重型，且攻击频率不高，这也让他们在对抗轻装部队时显得有些吃力
desc.en: The damage of [[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]armour-piercing weapons mostly ignores the armour of the target, making them the ideal choice against heavily-armoured enemies. They are often heavier and attack at a slower rate though, making them less efficient against poorly-armoured targets.

desc.zh: 这支部队的[[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/wh_dlc06_unit_contact_sundered_armour.png]][[/img]]碎甲攻击可以显著地削弱敌军的护甲
desc.en: The [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/wh_dlc06_unit_contact_sundered_armour.png]][[/img]]armour-splitting attacks of this unit can significantly weaken the target's armour.

desc.zh: 重甲部队可以扣减除了[[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]破甲杀伤之外的所有种类的杀伤
desc.en: Armoured units can block damage from any source apart from [[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]Armour-Piercing damage.

desc.zh: 重甲部队可以扣减除了[[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]破甲杀伤之外的所有种类的杀伤。[[img:icon_shield]][[/img]]盾牌有一定概率挡住敌方的箭矢、弹丸、枪击以及类似的小型火力，但只有在正面朝向敌军时才能发挥效果
desc.en: Armoured units can block damage from any source apart from [[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]Armour-Piercing damage. [[img:icon_shield]][[/img]]Shields have a chance of blocking arrows, bolts, rifle shots and similar small arms fire - but only in a forward facing arc.

desc.zh: 此部队会对生命值低于50%的目标造成双倍伤害
desc.en: This unit does double damage to targets below 50% health.

desc.zh: 该部队使用魔法攻击，并且在魔法之风充沛时会变得更强
desc.en: This unit has magical attacks and becomes stronger when the winds of magic are in full gale.

desc.zh: 魔古尔的毁灭之力聚集成了变形的光环，可以保护其免受大部分的伤害。但在光环冷却时，魔古尔会相当脆弱
desc.en: Morghur's Ruinous, transformative aura protects him from damage most of the time, but he is vulnerable whilst it recharges.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以提升附近所有友方部队的远程攻击
desc.en: This unit improves all nearby friendly missile units.

desc.zh: 这支部队拥有一面可以吸收伤害的消耗性魔屏。当没有受到伤害时，魔屏会缓慢地自我补充。魔屏最大生命值与剩余部队生命值成正比
desc.en: This unit has a barrier that absorbs damage until depleted. When not taking damage, the barrier will slowly replenish. Maximum barrier health is proportional to remaining unit health.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以学习法术，从而在战场上支援友军或是攻击敌军
desc.en: This unit can learn prayers to support allies and defeat foes in battle.

desc.zh: 一道向前散发的强大白热光线，以柯泰戈之怒燃烧并致盲敌人
desc.en: An intense, white-hot shaft of light emanates forth, burning and blinding the foe with the wrath of Chotec himself.

desc.zh: 作为最重、最壮也是最猛的兽人，无论对抗何等尺寸的敌人，大只佬都会证明自己的价值！
desc.en: The heaviest, strongest and meanest of Orcs, Big 'Uns are eager to prove it against enemies of all sizes.

desc.zh: 攻击血量低于33%的部队时造成大量额外伤害
desc.en: Causes massive bonus damage when attacking units below 33% health.

desc.zh:
[[b]][[col:white]]绑定火焰恶魔[[/col]][[/b]]不会[[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]溃逃，但他们会在[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力崩溃时受到伤害

[[b]][[col:white]]绑定火焰恶魔[[/col]][[/b]]同时拥有：
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_physical]][[/img]]物理抗性
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_fire]][[/img]]火焰抗性
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]恐惧与[[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]惊骇免疫

[[b]][[col:white]]绑定火焰恶魔[[/col]][[/b]]也会在部队拥有大部分[[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]生命值时赋予其[[img:icon_unbreakable]][[/img]]永不战败属性
desc.en:
[[b]][[col:white]]Bound Fire Daemons[[/col]][[/b]] cannot be[[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]routed, but they take damage when their [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]Leadership is broken.

[[b]][[col:white]]Bound Fire Daemons[[/col]][[/b]] also have:
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_physical]][[/img]]Physical Resistance
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_resistance_fire]][[/img]]Fire Resistance
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]][[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]Fear and [[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]Terror Immunity

[[b]][[col:white]]Bound Fire Daemons[[/col]][[/b]] are also [[img:icon_unbreakable]][[/img]]Unbreakable whilst most of their [[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]hit points are remaining.

desc.zh: 这些部队可以射出神秘的蓝色火焰箭，他们擅长射击脆弱的部队，并刺穿最坚韧的盔甲
desc.en: Loosing arrows of mystical blue fire, they excel at setting vulnerable units ablaze and piercing the toughest armour.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以攻击城墙，塔楼与城门
desc.en: This unit can attack walls, towers and gates.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以攻击城门
desc.en: This unit can attack gates.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以攻击城墙
desc.en: This unit can attack walls.

desc.zh: 此部队可以飞行
desc.en: This unit can fly.

desc.zh: 有些远程武器无法防空，比如榴弹发射器，炸弹以及爆炸性弹药等等
desc.en: Some ranged weapons, like grenade launchers, bombs or blasting charges, can't target airborne units.

desc.zh: 这支部队在任何地形都可隐蔽行动，远程攻击非常难以将其瞄准
desc.en: This unit can move hidden in any terrain and is exceptionally hard to target with missile attacks.

desc.zh: 混沌战争神龛的出现会强化周围所有友军部队的[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力\n\n此外，在混沌战争神龛周围被杀的所有兵模（无论敌友）都会增加『恩赐光荣』技能的强度
desc.en: The presence of a Chaos Warshrine empowers the [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership of any nearby friendly units.\n\nAdditionally, any entity (friend or foe) that is killed near the Chaos Warshrine increases the intensity of the "Giver of Glory" ability.

desc.zh: 当坚守阵地时，这支部队会无视敌方的所有[[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]冲锋加成
desc.en: When standing and bracing against a charge this unit will negate the enemy's [[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]charge bonus.

desc.zh: 当坚守阵地时，这支部队会无视敌方大型部队（骑兵或者巨兽）的[[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]冲锋加成
desc.en: When standing and bracing against a charge of large enemies (such as cavalry or monsters) this unit will negate the enemy's [[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]charge bonus.

desc.zh: 这支部队的近战攻击可以让那些被攻击到的家伙停手
desc.en: This unit's melee attacks can stay the hand of those on the receiving end.

desc.zh: 这支部队被冰冷的光环包围，可以减慢身旁敌军的速度
desc.en: This unit is surrounded by an aura of freezing cold, slowing enemies who come too close.

desc.zh: 由于没有视野盲区，侧袭的概念对其毫无意义
desc.en: Without blind spots, the very notion of flanking loses meaning.

desc.zh: 当在冲锋中撞到敌人时，这支部队可以进行额外的攻击
desc.en: This unit causes additional attacks when colliding with enemies when charging.

desc.zh: 当这枚炸弹爆炸时会喷出黑色的烟幕，遮住希望隐藏自己的军队并让其他人难以呼吸
desc.en: When a bomb is smashed, a dark smoke curls out, concealing those who wish to hide and choking everyone else.

desc.zh: 当目睹没有『蔑视异类』特性的友方部队溃逃时，此部队的[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力不会下降
desc.en: This unit won't lose [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership from witnessing a friendly unit rout unless the routing unit also has Contempt.

desc.zh: 此部队体型庞大，动作迟缓，因此其攻击会慢于平均水平
desc.en: This unit's attacks are slower than average due to its massive, lumbering form.

desc.zh: 此中充满了最恶毒的仇恨诅咒，这些空灵的炮弹可以撕裂整个敌人的纵队
desc.en: Imbued with the foulest proclamations of hate, these ethereal projectiles can tear through entire enemy columns.

desc.zh: 这支部队犹如得到了搞哥的亲身祝福，它的弹丸可以致盲目标，从而降低其射击精度、近战攻击以及近战防御
desc.en: As if smote by mighty Gork himself, this unit’s projectile blinds its target on impact, reducing accuracy, melee attack and melee defence capabilities

desc.zh: 恐虐恶魔冲锋强悍，并拥有很强的法力抗性
desc.en: Daemons of Khorne are powerful chargers and resistant against spell damage.

desc.zh: 纳垢恶魔拥有很强的恢复能力，周身萦绕的苍蝇还使他们更加难以被击中
desc.en: Daemons of Nurgle are resilient and the flies that surround them make them harder to hit.

desc.zh: 色孽恶魔速度极快，他们的魔爪和魔钳可以刺穿最重的盔甲
desc.en: Daemons of Slaanesh are fast and their claws and pincers can slice through the heaviest of armour.

desc.zh: 奸奇恶魔受到奸奇篡变之力的加护，可以使用魔屏吸收伤害
desc.en: Daemons of Tzeentch are protected by Tzeentch's manipulations, allowing them to absorb damage with a barrier.

desc.zh: 混沌之神赋予恶魔亲王毁灭之力，将他扭曲成混沌的真实形态
desc.en: A Daemon Prince is gifted ruinous powers by the Chaos Gods to twist and shape him into the true form of Chaos

desc.zh: 这支军队有很强的伤害输出能力。当对抗它时，记得抢在他们展开远程或近战输出前干掉他们
desc.en: This unit has a strong emphasis on dealing damage. If fighting it, make sure to take it out before it can get into firing or melee range.

desc.zh: 此部队的血液含有可怕的诅咒，它会污染任何被它咬过的东西，从而阻止所有形式的治疗
desc.en: The blood of this unit contains a terrible curse that taints anything it bites, preventing all forms of healing.

desc.zh: 这支部队在空中飞行时可以利用特殊攻击对下方敌人造成伤害
desc.en: While airborne, this unit can use a special attack to damage enemies below.

desc.zh: 这些由史库里氏族发明的球型炸弹里装满了魔力气体，它们比毒风球体里装着的次元石气体更为稳定。它们在空气中漂浮的时间更长，因此能传播得更远，所以能够更有效地对付大群的目标
desc.en: Invented by Clan Skryre, these globes release a magical gas that is more stable than the Warpstone gas used in Poison Wind Globes. Hanging in the air longer and thus spreading further, it is especially lethal against large groups of targets.

desc.zh: 屠夫们永不战败，并且会一直战斗到战局结束甚至更久！如果死亡迫在眉睫，这只会让他们更努力地奋斗。当在近战中阵亡时，屠夫们会拼尽全力，以濒死的努力发出最后一击
desc.en: Slayers are unbreakable and always fight to the bitter end – sometimes even beyond that! Imminent death only makes them fight harder. When killed in melee, Slayers launch a final attack with their dying breaths.

desc.zh: 虽然这是一支远程部队或法师部队，但一旦他们陷入近战，仍然可以发挥出不错的肉搏实力
desc.en: Despite being primarily a missile unit or spellcaster, this unit can also hold its own ground when fighting in melee.

desc.zh: 这支部队擅长在近战中坚守阵地，为其他部队争取准备时间
desc.en: This unit excels at pinning the enemy down in melee, buying time for the rest of your army to get into position.

desc.zh: 使用巨剑斩开射来的箭矢，这是一项很难学习的技术：剑刃领主们并不鼓励这种训练，但真正的剑圣可不会让谨慎占了荣誉的上风
desc.en: The art of deflecting arrows with a greatsword is painful to learn; such training is discouraged by Bladelord officers, but no true Swordmaster will let caution best his pride.

desc.zh: 若是未能控制塔拉贝海姆的焰阳骑士团礼拜堂，这支部队要付出高得多的金钱成本
desc.en: The Knights of the Blazing Sun are substantially more costly unless you control their Chapterhouse in the region of Talabheim.

desc.zh: 该部队敏捷度极高，可以轻松闪避剑刃与投掷武器；然而众所周知的是，当面对魔法武器时它可就没那么幸运了
desc.en: This highly dexterous unit dodges blades and missiles with ease; its luck is known to run out quickly when facing magical weapons, however.

desc.zh: 地狱炮可以将其先前受害者的灵魂转变成爆裂性质的巨大能量火球。受到这一弹丸轰击的部队会遭受[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力上的惩罚。同时，炮体与弹丸之间的恶魔联系也会让后续的弹丸自动进行弹道上的微调。当以第一人称模式进行射击时，玩家可以自行调整弹丸的飞行轨迹
desc.en: The Hellcannon transforms the souls of former victims into crackling bolts of energy. Targets hit by this projectile receive a [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership penalty. The daemonic bond between the Hellcannon and its shot also allows minor corrections of the latter's flightpath. When fired in first-person mode, you can control the projectile yourself.

desc.zh: 这件火山锻造的魔法盔甲的穿戴者可免受火焰攻击的伤害
desc.en: Fire attacks cannot harm the wearer of this enchanted, volcano-forged armour.

desc.zh: 猩红龙吐息是一击强大的紫晶魔法爆炸，在短短片刻之内便能使金属枯萎，或使肉体化为尘埃，仿佛已经过时间千年的流逝一般
desc.en: The Carmine Dragon's breath is a sorcerous blast of powerful Amethyst Magic capable of withering metal and rendering flesh to dust as if a millennia past in mere moments.

desc.zh: 混沌的黑焰会一视同仁地燃烧血肉、铠甲、灵魂；毁灭之力毫不厚此薄彼
desc.en: The dark flames of Chaos burn flesh, armour and souls alike; the Ruinous Powers do not discriminate.

desc.zh: 只需一声令下，多头蛇的脑袋们将争相喷吐出最为明亮炽热的烈焰吐息
desc.en: Just give the order and the Hydra's heads will spew forth their fiery breath, each competing for the brightest flame.

desc.zh: 当银月龙炽热的吐息将牺牲者吞噬，能留下来的往往只剩一副烧焦的铠甲
desc.en: After a Moon Dragon’s fiery breath engulfs its victim, scorched armour is often all that remains.

desc.zh: 某些龙会喷出带毒的吐息，对目标造成持续性的效果。当然，这得假设目标能挨过起初的龙息攻击才行！
desc.en: Some Dragons breathe noxious fumes that have a long-lasting effect on their target's coordination - if it survived the attack in the first place.

desc.zh: 最古老、最强大的龙能够以一个炽烈白热的吐息熔化铠甲以及其下的血肉
desc.en: The eldest, most powerful Dragons can melt armour and the flesh beneath with a molten blast of their white-hot breath.

desc.zh: 烈阳龙灼热的吐息并没有集中点，但与步兵部队作战时，能够攻击大片区域其实是一个优势
desc.en: The Sun Dragon's scorching breath lacks focus, but hitting a larger area is actually an advantage when fighting infantry groups.

desc.zh: 诅咒魔裔有两个独立的人格，它们会持续争夺身体的主导权
desc.en: The Ettin has two distinct personalities that constantly vie for dominance and control.

desc.zh: 这一部队很适合用于进攻单个的目标，如[[img:icon_general]][[/img]]领主与[[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]英雄等。它每次只能攻击很少数量的敌人，因此在面对较弱但人数较多的部队时会力不从心
desc.en: This unit is best used to attack individual targets such as [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lords or [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Heroes. As it can only damage very few individuals at a time, it is not suitable against hordes of weak enemies.

desc.zh: 使用强力的黑魔法，随时间逐步杀伤周围敌军
desc.en: Uses Dark Magic to damage nearby enemy units over time.

desc.zh: 精英部队，其战力相较标准部队有着很大程度的提高
desc.en: Elite unit with stats greatly improved over those of its standard counterpart.

desc.zh: 灵体部队会忽略掉大部分的非魔法武器的伤害。由于这些部队几乎没有物理上的形体，所以大部分的地形移动惩罚也对他们没有效果
desc.en: Ethereal units ignore most damage done by non-magical weapons. As they have shed most of their physical form, they are not slowed by terrain-based movement penalties either.

desc.zh: 黑马车中充溢着魔法能量，它既能增加其防御能力，也可以增加其冲锋威力
desc.en: The Black Coach feeds on magical energy that bolsters its resistance and strengthens its charge.

desc.zh: 其他部队的[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力不会因目击友方炮灰部队溃逃而降低，除非这支部队也是炮灰部队
desc.en: Witnessing friendly expendable units rout does not reduce other units' [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]Leadership, unless they are themselves expendable.

desc.zh: 当这支部队冲锋时，装在它上面的挥发性孢子会以惊人的效果发生爆炸，并在脱离战斗后缓慢再生
desc.en: When this unit charges, the volatile spores mounted upon it explode with dramatic effect and slowly regrow while out of combat.

desc.zh: 此部队会发生爆炸，对不幸位于其爆炸半径内的任何部队造成伤害
desc.en: This unit explodes, dealing damage to any units unfortunate enough to be caught in the blast radius.

desc.zh: 屠夫们永不战败，并且会一直战斗到战局结束甚至更久！如果死亡迫在眉睫，这只会让他们更努力地奋斗。当在近战中阵亡时，屠夫们会拼尽全力，以濒死的努力发出最后一击
desc.en: Slayers are unbreakable and always fight to the bitter end – sometimes even beyond that! Imminent death only makes them fight harder. When killed in melee, Slayers launch a final attack with their dying breaths.

desc.zh: 虽然在旧世界中矮人并不以灵敏著称，但这些部队在没有披戴重甲时，仍然可以用非常快的速度进行移动
desc.en: While Dwarfs are generally not the most nimble inhabitants of the Old World, they can move surprisingly fast when not slowed by heavy armour.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以在移动时射击
desc.en: This unit can fire while on the move.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以进行火焰攻击。遭受火焰攻击的部队在[[img:UI/skins/default/modifier_icon_flaming.png]][[/img]]『起火』状态下受到的治疗效果将会减半，惧怕火焰的部队还会受到额外伤害\n它也会对建筑造成[[img:ui/skins/default/weapon_building_damage_modifier.png]][[/img]][[col:green]]+50%[[/col]]的伤害加成
desc.en: This unit inflicts flaming attacks. Units hit by flaming attacks heal at half the usual rate whilst [[img:UI/skins/default/modifier_icon_flaming.png]][[/img]] 'on fire’ and sustain additional damage if vulnerable to fire. \n It also adds a [[img:ui/skins/default/weapon_building_damage_modifier.png]][[/img]] [[col:green]]+50%[[/col]] damage multiplier against buildings.

desc.zh: 艾索洛伦的精魂可以回避大部分的普通攻击，并在重新融回森林前造成魔法伤害
desc.en: The spirits of Athel Loren are able to shrug off most mundane attacks, causing magical damage in turn before melting into the forest from whence they came.

desc.zh: 当位于森林内时，此部队会获得近战防御与射击精度的加成
desc.en: This unit gains bonuses to melee defence and accuracy while fighting within the forest.

desc.zh: 森林战专家，这支部队在森林战中会获得近战攻防优势
desc.en: Specialists in forest warfare, this unit gains melee attack and defence advantages when fighting in forests.

desc.zh: 拥有[[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/wh_main_unit_passive_frenzy.png]][[/img]]狂暴属性的部队可以在[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力高昂时造成更高的伤害
desc.en: Units with [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/wh_main_unit_passive_frenzy.png]][[/img]]frenzy cause more damage while their [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership is high.

desc.zh: 这股霜冻气息可以冻结并减速敌军，它的逼人寒气足以减缓敌人的攻击效果
desc.en: This icy blast freezes and slows the foe, its withering cold hampering their attacks.

desc.zh: 刺骨的寒冷无情地咬噬血肉，灼烧着敌人的手足，从而大幅度降低他们的速度
desc.en: The intense cold cuts into the flesh and burns the foe's extremities, greatly reducing their speed.

desc.zh: 这支部队会自动对附近的敌人施放陷阱，阻碍他们的移动和冲锋
desc.en: This unit will automatically cast traps on nearby enemies, hindering their movement and charges.

desc.zh: 在弹药上绑上一只除了愚蠢之外一无是处的地精囚徒，然后将其发射出去！这家伙一路尖叫地砸向目标，从而大大打击目标的[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力
desc.en: A particularly stupid and otherwise useless Goblin prisoner is tied to a boulder and is then fired - screaming all the way - until he smashes into the target. Those hit by this projectile receive a [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership penalty.

desc.zh: 在使用近战武器时，这支部队可以用比其他部队更快的速度打破城门
desc.en: This unit is quicker than most when it comes to smashing through gates with their melee weapons.

desc.zh: 世界各地的门无不惧怕凯恩刺客的撬门工具和酸性药剂
desc.en: Doors and gates all across the world fear the Khainite Assassin's assortment of lock picks and acid vials.

desc.zh: 相比于同种的其他部队而言，这支部队的[[img:icon_range]][[/img]]射程更为出色。这会允许其在很远的距离上对敌方投射部队展开射击，而无需进入对方的射程
desc.en: This unit has a larger [[img:icon_range]][[/img]]range than most other units of the same class. This allows it to take out hostile missile units before they can come into firing range.

desc.zh: 这支部队所发射的弹丸可以一直瞄准目标。当以第一人称模式发射时，你可以自行控制这些弹丸的走向
desc.en: The projectile fired by this unit can home in on its target. When fired in first-person mode, you can control the projectile yourself.

desc.zh:
此部队完全通过远程攻击造成伤害，没有任何近战攻击手段

炮艇机部队同时拥有：
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]]可从正上方攻击地面目标
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]]可远程攻击飞行目标
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]]拥有[[b]][[col:white]][[img:icon_ammo]][[/img]]弹药[[/col]][[/b]]无限的载荷
desc.en:
This unit relies entirely on missile attacks to deal damage and has no melee capabilities.

Gunship-type units also:
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] Attack ground targets from directly above
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] Attack flying targets from range
[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] Have certain riders with infinite [[b]][[col:white]][[img:icon_ammo]][[/img]] Ammunition[[/col]][[/b]]

desc.zh: 此部队会为附近部队提供+25%的宁和加成效果。多项同类效果不会叠加，只有最强的加成效果会生效
desc.en: This unit increases Harmony bonuses for nearby units by +25%. Only the strongest amplifier bonus is applied.

desc.zh: 此部队会为附近部队提供+50%的宁和加成效果。多项同类效果不会叠加，只有最强的加成效果会生效
desc.en: This unit increases Harmony bonuses for nearby units by +50%. Only the strongest amplifier bonus is applied.

desc.zh: 此部队会为附近部队提供+75%的宁和加成效果。多项同类效果不会叠加，只有最强的加成效果会生效
desc.en: This unit increases Harmony bonuses for nearby units by +75%. Only the strongest amplifier bonus is applied.

desc.zh: 此部队会为附近部队提供+100%的宁和加成效果。多项同类效果不会叠加，只有最强的加成效果会生效
desc.en: This unit increases harmony bonuses for nearby units by +100%. Only the strongest amplifier bonus is applied.

desc.zh: 此部队可以在战斗中通过恶魔铁匠的重铸技能恢复
desc.en: This unit can be restored in battle by the Daemonsmith's Reforge ability.

desc.zh: 这支部队的主要职责是近战部队，但也可以进行远程攻击
desc.en: This unit is primarily a melee unit, but has missile capability too

desc.zh: 如同从天而降的铁锤之雨一般，这支部队可以同时投下多枚炸弹
desc.en: Like a rain of mighty hammer-blows from above, this unit drops more than one bomb at the same time.

desc.zh: 增加附近友军的[[img:icon_melee_attack]][[/img]]近战攻击与[[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]破甲能力
desc.en: Improves [[img:icon_melee_attack]][[/img]]melee attack and [[img:icon_ap]][[/img]]armour-piercing potential of nearby friendly units.

desc.zh: 为了恐虐，杀！
desc.en: Kill for Khorne!

desc.zh: 这支部队的成员拥有更强大的武器
desc.en: This unit's crew has more powerful weaponry.

desc.zh: 当在森林中移动时，大型部队不会受到惩罚，因为它们会直接踏平低矮的树丛
desc.en: Large units do not suffer penalties when moving through forest, simply smashing through the undergrowth instead.

desc.zh: 此部队的爆炸攻击优于其常规版本，可对集群步兵造成显著更高的伤害
desc.en: This unit's explosive attack is improved over its regular counterparts, doing significantly more damage to massed infantry.

desc.zh: 魂棺可以放出其中的一部分受折磨的灵魂。这不是出于怜悯，而是让这些可悲的灵魂如雨点般覆盖一片较为广大的区域
desc.en: The Keeper of the Casket may allow some of the tormented spirits trapped inside to escape; not for mercy, but to let the damned souls rain down upon a loosely-specified area.

desc.zh: 白狮皮毛不仅是时髦的地位象征，也可以有效抵御普通与魔法远程攻击
desc.en: White Lion fur is not merely a fashionable status symbol, it also provides protection against regular and magical missile attacks.

desc.zh: 白狮的厚重皮肤可以有效抵御普通与魔法远程攻击
desc.en: The thick pelt of the White Lions provides protection against regular and magical missile attacks.

desc.zh: 喝下圣杯中液体的骑士便会获得超乎常人的力量，他们正是货真价实的完人！
desc.en: Knights who have sipped from the Grail are elevated above mere mortals; they truly are what is best in men.

desc.zh: 这支部队的远程射击速率非常低下
desc.en: This unit has a very low rate of missile fire.

desc.zh: 当戈度兹的生命值低下时，他有概率恢复一些[[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]生命值
desc.en: When Gorduz's health is low, he has a chance to regain some of his [[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]hit points.

desc.zh: 巫灵的毒液会令使用者陷入凶残的愤怒，以深度疯狂为代价获得狂暴的战斗力
desc.en: The Witch Elves' venom makes the user fall into a murderous rage, gaining great martial ferocity at the cost of a deep madness.

desc.zh: 击中这件附魔护甲的魔法攻击，其效果会大打折扣
desc.en: Magical attacks have a reduced effect against the wearer of this enchanted suit of armour.

desc.zh: 增加运尸车附近敌军法师的失误概率
desc.en: Increases the chance of enemy Wizards miscasting in close vicinity to a Corpse Cart.

desc.zh: 增加[[img:icon_wom_power]][[/img]]法力储量水平
desc.en: Increases the level of magic [[img:icon_wom_power]][[/img]]power reserves.

desc.zh: 这支部队拥有一个或多个魔法光环，从而支援附近友军或是伤害附近敌军
desc.en: This unit is surrounded by one or more magical auras that either support nearby friends or harm its foes.

desc.zh: 携带创世神印记的战士便会承受他的神圣怒火：当被击倒时，杀死他们的凶手也会瞬间受到阿苏焉复仇烈焰的伤害！
desc.en: Those who bear the Creator’s sigil are afforded his divine vengeance; when struck down, their unworthy killer is soon engulfed by Asuryan’s vengeful flames!

desc.zh: 严格的选拔和持久的训练使这支部队成为了完美的战争机器。但如果该部队严重受创，这个效果会丧失
desc.en: A rigorous selection process and relentless training have turned this unit into the perfect fighting machine. This effect is lost, however, if the unit is badly damaged.

desc.zh: 为附近友军部队恢复[[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]生命值
desc.en: Regenerates nearby friendly units’ [[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]hit points.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以在任何地形上以隐蔽姿态进行移动，并在任何方向上进行射击，即使是在隐蔽时！
desc.en: This unit can move whilst hidden in any terrain, firing in any direction even whilst running!

desc.zh: 当羽蛇飞行时，所有位于其被动技能影响范围内的友军地面部队都会获得[[img:icon_stalk]][[/img]]潜行状态
desc.en: Whilst the Coatl is flying, any friendly ground unit that stands within range of its passive ability gains Stalk [[img:icon_stalk]][[/img]].

desc.zh: 虽说伤害不够高，但该部队能够充当有用的『肉盾』。如果没有肉盾吸收伤害，被伤及的或许会是更有价值的目标
desc.en: While unimpressive at causing damage, this unit is useful as a 'meat shield', absorbing damage that would otherwise hurt a more useful or precious target.

desc.zh: 拥有近战专家属性的部队可以拥有极高的[[img:icon_melee_attack]][[/img]]近战攻击或[[img:icon_melee_defence]][[/img]]近战防御，或者两者均有。一些部队也会拥有诸如[[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/charge_defense.png]][[/img]]抵御冲锋之类的强力近战技能。请善加利用他们来对付其他的那些强力近战部队。当对抗它时，记得抢在他们陷入近战前干掉他们
desc.en: Melee Experts might have a very strong [[img:icon_melee_attack]][[/img]]melee attack or [[img:icon_melee_defence]][[/img]]melee defence, or high values in both. Some also have melee-focused skills like [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/charge_defense.png]][[/img]]Charge Defence. Use them to counter other strong melee units. When facing them, it is best to take them out before they can enter melee.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以把一大发弹药转为若干发较小的弹药。这在对抗大目标时并不够精准有效，但分散的弹药有利于群体攻击
desc.en: This unit can switch its ammunition to fire multiple smaller shots instead of one large one. This is not as accurate or effective against large targets, but the spread of missiles can be helpful against hordes.

desc.zh: 这支部队能够很好地接受凯恩的杀戮祝福，即便没有被激怒，他也是疯狂而无情的屠戮代言人
desc.en: Merciless, frenzied agents of slaughter even when unprovoked, this unit takes especially well to Khaine’s murderous blessing.

desc.zh:
这支部队拥有至少两项属于同个互斥群组的技能

此群组内的技能无法同时启用

启用其中一项技能将令群组中的其它技能进入冷却状态
desc.en:
This unit has two or more abilities that are part of a mutually exclusive group.

Abilities within this group cannot be activated at the same time as one another.

Activating one of these abilities will place any other abilities that are part of the same group on cooldown.

desc.zh: 这些受到祝福的弹药永远不会伤害正确的人！爆炸不会伤害友军！
desc.en: These blessed munitions would never harm the righteous! Friendly units caught in their explosions suffer no damage!

desc.zh: 铁拳套是食人魔用来格挡攻击、拦截投射物的武器
desc.en: The ironfist is used by the Ogres to parry blows and block missiles.

desc.zh: 当攻击拥有抵御冲锋能力的部队时，这支部队只会损失一半的冲锋加成
desc.en: When attacking braced charge defenders, this unit only loses half of its charge bonus.

desc.zh: 年龄出众，勇气绝伦再加上胡子超长，这些长须战士会在[[img:icon_general]][[/img]]领主不在身边时大幅度地提升身旁盟友的[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力
desc.en: Respected for their great age, superior courage and the length of their facial hair, Longbeards have an encouraging effect on their allies' [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership should the [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lord be absent.

desc.zh: 纵使执行的是最令人筋疲力尽的行动，这支部队也永远不会疲劳
desc.en: Even when performing the most fatiguing acts, this unit never loses vigour.

desc.zh: 此部队发射的弹丸拥有非同寻常的贯通性，它可能会一举打穿多个较小生物！
desc.en: Projectiles fired by this unit have unusually high penetration for its class and may pass through scores of lesser creatures!

desc.zh: 这恶魔造物一般的香炉中充斥着次元石尘埃与恶劣的传染病，若是暴露在其下，无论是肉体还是精神都会受到可怕的影响
desc.en: Warpstone dust and vile contagions fill this diabolical censer, exposure to which does horrendous things to bodies and minds alike.

desc.zh: 这具投石机的液体炮弹里装满了次元石尘埃与恶劣的传染病。一旦有人染上了它们，那么他的身体与思维都会经受可怕的污染
desc.en: Warpstone dust and vile contagions are amongst the ingredients of this catapult’s liquid missiles, exposure to which does horrendous things to bodies and minds alike.

desc.zh: [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/wh_main_unit_contact_poison.png]][[/img]]淬毒攻击会削弱目标敌军的速度与杀伤力
desc.en: The [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/wh_main_unit_contact_poison.png]][[/img]]poisonous attacks of this unit weaken the target's speed and damage.

desc.zh: 毒风掷弹手投掷的这些球体让人谈之色变——里面装的不是毒气，而是一朵小小的致命次元石气体。因此，目标的表面积越大，他们所承受的痛苦就越深
desc.en: Misleadingly, and to the horror of anyone exposed to its content, the globes thrown by the Poison Wind Globadiers do not release poison, but a small cloud of lethal Warpstone gas. The larger the target's surface, the more pain it will experience.

desc.zh: 这支部队的攻击会有很大的概率打空
desc.en: This unit's attacks are prone to go stray.

desc.zh: 这支部队[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力低劣，因此很容易溃逃。请不要让他们轻易受到侧袭，并让[[img:icon_general]][[/img]]领主或其他有提振领导力功能的部队位于它们的近旁
desc.en: This unit suffers from poor [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership and will easily rout. Keep its flanks secure and your [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lord or other encouraging units nearby.

desc.zh: 关闭自由射击功能后，使用先驱远程武器的部队只会向下令冲锋的目标开火[[img:icon_effect_charge]][[/img]]。而开启自由射击时，部队便会向最近的敌人开火。先驱远程武器通常射程[[img:icon_range]][[/img]]较短，弹药数量[[img:icon_ammo]][[/img]]也较少
desc.en: If Fire-At-Will is disabled, a unit with a Precursor Missile Weapon will only fire at a target that they have been ordered to charge [[img:icon_effect_charge]][[/img]]. If Fire-At-Will is enabled, the unit will fire at the closest enemy. A Precursor Missile Weapon typically has low range [[img:icon_range]][[/img]] and a small amount of ammunition [[img:icon_ammo]][[/img]].

desc.zh: 这些部队是天生的猎手，能够感知到周遭隐藏的猎物
desc.en: These units are natural hunters that can sense prey hiding nearby.

desc.zh: 拥有原始狂怒的部队会获得更快的移动速度，也可发动更强的冲锋，接触敌人后也会造成更高的伤害
desc.en: Units possessed of primal fury move faster and charge harder, causing more damage when they connect with their targets.

desc.zh: 当面临压力时，这些掠食者的原始本能会占据主导地位，提高它们的战斗潜力
desc.en: When under pressure, the primal instincts of these natural predators take over, improving their combat potential.

desc.zh: 这些部队可以射出神秘的蓝色火焰箭，他们擅长射击脆弱的部队，并刺穿最坚韧的盔甲
desc.en: Loosing arrows of mystical blue fire, they excel at setting vulnerable units ablaze and piercing the toughest armour.

desc.zh: 当这支部队受伤且附近有敌人时，它会进入癫狂状态攻击最近的敌人，无视所有命令
desc.en: When this unit gets hurt and enemies are nearby it might go on a rampage, attacking the closest enemy and ignoring any orders given.

desc.zh: 当该部队使用法术时，其所有法术都将随机替换为当前拥有的其他法术
desc.en: When this unit uses a spell, all of their spells will be randomly reassigned to other spells they currently have access to.

desc.zh: 该部队拥有远程攻击能力，这在同类部队中并不常见
desc.en: This unit possesses a missile attack which is uncommon for this type of unit.

desc.zh: 这些专属于贵族的魔法弓，每次射击都会同时射出三支箭
desc.en: These enchanted bows, only entrusted to those of noble birth, fire three arrows at once.

desc.zh: 濒死时，这支部队有概率恢复一些生命值
desc.en: When death is imminent, this unit has a chance of regaining some of its health.

desc.zh: [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/wh_main_unit_passive_regeneration.png]][[/img]]重生技能允许部队在战斗中回复伤害。[[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_flaming.png]][[/img]]火焰攻击可打断此效果，并对拥有该技能的部队造成额外伤害
desc.en: [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/wh_main_unit_passive_regeneration.png]][[/img]]Regeneration allows a unit to heal while in battle. Fire is known to harm this healing process, so be warned that [[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_flaming.png]][[/img]]flaming attacks will cause more damage to units with Regeneration.

desc.zh: 水晶会守护蛇神的崇拜者，能够治疗伤口，还有起死回生之效
desc.en: The crystal protects those who worship the Serpent God, healing wounds and bringing supplicants back from the point of death.

desc.zh: 水晶会守护蛇神的崇拜者，能够治疗伤口，还有起死回生之效
desc.en: The crystal protects those who worship the Serpent God, healing wounds and bringing supplicants back from the point of death.

desc.zh: 河巨魔在它们的天然水族栖息地战斗时会得到增益，而环绕它们的河流碎屑的难闻气味会削弱附近的敌人
desc.en: River Trolls gain benefits when fighting in their natural watery habitat – and the wretched smell of river detritus that surrounds them weakens nearby enemies.

desc.zh: 如果一位[[img:icon_general]][[/img]]领主在战场上溃逃，或者已经逃跑或被击杀，该部队将会失去束缚符文的增益，并立刻陷入癫狂
desc.en: If the [[img:icon_general]][[/img]] Lord on the battlefield is routing, has routed or been killed, this unit will lose the benefits of Runes of Binding and immediately rampage.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以将魔法封入强大的符文，从而支援整场战斗
desc.en: This unit can bind magic into powerful runes which can be activated during battle.

desc.zh: 这支部队造成的伤害会随着目标损失的生命值而提高
desc.en: The amount of damage that this unit causes increases based on the amount of hitpoints the target has lost.

desc.zh: 鳞甲或兽皮可以有效阻挡来自远程武器的伤害，并赋予这一部队[[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/resistance_missile.png]][[/img]]远程抗性的效果
desc.en: Scaly skin or hides help to dampen or deflect the damage caused by missile weapons, increasing this unit's [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/resistance_missile.png]][[/img]]Missile Resistance.

desc.zh: 这件带鳞皮革来自不会飞的海龙，作为铠甲的材料，它十分轻盈却又非常坚固
desc.en: The scaled leather of the flightless Sea Dragon provides a very light yet incredibly sturdy material for armour.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以在战场上变化成其他的部队
desc.en: This unit can transform into other units on the battlefield.

desc.zh: 这支部队的[[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_armour_break.png]][[/img]]破盾攻击可以显著削弱目标抵挡远程攻击的概率
desc.en: This unit’s [[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_armour_break.png]][[/img]] shield-breaking attacks can significantly weaken the target’s chance of blocking missile attacks.

desc.zh: [[img:icon_shield]][[/img]]盾牌有一定概率挡住敌方的箭矢、弹丸、枪击以及类似的小型火力，但只有在正面朝向敌军时才能发挥效果
desc.en: [[img:icon_shield]][[/img]]Shields have a chance of blocking arrows, bolts, rifle shots and similar small arms fire - but only in a forward facing arc.

desc.zh: 此部队发射的实弹会在飞行中碎裂，弹片会像雨点一样落在目标身上
desc.en: Projectiles fired by this unit will split whilst in flight, the shrapnel created rains down upon the target.

desc.zh: 无论是厚实的表皮、重叠的甲片还是魔法防护，此部队对无论射自何方的小型实弹都具有显著的抵抗力
desc.en: Whether a thick hide, overlapping plates or magical protection, this unit has significant resistance to small projectiles, regardless of direction.

desc.zh: 短距离的投掷攻击，能对目标造成减速效果
desc.en: Short-range throwing attack that slows the target.

desc.zh: 虽然食人魔显然不是什么灵巧的生物，但这支部队非常出人意料地是一支潜行高手
desc.en: While Ogres are generally not the subtlest of creatures, this unit is surprisingly well versed in the art of stealth.

desc.zh: 这支部队是潜行、隐蔽与精准射击的大师，它甚至可以在射击时仍然保持隐蔽
desc.en: Masters of stealth, concealment, and the precision shot, this unit stays hidden while firing.

desc.zh: 光明魔乘可以对极远处的目标发动非常精准的光束攻击，虽然作用范围很小，却能造成巨额的伤害。因此它并不适合对抗大量脆弱的步兵
desc.en: The Luminark fires a highly-accurate beam over large distances, causing tremendous damage to its target but with a small area of effect, making it a poor choice against weak infantry.

desc.zh: 该部队的攻击会让敌人神志不清，降低他们的攻击和防御能力
desc.en: The attacks of this unit reduce the enemy into a stupor, lowering their ability to attack and defend themselves.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以吟唱法术
desc.en: This unit can cast spells.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以在任何地形上保持隐蔽
desc.en: This unit can move hidden in any terrain.

desc.zh: 这支部队更擅长隐藏，因此更难以被敌方部队发现
desc.en: This unit is more proficient at hiding and thus more difficult for enemy units to spot.

desc.zh: 这支部队携带的弹药数量超乎寻常地多
desc.en: This unit carries an unusually high amount of ammunition.

desc.zh: 虽然直接战斗力有所欠缺，但这支部队非常擅长提振盟友的战力
desc.en: Although somewhat lacking when it comes to direct combat, this unit is skilled in augmenting its allies' efficiency during battle.

desc.zh: 这支部队的附魔箭矢既轻捷又强大，因此它可以一次射出两支箭，但射程会有所降低
desc.en: As their enchanted arrows are both light and strong this unit can fire two at a time, but at the cost of range.

desc.zh: 每个凡人的身体都是可供蛆虫领主栖息的容器，他一如既往地寻求腐化他人脆弱的身体，从而达成慈父的邪恶目的
desc.en: Each mortal body is but a vessel that the Maggot Lord may inhabit, seeking as always to corrupt the fragile body of another being for the Urfather's vile purpose.

desc.zh: 这支部队可[[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/causes_terror.png]][[/img]]惊骇敌军，令其近战目标溃逃一段时间。对于能够造成惊骇的部队来说，其自身也将免疫[[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/causes_fear.png]][[/img]]恐惧与惊骇效果
desc.en: This unit can [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/causes_terror.png]][[/img]]cause terror, making its melee target rout for a short time. Units that cause terror are immune to terror and [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/causes_fear.png]][[/img]]fear themselves.

desc.zh: 蟾蜍龙的呼吸极为污浊，令人作呕。那些不幸被它的腐蚀性瘴气吞没的人将体验到肺部瞬间充溢血液与脓肿的极致恐怖
desc.en: So tainted and revolting is the breath of the Toad Dragon that those unfortunate enough to be engulfed by its corrosive miasma will experience the existential horror of blood and pus filling their lungs.

desc.zh: 当死亡迫在眉睫时，这支部队有概率或是恢复一定的生命值，或是会放出一队斯卡文鼠人来代替
desc.en: When death is imminent, this unit has a chance of either regaining some of its health or releasing a pack of ravening Skaven instead.

desc.zh: 这只臭名昭著的『绞架巨人』不会发射炮弹，而是用一波熊熊燃烧的火焰来覆盖它的敌人
desc.en: Instead of salvoes of cannonballs, the infamous 'Gallows Giant' covers its enemies in a wave of incinerating fire.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以变换它的外形，在此过程中改变它的状态和属性
desc.en: This unit can change its form, altering its stats and attributes in the process.

desc.zh: 这支部队不会承受任何有关[[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]领导力下降的惩罚，并且永远不会溃逃
desc.en: This unit does not suffer any form of [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership loss and will never rout.

desc.zh: 只要此部队保留大部分的[[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]生命值，部队内的兵模就不会死亡
desc.en: As long as this unit retains most of its overall [[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]hit points, entities within this unit will not die.

desc.zh: 这支部队会在撞击敌人时产生更强的击退效果
desc.en: This unit has an improved effectiveness at knocking back enemy units upon collision.

desc.zh: 猎颅者对敌人有着刻骨般的仇恨，这令任何手段都无法在战斗中降低他的[[img:icon_melee_attack]]近战攻击[[/img]]能力
desc.en: So great is Skulltaker's hate for his foes, his [[img:icon_melee_attack]]Melee Attack[[/img]] cannot be reduced in battle.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以在更大的区域内进行部署，这使得他们可以在能攻击到敌人的距离，或者其他令敌人意想不到的地方开始战斗
desc.en: This unit can deploy in an expanded deployment area, allowing it to start the battle within striking distance of the enemy - or somewhere unexpected.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以轻易绕过多数敌军部队，以此来嘲讽或袭扰敌军，并躲避其远程火力
desc.en: This unit can run circles around most other units, taunting and harassing the enemy or evading its missile fire.

desc.zh: 死亡风暴火箭会在爆炸时形成紫晶漩涡，向敌人倾泻致命的沙许之风
desc.en: The Deathstorm rockets errupt into an Amethyst vortex, raining the deathly Winds of Shyish down upon the foe.

desc.zh: 该部队将在战斗中为友方部队提供强大的战鼓支援
desc.en: This unit provides powerful war drum chants to support allies in battle.

desc.zh: [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/resistance_physical.png]][[/img]]物理抗性可以抵御除[[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_magical.png]][[/img]]魔法攻击之外的任何种类的杀伤
desc.en: [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/resistance_physical.png]][[/img]]Physical Resistance will reduce the damage from any attack that is not [[img:ui/skins/default/modifier_icon_magical.png]][[/img]]magical.

desc.zh: 洛依克的仆从与信徒们会以他的名义跳起多种错综复杂、眼花缭乱的致命舞蹈
desc.en: The servants and worshippers of Loec perform many intricate, swirling, lethal dances in his name.

desc.zh: 这支部队会在裸露的皮肤上涂抹油彩，从而为其提供蛮荒兽人独有的[[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/resistance_physical.png]][[/img]]物理抗性，并抵御除魔法攻击之外的任何种类的杀伤
desc.en: The colourful tattoos on their bare skin grant Savage Orcs [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/resistance_physical.png]][[/img]]Physical Resistance, which reduces the damage from any non-magical attack.

desc.zh: 当见识到了散发怪异味道的奇异火苗后，怕是能够仓狂逃窜的家伙都能称得上是幸运儿了
desc.en: After being showered in an unholy flood of odiferous flames, those left fleeing in panic are the lucky ones.

desc.zh: 这些魔法火焰会熔穿护甲，让敌人更加容易受到接下来的火焰攻击
desc.en: These magical flames sunder armour and leave the enemy vulnerable to further flaming attacks.

desc.zh: 这支部队的攻击几乎无法穿透护甲，因此让他们对抗重甲敌军无异于自寻死路
desc.en: This unit's attack can hardly punch through armour and is thus wasted on heavily armoured enemies.

desc.zh: 该部队携带着雷铳类的远程武器，在短距离上非常有效，但在长距离上就准头欠佳了
desc.en: This unit carries a Blunderbuss-type missile weapon, which is highly effective at short ranges, but lacks accuracy at a distance.

desc.zh: 泣泪剑能吞噬铠甲——要让腐蚀性毒液侵蚀哪怕是最厚的板甲，三两划痕便已经足够
desc.en: Weeping Blades devour armour. A couple of slashes is all that's needed for their corrosive venom to eat through even the thickest of plates.

desc.zh: 爪语者虔心敬奉卡茂神，以其神圣真言为战斗祷文，惠泽其余虎人战士
desc.en: Through veneration of the god Kamau, Clawspeakers use their holy mantras as Battle Prayers to impart benefits to other Tiger Warriors.

desc.zh: 该部队在移动前会先潜入地下，然后在受惊的敌人身旁破土而出
desc.en: This unit burrows underground before it moves, erupting next to its startled enemy.

desc.zh: 如果该部队因士气过低而溃逃，它将不会返回战场
desc.en: If this unit's morale drops enough for it to flee, it will not return to the battle.

desc.zh: 此部队可以施放限定数量的法术
desc.en: This unit can cast a limited number of spells.

desc.zh: 这位恶魔亲王从血淋淋的战场上收集了众多颅骨，他的实力极其危险
desc.en: With many skulls plucked from blood-drenched battlefields, this Daemon Prince is extremely dangerous.

desc.zh: 色孽虽可将凡人扭曲成多臂可怖之物，但即便最精妙的变异也需逐次释放其能力
desc.en: Slaanesh may twist a mortal into a many-armed horror, but even the most exquisite mutation must still unleash its abilities one at a time.

desc.zh: 鳞片上覆盖的多层污垢使该生物获得额外的[[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/resistance_missile.png]][[/img]]远程抗性
desc.en: Layers of filth on top of scaly skin give this creature additional [[img:ui/battle ui/ability_icons/resistance_missile.png]][[/img]]Missile Resistance.

desc.zh: 色孽舞者掌握多种可赋予战斗优势的舞剧，但每次仅能激活一种
desc.en: Dancers of Slaanesh have multiple dances to grant various advantages in combat, but may only be activated one at a time.

desc.zh: 该部队不习惯与同样持剑的对手交锋，最好远离前线
desc.en: Not being used to wielding a blade drawn against those who draw them back, this unit is better served away from the frontlines.

desc.zh: 此部队在移动或冲锋时最强悍
desc.en: This unit is strongest while in movement or charging.

desc.zh: 多条手臂使该部队拥有更快的攻击速度、更高的近战防御和更大的远程格挡概率
desc.en: Having multiple arms grants this unit a faster attack rate, a higher melee defence, and an increased missile block chance.

desc.zh: 屠夫装备两把战斧，他可以用极快的速度旋转它们，从而抵挡袭来的远程火力
desc.en: Slayers are armed with two axes, deftly whirling them at high speed to deflect incoming missile fire.

desc.zh: 此部队为阳系部队，当靠近阴系部队时会获得近战防御与领导力的加成
desc.en: This unit counts as a Yang unit and gains increased melee defence and leadership when near Yin units.

desc.zh: 此部队为阴系部队，当靠近阳系部队时会获得装弹技能与领导力的加成
desc.en: This unit counts as a Yin unit and gains increased reload skill and leadership near Yang units.

desc.zh: 毁灭巨轮装备全自动的次元闪电发电杆，它会向前方发射闪电，并逐渐扫射至左右两侧
desc.en: The Doomwheel sports fully automatic Warp-lightning rods which discharge bolts in front, and to the left and right.
